tadvyācakṣāṇaḥ sūriḥ vidhi-niyamaśabdāvalaukikau iti paro mā maṃsteti tatparyāyaśabdānuccārayati --vidhirācāra ityādi
lakṣaṇatastu anapekṣitavyāvṛttibhedārtho dravyārtho vidhiḥ, loke dṛṣṭatvāt

paryāyārthatastu niyamaḥ, nirādhikye, ādhikyena yamanaṃ niyamaḥ parasparaprativiviktabhavanādidharmalakṣaṇaḥ pratikṣaṇaniyato'vasthāviśeṣo yugapadbhāvyayugapadbhāvī vā rūpādiḥ śivakādiśca yo yo bhavati sa eva sa eveti
vidhividhistu śuklādibhedaniyamavādinaṃ pratyabhedapratipādanavyāpṛtaḥ--ko'yaṃ śuklādibhedo nāma gotvavyatiriktaḥ ? iti
vidherniyamo'tiprasaktasya viśeṣe'vasthāpanaṃ vidhipradhānasyaiva tadaṃśe'vasthāpanam, yathā gāṃ śuklāmānayeti
vidhi-niyamaṃ tu vidhiśca niyamaśca vidhi-niyamam, dvandvaikavadbhāvaḥ, tulyakakṣau vidhiniyamāveva sahitau, dvyātmakaṃ sarvamiti
sāmānyena tu kāraṇaṃ vidhiḥ, kāryaṃ niyamaḥ, ubhayaṃ vidhi-niyamam, śeṣāstadvikalpā eva
etaccihnāntargato vidhividhistu ityata ārabhya ubhayaṃ ityantaḥ pāṭho bhā॰ pratau nāsti
evaṃ bhaṅgān vyavasthāpyedānīṃ vṛttiṃ vyākhyātukāma āha --teṣāṃ vidhi-niyamabhaṅgānāṃ vṛttiriti
tasyāstu lakṣaṇam --svaviṣayasampātanena bhāvanā arthānām, ātmīya ātmīye viṣaye viṣaye'vatārya yayā tadarthā bhāvyante
tathāhi--tathā bhavanti nānyatheti, nitya evākṛtakatvādākāśavat, anitya eva kṛtakatvād ghaṭavad veti
pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ pūrvavat sthitāsthitamṛttvapṛthubudhnādisaṃsthānopādānakāraṇābhyāṃ vṛtti rvivakṣitadvādaśavikalpaviśeṣaṇā, anyathā avṛttitvameva vakṣyamāṇavat
tatra vidhivṛttistāvad yathālokagrāhameva vastu, svaparaviṣayatāyāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣayoranupapatterasaṃstato vivekayatnaḥ śāstreṣviti
sāmānyaviśeṣau hi svaviṣayau paraviṣayau vā syātām
tatra sāmānyaṃ tāvadekasya sarvatvād yadi svaviṣayam, sāmānyavirodhaḥ

yadi sāmānyam, tata tattvamityata āha --jainasatyatvasādhanavṛttā tu vṛttirvivakṣitadvādaśavikalpaviśeṣaṇeti, tatsamā- hāraikarūpatayā tattvānvākhyānamityarthaḥ, anekasambandhidevadattapitṛputratvādidharmasamāhāraikarūpavastutattvānvākhyānavat
anyathetyekāntāvadhāraṇe pratyekaṃ svarūpānavadhāraṇāt avṛttitvameva vakṣyamāṇavaditi, taditthamidameva śāstraṃ vartsyatīti parasparavyāhatatattvāstvavṛttaya eva tā ityarthaḥ
tatra vidhivṛttistāvad yathālokagrāhameva vastu, svaparaviṣayatāyāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣayoranupapatterasaṃstato vivekayatnaḥ śāstreṣviti
sāmānyaviśeṣau hi svaviṣayau paraviṣayau vā syātām
tatra sāmānyaṃ tāvadekasya sarvatvād yadi svaviṣayam, sāmānyavirodhaḥ
tatra etāsvanantaroddiṣṭāsu vidhyādivṛttiṣu vidhivṛttistāvad yathālokagrāhameva vastu
lokasya grāhaḥ, grāhavad grāhaḥ, yathā jalacaro grāhaḥ prāṇyantarāṇyabhyātmākarṣati tathā loko'pi svābhiprāyasakāśaṃ sarvamākarṣati
yo yo lokagrāho yathālokagrāham, evetyavadhāraṇāllokābhiprāyaṃ nātivartate vastvityarthaḥ
parīkṣakābhimānināṃ tu tīrthyānāṃ svaparaviṣayatāyāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣayoranupapatterasaṃstato lokābhiprāyād vivekayatnaḥ śāstreṣviti
itiśabdo hetvarthe, yasmādetamarthaṃ pratipādayiṣyāmastasmād yathālokagrāhameva vastu, tato lokābhiprāyādvivekayatnānarthakyam
tat kathamiti cet, ucyate --sāmānyaviśeṣau hi svaviṣayau paraviṣayau vā syātām, vastunaḥ sāmānyaṃ ghaṭādervastuna ātmani varteta, parasya vā paṭāderātmani ghaṭādvyatiricyamāne
caturṣvapyeṣu vikalpeṣu sāṅkhyādīnāṃ doṣa iti manyamāno laukikaḥ pakṣaṃ grāhayati dudūṣayiṣuḥ sopapattikam --tatra ādyaṃ sāmānyaṃ tāvadekasya sarvatvād yadi svaviṣayam
sarvamekamekaṃ ca sarvam, kasmāt ? kāraṇasya vaiśvarūpyāt
yadyevaṃ kasmāt sarvamekatra nopalabhyate sarvatra caikamiti ? ucyate--deśakālākāranimittāvabandhāttu na samānakālamātmābhivyaktiḥ

te manyāmahe jalabhūmyorapyetat pāriṇāmikaṃ rasādivaiśvarūpyaṃ sthāvarasya jaṅgamatāṃ gatasya jaṅgamābhyavahṛtavanaspatyāderjaṅgamaśarīrapariṇāmāpannasya, jaṅgamasyāpi sthāvaratāṃ gatasya sthāvarābhyavahṛtasya tatpariṇatasya, evaṃ sthāvarasya sthāvaratāṃ gatasya jaṅgamasya jaṅgamatāṃ gatasya
ātmā na bhavati, anekārthaviṣayatvāt sāmānyasya; atha ātmā, tato na sāmānyam, ekatvādātmanaḥ; senāhastinoriva
tata ekasya sarvatvāt sarvasya caikatvāt svaviṣayaṃ sāmānyaṃ ghaṭasyātmani vartata iti paramataṃ pradarśyottaramāha--yadyevam, sāmānyavirodhaḥ sāmānyasya virodhaḥ sāmānyena ca virodhaḥ
tat katham ? ucyate --yadi sāmānyam, tata ātmā na bhavati, anekārthaviṣayatvāt sāmānyasya
kaścidarthaḥ kenacidarthena kaiściddharmaiḥ samāno bhavatīti kṛtvānekārthaviṣayaṃ sāmānyam
tasmādanekārthaviṣayatvāt sāmānyasya vastunaḥ svamātmā ghaṭāderekarūpasya na bhavati, ekatvādātmanaḥ, sāmānyasya ca nivṛtterātmanaśca, ātmābhāvāt kasya sāmānyam ?
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityātmeṣyate, tato'pi na sāmānyam, ekatvādātmanaḥ kena sāmānyaṃ tasya ? ityātmanaḥ sāmānyena virodhaḥ, samānabhāvo hi sāmānyam
senāhastinoriveti, hastyaśvarathapadātisamūhaḥ senetyanekārthāpekṣāṃ darśayati, hastīti caikārthatāṃ darśayati
syādeva virodho yadi ātmanaḥ sāmānyam iti bhedena svatvamabhyupagamyeteti
yadyapi vyatirekārthaṣaṣṭhīprāpitaḥ svasvāmyādibhedaḥ tathāpyadoṣaḥ, vyapadeśivadbhāvāt rāhoḥ śiraḥ ityādyavyatirekaṣaṣṭhīdarśanāditi
kiṃ tarhi ? brūmaḥ--iha tu ātmaiva sāmānyam
ādhyātmikāḥ kāryātmakā bhedāḥ śabda-sparśa-rasa-rūpa-gandhāḥ pañca trayāṇāṃ sukha-duḥkha-mohānāṃ sanniveśamātram

kasmāt ? pañcānāṃ pañcānāmekakāryabhāvāt, sukhānāṃ śabda-sparśa-rasa-rūpa-gandhānāṃ prasādalāghavābhiṣvalāghavaprasavābhiṣvaṅgoddharṣaprītayaḥ kāryam, duḥkhānāṃ śoṣatāpabhedopaṣṭambhodvegāpadveṣāḥ, mūḍhānāṃ varaṇasadanāpadhvaṃsanabaibhatsyadainyagauravāṇīti
tathā karaṇātmakāḥ śrotra-tvak-cakṣu-rjihvā-ghrāṇavāg-hasta-pāda-pāyū-pastha-manāṃsyekādaśa tairyagyona-mānuṣa-daivāni bāhyāśca bhedāḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ kāryaṃ samanvayadarśanāt iti
atra ॰bhedāpaṣṭambho॰ iti ॰bhedāpastambho॰ iti ॰bhedāvaṣṭambho॰ iti vā pāṭho'pi bhavet
kintu adhunā upalabhyamāneṣu prāyaḥ sarveṣvapi sāṅkhyasiddhāntapratipādakagrantheṣu upaṣṭambhaśabdasya upastambhaśabdasya vā prayogadarśanādasmābhirapi sa ādṛta iti jñeyam
mudritanyāyakumudacandrasya ṭippaṇyāṃ tu pṛ॰ 350 upaṣṭambhaśabdasthāne ba॰ ja॰ bhāṃ॰ śra॰ pratiṣu avaṣṭambha iti pāṭhāntaramapi ullikhitamastīti dhyeyam
atra kāryam iti pāṭhaścet sambhāvyate tarhi bāhyāśca bhedāḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ kāryam, samanvayadarśanāt iti yojanīyam

ya॰ pratipāṭhānusāreṇa tu trayāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ sanniveśamātram iti pūrvatanavākyamanuvartya bāhyāśca bhedāḥ trayāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ sanniveśamātram, sattvarajastamasāṃ kāryasamanvayadarśanāt iti yojanīyam
evaṃ sati ātmabhedaḥ--sukhaṃ sukhaṃ ca sukhādisamudayaśca, tadātmatvāt
yathā ca pradhānāvasthāyāṃ tritvaikatvādivirodhadharmasambandho'vyatiriktatriguṇaikarūpatā ceṣyate sadā triguṇaikatvāt tritvai-
atra brūmaḥ --evaṃ satyātmabhedaḥ, samudāyaikakāryatvāt sukhādi ekamasāmānyamitīṣṭasya sāmānyasya bhedaḥ
tat kathamiti cet, ucyate --sukhaṃ sukhañca sukhādisamudayaśca
sattvaṃ sukham, rajo duḥkham, tamo mohaḥ
tat trayamaikātmyāpannamekameveti sukhasya sukhatvaṃ tatsamudāyatvaṃ ca prāptam
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tadātmatvāt, yasmāt sukhādyātmakaḥ samudāyaḥ samudāyātmakaṃ ca sukham
evaṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhañca duḥkhādisamudāyaśca, moho mohaśca mohādisamudayaśca
tataḥ ko doṣa iti cet, tataśca triguṇavipariṇāmakāraṇakalpanāvaiyarthyam

samudāyaikakāryāṇāṃ trayāṇāmekatvābhyupagamādekastatsāmyāvasthāviśeṣaḥ, tasmāccāvasthāviśeṣādapracyutatvāt kuto guṇānāṃ vaiṣamyam ? vaiṣamyābhāve kutaḥ prakṛtermahadahaṅkāratanmātrabhūtendriyādipūrvottarahetukāryabhāvaḥ ?

atrāśaṅkā --nityameva tryātmakamiti cet, pradhānāvasthāyāmapi triguṇatvānnityaṃ sarvakālaṃ tryātmakaṃ sattvarajastamaātmakamato guṇavaiṣamya-vipariṇāma-kāraṇatvānyupapadyante sukhādisamudāyātmakatve'pyātmabhedadoṣaśca nāstīti
etadapi vāṅmātratvādanuttaram, tathāpi tu sutarāṃ tathā, ekatvanityatvāt prakāśa-pravṛtti-niyamabhedābhāvādanārambhaḥ
ekatvasya nityatvāt ekatvena vā nityatvāt, sadaikatvādityarthaḥ

prakāśa-pravṛtti-niyamakāryabhedaḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ yo'bhyupagamyate bhavadbhirācārya-pavana-pāṣāṇavat, tadyathā--nāṭakācāryaḥ svahastotkṣepaṇādinā prakāśātmanā ātmano nartikāyāśca vyavatiṣṭhate, pavanaḥ parṇacalanādinā svaparapravartanena vyavatiṣṭhate, naustambhanapāṣāṇakaḥ svaparaniyamanena vyavatiṣṭhate tathā sattvarajastamāṃsi ityetannopapadyate, sarvakālamekatvanityatvāt tritvābhāvaḥ, tatastadanārambhaḥ pradhānāvasthāyāmiva guṇānāṃ sarvakālaṃ kāryānārambho nirvyāpāratvāt
ubhayasya cābhāvaḥ kāraṇasya kāryatvasya ca, athavā ātmanaḥ sāmānyasya ca, sukhādeḥ samudāyinastatsamudāyasya ca pradhānasya
tat kathaṃ bhāvyata iti cet, ucyate --yathā ca pradhānāvasthāyāmityādi yāvat tritvaikatvādivyatikrameṇeti
tritvaikatvādītyuktaparāmarśaḥ, yathā tritvamekatvaṃ ca viruddhau dharmāviṣyete evamavayavā avayavī ca, anyadananyacca, ātmā cānātmā ca, sarvamasarvaṃ cetyādi
ādigrahaṇāt sūkṣmaṃ katvādivyatikrameṇa, evaṃ śabdādau triguṇāvyatirekaikarūpatvaṃ virodhadharmasambandhaśca tanmayatvāt
yathā tatra tritvaikatvādyātmasvatattvavyatikrameṇeti virodhadharmasambandho'vyatiriktatriguṇaikarūpatā ceṣyata iti pradhānasyaiva dṛṣṭāntasya varṇanam

evaṃ śabdādāviti dārṣṭāntikopanayaḥ, triguṇāvyatirekaikarūpatvaṃ virodhadharmasambandhaśca śabdatanmātrādiṣu, tatkāryeṣvākāśādiṣu bhūteṣvekaguṇādivṛddheṣu, tadvikāreṣu ca gavādighaṭādiṣu ca, śrotrādiṣvekādaśasvindriyeṣu ca pradhānadharmā āpādyāḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tanmayatvāt, sattvādiguṇamayaṃ hi tat

tataśca sarvasyāvasthānāt pradhānāvasthāyāmiva na kiñcit sūtrādi paṭādi vā kasyacit kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vā pramāṇaṃ prameyaṃ veti niyamābhāvāt sarvatra yādṛcchikī pravṛttiḥ prasaktā, yadṛcchāmātratvānna pradhānamahadahaṅkārādikāraṇakāryanaiyamyam

puruṣaścaitanyasvarūpaḥ, tasyārtho dvividhaḥ--śabdādyupalabdhirādiḥ guṇapuruṣāntaropalabdhirantaḥ, tat kṛtvā tadvinivartata iti tasmai puruṣārthāya yatnaḥ pradhānasya, tasya yatnasya arthaḥ prayojanam, tasya hāniryādṛcchikatvāt
katvādivyatikrameṇa, evaṃ śabdādau triguṇāvyatirekaikarūpatvaṃ virodhadharmasambandhaśca tanmayatvāt
atra tat kṛtvā iti pāṭhaḥ sāmānye napuṃsakamityabhiprāyeṇa saṅgamanīyaḥ, anyathā taṃ kṛtvā iti syāt
sāmānyaṃ viśeṣa ityetau parasparasambandhinau, ādyantavat pitāputravadvā
tatra yadi sāmānyamabhyupagamyate viśeṣāpekṣitvāt sāmānyasya viśeṣo'vaśyaiṣyaḥ, pitṛtvābhyupagame putratvābhyupagamavat
viśeṣābhyupagame ca sāmānyābhyupagamastadvadevetyataste balādeva viśeṣapakṣāpattirapi niyamapakṣāpattirityarthaḥ
evaṃ tāvat svaviṣayatve sāmānyasya doṣā uktāḥ
amukhyasāmānyānāṃ sadṛśānupravṛttivyāvṛtti tatra dravyamapi bhavanalakṣaṇaṃ yugapadayugapadbhedabhāvimṛdbhavanaparamārtharūpādiśivakādivṛtti vyāpi

lakṣaṇānāṃ pareṣṭānāṃ pareṣṭānāṃ paraviṣayāṇāmasambhavāt sveṣṭasamānabhavanalakṣaṇasāmānyasambhavāt parakīyamasāmānyamevetyupari upasaṃhariṣyati laukikaḥ, tat siddhaṃ kṛtvā tāvadāha --asamānāvasthānādasāmānyamiti
tat punardravyakṣetrakālabhāvaviṣayam, te hi dravyādayaḥ pare parairiṣyamāṇā ghaṭādervastunaḥ, tadapi parasattadapekṣayā samānamityucyate nātmānameveti paraviṣayam
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tadasāmānyam ? ityata āha --anavadhṛtaikatarakāraṇatvāditi, nāvadhriyate dravyameva kṣetrameva kāla eva bhāva eva vā kāraṇamiti
evaṃ tarhi ekatamakāraṇatvāt iti vācyam; na cātra ḍataraḍatamau prāpnutaḥ, kasmāt ? anya-kiṃ-yat-tado nirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac
samānaguṇeṣu hi sparddhā bhavati, guṇavacanābhāvānneti cet, kāraṇatvaguṇato'tiśayo bhaviṣyati
evaṃ tarhi tamabastviti cet, dvayordvayoḥ prakarṣavivakṣāyāṃ tarabityadoṣaḥ
kena anavadhṛtamekatarakāraṇatvaṃ dravyādīnāmiti cet, ucyate--laukikairvyavahāranayapradhānaiḥ, sa ca ārhatanayaikadeśa eva
na punaryathā śāstrakārāḥ sāmānyameva viśeṣa eva dravyādyanyatamadeva vā kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vetyavadhārayanti
laukikastat siddhaṃ kṛtvā tāvadāha iti yojanīyam
atra nātmānameva iti saṅgamayituṃ tadapekṣya iti pāṭhaḥ syāccet sādhu
kathaṃ punardravyādikāraṇatāvadhāryate na veti ? ucyate--dravyaṃ tāvat tatra dravyamapi bhavanalakṣaṇaṃ vyāpītyabhisambhantsyate
sarvatantrasiddhānte vyākaraṇe dravyaṃ ca bhavye pā॰ 5
104 ityuktatvād bhavatīti bhavyaṃ bhavanayogyaṃ vā dravyam
dravati droṣyati dudrāveti druḥ, drorvikāro'vayavo vā dravyam, du dru gatau pā॰ dhā॰ 944--945, sadaiva gatyātmakatvād vipariṇāmātmakaṃ hi tat
na tu yathā guṇasandrāvo dravyam pātañjalama॰ 5
119 kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇamiti dravyalakṣaṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1

kathaṃ bhavatīti cet, bhidyate iti bhedaḥ, bhedena bhavituṃ śīlā tasyā dharmo vā sādhu bhavatīti vā bhedabhāvinī mṛt, tasyā bhavanaṃ bhedabhāvimṛdbhavanam, tadeva paramo'rthaḥ, ko'sau ? rūpādayaḥ śivakādayaśca
punarapi te vṛttirasya teṣu vā vṛttirasya tadidaṃ yugapadayugapadbhedabhāvimṛdbhavanaparamārtharūpādiśivakādivṛtti
yathā rūpādiśivakādayo mṛdo bhavanamātraṃ tathā yugapadbhūtaṃ pṛthivyādi paramārthaḥ pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśādi dravyabhavanamātram
ayugapadbhūtaṃ vrīhi-bījā-ṅkura-patra-nāla-kāṇḍa-puṣpa-phala-śūka-kaṇa-tuṣādi paramārtha iti sarvaṃ dravyabhavanamātram, ekapuruṣapitṛputratvādivasāttāṃvattāṃstān bhāvān bhavatīti dravyam
atra taveti iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīnaḥ pratibhāti, tathā ca tava pakṣe kathaṃ punardravyādikāraṇatāvadhāryate iti praṣṭurāśayo bhāti
tadevaṃ prāpyante prāpnuvanti vā dravyāṇi--iti tattvārthabhāṣye 1
kṣetramapi vyākaraṇasiddhāntagatyaiva kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ pā॰ dhā॰ 1407 iti sarvasya siddhaṃ sarvagatinivāsavṛttisvatattvam
ekaikabhāvārthasaṅghātasamavasthānātmā, ekaikasya ghaṭapaṭāderbhāvasyārthe pṛthubudhnādirūpeṇa saṃhatya samavasthitasya ātmā svarūpatattvaṃ pradhānamityarthaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? kṣetrābhāve tadabhāvāt kṣetrānugrahādeva tadbhāvāt
yathāsvaprakriyaṃ vaiśeṣikādīnām rūpa-rasa-gandha-sparśavatī pṛthivī vai॰ sū॰ 2
evaṃ ghaṭo'pyavayavī, guṇasamudayamātram, prajñaptisan veti vikalpanāmātram
lokanayena tu ta eva hi rūpagrīvādyavayavā rūpādayo grīvādayaścaikagatayastathā tathā samavasthitāḥ pṛthivyādīn ghaṭādīṃśca vyavasthāpayanti yatra tat kṣetram
kiṃ hi tat pṛthivyāḥ pṛthivītvaṃ rūpādyekagatisamavasthānādanyat, ghaṭasya vā grīvādyekagatisamavasthānādanyad ghaṭatvam ? tasmāt sarvagatinivāsavṛttisvatattvaṃ tat
viśvaṃ saddravyaṃ ca vyāpnoti yugapadayugadbhāvirūpādiśivakādibhāvavispaṃditaṃ pṛthivyabādi ghaṭapaṭādi vipariṇāmajātaṃ cetyarthaḥ
kkha ityakṣaraṃ raka ityevamālikhyate sma prācīnalipyāmiti dhyeyam
niṣṭhuraḥ kakkhaṭaḥ krūraḥ puruṣaḥ karkaśaḥ kharaḥ
katamaśca mahārāja ! ādhyātmikaḥ pṛthivīdhātuḥ ? yat kiñcidasmin kāye'dhyātmaṃ kakkhaṭatvaṃ kharagatamupāttam
tat punaḥ katamat ? tadyathā--keśā romāṇi nakhā dantā ityādi
katamaśca mahārāja ! bāhyaḥ pṛthivīdhātuḥ ? yat kiñcid bāhyaṃ kakkhaṭatvaṃ kharagatamanupāttamayamucyate bāhyaḥ pṛthivīdhātuḥ--iti śikṣāsamuccaye pṛ॰ 245
॰naye tu ta eva ityapi pāṭhaḥ syādatra
pariṇāmavatī kriyaiva kālaḥ, kalanaṃ kālaḥ, kalāsamūho vā
vartanaṃ bhavanamiti tatparyāyo vartanālakṣaṇo vā dravyātmā
sāṅkhyādiprakriyopavarṇyāsta eva hi dharmādharmākāśapudgalajīvāstikāyāḥ saprabhedāḥ, athavā pṛthivyādaya eva astikāyāḥ vidyamānakāyāḥ, te yatra yugapadvartante sa tadyugapadvṛttiḥ kālaḥ
ipradānyāḥ pūrva uttaraḥ pūrvottaraśca vāyavaḥ, śeṣāḥ śoṣakāḥ

atrāpi pratiprakriyamādityasantāpāpītasaliladhāraṇa-pācana-nisarjanavat, dhūma-jyotiḥ-salila-marutsaṅghātameghādāna-dhāraṇa-pācananisarjanavat, visrasāpariṇatapudgalavikārābhratvādivadvā, pudgalāvinābhāvād devavaikriyāderapi ādānād dhāraṇam, dhāraṇāt pācanam, pācanānnisarjanam
nirvṛttayaḥ kāryāṇi, tāsāṃ nirvṛttīnāṃ vṛttiṣvayugapadvṛttiḥ kāla eva, tadupaṣṭambhajanyatvāt teṣāṃ bhāvānāmiti

॰vrīhinaraudanādivadvā iti sarvāsvapi pratiṣu pāṭha upalabhyate, kintvatra naraśabdasyāsaṅgatatvād yugapadayugapatkālasvatattvabhūtapadārthanirūpaṇaprastāve yugapadbhāvināṃ pṛthivyādyastikāyānāmayugapadbhāvināṃ ca vrīhi-kaṇau-danādīnāṃ vivakṣitatvācca ॰vrīhikaṇaudanādivadvā iti pāṭhaḥ sambhāvito'smābhiḥ

athavā nisṛṣṭasya salilasya kāryāṇi bhūmidravībhāvavanaspatyoṣadhiprarohapuṣpaphalaprāṇiśarīrāpyāyanādīni ityanantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇatvāt tadanusāreṇa ॰vrīhiprarohaṇādivadvā ityapi pāṭho'tra syāditi dhyeyam
asmiṃstu pāṭhe iha ādānīyādiṣu caturṣu antyā visarjanāḥ pūrva uttaraḥ pūrvottaraśca vāyavaḥ ityarthasaṅgatirdraṣṭavyā
sa tu pūrvokteṣu dravyādiṣu bhavanaṃ bhāva ityuktatvādukta eva
guṇā rūpādayaḥ, śivakādayaḥ paryāyāḥ, te yugapadayugapadbhāvinaḥ, ta eva bhāvāḥ
kṣetrakālau ca dravyameva, bhavanasāmānyādbhāva eva vā
tasmānna tāni dravyādīni yugapadayugapadbhāvibhāvavyudāsena bhavitumarhanti bhavanāt teṣām, anyathā dravyādīnāṃ vandhyāputravadabhāvatvāpatteḥ

ata etāni ghaṭādivastvātmasāmānyapakṣagrāhiṇāpyavaśyāpekṣyāṇi, pratyakṣata eva tathātmatvāt; kimu paraviṣayamukhyasāmānyapakṣavādinā ? pratyakṣata eva tathā tathā paraviṣayasya samānasya bhavanāt, pareṇa samānena bhūyate
tathābhavanāt teṣāmiti tadeva bhavanaṃ hetutvena vyāpārayati
anyatheti bhavanasāmarthyābhāve dravyādīnāṃ vandhyāputravadabhāvatvāpatteḥ, na santi dravyādīni bhavanaśūnyatvād vandhyāputravat

ata etāni ghaṭādivastvātmasāmānyapakṣagrāhiṇāpyavaśyāpekṣyāṇi, pratyakṣata eva tathātmatvāt; kimu paraviṣayamukhyasāmānyapakṣavādinā ? pratyakṣata eva tathā tathā paraviṣayasya samānasya bhavanāt, pareṇa samānena bhūyate
etasmāt pratipāditopapattibalād dravyādīni bhāvaparyantāni bhavanapradhānānyapratyākhyeyāni tasmād ghaṭādivastvātmasāmānyapakṣagrāhiṇāpi svaviṣayasāmānyavādinetyarthaḥ
apiśabdāt svagrāharaktamanasāpi satā tvayā avaśyāpekṣyāṇi sāraṃ sārameṣitavyānītyarthaḥ
kimu paraviṣayamukhyasāmānyapakṣavādineti, dravyādīnāṃ parasparabhinnānāṃ samānabhavanānmukhyaṃ sāmānyam, lokaścaivaṃvidhasāmānyavādī, vyavahāranayānuyāyitvāt
na tu yathā sāṅkhyādiṣu sādṛśyānyāpohatattvādi pramāṇaviruddham

taccopacaritaṃ bhavitumarhati na mukhyam, sādṛśyānuvṛttīnāṃ loke samānena bhūyate iti sāmānyalakṣaṇasyādṛṣṭatvād dṛṣṭatvāccāsmadiṣṭasya laukikasya sāmānyasyetyata āha— pratyakṣata eva tathā tathā paraviṣayasya samānasya bhavanāt, tena tena prakāreṇa dravyakṣetrakālabhāvāpekṣayugapadayugapadbhāvibhāvasya rūpādiśivakādirūpasya samānasya bhavanāt
sarvatantrasiddhāntena vyākaraṇena lokānuvṛttinā niruktiṃ tattvānuvādinīmapyāha --pareṇa samānena bhūyata iti, samāno bhavatītyarthaḥ
samānabhāvaḥ sāmānyam, yad bhavanti sarvabhāvāḥ sa teṣāṃ bhāva iti svārthiko bhāvapratyayaḥ
svabhāvasambandhārthā cātra kartṛlakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī tasya bhāvaḥ iti
etadanusāreṇa sāṃkhyādīṣṭasādṛ॰ ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt, yataḥ dṛṣṭatvāccā'smadiṣṭasya laukikasya sāmānyasya iti vakṣyate'nantarameva
tathā ca sarvasyāsya jagato dravyādyapekṣayā tathā tathā viśeṣaṇaikatā, tadbhedatvasambandhatvābhyām, vikacasurabhiśarannīlotpalavat
tatrānyasya kasyacidapohyasya sadṛśasya tattattvasya vā samānasyābhāvāt sāmānyānupapattiḥ
evaṃ sāmānyaṃ vyākhyāyedānīṃ tadarthopasaṃhāreṇānumānamāha --tathā cetyādi yāvad viśeṣaṇaikatā
tathā ceti evaṃ ca kṛtvā pratipāditaparasparabhedatve parasparasambandhaikyāpattau ca sarvasyāsya jagato dravyadeśakālabhāvāpekṣayā tena tena prakāreṇa viśeṣaṇaikatā
dravyaṃ kṣetreṇa kālena bhāvena ca viśiṣyateviśeṣyate, dravyeṇa kṣetramitarau ca, evaṃ taistat parasparataśca tāni

yathāṅgulirvakrapraguṇatādyayugapadbhāvibhāvai rūpādiyugapadbhāvibhāvaiḥ deśena taṃdrataddravyāntaraiśca viśiṣyateviśeṣyate aṅgulirvakrā ṛjvī pradeśe'sminnākāśasya vartate pradeśinī adhunā ityādi tathaikaikamapi vastu ghaṭapaṭādi na kenacinnābhisambadhyate tathā tathā viśiṣyateviśeṣyate ca tadbhedatvasambandhatvābhyām
prayogaścātra--dravyādiviśeṣaṇasambandhī ghaṭaḥ, vastubhedatve sati tatsambandhatvāt, vikacasurabhiśarannīlotpalavat
vikaca-mukulitādi kṣetraviśeṣaṇam, surabhinīlatādi sahakramabhāvirūpādibhāvaviśeṣaṇam, śaraditi kālaviśeṣaṇam
utpalamiti dravyam, tadapi teṣāṃ viśeṣaṇameva vyavacchedakatvāt
atra deśena dravyāntaraiśca ityapi pāṭhaḥ sambhāvyate
śaraditi kālaviśeṣaṇam iti pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti

evamanekatvasāmānyamāpādya prāk pratijñātaṃ paraviṣayatāyāmapyasamānāvasthānādasāmānyaṃ pareṣāmiti taddarśayati --tatrānyasya kasyacidapohyasya sadṛśasya tattattvasya vā samānasyābhāvāt sāmānyānupapattiḥ

evamāpāditaparasparaviśiṣṭaikatvajagato ghaṭaikatvamātratve'rthāntarābhāvāt kuto'rthāntarāpohalakṣaṇaṃ vidvanmanyādyatanabauddhaparikḷptaṃ sāmānyam ? kuto vā samānaṃ dṛśyata iti sadṛśam, sadṛśabhāvaḥ sādṛśyamiti sādṛśyalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyam, sadṛśasya tasyābhāvāt ? kuto vā tattattvam ? tasya bhāvastattvam, tattattvamasya tattattvam, tattu bhinne bhavati samānānekārthānuvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ sattvadravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvādi
asmiṃstu bhā॰ pāṭhe na saḥ asaḥ iti nañtatpuruṣaṃ kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ rūpaṃ jñeyam atasya iti, tadbhinnasyetyarthaḥ
tathā ca sadṛśasyānyasyābhāvāt iti bhā॰ pāṭhānusāreṇārthaḥ pratīyate
yaduktaṃ prāk sa tatsamudāyakāryatvāt sāmānyam ityatra evaṃ satyātmabhedaḥ--sukhaṃ sukhaṃ ca sukhādisamudayaśca, tadātmatvāt
evaṃ śeṣāvapi saṅghātāvasthānabhedādvā ghaṭapaṭavadatyantabheda eva sarvārthānām
tathāhi--paramāṇvādīnāṃ ghaṭo bhavati, ghaṭasya vā kapālāni
anavasthāne vā nityapravṛttatvāt sarvārthānāṃ samayamapi tathā samavasthānaṃ nāsti yathā samānatā nirūpyeta
athāntareṇa rūpaprāptimuktipratyayābhyāṃ daṇḍivad vyaktibhinnārthasiddhi- ityādi yāvat sāmānyaviśeṣayośca tatsambandhitvādekatarābhyupagame niyamapakṣāpattirapi iti

svaviṣayasāmānyāpattirveti vāśabdo vikalpārthaḥ svasāmānyapakṣābhihitasarvapūrvottarapakṣavikalpapradarśanārthaḥ, dravyaṃ dravyaṃ ca dravyādisamudayaśca ityādi vikalpajātaṃ sarvamihāpi saṃbhavato yojyam
tathāhi--paramāṇvādīnāṃ ghaṭo bhavati, ghaṭasya vā kapālāni
anavasthāne vā nityapravṛttatvāt sarvārthānāṃ samayamapi tathā samavasthānaṃ nāsti yathā samānatā nirūpyeta
yadi saṅgrahanayadarśanena sarvamekam, atha ṛjusūtranayadarśanena sarvaṃ bhinnam, tathāpi saṅghātenāvasthitānāṃ ghaṭapaṭavadatyantaṃ parasparato bheda eva, naikatvaṃ sarvārthānām
nanūktam--saṅgrahanayadarśanenaikamiti, satyamuktam, tattu saṅghātenāvasthitānāṃ nopapadyate dṛṣṭaviruddhatvādityabhiprāyaḥ
tataḥ kimiti cet, tathāhi--evaṃ ca kṛtvā, kiṃ ? paramāṇvādīnāṃ ghaṭo bhavati ghaṭasya vā kapālāni, pitā putraḥ kaḥ sambandha ityarthaḥ
ādigrahaṇād dvyaṇukatryaṇukādīnāṃ grīvādīnāṃ cānyatra saṅghātasamavasthānabhedāt samavasthānakṛta eva teṣāṃ sambandhaḥ, tathā ca samānaṃ bhavanti te
na॰ ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti
syānmatam--evaṃ vyākhyātustavaiva matena parasparavilakṣaṇānāmarthānāṃ bhedādevānavasthānaṃ prāptam, dravyādibhedabhinnānāmanyonyanirapekṣāṇāṃ saṅghātasamavasthānābhāvāditi
atrocyate --anavasthāne vā nityapravṛttatvāt sarvārthānāṃ samayamapi tathā samavasthānaṃ nāsti yathā samānatā nirūpyeta, parasparanirapekṣotpādavināśatvādityarthaḥ
pakṣāntare'pi vaktukāmaḥ grāhayati --athāntareṇa rūpaprāptimityādi yāvat siddhiriṣyata iti

antareṇaikarūpaprāptiṃ bhedarūpaprāptiṃ vā uktipratyayābhyāṃ daṇḍivaditi, nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhirutpadyate, viśeṣapratyayānāmanākasmikatvācca daṇḍanimittadaṇḍipratyayābhidhānavat, daṇḍo'syāstīti daṇḍī ityatra hi daṇḍasaṃyoganimittau devadatte daṇḍyuktipratyayau yathā dṛṣṭāvevaṃ dravyatvaghaṭatvādisāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyanimittau dravyaghaṭādyuktipratyayau syātām, nānyathā
vyaktibhinnārthasiddhiriṣyata iti, uktipratyayābhyāṃ dravyaghaṭādivyaktito bhinnasya dravyatvaghaṭatvāderarthasya siddhiriṣyate
tau hi kasmiṃścideva ākārādimātre, sāmayikatvācchabdādarthe pratyayasya vṛddhavyavahārādākārādimātre pratipatteḥ
ākaraṇamākāraḥ, buddhyā yo yathā parigṛhyate'rthaḥ nāmnā vā nirdiśyate sa eva tasyākāraḥ

sa ca tāvanmātro na tato'dhikaḥ, yathā--ākāśaṃ ḍittha iti vā, sa vānyathā vānyathā vā, ākāśādiṣu vinānuvṛttyā ākāśakāladiśāṃ tvanmate'pyekatvāt kuto bhinneṣvabhinnābhidhānapratyayau ? kuto vākāśāditattattvānīti ? dṛśyete cātrāpyuktipratyayau
samayāya prabhavati samayaḥ prayojanamasya samayabhavo vā sāmayikaḥ
tau cābhidhānapratyayau lokavṛddhavyavahārātmakau vṛddhavyavahāraṃ dṛṣṭvā bālānāmabhidhānapratyayau bhavato'śikṣitavicitraśāstravyavahārāṇāmapi anvayavyatirekātmakādvṛddhavyavahārādeva
syānmatam --saṃjñākarma tvasmadviśiṣṭānāṃ liṅgam, pratyakṣapūrvakatvāt saṃjñākarmaṇaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 2
tasmād manvādayo'ntarālapralaya-mahāpralayeṣu vyucchinnavyavahārāṇāmapi śabdārthānāṃ sambandhaṃ paśyanti
tasmād ghaṭa-ghaṭatvasamavāyasambandho'pi sāmayikaḥ asyāyaṃ vācakaḥ iti yathā ayaṃ panasaḥ iti samayaṃ grāhyate bāla iti
etaccāyuktam, anavasthāprasaṅgāt--yena śabdena samayaḥ kriyate tasyānyena kārya ityanuṣaktaḥ, uttarasyārthāpratītau asya samayo na prakalpate
tatsamayānapekṣā svābhāvikī yasyārthe vṛttiḥ sa nitya iti ca śabdārthasambandhaparijñānaprayogavyavahāraparamparāyā avyavacchedāduktam
yathāha patañjaliḥ--na hi tadeva nityaṃ yat taddhruvaṃ kūṭasthamavicālyanapāyopajanavikāryanutpattyavṛddhyavyayayogi
kiṃ tarhi ? tadapi hi nityaṃ yasmiṃstattvaṃ na vihanyate
ākṛtau cāpi tattvaṃ na vihanyate pātañjalama॰ 1
samayapratyākhyānavat pratipādanapratyākhyānātideśo vṛddhavyavahārādākārādimātre pratipatterityadoṣāya, na śabdādeva iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt
ābhāmātre'pi tu tau tatra tattvopanilayanāt kṛtāviti cet, sthāṇu-mṛgatṛṣṇikayornara-salilatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tatra tadabhidhānapratyayasadbhāvāt
ko vidhiḥ ? svataḥ svātmani ca, ka upāyaḥ ? saṃyogādinimittāntarasahitāni, kā maryādā ? ā antyāvayavidravyāt dravyāṇi dravyāntaramārabhante

tatracchidrabudhne ghaṭe kāraṇavibhāgādutpanne saṃyogābhāvādārabdhadravyābhāve'pi ghaṭābhidhānapratyayau dṛṣṭau, tathā kuḍyalikhite samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇābhāve śiśūnāṃ ca krīḍanake loṣṭapāṣāṇādau sadbhāvāsadbhāvasthāpanākṛte

bhavedetat --ābhāmātre'pi tu ākāramātre saṃsthānamātre sādṛśyamātra ityarthaḥ, tau coktipratyayau tatra tattvasya ghaṭatvasyopanilayanāt kṛtamikṛtāviti cet, tatra tattvābhāva uktaḥ, satyapi ca tattve'smadiṣṭākāramātroktipratyayau coktau, athāpyābhāmātre tattvopanilayanamiṣyate tvayā tataḥ sthāṇu-mṛgatṛṣṇikayornara-salilatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tatra tadabhidhānapratyayasadbhāvāt tattattvopanilayanācca, ghaṭatvopanilayanād ghaṭavat

anupanipāte naratvasya sthāṇau salilatvasya mṛgatṛṣṇikāyāṃ narasaliloktipratyayau mā bhūtām, tau ca dṛṣṭau, kathamagṛhītaviśeṣaṇatvānnaratvasalilatvānupanipāte nāyuktau ? tatropacāralabhyau hi tau, iha tu lokanaye vinopacāreṇa labhyau
kathamiti cet, anupacaritakiñcidbhūtākārāttu kiñciduktipratyayau syātāṃ bhavitumarhataḥ, ākārasyāsampūrṇasya dṛṣṭatvādeva
bhavatpakṣe punarna hi tattvaṃ kiñcinnilīnaṃ kiñcinna nilīnamityasti
evaṃ tāvat sāmānyaṃ vikalpadvaye vicāritam, viśeṣo'dhunā vicāryaḥ
so'pi dvayīṃ kalpanāṃ nātivartate--svaviṣayaḥ paraviṣayo veti
viśeṣasya virodho viśeṣābhāvāpatteḥ, viśeṣeṇa virodha ātmābhāvāpatteḥ
kiṃ vāṅmā na bhavati, anyatvād viśeṣasya guṇataḥ kālato vā; anyathā ghaṭādau sāmānyāpatteḥ
atha ātmā, tato viśeṣo na bhavati, ekatvādātmanaḥ
yadyātmāpekṣa eva viśeṣaḥ eka evānya ityātmano'nyathābhavanādanātmatvaṃ rūpādirūpeṇa ghaṭarūpādipūrvottarāṇāmabhāvatvam
treṇa ? netyucyate, yadi viśeṣastata ātmā na bhavati, anyatvādviśeṣasya
viśeṣeṇa virodhastāvad yadi ghaṭādāvātmani viśeṣo vartate svaviṣayaḥ tata ātmā na, anyatvādviśeṣasya rūpāderdeśataḥ parasparato viśiṣyamāṇasyeti taddarśayati --guṇata iti
kālato vā pratikṣaṇānyānyotpattyā vinaṃṣṭṛṣu rūpādiṣu kastadātmā ? ityātmābhāvaḥ
tadabhāve kasya viśeṣaḥ ? anyathā ghaṭādau sāmānyāpatteḥ

anyatheti rūpādīnāṃ samudāyaikyāpattyabhyupagame viśeṣapakṣatyāgaḥ sāmānyaparigrahaścāpadyate, tatra coktā doṣāḥ sukhaṃ sukhaṃ ca sukhādisamudayaśca ityādayaḥ, ta evātra rūpaṃ rūpaṃ ca rūpādisamudayaśca ityādayaḥ
mā bhūdātmābhāvadoṣaḥ tasmiṃścātmābhāve viśeṣābhāvadoṣa iti pakṣāntaraṃ gṛhṇīyāt --athātmā saviśeṣaḥ, ātmā eka eva sa evānanya iti
tato viśeṣo na bhavati, ekatvādātmanaḥ, ghaṭādervastuna ekatvādātmanastattattvādityarthaḥ, anyo hi viśeṣaḥ
na bhavati, anyatvād viśeṣasya guṇataḥ kālato vā; anyathā ghaṭādau sāmānyāpatteḥ
atha ātmā, tato viśeṣo na bhavati, ekatvādātmanaḥ
yadyātmāpekṣa eva viśeṣaḥ eka evānya ityātmano'nyathābhavanādanātmatvaṃ rūpādirūpeṇa ghaṭarūpādipūrvottarāṇāmabhāvatvam
viśeṣeṇa virodhastāvad yadi ghaṭādāvātmani viśeṣeṇa virodhastāvad yadi ghaṭādāvātmani iti sarvāsu pratiṣu dvirbhūtaḥ pāṭhaḥ
ātmano viśeṣaḥ iti sambandhāpādānayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīpañcamīnirdeśe bhedena ātmani viśeṣaḥ ityadhikaraṇasaptamyā nirdeśe vā syātāmetau doṣau
atrocyate --yadyātmāpekṣa eva viśeṣa iti tatpratyuccāraṇam, dvitīyavikalpa āyāto viśeṣasya virodha iti
tat katham ? anye'nye rūpādaya eva bhavantīti ghaṭābhāvaḥ, tadabhāve kasya viśeṣaḥ ? ghaṭa eva vānyathā bhavatīti rūpādyabhāvaḥ
tataścottareṣāṃ śivakādīnāṃ piṇḍāvasthātaḥ pūrveṣāṃ ca mṛttvādīnāmabhāvaḥ
athavā ghaṭato'nyat paṭatvam, rūpato'nyacchabdāditvam, tena prakāreṇa anyathābhavanād ghaṭābhāvo rūpādyabhāvaśca
tathā cobhayābhāvaḥ, ātmābhāvo viśeṣābhāvaśca athavā rūpādyabhāvaprāpito ghaṭātmābhāvo ghaṭātmābhāvaprāpito rūpādyabhāva iti
kā hi vṛttisāhāyakādṛte siddhavṛtterghaṭasya paṭādyapekṣā ? tathātmaivāsya bhidyeta
atha vā pārthivatvādapekṣā, samānajātitvādapekṣyate ghaṭena paṭaḥ; vijātīyāt tarhi viśeṣābhāva udakādeḥ
tatrāpi sattāpekṣeti cet, vijātīyāt tarhyatyantāsato jāterivājāteḥ, kāryādvā katham ? iti bhāvābhāvayoraviśeṣaḥ
ghaṭāderātmano'nyathābhavanādanātmatvaṃ tataśca viśeṣasyātmanaścābhāvaḥ ityuktavirodhadoṣānabhyupagame parāpekṣapakṣaḥ paraviṣayo viśeṣo na svaviṣayaḥ ityāpannaḥ
sa kinnāmako doṣa iti cet, svapakṣaparityāganāmakaḥ
upacarya ca evamabhyupagamyamāne'pyayamaparo doṣaḥ --tathāpi dravyabhedaḥ, dravyasya ghaṭāderātmanaḥ svarūpapararūpābhyāṃ dvidhātmāvasthānaṃ prasaktaṃ parāpekṣatvādviśeṣasya
sahāyabhāvaḥ sāhāyakam, vṛtteḥ sāhāyakaṃ vṛttisāhāyakam, ghaṭavṛtteḥ sahāyabhāvaṃ paṭasya muktvā svata eva siddhavṛtteḥ pūrvameva ghaṭasya kānyā uttarakālā paṭādyapekṣā ? nāstyevetyarthaḥ
tathātmaivāsya bhidyeta, tena prakāreṇa tathā ghaṭasvarūpameva bhidyeta, sahāyāpekṣavṛttitvāt, śibikodvāhātmavṛttivat
yopadhād gurūpottamād vuñ 5--1--132 iti pāṇinisūtreṇa sāhāyakam ityeva sādhu
atha vā pārthivatvādapekṣā, asti ghaṭasya paṭādyapekṣetyāha
yadi samānajātyapekṣayā viśeṣa iṣyate evaṃ tarhyasamānajātīyādudakāderghaṭasya viśeṣābhāvaḥ prāpnoti
dravyatvāpekṣā tatrāpīti cet, dravyatvasāmānyāpekṣayā ghaṭasya udakāderviśeṣo bhaviṣyatīti cet
vijātīyābhyāṃ guṇakarmabhyāmaviśeṣaḥ, na hi vijātīyayorguṇakarmaṇordravyatvāpekṣāsti, tābhyāmapi ca ghaṭasya viśeṣa iṣyate
tatrāpi sattāpekṣeti cet, vijātīyāt tarhi atyantāsataḥ aviśeṣaḥ iti vartate
pārthivatvajāteśca bhavatsiddhāntena apagatajāterjātyantarāpekṣā nāsti, tasyāḥ kathaṃ jātyantarādudakādervā vyaktyantarād viśeṣo bhavati, apekṣābhāvāt ? kāryādvā kathaṃ viśeṣaḥ iti vartate

kāryaṃ hi bhavatsiddhānte prāgavidyamānaṃ samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇasānnidhye paścādutpadyate, kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvādasat kāryam iti siddhāntābhyupagamāt, kāraṇāvasthāyāṃ kāraṇānāṃ kāryasyāsattvādeva apekṣā nāstīti pārthivatvāditulyatvācca tadvat tadātmatvaṃ, tattattvena apekṣyatvāditi viveka- viśeṣābhāvaḥ prāptaḥ
niṣpanne coparatavyāpārāvasthāyāṃ siddhatvāt kāryasya kāraṇānāṃ kāraṇatvābhāvāt kāryakāraṇaviśeṣābhāvaḥ
itiśabdo hetūpasaṃhārārthaḥ, ityuktahetupāramparyād bhāvābhāvayoraviśeṣaḥ, yathā pūrvoktavidhinā sato'sadapekṣā'bhāvād viśeṣābhāvaḥ, evamasato'pi sadapekṣā'bhāvādaviśeṣaḥ
asato vā kāpekṣā ? evamanayoraviśiṣṭatvāt sattvameva vā abhāvasya bhāvavat, asattvameva vā bhāvasya abhāvavat
tasyāṃ kathaṃ raṃ॰ hī॰ vinā ya॰
pārthivatvāditulyatvācca tadvat tadātmatvaṃ, tattattvena apekṣyatvāditi viveka-
evaṃ tāvad ghaṭādeḥ pārthivatvādyapekṣā na yuktā
kāryasya ghaṭasya kāraṇena mṛdā saha pārthivatvena dharmeṇa tulyatvāt tadvaditi ghaṭasya ghaṭabhavanātmatvavat tadātmatvaṃ mṛttvaṃ, pārthivatvātmaghaṭatvavadvā

tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam, bhavanaṃ bhāvaḥ, tasya tattvaṃ tattattvam, tattattvenāpekṣyatvāt, ghaṭabhavanavadapekṣyate hi pārthivatvam, tasmāt prāptaṃ tadātmatvaṃ ghaṭatvaṃ pārthivatvasya ghaṭātmavad ghaṭatvenāpekṣyatvāt
aviśeṣa iti, evaṃ ca kṛtvā sa eva aviśeṣaḥ
syānmatam--ayaṃ viśeṣa eva na bhavati, āpekṣikatvāt sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāṃ dravyatvādīnāmaupacārikatvācca
dravyatvaṃ guṇatvaṃ karmatvaṃ ca sāmānyāni viśeṣāśca vai॰ sū॰ 1
5 ityuktāni, kiṃ punargotvaghaṭatvādīnīti ? kastarhi viśeṣo mukhyaḥ ? antya eva
tathā bhāva eva ca mukhyasāmānyam, saditi yato dravyaguṇakarmasu dravyaguṇakarmabhyo'rthāntaraṃ sā sattā vai॰ sū॰ 1
parimaṇḍalasaṃsthānāḥ sarva eva paramāṇava iti tulyākṛtitvaṃ pārthivāṇūnāṃ pārthivāṇubhiḥ sarvaiḥ samānaguṇatvam
aṇumanasoścādyaṃ karma vai॰ sū॰ 5-2-13 ityadṛṣṭakāritakriyāvattvaṃ sarveṣāṃ samānamiti
tasmādākāśadeśāt kaścit paramāṇuratikrāntaḥ, kaścitra tatsamakālameva tatra āyātaḥ
tatra ayamanyaḥ pūrvasmāt iti anyapratyayo nirnimittaḥ paramarṣerapi na bhavati
tasya anyapratyayasya yo hetuḥ so'ntyaviśeṣastasmāt paramāṇudravyādanya ityevaṃ naigamanayasya buddhiḥ--iti viśeṣāvaśyakabhāṣyasya koṭṭāryavādigaṇimahattaraviracitāyāṃ vṛttau pṛ॰ 155-2
ante bhavo'ntyaḥ, antye'pi tasmin viśeṣe viśeṣābhāva iti apiśabdāt sambandhaḥ
dravyamādiryeṣāṃ ta ete dravyādayaḥ dravyakṣetrakālabhāvāḥ, teṣāṃ prabhedaḥ tatprabhedaḥ, tatprabhedena gatiḥ pariṇāmo vṛttirvikalpaḥ, yathā asya kāryasyeyaṃ gatiḥ iti dṛṣṭatvāt
tasmāt taddravyādiprabhedagatigrāhyatvād nāntyaviśeṣaḥ kalpyaḥ, dravyāḍivyatirekeṇa pratyakṣānumānābhyāmagrāhyatvāt tatsvarūpeṇaiva grāhyatvācca

tadyathā--yogī pratyakṣeṇaikaṃ paramāṇuṃ paśyan dvyaṇukatvāt pracyutaṃ paśyati anyaṃ tryaṇukatvāt pracyutamanyaṃ dvyaṇukasamavetamanyaṃ tryaṇukasamavetaṃ ca, dravyataḥ svata eva ca bhinnāni tāni paramāṇvādidravyāṇi paśyati, tatra kimantyaviśeṣeṇa ? evaṃ kṣetrato pyūrdhakṣetrato'pyūrdhabhāgasthitamekamaparamarvāgbhāgamadhobhāgasthitam
kālato'pi kañcit prathame samaye sthitam, anyaṃ dvitīye sthitamāgataṃ vā
bhāvataḥ kañcit kṛṣṇaṃ śuklaṃ kañcit surabhimasurabhiṃ tiktaṃ kaṭukaṃ vetyādi, athavā kṛṣṇamanyaṃ kṛṣṇataraṃ kṛṣṇatamaṃ dviguṇatriguṇasaṅkhyeyāsaṅkhyeyānantaguṇakṛṣṇādiṃ vā
avaśyaṃ dravyādayo viṣayāḥ svata eva viśiṣṭā eṣitavyāḥ
na cet, yogino mithyājñānaprasaṅgaḥ, anyathāsthitasyārthasya anyathādarśanāt

svata eva viśiṣṭatve'ntyaviśeṣasya kalpanā vā tyājyā, paramāṇūnāmapi tadvad viśeṣo nimittanirapekṣaḥ kiṃ neṣyate ? viśeṣeṣvapi nimittāntarāṇi cet, anavasthāprasaṅgaḥ, tataśca viśeṣoktipratyayānupapattirevetyalaṃ prasaṅgena
anteṣu bhavā antyāḥ praśasta॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 168 iti praśastapādabhāṣyānusāriṇyeva antyaśabdavyākhyā prāyaḥ sarvatrāpi bahumatā svīkṛtā ca
śaṅkaramiśrastu vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre matadvayamatropanyasyati--ante'vasāne bhavantītyantyāḥ, yato na vyāvartakāntaramastītyācāryāḥ
teṣu bhavantītyantyā viśeṣā iti vṛttikṛtaḥ --vai॰ sū॰ upa॰ 1
atra kāyasya śarīrasya ityarthābhirucau tu yathāśruto bhā॰ pratipāṭhaḥ sādhureveti dhyeyam
atra pracyutātmānaṃ dvyaṇuka॰ iti pāṭho'pi sambhavet
atra ca nayacakravṛttau prāyaḥ sarvatrāpi ūrdhvaśabdasthāne ūrdhaśabda eva dṛśyata iti dhyeyam
nanu prāgapyuktam --parāpekṣapakṣāpattirvā iti, satyam, tatra upāttaparityāgādahṛdayatvāpādanadvāreṇa prasaṅgato'nye'pi paraviṣayatāyāṃ tu viśeṣasyānavasthānādaviśeṣaḥ
iha dravyādipratyapekṣayā sarvasyāsya sambaddhatvādekaikasya niravaśeṣamidaṃ jagad viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, ekaghaṭasaṃhatanānāvasthaguṇavat
tatra sarvārthānāṃ nityapravṛttatvāt samayamapi nāsti teṣāṃ samavasthānaṃ yadāśrayo viśeṣārtho'vasthāpyeta, āttavat
doṣā uktāḥ, iha tu prādhānyenaiva anyena ca prakāreṇa doṣābhidhānaṃ prakriyate

yathā ca prāk asamānāvasthānādasāmānyam iti prakramya sāmānyābhāvaḥ pratipāditastathehāpi tadviparyayeṇa tadeva prakaraṇaṃ yojyam --kiṃ kāraṇam ? anavadhṛtaikatarakāryatvādityādi sarvaṃ tādṛgeva yāvat tata etāni ghaṭādivastvātmaviśeṣapakṣagrāhiṇāpyavaśyāpekṣyāṇi, pratyakṣata eva tathā tathā pareṇa viśiṣṭatvādātmanaḥ; kimu paraviṣayamukhyaviśeṣavādinā ? pratyakṣata eva tathā tathā paraviṣayasya viśeṣasya bhavanāt pareṇa viśiṣṭena bhūyata iti

iheti paraviṣayaviśeṣapakṣe dravyādipratyapekṣayā sarvasyāsya sambaddhatvādekaikasya niravaśeṣamidaṃ jagad viśeṣaṇamiti, pūrvavadeva dravyaṃ dravyāntarāṇi kṣetraṃ kālaṃ bhāvaṃ ca pratyapekṣate svaprabhedān paraprabhedāṃśca, evaṃ kṣetraṃ kālo bhāvaśceti sarvaṃ sarveṇa sambaddham, tasmāt sarvasya sambaddhatvāt pūrvavat sahakramavṛttirūpādiśivakādipṛthivyādivrīhyādyaṅkurādisamavasthānād dravyāṇāṃ kṣetrato'pi teṣāmekagatisamavasthānāt kālato'pyanekaprabhedopavarṇyadharmādyastikāyapṛthivyādipānīyādānadhāraṇādisamavasthānād bhāvato'pi pūrvavad dravyādirūpādiśivakādibhavanasamavasthānāt syādekaghaṭasaṃhatanānāvasthaguṇavaditi

yathoktam --dravyameva hi tathāvasthānād rūpādibhāvaṃ labhate, ekapuruṣapitṛputratvādivat , dravyameva hi ghaṭākhyaṃ rūpaṃ raso gandhaḥ sparśaḥ saṅkhyā saṃsthānaṃ śuklaṃ nīlaṃ tiktaṃ kaṭu surabhi mṛdu karkaśaṃ śuklataraṃ śuklatamaṃ cetyādiviśeṣaṇatāṃ nātivartate
ta eva hyete guṇāḥ paryāyāśca nānāvasthāḥ parasparaviśiṣṭāḥ parasparasya dravyasya ca viśeṣaṇam, dravyameva guṇāḥ paryāyāśca
syācchabdāt punaḥ syādetadevaṃ yadyetad vakṣyamāṇadoṣeṇa na vyāhanyetetyata āha --tatra sarvārthānāṃ nityapravṛttatvāt samayamapītyādi yāvad yadāśrayo viśeṣārtho'vasthāpyeteti
evaṃ parasparaviśeṣaṇatvena sarve'rthā nityaṃ pravṛttā eveti samayamātramapi nāsti teṣāṃ samavasthānam
samavasthānāśrayo hi viśeṣo'vasthāpyeta, tadabhāvāt kuto viśeṣaḥ ? ātta- vaditi tatkālāvagṛhītakṣaṇotpannavinaṣṭabhāvavadityarthaḥ
tataḥ kimiti cet, samavasthānābhāvānnirāśrayaḥ khapuṣpavannāsti viśeṣaḥ
iha dravyādipratyapekṣayā sarvasyāsya sambaddhatvādekaikasya niravaśeṣamidaṃ jagad viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, ekaghaṭasaṃhatanānāvasthaguṇavat
tatra sarvārthānāṃ nityapravṛttatvāt samayamapi nāsti teṣāṃ samavasthānaṃ yadāśrayo viśeṣārtho'vasthāpyeta, āttavat
॰grāhiṇāpyavaśyāpekṣyāṇi pratyakṣagrāhiṇāpyavaśyāpekṣyāṇi pratyakṣa॰ iti ya॰ pratiṣu dvirbhūtaḥ pāṭhaḥ

kimuktaṃ bhavati ? sambandhadeśān dravyādīn muktvā nirāśrayatvād viśeṣo mā bhūt, sambandhadeśasthānāṃ tu ghaṭapaṭādīnāṃ kimiti mudhā viśeṣo na syāt sambandhadeśopekṣāyāmupāttatyāgo'kasmāt, tulyatvāt sāmānyābhyupagamāt
rūpādibhedasambandha eva viśeṣaḥ, na, anyāsambandhe'rūpāditvācchuddhānāṃ kvacidapyabhāvāt
loke dṛṣṭo nanu ca vāyuḥ śuddha eva sparśaḥ, tatrāpi hi kṣetrādidravyasya rūpādayo na gṛhyante, anabhivyaktisaukṣmyāt, dravyādivat
evaṃ sati akasmādevopāttasya viśeṣasya tyāgaḥ, sāmānyābhyupagamāt
kathaṃ sāmānyamabhyupagatamiti cet, tulyatvāt sambandhadeśasthānāṃ dravyakṣetrakālabhāvapratyāsattitulyalakṣaṇatvāt sāmānyasya samānabhāvasya
rūpādibhedasambandha eva viśeṣaḥ, na, anyāsambandhe'rūpāditvācchuddhānāṃ kvacidapyabhāvāt
loke dṛṣṭo nanu ca vāyuḥ śuddha eva sparśaḥ, tatrāpi hi kṣetrādidravyasya rūpādayo na gṛhyante, anabhivyaktisaukṣmyāt, dravyādivat
rūparasagandhasparśasaṅkhyāsaṃsthānādīnāṃ saprabhedānāṃ sambandha eva viśeṣa ucyate, ta eva hi parasparato viśiṣyamāṇā viśeṣākhyā iti
anyairdravyādibhiramambandhe teṣāmarūpāditvaṃ prasajyate, yasmāt sarve sarvatra sarvadā sarvathā dravyakṣetrakālabhāvāvibhāgasambaddharasā eva hi rūpādayaḥ

kiṃ kāraṇam ? śuddhānāṃ kvacidapyabhāvāt, prāguktaṃ dravyādisambandhābhāve rūpādisvarūpābhāvāt tatsambaddhānāmeva dṛṣṭatvāt saprabhedadravyādisambandhābhāve rūpādayo na santyevetyarūpāditvaṃ teṣāṃ prasaktam
॰tvādanyairdravyādibhirasaṃbaṃdha teṣāmarūpāditvādanyairdravyādibhirasaṃbaṃdhe teṣāmarūpādi॰ iti dvirbhūtaḥ pāṭhaḥ sarvāsu pratiṣu
etaccihnāntargataḥ ॰sambaddharasā ityata ārabhya dravyādi॰ ityantaḥ pāṭho bhā॰ pratau nāsti
itara āha --loke dṛṣṭo nanu ca vāyuḥ śuddha eva sparśaḥ

syādarūpāditvaṃ yadi dravyakṣetrakālarūparasādibhirasambandhe rūpādyabhāva eva ityayamekāntaḥ syāt, syāccānumānaṃ yadi dṛṣṭena na bādhyate, dṛṣṭaśca vāyuḥ sparśamātra eva, na hi dṛṣṭād gariṣṭhaṃ pramāṇamastīti
atrocyate --tatrāpi hi kṣetrādidravyasya rūpādayo na gṛhyante, anabhivyaktisaukṣmyāt, vaidharmyeṇa dravyādivat
yathā dravyādayo gṛhyante pratyakṣeṇa na tathā vāyau rūparasagandhādayo'nabhivyaktisaukṣmyād gṛhyante
yathoktaṃ saṅgrahāntare— mūrtiḥ kathaṃ na vāyornāsvādyeta ca kathaṃ na rūpyeta
tadvyaktigrahaṇaṃ prati na śaknuyāt tvindriyaiḥ kaścit
ihāpi ca sādharmyadṛṣṭānta ucyate--vātāyanareṇusparśarasarūpagandhādivad na gṛhyanta iti, teṣāṃ hi ravikaroddayotavyaktānāṃ rūpameva grāhyam
atra vāyo ityasya ṣaṣṭhyantatve bhā॰ pratipāṭho'pi sādhureva
mūrtiḥ kathaṃ na vāyornāsvādyeta ca kathaṃ na rūpyeta
tadvyaktigrahaṇaṃ prati na śaknuyāt tvindriyaiḥ kaścit || iti
athocyeta--ekakālasahāvasthānādarthānāṃ viśeṣo bhaviṣyati, avatiṣṭhate hi kiñcit kañcit kālam
sarvasāmānādhikaraṇyācca ekavikāre'pi sarvasyānyathātvaṃ jāyate, tanmātre'nyatvāt, gandhonādhikabhvambhovat
atha tu tadbuddhyāsannameva grahīṣyate sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ, evaṃ tarhi dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ na sāmānyaṃ nāpi viśeṣaḥ, teṣāṃ parasparāsattyabhāvāt

athocyeta pareṇa--yadi sambandhadeśasamavasthānādarthānāṃ viśeṣo na bhavati, ekakālasahāvasthānādarthānāṃ viśeṣo bhaviṣyati, yasmādavatiṣṭhate hi kiñcit kañcit kālam, yathā pūrvāparasthitaghaṭapaṭāviti
nanu viśeṣakāraṇamatra vaktuṃ prāptam, idaṃ tu sāmānyakāraṇameva āśaṅkitamiti
atrocyate— sāmānyadvāreṇa viśeṣaḥ siddhyatīti tadasiddhidvāreṇa viśeṣāsiddhiriti sarvatra grāhyam
parābhyupagama eva uttaratvamāpadyate, ekakālāvasthāne kālasāmānyābhyupagamād deśasambandhasāmānyābhyupagamavadupāttatyāgo'kasmāt tulyatvādityaviśeṣatvameva

kiñcānyat--prāguktavidhinā sarvasāmānādhikaraṇyācca viśeṣasvatattvasya parasparāpekṣatvād viśiṣyamāṇatvād bhāvānāṃ parasparataḥ sarvaṃ jagadekādhikaraṇam, tatraikavikāre'pi sarvasya śeṣasyāpyaśeṣasya tadapekṣatvādanyathātvaṃ vikāro jāyate
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? gandhonādhikabhvambhovaditi, yathā bhvambhasorayathāsaṅkhyena gandhonasya ambhaso gandhādhikāyāśca bhuvaḥ taddhīnādhikabhāvena vikāro dṛṣṭaḥ--gandhahīnā āpaḥ tadadhikā bhūriti
buddhyā āsannaṃ, saḥ iti buddhistadbuddhiḥ, yo'sau prathamo ghaṭaḥ sa eva dvitīya iti buddhiḥ
kā sā ? tattvānuvṛttibuddhiḥ, vyāvṛttibuddhirapi tadbuddhyāsattyā dravyatvabuddhau prasaktāyām nāpo na sikatā na śivakādirghaṭa eva iti
atra brūmaḥ --evaṃ tarhi dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ na sāmānyaṃ nāpi viśeṣaḥ

tayā tadbuddhyā dravyasya guṇasya karmaṇo vāsattirgṛhyate, kiṃ dravyabuddhyā guṇo gṛhyate karma vā ? dravyabuddhyā hi tad dravyameva, sannatā hi dravyasya dravyasya ca, tatraiva sāmānyaviśeṣau syātām, na guṇakarmaṇoḥ
tathāsattiḥ sikatānāṃ vajrasya ca, teṣāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣau syātām, na bhūmyambhasoḥ; yāvat tulyajāti- tadāsannatvād dravyam iti gṛhyate, tatraiva ca sāmānyaviśeṣau syātāṃ na guṇakarmaṇoḥ
kasmāt ? yasmāt tadbuddhyāsannatā dravyasya dravyasya ca, na dravyasya guṇasya ca, tathā na dravyasya karmaṇāṃ ca, na guṇasya karmaṇaśceti sāmānyābhāvo viśeṣābhāvaśca, tadbuddhyāsattyabhāvāt
tayoḥ dravyaguṇayorguṇakarmaṇordravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ ca tayośca tayoścetyāvṛttyā sattvalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ mā bhūt
tathā anityaṃ dravyavat kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavat iti ca sāmānyaṃ dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ mā bhūt
uktaṃ ca vaḥ śāstre — sadanityaṃ dravyavat kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavaditi dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmaviśeṣaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 1
evaṃ tarhi anānātvaṃ dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ prāptam iti codite viśeṣa ucyate--nāviśeṣa eva, ārambhānārambhabhedāt, dravyāṇi dravyāntaramārabhante guṇāśca guṇāntaram
karma karmasādhyaṃ na vidyate vai॰ sū॰ 1

kiñcānyat--lakṣaṇabhedāt, kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇamiti dravyalakṣaṇam, dravyāśrayī aguṇavān saṃyogavibhāgeṣvakāraṇamanapekṣa iti guṇalakṣaṇam, ekadravyamaguṇaṃ saṃyogavibhāgeṣvanapekṣaṃ kāraṇamiti karmalakṣaṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1
tathā virodhāvirodhabhedāt, kāryāvirodhi dravyaṃ kāraṇāvirodhi ca, ubhayathā guṇaḥ, kāryavirodhi karma vai॰ sū॰ 1
evaṃ tāvad dravyasya dravyasya ca sāmānyaviśeṣau syātām, na guṇakarmaṇoḥ
sannatā hi dravyasya dravyasya ca, tatraiva sāmānyaviśeṣau syātām, na guṇakarmaṇoḥ
tathāsattiḥ sikatānāṃ vajrasya ca, teṣāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣau syātām, na bhūmyambhasoḥ; yāvat tulyajāti-
etaccihnāntargataḥ ॰sāmānya॰ ityata ārabhya sattvalakṣaṇaṃ ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti
na dravyaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca vadhati --vai॰ sū॰ 1
asya vyākhyā--dravyaṃ na svakāryaṃ hanti na vā svakāraṇaṃ hanti, kāryakāraṇabhāvāpannayordravyayorvadhyaghātakabhāvo nāstītyarthaḥ, āśrayanāśārambhakasaṃyoganāśābhyāmeva dravyanāśāditi bhāvaḥ
vadhatīti sautro nirdeśaḥ --vai॰ sū॰ upa॰ pṛ॰ 20
itara āha--yathā dravyayoḥ pratyāsattirdravyatvābhisambandhāt tathā sattvābhisambandhād dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ bhaviṣyati
yathoktam --saditi yato dravyaguṇakarmasu dravyaguṇakarmabhyo'rthāntaraṃ sā sattā vai॰ sū॰ 1
atra brūmaḥ--dravyayorapi tvadanukampādravīkṛtacetasā mayā tvayi cittānuvṛttyā uktam, tatrāpyāśāṃ mā kṛthāḥ, tadapi nopapadyate buddhyāsattikṛtasāmānyaviśeṣavādino bhavataḥ sāmānyābhāve viśeṣābhāvāt
teṣāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣau syātām, na bhūmyambhasoḥ, anyatarasya pārthivatvābhāvāt
tenaiva hetukrameṇa tathāsattiḥ piṇḍaghaṭayoḥ, na mṛt-sikatānām; evaṃ parataḥ parato yāvat tulyajāti- guṇakriyayoraṇvoreva, na tu tayorapi antyaviśeṣasamavāyena apakṣiptapratyāsattyoḥ
arthāśleṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ tvāsattau pṛthivīghaṭarūpādīnāmeva syāt sāmānyaviśeṣatā, netarasāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ

tathāsattiḥ ghaṭakapālayoḥ, na piṇḍaghaṭayoḥ; evaṃ kapālaśakalayoḥ, na ghaṭaśakalayoḥ; śakalaśarkarayoḥ, na ghaṭaśarkarayoḥ; pāṃśuśarkarayoḥ, na śakalaśarkarayoḥ; pāṃśudhūlyoḥ, na dhūlīśarkarayoḥ; dhūlītruṭyoḥ, na pāṃśutruṭyoḥ; truṭiparamāṇvoḥ, na dhūlīparamāṇvoḥ
athavā ghaṭasya ca ghaṭasya ca, na ghaṭasya kapālasya cetyādi

tulyajātiguṇakriyāsamavāyinoranyatvapratyayaprabhāvolliṅgitāntyaviśeṣayoḥ tatsamavāyenāpakṣiptā apahṛtā pratyāsattistayorapi iti kṛtvā kutastadbuddhyāsannaprakaraṇam ? tasmāt sāmānyābhāvād viśeṣābhāvaḥ, sarvatraivobhayābhāva iti dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ na sāmānyaṃ nāpi viśeṣaḥ ityataḥ prabhṛti yāvat aṇvoḥ ityetadavadhimadhyābhihitopattibalād yathopapāditasāmānyaviśeṣābhāvaṃ smārayati
guṇakriyayoraṇvoreva, na tu tayorapi antyaviśeṣasamavāyena apakṣiptapratyāsattyoḥ
arthāśleṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ tvāsattau pṛthivīghaṭarūpādīnāmeva syāt sāmānyaviśeṣatā, netarasāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ
ya॰ pratiṣvapi prāyaḥ sarvatrāpyagre tuṭiśabda eva dṛśyate
tadbhedalakṣaṇaṃ ca --rūparasa- gandhasparśavatī pṛthivī, rūparasasparśavatya āpo dravāḥ snigdhāśca, tejo rūpasparśavat, vāyuḥ sparśavān vai॰ sū॰ 2
1-4, yatra rūpādicāturguṇyaṃ sā pṛthivī, gandhahīnā dravasnehādhikāścāpaḥ, dravasneharasagandhahīnaṃ tejaḥ, rūpahīno vāyuḥ, dravyāśrayyādilakṣaṇo guṇaḥ
śrotragrahaṇo yo'rthaḥ sa śabdaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 2
dravyāśrayī aguṇavān saṃyogavibhāgeṣvakāraṇamanapekṣa iti guṇalakṣaṇam--vai॰ sū॰ 1
atrocyate --arthāśleṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ tvāsattau pṛthivīghaṭarūpādīnāmeva syāt sāmānyaviśeṣatā, lakṣaṇoddeśanirdeśakṛtaivetyarthaḥ
netarasāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣatā iti vartate, sattva tathāpi svaviṣayasāmānyaviśeṣāpattiḥ
tasmāt sarvathāntaraṅgaṃ svamūrtisthaṃ pradhānaṃ vyavasthitamanapekṣam--na hi tasya dravyatvapṛthivītvaguṇatvarūpatvādyanuvṛttivyāvṛttibuddhilakṣaṇayorna syāt
tasmāt sarvathāntaraṅgaṃ svamūrtisthaṃ pradhānaṃ vyavasthitamanapekṣam--na hi tasya
atra prakalpete iti bhā॰ pāṭhe sāmānyaviśeṣau na prakalpete ityartho jñeyaḥ
prakalpyate iti ya॰ pāṭhe tu sāmānyaviśeṣatā na prakalppateprakalpyate ityabhisambandho jñeyaḥ
arthāśleṣalakṣaṇāsattau satyāmapi svaviṣayameva sāmānyam, svaviṣaya eva viśeṣaḥ ityetau prāguktau vikalpāvāpannau
sā coktadoṣā, sāpi ca svaviṣayasāmānyaviśeṣāpattiruktadoṣaiva --yadi svaviṣayam, sāmānyavirodhaḥ
yadi sāmānyaṃ tata ātmā na bhavati, anekārthatvāt sāmānyasya
atha ātmā tato na sāmānyam, ekatvādātmanaḥ
atha ātmaiva sāmānyam, rūpādirghaṭāderātmā tatsamudāyakāryatvāt; evaṃ satyātmabhedaḥ--rūpaṃ rūpaṃ ca rūpādisamudayaśca ityādi
yadi viśeṣastata ātmā na bhavati, anyatvādviśeṣasya guṇataḥ kālato vā, anyathā ghaṭādau sāmānyāpatteḥ
atha ātmā tato viśeṣo na bhavati, ekatvādātmanaḥ

athocyeta--naikatvānyatvavirodhadoṣau, ātmaiva viśeṣaḥ ityanapādānādipratijñānāt; yadi ātmāpekṣa eva viśeṣaḥ, eka eva anya ityātmano'nyathābhavanādanātmatvamityādipūrvoktadoṣasambandhinī svaviṣayasāmānyaviśeṣāpattiḥ
bhā॰ vinānyatra --ityeto prāguktau vika॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰
ityuto prāguktau vika॰ pā॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
atrāha saṃsargavādī--yadi ātmaiva sāmānyam, ātmaiva viśeṣaḥ iti brūyāṃ sāṅkhya-bauddhavat syurete doṣā mamāpi

mama tu sāmānyaviśeṣau dravyaguṇakarmabhyo'rthebhyo'tyantabhinnau, nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhirastīti sattvābhisambandhāt sat, dravyatvābhisambandhād dravyam ityādisāmānyaviśeṣavādinaḥ kathaṃ svaviṣayasāmānyaviśeṣapakṣadoṣāḥ ? iti
atrāpi paraviṣayasāmānyaviśeṣavādipratyākhyānāt kā gatiḥ ? ityalaṃ prasaṅgena
tasmādityuktadoṣopasaṃhārārthaḥ, etaddoṣāpetaṃ sarvathāntaraṅgaṃ vastu iti pratipattavyaṃ ghaṭādi ityabhisambhantsyāmaḥ

sarveṇa prakāreṇa sarvathā yāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ gatvā sāmānyameva, viśeṣa eva ityevamādinā vicārya vicārya antaraṅgaṃ vastu ghaṭasya kenacit prativiśiṣṭenākāreṇa udakādyāharaṇadhāraṇādisamarthena bhavanaṃ samānena cārthāntaraistadevāśrayaṇīyam, na bahiraṅgaṃ sattvadravyatvādi svaparaviṣayasāmānyaviśeṣavādi anuvṛttyapekṣā ghaṭāntareṣu
yadi syāt tato'nuvarteta sa teṣvapi, tataśca sarvasāmānyāt sa eva sa syāt, tadyathā--pūrvāhṇāparāhṇayoreka eva ghaṭaḥ
ya eṣa prekṣāpūrvakārī puruṣaḥ sa prātarutthāya pratyaṅgavartīni svāni kāryāṇi kurute, tataḥ sambandhinām, tataḥ suhṛdām, tataḥ śeṣāṇām pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1
tadantaraṅgatvaṃ kutaḥ ? svamūrtisthatvāt, svā mūrtirgrīvādyātmikā, tatrasthatvājjalādyāharaṇasamarthasya bhavanasya
kutaḥ pradhānam ? tadarthatvāt sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ, kanyārthavastrālaṅkāravat, ghaṭārtho hi sāmānyaviśeṣakalpanāvyāpāraḥ
vyavasthitaṃ ca ātmanyeva sthitatvāt, na yathā tau sañcāriṇau sāmānyaviśeṣāvavyavasthitau parāpekṣatvādavyavasthitatvāccāvastu vandhyāputravat
sad-dravya-pṛthivī-mṛd-ghaṭatvābhisambandhāt asti dravyaṃ pārthivo mārtiko ghaṭaḥ iti ghaṭe sampratyayaḥ ityuktaṃ hyācāryeṇa
evaṃ yāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ gatvā kalpayitvāpi sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa --nayacakravṛ॰ pṛ॰ 92-- 2
yadi syāt tato'nuvarteta sa teṣvapi, tataśca sarvasāmānyāt sa eva sa syāt, tadyathā--pūrvāhṇāparāhṇayoreka eva ghaṭaḥ
tadyathā--puruṣo'yaṃ prātarutthāya yānyasya pratiśarīraṃ kāryāṇi tāni tāvat karoti, tataḥ suhṛdām, tataḥ sambandhinām--iti pāṭhaḥ pātañjalamahābhāṣye

etacca ācāryīyaṃ vacanaṃ nayacakravṛttikāraḥ punarapyagre uddhariṣyatīttham— yathoktam --saddravyapṛthivīmṛddhaṭādibhisambandhādasti dravyaṃ pārthivo mārtiko ghaṭa iti ghaṭe sampratyayaḥ iti --nayacakravṛ॰ pṛ॰ 422-1
anapekṣatvācca, tadeva vastu ityabhisambhantsyate pratyekaṃ sarvatra

taddhi ghaṭabhavanaṃ na ghaṭa iti vā paṭa iti vā ghaṭapaṭādidravyāntaradi dravyāntaramapekṣate yathā anuvṛttivyāvṛttisāmānyavādimate tadarthaṃ ghaṭapaṭādyarthāntarāpekṣā vyāvṛttiviśeṣavādimate ca tadarthaṃ paṭādidravyāntarāpekṣā
laukikānuvartivyavahāranayavādimate tu sannihitasvādhīnavṛttitvād ghaṭātmabhavanasya na tadapekṣāstīti ta ddarśayati --na hi tasyānuvṛttyapekṣā ghaṭāntareṣu
yadi syādapekṣā tato'nuvarteta sa ghaṭaḥ teṣvapi ghaṭāntareṣvapi
na punarapekṣāsti, tasya svasāmarthyenaiva siddhatvād ghaṭātmanaḥ
tataśca sarvasāmānyāt sa eva sa syāt, ghaṭāntaramapi ghaṭātmaiva syāt, tattattvānuvṛtteḥ, ghaṭātmavat iti doṣaḥ syād deśabhinneṣvapi ghaṭeṣu kālabhinnaghaṭavat

nāpi ghaṭastattvānuvṛttimapekṣate, ghaṭātmanyasiddhe tattvānuvṛttyasiddheḥ; tata eva ca na paṭādivyāvṛttimapekṣate, tadāyattatvādityata āha --tatsanniveśasvarūpā- pekṣatvācca tasyāstadapekṣā vyarthā, itaretarāśrayadoṣāpādanāt
tathā viśeṣe'pyasya nāpekṣā, tathāhi sa eva na syāt, uktavat
--pūrvaṃ yathālokaprasiddhamanapekṣitapūrvāparaprabhedaṃ prakṛtiḥ iti vā anyat iti vā vartamānaṃ nityaṃ na pralayabhāk sad vartate bhāvo yo'sau tadeva vastviti pratipattavyam
kiṃ na etena ? yadi kāraṇam, yadi kāryamkāryam, yadi sāmānyaṃ, yadi viśeṣaḥ
ghaṭāvayavasanniveśasvarūpamapekṣate ghaṭāntarānuvṛttiḥ paṭādivyāvṛttiśceti yuktā anuvṛtterghaṭāpekṣā vyāvṛtteśca paṭādeḥ
ghaṭasya punaranuvṛttivyāvṛttyapekṣā vyarthā, svata eva siddhatvāt
ghaṭa-ghaṭatvānuvartanayoritaretarāśrayatvadoṣamāpādayatyeṣā kalpanā, itaretarāśrayāṇi ca kāryāṇi na prakalpante, tadyathā--naurnāvi baddhā netaratrāṇāya
yathā sāmānyāpekṣā nāsti ghaṭātmalābhasya tathāviśeṣetathā viśeṣe'pīti proktahetuvidhinātidiśati
granthato yojanāpi --tathā hi sa eva na syāduktavaditi
tataśca sarvaviśiṣṭatvāt sa eva na syād ghaṭo'pi, ghaṭapaṭayoriva
tatsanniveśasvarūpāpekṣatvācca tasyāḥ tadapekṣā vyarthā, itaretarāśrayadoṣāpādanāditi sarvamatideśyam
tulanā--tataśca sarvaviśiṣṭatvātsa eva na syāt --nayacakravṛ॰ pṛ॰ 34 paṃ॰ 13
tathā viśeṣe'pyasya nāpekṣā, tathāhi sa eva na syāt, uktavat
--pūrvaṃ yathālokaprasiddhamanapekṣitapūrvāparaprabhedaṃ prakṛtiḥ iti vā anyat iti vā vartamānaṃ nityaṃ na pralayabhāk sad vartate bhāvo yo'sau tadeva vastviti pratipattavyam
kiṃ na etena ? yadi kāraṇam, yadi kāryamkāryam, yadi sāmānyaṃ, yadi viśeṣaḥ
tadyathā naurnāvi baddhā netaratrāṇāya bhavati --iti pātañjalamahābhāṣye 1
loke prasiddhaṃ lokaprasiddham, yathaiva loke prasiddhaṃ tathā ghaṭabhavanam, ākārādimātrameva ca ghaṭa iti loke prasiddham, tadeva pūrvam, anapekṣitapūrvāparaprabhedatvāt

ke punaḥ pūrvāparaprabhedāḥ ? ghaṭādārabhya yāvat prakṛtiste pūrvaprabhedāḥ sāṅkhyānām, sat iti vā vaiśeṣikāṇām, apare prabhedāḥ yāvadantyaviśeṣakṛtamanyat, iti sāṅkhyavaiśeṣikābhyāṃ kalpitam, ata āha --prakṛtiriti vānyaditi vā
vartamānatvācca, vartaterastyarthatvāt, astibhavatividyatipadyativartatayaḥ sannipātaṣaṣṭhāḥ sattārthāḥ iti vacanāt
ata eva nityaṃ jalāharaṇādivyavahārasannipāti satatamatītānāgatakālayorapi ghaṭapaṭādyavasthānāt

na pralayabhāgiti, na ambhastaraṅgavat svātmapraveśam, na pradīpajvālānalavadatyantavināśam, dvividhamapi pralayaṃ na bhajate, dravyasya paryāyāntareṇa paryāyasyāpi dravyāvinābhāvādeva, ekāntāsadutpattivināśavādayorahetudṛṣṭāntatvādekāntanityavāde ca dharmāvirbhāvatirobhāvābhāvāt
taddhi tena rūpeṇa sarvakālaṃ sad, vartateḥ sattārthatvāditi tadeva vyācaṣṭe — ko hi vādānāmantaṃ kartuṃ śaknuyāt ? āha ca--ṇiyayavayaṇijjasaccā savvaṇayā paraviyālaṇe mohā
te puṇaadiṭṭhapuṇa adiṭṭhasamayo vibhajai sacce va alie vā
28ko hyetad veda ? kiṃ vā'nena jñātena ? vartata iti
bhāva iti vṛttibhavanayoḥ prāguktaṃ paryāyaśabdatvaṃ darśayati
yo'sāviti pratyāmanati, ya evaṃ vyākhyāto bhāvaḥ so'sau tadeva vastu nānyaditi pratipattavyamiti nigamayati
tadantaraṅgaṃ pradhānamanapekṣaṃ pūrvaṃ vartamānaṃ ca tad vastu

itiśabdaḥ parisamāptyartho'vadhāraṇārtho vā, ityāneva paryāpto'rthaḥ, nāto'dhiko nyūno vā, ye'nye'nyat kalpayanti--kāraṇameva, kāryameva, sāmānyameva, viśeṣa eva, tadubhayameva, anyataropasarjanapradhānameva, naiva vāstyubhayamiti
kiṃ na etena ? yadi kāraṇam, yadi kāryam, tataḥ ko doṣaḥ ? dṛśyate hi kāraṇamapi kāryamapi, yathā--paramāṇukāraṇaṃ dvyaṇukādi mṛtpiṇḍaśivakādīnāṃ kāryamapi, tadbhedajatvāt
ko hi vādānāmantaṃ kartuṃ śaknuyāt ? āha ca--
te puṇaadiṭṭhapuṇa adiṭṭhasamayo vibhajai sacce va alie vā || sanmati॰ 1 | 28
ko hyetad veda ? kiṃ vā'nena jñātena ?
mnā abhyāsepā॰ dhā॰ 929 iti dhātoḥ pratyāpūrvakasya rūpamidam
sa eva vyavahāranayāśrayāllaukiko brūte --ko hi vādānāmiti ekāntavādānām antaṃ kartuṃ śaknu yāt--ucchedaṃ śaknuyāt kartumiti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? na hi sāṅkhyābhihitāḥ sat kāraṇe kāryam, asadakaraṇādupādānagrahaṇāt sarvasambhavābhāvāt
sāṅkhyakā॰ 9 ityevamādayo hetavaḥ, na vā vaiśeṣikoktāḥ kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvādasat vai॰ sū॰ 9
1 ityādayaḥ, kṣaṇikā ghaṭādayaḥ pratyayāyattajanmatvāt ityādayo vā bauddhoktāḥ paraspareṇocchettuṃ śakyante, abhiyuktabuddhyutkarṣaparamparāyā adṛṣṭaniṣṭhatvāt
etasminnarthe jñāpakamāha --āha ceti, nāhameva svamanīṣikayā bravīmi, kiṃ tarhi ? anye'pyevaṃ bruvate
te puṇa adiṭṭhasamayo vibhajai sacce va alie vā
teṣāmanekāntasthitisvatattvānavabodhāt satyameva, asatyameva vā ityadṛṣṭasamayastān vibhajate ityācāryasiddhasenaḥ
śaktasya śakyakaraṇāt kāraṇabhāvācca sat kāryam || sāṅkhyakā॰ 9
niṣṭhā samāptiranta iti paryāyāḥ, tathā ca adṛṣṭaniṣṭhatvāt adṛṣṭaparyantatvādityarthaḥ
te puṇa adiṭṭhasamayo vibhajai sacce va alie vā || sanmati॰ 1 | 28
tathā ca kāraṇe kāryasadasattvāniyamaḥ, kāraṇe satyeva bhāvābhāvābhyāmasati ca sevādyudyogaphalāniyamāt
ko hyetad veda ityaśakyaprāptiṃ darśayati kiṃ vānena jñātena iti prayojanābhāvaṃ ca
yasmāt pratijñāhetudṛṣṭāntopanayanigamanānāṃ jijñāsāsaṃśaya-śakyaprāpti-prayojanapūrvāṇāṃ saṃśayavyudāsaḥ phalamante bhaviṣyatīti daśāvayavavādināṃ matam, tathā ca vyavahāraprasiddhiḥ
daśāvayavāneke naiyāyikā vākye sañcakṣate jijñāsā saṃśayaḥ śakyaprāptiḥ prayojanaṃ saṃśayavyudāsa iti--iti nyāyasūtrabhāṣye 1

evaṃ ca kṛtvānena nyāyena yathā kāraṇameva, na kāryam; kāryameva, na kāraṇam; sāmānyameva, na viśeṣaḥ; viśeṣa eva, na sāmānyam; ubhayam; anyataropasarjanam; ubhayābhāvo vā ityayaṃ niyamo nāstyuktavidhinā tathā kāraṇe kāryasya sattvameva asattvamevetyayamapi niyamo nāsti
katham ? yadi kāryaṃ sat tataḥ kāraṇameva iti nāsti, kāryasyāpi sattvāt
katham ? kriyānimittakatvāt kāraṇakāryatvayoḥ kāryābhāve kāraṇābhāvaḥ kāraṇābhāve kāryābhāva iti
tathā yadi kāraṇaṃ sat, tataḥ kāryameva na bhavati, kāraṇasyāpi sattvāt
tatra tāvat kāraṇe kāryaṃ sadeva asadeva sadasaccaiva iti vā ye bruvate teṣāṃ niyamābhāva uktaḥ anyataropasarjanobhayābhāvayorapyukta eva bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ
ko hetuḥ ? kāraṇe satyeva bhāvābhāvābhyāmityayathāsaṅkhyaṃ hetū
satyeva bhāvāt asat kāraṇe kāryam ityaniyamaḥ, satyevābhāvāt sadeva ityaniyamaḥ
asati ca kāraṇe kāryasya sadasattvāniyamaḥ iti vartate
dṛṣṭo hi loke kṛṣīvalavaṇigrājapuruṣaśilpyādīnāṃ kṛṣivāṇijyasevāśilpādiṣu kāraṇeṣūdyuktānāṃ phalāniyamaḥ
tadyathā --vātakarkoṭakīpuṣpaṃ phalakāraṇaṃ satkāryam, puṣpatvāt, āmrapuṣpavadityanumānaprasaṅge'pi ca dṛṣṭamasatkāryam
atra asattvameva vetyayamapi ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
syānmatam--avyaktāni vātakarkoṭakī-vañjula-japākusumādīnāṃ phalāni miti cet, na, vyaktikāryasya avyaktakāryatvādasattvatulyatvāt
kāryasadasattvāniyamāttu kāraṇe kāraṇatāyāmeva karaṇākaraṇe kāryasya, aviditavedanārthavidhiparatāyāṃ vākyapravṛttestasyāmavasthāyāmanupajanitaviṣayatvādapavāda- kāryāṇīti
tasya kāryasya avyaktakāryatvāt, asattvena tulyam, tadbhāvo'sattvatulyatvam, tasmādasattvatulyatvānnāvyaktaṃ kāryamastīti
athavā vyaktiśca sā kāryaṃ tad vyaktireva kāryam, tadavyaktaṃ kāryamavyaktakāryam, tasyāvyaktakāryatvādasattvatulyatvam, tasmādasattad vātakarkoṭakyādipuṣpaphalam, nāvyaktaṃ kāryamiti
kāryasadasattvāniyamāttu kāraṇe kāraṇatāyāmeva karaṇākaraṇe kāryasya, aviditavedanārthavidhiparatāyāṃ vākyapravṛttestasyāmavasthāyāmanupajanitaviṣayatvādapavāda-
atra tadavyaktaṃ kāryamavyaktakāryaṃ tasyāvyaktakāryatvādasattvatulyam iti yojanāyāṃ yathāśrutamapi samīcīnameveti bhāti
etadapi nopapadyate, yasmād bījādīnāmapyakāraṇataiva kvacidakaraṇāditi prāptam
yasmāt teṣāmapi bījānāṃ trivarṣaparamoṣitānāmaṅkurādyutpādane śaktyabhāvaḥ, ādigrahaṇād mṛdāderghaṭādyutpādane
evaṃ ca sati kṛṣīvalādīnāṃ sakṛddṛṣṭabījāṅkurādikāraṇakāryabhāvavyabhicārāṇāṃ tadarthapravṛtteḥ punaranārambhāt karaṇābhāve kāraṇābhāva eva syāt, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
loke punarupapadyate --kāryasadasattvāniyamāttu kāraṇe bījādau kāraṇatāyāmeva satyāṃ karaṇākaraṇe sannihite tantvādau kāraṇe kāryasya paṭādeśca, kādācitkayoḥ karaṇākaraṇayordarśanāt
syānmatam--kāraṇe kāryasya sadasattvayoḥ karaṇākaraṇayoścāniyame kimarthaṃ punaḥ karotīti kāraṇam iti śabdavyutpattirāśrīyate ? iti
ajñātajñāpanamaviditavedanamartho'sya vidheriti aviditavedanārtho vidhiḥ, tatparatāyāṃ vākyapravṛtteḥ tasyāmavasthāyāmanupajanitaviṣayatvādapavādasparśasya
tadā hi karotīti kāraṇam iti kāraṇatvavidhānamātraṃ kriyate deśakālādiviśeṣāviśeṣaṇādasati svaviṣaye kamarthamapavādaḥ spṛśet--kiṃ karotyeṣa na karotyapi kvacit kadāciditi ? sparśasya, nīlotpalavat
sarvasarvātmakatvasarvakāraṇatvāt sevādikriyākalāpo yathā arthaprāpteḥ kāraṇaṃ tathā kleśaprāpterapi
nanvata eva kleśo'pi bhavatīti cet, evaṃ satīpsitena tāvadbhavitavyam, sannihitatacchaktyabhīhitatvāt, sarvaśāstrajñānyataravyākhyānavat
tadā sa manyate vaktā--idaṃ tāvat pratiṣṭhāṃ yātu karotīti kāraṇam iti
pratiṣṭhite cāsmiṃstata uttarakālaṃ siddhe sati kāraṇatve sambhavataḥ kāryasattvāsattvayoḥ tena viśeṣaṇaprakāreṇa karotyeva na karotyeveti vikalādeśavaśānniyamopapatterviśeṣaṇamāśrīyate

yathā hi nīlotpalaṃ bhavati iti tadbhavanamātraṃ vidhīyate nīlameva, utpalameva iti vā niyamaviśeṣānāśrayaṇāt, tathā karotīti kāraṇam iti kriyābhāvanamātraṃ vidhīyate karotyeva, na vā ityanāśritya viśeṣaniyamam

yathā vā nīlaṃ tila-kambalādiviśeṣānapekṣam utpalamapi raktatādiviśeṣānapekṣaṃ parasparaviśiṣṭamubhayamucyate tathā karotīti kāraṇam iti karaṇamātraṃ deśakālādikāryapratibandhāpratibandhanirapekṣamucyate
athavā śabalotpalatve satyapi tasya dharmabhedānapekṣaṃ nīlotpalam ityucyate, tathā karaṇabhāvābhāvabhedadharmanirapekṣaṃ kriyāmātraṃ karotīti kāraṇam ityucyate
sarvasarvātmakatvasarvakāraṇatvāt sevādikriyākalāpo yathā arthaprāpteḥ kāraṇaṃ tathā kleśaprāpterapi
nanvata eva kleśo'pi bhavatīti cet, evaṃ satīpsitena tāvadbhavitavyam, sannihitatacchaktyabhīhitatvāt, sarvaśāstrajñānyataravyākhyānavat
sambhavataḥ iti pañcamyarthe tasipratyayāntaḥ śabdaprayogaḥ, kāryasattvāsattvayoḥ sambhavādityarthaḥ
atra karotyeva na karotyeva veti ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
tena prakāreṇa tathā, yathā prāguktasadasattvāniyamāttu kāraṇe kāryasya kāraṇatāyāmeva karaṇākaraṇe tathā kāryakaraṇākaraṇāniyamāttu kāraṇasya kāryasya kāryatvāniyamaḥ
vaṭanyagrodhodumbarādiphalānāṃ phalatvāt puṣpakāryatvānumānaprasaṅge phalamasatkāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭamiti pūrvavad vyabhicāraḥ
āmrapuṣpaphale satkāryakāraṇe dṛṣṭe ityatrāpi kādācitkayoreva kāryakāraṇayordarśanāt kāryakāraṇasadasatkaraṇākaraṇāniyamameva darśayati

sthāvarajaṅgamābhyavahṛtānyonyarasarudhirādirūpādipariṇāmāpattivaiśvarūpyadarśanāt sarvaṃ sarvātmakam, tata eva sarvaṃ sarvasya kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ ceti kṛtvā sevādikriyākalāpo yathā arthaprāpteḥ kāraṇaṃ tathā kleśaprāpterapi prakalpyata eva kāraṇam
tadapi ca phalamarthakleśaprāptyādi aniyatam, ubhayatra vyabhicārāt
itara āha --nanvata eva kleśo'pi kāryasattvādeva bhavatīti niyataṃ kāraṇe kāryam ityāpannaṃ cedityevaṃ cenmanyase
kiṃ ca tadīpsitaṃ phalam ? arthaprāptiḥ, na kleśaḥ sevakasya

sannihitā sā śaktirasya so'yaṃ sevakaḥ sannihitatacchaktiḥ aproṣitārthaprāptiśaktiḥ, sevā vā sannihitā, sā śaktirasyāḥ sā sannihitatacchaktiḥ, tayā abhīhitatvāt ceṣṭitatvāditi vṛttivṛttimatorananyatvāt sevā tatra deśakālākāranimittāvabaddhatvānneṣṭameva phalamavāpyate, jñāvyākhyānavat
atha deśādayaḥ kim ? yadi te kāryaṃ tatasteṣāmakāraṇatvādasarvatvādatantratvādapratibandhakatvam

atha te kāraṇaṃ tataḥ sarvakāraṇatvasarvātmakatvāt kimiti sarvaṃ na bhavati, samuditakāraṇatvāt, saṃyuktatantupaṭavat ? atha vā sarvaṃ na bhavati, anabhivyaktatvāddeśādeḥ, pradhānasāmyāvasthānavad sevakayoryatheṣṭaṃ vigrahasambandhau
yathā sarvaśāstrajñaḥ puruṣo vyākaraṇādyanyatamacchāstramīpsitameva vyācaṣṭe tathaitaditi
atha deśādayaḥ kim ? yadi te kāryaṃ tatasteṣāmakāraṇatvādasarvatvādatantratvādapratibandhakatvam
atha te kāraṇaṃ tataḥ sarvakāraṇatvasarvātmakatvāt kimiti sarvaṃ na bhavati, samuditakāraṇatvāt, saṃyuktatantupaṭavat ?
atha vā sarvaṃ na bhavati, anabhivyaktatvāddeśādeḥ, pradhānasāmyāvasthānavad

atra brūmaḥ --tatra deśakālākāranimittāvabaddhatvānneṣṭameva phalamavāpyate sevakeneva prasannanṛpādapi, svanagarabhāṇḍāgārādikṣetrapratibandhavat śvaḥprabhātādikālapratibandhavat prasādadānābhimukhyākārāvabandhavat dvitīyakarmaṇyatāpradarśanādinimittāvabandhavat
śāstrajñadṛṣṭāntasyāpi tādṛgvidhāvabandhasadbhāve sati avyākhyānavadaniyama eva phalasyetyata āha --jñāvyākhyānavat, sarvaśāstrajño'pyebhirevāvabandhairīpsitaṃ na vyācaṣṭa iti
kāraṇabhāvāddhi sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ syāt, tadabhāvādasarvatvaṃ deśādīnāṃ prāptam
tataḥ kāraṇaṃ cet, sarvakāraṇatvāt sarvātmakatvāt kimiti sarvaṃ na bhavati ? bhavatyevetyarthaḥ
atra prayogaḥ--sarvaṃ sarvatra syāt, samuditakāraṇatvāt, saṃyuktatantupaṭavat
yathā tantūnāṃ parasparasaṃyoge sati niyamāt paṭo bhavati svakāraṇatvasaṃnidhānādevaṃ sarvakāraṇatva- sarvātmakatvasadbhāve ko deśādipratibandho nāma anya iti kimiti mudhā sarvaṃ na bhavediti ?
atha vā sarvaṃ na bhavatītyādi sa eva laukika āśaṅkate
atha mataṃ bhavataḥ sāṅkhyasya--sarvaṃ na bhavati śarīrakleśasukhārthānarthaprāptyādi
añjū vyaktimrakṣaṇagatiṣu pā॰ dhā॰ 1459, mrakṣitamabhivyaktaṃ sphuṭīkṛtam, anabhivyaktamasphuṭam, anabhivyaktatvād deśādeḥ kāraṇasya sarvaṃ na bhavati

yathā pradhānaṃ sattvarajastamastriguṇatvasāmyāvasthāne'nabhivyaktatvāt sarvakāraṇamapi sat sarvān bhāvānna prakaroti ghaṭapaṭādīn, atha ca prakaraṇāt prakṛtiḥ pradhīyante bhāvāstata iti pradhānam ityādibhirnāmabhirucyate, tasya cānabhivyaktatvaṃ tatsāmyāvasthānānma mayūrāṇḍakarasagatagrīvādivadvā
nanu ca deśādeḥ sarvatvāt sarvātmakatvād vaiṣamyāvasthaiva iti laukikaprakṛtitvameva prakṛteḥ, sarvātmakatvāt, deśādivat
nyethāḥ tathā hi deśādikāraṇaṃdeśādi kāraṇaṃ sāmyāvasthānādanabhivyaktaṃ pradhānavat sarvaṃ kāryaṃ na kurute
yathā mayūrāṇḍakarasāvasthāyāmeva mecakavarṇagrīvādyavayavānabhivyaktiḥ tatsāmyāvasthānāt, ataḥ sarvaṃ na bhavati mayūrāṇḍakarasāvasthāyāmiva tadgrīvādīti
nanu ca deśādeḥ sarvatvāt sarvātmakatvād vaiṣamyāvasthaiva iti laukikaprakṛtitvameva prakṛteḥ, sarvātmakatvāt, deśādivat
॰nādataḥ sarvaṃ na bhavati mayūrāṇḍakarasādataḥ sarvaṃ na bhavati mayūrāṇḍāvasthāyāmivaya॰
tasmād deśādeḥ sarvatvāt sarvātmakatvam, sarvātmakatvācca vaiṣamyāvasthaiva
katham ? yathā hi laukikī prakṛtirdeśādirviṣamāvasthaiva satī sarvakāraṇātmikā kāryātmikā viṣamā samā ca vyaktā cāvyaktā ca tathā sāṅkhyaparikalpitaprakṛtirapi syāt
kiṃ kāraṇam ? sarvātmakatvāt, deśādivad mayūrāṇḍakarasavad vā vaiṣamyāvasthaivetyarthaḥ
kiñcānyat--ete api ca kalpane nopapanne--deśādīnāmanabhivyaktiḥ prakṛteḥ sāmyāvasthānamiti
na hi deśādīnāmanabhivyaktau prayojanamasti, puruṣavimokṣaṇahetorvyaktarūpatayā pravartamānānāṃ tathā puruṣārthasiddheḥ, anirvṛttaudanasya pacikriyāyāmaudāsīnyavat
nāpi nirvartitārthāyāḥ prakṛteḥ punarātmānamupasaṃhṛtya sāmyāvasthāne kiñcit prayojanamasti, siddhaudanasya odanārtharandhanādipravṛttivat
athavā prakṛtereva anabhivyaktisāmyāvasthāne na yukte, aprayojanatvāt
kiṃ kāraṇam ? prakāśanārthaṃ pravṛttāyā vyaktivaiṣamyābhyāṃ tadarthasiddheḥ, tābhyāmṛte cāsiddheḥ, anabhivyaktisāmyāvasthānayorapi pravṛttiviśeṣatvāt, dvidhāpyaprayojanatvādayuktamiti

athavā'prayojanā anabhivyaktiḥ, nirvṛttārthatvāt, deśādirūpeṇa prakāśitātmavṛttiḥ kimarthaṃ nābhivyajyate ? kimarthaṃ vā sarvaṃ puruṣārthamakṛtvā sāmyena avatiṣṭhate ? sāṅkhyaiśca dvividhapuruṣārthasiddhyai prakṛtipravṛttiriṣṭā, nākasmikī yadṛcchāvādimatavat
etaccāyuktam, prakṛtikāraṇatyāgena abhyupetavirodhadoṣa ātmāntaratvaprakāśanaṃ hi jñānārthasya svatantrasya apratihatasarvagatatvasya pradhānasya dharmaḥ

atastena nityapravṛttenaiva bhavitavyam, tatsvabhāvatvāt, yathā sambandhinī yasmāt kāraṇāntarasya vā tathāpraṇeturāpattiḥ, kāraṇādanyat kāraṇaṃ kāraṇāntaram, prakṛteranyat kāraṇaṃ yat prakṛtiṃ tathā praṇayati tadasti svabhāvaniyatikālayadṛccheśvarādīnāmanyatamadityāpannam, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
ātmāntaratvaprakāśanaṃ hi jñānārthasya svatantrasya apratihatasarvagatatvasya pradhānasya dharmaḥ
kāraṇāntaranirapekṣasya kāraṇasya svakāryākaraṇaṃ ca yuktiviruddhamityata āha --ātmāntaratvaprakāśanaṃ hītyādi yāvat pradhānasya dharma iti
ātmano'nya ātmā ātmāntaram, tasya bhāva ātmāntaratvaṃ parasparavibhinnamahadahaṅkārādyavasthāntaratvam, tasya prakāśanam
hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmādanabhivyakteḥ sāmyāvasthānasya ca pratipakṣo'vasthāntaraprakāratvena ātmaprakāśanamayaṃ prakṛterdharmaḥ
syānmatam--upāyānabhijñatvāt kāraṇāntaraṃ sācivyaguṇopetamapekṣata iti, etaccāyuktam, jñānārthatvāt
teṣāmaṣṭānāṃ saptabhirbadhnāti ekena mocayati iti tasya pradhānasya jñānārthasya pariṇatyavasthātmakasyāyuktā sacivāpekṣā
syānmatam--kvacit pradhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ kvacidanyat, avyāpitvāt, laukikakālādikāraṇavaditi
tena jñānena ātmānaṃ puruṣād vimocayati ekena --je॰ sāṅkhyakā॰ vṛ॰ B
athavā ātmāntaratvaprakāśanamiti ātmā puruṣaḥ, ātmano'nya ātmā ātmāntaram, tasya bhāva ātmāntaratvaṃ puruṣādbhinnaṃ triguṇasvabhāvaṃ svamātmānaṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣāya prakāśayati

puruṣādvānyaḥ puruṣa ātmāntaram, tasya bhāva ātmāntaratvaṃ puruṣāntaratvam, tasmai puruṣāya prakāśya ātmasvarūpaṃ puruṣāntarāṇāṃ prakāśayati, puruṣāntaratvaṃ vā caitanyasvarūpamadhyasthaśuddhakevalatvaiḥ parasparabhinnaiḥ puruṣāntarasthaiḥ puruṣāntareṣu prakāśiteṣvapi anyeṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ yat puruṣāntaratvaṃ taireva caitanyādibhiryuktaṃ prakāśayati
ayaṃ hi dharmastasya jñānārthasya svatantrasya apratihatasarvagatatvasya pradhānasya
evaṃ tasya svabhāvadharmaṃ samarthya idānīmanabhivyaktisāmyāvasthānapratipakṣabhūtaṃ nityapravṛttatvaṃ pradhānasyānumimīte --atastena nityapravṛttenaiva bhavitavyamiti pratijñā

ata ityanantaroktadharmatvāt pradhānasya, taddharmatvamidānīṃ hetutvena vyāpārayitumāha sāmānyataḥ --tatsvabhāvatvāditi, sa svabhāvo dharmo yasya tat tatsvabhāvaṃ pradhānaṃ pūrvoktairhetubhirviśeṣitamatastannityapravṛttaṃ bhavitumarhati
iha yad yad yatsvabhāvaṃ tat tat agnirdahanaprakāśanapravṛttaḥ
nanu bhasmacchanno'gnirapi na dahati na prakāśayati
atha kathaṃ jīvati ? kathaṃ jñāyate agniḥ iti adahannaprakāśayan vā tāvat kośakādi svāśrayamātram, gṛhapradīpakavat ? chādanābhāvo'pi ca pradhāne
yat punarnityapravṛttaṃ na bhavati na tat tatsvabhāvam, yathā na kiñcit tādṛgiti
nanu bhasmacchanno'gnirapi na dahati na prakāśayati
atha kathaṃ jīvati ? kathaṃ jñāyate agniḥ iti adahannaprakāśayan vā tāvat kośakādi svāśrayamātram, gṛhapradīpakavat ? chādanābhāvo'pi ca pradhāne
dahanāditatsvabhāvasyāgnestathāpravṛttyadarśanāt sādhyadharmavaikalyaṃ dṛṣṭāntadoṣa iti tannidarśayannāha — nanu bhasmacchanno'gnirapi na dahati na prakāśayatīti, dahanatapanayorabhedāditi
sa cendhanaṃ dahan jīvati, sthiterjīvitaparyāyatvāt sthiterindhanadahanāvinābhāvāt

acetanatvamabhyupagamyāpi sthitiprakāśanendhanadahanātmakasyāgneḥ pratyakṣānumānaviṣayasya satastathā pratyakṣānumānābhyāmagrahaṇe'stitve pramāṇāntarāsiddheḥ kathaṃ jñāyate agniḥ iti adahan aprakāśamānaḥ aprakāśayan vā dravyāntaraṃ tāvat kośakādi svāśrayamātram ? tat parimāṇamasya tāvat, svaparimāṇamātramapi svāśrayadravyaṃ kośakādi aprakāśayan katham agniḥ ityucyate ? kośaka ityucyate'nnapulikā

gṛhe prajvālitaḥ pradīpako gṛhapradīpakaḥ, yathā gṛhapradīpako'nnapulikāmātramapi yadi na prakāśayati prakāśātmakaḥ sanna pradīpaḥ iti jñāyate; agnivaidharmyadṛṣṭānto vā--gṛhapradīpo gṛhaṃ prakāśayannasti, yadi na tathāgniḥ svamāśrayaṃ prakāśayati prakāśātmakaḥ saṃstato nāstīti gamyate
kiñcānyat, bhasmacchannāgnisādharmyābhāvo'pi ca pradhānasya cchādanābhāvādityata āha --chādanābhāvo'pi ca pradhāna iti
agnerbhasmavat prakṛterāvaraṇābhāvād bhasmacchannāgnitulyaṃ na bhavati pradhānamato viśeṣya brūmaḥ--nirāvaraṇāgnidahanaprakāśanavat tatsvabhāvatvānnityapravṛttenaiva bhavitavyam
sarvāsvapi pratiṣūpalabhyamānasya atrapulikā iti pāṭhasyātra ko'rtha iti samyag na vijñāyate, tathāpi bhājanaviśeṣo'trābhipretaḥ syāditi matvā annapulikā iti pāṭho'tra sambhāvyate
atra iti pulikā iti ca pṛthak padadvayaṃ tu naivātra jāghaṭīti
, agre'pi gṛhapradīpako'trapulikāmātramapi paṃ॰ 15 iti vacanāt tatra ca atra iti pṛthak padasya sarvathā anāvaśyakatvādasaṅgatatvācceti dhyeyam
ya॰ pratipāṭhānusāreṇātra jñāyate tathā na jñāyate'gniriti

syānmatam--yadyapi pradhānaṃ mahadādibhāvenātmāntaratvaprakāśanārthaṃ puruṣasya pravartate tathāpi keṣāñcit puruṣāṇāṃ kṛte prayojane'nyeṣāmakṛte kālakrameṇa vyaktyavyaktisāmyavaiṣamyāvasthāḥ pratipadyate, sā cāsya kālādikāraṇāntaranirapekṣasya tasya svatantratvāt sarvapuruṣārthapravṛttatvācca niravaśeṣapuruṣaviṣaye svānyatvajñāpane kṛte kṛtakṛtyatvāt kiṃ sāmyāvasthānena ? akṛte'pyakṛtakṛtyatvāt kiṃ pratinivṛttyā prayojanam ? anabhivyaktisāmyāvasthānānupapatteśca kimiti satatasamavasthitasamanupravṛtti pratyakṣakāraṇanānābhedābhivyaktisvabhāvamevedaṃ jagannābhyupagamyate ? mṛtpiṇḍa- pravṛttiḥ svabhāvād niyateḥ kālād yadṛcchāyā veti
pradhānaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ niyatikālasvabhāveśvarayadṛcchādyanyatamānapekṣaṃ kāraṇaṃ jagato'bhyupagataṃ bhavatā, na tu yathā lokanaye kvacit kālo'pi niyatirapītyādi

svatantratvācca tasya prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ svarūpabhedaparijñāpanasya svārthasyānurūpaśrotrādyekādaśendriyagrāmasya śabdabuddhyādivikalpagrāmasya vacanādānaviharaṇānandotsargakarmaśabdādyarthagrāmasya ca nirvartane svatantratvānna kāraṇāntarāpekṣāsti

sarvapuruṣārthapravṛttatvācca kṛtārthasyākṛtārthasya ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ sāmyāvasthāne nivṛttau ca prayojanābhāva ityata āha --niravaśeṣapuruṣaviṣaye svānyatvajñāpane kṛte kṛtakṛtyatvāt kiṃ sāmyāvasthānena ? akṛte'pyakṛtakṛtyatvāt kiṃ pratinivṛttyā prayojanam, asiddhaudanasūpakāranivṛttivat ? iti tadavasthamaprayojanatvam
atra codyam--nanu prāguktam --anabhivyaktisāmyāvasthāne cāyukte, aprayojanatvāt, nirvṛttānirvṛttārthakriyaudāsīnyavaditi, ataḥ punaruktamiti
atra brūmaḥ--na, kāraṇāntarāpekṣāpratiṣedhaparatvādasya, pravṛttinivṛttyoḥ pradhānasya aprayojanatvamātrapratipādanaparatvāt tasyetyadoṣaḥ

kālādikāraṇāntaranirapekṣasya tasya svatantratvāt sarvapuruṣārthapravṛttatvācca niravaśeṣapuruṣaviṣaye svānyatvajñāpane kṛte kṛtakṛtyatvāt kiṃ sāmyāvasthānena ? akṛte'pyakṛtakṛtyatvāt kiṃ pratinivṛttyā prayojanam ?
aprayojanatvādibhiranabhivyaktisāmyāvasthāne anupapanne, tataścāvyaktisāmyāvasthānānupapatteḥ kimiti kiṃ kāraṇaṃ jagadevaṃsvabhāvamiti na gṛhyate ? ityabhisambandhaḥ
satatasamavasthitasamanupravṛttīti, satataṃ sarvakālaṃ samavasthitā nityānuparatā samanupravṛttiḥ kāraṇakāryapravṛttyātmikā prakarṣeṇa vṛttiryasya tadidaṃ jagat satatasamavasthitasamanupravṛtti

pratyakṣakāraṇanānābhedābhivyaktisvabhāvamiti, pratyakṣāṇi ca tāni kāraṇāni ca pratyakṣakāraṇāni mṛtpiṇḍadaṇḍacakrodakasūtra- kulālādīni ghaṭādīnāṃ kāryāṇām, tāni nānājātīyāni, tantuturīvemakuvindādīni paṭādīnāmityevaṃprakārāṇi, teṣāṃ bhedāḥ pratyakṣakāraṇanānābhedāḥ, taisteṣāṃ vābhivyaktirghaṭapaṭādikāryarūpeṇa, saiva svabhāvo yasya tadidaṃ pratyakṣakāraṇanānābhedābhivyaktisvabhāvam
tasmād dṛṣṭakāraṇanānābhedābhivyaktisvabhāvamevedaṃ jagat kimiti nābhyupagamyate ? kimityadṛṣṭaṃ kāraṇāntaraṃ parikalpyate ? iti
ato'vagamyatāṃ na kiñcidanyat phalaṃ tacchāstreṇa kriyate yallokavyavahāra-

kiṃ tarhi ? etāvānniyamaḥ --kāraṇādhyāsāvimuktyanirmūlatvaṃ kāryasyeti, tathānugamyadṛṣṭārthatvāt, mṛtpiṇḍaśivaketyādipāṃśumṛtpiṇḍāderityantasya daṇḍakasyopari aniyatādisadasadbhūtakāraṇādhyāsāvimuktyanirmūlatvamiti vakṣyamāṇasambandhatvāt

kāryameva, sadeva asadeva vā kāraṇaṃ kālādi, sādikāraṇamityasya vā'niyamapradarśanārthamudāharaṇamāha --mṛtpiṇḍaśivaketyādi yāvat pāṃśumṛtpiṇḍāderiti, eṣāṃ mṛtpiṇḍādyavasthāviśeṣāṇāṃ vātāyanareṇuparyantānāmeva loke dṛṣṭatvāt punarupacayāt prāptamānantyaṃ yeṣāṃ skandhānāṃ te punarupacayaprāptānantyaskandhāḥ vātāyanareṇubhyaḥ prabhṛti punarupacayakrameṇa pāṃśu-mṛtpiṇḍa-śivaka-sthāsa-kosaka-kuśūlaghaṭa-kapāla-śakala-śarkarikā-pāṃśu-vātāyanareṇava iti cakrakakrameṇa kāraṇakāryāniyamo dṛṣṭaḥ

utkrameṇāpi ca saṅghātabhedābhyāṃ kāryakāraṇasadasattvāniyamo dṛṣṭaḥ, piṇḍamupamṛdya śivakakaraṇāt śivakaṃ copamṛdya piṇḍakaraṇāt sthāsakādīnāmanyatamamavasthāviśeṣamupamṛdyāpi piṇḍādikaraṇāt kriyākriyāphalakrameṇa ca kadācit kāraṇakāryāniyamadarśanādityaniyatādi, itthamaniyata ādirasyetyaniyatādi, jagaditi sambadhyate, tadeva aniyatasadasadbhūtakāraṇakāryam, aniyatādisadasadbhūtaṃ kāraṇam, tasya adhyāsastena vā kāraṇena adhyāso'dhiṣṭhānam
tena kāraṇādhyāsena avimuktiratyāgaḥ kāraṇasāmānyāvinābhāvaḥ, na tu atyantanirmūlotpattivināśalakṣaṇakāryatvaṃ khapuṣpavat, tathaiva loke dṛṣṭatvāt

ataḥ proktahetordṛṣṭakāryakāraṇasadasattvāniyamāt paraparikalpitapradhānādyadṛṣṭaikakāraṇānupapatteḥ kālādiviśeṣakāraṇaikyānumānābhāvācca kāraṇasāmānyamātrānumānāccāvagamyatām--na kiñcidanyat phalaṃ tacchāstreṇa kriyate, nirarthakāni śāstrāṇītyarthaḥ
kiṃ tat ? yallokavyavahāraphalādatiricya varteta, yadapekṣya śāstrāṇi sārthakāni syuḥ
na tu yathānyaiḥ kalpitam--uparatavyāpāraṃ sat pradhānamatīndriyaṃ punarindriyagrāhyatvādibhāvena jagat sṛjati, punarātmānaṃ saṃhṛtya uparatavyāpāraṃ tiṣṭhati
kasmin sādhye ? phalādatiricya varteta iti vṛthaivamādau śāstrārambhaḥ
atra tu śāstramarthavat syāt— idaṅkāma idaṃ kuryāditi
arthyo hi kriyāyā evopadeśaḥ, citrādivat, na tu laukike eva gṛhyamāṇe'rthe idamevaṃ naivaṃ vetinaivaṃ ceti vicāraḥ
anupahatendriyamanaḥpratyakṣeṇa loke yathāsau śāstrārambhavṛthābhāve, ata āha --vṛthā evamādau śāstrārambhaḥ
kva tarhi śāstramarthavat syāditi cet, atīndriye puruṣārthasādhyasādhanasambandhe
ko'sau ? ityata āha --atra tu śāstramarthavat syāt— idaṅkāma idaṃ kuryāditi

idaṃ śabdena sarvanāmnā sāmānyavādinā sarvāḥ kriyāḥ phalecchāpreritāstatsādhanīḥ sūcayati agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ, putrakāmo yajeta, paśukāmo yajeta, annādyakāmo yajeta ityādyāḥ, kriyākriyāphalasambandhasyātīndriyatvāt
atra hetvarthe iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīnatara iti bhāti
atra tu śāstramarthavat syāt— idaṅkāma idaṃ kuryāditi
arthyo hi kriyāyā evopadeśaḥ, citrādivat, na tu laukike eva gṛhyamāṇe'rthe idamevaṃ naivaṃ vetinaivaṃ ceti vicāraḥ
atra ॰vācinā iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīnatara iti bhāti
bhā॰ pratau tu ityādyāḥ kri॰ iti pāṭhādanantaraḥ arthādanapeto'rthyaḥ ityantaḥ sarvo'pi pāṭho nāstyevātra
hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmāt kriyāyā evopadeśo'rthyaḥ sasādhanāyāḥ phalādisambandhinyāḥ, citrādivat

yathāvayavasthānavinyāsavarṇasaṃyogapravibhāgaviṣayaviniyogādyupadeśa evopayogāt sārthakaḥ, na kuḍyavarṇacitrakārādisvarūpopadeśaḥ tatra tadanupayogāt, tathā nityakṣaṇikatvāditattvavarṇanaṃ ghaṭapaṭādeḥ triguṇakāraṇapūrvakatvādivarṇanaṃ jagataḥ satatasaṃpravṛttikṣaṇikānupākhyatvādivarṇanaṃ vā
etadapi nopapadyate, yasmād na tu laukika eva gṛhyamāṇe'rthe idamevaṃ naivaṃ vetinaivaṃ ceti sārthako vicāra ityabhisambandhaḥ, prasiddhārthaviṣayasya vicārasyāniṣṭhādoṣaniṣṭhatvāt

neti pratiṣedhe, turviśeṣaṇe, loke bhavo laukikaḥ, deśakālapuruṣakriyā- viśeṣādyapekṣarūpādimadarthe kāryakāraṇamṛtpiṇḍādighaṭādyākārādike pratyakṣata eva gṛhyamāṇe idaṃ sarvaṃ sattvarajastamaḥsaṃjñatriguṇātmakameva, na caitadevam; kṣaṇabhaṅgajanmātmakam, na vaivamcaivam ityādivicāraḥ kiṃsambandhaḥ ? kimphalaḥ ? ko vātra puruṣārthasādhanaparijñānopayogaḥ ? iti vimṛśyatāṃ bhavadbhireva
laukika eva gṛhyamāṇe'rthe idamevaṃ naivaṃ ceti vicāro'rthavānna bhavati

yadi bhavet catuṣpāttve sati utplutya gamanāt lomaśo hariṇavad maṇḍūkaḥ, tata eva nirlomā hariṇo maṇḍūkavat syāditi prasiddhiviparītaṃ sidhyellokāprāmāṇyakaraṇa iti tat prasaktamihāpītyata āha--na tu laukika eva gṛhyamāṇa ityādyuktadarśanavaditi
atra aniṣṭhā anavasthā, tathā ca anavasthādoṣavattvādityarthaḥ
tatra punarvacanaṃ pratyakṣaprasiddherbādhakamāpadyate anuvādādibhāvābhāve siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ iti loke dṛṣṭatvāt--na yathedaṃ lokena gṛhyata iti
pratyakṣāpramāṇīkaraṇe sarvaviparyayāpattistarkataḥ--alomā hariṇaḥ, catuṣpāttve satyutplutya gamanāt, maṇḍūkavat
kiṃ tarhi ? anupahatendriyamanaḥpratyakṣaṃ yat tanna vyabhicaratīti gṛhyatām

tādṛśā ca pratyakṣeṇa loke ghaṭapaṭādiryathāsau yena prakāreṇa yena svarūpeṇa vyavasthitastathā gṛhyata eva svasthendriyamānasaiḥ, tatra tādṛśe'rthe punarvacanam idamevaṃ naivaṃ vetinaivaṃ ceti, pratyakṣaprasiddherbādhakamāpadyate yadi tad vacanaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt
na punastat pramāṇam, tayā prasiddhyā svayameva bādhyamānatvāt

prasiddhārthaṃ vacanaṃ na niyamādanuvādād vā anyatra pramāṇaṃ syādityato jñāpakamāha --anuvādādibhāvābhāve yaḥ siddhe sati ārambho niyamārthaḥ sa iti paribhāṣāyā loke dṛṣṭatvāt, lokavyavahārānuvādi vyākaraṇādiśāstramapi lokata eveti kṛtvā
kīdṛk punastad vacanam ? ityata āha --na yathedaṃ lokena gṛhyata iti
itiśabdaḥ pradarśane, idaṃ tadvacanaṃ prasiddherbādhakābhimatamiti pradarśyate

katham ? neti pratiṣedhe, yena prakāreṇa yathā, yathā mṛtpiṇḍadaṇḍacakrasūtrodakakulālaparispandanirvṛtto ghaṭaḥ pṛthukukṣyādisvarūpa udakādyāharaṇasamartha iti lokena cakṣurādibhirgṛhyate nāyamevaṃsvabhāvaḥ

kiṃ tarhi ? yathāhaṃ bruve sarvasarvātmakatvāt paṭakaṭarathādirūpo'pi, guṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyāśrayaḥ paramāṇvādyasmadatyantāparokṣapārthivadravyārabdhastadvyatirikto'vayavī, rathāṅgādivad buddhyā vibhajyamāno vibhajyamāno na paramāṇuṣu na rūpādiṣu na buddhimātre vā tiṣṭhati nirupākhyatvāditi vā, tathā tathā bhavatīti
śāstravidvacanaṃ mā bhūdanarthakamiti prasiddherbādhakamāpadyate iti nyāyyamucyate
saṃjñābhiprāyabhedāttu vivadante tapasvinaḥ || siddha॰ dvā॰ 20 | 4 iti
evaṃ ca sati ko doṣaḥ ? tatra pratyakṣāpramāṇīkaraṇe sarvaviparyayāpattistarkataḥ, sarvabhāvānāṃ pratyakṣapramāṇasiddhānāṃ viparyaya āpādayituṃ śakyate
tadyathā --alomā hariṇaḥ, catuṣpāttve satyutplutya gamanāt, maṇḍūkavat
bhramaro'pakṣaḥ, ṣaṭpāttvāt, pṛthivī avasudhā, padārthatvāt mahābhūtatvāt, ākāśavat
ākāra-gauravaraukṣyādidharmasambandhinī na bhavati, tata eva, tadvat
tathā bauddhamate'pi pṛthivī na bhūḥ, mahābhūtatvād rūpatvācca, jalavat; na kakkhaṭa-dhāraṇadharmā, tata eva, tadvat

evaṃ śeṣapadārthabhedeṣvapīti jalānalā- nileṣu vyomanīndriyādiṣu ātmādiṣu yathāprakriyaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ ca svarūpanirākaraṇam, asādhāraṇadharmanirākaraṇe ca padārthatvamahābhūtatvarūpatvādihetukāni sādhanāni yojyāni mahadahaṅkāratanmātrendriyaśabdādiṣu ātmani ca dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyeṣu saprabhedeṣu nāmarūpayoḥ saṃjñāvijñānavedanāsaṃskāreṣu kṣityudakajvalanapavaneṣu cakṣurādiṣu rūpādiṣu ca
dṛṣṭāntabhedāditi bhūmerākāśadṛṣṭāntavadākāśasya bhūmyādidṛṣṭāntena tathā jalāderapi parasparataste te dharmā nirākāryā itaramitarasya dṛṣṭāntaṃ kṛtveti
etaccihnāntargataḥ pṛthivyavasudhā ityata ārabhya na bhavati ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti
kharasvabhāvā na mahī, bhūtatvāt, tadyathā anila ityādiṣu hetvādyasiddhiḥ svata eva yojyā
śāstreṇa nirūpaṇaṃ śāstre nirūpaṇaṃ vā śāstranirūpaṇam

sandigdhaviparyastāvyutpannabuddhyanugra hārthaṃ hi śāstreṇa nirūpayanti santo vastu anugrāhyebhyaḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ--prakṛtipuruṣāveva, kṣaṇabhaṅgaḥ, vijñānamātrameva, dravyaguṇādi vā, iti śāstrasyāpavādatvācchāstreṇāpoditād viparītaṃ vastūcyamānamapramāṇam, śāstrasya sandehādyapavādatvāt
na hariṇādisvabhāvādi apramāṇam, tatra śāstreṇa moha eva vyāpāra iti tannirapavādaṃ hariṇasvarūpādi, tasya nirapavādatvāt tattu lokena yathā gṛhītaṃ tathaiva
yathā hi śāstraṃ ghaṭādivastu parikalpya apavādapravṛttaṃ tathā hariṇādisvarūpaṃ pratyakṣato lokaprasiddhamapyapavadati niraṅkuśatvāt
atra pūrvāparasandarbhānusāreṇa kiṃsthāne hi ityeva śuddhaṃ pratīyate
prācīnalipyāṃ kakārahakārayoḥ samānalekhadarśanāt hi ityasyaiva kiṃ iti vikṛtirjāteti pratibhāti
asmin pāṭhe tu na ūha eva ityarthaḥ syāt

athavā śāstranirūpaṇaviparītamapramāṇam, nirapavādatvāt iti vakṣyate, śāstranirūpaṇaṃ pṛthivīgandhavattvādi prakṛtipuruṣādi vā, tasya vā viparītaṃ tarkataḥ pratipādyamānamapramāṇam, pratyakṣatarkayo- sarvasyaivāpoditatvāddeśakālakṛtaviśeṣaikāntinaḥ
