sarvasarvātmakaikānte maṇḍūko'pi lomaśa eva, arthānarthaviṣayasāmānyaviśeṣanānātvaikānte'tadātmakatvāt raviṣayārthatvācchāstrasya kenāpodyate śāstram ? na hariṇasvarūpādi

śāstreṣvapi hi hariṇasvarūpādi pratyakṣasiddhamapodyata eva, kathaṃ nirapavādatvaṃ śāstrāṇām ? varaṃ hariṇasvarūpādiviparītapratipādanaṃ tarkataḥ tanmātrāpavādāt, tārkikaistu śāstreṇa sarvamapodyate pratyakṣato lokaprasiddhaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ ca

tat kathamiti cet, deśakālakṛtaviśeṣaikāntinaḥ, deśakṛtaḥ kālakṛtaśca viśeṣo deśakālakṛtaviśeṣaḥ, sa evaikāntaḥ, sa yasyāstyasau deśakālakṛtaviśeṣaikāntī, tasya vādinaḥ pratideśaṃ pratisamayaṃ ca sarvaṃ viśiṣṭameva na samānaṃ kiñcit
ato yāvadaṇuśo rūpādiśo vijñānamātraśo nirupākhyatvaśaśca bhedāt kuto hariṇaḥ ? kutastasya lomādyavatiṣṭhate ? ataḥ sarvamapoditam, kiṃ vā nāpoditam ? kiṃ vātra pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ceti ?
kiṃ vā nāpoditam iti pāṭho bhā॰ pratau nāsti
tathā sarvasarvātmakaikānte maṇḍūko'pi lomaśa eva, sthāvarasya jaṅgamatāṃ gatasya sthāvarasya sthāvaratāṃ jaṅgamasya sthāvaratāṃ jaṅgamasya jaṅgamatāṃ gatasya iti vacanāditi
nanu tena vādinā sarvaṃ samarthitam, nāpoditamiti cet, sarvasya sarvātmakatve sarvaikyāt kiṃ tat sarvam ? ityapoditameveti, bhinnārthasamūhavācitvāt sarvaśabdasya
tadyathā--dravyasya pṛthivyāderarthaviṣayaṃ sāmānyam --rūparasagandhasparśavatī pṛthivī vai॰ sū॰ 2
1, yatraitaccāturguṇyaṃ sā pṛthivī, rūpasparśarasadravasnehavatya āpaḥ, evaṃ yatra rūpasparśau tat tejaḥ, yatra sparśa eva sa vāyuriti sāmānyam
teṣāmevānarthasāmānyaṃ pṛthivītvam, tatsambandhalabhyatvāt pṛthivībuddhyabhidhānayoḥ, evamaptejovāyutvāni sāmānyāni, viśeṣāścetaretarebhyasta eva, svasāmānyabhedā vā viśeṣāḥ

tāni dravyāṇi guṇāḥ karma sāmānyāni viśeṣāḥ tatsamavāyalakṣaṇaśca sambandha ityete padārthā nānā, svatattva-prayojana-lakṣaṇa-matyabhidhāna kuto'ṇuhariṇamaṇḍūkakāraṇakāryadharaṇisaṃyogaguṇotplavanakarmabhavanavyāvṛttitathāsamavāyāḥ, dravyādīnāmitaretarānātmakatvādatyantamanyatvānnirmūlatvāt sarvathā tattvavṛttivyatītatvāt, khapuṣpavat; anyathā bālakumāravat

bhedāditi ye vadanti teṣāṃ tannānātvaikānte atadātmakatvāt kuto'ṇuhariṇamaṇḍūkakāraṇakāryadharaṇisaṃyogaguṇotplavanakarmabhavanavyāvṛttitathāsamavāyāḥ ? aṇugrahaṇena hariṇamaṇḍūkasamavāyikāraṇadravyagrahaṇaṃ paramatena

tasya hariṇamaṇḍūkādidravyasya dharaṇyāṃ saṃyogo guṇaḥ, utplavanaṃ karma, bhavanaṃ bhāvaḥ sattā, vyāvṛttiranyabhavanavilakṣaṇo viśeṣaḥ, teṣāṃ tathāsamavāyaḥ sambandha iti ṣaḍapyete padārthā vakṣyamāṇakhapuṣpadṛṣṭāntā na santi
kā tarhi bhāvanā ? nāsti paraparikalpitaṃ dravyam, guṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣānātmakatvāt, khapuṣpavat, tebhyo'- tyantamanyasvabhāvatvādvā
na dravyaṃ sat, aguṇakarmatvāt, khapuṣpavat; asāmānyaviśeṣātmatvāt, khapuṣpavat
na pṛthivī pṛthivī iti vyapadeśyā, pṛthivītvādatyantamanyatvāt, jalavat
pṛthivītvaṃ pṛthivītvam iti na vyapadeśyam, pṛthivyā atyantamanyatvāt, jalatāvat
evamekaikamapi itarānātmakatvāt khapuṣpavannāsti, itarasvarūpavad vā na svātmasvarūpamiti śeṣapadārthadṛṣṭāntabhedādāyojyamiti
dravyaṃ bhavyam, dravyaṃ ca bhavye pā॰ 5
104 iti vacanād bhavatīti bhavyaṃ dravyam, bhavanaṃ ca bhāvaḥ
na bhavati vā dravyam, bhavanasvarūpānāpatteḥ, vandhyāputravat
atra nānā, svasvatattva॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
matiḥ buddhiḥ ityarthapratyavekṣayā atra ॰matya॰ iti śuddhaṃ pratīyate
॰mitya॰ iti yathāśrutapāṭhe'bhirucau tu mānaṃ mitiḥ iti vyutpādya mitiḥ pramitiḥ yathārthā buddhirityartho jñeyaḥ
etadeva hi viśeṣāṇāṃ viśeṣatvaṃ yatte parato viśiṣyante
etadeva lakṣaṇaṃ bhedānāṃ saṃjñā-svālakṣaṇya-svatattva-prayojana-matibhedāt--iti viśeṣāvaśyakabhāṣyasya koṭṭāryagaṇivādimahattaraviracitaṭīkāyā hastalikhitapratau pṛ॰ 174-- 2
atra pūrvāparasandarbhaparyālocanena kuto'ṇuhariṇamaṇḍūkakāraṇakāryadharaṇi॰ iti pāṭha eva samīcīna iti pratīyate
atra vakṣyamāṇakhapuṣpadṛṣṭāntānna santi ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
etādṛśacihnāntargataḥ khapuṣpavat ityata ārabhya aguṇakarmatvāt khapuṣpavattvāt ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti
tulanā--aguṇākarmatvādibhyo hetubhyaḥ pūrvoktavadabhāva eva pṛ॰ 53 paṃ॰ 5
athavā kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvādasadeva kāryaṃ paścājjāyate iti, tannopapadyate, nirmūlatvāt, khapuṣpavat
evamaguṇatvād guṇādanye, asāmānyatvāt sāmānyādanye, aviśeṣatvād viśeṣādanye, akāraṇatvāt kāraṇādanyat, akāryatvāt kāryādanyad nāsti

tasya bhāvastattvam, tattvasya vṛttistadatattvena tatsvarūpānyasvarūpeṇa ca vṛttiḥ, hariṇādisvarūpaviparītoktau prasiddhiviruddhapratijñatvādevātathātvamiti cet, na, uktavat tulyatvāllokasya cāpramāṇīkṛtatvādevaṃ vacane'bhyupagamavirodhāt

lomaśālomaśaikye sapakṣāsapakṣāvṛttivṛttyoratarka iti cet, na, dṛṣṭāntasya yathā dravyameva vartate tathā tathā rūparasādiguṇasthitigatyādikriyābhavanavyāvṛttisambandhi, ekapuruṣapitṛputratvādidharmasambandhitvavaditi
khapuṣpavadityante dṛṣṭānta upadiṣṭaḥ sarvatra draṣṭavyaḥ, tathā ca yojitam

yadasti tat tadatatsvarūpatattvavyatītaṃ na bhavati, yathā bāla eva kumāraḥ kumāra eva ca bālaḥ, anyau ca tau avasthābhedāt, bālatvamūlaṃ kumāratvaṃ kumāratvānyacca bālatvamiti tadatattvarūpā tattvavṛttiḥ, tāṃ vyatītya na sa bālaḥ kumāro veti, sa ca saṃstattvavṛttivyatīto na bhavatīti
hariṇādisvarūpaviparītoktau prasiddhiviruddhapratijñatvādevātathātvamiti cet, na, uktavat tulyatvāllokasya cāpramāṇīkṛtatvādevaṃ vacane'bhyupagamavirodhāt
lomaśālomaśaikye sapakṣāsapakṣāvṛttivṛttyoratarka iti cet, na, dṛṣṭāntasya
kuto'ṇuhariṇamaṇḍūkakāraṇakāryadharaṇisaṃyogaguṇotplavanakarmabhavanavyāvṛttitathāsamavāyāḥ pṛ॰ 49 paṃ॰ 1 ityatra ullikhitā aṇudravyādayaḥ ṣaṭ padārthā atrābhipretā iti bodhyam

cedityāśaṅkāyām, syādāśaṅkā--hariṇasvarūpaṃ lomaśatvam, tasya vitathoktiralomā hariṇa iti, tasyāṃ vitathoktau prasiddhiviruddhā pratijñā yasya sa prasiddhiviruddhapratijñaḥ, tadbhāvaḥ prasiddhiviruddhapratijñatvam, tasmādeva atathātvamiti
yathoktam --śāstranirūpaṇaviparītamapramāṇaṃ nirapavādatvāditi, tenaitadapi tulyam— hariṇādisvarūpavitathoktau prasiddhiviruddhapratijñatvādeva atathātvam iti, atrāpi uttarasyāpi tulyatvāt
kathamiti cet, na, sarvasyaivāpoditatvādityādi sarvaṃ tadeva yāvat khapuṣpavat, anyathā bālakumāravaditi
kiñca, lokasya cāpramāṇīkṛtatvāttathā kutaḥ prasiddhivirodhaḥ ? kva vā tat prasiddhamiti
nanu bhavatāmekāntavādināṃ lokamapramāṇīkṛtya lokaprasiddhiviruddhapratijñatvadoṣāpādanamabhyupagamavirodhāya kalpate, tasmādayuktamevaṃ vaktumiti
atra ॰kṛtatvāttvayā kutaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ syāditi sambhāvyate
bhā॰ vinānyatra --evaṃ vane vi॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
syānmatam--pratijñādoṣadvāreṇa hariṇasvarūpādiviparītapratipādanāprāmāṇyaṃ na śakyate mayābhyupetavirodhāt, hetudoṣadvāreṇa śaknomītyata āha --lomaśālomaikye sapakṣāsapakṣāvṛttivṛttyoratarka iti cet

catuṣpāttve sati utplutya gamanād hariṇo nirlomā, lomaśo maṇḍūkaḥ ityubhayorubhaya pratyakṣaprasiddhiviṣayatvāllokasyāpramāṇīkṛtatvāt pratyakṣasya ca iheva tavaiva sarvatrāpi sapakṣāsapakṣavṛttyavṛttyorasattvāpatteḥ

aviśeṣaikānte tāvat kuto'nyapakṣo'sapakṣo dharmāpattau lomaśālomnoraikye sati ayaṃ heturdharmaparikalpakṛtādbhedād hariṇālomatve sādhye sapakṣe nirlomanyavṛtteḥ asapakṣe ca lomaśe vṛtterviruddho hetuḥ catuṣpāttve sati utplutya gamanāt ityāpadyate, sapakṣāsapakṣavartitvāt sādhāraṇānaikāntiko vā, lomaśālomaikye pakṣābhedād dharmābhede ca sapakṣāsapakṣābhāvādasādhāraṇānaikāntiko vā
cedityāśaṅkāyām, evaṃ cenmanyase, tanna, dṛṣṭāntasya pratyakṣaprasiddhiviṣayatvāt
dṛṣṭānto hi loke pratyakṣapramāṇaprasiddho ghaṭapaṭādirarthaḥ, tadviṣayaṃ ca sādhyasādhanasamanvayavyatirekavibhāvanam, sarvānumānasya sarvāvayavānāṃ ca tadbalena sādhyasiddhau sāmarthyasiddheḥ
pratyakṣatvācca tasya tadvad vastupratipatteraśeṣaṃ tava siddhāntadarśanamavabhotsyate
pratyakṣagrāhe ca sidhyati parokṣagrāhaḥ sidhyet, tadasiddhau sambhāva- nā'bhāva eva iti
dṛṣṭāntasyābhāve kuto dārṣṭāntikasādhyasādhanasamanvayavyatirekā iti pratyakṣanirākaraṇe tarkāsiddhireva, kutastarkātarkatvavicāraḥ ? iti tadavastho hariṇādisvarūpaviparītāpattidoṣaḥ
gamanād iti pāṭhaḥ sarvāsu pratiṣu nāsti
pratyakṣaprasiddhiviṣayatvāllokasyāpramāṇīkṛtatvāt pratyakṣasya ca iheva tavaiva sarvatrāpi sapakṣāsapakṣavṛttyavṛttyorasattvāpatteḥ

yathā hariṇasvarūpanirākaraṇe bhavān yaṃ yaṃ doṣaṃ mamāpādayati sa sa tavaiva, atra ca vīpsārtho draṣṭavyaḥ--tava tavaiva ekāntavādinaḥ, evakāro'vadhāraṇe, yathāsmin sādhane mama doṣo nāsti, tavaiva iti tvadabhyupagamānurūpyeṇopapāditaṃ tathā nātraiva, kiṃ tarhi ? sarvatrānyatrāpi pakṣahetudṛṣṭānteṣu doṣāstavaiva na mametyarthaḥ
apramāṇīkṛtatvāllokasya pratyakṣasya ca iti vartate, kāraṇāntaropanyāso'pyeṣo'bhidhīyate --sapakṣāsapakṣavṛttyavṛttyorasattvāpatteḥ
yadiṣṭaṃ bhavatāmanvayavyatirekābhyāmarthānumānam, tau ca sapakṣāsapakṣayorvṛttyavṛttī, tadbalena sādhyasiddhiḥ, tayoreva cāsattvamāpadyate
tatastasyāḥ sapakṣāsapakṣavṛttyavṛttyoryathāsaṅkhyamasattvāpatteḥ tavaiva aviśeṣaikāntavādino viśeṣaikāntavādinaḥ tadubhayānekatvaikāntavādino veti hetūddeśamātrametat

tadidānīṃ pratyekaṃ vidhīyate--tatra tāvadaviśeṣaikānte kuto'nyapakṣaḥ, asapakṣaḥ, vyāvṛttirvā ? aviśeṣaḥ sāmānyam, aviśeṣa eva ityekāntaḥ sarvaṃ sarvātmakamiti, tasminnaviśeṣaikānte tava grāhe kuto'nyapakṣaḥ, anyasya pakṣo'nyapakṣaḥ, prati vyāvṛttirvā, tattva eva tathābhivyakteḥ ? viśeṣaikānte kutastatpakṣaḥ sapakṣastatsattvaṃ vā, tathā'sthiteḥ ? ubhayānekatvaikānte sādhyasādhanadharmadharmiṇa eva kutaḥ, tathā'pūrvatvāt ? vādino'nyasyābhāvāt tavāpi cānyenāviśeṣāt sarvasarvātmakaikatvāviśeṣāt
athavā anyasya vacanasyābhāvāt tvadvacanātmakatvādeva sarvavacanānāṃ tvadanyavacanatvaviśeṣābhāvādeva vā

athavā kiṃ naḥ paravādivacanayorabhāvābhyupagama-niṣṭhuravacanābhyām ? anyaścāsau pakṣaścetyanyapakṣo'rtho'stu, sa kutaḥ, tvatpakṣasarvaikātmakatvādarthāviśeṣaikāntāt ? evaṃ nityaḥ śabdaḥ, akṛtakatvāt, ākāśavat iti vādino'nityaśabdapakṣavaktṛvacanavācyānāmabhāvaḥ
vāśabdāt kutaḥ svapakṣaḥ sapakṣaḥ tadvṛttirvā, sarvasarvātmakaikatvābhedādeva ? syānmatam--āvirbhāvatirobhāvayorabhūtvā bhāvād bhūtvā cābhāvādanityatvakṛtakatve sta eva aviśeṣavādino'pīti
tattvamekatvam, tasmiṃstattva eva tathā tena prakāreṇa tathā abhivyakteḥ

kimuktaṃ bhavati ? mṛda evābhinnāyā antarlīnāvirbhāvatirobhāvamātratvādaṅgulivakrapraguṇāvasthayoriva avasthāviśeṣābhivyakteḥ kimanyā mṛt sā piṇḍaśivakaghaṭādyavasthāsu ? tasmāt tattva eva tathābhivyakteḥ kuto'nyapakṣo'sapakṣo vyāvṛttistatpakṣaḥ sapakṣastatsattvaṃ ceti sādhūcyate--tavaiva aviśeṣaikāntavādinaḥ sapakṣāsapakṣavṛttyavṛttyorhariṇādisvarūpaviparītāpādanasādhaneṣviva asattvāpattiriti
atra pūrvāparapratyavekṣayā iheva iti pāṭha eva sādhurityābhāti
tulanā--iti sādhūcyate--tavaiva aviśeṣaikāntavādinaḥ sapakṣāsapakṣavṛttyavṛttyorhariṇādisvarūpaviparītā pādanasādhaneṣviva asattvāpattiriti--pṛ॰ 52 paṃ॰ 13
yaṃ yaṃ doṣaṃ yaṃ mamāpādayati bhā॰
viśeṣaikāntavādinaḥ iti pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti
vyāvṛttirvā, tattva eva tathābhivyakteḥ ? viśeṣaikānte kutastatpakṣaḥ sapakṣastatsattvaṃ vā, tathā'sthiteḥ ? ubhayānekatvaikānte sādhyasādhanadharmadharmiṇa eva kutaḥ, tathā'pūrvatvāt ?
atra tvatpakṣe sarvai॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

tathā viśeṣaikānte kutastatpakṣaḥ sapakṣastatsattvaṃ vā ? deśataḥ paramāṇuśo rūpādiśo vijñānamātraśo'nupākhyatvaśaśca bhedāt kālato'tyantaparamaniruddhakṣaṇādūrddhamanavasthānācca kutastatpakṣaḥ, atrāpi tasya pakṣo vakturvacanasya vā, sa eva pakṣaḥ ityartha eva vā, anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti dharmadharmiṇorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoścāsambhavāt
kutaḥ sattvaṃ tatra, tadabhāvāt kṛtakatvādisavikalpadharmāntarābhāvāt parasparavilakṣaṇanirvyāpāradharmamātratvāt sarvadharmāṇāṃ nirupākhyatvaśūnyatvaparamārthatvācca
tena prakāreṇa tathā kṣaṇikanirvyāpāraśūnyatvaprakāreṇa asthiteḥ kasyacidarthasyeti viśeṣaikānte'pi sarvatra sapakṣavṛttyādyasattvāpattiritthamiti
yathā pūrvaṃ vāśabdāt svapakṣa-sapakṣa-tadvṛttyabhāvo vivakṣitastathātrāpi vāśabdāt prativādipakṣāsapakṣavyāvṛttyabhāvo vivakṣita iti bhāvaḥ

ubhayamiti sāmānyaviśeṣau, tadubhayamanekaṃ bhinnaṃ parasparataḥ ityetasminnapyekānte sādhyasādhanadharmadharmiṇa eva kutaḥ ? sādhyasya tāvadanityatvasyābhāvaḥ, dharmamātrasya dṛṣṭāntābhyupagamāt pratyakṣapramāṇīkaraṇāllokatvāpatteḥ pratijñātavyāghātaḥ
śāstratvādalokatvamiti cet, na, lokāśrayatvāt teṣāṃ śāstrāṇām
tāni hi śāstrāṇi sāmānyaviśeṣakāraṇakāryamātrāṇāṃ sarvatrādhyāropeṇa praṇītāni
dharmiṇorapi śabdaghaṭayoḥ aguṇākarmatvādibhyo hetubhyaḥ pūrvoktavadabhāva eva
evaṃ tāvat sapakṣāsapakṣavṛttyavṛttiviparītatvāt tavaiva atarkatvadoṣo dṛṣṭāntabalāt tarkasiddherityaviśeṣaviśeṣobhayānekatvaikāntavādeṣūktā doṣāḥ
śāstratvādalokatvamiti cet, na, lokāśrayatvāt teṣāṃ śāstrāṇām
tāni hi śāstrāṇi sāmānyaviśeṣakāraṇakāryamātrāṇāṃ sarvatrādhyāropeṇa praṇītāni
kiñcānyat, dṛṣṭāntasya pratyakṣatvāt, anumānatvāddhetoḥ, upanayasya upamānatvāt, āgamatvāt pratijñāyāḥ, dṛṣṭāntābhyupagamāt pratyakṣapramāṇīkaraṇamāpannam
yathoktam --laukikaparīkṣakāṇāṃ yasminnarthe buddhisāmyaṃ sa dṛṣṭāntaḥ nyāyasū॰ 1
tathā loko dṛṣṭāntaḥ, tadviruddhaṃ yadabhidhīyate tad dṛṣṭāntaviruddhamiti
tataḥ ko doṣa iti cet, pratijñātavyāghātaḥ
kiṃ pratijñātam ? śāstranirūpaṇaviparītamapramāṇam, na hariṇasvarūpādi, nirapavādatvāditi, tadvyāhanyate śāstrapramāṇīkaraṇe, pratyakṣabalāllokasya pravṛttatvāt
syānmatam--nanūktaṃ śāstrakārāḥ svadṛṣṭārthapratipādanakuśalā buddhisaṃvādārthaṃ dṛṣṭāntaprāṇaistarkaiḥ śāstrārthān pratipādayanti, na punaḥ śāstrārthā loke pratyakṣīkartuṃ śakyāḥ

tāni hi śāstrāṇi, yasmādarthe hiśabdaḥ, yasmāt tāni sāmānyaviśeṣakāraṇakāryamātrāṇāṃ sāmānyamātrasya dadhni kāraṇamātrasya snehaśauklyāderdṛṣṭasya viśeṣamātrasya cārciṣṣu navanavotpādavināśarūpasya dṛṣṭasya sarvatrādhyāropeṇa praṇītāni

kṣīrasyaiva snehādisāmānyasya kāraṇākhyasya saṃsthānamātraṃ dṛṣṭvā dadhyādyavasthāviśeṣamantareṇa tasya sāmānyasya sthityabhāvamapaśyadbhiḥ yathedaṃ saṃsthānamātram, na kāryaṃ na viśeṣastathānye'pi ghaṭapaṭādayo'rthāstriguṇapradhānasaṃsthānamātram iti sarvatrādhyāropya tadarthāni śāstrāṇi praṇītāni kāraṇameva sāmānyameva sarvatra ityetasyārthasya pratipādanaprasaṅgena

tathā arciṣāṃ pratikṣaṇotpattivināśapārthakyāni dṛṣṭvā rūparasasparśagandhamūrttyādisāmānyāvasthānamantareṇa tadasambhavamapaśyadbhiḥ yathedaṃ viśeṣamātram, na sāmānyaṃ na kāraṇaṃ tathānye'pi mahīmahīdhrasaritsamudradvīpagaganatārānakṣatragrahagaṇādayo bhāvāḥ iti sarvatrādhyāropya tadarthāni śāstrāṇi tatpratipādanaprasaṅgavacanaracanāvibhaṅgataraṅgāpāratoyasamudrībhūtāni praṇītāni
anyatra dṛṣṭasyādhyāropād ghaṭatattvavadalaukikatvamiti cet, na, vyāmohasya mṛgatṛṣṇikādivadalaukikatvāttathā
tathāca tatra pratijñādīnāmapyanupapattiḥ, yadi yathā lokena gṛhyate na tathā vastu, pratijñā tāvad yathā gṛhyamāṇā aviśeṣāderna tathā syāt
yadatra ghaṭe ghaṭatattvaṃ pṛthukukṣyāvikukṣyādyākāraviśeṣastadanyatra ghaṭāntare'dhyāropyate, tacca nāsti adhyāropādeva
evaṃ śāstrāṇāmapyadhyāropādevālaukikatvamiti nāsti pratijñātavyāghātadoṣo yaṃ bhavān manyate lokatvāpatteriti
tena prakāreṇa tathā, satyam, bhavati tadalaukikamaviśuddhatvād mṛgatṛṣṇikādijñānavat
viśuddhalokasya na punarupapadyate, mṛgatṛṣṇikācadeva tasya vyāmohasyāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt
ūṣarabhūpradeśe graiṣmoṣmasantaptacakṣuṣo ravikiraṇāḥ patitāḥ pratyutpatanto dūrād vyāmohahetavastoyavadābhāsante

agre'pi kiñcidīdṛśa eva aśuddhaḥ pāṭha itthaṃ dṛśyate--ghaṭenaiva ghaṭaḥ kriyata iti mṛtpiṇḍaghaṭena ūrddhagrīvakuṇḍalauṣṭhapṛthithukukṣibudhnādighaṭaḥ kriyate prakāśyate, karoteḥ prakāśārthatvāt --nayacakravṛ॰ pṛ॰ 215-- 2
etadanusāreṇa atrāpi pṛthukukṣyā॰ iti śuddhaṃ sambhāvyate
yathāśrutāgrahe tu vikukṣyā॰ iti pāṭhaḥ kalpyaḥ, viśālā kukṣirvikukṣiḥ pṛthukukṣiḥ iti ca tadartho jñeyaḥ
na kevalaṃ śāstravijñānāprāmāṇyameva, kiṃ tarhi ? tena prakāreṇa tathā ca evaṃ ca kṛtvā tatra sati tasminnalaukike mṛgatṛṣṇikāvat pratijñādīnāmapyavayavānāmanupapattiḥ
katham ? yadi yathā lokena gṛhyate na tathā vastu

yadīti parābhyupagamaṃ darśayati, yadi pratipādanakauśalena pratipādanabuddhisaṃvādamātratvena dṛṣṭāntamupādāya yathāhaṃ yuktyopapādayāmi śāstreṇa ca tathā tad vastu na tu yathā lokena gṛhyate tatheti bhavato'bhiprāyaḥ
tatra pratijñā tāvad yathoktā gṛhyamāṇā aviśeṣāderna tathā syāt
aviśeṣaikāntavāde tāvat sarvasya sarvātmakatvāt nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñā yathā śrotreṇa gṛhyate na tathā bhavitumarhati

evaṃ viśeṣaikāntavāde'pi anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñā akāranikārādivarṇavijñānānāṃ deśakālakṛtātyantanānātvakṣaṇikatvaśūnyatvanirupākhyatvāt parasparāpekṣābhāve sarvabhāvābhāve ca yathā gṛhyate na tathā syāt

tataśceti tasmādeva hetorloke gṛhyamāṇasya viparītatvādaviśeṣaikānte tāvat pratyakṣavirodhaḥ, aṃśe bhāge, tasyaiva vastunaḥ aviśeṣaikāntavādiparikalpitasya pratyakṣopalabhyasya viśe pratyakṣavirodhaḥ, aṃśe svavacanavirodhaḥ, aṃśe'bhyupagamavirodhaḥ, svoktaviparyayarūpābhyupagamāt
atha tathā tato na tarhi lokagṛhītamanyathā
kiñcit tathā kiñcidanyathā unmattapratipattivaditi cet, evaṃ tarhi sākṣāllokapakṣāpattyābhyupagamavirodhaḥ, kiñcidgrahaṇāttathāgrahaṇādanyathāgrahaṇācca
aṃśe'bhyupagamavirodhaḥ, svaśāstre sarvatra prasiddhena pūrvakālābhyupagatena sarvātmakatvenādhunātanadharmadharmiviśeṣasya virodhāt
evaṃ viśeṣaikānte śrotrendriyagrāhyasya śabdasya tāvanmātrakālāvasthātuḥ pūrvottaravarṇasambandhatadbuddhyavasthānasopākhyatvapratyakṣatvāt pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
tathā ubhayānekatvaikānte prāgabhihitasādhanānyevātra vyāpāryāṇi adravyatvād vandhyāputravad nānityatvam, na śabdo'sti ityādisvarūpābhāvaḥ
acākṣuṣapratyakṣaguṇasya sato'pavargaḥ karmabhiḥ sādharmyam, sato liṅgābhāvāt vai॰ sū॰ 2
25--26 kāryatvāt kāraṇato vikārāt ityādiśāstravihitahetuvyākhyānārthaṃ pratipādanakāle tatprayogāt pratyakṣīkaraṇāccānityatvaśabdatvādyabhāvāt pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
atha tathā tato na tarhi lokagṛhītamanyathā
kiñcit tathā kiñcidanyathā unmattapratipattivaditi cet, evaṃ tarhi sākṣāllokapakṣāpattyābhyupagamavirodhaḥ, kiñcidgrahaṇāttathāgrahaṇādanyathāgrahaṇācca
bhā॰ vinānyatra --॰vyākhyātārthaṃ prati॰ pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰
athaite doṣā mā bhūvan vitathatvāśrayā iti tathaiva ityabhyupagamyate paraiḥ
syānmatam--kiñcillokena gṛhītaṃ tathaiva bhavati pratijñādi, kiñcidanyathā ghaṭādi, lokasyāparīkṣakatvāt
yathonmatto'parīkṣakaḥ padavākyapramāṇānabhijñaḥ kiñcit tathā pratipadyate kiñcidanyathā, tatpratipattiścāpramāṇaṃ sadasatoraviśeṣād yadṛcchopalabdheśca, tadvallokapratipattirapīti
kiñcittvādeva na sarvaṃ sarvātmakam, sarvāsarvatvasiddhiśca vibhāganirdeśāt kiñcit iti
evaṃ tena prakāreṇa tathā iti sa cānya bhedapadārthopādānācca na tathā iti punarnavo'bhyupagamavirodhaḥ
stayośca kaściddharmaḥ prakāravyapadeśabhāgeṣitavyaḥ, teṣu triṣvapi siddheṣu yasmāt tathā iti ghaṭate
evam anyathā ityapi, ayamanyasmādanyaḥ, anyaśca asmādanyaḥ iti sarvāsarvatvasiddherlokapakṣāpattiḥ
evaṃ viśeṣaikānte deśakālakṛtātyantabhedanirupākhyaśūnyatveṣu kiṃ tat syāt kiñcit iti vibhajya anyasmādavasthitādanavasthitamasadvānyaditi vocyeta vilakṣaṇamiti ? evaṃ tathā anyathā iti ca na ghaṭete
evamubhayānekatvaikānte pūrvavad dravyādīnāmitaretarānātmakatvāt sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ kāryakāraṇayorvā nirmūlatvādibhyo vā hetubhyo'sattvād vastunaḥ kiñcittathānyathā ityanupapatterlokapakṣāpattiḥ
unmatta iti ca dṛṣṭānto lokapakṣapātādṛte na sidhyati, utkṛṣṭo mada unmāda iti madāntarāpekṣo vimadatvāpekṣo vā nirdeśaḥ, sa ca laukika eva, tamabhyupagamya tannirācikīrṣava evonmattatarā iti
atra sākṣāllokapakṣāpattyābhyupagama॰ ityeva pāṭho yuktaḥ, ṭīkāyāṃ tathaiva vyākhyātatvāt
vada vyaktāyāṃ vāci pā॰ dhā॰ 1009 iti dhātoratra vivakṣāyāṃ tu pratistho yathāśrutapāṭho'pi sādhureva
67 iti sūtraṇasūtreṇa appratyayasya vidhānāt mada iti bhā॰ pāṭha eva sādhuḥ
madanaṃ madaḥ vyadhajapamadbhayaḥ siddhahema॰ 5-3-47 ityal --abhi॰ cintā॰ svo॰ 2
atra ca vi॰ pratipāṭhe ॰smā॰ ityata ārabhya ॰vilakṣā॰ ityantaḥ pāṭhāṃśo'gretanāt pṛ॰ 57 paṃ॰ 17 sthānāt utpatya iha āgataḥ sarvathā nirarthako'śuddhaḥ parityājya eva
idānīmekapadaviṣaya ucyate --bhedavadabhedapadārthopādānācca na tathā iti punarnavo'bhyupagamavirodhaḥ
bhedo'syāstīti bhedavān, nāsya bheda ityabhedaḥ, bhedavāṃśca abhedaśca sa eveti bhedavadabhedaḥ, ko'sau ? padārthaḥ vṛkṣa ityādiḥ svārtha-dravya-liṅga-saṅkhyā-karmādikārakarūpaḥ
yaduktaṃ krama-yaugapadyacintāyām— svārthamabhidhāya śabdo nirapekṣo dravyamāha samavetam
samavetasya tu vacane liṅgaṃ saṅkhyāṃ vibhaktiṃ ca
tatra svārtha iti jātirākāro vocyeta sva evārthaḥ svārtha iti so'nyāpekṣatvādanyena vinā na svaḥ iti syāt, ato dravyādisiddherbhedavān padārthaḥ
teṣāmeva ca svārthādīnāmatyantabhede'nyonyānātmakatvāt khapuṣpavadabhāvaḥ syāt, deśakālādyabhedopalabdheśca abhedasiddherabhinnaḥ padārthaḥ
tasmād bhedavadabhedapadārtha upāttaḥ padaṃ prayuñjānena śāstravidā svārthamātravādināpi
tathā dravye atha pratijñaivābhyupagamaḥ, tasyā lokāprāmāṇyāt
nanvaviśeṣādiṣvasataḥ pakṣāderupādānāllokābhyupagamāt lokavadeva cārthaḥ iti vyavasthāpya śabda- liṅge saṅkhyāyāṃ kārake kutsādau padārthe ca yojyaṃ krameṇa yugapadvā vācye
tamabhyupagamyāviśeṣavādino viśeṣavādina ubhayānekatvavādino vā na tathā iti tameva punarbruvato navo'bhyupagamavirodhaḥ
nava iti na svaśāstrābhyupagamena, kiṃ tarhi ? tatkālābhyupagamenetyarthaḥ
atra vṛkṣajātyādiḥ svārtha॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
samavetasya tu vacane liṅgaṃ saṅkhyāṃ vibhaktiṃ ca
samavetasya ca vacane liṅgaṃ vacanaṃ vibhaktiṃ ca
priyakutsanādiṣu punaḥ pravartate'sau vibhaktyantaḥ--iti pātañjalamahābhāṣye pāṭhaḥ
priyakutsanādiṣu tathā pravartate'sau vibhaktyantaḥ || pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 5 | 3 | 74
nanvaviśeṣādiṣvasataḥ pakṣāderupādānāllokābhyupagamāt lokavadeva cārthaḥ iti vyavasthāpya śabda-
apoddhāraparikalpanāvyavasthāmāśritya svārthamabhidhāyaśabdo nirapekṣo dravyamāha samavetam iti pratipattikramaniyamānugamamātraṃ kriyate
na hi śabdasya kramavatī viramya viramya svārthādiṣu vṛttiḥ sambhavati, sakṛduccāraṇādarthena ca nityamaviyogāt

sarvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ hi vastu saṃsargiṇīnāṃ mātrāṇāṃ kalāpaṃ yaugapadyena ekasyā buddherviṣayatāmāpannamuttarakālamicchan buddhyantaraiḥ pravibhajate--iti bhartṛhariviracitāyāṃ vākyapadīyasvavṛttau 1
syānmatam--na hi padaprayogaviṣayo'bhyupagamo'sti, padārthābhāvāt, padārthasya utprekṣāviṣayatvād vākyārthādhigamopāyatvena uddhṛtya vākyārthād vyākhyeyatvāt
vākyameva śabdaḥ, tadartha eva ca śabdārthaḥ
tataḥ tasyāḥ pratijñāyāḥ hetubhūtāyāḥ, tadbalādityarthaḥ, lokāprāmāṇyāt lokasyāpramāṇatvasiddheḥ
nityaḥ śabdo'kṛtakatvādākāśavat iti nityatve siddhe tadbalād nityānityādyanekarūpaikavastupratipattirloko'pramāṇībhavatīti
sarvaṃ sarvātmakam ityetasminnaviśeṣaikānte'bhyupagate punaḥ nityaḥ śabdaḥ ityasya pakṣasya taddhetordṛṣṭāntasya cābhāvaḥ pūrvoktebhyo hetubhyo nirviśeṣatvādibhyaḥ
tathā viśeṣaikānte pūrvoktahetubhya eva pakṣādīnāmabhāvo nirmūlatvādibhyaḥ
tasmādaviśeṣādiṣvasataḥ pakṣāderlokamatasiddhasyopādānālloka eva punarabhyupagato bhavati agatibhiḥ śāstravidbhiḥ

tasmāllokābhyupagamāllokaḥ pramāṇīkṛta eva kiñcidakiñcittathānyathā ityādiparasparavilakṣaṇavyavahārābhyupagamācca lokāprāmāṇyaṃ na sidhyatīti te yūyaṃ sudūramapi gatvā lokameva śaraṇaṃ gantumarhatha śāstravidaḥ
evaṃ śāstravyavahāro lokadarśanamantareṇa na sidhyatīti vākyaviṣayaḥ padaviṣayo vā tataḥ sākṣāllokapakṣāpattyābhyupagamavirodha ityuktaḥ
kasmāt ? lokavadeva cārtha iti vyavasthāpya śabdaprayogāt
lokena tulyaṃ vartate lokasyeva loka iva vā lokavat, evetyavadhāraṇe, kimavadhārayati ? loke'rthamavadhārayati nārthe lokam, śāstravidāmapi lokatvāt

pṛthaktve'pyarthalokayorubhayatra vāyamevakāro draṣṭavyaḥ--lokavadevārthaḥ arthavadeva loka iti, dvayorapi parasparāvyabhicārāt śāstravidāṃ lokapṛthaktve prayogāt tathāsatyatvasiddhe śabdārthe punaḥ na yathālokagrāhaṃ vastu iti virudhyeta svavacanena

itiśabdaḥ prakāre, anena prakāreṇa itthaṃ vyavasthāpya buddhyā abhyupagamya svaniścitārthapratipādanārthaṃ pareṣāṃ śabdaprayogāt, padāvadhiko vākyāvadhiko vā śabdaprayogavyavahāro lokānupātītthamiṣṭaṃ tairapi śāstrakāraiḥ

tatra ca tathāsatyatvasiddhe śabdārthe, tena prakāreṇa tathā, yena prakāreṇa mṛdrūpādipṛthukukṣyādike'rthe ghaṭaśabdo lokena prayuktastenaiva prakāreṇa satyatvena siddhe satyatvasiddhe loke śabdaṃ prayuñjānaiḥ śāstravidbhiḥ loko'bhyupagato'smābhiḥ ityuktameva bhavatyarthāt
tataḥ punaḥ na yathālokagrāhaṃ vastu iti virudhyeta
lokasya grāho lokagrāhaḥ, grāha iva grāhaḥ, yo yo lokagrāho yathālokagrāham
yathaivāgopālaprasiddhaṃ vastu bruvāṇo vādī yo yaḥ prayujyate mayā śabdaḥ sa sa na tathārthaḥ syāt ityanena svavacanenaiva viruddhamāha, svena vacanena tattadvacanaṃ virudhyeta
134, kathaṃ mukhaniṣṭhuraṃ virudhyata eva ityavadhāryocyate ? kathañcid virudhyeta iti dākṣiṇyamācāryaḥ svakaṃ darśayati
prayogāt tathāsatyatvasiddhe śabdārthe punaḥ na yathālokagrāhaṃ vastu iti virudhyeta svavacanena
rūḍhivirodho lokavirodhaḥ, sa tu prastuta eva
tadavirodhe'pravṛtteḥ, tena lokena avirodhe śāstrāṇāmapravṛtteḥ, tasyā rūḍheḥ śabdaprayogādevābhyupagatāyā virodhamanupapādya śāstrāṇāmaviśeṣaviśeṣobhayānekatvaikāntapratipādanārthānāmapravṛtteḥ
kathamapravṛttiḥ ? tāni rūḍhamevārthamanubrūyuḥ, arūḍhaṃ vā vyutpādayeyuḥ ? yadi rūḍhamanuvadanti, vyarthāni
athārūḍhaṃ vyutpādayanti rūḍhivirodhinamartham, virudhyanta eva lokena niḥsaṃśayamiti sādhūcyate --tadavirodhe'pravṛtterlokavirodhaḥ prastuta eveti
kiñcānyat --lokāprāmāṇye ca śāstrakārāṇāṃ sarvatra pade pade vākye vākye pratyakṣānumānavirodhāvupasthitāveva
tatra tāvat aṃśe pratyakṣavirodha ityādyabhihitaṃ pūrvam, idānīṃ sarvatra pratyakṣavirodho vācya iti viśeṣaḥ
anumānavirodho vā noktaḥ so'bhidheyaḥ, tadanuṣaṅgeṇa punaḥ pratyakṣavirodhavacanaṃ ca tatpūrvakatvādanumānasyeti
evetyavadhāraṇe, na na bhavataḥ, bhavata evetyarthaḥ
tayoḥ tasmi~lloke sthitatvāt pratyakṣānumānayoḥ lokaścedapramāṇaṃ lokasthe pratyakṣānumāne prāgevāpramāṇe
athavā sa eva sthitastatsthaḥ, supi sthaḥ pā॰ 3
4 iti vacanāt, loka eva prāmāṇyena vyavasthitaḥ
sa eva lokaḥ pratyakṣānumānajñānādhāratvāt tadrūpāpatteśca pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca, tatastadaprāmāṇye tayoraprāmāṇyamiti
syānmataṃ bhavatām--kathaṃ pramāṇajyeṣṭhaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na pramāṇīkriyeta ? iti
tatra vaḥ sampradhāramimaṃ prayacchāmi--tadapi ca pratyakṣamevaṃ kalpyaṃ śāstravadevetyādi
śāstre jñāte'pi tadvihitakriyāsādhyatvāttadiṣṭaphalasya kriyāyāścāvyabhicārājjñāne, yathoktam— jānānāḥ sarvaśāstrāṇi cchindantaḥ sarvasaṃśayān
na ca te tat kariṣyanti gaccha svargaṃ na te bhayam
tasmāt jñānaṃ phalasyāvyabhicāri kāraṇaṃ kriyāsādhanavādino'pi, kimaṅgaṃ punarjñānamātrasādhanavādinaḥ ? iti tadeva vicāryate --śāstravadevetyārabhya yāvad vyañjanakāya iti

śāstra iva śāstravat, yathā śāstre'bhihitāḥ padārthā atyantavilakṣaṇāstathā pratyakṣamapi laukikapratyakṣavilakṣaṇaṃ tathānumānaṃ cāstu, tayorapyalaukikatvakalpanārthaṃ pratyakṣānumānayorapyalaukikatvasya kalpanārthaṃ lakṣaṇāntaraṃ kalpyam

kiṃ tat ? sāmānyaviśeṣaikāntasaṃvādi, sāmānyaṃ ca viśeṣaśca sāmānyaviśeṣau, sāmānyaviśeṣau ca sāmānyaviśeṣau ca sāmānyaviśeṣā ityekaśeṣaḥ sarūpatvāt sāmānyameva, na viśeṣaḥ; viśeṣa eva, na sāmānyam; tau parasparavilakṣaṇau vā iti ta eva ekāntā laukikapadārthavilakṣaṇāḥ śāstreṣu kalpitāḥ
ghaṭa ādiryasyāḥ kalpanāyāḥ sā ghaṭādikalpanā ghaṭasaṅkhyotkṣepaṇasattāghaṭatvādyadhyāropāt, tasyāḥ tataḥ kalpanāyā apoḍhaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kalpanīyam

syādāśaṅkā-- kalpanāpoḍhaṃ pratyakṣaṃ viśeṣaikāntavādina eva mataṃ netarayoḥ, tayoḥ kathamalaukikatvamiti cet, atrocyate— yat tāvad viśeṣamātraṃ svalakṣaṇaviṣayamanirdeśyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tat kalpanāpoḍhatvādalaukikaṃ tat sāmānyānātmakatvāt khapuṣpavadasaditi siddham
tathā viśeṣānātmakatvāt khapuṣpavat sāmānyamātraṃ sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ kalpanāpoḍhaṃ vastu tadasat, asattvāt tajjñānamapi tadvat
yadyapi sāmānyaviśeṣavyapāśrayaṃ lakṣaṇamabhihitam --śrotrādivṛttiḥ pratyakṣam ṣaṣṭita॰, ātmendriyamano'rthasannikarṣād yad niṣpadyate tadanyat vai॰ sū॰ 3
18 ityādi, tathāpi sāmānyaviśeṣaikāntavādināṃ balāt tadeva kalpanāpoḍhamalaukikaṃ cetyāpannam, tasya cobhayātmakatvābhyupagame pratijñāhāniḥ

athavā tenaiva dūṣitatvāt kastau hatau haniṣyati ? iti tasyaivopari badhyate parikara ityanenābhiprāyeṇa pūrvameva tāvattatparikalpitapratyakṣalakṣaṇamupanyasya dūṣayitukāmaḥ sūrirityalamatiprasaṅgena
evaṃ tāvat kalpitameva bhavatsiddhānte kiṃ sampradhāraṇayā atra--iti vakṣyate paramatopanyāsānte'traiva nayacakravṛttau pṛ॰ 62 paṃ॰ 26
na ca te tat kariṣyanti gaccha svargaṃ na te bhayam || iti
ātmendriyārthasannikarṣād--iti mudrite vaiśeṣikasūtre pāṭhaḥ, kintu apapāṭha eva saḥ
vyaktā tadātve yā buddhiḥ pratyakṣaṃ sā nirucyate
prakṛtamucyate --atha kā kalpanā yayāpoḍhaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣamiti ? atrocyate --nāma-jāti-guṇa- kriyādravyasvarūpāpannavastvantaranirūpaṇānusmaraṇavikalpanā
nāma saṃjñā śabdaḥ ityanarthāntaram, taddvārikā kalpanā
nimittanirapekṣaṃ nāma yādṛcchikaṃ ḍittho ḍavitthaḥ ityādi

tatra gauḥ iti jātyā śuklaḥ iti guṇataḥ matublopādabhedopacārādvā viśeṣaṇasvarūpāpannaṃ tato viśeṣaṇādanyad vastu tayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorabhedasambandhanātmikayā kalpanayā pūrvaṃ manasā nirūpyate paścādanusmaryate
tathā ḍitthādiṣvapi asyedam, so'yam iti vā bhinnayorarthābhidhānayorabhedasambandhanayā nirūpaṇānusmaraṇe, śabdārthayornimittanaimittikayorbhinnayorabhedādhyāropāt
kriyāśabdeṣu pācakaḥ ityādiṣu nābhedopacāraḥ abhinnarūpatvāt kriyākriyāvatoḥ, ato na nirūpaṇaṃ kintu anusmaraṇameva
tathā dravyaśabdeṣu saṃyogasamavāyanimittād daṇḍī, viṣāṇī ityādiṣu
cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpaṃ ca ālokaṃ ca bāhyaṃ samanantaraniruddhaṃ manaḥsaṃjñitaṃ cittaṃ cittāntarāvakāśadānātmakaṃ pratītya cakṣurvijñānamutpadyate, caturbhiścittacaittāḥ abhi॰ ko॰ 2
tathāpi ca adhipatinā cakṣuṣā vyapadiśyate cakṣurvijñānam iti, asādhāraṇakāraṇatvāt, yathā yavāṅkura iti bījartuvārimārutākāśasaṃyoge satyapīti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? pratyātmasaṃvedyatvāt, ātmānamātmānaṃ prati pratyātma, pratyātmanā saṃvedyate nānyasmai śakyamākhyātuṃ śūlādivedanāsvarūpavat
yāvṛttikī vi॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
bhā॰ vinānyatra ॰kāyā kalpanayā pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ vi॰
yaccāsādhāraṇaṃ tadvyapadeśabhāg bhavati, tadyathā--ṛtvādikāraṇāt prādurbhavannaṃkuro na ṛtvādibhirvyapadiśyate, api tvasādhāraṇena bījena vyapadiśyate yavāṅkuraḥ iti
yasmājjñāne eva kalpanāsaṃsargo'sti tasmāt tatpratiṣedhena tadeva pratīyate
yathā avatsā dhenurānīyatām iti vatsapratiṣedhena godhenureva pratīyate, nānyā
kalpanāpratiṣedhācca jñānasya sāmarthyalabdhatvāt, avatsā dhenurānīyatāmiti yathā vatsapratiṣedhena godhenoḥ --tattvasaṃ॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 367
rvijñānasamaṅgī nīlaṃ vijānāti no tu nīlam itiabhidharmāgamo'pi
prakaraṇapāde'pyuktam— nīlaḥ sa nāma nīlaṃ na nīlārtho'nakṣaraḥ sa ca
etasyaivārthasya bhāvanā tu--arthe'rthasaṃjñī, na tvarthe dharmasaṃjñī abhi॰ pi॰
nīlaḥ sa nāma nīlaṃ na nīlārtho'nakṣaraḥ sa ca
cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī nīlaṃ vijānāti no tu nīlam iti abhidharmāgamo'pīti viśvastameva laukikapratyakṣavilakṣaṇaṃ kalpyamānamacīkḷpaḥ, tavāgamo'pyevameveti darśayati
cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī cakṣurvijñānasamanvayī santānaḥ, agi ragi lagi gatyarthāḥ pā॰ dhā॰, cakṣurvijñānaṃ samaṅgituṃ śīlamasyeti cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī, evaṃ śrotrādivijñānasamaṅginaḥ
nīlaṃ vijānāti, rasādiviviktaṃ rūpaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ vijānāti
no tu nīlam iti vijānāti, itiśabdasya śabdaparyāyatvāt idaṃ tad nīlam iti śabdanirdeśyaṃ na vijānāti, apaṭutvādindriyavijñānasya kutaḥ śaktirevaṃ kalpayitum

128 ukha 129 ukhi 130 vakha 131 vakhi 132 makha 133 makhi 134 ṇakha 135 ṇakhi 136 rakha 137 rakhi 138 lakha 139 likhi 140 ikha 141 ikhi 142 īkhi 143 valga 144 ragi 145 lagi 146 agi 147 vagi 148 magi 149 tagi 150 tvagi 151 śragi 152 ślagi 153 igi 154 rigi 155 ligi gatyarthāḥ--iti pāṇinīyadhātupāṭhe
nīlaḥ sa nāma nīlaṃ neti ślokaḥ
yadetannīlametaditi nāmnā nirdeśo nīlamasya nāma etannirūpaṇavikalpakṛtam
na nīlārthaḥ nīlasya rūpasya vastunaścakṣurindriyaviṣayasya paramārthaḥ svarūpato'nakṣaraḥ akṣarairvyañjana-pada-nāmakāyairanabhilapanīyaḥ

sa ca puruṣo nirūpaṇakāle svayaṃ niścinvannanusmaraṇakāle vānusmaran paraṃ pratipipādayiṣan vā nīlamiti vācaṃ bhāṣamāṇo nīlasyārthamanabhilāpyasvarūpaṃ svajñānāṃśavadavikalpaṃ na paśyati, tadā tatsvarūpaviṣayasyāvikalpasya nīlārthavijñānasya ca niruddhatvāt tadānyasya nīlaśabdābhilāpyasyādhyāropitasya sāmānyasya indriyagocarānāgateḥ
tasya śarīrabhūtasya ṣaṭ pādāḥ --prakaraṇapādo vijñānakāyo dharmakāyaḥ prajñaptiśāstraṃ dhātukāyaḥ saṃgītiparyāya iti
sa nāma nīlaṃ ti stokaḥ padetannī॰ya॰
sa nāma nīlaṃ ti stokaḥ padetannī॰ bhā॰
bhavati eṣo'rthaḥ, taṃ bhavantaṃ bhava bhava iti buddhau bhāvayati yayā vyākhyayā sā bhāvanā
kā punaḥ sā ? arthe'rthasaṃjñī, na tvarthe dharmasaṃjñīti
etasya bhāvanāvākyasya punarvyākhyā --arthe rūpādike pratyakṣavijñānaviṣaye svarūpasaṃjñī, arthasvarūpaviśeṣamātrālambanayā saṃjñayā nirvikalpayā samprayuktaṃ svalakṣaṇaviṣayamasya santānasyeti
evamabhidharme uktam--dharmo nāmocyate nāmakāyaḥ padakāyo vyañjanakāyaḥ
svavacanavyapekṣākṣepadustaravirodhapari- rūparasagandhaśabdaspraṣṭavyalakṣaṇe svarūpasaṃjñī rūpādimātrasaṃjñī, saṃjānātīti saṃjñī, svarūpasaṃjñā asyāstīti vā svarūpasaṃjñī

kimālambanā sā saṃjñā kiṃsvarūpā vā yayā samprayuktaṃ tat pratyakṣaṃ rūpādicittaṃ nirvikalpaṃ caitasikyā samprayuktakadharmākhyayā yogāt saṃjñayā saṃjñītyucyate tatsantānaḥ ? ityata āha --arthasvarūpaviśeṣamātrālambanayā nirvikalpayā saṃjñayā samprayuktamiti gatārthaṃ vyākhyātatvād bhāṣyeṇa
tadeva svalakṣaṇaviṣayam, svameva viśeṣa eva lakṣaṇam, lakṣyata iti lakṣaṇam, kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam pā॰ 3
asya santānasyeti cakṣurvijñānasamaṅginaḥ, cakṣurvijñānavat cakṣurādipañcavijñānakāyā vyākhyātā itthaṃ kalpanāpoḍhā iti pradarśyate
yat punaruktaṃ kalpanātmakaṃ jñānaṃ na tat pratyakṣam, arthasvalakṣaṇāviṣayatvāt, gavi aśvajñānavat iti sādhanam
itaśca savikalpakaṃ nīlamidam ityādijñānaṃ na pratyakṣam, viśeṣaṇādhyāropāt, utpalādhārasurabhyādijñānavaditi
iti parisamāptyarthaḥ, arthe'rthasaṃjñī ityetasya vyākhyānamiti parisamāptam
ḍe॰līṃ॰ vinānyatra --bhāvanāt tuśabdo bhā॰ pā॰ vi॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
svarūpasaṃjñī, arthasvarūpaviśeṣamātrālambanayā saṃjñayā nirvikalpayā samprayuktaṃ svalakṣaṇaviṣayamasya santānasyeti
evamabhidharme uktam--dharmo nāmocyate nāmakāyaḥ padakāyo vyañjanakāyaḥ
itiḥ pradarśane pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
atra yat punaruktakalpanātmakaṃ ityapi pāṭhaḥ sambhavet
na tvarthe dharmasaṃjñī ityasya vyākhyā --na tvarthe
neti pratiṣedhe, tu viśeṣaṇe, tamarthamadhyāropaviśiṣṭaṃ pratiṣedhati
tasminneva rūpādike'rthe na tu yadṛcchādināmasaṃjñī yadṛcchā-jāti-guṇa-kriyā-dravyaśabdasaṃjñī, dharmaśabdasya śabdaśabdārthaparyāyatvāt dharmasaṃjñī na bhavati śabdasaṃjñī na bhavatītyarthaḥ
naiṣā svamanīṣikocyate, kiṃ tarhi ? evamabhidharma uktam abhidharmapiṭake'bhihitam
kimuktam ? dharmo nāma ucyate nāmakāya ityādi
nāmaiva nāmakāyaḥ, kāyavat pratikṣaṇaṃ śarārutvāccaturbhūtasaṅghātatvācca nāmnāṃ vā vijñānādīnāṃ saṅghātatvāt, saṃjñāśabdānāṃ kṣaṇikānāmapi saṃhatānāmeva utpattivināśābhyupagamāt
yathoktam— varṇo gandho rasaḥ sparśaścatvāro'pi ca dhātavaḥ
atra nāmaiva kāyo nāmakāyaḥ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
varṇo gandho rasaḥ sparśaścatvāro'pi ca dhātavaḥ
evaṃ tāvat kalpitameva bhavatsiddhānte, kiṃ sampradhāraṇayā atra ? idānīṃ paramārtho vicāryate— kalpitamapi tu idamaphalamityādi

kasmādalaukikatvamiti cet, svavacanavyapekṣākṣepadustaravirodhapari- hāraṃ tvaduktivadevedamapratyakṣam, kalpanātmakatvānnirūpaṇavikalpātmakatvādālambanaviparītapratipattyātmakatvādadhyāropātmakatvāt sāmānyarūpaviṣayatvāt tadatadviṣayavṛttitvāt sadasadabhedaparigrahātmakatvāt sarvathā sādhāraṇārthatvādeḥ, anumānādijñānavat

yasmāt svaṃ vacanaṃ svavacanaṃ pratyakṣalakṣaṇavādino dinnabhikṣoḥ, svavacanasya svavacane vā vyapekṣā pratyavamarśaḥ svavacanavyapekṣā, saiva ākṣepaḥ, tena ākṣepeṇa dustaro virodhasya parihāro'syeti svavacana vyapekṣākṣepadustaravirodhaparihāram, svenaivaitadvacanena paurvāpareṇa pratyavamṛśyamānena virudhyate sadāhaṃ maunavratiko'smi, pitā me kumārabrahmacārī ityādivacanavat, na tu asmadupapattivad dūṣyamidam, tadarthe dṛṣṭāntamāha --tvaduktivadevedam, yatheyaṃ tvaduktiḥ kalpanātmikā satī na pratyakṣaṃ tathaivedamapratyakṣamiti pratijñā
atredaṃ tatsādhanārthamabhidhīyate dharmāntaram--tat kalpanātmakaṃ nirūpaṇavikalpātmakatvāt, idam ittham iti jñānaṃ nirūpaṇam, sa eva vikalpaḥ, tadātmakaṃ tat pratyakṣaṃ ghaṭatvādijñānavaditi
tatrālambanaṃ dravyasanto nīlādiparamāṇavo na tatsamūho nīlapītādyākāravān, saṃvṛtisattvāt
tasyāpi nīlapītādyākārasya pratyekaṃ tāratamyavattvāt yathā pratipattirna tathālambanamityālambanaviparītapratipattyātmakaṃ tat
yadālambanaviparītapratipattyātmakaṃ na tat pratyakṣam, yathā sthāṇau puruṣapratipattiriti
syānmatam— dravyasatāmevāṇūnāṃ nīlapītādyākāratvānna viparītā pratipattiriti, etaccāyuktam, ākārasya adhyāropā- tmakatvāt, māṇavake siṃhatvādhyāropavat
sa cādhyāropita iti kuto gamyate ? sāmānyarūpaviṣayatvāt

sa ca asaśca viṣayastadatadviṣayau, tatra vṛttirasyeti tadatadviṣayavṛtti tad jñānam, anekaparamāṇusamūhajatvāt tasya samūhe teṣu ca vṛttatvāt, samūhasya asattvāt samūhināmeva dravyasatāmaṇūnāṃ sattvāt tayośca abhedena nīlādyākāraparigraheṇa jñānotpatteḥ
uktaṃ ca— guṇānāṃ paramaṃ rūpaṃ na dṛṣṭipathamṛcchati
uktaṃ vo'bhidharme eva--sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ, rūpādiparamāṇorekasyāsañcitasyālambanasya ghaṭanīlādiṣvabhāvāt

tasmāddhetupārampaṇa kalpanātmakatvasiddherekaikasmādvoktahetorapratyakṣamidaṃ kalpanāpoḍhalakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ jñānam, anumānādijñānavaditi, yathā anumānādijñānaṃ kalpanātmakatvādapratyakṣaṃ tathā bhavateṣṭamindriyajñānam

hāraṃ tvaduktivadevedamapratyakṣam, kalpanātmakatvānnirūpaṇavikalpātmakatvādālambanaviparītapratipattyātmakatvādadhyāropātmakatvāt sāmānyarūpaviṣayatvāt tadatadviṣayavṛttitvāt sadasadabhedaparigrahātmakatvāt sarvathā sādhāraṇārthatvādeḥ, anumānādijñānavat

atra etādṛśacihnāntargato yaḥ tatrālambanaṃ i ārabhya nīlapītādyākāratvānna ityantaḥ pāṭhastatsthāne sarvāsvapi ya॰ pratiṣu evaṃvidhaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate --yathā pratipattiriti syānmataṃ dravyasatāmevāṇūnāṃ nīlapītādyākāravān saṃvṛtisattvāt tasyāpi nīlapītādyākārasya pratyekaṃ tāratamyavattvāt yathāpratipattiriti syānmataṃ dravyasatāmevāṇūnāṃ nīlapītādyākāratvānna
ayaṃ ya॰ pratisthaḥ pāṭhaḥ khaṇḍitatvāt paribhraṣṭatvāt kvaciddvirbhūtatvāccāsaṅgata iti parityā eva
yat tu dṛṣṭipathaprāptaṃ tanmāyeva sutucchakam || ṣaṣṭita॰ iti
uktaṃ vo'bhidharme eva--sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ, rūpādiparamāṇorekasyāsañcitasyālambanasya ghaṭanīlādiṣvabhāvāt
smārtābhilāṣikaṃ ceti tadābhāsaṃ sataimiram || pra॰ samu॰ 1 | 8 iti
yasmāduktaṃ vo'bhidharma eva abhidharmapiṭaka eva buddhavacane'bhihitam --sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyā iti
nityaṃ samprayuktakadharmairyuktatvād rāgādibhiḥ kāyā ityucyante pañca cakṣurādivijñānāni

rūpādiparamāṇorekasya asañcitasya anyaiḥ samānajātīyairasaṅgatasya ālambanasya viṣayasyendriyabuddhigrāhyatvasya ghaṭādiṣu ghaṭapaṭarathādiṣu nīlādiṣu rūparasagandhasparśabdeṣu tadguṇeṣu pratyakṣābhimateṣu saṃvṛtisatsu abhāvāt sañcitāṇughaṭanīlādyākāra eva gṛhyate cakṣurādibhiḥ
tasyāṃ cāvasthāyāṃ paramāṇutvena avasthānam ārhatān pratyasiddham, pariṇāmāntarāpattyabhyupagamāt
laukikānāṃ tu sthūlakāryānumitatajjātīyasūkṣmakāraṇamātrasambhāvanam--santi kecit sūkṣmā bahavaḥ sthūlasya kāraṇabhūtāḥ paṭasyeva tantava iti
sambhāvitānāṃ tathāsambhāvane'pi teṣāṃ saṅghāta-pariṇāmābhyāmṛte cākṣuratvādyabhāvo lokavyāptāṇuvat, ato'tīndriyatvādālambanatvānupapattiḥ
ataścālambanatvānupapatterdravyasatāṃ paramāṇūnāmetat pratipattavyam --cakṣurādivijñānānāṃ rūpādiparamāṇusaṅghāta eva ālambanamiti

tataḥ kimiti cet, tataḥ pratyekamālambanaparamāṇūnām, ālambanārthāḥ paramāṇava ālambanaparamāṇavaḥ, teṣāṃ paramārthasatāmeṣām, ta eva hi paramārthasanto na samūho nīlādirghaṭādiśca saṃvṛtisattvāt, bhavatsiddhāntenaiva aviṣayatā paramāṇūnām
tatra prativiviktarūpāntarāviviktasvatattve rūpasaṅghāte indriyasannikṛṣṭe ālambanaviparītā yeyaṃ pratipattiravyapadeśyaikātmakanīlarūpaviṣayā nanu hetvapadeśavyapadeśyaiva sā
yataḥ sañcayagrahaṇāpadeśena vyapadeśyaṃ dhūmenevāgniriva gṛhyate tato'nyat kalpitamekaṃ sāmānyaṃ nīlarūpaṃ taddvāreṇa
tatra prativiviktarūpāntarāviviktasvatattve, pratyekaṃ viviktāni rūpāntarāṇi pratiparamāṇu vā rasādibhedena vā, teṣāmeva rūpāntarāṇāmaviviktaṃ svatattvaṃ yasya so'yamaviviktasvatattvaḥ

tasmin rūpasaṅghāte indriyasannikṛṣṭe svaviṣayyābhimukhyena upasthite ālambanaviparītā paramārthata ālambanabhūtebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ nīlam iti vā ghaṭaḥ iti vā yeyaṃ pratipattiḥ sā viparītā, tadagrahe tadbuddhyabhāvāt, balākāsu paṅktijñānavat, avyapadeśyaikātmakanīlarūpaviṣayā, vyapadeśyānekaparamāṇvālambanebhyo'nyo'vyapadeśya eka ātmā asyeti avyapadeśyaikātmakam, kiṃ tat ? nīlarūpam, tad viṣayo'syā iti avyapadeśyaikātmakanīlarūpaviṣayā abhimatā pratipattiḥ iti vartate
saiva vā pratipattiravyapadeśyā ekātmakānekaparamāṇunīlarūpaviparītaikanīlarūpaviṣayā, tadvyākhyānārthamabhidharmapiṭake bhavatāṃ yathocyate --nīlaṃ vijānāti, no tu nīlam iti
nāvyapadeśyā sā pratipattirityabhiprāyaḥ, taṃ pradarśayati --nanu hetvapadeśavyapadeśyaiva sā
yasmāduktam --heturapadeśo nimittaṃ liṅgaṃ pramāṇaṃ kāraṇamityanarthāntaram vai॰ sū॰ 9
na cāvaśyaṃ śabdābhidheyameva vyapadeśyam, kiṃ tarhi ? yadyadarthāntareṇādhigamyate tattadvyapadeśyam, arthāntarasya hetvapadeśanimittādiparyāyatvāt
tavāpi ca yataḥ sañcayagrahaṇāpadeśena nimittāntarajanyami- ndriyajñānamiṣṭaṃ tasmād vyapadeśyaṃ tat
tathā coktam --sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ abhi॰ pi॰ iti, na sañcayālambanā iti

etasyārthanidarśanārthamudāharaṇamāha --dhūmeneva agniriva gṛhyate, yathā dhūmena arthāntarabhūtena agniratra iti jñānamutpadyamānaṃ vyapadeśyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathaitadapi nīlarūpādiviṣayaṃ cakṣurādivijñānaṃ paramāṇubhirarthāntarairjanitatvād vyapadeśyam

tata eva yathā vyapadeśyaṃ tathā dhūmādagniriva tad nīlarūpaṃ tataḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ paramārthasadbhyaḥ anyat kalpitamakalpitebhya ekaṃ bahubhyaḥ sāmānyaṃ viśeṣebhyaḥ, na sākṣādindriyairavyavahitaṃ gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi ? vyavahitamevārthāntaraiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ taddvāreṇa paramāṇudvāreṇa gṛhyate, na svata eveti

atra yadyapi ya॰ pratiṣu ekātmikā॰ iti pāṭha upalabhyate tathāpi pratipatterekātmakatvasya ālambanaviparītapratipattitvāsādhakatvāt ekātmakanīlarūpaviṣayatvasyaiva tatsādhakatvācca ekātmakāneka॰ ityeva pāṭho'tra samīcīna iti bhāti
nanu ca sañcayasya kārakahetutvenāpadeśaḥ pratyakṣapratipatterna dhūmavajjñāpakahetvapadeśatayā agnerivārthāntarasyaikarūpatvasya

nanvidamasyaivārthasya pradarśanārthaṃ prastutamasmābhiḥ, yadīdaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt kārakādeva svārthādālambanāddhetorjāyeta dāhānubhavanavat pratyakṣatvādavyavahitapratipattyātmakatvāt pratyakṣasya svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvādanadhyāropātmakatvāditi yāvat
nanvityanujñāpane, caśabdaḥ prasiddhabhedasamuccaye, nanvidaṃ prasiddham--anyaḥ kārako heturanyo jñāpaka iti

tasmādaṇūnāṃ tatsañcayasya nīlasya ca kārakasambandhād dhūmasyāgneśca jñāpakasambandhāt pratyakṣānumānapratipattyorvaiṣamyamataḥ sādhyadharmavaikalyaṃ dṛṣṭāntasya iṣṭavighātād viruddhatā hetoriti vākyārthaḥ
naitadaniṣṭamasmākaṃ na vā sādhyadharmavaikalyaṃ yat sañcayasya jñāpakatvaprasaṅgāt pratyakṣapratipattestaddoṣadvayamasmān pratyāpādyeta

taducyate --yadi bhavanmatamidaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt, kārakādeva niṣpādakādeva cakṣurādivijñānasya nīlapītādeḥ svārthābhimatādālambanabhūtāddhetorjāyeta sañcayākhyāt saṃvṛtisataḥ, na paramārthasato'ṇvāderapi syāt, bhavati tu

421 avyavahitapratipattyātmakatvāt pratyakṣasyeti tasyaivopacayahetuḥ, arthāntareṇāvyapetasyārthasya grāhakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā dāhānubhavaḥ, tathā tasya svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvāt pratyakṣasyārthāntaranirapekṣatā syāt, na punarastīti svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvādanadhyāropātmakatvāditi yāvat, sarvatrārthāntarādhyāropavṛttyarthāntaraheyatayotpannaṃ na jñānamiti yāvaduktaṃ bhavati tāvaduktaṃ bhavati svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvādavyavahitapratipattyātmakatvāt pratyakṣatvādityādi
evaṃ tāvat kārakatāṃ sañcayasyābhyupagamya doṣa āpāditaḥ
atra arthāntarādhyāropavṛtti arthāntaraheyatayotpannaṃ na jñānam ityarthaḥ pratibhāti
arthāntaraheyatayā arthāntaragamyatayetyarthaḥ, hi gatau pā॰ dhā॰ 1258 iti hidhātorgatyarthatvāt sarveṣāṃ gatyarthānāṃ ca jñānārthatvāt
arthāntaranimittagrāhyaṃ cāpratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭam paṃ॰ 23 iti ca vakṣyate
kārakatāpi ca sañcayasya naiva tasya, paramārthato'sattvādalātacakravat pratyavayavavyavasthānamātratvāt
lokavattu sañcayasattve viśiṣṭo'padeśo vyapadeśo grāhyādanyaḥ, tena vyapadeśena vyapadeśyaṃ prameyamanumeyaṃ na pratyakṣam, dhūmānumitāgnivat,
idānīṃ kārakatāmapi dūṣayitukāma āha --kārakatāpi ca sañcayasya naivāstiṃ tasyeti pratijñā, paramārthato'sattvāditi hetuḥ
yathoktam— yasmin bhinne na tadbuddhiranyāpohe dhiyā ca tat

yathā ulmukaṃ bhramad bhrāntadṛṣṭeścakravadābhāti, na taccakramasti, agnikaṇānāṃ nairantaryābhāvāt, cakrasya para- mārthato'sattvācca cakravijñānasya akārakatā evaṃ sañcayasya saṃvṛtisattvānnīlavijñānasya akārakatā

itaśca sañcayasya akārakatā, pratyavayavavyavasthānamātratvāt, avayavamavayavaṃ prati pratyavayavam, avayavā nīlādiparamāṇavaḥ, teṣāmeva saṃhatyaikatra parasparāsattyā vyavasthānamātraṃ sañcayo na tebhyo'rthāntaramiṣṭaṃ bhavatām
ataḥ paramārthato nāstyevāsau sañcayo nāma kaścit
yasmin bhinne na tadbuddhiranyāpohe dhiyā ca tat
atra tat iti abhidharmakośe pāṭhastathaiva ca vyākhyāto vasubandhunā tadbhāṣye

nayacakravṛttikṛtāmapi tat iti pāṭha eva sammataḥ, yatastaireva asya ślokasya vivaraṇāvasare itthaṃ vyākhyāsyate--yasmin ghaṭe bhinne'vayavaśo na tadbuddhirbhavati tad ghaṭavat saṃvṛtisat --nayacakravṛ॰ pṛ॰ 66-- 1
ghaṭāmbuvat saṃvṛtisat paramārthasadanyathā || abhi॰ ko॰ 6 | 4 iti

abhyupetyāpi sañcayasya sattvaṃ doṣaṃ brūmaḥ --lokavattu sañcayasattve, yathā lokasya avyutpannasyāpi samudāyivyatirekeṇa sanneva avayavī pariṇāmāntaraṃ tatsamudāyo vā yo'stu so'stu parairvyutpāditaḥ sannevāsau tantupaṭādiṣu buddhi-śakti-kāryā-'bhidhāna-saṅkhyādibhedadarśanādiṣṭaḥ, tatrākṣarārthānusāreṇa vyapadeśo'styeveti gṛhyatām
tataśca avyapadeśyo viṣayaḥ pratyakṣasya, pratyakṣaṃ cāvyapadeśyam ityubhayamanṛtam
tat kathamiti cet, viśiṣṭo'padeśo vyapadeśa iti viśabdasya viśiṣṭārthatām apadeśaśabdasya hetvarthatāṃ ca darśayati
kuto'nya iti cet, ucyate --grāhyādanyaḥ, grāhyo nīlādiḥ, tasmādanyaḥ sañcayastadvyapadeśaḥ
tena sañcayena vyapadeśena hetunā vyapadeśyam, kiṃ tat ? prameyaṃ nīlādi tvadabhimatapratyakṣapramāṇagamyam
kiṃ bhavati tannīlādirūpam ? anumeyaṃ prāpnoti, vyapadeśavyapadeśyatvāt, na pratyakṣam
tasya jñeyasyāsmādeva hetoḥ pratyakṣatvābhāvo'numeyabhāvaśca sādhyate, tadvajjñānasya apratyakṣatā anumānatā ca sādhyate
yathā dhūmena vyapadeśena sādhito'gni kārakatāyāmakārakatāyāṃ vā vastunaḥ pitṛdhūmādivat
abhidhānāvyapadeśyataikātmakatve api ca naiva, anumitāgnivad bahuviṣayatvād nīlasya
taddhi nīlarūpanirūpaṇaṃ vikalpaḥ, pratiparamāṇuparasparapratibhinnasvatattvāneka- ranumeyo'pratyakṣaśca tathā nīlarūpam
yathā ca dhūmālambanotpāditāgnijñānamanumānamapratyakṣaṃ ca tathā nīlajñānaṃ saṃyogotpāditamiti
abhidhānāvyapadeśyataikātmakatve api ca naiva, anumitāgnivad bahuviṣayatvād nīlasya
kiñcānyat--sarvathā tad nīlādijñānaṃ tena sañcayena vyapadeśyaṃ tadavinābhāvāt tasya, kārakatāyāmakārakatāyāṃ vā na kaścid viśeṣo vyapadeśyatvasiddhau vastunaḥ
kutaḥ ? arthāntaranimittādeva, pitṛdhūmādivat, yathā pitā putrasya janakaḥ, tena vyapadiśyate kārakeṇa putraḥ dhūmena jñāpakena agniḥ, aviśiṣṭatvādvastunaḥ
tatastulye vyapadeśyatvahetau apratyakṣatvānumānatvasādhanasamarthe satyavyapadeśyanirodhako'yamanarthako vicāraḥ kārako jñāpaka iti kārakatvamabhyupetyāpyeṣa doṣo'bhihitaḥ
evaṃ tāvadarthakṛto'sya nīlasya vyapadeśaḥ siddho yatsiddherapratyakṣānumeyatve siddhe
yadapīṣṭam--abhidhānato na vyapadeśyaṃ tannīlādiparamāṇurūpaṃ paramāṇusamūhābhedādekaṃ ceti, ete dve abhidhānāvyapadeśyataikātmakatve api ca naiva sto nīlarūpasya iti pratijñā
dṛṣṭānto'numitāgnivaditi pratipattisaukaryāt prāgeva hetordṛṣṭānta uktaḥ, tadbalāvayavasiddheḥ
yathā dhūmajñānānumito'gnirabādivinivṛttyupalakṣito deśakālādibhedabhinno'pi abhidhānavyapadeśyo'nekātmakatvāpanna eva gṛhyate tathā nīlārtho'pi syād bahuparamāṇuviṣayatvāt, tathā jñānamapīti
tadbalā cāsau avayavasiddhiśceti tadbalāvayavasiddhiḥ iti samāse yathāśrutapāṭhaḥ saṅgacchate
tadbalādavayavasiddheḥ ityapi sambhavedatra pāṭhaḥ, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 51 paṃ॰ 9
idānīṃ prāgabhihitakalpanātmakatvādibhirhetubhiranumānāt pāpīyastvaṃ tasya pratyakṣasya pratipādayitukāma āha --taddhi nīlarūpanirūpaṇamityādi

taditi prāgapadiṣṭaṃ vikalpātmakatvam, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmānnīlarūpasya nirūpaṇamuktanyāyena arthavyapadeśena śabdavyapadeśena vā dṛṣṭam, sa ca vikalpa evetyavikalpakatvaṃ nāsti, ataḥ kalpanāpoḍham iti duṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ jñānārthayoḥ
adhyāropācca nirūpaṇaṃ tasya, tat kathamiti cet, ucyate --pratiparamāṇu paramāṇuṃ paramāṇuṃ prati pratiparamāṇu parasparataḥ pratibhinnāni svāni tattvāni

yo yasya bhāvaḥ sa tasya tattvam, na so'nyatra bhavati, bhavanameva hi tattvam, ato vibhinnāni pratiparamāṇu tattvāni, ekaikasya paramāṇoḥ paramāṇvantarebhyo'tyantabhinnaṃ svaṃ tattvam, bhāvāntaramanapekṣya rūpaikatattvaikarūpādhyāropād rūpāntarasāmānyarūpaviṣayatvāt tadatadviṣayavṛttatvādatadanapohād nāgnyanumānavat tatsāmānyātmakataiva, prajñaptiparamārthasthitasañcayaparamāṇuparigrahābhedātmakatvāt sarvathā sādhāraṇārthatā, kalpanātmakatvānna pratyakṣam, apratyayapratyayātmakatvāt, śabdāśrāvaṇatvapratyayavat
saṃvṛtyatīndriyatvābhyāṃ hi svarasenaiva bhavanād bhāvānāmekavacadasādhāraṇabhavanatvāt paramāṇūnāṃ svāni tattvāni bhinnāni

teṣāṃ ca svatattvānāṃ teṣāṃ ca nīlādisvarūpāṇāmanekarūpāṇāmekadvitriguṇādibhinnānāṃ yathāsaṅkhyam ekatattvaikarūpādhyāropāt sarvaparamāṇutattvānāmekasvatattvādhyāropāt sarvaparamāṇurūpāṇāmekanīlarūpādhyāropādarthāntaranirūpaṇam

sa cāpyadhyāropo rūpāntarasāmānya- rūpaviṣayatvāt, rūpādanyad rūpaṃ rūpāntaram, paramāṇurūpāt paramāṇvantararūpaṃ rūpāntaram, evaṃ sarvāṇi paramāṇvantararūpāṇi, teṣāṃ rūpaṃ nīlamityabhedena yat sāmānyaṃ buddhyā gṛhyate so'dhyāropastadviṣayaḥ
tadapi sāmānyaṃ tadatadviṣayavṛttatvāt sāmānyamityucyate, sa cānyaścārtho viṣayo'syeti kṛtvā
tasmādatadanapohāt pratyakṣamaviviktaviṣayaṃ svaviṣayābhimate'nyatra cāparityāgena abhedena ca vṛtteḥ, nānumānaṃ svaviṣaye sāmānyamātra eva vṛtteḥ
tasmād nāgnyanumānavaditi tat agnyanumānatulyamapi tanna bhavati, apohyārthāpohaśaktiśūnyatvāt
tasmāt tatsāmānyātmakataiva gnyanuagnyanumānasya, na pratyakṣasyeti tasya nīlāderarthasya pratyakṣaviṣayasya tajjñānasya ca tadavasthā saṅkīrṇarūpatā

rūpaikatattvaikarūpādhyāropād rūpāntarasāmānyarūpaviṣayatvāt tadatadviṣayavṛttatvādatadanapohād nāgnyanumānavat tatsāmānyātmakataiva, prajñaptiparamārthasthitasañcayaparamāṇuparigrahābhedātmakatvāt sarvathā sādhāraṇārthatā, kalpanātmakatvānna pratyakṣam, apratyayapratyayātmakatvāt, śabdāśrāvaṇatvapratyayavat
atra bhāvānāmekavadasādhāraṇabhavanatvādasādhāraṇabhavanatvāt paramāṇūnām ityapi pāṭhaḥ ya॰ pratipāṭhānusāreṇa sambhāvyate
ekaikavat sarveṣāṃ paramāṇūnāmatyantabhinnaṃ svatattvamityabhidhātum asādhāraṇabhavanatvādasādhāraṇabhavanatvāt iti vīpsayā prayoga iti bhāti
athavā bhāvānām, evaṃ cāsādhāraṇabhavanatvāt paramāṇūnām ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt
yathā pratyakṣamaviviktasvaviṣayaṃ tathā nānumānamaviviktasvaviṣayam, svaviṣaye sāmānyamātre eva vṛtteḥ ityāśayo'tra bhāti
prajñaptisan sañcayaḥ, paramārthasantastu tathāsthitāḥ paramāṇavaḥ, teṣāṃ parigrahaḥ sadasadabhedātmakaḥ, tasmāt sadasatparigrahābhedātmakatvāt tadatadviṣayavṛttatā
sā ca sarvathā sādhāraṇārthatā, sarvathā eteṣvanantarokteṣu hetuṣu

tato mūlahetuḥ kalpanātmakatvāt iti sa evaitaiḥ sādhitaḥ, tasmānna tat pratyakṣaṃ na cānumānavadasaṅkīrṇasvaviṣayamityetadarthabhāvanārthāḥ punasta eva hetavo vyāpāritāḥ pratyekamapi pūrvavadetasminnarthe yojyāḥ
pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ heturityarthaḥ, na pratyayo'syeti apratyayaḥ, nāṇuṣu na sañcaye pratyayatā tathāpratipattiṃ prati
anumānajñānamapi ca tanna pratipūryate sambaddhagṛhītasyānyathāpratipatteḥ, viruddhādijñānavat

tiṣṭhatu tāvat pratyakṣavidhividhānābhyupagamena svalakṣaṇamātraviṣayapratyakṣatvasya ko'sau ? pratyayaḥ, pratyayo vijñānam, dvitīyasya pratyayaśabdasya vijñānārthatvāt, akāraṇajñānatvādityuktaṃ bhavati

kathaṃ punarakāraṇaṃ tajjñānam ? saṃvṛtyatīndriyatvābhyāṃ yasmānnāṇuṣu na sañcaye pratyayatā tathāpratipattiṃ prati, dravyasatāmaviṣayatvāt tasya, dravyasanto hi paramāṇavo'tīndriyatvādeva na pratyakṣajñānahetavaḥ; tathā nīlatvādayaḥ saṃvṛtisantaḥ, tatsañcayo'sattvādeva akāraṇam
tasmādubhayathāpi apratyayaḥ sa pratyayaḥ nīlaṃ rūpam iti
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? yathā aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratyayo'pratyayo'pratyakṣaṃ ca tathedamapīti
nāṇuṣu na sañcaye pratyayatā tathāpratipattiṃ prati
anumānajñānamapi ca tanna pratipūryate sambaddhagṛhītasyānyathāpratipatteḥ, viruddhādijñānavat
syānmatam--kalpanātmakatvādibhya eva hetubhyo'numānajñānaṃ tarhi cakṣurādivijñānaṃ bhaviṣyatīti

karmakartaryātmanepadaṃ yak ca, tatpratiṣedhād na pratipūryate iti rūpam, yathā'yamodano vipannatvāt pūtimāṃsavadātmānaṃ na bhojayati na bhujyate svayameva tathedamapi jñānamātmānaṃ na pratipūrayati na pratipūryate
sambaddha eva gṛhītaḥ, tasya sambaddhagṛhītasyānyathāpratipatteḥ, tasya jñānasya anyathāpratipadyamānasambaddhagṛhītārthatvādityarthaḥ
yad jñānaṃ sambaddhamevārthaṃ gṛhṇat tamevārthamanyathā pratipadyate tad jñānaṃ nānumānamapi sampūrṇaṃ bhavati

yathā kṛtakatvānnityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pakṣadharmajñānaṃ śabdasambandhi ghaṭādiṣvanityānugamasambaddhaṃ gṛhītvā nityaṃ śabdaṃ pratipadyamānaṃ viruddhahetvābhāsajñānaṃ bhavati, ādigrahaṇāt prameyaśrāvaṇatvadvāraṃ nityajñānaṃ vā śabdaviṣayamanaikāntikābhāsaṃ yathā tathedamapi na sampūrṇamanumānajñānamapīti
karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā karmavat syāt, kāryātideśo'yam, tena yagātmanepadaciṇciṇvadiṭaḥ syuḥ
athavā tiṣṭhatu tāvadityādi yāvat pratyakṣaviṣayatvābhyupagamavirodha iti
sthitaṃ tāvadastu vidūrasthena āgamenābhyupagatena pratyakṣaviṣayatvasya virodha ityetat
idamevāsmin prakaraṇe yadudāhṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī ityādi tadeva na ghaṭata iti vākyārthaḥ
pratyakṣasya vidhiḥ pratyakṣasya janma, tasya vidhānaṃ vyākhyānam --sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ abhi॰ pi॰ iti, sa eva abhyupagamaḥ pratyakṣavidhividhānābhyupagamaḥ

svalakṣaṇamātraviṣayapratyakṣatvameva, svalakṣaṇamātraṃ viṣayo yasya tat svalakṣaṇamātraviṣayam, kiṃ tat ? pratyakṣam, tasya bhāvaḥ svalakṣaṇamātraviṣayapratyakṣatvam, tasya pratyakṣavidhi- virodhaḥ pratyakṣaviṣayatvābhyupagamavirodhaḥ
cakṣurvijñānasamaṅginīlavijñānam ityetadeva tu na ghaṭate pratyakṣalakṣaṇodāharaṇam
evaṃ te sañcayasya rūpamātratvāt tadgrahaṇe tatpratyakṣatvāt sañcitālambanakalpanāvaiyarthyādatanmātratve saṃvṛtisattvādarūpatvācca cakṣurnaiva cakṣuḥ syāt, ubhayathāpi rūpāgrāhitvāt, ghaṭādivat

cakṣuṣaḥ cakṣuṣi cakṣuṣā vā viśiṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ vijñānamasādhāraṇaviṣayam, tat samaṅgati samanvetīti cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī, kaḥ ? santānaḥ, vijñānasya tadarthaikagamanāt taddvāreṇa tatsantāno'pi samaṅgatītyucyate
tadeva pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍhamanirdeśyaṃ svalakṣaṇaviṣayam ityādi vacanaṃ tena lakṣitasya udāharaṇam idaṃ tat iti pratyakṣīkaraṇaṃ pradarśanam, yathā vṛddhirādaic pā॰ 1
atra pratyakṣatvam, evaṃ svalakṣaṇamātraṃ viṣayo yasya ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
cakṣurvijñānasamaṅginīlavijñānam ityetadeva tu na ghaṭate pratyakṣalakṣaṇodāharaṇam
evaṃ te sañcayasya rūpamātratvāt tadgrahaṇe tatpratyakṣatvāt sañcitālambanakalpanāvaiyarthyādatanmātratve saṃvṛtisattvādarūpatvācca cakṣurnaiva cakṣuḥ syāt, ubhayathāpi rūpāgrāhitvāt, ghaṭādivat
naḍādiṣu parigaṇitāt aśvalaśabdāt naḍādibhyaḥ phak pā॰ 4
99 iti sūtreṇa phakpratyaye vihite taddhiteṣu acāmādeḥ pā॰ 7
kathaṃ tanna ghaṭate ? tata āha --evaṃ te sañcayasyetyādi yāvat sañcitālambanakalpanāvaiyarthyāditi
evaṃ te udāharaṇatveṣṭau satyāṃ sañcayasya rūpamātratvāt, kiṃ bhavati ? sañcitālambanakalpanāvaiyarthyaṃ syādityabhisambhantsyate

rūpamātratvaṃ sañcayasya kuta iti tadgrahaṇe tatpratyakṣatvāt, yadgrahe yasya pratyakṣatvaṃ tat tāvanmātrameva dṛṣṭam, yathā dāhagrahe dāhapratyakṣatve dāhamātrameva nāto'nyo'rtha iṣṭa evaṃ sañcayagrahe nīlarūpamātrameva
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti na rūpamātraṃ sañcayaḥ, sa eva ca gṛhyata itīṣyate, tataḥ sañcayasya saṃvṛtisattvādarūpatvaṃ kharaviṣāṇavat
arūpatvācca na cakṣurgrāhyaḥ syāt sañcayaḥ, rūpādanyatvāt, śabdavat khapuṣpavadvā
tataḥ ko doṣa iti cet, ucyate --cakṣurnaiva cakṣuḥ syāt, rūpasyāgrāhakatvāt, ghaṭavat jihvāvat tvagvadityādi
kathaṃ rūpasyāgrāhakaṃ cakṣuḥ iti dṛṣṭa-prasiddhiviruddhamucyata iti cet, tavaiva dṛṣṭaprasiddhivirodhāvāpādyete mayā
yadi sañcayastathāpyasannarūpa evetyuktatvādacakṣurviṣayo rūpam, tato rūpasyāgrāhakatvāccakṣuracakṣuḥ śrotravat
athāsañcitameva paramāṇunīlarūpamiṣṭaṃ tathāpyatīndriyatvādacakṣurviṣayo rūpam, ato rūpasyāgrāhakatvācca cakṣurna ca cakṣuḥ syāduktavaditi sūktam--ubhayathāpi rūpasyāgrāhakaṃ cakṣuriti
vijñānamapi na vijñānaṃ syāt, anyathārthapratipatteḥ, alātacakrādijñānavat
yadapi ca tadrūpaṃ tadviṣayamapi cakṣurvijñānasya samaṅganaṃ nāsti, aviṣayatvāt, anyendriyaviṣayavat
nīlavijñānasambandhī na bhavati tatsantānaḥ, tadākārajñānotpattihetvabhāvāt, adagdhasya dāhājñānavat
vijñānagrahaṇamapyata evānarthakamityata āha --vijñānamapi na vijñānaṃ syādityādi yāvat khapuṣpavaditi

viśeṣeṇa jñānaṃ vijñānaṃ tadbhavadabhimataṃ pratyakṣaṃ mukhyaṃ vijñānaṃ na syāt, itarathā kathamācāryaśrīmallavādī 'vijñānaṃ na syāditi svavacanavirodhaṃ māyeya-dinnāviva brūyāt ? kiṃ kāraṇaṃ punarvijñānaṃ tanna syāt ? anyathārthapratipatteḥ, arūpasya sañcayasya rūpatvena pratipatteḥ sañcayatvena vā rūpamātrasya pratipatteḥ
yatholmukāgnikaṇamātramārthaṃ cakram iti pratipadyamānaṃ na vijñānamevaṃ tadapi
evaṃ tāvaccakṣuriti vijñānamiti ca dvayaṃ dūṣitam
cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī ityatra samaṅgitvamapi dūṣayitukāma āha --na ca cakṣurvijñānaṃ samaṅgatīti, taddvāreṇa puruṣākhyasantānaikagamanaṃ samaṅganaṃ tatastanniṣedhaḥ
kasmānna samaṅgati ? cakṣurvijñānasya rūpādanyatrāsambhavāt, na vā tatsantāno'nyatra sambhavati, uktaṃ hi --sati sambhave vyabhicāre ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ iti
sañcayāpekṣo vyabhicāro'styato viśeṣyata iti cet, tanna, yasmānna sañcayo rūpam

abhyupetyāpi tvanmatena yadapi ca tadrūpam, rūpata iti rūpyamrūpyata iti rūpam, cakṣurvijñānena kila rūpyata iti, tadviṣayaṃ sa viṣayo yasya tat tadviṣayam, kiṃ tat ? ekagamanam, kasya ? cakṣurvijñānasya, tadapi nāsti
anyendriyaviṣayavat, yathā śabdo'nyendriyaviṣayaścakṣurvijñānena na samaṅgyate tathā tadapi rūpamiti
syānmatam--sañcayaścakṣurvijñānasaṅgatiyogyaḥ syāditi, atra brūmaḥ --sañcayaviṣayamapi cakṣurvijñānasya samaṅganaṃ nāsti iti vartate
evaṃ tāvad rūpam, cakṣuḥ, vijñānam, samaṅgī ityetāni dūṣitāni
idānīṃ nīlam, vijānāti iti ca dūṣyam
tatra nīlaṃ padārthato dūṣitameva, vijānātīti ca dūṣitameva padārthataḥ, rūpacakṣurvijñānānāṃ saṅgateśca dūṣitatvāt
mā bhūdakṣarasthānaṃ dūṣaṇaśūnyamiti kṛtvā vākyārthato'pi dūṣyate --nīlavijñānasambandhī na bhavati tatsantānaḥ, tadākārajñānotpattihetvabhāvāt
sa ākāro'syeti tadākāraṃ jñānaṃ nīlākāram, tasyotpattistadākārajñānotpattiḥ, tasyā hetuḥ sañcayo nīlarūpaṃ vā syāt, ubhayamapi tanna bhavatyuktavidhinaiva, atastadākārajñānotpattihetvabhāvāt
nīlaṃ ca sañcayaṃ ca pratyekasamuditakāraṇatvād vijñāsyatīti cet, na, yugapajjñānāsambhavāt, jñānasya kriyāvaidharmyāt

tataśca yathātra sandrāvāt sarvanīlaikatā ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? adagdhasya dāhājñānavat, yathā adagdhasya dāhānubhavajñānaṃ tadākārajñānotpattihetvabhāvānnāsti tathā nīlavijñānasambandhī na bhavati tatsantāna iti
nīlaṃ ca sañcayaṃ ca pratyekasamuditakāraṇatvād vijñāsyatīti cet, na, yugapajjñānāsambhavāt, jñānasya kriyāvaidharmyāt

idānīṃ pratyekaṃ ta eva samuditā ityubhayaikaviṣayatve doṣaṃ vaktukāmaḥ pakṣāntaraṃ grāhayati --nīlaṃ ca sañcayaṃ ca pratyekasamuditakāraṇatvādvijñāsyatīti cet, syānmatam--ta eva hi nīlaparamāṇavaḥ pratyekaṃ śibikodvāhanyāyena samuditāśca kāraṇaṃ na caikaikaḥ, na ca samudāyastadvyatirikto'stītyubhayakāraṇatvaṃ jñānasya, tasmājjñānotpattihetvabhāvāsiddhiriti
jñānaṃ ca pratyakṣamucyate, kalpanāyā jñānāvyabhicārāt, pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍhaṃ yajjñānamarthe rūpādau nyāyapra॰ iti vacanāt
ekamarthaṃ vijānāti na vijñānadvayaṃ tathā || catuḥśa॰ 268 iti
ātmapratyāyanārthaṃ tu pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca dve eva pramāṇe
tatra pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍhaṃ yajjñānamarthe rūpādau nāmajātyādikalpanārahitaṃ tadakṣamakṣaṃ prati vartata iti pratyakṣam--nyāyapra॰ pṛ॰ 7

yadyapi syāt tayorekajñānatvādekajñeyatvam, ekaṃ jñānamanayorityekajñāne, tayorekajñānatvāt ekameva jñeyaṃ tadbhāva ekajñeyatvaṃ dāhānubhavavat, tasminnekajñeyatve itaretaratve anyonyātmāpannatve sati sarvasarvātmavāditā
katham ? samudāyānarthāntaratvād rūpaṃ samudāya eva samudāyasvarūpavat, samudāyo vā rūpameva rūpānarthāntaratvād rūpasvarūpavat

tasmāt sarvaparamāṇunīlānāṃ sañcayānarthāntaratvādaikye sati samavāya- grahaṇe yuvatikeśapāśasamudāye gṛhyamāṇe, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmāt sarvanīlaikyaṃ tasmādekameva nīlaṃ rūpamekakeśagataṃ gṛhyeta, ekamekaṃ prati pratyekaikanīlagrahaṇaṃ syāt, ekanīlavālagrahaṇe'pi ca sarvanīlakeśapāśagrahaṇamekanīlātmakatvāt samudāyasya

tataśca yathātra sandrāvāt sarvanīlaikatā, guṇasandrāvo dravyam, nārthāntaram, sandrutya sarvanīlaguṇā ekatāmāpannāḥ, tathā rūpādipañcakasyāpi rūparasagandhasparśaśabdapañcakasyāpi sandrāvādekatā syāt iti vartate
kasmāddhetoḥ ? guṇatvāt, dharmatvādityarthaḥ, na hi vaiśeṣikavad dravyaguṇabhedo'stīti kṛtvā
dṛṣṭānto nīlaikatvavat, yathā sarvanīlānāṃ guṇatvāddharmatvā tathā rūpādipañcakasyāpi, guṇatvāt, nīlaikatvavat
tataśca guṇasandrāvadravyatvāt sarvathā pṛthivyādīnām, teṣāmapi rūpādiparamārthatvāt sarvasarvātmakatvam
ayaṃ tu sandrāvātiśayo māyeyīyaḥ, sañcitālambanābhyupagamād rūpādiparamāṇūnāṃ sañcitānāmasañcitānāṃ prāganabhyupagamāt
āgama evoktaṃ hi vaḥ--saṅghātā eva saṅghātān spṛśanti, sāvayavatvāt
tatra parasparasparśanirūpaṇe sarvātma- dekatvaṃ tathā rūparasādyekatvam

tataśca sandrāvasiddhau guṇānāṃ rūpādyaikye sati ko doṣaḥ ? ucyate — guṇasandrāvadravyatvāt guṇānāṃ sandrutimātrameva yasmāddravyaṃ tasmāt sarvathā pṛthivyādīnāṃ pṛthivyaptejovāyvādīnām ekatvam iti vartate

kiṃ kāraṇam ? tadeva rūpādyekatvaṃ kāraṇam, tata āha --teṣāmapi rūpādiparamārthatvāditi, rūpādaya eva paramārtho guṇasandrāvadravyatvāt, teṣāṃ caikyam, ataḥ pṛthivyaptejovāyughaṭapaṭasaritsamudrajyotirādeḥ sarvasya lokasya tadātmakatvādaikyaṃ prāptamiti
tataśca guṇasandrāvadravyatvāt sarvathā pṛthivyādīnām, teṣāmapi rūpādiparamārthatvāt sarvasarvātmakatvam
ayaṃ tu sandrāvātiśayo māyeyīyaḥ, sañcitālambanābhyupagamād rūpādiparamāṇūnāṃ sañcitānāmasañcitānāṃ prāganabhyupagamāt
āgama evoktaṃ hi vaḥ--saṅghātā eva saṅghātān spṛśanti, sāvayavatvāt
aviśeṣaikāntavādinamatiśete ca viśeṣaikāntavādīti tadvyācikhyāsurāha guṇasandrāvātmakadravyatvāpādanāya --ayaṃ tvityādi yāvanna sa sañcayādṛte sambhavatīti

tuśabdo viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, kiṃ viśinaṣṭi ? rūpādīnāmaikyāpatteḥ prāk pṛthaksvarūpaistanmātraiḥ śabdādibhirāhaṅkārikairākāśādyārambhābhyupagamavādināmaviśeṣaikāntavādināṃ kadācidasañcitāḥ santyapi rūpādaya iti prakriyā, viśeṣaikāntavādināṃ tu sañcitatayaikyāpattireva kvacit pṛthagasañcitarūpādyanabhyupagamāt sarvasarvātmakavādātiśaya iti viśinaṣṭi vyākhyātārthaṃ sandrāvātiśayo'yaṃ māyeyīyaḥ sañcitālambanābhyupagamādrūpādiparamāṇūnāmiti grantham
tatsañcayatvakāraṇapradarśanārthamāha --sañcitānāmasañcitānāṃ prāganabhyupagamāt, prāgasañcitāḥ paramāṇurūpādayaḥ paścāt sañcitya ālambanībhūtā iti nābhyupagamyate yasmād māyāsūnavīyaiḥ
avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ bhavadbhirabhyupagatametaditi tadarthopapradarśanārtham āgama evoktaṃ hi vaḥ
hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmāduktaṃ hi vaḥ siddhānte, kimuktam ? saṅghātā eva saṅghātān spṛśanti sāvayavatvādityuktam

kiṃ paramāṇavaḥ parasparaṃ spṛśanti ? na spṛśanti ? spṛśanto'pi kiṃ deśena deśaṃ spṛśanti ? sarvaṃ vā ? saṅghātaṃ vā ? saṅghātā vā saṅghātān spṛśanto deśena vā deśaṃ sarvaṃ vā spṛśanti ? iti paripraśnopakramaṃ tatra parasparasparśanirūpaṇe ityādi, sarvātmasparśanāsparśanayordoṣāpādanena nirddhāritam --saṅghātāḥ saṅghātān deśena spṛśanti deśameva iti
yadi paramāṇuḥ paramāṇuṃ spṛśed deśābhāvāt sarvātmanā spṛśet, tataśca sa tatpraveśena piṇḍo'ṇumātrakaḥ syāt sapratighatvahānaṃ cāsya syāt
yattūktaṃ no nīlamiti etadevaikaṃ saṃvadati, kadācidapi nīlaparamāṇvākāraniyatajñānotpattihetvabhāvāt, samudāyasyānīlatvāt
paramāṇuṣu cāvidyamānaḥ pratighātaḥ sikatāsvivāsat tailaṃ tatsaṅghāte'pi na syāt, sa ca dṛṣṭaḥ saṅghāte, tasmānnāstyasparśanaṃ paramāṇūnāṃ saṅghātānāṃ ca
tasmāt saṅghātā eva saṅghātān deśena spṛśanti
ādigrahaṇād gatipratibandhābhāvadoṣasteṣāṃ syāt, tataśca saṅghātābhāvādālambanābhāvaḥ syādityādidoṣāpatteḥ deśasparśa evopāttaḥ
so'pi ca sparśo na ca sañcayādṛte sa sambhavati kathañciditi sādhūcyate--sandrāvātiśayo māyeyīya iti
evaṃ nīlaṃ vijānāti iti vākyārtho'pi na ghaṭata ityuktam
saṃghātaṃ vā iti pāṭho bhā॰ pratau nāsti
sapratighā daśa rūpiṇa iti rūpigrahaṇamarūpinirāsārtham, rūpaṇaṃ rūpam, tadeṣāmastīti rūpiṇaḥ
yattūktaṃ no nīlamiti etadevaikaṃ saṃvadati, kadācidapi nīlaparamāṇvākāraniyatajñānotpattihetvabhāvāt, samudāyasyānīlatvāt
kenārthena katamat ? yattūktaṃ no nīlamiti vijānāti iti vartate
a-mā-no-nāḥ pratiṣedhe, nīlaṃ na vijānāti iti etadevaikaṃ saṃvadati nānyat kiñcit

ye tāvat paramāṇavo nīlā ucyante teṣāṃ kadācidapi nīlākāre niyatasya jñānasyotpattau hetutvaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhavati na bhaviṣyati cātīndriyatvāt, ato'sau tvadabhimatacakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī na kadācinnīlaṃ vijānātīti suniścitopapattikaṃ vacaḥ
yadi samudāye saṃvṛtisati nīlatvaṃ syāt syādetadevam, na punarabhāvasya nīlatāstīti na vijānāti nīlam ityetadevātra subhāṣitamiti

syānmatam--na vijānīyānnīlaṃ yadyekaikaṃ paramāṇumatīndriyaṃ paśyatīti brūyāt tatsamudāyaṃ vā khapuṣpasthānīyamiti, kiṃ tarhi ? tāneva paramāṇūn pratyekaṃ bhinnān saṃhatān sarṣapapracayavadekasthān paśyatīti

bhedā eva tattvaṃ bhedatattvam, tadbhāvastattvam, bhedatattvam ityabhimatāḥ pratyekaṃ ta eva samudāyaḥ, na samudāyaprādhānyam, kiṃ tarhi ? bhedapradhāna eva samudāyaḥ pratyekasamudāyaḥ saḥ, tatparigrahe'pi bhedasvarūpaparasparaviśiṣṭasamudāyaparigrahe'pi, śibikodvāhakanyāyena pratyekamasāmarthye'pi tatpradhānasamudāye nīlajñānotpattihetusāmarthyamastvityetasminnapi ca pakṣe parigṛhyamāṇe nīlābhāvānna nīlaṃ vijānāti
tāni nīlatvāni pratiparamāṇu bhinnāni svāśrayaparamāṇuto'nyatra na vartante, svarasotpattibhaṅgavattvādarthāntarāsambandhācca bhāvānām
tasmāditarasya nīlatvamitaratra nāsti, tasyāpi nīlatvamitaratra nāsti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? atadrūpatvāt, karasyānupapatteratyantavyāvṛttārthatvāddravyasadrūpatvād grahaṇābhāvānna nīlaṃ vijānāti

ata eva pratyakṣavidhividhāyakavākyasyaiṣo'rtha āpadyate--cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī sañcitālambanaḥ santānaḥ sañcayaṃ saṃvṛtisantaṃ nīlaṃ vijānāti, tasyāsataścakṣuṣā tadeva rūpaṃ tadrūpam, na tadrūpamatadrūpam, tadbhāvo'tadrūpatvam, tasmādatadrūpatvāt
yadi bhavet tadeva tat syāt, tadrūpatvāt, tadvat; na tu bhavati
athavā tadrūpamasya tadrūpam, na tadrūpamasya rūpamityatadrūpam

kena rūpeṇa ? jātyākārādinā, na hi tannīlamitaranīlarūpaṃ jātyā nīlatvalakṣaṇayā sāmānyabhūtayā ākāreṇa vā saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇa vṛttaparimaṇḍalādinā, jātirūpeṇākārarūpeṇa vā yat syādananyatvakaraṃ tayornīlayoḥ paramāṇvostasya tvanmatena kasyacidanupapatteratadrūpatvam
ato na nīlaṃ nīlāntararūpeṇāsti, tadvannīlāntaramapi tadrūpeṇa nāsti
ādigrahaṇāt prathamakṣaṇadṛśyaṃ dvitīyakṣaṇadṛśyarūpaṃ na bhavati, tadapītararūpaṃ na bhavatīti
artha iti paramārthasan nīlaparamāṇureva, te ca paramāṇavo'tyantamitaretaravyāvṛttāsādhāraṇarūpāḥ
kasmāt ? dravyasadrūpatvāt, dravyasato hyetad rūpaṃ yadanyanirapekṣaviviktasvarūpatvam, tatra yathā tad rasarūpeṇa gandharūpeṇa vā nāsti dravyasadrūpatvāt tathā nīlāntararūpeṇāpi nāsti
tadapi ca dravyasadrūpamāṇīṣādyabhāve rathābhāvavat nīlāntararūpābhāvavadvā tadabhāve'pi na bhavatyeva, nīlatvaśūnyatvādvā nīlāntaranīlavat
ataḥ katarat tannīlaṃ syādyadvijñāyeta cakṣuṣā cakṣurvijñānasamaṅginā ? iti grahaṇābhāvānna nīlaṃ vijānāti cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī
ananyatvakarasya jātyāderabhāvādeva vā rūpamiti vā rasa iti vātyantabhinnānāṃ paramāṇūnāmabhedena dravyasatāṃ grahaṇābhāvānna nīlaṃ vijānāti
itaretarābhāvaparamārthatvādvoktanyāyenaiva na nīlaṃ nīlāntaraṃ cāsti rūparasādivadananyarūpamiti na nīlaṃ vijānāti ityetadeva saṃvadatīti sūktamiti
tasyāpi nīlatvamitaratra nāsti iti pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti
ata eva pratyakṣavidhividhāyakavākyasyaiṣo'rtha āpadyate--cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī sañcitālambanaḥ santānaḥ sañcayaṃ saṃvṛtisantaṃ nīlaṃ vijānāti, tasyāsataścakṣuṣā
akṣasya nābhikṣepyasya kāṣṭhasyāgre'nte bandhārthaṃ kīlastatra, aṇati śabdāyate aṇiḥ, āṇiḥ kṛśṝkuṭi uṇādi॰ 619 iti vā ṇidiḥ — abhi॰ cintā॰ svo॰ 3

ata ityanantaranirdiṣṭanīlārthacakṣurvijñānasamaṅganābhāvāt, evetyavadhāraṇe, vakṣyamāṇavākyārthāpattiḥ, pratyakṣavidheḥ pratyakṣajanmano vidhāyakasya vākyasyaiṣo'rtha āpadyate, no tu nīlamiti ityatra itiśabdasya prakārārthavācitvādevaṃprakāro vākyārtha āpadyata iti
katamasya vākyasyeti sphuṭīkaraṇārthaṃ prastutameva pratyakṣalakṣaṇodāharaṇavākyaṃ pratyuccārya pradarśayati --cakṣurvijñāna ityādi tadeva

cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī sañcitālambanaḥ pūrvoktaḥ santānaḥ cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī sañcitamālambanamasyeti sañcitālambanaḥ sañcayaṃ saṃvṛtisantaṃ nīlaṃ rūpaṃ vijānātyasadavastu nīlābhimataṃ jānāti, na sat kiñcidityayamartho jāyate
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasya nīlasya sañcayasya asataḥ cakṣuṣā cakṣurindriyeṇa grahaṇāt
bhāvanā tvasya--anarthe'rthasaṃjñī, na ca kadācit kaścidapyarthe dharmasaṃjñī
anarthe saṃvṛtisati samudāye dravyasannīlasaṃjñī, na tvarthe'rthasaṃjñī, na tvarthe eva dravyasati arthasaṃjñī tasyātīndriyatvāt
na ca kadācit kaścidapyarthe dharmasaṃjñī, atīndriyatvādatyantaṃ sarvakālamagrāhyatvāt
anarthe eva dharmasaṃjñī, anarthe evāsati nāmādidharmasaṃjñyapi, sañcayasya nāmādīnāṃ ca kalpanātmakatvāt kalpanāpohāsambhavāt
no tu nīlamevaṃ bhavati, evamprakāramasadrūpaṃ nīlaṃ na bhavati, sadeva hi tannīlaṃ na jānāti paramārthasat
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tannīlaṃ na bhavatīti cet, paramārthasatparamāṇunīlatvāt, paramārthasanto hi paramāṇava eva nīlā na sañcayaḥ
bhāvanā tvasya--anarthe'rthasaṃjñī, na ca kadācit kaścidapyarthe dharmasaṃjñī
anarthe saṃvṛtisati samudāye dravyasannīlasaṃjñī, na tvarthe'rthasaṃjñī, na tvarthe eva dravyasati arthasaṃjñī tasyātīndriyatvāt
na ca kadācit kaścidapyarthe dharmasaṃjñī, atīndriyatvādatyantaṃ sarvakālamagrāhyatvāt
anarthe eva dharmasaṃjñī, anarthe evāsati nāmādidharmasaṃjñyapi, sañcayasya nāmādīnāṃ ca kalpanātmakatvāt kalpanāpohāsambhavāt
uktopapattibalādeva tvaduktā bhāvanā na ghaṭate --arthe'rthasaṃjñī, na tvarthe dharmasaṃjñī abhi॰ pi॰ iti
kathaṃ tarhi ghaṭate ? ityatrāha --bhāvanā tvasya anarthe'rthasaṃjñī, na ca kadācit kaścidapyarthe dharmasaṃjñīti
anartho hi saṃvṛtisattvāt samudāyaḥ, tadagrahe tadbuddhyabhāvāt, yathoktaṃ yasmin bhinne na tadbuddhiḥ abhi॰ ko॰ 6
iti tvanmatenaiva tasminnasallakṣaṇe samudāye dravyasannīlasaṃjñī paramārthasatparamāṇunīlasaṃjñī, teṣāmevārthatvāt
tadvyācaṣṭe --na tvartha eva dravyasati paramāṇunīle eva arthasaṃjñī bhavati
yadyevamarthe dharmasaṃjñī bhavatu, netyucyate, na ca kadācit kaścidapyarthe dharmasaṃjñī
kadāciditi samudāyasyaivendriyaviṣayatvāt tadgrahaṇakāle itarakāle vā na dharmasaṃjñyapyarthe bhavitumarhati
kiṃ kāraṇam ? atīndriyatvāt, atyantaṃ sarvakālaṃ kadācit ityasya vyākhyānam, agrāhyatvāt
kiṃ kāraṇam ? sañcayasya nāmādīnāṃ ca kalpanātmakatvādanarthe'narthasaṃjñīti yāvat, kalpanātmake sañcaye'narthe'narthakalpanātmakaśabdādidharmasaṃjñī
kasmāt ? kalpanāpohāsambhavāt samudāye samudāyāśrayanāmādiṣu vā, nāmajātyādiyojanā ca kalpanā, tadapohastasya jñānasya kalpitasamudāyatannāmādiviṣayasya na sambhavatyeva
athavā tvadīyairevākṣaraireṣo'rtho bhāvyate --arthe'rthasaṃjñī na, arthe nīlādau paramārthasatyarthasaṃjñī na bhavatyatīndriyatvāt tasya
tuśabdo viśeṣaṇe, arthe dharmasaṃjñī na iti vartate, yastāvadartha evārthasaṃjñī na bhavatīti sa kuto'rthe dharmasaṃjñī bhavati ? iti viśeṣastuśabdāt
atra ॰kāle uttarakāle vā ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? śūnyaśūnyapratyutpādanāvadasadviṣayatvaṃ doṣajātamapi tasyāḥ kalpanāyāḥ
yathā śūnyaṃ śūnyena guṇitaṃ jātaṃ śūnyameveti yathā gaṇakānāṃ kvacit kalpanamasadviṣayaṃ śiṣyamatiparikarmārthaṃ tathedamasadviṣayam

tataśca asadviṣayatvānnirmūlakalpanāmātrasatyatā, nirbījā samudayakalpanā taddharmakalpanā ca, nirmūle dve api kalpane, te pramāṇamasya tanmātram, tanmātrameva satyam, nānyat kiñcit satyaṃ bhavatkalpite pratyakṣe

yaccāpyabhihitamabhidharmakośe yadetadanekaprakārabhinnamityādi yāvadanekavarṇasaṃsthānaṃ paśyata dravyeṇa cakṣurvijñānamutpādyate yadā nīlāditatprakāravyavacchedo bhavati, kadācidanekena yadā na tatprakāravyavacchedaḥ, tadyathā dūrānmaṇisamūhamanekavarṇasaṃsthānaṃ paśyataḥ
atrāpi kathamanekaprakārabhinna- iti buddhavacanaṃ pratyakṣalakṣaṇānuṣaṅgāgataṃ cakṣurvijñānasamaṅginīlavijñānodāharaṇasabhāvanavākyavannopapadyate evetyupapādayiṣyannupanyasyati
idaṃ punarbuddhavacanaṃ pramāṇam iti abhidharmakośe nidarśitaṃ tadvicāryam
tatrānekaḥ prakāraḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ kāraḥ, ko'sau ? anyonyātulyatvam
tatra tasmin rūpāyatane'nekaprakārabhinne kadācidekena dravyeṇa cakṣurvijñānamutpādyate

kadā punarekena dravyeṇotpādyate ? yadā nīlāditatprakāravyavacchedo bhavati, nīlamevedaṃ na pītādi, pītamevedaṃ na nīlādi ityekaprakāravyavacchedo yadā bhavati tadā cakṣurvijñānamekena dravyeṇotpādyate
kadācidanekena, kadā punaranekena ? yadā na tatprakāravyavacchedo bhavati, nīlādiprakāravyavacchedo yadā na bhavati tadā cakṣurvijñānamanekena dravyeṇotpādyate
viprakṛṣṭadeśasthitaṃ maṇīnāṃ samūhamanekavarṇasaṃsthānamanekena varṇena saṃsthānaṃ vyavasthānamasya tamanekavarṇasaṃsthānaṃ paśyataḥ, anekavarṇamanekasaṃsthānaṃ ca paśyata iti vā

yo nīlapītādyanekavarṇo vṛttatryasrādyanekasaṃsthāno vajrendranīlamarakatasasyakapuṣparāgapadmarāgasphaṭikādimaṇisamūho'nekaprakārabhinnastaṃ paśyataḥ puruṣasya dūrānna vyavacchedo bhavati, ārāttu vyavacchedo bhavati--ayamindranīlo vajrādīnāmanyatamo veti

tatra ca vidvadvaraśrīvāsudevaviśvanāthagokhalemahodayānāṃ prayāsena bhadantaśrīśāntibhikṣumahodayasāhāyyena ca vidvadvaraśrīprahlādapradhānamahodayānāṃ saujanyāt samupalabdhe hastalikhite'bhidharmakośabhāṣye evamvidhaḥevaṃvidhaḥ pāṭhaḥ--
tatra tāvad rūpaṃ dvidhā--varṇaḥ saṃsthānaṃ ca

tadeva rūpāyatanaṃ punarucyate viṃśatidhā, tadyathā--1 nīlam, 2 pītam, 3 lohitam, 4 avadātam, 5 dīrgham, 6 hrasvam, 7 vṛttam, 8 parimaṇḍalam, 9 unnatam, 10 avanatam, 11 sātam, 12 visātam, 13 abhram, 14 dhūmaḥ, 15 rajaḥ, 16 mahikā, 17 chāyā, 18 ātapaḥ, 19 ālokaḥ, 20 andhakāramiti
tatra sātaṃ samasthānam, visātaṃ viṣamasthānam, mahikā nīhāraḥ, ātapaḥ sūryaprabhā, ālokaḥ candratārakāgnyoṣadhimaṇīnāṃ prabhā, chāyā yatra rūpāṇāṃ darśanam, viparyayādandhakāram
asti rūpāyatanaṃ varṇato vidyate na saṃsthānataḥ nīlapītalohitāvadātacchāyātapālokāndhakārākhyam
asti saṃsthānato na varṇataḥ dīrghādīnāṃ pradeśaḥ kāyavijñaptisvabhāvaḥ
ātapālokāveva varṇato vidyete ityapare, dṛśyate hi nīlādīnāṃ dīrghādipariccheda iti
kathaṃ punarekaṃ dravyamubhayathā vidyate ? asti ubhayasya tatra prajñānāt, jñānārtho hyeṣa vidiḥ, na sattārthaḥ
sa tu yathaikavarṇaparamāṇurna bhūtacatuṣkadvayamupādāyeṣyate tathā naiveṣṭavya iti uktaḥ śabdaḥ
spṛśyamekādaśātmakam, spraṣṭavyamekādaśadravyasvabhāvam--catvāri mahābhūtāni ślakṣṇatvaṃ karkaśatvaṃ gurutvaṃ laghutvaṃ śītaṃ jighatsā pipāsā ceti
jighatsā bhojanābhilāṣakṛt, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt, yathā--buddhānāṃ sukha utpādaḥ sukhā dharmasya deśanā
sukhā saṅghasya sāmagrī samagrāṇāṃ tapaḥ sukham
tatra rūpadhātau jighatsāpipāse na staḥ, śeṣamasti
yadyapi tatra vastrāṇyekaśo na tulyante sañcitāni punastulyante
yadetad bahuvidha rūpamuktabahuvidhaṃ rūpamuktaṃ tatra kadācidekena dravyeṇa cakṣurvijñānamutpadyate yadā tatprakāravyavacchedo bhavati
kadācid bahubhiryadā na vyavacchedaḥ, tadyathā-senāvyūhamanekavarṇasaṃsthānaṃ maṇivyūhaṃ cāvā dūrāt paśyataḥ
kāyavijñānaṃ tu paraṃ pañcabhiḥ spraṣṭavyairutpadyate ityeke caturbhirmahābhūtairekena ca ślakṣṇatvādinā
nanu caivaṃ samastālambanatvāt sāmānyaviṣayāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ prāpnuvanti, na svalakṣaṇaviṣayāḥ
āyatanasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratyete svalakṣaṇaviṣayā iṣyante na dravyasvalakṣaṇamityadoṣaḥ
idaṃ vicāryate--kāyajihvendriyayoryugapad viṣayaprāptau satyāṃ katarad vijñānaṃ pūrvamutpadyate ? yasya viṣayaḥ paṭīyān
samaprāpte tu viṣaye jihvāvijñānaṃ pūrvamutpadyate bhoktṛkāmatāvarjitatvāt santateḥ
uktāḥ pañcendriyārthā yathā ca teṣāṃ grahaṇam
dravyeṇa cakṣurvijñānamutpādyate yadā nīlāditatprakāravyavacchedo bhavati, kadācidanekena yadā na tatprakāravyavacchedaḥ, tadyathā dūrānmaṇisamūhamanekavarṇasaṃsthānaṃ paśyataḥ

tatra kalpanāpoḍhasvalakṣaṇaviṣayapratyakṣalakṣaṇacodyopakramaprasaṅgena yattarhīdaṃ sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ abhi॰ pi॰ iti tat kathaṃ yadi tadekato na vikalpayati ? iti, yaccoktamanekaprakārabhinnaikānekadravyotpādyajñānatetyatra kalpanātmakatvaprasaṅgo'svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvaprasaṅgaśceti codite tatparihārārtham — āyatanasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratyete svalakṣaṇaviṣayā na dravyasvalakṣaṇam abhi॰ ko॰ bhā॰ 1
10 iti kathaṃ tat kalpanāpetam ? ityatra vicāraḥ kariṣyate
idameva tāvadvicārayāmo buddhavacanam--kadācidekena dravyeṇa jñānamutpādyate kadācidanekeneti

atrāpi kathamanekaprakārabhinnasāmānyavṛttirūpāyatanatāyāṃ sāmānyavṛttirūpāyatanatāyāṃ tadrūpāyatanaṃ paśyatastasya tadviṣayatvāt svalakṣaṇaviṣayāḥ pañcavijñānapañca vijñānakāyāḥ paṭhyante iti vaktavyam

kathaṃ ceti sañcitālambanatāyāmavibhāgasamavasthasamūhātmakatvādekaprakārāvacchedo maṇisamūhaprabhānuviddhavarṇasaṃsthānavat ? ekasya ca dravyasya kadācidagrahaṇādekena dravyeṇa kathaṃ cakṣurvijñānamutpādyate, rasānāsvādanarasājñānavat

anekaprakāre bhinne sāmānye vṛttirasya rūpāyatanasya tadanekaprakārabhinnasāmānyavṛttirūpāyatanam, tadbhāvastādṛgrūpāyatanatā, tasyāṃ satyāmanekaprakārabhinnasāmānyavṛttirūpāyatanatāyāṃ tadrūpāyatanaṃ paśyataḥ samūhātmakaṃ tadālambanatvāt tasya cakṣurvijñānasya tadviṣayatvāt sāmānyākhyasamūharūpāyatanaviṣayatvāt kathaṃ svalakṣaṇaviṣayaṃ tadyujyate ? tathāsarvarūpādipañcavijñānakāyā rūpāyatanatadvijñānayorudāharaṇamātratvāt kathaṃ svalakṣaṇaviṣayāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ paṭhyanta iti vaktavyo'tra samādhiḥ
evaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍhamupapannam, abhidharme'pyuktam--cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī nīlaṃ vijānāti no tu nīlamiti

yattarhīdaṃ sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ abhi॰ pi॰ iti tat kathaṃ yadi tadekato na vikalpayati ? yaccoktam--āyatanasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratyete svalakṣaṇāviṣayāsvalakṣaṇaviṣayā na dravyasvalakṣaṇaṃ prati abhi॰ ko॰ bhā॰ 1
10 iti tat katham ? iti cet, tatrānekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaram
anekadravyotpādyatvāt tat svāyatane sāmānyagocaramityucyate na tu bhinneṣvabhedakalpanāt
sāmānyavṛttirūpāyatanatāyāṃ tadrūpāyatanaṃ paśyatastasya tadviṣayatvāt svalakṣaṇaviṣayāḥ pañcavijñānapañca vijñānakāyāḥ paṭhyante iti vaktavyam
ekasya ca dravyasya kadācidagrahaṇādekena dravyeṇa kathaṃ cakṣurvijñānamutpādyate, rasānāsvādanarasājñānavat

kathamiti hetuparipraśne, caśabdo doṣasamuccaye, kena hetunā tasyāmanekaprakārabhinnasāmānyavṛttirūpāyatanatāyām, itiśabdaḥ prakāravācī, itthaṃ nānārūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ paśyataḥ sañcitālambanatāyāmavibhāgasamavasthasamūhātmakatvāt, avibhāgenaikyāpattyā samavasthā yasya samūhasya so'yamavibhāgasamavasthasamūhaḥ, tadātmakatvādrūpāyatanasya kathamekaprakārāvacchedaḥ ? na bhavitumarhatītyarthaḥ
kimiva ? maṇisamūhaprabhānuviddhavarṇasaṃsthānavat, yathā nānāvarṇānāṃ maṇīnāṃ samūhe tatprabhayānuviddhe varṇasaṃsthāne nāstyekaprakārāvacchedastathaikadravyāvacchedābhāva iti

kiñcānyat --ekasya ca dravyasya kadācidagrahaṇāt ekasya ca dravyasya paramāṇoḥ sarvadāpyatīndriyasya grahaṇābhāvādekena dravyeṇa kathaṃ cakṣurvijñānamutpādyate ? na kadācit kathañcidutpādyata ityarthaḥ
tasmāt kadācidekena dravyeṇa jñānamutpādyate yadā nīlādiprakāravyavacchedo bhavati iti kimetadabuddhavacanaṃ buddhavacanam ? iti cintyatām

kimiva punarekasya dravyasya kadācidagrahaṇāccakṣurvijñānaṃ notpādyate iti cet, ucyate --rasānāsvādanarasājñānavat, rasanendriyeṇānāsvādite yathā rasajñānaṃ notpadyata evaṃ cakṣuṣā na gṛhīte cakṣurvijñānaṃ nāsti
yadi cāsya buddhavacanasya buddhavacanatvasiddhyarthamekena dravyeṇa jñānamutpādyata ityabhyupagamyate tata ekadravyajñānotpādane tu sañcitālambanakalpanā nirarthikaiva
yadā caivaṃ pratyekaṃ cakṣurviṣayatā aṇūnāmiṣyate tadedamaparaṃ buddhavacanamabuddhavacanaṃ nirarthakaṃ ca jāyate
katamat ? sañcitālambanāḥ pañcavijñānapañca vijñānakāyāḥ abhi॰ pi॰ iti
etasya vā satyatve tadasatyatā sthitaiveti parasparato vacanadvayaviṣayo'bhyupagamavirodha ityata āha --tadabhyupagamavirodhaḥ
atra ucyate rasanānāsvādane ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
narasiṃhānekaprakāragatirapi hi naratvasiṃhatvasañcayayoḥ pūrvaṃ bhedena darśanāt
asañcaye tu taddravyeṣvaṇuṣu prakāragrahaṇameva nāsti, asañcitasyādarśanāt; kuta eva tadvyavacchedādi ?
anekena iti vacanāt saṃvṛtisatsāmānyāsatkalpanaviṣayāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ,
na prakāraḥ, avacchedaḥ, anavacchedaḥ, anekaprakārabhinnatvam ityetānyapi jñānāni bhavitumarhanti
kasmāt ? rūpāyatanasya sañcitagatereva, sañcitameva hi rūpāyatanaṃ gamyate nāsañcitam

ato na prakāraḥ iti jñānaṃ ghaṭate prakṛṣṭaḥ kāraḥ prakāraḥ nīlaḥ pīta iti, ayamasmādviśiṣṭa iti parasparato'tyantabhedābhāve prakārābhāvāt, abhedagateḥ sāmānye na tu prakārajñānaṃ ghaṭate, tathāvacchedo'nyasmādanyasya bhedābhedavikalpanāt, tathānavacchedaḥ, anekaḥ iti, anekena ca prakāreṇa bhinnaḥ iti bhinnānāmabhedagatiḥ
sañcitagaterabhedagateśca na prakārādijñānāni akalpanātmakāni svalakṣaṇaviṣayāṇi ca bhavitumarhanti
kimiva ? narasiṃhavat, yathā narasyākāro'dhastyaḥ siṃhasyākāraḥ śirobhāgaḥ, tadubhayābhedagaternarasiṃha ityucyate evaṃ prakārādijñānānyapi bhinne- ṣvabhedakalpanādeva syurnānyatheti
nare siṃhe ca narasiṃhāviti bhinnayorabhedagatyabhāvādadṛṣṭāntateti cet, na, sañcayayorevābhedarūpatvāt

narasiṃhānekaprakāragatirapi hītyādi, tayorhi pratyekaṃ nara iti siṃha iti ca bhinnayorapi prakāragatiryasmānnaratvasiṃhatvasañcayayoḥ, nīlādiparamāṇvādidravyāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ bhedena darśanādabhedakalpanātmikā bhedagatiriti yuktā, na tathā tu
abhyupetyāpi narasiṃhaprakāragatimeva ca asañcaye tu taddravyeṣvaṇuṣvityādi
sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyā iti yaduktaṃ tvayā tadvismṛtyedamuktam --yadetadanekaprakārabhinnaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ tatra kadācidekena dravyeṇa jñānamutpādyata iti
