cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī nīlaṃ vijānāti no tu nīlamiti etadapi vismṛtyedamuktam --kadācidanekena yadā tadvyavacchedo na bhavati, tadyathā--maṇisamūhamanekavarṇasaṃsthānaṃ paśyata iti, nīlapītādyanekarūpasya yugapadgrahaṇābhyupagame nīlaikarūpavijñānavirodhādityalaṃ prasaṅgena
prakṛta- mucyate--dravyasatsu aṇuṣu nīlapītādiprakāragrahaṇameva nāsti tadasañcaye
kuta eva tadvyavacchedādi ? sati hi darśane tadvyavacchedānavacchedaprakārabhinnatvajñānāni sambhāvyeran, asati darśane dūrādeva tāni na syuḥ

yadapi coktam anekena dravyeṇa kadācijjñānamutpādyate iti, etasmāt anekena iti vacanāt tasyānekadravyasya saṃvṛtisattvāt sāmānyatā, sāmānyatvādasatkalpanaṃ tat, tadviṣayāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ, asatkalpanaviṣayatvādanumānatadābhāsajñānavadapratyakṣamapramāṇaṃ vā dūrānmaṇisamūhadarśanavadveti na svalakṣaṇaviṣayāḥ, ekavijñānānekaviṣayatāpi
katamad dvayaṃ pratītya ? cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi cotpadyate cakṣurvijñānam
atrāpi yadi vyaktyapekṣo nirdeśaḥ sañcayavacanāya tato'yameva doṣaḥ
na ca kevalamasvalakṣaṇaviṣayataiva doṣaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? ekavijñānānekaviṣayatāpi dūradarśanavadeveti
katamad dvayaṃ pratītya ? cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi cotpadyate cakṣurvijñānam
atrāpi yadi vyaktyapekṣo nirdeśaḥ sañcayavacanāya tato'yameva doṣaḥ
yadyanekena dravyeṇa jñānamutpādyate, sākṣād buddhenoktaṃ yadapi ca dvayaṃ pratītyetyādi virudhyata ityabhisambandhaḥ

ādhyātmikamāyatanaṃ bāhyaṃ ca dvayaṃ pratītya vijñānasyotpattirbhavati ityuktvā svayameva punaḥ pratipṛcchaya vyākaroti --katamaddvayaṃ pratītya ? cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi ca pratītya ityādi vibhajya vācyaṃ gatārthameva tat
ekamarthaṃ vijānāti na vijñānadvayaṃ tathā || catuḥśa॰ 268 iti

atrottaramāha --atrāpi cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi ca pratītya cakṣurvijñānasyotpattirbhavati iti dvayī gatirbahuvacananirdeśasya--sañcayāpekṣayātīndriyāṇāmapi rūpāṇāṃ vyaktipadārthāśrayaḥ syāt ? jātyākhyāyāmekasmin bahuvacanamanyatarasyām pā॰ 1
958 iti jātipadārthāśrayo vā ? tatra yadi vyaktyapekṣo nirdeśaḥ sañcayavacanāya tato'yameva saṃvṛtisatsāmānyāsatkalpanaviṣayāḥ pañca vijñānakāyā na svalakṣaṇaviṣayā iti doṣaḥ
atha dravyoktaye tajjātīyāḥ paramāṇava ekarūpanirdeśena sarve nirdeṣṭavyā ityekasmin bahuvacanaṃ tata ihābhyupagamavirodhaḥ, abhyupagataṃ tvayā atīndriyāḥ paramāṇavaḥ iti, tena virodhaḥ
rūpaṃ vā na cakṣurgrāhyaṃ syāt, atīndriyatvāt, buddhyādivat
brūyāstvam--nanvatīndriyatvaṃ cakṣurgrāhyatvaṃ ca parasparato virudhyete iti
athāpi yaścātra virodhaḥ sambhāvyeta sa tulyaḥ paramāṇvaindriyakatvena, paramo'ṇuḥ paramāṇuḥ, uktabhāvanāvat svavacanavirodho'pi
na ca nastena saha virodhaḥ, tasya lokanāthatvāt
sa hi vilupyamānasya lokatattvasya trātātrātā sarvavādabhedayāthārthyaparipālanāt

aṇuśabdaḥ sūkṣmaparyāyaḥ, paramaśabdastadatiśayavācī, sa cātīndriyatve ghaṭate, tasyātīndriyasyaindriyakatvaṃ cākṣuṣatvaṃ yathā viruddhamevamidamapi buddhyādyaindriyakatvaṃ tulyamiti samānadoṣatayā virodhodbhāvanamastu ko doṣaḥ ? kiñcānyat, cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi ca pratītya cakṣurvijñānamutpadyate iti cātīndriyatvādanumāna- virodhaḥ, sthūlānāṃ sūkṣmapūrvakatvāt kāryānumānasiddhāḥ paramāṇavaḥ, tasmānnityānumeyānāṃ teṣāṃ cakṣurviṣayatvābhyupagame vacanayoranumānavirodhitā

kiñcānyat --uktabhāvanāvat svavacanavirodho'pi, uktā bhāvanā uktabhāvanā, tadvaduktabhāvanāvat, anayaiva paramāṇuratīndriyatvāccākṣuṣaścetyanumānavirodhabhāvanayoktayā tulyatvāt atīndriyābhimataḥ paramāṇuścakṣurviṣayatāmāyāti iti bruvataḥ svavacanavirodho'pi
na ca nastena saha virodhaḥ, tasya lokanāthatvāt
sa hi vilupyamānasya lokatattvasya trātātrātā sarvavādabhedayāthārthyaparipālanāt
atra uktā bhāvanā, tadvaduktabhāvanāvat ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
vādāḥ sarva eva lokaṃ svasātkartuṃ samarthatvāllokasya īśate ekāntā api

teṣāṃ svārthonnayanasamarthānāmapi parasparavirodhadoṣavatāmudāsīnamadhyamanṛpativat sandhyādiṣāṅguṇyānyatamaguṇāśrayiṇāṃ vijigīṣūṇāṃ parārpaṇalakṣaṇasaṃśrayaguṇādhāraḥ parameśvaraḥ syādvādaḥ, tatsaṃśrayeṇaiva svavṛttilābhāt tadasaṃśraye parasparakāryavilopāt svayaṃ vināśācca teṣām
laukiko vyavahāranaya āha --na ca nastena saha virodhaḥ
loko hi vyavahāranayastadvaśavartitvena tanmatavilokanāt, tasya lokasya nāthata iti lokanāthaḥ syādvādaḥ
kasmāt ? sa hi ito'muto vilupyamānasyaikāntavādibhirlokatattvasya lokasārasya samyagdarśanaratnasya trātā trāṇaśīlastrāṇadharmā sādhu trāṇakārī veti

kathaṃ trāteti cet, sarvavādabhedetyādi, lokabhūtānāṃ sarvavādānāṃ bhedāḥ sarvavādabhedā nityānityādyekāntāḥ, teṣāṃ yāthārthyāni yathārthabhāvāḥ svaviṣayasamarthanāni, teṣāṃ lokasaṃvādenopagrāhayitṛ- tvāt parasparasāmyāvasthāpanena paripālanāt trātetyucyate
...tatra paṇabandhaḥ sandhiḥ 1, apakāro vigrahaḥ 2, upekṣaṇamāsanam 3, abhyuccayo yānam 4, parārpaṇaṃ saṃśrayaḥ 5, sandhi-vigrahopādānaṃ dvaidhībhāvaḥ 6 iti ṣaḍ guṇāḥ
na māṃ paro nāhaṃ paramupahantuṃ śakta ityāsīta 3

astu tāvadvādaparameśvaratvaṃ lokatrāṇāt syādvādasya lokatrāṇaṃ ca parasparāvirodhopapādanenaikīkaraṇācca teṣām, vādaparameśvarasamāśrayaḥ kathamekāntavādānām ? ityatrocyate— anekātmakarūpāyatanābhyupagamāt
aneka ātmā yasya tadidamanekātmakaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ yat tadekena atra caikarūpāyatanādhāratayā tatraśabdena anantaranidiṣṭameva rūpāyatanamuktaṃ tasyaivobhayarūpatā punardarśitā
tataśca syādekaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ syādanekaṃ rūpāyatanam, uktahetuvat
dravyeṇa kadācijjñānamutpādayati kadācidanekeneti tadvyavacchedāvyavacchedābhyāmiti, tadabhyupagamāt syādvādasamāśrayaḥ
syādvādaikadeśāśca nayā ekāntavādāḥ, yathoktam --bhaddaṃ micchaddaṃsaṇa sanmati॰ 3

naitāḥ svamanīṣikāḥ, lakṣaṇamapi tathaiva nayānām, uktaṃ hi --dravyasyānekātmakatve'nyatamātmakaikāntaparigraho nayaḥ svaprādhānyenārthanayanānnayaḥ , sa ca mithyādṛṣṭiranekākārārthasya viparītapratipattitvāt, anekātmakavastupratipattitvāt syādvādasya yāthārthyam

kathaṃ punarlokabhūtena vyavahāranayenaikāntavādino nigṛhyanta iti cet, lokanāthasamāśritatvāt teṣāṃ lokanāthapakṣasamāśraya eva prativādipakṣābhyupagamaḥ, sa nigrahasthānamekāntavādināmabhyupagamasamakālamevāvasito vāda iti
atra caikarūpāyatanādhāratayā tatraśabdena anantaranidiṣṭameva rūpāyatanamuktaṃ tasyaivobhayarūpatā punardarśitā
tataśca syādekaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ syādanekaṃ rūpāyatanam, uktahetuvat

tvayāpi syādvādyabhyupagatānekātmakavastvekānekatvānekāntavādo'bhyupagata eva, yasmādanekaprakārabhinnamityādi yāvadanekavarṇasaṃsthānaṃ paśyata ityatra ca vākye ekameva rūpāyatanaṃ jñānādhāra itīṣṭam, yasmāt tadādhāratayā punaḥ tatra ityadhikaraṇavācipratyayāntena tatraśabdenānantaranirdiṣṭameva rūpāyatanamuktamavyatirekamabhedaṃ tasya vastuna āgṛhyoktam
tasyaivobhayarūpatā punardarśitā kadācidekena dravyeṇa kadācidanekena jñānamutpādyate iti bruvatā

rūpāyatanasyaivaikānekasaṅkhyānirdeśyatvamanabhyupagacchatā kathaṃ tatraśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyamāpādayituṃ śakyate ? yadi tadekamanekaṃ ca na syāt, tathā itarathā tatra ca rūpāyatane'nyatra veti syāt, na tu bhavati
atra ॰ṇyamupapādayituṃ śakyate iti pāṭhaḥ syāditi bhāti
evaṃ coktavidhinā tasya tvayaivoktasya rūpāyatanasyaikasyaivaikatānekatā ca atastvayaivoktā
tena prakāreṇa tathā, avibhaktaṃ tattvaṃ tadbhāvastattvaṃ yasya tadidamavibhaktatattvam, tadbhāvastattvamekānekatvādyavibhaktavastutattvam, tena tathā'vibhaktatattvena jñānotpatteriti hetuḥ
dṛśyate hi tadeva rūpāyatanamekamanekaṃ ca paramāṇavastatsamūhaśceti jñānotpattiḥ
dūrānmaṇisamūhamanekavarṇasaṃsthānaṃ paśyata ityudāharaṇamapyevamevaikānekarūpadravyarūpāyatanatve sādhye cakṣurvijñānādhārasya vastunaḥ sādharmyadṛṣṭāntatvaṃ bhajate, na ekāntaikānekarūpatve
kasmāt ? snigdharūkṣatvābhyāṃ bandhaikyapariṇāmāpattestatsamūhagrāhyatvādekam, dravyārthāvasthānāt paramāṇūnāṃ svarūpabhinnānāṃ bhedādanekam

sādhāraṇībhūtabhedasamūhāpekṣacākṣuṣatvādipariṇāmāpatteḥ sāmānyaviṣayam, nanu kadācicchabdaḥ kālāntaravacanaḥ, na, ekakāla evobhayarūpatvāt syāt tat tat syānna tat tat, grahaṇāpadeśaviśiṣṭārthatvāt, anekavarṇamaṇirūpavadekapuruṣapitṛputratvādivadvā
nanu kadācicchabdaḥ kālāntaravacanaḥ, na, ekakāla evobhayarūpatvāt syāt tat tat syānna tat tat, grahaṇāpadeśaviśiṣṭārthatvāt, anekavarṇamaṇirūpavadekapuruṣapitṛputratvādivadvā
tasminneva hi vastuni kadācit kālāntare jñānamekākāramutpadyate kadācidanekākāram, jñānasyaivākāravattvānnirākārabāhyavastupakṣe iti

ekasminneva hi kāle nīlaparamāṇusamūhākārajñānasya bhedābhedātmakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam, ato na samyaguktam--kadācicchabdaḥ kālāntaravacanaḥ, tasmādekākāraṃ kadācit kadācidanekākāraṃ jñānamutpadyate tasminneva vastuni iti
tasmāccaikakāla evobhayarūpatvāt syāt tat tat, tadeva tadvastu paramāṇudravyasamūhābhedāt
hetvantaramapyatrocyate --grahaṇāpadeśaviśiṣṭārthatvāt, grahaṇaṃ jñānam, jñānamevāpadeśo hetuḥ, tena hetunā viśiṣṭo grahaṇāpadeśaviśiṣṭaścāsāvarthaśca, tadbhāvo grahaṇāpadeśaviśiṣṭārthatvam
yasmāccakṣurvijñānāddhetorviśiṣṭo'rtho rūpaṃ samudāyasamudāyyātmakaṃ gṛhyate tasmādanekātmakaṃ tadvastu
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? anekavarṇamaṇirūpavat, eka eva vā maṇirmecakasphaṭikādyanyatamastadrūpavat, nānāvarṇānāṃ vā maṇīnāṃ samūhasya rūpavat
yathā tad grahaṇāpadeśaviśiṣṭaṃ jñānapari- cchinnaṃ vibhinnarūpaṃ tathā cakṣurviṣayābhimataṃ vastu

yathaikaḥ puruṣo'nekasambandhijanāpekṣayā pitā putro bhāgineyo mātulaḥ ityevamādivyapadeśyatvaṃ bhajate na cāsya virodha-saṅkarā-'navasthāprasaṅgadoṣā grahaṇāpadeśaviśiṣṭārthatvādevaṃ cakṣurvijñānavijñeyaṃ vastu pratipattavyam

ata eva kāraṇād ye'tra codayanti parasparaviruddhānāṃ kathamekatra sambhavaḥ iti, teṣāṃ tadanapekṣitasvābhyupagamamanekāntadūṣaṇamāpadyate, svo'bhyupagamaḥ svābhyupagamaḥ, sa nāpekṣito yasmin dūṣaṇe tadanapekṣitasvābhyupagamamanekāntadūṣaṇam

tadyathā--sarvaṃ sarvātmakamaviśiṣṭaṃ pratijñāya pariṇāmabhedavyākhyānaṃ cānapekṣyānekāntadūṣaṇam, deśakālakṛtātyantaviśiṣṭatvaṃ pratijñāya santānāviśeṣavyākhyānaṃ cānapekṣyānekāntadūṣaṇam, asatkāryotpattiṃ pratijñāya tulyajātīyadravyaguṇāntarārambhaniyamavyākhyānaṃ cānapekṣyānekāntadūṣaṇaṃ ca
uktānekāntasvarūpo'rtha evamarthaḥ, tadbhāva aivamarthyam, avibhāvitamaivamarthyaṃ pūrvābhyupagamaśca yaista bhyupagamatvāttvekāntavādināṃ na viśeṣadoṣaḥ kasyacidapi
āyatanasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratyete svalakṣaṇaviṣayāḥ, na dravyasvalakṣaṇaṃ prati abhi॰ ko॰ bhā॰ 1
yattu samastālambanaṃ vijñānaṃ sāmānyaviṣayaṃ prāpnoti, na svalakṣaṇaviṣayam ityetat pratiṣṭhāpitameva kṛtam

...kutaḥ pratyakṣatvam ? yo'pi caikākāraparikalpanāt pratyakṣasya kalpanātmakatvaprasaṅgo'svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvaprasaṅgaśca sañcitālambanatāyāmiti codite samādhirabhidhīyate'svalakṣaṇatvadoṣaparihāraḥ— anekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaram
anekadravyotpādyatvāt tat svāyatane sāmānyagocaram ityucyate, na tu bhinneṣvabhedakalpanāt pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1
yathā hi śamīśākhāpatreṣu sarva- ime'vibhāvitaivamarthyapūrvābhyupagamā ekāntavādinaḥ, tadbhāvādavibhāvitaivamarthyapūrvābhyupagamatvādunmugdhabhrāntamattādivadanapekṣitasvābhyupagamamanekāntadūṣaṇam

tasmāt kasya vayaṃ viśeṣya ayameva unmugdho bhrānta unmatto vā iti doṣaṃ brūmaḥ ? sarva eva yūyamevaṃ doṣaduṣṭāḥ, kiṃ tapasvinā viśeṣaikāntavādinaivāparāddhaṃ vādaparameśvaraparirakṣyalokatattvavilopanodyaminā ? ityata āha --na viśeṣadoṣaḥ kasyacidapīti prāgabhihitam
āyatanasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratyete svalakṣaṇaviṣayāḥ, na dravyasvalakṣaṇaṃ prati abhi॰ ko॰ bhā॰ 1
yattu samastālambanaṃ vijñānaṃ sāmānyaviṣayaṃ prāpnoti, na svalakṣaṇaviṣayam ityetat pratiṣṭhāpitameva kṛtam

yo'pi caikākāraparikalpanāt pratyakṣasya kalpanātmakatvaprasaṅgo'svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvaprasaṅgaśca sañcitālambanatāyāmiti codite samādhirabhidhīyate'svalakṣaṇatvadoṣaparihāraḥ— anekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaram
anekadravyotpādyatvāt tat svāyatane sāmānyagocaram ityucyate, na tu bhinneṣvabhedakalpanāt pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1

sambandhāgatakalpanātmakatvāpādanacodyadūṣaṇamanuktvā tadabhyupagamena parihāroktiḥ āyatanasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratyete svalakṣaṇaviṣayā na dravyasvalakṣaṇaṃ prati ityetattu vyākhyānaṃ prāguccārya coditameva doṣaṃ calayitvā pratiṣṭhāpitavānasi sthirīkṛtavānasītyarthaḥ
tadyathā --sphuṭataraka ityādi yāvat kutaḥ pratyakṣatvamityetadupadarśitamiti gatārtham

etaduktaṃ bhavati— yadi tadekato na vikalpayati kathaṃ sañcitālambanatā ? kalpanānāntarīyikā hi sā kalpanāmantareṇa na sambhavatīti codite tatrottaro vakṣyamāṇo yaḥ samādhirabhidhīyate sa eva ca kila asvalakṣaṇatvadoṣaparihāro'bhimato'rthadvayavācitvāvirodhādasya vākyasyeti tat pratyuccārayati savyākhyānam --anekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaramityādi yāvat teṣu pṛthak pṛthaggrahaṇābhāvāditi gatārtham

piṇḍārthastu— yadyapi paramāṇusamūhajanyatvānna jñānamarthataḥ sāmānyagocaraṃ tathāpi rūpaṃ raso vā svārtho'nyāpṛktatvādarthāntarakalpane tasya jñānasyāpaṭutvāt, tacca vijñānamutpādayituṃ śibikodvāhavat saṃhatya samarthāḥ paramāṇavo nānyatheti sāmānyagocaratāstu, ko doṣaḥ
yadi tad bhinneṣvabhedaṃ kalpayadutpadyeta syāt kalpanā patrālambanaṃ jñānamavivekenotpadyate, na ca saṅghātaḥ kaścideko'sti teṣāmanārabdhalakṣaṇakāryatvāt, evamaṇuṣvapi
nanvata eva na tat pratyakṣam, svārthe sāmānyagocaratvāt, anumānavat
tmakam, na tu bhinneṣvabhedaikākāraparikalpanāt tadutpadyate iti
syānmatam— tadvyatirekeṇa patre samudāye ca yathā jñānaṃ pratyakṣamapi tathā syāditi
patrālambanaṃ jñānamavivekenotpadyate, na ca saṅghātaḥ kaścideko'sti teṣāmanārabdhalakṣaṇakāryatvāt, evamaṇuṣvapi
nanvata eva na tat pratyakṣam, svārthe sāmānyagocaratvāt, anumānavat
etaccihnāntargataḥ syānmatam ityata ārabhya pratyakṣamapi ityantaḥ pāṭho bhā॰ pratau nāsti
kutaḥ ? arthasyāsya jaratkuṭīravadāroṭanākṣamatvāt tvadvākyajanitasya prākcoditadoṣasyāyaṃ samādhirapyasamādhireva, aṅgīkṛtārthavināśitvāt, śabdakṛtakatvābhivyaktisthāpanārthapravṛttavaiśeṣikavat
vaiśeṣikasyeva vaiśeṣikavat, acākṣuṣapratyakṣasya guṇasya sato'pavargaḥ karmabhiḥ sādharmyam, sato liṅgābhāvātvai॰ sū॰ 2

25--26 kāryatvāt ityādibhiranityatvaṃ vaiśeṣikatvāt siddhaṃ kṛtakatvaṃ ca, tasyābhivyaktisthāpanārthaṃ pravṛttasya vaiśeṣikasyevāṅgīkṛtārthanāśitvamevam anekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaram ityarthavacanayordoṣaḥ
tadvyācaṣṭe, kutastatsādharmya- miti cet, ucyate --svaviṣayatāṃ pratijñāya tadatadviṣayatayā tadatadabhūtasāmānyagocaropasaṃhārāt
sa cāsaśca viṣayo'sya sa tadatadviṣayaḥ, tadbhāvastadatadviṣayatā
tadatadabhūtaṃ sāmānyam, tad gocaro'sya viṣaya upasaṃhārasya, tasmādupasaṃhārāt
sa cānyaśca viṣayaḥ sāmānyasyeti tadanyataratraiva na pravartate ekataratrādṛṣṭatvāt, tvanmatenaiva pratisvaṃ niyatatvādbhāvānāṃ naikarūpamapi tanna ca tatra vṛttaṃ na cāto'nyatra
tatastadatadabhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ gocaro'syopasaṃhārasya yaḥ sa tadatadviṣayatayā tvayedānīṃ kriyate
tasmāt tadatadviṣayatayā tadatadabhūtasāmānyagocaropasaṃhārādaṅgīkṛtapratyakṣavināśa ityata āha --nanvata eva na tat pratyakṣaṃ svārthe sāmānyagocaratvādanumānavat
svārthe iti svaviṣaye svagrāhye vastuni, yat svagrāhye vastuni sāmānyagocaraṃ tajjñānamapratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathānumānamiti
anumānamapi vā neti, nānumānamapi tat syāt, svārthe sāmānyagocaratvāt, pratyakṣavat
yat svagrāhye vastuni iti pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti

svavacanavirodhi kumārabrahmacāripitṛvacanavaccaitat asvārthaviśiṣṭe svārthe svaviṣaye rūpādiprakāre sāmānyagocaram iti, yasmādarthaviṣayaśabdau lakṣaṇārthāveva, uktaṃ hi tvayaiva--pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca pramāṇe

kimiva ? kumārabrahmacāripitṛvacanavaccaitat, yathā kaścid brūyāt pitā me kumārabrahmacārī iti, tasya tadvacanaṃ svata eva virudhyate--yadi pitā kathaṃ kumārabrahmacārī ? atha kumārabrahmacārī kathaṃ pitā ? iti, tathedamapi yadi tajjñānaṃ svārthe kathaṃ sāmānyagocaram ? atha sāmānyagocaraṃ kathaṃ tat svārthe ? svārtha iti ca tvayā na cakṣuṣo'nyasya vendriyasya viṣaya iti viśeṣamāśritya lakṣaṇamabhidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? prameyamucyate sāmānyato vastu svalakṣaṇaṃ svārthaḥ iti
tathā sāmānyalakṣaṇamiti na dhūmānumeyāgnimātram, kiṃ tarhi ? liṅgagamyaṃ sarvam

etasyārthasya pratipādanārthamāha svārthalakṣaṇameva nirūpayan --asvārthaviśiṣṭe, svo'rthaḥ svārthaḥ, na svārtho'svārthaḥ svārthādanyaḥ, tato viśiṣṭaḥ svārthaḥ, tasmin svārthe, tamevārthaṃ paryāyeṇāha --svaviṣaye, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? ekasmin rūpādiprakāre prakṛṣṭe kāre rūpe rase'nyasminneva sāmānyagocaramiti, sāmānyaviṣayaṃ ca svārthe jñānamiti ca vispardhitametat parasparato dvayam

yasmādarthaviṣayaśabdau lakṣaṇārthāveva lakṣaṇaśabdaparyāyavācinau tasmāt svārthaḥ svaviṣayaḥ svalakṣaṇamityetadvivakṣitaṃ bhavataḥ, tadvismṛtya bhrāntena nendriyagrāhyasvārthasāmānyabhedakalpanāt parihāro yujyate vaktum
etaccihnāntargataḥ pratyakṣa॰ ityata ārabhya tvayaiva ityantaḥ pāṭho bhā॰ pratau nāsti
mā maṃsthāḥ--naitadevaṃ bhavatīti, uktaṃ hi pramāṇasaṅkhyānirūpaṇe tvayaiva--pratyakṣamanumānañca pramāṇe ityādi
tannivāraṇārthamāha --na hi svasāmānyalakṣaṇābhyāmanyat prameyamasti, pratyakṣānumānābhyāmagrahaṇāt, kharaviṣāṇavat

syānmatam--tatraiva viṣayadvaye vikalpasamuccayāṅgāṅgibhāvaiḥ pratyakṣānumānāgamādīnāṃ pramāṇānāṃ vṛttirbhaviṣyatīti, tanna bhavati, yasmāt svalakṣaṇaviṣayaniyataṃ pratyakṣaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaviṣayaniyatamanumānamityuktam
tacca lakṣaṇaṃ vastu svabhāvaḥ svarūpamarthaḥ prameyamiti paryāyāḥ
tat punardvirūpaṃ paricchedyaṃ dvābhyāṃ pramāṇābhyāṃ paricchedyatvāt, pramāṇaṃ paricchedakaṃ prameyaṃ paricchedyamityarthaḥ
na ca pramāṇayorviṣayasaṅkara ityadhigamyasya dvitvāt tadadhigamanimittaṃ dvirūpamityevaṃ vyavasthāpite sāmānyagocaravyāvṛttārthena svārthena bhavitavyam
sāmānye svaviṣaye pratyakṣaṃ jñānamutpadyate iti cet, sāmānyameva svaviṣayaḥ, svalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti
ato lakṣaṇadvayābhāvāt prameyapramāṇadvitvāvadhāraṇakalpanā vyarthā, pramāṇayorvā viṣayasaṅkaraḥ prāptaḥ

pratyakṣamapi vānumānabheda eva syāt, anekārthajanitasāmānyagocararūpādiprakāraparigrahāt, dhūmabalākāliṅga- yasmālloke dṛṣṭaṃ prameyādhigamanimittaṃ pramāṇam, hiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt, prameyādhigamanimittaṃ hi pramāṇamiti
na caitat agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ, dānaṃ dadyāddharmakāmaḥ ityevamādyāgamavadadṛṣṭārtham, pratyakṣadṛṣṭārthamevaitadupalambhakatvādupalabhyasya dvividhasya dṛṣṭatvāt
na ca pramāṇayorviṣayasaṅkara iti prāguktayuktikāṃ viviktaviṣayatāṃ darśayati
itiśabdaḥ pradarśane, etāvānatra saṅkṣepeṇārthaḥ, tadvistaro'paro grantha iti sūcayati
atra naitadevaṃ saṃbhavatīti ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
bhā॰ pratau tu atra sarvo'pi pāṭho nāstyeva
svalakṣaṇaviṣayaṃ hi pratyakṣam, sāmānyalakṣaṇaviṣayaṃ hyanumānamviṣayamanumānam--pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1
ṛ gatau pā॰ dhā॰ iti dhātoḥ aryaṃtearyate iti rūpam
na ca pramāṇayorviṣayasaṅkara ityadhigamyasya dvitvāt tadadhigamanimittaṃ dvirūpamityevaṃ vyavasthāpite sāmānyagocaravyāvṛttārthena svārthena bhavitavyam
sāmānye svaviṣaye pratyakṣaṃ jñānamutpadyate iti cet, sāmānyameva svaviṣayaḥ, svalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti
ato lakṣaṇadvayābhāvāt prameyapramāṇadvitvāvadhāraṇakalpanā vyarthā, pramāṇayorvā viṣayasaṅkaraḥ prāptaḥ

idānīṃ vyavasthāpitārthopasaṃhārārthamidaṃ vākyamāha --adhigamyasya dvitvāt tadadhigamanimittaṃ dvirūpamityevaṃ vyavasthāpite lakṣaṇaśabdo'rthaparyāyavācī nendriyagrāhyaviśeṣārthaprakṛta ityetasmiṃścārthe sthite pratyakṣānumānayoḥ svarūpābhāvaḥ svavacanavirodhaśca doṣāḥ svārthe sāmānyagocaram iti bruvataḥ proktavidhineti sthitam
tataḥ ko doṣaḥ ? svārthe sāmānyagocaram ityetadvirudhyate, na hi tādṛśaḥ svārthasya sāmānyatāsambandho'sti, nāpi sāmānyasya svārthasambandha iti
mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti tasminneva sāmānye svaviṣaye svārthe pratyakṣaṃ jñānamutpadyata iti cet, tata evaṃ sāmānyameva svaviṣayaḥ, svalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti
ataḥ paribhāṣitāsādhāraṇasvalakṣaṇaviṣayābhāvādevaṃ kalpyamāne lakṣaṇadvayaṃ nāsti, ekameva sāmānyalakṣaṇam, dvayābhāvāt tadviṣayamekamevānumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt
tataśca prameyapramāṇadvitvāvadhāraṇakalpanā vyarthā, mā bhūdavadhāraṇavaiyarthyamiti, svārthe sāmānye ca pratyakṣaṃ pravṛttaṃ tathānumānaṃ ceti pramāṇayorvā viṣayasaṅkaraḥ prāptaḥ
mā jñāsīdasiddho'yaṃ heturiti, tvayaivoktaṃ hi— tatrānekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaram
anekena bhinnenārthena abhinnamekaṃ sāmānyaṃ rūpaṃ rasa ityādiprakāraṃ parigṛhyotpadyamānaṃ jñānaṃ tena janitaṃ tat, tasmādanekārthajanitasāmānyagocararūpādiprakāraparigrahāt tasya jñānasya

evamaṇuṣvapi, balākāliṅgajanitajñānavat, dhūmādatrāgniḥ, balākābhyo'tra jalam iti liṅgajanitayoragnijalajñānayorapi svarūpato'numānatvābhedaḥ, evaṃ rūpādiṣūtpadyamānānāṃ pratyakṣābhimatānāmanumānatvābhedaḥ
etasmādeva hetorasvalakṣaṇaviṣayatvaṃ ca, asvalakṣaṇaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣam, anekārthajanitasāmānyagocararūpādiprakāraparigrahāt, anumānavat
ubhayatretyanena anumāne'pyasvalakṣaṇaviṣayatvam, tata eva hetoḥ, anantarabhāvitapratyakṣavat
tatsāmānyamapi na svalakṣaṇam, ata eva, anantaroktasamudāyavat
sāmānyāsvalakṣaṇatvaṃ siddhaṃ sādhyata iti cet, na, svārtha eva sāmānyagocaram iti vacanāt svārthatvenābhyupagatatvāditi

avaśyaṃ caitadevamabhyupagantavyam, yataḥ śamīśākhāpatrasaṅghātāviśeṣadarśanodāharaṇena ca sphuṭameva darśitamapratyakṣatvamananumānatvamapramāṇatvamasvalakṣaṇaviṣayatvaṃ viṣayasaṅkara ityevamādi doṣajātam
tatrānekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaram | pra॰ samu॰ 1 | 4 iti

pratyakṣamapi vānumānameda eva syāt pṛ॰ 89 paṃ॰ 7 iti vacanānusāreṇa ॰manumānatva॰ iti sarvapratiṣu dṛśyamānasya pāṭhasyātra saṅgatatve'pi śamīśākhāpatrasaṅghātāviśeṣodāharaṇānantaram nanvata eva na tat pratyakṣam, svārthe sāmānyagocaratvāt, anumānavat
anumānamapi vā na pṛ॰ 87 paṃ॰ 4 ityabhihitatvāt ॰mananumānatva॰ iti pāṭho'tra samīcīnatara iti pratibhāti

syānmatam--anekasyaikatvāpattiḥ sāmānyam, sa eva gocaro'syeti anekaikatvāpattisāmānyagocaraḥ, sa eva svalakṣaṇaḥ sāmānyagocara eva svalakṣaṇaḥ, asāvevārthaḥ pratyakṣasyetyeṣā bhavata āśaṃsā cet, na, ārātparāntamadhyetyādi yāvat svalakṣaṇaviṣayasāmānyātmakatvāt

ārādantaḥ, parāntaḥ, madhyaḥ, nīlaprakarṣādirvarṇaḥ, hrasvadīrghālpamahattvādi pramāṇam, vṛttādi saṃsthānaṃ ca, tairviviktā vṛttayo'vasthāśca yeṣāṃ patraviśeṣāṇāṃ te tairviviktavṛttyavasthapatraviśeṣāḥ, ta eva svalakṣaṇāḥ, te viṣayo'sya sāmānyasya tat svalakṣaṇaviṣayaṃ sāmānyamātmā svarūpamasya, tadbhāvaḥ sāmānyātmakatvam, tasmāt sāmānyātmakatvāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--deśākṛtivarṇapramāṇasaṃsthānādibhiratyantaviśiṣṭānāṃ svalakṣaṇānāmeva sāmānyātmakatvam, nānyat sāmānyamasti, ato'nupapannam--anekaikāpattisāmānyagocarasvalakṣaṇa evārtha iti
nanūktamanekaikāpattisāmānyagocaramiti, tanna, yasmād na ca saṅghātaḥ kaścidasti
caśabdānnāvayavī, na ca pariṇāmāntaraṃ tadvyatiriktaṃ tvanmatena
na ca sañcayaḥ kaścidasti, ata eva na pratyayasyālambanaṃ yujyate, anālambanatvāccābhāsārtho'pi na tatrāsti vandhyāputraputratvānābhāsanavat
asvatvāttvasya adravyatvāt kuta ābhāsavijñāpanam ? sve tu paramāṇavo nābhāsamutpādayitumalam, atīndriyatvāt
na hi patraviśeṣairārabdhaṃ kiñcit kāryāntaramasti, ta eva hyanārabdhalakṣaṇāḥ patraviśeṣāḥ sañcitya kāryībhūtāḥ, tasmānna teṣvanyat sāmānyamasti
evamaṇuṣvapi, paramāṇuṣvapi tathā na kiñcit sāmānyamasti
etaccihnāntargataḥ anekaikatvā॰ ityata ārabhya ॰'syeti ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti
na ca sañcayaḥ kaścidasti, ata eva na pratyayasyālambanaṃ yujyate, anālambanatvāccābhāsārtho'pi na tatrāsti vandhyāputraputratvānābhāsanavat
asvatvāttvasya adravyatvāt kuta ābhāsavijñāpanam ? sve tu paramāṇavo nābhāsamutpādayitumalam, atīndriyatvāt
yadapi coktam --anekadravyotpādyatvāt tat svāyatane sāmānyagocaramityucyate na tu bhinneṣvabhedakalpanāt pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1
4 iti, sā tvadiṣṭā sāmānyagocaratāpi ca na ghaṭate, yasmānna tadanekadravyotpādyam
na ca sañcayaḥ sāmānyam, tato na ca sa rūpādibhyo bhedena kaścidasti rūpādisañcayaḥ
ata eva na pratyayasyālambanaṃ yujyate, pratyayo jñānam
etat kutaḥ ? akāraṇatvādevālambanatvābhāve kā pratyāśā ābhāsārthasya ? ityata āha — anālambanatvācca ābhāsārtho'pi na tatrāsti
viṣayo hi nāma yasya jñānena svabhāvo'vadhāryate ālambanaparīkṣāvṛ॰ 1 iti tvaduktopapattirevātra vyāpāryate

yastvātmanā svabhāvenāsiddhaḥ sa viṣayaḥ syājjñānasyeti kā yuktiḥ ? asvatvāttvasyādravyatvāt paramārthasattvābhāvāt kuta ābhāsavijñāpanaṃ paravācoyuktyā, vijñāpanaṃ vijñaptirbuddhiriti paryāyāḥ, dūrata eva nāstītyarthaḥ
evaṃ tarhi sve tu paramāṇava ātmānaḥ te viṣayatāṃ yāntu, netyucyate, te nābhāsamutpādayitumalamatīndriyatvāt
itiśabda upasaṃhāre, itītthamanālambanatvaṃ sañcayasyāṇūnāṃ ca siddhaṃ pratyakṣajñānasya, tasmāt pratyakṣajñānaṃ notpadyate, nirālambanatvāt, svapuṣpavat

ataḥ pratyakṣasya nirālambanasya khapuṣpavadanutpatteruktopapattividhinā kalpanāpoḍhasya saviṣayasya pratyakṣasya jñānasya vā'bhāve pratipādite svavacanavyapekṣākṣepadustaravirodhaprastuteśca kalpanāpoḍhaṃ pratyakṣam ityetallakṣaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, lakṣyasyābhāvāt, kharaviṣāṇakuṇṭhatīkṣṇādinirṇayavat

abhyupete'pi tu sañcitālambanapratyayatve naivāsya pratyakṣatā, tadābhāsatvāt kalpanātmakatvād bhrāntijñānātmakatvāt saṃjñāsaṃsthānasaṅkhyāvarṇānyathākalpanāt, mṛgatṛṣṇikāpratyayavadalātacakrapratyayavad dvicandrapratyayavat kāmalopahatacakṣuṣo nīlarūpapītapratyayavat
ata idaṃ naiva pratyakṣam, atathābhūtārthādhyāropātmakatvāt, bhrāntivat saṃvṛtisajjñānavat, yathā gopāla...
yasmin bhinne na tadbuddhiranyāpohe dhiyā ca tat
sa cābhyupagamyamāno'pi viṣayaḥ sañcaya eva sambhāvyeta, na paramāṇavo'tīndriyatvāt
sa cālambanapratyayo jñānasya sañcayaḥ, tasminnabhyupete'pi tu sañcitālambanapratyayatve naivāsya pratyakṣatā sidhyati tvanmatenaiva, tadābhāsatvāt
bhrāntiḥ saṃjñāsaṃsthānasaṅkhyāvarṇānyathākalpanāt, saṃjñā ca saṃsthānaṃ ca saṅkhyā ca varṇaśca, teṣāṃ tairvānyathākalpanāt

saṃjñāsaṃsthānasaṅkhyāvarṇānāmanyathāpratipattermṛgatṛṣṇikāpratyayavadalātacakrapratyayavad dvicandrapratyayavat kāmalopahatacakṣuṣo nīlarūpapītapratyayavaditi yathāsaṅkhyaṃ dṛṣṭāntāḥ yathākramaṃ ca hetavo bhrāntijñānātmakatve sādhye tataśca pratyakṣatvābhāve sādhye

tadarthamupasaṃhṛtyānte sādhanam --ata idaṃ naiva pratyakṣam, atathābhūtārthādhyāropātmakatvāt, bhrāntivat, nāvārūḍhasya tīravṛkṣadhāvanadarśanātmikāmekāṃ kriyābhrāntiṃ muktvā proktacaturvidhabhrāntivat
tadvyākhyā --yathā gopāletyādinā dṛṣṭāntaṃ samarthya tathā saṃvṛtisatītyādinā dārṣṭāntikasamarthanam
saṃjñā ca saṃsthānaṃ ca varṇaṃ ca pra॰

yasmin ghaṭe bhinne kapālaśakalaśarkarādibhāvena ghaṭābhimatādvastuno'nyeṣvapyapoḍheṣu kapālādiṣu na ghaṭabuddhirasti, tadagrahe tadbuddhyabhāvāt, aṅgulya rajjvāṃ sarpa iti jñānaṃ rajjudṛṣṭāvanarthakam
hastavālapra॰ 1 yaccoktam--āyatanasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratyete svalakṣaṇaviṣayā na dravyasvalakṣaṇaṃ prati iti tat kathamiti cet, tatrānekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaram
anekadravyotpādyatvāt tat svāyatane sāmānyagocaramityucyate, na tu bhinneṣvabhedaikākāraparikalpanāt pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1
ato'ṅgulivyatirekeṇa mṛṣṭyabhāvavat kapālādivyatirekeṇa ghaṭābhāva iti saṃvṛtisan ghaṭaḥ
yatrāpi kriyayā'poho na sambhavati tatrāpi dhiyā'pohe'nyeṣāṃ rūpādīnāṃ ghaṭasya samudāyād na tadbuddhirasti

rūpādisamudāyasya ca paramāṇurūpādyapohe na tadbuddhirasti iti vartate, dṛṣṭāntaḥ --ambuvat, ekasminnapi jalabindau jalabuddhidarśanāt, rūpādiṣu punarbuddhyāpoḍheṣu na toyabuddhirastītyetat saṃvṛtisato lakṣaṇam
athavā yasmin ghaṭe bhinne'vayavaśo na tadbuddhirbhavati tad ghaṭavat saṃvṛtisat
yatra cāmbubuddhyā'rthāntarāpohe na tadbuddhirarthāntaranivṛttirūpasya vastunaḥ svarūpābhāvādagnivāyvādinivṛttimātraṃ vyavahāraprasiddhāmbuvat tadapi saṃvṛtisat
paramārthasadanyathā, etadviparītalakṣaṇaṃ svata eva viviktarūpaṃ yadvidyate rūpaṃ rasa ityādi tat paramārthasat pratyakṣagocaramiti
catvāryapi satyānyuktāni bhagavatā dve api satye--saṃvṛtisatyaṃ paramārthasatyaṃ ca
tayoḥ kiṃ lakṣaṇam ? yatra bhinne na tadbuddhiranyāpohe dhiyā ca tat
yasminnavayavaśo bhinne na tadbuddhirbhavati tat saṃvṛtisat, tadyathā--ghaṭaḥ
tatra hi kapālaśo bhinne ghaṭabuddhirna bhavati
yatra cānyānapohya dharmān buddhyā tadbuddhirna bhavati taccāpi saṃvṛtisad veditavyam, tadyathā--ambu
tatra hi buddhyā rūpādīn dharmānapohya ambubuddhirna bhavati, teṣveva tu sā saṃvṛtisaṃjñā kṛtā iti saṃvṛtivaśād ghaṭaśca ambu ceticāstīti bruvantaḥ satyamevāhuḥ na mṛṣeti etat saṃvṛtisat
yatra bhinne'pi tadbuddhirbhavatyeva anyadharmāpohe'pi buddhyā tat paramārthasat, tadyathā--rūpam
tatra hi paramāṇuśo bhinne vastuni rasādīnapi ca dharmānapohya buddhyā rūpasvabhāvabuddhirbhavati
yathā lokottareṇa jñānena gṛhyate tatpṛṣṭhalabdhena vā laukikena tathā paramārthasatyam, yathānyena tathā satyaṃ saṃvṛtisatyamiti pūrvācāryāḥ
yaccoktam--āyatanasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratyete svalakṣaṇaviṣayā na dravyasvalakṣaṇaṃ prati iti tat kathamiti cet, tatrānekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaram
anekadravyotpādyatvāt tat svāyatane sāmānyagocaramityucyate, na tu bhinneṣvabhedaikākāraparikalpanāt pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1

etadapi paramārthasadityabhimataṃ saṃvṛtisallakṣaṇānativṛtterasadeva, yathoktavidhinā saṃvṛtisadeva sarvamapītyatrāpi jñāpakodāharaṇaṃ tatsaṃvādyabhihitam --rajjvāṃ sarpa iti jñānam, tāvadeva rajjvāṃ sarpa iti viparyayajñānaṃ bhavati yāvadaspandādiviśeṣaliṅgādarśanam
viśeṣatastu tadavadhāraṇadṛṣṭau satyāṃ prāktanaṃ sarpadarśanaṃ jāyate'narthakam
sāpi rajjubuddhistadavayave dṛṣṭau satyāṃ yathā sarpa iti jñānamanarthakaṃ tathānarthikā, tata āha --tadaṃśadṛṣṭau tatrāpi sarpavad rajjuvibhrama iti
evamanayā kalpanayā sarvapiṇḍajñānānāṃ saṃvṛtisadviṣayataiveti sādhūktam--apratyakṣaṃ nīlādiviṣayaṃ cakṣurādivijñānaṃ śākyaputrīyaṃ bhrāntivaditi

adhunā yadetadanekaprakārabhinnarūpetyādigranthacodyadvārāyātakalpanātmakaparihārārthaṃ yaccoktam āyatanasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratyete svalakṣaṇaviṣayā na dravyasvalakṣaṇaṃ prati iti tat kathamityetatpari- hārārthasya tasya vākyasya doṣaṃ vaktukāmaḥ parapakṣameva tāvat pratyuccārayan vyācaṣṭe sūriṣṭīkākāralikhitaṃ likhan yāvadekākāraparikalpanāditi gatārtham
uttaraṃ tu atrāpi, apiśabdāt pūrvasminnarthavikalpe vyākhyātā doṣāste'trāpi sambhavanti
kathamiti cet, anekārthaviṣayaikapratyayatvāt, aneko'rthaḥ paramāṇavaḥ, tadviṣaya eka iti pratyayaḥ so'nekārthaviṣayaikapratyayaḥ, tadbhāvādanekārthaviṣayaikapratyayatvāt
jñāpakaḥ sa heturiti cet, kārakādapi anekasmādarthājjāyate sādhyasādhanadharmānvayaikāntavataḥ

nanu dhūmādirapi sañcaya eva gṛhīto'- teṣu paramāṇuṣu pratyekamatīndriyeṣu samuditeṣvasamuditeṣu vā pratyayābhāvāt tatsamūhe'nekārthaviṣayaḥ sa evaikaḥ pratyayaḥ, samūhālambanatadābhāsajñānotpattyabhyupagamāt
arthabhedaviṣayajñānābhyupagame ca vijānāti na vijñānam catuḥśa॰ 268 ityādi virudhyeta
tataśca asvalakṣaṇaviṣayaḥ, ta eva hi paramāṇavaḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ na tatsamūhaḥ sāmānyatvāt
tasmādasvalakṣaṇaviṣayatvāt kalpanātmako nirdeśyaścetyevamādyasmābhiḥ prāk prakrāntaṃ tat sutarāmaśeṣaṃ tvayaiva bhāvitam anekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaram pra॰ samu॰ 1
jñāpakaḥ sa heturiti cet, kārakādapi anekasmādarthājjāyate sādhyasādhanadharmānvayaikāntavataḥ
kiñcānyat, bhavadabhimatapratyakṣasyāpratyakṣatvasādhane ca dve leśenonnīte tvayaiva, mā bhūt svābhyupagamadoṣavyaktiriti kuśalajanatarkagamye, na sphuṭe
katame dve ? anekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaratvāditi caite dve
tatra tāvat prathamaṃ sādhanam --tvadabhimatapratyakṣamapratyakṣam, anekārthajanyatvāt, anumānavat

dṛṣṭānte'numāne'nekārthajanyatvamasiddhamiti mā maṃsthāḥ, yasmādanumānamapi pakṣadharmādyanekārthajanyam, pakṣadharmaḥ sapakṣānugamo vipakṣavyāvṛttirityanekārthena janyate'gnyanityādyanumānajñānaṃ tathedamapi pratyakṣamanekaparamāṇvarthajanyamiti

syānmatam--anumāne pakṣadharmādiraneko'pyartho dhūmakṛtakatvādiragnyanityādijñānasya na kārakaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? pūrvaprasiddhamevāvinābhāvinaṃ sambandhaṃ smārayatīti jñāpakaḥ sa hetuḥ, itarastu pratyakṣajñānasya kārako'rthaḥ, tasmādvaidharmyādadṛṣṭānta iti
etaccāyuktam, atrāpi tulyatvāt, kārakādapītyādi, anumānamapi iti vartate, anumānamapi svārthaṃ kārakādanekasmādarthājjāyate

katamasmāt ? sādhyasādhanadharmānvayaikāntavataḥ pakṣadharmasapakṣānugamavipakṣavyāvṛttimata aikāntikāt, agnimān pradeśo dhūmavattvāccullīmūlavat, anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvād ghaṭavat, na nadīvannākāśavat iti kārakahetutaivānumāne'pi tadarthasya
atra ॰gamye te, na sphuṭe ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
naitat sādharmyamupapadyate, kasmāt ? asañcitānekārthajanyatvādanumānasya sañcitānekārthajanyatvācca pratyakṣasya
atrocyate --nanu dhūmādirapi sañcaya eva gṛhīto'- gnyādimaṇūniva gamayati
hetupratyayo'sau, anadhipatipratyayaḥ kalpanāyā iti cet, kārakādapyanekasmādarthājjāyate sādhyasādhanadharmānvayaikāntavataḥ
anumānaṃ vā pratyakṣaṃ syāt, anekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaratvāt, pratyakṣavat

nanviti prasiddhānujñāpane, nanu dhūmo'gnimattvaviśiṣṭapradeśadharmaścaturbhūtasaṅghāto'nvayavyatirekasahito'gnimattvavijñānaṃ pradeśe janayatyaṇusamudaya iva rūpavijñānam, gamayatyagniṃ tajjñānaṃ janayatīti jñānotpattau kārakatvāvyabhicārādubhayatreti
hetupratyayo'sau, anadhipatipratyayaḥ kalpanāyā iti cet, kārakādapyanekasmādarthājjāyate sādhyasādhanadharmānvayaikāntavataḥ
anumānaṃ vā pratyakṣaṃ syāt, anekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaratvāt, pratyakṣavat
syānmatam--hetuḥ pratyayo nimittamanālambanamityarthaḥ, asau dhūmo'numāne nimittam
anadhipatipratyayaḥ, kalpanāyā hetoḥ, nirvikalpaṃ hi jñānamadhipatipratyayaṃ pratyakṣam, na tathānumānam, ato vaidharmyānna dṛṣṭānta iti cet, evaṃ cenmanyase
atra nimittaṃ nālambana॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
paramāṇusañcaya eva pratyakṣe'pyanadhipatiḥ, tasmādeva hetorindriyāviṣayatvāt, sañcayasya paramāṇuvyatiriktasyāsattvāditi vistareṇa prāgabhihitametat
tathā svārthe sāmānyagocaratvādanumānavadapratyakṣamityetasmin sādhane kārakahetutvapratipādanārthaḥ prapañcastulya ityatidiśati

vāśabdo vikalpārthaḥ, yadi pratipāditamidaṃ yuktivaśāt pratyakṣasya tvadabhimatasyānumānatvaṃ mayā tat tvayā svagrāharaktamanasā svasamayaprasiddhyanupātinā neṣyate pratyakṣatvameveṣyate tatastasmāt sādharmyādanumānaṃ vā pratyakṣaṃ syādanekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaratvādityetābhyāmeva hetubhyāṃ pratyakṣavadityete api dve sādhane leśenonnīte, na sphuṭamiti
kiñcānyat, etasmādeva hetudvayādviṣayaikyāpatteḥ pramāṇaikyamityata āha --dvayamapyetadekameva, eka- lakṣaṇatvāt

svasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ hyekameva vastu viṣayo'sya pramāṇadvayasyetyuktavidhinā prasaktatvāt pratyakṣamevaikaṃ pramāṇaṃ tadubhayaṃ syāt, anekārthajanyasāmānyaikagocaratvāt, cakṣurādidvārajanmapratyakṣabhedapratyakṣatvavat
anumānameva vā syāt, tata eva kāraṇāt, dhūmakṛtakatvādyanumitāgnyanityādijñānānumānavat
anekārthajanyatvācca svārthasāmānyagocaratāyāṃ yadābhāsaṃ teṣu jñānamutpadyate tathā ta ālambanam, pratyekaṃ paramāṇurūpasya buddhāvasanniveśāt samudayakṛtatannirbhāsatayālambanamiti prāptam
evaṃ ca sati arthasannikarṣādakṣaṃ prati yadutpadyate tajjñānaṃ

idānīṃ vasubandhoḥ svaguroḥ tato'rthād vijñānaṃ pratyakṣam vādavi॰ iti bruvato yaduttaramabhihitaṃ paraguṇamatsarāviṣṭacetasā tattvaparīkṣāyāṃ paramodāsīnacetasā tu yena kenacidabhiprāyeṇa svamataṃ darśitameva dinnena vasubandhupratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ dūṣayatā, tasya punarartho yo'stu so'stu kiṃ no'nena ? idameva tāvadastu --rūpādiṣvālambanārtho vaktavyaḥ pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1

15 iti vikalpya vikalpadvaye doṣajātaṃ tallakṣaṇe prakrāntaṃ tat tavāpi samānamiti pratipādayiṣyan nayacakrakāraḥ saviśeṣaṃ tanmatavirodhahetuṃ svavacanajanitamāha --anekārthajanyatvācca svārthasāmānyagocaratāyāmityādi, śiṣyācāryayostulyottaratvāt

svārtha iti nīlādiḥ, sa eva kila sāmānyamanekārthajanyatvāt, aneko'rthaḥ paramāṇavaḥ tajjanyaṃ nīlaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣamata indriyasya svārtha ityetasyāmanekārthajanyatvācca svārthasāmānyagocaratāyāṃ yadābhāsaṃ teṣu jñānamutpadyate tathā ta ālambanaṃ rūpādaya iti nīlapītāditvena yathaivābhāsante tathaivālambanamityetadiṣṭam

kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ta eva nīlādiparamāṇavo nālambanamiti cet, ucyate --pratyekaṃ paramāṇurūpasya buddhāvasanniveśāt, ekamekaṃ prati pratyekaṃ paramāṇūnāṃ yannīlādirūpaṃ tasyātīndriyatvādbuddhau na sanniveśaḥ, tasmāt kiṃ prāptam ? samudayakṛtatannirbhāsatayālambanamityetat prāptam, nīlādirūpasya tatsamudāyātmakatvāt
tato'rthād vijñānaṃ pratyakṣam iti pratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ vādavidhau bauddhācāryeṇa vasubandhunā'bhihitam

dinnena svagurorvasubandhoḥ pratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ dūṣayitukāmena pramāṇasamuccaye tadvṛttau ca vistareṇa prakrāntamittham--tato'rthādvijñānaṃ pratyakṣam vādavi॰ ityatra tato'rthāditi sarvaśced yena tat tata eva na
yadi tataḥ ityanena sarvaḥ pratyaya ucyate, yajjñānaṃ yasmādviṣayādbhavati tasya vyapadiśyate, tata eva tu na bhavati, ālambanapratyayādeva jñānaṃ na bhavati caturbhiścittacaittāḥ abhi॰ ko॰ 2
yadi tato'rthāt ityanena viṣayamātram, smṛtyanumānābhilāṣādijñānamapi ālambanāntaraṃ nāpekṣate, agnyādijñānaṃ hi na dhūmādyālambanam

rūpādiṣvālambanārtho vaktavyaḥ--kiṃ yadābhāsaṃ teṣu jñānamutpadyate tathā te ālambanam, atha yathā vidyamānā anyābhāsasyāpi jñānasya kāraṇaṃ bhavanti ? tataḥ kimiti cet, yadi yadābhāsaṃ teṣu jñānamutpadyate tathā pañcānāṃ vijñānakāyānāṃ sañcitālambanatvāt saṃvṛtisadevālambanamitīṣṭaṃ nīlādyābhāsajñāneṣuvijñāneṣu tato'rthād vijñānatvāt pratyakṣatvaṃ bhavati, tathāhi--teṣu tatsamudāyādhyārope satyapi dravyasadākāro labhyate
dravyasaṅkhyādyākāro'pi lapsyate, ta eva hi dravyāditvenābhāsante

atha yathā vidyamānā anyābhāsasyāpi jñānasya kāraṇaṃ bhavanti tathā sati dravyādiprasaṅgadoṣo nāsti tathā teṣāmasattvāt, tathāpi yena tasya vyapadeśa ityetanna labhyate, pratyekaṃ ca te samuditāḥ kāraṇaṃ na samudāyo vyavahārasattvāt
etadevāha --yadābhāsā na sā tasmāccitālambaṃ hi pañcakam
yataḥ sā paramārthena tatratasya na vyapadiśyate
cakṣurādīnāmapyālambanatvaprasaṅgaḥ, te'pi hi paramārthato'nyathā vidyamānā nīlādyābhāsasya dvicandrādyābhāsasya ca jñānasya kāraṇībhavanti --pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1

evaṃ ca sati paramāṇusañcayanīlādinirbhāsatayālambanatve sati pratyakṣārtha evaṃ jāyate, tadyathā — arthasannikarṣādakṣaṃ prati yadutpadyate tajjñānaṃ pratyakṣamiti jñānamarthena viśeṣyate, arthenendriyasya sanni pratyakṣam
yathā cātra samānānekārthajanyendriyasvārthādyadutpadyate tadapi ca taimirakavada- karṣādutpadyamānaṃ jñānamakṣaṃ prati vṛtteḥ pratyakṣamiti jñāne'rthasya viśeṣaṇatā
sannikarṣādvā akṣaṃ prati yo vartate'rthaḥ sa pratyakṣaḥ, arthendriyasannikarṣādakṣaṃ prati vṛtteḥ pratyakṣamitatvādupacaritavṛttirartho'kṣeṇa viśeṣyate iti
evaṃ ca sati ityuccārya sañcayaḥ prasakta ityabhyupagamyagamayya dūṣayati--yasmānna ca sañcayo'rthaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ nārthaḥ sañcaya iti cet, saṃvṛtisattvāt
ata etasmāt kāraṇād nāsāvutpattipratyaya iṣyate, utpattau pratyaya ālambanapratyaya ityarthaḥ, so'sattvānneṣyate

itiśabdo hetvarthe, etasmāt kāraṇāt so'rtho na viśeṣaṇena viśeṣyastasmādviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvābhāvājjñānatvapratyakṣatvābhyupagamahāniḥ, jñānaṃ pratyakṣam ityetadabhyupagataṃ viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyasya cārthasyābhāvāt kimviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ ca syāditi hīyate
cakṣurādīndriyabuddhayaḥ svaviṣayanirbhāsasvarūpamātrā eva, jñānatvāt, vastutvāt, sattvāt, taimirikādijñānavat
tataśca taimirikasya keśonduka-maśaka-makṣikā-dvicandrādidarśanavat sā tu asatsatpratipattireva, asadavastu sadvastu iti pratipattiḥ

tasmāddhetorasatsatpratipatterviparyayapratipattestasya jñānasyāpratyakṣatvaṃ prasiddhamalātacakrādijñānavat, tena apratyakṣatvena prasiddhena tvayā pratijñātaṃ tatpratyakṣatvaṃ nirākriyate, tannirākaraṇādanumānavirodhaḥ

nanu pratyakṣanirākaraṇāt pratyakṣavirodho'yaṃ kathamanumānavirodhaḥ ? ityatrocyate--tvanmatena pratyakṣadharmasya vikalpasyoktānumānena nirākaraṇānnirvikalpakapratyakṣatvābhāvāt katamat tat pratyakṣaṃ yena nirākriyeta yadvā nirākuryāt ? ato'numānavirodha evāyam
kathamiti cet, ucyate --yathā cotretyādi dārṣṭāntikaṃ muktvā dṛṣṭāntaṃ tatsādharmyaṃ ca varṇayati

yathā cātra bhavanmatena samānānekārthajanyendriyasvārthāt, samānena nīlavarṇenā'nekena paramāṇusaṅghātalakṣaṇenārthena janya indriyasvārthaḥ, nāsādhāraṇo vastvabhimatasvalakṣaṇasvārthaḥ, kasmāt ? tattyaktvā tatrānekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaraṃ jñānam pra॰ samu॰ 1

4 iti vacanādanyādṛśaḥ svārthasyeṣṭatvāt, tādṛśaḥ svārthād yadutpadyate pramāṇam, samānānekārthātathābhūtārthānnīlādisaṅghātāt prajñaptisata ālambanāt paramārthasadākāro labhyate, ta eva hi paramāṇavo nīlāditvenābhāsante iti tadviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣamiṣṭaṃ tathā ghaṭasaṅkhyādyākārebhyaḥ pratyakṣajñānajanakārthasadharmabhyaḥ samānānekārthajanyendriyasvārthebhyaḥ samānānekārthātathābhūtārthebhyaḥ paramārthasadākāro lapsyate iti ghaṭādijñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt, saṃvṛtisadālambanatvāt, nīlādijñānavat
nīlādijñānaṃ vā na pratyakṣaṃ syāt, ghaṭādijñānavat
ta eva hi te paramāṇava ābhāsante
evamubhayostulye janakatve kuta etat--nīlādyābhāsaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na ghaṭādyābhāsamiti

yathaiva hi paramāṇvavayavasamudāye ta evābhāsante tathā ghaṭādijñāneṣvapi samuditāsta evābhāsante, tathāstheṣveva ghaṭabuddhiḥ pravartate prajñaptiśca evaṃ tathāstheṣveva nīlādirūpabuddhiḥ pravartate prajñaptiśca

jñānam ityabhisambhantsyate, tadapi ca taimirakavadapramāṇam, timire bhavaṃ taimiram, yathā dvicandradarśanaṃ tathā samānenāpyanekavarṇamaṇisamūhena janya indriyasvārtho mecakastasmādutpadyamānaṃ tadapi ca taimirakavadapramāṇam

kutaḥ ? yasmāt samānānekārthāt tasmādatathābhūtārthāt tannīlādisaṅghātājjñānamutpadyate, atathābhūtārthatvamasya saṃvṛtisattvamata āha --samānānekārthātathābhūtārthānnīlādisaṅghātāt prajñaptisata ālambanāt saṃvṛtisataḥ paramārthasadākāro nīlādiko labhyate, yatasta eva hi paramārthasantaḥ paramāṇavo nīlāditvenābhāsanta iti tadviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ nīlādipratyakṣamiṣṭam

tathā nirākṛtebhyaḥ pratyakṣatvena ghaṭasaṅkhyādyākārebhyo ghaṭasaṅkhyotkṣepaṇasattāghaṭatvādyākārebhyaḥ pratyakṣajñānajanakārthasadharmabhyaḥ, katamena sādharmyeṇa sadharmabhya iti cet, ucyate --samānānekārthajanyendriyasvārthebhya ityetatsadharmabhyaḥ

kimuktaṃ bhavati ? samānānekārthātathābhūtārthebhyaḥ, paramārthasadākāro lapsyate nīlādisaṅghātavadityatastadupasaṃhṛtya sādhanamāha --ghaṭaḥ saṃyukto viyuktaḥ paro'paraḥ spandata ityādi jñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sa ca tadviṣayaḥ pratyakṣaḥ syāt, saṃvṛtisadālambanatvāt, nīlādijñānavat
nīlādijñānaṃ tadarthaśca na pratyakṣe vā syātām, saṃvṛtisattvāt, ghaṭādijñānārthavat
tat samarthayati --ta eva hi te paramāṇavo ya eva ghaṭāditvenābhāsante ya eva nīlāditvenābhāsanta iti
evamubhayornīlādighaṭādijñānayostulye janakatve tat kuta etat--nīlādyābhāsaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na ghaṭādyābhāsamiti ? svarucimātrādanyat kāraṇaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ

pramāṇam, samānānekārthātathābhūtārthānnīlādisaṅghātāt prajñaptisata ālambanāt paramārthasadākāro labhyate, ta eva hi paramāṇavo nīlāditvenābhāsante iti tadviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣamiṣṭaṃ tathā ghaṭasaṅkhyādyākārebhyaḥ pratyakṣajñānajanakārthasadharmabhyaḥ samānānekārthajanyendriyasvārthebhyaḥ samānānekārthātathābhūtārthebhyaḥ paramārthasadākāro lapsyate iti ghaṭādijñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt, saṃvṛtisadālambanatvāt, nīlādijñānavat
nīlādijñānaṃ vā na pratyakṣaṃ syāt, ghaṭādijñānavat
ta eva hi te paramāṇava ābhāsante
evamubhayostulye janakatve kuta etat--nīlādyābhāsaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na ghaṭādyābhāsamiti

yathaiva hi paramāṇvavayavasamudāye ta evābhāsante tathā ghaṭādijñāneṣvapi samuditāsta evābhāsante, tathāstheṣveva ghaṭabuddhiḥ pravartate prajñaptiśca evaṃ tathāstheṣveva nīlādirūpabuddhiḥ pravartate prajñaptiśca
yathaiva hītyādi yāvat samuditāsta evābhāsanta iti buddhāvābhāsanasāmarthyāviśeṣācca janakahetvaviśeṣameva darśayati

atra ca yathā paramāṇvavayavasamudāye ta eva nīlapratyavabhāsatvājjñānasyākārasanniveśaviśiṣṭāḥ sāmānyata ābhāsante tathā ghaṭādijñāneṣvapi ākāraviśeṣeṇa samuditāsta evābhāsante, nānyo ghaṭo nāmāsti yastathābhāseta
tathāstheṣu tena prakāreṇa sthiteṣu rūpādiṣveva ghaṭa athocyeta--nīlādisamudāye dravyasadākāro vidyate, tadaṇvātmakatvāt tathāsattvāt tatpratyakṣatvaṃ nyāyyam
yathaiva tasmin ghaṭādyanākāratā tadanaṇutvāt tathā'sattvāt evaṃ rūpādyākārasyānākāratā sañcitasyaindriyakatvādālambanatvāt tadanaṇutvāt tathā'sattvādanyathā'viṣayatvādanālambanatvādapratyakṣatvāt
pakṣāntarāpattiścaivaṃ yathā te vidyante tathā ta ālambanamiti
yathā coktaṃ pratyekaṃ iti buddhiḥ pravartate prajñaptiśca evaṃ tathāstheṣveva paramāṇuṣu nīlādirūpabuddhiḥ pravartate prajñaptiśceti sarvamubhayatra tulyam
athocyeta--nīlādisamudāye dravyasadākāro vidyate, tadaṇvātmakatvāt tathāsattvāt tatpratyakṣatvaṃ nyāyyam
yathaiva tasmin ghaṭādyanākāratā tadanaṇutvāt tathā'sattvāt evaṃ rūpādyākārasyānākāratā sañcitasyaindriyakatvādālambanatvāt tadanaṇutvāt tathā'sattvādanyathā'viṣayatvādanālambanatvādapratyakṣatvāt
pakṣāntarāpattiścaivaṃ yathā te vidyante tathā ta ālambanamiti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tadaṇvātmakatvāt teṣāṃ nīlādīnāmaṇvātmakatvāt aṇūnāṃ dravyasattvāt
tatpratyakṣatvaṃ nyāyyam, nyāyādanapetaṃ nyāyyaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ, tadviṣayasya ca jñānasya pratyakṣatvaṃ tatpratyakṣatvam
na tu ghaṭādyākāro na tvasti ghaṭasaṅkhyotkṣepaṇādyākāraḥ, atatparamāṇutvāt, tasyākārasya paramāṇutvaṃ tatparamāṇutvam, na tatparamāṇutvamatatparamāṇutvam, ato'tatparamāṇutvāt
tataḥ kim ? tathā'sattvāt, tena prakāreṇāsattvāt paramāṇutvena teṣāṃ ghaṭādyākārāṇāmasattvāt
yathaiva tasmin rūpādisamudāye ghaṭādyanākāratā tadanaṇutvāt, tasya ghaṭādyākārasyānākāratā tasyākārasyānaṇutvāt, tathā'sattvādanaṇusattvena ghaṭādyākāreṇāsattvādaṇutvenaivāsattvāt

evaṃ rūpādyākārasyānākāratā anantaroktahetoḥ sañcitasyaindriyakatvāt paramāṇusamudāyasyaindriyakatvāt tasyaivālambanatvāt, asañcitasyātīndriyatvādata evānālambanatvāt, tadanaṇutvāt tasya sañcitasyaindriyakasyālambanasyānaṇutvāt tathā'sattvādanaṇutvādevāsattvāt, anyathā'viṣayatvāt paramāṇutvenā- viṣayatvāt, aviṣayatvādeva anālambanatvāt, ata eva apratyakṣatvāt
yadābhāsaṃ teṣu jñānamutpadyate tathā ta ālambanam pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1
15 ityevaṃ pakṣaṃ parityajya yathā te vidyante tathā ta ālambanamityayaṃ pakṣa āśrito bhavati, pakṣāntaragamanaṃ ca vādāvasānāyeti
kiñcānyat, asminnapi ca pakṣe tvayaiva vasubandhuṃ pratyuktā ye doṣāste tavāpi syuḥ
kathamiti cet, taddarśayati --yathā ca pratyakṣotpattibījasañjananārthamuktam--pratyekaṃ ca te samuditāḥ kāraṇamiti
4 ityasya vyākhyāyāṃ punarvasubandhuṃ dūṣayitukāmena vikalpitaḥ sa evārthaḥ--kiṃ yathā vidyamānā anyābhāsasyāpi vijñānasya kāraṇaṃ bhavanti tathā pratyakṣasyālambanaṃ rūpādayaḥ iti pūrvapakṣatvena
tataḥ ko ca te samuditāḥ kāraṇam pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1
evamvievaṃvidhālambanatāyāṃ ca dhūmo'gnipratyakṣajñānālambanaṃ syāt, tathā vidyamānatve'nyathābhāsasyāpi jñānasya kāraṇībhavanāt, tvaduktapratyakṣālambanavat

na ca grāhyasya nīlāderviṣayasya cakṣurādivijñānasya nīlādiparamāṇava āla- doṣa iti cet, evamapi na ta ālambanamatīndriyatvādindriyagocarātītatvād gaganavadindriyajñānālambanaṃ na bhavanti paramāṇavaḥ
ca te samuditāḥ kāraṇam pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1
evamvievaṃvidhālambanatāyāṃ ca dhūmo'gnipratyakṣajñānālambanaṃ syāt, tathā vidyamānatve'nyathābhāsasyāpi jñānasya kāraṇībhavanāt, tvaduktapratyakṣālambanavat
na ca grāhyasya nīlāderviṣayasya cakṣurādivijñānasya nīlādiparamāṇava āla-
kiñcānyat, uttaradoṣa ucyate'bhyupagamyāpi evaṃvidhālambanatāyāṃ cetyādi yāvat tvaduktapratyakṣālambanavaditi

anyathā vidyamānāḥ paramāṇavo'tīndriyatvena vidyamānāḥ samūhābhāsasyāpi jñānasya kāraṇaṃ bhavanti ityevaṃvidhālambanatāyāṃ satyāṃ dhūmo'gnipratyakṣajñānālambanaṃ syāt, tathā vidyamānatve'nyathābhāsasyāpi jñānasya kāraṇībhavanāt

yathā tvaduktasya pratyakṣasyālambanaṃ paramāṇavo'nyathā vidyamānāḥ paramāṇutvena vidyamānāḥ samūhābhāsajñānasya kāraṇaṃ bhavanti tathā dhūmo'pi tatsādharmyāt tajjanitajñānālambanasyāgneḥ pratyakṣālambanatayā vyāptatvāt pratyakṣālambanatāmātmanaḥ sādhayati
dhūmanimittāgnijñānaṃ vā pratyakṣaṃ syāt, tathā vidyamānatve'nyābhāsavijñānajanakārthālambanatvāt, tvaduktapratyakṣavat
tatsādharmyādeva vā tvaduktapratyakṣaṃ sahārthenāpratyakṣaṃ syād dhūmajanitāgnyarthajñānavat
raṃ॰ hī॰ pratyostu ayaṃ pāṭha eva nāsti
kiñcānyat, tasmādeva hetoścakṣurādyapi vālambanaṃ syāt, evamayamatiprasaṅgadoṣa evaṃvādinaḥ

yadi kāraṇamālambanaṃ vijñānasyānyābhāsasyāpiṣṭaṃ tataścakṣurādīndriyāṇi cakṣurādivijñānānāmālambanāni syuḥ, anyathā vidyamānatve'nyābhāsasyāpi vijñānasya kāraṇībhavanāccakṣurindriyaṃ cakṣurvijñānasyālambanaṃ syād rūpādiparamāṇuvat
tajjñānaṃ vā cakṣurindriyālambanaṃ syāt, tajjanyatve satyanyābhāsatvāt, paramāṇujanyarūpavijñānavat
cakṣurādibhirgrāhyasya nīlādeḥ samūhātmakasya, viṣayo gocaraḥ, sambandhi cakṣurādivijñānam, tasya nīlādiparamāṇavo na ālambanam, anyathā paramārthato vidyamānatvāt

anyatheti svābhāsādanyathābhāsante na tathā paramārthato vidyante paramārthatastu svalakṣaṇā apyagrāhyā vidyante, tasmādanyathā paramārthato vidyamānatvāt cakṣurādivannīlādigrāhyaviṣayajñānālambanā na bhavanti paramāṇavaḥ
yathā cakṣurādīndriyāṇyanyathā paramārthato'nīlādiparamāṇvātmakāni santi anyathā nīlādijñānotpattau hetubhāvaṃ bibhrati nālambanāni tathā paramāṇava iti
itaśca paramāṇvālambanaṃ na bhavati mbanam, anyathā paramārthato vidyamānatvāt tadasādhāraṇaviṣayatvādvā, rasajñānavat
nanu ca pratyekameva te samuditāḥ kāraṇam, tathāsanta eva samuditāḥ paramāṇavaścakṣurādijñānotpattihetutvādālambanam, tadavasthānāṃ jñānotpādanaśaktyabhivyakteḥ, cakṣurādiparamāṇūnāmiva
na hyeka indriyaparamāṇurviṣayaparamāṇurvā vijñānamutpādayitumalam, na tatsamudāyaḥ prajñaptisattvāt
pratyekakāraṇatāyāmaṇūnāṃ samudāye darśanaśaktivyaktiḥ, śibikāvāhakasamudāyavahanaśaktivat, andhapaṅktivat pratyekādarśanavailakṣaṇyena
asādhāraṇa ekaiko nīlaparamāṇurviṣayo'syeti tadasādhāraṇaviṣayatvam, tacca siddham, pratyekaṃ ca te samuditāḥ kāraṇam pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1
tasmādasādhāraṇaviṣayatvādvā rasajñānavat, yathā rasajñānamasādhāraṇaviṣayatvānnīlaparamāṇvālambanaṃ na bhavatyevaṃ cakṣurvijñānamapi

vāśabdāt tannīlaparamāṇavaścakṣurviṣayā na bhavanti, asādhāraṇaviṣayatvāt, asādhāraṇāśca te viṣayāśca, rasajñānavat, rasajñāne iva rasajñānavat, yathā rasajñāne rasalakṣaṇo'rtho'sādhāraṇaviṣayatvāt tvanmatenaiva cakṣurvijñānaviṣayo na bhavati evaṃ nīlaparamāṇava iti
etaccihnāntargataḥ anyatheti ityata ārabhya ॰mānatvāt ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti
mbanam, anyathā paramārthato vidyamānatvāt tadasādhāraṇaviṣayatvādvā, rasajñānavat
nanu ca pratyekameva te samuditāḥ kāraṇam, tathāsanta eva samuditāḥ paramāṇavaścakṣurādijñānotpattihetutvādālambanam, tadavasthānāṃ jñānotpādanaśaktyabhivyakteḥ, cakṣurādiparamāṇūnāmiva
na hyeka indriyaparamāṇurviṣayaparamāṇurvā vijñānamutpādayitumalam, na tatsamudāyaḥ prajñaptisattvāt
pratyekakāraṇatāyāmaṇūnāṃ samudāye darśanaśaktivyaktiḥ, śibikāvāhakasamudāyavahanaśaktivat, andhapaṅktivat pratyekādarśanavailakṣaṇyena
itara āha --nanu ca pratyekameva te samuditāḥ kāraṇamityādi yāvadandhapaṅktivat pratyekādarśanavailakṣaṇyeneti
nanu mayā viśeṣyoktam--pratyekameva te samuditāḥ kāraṇamiti
kimuktaṃ bhavati ? tathāsanta eva paramāṇutvena paramārthasanta eva samuditāḥ paramāṇavaścakṣurādijñānotpattihetutvādālambanam

kiṃ kāraṇam ? tadavasthānāṃ jñānotpādanaśaktyabhivyakteḥ, samudāya avasthā yeṣāṃ te tadavasthāḥ, tadavasthā eva hi jñānamutpādayituṃ śaktāḥ, sā hi jñānotpādanaśaktiḥ pratyekaṃ vidyamānāpi nābhivyajyate, samudāye'bhivyajyate
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? cakṣurādiparamāṇūnāmiva pratyekaṃ rūpadarśanaśaktānāmapi na sā śaktirabhivyajyate samudāye tvabhivyajyate, tadvadālambanaparamāṇūnāmapi
viṣaya-viṣayiparamāṇūnāṃ pratyekaṃ tacchaktīnāmapyasamuditānāṃ śaktyabhāvaṃ tulyaṃ darśayati --na hyeka indriyaparamāṇurviṣayaparamāṇurvā vijñānamutpādayitumalamiti
na tatsamudāyaḥ prajñaptisattvāt, nāpi teṣāmindriyaviṣayaparamāṇūnāṃ samudāyo vijñānamutpādayitumalaṃ prajñaptisattvāt paramārthato'sattvādityarthaḥ
tasmādekamekaṃ prati kāraṇabhāvaḥ pratyekakāraṇatā, tasyāṃ satyāmeva pratyekakāraṇatāyāmaṇūnāṃ samudāye darśanaśaktivyaktiḥ
kimiva ? śibikāvāhakasamudāyavahanaśaktivat, yathā śibikāvāhakānāṃ pratyekaṃ vidyamānaiva sā vahanaśaktiḥ samudāye'bhivyajyate tathendriyaviṣayaparamāṇūnāṃ darśanadṛśyaśaktiḥ
vaidharmyeṇa andhapaṅktiḥ pratyekādarśanavailakṣaṇyena, yathāndhānāṃ pratyekamasatī darśanaśaktivyaktistatpaṅktāvapi na bhaviṣyati tathehendriyaviṣayadraṣṭṛdṛśyaśaktayo nābhaviṣyan, bhavanti tu
tasmāt pratyekaṃ vidyamānaśaktaya evendriyaviṣayaparamāṇavaḥ samudāye'- bhivyaktaśaktayo bhavantīti
abhyupagataṃ sañcitālambanāḥ pañca vijñānakāyāḥ abhi॰ pi॰ iti, tasyābhyupagatasya nirākaraṇaṃ phalamasyāḥ pratyakṣavyavasthāyāḥ

kutaḥ ? asañcitaparamāṇvālambanaśrayaṇāt, pratyekaṃ darśanaśaktimatāmindriyaviṣayaparamāṇūnāṃ darśanaśaktivyaktirityasyāṃ kalpanāyāṃ nanvasañcitāḥ paramāṇavaścakṣurvijñānotpādanaśaktā ityetadāśritaṃ bhavati pañcānāṃ vijñānakāyānāmasañcitālambanatvam
kiṃ kāraṇam ? pratyekadarśanaśaktikhyāpanāt, śibikāvāhakasādharmyāt ta eva hi darśanaśaktiyuktāḥ pratyekamiti bhavati

ācārya āha--satyam, uktametat, ayuktam, kiṃ kāraṇam ? janakānanyathātvāt, na hi jñānasya janakebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyo'nyaḥ sañcayo'stīti prāgetad vistareṇa pratipāditam, tasmājjanakānanyathātvāt sañcayābhāvāt pratyekaṃ darśanaśaktyabhivyaktipratyakṣavyavasthā abhyupagatanirākaraṇaphalaiveyam

athavā janakānāmanyaḥ prakāro'nyathā, tadbhāvo'nyathātvam, tatpratiṣedho janakānanyathātvam, tasmājjanakānāṃ paramāṇūnāmatīndriyāṇāmananyathātvādaindriyakatvavyavasthānābhāvāt sañcayasyārthāntarabhūtasyābhāvādasañcitaparamāṇvālambanaśrayaṇaṃ tadavastham
satyam, uktametat, ayuktaṃ tūktam ityapi pāṭhaḥ sambhavedatra
athavā yuktaiṣā kalpanā tvayāśrayituṃ svalakṣaṇaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣam ityetatpratijñānasaṃvāditvāt tannirvoḍhukāmena
yasmāt pratyekaṃ te samuditāḥ kāraṇam pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 1

15 ityetat pratyakṣaviṣayasamarthanavacanamādipratijñānena tulyaṃ vartata iti ādipratijñānavat, ādipratijñānānurūpam, yā hi pratijñā svalakṣaṇaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣam iti saitena vacanena niruhyate, yasmāt svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvapratisamādhānena nirvahaṇametat svalakṣaṇaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣam iti ādau pratijñāya pratyekaṃ te samuditāḥ kāraṇamiti bruvatā'ṇūnāṃ svalakṣaṇatvāt pratyavekṣitapaurvāparyasādhyasādhanasambandhaṃ hi vaktavyam
aho sādhu, kintu punaratra devānāṃpriya bhavato doṣajātam
kiṃ tat ? anekārthajanyasvārthasāmānyagocaranirasanam, tatrānekārthajanyatvāt svārthe sāmānyagocaram pra॰ samu॰ 1
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti pratyavekṣitapūrvāparānumata- ādipratijñātārthanirasanam
itarathāpi caiṣāṃ samudāya eva na syāt, pratyekamabhūtatvāt, vandhyāputravat
bauddhairevoktā trayātiriktasaṃskṛtakṣaṇikānityatvābhyupagamena sahāsaṅgatirasya, pratyeka- nigamanaparigraheṇa vā ādipratijñātārthanirasanam
vāśabdasya vikalpatvāt svalakṣaṇaviṣayapratyakṣatvaṃ vā nirasyate, anekārthajanyasvārthasāmānyagocaratā vā, ubhayaṃ vā nirasyata iti
itarathāpi caiṣāṃ samudāya eva na syāt, pratyekamabhūtatvāt, vandhyāputravat
kiñcānyat, pratyekaṃ te samuditāḥ kāraṇamiti vacanādavyastā ityetadarthādāpannamiti tadeva punaḥ smārayati doṣāntaraiḥ --anekāntavad dvayorantayoravasthātavyam
dvāvantau dvau deśau, dvayordeśayoravastheyaṃ taiḥ paramāṇubhirekataḥ pratyekasamuditaiḥ
anekāntena tulyaṃ vartata ityanekāntavat, yathā dravyāntaparyāyāntayoravatiṣṭhamānāḥ paramāṇavasta eva tatsamudāyaśceti vyapadiśyante tathā pratyekatāyāṃ cāvastheyamityanekāntasādharmyaṃ darśayati
caśabdaḥ samuccaye, kiṃ samuccinoti ? samudāyamuparitanam, pratyekatāyāṃ ca samudāye cāvasthātavyamiti

agnyambhovacca tadaśakyaśakte samudāye, agneḥ śakyaṃ dahanādi hlādanasnehanādyaśakyam, ambhasastu snehanahlādanādi śakyamaśakyaṃ dahanādi, tadaśakye śaktastadaśakyaśaktaḥ pratyekāśakye śaktaḥ samudāyaḥ
vākyārthastu lokavyāpino'pi paramāṇavaḥ saṅghātabhedapariṇāmāpekṣā eva cākṣuṣatvādibhājo bhavanti nānyathetyubhayāntātyāgavādino jainā yad vadanti tadeva tavāpyāpannam
kutaḥ ? sākṣāttvaduktatattvatvāt, tvayaiva sākṣāduktaṃ tattvameṣāṃ paramāṇūnām pratyekaṃ cakṣurvijñānotpādane na śaktāḥ, samuditāḥ śaktāḥ iti

samityekībhāve, sa caikībhāvo'nekasya, iṇ gatau pā॰ dhā॰ 1045, ayanaṃ gamanaṃ gatirāya iti paryāyāḥ, utkaṭāya udāyaḥ, saṅgato bhṛśamāyaḥ, samudāyaśabdasya tatparigrahāt pratyekaṃ te samuditā anekaikībhūtabhṛśagatayaḥ ityarthaḥ kṛtaḥ, tasmāccānekāntavādābhyupagamaḥ
kiñcānyat, itarathāpi caiṣāṃ samudāya eva na syāt, nyāyato'pītyarthaḥ, etat pratijñānam
samudāya eva na syāt, pratyekamabhūtatvāt, vandhyāputravadityeṣa nyāyaḥ, yathā pratyekamabhūtānāṃ vandhyāputrāṇāṃ samudāyo nāsti tathā paramāṇūnāmiti
nanvayamanyāyaḥ pratyekamabhūtatvāsiddheḥ paramāṇūnāmiti cet, netyucyate, bauddhairevoktā trayātiriktasaṃskṛtakṣaṇikānityatvābhyupagamena sahāsaṅgatirasya
kiṃ bhūtasya sahatā ? abhūtasya ? yadi bhūtasya bhavanānantaravinaṣṭatvāt kutaḥ sahatā, uktavadasattvāpattereva ? yaduktaṃ vaḥ siddhānte— buddhibodhyaṃ trayādanyat saṃskṛtaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ ca tat

ākāśa-pratisaṅkhyā-'pratisaṅkhyānirodhākhyāt trayādanyat pratyayajanitatvāt saṃskṛtam, saṃskṛtatvācca kṣaṇikānityam, kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇikam, kṣaṇamātramevāsya kālo na parata iti kṣaṇikānityameva na kālāntarāvasthāyyanityatvaṃ laukikābhimataghaṭādivadityetenābhyupagamena saha pratyekaṃ te samuditāḥ kāraṇamityasyābhyupagamasya saṅgatirnāsti

kiṃ kāraṇam ? pratyekatvaprāptyanantarameva vinaṣṭatvāt, ekaikasya paramāṇoḥ svarūpalābhasamanantarameva vinaṣṭatvāt kaḥ pratyekasamudāyaḥ ? ko vā deśato'tyantaṃ rūpādibhedena yāvadanabhilāpyatathāvasthānāṃtayāvaśyaṃ bhidyamānānāṃ pratyekaṃ bhāvaḥ ? iti siddhaṃ pratyekamabhūtatvaṃ deśataḥ kālataścāvasthāntarāprāpteriti

pratyekatvaprāptirapi caivaṃ naiva, nirmūlata eva paramāṇūnāṃ yāpi pratyekatvaprāptiḥ sāpi caivamuktavidhinā naivāsti, svarūpaprāptimātradeśakālāpratīkṣitvavināśitvādasattvāt, vandhyāputravat, yathā vandhyāputrāṇāṃ pratyekatvaprāptirnāsti tathā paramāṇvabhimatānāṃ tathānavasthānāmabhāvānna pratyekatvaprāptiriti
kiṃ bhūtasya sahatā ? abhūtasya ? yadi bhūtasya bhavanānantaravinaṣṭatvāt kutaḥ sahatā, uktavadasattvāpattereva ?
buddhibodhyaṃ trayādanyat saṃskṛtaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ ca tat | iti
apica vaināśikāḥ kalpayanti buddhibodhyaṃ trayādanyat saṃskṛtaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ ca iti
buddhipūrvakaḥ kila vināśo bhāvānāṃ pratisaṅkhyānirodho nāma bhāṣyate, tadviparīto'pratisaṅkhyānirodhaḥ, āvaraṇābhāvamātramākāśamiti --brahmasūtraśāṅkarabhā॰ 42
sahotpādādadoṣa iti cet, teṣāṃ paramāṇūnāmasattvamasiddhaṃ tathānavasthānāmapi deśaikyena kālaikyena ca sahotpādābhyupagamāt, tasmādasti pratyekatvaprāptiriti

etacca na, tulyatvāt paramāṇvasattvasya, deśakālabhedotpādāsattvena sahotpādāsattvasya tulyatvāt, vikalpadvaye'pi yaugapadyāsiddheridamasi tvaṃ praṣṭavyaḥ --kiṃ bhūtasya sahatā ? abhūtasya ? iti vikalpadvayānativṛttereṣa praśna ubhayathāpi na ghaṭata ityuttaraṃ vaktumanasaḥ
itara āha--abhūtasya sahatetyayukto vikalpaḥ, ka evaṃ brūyāt abhūtasya khapuṣpasyeva satā'satā vā sahatā iti yataḥ sa vikalpaḥ pūrvapakṣyate ? tasmādbhūtasya sahateti brūmaḥ
atrācārya āha--tvamevaitadvikalpadvayaṃ tathāvasthāḥ pratyekaṃ samuditāḥ kāraṇaṃ paramāṇavaḥ iti bruvāṇaścintaya ka evamāheti
kiṃ na etena ? yo bravīti sa bravītu, yadi bhūtasya yadi tāvad bhūtasya sahotpādaḥ, bhavanānantaravinaṣṭatvāt kṣaṇikavāde kutaḥ sahatā ? nāstyatra kāraṇaṃ sahatve kasyacit kenacidityarthaḥ
uktavadityatideśāddeśakālābhyāmatyantabhede nirabhilāpyasvabhāvānāṃ pratyekatvaprāptireva nāstītyuktaṃ tathā teṣā masattvāpatterevāṇūnāṃ kutaḥ sahatā ityabhisambandhaḥ
pratilabdhasahatvasya cotpāda ucyate tvayā, tattu athābhūtasya vandhyāputrasamudāyo'pi syāt, abhūtatvādasthitatvāt, aṇusamudāyavat
santānāditi cet, syānmatam--abhūtatvamasthitatvaṃ ceṣyate teṣām, tathāpi janmavināśasantānasyāvyavacchedāt sthitatvamastyataḥ sahotpādādadoṣa iti

etaccāyuktam, yasmāt so'pyevameva, so'pi santāno bhūto vā syādabhūto vā ? yadi bhūtaḥ kutaḥ sahatā, uktavad bhavanānantaravinaṣṭebhyo'nyasya santānasyābhāvāt ? asti cet tadvilakṣaṇo nityo'nya iti sarvakṣaṇikapratijñāhāniḥ

athetyadhikārāntare, atha sañcitālambanaviṣayajñānapakṣe kalpitāḥ kalpitā upapattayo viphalā bhavanti sadoṣāśceti taṃ parityajyedamucyeta --sarva evaiṣa virodhasaṃkleśo bāhyavastutattvapratipattijanitaḥ, vijñānād bāhyaṃ vastutattvamasti iti pratipattau satyāṃ jāyate'yaṃ saṃkleśaḥ

yadi paramāṇava ālambanaṃ tato'tīndriyatvasañcitālambanatvādyabhyupagamavirodhaḥ; atha samudāyaḥ, asattvāt khapuṣpavadanālambanameva; pratyekaṃ te samuditāḥ, svavacanavirodhādidoṣaḥ proktanyāyenetyevamādivirodhodbhāvanajanitena cittasaṃkleśena kimarthaṃ bādhyāmahe ? evaṃ tu sarvadoṣavinirmuktamidaṃ kalpanāntaramāśrayāmahe --vijñānamātrakamidaṃ tribhuvanam
yaduktam— dyaiḥ kṣamā vāyurākāśaṃ sāgarāḥ sarito diśaḥ

na dravyasaṃvṛtyādi, na punaretasyāṃ kalpanāyāmevamvidhaḥmevaṃvidhaḥ saṃkleśo'sti yat idaṃ saṃvṛtisadidaṃ paramārthasadidamaindriyakamatīndriyamityādi vikalpyamānaṃ vijñānādvyatiriktamarthajātamicchatāṃ syāt, na tu tat tato bhinnamasti
dyaiḥ kṣamā vāyurākāśaṃ sāgarāḥ sarito diśaḥ
dyauḥ kṣamā vāyurādityaḥ sāgarāḥ sarito diśaḥ
antaḥkaraṇatattvasya bhāgā bahiriva sthitāḥ || vākyapa॰ 3 | 7 | 41 iti
atra ya idaṃ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
yathedaṃ tiṣṭhatu tāvad bāhyārthābhāve vijñeyatvābhāvo vijñeyatvābhāve ca vijñānatvābhāvaḥ
tatra katamad vijñānamātramidaṃ sarvaṃ traidhātukam ? na tāvat pratyakṣavijñānamātram, tasyaivamavasthatvāt

na saṃśayabhrāntyādikalpanāvijñānamātraṃ kalpanāpoḍhaṃ pratyakṣamityetasya tvanmatasya tatsaṃvādino buddhavacanasya ca vidhvaṃsanārtho'yaṃ mamārambhastathā vijñānamātravādavidhvaṃsanārtho'pyayamevārambhaḥ, tvattīrthakarābhihitatvāt tasyāpi
athavā tatparamārthatvāt tatpratipādanārthatvācca sarvadeśanānāṃ bauddhīnāṃ tadvidhvaṃsanārtha evāyamārambhaḥ
etadapi pramāṇābhāvādayuktamiti grāhyam, pramāṇābhāvaśca prameyābhāvāditi sa doṣaḥ sthita eveti darśayati --tiṣṭhatu tāvadityādi
taṃ copāyena darśayiṣyannāha --bāhyārthābhāve vijñeyatvābhāvaḥ, tasya vijñānamātratvāt

vijñeyatvābhāve ca tasya vijñānatvamapi nāsti, vijānātīti hi vijñānam, kiṃ vijānāti vijñeyābhāve ? tataḥ prameyatvābhāvāt pramāṇatvābhāvaḥ pratyakṣasyeti jñeya-jñāna-pramāṇa-prameyatvavilakṣaṇaṃ khapuṣpavat kiṃ tat pratyakṣaṃ nāma ? ityeṣa doṣo durnivāraḥ, sa tāvat tiṣṭhatu
hiśabdo dṛṣṭāntārthe, dṛṣṭaṃ hi loke vijñānaṃ pratyakṣādi, pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca pramāṇe vijñāne
idamasi tvaṃ praṣṭavyaḥ --tatra nirdhāryaṃ katamad vijñānamātramidaṃ sarvaṃ traidhātukamiti, naikamapi vijñānamātraṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ

brūyāstvam--pratyakṣavijñānamātramiti, tanna tāvat pratyakṣavijñānamātraṃ tasyaivamavasthatvāt, tasya pratyakṣavijñānasyaivamavasthā yathāsmābhirvyākhyātā na rūpādiviṣayā na samudāyaviṣayā na cakṣurādinimittā saṃvṛtyā paramārthena vā yujyate iti tasmānna pratyakṣavijñānamātram
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasyāpi tatpūrvakatvāt, tasyāpyanumānasya tatpūrvakatvāt pratyakṣapūrvakatvāt

pratyakṣapūrvakaṃ hi svānubhavottarabhāvivikalpātmakamavikalpajñānasamanantarajanmā'numānaṃ mānasamaindriyamayogimānasapratyakṣapūrvakameveṣyate, tasyaiva pratyakṣasyāsiddhau kuto'numānasiddhiḥ ? ato nānumānamātramata āha --tadasiddhāvasiddhiratantvapaṭavat
yathā tantupūrvakasya paṭasya tantvasiddhāvasiddhistatpūrvakatvāt tathā pratyakṣāsiddhāvasiddhiranumānasya

evaṃ tarhi saṃśayabhrāntyādikalpanāvijñānamātramastu, tadapi na saṃśayabhrāntyādikalpanāvijñānamātraṃ vā, na saṃśayamātraṃ na bhrāntyādimātram, ādigrahaṇānna svapnānubhavānubhūtānukāramātraṃ na taimirikakeśondukādyākāramātram, sarvasyāsya kalpanātmakasya pramāṇābhāsasya ata eva pratyakṣapūrvakatvādeva tadasiddhāva vā, ata eva
sarvasarvātmakatāyāṃ śrotrādivṛttiḥ pratyakṣam ṣaṣṭita॰ iti bruvato nirvikalpatvādvibhāgābhāvāt siddheḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? anavagrahātmakatvāt tasya, na hi tadatyantāsañcetitaṃ nāma jñānamasti
yadyapyavyaktajñānamasti apaṭutvāt tadarthāvagrahātmakaṃ na bhavatyato vijñānameva na bhavati, yasmād vijānātīti vijñānamiṣṭam, tacca na kiñcid vijānātīti nānadhyavasāyavijñānamātram
tasmānna vijñānamātram, pramāṇapramāṇābhāsavijñāneṣvanantarbhāvāt katamad vijñānamātramidaṃ sarvam ? etebhyaśca vijñānebhyo vyatiriktasyānyasya vijñānasyābhāvānna kiñcidetadvijñānamātraṃ sarvam
ityalamativikāśinyā saṅkathayeti saṅkṣipyopasaṃharati pratyakṣalakṣaṇasya sarvathā dūṣitatvāt, itarathā hyadyāpi dūṣaṇavacanaprapañcasyānekasyāvakāśo'stīti
evaṃ tāvadviśeṣaikāntavādinā kalpitaṃ laukikapratyakṣavilakṣaṇaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na ghaṭate, svavacanavyapekṣākṣepadustaravirodhatvāt
tiṣṭhatu tāvad bāhyārthābhāve vijñeyatvābhāvo vijñeyatvābhāve ca vijñānatvābhāvaḥ
tatra katamad vijñānamātramidaṃ sarvaṃ traidhātukam ? na tāvat pratyakṣavijñānamātram, tasyaivamavasthatvāt
sarvasarvātmakatāyāṃ śrotrādivṛttiḥ pratyakṣam ṣaṣṭita॰ iti bruvato nirvikalpatvādvibhāgābhāvāt
anayaiva ca diśā svavacanavyapekṣaivākṣepo draṣṭavya iti vākyaśeṣaḥ

tatra yad viśeṣavādinaḥ prāguktaṃ doṣajātaṃ kalpanāpoḍhaṃ pratyakṣam icchataḥ kalpanātmakatvameva hetuparamparayā''pādya apratyakṣatvam, anumānatvam, ubhayaikyam, saṅkaraḥ, abhāvaḥ, nirdeśyatvam, asvalakṣaṇatā ca, kārakajñāpakāviśeṣāpādanādabhidhānārthavyapadeśyatā ca paścācca kalpanāpoḍhatāmabhyupetyāpi svasāmānyayorlakṣaṇayorabhāvāccakṣuṣo rūpasya tadvijñānasya cābhāvaḥ ityādi lakṣaṇavākyamuddiśya tadidānīmutkrameṇa vācyamiti taddiśaṃ darśayati --sarvasarvātmakatāyāmityādinā yāvadanakṣamiti

evaṃ hi lakṣaṇadūṣaṇātideśaḥ--sarvaṃ sarvātmakam ityaviśeṣamicchataḥ sāṅkhyasyāpi sarvātmakasyaikasya vastuno rūparasādibhedena śrotrādibhedena ca vikalpayitumaśakyatvād viśeṣaikāntavādina iva nirvikalpaparamārthaparamāṇumātra- sādharmyādavikalpakatvam

avikalpakatvād yathā pūrvaṃ pratyakṣalakṣaṇodāharaṇavākye doṣāḥ cakṣurnaiva cakṣuḥ, rūpaṃ naiva rūpam, vijñānaṃ naiva vijñānam ityādayastathā śrotrādivṛttiḥ pratyakṣaṃ śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇānāṃ manasā'dhiṣṭhitā vṛttiḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandheṣu yathākramaṃ grahaṇe vartamānā pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣamiti bruvataḥ sarvasarvātmakatve nirvikalpatvādvibhāgābhāvāt kiṃ śrotraṃ yat tvagādibhyo vibhaktam ? kimaśrotraṃ tvagādi yacchrotrādvibhaktam ? yaccoktaṃ śrotrādi iti, tatra ka ādiḥ sarvātmakaikavastutve kiṃ śrotram ? kimaśrotram ? ka ādiḥ ? ko'nādiḥ ? kā vṛttiḥ ? kā vā'vṛttiḥ ? kiṃ prati ? kimaprati ? kimakṣam ? kimanakṣamityādi ? loke śāstre ca hi vastusvatattvasākṣātpratipattiḥ pratyakṣam
tattu tvanmatavanna tvevaṃlakṣaṇam pratyakṣam, nirvikalpatvāsiddheḥ kalpanātmakatvādibhyo bhrāntyādivat

sañcitālambanasthāna uktavad rūpāderekasyāsarvasyālambanasyāsañcitavad ghaṭa- prathamadvitīyādyanyonyāpekṣavibhāgābhāvāt ? ko'nādirmadhyo'nto vā ? kā vṛttisteṣāṃ śrotrādīnāṃ pūrvamapravṛttānāṃ paścādvṛttiḥ kālabhedenāvasthāntaratvena ca viśiṣṭā ? kā vā'vṛttirvṛttyuparamalakṣaṇā vibhāgābhāvādeva ? kiṃ prati, katamo'nyo bhāvo yamapekṣya taṃ pratyakṣamityucyate ? napuṃsakaliṅgasyāvyaktaguṇasandehaviṣayatvāt kiṃ prati iti praśnaḥ

kimaprati, sarvasarvātmakaikatve kaiḥ kiṃ nāpekṣyate ? kimakṣamindriyaṃ yad viṣayavyatiriktaṃ śrotrādi parasparavyatiriktaṃ vā ? kimanakṣamindriyavyatiriktaṃ viṣayo rūpādi parasparato vā ? iti pradarśane, itthaṃ vibhāgābhāvād vibhāgena lakṣaṇapraṇayanaṃ svavacanavyapekṣākṣepadustaravirodham
ādigrahaṇāt kiṃ śabdādi ? kiṃ manaḥ ? kimadhiṣṭheyaṃ kena ? iti
kiṃ śrotram ? kimaśrotram ? ka ādiḥ ? ko'nādiḥ ? kā vṛttiḥ ? kā vā'vṛttiḥ ? kiṃ prati ? kimaprati ? kimakṣam ? kimanakṣamityādi ?
loke śāstre ca hi vastusvatattvasākṣātpratipattiḥ pratyakṣam
tattu tvanmatavanna tvevaṃlakṣaṇam pratyakṣam, nirvikalpatvāsiddheḥ kalpanātmakatvādibhyo bhrāntyādivat
loke śāstre ca hi vastusvatattvasākṣātpratipattiḥ pratyakṣam, vastunaḥ svaṃ tattvamasādhāraṇamātmīyaṃ rūpam, yā tasya sākṣātpratipattirna vyavahitā sā pratyakṣam

tattu tvanmatavanna tvevaṃlakṣaṇaṃ pratyakṣam, tvanmata iva tvanmatavat, yathā sarvasarvātmakatve tvanmate śrotrādivṛtteḥ sarvasarvātmakavastvekadeśaśabdādiviṣayatvāt samudāyarūpatvādvastusvatattvasya vibhāgābhāvācchrotrādivṛttirna sambhavatītyuktaṃ tathā tasya nirvikalpasya vastuno vastusvatattvasākṣātpratipattyabhimataṃ laukikaṃ sāmayikaṃ ca pratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ na ghaṭate, nirvikalpatvāsiddheḥ, naiva tannirvikalpaṃ pratyakṣaṃ śabdādivibhāgavikalpaviṣayatvāt, avibhāgarūpaṃ ca sarvasarvātmakaṃ vastusvatattvam, tadviṣayaṃ ca tanna bhavati, tataśca kalpanātmakam, kalpanātmakatvādibhyo bhrāntyādivad na pratyakṣam iti vartate, kalpanātmakatvānnirūpaṇavikalpātmakatvādālambanaviparītapratipattyātmakatvādadhyāropātmakatvādasāmānyarūpaviṣayatvāt tadatadviṣayavṛttitvāt sadasadabhedaparigrahātmakatvāt sarvathā sādhāraṇārthatvāt, bhrāntisaṃśayānumānādijñānavaditi
pratyakṣā pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ vi॰ bhā॰
sañcitālambanasthāna uktavadityādi yāvannīlādiṣvabhāvādityanenā'tidiṣṭagranthārthabhāvanopāyadikpradarśanaṃ karoti mā bhūd vyāmoha iti
yādṛk sañcitālambanasthāne'smābhiruktam paramāṇunīlādīnāṃ sañcayaḥ sāmānyaṃ saṃvṛtisattvādasat iti, iha tu tadviparītaṃ samudāyaparamārthatvaṃ nīlādisaṃvṛtisattvam
te ca pratyekaṃ paramārthato'santa iti teṣāmaviṣayatetyādyaśeṣaṃ yathābhāgamatra yojyaṃ bhedābhedasaṃvṛtiparamārthasthānavyavasthāpanayā

kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasya rūpādyātmakatvāt tadekadeśabhūtasya rūpāderaparamārthasato'pyavibhāgāvasthasya ekasyāsarvasyālambanasyāsañcitavat na hyeko'sarvaḥ kadācidālambanaṃ rūpaṃ rasaḥ śabdo vā yathā'sañcitāḥ paramāṇavaḥ pūrvasmin vāde naindriyakā evamasañcita- vadasmin vāde lokalokottaravyavahārapratyakṣābhimateṣu ghaṭādiṣu nīlādiṣu cābhāvānna pratyakṣaṃ tadviṣayaṃ jñānamityabhisambandhaḥ
kimuktaṃ bhavati ? rūpādayaḥ sarvaikātmarūpā eva santi na pṛthaksvarūpāḥ
anayā diśā yadābhāsaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na so'sti viṣayaḥ, yo'sti na tadābhāsaṃ pratyakṣam ityādi viśeṣaikāntavādinaṃ prati yo'bhihitaḥ prapañcaḥ sa sarvo yojyaḥ

naiva tatsāmyāvasthānaṃ śabdādibhedaikasarvātmakatvābhāvarūpaṃ sambhāvyate, sambhāvyamāne'pi ca tasminnavyakte tasyā'vyaktasyātīndriyatvādālambanatvānupapatteścakṣurādivijñānānāṃ rūpādisaṅghāta ālambanamiti prāptam
te ca rūpādayaḥ pratyekaṃ paramārthato'santaḥ, itiśabdo hetvarthe, ityataḥ kāraṇādrūpādisaṅghātālambanatvāt teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ paramārthasattvābhāvānna viṣayatā
rūpādiviṣayaṃ vā na pratyakṣam, paramārthato'sadviṣayatvāt, vandhyāsutajñānavat
yadindriyaviṣayaṃ tatpariṇāmabhede saṅghāte rūpādi na tat paramārthasat
ityā- dyaśeṣaṃ viśeṣaikāntavādimate yathābhāgaṃ yo yo bhāgo yathābhāgaṃ tadviparyayeṇāviśeṣaikāntavāde'tra yad yatra bhajate tat tathānusṛtya yojyamityatītaṃ granthārthaṃ smārayati
ye tatra bhedarūpāḥ paramāṇavaḥ paramārthasantaste'tra saṃvṛtisantaḥ sarvasarvātmakaparamārthavāde, yastatrābhedaḥ paramāṇusamudāyaḥ saṃvṛtisan so'tra paramārthasannityanayā vyavasthāpanayā yojyam
te ca pratyekaṃ paramārthato'santa iti teṣāmaviṣayatetyādyaśeṣaṃ yathābhāgamatra yojyaṃ bhedābhedasaṃvṛtiparamārthasthānavyavasthāpanayā

tadyathā --sarvasarvātmakaikarūpāntarāviviktasvatattve rūpādisattvādisaṅghāta indriyasannikṛṣṭa ālambanaviparītaikarūpeyaṃ pratipattiḥ vyapadeśyānekātmakanīlarūpaviṣayā, na ca hetvapadeśāvyapadeśyaiṣā, yataḥ sarvātmakagrahaṇāpadeśena dhūmenevāgnisāmānyavad gṛhyate nānirdeśyarūpam
18 dravyādinirmūlatvāt kimātmādi ? iti na pratyakṣam, dravyarūpādibhavanaviśeṣakāraṇa- kiṃ kāraṇam ? tato'nyat kalpitamekaṃ rūpam

nanvidamasyaivārthasya pradarśanārthaṃ prastutamasmābhiḥ, yadīdaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt kārakādeva svārthādālambanāddhetorjāyeta dāhānubhavavat pratyakṣatvādavyavahitapratipattyātmakatvāt pratyakṣasya svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvādanadhyāropātmakatvāditi yāvat
api ca kārakatāpi sarvasya naiva tatra, dvitīyacandravat paramārthato'sattvādanupāttavyāvṛttivyavasthānamātratvāt
lokavattu sarvasattve viśiṣṭo'padeśo vyapadeśo grāhyādanyaḥ, tena vyapadeśena prameyaṃ vyapadeśyamanumeyaṃ na pratyakṣam, dhūmānumeyāgnivat, akārakatāyāṃ kārakatāyāṃ vā vastunaḥ pitṛdhūmādivat
18 dravyādinirmūlatvāt kimātmādi ? iti na pratyakṣam, dravyarūpādibhavanaviśeṣakāraṇa-

taddhi nīlarūpanirūpaṇaṃ vikalpaḥ, pratiparamāṇuparasparapratibhinnasvatattvānekarūpaikatattvaikarūpādhyāropāt sarvasarvātmakaikarūpavasturūpādyanekarūpādhyāropādvā rūpāntarasāmānyarūpaviṣayatvāt tadatadviṣayavṛttatvādanapohādapohādvā'gnyanumānavat tatsāmānyātmakataiva paramārthasthitasañcayaprajñaptinīlāṇubhedaparigrahātmakatvāt sādhāraṇārthaviviktakalpanātmakatvānna pratyakṣamapratyayapratyayātmakatvācchabdāśrāvaṇatvapratyayavat
saṃvṛtyatīndriyatvābhyāṃ hi na nīlādiṣu na ca sañcaye kāraṇatā tathāpratipattiṃ prati
anumānajñānamapi ca tanna pratipūryate, sambaddhagṛhītasyānyathāpratipatteḥ, viruddhādijñānavaditi samānametat kalpanātmakatvāt
anyadapi yathāsambhavaṃ tatprakriyāpatitaṃ muktvā yadubhayoḥ sāmānyaṃ tat sarvaṃ yojyam

kīdṛśaṃ vā tat pratyakṣaṃ kathamayuktaṃ vā ? iti, ātmendriyamanorthasannikarṣād yanniṣpadyate tadanyat, ātmā manasā mana indriyeṇa indriyamartheneti catuṣṭayatrayadvayasannikarṣādutpadyamānaṃ pratyakṣamityetadapi nānātvaikāntavādimataṃ dravyādinirmūlatvāt kimātmādi ? iti na pratyakṣam, dravyamādiryeṣāṃ ta ime dravyādayo dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyā adravyatvāt dravyebhyo'nye khapuṣpavanna syuḥ, evaṃ guṇebhyo'nye na syuraguṇatvāt, akarmatvāt karmaṇo'nye, asāmānyatvāt sāmānyato'nye, aviśeṣatvād viśeṣebhyo'nye, asamavāyatvāt samavāyādanye, nirmūlatvācca khapuṣpavat sarve

ato'sattvādātmādīnāmātmamano'kṣārthābhāve kimātmādi, yatsannikarṣājjñānamutpadyeta ? kasya tat, ātmadravyābhāvāt ? kiṃ tat, guṇābhāvāt ? itiśabdo hetvarthe, rājapuruṣo'smīti na bibhemi iti yathā tathā iti na pratyakṣam, ātmādidravyāṇāṃ jñānādiguṇānāṃ cābhāvānnāsti pratyakṣamityarthaḥ

teṣāṃ cātmādīnāmanyathā paramārthato vidyamānānāmanekāntātmakānāmekāntātmatayā kalpanādanyathādhyāropāt kalpanātmakatvādibhyo hetubhyo bhrāntyādivanna pratyakṣamiti pūrvoktaṃ tadeva vyācaṣṭe --dravyarūpādītyādi yāvatkalpanāt

eṣa ca vedavādibhirapi lokapramāṇaka ājñānikavāda upajīvyate yasyāya- dravyagrahaṇena pṛthivyādīnāṃ tatkalpitānāṃ sarvaguṇānāṃ guṇagrahaṇena bhavanagrahaṇena sattāyāḥ viśeṣagrahaṇena gotvādīnāṃ yāvadantyaviśeṣasya kāraṇagrahaṇenāvayavādidravyāṇāṃ saṃyogādiguṇānāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca grahaṇam
tatra paramārthataḥ sa ca asaśca padārtho'nantarokto dravyādiḥ, tasyānekāntaḥ svatattvaṃ dravyamapi rūpādyapi bhavanamapi viśeṣo'pi kāraṇamapi kāryamapīti
tasya tasyānyatamaikāntakalpanādatattvaṃ dravyameva guṇa eva karmaiva bhavanameva viśeṣa eva netarasvatattvamapīti
eṣa ca vedavādibhirapi lokapramāṇaka ājñānikavāda upajīvyate yasyāya-

ata ityanantaroktasarvopapattiprapañcato yat prāk pratijñātaṃ yathālokagrāhameva vastu iti tannigamayati sopapattikaṃ sarvapramāṇāvirodhitattvavyavahārasamavasthalokaparigrahavadeveti, pratyakṣānumānāgamapramāṇairanavadhāritakāraṇakāryobhayānubhayātmakaṃ tasya tasya vastuno bhāvastattvamavirodhi, tasmiṃstattve tattvasya tattvena vā vyavahāraḥ, tasmin samavasthā yasya lokasya tasya lokasya parigrahaḥ sa sarvapramāṇāvirodhitattvavyavahārasamavasthalokaparigrahaḥ, tadvat tena tulyaṃ vartata iti
evetyavadhāraṇe, tādṛglokaparigrahavadeva sāmānyaviśeṣau, na tu sāmānyameva viśeṣa eva parasparato bhinnāvabhinnāveveti vā yathā śāstreṣu kalpitāviti

athavā sarvapramāṇāvirodhini tattvavyavahāre samavasthā yasya sa lokaḥ sarvapramāṇāvirodhitattvavyavahārasamavasthaḥ, tasya parigrahavadeva sāmānyaviśeṣau nānyatheti yathā pratipāditaṃ lokavadeva ghaṭādiviṣayāviti, yathā loke ghaṭādibhavanameva sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaśca dravyakṣetrakālabhāvarūpabhavanāviśeṣaviśeṣābhyāmuktavidhinā kāryakāraṇādibhedena vā niyatau sarvatra na maryādayetyanavadhṛtasvabhāvau
iti vidhiḥ, iti pradarśane, eṣa vidhiritthaṃ vicārito yaḥ pṛthaguddiṣṭaḥ
atra prathama uddiṣṭaḥ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
eṣa ca vedavādibhirapi lokapramāṇaka ājñānikavāda upajīvyata iti
nayānāmekaikasya śatadhā bhedāt saptanayaśatāni ārṣe vyākhyāyante, teṣāṃ punaścaturdhā saṅkṣepaḥ kriyā-'kriyā-'jñāna-vinaya manyo bhedaḥ--sarvamidamajñānapratibaddhameva jagat pṛthivyādi
tatkaraṇatvāt taiḥ prakāśitaṃ sthūlamajñaṃ pratipadyeta jñaḥ

tasyāpi cendriyasannikṛṣṭasyāsādhāraṇasvarūpasya na nirūpaṇopāyo'sti, pratyekaṃ samudāye vā vādasamavasaraṇavacanāt tatroktaḥ, ājñānikavādaḥ kiñcinna jñāyate, ko ha vaitad veda ? kiṃ vā'nena jñātena ? ityaśakyaprāptyaphalatvābhyāṃ vastutattvavicāro na yujyate, kriyāyā evopadeśo'taḥ śreyān iti leśenābhyupagatatvāt

nanvete padārthā ajñā eva, kimarthamajñānapratibaddhaṃ jagat pṛthivyādītyucyate ? ucyate--ākāśakāladigātmendriyamanaḥprabhṛtīnāmapi tadvyatirekeṇānupalabdherna santi tanmayatvādeva ca tadvadacetanānyata āha --indriyāṇyapi ca tanmayānyevācetanānīti
tanmayatvānumānaṃ ca bhūyastvād gandhavattvācca pṛthivī gandhajñāne
tathāpastejo vāyuśca rasarūpasparśeṣu rasarūpasparśaviśeṣāt vai॰ sū॰ 8
cattāri vāisamosaraṇā paṇṇattā, taṃ jahā--kiriyāvāī akiriyāvāī aṇṇāṇiyavāī veṇaiyavāī iti sthānāṅgasūtre caturthasthāne
tatkaraṇatvāt taiḥ prakāśitaṃ sthūlamajñaṃ pratipadyeta jñaḥ
tasyāpi cendriyasannikṛṣṭasyāsādhāraṇasvarūpasya na nirūpaṇopāyo'sti, pratyekaṃ samudāye vā
tathāpastejo vāyuśca rasarūpasparśāviśeṣāt--iti mudrite vaiśeṣikasūtre pāṭhaḥ

abhyupetyāpi ātmādivyatirekaṃ tatkaraṇatvāt teṣāmindriyāṇāṃ karaṇatvāt tāni vā'sya karaṇāni tatkaraṇo jñaḥ, taiḥ karaṇaiḥ prakāśitaṃ ghaṭādisthūlamajñaṃ prakāśyatvādeva cānyamapyarthaṃ prakāśya pratipadyamāno'pi pratipadyeta jñaḥ, sambhāvyamānapratipattirapi puruṣaḥ sthūlamevārthaṃ pratipadyetājñānātmakam
acetanakaraṇaprakāśitamapyacetanaṃ pradīpaprakāśitaghaṭādivadeva syāt sthūlaṃ ca, na paramāṇvādi sūkṣmaṃ śuddhaṃ cetanasvarūpapuruṣādi vā syādajñānāpratibaddham
satyapi ca tasya sthūlasya grāhyatve tatsvarūpājñānādajñānasambaddhameva
tasyendriyasannikṛṣṭasya dravyāntaravyatiriktamasādhāraṇaṃ yat svarūpamātmādervātīndriyasya tasya kvacit kadācidadṛṣṭatvāt idamidam iti na nirūpaṇopāyo'sti
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ na nirūpaṇopāyo'sti idamidam iti cet, ucyate --pratyekaṃ samudāye vā taddṛṣṭyanupapatteḥ, tasyāsādhāraṇarūpasyāpūrvasyāpūrvatvādeva dṛṣṭyanupapattirnirṇayānupapattiśca

pratyekaṃ tāvanna hi ghaṭa ekaikaḥ kṛṣṇādirūpo'pūrvatvāddṛśyate svarūpataḥ, tata eva pratyekamanirūpitasvarūpāṇāṃ kuto nirūpaṇaṃ samudāye, sikatāsu pratyekamanirūpitasya samudāye tailasya nirūpaṇābhāvavat ? niścayena rūpaṇaṃ nirūpaṇam, tadupāyābhāvāt ajñānapratibaddhameva sarvam iti sādhūktam
syānmatam--anubhaviturbāhyaviṣayam idamidam iti nirūpaṇaṃ mā bhūd yadi na bhavati, svasaṃvedanaṃ tvāntaraṃ sukhaduḥkhādiṣu kiṃ nirūpaṇaṃ na bhavati ? iti

ucyate --svasaṃvedanenocchvasanābhyavahṛtapariṇatītyādi, vyabhicārānna bhavati, prāṇāpānāvasañcetayanneva hi kurute sarvo lokaḥ, abhyavahṛtamapi khalarasabhāvena rasarudhirādibhāvena ca pariṇamayanna sañcetayati svayameva
tathā suptādīnāṃ calanakaṇḍūyanasphuraṇādikriyāḥ kurvatāmasañcetayamānānāmeva tāḥ kriyā dṛśyante
itthaṃ kalpitākalpitatathābhūtapratyayānupapatteḥ, kalpitastāvat kalpitatvādeva tathābhūto na bhavati pratyayaḥ, akalpito'pītthamuktavidhinā nopapadyate tathābhūtaḥ pratyayaḥ śuddha ityarthaḥ
paricchedārthaśca pramāṇavyāpāraḥ, pramāṇaṃ hi vyāpriyamāṇaṃ yathārthaparicchedārthamiṣyate, na cetthaṃ tatparicchedo'stīti vaidharmyaṃ darśayati
syānmatam--ajñānapratibaddham ityajñānaśabdoccāraṇādeva jñānābhyupagamaḥ kṛto bhavati pratiṣedhasyā'brāhmaṇavadanyatra prasiddhaviṣayatvāt, anyathā pratiṣedhānupapatteḥ svavacanavirodhācca

kutaḥ ? viśeṣyaprādhānyādanavadhāraṇāt, kā bhāvanā ? yathā rādhakasya pūrṇakasya vaikaiva mātā vivakṣitā bhavati tadā rādhakamātā iti rādhakena viśiṣyamāṇāviśeṣyamāṇā pūrṇakamātā iti pūrṇakena vā atha rādhakapūrṇakamātā ityubhābhyāṃ vā, sarvathā rādhakasyaiva pūrṇakasyaiva vā mātetyavadhāraṇaṃ nāsti, viśeṣyaprādhānyāt, tathā jñānājñānābhyāṃ tadeva viśiṣyateviśeṣyate vastviti viśeṣyaprādhānyānnoktivirodho jñānājñānayoraviśeṣāt
na tu yathā viśeṣaṇaprādhānyādavadhāraṇaṃ nīlamutpalam iti
gamḷ sṛpḷ gatau pā॰ dhā॰ 982--983, ava pūrṇagamanamavagamaḥ, avagamaścāvabodhaḥ, abudha vagamanebudha avagamane pā॰ dhā॰ 858, 1172 iti vacanāt
bhaṅgagrahaṇaṃ bhaṅgāntarasūcanārtham, parasparanirapekṣāṇāṃ bhaṅgānāṃ vṛttermṛṣātvāt tadviparyayāyāḥ satyatvāt teṣāṃ ca vidhiniyamayoreva bhaṅgatvānnayānām
tasmādasminneva nayabhaṅge śabdasyājñāto'rthaḥ, nānyeṣu, teṣvapyanye'nye'rthā iti
etasya darśanasya jñāpakamāha— yathā cāhuḥ--astyarthaḥ sarvaśabdānāmiti ślokaḥ
sattāmātramarthaḥ sarvaśabdānām, ko'pyasyārtho'sti, na nirarthakaḥ śabdaḥ, sa punarartho na nirūpayituṃ śakyaḥ ayamayam iti, etat pratyāyyalakṣaṇam

tatra dṛṣṭānto'pūrvadevatāsvargaśabdānāmarthāḥ, yathā teṣāmatyantāparidṛṣṭatvāt īdṛśo'pūrvaḥ svargo devatā vedṛśī iti na pratipadyāmahe nirūpaṇena tathā gavādiśabdānāmapyarthaistatsamaireva bhavitavyam, na hi gamanagadanagarjanādiṣvarthavyavasthā viśeṣarūpeti kaścidastyarthaḥ ityetāvat pratipattavyam
etasminneva nayabhaṅge sarvāṇi ca padāni vākyārthaḥ
tadyathā--devadatta ! gāmabhyāja śuklāṃ daṇḍena ityatra parasparāvivekena saṅkīrṇarūpāṇi padāni ekārthāni anvayavyatirekābhyāmanugamyamānaṃ sampiṇḍitamevārthaṃ brūyurna pṛthagbhūtam
tasmāt sarvāṇi padāni vākyāya vākyārthaḥ, padānyeva vākyārthaḥ, naikaikaṃ na tadvyatiriktam
yathoktam --arthaikatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ sākāṅkṣaṃ cedvibhāge syāt mīmāṃsāsū॰ 2
na tu yathānyaiḥ kalpyate'nyathā— ākhyātaśabdaḥ saṅghāto jātiḥ saṅghātavartinī

yathaiva hi gamikriyā jātyantaraikārthasamavāyinībhyo gamikriyābhyo'tyantabhinnā tulyarūpatvavidhau tvantareṇaiva gamimabhidhīyamānā gauriti śabdavyutpattikarmaṇi nimittatvena āśrīyate tathaiva girati garjati gadati ityevamādayaḥ sādhāraṇāḥ sāmānyaśabdanibandhanāḥ kriyāviśeṣāstaistairācāryaiḥ gośabdavyutpādanakriyāyāṃ parigṛhītāḥ— iti vākyapadīyasvavṛttau 2
gacchati gadati garjati vā gauḥ--iti pātañjalamahābhāṣyasya bhartṛhariviracitāyāṃ tripādyākhyāyāṃ vṛttau
bhā॰ pratipāṭhe tu caturthī tadarthārthabalihitasukharakṣitaiḥ pā॰ 2
36 iti sūtrānusāreṇa vākyāya iti vākyārthaḥ iti caturthītatpuruṣo'tra vivakṣito viśeṣyaliṅgavacanānusāritā tu nādṛteti bhāti
vākyaṃ prati matirbhinnā bahudhā nyāyadarśinām || vākyapa॰ 2 | 1--2
kva punarayaṃ nayo'ntarbhāvyate, kiṃ dravyanayabhede ? paryāyanayabhede ? ucyate --vyavahāradeśatvāccāsya dravyārthatā, laukikasama upacāraprāyo vistṛtārtho vyavahāraḥ tattvārthabhā॰ 1
35 iti vacanāt tasya tasyā avayava ekadeśo'samastavṛttiranyathāvṛttitvāt
nibandhanaṃ cāsya--ātā bhaṃte ! ṇāṇe, aṇṇāṇe ? gotamā ! ṇāṇe ṇiyamā ātā, ātā puṇa siyā ṇāṇe siyā aṇṇāṇe
lokavyavahāraviṣayo hi vyavahāraḥ, tadekadeśo vidhinayaḥ, tasmāddravyārthabhedaḥ

4 tasya śabdārthavyutpattidarśanārthamāha --dravyaśabda iti, droravayavo dravyam iti vyutpāditatvāt atha druḥ kaḥ ? du dru gatau pā॰ dhā॰ 944, 945, tattulyārthamavyutpannaṃ prātipadikam, dyudrubhyāṃ maḥ pā॰ 5
108 iti nipātitatvāt, tasyārtho drurgatiryātrā vyavahāro lokasyeti
sā punarasyā vidhivṛtterekadeśavṛttitā kutaḥ paricchidyata iti cet, lokata eva paricchidyata ityarthaḥ
yasmālloke tadekadeśavṛttitā mṛdghaṭādisāmānyaviśeṣatvadravyatvānām, mṛt sāmānyam, ghaṭo viśeṣaḥ, mṛdaḥ sāmānyaṃ dravyatvam, ghaṭaviśeṣaśchidrabudhnakhaṇḍauṣṭha-sampūrṇa-rakta-kṛṣṇatādiḥ
sarva evaiṣo'parityājyo'rthakalāpaḥ samastavṛttau nayānāṃ yathāsvaṃ ca pramāṇavaśādvyavasthāpyaḥ
nibandhanaṃ cāsya--ātā bhaṃte ! ṇāṇe, aṇṇāṇe ? gotamā ! ṇāṇe ṇiyamā ātā, ātā puṇa siyā ṇāṇe siyā aṇṇāṇe
