paḍirūvaṃ puṇa vayaṇatthaṇicchao tassa vavahāro || sanmati॰ 1 | 4
vyatireke ghaṭavaditi, yadvastu tallaukikameva yathā ghaṭaḥ kāryaṃ vā kāraṇaṃ vā sāmānyaṃ vā viśeṣo vā yo vā sa vāstu yathālokaprasiddhi pṛthubudhnādiprāguktasāmānyaviśeṣabhavanāt sa ca laukika iti
asmin pāṭhe tu svārasye ॰bhāvitatvāt ityarthamabhipretya saṅgamanīyam

sarvanayānāṃ jinapravacanasyaiva nibandhanatvāt kimasya nibandhanamiti cet, ucyate, nibandhanaṃ cāsya— ātā bhaṃte ! ṇāṇe, aṇṇāṇe ? iti svāmī gautamasvāminā pṛṣṭo vyākaroti gotamā ! ṇāṇe ṇiyamā ātā, jñānaṃ niyamādātmā jñānasyātmavyatirekeṇa vṛttyadarśanāt

ātā puṇa siyā ṇāṇe siyā aṇṇāṇe, ātmā punaḥ syājjñānam, syādajñānamapyasau jñānāvaraṇīyakarmavaśīkṛtatvāt saṃśayaviparyayānadhyavasāyabāhulyādityasmāt sūtrādetad mithyādarśanaṃ nirgatamajñānoktivirodhasamādhimaditi
āyā puṇa siya nāṇe sia annāṇeya॰

kaḥ punaḥ sambandhaḥ ? svaviṣayasampātanenārthānāṃ bhāvanātmabhirvidhiniyamavṛttibhirviditapratyekatattvābhiḥ samadhigamyā jainasatyatvasādhanavṛttā vivakṣitadvādaśavikalpaviśeṣaṇaikaiva vṛttiradhikṛtetyanantaroktāyā vidhivṛtterapi pratyekavṛttāyā mithyādṛṣṭitvādayamapi tu vidhivṛttyekāntastyājyaḥ
viruddhaḥ pratiṣedho vipratiṣedhaḥ, sarvamuktaṃ mṛṣā iti pratiṣedhavat

kathaṃ vipratiṣedha iti cet, ucyate--yaduktaṃ tvayā sarvamajñānānuviddhameva jñānam, na ca jñānājñānayoḥ kaścidviśeṣo'sti saṃśayaviparyayānadhyavasāyanirṇayānāmavabodhaikārthatvāt, na lokatattvaṃ jñātuṃ śakyam, viphalaśca vivekayatnaḥ śāstreṣu iti

tadyadi lokatattvamajñeyameva sarvaśāstravihitalokatattvavyāvartanaṃ tarhyapratyayameva aśakyaprāptyaphalatvābhyām, pratiṣedhasya pratiṣedhya- svarūpajñānaviṣayatvācca kiṃ tvayaivedaṃ viditvā'viditvā vā sāmānyaviśeṣau svaviṣayau paraviṣayau vā syātāmityādi lokatattvaṃ śāstrāntareṣu kalpitaṃ dūṣitam ? viditvā cet, na tarhi tanmataṃ na viditam
athāviditvā tataḥ kathaṃ dūṣitam ? ityubhayathāpi na yujyate pratiṣedho viruddhatvāt, pratiṣidhyate pratiṣedhyaṃ ca na jñāyata iti hāsyametat
syānmatam--pratiṣedhyaṃ jñāyate, taistasya vastunaḥ sattvādiguṇatrayātmakakṣaṇasadrūpa-dravyādiṣaṭvadārthātmakāditayā bahudhā kalpitasyānupapatteriti

etadapi vipratiṣiddham, teṣāmapi matānāṃ lokatattvāntaḥpātināṃ mithyāvidhikatvaṃ jñātamajñātaṃ vā syāt ? iti tulyavikalpatvāt, jñātā pratiṣedhaprayāsaḥ ? kriyopadeśanyāyyatvābhyupagamo'pi caivaṃ vighaṭeta, saṃsevyaviṣayasvatattvānupātipariṇāmavijñānavirahitatvāt, avaidyauṣadhopadeśavad bālakāhigrahaṇavat
sāmānyaṃ svaviṣayaṃ paraviṣayaṃ cetthamitthaṃ ca na yujyate tathā viśeṣa iti prapañcitatvādajñātaṃ cet tat sarvam, apratyayatvānna pratiṣedha ityuktam
jñātaṃ cet kathaṃ jñātumaśakyaṃ lokatattvam ? ityapratyayameva
svayamasamīkṣitavācyavācakasambandhatvāt te vacasa unmattavadeva tāvat aśakyaṃ prāptuṃ lokatattvam ityuktam, vipratiṣedhāt
pratiṣedhaprayāsaḥ ? kriyopadeśanyāyyatvābhyupagamo'pi caivaṃ vighaṭeta, saṃsevyaviṣayasvatattvānupātipariṇāmavijñānavirahitatvāt, avaidyauṣadhopadeśavad bālakāhigrahaṇavat
vipratiṣedhāt yadyapyuktamanarthako vivekayatnaḥ śāstreṣviti tatrāpi vipratiṣedhāttu tad jñānamaphalamevaraṃ॰hī॰ ḍe॰līṃ॰
yadyapyuktamanarthako vivekayatnaḥ śāstreṣviti tatrāpi vipratiṣedhāttu tad jñānamaphalameva pā॰ vi॰

yadapyuktam --anarthako vivekayatnaḥ śāstreṣviti, tatrāpi vipratiṣedhāt, yadi tajjñānamaphalameva kimiti śāstravihitārthapratiṣedhaprayāsaḥ ? śāstravihitārthajñānaṃ tatpratiṣedhopāyajñānaṃ cāvadhāryam--kiṃ saphalam ? aphalam ? yadyaphalaṃ vijñānam, śāstravihitārthān pratiṣiṣedhiṣataḥ prayāso'pyaphala evājñātatvāt pūrvavat
atha saphalam, aphalameva lokatattvajñānam iti vyāhanyate
ataḥ ko ha vaitadveda ? kiṃ vā'nena jñātena ? ityetadayuktamuktam, vipratiṣedhāt

yadapyuktaṃ vastutattvāśakyaprāpteḥ kriyāyā evopadeśo nyāyyastatpūrvakatvāt sukhāvāpteḥ ityatrocyate — kriyopadeśanyāyyatvābhyupagamo'pi caivaṃ vighaṭeta, vighaṭata eva iti kathaṃ niṣṭhuramucyate ? vighaṭeta iti tatsambhāvanayocyate dākṣiṇyalokajñānābhyām
sam ityekībhāve, ātmasādbhāvena sevyamānasya viṣayasya svatattvamāhārādeḥ śabdasparśarasarūpagandhātmakasya svarūpaṃ vātādiprakopaśamopacayapralayāvaham— nāgarātiviṣāmustākvāthaḥ syādāmapācanaḥ
tattattvānupātī pariṇāmaḥ, tadanupatituṃ śīlamasyeti, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? āsevyamānasya vastunastatkriyāta eva svarūpānupātena vipākaḥ pariṇāmaḥ
sa itthaṃ vipākaḥ sukhāya duḥkhāya vetyetadvijñānaṃ hitāhitaprāptiparihārārtham, tattu bhavatāṃ nāstyeva

atastadvirahitatvāt kriyopadeśo'pi agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ, taṇḍulān pacedbhoktukāmaḥ ityādirdṛṣṭādṛṣṭārtho na ghaṭate, ajñātasaṃsevyavastutattvapariṇāmatvāt, avaidyauṣadhopadeśavat, yathā kasyacidavijñātarasavīryavipākaprabhāvadravyaguṇaviśeṣabhāgābhāgasaṃyogasya deśa upadeśādeva tajjñānayoga iti cet, na, ubhayathāpi pauruṣeyatvādveda- kālāturaprakṛtisātmyāgnibalābalavātādirogasamutthānanidānādilakṣaṇānabhijñasyauṣadhopadeśo na ghaṭate tathā agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ ityādyupadeśaḥ

athavā hitāhitaprāptiparihārārthatvāt sarvopadeśānāṃ tada- bhāvāt krīḍitamevāstvitīdaṃ bālakāhigrahaṇavat tajjñānavirahitasyopadeśaśravaṇagrahaṇadhāraṇatarkaṇānuṣṭhānādi anarthānubandhyeva syāditīdamarthapradarśanārthaṃ dvitīyamudāharaṇam
upadeśādeva tajjñānayoga iti cet, na, ubhayathāpi pauruṣeyatvādveda-

etaccāyuktam, ubhayathāpi pauruṣeyatvāt, dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthatvenopadeśajñānasyāpi pauruṣeyatvāt, jñānato vacanataśca puruṣādhīnatvāditi vā; yathā tvamatīndriyeṣvartheṣu pūrvavijñānakāraṇābhāvaṃ manyase puruṣasya puruṣajñānavacanānāṃ tadviṣayāṇāṃ cāprāmāṇyaṃ rāgādiyogāttathā sarvopadeśasyopadeṣṭṛjñānasya śrotṛjñānavacanayośca jñānatvavacanatvābhyāṃ pauruṣeyatvānativṛtterbhāratarāmāyaṇādivadaprāmāṇyam
vānaramūlikādiparijñānavat kasyacit kiñcidviṣayaṃ tattvajñānaṃ syāt, na tu sarvauṣadhādiviṣayaikapuruṣajñānam, ato vaidyakādiṣvapi pūrvajñānakāraṇābhāvaḥ

tadviṣayaikapuruṣavijñānavadatīndriyendriyagrāhyasarvapadārthaviṣayaikapuruṣavijñānābhyupagamo vāvaśyambhāvī, kiṃ kāraṇam ? vedavacanayoranyathānupapatteḥ, puruṣamantareṇa vedanaṃ vedo jñānamityarthaḥ tena ca jñātasya vacanaṃ parapratyāyanaṃ tadubhayaṃ pratyayanaṃ pratyāyanaṃ ca nopapadyate, tayoḥ puruṣasamavāyitvāt
uktaṃ ca— rūpaṃ nibandhaḥ sambandhaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ pratyayaḥ kriyā
upadeśāprasiddhirapi caivaṃ bhavataḥ, sarvasyopadeśasya sāṅkhyādyupadeśavallokatattvānveṣaṇādṛte sambhavābhāvāt
tasyāpi tvanavasthāne auṣadhopadeśājñānavadagnihotrādyupadeśājñānam, tajjñānavat tadapi vā pramāṇāntaragamyamiti
atra svargāpūrvakarmasambandhajñāne vandhyāyā dauhitrasmaraṇavat pūrvavijñānakāraṇābhāvāt upadeśādeva tajjñānayogaḥ ityarthamabhipretya saṅgamanīyo'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ
anyathā pūrvavijñānakāraṇābhāvo vandhyāyā dauhitrasmaraṇavat iti pāṭhaḥ syāt
...śabdalakṣaṇo'rtho dharma ityuktam, codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharma iti, ato nirmūlatvānnāpekṣitavyamiti
nanu ye viduḥ itthamasau padārthaḥ kartavyaḥ iti kathamiva te vadiṣyanti akartavya evāyam iti ? smaraṇānupapattyā
na cāsya vaidikasya alaukikasya ca smaraṇamupapadyate pūrvavijñānakāraṇābhāvāditi
yā hi vandhyā smaredidaṃ me dauhitrakṛtamiti na me duhitāstīti matvā na jātucidasau pratīyāt samyagetajjñānamiti --mī॰ śābarabhā॰ 1
rūpaṃ nibandhaḥ sambandhaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ pratyayaḥ kriyā
upadeśāprasiddhirapi caivaṃ bhavataḥ, sarvasyopadeśasya sāṅkhyādyupadeśavallokatattvānveṣaṇādṛte sambhavābhāvāt

anabhyupagamyāpi upadeśāprasiddhirapi caivaṃ bhavataḥ, tvanmatenaiveti vākyaśeṣaḥ, sarvasyopadeśasya sāṅkhyādyupadeśavallokatattvānveṣaṇādṛte sambhavābhāvāt, upadeśo vyākhyā, asau ca vyākhyā padaviṣayā vākyaviṣayā pramāṇaviṣayā tadviṣayavastuviṣayā vā vedavyākaraṇasāṅkhyādiśāstravikalpitā yathāsvaṃ prakriyābhiḥ

tatra yathā sāṅkhyādiprakriyābhirvastutattvaṃ ghaṭāderlokatattvānveṣaṇaparayā vyākhyayā vinā nādhigamyate'tastathā vyākhyāyate evamagnihotrādi saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhavyutpādanena vyākhyāyate, prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgena padaviṣayaṃ vākyaviṣayaṃ pramāṇaviṣayaṃ ca pratyakṣānumānāgamabādhābhyuccayavikalpāṅgāṅgibhāvavikalpādi lokatattvānveṣaṇamantareṇa nādhigantuṃ śakyamityupadeśastattvānveṣaṇaparaḥ sarvaḥ pravartate

atha lokatattvānveṣaṇaparāṇāṃ teṣāmupadeśānāṃ śakyaprāptyarthopadeśasāphalye śakyete, kaḥ parābhyupagame pradveṣaḥ ? ihāpi ca yathā lokata eva pratyakṣānumānagamyaghaṭapaṭāditattvaparicchedaḥ śakyate kartumevaṃ padavākyapramāṇaparicchedo'pi śakyaḥ, ghaṭādipadācchabdārthapratyayaviṣayasya lokata eva varṇānupūrvyādiniyatavācyavācakapratyayāvyabhicārasya prasiddheḥ
uktaṃ ca— pramāṇāni pravartante prameyaiḥ sarvavādinām
tasmādupadeśānāṃ tvanmatenaiva sarveṣāmaprāmāṇyasiddhiḥ, lokatattvānveṣaṇaparatve sati aśakyaprāptyaphalatvenābhyupagatatvāt, sāṅkhyādiśāstrakāropadeśavat
saṃjñābhiprāyabhedāttu vivadante tapasvinaḥ || siddha॰ dvā॰ 20 | 4 iti

padādīnāmabhyupagamyāpi tvanmatenā'navasthāmāha --tasyāpi kriyāvidhāyyapi śāstraṃ nāvatiṣṭheteti tatprāpyapuṇyādyabhāvaḥ, yathā agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāma iti vidheraprasiddhārthaviṣayavidhāyitayā'saṃvyavahāryatvāttadvihitakriyāphalasambandhābhāva ārogyārthiḍitthabhakṣaṇoktivat
athocyeta--kartavyatāṃ vidhāya itikartavyatāvidhānāt evamprakāramevāgnihotraṃ nāma karma bhavati iti prasiddhaṃ bhaviṣyati tasyetarārthāvicāreṇa
tvanavasthāne jagattattvasya pramāṇavicārasya vā kriyāvidhāyyapi śāstraṃ nāvatiṣṭheta, tasyāpi lokatattvānveṣaṇātmakatvānativṛtterapramāṇatvāt
itiśabdo hetvarthe, ayaṃ hetuḥ kriyāvidhāyiśāstrānavasthānāt iti, atastatprāpyapuṇyādyabhāvaḥ, kriyāvidhāyiśāstropadiṣṭakriyābhivyaṅgyāpūrvābhāva ityarthaḥ
katamat punastat kriyāvidhāyi śāstram ? ucyate, yathā--agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ ityetacchāstram
idaṃ tu punaḥ kiṃ vidhiḥ, anuvādaḥ, arthavādaḥ ? ucyate --vidhiḥ

atrāprasiddhamagnisampradānaṃ havanaṃ vidhīyate, svargasya sukhasaṃjñasya tatprāptyāśrayasya viśiṣṭadeśādyātmakasya vā tadabhilāṣasya ca kartari siddhatvāt svargāvāptāvupāyo'gnihavanam ityupāyasyāpūrvatvāt

itaśca tarkotthāpitalokatattvajñānānapekṣatvāt tasya vidherasaṃvyavahāryatvam, asaṃvyavahāryatvāt tadvihitakriyāphalasambandhābhāvaḥ, dṛṣṭānta ārogyārthiḍitthabhakṣaṇoktivat, yathā ārogyārthine puṃse ḍitthaṃ bhakṣaya ityuktistatkriyā ca viphale aprasiddhatvādevaṃ tvaduktikriye aśakyaprāptyarthe cetyaśakyaprāptyādimatsāṅkhyādivivekayatnatulyatvaṃ tavāpi

kriyāvidhāyyapi śāstraṃ nāvatiṣṭheteti tatprāpyapuṇyādyabhāvaḥ, yathā agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāma iti vidheraprasiddhārthaviṣayavidhāyitayā'saṃvyavahāryatvāttadvihitakriyāphalasambandhābhāva ārogyārthiḍitthabhakṣaṇoktivat
athocyeta--kartavyatāṃ vidhāya itikartavyatāvidhānāt evamprakāramevāgnihotraṃ nāma karma bhavati iti prasiddhaṃ bhaviṣyati tasyetarārthāvicāreṇa
agnau jyotirjyotiragnā ityagnihotraṃ juhuyāt, etadvai vācassatyam...
dvādaśa rātrīragnihotraṃ juhuyād yā vā agnerjātavedāstanūstayaiṣa prajā hinasti
yasyāhute'gnihotre'paro'gniranugacchet tata eva prāñcamud dhṛtyānvavasāyāgnihotraṃ juhuyāt, athābhimantrayeta

atrāha--mā maṃsthāḥ sāṅkhyādiyatnatulyatvametasya, kiṃ kāraṇam ? vaidharmyāt, tadyathā --kartavyatāṃ vidhāya itikartavyatāvidhānāt, tatra agnihotraṃ juhuyāt iti kartavyatayāgnihotraṃ vidhīyate, tataḥ punaruttaratra viśeṣya itikartavyatā vidhīyate tadagnihotramevamevaṃ ca kartavyam iti yadyathāgniṣṭomādisaṃsthāviśeṣairdravya-guṇa-devatā-kartṛ-kāma-kāla-deśādiviśeṣaiśca, vasante brāhmaṇo yajeta, grīṣme rājanyaḥ, śaradi vājapeyena vaiśyaḥ

nanu caivamapi kartavyatāpratipattirlaukikakartavyatādyarthatattvānusṛtereva, kartavyatāvidhānānantaraṃ cetikartavyatāvasaraḥ, yathā ghaṭādikartavyatāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ ghaṭaṃ kuru iti tataḥ punaritikartavyatākramaḥ--evaṃ nirvartayeriti
na tu ghaṭavadagnihotraśabdaḥ bāyavyaṃvāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta bhūtikāmaḥ, vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā, vāyumeva svena bhāgadheyenopadhāvati, sa evāsmin bhūtiṃ nidhatte tai॰ saṃ॰ 2

tata uttarakālam evamprakāramevāgnihotraṃ nāma karma bhavatiiti viśeṣavidhāyinārthapratipattibalena prasiddhaṃ bhaviṣyati tasya śiṣyasya sāṅkhyādivivekaprayatnavailakṣaṇyena itarārthāvicāreṇa ghaṭaparamāṇvādikāryakāraṇasāmānyaviśeṣādisvarūpāvicāreṇeti
brāhmaṇo vasanta ādadhīta, brahma hi vasantaḥ
tasmāt kṣatriyo grīṣma ādadhīta, kṣatraṃ hi grīṣma
tasmādvaiśyo varṣāsu ādadhīta, viḍ hi varṣāḥ
tasmād holākādayaḥ prācyaireva kartavyāḥ, āhnīnaibukādayo dākṣiṇātyaireva, udvṛṣabhayajñādaya udīcyaireva --śābarabhā॰ 1
...udvṛṣabhayajñādaya udīcyaiḥ, jyeṣṭhamāsasya paurṇamāsyāṃ balīvardānabhyarcya dhāvayanti so'yamṛdvṛṣabhayajñaḥ--iti jaiminīyanyāyamālāyāḥ sāyaṇamādhavīye bhāṣye 1

nanu caivamapi kartavyatāpratipattirlaukikakartavyatādyarthatattvānusṛtereva, kartavyatāvidhānānantaraṃ cetikartavyatāvasaraḥ, yathā ghaṭādikartavyatāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ ghaṭaṃ kuru iti tataḥ punaritikartavyatākramaḥ--evaṃ nirvartayeriti
sa evainaṃ bhūtiṃ gamayati--iti kṛṣṇayajurvedasya taittirīyasaṃhitāyāṃ pāṭhaḥ 2
sa enaṃ bhūtyai ninayati--iti kṛṣṇayajurvedasya maitrāyaṇīsaṃhitāyāṃ pāṭhaḥ 2

nanvityanujñāpane, kartavyatā iti yā kartavyatāpratipatti ragnihotrādiviṣayā sā pratipattitvāllaukikakartavyatādyarthatattvānusṛtereva, pratyekaṃ patanaṃ pratipattiḥ, sā dvividhā--ādhyātmikī bāhyā ceti, tatrādhyātmikī idaṃ kartavyamidaṃ na kartavyam ityādikā buddhireva, bāhyā tu dvipadacatuṣpadadhanadhānyādyarthaṃ mamīkriyā
sā dvividhāpi lokaprasiddhamevārthamanusṛtya bhavitumarhati nāprasiddham, tasmādagnihotrādipratipattirapi lokatattvānusṛtereva, nānyathā

anyathā kimviṣayākiṃviṣayā sā syānnālikeradvīpajātavṛddhasya godhenupratipattyabhāvavat ? iti taddarśayati --kartavyatāvidhānānantaraṃ cetikartavyatāvasaraḥ, laukikakartavyatādyarthatattvānusṛtereva iti vartate

tadvyāvartanārthaṃ lokaprasiddhakartavyatetikartavyatāvaidharmyaṃ darśayannāha --yathā ghaṭādikartavyatāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ ghaṭaṃ kurviti tataḥ punaritikartavyatākramaḥ, evamiti prakāranirdeśaṃ darśayati, mṛtpiṇḍaṃ cakramūrddhani saṃsthāpya daṇḍena bhramayitvā dvābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ śivakādyākāraviśeṣakrameṇa nirvartayeriti prasiddhakartavyatāvidhānottarakālaṃ prasiddhetikartavyatāvidhānaṃ ghaṭādiviṣayamupapannaṃ prasiddhārthatvāt, na tvagnihotrakartavyatāyāḥ paśuvadhādītikartavyatāyāśca prasiddhiḥ, aprasiddhatvādagnihotraśabdasya kāñcidapi itikartavyatāṃ kartavyatāṃ vā vaktumaśaktatvāt, ata āha --na tu ghaṭavadagnihotraśabdaḥ kāñcidapi kartavyatāṃ bravīti, apiśabdāditikartavyatāmapīti
juhoterhi dhātorayaṃ pratyaya utpannaḥ sa tatkartavyatāṃ hitvā padāntarakartavyatāyāṃ kathaṃ pravarteta ? atha tadeva tat, prasiddhiviruddhaṃ punaruktaṃ ca
padāntarakartavyatāyāṃ tāvat parihāraḥ--havanaṃ padāntarakartavyatāmapekṣate vākyanyāyena sāmarthyāt

syānmatam--juhuyāt ityayaṃ tarhi bravīti, hu dānādanayoḥ pā॰ dhā॰ 1083 ityasyāḥ prakṛteḥ kriyāvācinyā vidhyarthaliṅpratyayāntatvāt, tacca havanamagniviṣayam, atastatkartavyatāṃ juhuyāt ityeṣa śabdo bravīti

atrocyate--evamapi tadavastham, satyamayaṃ bravīti tatkartavyatām, kintu havana- mātrasya, tasyāpyaprasiddhasyaiva, na tvagnihotrakartavyatām, juhuyāt ityākhyātasya pūrvāparībhūtāniṣpannāvayavakriyārthavācitvāt, nāmnāṃ piṇḍitaniṣpannārthavācitvāt
tata āha --juhoterhi dhātorayaṃ pratyaya utpannaḥ sa tatkartavyatāṃ hitvā padāntarakartavyatāyāṃ kathaṃ pravarteta ? pratyayagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtaḥ pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 3
syānmatam --atha tadeva tat, yadevāgnihātraṃ tadeva havanaṃ yadeva havanaṃ tadevāgnihotramiti
abhyupetyāpyekārthavācitvamanayoḥ paunaruktyaparihārārthaṃ lāghavārthaṃ ca juhuyāt ityevāstu, kim agnihotram ityanena ?
tāvacchabdaḥ kramārthe, yat tāvaduktaṃ padāntarakartavyatāyāṃ kathaṃ pravarteta ityatra parihāraḥ
asmin parihāre'bhihite paunaruktyāprasiddhidoṣāvapi tadeva tat ityetatpakṣagatau parihṛtāvevetyabhiprāyaḥ

tatra havanaṃ padāntarakartavyatāmapekṣate, kena nyāyena ? vākyanyāyena, ko vākyanyāyaḥ ? bhedasaṃsargābhyāṃ parasparākāṅkṣā sambandhaḥ, tayākāṅkṣayā padāntarārthe vartate padam, yathā sabrahmacāriṇā sahādhīte ityukte yena samāno brahmacārī sabrahmacārī tena sabrahmacāriṇā ya evādhīte tenaiva samāna ityākāṅkṣā bhavati sāmarthyāt, nānyena kenacit
na tu yathā padārthe paricchinne ghaṭa iti na padārthāntaramapekṣyate padena

sā punarapekṣā ghaṭavat ghaṭaśabdavat, abhedanirdeśād ghaṭārthatvena ghaṭaśabda uktaḥ, ghaṭaśabdasyārthavattvavadagnihotraśabdasyāpyarthavattvāyeṣyate, anyathāgnihotraśabdo'narthakaḥ syāt, tanmā bhūdānarthakya tato'gnihotraśabdaḥ pramādādhīta āpadyeta
tata evaṃ vacanavyaktirbhavati agnihotrākhyaṃ havanaṃ kuryāt iti, yathā ghaṭaṃ kuryādityukte ghaṭakriyāṃ kuryāditi

na hi kiñcidagnihotraṃ nāma havanaṃ ghaṭavat prasiddhaṃ yadanūdyocyeta yadagnihotrasaṃjñakaṃ havanaṃ tat kuryāditi, nāpi havanaṃ yat kuryāt tadagnihotrākhyamiti, vākyāntareṇa pramāṇāntareṇa vā'prasiddhatvāt

na cedevaṃ tato doṣa iti, yadi tu nirapekṣo'gnihotraśabdo havanaprakṛtyarthamātra eva vartate tataḥ ko doṣaḥ ? tato'gnihotraśabdaḥ pramādādhīta āpadyeta, agniśabdasya ca na pṛthak kaścidartho havanaprakṛtyarthamātratvāt syāt, tataśca daśadāḍimādiślokāvayavavat pramādādhīta āpadyeta nirākāṅkṣatvāt, na punarevamiṣyate
tata evaṃ vacanavyaktirbhavati--agnihotrākhyaṃ havanaṃ kuryāt agnihotrasaṃjñakriyākāṅkṣahavanaṃ kuryāditi
kimiva ? yathā ghaṭaṃ kuryāt ityukte sāmānyacodanāyāḥ plavanād viśeṣābhisambandhamantareṇa nairarthakyaṃ syāt, tanmā bhūditi ghaṭaṃ kuryād ghaṭakriyāṃ kuryāditi vacanavyaktistathāgnihotraṃ juhuyāditi
tata evaṃ vacanavyaktirbhavati agnihotrākhyaṃ havanaṃ kuryāt iti, yathā ghaṭaṃ kuryādityukte ghaṭakriyāṃ kuryāditi

na hi kiñcidagnihotraṃ nāma havanaṃ ghaṭavat prasiddhaṃ yadanūdyocyeta yadagnihotrasaṃjñakaṃ havanaṃ tat kuryāditi, nāpi havanaṃ yat kuryāt tadagnihotrākhyamiti, vākyāntareṇa pramāṇāntareṇa vā'prasiddhatvāt

ācārya āha --etadayuktaṃ dṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyāt, arthabhedāsiddheḥ, abhyupetyāpi ākāṅkṣākṛtamarthabhedamagnihotrahavanayoraprasiddherdṛṣṭāntena prasiddhena ghaṭena vaiṣamyamiti taddarśayati --na hi kiñcidagnihotraṃ nāma havanaṃ ghaṭavat prasiddhaṃ yadanūdyocyeta, yathā ghaṭaṃ loke prasiddhamanūdya tadviṣayaṃ karma kuryād ghaṭaṃ kuryādityucyate na tādṛganuvadanamatropapannamaprasiddhatvādagnihotrahavanayornāpyākāṅkṣākṛtamaikyamastīti taddarśayati vaidharmyeṇa --yadagnihotrasaṃjñakaṃ havanaṃ tat kuryāditi, agnihotrahavanayoraikyena prasiddhau satyāṃ tadviṣayaṃ karaṇamanuvidhīyeta

nāpi havanaṃ yat kuryāditi havanakriyāmanūdya tadagnihotrākhyamityaikyena vidhānaṃ yujyeta vākyāntareṇāgnihotrasya havanasya vā avihitatvālloke śāstrāntareṣu vā pramāṇāntareṇa vā'prasiddhatvādagnihotrahavanakriyayoḥ kathamanūdya vidhānaṃ ghaṭate ?

ata ityetasmādanantaroktāddhetorvākyāntareṇa pramāṇāntareṇa vā'pratītatvādubhayamapyaśakyaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyaṃ ca pradhānamupasarjanaṃ ca vidhiranuvādaśca śeṣaḥ śeṣī ca utsargo'pavādaśca, anyatarasyāpyarthāpratīteḥ
kiṃ havanakriyāviśeṣaṇamagnihotraṃ viśeṣyam ? agnihotraviśeṣaṇaṃ havanaṃ viśeṣyam ? evaṃ vidhyanuvādapradhānopasarjanotsargāpavādaśeṣaśeṣibhāvādiṣu khapuṣpakharaviṣāṇayorivāyuktamiti
tuśabda eva mapyaśakyam, yadi viśeṣyeta evaṃ viśeṣaṇīyam--havanaṃ kuryāt taccāgnihotrasaṃjñakamagnihotraṃ vā havanamiti, etadayuktam, anuvādavidhiviṣayatve vākyabhedāpatteḥ
nāpi ghaṭādi kartavyatāyāmiva kācit kriyā prasiddhā yayāgnihotrākhyatā havanasyātidiśyeta havanākhyatā vāgnihotrasya
kārārthaviśeṣaṇe, proktavadeva viśeṣaṇatvādi na ghaṭata iti viśinaṣṭi

kathamaśakyamiti ceddarśayati --yadi viśeṣyeta evaṃ viśeṣaṇīyam--havanaṃ kuryāt taccāgnihotrasaṃjñakamiti havanakriyayāgnihotraṃ viśeṣyeta, agnihotraṃ vā havanamiti yadagnihotraṃ taddhavanaṃ karma ityagnihotreṇa havanaṃ viśeṣyeta
iti pradarśane, itthaṃ viśeṣyeta yadi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatayā prayojanamavaśyam, tacca naivaṃ śakyamaprasiddhārthatvāt

yadapyuktam anūdyāgnihotraṃ havanakriyā vidhīyate, havanaṃ vānūdyāgnihotraṃ vidhīyate iti, etadayuktaṃ vākyabhedāpatterityata āha — anuvādavidhiviṣayatve vākyabhedāpatteriti, tatraikamanuvādakamekaṃ vidhāyakam, tayoranyatarad yatheṣṭaṃ te'stu, tato bhinnārthatvād vākyabhedo'nayorāpadyate, yathā kuśalo'yaṃ devadatto jñeyaḥ iti prasiddhamarthamanūdya ānayainam ityānayanaṃ vidhīyate, devadattamānaya iti devadattānayanaṃ vā vidhāya aviduṣe yaḥ kuśalataro'nayoḥ ityanuvāde prasiddhāprasiddhārthānuvādavidhiviṣaye dve vākye, evamekasyānuvādatve'nyasya ca vidhitve vākyabhedāpattiḥ, ato naiṣo'pi vyākhyānādhvā śobhana iti
atra ॰śeṣibhāva di khapuṣpa॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
mapyaśakyam, yadi viśeṣyeta evaṃ viśeṣaṇīyam--havanaṃ kuryāt taccāgnihotrasaṃjñakamagnihotraṃ vā havanamiti, etadayuktam, anuvādavidhiviṣayatve vākyabhedāpatteḥ
nāpi ghaṭādi kartavyatāyāmiva kācit kriyā prasiddhā yayāgnihotrākhyatā havanasyātidiśyeta havanākhyatā vāgnihotrasya
syānmatam--na vākyabhedāpattyādidoṣāḥ sambhavanti, kriyāyā eva vidheyatvāt
kiṃ tarhi ? ālabdhavyo nālabdhavya iti pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1
43, tathā svabhāvasiddhaṃ dravyam, kriyā caiva hi bhāvyate pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1

tasmādagniviṣayā havanakriyaiva vidhīyate, ato dṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyaṃ nāsti dravyasyāvidheyapratiṣedhyatvāt ghaṭaṃ kuryāt, mā kārṣīt iti, kiṃ tarhi ? ghaṭakriyāṃ kuryāditi, tathā havanaṃ kuryādagnihotraṃ kuryāditi havanāgnihotrakriyayoratideśo nyāyya iti

yathā ghaṭādiviṣayā kartavyatā mṛdānayanamardanādyupakramātmikā loke prasiddhā na tathā kācidagnihavanakartavyatā nāma prokṣaṇabarhirāstaraṇājyaprakṣepādyupakramātmikā mantrapūrvakriyā kramavatī prasiddhā yayā kartavyatayātidiśyeta havanākhyayāgnihotrākhyatā agnihotrākhyayā vā havanākhyatātidiśyeteti

anantaroktavidhinā na nirvahati havanaṃ kuryājjuhuyāt iti havanavidhāvagnihotrānuvāda ityasminnarthe'prasiddhatvādviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatādyabhāvādvākya- atha punarevamanirvahatyucyeta--naiva havanaṃ kuryāditi pakṣaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? agnihotraṃ kuryāditi pakṣāntaramāśrīyate, agnihotraśabde juhoterdhātordarśitārthatvāt kartṛpratyayārthe ca kṛñaḥ
evamapi kartṛpratyayakṛñdarśanena juhotyarthatyāgabhedābhyāṃ juhotyarthatyāgabhedavat sarvadhātvarthaviśeṣatyāgāttattyāgāpattirapi, viśeṣābhāve nirāśrayasya sāmānyasyā bhāvāt
bhedāpatteśca dravyasya kriyāyā vā vidhāne nirvoḍhumaśakye pareṇocyeta--naiva havanaṃ kuryāditītyādi kartavyatāvākyatātyāgena parihāraṃ manyate
pakṣāntarasaṃśraye sopapattikaṃ nirdoṣaṃ ca katamat punaḥ pakṣāntaram ? ityata āha --kiṃ tarhi ? agnihotraṃ kuryāt ityetat pakṣāntaramāśrīyate
upapattiścātra --agnihotraśabde juhoterdhātordarśitārthatvāt kartṛpratyayārthe ca kṛño darśitārthatvāt
ayaṃ hi juhuyāt iti hudhāturliṅpratyayāntaḥ, sa ca liṅ kartari vihitaḥ, kartari kṛllaḥ karmaṇi ca pā॰ 3
67, 69 iti, kartṛśabdaśca kṛñprakṛtistṛjantaḥ, kartari kriyāyā nirvartake'rthe'bhidheye kṛto lakārāśca bhavantīti
tathā karmaṇi vihito'pi kṛllakāro vā kṛñarthaṃ nātivartate
kiṃ karoti ? iti sarvakriyāviśeṣeṣu pacatyādiṣu viśeṣaṇapraśnapradarśanāt juhuyāt ityayaṃ kuryādartha eva, tathā bhūyate devadattena supyate devadattena ityevamādyakarmakeṣvapi svapiti bhavatīti
agnihotraśabdena punastadviśeṣabhūto juhoterartho'bhihita eva, tasmāt agnihotraṃ kuryāt ityayamartha iti
atha punarevamanirvahatyucyeta--naiva havanaṃ kuryāditi pakṣaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? agnihotraṃ kuryāditi pakṣāntaramāśrīyate, agnihotraśabde juhoterdhātordarśitārthatvāt kartṛpratyayārthe ca kṛñaḥ
evamapi kartṛpratyayakṛñdarśanena juhotyarthatyāgabhedābhyāṃ juhotyarthatyāgabhedavat sarvadhātvarthaviśeṣatyāgāttattyāgāpattirapi, viśeṣābhāve nirāśrayasya sāmānyasyā bhāvāt

evamidānīṃ kuryādagnihotramityetat pakṣāntaraṃ hotraśabdoktahavanārthatā kartṛpratyayāntakṛñarthatā ca juhoterityetat tvayoktaṃ mayā yuktyā sahāvadhāritaṃ tathāpi juhotyarthasya tyāgo'rthabhedaśca, juhotyarthatyāgastāvat kartṛviśiṣṭakriyāsāmānyamātravācitvābhyupagamāt juhoteśca kriyāviśeṣatvāt sāmānyaviśeṣayoścānyonyato bhinnatvāt kuryācchabdārthaṃ juhuyācchabdo bravīti iti vacanād hotraśabdena darśitārthatvājjuhotiranarthaka iti tvayaiva tyaktatvāt
tataśca juhuyācchabdo'pi hotraśabdārthaṃ hotraśabdo'pi juhuyācchabdārthaṃ bravītīti nāmākhyātayoḥ pratyekaṃ dvyarthavṛttitvādbhedaśca hotraśabdaḥ kriyāvācī nāmavācī ca tathā juhuyācchabdo'pīti

evaṃ sati śabdārthasaṅkaraḥ prasiddhivirodhaśca jāyate, yathā --pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhāvamākhyātenā''caṣṭe vrajati pacatītyupakramaprabhṛtyapavargaparyavasānaṃ mūrtaṃ sattvaṃ nāmabhirvrajyā paktiḥ niruktaḥ 1
tataśca juhotyarthatyāgabhedābhyāṃ hetubhyāṃ āsannaśrutāgnihotrakartavyatvānneti cet, na, āsannataraśrutajuhotyarthatyāgāt

parapadārthavidhāne'pi ca padāntarapariśrutahotramātravṛttatvājjuhuyādarthamātrameveti juhotyarthatyāgabhedavat sarvadhātvarthaviśeṣatyāgaḥ, yathā juhotiḥ kartṛpratyayāntakṛñprakṛtyarthavācyevaṃ pacatipaṭhatyādayaḥ sarve dhātavo dhātutvāt tadvācinaḥ, tasmāt sarvadhātvarthaviśeṣāstyaktāḥ, viśeṣaśabdasya bhedārthatvānnāmākhyātadvyarthavṛttitvāt pūrvoktakarotyarthavad bhinnārthatā ca
tataśca sarvadhātvarthaviśeṣatyāgāt tattyāgāpattirapi, tasya kṛñarthasya sarvadhātvarthasāmānyabhūtasyāpi tyāga āpadyate
kiṃ kāraṇam ? viśeṣābhāve nirāśrayasya sāmānyasyābhāvāt, karoti ityukte kiṃ karoti ? juhoti pacati paṭhati ityādiviśeṣasaṃśrayeṇa vinā karoterarthābhāvāt
pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhāvamākhyātenācaṣṭe vrajati pacatītyupakramaprabhṛtyapavargaparyantaṃ mūrtaṃ sattvabhūtaṃ sattvanāmabhirvrajyā paktiḥ--iti yāskanirukte pāṭhaḥ
tatra yacchabdasannidhisaṃjñakaṃ sāmarthyaṃ tad vyavacchedakāraṇamihāpyasti, tadyathā--āsannaśruto'gnihotraśabdaḥ, taccoditakartavyataivātra sambadhyate
tasmānna juhotyarthastyaktastatkartṛpratyayakṛñarthadarśane satyapi agnihotraṃ kuryāt iti havanaviṣayasyaiva karaṇasyopādānāt

cedityāśaṅkāyām, evaṃ cenmanyase, tadapi na, āsannataraśrutajuhotyarthatyāgāt, yadyāsannaśrutāgnihotrasānnidhyāt tadarthopādānaṃ nyāyyaṃ manyase tato'pyāsannataraśrutajuhotiśabdārthopādānaṃ nyāyyataraṃ kiṃ na manyase ? sa cārthastyaktastvayā, tadupādāne'pi cāprasiddhatādidoṣāstadavasthāḥ, svapadārthaṃ tyaktvā padāntarārthe kathaṃ varteteti coktam
abhyupetyāpi padāntarārthābhidhānaṃ doṣa ucyate --parapadārthavidhāne'pi ca padāntarapariśrutahotramātravṛttatvājjuhuyādarthamātrameveti kuryādarthopādānamabhedakam

padāntare'gnihotrapade pariśrutaṃ parigataṃ jñātam, kiṃ tat ? hotramātram, na tadvyatiriktamarthāntaraṃ gamyate, ato juhuyādityetasya śabdasya yo'rthastanmātra eva vṛttaḥ kuryācchabdaḥ, itiśabdo hetvarthe, asmāddhetorjuhuyācchabdārthamātratvāddhotraṃ kuryādityasyārtha kuryādarthopādānamabhedakaṃ tiṅpratyayārthaikībhūtaprakṛtyarthatvādagnisamāsāsattvāt, apaśabdaścāyamasminnarthe
kuto bhinnārthaṃ na bhavatīti cet, havanaṃ kuryāt ityasmādvākyārthāt
na hi hotramātrameva śrūyate, kiṃ tarhi ? agneragnāvagnaye vā hotramagnihotram, tat kuryāditi bhinno'rtha iti
yatra tiṅpratyayārthenaikībhūtaḥ prakṛtyarthastatra prakṛtyarthamātravṛttirdṛṣṭā, yathā pralambate'dhyāgacchatīti

kumbhakāravadeva viśiṣṭārthatvamiti cet, tadapi nopapadyate, agnisamāsāsattvāt, na hyasti agniśabdasya hotraśabdena tiṅpratyayārthasākāṅkṣeṇa samāsaḥ, sup supā samarthena saha samasyate pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
tiṅantena astikṣīrāśnītapibatādiṣu samāsadarśanādadoṣa iti cet, na, parigaṇitebhyo'nyatrābhāvāt tiṅantapratirūpakanipātasubantatvācca teṣām, asti nāsti diṣṭaṃ matiḥ pā॰ 4
anyathā devadattaḥ pacati ityatrāpi samāsaḥ syāt, na tu bhavati
asāmarthyaṃ ca sāpekṣatvāt, yathā śaṅkulākhaṇḍaprātipakṣyeṇa paśya śaṅkulayā khaṇḍaḥ iti samāsānupapattistadvat
na ca prādhānyābhāvāt devadattasya gurukulam ityanena tulyam, tatra tu pradhānatvādbhavati samāsaḥ
uktaṃ tu --bhavati hi pradhānaśabdasya sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
na cātrāgniśabdasya hotraśabdasya vā prādhānyamasti, kuryājjuhuyāditi tiṅantasya kriyāvācinaḥ prādhānyāt sādhanānāṃ sādhyasiddhyarthapravṛttitvāt
yathā goṇīśabdo hi sāsnādimatyarthe'paśabdaḥ, sa tu āvapane śabda eva
tathā gāvīśabdo'pi gavyavaseye'śaktiḥ gāvī ityasminnarthe śabda eva
tathā coktam— yastu prayuṅkte kuśalo viśeṣe śabdān yathāvadvyavahārayukte
tataḥ supā, supā ca saha sup samasyate
bhavati ca pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ iti pātañjalamahābhāṣye pāṭhaḥ 2
yastu prayuṅkte kuśalo viśeṣe śabdān yathāvadvyavahārayukte
so'nantamāpnoti jayaṃ paratra vāgyogavidduṣyati cāpaśabdaiḥ || pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1 | 1 | 1
kriyānāmasvavṛttityāgopādānābhyāṃ dhātuprātipadikaprakṛtibhedo'pi, na padabheda eva padāntaraviṣayatvāttvāt vākyabheda eva vā, ajñātasyāgnihotrasya kriyāviśeṣaṇatvenānuvādāt
athācakṣīthāḥ--etaddoṣabhayāt tyaktvā juhotyarthaṃ niṣkriyaṃ kartrarthamātrameva gṛhyate kuryāt iti kartavyatāmātracodanārthaḥ

evaṃ ca sati tyaktajuhotikartrarthagrahe tu, tuśabdo viśeṣaṇe, atyantamarthābhāvenaiva viśeṣayati, karoti, kuryāt ityevamādiśabdānāṃ kṛñprakṛtīnāṃ ghaṭādikarmāpekṣāmantareṇa kiṃ karotu, kiṃ kuryāt ityanirṇītārthatvāt ko'rthaḥ syāt ? kṛñarthābhāVe kartrarthasya niḥsādhyasya vā'kartṛtvaṃ syāt
ataḥ kuryācchabdo nirarthakaḥ, tyaktasvaprakṛtyarthatvāt tādṛgvidhasya kṛbhvādiprakṛtirahitasya yādādipratyayāntasya prayogasyādarśanāt
abhyupetyāpi prayogaṃ juhotiprayogāsattvaṃ brūmaḥ, asattvamapraśastatvam, kutaḥ ? tyājyatvāt, tyājyatvaṃ tvayā tyaktatvādasmanmatenā'rthābhāvāt
dṛṣṭānto vyādhivat, yathā vyādhistyājyatvādapraśastastathā juhotiśabdo'pi sārtha iti

ākhyātasya kriyārthatvarūḍhasya svārthaṃ viprakīrṇāvayavakalāpaṃ tyaktvā piṇḍitahotrasattvārthopādānam, na ca tamapyupādāya tatraivāvatiṣṭhate, kiṃ tarhi ? punarapi sattvārthaṃ tyaktvā kriyārthopādānam
evaṃ nāmaśabdasyāpi sattvavṛttiṃ svāṃ tyaktvā kriyārthopādānaṃ kriyārthaṃ tyaktvā sattvārthopādānamiti
tābhyāmeva ca tyāgopādānābhyāṃ kuryāt, juhuyāt ityetayorapi śabdayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣārthayoritaretarārthavṛttyā bhedaḥ svaprakṛtibalena piṇḍanaviprakiraṇāt tadbhedavat tadbalenā'syāpi

kayoḥ prakṛtyoriti cet, dhātuprātipadikayoḥ, ata āha --dhātuprātipadikaprakṛtibhedo'pi, na padabheda eva, sa kutaḥ padabheda iti cet, padāntaraviṣayatvāt, padāntarasya viṣayo'syeti padāntaraviṣayaṃ tat padamākhyātaṃ nāma vā, tadbhāvāt padāntaraviṣayatvāt kuryājjahuyāditi

athavā vākyārthavicārapradhānasya mīmāṃsakasya yaduktaṃ prāk vākyabhedo vidhyanuvādatvāpatteḥ iti, sa tu na kevalo vākyabhedaḥ padabheda eva vā, kiṃ tarhi ? dhātuprātipadikabhedo'pītyabhisambadhyate, na ityanuvartanāt
tatra ko heturiti cet, ajñātasyāgnihotrasya kriyāviśeṣaṇatvenānuvādāt, ajñātārtho evaṃ ca śruteryāsau pratipattistasya abhāvaḥ
svapratyavekṣānuvādanyāyena ca tattyāgāt kartrādyarthapratipattivaśena śabdārthasthāpanād nṛjñānameva pramāṇīkṛtam
vidhiḥ, jñātārtho'nuvādaḥ, agnihotramajñātatvād vidhīyate, tat kuryāt, juhuyāt, havanaṃ kuryāt iti juhotikriyayā viśeṣya prasiddhasya vihitasyaivānuvadanāditi prāguditamarthamupapattitvenopadarśayati
svapratyavekṣānuvādanyāyena ca tattyāgāt kartrādyarthapratipattivaśena śabdārthasthāpanād nṛjñānameva pramāṇīkṛtam
tataśca kim ? evaṃ cetyādi yāvat tasyā abhāvaḥ

evaṃ cetyanantaranirdiṣṭakriyānāmasvavṛttityāgopādānābhyāmeva śruteryāsau pratipattirjuhuyādityasyāḥ padaśruterhavanakriyāvidhānamartho juhuyād havanaṃ kuryāditi tasyā abhāvaḥ, sā na bhavati, anyathārthādhigateḥ, yacchabda āha tannaḥ pramāṇam pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2

nāmākhyātayorarthabhedatyāgopādānadoṣebhyaśca śabdāvyavasthānāt puruṣabuddhivaśena śabdārthāvasthānam, kutaḥ ? svapratyavekṣānuvādanyāyena ca tattyāgāt, svayaṃ pratyavekṣito'rthastvayā ayamasya śabdo'syārtha evaṃ bhavati na veti doṣavattvādayaṃ tyājyo'yaṃ guṇavattvādāśrayaṇīyaḥ iti vicārya svamatipramāṇīkaraṇena śratiśrutiprāmāṇyatyāgaḥ kṛtaḥ
tatastattyāgāt kartrādyarthapratipattivaśena śabdārthasthāpanād nuḥ puruṣasya jñānameva pramāṇīkṛtam, tasyaiva vidhyarthavadavasthitasyānuvadanāt
ataśca te vādāvasānaṃ nigrahasthānaṃ puruṣajñānaprāmāṇyāśrayeṇa kriyopadeśavākyāpramāṇīkaraṇāt pratijñātyāgapratijñāntaragamanalakṣaṇam

eṣa ca pratijñātyāgapratijñāntarāśrayaṇadoṣa itaratrāpyarthavyākhyāne havanaṃ kuryāt ityetasmin bhavati, kasmāt ? svapratyavekṣānuvādena ca tattyāgāt kartrādyarthaniyatapratipattivaśena śabdārthasthāpanādevameva saprakṛtipratyaya evāgnihotraśabdo'vabodhyate śabdaprāmāṇyatyāgena svamatiprāmāṇyāvalambanāt
śabdapramāṇakā vayam, yacchabda āha tadasmākaṃ pramāṇam--iti pātañjalamahābhāṣye paspaśāhnike samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ pā॰ 2
॰sthāt tadavyavasthānāt pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
kiṃ tarhi ? yā yā śrutiryathāśruti, yathāgnihotraśabdaśravaṇāt tadartho gṛhyate tathā havanamapi juhuyācchabdaśravaṇādgrahīṣyate, tato na doṣo'stīti
atrocyate --nanvarthadvayavidhānamaśakyamekena vākyena agnisampradānakasya karmabhūtasya havanasya tadviśiṣṭasya ca kartṛtvasya, yathā brāhmaṇasampradānakahavirdānavākyena śuklagavānayanamapi
naiva havanaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? agnihotraśabdena vihitaṃ havanamanūdyate
yadagnihotraṃ havanameva tat, punaruktaṃ tarhyevam, anayoraviśeṣāt
atha tvicchayaivānuvādo yathākathañcit syāt tataḥ punaruktadoṣābhāva eva syāt
juhuyācchabdena naiva havanaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? agnihotraśabdena vihitaṃ havanamanūdyate, vidhyanuvādayorbhinnalakṣaṇatvāt
kiṃ tayorlakṣaṇamiti cet, ucyate --prāptamanūdyate vākyāntareṇa, yathā paṇḍitastiṣṭhati iti śāstrajñaḥ paṇḍitaḥ iti vākyāntaravihitapāṇḍityasya sthānānuvādāt
aprāptaṃ ca vidhīyate, yad vākyāntarāprāpitamavijñātaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa tad vidhīyate, yathā svargakāmo juhuyāditi
atrocyate--yadyetadvidhyanuvādayorlakṣaṇaṃ nānuvādo havanasya yujyate, yasmānna ca prāptirasti havanasya, avihitatvāt
itara āha--asti prāptirhavanasya, agnihotrasya havanatvāt tasya ca vihitatvādityata āha --yadagnihotraṃ havanameva tat, punaruktaṃ tarhyevamanayoragnihotrahavanavidhānayoraviśeṣāt
anuvādalakṣaṇābhāvaṃ cāsya darśayati --vidhivihitasya hi anuvadanamanuvāda iti, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmād vidhivākyavihitasyārthasya paścādarthaviśeṣaprāpaṇārtho vādo'nuvādaḥ
tadatra lakṣaṇaṃ na ghaṭate, agnihotrahavanavidheyatvāt, agnihotrasya havanasya caikībhūtayorvidheyatvāt
syānmatam--vakturvivakṣitapūrvikā śabdapratipattirityasya havanasya vidhānaṃ na vivakṣyate, anuvādo vivakṣyata iti
etadapi yathākathañcit syād vihitārthābhāvāt, vivakṣecchayoranarthāntaratvādicchāmātrataśca nirupapattikasyārthasyāsiddherna syādityabhiprāyaḥ
yadyapi yathākathañcit syāt tataḥ punaruktadoṣābhāva eva syāt, iṣyate ca paunaruktyaṃ śabdato'rthataśca, uktārthaśabdārthakathanamaviśeṣeṇa punaruktamanyatrādarādibhyaḥ iti paunaruktyābhāvaḥ
paṇḍitamānaya ityukte paṇḍito devadatta ityanuvādo na punaruktam
athocyeta--vidhiliṅkartrarthe pratyayārthe'vaśiṣyamāṇe'vaśyavācye prakṛtiparavyava- bhṛśārthe ghanaṃ ghanaṃ mṛdu mṛdu śanaiḥ śanairiti
smaraṇe ā ! vidito viditaḥ pāṭaliputre dṛṣṭo dṛṣṭo'sīti

kutaḥ ? vidhīyamānatvāt, yo'rtho vidhīyate na so'nūdyate, ākhyāyamānapaṇḍitatvavat, yathāyaṃ paṇḍito devadatta iti vidhīyamānapāṇḍityo devadatto nānūdyate tathā juhuyādityetadapi apūrvopadeśatvādanuvādavaidharmyāccāsya tallakṣaṇābhāvāt
kiṃ tallakṣaṇamiti cet, vihitameva tvanūdyate ca viśeṣavidhānārtham, yathā--paṭurdevadattaḥ, payasainaṃ bhojayeti
tallakṣaṇābhāvāt kim ? tallakṣaṇābhāvānnānuvādo'pūrvavidhānāt, yatra na viśeṣo vidhīyate maulavidhireva saḥ

evaṃ tarhi viśeṣavidhānādanuvādo'stu tadvaditi cet, tanna bhavati, yasmād na cātra kaścijjuhotipunarvacanena viśeṣo janyate, juhuyāt ityanena śabdena agnihotraśabdābhihitādarthānna kaścidanyo viśiṣṭo'rtho'bhidhīyate yato'nuvādaḥ syāt
tataśca prāktanameva sañjātaṃ yāvadeva agnihotraṃ kuryāt iti vākyavikalpe'bhihitaṃ tāvadeva agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityatrāpi vākye, tato'dhikaṃ na kiñcidasti

evaṃ yāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ gatvā kalpayitvāpi sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityasmin vākye'gnihotrakarmaṇyevāntarbhāvitahavane juhuyācchabdaprakṛtyarthe kimatiricyate paunaruktyadoṣavyapetam ? vidhiliṅkartāste, vidhau vihitasya liṅpratyayasya kartṛkārakasya tanmātrārtha āste na dūṣitaḥ, anyat sarvaṃ punaruktādidoṣaduṣṭamevetyarthaḥ agnihotraṃ kuryāt, agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityetayorvākyārthavikalpayoruktadoṣatvāt

atha tvayocyeta --vidhiliṅkartrarthaḥ pratyayārtho'nuktatvādavaśiṣyate, avaśyaṃ ca vācyo'sau, tasmin pratyayārthe'vaśiṣyamāṇe'vaśyavācye, prakṛtiparavyavasthāyā iti sthāyā āvaśyake prakṛtyupādāne prāpte varamāsannā prakṛtirupāttā, arthaḥ punarasyā na vivakṣyate gatārthatvāt
evaṃ tarhi varatarakaṃ pratyāsannatarā'vivakṣitārthā kṛñprakṛtirupāttā, vacanasyopāttārthapratyāyanārthatvāt
asmiṃstu nyāye'tilaṅghyamāne kriyopadeśavādo'pi tattvavādavadeva tyaktaḥ syāt, tatrāpi yadṛcchābhyupagamāt
ko ha vaitadveda bālapralāpavad vyavasthāpetamu- hetvarthe pañcamī, prakṛteḥ paraḥ pratyayaḥ prayoktavyaḥ pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 3

2 itīyaṃ vyavasthā, tasyā vyavasthāyā maryādāyāḥ sthiterhetorāvaśyakaṃ prakṛtyupādānam, tasmiṃścāvaśyake prakṛtyupādāne prāpte katamā prakṛtirupādātuṃ yogyā ityevaṃ vicārayata idaṃ me yogyamiti pratibhāti --varamāsannā prakṛtirupāttā, arthaḥ punarasyā na vivakṣyate gatārthatvāt, tasmādavivakṣitārthā sā, satyapi nāntarīyakatve pratyāsannaprakṛtyupādāne vilakṣaṇāmanyāṃ parityajyā'vilakṣaṇā juhotiprakṛtirevopāttetyavaseyam, prayogo'gnihotraṃ juhuyāditi

cenmanyase varamāsannaprakṛtyupādānaṃ nāntarīyakatvāditi, tatrāhameva te varatarakaṃ sāhāyakaṃ dadāmi buddheḥ--kartṛpratyayārthasamārthaiva pratyāsannatarā paunaruktyaparihārārthamavivakṣitā- rthā'nuktārthā kṛñprakṛtirupāttā
kiṃ kāraṇam ? vacanasyopāttārthapratyāyanārthatvāt, arthaṃ pratyāyayiṣyāmīti hi śabdaḥ, kartṛpratyayāntayā kṛñprakṛtyā pratyāyyate sphuṭataram, ato'gnihotraṃ kuryādityevāstu

ācārya āha--syādevaṃ yadi sāpi cārthasthitirnirdoṣā syāt, kintu sāpi cāpakṣiptavācyārthasthitiruktavat, tasyāmapyarthasthitau nirākṛto vācyo'rthaḥ juhrotyajuhotyarthatyāgabhedābhyām ityādiprabandhena uktavad yathāśrutārthābhāvādidoṣāt pauruṣeyatvādiprasaṅgācca
evaṃ tāvannyāyena parīkṣyamāṇametadvākyaṃ na yujyate puruṣatarkalakṣaṇena
sthāyā āvaśyake prakṛtyupādāne prāpte varamāsannā prakṛtirupāttā, arthaḥ punarasyā na vivakṣyate gatārthatvāt
evaṃ tarhi varatarakaṃ pratyāsannatarā'vivakṣitārthā kṛñprakṛtirupāttā, vacanasyopāttārthapratyāyanārthatvāt
asmiṃstu nyāye'tilaṅghyamāne kriyopadeśavādo'pi tattvavādavadeva tyaktaḥ syāt, tatrāpi yadṛcchābhyupagamāt
prakṛtipara eva pratyayaḥ prayoktavyaḥ iti pātañjalamahābhāṣye pāṭhaḥ
atra ॰vaseyaṃ prayoge'gnihotraṃ juhuyāditi ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
tatraikenoktatvāttasyārthasya dvitīyasya prayogeṇa na bhavitavyam, uktārthānāmaprayoga iti--iti pātañjalamahābhāṣye 1

yadyapi puruṣatarkalakṣaṇaṃ nyāyamatilaṅghyāpauruṣeyo nityo vedākhyaḥ kriyopadeśaḥ puruṣagatarāgādidoṣāśaṅkāhetuvinirmuktaḥ pramāṇam, puruṣakṛtāni hi vākyāni avidyārāgādyaviyuktapuruṣavadapramāṇāni aphalāśakyaprāptinityānityādivastutattvavicāraviṣayāṇi, saphalaśakyaprāptipuruṣahitopāyakriyopadeśāttu vedavādaḥ śreyānitīṣṭam, tathāpi tvadvacanādevāsmiṃstu nyāye'tilaṅghyamāne kriyopadeśavādo'pi tattvavādavadeva tyaktaḥ syāt

kiṃ kāraṇam ? tatrāpi yadṛcchābhyupagamāt, avidyārāgādyaviyogādeva sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ vaktṛśrotṛpuruṣādhīnatvāccopadeśaparamparāyā na kaścidbuddhipūrva upadeśaḥ, ataḥ suptamattādivipralāpavad yadṛcchayā ditam ? kiṃ vā'nena jñātena yadetajjñā evamuktavanto'vyaktaṃ yadyajñānād yadi dveṣādeḥ ? ko vā''ha jñavacanametat ? yadi saṃśayādiyogānna jñaḥ pramāṇaṃ tarhīdamajñoktatvādunmattavākyavat
acetanatvāt kuto'sya prāmāṇyam ? kuto'sya vacanam ? kāṣṭhaśabdavaditthamacetanatve'pi na ghaṭate vedavākyaprāmāṇyam
ata idamāpannam --ko ha vaitadveda agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ ityetad vākyaṃ sārthakaṃ nirarthakaṃ veti ?
kimiva na jñāyate ? bālapralāpavat, yathā hi bālairaniyatakriyākārakasambandhamuktamabuddhipūrvatvājjñātumaśakyaṃ kenārthenā'rthapratyāyanārthavat ? iti

kiṃ kāraṇam ? vyavasthāpetatvāt, śabdaprayogo hyarthapratyāyanārthaḥ svaniścitārthapratipādanasamarthaniyatavarṇānupūrvīkaḥ pratyapekṣitavācyavācakasambandha itīyaṃ lokaśāstravyavasthā, tato'petaṃ brahmādisarvavedavādivacanamavidyārāgādyaviyogātteṣāmityaśakyaprāptiragnihavanavidhānādivākyārthasya

tasmāt ko ha vaitad veda bālapralāpavad vyavasthāpetamuditam ? kiñcānyat, aphalaṃ caitadityata āha --kiṃ vā'nena jñātena yadetajjñā vedajñā agnihotrakarmajñā evamuktavantaḥ agnihotraṃ juhuyāt iti vākyamavyaktamavyaktārthamasphuṭārtham, yasmādavyaktajñānā eva te puruṣatvādavidyāyogācca daśadāḍimādiślokavādivat
ditam ? kiṃ vā'nena jñātena yadetajjñā evamuktavanto'vyaktaṃ yadyajñānād yadi dveṣādeḥ ?
ko vā''ha jñavacanametat ? yadi saṃśayādiyogānna jñaḥ pramāṇaṃ tarhīdamajñoktatvādunmattavākyavat
acetanatvāt kuto'sya prāmāṇyam ? kuto'sya vacanam ? kāṣṭhaśabdavaditthamacetanatve'pi na ghaṭate vedavākyaprāmāṇyam
athavā ko vā''ha jñavacanametaditi jñasya puruṣasya sarvatra pramāṇabhūtasyābhāvāt, kiṃ tarhi ? śabdasyaiva ca nirdoṣatvāditi
atrācārya āha --yadi saṃśayādiyogānna jñaḥ pramāṇaṃ tarhīdamajñoktatvādunmattavākyavaditi kriyopadeśasāphalyavādaḥ kva gacchatīti cintyatām
evaṃ tāvad buddhipūrvakamakārādivarṇānupūrvyā śabdoccāraṇaṃ cetanodīritaṃ kākavāśitaṃ puruṣavāśitaṃ vā tulyam

evaṃ ca kṛtvā'cetanatvāt kuto'sya vacanam ? yacchabda āha tad naḥ pramāṇam pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ itīṣṭaṃ bhavatā, bhāṣaṇaṃ vacanamuktiḥ śabdoccāraṇam, bhāvasādhanatvādvacanaśabdasya, acetanatvādvaktṛtvamasya nāstītyarthaḥ
katham ? ajñodīritatvādeva ca vacanatvamasya nāsti, vācyārthapratipādanābhisandhipūrvakaṃ hi tat, tadabhāve'nuktamityata āha --kāṣṭhaśabdavaditthamacetanatve'pi na ghaṭate vedavākyaprāmāṇyam
atrāha--yaduktaṃ prāk ko vā''ha jñavacanametat iti dvitīyo vikalpo na brūmaḥ sarvavaktṛvacanāprāmāṇyamiti, svavacanavirodhadoṣāt
kiṃ tarhi ? sarvajñavītarāgādyabhāvād granthasya sarvabhāvasvabhāvaviṣayasya karturaprāmāṇyam, na tu vakturanādinidhanasya vaktṛparamparāgatasya, vaktṛvacanayoḥ kvacit prāmāṇyāditi

kvaciccārthe satyeva arthāvivakṣā nyāyyā dṛṣṭā, tayoḥ kvārthavattvena dṛṣṭayostadavivakṣayā ca sārthakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam ? ato'nyāyyametaduktam avivakṣitārthasya nāntarīyakatvāt prayogaḥ iti, prayuktasyānarthakatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt
vivakṣāvivakṣayoraniyamena śabdapravṛttau satyāmaprayojanāyāṃ cāvivakṣāyāmagnyādyavivakṣā'bhāve viśeṣa- atrocyate --ādivaktṛvaccottaravaktaryapi

yathā''divaktāro'pramāṇamasarvajñatvādavītarāgatvācca śāstrāṇāṃ sarvabhāvasvabhāvaviṣayāṇāṃ yathārthajñānavacanahīnāstathā''dimadanādiprasiddhīnāṃ śāstrāṇāmadhyetāro yathārthajñāna- vacanahīnāḥ, tasmādubhayeṣāṃ jñātṛtvavaktṛtvayorayathārthayoranāśvāsastulyaḥ
kimiva ? vātikamantrādivat, yathā dhātuviṣayabalādivātikānāṃ jñānāni mantravacanāni ca vipralambhabhūyiṣṭhatvādanāśvāsanāni, ādigrahaṇād vaśīkaraṇamantrayogādivat
atra dvitīye vikalpe ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt, dṛśyatāṃ paṃ॰ 16--17

kvaciccārthe satyeva arthāvivakṣā nyāyyā dṛṣṭā, tayoḥ kvārthavattvena dṛṣṭayostadavivakṣayā ca sārthakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam ? ato'nyāyyametaduktam avivakṣitārthasya nāntarīyakatvāt prayogaḥ iti, prayuktasyānarthakatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt

kvacicceti na sarvatra, yathā nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭvā vāco visṛjanti iti, kataraddevadattasya gṛham ? ado yatrāsau kākaḥ iti nakṣatrekṣaṇe pakṣiṇi copayuktārthayoreva nakṣatraṃdṛṣṭvā-kākaśabdayoḥ sārthakayoḥ kāla-gṛhopalakṣaṇe'rthe satyeva nakṣatradarśana-kākārthāvivakṣā nyāyādanapetā nyāyyā dṛṣṭā nānarthakasyaivonmattapralapitādestathā tayoragnihotrahavanayoḥ kvārthavattvena dṛṣṭayostadavivakṣayā ca sārthakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam ? ato nyāyāpetametaduktam--avivakṣitārthasya nāntarīyakatvāt prakṛteḥ prayogo juhuyācchabdasyeti

kiṃ kāraṇam ? prayuktasyānarthakatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt, yadyeṣa nyāyaḥ śabdānāṃ prayoge niyato na syānnāntarīyakatvādapi prayoge sādhutvameva syāt tataśca pramādādapramādādvā prayuktasya śabdasyānarthakatvābhāva eva syāt pramattāpramattavaktraviśeṣaśca syāt, na tvevaṃ bhavati dṛṣṭaśiṣṭeṣṭaviruddhatvāt
syānmatam--upalakṣaṇādiprayojanāyāṃ viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ kimanayā svārthāvivakṣayā ? sarvasya śabdaprayogasya vakturvivakṣitapūrvakatvāt pravṛtteravivakṣā vivakṣā veti

etadayuktam, vivakṣāvivakṣayoraniyamena śabdapravṛttau satyāmaprayojanāyāṃ cāvivakṣāyāmagnyādyavivakṣā'bhāve viśeṣaheturvācyaḥ, agniśabdasyāpi juhotiprakṛtyupādānavannāntarīyakatvāt prayogo'rtho'syāvivakṣita iti prāptam
ityetadvākyaṃ sādhīyaḥ agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityetat sādhīya iti kena hetunā paricchedyam ? kiñcānyat, yuktatarīyuktatarā tu tadavivakṣā agnyādyavivakṣā
kiṃ kāraṇam ? vakṣyamāṇanyāyadarśanāt, vakṣyamāṇo hi vidhividhinaye'yaṃ nyāyo drakṣyate bhavatā puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam ṛgveda॰ 10

90 ityādi, taddarśanāccedamagnyādivikalpāsattvānnāgnihotraṃ na hotetyarthābhāvādevā'vivakṣā nyāyyā, kiṃ kāraṇam ? arthatattvatantratvāt tasyāḥ, arthavaśāddhi vivakṣā'vivakṣā vā bhavitumarhati, nānyatheti
atra avivakṣitārthāyā nāntarīyakatvāt prakṛteḥ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atra śabdānāṃ vṛttau ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

evamanantaroktopapattividhinā agnihavanaṃ kuryāt ityetasminnarthe pradarśitadoṣatvādathavā agnihotraṃ kuryāt, agnihotraṃ juhuyāt, havanaṃ kuryāt, agnihotraṃ havanaṃ kuryāt, juhuyāt ityevamādyartheṣu pradarśitadoṣatvāt
tāvacchabdaḥ kramārthaḥ, doṣāntarābhidhānamapi bhaviṣyati, eṣa tāvaddoṣa iti

apratyāyakatvamasya vākyasya, kutaḥ ? apratyavekṣitārthayāthātathyokterbālapralāpavat, yathātathābhāvo yāthātathyam, arthasya yāthātathyamarthayāthātathyam, tasmādarthayāthātathyāt tasyāpratyavekṣitasyārthasyāvicāritasya kiṃsvarūpo'yamarthaḥ ? pramāṇam ? prameyaḥ ? kena vā rūpeṇa pramāṇaṃ prameyo vā ? ityapratyavekṣitasyārthasyokteḥ śabdasyārthasya vā pratyāyakasvarūpamapratyavekṣyoktatvāt tadapratyāyakatvam
arthatvācca śabdastadabhidheyo vā pratyavekṣitayāthātathyoktereva pratyāyakaḥ pradhānādivaditi vaidharmyeṇa
kiñcānyat--agnihotraṃ havanaṃ kuryāt ityasminnevānantarokte'rthe doṣāntaraṃ brūmaḥ --tvadabhiprāyavadityādi

tvadabhiprāyeṇa tulyaṃ tvadabhiprāya iva tvadabhiprāyavat, yathā tvadabhiprete agnihotraṃ havanaṃ kuryāt ityetasminnarthe havanānuvādena viśiṣṭe'gnihotre'bhyupagamyamāne'gnihotrasya tvadiṣṭasya karmaṇaḥ sāṅkhyādiparaparikalpitātmādivastutattvasyālaukikasyāprasiddhasya durjñānatvavadalaukikatvādaprasiddhasvarūpatvād durjñānatvam, avijñātasya ca karaṇāsiddhiḥ, sā havanakriyā na sidhyatītyarthaḥ
agnihotraṃ juhuyādityetasmādvidheranyo vidhirvidhyantaraṃ yūpaṃ chinatti ityādi
kālatastāvanna hi sa chedanakriyākāla eva yūpaḥ, chedanādibhiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ san bhaviṣyati yūpaḥ, tasya tadā yūpatvenāsato yuktaṃ yūpasvarūpaṃ kālāntarabhāvyupekṣituṃ na punaragnihotrasya tadaiva sataḥ
nanu tacchabdatā tādarthyāt, yathendrārthā sthūṇā indraḥ
chedanasya saṃskāratā na vihitā syāt, yūpasya nirvṛttatvāt
asatyāṃ ca saṃskāratāyāṃ chidiravivakṣitārthaḥ kartavyatābhirnirūpaṇam, śailī svabhāvaḥ, śailyā dṛṣṭayā vidhitvādasyāpi vidhereṣā śailī ityanumānāt siddhirbhavati
kasya punarvidhervidhyantaravidhānaśailyā siddhirdṛṣṭā ? yathā yūpaṃ chinattītyādi yāvat pālāśamaṣṭāśrimityādīti śailyanumāne dṛṣṭāntamāha
yathātra pūrvamavivakṣitaniścayāvadhāraṇātmikā kartavyatā coditā paścāt aṣṭāśriṃ pālāśaṃ bailvaṃ vā ityādītikartavyatācodanayā svarūpe vyavasthāpyate tathehāpi
ācārya āha --etadapi na, vaiṣamyāt, dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ śailīvaiṣamyāt
tatra kālatastāvanna hi sa cchedanakriyākāla eva yūpaḥ, bhavatīti vākyaśeṣaḥ, chedanādyānarthakyaprasaṅgāt
kiṃ tarhi ? chedanādikriyābhiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ san bhaviṣyati yūpaḥ
itthaṃsvarūpasya tasya kāṣṭhasya tadā yūpatvenāsato yuktaṃ yūpasvarūpaṃ kālāntare bhāvyupekṣitum, na punaragnihotrasya tadaiva sataḥ saṃskāranirapekṣasya kālāntarābhāvyarthopekṣaṇamiti vaiṣamyam
kālatastāvanna hi sa chedanakriyākāla eva yūpaḥ, chedanādibhiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ san bhaviṣyati yūpaḥ, tasya tadā yūpatvenāsato yuktaṃ yūpasvarūpaṃ kālāntarabhāvyupekṣituṃ na punaragnihotrasya tadaiva sataḥ
yathā yūpaṃ chinatti iti avivakṣitanirūpaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ paścāditikartavyatābhirnirūpaṇaṃ bailvaṃ pālāśamaṣṭāśrimityādi ityevaṃ mūlamatra sambhāvyate
nanu tacchabdatā tādarthyāt, yathendrārthā sthūṇā indraḥ
chedanasya saṃskāratā na vihitā syāt, yūpasya nirvṛttatvāt
iti āpastambaśrautasūtre ca vistareṇa varṇitaṃ yūpasvarūpam
itara āha --nanu tacchabdatetyādi yāvat sthūṇendra iti
yathātra tādarthyāt tācchabdyamevaṃ yūpārthaṃ dāru yūpa iti tatkālatvāt

atrocyate --chedanasya saṃskāratā na vihitā syād yūpasya nivṛttatvāt, tannirvartanārtho hi cchedanasaṃskāraḥ, tasyāmasatyāṃ ca saṃskāratāyāṃ chidiravivakṣitārthaḥ syāt, asaṃskārārthatve'narthaka eva cchidiḥ syādityarthaḥ
tasmād yāvadeva yūpaṃ svīkaroti svatvena parigṛhṇātītyuktaṃ bhavati tāvadeva chinattītyuktaṃ bhavati, chinatteḥ saṃskārārtharahitatvāt
mā bhūdayaṃ doṣo dṛṣṭaviruddhatvāt, adṛṣṭārtho vā syāt iti vartate
evaṃ tāvat kālataḥ śailīvaiṣamyādayuktamuktam --vidhyantaravidhānaśailyā tatsiddhiḥ, yūpaṃ chinatti pālāśamaṣṭāśrimi- tyādivaditi
tādarthyāt tācchabdyaṃ bhaviṣyati, yathā indrārthā sthūṇā indra iti iti pātañjalamahābhāṣye 6
syād yūpaṃ chinatti svīkarotīti yāvat, adṛṣṭārtho vā

iyaṃ bhāvanā--yā tatra bhāvanā yūpaṃ chinatti cchedanena yūpaṃ svīkarotīti, na ca cchedanamevetyavadhāryate'ṣṭāśrikaraṇādīnāmasaṃskāratvaprasaṅgāt, kintu karotyevetyavadhāryate, seha na śakyāśrayitumavadhāraṇāsambhavāt, havanena hyagnihotraṃ karoti na pravrajyādinā, na ca karotyevetyavadhāryate svargādikāmābhāve karaṇābhāvāt

anantaroktā yeyaṃ bhāvanā, anayaiva bhāvanayāvadhāraṇavaiṣamyamapi bhāvayiṣyāmi, ata āha --yā tatra bhāvanā yūpaṃ chinatti cchedanena yūpaṃ svīkarotīti chideḥ saṃskārābhāve yūpasvīkaraṇārthatāyā uktatvāt
tatra ca kathamavadhāryam ? ucyate --na ca cchedanamevetyavadhāryate, karotīti vartate
kastatra doṣa iti cet, yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇam, aṣṭāśrikaraṇādīnāmasaṃskāratvaprasaṅgaḥ, tadatra prasaktam, tat tu neṣyate
kathaṃ punarasambhavaḥ ? yasmāddhavanenāgnihotraṃ karoti na pravrajyādinā, na ca karotyevetyavadhāryate svargādikāmābhāve karaṇābhāvādityavadhāraṇavaiṣamyam
havanenāgnihotraṃ karotīti havanādanyasyāgnihotrasyābhāvādata eva prasiddhivaiṣamyamapi, tasyāgnihotrasyāprasiddhasya kriyākalāpābhimatārthanāmadheyamātratvāt prasiddhayūpadravyacchedanādivaiṣamyam
mātragrahaṇaṃ nāmadheyatvasāmānyamevānumīyeta nārthaviśeṣaḥ idaṃ tadagnihotraṃ nāma vastu iti

śailīprāmāṇye cāvalambyamāne'syāgnihotrasya śailyā yūpakriyāyā uktavidhinaivāyāthārthyāt, yathārthabhāvo yāthārthyam, na yāthārthyamayāthārthyam, tasmādayāthārthyād yūpakriyayā agnihotrakriyāyāḥ śailīsāmyaṃ nāsti

athavā śailīpramāṇaṃ śailyanumānam, tasmiṃśca śailīprāmāṇye'bhyupagamyamāne cāgnihotrasya śailyā yūpakriyāyā nanu sevādivat kriyāmātratva itikartavyatābhyaḥ pratipattiḥ, na, bhajanārthasevājñātatve tāsāṃ sevārthatvāt

etadapi na, lokaviditadānādyarthānubaddhetikartavyatāmātrārthatāpatteragnisampradānavirodhāt 'na tu laukika eva ayāthārthyāt kathaṅkāraṃ vidhividhyantaraśailyostulyā prasiddhiḥ, alaukikatvādanumānānupapatteḥ ? loke hi dṛṣṭamanumīyate, na tu yūpakaraṇamaṣṭāśryādirūpamagnihotrakarmadharmasvarūpapṛthagbhūtaṃ prasiddhamasti yatastacchailyāgnihavanaśailyanumīyeta
hi gatau pā॰ dhā॰ 1258, sarveṣāṃ gatyarthānāṃ jñānārthatvād hinoti gamayatīti heturliṅgamityarthaḥ, tathā ca heyaṃ gamyaṃ sādhyamityarthaḥ
nanu sevādivat kriyāmātratva itikartavyatābhyaḥ pratipattiḥ, na, bhajanārthasevājñātatve tāsāṃ sevārthatvāt

yathā hi sevetyupasthānāñjalikaraṇādisvāmyājñānuvṛttibhajanārthā viśeṣeṇa manovākkāyaparispandabhedātmikā ekaiva svāmicittānurodhalakṣaṇā sevā evamagnihotrākhyaikā kriyā, na sā svāvayavakalāpavyatiriktā kācidasti
tasmāttā eva paśvālambhana- prokṣaṇādikriyāḥ agnihotram ityabhedenocyante
ādigrahaṇāt kṛṣivāṇijyādikriyāmātratve svābhya eva itikartavyatābhyaḥ pratipatti stathepattistathehāpīti

taddarśayati--bhajanaṃ bhaktiḥ, saivārthaḥ sevāyā iti bhajanārthā sevā, tasyāḥ sevāyā jñātatve tāsāṃ tadavayavābhimatānāmupasthānāñjalikaraṇādīnāṃ sevārthatvāt, ajñātatve tadarthāpratipādanāt, jñātā eva hi tāḥ sevā iti pratipattiṃ janayanti, nānyathā

avaśyaṃ caitadevam, itarathā pratikriyaṃ pṛthaktvāpatteḥ, yathā kṛṣisevayoḥ parasparaṃ tadaṅgakriyāṇāṃ ca pṛthaktvaṃ tadaṅgatvenājñātatvādevamagnihotrasya tadaṅgakriyāṇāṃ ca syāt, na tu bhavati tadaṅgabhāvenājñātatvādagniṣṭomādīnāmiti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? atrāpi hu dānādanayoḥ pā॰ dhā॰ 1083 iti dānādyarthatvāddhavanādīnāṃ jñātatvam, ato'gnihotrasyāpi jñātadānādyaṅgakriyatvāt sāmyameva sevādibhiḥ
evamapi lokaviditairdānādyarthairanubaddhāyā itikartavyatāyā yo'rthastanmātrārthatvamāpanna- gṛhyamāṇe' ityādyuktadarśanavat
atha agnihotram ityasyāpūrvaviśeṣābhidhānārthataiva kalpyeta tathā sati apūrvābhidhāne ko'rthaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt ? yaḥ svargakāmaḥ sa havanena svargaṃ bhāvayedityayamarthaḥ magnihotrasya

loke hyanugrahārthaṃ svasyātisargo dānam, saṅgatya prītyā dānamasmiṃstat sampradānam, tasmai dānaṃ yatra svaparānugraho vidyate tādṛśastyāgo dānam, na tu yatra kvacana mūtrapurīṣādivisargavad dravyavisargo bhasmani vā sarpiḥprakṣepavat
tasmāt svaparopakārakameva agnau sarpirādivisarjanaṃ sarvaṃ syāt, na caitadiṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vā

kiṃ kāraṇam ? agnisampradānavirodhāt, tasyāgnerdahanātmakasya sarvadravyāṇāṃ vināśakasya sampradānatvavirodhāt, chinnapāṇermatsyābhayadānavat muṣitasya vā caurābhayapradānadānavat, agnaye iti sampradānaviśeṣokterlokayajñatulyatvāllaukika eva gṛhyamāṇe'rthe idamevaṃ naivaṃ ceti vicāro'rthavānna bhavati, yadi bhaveccatuṣpāttve satyutplutya gamanāllomaśo hariṇavad maṇḍūkastata eva nirlomā hariṇo maṇḍūkavat syāditi prasiddhiviparītaṃ sidhyellokāpramāṇīkaraṇe iti tat prasaktamihāpītyata āha --na tu laukika eva gṛhyamāṇe ityādyuktadarśanavaditi
atha agnihotram ityasyāpūrvaviśeṣābhidhānārthataiva kalpyeta tathā sati apūrvābhidhāne ko'rthaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt ? yaḥ svargakāmaḥ sa havanena svargaṃ bhāvayedityayamarthaḥ
naiva setyādi atrāpyaniṣṭāpādanasādhanam, naiva sā tathābhūtārthā havanakriyā tadābhatvāt, tadābhatvamasyāḥ paramārthena adānātmikāyā dānatvenādānāt, tacca siddham
yathā bālaramaṇakādikriyāyāṃ svādvannādisaṃjñādikriyāyāmanyonyadānabhojanādikriyāstadābhā eva evamidamapi dānamagnau prakṣepa iti

idaṃ cātrāniṣṭāpādanam --pradhānādivādasādhutā ca prasiddhiviparītetyādi, prasiddherviparītaṃ tattvam, tadbhāvastattvam, prasiddhiviparīte tattve sthito'rtho'sya vādasya, tadbhāvāt prasiddhiviparītatattvasthitārthatvād vedavādavat sādhutā syāt pradhānasaṃsargakṣaṇabhaṅgādyātmakādivādānām
athetyadhikārāntare, athaiteṣu vikalpeṣvagnihotraśabdasya kriyāvācitve sarvathā doṣotpādabhītena pareṇa agnihotram ityasyāpūrvaviśeṣābhidhānārthataiva kalpyeta
na pūrvo'pūrvo'dṛṣṭo dharmaviśeṣaḥ, tadabhidhānamarthaḥ prayojanaṃ vyāpāraḥ, tadbhāvo'pūrvaviśeṣābhidhānārthataiva kalpyeta

viśeṣaśabdāt parasparaviśiṣṭābhiryajñasaṃsthābhiragniṣṭomādibhiriṣṭibhiścābhivyaktavyāpūrvā api viśeṣyante dravya kṛtaḥ syāt, kimūnīkṛtamarthāvidyāyāḥ ? yāvadeva svargakāmo juhuyādityuktaṃ bhavati tāvadeva apūrvaṃ juhuyāt svargakāma ityuktaṃ bhavati, tato bhāvanasya gatārthatvāt
na ca sa pratyakṣo'pūrvo yatastena nirūpaṇamārabhyeta--yena havanenāpūrvo nirvartate tadanuṣṭhātavyam
mā bhūd yajñasaṃjñāyāḥ kriyāyā eva dharmatvaṃ yathā kaiścinmīmāṃsakairevaṃ vyākhyāyate --yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan ṛgveda॰ 10

15 iti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasminnarthe pratyakṣata evānityāyāḥ kriyāyā anantaraṃ phalasambandhādarśanāt kriyāvaiphalyadoṣaprasaṅgācca agnihotram iti dharmaḥ kriyābhivyaṅgya ucyate kārye kāraṇopacārādagnihotrābhivyaṅgyo'gnihotramiti

tataḥ agnihotraṃ dharmaṃ juhuyād bhāvayet svargakāmaḥ ityeṣa vākyārtho nirdoṣa ityetamarthaṃ spaṣṭīkārayituṃ vidhividhinayaḥ pṛcchati --tathā sati apūrvābhidhāne ko'rthaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt ? arthaśabdasya prayojanābhidheyayordṛṣṭatvāt ko'rthaḥ sādhitaḥ, kiṃ prayojanaṃ kṛtaṃ syāt ? ko'bhidheyaḥ samarthitaḥ syāt ? vidhinayo bravīti --yaḥ svargakāmaḥ sa havanenetikartavyatāviśeṣeṇa svargaṃ bhāvayedityayamarthaḥ kṛtaḥ sādhitaḥ samarthitaḥ syādityarthaḥ
vidhividhinaya āha--vidyāparyāyatattvajñānotpādanārthatvādavidyānirākaraṇārthatvācca śabdaprayogasya kimūnīkṛtamarthāvidyāyā iti, na kiñcidūnīkṛtamityabhiprāyaḥ

tat samarthayati --yāvadevetyādi, yaduktaṃ bhavati yaḥ svargaṃ kāmayate sa juhuyāditi taduktaṃ bhavati apūrvaṃ juhuyāt svargakāma iti, nāpūrvo'rtho'dhiko'gnihotraśabdena labhyate, havanenaiva tasyābhivyaṅgyatvāt juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ ityetāvataiva gatārthatvāt juhuyād dharmaṃ bhāvayet svargakāmaḥ ityetasyāṃ vākyārthavyaktau ko'gniśabdena hotraśabdena cārthaḥ ? ityata āha --tato bhāvanasya gatārthatvāt, bhavantaṃ dharmaṃ bhāvayato hetukartṛsādhanasādhyasya dhātvarthasya bhāvanasya juhuyācchabdaprayogādeva gatārthatvānnārthaḥ kaścidagnihotramityanena
kṛtaḥ syāt, kimūnīkṛtamarthāvidyāyāḥ ? yāvadeva svargakāmo juhuyādityuktaṃ bhavati tāvadeva apūrvaṃ juhuyāt svargakāma ityuktaṃ bhavati, tato bhāvanasya gatārthatvāt
na ca sa pratyakṣo'pūrvo yatastena nirūpaṇamārabhyeta--yena havanenāpūrvo nirvartate tadanuṣṭhātavyam
prasiddhiviruddhā ceyaṃ kalpanā, loke vede vā tasya tadarthābhāvāt
abhyupetyāpi apūrvaviśeṣābhidhānamapratyakṣatvāt tannirūpaṇaṃ havanena nopapadyata iti brūmaḥ, nirūpaṇavaidharmyāt

iha hi yad ghaṭādi vastu mṛdānayanamardanādikriyayā nirūpaṇārthaṃ pratyakṣata upalabdhacaraṃ tad vyapadiśyate anayā kriyayā ghaṭo nirvartate, asyāstat kāryam, idaṃ kāraṇam iti, dṛṣṭakāraṇakāryasambandhatvāt
ata āha --na ca sa pratyakṣo'- pūrvo yatastena nirūpaṇamārabhyeta havanasya kāryakāryaṃ sa idaṃ cāsya kāraṇamiti
sā kathaṃ vyākhyeti cet, ucyate --yenaṃ havanena dṛṣṭāpūrvanirvartanaśaktinā nirvartyo'gnihotrākhyo'pūrvo athocyeta--asyāstāvat prāpteḥ prasiddhirbhaviṣyati, tadanubandhāccetikartavyataiva kartavyatā
na tarhi punaḥ juhuyāt iti vācyaṃ syāt
api caivamuttarottaravirodhaparihāravicāraprāpyārthaparigrahāt puruṣapramāṇakastarka nirvartate tat tvayānuṣṭhātavyaṃ havanam, yathā mṛdānayanādikriyā ghaṭanirvartanārthamiti
na tarhi punaḥ juhuyāt iti vācyaṃ syāt
atra tacca na ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

sambhāvanayaitadapi kṛtvā kalpanātmikayoktamapi na sambhavatīti ye'bhihitā doṣāstatparihāramanādṛtya pareṇa prasiddhamātrapratipādanārthamathocyeta--asyāstāvat prāpteḥ prasiddhirbhaviṣyatīti tato doṣaparihāro bhaviṣyatīti
94 ityatra ābādīnāṃ ca iti vaktavyaṃ gurośca halaḥ pā॰ 3
103 iti apratyayenāpavādena mā bhūd bādheti prāpaṇāt prāptervākyāntaraprāpitā prasiddhirbhaviṣyati
agnaye hotramagnihotramiti caturthīsamāsaḥ, yogavibhāgādaśvaghāsādyupasaṅkhyānādvā rūpasiddhistadarthaprasiddhiśca, tataḥ karaṇaṃ tatphalasambandhaśca karturiti sarvamupapannam
katamasmādvākyāt prāpitā prasiddhiriti cet, vakṣyamāṇe vākyāntare yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti mai॰ saṃ॰ 1
7 iti, ghṛtena payasā dadhnā juhuyāt iti
tadanubandhācca itikartavyataiva kartavyatā, tasyāḥ prāptervākyāntaraprāpitāyā anubandhāt sambandhādanuparatākāṅkṣāduttarāḥ sarvā itikartavyatā eva kartavyatāḥ

atrocyate --na tarhi punaḥ juhuyāt iti vācyaṃ syāt, agnihotraśabdenaiva agniprajāpatyādisampradānajuhotyādītikartavyatenoktārthatvāt punarapi prāgabhihito yo na hi kaścijjuhotipunarvacanena ityādigranthārthaḥ sa eva doṣaprapañco'sminnapi vyākhyādhvanyupasthitaḥ
striyāṃ ktinityatra ābādibhyaśceti vaktavyam iti pātañjalamahābhāṣye 3
vikṛtiḥ prakṛtyeti cet, aśvaghāsādīnāmupasaṅkhyānaṃ kartavyam iti pātañjalamahābhāṣye 2
kiṃ tacchāstrāntaramiti cet, yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti iti kecit iti arthasaṅgrahe pañcamaparicchede

preyamedhā vai sarve saha brahmāviduḥ, te'gnihotreṇa samarādhayaṃsteṣāṃ trireko'juhod dvirekaḥ sakṛdekaṃsteṣāṃ yastrirajuhot tamapṛcchan kasmai tvamahauṣīriti, so'bravīt--tredhā vā idam agnaye prajāpataye sūryāyeti
atha yo dvirajuhot tamapṛcchan kasmai tvamahauṣīriti, so'bravīd dvedhā vā idam agnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ sūryāya ca prajāpataye ca prātariti
atha yaḥ sakṛdajuhot tamapṛcchan kasmai tvamahauṣīriti, so'bravīd ekadhā vā idaṃ prajāpataya eveti
teṣāṃ yo dvirajuhot sa ārdhnot tasyetare sājātyamupāyan ṛdhnoti ya evaṃ vidvānagnihotraṃ juhoti upāsya samānāḥ sājātyaṃ yanti
ājyena juhuyāt tejaskāmasya, tejo vā ājyam, tejasvī eva bhavati
payasā paśukāmasya, etadvai paśūnāṃ rūpam, rūpeṇaivāsmai paśūnavarundhe, paśumāneva bhavati
dadhnendriyakāmasya, indriyaṃ vai dadhi, indriyāvyeva bhavati
kiṃ kāraṇam ? uttarottaravirodha āśrito bhavati sāmānyādyarthaikāntavadeva

ekāvasthāmātravicchinnapūrvāparatattvāgnyādibhinnavastutvābhiniveśavidhānācca kuryāditi kāraṇe kāryasyāsattvaikāntābhyupagamāt sarvagatasatkāryakāraṇavṛttitve parihāravicāraprāpyārthaparigrahāt, agnihotrahavanayoḥ paunaruktyādidoṣādvirodha ityukte anuvādavidhitve na iti parihāraḥ, punaraprasiddhatvādvirodha ityukte kuryādartho juhuyācchabdaḥ ityevamādivicāraiḥ prāpyo'rthastvayā parigṛhītaḥ, ataḥ svabuddhiprāmāṇyāvalambanāt puruṣapramāṇakastarka āśrito bhavati, tarkalakṣaṇaṃ ca avijñātatattve'rthe kāraṇopapattitastattvajñānārthamūhastarkaḥ nyā॰ sū॰ 1

kimiva ? sāmānyādyarthaikāntavadeva, yathā sāmānyameva, viśeṣā eva, sāmānyaṃ viśeṣāśca ityekāntārthaparigrahe prāguktavidhinā pūrvottaravirodhaparihāraprāpyo'rtho'śakyaprāptiraphalaḥ puruṣapramāṇatvāt tathā'yamapi tarkaḥ
sa cāniṣṭha iti, api ca tarko'pratipūrṇo yadi na bhavedāśrīyeta, kintu na pratipūrṇaḥ

ekāvasthāmātravicchinnapūrvāparatattvāgnyādibhinnavastutvābhiniveśavidhānācceti, caśabdājjuhuyādukteśca, ekasyaivāvasthā ekā ca sāvasthā ca ekāvasthā, tatparimāṇamekāvasthāmātraṃ timitasaraḥsalilavadavicchinnam, tasyaiva punastattvaṃ vicchinnaṃ pūrvasyāparasya cendhanāderagnyāde- rbhasmāderghaṭapaṭādeśca paraviṣayasāmānyavādimatavat, sarvaikyāpannasya sato'gnyāderbhinnavastutvenābhiniveśastadabhyupagamo'gniriti paramāṇudvyaṇukādibhūmyabādisaṃyogasambhūtavanaspatībhūtāgnibhasmatruṭiparamāṇvādivicchinnāvasthāmātratve sati agniriti bhavati krameṇa pariṇāmabhedābhyupagamāt, tasya vidhānāt, agnihotraṃ juhuyāt iti ca havanakriyānuṣṭhānaṃ tatphalābhimataḥ svargastayośca sambandha iti parasparaṃ vighaṭitatvānnopapadyeta pūrvāparābhyupagamayoḥ
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ vighaṭitatvamiti cet, ucyate --kāraṇe kāryasyāsattvaikāntābhyupagamāditi vighaṭanapradarśanam

evaṃ hi kāraṇe ghṛtādau kāryasyāgnihavanakarmaṇastatkāryasya ca svargāderasattve sati karaṇamupapadyate, tacca sati nopapadyate siddhaudanapacanavat, viśiṣṭaikāgnyādyavasthābhyupagame ca puruṣādikāraṇātmakasarvaikyābhyupagamavirodhini satyupapadyate nānyathetyata āha --sarvagatasatkāryakāraṇavṛttitve bhedavidhinirviṣayatvāt, suptasuṣuptajāgaritaturīyāvasthākrameṇaikameva yugapadvā sarvagataṃ puruṣākhyaṃ kāraṇam, tacca satkāryam, bhedavidhinirviṣayatvāt sarvavastusannidhisadbhūtaiva sā bhedasādhanasambandhābhinirvartyeti vidhīyate, tadanu yathābhāgakārakavinyāsātmikayetikartavyatayānuṣṭhīyate
ato'sau prāg nāsīt, kāryatvena parigṛhītatvāt, viśeṣaikāntivastuvat

na tu tattvamevaṃ vastuno'satkāryatvam, vyaṅgyatvāt, piṇḍakālaghaṭavat, tattva sarvagataṃ ca tat satkāryakāraṇaṃ ca taditi vigrahāt, vakṣyamāṇavidhividhinayadarśanena tadvṛttitve agnihotraṃ kuryāt iti bhedavidhinirviṣayatvamagnyādyabhāvāt
tatśabdā॰ pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
bhedavidhinirviṣayatvāt sarvavastusannidhisadbhūtaiva sā bhedasādhanasambandhābhinirvartyeti vidhīyate, tadanu yathābhāgakārakavinyāsātmikayetikartavyatayānuṣṭhīyate
ato'sau prāg nāsīt, kāryatvena parigṛhītatvāt, viśeṣaikāntivastuvat
na tu tattvamevaṃ vastuno'satkāryatvam, vyaṅgyatvāt, piṇḍakālaghaṭavat, tattva
na karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena tyāgenaike amṛtatvamānaśuḥ
na karmaṇā prajāyana dhanena tyāgenaikena amṛtatvamānasaḥ pra॰
pareṇa nākaṃ nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ vibhrājate yad yatayo viśanti || kaivalyopa॰ 3
tathā— puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam

ataḥ sarvavastusannidhītyādi, sarvavastūnāṃ sannidhau sadbhūtaiva sā havanakriyā tathāpi bhedāḥ sādhanānyasyāḥ, ghṛtena payasā juhuyāt ityādibhedakriyā evāgnihavanakriyāyāḥ sādhanāni tānyantareṇa tadabhāvāt sādhanasambandhābhinirvartyeti vidhīyate, kena ? upadeṣṭrā svargakāmaṃ puruṣaṃ prati vacanena tvayā kartavyeti vidhīyate

tadanu anuṣṭhātrāpi tadupadiṣṭabhedasādhananiṣpādyetyabhyupagamya yo yo bhāgo yathābhāgaṃ kārakāṇāṃ vinyāsa ātmā yasyā itikartavyatāyāḥ sā yathābhāgakārakavinyāsātmikā, tayā itikartavyatayā gavālambhanājyaprakṣepādiprakārarūpayānuṣṭhīyate, sāmarthyādato'sau prāg nāsīdityāśritā
kasmāt ? kāryatvena parigṛhītatvāt, kuryājjuhuyāt ityādivacanāt kāryatvena nirvartyatvena parigṛhītaiva sā

dṛṣṭānto viśeṣaikāntivastuvaditi, yathā viśeṣaikāntavādinā kāryameva, na kāraṇam iti pratikṣaṇotpattivināśātmakatvāt pratipannaṃ vastu tat prāg nāsti, tacca tvayābhyupagataṃ kriyābhyupagamāditi tvāṃ prati sādhyasādhanadharmānvito dṛṣṭāntaḥ, mayāpi ca tadabhyupagamyoktatvāditi sādhyasādhanam
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam
na tu tattvamevaṃ vastuno'satkāryatvam, kiṃ kāraṇam ? vyaṅgyatvāt, vyaṅgyā hi sā kriyā na kāryā, avivakṣitapratyekasamuditaghṛtādidravyadharmatvenābhivyakteḥ
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? piṇḍakālaghaṭavat, yathā mṛtpiṇḍakāla eva ghaṭo vidyamāno'pi sādhanāntarāpekṣābhivyaktitvānnopalabhyate, śukraśoṇitāvasthāyāmiva evātathābhūterghaṭasvātmavat
ata eva ca kāraṇamātramasau saha phalenāpi, tadātmatvāt tannirvṛttatvāt, ghaṭamṛttvavat
vā devadattastadavasthāviśeṣāntaratve sati uttarakālamupalabhyatvāt, kāryatvādeva vā prakāśyaghaṭavadabhivyañjanasyaiva karaṇākhyatvāt

evaṃ tarhi sattvarajastamasāṃ sāmyavaiṣamyavad vyaktāvyaktatā ekakāraṇatvasya bādhikā syāditi cet, netyucyate, kutaḥ ? tattva evātathābhūteḥ, na hyavyaktāvasthā nāma kācidasti, kiṃ tarhi ? tattva evānyathābhāvo'sti, tasya bhāvastattvam, tasmiṃstattva eva tadbhāvāvasthāyāmevānyathābhavanāt, tadeva hi vastu svarūpāvasthāyāmevānyathā bhavati, yadyanyadanyathā bhaved mṛtpiṇḍo'pi paṭo bhavet, na tu bhavati

yathā ghaṭo ghaṭasvātmanyeva sthito navaḥ purāṇatayotpadyate tathā sa eva mṛtpiṇḍo'nyo ghaṭo bhavati, na tu sāṅkhyābhimatā'vyaktatā nāma kācidasti, yadi sa eva ghaṭo navaḥ purāṇatayā'nyo na bhaved na purāṇaḥ syāt, nava eva syāt, tato'nyo vā paṭādiḥ purāṇaghaṭaḥ syāt, naiva vā kaścidapi bhavet, tasmāt tattva evātathābhūternāvyaktāvasthā nāma kācidasti

atrāha--ghaṭasvātmavat ityayaṃ dṛṣṭānta upapadyate navatvāvasthānantaraṃ purāṇatvāvasthānubhavāt, mṛtpiṇḍakālaghaṭavat iti na yujyate tattva evānyathābhāvābhāvāt, piṇḍānantaraṃ hi śivako bhavati na ghaṭo na stūpakacchatrakasthālakakośakakuśūlakā iti

atrocyate--tulyapratyāsattitvād yathā ghaṭo bhavati kuśūlakāt tathā kuśūlakaḥ kośakāt, kośakaḥ sthālakāt, sthālakaśchatrakāt, chatrakaḥ stūpakāt, stūpakaḥ śivakāt, śivakaḥ piṇḍāt, piṇḍo mṛdaḥ, iti mṛda eva tathā tathā bhūteḥ

athavā kimanayā sāṅkhyasṛṣṭikramakākvanumatyā ? tasyāmeva mṛtpiṇḍāvasthāyāṃ ghaṭo bhavatīti pratipadyasva stimitasaraḥsalilavattaraṅgavat tattva evānyathābhavanānnāstyatrāpi krama ityatastadupadarśanārthamāha--mṛtpiṇḍakālaghaṭavaditi
athavā tattva eva tathābhūteriti pāṭhaḥ, tattva eva tadbhāva eva sati tena tena prakāreṇa bhavanāt, piṇḍa eva mūrtisvabhāvarūpādyātmake śivakādyātmanā nīlaraktādyātmanā ca bhavanāditi
ata eva ca kāraṇamātramasau saha phalenāpi, tadātmatvāt tannirvṛttatvāt, ghaṭamṛttvavat

ata eva ca kāraṇamātramasau, tattva evātathābhūtestathābhūtervā kāraṇapramāṇamasau havanakriyā ghṛtādikāraṇebhyo na vyatiriktā, uktahetorasatkāryābhāvāt kāraṇamātramasau kriyā iti pratipattavyamavaśyam
na kevalaṃ kriyaiva kāraṇamātram, saha phalenāpi sā kāraṇamātram, phalamapyasyāḥ svargākhyaṃ sukhādi ghṛtādikāraṇānyathābhavanamātram

atropacayahetū pratipāditārthāveva tadātmatvāt tannirvṛttatvāditi, tasyātmā sa ātmāsyeti vā tadātmā, tena tasmiṃstasya sa eva vā nirvṛttaḥ, tadbhāvastannirvṛttatvaṃ tadātmatvaṃ ca, tasmāt tadātmatvāt tannirvṛttatvād ghaṭamṛttvavat, ghaṭasya mṛttvaṃ ghaṭamṛttvaṃ mṛdeva ghaṭaḥ, ghaṭa eva mṛd yathā pratipāditaṃ ekāntavādasvābhāvyāditikartavyatākartavyatābhyupagamāttu pūrvottarāvasthānubandhāt sarpasphaṭāṭopamukulaprasāraṇakuṇḍalīkaraṇavad yajñopavītasūtratantutvapaṭatvavadvā saṃsthānamātrabhinnakāraṇakāryatvābhyupagama āpadyata iti kāryatyāga iti svaśabdārthāpattiviṣayaviparītārthatvād vivakṣābhedavyāghātaḥ
yadītikartavyatā janayati tataḥ sā tajjanyā na, janakatvāt kāraṇatvāt tattva evātathābhūtestathābhūterveti tadvat
evaṃ tāvadapratipūrṇastarkaḥ prāg nāsīt kriyā kāryatvena parigṛhītatvāt iti, asiddhahetutvāt pratitarkeṇa bādhyatvācceti suṣṭhūcyate

ekāntavādasvābhāvyāditikartavyatākartavyatābhyupagamāttu pūrvottarāvasthānubandhāt sarpasphaṭāṭopamukulaprasāraṇakuṇḍalīkaraṇavad yajñopavītasūtratantutvapaṭatvavadvā saṃsthānamātrabhinnakāraṇakāryatvābhyupagama āpadyata iti kāryatyāga iti svaśabdārthāpattiviṣayaviparītārthatvād vivakṣābhedavyāghātaḥ
yadītikartavyatā janayati tataḥ sā tajjanyā na, janakatvāt kāraṇatvāt

kiñcānyat, svayameva tvayā parityaktatvāccāpratipūrṇa eva, kasmāt ? ekāntavādasvābhāvyāt, evaṃsvabhāvā hyekāntavādāḥ sarvoktamṛṣātvavādavat, yathoktaṃ tvayā tadanubandhāccetikartavyataiva kartavyatā iti bruvatā kāraṇe kāryasya sattvamabhyupagamyāsattvaṃ ca tyaktaṃ bhavati, ato brūmaḥ --itikartavyatākartavyatābhyupagamāttvityādi

itiśabdasya prakārārthavācitvāditthamitthaṃ ca kartavyaṃ ghṛtena juhuyāt payasā juhuyāt ityādiprakārā kartavyatā itikartavyatā, saiva kartavyatā kāraṇabhūtāstā eva prokṣaṇādikriyāḥ agnihotram ityabhyupagamāt, pūrvottarāvasthānubandhād vicchinnapūrvottarāvasthasya kasyacidabhāvāt kāraṇameva kāryaṃ sarpasphaṭāṭopamukulaprasāraṇakuṇḍalīkaraṇavad yajñopavītasūtratantutvapaṭatvavadvā, sūtrameva yathā yajñopavītākhyāṃ labhate tathāsamavasthānāt tathā tantava eva paṭastadvat saṃsthānamātrabhinnasya kāraṇasyaiva kāryatvamityayamabhyupagama āpadyate iti, itiśabdo hetvarthe, etasmāt saṃsthānamātrabhinnakāraṇakāryatvābhyupagamāpatterhetoḥ kāryasya tyāgaḥ kāryatyāgaḥ, kuryāt ityayaṃ hi śabdaḥ kāryārthe sati arthavān bhavati, nānyathā

punaritiśabdo hetvarthe, tataśca kuryādarthatyāgāt svaśabdārthāpattiviṣayaviparītārthatvād vivakṣābhedavyāghātaḥ, agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityanena svaśabdenaivāsatkāryavādo'bhyupagataḥ, tadanubandhāccetikartavyataiva kartavyatā ityarthāpattyā kāraṇātmakakāryavādo'bhyupagataḥ, tayoranyonyaviparītārthatvādviruddhatvād vivakṣābhedo vyāghātaśca
ata eva ca parasparato virodhād vyāghāto'nayoḥ

athavārthadvayasya svaśabdārthāpattiviṣayasyābhyupagamād vivakṣābhedo'yaṃ puruṣabuddhivaśād vedavādaprāmāṇyamapauruṣeyaṃ vyāhantīti vivakṣābhedavyāghātaḥ, sa ca tvayā tattvānapekṣaṇadoṣānnekṣyate vastutattvavicārapradveṣiṇā yaḥ kāryakāraṇasvarūpānapekṣiṇo'pi balādayaṃ kāraṇakāryatattvavāda āpadyate'nekāntarūpo vastunastādātmyādanapekṣyamāṇo'pi svamatavyāghātīti
evaṃ kāraṇātmakatve'bhyupagate'pi yadītikartavyatā janayatīti iṣyate tato na sā kartavyatā ghṛtādi pūrvatvād vidhāyakatvāt, mātṛvad vacanavat
atha janyā sā, evaṃ tarhi na janikā, janyatvādibhyaḥ, putrādivat
kāraṇetikartavyatāvyatiriktā kācidasti tataḥ sā tajjanyā na bhavati kriyā, nātmanaivātmānaṃ janayatītyarthaḥ
kasmāt ? janakatvāt kāraṇatvāt pūrvatvād vidhāyakatvād mātṛvat, yathā mātā nātmānaṃ janayati, kiṃ tarhi ? tato'nyāṃ duhitaraṃ janayati, evamiyamitikartavyatā janikā satī
vacanavadityatra yathā vacanamapi nātmānaṃ janayati buddhiṃ tu tato'nyāṃ vācyaviṣayāṃ janayati tathā itikartavyateti

atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti janakatvamasiddhaṃ tasyā janyatvāt, janyā hi setyatrocyate --atha janyā sā evaṃ tarhi na janikā na kāraṇam, janyatvādibhyaḥ, janyatvāt kāryatvādapūrvatvād vidheyatvāt, putrādivat
tasmāt svavihitadoṣatvājjanyatve janakatve vā doṣānativṛtterayuktamuktam --itikartavyataiva karta- vyatā tadanubandhāditi
atha janyā sā, evaṃ tarhi na janikā, janyatvādibhyaḥ, putrādivat

kiñcānyat, kāraṇamātratve sati kartavyatā pratītikartavyataṃ parisamāptā vā syāt, aparisamāptā vā ? tatra tāvad yadi pratyekamitikartavyatāsu kartavyatā parisamāptā tataḥ pratītikartavyataṃ ca kartavyatāsamāpteritikartavyatāntarānārambhaḥ, ekayā ghṛtena juhuyāt ityanayaiva itikartavyatayā tanmātraparisamāptāyāḥ kartavyatāyāḥ kṛtatvāt payasā dadhnā ityādīnāmitikartavyatāntarāṇāmārambho nirarthakaḥ prāptaḥ

anārambha eva vā tasyā api kāraṇamātratvāt itikartavyataiva kartavyatā iti tvayaivābhyupagatatvāt nyāyataśca ghṛtādikāraṇadravyamātratvasya kriyāyāḥ pratipāditatvāt siddhaudanapacanavadanārambha eva prāptaḥ
pratyekaṃ tvasamāptāvakāraṇabhāvādatathātā ca, yadi śibikāvāhakakāraṇatvavat pratyekamasamāptā ca kartavyatā itikartavyatāsu tathāpyakāraṇatā, pratyekamakāraṇatvāt, sikatātailavat

itiśabdasya evamarthatvāt evaṃśabdasya ca prakārārthatvādevaṃ kartavyamitikartavyam, ghṛtādiprakṣepasvarūpakartavyatā tathātā, na tathātā atathātā, tattathātvaṃ na prāpnoti pratyekamakāraṇatvādityatathātā ca

nanūktaṃ śibikāvāhakavahanaśaktivat samudāye setikartavyatāśaktiriti, atrocyate --samudāyasyāpi ca tanmātratvādavayavamātratvāduktavaditi, uktaṃ hi tattva evātathābhūtestathābhūterveti, avayavā eva hi samudāyībhavanto dṛśyante, no cet sikatātailavadeva na syāt tilasamudāyatailamapi
tanmātrahavanārthatvād ghṛtādivad havanasya vidhāyakatā, anuvādatā ca ghṛtādeḥ kāraṇamātravṛttitvād havanavat

tatra tāvat ghṛtena juhuyāt payasā juhuyāt ityādivākyeṣu ghṛtādervidheyatvābhimatasya kāraṇamātrasya havanakāryasyānyasya tanmātretikartavyatāmātrahavanārthatvāt agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityatra śrutahavanānuvādābhāvo'pi, havanasya ghṛtādivyatiriktasyābhāvāt
tataśca ghṛtādividhānavajjñātārthābhimatasya havanavākyasya vidhāyakataiva syāt, nānuvādatā
anuvādatā ca ghṛtāderajñātārthavidhāyakābhimatasyāpi, kāraṇamātravṛttitvād havanavaditi, kāraṇamātre vṛttirasya tat kāraṇamātravṛtti ghṛtādi havanaṃ ca, uktavidhinā kāryābhāvasya pratipāditatvāt
tasmāt kāraṇamātravṛttitvād havanavad ghṛtāderanuvādatā ghṛtādivaddhavanasya vidhāyakateti
evaṃ ceti, vidhyanuvādayoranyonyasvabhāvasaṅkarāvyavasthitātmasvabhāvatvānna vidhirnānuvādo'sti, ata evamuktaprakāreṇāvākyatvam, ananuvādatvādavidhāyakatvāt, vicchinnārthapadavat
yathā vicchinnārthamekaṃ padamadhikṛtapadārthāntarāsambandhaṃ gām ityetanna vākyamata eva vidhyanuvādatvākāṅkṣyārthābhāvāt tathā agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ, ghṛtena payasā juhuyāt ityādīni
yasyāpi padārtho nāstyeva taṃ prati kākarutavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ
evamiti kāraṇamātrakāryatvābhyupagame sādhutāsādhutayoḥ sādhutā tāvat gauḥ ityādeḥ padasya agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityādervākyasya vidhitvamanuvādatvaṃ ca nopapadyate

śabdo hi jñātārtho'jñātārtho vā prayujyate, jñātārtho'nūdyājñātārthavidhānārthaṃ prayujyate, sa punarjñātārthaḥ svata eva pratyakṣādinā pramāṇena jñāte'rthe prayujyeta vākyāntareṇa vā pareṇa jñāpite'rthe, yathā ayaṃ devadattaḥ iti ayaṃśabdasya pratyakṣadṛṣṭārthavācitvādanūdya devadattatvaṃ vidhīyate, vākyāntaraveditārthāni vā padānyanūdya abhyājanaṃ vidhīyate devadatta ! gāmabhyāja śuklām iti jñātājñātārthatā padānāṃ vākyānāṃ ca sādhutvābhimatānāṃ pratyekaṃ sarveṣāṃ dvyarthatā dṛṣṭā
yathā ghaṭasyārātīyā bhāgāścakṣurādyupalabhyā jñātāḥ parāntarbudhnādibhāgā na jñātāḥ

saiṣā lokaprasiddhā sādhutā padavākyaśabdānāṃ kāraṇātmakāryavāde'sminna ghaṭeta, sarvasyaikātmakatve jñātājñātabhedānupapatteḥ, ekasyaiva vā tadubhayābhāvādvidhyanuvādatvābhāvasyoktatvāt kākarutādivaditi
idaṃ cājñātamapi sat tvayā tattvamevaivaṃ vivektāraṃ prati pradarśitaṃ ghuṇākṣaravat

athocyeta--kāraṇamātrakāryadarśanamiha nirmūlāpaviddhakriyāvākyaprabandhamiti ślathatā, yathāsaṅkhyena jñātālambano'nuvādaḥ, ajñātālambano vidhiḥ, tayorarthayoryugapadvaktumicchā yugapadvivakṣā, ekasminnarthe tasyā vṛttiḥ, asau dvyarthatā vākyabhedaḥ, devadattākhyānavākyasyaiva gavānayanacodanāyāṃ devadattānvākhyānavadanuvādo gavānayanavidhānavākyasya vā devadattākhyānavākyavad devadatta- vidhānamiti yeyamekasya śabdasya yugapadarthadvayābhidhānaśaktyabhāvādvākyabhedadoṣaparikalpanā tasyāḥ pariślathatā, arthabhedābhāvāt
ato'sādhutāpi śabdānāṃ nāsti, sarve sādhavo'sādhavo vā śabdāḥ prasaktā iti
idaṃ cājñātamapi sat tvayā tattvamevaivaṃ vivektāraṃ prati pradarśitaṃ ghuṇākṣaravat
kiñcānyat, na kevalaṃ vākyabhedadoṣo bhedābhāvadoṣaścāpadārthātmakaḥ, śrutibhedo'pi vṛthaivaṃ sādhvasādhutvābhyām

evamiti kāraṇātmakakāryavādābhyupagamaprakāreṇoktamatidiśya saṅkṣipya sādhanamāha sodāharaṇam --ekārthatvād ghaṭakuṭavaditi, yathā pratītārthayorghaṭakuṭaśabdayorekārthatvādanyataraprayogo vṛthā sādhutvābhimatayoḥ, asādhutvābhimatasya gośabdamātrasya vācā-diśā-sāsnādimadartheṣu yugapat prayuktasya caikārthatvāt arthabhedadoṣaparikalpanāpariślathatā iti vartate
evaṃ te juhuyādukteḥ paunaruktyasvavacanavirodhau svaśabdoktāsatkāryavādatyāgaḥ kāraṇātmakasatkāryāvādābhyupagamaścetyapratipūrṇatarkatā sadoṣatvādityuktam

yadapyetat tvayābhyupagataṃ kāraṇātmakasatkāryatvaṃ tadapyasamīkṣyābuddhipūrvakamevoktamityatastatpradarśanārthamāha --idaṃ cājñātamapi sat tvayā tattvamevaivaṃ vivektāraṃ prati pradarśitaṃ ghuṇākṣaravat
yathā ghuṇaḥ kāṣṭhamutkirannakṣarākārāmapi rekhāmutkirati yadṛcchayā tathā tvayedaṃ tattvamevaivaṃ kāraṇātmakasatkāryatvaṃ pradarśitam itikartavyataiva kartavyatā iti bruvatā

tat punarvivektāraṃ prati pradarśitam, itthamasatkāryaṃ bhavati, itthaṃ satkāryam iti yo vācyavācakasādhanasvarūpavivekajñastaṃ pratyeva pradarśitaṃ nātmatulyabuddhīn prati, darśayannapi svayaṃ tadvivekaṃ na cecchati
atha tvayaivamucyeta--na mayā kāraṇamātrakāryadarśanaikānto'bhyupagamyate yatastvayaite doṣā māṃ pratyāpādyante
kiṃ tarhi ? mayābhyupagamyate asatkāryaṃ vivakṣyate, alabdhavṛttitvāt, khapuṣpavat
tacca na kāraṇamātram, kuryātpratipāditādasatkāryavādādādau madhye'nte ca kartavyatābhyupagamād yaducyate tvayā doṣajātaṃ tad vacanacchalāt
na kāraṇameva na kāryameva nobhayameva nānubhayamevetyavicārya vastutattvaikāntaparigrahamakṛtvā kāraṇaṃ kāryamubhayamanubhayaṃ vābhyupagamyate

asmin agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ iti vākye yat kāraṇamātrakāryapradarśanamanupāttāparityaktamiha vidhinaye sadapi yat tadatra nirmūlāpaviddhakriyāvākyaprabandham, nirmūlamapaviddhaḥ kriyāprabandho vākyaprabandhaśca yasmiṃstadidaṃ nirmūlāpaviddhakriyāvākyaprabandham

itiśabdo hetvarthe, yasmānnirmūlāpaviddhakriyāvākyaprabandhaṃ tasmāt kāraṇamātrakāryadarśanasya taddoṣaparihārārthamiṣyatemiṣṭato vivakṣyate'navadhāritaikāntadarśanatvāt kāraṇamātratvaṃ tyaktvā yat kāryāsattvaṃ tadeva agnihotraṃ juhuyāt iti vākye kāraṇamātrakāryadarśanameva sat asat kāryam iti vivakṣyate'bhyupagamyate ca
kiṃ kāraṇam ? alabdhavṛttitvāt, alabdhā vṛttiranenetyalabdhavṛtti kāryam, tasmādalabdhavṛttitvāt khapuṣpavat, yathā khapuṣpamalabdhavṛttitvādasattathā kāryaṃ svargāpūrvādi alabdhavṛttitvādasat
labdhavṛttitve kuryājjuhuyāt iti na codyeta, siddhaudanārthaṃ pacet ityacodanāvat
ato'sat kāryamāgṛhya svargādi tatprāptyarthaṃ kriyāśrīyate— agnihotraṃ kuryāditi
tad dvividham, tacca kāryaṃ dvividham --anitikartavyatātmakamitikartavyatātmakaṃ ca

tatrānitikartavyatātmakaṃ kāryaṃ ghaṭādi yūpādi ca loke vede ca dṛṣṭam, mṛdānayanamardanadaṇḍagrahaṇacakrabhramaṇādītikartavyatātmakaṃ ghaṭākhyaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavati taduparame'pi pṛthagupalabdheḥ, tathāṣṭāśrikaraṇādītikartavyatātmako na bhavati yūpaḥ
itikartavyatātmakaṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ prāptisaṃvādi, prāptyā saṃvadituṃ śīlamasya prāptisaṃvādi, yathā sevādi, upasthānāñjalikaraṇādirūpaiva sevā tābhyaḥ pṛthaganupalabdheḥ

tacca kāryaṃ na kāraṇamātraṃ netikartavyatātmakaṃ ghaṭādiyūpādivat, kuryātpratipāditādasatkāryavādāt, kuryācchabdapratipāditāt agnihotraṃ kuryāt ityatra kuryācchabdena pratipāditāt ghaṭaṃ kuryāt iti pratipāditaghaṭāsatkāryārthavākyavadidamapi vākyaṃ sphuṭatarāsatkāryārtham

kiṃ kāraṇam ? ādau madhye'nte ca kartavyatābhyupagamāt, ato'satkāryavādasya upakramaprabhṛtyapavargaparyavasāneṣu kriyāviśeṣeṣvabhyupagatatvād yaducyate tvayā doṣajātaṃ tat tvadvacanāt prāptiprāpitetikartavyataiva kartavyatā iti vacanacchalāt, kāraṇamātrakāryatvāpattistato vidhyanupapattirityādi sarvaṃ doṣajātaṃ nāstīti
tacca na kāraṇamātram, kuryātpratipāditādasatkāryavādādādau madhye'nte ca kartavyatābhyupagamād yaducyate tvayā doṣajātaṃ tad vacanacchalāt
abhyupetyāpi asa asatkāryavādoktāvapi naivāsya vākyatā, itikartavyatāvākyāsiddhau tadasiddhestatsiddhau tatsiddheḥ

kvedamabhihitaṃ juhuyāt iti ? havanāpūrvakaraṇārthatayoḥ pradhānāgnihotraśruti- tkāryavādoktāvapi naivāsya vākyatā prāptyanubandhaprāpitetikartavyatākartavyatārthasyāgnihotrahavanakaraṇārthasya vākyasya vākyatā
kutaḥ ? itikartavyatāvākyāsiddhau tadasiddhestatsiddhau tatsiddheḥ, tat punaritikartavyatāvākyam, tadavākyatve tadbalapratiṣṭhāpyakartavyatāvākyamapyavākyam
tatra tāvat ghṛtena juhuyāt ityetaditikartavyatāvākyamavākyam, ananuvādatvāt, unmattapralāpavat
yathā kāmonmattasya pakṣī iti darśane bhrānteḥ hā priye ! hā priye ! ityādirvipralāpo na vākyaṃ prasiddhārthānuvādābhāvādevaṃ ghṛtena juhuyāt ityasyāpi tadabhāvāt tatkartavyatāvākyābhāvaḥ
syānmatam--vidhimātrasya dvāraṃ dvāram iti anuvādamātrasya udghāṭyatām iti dṛṣṭatvād nāpekṣeteti cet, na, tatrāpi bahiraṅgasthitaprakaraṇādibhyastatsiddherapekṣaiva

tasmādiha itikartavyataiva kartavyatā iti vacanāt kartavyatāvākyasyaivāsiddheḥ ghṛtena juhuyāt ityasya prasiddhārthasyānuvādatvābhāvādavākyatvam, tadavākyatvāt tadbalapratiṣṭhāpyāgnihotrahavanakartavyatāvidhivākyāsiddhiḥ, ata āha --juhuyāt ityasya uktavadevetyādi, juhuyāt, agnihotraṃ kuryāt, havanaṃ kuryāt, agnihotraṃ havanaṃ kuryāt, prāptyanubandhaprāpitaghṛtādītikartavyatātmakakartavyatāgnihotraṃ kuryāt, agnihotramapūrvaṃ kuryāt ityuktavikalpeṣu prāgabhihitadoṣasambandhādetaiḥ sarvaiḥ prakāraiḥ prayogasya parīkṣāyāṃ nirmūlārthatvamaviṣayatvāt, aviṣayatvamapūrvārthatvāt, apūrvārthatvamajñātārthatvāt, ajñātārthatvaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa vākyāntareṇa vā prāgavihitatvāditi
asatkāryavādoktāvapi naivāsya vākyatā, itikartavyatāvākyāsiddhau tadasiddhestatsiddhau tatsiddheḥ

kvedamabhihitaṃ juhuyāt iti ? yaducyate tvayā yajjuhuyāt tad ghṛtādinā iti havanamanūdya ghṛtādinā tadvidhānaṃ kriyeta yathā ghaṭaṃ kuryāt iti prasiddhaṃ ghaṭamanūdya tatkaraṇavidhānam, tattu na prasiddham
kathaṃ na prasiddham ? agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityatra havanasyoktatvādihānuvadanaṃ nanūpapannamiti cet, na, tasyaiva sarvaprayogaparīkṣāyāmarthābhāvāt

śailīprasiddhau chidivadahavanātmakāgnihotratvādanagnihotratvaprasaṅgāt pradhānasvargakāmānabhisambaddhajuhotyarthānuvādena kiṃ prayojanam ? dyāpatteḥ arthābhāvāt ityādyabhisambadhyate, kramollaṅghanena vikalpadvayopanyāsastulyottaratvāt, havanaṃ kuryāt, agnihotrākhyamapūrvaṃ kuryāt ityetayorarthavikalpayoḥ pradhānasyāgnihotraśabdasya tadarthasya ca tyāga āpadyate
ghṛtena juhuyāt ityādiṣu anuvādasaphalīkriyārtham agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityatra juhuyācchabdasya svaprakṛtyarthasya sārthakatve'gnihotraśabdaḥ paunaruktyānnirarthaka āpadyate
atha pradhānatvādagnihotrasya mā bhūdagnihotraśabdo nirarthaka iti juhuyācchabdo nirarthaka iṣyate tato juhuyācchabdanairarthakyāt prayogo nopapadyate vihitārthābhāve'nuvādatvābhāvāt
pradhānatvaṃ cāgnihotrasya sākṣāt svargādikāmyapuruṣārthasādhanatvena vidhānāt, juhotiprādhānye ca tadanupapattiḥ
