atra ca na tu ghaṭavadagnihotraśabdaḥ kāñcidapi kartavyatāṃ bravīti ityādiḥ sarvo granthaḥ pūrvottarapakṣaprasaṅgato yojyo yāvat nāpi ghaṭādikartavyatāyāmiva kācit kriyā prasiddhā yayāgnihotrākhyatā havanasyātidiśyeta havanākhyatā vāgnihotrasya iti havanaṃ kuryāt ityayamuktottaro'rthavikalpaḥ
apūrvārthapakṣe'pi agnihotraśabdasya juhuyācchabdasya caikārthatvāt pradhānāpūrvavācyagnihotraśabdasya tyāgastathaiva
viśeṣastu atha agnihotram ityapūrvaviśeṣābhidhānārthataiva kalpyate tathā sati apūrvābhidhānena ko'rtha ityādi yāvat tadanuṣṭhātavyam iti granthaśca yojyaḥ

agnihotrobhayakaraṇārthatayorapi juhotityāgādyāpatteḥ,agnihotraṃ kuryāt, agnihotraṃ havanaṃ kuryāt ityetayorapi vikalpayostulyottaratvāt, ubhayārthavikalpasya agnihotraṃ kuryāt, havanaṃ kuryāt ityetayoḥ pakṣayoruktadoṣaduṣṭatvāt samānottaratvāditi
atrāpi atha punarevamanirvahati ityādigrantho yojyaḥ saprapañco yāvat tvadabhiprāyavattu havanānuvādaviśiṣṭāgnihotrābhyupagame'pi cāgnihotrasyātmādivastutattvavadaprasiddhasvarūpatvāt karaṇāsiddhiḥ

śailīprasiddhau chidivadityādi, chidāviva cchidivat, yathā chidau dṛṣṭalaukikayūpamātraphalatvaṃ nādṛṣṭālaukikahavanātmakāgnihotratvaṃ tathā, agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityasyāpi tacchailyaivāgnihotramahavanātmakam, prāptipratipādyaprasiddhāvagnihotre juhotiprayogo dānādiprasiddhyuparodhena dāhana eva tāvadvidheya iti tathā'prasiddheravidhāyaka eva, kutastadanuvādaḥ ? tathābhūtārthābhyupagame ca prāptervyudāso juhotiprayogādapramattaprayuktatvāt, iṣe tvādivadakṣaravidyāvat
atra ca etadapi na vaiṣamyāt ityādigrantho yojyo yāvat śailīprāmāṇye cāsya śailyā yūpakriyā'yāthārthyāt iti

tataścānagnihotratvaprasaṅgād yadagnaye hotraṃ tadagnihotramiti tāvanmātrārthatvāt pradhānasya svargasādhanatābhimatasyānagnihotratvād ghṛtena juhuyāt ityanenānuvādena pradhānasvargakāmānabhisambaddhajuhotyarthānuvādena kiṃ prayojanam ? itikartavyatākartavyatayā pradhānena svargakāmena vinā kiṃ tayā ? yathoktam— kātarasateṇa sūraṃ sūrasahasseṇa paṃḍitaṃ bharasu
alasaṃ jeṇa va teṇa va ṇavara katagghaṃ pariharāhi
॰gnihotratvaṃ pratathāgnihotratvaṃ tathā pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
prāptipratipādyaprasiddhāvagnihotre juhotiprayogo dānādiprasiddhyuparodhena dāhana eva tāvadvidheya iti tathā'prasiddheravidhāyaka eva, kutastadanuvādaḥ ?
tathābhūtārthābhyupagame ca prāptervyudāso juhotiprayogādapramattaprayuktatvāt, iṣe tvādivadakṣaravidyāvat
alasaṃ jeṇa va teṇa va ṇavara katagghaṃ pariharāhi

prāptipratipādyaprasiddhāvagnihotre, prāptyā pratipādyā prasiddhirasya tadidaṃ prāptipratipādyaprasiddhi, tasmin prāptipratipādyaprasiddhau, kva ? agnihotre, yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti ityanayā prāptyā pratipādyaprasiddhau tu tasmin juhotiprayogo dānādiprasiddhyuparodhena dāhana eva tāvad vidheyaḥ, tāvacchabdaḥ kramārthe, juhoti ityayaṃ dhāturlokaprasiddhadānādanārtho na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? dahanenāgninā dāhayed ghṛtādi dravyam ityuktaṃ bhavati agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityetaditi paribhāvya paścāt prasiddhe dāhane ghṛtena juhuyāt, ghṛtaṃ dāhayedagnim, agninā ghṛtaṃ dāhayet, agnirghṛtaṃ dahet iti jñātārthamanūdya itikartavyatāvidhiryokṣyate lokaprasiddhivaiparītyena vyutpādanāt, nānyathā

anyathā tu loke dāhanādiṣvadṛṣṭatvāt kathaṃ dāhanamanūdya ghṛtādītikartavyatā vidhīyate ? iti tathā'prasiddheravidhāyaka eva, kutastadanuvādaḥ ? itiśabdo hetvarthe, ityetasmāt kāraṇāt tathā tena prakāreṇa dāhanārthatvenāprasiddheḥ agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityatraiva tāvajjuhuyācchabdo dāhanasyāvidhāyakaḥ, dūrata evānuvādaḥ
atraiva nanu sevādivat kartavyatāpratipattiritikartavyatābhyaḥ ityupakramya grantho yojyo yāvat vedavādāsādhutā vā tadvat iti

tathābhūtārthābhyupagame ceti, abhyupetyāpi dāhanātmakameva dānamiti doṣaṃ brūmaḥ, ko'sau ? prāptervyudāsaḥ, yeyaṃ prāptiḥ yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti iti yayā prāpitamagnau prakṣepo dānamiti tasyāḥ prāptervyudāsaḥ, kasmāt ? ghṛtena juhuyāt ityatra juhotiprayogāt, anyathā prāptau evaṃ tarhi prāptivākyavṛttajuhotyanuvāda iti cet, na, tatra vidhiliṅviṣayasyāvṛtterajñātatvāt

vyatyayādasya tadviṣayateti cet, na, ajñātatvādevānanuvādatvāt kośa- śrutena juhotinoktatvāt tadarthasya gatatvādaprayogārhatvāt paunaruktyamasya syāt, prayuktastu ayam, ato jñāyate prāptiśrutajuhotiranarthaka iti
yadā vāyaṃ ghṛtena juhuyāt iti prayujyate tadā hyayamagatārtha iti vijñāyeta yadyanyena śabdenāsyārtho'nabhihitaḥ syāt

kiṃ kāraṇam ? apramattaprayuktatvāt, apramattena hi vedena pramattāt puruṣādvilakṣaṇena rāgāvidyādiyogarahitena prayukto'yaṃ tvanmatena, laukikenaiva vā puruṣeṇāpramattena viduṣā prayuktatvādasmanmatena, mā bhūt sarvapuruṣāprāmāṇye śabdānāṃ ca puruṣādhīnopalabdhitvādaprāmāṇyameveti
ayaṃ hi ghṛtena juhuyāt ityatra juhotiśabdo'pramattaprayuktaḥ, na yena kenacid bālagopālādiprayuktakalpena tulyaḥ kākarutādikalpena vā tulyaḥ
ka iva ? iṣe tvādivat, yathā iṣe tvorje tvā vāyavaḥ sthopāyavaḥ stha devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇe yajurveda॰ 1
1 ityādiśabdā agatārthā iti vijñāyante tathāyaṃ ghṛtena juhuyāt iti vākye juhotirapramattaprayuktatvādagatārtha iti vijñāyeta, nānyathā
athavā akṣaravidyāvat, yathā dve vidye veditavye--parā cāparā ca
atha parā yayā tadakṣaramadhigamyate yat tadadṛśyamagrāhyamagotramavarṇamacakṣuḥśrotraṃ tadapāṇipādam
nityaṃ vibhuṃ sarvagataṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ viśvātmānaṃ tadavyayaṃ yad bhūtayoniṃ paripaśyanti dhīrāḥ muṇḍako॰ 1
1 itīyamakṣaravidyā kvacidagatārtheti vijñāyate'pramattaprayuktatvāt tathā'yamapi juhotiprayogaḥ, nānyathā
tadyadi prāptiprāpitadānārthaḥ agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityatra hotraśabdo juhotiśabdo vā tato'yaṃ ghṛtena juhuyāt iti punarjuhotirna prayujyeta, prayuktastu, tasmāt prāptirvyudasteti
evaṃ tarhi prāptivākyavṛttajuhotyanuvāda iti cet, na, tatra vidhiliṅviṣayasyāvṛtterajñātatvāt
vyatyayādasya tadviṣayateti cet, na, ajñātatvādevānanuvādatvāt kośa-
tadadreśyamagrāhyamagotramavarṇamacakṣuḥśrotraṃ tadapāṇipādaṃ nityaṃ vibhuṃ sarvagataṃ susūkṣmaṃ tadavyayaṃ yad iti muṇḍakopaniṣadi pāṭhaḥ
syānmatam--prāptivākye agnaye juhoti iti śrutasyāgnisampradānakasya dānārthasya juhoteranuvādo'yaṃ ghṛtena juhuyāt iti juhotiriti

naivamapyupapadyate, tatra prāptivākye juhoti ityasyāvyāpāryamāṇakartṛsādhanadānārthajuhotidhātuprayogasya vidhiliṅo viṣaye vyāpāraṇārthe vṛttyabhāvāt asya ca juhuyācchabdasya vidhiliṅviṣayasya niyogārthasya niyogarahite juhotiśabdārthe tatrāvṛtterayaṃ vidhānārtho na vidita eva, tasmādajñātatvāt prāptivākyavṛttajuhotyarthānuvādāyogyatā, prāptamanūdyate'prāptaṃ vidhīyate iti vacanāt

prāptivihitasvarūpasiddheragnihotrasya svargakāmakarmatvābhidhānādavagamitakāmānurūpakarmoktestadvidhakriyāviśeṣagateḥ kriyāprāpyatvācca kāmasya andhalakāvagamita- suptiṅupagrahaliṅganarāṇāṃ kālahalacsvarakartṛyaṅāṃ ca
vyatyayamicchati śāstrakṛdeṣāṃ tadapi ca sidhyati bāhulakena
etadapi na, ajñātatvādevānanuvādatvāt, savyāpāraṇārthaśabdadarśanānna nirvyāpāraṇārthapratipattiryuktā vyavasthālopaprasaṅgāt

idaṃ tvayā sannihitadevatākośapānena pratyāyyam, viśeṣaliṅgābhāvāt kuta eva jñāyate juhotyarthe juhuyācchabdaḥ prayukto na svārtha eva, juhotirvā juhuyādarthe prayukta iti ? tasmādaviditārthatvād vidhitvam, vidhitvācca nānuvādaḥ, ananuvādatvāccaivamapi na yuktam
abhyupetyāpi juhotyarthe juhuyācchabdasya vṛttiṃ doṣaṃ brūmaḥ --havanācca bhāvanamevamanavagamitamevābhipretasya syāt

vidhyarthābhāvāt puruṣo havanakarmaṇi aniyojita eva, tato bhāvanaṃ svargākhyasya viśiṣṭasukhalakṣaṇasya deśaviśeṣasya vā viśiṣṭasukhasādhanabhūtasyābhipretasyārthasya nāvabodhakaṃ syād yadarthamabhivṛttamidaṃ vākyam, svargākhyaphalasādhane'gnihotrakarmaṇi puruṣaṃ niyokṣyāmīti tadarthaṃ hi vākyam agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityetat pravṛttam, etenaiva karmaṇā svargo bhāvyate, tasmāt idaṃ kuru iti tadarthajñāpanābhāve kimanena vākyena juhoti juhoti ityuktena ?
vyatyayamicchati śāstrakṛdeṣāṃ tadapi ca sidhyati bāhulakena || pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 3 | 1 | 85
etaccihnāntargataḥ ॰rthapratipattiryuktā ityata ārabhya ॰pratyāyyā॰ ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu nāsti
atra evaṃ jñāyate ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atra ॰mītyetadarthaṃ hi iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīno bhāti

idaṃ tāvad vyavasthitaṃ yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti ityanayā prāptyā vihitamagnihotrasya svarūpaṃ siddham, ataḥ prāptivihitasvarūpasiddheragnihotrasya karmatvena ca śravaṇāt, kasya ? kartuḥ svargakāmasya karmatvābhidhānāt

tataḥ kimiti cet, svargaśabdābhihitaviśiṣṭakarmaviṣayakāmābhidhāyiśabdaśravaṇāt karmāpi tadagnihotrākhyaṃ tadanurūpaṃ viśiṣṭamevetyuktaṃ bhavati, ataḥ svargakāmakarmatvābhidhānādavagamitakāmānurūpakarmokteḥ svargakāmaśabdāvabodhitakāmānurūpasyaiva karmaṇa uktatvādeva tadvidhakriyāviśeṣagateḥ, viśiṣṭaphalaviṣayakāmaḥ puruṣaḥ kartā, karmāpi tadanurūpatvād viśiṣṭameva, tadvidhaiva kriyāpi, aprasiddhaphalaviṣayakāmasambandhi karmāprasiddhaṃ yathā tathā tadanuṣṭhānavyāpāraviśeṣo'pi viśiṣṭo'prasiddha eveti gamyate

kiṃ kāraṇam ? tata eva śabdāt tasya kriyāviśeṣasya gatervākyāntarābhāvāt tadviśeṣagatiḥ, ataḥ kriyāviśeṣagateḥ kriyāprāpyatvācca kāmasya, na hyanyaḥ kaści kāmaraṭanavat juhuyāt ityarthāpannārthānuvāda itīyaṃ vyākhyā nyāyyā ādivākye pradhānaśrutyatyāgaguṇakṛdapīti cet, tanna, arthāpannasvaśabdārthapunaruktatvādanuvādā- dupāyo'sti kāmaprāptau kriyātaḥ kriyayā śabdena vā tadarthāvagamanāt, yathā andhalakasya vīthīmadhyapatitasya hastaṃ prasārya kapardikāṃ kapardikāṃ dehi dehi bho iti vā rāraṭyamānasya kāmo'vagamitaḥ kriyayā śabdena vā prakaraṇaviśeṣasambandhāt, sā ca kriyā nopadeśamantareṇa sidhyati, andhalakāvagamitakāmaraṭanavat agnihotraṃ svargakāmaḥ ityukte kuryāt ityarthādāpanno vidhyartho'vagamitakāmatvāt, yathā tasyāndhalakasya yācñārthaḥ

sa ca viśeṣasambandho vākyanyāyena bhavati, yathā sabrahmacāriṇā sahādhīta iti samānena brahmacāriṇā sahādhīte, kena sāmānyena samānena ? prakṛtaviśeṣaṇatvāt prakṛtādhyayanakriyeṇeti gamyate evamidamapi vākyam, anena vākyanyāyena prakṛtasvargakāmāgnihotrakarmānurūpavidhyarthakriyopadeśatā'syeti gamyate, ato hetuhetumadbhāvapratipāditaṃ prāptivihitasvarūpasiddheragnihotrasyetyādi yāvajjuhuyādityarthāpannārthānuvādaḥ agnihotraṃ svargakāmaḥ ityetāvatā kuryādvākyaśeṣeṇa vākyena gatārthatvāt
kāmaraṭanavat juhuyāt ityarthāpannārthānuvāda itīyaṃ vyākhyā nyāyyā ādivākye pradhānaśrutyatyāgaguṇakṛdapīti cet, tanna, arthāpannasvaśabdārthapunaruktatvādanuvādā-

tadevaṃ juhuyāt ityanuvādo na vidhiritīyaṃ vyākhyā nyāyyā, vyaktārthopapattitvāt prāgabhihitavyākhyāvikalpasamutthadoṣābhāvācca nyāyyeti mantavyā, yasmādādivākye pradhānaśrutyatyāgaguṇakṛdapīti, yadabhihitaṃ prāk agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityasya vākyasya agnihotraṃ kuryāt ityarthavyākhyāvikalpe vidhyarthavācitvābhimataśrutapradhānajuhotyarthatyāgastataḥ puruṣapramāṇakatā, tadatyāge vākyabhedāpattiḥ paunaruktyādidoṣajātam, tadapyatra nāsti juhuyācchabdasyānuvādatvādeva, havanaṃ kuryāt ityatrāpyagnihotrapradhānatyāga ityādidoṣajātaṃ tadapi nāsti, tasmādiyaṃ vyākhyā ādivākye pradhānaśrutyatyāgaguṇakṛdapīti, tasya juhoteranuvādatvena paunaruktya-tyāga-bhedādyabhāvāt
cedityāśaṅkāyām, evaṃ cenmanyasa ityevaṃ paraṃ pṛṣṭvācārya uttaramāha --tanna, arthāpannetyādi
eṣāpi vyākhyā nopapadyate, kiṃ kāraṇam ? punaruktatvātapunaruktatvāt prayogāyogyatvam, tataścānuvādatvāsambhavaḥ, tasmādanuvādāsambhavāt tannetyabhisambandhaḥ
idaṃ ca punaruktamarthāpannasvaśabdārthaṃ punarvacanalakṣaṇe punarukte nigrahasthānavikalpe
dvividhaṃ punaruktaṃ nigrahasthānam, tadyathā— śabdārthayoḥ punarvacanaṃ punaruktam, arthādāpannasya svaśabdena punarvacanaṃ ca nyā॰ sū॰ 5
ghṛtena juhuyāt ityatra na syāt punaruktam, ghṛtaviśiṣṭahavanavidhānāt

iha tu svargakāmānurūpakarmānurūpakriyāviśeṣavidhyarthatāyā upadeśavṛttereva gatārthatayābhyupagatatvād ghṛtaviśiṣṭahavanavidhānajuhotyanuvādatāyāśca mūlavākyagatajuhotya sambhavāt sākṣācchrutavidhijuhuyāttyāgena cārthāpannārthāśrutānūditajuhuyātkalpanād vidhīyamānavākyārthaviṣayānuvadanācca vākyabhedapunaruktadoṣāṅgīkaraṇādanuvādānuvādasya ca prāptaviśeṣaṇaparārthaviṣayārthatvādvidhiviṣayaviprakṛṣṭībhūtārthatvāt
kasmāt ? sākṣācchrutavidhijuhuyāttyāgena cārthāpannārthāśrutānūditajuhuyātkalpanāt sa eva puruṣapramāṇakatvadoṣaḥ śabdāprāmāṇyadoṣaśca

juhuyāt ityasya kriyāśabdasya vidhyarthasya sākṣācchrutasya pratyakṣasya tyāgaṃ kṛtvā arthāpannārthasya arthādāpanno'rtho'syetyarthāpannārthaḥ, ko'sau ? sa eva juhuyācchabdo'nuvādābhimataḥ, tasya aśrutasyārthāpannārthasyānūditavikalpanādanuvādakalpanāt tanna iti vartate

kiñcānyat, vidhīyamānavākyārthaviṣayānuvadanācca, vidhīyamāno vākyārtho vidhīyamānavākyārthaḥ, sa viṣayo'syeti vidhīyamānavākyārthaviṣayaḥ sa eva juhuyācchabdaḥ, tasyaivānuvadanaṃ sa evānuvādaḥ, tasmād vidhīyamānavākyārthaviṣayānuvadanācca kiṃ saṃvṛttam ? vākyabhedasya punaruktasya cāṅgīkaraṇam, na hīdameva vākyaṃ svargakāmābhisambaddhāgnihotravidhānaṃ tadanuvadanaṃ ca kartuṃ śaknoti svargakāmakartṛkasyāgnihotrakarmaṇo vākyāntareṇāprāpitatvāt
yathā ayaṃ devadattaḥ ityatra na devadatta evānūdyate vidhīyate ca, pratyakṣasiddhastu idamo viṣayo'nūdyate, evamiha prasiddhārtho'pekṣyaḥ, sa tu nāsti

paunaruktyaṃ tu viśeṣavidhānābhāvāt, viśeṣavidhyartho hyanuvādo yuktaḥ, yathā ayaṃ devadattaḥ iti ayaṃśabdapratyakṣaprasiddhārthamanūdya devadattavidhānam, na tu tathātra kaścid viśeṣo vidhīyate, tasmādaviśeṣābhidhānāt paunaruktyam

tasmāt agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityasya vākyasya prathamatvādekavākyagatatvāccānayorvidhyanuvādayorarthāpannāgnihotrakarmavidhitve juhoteranuvādatve vā vākyabhedapunaruktadoṣāṅgīkaraṇād na ityevābhisambadhyate
evaṃ tāvat agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityatra juhuyācchabdo nānuvādo ghaṭate, na ca agnihotraṃ svargakāmaḥ iti vidhiḥ
anuvādatvaṃ hi prāptaviṣayārtham, yathā ayaṃ devadattaḥ iti ayaṃśabdārthaḥ prāptārtho'prāpto devadattārtho'dhunā prāpaṇīyaḥ
na tathā agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityatra prāptaviśeṣaṇaparārthaviṣayatvamagnihotraṃjuhuyācchabdayoḥ, ato'prāptāviśeṣaṇāparārthatvāt sāmyādanuvādatvābhāvaḥ
abhyupagamyāpi prāptādi doṣa ucyate--yat paścāducyate kartavyatāprasiddhyarthamiti- kartavyatāvākyaṃ ghṛtena juhuyāt iti tasya vidhiviṣayaviprakṛṣṭībhūtatvaṃ juhuyācchabdasyānuvādābhimatasya
ghaṭitavighaṭitapratisamādheye tatpratisamādhānārthamudyatena tvayā cikitsayaiva gaṇḍasyopari sphoṭa āpāditaḥ

laukikajuhotyarthānuṣṭhānapravṛttopadeśaviṣaya eva tvayaṃ paramanuvādaḥ syāt, sa cānupapannaniyamārtha upadeśaḥ prāptivihitetikartavyatānatiriktahavanakriyānāma- kiṃ kāraṇam ? prāptaviśeṣaṇaparārthaviṣayatvādanuvādasya aprāptaviśeṣyasvārthaviṣayatvādvidherādivākyagata eva tāvajjuhuyācchabdo'nuvādo na ghaṭate prāptatvādyabhāvāt, tasyānuvādastu ghṛtena juhuyāt ityatra juhuyācchabda iṣṭaḥ syāt tatpratirūpakastasyārthaḥ pratiśabdakasyevetyāpanno'prāptāviśeṣaṇāparārthatvād vidhiviṣayaviprakṛṣṭībhūtārthaśceti
kiñcānyat, iti ghaṭitavighaṭitetyādi yāvad gaṇḍasyopari sphoṭa āpāditaḥ

itiśabdo hetvarthe, yasmāditthaṃ kartavyaviṣayaviprakṛṣṭatvamitikartavyatāyāḥ ityādi doṣajātaṃ vidhyanuvādatvābhāvāt tasmād ghaṭitavighaṭitam, prāgīṣad ghaṭitamāsīt sevādivaditikartavyataiva kartavyatā iti, tadapyanayā prāptivihitasvarūpasiddheḥ ityādikayā kalpanayā vighaṭitamuktavidhinaiva

tataśca pratisamādheye tasminneva vākye'nuvādatvābhāvādavākyatvādidoṣaduṣṭe tatpratisamādhānārthamudyatena tvayā aho paramaviduṣā cikitsakenānapekṣitapūrvāparakriyāvidhivipākena cikitsayaiva gaṇḍasyopari sphoṭa āpāditaḥ
atra sa eva vānuvādaḥ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atra ayaṃśabdārthaḥ prāptaḥ, devadattārtho'dhunā prāpaṇīyaḥ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
ghaṭitavighaṭitapratisamādheye tatpratisamādhānārthamudyatena tvayā cikitsayaiva gaṇḍasyopari sphoṭa āpāditaḥ
laukikajuhotyarthānuṣṭhānapravṛttopadeśaviṣaya eva tvayaṃ paramanuvādaḥ syāt, sa cānupapannaniyamārtha upadeśaḥ prāptivihitetikartavyatānatiriktahavanakriyānāma-

yadi bhavato ghṛtena juhuyādityasyānuvādatvamiṣṭaṃ tato'hameva te buddhisaṃvibhāgaṃ karomi, śrūyatām— laukikajuhotyarthānuṣṭhānapravṛttopadeśaviṣaya eva tvayaṃ paramanuvādaḥ syāt, laukiko hi dānādanārtho juhotiḥ, tadarthānuṣṭhānapravṛttopadeśo yadyasya viṣayaḥ syād dadyāt, adyāt iti tadarthaprasiddhestadviṣayo'nuvādo yujyate vidhirvā
yasmai kasmaicidyadi kiñciddadyāt ghṛtaṃ dadyāt tena juhuyāt, yadi bhuñjīta ghṛtena juhuyādityetasminnarthe'nuvādo ghaṭate

sa cānupapannaniyamārtha upadeśaḥ, samīkṛtya vyākhyāto'rtho'sya śabdasya te mayā tathāpi tu punastvadiṣṭaviruddhārthametadāpadyate, loke'nupapannaniyamopadeśārthatvadarśanād vicitrayordānabhojanayoḥ svaparaprītihetutvād yathopapatti ghṛtena payasā dadhnā guḍena ca bhuñjīta tānyeva ca bubhukṣave dadyāditi
na tu yathā akṣivaidyake triphalāṃ ghṛtenaiva bhakṣayet, na guḍena, guḍasya cākṣuguḍasyācakṣuṣyatvāt
cakṣustejomayaṃ tasya viśeṣācchleṣmaṇo bhayam | carakasaṃ॰ 1 | 5 | 16 iti
tanmātratvāttu tasyāḥ prakaraṇānubandhanāddhitvā juhotiprayogabāhulyaṃ kṛñprakṛtiliṅkartṛtā pradarśayitavyā--yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti tad ghṛtādinā svargakāmaḥ kuryāditi
7 yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti mai॰ saṃ॰ 1
5 śūrpeṇa juhoti tena hyannaṃ kriyate tai॰ brā॰ 1

5 ityevamādividhyanuvādārthavādavākyagato juhotiḥ śrūyamāṇa upasthānādītikartavyatānatiriktasevanakriyānāmadheyamātrārthatvavat prāptivihitetikartavyatānatiriktahavanakriyānāmamātrārthaḥ, viprakīrṇāvayavakalāpā- kārā kriyaivāsyārtho'siddharūpaḥ, na siddharūpo yathā yūpaghaṭādi
tanmātratvāt tu tasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ prakaraṇānubandhanāt prakaraṇena anubandhayan vaktā brūte śrotā ca pratipadyate--kriyāmātramavaśyamanena śabdena kartavyamityetāvaccodyata iti

tasmāt kriyāmātratvāt prakaraṇānubandhanād hitvā tyaktvā juhotiprayogabāhulyaṃ sarvajuhotiprayogān, kriyāmātre pratipādye nāntarīyakatvāt kṛñprakṛtiliṅkartṛtā pradarśayitavyeti tatpratipādanārtham, abhimatavākyārthatāsya syādevaṃ kalpyamāne

tannidarśayati --yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti tad ghṛtādinā svargakāmaḥ kuryāditi, etāvatā tadarthasya sugamatvājjuhotiprayogabāhulyamapratyayaraṭitameva punaranyatrānyatra juhuyāt, juhoti ityādi
tat punaḥ sambhāvayāmi bhavedevam, mā maṃsthā niṣṭhuram apramāṇaniyamāgamo'nupadeśakaśca ityavadhāryaivocyata iti
ghaṭitavidhvaṃsanam itikartavyataiva kartavyatā iti ghaṭitasya ādivākyagatajuhotyanuvādābhyupagamād ghaṭitānumatavidhvaṃsanam

dṛṣṭānta unmattapralāpavat, yadvākyamunmattādipralapitaṃ puruṣoccāritaśabdasāmānyāt sadvākyavadābhāsamānamapramāṇaniyamamagamakaṃ ca, yathā— śaṅkhaḥ kadalyāṃ kadalī ca bheryāṃ tasyāṃ ca bheryāṃ sumahad vimānam
pralāpavat, pratyavekṣāprāmāṇyayorjñānaviṣayatvāt, tvanmatāttu vedo na jñānaṃ tato'pramāṇaniyamo'nupadeśakaśca, acetanatvāt, ākāśavat
yadapi ca prasahya kāraṇeṣu phalasya khapuṣpavadasattvamucyate evaṃvidheṣvekāntena tadapi cānyāyyameva
yadetadasattvaṃ nāma tvayā kvacinmanyate tato'nyat kāryam, iti, tathedamapi vivekturapyarthapratipādanasamarthaṃ na bhavatīti
evaṃ vicāryamāṇamidaṃ vākyaṃ doṣebhyo na mucyate

athavā naivāyaṃ doṣo na ca vicārayogyo'yamudvrāhaḥ pratyavekṣāprāmāṇyayorjñānaviṣayatvāt, jñānaṃ hi pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ veti vicāryate pratyavekṣyate ca tatra prāmāṇyasya mukhyatvāt, na hyatra kudupādiprāmāṇyavat prāmāṇyamaṅgīkriyate
tasmāt pratyavekṣāyāḥ prāmāṇyasya ca jñānaviṣayatvāt tvanmatādeva vedasyājñānābhimatatvānna vicāro na pramāṇabhāvo vāsti ajñānatvādvedasya
tvayā hi prāgevotpatatoktam--na hi kiñcijjñānaṃ niścitaṃ viśuddhaṃ cāsti sarvasya saṃśayādyajñānānuviddhatvāditi
taddarśayannāha --tvanmatāttu vedo na jñānaṃ na jñānata iti, na yathā jñānakāryatvājjñānātmātmaprayuktaśabdacaitanyamapi kārye kāraṇopacārādannakāryaprāṇānnatvavaditi vā
tataḥ kimiti cet, apramāṇaniyamo'nupadeśakaśca vedaḥ, acetanatvāt, ākāśavat
yathā ākāśamacetanatvādapramāṇaṃ kūṭasthanityatvācca na jñānavadvacanamevaṃ vedo'pīti prāmāṇyopadeśābhāvaḥ
śaṅkhaḥ kadalyāṃ kadalī ca bheryāṃ tasyāṃ ca bheryāṃ sumahad vimānam
pralāpavat, pratyavekṣāprāmāṇyayorjñānaviṣayatvāt, tvanmatāttu vedo na jñānaṃ tato'pramāṇaniyamo'nupadeśakaśca, acetanatvāt, ākāśavat
yadapi ca prasahya kāraṇeṣu phalasya khapuṣpavadasattvamucyate evaṃvidheṣvekāntena tadapi cānyāyyameva
yadetadasattvaṃ nāma tvayā kvacinmanyate tato'nyat kāryam,
tvanmatāttavedo na jñānanna jñānava iti na'va itibhā॰
tvanmatāttado na jñānanna jñānava iti ya॰

prasahya balātkāreṇa paraṃ kañcit puruṣamagaṇayatā ekavīraṃmanyenākramya paribhūyāsmanmataṃ yadapi ca agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityatra kāraṇeṣu ghṛtādiṣvitikartavyatātmasu svargādiphalasya khapuṣpavadasattvamucyate evaṃvidheṣviti sarvetikartavyatānāmādimadhyāvasāneṣu, tat punarasattvamekāntena kathañcit kāryādisattvamapi ityetatpakṣanirapekṣaṃ sarvathā nāstyeva iti tvayeṣṭaṃ tadapi cānyāyyameva
yato yadetadasattvaṃ nāma tvayā kvacinmanyate, nāmeti mithyākalpitanāmamātrameva tad yat tvayā kvacit sattvanirapekṣamasaditi cintyate
kathaṃ punaranyāyyaṃ tadasattvamiti cet, ucyate, nyāyena bādhyatvāt
katamo nyāya iti cet, evaṃ tarhi brūmaḥ --tato'nyat kāryam, asato'nyadityarthaḥ
kutaḥ ? tadasamarthavikalpatvāt, asaṅgatārtho'samartho'sambaddho vikalpaḥ, tenāsatā sahāsambaddho vikalpo'syeti tadasamarthavikalpaṃ kāryam, tasya kāryasyāsamarthavikalpatvāt tato'nyatvam

kimiva ? ghaṭapaṭavat, yathā ghaṭavikalpāḥ pṛthubudhnordhvagrīvādayo mṛducaturasrādibhiḥ paṭavikalpairasaṅgatāḥ paṭavikalpāśca tairityanyau ghaṭapaṭau parasparata evamasadvikalpairasaṅgataṃ kāryaṃ tasmāt tato'nyaditi
caturṣu vikalpeṣu kāryakhapuṣpayorubhayorasattvaṃ kāryāsattvameva vetyetad vikalpadvayaṃ syāt, ubhayasattvakāryasattvayoḥ pratipakṣābhyupagama eveti vādābhāvāt
tadyadi tāvadubhayāsattvaṃ tato'sattvāviśeṣādevāviśeṣe kāryāvirbhāvavat khapuṣpāvirbhāvo'pyāyatyāṃ syādasatkāryavat
atha na kāryaprādurbhāvavat khapuṣpaprādurbhāvo'sacca kāryamiti niścitam, tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhyasat khapuṣpam, sadasadvilakṣaṇatvād ghaṭavat, itara udumbarapuṣpavat
nanu ghaṭāsattvaṃ paṭāsattvavilakṣaṇam, na, sato vailakṣaṇyāt
syānmatam--asadvikalpāsaṅgatatvaṃ kāryasyāsiddham, tanna, siddhameva, yasmād vikalpāsāmarthyaṃ cāsatkāryayorasataḥ kāryasya ca siddhameveti gṛhāṇa, vikalpacatuṣṭaye dvayoreva sambhavāt

asat khapuṣpam, kāryamaṅkurādi, tayorvikalpāścatvāraḥ--1 khapuṣpamasat kāryamapyasat, 2 khapuṣpaṃ sat kāryamasat, 3 khapuṣpamasat kāryaṃ sat, 4 khapuṣpaṃ sat kāryamapi sat, ityeṣu caturṣu vikalpeṣu kāryakhapuṣpayorubhayorasattvaṃ kāryāsattvameva vetyetadvikalpadvayaṃ syāt sambhavet

kiṃ kāraṇam ? ubhayasattvakāryasattvayoḥ pratipakṣābhyupagama eva, satkāryavādaḥ pratipakṣo'satkāryavādasya, itiśabdo hetvarthe, ityasmāddhetorvādābhāvaḥ, tasmād vādābhāvādubhayābhāvakāryābhāvavikalpāveva sambhavetām, netarau

tataśca tayorubhayāsattvakāryāsattvavikalpayostad yadi tāvadubhayāsattvaṃ tato'sattvāviśeṣādevāviśeṣaḥ khapuṣpakāryayoḥ, asattvāviśeṣādevāviśeṣe kāryāvirbhāvavat khapuṣpāvirbhāvo'pyāyatyāṃ syāt, eṣyati kālāntare'smād vartamānāt kṣaṇādanyasmin kṣaṇe bhavet
athaitasmādaniṣṭāpattidoṣād dṛṣṭeṣṭavirodhādapasarpan brūyāstvam --na kāryaprādurbhāvavat khapuṣpaprādurbhāva iṣyate, asacca kāryamiti niścitam
tataḥ ko doṣa iti cet, ucyate --tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhyasat khapuṣpam, asatkāryavailakṣaṇyānnedānīmasat khapuṣpam, kintu saditi prāptam

asatkāryavailakṣaṇyaṃ khapuṣpasyāyatyāmaprādurbhāvaḥ, tasmādasatkāryavailakṣaṇyādāyatyāmaprādurbhāvānna tarhyasat khapuṣpam, kiṃ tarhi ? sat, ko hetuḥ ? asadvilakṣaṇatvāt, asatā kāryeṇa saha vilakṣaṇatvāt
dṛṣṭānto ghaṭavat, yathā ghaṭo'sadvilakṣaṇatvāt sannevaṃ kharaviṣāṇamapyāyatyāṃ prādurbhavatā kāryeṇa vailakṣaṇyāt sat prasaktam
itara udumbarapuṣpavat, itara iti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ, yadasat tadasadvilakṣaṇaṃ na bhavati yathodumbarakusumamiti parasyāniṣṭāpādanārthatvādasadvaidharmyaṃ khapuṣpasyeti
syānmatam--ghaṭasyā athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye khapuṣpāsattvaniścayo na nivartate'prādurbhāvātmakaṃ ca tat, na tarhi prādurbhāvātmakatvāt kāryamasad nirvṛttaghaṭavat
asattva āyatyāṃ na prādurbhavet, asattvāt, khapuṣpavat

sattvaṃ paṭātmanā, paṭāsattvaṃ ghaṭātmaneti tayoritaretarābhāvalakṣaṇāsattvaṃ vailakṣaṇyaṃ ca parasparato dṛṣṭam, tau ca ghaṭapaṭau santau, tasmādasadvailakṣaṇyasya satyapi darśanādanaikāntikateti cet, ucyate --na, sato vailakṣaṇyāt
sata eva vailakṣaṇyam, taddhītaretarābhāvātmakaṃ vailakṣaṇyaṃ sata eva, nāsataḥ
tasmādasato vailakṣaṇyaṃ na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? sadvailakṣaṇyamapi tat sata evetarāpekṣayā tadrūpeṇāsattvāt
ayaṃ tu kāryasyāyatyāṃ prādurbhāvo'satā khapuṣpeṇātyantavilakṣaṇo'prādurbhāvaśca khapuṣpasya kāryeṇāsateti nāsti sato vailakṣaṇyaṃ satā tadviśeṣadharmatvād rūpādiviśeṣadharmāvailakṣaṇyavat
satastu ghaṭādeḥ paṭādinā saha vailakṣaṇyaṃ nāstyeva, sattvānvayāviśeṣād deśakālākārādimātraviśeṣasyāviśeṣatvāt, aṅgulyādiviśiṣṭākāśāviśeṣavat
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye khapuṣpāsattvaniścayo na nivartate'prādurbhāvātmakaṃ ca tat, na tarhi prādurbhāvātmakatvāt kāryamasad nirvṛttaghaṭavat
asattva āyatyāṃ na prādurbhavet, asattvāt, khapuṣpavat
sacca dvividham--tulyajātīyaṃ ghaṭasya ghaṭa eva, atulyajātīyaṃ paṭādi

khapuṣpamatyantāprādurbhāvāt kāryeṇāsatā vilakṣaṇaṃ satā ca ghaṭapaṭādinā tvanmatena itaretarābhāvavailakṣaṇyena tulyajātīyena atulyajātīyena ca bhāvānāṃ parasparavailakṣaṇyavad, dṛṣṭānto ghaṭavaditi, yathā ghaṭastulyajātīyebhyo ghaṭāntarebhyo'tulyajātīyebhyaśca paṭādibhyaḥ sadbhyo vilakṣaṇo'sataśca khapuṣpādeḥ saṃśca dṛṣṭastathā khapuṣpaṃ ghaṭavat sadasadvilakṣaṇatvānnāsat, sadevetyarthaḥ, dviḥ pratiṣedhaḥ prakṛtiṃ gamayatīti kṛtvā
itara udumbarapuṣpavat, yadasat tanna sadasadvilakṣaṇam, yathodumbarapuṣpam

astu tadā sadvilakṣaṇatvamitaretarābhāvāpekṣatvāt, kathamasadvilakṣaṇaṃ khapuṣpamiti cet, āyatyāṃ prādurbhavatā kāryeṇāsatā vailakṣaṇyasya tvayaivābhyupagatatvāt tvanmatanivāraṇārthatvādasya prayāsasya nāsmākaṃ doṣa iti
atulyajātīyena iti pāṭho yadyapi kutrāpi pratiṣu nāsti tathāpyāvaśyaka iti bhāti
॰ṇyavaca dṛṣṭāṃto pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
atra sādhyānta pātitvāt ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

atha te prādurbhāvāprādurbhāvavailakṣaṇye satyapi kāryakhapuṣpayoḥ asadeva khapuṣpam ityayaṃ niścayaḥ asadvailakṣaṇyād ghaṭavat sad bhavatu ityasmānnyāyānnivartyamāno'pi na nivartate, aprādurbhāvātmakaṃ ca tat khapuṣpam ityetacca vailakṣaṇyamiṣyata eva, prāduḥ prākāśye janmani ca, tathā''viḥ ataḥ kāryaṃ sat, āvirbhāvātmakatvāt, nirvṛttaghaṭavat; vaidharmyeṇa ākāśaghaṭavat
asacca khapuṣpam, anāvirbhāvātmakatvāt, khaghaṭavat; vaidharmyeṇa nirvṛttaghaṭavat

tulye vā'sattve viśeṣo vaktavyaḥ, aviśeṣe vailakṣaṇyānupapatterghaṭaghaṭasvātma- , prādurbhavati prakāśaṃ bhavati gṛhyate jñāyate utpadyate jāyata iti vā, tathāvirbhavatīti, evaṃ cāprādurbhāvātmakasya khapuṣpasyāsattve'rthādāpannam --na tarhi prādurbhāvātmakatvāt kāryamasat, sadevetyarthaḥ
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? nirvṛttaghaṭavat, yathā nirvṛtto ghaṭaḥ prādurbhāvātmakatvāt prakāśātmakatvāt sanneva tathā kāryamapi sat
asyāścārthāpatteraikāntikatvānna jātyuttaratā, yathā gehe devadattasyābhāve sthitimato bahirbhāvānumānamarthāpannamaikāntikatvānna jātivādaḥ
asmākaṃ tvatrābhiprāyaḥ--sadeva kadācidupalabhyate jāyate vā nātyantāsaditi, darśanādarśane ca sadviṣaye nātyantāsadviṣaye ityetaduttaratra darśayiṣyāmo vicārasyāsya tatphalatvāt
athaivamapi tvayā kāryasya sattvaṃ neṣyate tato'sattve kāryasyāyatyāṃ na prādurbhavet kāryamasattvāt khapuṣpavat, prādurbhavati tu, tasmāt sat
tadyathā--atha na khapuṣpāprādurbhāvavat kāryāprādurbhāvo'sacca kāryamiti niścitam, na tarhyasat kāryam, sadeva tat, asadvilakṣaṇatvād ghaṭavat, itara udumbarapuṣpavat
nanu ghaṭāsattvaṃ paṭāsattvavilakṣaṇam, na, sato vailakṣaṇyāt
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāryāsattvaviniścayo na nivartate prādurbhāvātmakaṃ ca tat, na tarhi prādurbhāvātmakatvādasat kāryaṃ nirvṛttaghaṭavat, asattve āyatyāṃ na prādurbhavedasattvāt khapuṣpavaditi
ataḥ kāryaṃ sat, āvirbhāvātmakatvāt, nirvṛttaghaṭavat; vaidharmyeṇa ākāśaghaṭavat
asacca khapuṣpam, anāvirbhāvātmakatvāt, khaghaṭavat; vaidharmyeṇa nirvṛttaghaṭavat
tulye vā'sattve viśeṣo vaktavyaḥ, aviśeṣe vailakṣaṇyānupapatterghaṭaghaṭasvātma-

tadupasaṃhārārthamāha --ataḥ kāryaṃ sat, āvirbhāvātmakatvāt, nirvṛttaghaṭavat; vaidharmyeṇa ākāśaghaṭavat, ākāśamevākāśasyākāśe vā ghaṭa ākāśaghaṭaḥ, sa tvanāvirbhāvātmakatvānnāsti, na tathā kāryamanāvirbhāvātmakam, tasmāt tat saditi
asacca khapuṣpam, anāvirbhāvātmakatvāt, khaghaṭavat; vaidharmyeṇa nirvṛttaghaṭavaditi tayoḥ sadasatoḥ kāryakhapuṣpayorvailakṣaṇyaṃ darśayati
yadi bhavanmatena kāryakhapuṣpayorasattvameva tulyaṃ tulye vā'sattve viśeṣo vaktavyaḥ--asmād viśeṣahetoḥ kāryamasattve satyapi prādurbhavati na tu khapuṣpamiti
aviśeṣe ca vailakṣaṇyānupapattiḥ khapuṣpakharaviṣāṇayorivāsatoḥ, dṛṣṭaṃ ca vailakṣaṇyamāyatyāṃ prādurbhāvāprādurbhāvābhyām, tattu aviśeṣe tayornopapadyate
tasmāddhetoraviśeṣe vailakṣaṇyānupapatterghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat, yathā ghaṭa eva ghaṭasvātmeti tayorna vailakṣaṇyamaviśiṣṭatvādevamaviśeṣaḥ syāt, na tu bhavati dṛṣṭatvāduktatvāccāvirbhāvānāvirbhāvayoḥ
viśeṣonnayane'pi tu viśeṣasya sadāśrayatvāt sattvaṃ ghaṭavaditi sāmānyameva
athaitat sāmyamubhayāsattvānmā bhūdityanyatarāsattvaṃ kāryasattvābhyupagamaparihāreṇa kāryamevāsaditi, atra kāryasamīpa evakāra ityanyatra pratiyoginyasattve niyamaḥ--asattvaṃ kārye eva nānyatrāpīti
tathā ca sato- yasmāccaturvidho'sanniṣyate prākpradhvaṃsetaretarātyantābhāvākhyo ghaṭasya mṛtpiṇḍādikapālādipaṭādikharaviṣāṇādivaditi
atrocyate --viśeṣonnayane'pi tu viśeṣasya sadāśrayatvāt sattvaṃ ghaṭavaditi

apiśabdo'nabhyupagamaṃ darśayati, naivābhāvasya kharaviṣāṇavandhyāsutādeḥ parasparato viśeṣo'styavastutvāt tvanmatenaiva, asmanmatena tu vastutvamabhāvasyāpi kasyacit prameyatvasāmānyaviśeṣavattvādihetubhyastvadabhyupagatebhyaḥ pramāṇavat
abhyupetyāpi brūmaḥ--viśeṣonnayane'pi tu yena kenacit prakāreṇa sadāśrayo'sāvabhāvastvatparikalpitaścaturvidho'pi viśeṣatvād rūpādivad ghaṭavat
tataśca viśeṣasya sadāśrayatvāt sattvaṃ ghaṭavat, yathā ghaṭaḥ santaṃ pṛthivyādyarthamāśritya vartamānaḥ sanneva svameva vātmānamāśritya vṛtteḥ sannevaṃ viśeṣo'pi sadāśrayatvāt sanniti
itiśabdo hetudṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikopasaṃhāre, itthaṃ bhāvābhāvayoḥ sāmānyameva, na viśeṣa iti
viśeṣonnayane'pi tu viśeṣasya sadāśrayatvāt sattvaṃ ghaṭavaditi sāmānyameva
athaitat sāmyamubhayāsattvānmā bhūdityanyatarāsattvaṃ kāryasattvābhyupagamaparihāreṇa kāryamevāsaditi, atra kāryasamīpa evakāra ityanyatra pratiyoginyasattve niyamaḥ--asattvaṃ kārye eva nānyatrāpīti

athaitadāpāditaṃ sāmānyamanicchatā kāryasattvaparihāreṇa ubhayāsattvābhyupagamādāyātamidamanyatarāsattvaṃ kāryasattvaparihāreṇābhyupagamyate pratipakṣavādādanyat pūrvoktadvayānyataraviśiṣṭam, kiṃ tat ? kāryamevāsaditi, avaśyaṃ dvayoranyatarābhyupagame'vadhāraṇamāpadyate, taccāvadhāraṇaṃ yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇam iti paribhāṣitatvācchāstreṣu loke ca dṛṣṭatvādavadhāraṇaphalatvācca vākyasyaitadupapadyate --kāryasamīpa evakāra iti kāryamevāsat iti kāryaśabdasamīpa evakāraprayogāt, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt, anyatra pratiyogini asattve niyamaḥ, asacchabdavācye'rthe khapuṣpādau niyamastatra evakārābhāvāt, na kāryaśabdārthe

yathā vṛkṣaścūta ityatra cūto niyamādvṛkṣaḥ, vṛkṣastu cūto'nyo vā syādityaniyamaḥ, tathehāpi kāryamevāsat, na khapuṣpādyakāryamasat, kiṃ tarhi ? sat, na tu asadeva kāryam iti niyamyate, yadi sadapi kāryaṃ syādastu, ko doṣaḥ ? iti taddarśayati— asattvaṃ kārya eva, nānyatrāpītyakārye khapuṣpādāviti

evaṃ sati ko doṣa iti cet, ucyate --tataśca na khapuṣpamasaditi prasaktaṃ dṛṣṭeṣṭaviruddhaṃ sattvaṃ khapuṣpasyetyarthaḥ 'saditi asataśca saditi saṃjñā kriyate, kāryāsattvaṃ kharaviṣāṇaviparītaghaṭādīnāmasattvena tulyam, nāmamātre visaṃvādaḥ
athocyeta--asattvādeva tayoḥ kāraṇakāle na kaścid viśeṣo'sti, yadeva tathā cetyādi yāvad nāmamātre visaṃvādaḥ
evaṃ ca kṛtvā kāryamasat kharaviṣāṇaṃ saditi saṅgītyā sato'saditi asataśca saditi saṃjñā kriyate

kāryāsattvamiti tataḥ kharaviṣāṇaviparītā ye nirvṛttā ghaṭādayasteṣāṃ ghaṭādīnāmasattvena tulyam, kāryasyāsattvaṃ satāmevāsattvena tulyaṃ viparītaṃ nāmamātramagnermaṅgalanāmavat, na cātra kaścidarthasya sattve visaṃvādo'sat kāryamiti
kāryasattvanivṛttiḥ kāryāsattvam, tadavadhāraṇamekāntaḥ, kāryamevāsaditi tasya tyāgo'nantaroktavidhinā prāptaḥ, tataśca kāryasattvanivṛttyekāntatyāgācca svavacanādivirodhāpattiḥ
svavacanavirodhastāvat tadeva kāryamasadityuktvā tasyaivakārasāmarthyāt sattvāpādanāt tadeva sat tadevāsaditi bruvataḥ
athavā yadi kāryaṃ kathamasat ? athāsat kathaṃ kāryam ? kriyate ghaṭo ghaṭatayā vyajyate dīpeneva kriyayeti vakṣyati
evaṃ tāvat kāryamevāsat, na khapuṣpādi ityavadhāraṇadoṣaḥ
atra atha kāryasattvaparihāreṇa ubhayāsattvābhyupagamādāyātametadāpāditaṃ sāmānyamanicchatā ityanvayavivakṣāyām ubhayāsattvābhyupagamāt iti ya॰ pratipāṭhaḥ sādhureva

kāryasattvaparihāreṇa ubhayāsattvābhyupagamādāyātamidamanyatarāsattvaṃ kāryasattvaparihāreṇa ityanvayavivakṣāyāṃ tu ubhayāsattvānabhyupagabhāt ityeva pāṭho'tra kalpanīyaḥ, sa eva ca śuddha iti dhyeyam
'saditi asataśca saditi saṃjñā kriyate, kāryāsattvaṃ kharaviṣāṇaviparītaghaṭādīnāmasattvena tulyam, nāmamātre visaṃvādaḥ
athocyeta--asattvādeva tayoḥ kāraṇakāle na kaścid viśeṣo'sti, yadeva
kāryamevāsat, na kāraṇam ityasyāvadhāraṇasya pratipakṣavādāpatterathaivamavadhāryate kāryamasadeva iti

tatrāpi yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamityasatsamīpa evakārāt kāryamasattvenāvadhāryate kāryaṃ niyamādasat, asattu kāryaṃ vā syāt khapuṣpādi vā ityevamasadevakāre tvasadanavadhṛteḥ pūrvo doṣo yo'sattvāviśeṣādityādiḥ sa eva, kāryakhapuṣpayorasattve āyatyāmāvirbhāvānāvirbhāvakṛto viśeṣo na syādityaviśeṣāpattidoṣaḥ prāguktaḥ sa evātrāpi

aviśeṣāpattidoṣasya ca parihārārthamathocyate tvayeti paramatamāśaṅkate, katham, asattvādeva tayoḥ kāryakhapuṣpayoḥ kāraṇakāle viśeṣāsambhavaḥ, yathā khapuṣpamasat tathā kāraṇakāle kāryamapyasadeveti nānayoḥ kaścid viśeṣo'sti, na hyasato nirupākhyasya khapuṣpasya vṛntaphalakesarādyavayavasaurabhādiviśeṣāḥ kharaviṣāṇakuṇṭhatīkṣṇatvādibhyo bhinnalakṣaṇāḥ santyubhayeṣāmavastutvānnirupākhyatvāccetyasmā kāryāsattvaṃ tadeva khapuṣpāsattvamapīti nāvadhāraṇakṛto doṣo nāpi pūrvastulyatvāpattidoṣaḥ, anekaviṣayatvāttulyatvasya
yathaiva hi khapuṣpamanupādānamabuddhisiddhaṃ niḥsāmānyaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ ca evaṃ kāryasyopādānaṃ buddhisiddhatvaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavattvaṃ ca na syāt

atha sāmānyaviśeṣopādānabuddhisiddhatvasadbhāvāsadbhāvau kāryakhapuṣpayoriṣyete khapuṣpavadabhavadapi tadasadeva, nirvṛttamapi tarhyasat sāmānyaviśeṣavattvāt kāraṇa- daviśeṣāt kāraṇakāle yadeva kāryāsattvaṃ tadeva khapuṣpāsattvamapīti
tataḥ kiṃ parihṛtamiti cet, nāvadhāraṇakṛto doṣa ityavadhāraṇadoṣaḥ parihṛto bhavati
kāryamevāsat, asadeva kāryam ityavadhāryamāṇe khapuṣpasattvaṃ kāryakhapuṣpayoraviśeṣa ityetau doṣau tayoraviśeṣābhyupagamānna sta iti
asyāpi tulyatvāpattidoṣasyābhāvo'sato viśeṣābhāvādanekaviṣayatvāt tulyatvasya, ayamanenābhyāmebhirimāvime vārthāstulyāḥ iti hi tulyatvamanekaviṣayaṃ dṛṣṭam, na hi tadeva tena tulyamiti
kāryāsattvaṃ tadeva khapuṣpāsattvamapīti nāvadhāraṇakṛto doṣo nāpi pūrvastulyatvāpattidoṣaḥ, anekaviṣayatvāttulyatvasya
yathaiva hi khapuṣpamanupādānamabuddhisiddhaṃ niḥsāmānyaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ ca evaṃ kāryasyopādānaṃ buddhisiddhatvaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavattvaṃ ca na syāt
atha sāmānyaviśeṣopādānabuddhisiddhatvasadbhāvāsadbhāvau kāryakhapuṣpayoriṣyete khapuṣpavadabhavadapi tadasadeva, nirvṛttamapi tarhyasat sāmānyaviśeṣavattvāt kāraṇa-
atrocyate --evamapyekatvād viśeṣābhāva iti, tvayaiva kāryakhapuṣpayorasattvāviśeṣo'bhyupagata ekarūpatvādavastuna iti tadavastha evāviśeṣadoṣaḥ

yathaiva khapuṣpasyopādānaṃ pūrvadṛṣṭaśrutānubhūtaṃ buddhau siddhaṃ vākārādiviśiṣṭatvaṃ nāstītyanupādānamabuddhisiddhaṃ ca khapuṣpam, tataḥ kim ? anupādānābuddhisiddhatvābhyāṃ tad niḥsāmānyaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ ceti siddhamevaṃ ghaṭādeḥ kāryasya mṛdādyupādānaṃ buddhisiddhatvaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavattvaṃ ca na syāt, tacca mṛda eva yenākāreṇa bhavanaṃ deśakālanavapurāṇakṛṣṇaraktatvādighaṭabhede'pi tulyatayā sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaśca paṭādibhyaḥ
atra tacca khapuṣpasyopādānaṃ buddhisiddhatvaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavattvaṃ ca syāt ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atha sāmānyaviśeṣopādānabuddhisiddhatvasadbhāvāsadbhāvau kāryakhapuṣpayoriṣyete tvayā viśeṣau, khapuṣpavadabhavadapi tadasadeva

khapuṣpavaditi yena prakāreṇa khapuṣpaṃ na bhavati notpadyate tena prakāreṇābhavadapi anyathā bhavadapi utpadyamānaṃ kadāciddṛśyamānamapītyarthaḥ, upādānabuddhisiddhatvasāmānyaviśeṣavattvaprakāreṇa bhavadapi tat kāryamasadeveṣyate, tataścaivaṃ sati ayamaparo doṣaḥ --nirvṛttamapi tarhyasat kāryam iti vartate, sopādānabuddhisiddhatvasadbhāve'pi
kasmāt ? sāmānyaviśeṣavattvāt kāraṇakālakāryavat, yathā kāraṇakāle kāryamasat tvanmatena sāmānyaviśeṣavadapi sopādānaṃ buddhisiddhamapi tathottara kālakāryavat
kāryavaccābhavadapi khapuṣpamasanna syād niḥsāmānyanirviśeṣatvāt sāmānyaviśeṣavat, kāryāsattvavailakṣaṇyādvā kāraṇavat
atha na kāryopādānādimattvavat khapuṣpasyāpyupādānādimattvamasacca kāryamiti niścitamityādi pūrvavaccakrakadvayapravartanam

kāryavaccābhavadapi khapuṣpamasanna syāt, kāryaprādurbhāvaprakāreṇābhavadapi tasminnabhavanaprakāraviśeṣe satyapi sat prāpnoti khapuṣpaṃ niḥsāmānyanirviśeṣatvāt, taddhi khapuṣpaṃ niḥsāmānyaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ ceti siddham, atastasya niḥsāmānyanirviśeṣatvāt sattvaṃ syāt
kāryavaditi siddhe vaiśeṣikamatālambanena sāmānyaviśeṣadṛṣṭānto niḥsāmānyanirviśeṣāṇāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāṃ vastutvaṃ khapuṣpatulyameveti kākvā darśitaṃ bhavati
prakṛtārthopanayastu yathā sāmānyaviśeṣo ghaṭatvādirniḥsāmānyo nirviśeṣaśca saṃśceti siddhastathā khapuṣpamapi sat syāt
kiñcānyat, kāryāsattvavailakṣaṇyādvā kāraṇavat asanna syāt khapuṣpam iti vartate
kāryasya ghaṭāderasattvena khapuṣpasyāprādurbhāvānupādānābuddhisiddhatvaniḥsāmānyaviśeṣatvavailakṣaṇyāt khapuṣpamapi sat syāt kāraṇavat
etaiśca prakāraiḥ siddhameva kāryāsattvavailakṣaṇyamiti siddho hetuḥ
nirvṛttatvādiprakāreṇa ca kāraṇasya tadvailakṣaṇyaṃ siddhamiti sādharmyaṃ kāraṇakhapuṣpayoḥ
kāraṇaṃ vā khapuṣpavat kāryāsattvavailakṣaṇyādasat syāt kāryasyāsattvaṃ vā tyājyamityabhiprāyaḥ
kāryavaccābhavadapi khapuṣpamasanna syād niḥsāmānyanirviśeṣatvāt sāmānyaviśeṣavat, kāryāsattvavailakṣaṇyādvā kāraṇavat
atha na kāryopādānādimattvavat khapuṣpasyāpyupādānādimattvamasacca kāryamiti niścitamityādi pūrvavaccakrakadvayapravartanam

atha bhavatā khapuṣpasattvaprasaṅgadoṣabhayād yuktapratipādanamapi kāryopādānādimattvavat khapuṣpasyāpyupādānādimattvaṃ neṣyate, ādigrahaṇād buddhisiddhasāmānyaviśeṣavattvāni neṣyante, idaṃ kāryasyāsādharmyaṃ khapuṣpeṇa saheṣyate, asacca kāryamiti niścitamityādi pūrvavaccakrakadvayapravartanamiti granthamatidiśati tameva

kathaṃ punarbhāvyate, yadi kāryopādānādimattvavat khapuṣpasyopādānādimattvaṃ neṣyate kāryaṃ cāsaditi niścitam, tadvailakṣaṇyādanupādānādivailakṣaṇyād na tarhyasat khapuṣpam, sadasadvilakṣaṇatvād ghaṭavat, itara udumbarapuṣpavat
nanu ghaṭāsattvaṃ paṭāsattvavilakṣaṇam, na, sato vailakṣaṇyāt
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye khapuṣpāsattvaviniścayo na nivartate'nupādānādimattvāt, na tarhyupādānādimattvāt kāryamasat, asattve nopādānādimat syāt khapuṣpavat, etadaviparyayacakrakam
ataḥ sat kāryamu- pādānādimattvād nirvṛttaghaṭavat, vaidharmyeṇākāśaghaṭavadityādirapi yāvat sadāśrayatvāt sattvaṃ ghaṭavaditi, etadviparyayacakrakamevacakrakam, evamubhayāsattve
anyatarāsattve tu athaitat sāmyamubhayāsattvānmā bhūdityanyatarāsattvaṃ kāryasattvābhyupagamaparihāreṇa kāryamevāsaditi, atra kāryasamīpa ityādi yāvat svavacanādi tasmāt kāryaṃ sat kāraṇavat
nanu sattve'pi kāraṇavat pratyakṣatvaṃ prasajyate, na, avyaktatvād vitaṭīkhātahastīva pūrvaṃ khananād bhūgandhavat
ata eva ca prakaraṇacintā--kiṃ ghaṭādi kāryaṃ sat ? asat ? apratyakṣatvasya satyasati ca darśanādanekāntāt
athocyata ityādi yāvat kāryāsattvavailakṣaṇyādvā kāraṇavaditi sa eva granthaḥ
upādānādimattvaviśeṣaṇakṛto viśeṣa iti, ataḥ kāryaṃ sadupādānādimattvāt kāraṇasvātmavat, vaidharmyeṇākāśaghaṭavat
tathā sat kāryaṃ buddhisiddhatvād nirvṛttaghaṭavat, itaro nabhoghaṭavat
asacca khapuṣpaṃ buddhyasiddhatvāt khaghaṭavat, itaro nirvṛttaghaṭavat
tasmāt kāryaṃ sat kāraṇavat, na tu khapuṣpamityarthaḥ
nanu sattve'pi kāraṇavat pratyakṣatvaṃ prasajyate, na, avyaktatvād vitaṭīkhātahastīva pūrvaṃ khananād bhūgandhavat
ata eva ca prakaraṇacintā--kiṃ ghaṭādi kāryaṃ sat ? asat ? apratyakṣatvasya satyasati ca darśanādanekāntāt
tvatparikalpitaṃ mṛtpiṇḍāvasthāyāṃ kāryaṃ ghaṭākhyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt, sattvāt, kāraṇavat mṛtpiṇḍavadityartha iti

naiṣa doṣaḥ, kasmāt ? avyaktatvāt, tasyāṃ hi mṛtpiṇḍāvasthāyāṃ ghaṭo'nabhivyaktatvādindriyairnopalabhyate vitaṭīkhātahastīva pūrvaṃ khananāt, ta eva hi mṛdavayavā bhittigatāḥ khananāt prāgapi vidyamānāḥ khananottarakālaṃ hastyākāravyapadeśaṃ labhante, na ca te prāgabhivyakteranupalabdhatvānna santi

athavā kārye satyapi hyavyakte bhūgandhavadapratyakṣatvaṃ kāryasya, yathā bhuvo gandho vidyamāno'pi na ghrāṇendriyagocaramāgacchatyavyaktatvāt, salilasiktastūttarakālamabhivyakta upalabhyate, tathā mṛdavasthāyāmapratyakṣo ghaṭaḥ kulālaprayatnadaṇḍacakrasūtrādikāraṇābhivyañjitaḥ paścādupalabhyate, atastasya pratyakṣatvaṃ bhavatīti ko doṣaḥ ? ata eva ca prakaraṇacinteti prakaraṇasamadoṣo'nekāntāt, uktamanaikāntikatvamasya hetoḥ
yata eva prakaraṇacintā sa nirṇayārthamapadiṣṭaḥ san prakaraṇasamaḥ nyā॰ sū॰ 1

7, iha hi ghaṭādeḥ kāryasyāpratyakṣatvādeva cintā samutpannā --kiṃ ghaṭādi kāryaṃ sat ? asat ? iti, apratyakṣatvasya sati asati ca darśanād mūlodakādau kharaviṣāṇādau cetyato vyabhicaratyapratyakṣatvaṃ tathā sattvamapi pratyakṣāpratyakṣayordarśanāt sato'pratyakṣasya merūttarakurudvīpagrahagṛhītagrahādeḥ kharaviṣāṇādeścāsata ityanekāntāditi
evaṃ tarhi darśanādarśanayoḥ prādurbhāvāprādurbhāvayośca samānaḥ prakaraṇasamadoṣa iti cet, na, janmaprakāśaviṣayaviśeṣasyoktatvāt
upādānādimattvāviśeṣācca tvatpakṣe na samāno doṣa iti
evaṃ tarhi mayāpi śakyaṃ vaktum--yadetat sannāma tato'nyat kāryaṃ tadvikalpāsāmarthyād ghaṭapaṭavat
tadyadi tāvadubhayasattvaṃ tataḥ sattvāviśeṣādevāviśeṣe sarvatvaikatvabhedo na syāt, kāryaikatvavat kāraṇaikatvamapi syāt
atha na kāryaikatvavat kāraṇaikatvaṃ sacca kāryamiti niścitaṃ tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāraṇam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvādudumbarapuṣpavat, itaro nirvṛttaghaṭavat
nanu ghaṭasattvaṃ paṭasattvavilakṣaṇam, na asato vailakṣaṇyāditaretarāsattvāt
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāraṇasattvaniścayo na nivartate'nekātmakaṃ ca tat, na tarhyekātmakatvāt kāryaṃ sat
sattva ekātmakaṃ na bhavet, sattvāt, kāraṇavat
itara āha--tvaduktasādhanaprapañcasya kāryāsattve'pi tulyatvād mayāpi śakyaṃ vaktum, kāryasattvasya kāraṇe tvanmatasya nivāraṇe kṛte kāryāsattvaṃ bhavitumarhati
tatsādhanaṃ śrūyatām --yadetat sannāma kāraṇaṃ tato'nyat kāryam, tadvikalpāsāmarthyāt, ghaṭapaṭavat

atrāpi 1 kāraṇaṃ sat kāryaṃ sat, 2 kāraṇaṃ sat kāryamasat, 3 kāraṇamasat kāryaṃ sat, 4 kāraṇamasat kāryamasaditi caturṣu vikalpeṣu dvayoḥ pūrvavat pratipakṣavādāpattestyāgādubhayasattvamanyatara- sattvaṃ ca syāt
tatrobhayasattve tāvat tad yadi tāvadubhayasattvaṃ tataḥ sattvāviśeṣādevāviśeṣe sarvatvaikatvabhedo na syāt
mṛdeva sarvaṃ piṇḍaśivakādighaṭapiṭharakapālādi, kāryaṃ tvekameva piṇḍa iti vā śivaka iti vā'nanyadekam
atha na kāryaikatvavat kāraṇaikatvaṃ sacca kāryamiti niścitam, tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāraṇam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvādudumbarapuṣpavat, itaro nirvṛttaghaṭavat
nanu ghaṭasattvaṃ paṭasattvavilakṣaṇam, na, asato vailakṣaṇyāditaretarāsattvāt
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāraṇasattvaniścayo na nivartate'nekātmakaṃ ca tat sarvātmakamityarthaḥ, na tarhyekātmakatvāt kāryaṃ sat
sattva ekātmakaṃ na bhavet sattvāt kāraṇavat, etat prathamacakrakam

śeṣaṃ pūrvavadviparyayeṇetyādi yaduktaṃ tadapi, atha na kāraṇasarvatvavat kāryasarvatvaṃ sacca kāraṇamiti niścitam, tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāryam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvādudumbarapuṣpavat, itaro ghaṭavat
nanu ghaṭasattvaṃ paṭasattvavilakṣaṇam, na, asato vailakṣaṇyāditaretarāsattvāt; etad dvitīyaṃ cakrakam
ataḥ sarvātmakatvasataḥ kāraṇādanyat kāryamekātmakatvāt kumbhādiva ekakaṇaḥ
ekātmakatvasataśca kāryādanyat kāraṇaṃ sarvātmakatvāt kaṇādiva kumbha iti
tathānuvṛttivyāvṛttī, anuvṛttiḥ mṛd mṛd iti piṇḍaśivakādiṣu, vyāvṛttiḥ ghaṭaḥ piṭharaḥ divicāreṇa pūrvavaccakrakadvayapravartanaṃ tathopasaṃhārameva
yadi hi ghaṭo mṛtpiṇḍādanyaḥ, tadvadeva piṇḍāderapyasarvatvaṃ iti
tad yadi tāvadubhayasattvaṃ sattvāviśeṣādevāviśeṣe kāryavyāvṛttivat kāraṇavyāvṛttirapi syāt sattvād ghaṭavat
atha na kāryavyāvṛttivat kāraṇavyāvṛttiḥ sacca kāryamiti niścitam, tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāraṇam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvādudumbarapuṣpavat, itaro nirvṛttaghaṭavat
nanu ghaṭasattvaṃ paṭasattvavilakṣaṇam, na, asato vailakṣaṇyāt
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāraṇasattvaviniścayo na nivartate'nuvṛttyātmakaṃ ca tat, na tarhi vyāvṛttyātmakatvāt kāryaṃ sat, sattve na vyāvarteta sattvāt kāraṇavat; dvitīyaṃ cakrakamaviparyayeṇa
śeṣaṃ pūrvavad viparyayeṇetyādi, atha na kāraṇānuvṛttivat kāryānuvṛttiḥ sacca kāraṇamiti niścitam, tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāryam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvādudumbarapuṣpavat, itaro ghaṭavat
nanu ghaṭasattvaṃ paṭasattvavilakṣaṇam, na, asato vailakṣaṇyāt; prathamaṃ viparyayacakrakam
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye tatsattvaviniścayo na vinivartate'nuvṛttyātmakaṃ ca tat, na tarhi vyāvṛttyātmakatvāt kāryaṃ sat, sattve na vyāvarteta sattvāt kāraṇavat; etad dvitīyaṃ cakrakaṃ viparyayeṇa
vyāvṛttisataśca kāryādanyat kāraṇam, anuvṛttatvāt, ekasmādiva paṅktiḥ
yadi hi ghaṭo mṛtpiṇḍādanyaḥ, tadvadeva piṇḍāderapyasarvatvaṃ
yadi tāvadubhayasattvaṃ tataḥ sattvāviśeṣādevāviśeṣe prāk kāryānāvirbhāvavat kāraṇānāvirbhāvo'pi syāt
atha na prāk kāryānāvirbhāvavat kāraṇānāvirbhāvaḥ sacca kāryamiti niścitam, tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāraṇam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvād ghaṭavat, itara udumbarapuṣpavat
nanu ghaṭasattvaṃ paṭasattvavilakṣaṇam, na, asato vailakṣaṇyāt
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāraṇasattvaviniścayo na vinivartate nityāvirbhāvātmakaṃ ca tat, na tarhi satatānāvirbhāvātmakatvāt kāryaṃ sat, sattve prāgapyāvirbhavet sattvāt kāraṇavat; prathamam

śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva viparyayeṇa--atha na kāraṇasatatāvirbhāvavat kāryasatatāvirbhāvaḥ sacca kāraṇamiti niścitam, tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāryam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvādudumbarapuṣpavat, itaro ghaṭavat
nanu ghaṭasattvaṃ paṭasattvavilakṣaṇam, na, asato vailakṣaṇyāt; dvitīyaṃ cakrakam
etaccihnāntargato ghaṭavat, itara iti pāṭho yadyapi sarvāsvapi pratiṣu dṛśyate tathāpi nāyaṃ kathañcidapi saṅgataḥ pratīyate tataḥ parityājya eva
vastutastu sadvilakṣaṇatvādudumbarapuṣpavat, itaro ghaṭavat ityevātra vaktumucitam, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 169 paṃ॰ 18, 23, pṛ॰ 170 paṃ॰ 5, 9, 21
naitadupapadyate'smatpakṣasādhanavat tvatpakṣasādhanam, kiṃ kāraṇam ? asarvatvādihetūnāmasiddhatvāt, yasmādasmākaṃ sarvameva anuvṛttireva kāraṇameva upādānameva buddhisiddhameva sarvasmādanyatvāt
yadi kāryaṃ kathamasat ? athāsat kathaṃ kāryam ? mṛdeva hi ghaṭaḥ kriyate ghaṭatayā vyajyate dīpeneva kriyayā

tatrāsarvatvāsiddhau pratipāditāyāṃ vyāvṛttyādīnāmapyasiddhirāpāditaiva bhaviṣyatītyasarvatvābhāvamevāpādayitumāha --yadi hi ghaṭo'sarvakāryatvābhimato mṛtpiṇḍāt sattvābhimatādanya itīṣyate tadvadeva ghaṭavadeva kāryavadeva piṇḍāderapyasarvatvaṃ viprakṛṣṭasyāpi, kimuta sannikṛṣṭasya śivakādeḥ ? sarvasmādanyatvād ghaṭavat
tathānuvṛttyādyabhāvaśca tata eva nāsti, yathaikasya ghaṭasya mṛdanuvṛttyabhāvastathā sarvaghaṭeṣu tathā śivakādiṣvapyabhāva ityanuvṛttyabhāvādanuvṛttivyāvṛttikṛtavikalpābhāvaśca
yadi kāryaṃ kathamasat ? athāsat kathaṃ kāryam ? mṛdeva hi ghaṭaḥ kriyate ghaṭatayā vyajyate dīpeneva kriyayā
atra sarvatvābhi॰ iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīnatara iti bhāti
atra sarvapratiṣu daṇḍāde॰ iti pāṭhopalambhe'pi piṇḍāde॰ ityeva pāṭhaḥ samīcīno bhāti
tatra svavacanavirodhastāvad yadi kāryaṃ ghaṭavat kriyate tat kathamasat khapuṣpavat kāryaṃ ca ? svena vacanena svameva vacanaṃ virudhyate
athāsat khapuṣpavat kathaṃ kāryaṃ ghaṭavat ? iti saiva svavacanavirodhabhāvanā viparyayeṇa tayoreva śabdayorvirodhadarśanārthā
hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmāt sarpasphaṭāṭopakuṇḍalībhavanavad mṛda eva ghaṭībhavanaṃ tathā prakāśanaṃ vyaktirvimalatā kriyate
karaṇaṃ yathā pṛṣṭhaṃ kuru pādau kuru iti
taddarśayannāha --ghaṭaḥ kriyate ghaṭatayā vyajyate vidyamāna eva vyaktībhavati
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? sa eva ghaṭo dīpeneva kriyayā vyajyate daṇḍādivyāpāraṇātmikayā

tathā ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyāprasiddhirapi, kāryamasat iti vyāghātāt proktasvavacanavirodhabhāvanāta eva khapuṣpanirvṛttaghaṭayoriva na kāryamasatā viśeṣyaṃ nāpyasat kāryeṇeti na parasparato viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyaṃ veti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyāprasiddhirasmādeva kāraṇāt
ata eva yatnena mahatā pratipādanārthaṃ na kriyāyāṃ khedaḥ kartavyo bhavati
ata evetyādi yāvat khedaḥ kartavyo bhavati
yat tvayā vyākhyānamanuṣṭhitam itikartavyataiva kartavyatā iti yatnena mahatā pūrvottaracodyaparihārapakṣāvyavacchedavatā pratipādanārthaṃ na kriyāyāṃ kriyāvyākhyānārthaḥ khedaḥ kartavyaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? sāmānyādivastuvicārakhedasyāvyavasthitaparamārthatvāt sarvasya kriyāyā evopadeśo nyāyya ityasyābhyupagamasyoparodhāt

yasminnapi agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityādikriyopadeśopajīvanaṃ nāsti ajñānapratibaddhameva sarvam ityekāntastasminnajñānapratibaddhaikānte'pi cājñānapratibaddhatve svavacanasya virodhaḥ, asat kāryam iti jñātvoktaṃ cenna tarhi sarvamajñānapratibaddhamevāsya jñānaprasiddhatvāt
athājñātvā kathaṃ pratipādakaṃ sādhakaṃ ca ? iti svavacanavirodhaḥ
tvayāpi etadevam iti niścityābhyupagamyoktatvādajñānapratibaddhābhyupagamasya ca tena virodhāt evam ityavagamādabhyupagamavirodhaḥ kṛtaḥ
loke jñānavyavahārāt tadvirodhaḥ, jñānapūrvako hi lokavyavahāraḥ, tatastasyājñānapratibandhābhyupagamāpratīterlokarūḍhivirodhaḥ
pramāṇavirodhastu prastuta eveti, pratyakṣavirodhastāvat tathā loke dṛṣṭatvāt, kriyayābhivyajyamānasya ghaṭādeḥ kāryasya dīpeneva sata upalabdheranumānavirodhaḥ
jñāpakatvād viśeṣavirodha iti, asya asat kāryam iti jñāpakavākyasya jñāpakatvaviśeṣeṣṭeḥ pratyakṣasvavacanādivirodheṣu dharmaviśeṣaviparyayasiddherviśeṣavirodhaḥ
tasmādayukto'satkāryavādaḥ agnihotraṃ juhuyāt, itikartavyataiva kartavyatā, kuryāt iti cābhyupagataḥ pareṇeti

ata etebhyo doṣebhyo niḥsṛtya kiṃ pratipattavyam ? ucyate --ataḥ pūrvoditadoṣāsambandhena, ye pūrvamuditā vidhivādinā sāmānyaikāntavāde viśeṣaikāntavāde sāmānyaviśeṣanānātvavāde doṣā mayāpi ca ye doṣā uktāḥ sāmānyādivicārapratyākhyāyinaḥ kriyopadeśavādino'jñānavādinaśca teṣāmubhayeṣāmapi doṣāṇāmasambandhena idaṃ pratipattavyam--ātmaiva sāmānyamiti

nanu pūrvatra dūṣitamevaitad matam ātmaiva sāmānyam iti sukhaṃ sukhaṃ ca sukhādisamudayaśca ityādipūrvottarapakṣaprapañceneti, atrocyate--na, ātmaśabdasya puruṣaparyāyatvādavayavānabhyupagamāt samudāyavādaparihāreṇāsya puruṣasāmānyasyāvasthāvato'vasthābhyo'nanyasya tatsvarūpāvasthānāt tadvaidharmyāt
ayaṃ tasya pravṛttiparyāyasya vidhervidhiḥ, evaṃ pravṛttirityarthaḥ
vidhinā bhavatīti grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? atati satataṃ gacchati tāṃstānavasthānaviśeṣān svarūpāparityāgeneti ātmā, sa eva sāmānyaṃ caitanyalakṣaṇam
evaṃ tarhi viśeṣābhāve kasya sāmānyam ? iti sāmānyābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ, sa mā bhūditi viśeṣā vaktavyāḥ
ucyate--sāmānyaṃ puri śayanāt puruṣaḥ, viśeṣāstu tasyaivāvasthāvato'vasthā jāgratsuptasuṣuptaturīyākhyāḥ

kiṃ nidarśanamiti cet, ghaṭagrīvādirūpādinavādibhedābhedasamavasthāvat, yathā ghaṭasya sthūlā grīvābudhnamadhyāvasthāḥ sūkṣmāśca rūpādayo deśabhedabhinnāḥ kālabhedabhinnāśca navapurāṇāvasthāḥ, teṣāmevāvasthābhedānāmabhedena samavasthā ghaṭa iti tadvadātmaiva svāvasthānāṃ sāmānyam

evaṃ ca kalpyamānaṃ sarvasarvātmakatvasatkāryatvamūlarahasyānatikrameṇa kalpitamiti guṇaścātra vidyate, evaṃ hi sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ sacca kāryam iti mūlarahasyametannātikrāntaṃ bhavati puruṣātmakatvāt sarvasya tadvikāramātratvācca bhedānāṃ tatraivāntarlayāvirbhāvāt sarvakāryāṇāṃ kṛkalāsavarṇaviśeṣāṇāmiva kṛkalāse
ayaṃ tasya pravṛttiparyāyasya vidhervidhiḥ, evaṃ pravṛttirityarthaḥ

yadapi ca anarthako vivekayatnaḥ śāstreṣu ityavicāra iṣyate so'pyanenaiva yuktimārgeṇa tattvenaikyamāśritya nyāyyaḥ, tasya bhāvastattvam, ātmano bhāvenaikyamāśritya nyāyādanapeto nyāyyaḥ, nājñānapratibandhāt
iha tu jñānātmakapuruṣasvarūpaikyāpattisanniścaye niścitamevaitat, kiṃ vicāreṇa gatārthatvāt, na tu jñātumaśakyatvāditi
vidhiḥ sthitirācāraḥ pravṛttirmaryādā ityasya vidhinayasyāyameva vidhirācāraḥ sthitirityādi
evaṃ pravṛttirityarthaḥ, yā caitanyātmasvarūpā pravṛttiḥ sā vidhervidhirityetamarthaṃ vyācaṣṭe
yaḥ punarvidhiḥ prāktanaḥ sa na yujyate, yasmād vidhinetyādi
bhavatīti bhāvo bhūprakṛtiḥ kartrarthaḥ, prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtaḥ pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 3

bhāve ghaño vihitatvād bhūyata iti bhāvaḥ, na bhavati iti kartrartha iti cet, tatrāpi yena bhūyate samānena samāno bhavatīti bhāvo ṇaprakaraṇe bhuvaścopasaṅkhyānamiti vā kartā sāmānyamityevaṃ vyavasthite'rthe sarvatantra bhāvo bhedābhedanānātāsu na bhāvo bhaviturabhāva iti vivicyate, na ca vivicyate ca
tathā na bhavatyeva vidhitvaṃ vidheḥ, lokavaditi vidhānādvidhirutsarga evaṃ na bhavati
yathā tat tathānyathā ca bhavati tathā vaktavyamiti vidhirvihito bhavatyutsṛṣṭaḥ

siddhāntena vyākaraṇena tatra viśeṣamātravāde deśakālabhede parasparaviviktadravyadeśakālabhāvabhinne bhavane'bhede ca dravyāditayā bhavanamātre sāmānyavāde nānābhāve ca sāmānyaviśeṣayorbhedābhedanānātāsu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ bauddhasāṅkhyavaiśeṣikamatāsu doṣānna bhāvaḥ, bhaviturabhāvāt tatprakṛtyarthakarturabhāvāt, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt pañcamīmaprayujya bhaviturabhāva ityuktaṃ prāguktanyāyena bhaviturabhāvāt
bhavatīti bhāvo ghaṭādiriti vyākaraṇadṛṣṭena niruktyarthena samarthito vidhinā vivicyate ca sādṛśyāsādṛśyābhyām
sādṛśyāt samāno bhavatīti pṛthak pratijñāyate, teṣu vikalpeṣu doṣāṇāmabhihitatvād nirdoṣabhavanokteśca vivicyate vidhinā
kimevaṃ vivicyata eva ? netyucyate, na ca vivicyate ceti, pratijñā sā punaraviviktaiva kṛtā ko ha vaitadveda, kiṃ vānena jñātena iti vacanāt
sa eṣa vidhervidhirna bhavati vivicyamānārthavidhānāt svavacanavirodhadoṣādaṃśena vivekādavivekācca

yatrāpyaṃśena vivekastatra vivicyamānāṃśe'pi ca yathā bhavatā vidhinayavādinābhihitaṃ tadvad vivicyate na ca vivicyate cāpi paramatadūṣaṇāt svamatasādhanācca ghaṭādirbhāvo vivicyate na ca vivicyate tathā na bhavatyeva vidhitvaṃ vidheḥ, na vidhirvihita evamityabhiprāyaḥ
kathaṃ punarvidhīyate iti cet, lokavat, loka iva lokavat, lokavaditi vidhānād yadi lokavadeva vidhīyate vidhirutsarga evaṃ na bhavati
kathaṃ na bhavati ? kiṃ na etena yadi kāraṇam ? yadi na ca vivicyate pratijñāpi tadaṃśadvārikā na kāryā ityādyavicārya vidhānānna bhavati
kiṃ tarhi ? yaduktasūktatayā sarvātmakatvena vidhirutsargaḥ sidhyati, tadyathā yathā tat tathānyathetyādi
athavā yathā loke dṛṣṭaṃ tathā vidhervidhirbhavati

iti itthamanantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇo vidhirvidhirbhavati loke, yathā tat tathānyathetyādi, mṛtpiṇḍaśivakādiprakāreṇa tathānyathā ca bhavati yathā tathā vaktavyam, taccātacca yayopapattyā bhavati tathā vaktavyam, eṣa vidhervidhiḥ
evaṃ so'vivakṣitavyāvṛttiranaṅgīkṛtabhedastirakṛtaviśeṣo nirvyāvṛttireva vidhirvihito bhavatyutsṛṣṭa iti paryāyaśabdenotsargo vidhiriti sarvatrāsya vidhilakṣaṇasya darśayati
bhāvo bhedābhedanānātāsu na bhāvo bhaviturabhāva iti vivicyate, na ca vivicyate ca
tathā na bhavatyeva vidhitvaṃ vidheḥ, lokavaditi vidhānādvidhirutsarga evaṃ na bhavati
yathā tat tathānyathā ca bhavati tathā vaktavyamiti vidhirvihito bhavatyutsṛṣṭaḥ
vividyate ca sādṛśyābhyāṃ sādṛśyā samāno bhavatīti pra॰
॰daṃśena vivekāt ca yatrāpyaṃśena vivekastatra raṃ॰ hī॰
tanmayaṃ cedaṃ sarvaṃ tadekatvāt sarvaikatvācca bhavatīti bhāvaḥ
nanu kṣīrarasādi dadhyādeḥ kartṛ, na ca tajjñam, na, tatpravṛttiśeṣatvād gopravṛttiśeṣakṣīradadhitvavat, jñaśeṣatvādvā cakrabhrāntivat
nanu cakrabhrāntāvapi ko bhavitā ? iti pratyapekṣāyāṃ ghaṭabhavanavyavahāravad mṛd
ko'sau ? nidarśyatāmiti cet, ucyate --tadyathā puruṣo hītyādi
uktaniruktaḥ puruṣaśabdaḥ, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmādasau jñātā jñānaśīlo jñānadharmā sādhujñāyī vā puruṣa eva
jñātṛtvaṃ ca jñānamayatvāt, jñānāvayavo jñānavikāro vā jñānamayaḥ sa upayogalakṣaṇatvāt

tataḥ kimiti cet, tanmayaṃ cedaṃ sarvaṃ devamanujatiryaṅnarakapṛthivyādighaṭādibhedabhinnaṃ jagat, tadekatvāt tasya puruṣasyaikatvāt vastutvāt tadekatvavat sarvaikatvam, sarvaikatvāccaikaṃ sa ca jagacca sarvaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ, na tu ghaṭapaṭādibhedena bhavati jñānamayapuruṣātmakatvāt
yena bhūyate sa eva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ

tannirṇayārthaṃ praśnottarakrameṇa granthaḥ --ko bhavatītyādirgatārtho yāvat kaḥ svatantraḥ ? yo jña iti, ajñasyāsvātantrayādeva kartṛtvābhāvāt, kāṣṭhādiviprakīrṇapacananirvartanavat, yathā kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyāmodanaṃ devadattaḥ pacatītyatra devadatta eva pacanasya nirvartako jñātṛtvāt na kāṣṭhādīni tathā puruṣa eva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ
kṣīrāddadhi bhavatyajñāt kartṛṇaḥ, rasād guḍaḥ, na ca tat kṣīraṃ raso vā jñamiti jñakartṛtvamanaikāntikamiti
etacca na, tatpravṛttiśeṣatvāt, tasyaiva jñasya pravartamānasya pravṛtteraparisamāptāyāḥ śeṣatvāt
gopravṛttiśeṣakṣīradadhitvavat, yathā gordhenoḥ pravṛtteraparisamāptāyāḥ kṣīradadhinavanītaghṛtaniṣpandanādi śeṣastathā puruṣapravṛttiśeṣa eva jagaditi

kā vā sā pravṛttiḥ pravartamānapuruṣavyatiriktā, sarvasya jñaśeṣatvāt ? dṛṣṭāntaścakrabhrāntiḥ, yathā kulālaprayatnabhramitasya cakrasya bhrāntau kulālapravṛttiśeṣatvaṃ jñaśeṣatvamevaṃ dadhyāderapi jñaśeṣatvam, gorjñasya śeṣatvaṃ dadhnaḥ, gobhuktatṛṇādyāhārasya rasarudhirādipariṇatasya jñamantareṇa kṣīradadhyādibhāvo nāsti
jejjaṭaviracitāyāṃ tadvṛttau tu śarkarāsamavīryastu dantaniṣpīḍito rasaḥ
nanvityanujñāpane, cakrabhrāntāvapi ko bhavitā ? iti pratyapekṣāyāṃ jijñāsāyāṃ mūlabhavitā yena bhūyate tadeva
jñasyaiva suptāvasthatvādvasthātvād na ca cakradaṇḍādi karaṇanirīhatvāt, dadhīva payasaḥ, jñaśeṣasuptāvasthatvātvasthātvāt

yathaiva hi rūpādayo'mūrtatvena sūkṣmāṃ vṛttimatyajanta eva svapravṛttiprabhāvāvabaddhamūrtatvaprakramān paramāṇūnadhyāsya nānāprabhedapṛthivyādibhedasthūlarūpā jāyante vaśyāpekṣyo ghaṭabhavanavyavahāravad mṛt, yathā piṇḍaśivakādyavasthākrameṇa ghaṭabhavanavyavahāre mṛdevādyā bhavitrī tathehāpi cakrabhrāntau bhavanavyavahāratvād mūlabhavitṛ dravyamapekṣyaṃ parataḥ parato'pi yena bhūyate yad bhavati tadeva, maulaṃ kāraṇaṃ tadevetyarthaḥ
tasmād ghaṭabhavane mṛdvad bhrāntibhavane kulālo'pekṣyaḥ, kulālaśeṣabhrāntivacca jñaśeṣaṃ sarvam, itarathāsau naiva syād bhaviturabhāvād vandhyāputravadamūlatvādityarthaḥ
jñasyaiva suptāvasthatvādvasthātvād na ca cakradaṇḍādi karaṇanirīhatvāt, dadhīva payasaḥ, jñaśeṣasuptāvasthatvātvasthātvāt
yathaiva hi rūpādayo'mūrtatvena sūkṣmāṃ vṛttimatyajanta eva svapravṛttiprabhāvāvabaddhamūrtatvaprakramān paramāṇūnadhyāsya nānāprabhedapṛthivyādibhedasthūlarūpā jāyante

etaccāyuktam, jñasyaiva suptāvasthatvātvasthātvāt na ca cakradaṇḍādi karaṇanirīhatvāt, na ca cakradaṇḍādi svata eva bhavati karaṇanirīhatvāt, karaṇatvānnirīhāṇi, nirīhatvānna svata eva jñāturyatnamantareṇa tadyatnaśeṣaṃ vāntareṇa tasyaiva suptāvasthā daṇḍacakrādi niṣpandabhūtā niścetanībhūtā bhavitumarhati
tasmāt sāpi suptāvasthā jñasya cetanasyaiva vṛttirbhavitumarhati, dadhīva payasaḥ, yathā dadhi payaso'vasthā tathā daṇḍacakrādi jñasyaiva kulālasya

etena dadhyādyapi jñabhavanamākhyātameva, jñaśeṣasuptāvasthatvātvasthātvāt tasyāpi dadhyādeḥ kulālayatnaśeṣacakradaṇḍādivajjñayatnaṃ jñayatnaśeṣaṃ vāntareṇa pravṛttyabhāvājjñapravṛttimātratvamevetyarthaḥ

yathaiva rūparasagandhasparśaśabdā amūrtatvena sūkṣmāṃ vṛttimatyajanta evetyādi, sūkṣmapūrvakatvāt sthūlasya sūkṣmatāṃ nirūpya sthūlatvaṃ nirūpayati, na hi te rūpādayaḥ pratiniyatacakṣurādivijñānaprabhāvitasvarūpā mūrtāḥ sthūlā iti vā kenacidiṣṭāstasmādamūrtāḥ, tadbhāvo'mūrtatvam, tena amūrtatvena vṛttiḥ, saiva ca sūkṣmā, tāmatyajanto'jahata eva svapravṛttiprabhāvāvabaddhamūrtatvaprakramān svayā pravṛttyā prabhāvena cāvabaddho mūrtatvena prakramo yeṣāṃ te svapravṛttiprabhāvāvabaddhamūrtatvaprakramāḥ paramāṇavaḥ, rūpādīnāmātmīyayā pravṛttyāvabaddho mūrtatvena prakramaḥ paramāṇūnāṃ sabhedānām, tān paramāṇūnadhyāsyeti sṛṣṭeḥ kramaṃ darśayati dṛṣṭāntarūpeṇa
tata uttarakālaṃ nānāprabhedapṛthivyādibhedasthūlarūpā jāyante rūpādaya eva

pṛthivyā aśma-loṣṭa-sikatā-vajrādayaḥ prabhedāḥ, himakarakādayo'pām, jvālāṅgāramurmurādayastejasaḥ, utkalikā-maṇḍala-guñjā-jhañjhādayo vāyoḥ, vṛkṣagulmavallīlatāvitānavīrudho vanaspateḥ, kṛmi-pipīlikā-bhramarādi-manuṣya-deva-nārakā jaṅgamānām
rasa-vīrya-vipāka-prabhāvāśca vastunaḥ pravartamānasya vipariṇāmāḥ, tatra nidarśanam— citrakaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke vīryoṣṇaḥ kaṭuko rase
tadvad dantī, prabhāvāttu virecayati sā naram

yathaite pṛthivyādayaḥ sūkṣmā mūrtasūkṣmāmūrtarūpādipūrvakāḥ sthūlatvāt tantupūrvapaṭavadevaṃ tato'pi parato'pi paraṃ evaṃ tato'pi paraṃ kāraṇaṃ rūpādibhāvamāpadyata iti rūpādipravibhaktamapravibhaktasvatattvaṃ yat tad bhavati tadeva tattvam

tat kim ? nanu jñānasvatattva ātmeti rūpādibhireva nirūpitaṃ tat, taddhi rūpaṇaṃ rūpaṃ jñānameva vibhaktāvibhaktaṃ grahaṇameva, na tu rūpyate tat tena tasmin vetyādi rūpam, rasāderguṇagaṇād dravyādvā vibhaktasyānavasthānādrūpasya puruṣabhinnaputratvādivat
dvidhāpi rūpasyāvibhaktatattvātmakatāyāmapi rūpādanyeṣāṃ rasādīnāṃ pratyakṣato rūpādibhyaḥ parato'pyaparamanyat paraṃ variṣṭhaṃ pradhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ rūpādibhāvamāpadyate iti pratipattavyam
tacca paraṃ yat kāraṇamātmānamamūrtasūkṣmarūpāditvena sthūlamūrtaparamāṇudvipradeśādiskandhapṛthivyāditvena ca pravibhajamānaṃ pravartate
kiṃ punastasya svatattvam ? tasya bhāvastattvam, svārthiko bhāvapratyayaḥ, taddarśayati --yat tad bhavati tadeva tattvam
svaṃ ca svaprabhedāpekṣayā, tattvatā anusṛtatvāt, paratattvābhāvena viśeṣyate svatattvamiti paramatāpekṣayā ceti
citrakaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke vīryoṣṇaḥ kaṭuko rase
tadvad dantī, prabhāvāttu virecayati sā naram || carakasaṃ॰ 1 | 26 | 68 iti
evaṃ tato'pi paraṃ kāraṇaṃ rūpādibhāvamāpadyata iti rūpādipravibhaktamapravibhaktasvatattvaṃ yat tad bhavati tadeva tattvam

tat kim ? nanu jñānasvatattva ātmeti rūpādibhireva nirūpitaṃ tat, taddhi rūpaṇaṃ rūpaṃ jñānameva vibhaktāvibhaktaṃ grahaṇameva, na tu rūpyate tat tena tasmin vetyādi rūpam, rasāderguṇagaṇād dravyādvā vibhaktasyānavasthānādrūpasya puruṣabhinnaputratvādivat
ācārya āha --nanu jñānasvatattva ātmeti rūpādibhireva nirūpitaṃ tat paraṃ kāraṇam
ātmā jñānasvatattvaḥ, sa punā rūpādibhireva nirūpitaḥ, rūpa rūpakriyāyām pā॰ dhā॰ 1934, rūpitaṃ nirṇītaṃ tu jñātam, nirṇayo rūpaṇamityeko'rthaḥ
taddhi rūpaṇaṃ rūpamiti yasmāt kāraṇād rūpaṇaṃ rūpamityeko'rthaḥ

ādigrahaṇād rasanamāsvādanaṃ rasaḥ, evaṃ śeṣāṇāmapi rūpaṇakṛtātmalābhaniruktatvād rūpaṇatā, jñānameva rūpaṇaparyāyatvājjñānasya, vibhaktāvibhaktaṃ grahaṇameva, vibhaktagrahaṇaṃ rūpaṃ raso gandhaḥ śabdaḥ sparśa iti jñānam, rūpamityavibhaktaṃ sarveṣu, tad dvividhamapi grahaṇameva rūpaṃ bhāvasādhanatvād rūpaśabdasya
na tu rūpyate tat tena tasmin vetyādi rūpam, na tu karmakartṛkaraṇādhikaraṇasādhanatvam, ādigrahaṇāt na tasmai tasmād rūpamiti sampradānāpādānakārakabhedebhyo rūpamiti bhavitumarhati

kiṃ kāraṇam ? rasyate spṛśyata ityāderapi tatraiva darśanād rūpaṇopalakṣitasya jñānātmano vastuno rasāderguṇagaṇād dravyādvā guṇagaṇavyatiriktādvibhaktasyānavasthānād rūpasya puruṣabhinnaputratvādivat, anekasambandhinaḥ puruṣāt pitṛputrabhrātṛbhāgineyamātulatvādidharmāḥ pṛthag nāvatiṣṭhante tathā rūpaṇātmakaṃ rūpaṃ rasādiguṇavyatirekeṇa tadvyatiriktaparamāṇvādidravyavyatirekeṇa vā nāvatiṣṭhate paramārthataḥ
athavā na tu karmakartṛkaraṇādhikaraṇasādhanatvamādigrahaṇāttasmai tasmādrūpamiti iti yathāśrutapāṭho'pi na tu ityasya anuvṛttiṃ vivakṣya saṅgamanīyaḥ

evaṃ tarhi rūpaṇāvibhaktatattvātmakānāṃ rūpavadavibhaktagrahaṇaṃ cakṣuṣaiva syāt, rasanādibhiśca grahaṇadarśanāt pratyakṣaviruddheyaṃ kalpaneti cet, na, tasya tattvasyānekātmakatvābhyupagamād dvidhāpi rasādyabhedena dravyābhedena vā rūpasyāvibhaktatattvātmakatāyāmapītyādi yāvaddravyādrasā ?dīti śakyaṃ vaktum, darśanād rūpameva na rasādi iti śakyaṃ vaktum, na rūpādibhyo bhinnamidamekaṃ dravyameveti, rūpādivyatiriktādarśanāt
sa eva tu vyatirekasyānupapatterjñānasvatattvātmaiva grāhyo grāhakaścaiṣitavyaḥ, abhimatātmapratipattivat
rūpaṃ rasa iti pratyakṣaṃ bhedena darśanāt tasyānekātmakasya svapravṛttiprabhāvāvabaddhasya prabhedānāmuktatvāt
evaṃ tāvad rasādiguṇagaṇasamudāyo nāstyanyaḥ parasparataste cānye rūpādayaḥ, kintu rūpaṇasvarūpabhedā evetyuktam
syānmatam--rūpādibhyo bhinnamekaṃ dravyaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇāpadeśāditi, etacca na rūpādibhyo bhinnamidamekaṃ dravyameveti, śakyaṃ vaktumiti vartate
pūrvatra rūpādanyeṣāṃ rasādīnāṃ pratyakṣato darśanād rūpameva na rasādaya iti śakyaṃ vaktum, iha tu rūpādibhyo bhinnaṃ dravyamiti pratyakṣeṇādarśanādaśakyamiti
yadyapi sarvāsvapi pratiṣu yāvaddravyādīti iti pāṭha upalabhyate tathāpi yāvadrasādīti iti pāṭhaścet syāt tarhi samīcīnamiti bhāti
athavā kaścit pāṭho'tra truṭita iti bhāti
darśanād rūpameva na rasādi iti śakyaṃ vaktum, na rūpādibhyo bhinnamidamekaṃ dravyameveti, rūpādivyatiriktādarśanāt
sa eva tu vyatirekasyānupapatterjñānasvatattvātmaiva grāhyo grāhakaścaiṣitavyaḥ, abhimatātmapratipattivat
kasyāṃ punaḥ kalpanāyāṃ pratyakṣavirodho nāsti ? ucyate --ātmatattvāvibhaktagrahe tu pratyakṣāvirodhaḥ
tat katham ? bhāvyate --caitanyamekameva rūpādivibhaktamapyavibhaktaṃ caitanyāvyavacchedānvayād rūpaṇasāmānyenāvibhaktamevaikatvāt, rūpādirūpeṇa grahaṇavibhāgād vibhaktamapi sat tadekameva
anekātmakatvād vibhaktamavibhaktaṃ ceti pratyakṣadarśanaṃ rasādibhedarūpaṃ rūpaṇābhedarūpaṃ ca na virudhyate rūpādirūpatvāccaitanyasya
yasmācca yathā paraiḥ parikalpitaṃ bhinnamiti tatra ca rūpādi caitanyebhyo bhinnamatra darśanavirodhakāri sambhavati bāhyaṃ rūparasādiguṇasamudāyātmakaṃ tadāśrayadravyātmakaṃ vā
kintu tadeva rūpādi caitanyātmatattvāvibhaktagrahe tu darśanāvirodhakāri, caitanyasyaiva vibhaktāvibhaktātmakatvāt tathā tadanubhavadarśanāt svaparicchede tato'nyasya pramāṇasyāsambhavāt

kiṃ tarhi ? sa eva tu vyatirekasyānupapatterjñānāt pṛthagbhūtārthasyānupapatterjñānasvatattvātmaiva grāhyo grāhakaścaiṣitavyo'bhimatātmapratipattivat, yathā tvadabhimataḥ pratiśarīraṃ śarīrādivyatiriktamātmaiva ātmānaṃ śarīrādīṃśca bāhyānarthān pratipadyamāno'pi svātmādhigame pramāṇāntarābhāvād grāhyo grāhakaśca tathā rūpādibhedena jñānasukhādibhedena ca svayameva viparivartamāna iti
nidarśanamapyāha --buddhyādītyādi, buddhisukhaduḥkhecchādveṣādikālākāśadigātmādyamūrtaṃ sūkṣmamucyate, rūpādayastu sthūlā eva pratyakṣatvāt
sūkṣmasthūlatvādi ca teṣāṃ yathāsaṅkhyaṃ buddhyādīnāṃ rūpādīnāṃ ca tattva evetyabhisambhantsyate
kṣīrādyatyantāparidṛṣṭatattvetyādi, yugapadbhāvinaḥ kṣīrāvasthāyāmatyantāparidṛṣṭā dharmā evaṃ ca sārvajñyamayatnena labdhaṃ puruṣātmakatvāt sarvasya
jñatvamevotkarṣaparyantavṛttaṃ tāratamyāt parvatonnativat kṣetrapramāṇavat pratyavagamakātmakatvāt khadyotāditāratamyavṛttoddyotavat
nanu vaktṛtvādīnāmasārvajñyāvyabhicārādasarvajñataiva, na, vaktṛtvasyāpi tāra- stattva eva dṛśyante, tadyathā--ā dravo rasaḥ, ā kaṭhinaṃ dadhi, mūlamadduḥ kaṭhinaḥ, mastu dravameva

ādigrahaṇāt kṣīramapi dhenāvatyantāparidṛṣṭam, dhenvabhyavahṛtatṛṇagoraktādāvatyantāparidṛṣṭā dhenugatarasarudhirādipariṇativiśeṣakramāgatapraśravādayastattva eva pravibhāgena vyavasthitāḥ, teṣāṃ vyavasthāvat sarvasya cetanācetanasya jagataścetanātmani puruṣe'tyantāparidṛṣṭasya vyavasthā yugapadeva
yathā ca tasyaiva kramabhuvo'nye dharmā mādhuryāmlādayastathā paryāyāstattva eva jñānātmake tasyaiva cāvasthāḥ
naitāḥ svamanīṣikā ucyante, kiṃ tarhi ? jinavacanārṇavavipruṣa evaitāḥ, tadyathā --se kiṃ bhāvaparamāṇū ? bhāvaparamāṇū vaṇṇavaṃte gaṃdhavaṃte rasavaṃte phāsavaṃte bhagavatīsū॰ 20
6॰ iti varṇādīnāṃ tattva evānekātmake tadātmanāṃ bhāvāt
evaṃ ca sārvajñyamayatnena labdhaṃ puruṣātmakatvāt sarvasya
jñatvamevotkarṣaparyantavṛttaṃ tāratamyāt parvatonnativat kṣetrapramāṇavat pratyavagamakātmakatvāt khadyotāditāratamyavṛttoddyotavat
bhāvaparamāṇū ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! kaivihe paṇṇatte ? goyamā ! cauvvihe paṇṇatte, taṃ jahā vaṇṇamaṃte gaṃdhamaṃte rasamaṃte phāsamaṃte iti bhagavatīsūtre pāṭhaḥ

asmin jñānātmakaikakāraṇavivartamātrabhedavāde yuktyantarapratipādyaṃ sārvajñyamayatnena labdhaṃ puruṣātmakatvāt sarvasya, na hi puruṣaḥ kaścidātmānaṃ na vetti, yathā tṛṇādiṣvatyantāparidṛṣṭaṃ dadhitvaṃ tatkāraṇatvāt tadātmakaṃ tathā sarvajñatāpyasya

kā sā sarvajñatā ? jñatvamevotkarṣaparyantavṛttam, tadeva jñatvamutkarṣaparyantaṃ niratiśayaṃ kvacit prāpnoti, tāratamyāt, taratamabhāvastāratamyaṃ jñataro jñatama iti parasparata utkarṣabhedaḥ, tena tāratamyena yuktatvāt tatparyantena niratiśayena vinā na bhavitumarhati

parvatonnativat, yathā parvatānāmunnatistāratamyayuktatvād vindhyasahyojjayantapāriyātrendrapadamalayamahendrahimavatkailāśādīnāmanyatamasya utkarṣaparyantaṃ prāptayā niratiśayayonnatyā vinā na bhavatyevaṃ jñatvamapi

yo'pi kailāśaṃ mandaraṃ vā nābhyupagacchati tasyāpi śuṣirasyāvakāśadānasamarthasya pṛthivyādyāśrayasya kṣetrasya sadbhāvāt tasya ca samantato'nantatvād mahad mahattaraṃ mahattamamiti pramāṇotkarṣasya tatra niratiśayasya darśanāt kṣetrapramāṇavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ
asyāmeva pratijñāyāṃ hetvantaram --pratyavagamakātmakatvāt, pratyavagamayatīti pratyavagamakaṃ tadeva jñatvam, tataśca niratiśayotkarṣaparyantaṃ tat
dṛṣṭāntaḥ khadyotāditāratamyavṛttoddyotavaditi, yathā khadyotamaṇyagnipradīpatārakādiṣu tāratamyena vṛttatvāduddyoto bhāskare niratiśayotkarṣaparyanto dṛṣṭastathā jñānamapi kvaciditi
kiñcānyat, atraivendriyapratyakṣānumānayorviṣaye prakarṣanikarṣadarśanāccā tamyādutkarṣavṛtteḥ sātiśayaparimāṇakaṃ vastu sapratipakṣaṃ bhāvaviśeṣatvād ghaṭavat
asarvātathyābhidhāyitābhyāṃ viparyayeṇa bhavitavyam, asarvajñatāyā vaktṛtvāsarvajñatāyā vā avasthātvād vastutvād viśeṣatvāt, jñatvājñatvāvasthāvad nīlotpalaraktotpalatvavat
ko vicāraḥ ? niścitamevaitat, tenāpi tattvato bhavitavyam
tena tu jñānātmakatvādātmanastadvijṛmbhitavikalpatvācca śabdasya puruṣasvarūpasyaiva tasya vacanaṃ yujyate uktatvād sarvajñataiveti
vaktṛtvādeva sārvajñyaṃ tāvad brūmaḥ, vaktā vaktṛtaro vaktṛtama ityutkarṣaparamparāyā niratiśayaniṣṭhatvāt sarvasya vaktā tathyasya cetyavaśyameṣitavyam
tacca sarvasya tathyasya ca vaktṛtvāt tajjña iti vaktṛtvādeva sārvajñyotkarṣasiddherayuktaḥ sārvajñyapratiṣedhaḥ
syānmatam--ākāśāsiddheradṛṣṭāntamiti, etaccāyuktamanumānasadbhāvāt, sātiśayaparimāṇakaṃ vastu sapratipakṣaṃ bhāvaviśeṣatvād ghaṭavaditi vibhaktapadārthavādimatāpekṣayaitadanumānam

tāratamyayuktatvāt sādhitaṃ sādhayiṣyamāṇārthānusāreṇa pratijānāno bhāvitārthopanayanārthamāha --asarvātathyābhidhāyitābhyāṃ viparyayeṇa bhavitavyamasarvajñatāyā vaktṛtvāsarvajñatāyā vā avasthātvāt, vaktṛtvāvyabhicāriṇyā asarvajñatāyā vākyarūpeṇānumānātmakatayā sthitāyā itarasyāḥ padārthatayeṣṭāyā vā avasthātvāt, sā dvividhāpyasarvajñatā avasthaiva, tathā vastutvād viśeṣatvādityādi hetusaulabhyaṃ darśayati

nidarśanaṃ jñatvājñatvāvasthāvat, jñaṃ cetanaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam, ajñamaraṇyakāṣṭhādi, tadvat, vidhividhinayadarśanena jāgratsuṣuptāvasthe te ca, etat padārthaviṣayaṃ nidarśanam, vākyaviṣayaṃ nīlotpalaraktotpalatvavat

yathā jñamajñena ajñaṃ ca jñena vinā na bhavati nīlotpalamanīlenānutpalena raktotpalena vā vinā na bhavati tadviparyayeṇa vākyārthena tathā sārvajñyamasārvajñyena vinā na bhavati asārvajñyaṃ vā sārvajñyeneti
tamyādutkarṣavṛtteḥ sātiśayaparimāṇakaṃ vastu sapratipakṣaṃ bhāvaviśeṣatvād ghaṭavat
asarvātathyābhidhāyitābhyāṃ viparyayeṇa bhavitavyam, asarvajñatāyā vaktṛtvāsarvajñatāyā vā avasthātvād vastutvād viśeṣatvāt, jñatvājñatvāvasthāvad nīlotpalaraktotpalatvavat
ko vicāraḥ ? niścitamevaitat, tenāpi tattvato bhavitavyam
tena tu jñānātmakatvādātmanastadvijṛmbhitavikalpatvācca śabdasya puruṣasvarūpasyaiva tasya vacanaṃ yujyate uktatvād
atra tathā'sārvajñyena sārvajñyaṃ vinā na bhavati ityapi pāṭhaḥ kathañcit saṅgaccheta
itara āha --dhūmavattvāgnimattvāvasthāviparyayeṇāpi tarhi bhavitavyaṃ tattvataḥ, dhūmasyāvasthātmakāryasyāgnyavyabhicāriṇaḥ kvacit kadācidapyanagnāvadarśanādavasthātvaṃ saṃśayaheturityabhiprāyaḥ
ācārya āha — ko vicāraḥ ? niścitamevaitat, anagnirapi bhavatyevetyarthaḥ

tenāpi viparyayeṇāpi tattvato bhavitavyam, nanvidameva vartate jñānātmakaikakāraṇasyāgnyanagnyādisvāvasthātmakatvapratipādanasya prastutatvāt, evamagniṃ vyabhicārayiṣyāmaḥ, paramate tāvat pratijñārthaṃ bhāvayāmaḥ --tena tvityādi, jñānātmakatvādātmanastadvijṛmbhitavikalpatvācca śabdasya yaducyate yacchabda āha tadasmākaṃ pramāṇam pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
1 iti vyākaraṇavat pauruṣeyaṃ sarvasya tadātmakatvāt tadavasthāmātratvād vastutvādapi
nanu pratyakṣata eva vrīhyādi ekaṃ vastu ekasminneva kāle bhūmyabādi, sarvātmakatvād vrīheḥ
tatkāle tathā'grahaṇādapratyakṣateti cet, sarvāpratyakṣatā tarhi sadāpi
na hi yad yathā bhavati tathendriyairgṛhyate, tuṣakaṇādirūpādimātragrahaṇavṛttatvād vrīhyādicakṣurādipratyakṣasya yāvadrūpagrahaṇavṛttatvādrūpādipratyakṣasya

so'pi śabdo na puruṣapravṛttimantareṇa bhavituṃ vaktuṃ vārhatīti puruṣasvarūpasyaiva tasya vacanaṃ yujyate nānyathetyasminnarthe kāraṇamāha --uktatvād vacanatvād vyākaraṇavat pauruṣeyamiti sarvasya puruṣātmakatvaṃ darśayati
sarvasya tadātmakatvāt tadavasthāmātratvādityādi sarvo heturasminnarthe bhavati
itarathā sa naiva vacanaṃ syācchabdo'pauruṣeyatvāt kharaviṣāṇavat
kiṃ vā vacanaṃ na vacanamityanena ? naiva vā syādapuruṣātmakatvād vandhyāputravat
vyākaraṇavat pauruṣeyaṃ sarvasya tadātmakatvāt tadavasthāmātratvād vastutvādapi
nanu pratyakṣata eva vrīhyādi ekaṃ vastu ekasminneva kāle bhūmyabādi, sarvātmakatvād vrīheḥ
tatkāle tathā'grahaṇādapratyakṣateti cet, sarvāpratyakṣatā tarhi sadāpi
na hi yad yathā bhavati tathendriyairgṛhyate, tuṣakaṇādirūpādimātragrahaṇavṛttatvād vrīhyādicakṣurādipratyakṣasya yāvadrūpagrahaṇavṛttatvādrūpādipratyakṣasya
yaducyate tvayā ekasminneva kāle tasyaivaikasya vastuno'gnitvamanagnitvaṃ ceti tat pratyakṣādiviruddhaṃ sāmastyenābhāvāt
ācārya āha --nanu pratyakṣata ityādi, sarvapramāṇajyeṣṭhamūlapratyakṣata eva vrīhyādi, ādigrahaṇādāmrajambūphalādi ekaṃ vastvekasminneva vrīhyavasthānakāle bhūmyabādi, sarvātmakatvād vrīheḥ
katamo'sau vrīhiḥ kṣityudakabījādigatavarṇagandharasasparśādidharmapariṇatimantareṇa ? iti bhūmyādeḥ parasparadharmāpatteḥ sarvātmakatvam
tasmādabādireva vrīhistena vinā'bhāvāt tasya tathā bhavanāt vrīhisvātmavat
syānmatam--vrīhikāle bhūmyabādyātmakasya vastunastathā bhūmyabādiprakāreṇāgrahaṇānna tarhi tadvastupratyakṣaṃtadvastu pratyakṣaṃ syāt, na hi tadvastu vrīhimātrameveti
ucyate --sarvāpratyakṣatā tarhi sadāpītyādi, sarvasya vastunaḥ sadāpi sarveṇātmasvarūpeṇa grahaṇābhāvād na kasyacit pratyakṣatvaṃ syāt

vrīherapi pratyakṣatvaṃ nāsti yathā vidyate tathendriyairgrahaṇābhāvāt, indriyeṇa tu tuṣamātradarśanāt tanmātrasyāvrīhitvāt kaṇādyadarśanāt, kaṇamātrasyāpyavrīhitvāt kuṇḍakādyadarśanādityādi, rūparasagandhasparśānāmanyatamasyaivendriyaviṣayatvāt, ata āha --tuṣakaṇādirūpādimātragrahaṇavṛttatvād vrīhyādicakṣurādipratyakṣasya

syānmatam--rūpasya rūpamātratvāt tarhi pratyakṣatvamiti, etaccāyuktam, yāvadrūpagrahaṇavṛttatvād rūpādipratyakṣasya, rūparasagandhaśabdasparśā tasya ca catasro'vasthā jāgratsuptasuṣuptaturīyānvarthākhyāḥ
sarvajñatā vā turīyaṃ nirāvaraṇamohavighnaṃ nidrāviyoga ātyantiko nidrāsambandhijāgradādyavasthāvilakṣaṇamātmasvatattvam
rūpādayaḥ, te hi parasparāvinirbhāgavṛttayaḥ, teṣu rūpamātragrahaṇaṃ kathaṃ yathārthaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt ? iti nāsti pratyakṣam
sarvajñatā vā turīyaṃ nirāvaraṇamohavighnaṃ nidrāviyoga ātyantiko nidrāsambandhijāgradādyavasthāvilakṣaṇamātmasvatattvam
tasya anantarapratipāditacaitanyatattvasya imāścatasro'vasthā jāgratsuptasuṣuptaturīyānvarthākhyāḥ, jāgradavasthā suptāvasthā suṣuptāvasthā turīyāvasthā, etāścānvarthāḥ
tāśca bahudhā vyavatiṣṭhante, caturthīmavasthāṃ muktvā tisṛṇāmekaikasyāḥ pratiprakriyaṃ saṃjñādibhedāllokavyavahārabhedāccānekabhedatvāt
caturthī punarekasvarūpaiva viśuddhatvāt, athavā sāpi svarūpasāmarthyāt sarvātmanaivānekadhā viparivartate, tadyathā— jaṃ jaṃ je je bhāve pariṇamati payogavīsasādavvaṃ
taṃ taha jāṇāti jiṇo apajjave jāṇaṇā ṇatthi
athavā ūrdhvatiryagadholokāvibhāgā vā, yathāsaṅkhyameva, ūrdhvaloko jāgradavasthā, tiryaglokaḥ suptāvasthā, suṣuptāvasthā adholokaḥ, avibhāgāvasthā turīyāvasthā

saṃjñyasaṃjñyacetanabhāvā vā, saṃjñinaḥ samanaskā devamanuṣyanārakapañcendriyatiryañco jāgrati, suptā asaṃjñinaḥ pṛthivyabagnivāyuvanaspatidvitricaturindriyāmanaskapañcendriyāḥ, kāṣṭhakuḍyādayaḥ suṣuptāḥ, bhavanamātraṃ bhāvaḥ sarvatrāvibhāgā turīyāvastheti
jaṃ jaṃ je je bhāve pariṇamati payogavīsasādavvaṃ
taṃ taha jāṇāti jiṇo apajjave jāṇaṇā ṇatthi || āva॰ ni॰ 794
atrāha--avibhāgātmanastasyaivātmanaścaturavasthatvāt kālabhedābhāvācca catasro'pi prathamadvitīyatṛtīyaturīyākhyāḥ syuriti, etadayuktam, yasmānniyatā evaitā vimuktikramāt,
sarvajñatā vā turīyamiti, suṣuptāvasthāyāḥ sthirībhūtacaitanyāyāḥ suptāvasthā vimuktamalatvād dvitīyā mithyādṛṣṭyādikā, tṛtīyā samyagdarśanajñānacāritrātmikā muktipratyāsatteḥ, sarvajñatā caturthī

tat punasturīyaṃ nirāvaraṇamohavighnam, nirgatā jñānadarśanāvaraṇamohavighnā asminniti nirāvaraṇamohavighnam, mohasyaiva mahāsvāpatvāt, ekendriyādiṣu mahāmohanidrākṣayopaśamaśaktyā nirvṛttyupakaraṇendriyapratyayaṃ caitanyaṃ pratyakṣādipratyavekṣaṇātmakatvājjāgradavasthā karaṇātmā cetanātmā dravyapuruṣavat, arthasya ca tathā tathā tattvājjñānameva
tathā suptāvasthāpi jñānameva saṃśayādi īṣatsuptatā vastunastathā tathā tattvāt

tathā viparyayo'pi jñānameva tathā tathā tattvāt, styānarddhyudayasadbhāvādviśeṣeṇa svāpaḥ, aviśeṣeṇa tu sarvaprāṇināṃ samohānāṃ mithyādṛṣṭyacāritrāṇāṃ svāpāt, yathoktam --suttā amuṇī sayā, muṇiṇo sayā jāgaraṃti ācārāṅgasū॰ 1
tacca turīyaṃ kaivalyaṃ vigatāvaraṇamohavighnaṃ rāgadveṣamohapratīghātebhyo viviktatā darśanaṃ viśuddhaṃ pratipūrṇamekatvamiti tatparyāyāḥ
tadvyākhyānam --nidrāsambandhijāgradādyavasthāvilakṣaṇamātmasvatattvam, nidrāsambandhinyastisro'vasthā jāgratsuptasuṣuptākhyāḥ, tattadvilakṣaṇamātmanaḥ svaṃ tattvaṃ śuddhaṃ caitanyam
sa evānena vyākhyāvikalpena paramātmā vimuktaḥ sarvajña eva vyākhyāto veditavyaḥ
atra vimuktamalatvād dvitīyā, dvitīyā mithyādṛṣṭyādikā ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
mahāmohanidrākṣayopaśamaśaktyā nirvṛttyupakaraṇendriyapratyayaṃ caitanyaṃ pratyakṣādipratyavekṣaṇātmakatvājjāgradavasthā karaṇātmā cetanātmā dravyapuruṣavat, arthasya ca tathā tathā tattvājjñānameva
tathā suptāvasthāpi jñānameva saṃśayādi īṣatsuptatā vastunastathā tathā tattvāt
tathā viparyayo'pi jñānameva tathā tathā tattvāt,
karaṇātmānaṃ kāryātmānaṃ ca vyākhyāsyāmaḥ, tatra tāvanmahāmohetyādi yāvat karaṇātmā
darśana- cāritramohodaye yasmāt suptā mithyādṛṣṭayo'cāritrāśca prāṇinastasmād mahāmoha eva nidrā, tadudaye svāpaḥ, tatkṣaye vibodhaḥ
yathoktam— yadā tu manasi klānte buddhyātmānaḥ śramānvitāḥ

tasyā nidrāyāḥ kṣayopaśamo'nantānāṃ puruṣapariṇatyāpannāṣṭādaśavidhatadghātikarmaṇāmuditānāṃ kṣayādanuditānāmupaśamāllabdhiśaktirutpadyate tasminneva puruṣe jñānadarśanavīryavikalpā, tayā ghātikarmakṣayopaśamaśaktyā nirvartitāni kṛṣṇasāraśabalapakṣmapuṭākāreṇa cakṣuḥ śeṣendriyāṇi ca yathāsvamākāraiḥ, tānyeva copakṛtāni upakaraṇatvena masūrakakṣuraprātimuktacandrakayavanālikānekasaṃsthānaiḥ, tatastatpratyayaṃ labdhijanitanirvṛttyupakaraṇendriyapratyayaṃ caitanyamupayogo jāyate, labdhyupayogau bhāvendriyam tattvārtha॰ 2
yathoktam --ṇo sutte sumiṇaṃ pāsati, suttajāgariyāe vaṭṭamāṇe sumiṇaṃ pāsati bhagavatīsū॰ 16
sā cāpi jāgrada cetanātmā suptatvād dravyapuruṣavat
tathānadhyavasāyo'pi viśiṣṭasvāpo jñānameva cetanātmakatvājjāgaritavat, cetanācetanāt saṃśayādivat suptavat
vasthā karaṇātmākhyā cetanātmā cetanā evātmā, tasyaivārthasya jāgaraṇātmatvāt

dravyapuruṣavat, dravyapuruṣo bhūto bhāvī vā yathāyaṃ rājāsīd bhaviṣyati veti rājaiva ityucyate karacaraṇagatacakrapadmādyākṛtirekhādilakṣaṇadarśanāt, tadeva hi hihi śarīramanubhūtarājyaṃ bhaviṣyadrājyaṃ vā rājā tathā karaṇātmānaḥ svapanto jāgrato vā cetanātmaiva

anupayukto vā dravyapuruṣaḥ, tasmin jñeye'nupayuktatvāt, yathānupayukta odane'nātmatvena pariṇamita ātmasvarūpajñānatvenāpariṇamito dravyapuruṣo dravyātmaiva tathā karaṇātmā jñānopayogarahito'pi cetanātmaiveti

evaṃ tarhi paramātmanaḥ śuddhacetanātmatvāt sarvātmakatvācca tasya karaṇātmāvasthānupapattiriti cet, netyucyate, caitanyasya sarvātmakatāyāmapi sanidragrahaṇāt suptotthitasya sāvaśeṣanidrasyeva yajjñānaṃ sā jāgarāvasthā karaṇātmā, vyapagatanidrasyeva sarvajñāvasthā, ityanayoḥ karaṇātmaparamātmāvasthayorviśeṣaḥ

syānmatam--arthasvarūpāgrahaṇāt karaṇātmāvasthāyāḥ paramātmātyantavairūpyamiti, etaccāyuktam, kasmāt ? arthasya ca tathā tathā tattvājjñānameva, sa hyarthaḥ puruṣasṛṣṭeranekarūpatāyāḥ pratipāditatvādekātmaviparivarto'pyanekarūpa eva tena tena prakāreṇa tasya bhavanāt tathā tathā tattvāt, tadapi karaṇajñānaṃ jñānameva karaṇamapi jñānameva vā jñānaviparivartatvāt
yadā tu manasi klānte buddhyātmānaḥ śramānvitāḥ
viṣayebhyo nivartante tadā svapiti mānavaḥ || carakasaṃ॰ 1 | 21 | 35 iti
...catvāri jñānāni trīṇyajñānāni trīṇi darśanāni pañca labdhaya iti
sarvaghātispardhakānāmudayakṣayāt teṣāmeva sadupaśamād deśaghātispardhakānāmudaye kṣāyopaśamiko bhavati iti tattvārthādhigamasūtrasya pūjyapādācāryadevanandiviracitāyāṃ sarvārthasiddhivṛttau 2
sutte ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! suviṇaṃ pāsati, jāgare suviṇaṃ pāsati, suttajāgare suviṇaṃ pāsati ? goyamā ! no sutte suviṇaṃ pāsai, no jāgare suviṇaṃ pāsai, suttajāgare suviṇaṃ pāsai iti bhagavatīsūtre pāṭhaḥ
tathānadhyavasāyo'pi viśiṣṭasvāpo jñānameva cetanātmakatvājjāgaritavat, cetanācetanāt saṃśayādivat suptavat
yathā cedaṃ jñānaṃ tathā jāgradavasthāśeṣaḥ suptāvasthāprārambhamātraṃ suptāvasthā, sāpi jñānameva saṃśayādi īṣatsuptatā, ayamapi karaṇātmā saṃśayādi jñānam, ādigrahaṇād viparyayānadhyavasāyau
sā ca suptāvasthāpi satīṣatsuptatā jñānameva, pūrvavadeva sarvātmakatāyāṃ vastunastathā tathā tattvāt

sthāṇuḥ syāt puruṣaḥ syāt ? ityūrdhvatāsāmānyasya vastutvāt, yadi sthāṇurvayonilayanādiviśeṣāt yadi utthāyopaviṣṭatvakaracaraṇacalanādiviśeṣāt puruṣa ityubhayathāpi tasya vastunastathā tathā tattvāt sthāṇutvapuruṣatvābhyām

tathā viparyayo'pi jñānameva tathā tathā tattvādarthasya sthāṇupuruṣatvābhyāṃ viparyayeṇa ceti saiva vyākhyātrāpi, sādhanam --cetanātmā suptatvād dravyapuruṣavat, pūrvavadeva vyākhyā suptatvaṃ jāgrattvaṃ vā cetanasyaiva bhavati nācetanasya kasyacit

yathā caitajjñānaṃ tathānadhyavasāyo'pi, na adhyavasāyo'nadhyavasāyo'nabhivyaktabodhaḥ, so'pi saṃśayaviparyayābhyāṃ viśiṣyamāṇaḥ svāpaḥ suptatvājjñānameva, cetanātmakatvājjāgaritavat, yathā jāgaritāvasthā jñānameva cetanātmakatvāt tathānadhyavasāyo'pi
