cetanācetanāt, yasmāt tadeva cetanamacetanaṃ ca tasyaiva bahvacetanatvādalpacetanatvāccetanaṃ ca tadacetanaṃ ceti vigrahāccetanāyā evācetanādvā, saṃśayādivat, ādigrahaṇādviparyayanirṇayau gṛhyete tadvaccetanācetanājjñāna yathā caitat tathānadhyavasāyamapi dravyendriyapṛthivyādi kāryātmā jñānameva, suṣuptāvasthātmakatvāt, hālāhalānuviddhamadirāpānāpāditanidrāprasuptavadanadhyavasāyavat
yo'sau puruṣastadeva tat, tenātmatvena pariṇamitatvāt taddravyatvād bhūmyabādivrīhitvavat, tatkāryatvāt paṭatantuvat, tena vinā'bhūtatvāt tadvyatirekeṇā- mevānadhyavasāyaḥ
athavā suptavat, yathā hi supta ucchvāsaniḥśvāsādikriyāsu avyaktaṃ cetayamāno'pi jñātaivamanadhyavasāyo'pi karaṇātmaiva vyaktataraḥ svāpaḥ viśiṣṭasvāpa ityarthaḥ
asmiṃstu pāṭhe svārasye so'pi karaṇātmā ityartho jñeyaḥ
yathā caitat tathānadhyavasāyamapi dravyendriyapṛthivyādi kāryātmā jñānameva, suṣuptāvasthātmakatvāt, hālāhalānuviddhamadirāpānāpāditanidrāprasuptavadanadhyavasāyavat
yo'sau puruṣastadeva tat, tenātmatvena pariṇamitatvāt taddravyatvād bhūmyabādivrīhitvavat, tatkāryatvāt paṭatantuvat, tena vinā'bhūtatvāt tadvyatirekeṇā-

yathā caitadanantaravyākhyātamanadhyavasāyaviparyayasaṃśayāvitathapratyakṣādi jñānaṃ caitanyaṃ tathānadhyavasāyamapagatādhyavasāyamanadhyavasāyamacetanābhimataṃ dravyendriyapṛthivyādi kāryātmā ātmā, ātmanaivātmatvena pariṇamitatvādityādayo hetavo vakṣyante
sā ca suptāvasthā dravyendriyam, nirvṛttyupakaraṇadravyendriye vyākhyāte prāk, te ca puruṣeṇātmatvena pariṇamite

pṛthivyādi ca viparivartamānātmatvapariṇāmāpannameva, pṛthivyaptejovāyuvanaspatidvīndriyādi tat kāryātmā suṣuptāvasthā, tadapi jñānātmakameva suṣuptāvasthātmakatvāt, hālāhalānuviddhamadirāpānāpāditanidrāprasuptavat, yathā hālāhalaviṣeṇa sadyomārakeṇānuviddhāṃ madirāṃ pītvā tadāpāditāyā nidrāyā vaśamupagamya suṣuptaścetana eva sanna kiñcit cetayate puruṣastathā dravyendriyapṛthivyādi kāryātmā
athavā anadhyavasāyavat, yathā jāgarādipūrvavyākhyātāvasthābhyo viśiṣṭā suptāvasthānadhyavasāyākhyā jñānameva tadvat kāryātmāvasthā dravyendriyapṛthivyādi jñānameva
ata āha --yo'sau puruṣastadeva tad dravyendriyapṛthivyādi, tenātmatvena pariṇamitatvāt
ko vātra bhedaḥ pariṇāmakapariṇamyayoḥ ? ityāha --taddravyatvāt, sa eva dravyaṃ taddravyaṃ saprabhedaṃ karma, tasmāt taddravyatvāt

bhūmyabādivrīhitvavat, yathā bhūmyambvādyeva vrīhirvrīhitvena pariṇatatvāt taddravyatvād vrīhirbhūmyādireva bhūmyādibhirevātmatvena pariṇamitatvād vrīhirbhūmyādireva tathā pṛthivyādi puruṣa eva cetanātmakaḥ
itaśca yo'sau puruṣastadeva tat tatkāryatvāt, yad yasya kāryaṃ tadeva tat paṭatantuvat, yathā tantūnāṃ kāryatvāt paṭastantureva tathā puruṣa eva pṛthivyādi, puruṣapūrvakatvapratipādanasya kṛtatvāt
itaśca tena vinā'bhūtatvāt, tadeva tat tena vinā'bhūtatvāt, yad yena vinā na bhavati tadeva tat, bhāvāt taddeśatvācca ghaṭasvatattvapratyagrāditvavat
caitanyādātmā pṛthivyādisuṣuptāvasthāyā viparyayeṇa vṛtto rāgādyupayukta upayogasvātantryeṇa baddhvātmanātmānamasvatantrīkaroti, karmabandhena rūpādimattvamanādyanantaśa āpadyate
anādyanantaśaḥ sūkṣmasthūlaśarīrādirūpādimattvaṃ pratipadyate yathā rūpādaya eva pṛthivyādayaḥ pṛthivyādaya eva rūpādayaḥ, te'nyonyairvinā na bhūtatvādanyonyātmakāstathā puruṣa eva kāṣṭhādyapi
kiñcānyat, tadvyatirekeṇābhāvāt, yaddhi yadvyatirekeṇa na bhavati tadeva tat, yathā ghaṭasvatattvapratyagrāditvam
taddeśatvācca, tasya deśastaddeśaḥ, tatpuruṣasyaiva deśo'vayavaḥ svātmā rathyāpuruṣapāṇyādivat, taddeśatvaṃ sṛṣṭestatpūrvakatvāditi hetuḥ
yo yaddeśaḥ sa tatsvatattva eva, kimiva ? ghaṭasvatattvapratyagrāditvavat, yathā ghaṭasya pratyagrayuvamadhyamapurāṇatā ca ghaṭasvatattvameva tathā pṛthivyādya cetanamapi cetanapuruṣasvatattvameva
caitanyādātmā pṛthivyādisuṣuptāvasthāyā viparyayeṇa vṛtto rāgādyupayukta upayogasvātantryeṇa baddhvātmanātmānamasvatantrīkaroti, karmabandhena rūpādimattvamanādyanantaśa āpadyate
tatraiva punaḥ saṃsārasiddhyai yuktyopapādanārthaṃ prastūyate --caitanyādātmetyādi yāvad viparivartānantyavat

cetanabhāvaścaitanyam, tasmāccaitanyādātmā pṛthivyādisuṣuptāvasthāyā viparyayeṇa vṛttastata īṣadviśuddhāvastha ityarthaḥ, caitanyasya rāgādivipariṇāmād rāgāderbandhakāraṇatvāt tadupayukta upayogasvātantryeṇa, upayogo hi cetanā, tasya svātantryaṃ kartṛtvāt, mithyādarśanāviratipramādakaṣāyayogā bandhahetavaḥ tattvārtha॰ 8

1 iti vacanād rāgādyātmakakaṣāyavikalpātmakatvānmithyādarśanādīnāṃ tena svātantryeṇa baddhvātmanātmānamasvatantrīkaroti, tenaiva ca svayaṃ kṛtena bandhena asvatantrīkriyate madyeneva svayaṃ pītena madyapaḥ, svayaṃ pūritavegayā ḍolayeva vā puruṣo bhramyate karmaḍolayā, karmabandhena rūpādimattvamanādyanantaśa āpadyate
evametadubhayaṃ santatyā'nādyanantaṃ ca dravyārthatayā, yathoktam --puvviṃ bhaṃte ! kukkuḍī pacchā aṃḍae ? puvviṃ aṃḍae pacchā kukkuḍī ? rohā ! jā sā kukkuḍī sā kato ? aṃḍagāto
je se aṃḍae se kato ? kukkuḍīto
evaṃ rohā ! puvviṃ pi ete pacchā vi ete, do vi ete sāsatā bhāvā, aṇāṇupuvvī esā rohatti bhagavatīsū॰ 1
tathā savvajīvā ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! ekkamekkassa mātattāe pitittāe bhātittāe bhajjattāe puttattāe dhītittāe ? gotamā ! asati aduvā aṇaṃtakhutto bhagavatīsū॰ 12

nanvevamanādyanantatve sati aviveke caitanyarūpādimattvayostulye kimarthaṃ jñānātmakamityucyate, kiṃ rūpādimadātmakamiti nocyate sarvam ? naivaṃ parigrahe'pi kaściddoṣaḥ, asyaivārthasya sisādhayiṣitatvāt
tathāhitathā hi--jñasyaiva bhavanasyopapattestadanvayācca deśakālābhyāṃ bhavanaṃ sidhyati
etat prakriyayaiva pratipāditamapi sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ pratijñāyate --anādyanantaśaḥ sūkṣmasthūlaśarīrādirūpādimattvaṃ pratipadyate caitanyamiti

kutaḥ ? kāryātmatvāt, kāryātmatvaṃ ca tasya siddhaṃ rūpādipṛthivyādibhedarūpeṇa viparivṛtteḥ sādhitatvāt, iha tvanādyanantaśaḥ seti sādhyate, yo yaḥ kāryātmā sa so'nādyanantaśo viparivartamāno dṛśyate, tadyathā mṛdghaṭetyādi, dravyaṃ mṛd bhavati, mṛd ghaṭo bhavati, ghaṭaḥ kapālāni, tataḥ krameṇa śakala-śarkarā-dhūli-pāṃśu-truṭi-paramāṇavaḥ, tato rūpādayaḥ, rūpādibhyaḥ punarutkrameṇa paramāṇvādayo yāvaddravyāditvaviparivartānantyam
evaṃprakārasya bhavanasya svajātyaparityāgarūpasya deśakālabhedaikāntābhyupagame'nantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇadoṣatvānnānyathaitaditi pratipattavyam
puvviṃ bhaṃte ! aṃḍae pacchā kukkuḍī ? puvviṃ kukkuḍī pacchā aṃḍae ? rohā ! se ṇaṃ aṃḍae kao ? bhayavaṃ ! kukkuḍīo
sā ṇaṃ kukkuḍī kao ? bhaṃte ! aṃḍayāo
evāmeva rohā ! se ya aṃḍae sā ya kukkuḍī puvviṃ pete, pacchā pete, duvete sāsayā bhāvā, aṇāṇupuvvī esā rohā iti bhagavatīsūtre pāṭhaḥ
ayaṃ ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! jīve savvajīvāṇaṃ māittāe pitittāe bhāittāe bhagiṇittāe bhajjāttāe puttattāe dhūyattāe suṇhatāe uvavaṇṇapuvve ? haṃtā goyamā ! jāva aṇaṃtakhutto iti bhagavatīsūtre pāṭhaḥ

nanvevamanādyanantatve sati aviveke caitanyarūpādimattvayostulye kimarthaṃ jñānātmakamityucyate, kiṃ rūpādimadātmakamiti nocyate sarvam ? naivaṃ parigrahe'pi kaściddoṣaḥ, asyaivārthasya sisādhayiṣitatvāt
tathāhitathā hi--jñasyaiva bhavanasyopapattestadanvayācca deśakālābhyāṃ bhavanaṃ sidhyati

nanvevamanāditvāt kukkuṭyaṇḍakayorivānantatvācca kutsitā kuṭiḥ kukkuṭirityarthe kukkuṭiśabdasya śarīrārthavyākhyānācca muktasyāpi rūpādyarthajñānapariṇāmādaviveke caitanyarūpādimattvayostulye kimarthaṃ jñānātmakamityucyate, kiṃ vā kāraṇaṃ rūpādimadātmakamiti nocyate sarvam ? viśeṣaheturvā vācya iti taddarśayannāha paraḥ --nanvevamanādyanantatve satīti gatārtham

ācārya āha --naivaṃ parigrahe'pi kaściddoṣaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? asyaivārthasya sisādhayiṣitatvāccaturavasthātmakatvāt tasya, tata eva rūpādidravyendriyapṛthivyādirūpaḥ sa evocyate, tathā ca sṛṣṭeḥ pūrvamuktatvāt
āha--cetanācetanayoraikyāpādanaprastuteḥ jñaḥ puruṣaḥ, tanmayaṃ cedam, sa eva svatantro bhavati iti ca viśeṣya jñagrahaṇaṃ svatantragrahaṇaṃ ca kimarthamiti

bhavatīti bhāva ityuktam, bhāvasvarūpapradarśanārthaṃ tu yo bhavati sa vācya iti jñagrahaṇam, tadapi tathāhītyādinā ca evaṃ ca kṛtvā yat prāguktaṃ deśakālabhede bhavanābhāvadoṣo vakṣyamāṇaḥ iti tatparihāreṇa jñasyaiva bhavanasyopapattestadanvayācca sarvadeśakālātmasānnidhyād deśakālābhyāṃ bhavanaṃ sidhyati, tathā hi vastu bhavatīti śakyaṃ vaktum
tadbhinnetyādi, deśakālabhinnapṛthivyādibhedabhūtapadārthaparigrahe tu anyathā tu ghaṭabhavanaṃ yadetat pratyakṣasamprasiddhaṃ tadapi na sidhyati
kālabhedapratyayenāpi pratikṣaṇamavyapadeśyabhavanāt katarad ghaṭabhavanam, mṛdbhūtavrīhyādyambvādikālabhinnabhāvabhede mṛdabhāvāt parato'pi kapālādipāṃśuvrīhyādibhūteḥ
ghaṭādisarvātmakasyaikasya sattvasyābhāvāt pratyekatvasya cetaretarāsattvātmakatvāt kuto bhavanaṃ bhaviturghaṭādeḥ ?
yathā tu rūpādibhedena sarvabhedaparyantaṃ bhedaṃ vidhāya vijñānamātrameva vyavasthāpyate

tat katham ? deśabhedapratyayena tāvadityādi, grīvāpṛṣṭhakukṣibudhnauṣṭhādīnāṃ deśabhinnānāṃ kapālaśakalādīnāṃ ca yāvat paramāṇuśo rūpādiśo nirupākhyatvaśaśca bhedabhāve ghaṭabhavanaṃ na, sidhyatīti vartate
pṛthivyaptejovāyvādibhedānna dravyaṃ guṇakarmabhedādveti, tadeva hi dravyaṃ rūpagamanādiguṇakarmabhedād yāvannirupākhyatvabhedāt samudāyābhāvāccāsambandhānna dravyam
evaṃ tāvad deśabhede ghaṭabhavanaṃ na syāt, dravyādīnāmanupapatteḥ

kālabhedapratyayenāpi pratikṣaṇamavyapadeśyabhavanāt katarad ghaṭabhavanaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'tyantamasambaddhāyaḥśalākākalparūpādyātmakatvānupapatteḥ ? kiṃ kāraṇam ? mṛdbhūtavrīhyādyambvādikālabhinnabhāvabhede mṛdabhāvāt, asmanmatena mṛdbhūto vrīhyādirambvādiścaika eva kālāntarāvasthāne sati tatpariṇāmopapatteḥ, tvanmatena tu kālabhinnabhāvabhede kṣaṇe kṣaṇe navanavārthāsambandhād bhāvabhede vrīhireva vinaṣṭo mṛnna bhavati, na codakādi vinaṣṭaṃ mṛd bhavatīti nirbījatvānmṛdabhāvaḥ

mṛdabhāvācca ko ghaṭaḥ ? bhavanaṃ vā kiṃ syāt ? asmākaṃ tu sāmānyānvayād vrīhyādaya udakādaya eva vā mṛd bhavati ghaṭo bhavatītyādi yujyate, parato'pi kapālādipāṃśuvrīhyādibhūteḥ, ghaṭabhavanāt parato'pi ghaṭa eva kapālādi bhavati, kapālāderapi parato yāvaccharkarābhavanāt, pāṃśvāderapi parato vrīhyāderbhavanāt

na cedetadiṣyata evamprakārakaṃ bhavanaṃ tata evaṃ ghaṭādisarvātmakasyaikasya deśakālavyāpinaḥ sattvasyābhāvāt tvanmatenaiva pratyekatvasya ceṣṭasya tvayā itaretarāsattvātmakatvāt kuto bhavanaṃ bhaviturghaṭādeḥ ? ghaṭaḥ paṭātmanā nāsti paṭo'pi ghaṭātmaneti deśataḥ kālataśca prāk paścādvā na sa eveti na paṭo'sti na ghaṭa iti pratyekaṃ bhinnatve bhāvānāmabhāvāt ko ghaṭaḥ ? kiṃ vā bhavanam ?

yaiśca varṇyate vijñānamātratvaṃ deśabhedād ghaṭo bhidyamāno rūpādibhedena bhidyate yāvad nirupākhyaśaḥ kālabhedena ca bhidyamānaḥ paramaniruddhakṣaṇotpattivināśanirupākhyaśo bhidyata iti taiḥ sarvabhedaparyantaṃ bhedaṃ vidhāyāpi vijñānamātrameva tathāsmadupavarṇanavadevābhihitaṃ bhavati
anvāha ca--puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam

yathā tu tad vyavasthāpyate tathāsmaduktavadupavarṇitamabhinnamekaṃ vijñāna- mityuktaṃ bhavati, tataśca rūparasādighaṭapaṭādiviśvabhedātmakatvāt tasya, rūpādiparasparaviviktatve tu tadvijñānānvayābhāvād rūparasādibhedaparikalpanābhāvastadaṃśakalpanābhāvo nirupākhyatvakalpanābhāva iti vijñānamātratā na bhavati
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam

atha kaścid brūyāt--tadapi vijñānamasat sarvabhāvaśūnyatvāditi, etaccāyuktam, jñānasyāpi tvabhāvābhyupagame rūpādyapalāpabījanirūpaṇādinirmūlatvāt pratyakṣādivirodhāḥ, rūpādayo na santīti yadapalāpabījaṃ nirūpaṇaṃ tadapi nāstīti rūpādipratiṣedho na sidhyati, pratyakṣataśca svānubhavena rūpasya nirūpaṇamupalabhyate pratisvam, ādigrahaṇādāsvādanaghrāṇasparśanaśravaṇānubhavā upalabhyante, ataḥ pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
tadanusmaraṇadarśanādanumānavirodha ādigrahaṇāt, anusmaraṇaṃ hi svayamanubhūtasyārthasya nānanubhūtasya
tasmādavaśyamātmā jñānasvabhāva ekaḥ sarvabhāvavyāpī viparivartamāno'vasthitaḥ kāraṇamiti siddham

etasmādeva ātmavyāptiviparivṛttivyavasthitatvāddhetoruktena tulyamuktavad rūpādīnāṃ tattvād rūpaṇātmakatvājjñānasvabhāvātmāvasthāviśeṣamātratvāt sarvatra sarvabhāveṣu eṣa viśeṣastasyaiva kāraṇapadārthasyopakāraviśeṣebhyo'paro draṣṭavyaḥ--sannipatyopakāriṇī buddhirātmanaḥ sākṣādavyavahitā bhāvānāṃ svaparivartaviśeṣāṇāmupabhoge, bhoktā tu svayameva svaparayoḥ

ārādindriyāṇi karaṇatvāt dūrāt prakāśādayo'nugrāhakā indriyāṇāṃ davīyāṃso rūpādayo daviṣṭhā ghaṭādaya auṣadhavyañjaauṣadhābhyañjanādīni indriyāṇāṃ pāṭavajananādupakāryupakāritvena tadupodvalakarāścāhārāḥ sarvabhāvagatāsu jñānavṛttiṣvityata āha --sarvatra sannipatyārāddūrādupakāritvebhyo hetubhya ātmabuddhīndriyaprakāśarūpaghaṭauṣadhāhārādiṣu jñānavṛttirbhavatīti
anvāha ceti jñāpakam, etasminnarthe pūrvoktameva jainairvakṣyamāṇajñāpakārtham eko'pyahamaneko'pyaham bhagavatīsū॰ 18
puruṣa evedamityādi, evetyavadhāraṇe, bhavituranyasyābhāvāduktavat tasyaiva ca bhavanāt
idamiti dṛśyaspṛśyādi indriya ata eva tasya sarvatvasamprasiddhyā ātmādyākhyatā, mṛdanuttīrṇaghaṭapiṭharādivad bhvastyarthādibhyaḥ sarvasyānuttarāt sarvasyāsāvātmā svarūpaṃ tattvamityarthaḥ
kālatastu bhūtaṃ bhāvyamiti atītānāgatavartamānānāṃ pradarśanam, bhūtaśabdasya vartamānātītavācitvāt
amṛtatvasya akṣayatvasya īśānaḥ prabhavitā, sa hyakṣayo'jaro'maraḥ puruṣo jñānasyāvināśitvāt so'kṣayatvamanubhavatītyarthaḥ
yathoktam — akkharassa aṇaṃtabhāgo ṇiccugghāḍitao savvajīvāṇaṃ nandisū॰ 42 ti
tadvyākhyānanidarśanaṃ ca taṃ pi jadi āvarijjijja teṇa jīvo ajīvayaṃ pāve
suṭṭhu vi mehasamudaye hoi pabhā caṃdasūrāṇaṃ

yaditi yasmāt kāraṇādannenātirohati, adyate bhujyate'śyata ityannaṃ pudgaladravyaṃ tenaivātmanānādyanantaśo'pi viparivartitatvāt, tenānnenāsāvatirohati vardhata upacīyate tatsvārūpyād bālaka iva navanītāhāreṇa tena jñānakriyayorupaṣṭambhopalambhāt karaṇakāyavivṛddheśca
yathoktam --annaṃ vai prāṇāḥ, annamayo hyayaṃ puruṣaḥ, puri śayanāt puruṣaḥ , nājñasyaitat sarvaṃ ghaṭate'tirohati bhṛśaṃ rohatīti
ege bhavaṃ duve bhavaṃ akkhae bhavaṃ avvae bhavaṃ avaṭṭhie bhavaṃ aṇegabhūyabhāvabhavie bhavaṃ ? somilā ! ege vi ahaṃ jāva aṇegabhūyabhāvabhavie vi ahaṃ iti bhagavatīsūtre pāṭhaḥ 18
"ege bhavaṃ duve bhavaṃ aṇege bhavaṃ akkhae bhavaṃ avvae bhavaṃ avaṭṭhie bhavaṃ aṇegabhūyabhāvabhavie vi bhavaṃ ? suyā ! ege vi ahaṃ duvevi ahaṃ jāva aṇegabhūyabhāvabhavi
ata eva tasya sarvatvasamprasiddhyā ātmādyākhyatā, mṛdanuttīrṇaghaṭapiṭharādivad bhvastyarthādibhyaḥ sarvasyānuttarāt sarvasyāsāvātmā svarūpaṃ tattvamityarthaḥ
taṃ pi jadi āvarijjijja teṇa jīvo ajīvayaṃ pāve
suṭṭhu vi mehasamudaye hoi pabhā caṃdasūrāṇaṃ || nandisū॰ 42 iti
annaṃ vai candramāḥ, annaṃ prāṇāḥ, ubhayamevopaityajāmitvāya iti taittirīyabrāhmaṇe 3
etasmādeva kāraṇāt sarvatvasiddhistasya tattvajñānasvarūpasya, tayā ca punaḥ sarvatvasamprasiddhyā ātmādyākhyatā
sato bhāvaḥ sattvam, sa eva san bhavati cetyarthaḥ
puri śayanāt puruṣaḥ śarīre jagati vā svavijṛmbhitavikalpātmake
pūraṇād galanācca pudgalaḥ pumāṃsaṃ gilatīti vā pudgalaḥ, jīvaśarīratayā vibhajya bhoktṛbhogyabhāvād vṛddhihānibhyāmutpattivināśābhyāṃ pūraṇagalanābhyāmityarthaḥ
pañcendriyamanovākkāyabalāyurucchvāsaniḥśvāsākhyadaśaprāṇadhāraṇāt prāṇī jīva iti cocyate ityevamādyabhikhyāḥ sarvatve sati ghaṭante tena tena dharmeṇa vyapadeśāvirodhāt

mṛdanuttīrṇaghaṭapiṭharādivat, yathā mṛdo'nuttīrṇā ghaṭapiṭharādayo bhavanti santi vartanta ityādibhyo bhvastyādyarthebhyo nottaranti bhavanānuttarāt sarvadhātūnāṃ ca bhvādyarthatvādevaṃ jñānasvarūpaḥ kartā bhavati asti vartate jñānasvarūpabhavanānuttarāt

ata āha --bhvastyarthādibhyaḥ sarvasyānuttarāt, astibhavatividyatipadyativartatayaḥ sannipātaṣaṣṭhāḥ sattārthāḥ, bhvādayaśca sarvadhātavastadarthaṃ nātivartanta iti yāvadeva kiñcidutpadyate vinaśyati vyavasthitaṃ vā tasya sarvasyāsāvātmā svarūpaṃ tattvamityartha iti paryāyaiḥ svarūpopanayaḥ

syānmatam--svātmani vṛttivirodhāt kathamātmanātmānaṃ sṛjatyupasaṃharati ca badhyate mucyate ca ? na hyaṅgulyagramaṅgulyagraṃ spṛśati nāsirātmānaṃ chinattīti, etaccāyuktam, śaktibhedāt kārakabhedopapatteḥ, tantra tantravāyakakośakārakakīṭavacca tadātmakā evaite saṃhāravisargabandhamokṣāḥ

yena yatra yathā yasmād yadā yadarthaṃ ca pravartitavyaṃ vāyakakośakārakakīṭavacca tadātmakā evaite saṃhāravisargabandhamokṣāḥ, yathā tantravāyakīṭaḥ svaśarīrajayaiva lālayā tantraṃ prasārayatyupasaṃharati ca na cānyataḥ kutaścit tathātmana eva saṃhāravisargau
uktaṃ hi --yathorṇanābhiḥ sṛjate gṛhṇīte ca yathā pṛthivyāmauṣadhayaḥ sambhavanti
yathā sataḥ puruṣāt keśalomānīti vā, yathā sudīptāt pāvakādvisphuliṅgā bhavanti tathākṣarāt sambhavatīha viśvam muṇḍakopa॰ iti
bandhamokṣāvapi yathā kośakārakīṭaka ātmānaṃ veṣṭayati svaśarīravinirgatena kośena punaśca tatraiva pralīyate kaścicca kośakaṃ chidrīkṛtya nirgacchatyevamātmano bandhamokṣau nānyata iti
kiñcānyat, yathā ca sudīptādityādi, ayamapi dṛṣṭānto'gnisvatattvānativṛttyāgnirūpasambhavāt puruṣasya tatsādharmyapradarśanārtham, yathā'nvāha --yathā sudīptāt pāvakādityādi
atra yathā ca sudīptāt pāvakād visphuliṅgā bhavanti tathākṣarāt sambhavatīha viśvam
yena yatra yathā yasmād yadā yadarthaṃ ca pravartitavyaṃ
yathorṇanābhiḥ sṛjate gṛhṇate ca yathā pṛthivyāmoṣadhayaḥ sambhavanti
yathā sataḥ puruṣāt keśalomāni tathākṣarāt sambhavatīha viśvam
...tadetat satyam--yathā sudīptāt pāvakādvisphuliṅgāḥ sahasraśaḥ prabhavante sarūpāḥ
tathākṣarād vividhāḥ somya bhāvāḥ prajāyante tatra caivāpiyanti
atra yathā ca sudīptāt pāvakād visphuliṅgā bhavanti tathākṣarāt sambhavatīha viśvam
yathorṇanābhiḥ sṛjate gṛhṇate ca yathā pṛthivyāmoṣadhayaḥ sambhavanti
yathā sataḥ puruṣāt keśalomāni tathākṣarāt sambhavatīha viśvam
...tadetat satyam--yathā sudīptāt pāvakādvisphuliṅgāḥ sahasraśaḥ prabhavante sarūpāḥ
tathākṣarād vividhāḥ somya bhāvāḥ prajāyante tatra caivāpiyanti
sa evocyate kālo'pi, sa eva jñatvāt kalanāt kālaḥ, kala saṅkhyāne pā॰ dhā॰ 497, 1866, kalanaṃ jñānaṃ saṅkhyānamityarthaḥ
yathā cāhureke --kālaḥ pacati bhūtāni iti ślokaḥ
sattvarajastamaḥsvatattvān prakāśapravṛttiniyamārthān guṇānātmasvatattvavikalpāneva bhoktā prakurute iti prakṛtiḥ, yathāhureke-- ajāmekāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ bahvīḥ prajāḥ sṛjamānāṃ sarūpāḥ
rūpaṇādiniyamanānniyatiḥ, rūpaṇāccakṣuṣo viṣayo rūpameva na rasādayaḥ, rasanād raso rasanaviṣayo na rūpādaya ityādi niyamanānniyatiḥ
svo bhāva ātmanaiva svena rūpeṇa bhavanāt svabhāvaḥ
ajāmekāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ bahvīḥ prajāḥ sṛjamānāṃ sarūpāḥ
ajo hyeko juṣamāṇo'nuśete jahātyenāṃ bhuktabhogāmajo'nyaḥ || śvetāśva॰ 4 | 1 | 55
kaḥ kaṇṭakānāṃ prakaroti taikṣṇyaṃ vicitrabhāvaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ ca
etaccihnāntargatasya pāṭhasya sthāne kaḥ kaṇṭakānāmityādi ityeva ya॰ pratiṣu pāṭhaḥ
svabhāvataḥ sarvamidaṃ pravṛttaṃ na kāmacāro'sti kutaḥ prayatnaḥ || iti
kālaḥ pacati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharatisaṃharate prajāḥ
kālaḥ supteṣu jāgarti kālo hi duratikramaḥ
tena tatra tathā tasmāttadā tadarthaṃ ca pravṛttiḥ
tadantareva tasya, na tato vyatiriktam, sa eva hīdaṃ vṛttamavivṛttaṃ ca bahudhānakaṃ cetanācetanādiprabhedarūpam
tadantarasya sarvasya tadu sarvasyāsya bāhyataḥ || śuklayaju॰ vā॰ saṃ॰ 40 | 5
arhaṇabodhanetyāderviśuddhiprakarṣaviśeṣād devatā api sa eva, yāvadarhannapi bhavatiti sambhāvyate

yena hetunā yatra kṣetre yathā yena prakāreṇa yasmādāśrayād vastuno yadā yasmin kāle yadarthaṃ ca yat prayojanamuddiśya pravartitavyaṃ tena tatra tathā tasmāttadā tadarthaṃ ca pravṛttiḥ, tadyathā--rājñājñaptaḥ sūpakāraḥ sthālyāmodanaṃ kuśūlāt taṇḍulānāhṛtya mṛduviśadamodanaṃ peyātyaipūrvakaṃ kṣutpraśamanārthaṃ ca pacatīti
tat punaḥ pravartanaṃ tadantareva tasya puruṣasya, na tato vyatiriktaṃ bahirbhūtam
sa eva hīdam, sa eva puruṣo yasmādidaṃ sakalaṃ jagad vṛttaṃ tataḥ prasṛtaṃ nānābhedena vivartamānam, avivṛttaṃ ca tatsvarūpāparityāgāt
cetanācetanādiprabhedā rūpamasyeti cetanācetanādiprabhedarūpam, yacca cetanaṃ naratiryagamaranārakādi tatprabhedāśca rūpamasya kāṣṭhakuḍyaghaṭapaṭādyacetanaṃ ca saprabhedamasya rūpam
atra pravṛttiḥ, yathā rājñājñaptaḥ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
tadejati calati spandate, naijati na calati na spandate
tadu sarvasyāsya bāhyataḥ, tasyaivāloke'pi sadbhāvāt, sarvasyāsya iti lokagatabhāvanirdeśāt tasya bāhyamaloka iti
atra tadvantike iti yajurvede pāṭhaḥ, evaṃ cātra nayacakravṛttau tadu cāntike ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

arhaṇabodhanetyāderviśuddhiprakarṣaviśeṣād devatā api sa eva, arhati sarvalokātiśayapūjā ityarhan, budhyata iti buddhaḥ, vardhanād bṛhattvād brahmā vardhamāno vā, vyāpnotīti viṣṇurjñānātmanaiva sarvānarthān, īśanādīśvaraḥ, etebhyaśca jñānaviśuddhyutkarṣabhedebhyastatparyantaprāpteryāvadarhannapi bhavatīti sambhāvyate, duṣprāpatvādārhantyasya sambhāvanayocyate, śeṣapadaprāptistu sulabhaiveti, tāmapi ca durāpāṃ sarvajñāvasthāṃ paramaviśuddhāṃ paramarṣyākhyāṃ sa eva prāptumarhatīti
satyaṃ yuktametaducyate tvayā--tanna bhavataḥ svātantryamupalabhyamānaṃ pacāviva śakyamapahnotum
sa yadi jñaḥ svatantraśca, nātmano'narthamaniṣṭamāpādayed vidvadrājavat
nanu tajjñatvādyayuktataivaiṣā samarthyate, yuktatvābhimatatve'pi cāyameva niyamaḥ kartrantaratvāpādanāya
tanniyamakāriṇā bhavanasya kriyātvāt, yā kriyā sā bhavitureva ghaṭādeḥ paramāṇvādervā, yathā pacikriyā paktureva bhavati svatantrasya
bhavanamapi ca kriyā, kriyātvād bhavitrā vinā na bhavati, pacivat
bhavitā ca kartā, kartā ca svatantraḥ, kartṛtvādeva na kenacidasau bhāvyate kāryate vā svātantryāt kartṛtvāt
yattu sa jña iti sampradhāryametat, yat punarucyate svātantryāt kartā jña eva ityavadhārya tatra tvayā sahaitat sampradhāryaṃ vicārya- masti, sarvajñameva ityayuktamityabhiprāyaḥ

kiṃ kāraṇamayuktam ? sarvajñasyaiva bhavanābhyupagame doṣadarśanāt, kartṛtvāt svātantryamastu, ko vārayati ? sa yadi jñaḥ svatantraścetyubhayaguṇasampanna iṣyate yadi jñaḥ san svatantro'pi syād nātmano'narthamaniṣṭamāpādayet jñatve sati svatantratvāt

ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? vidvadrājavat, yathā hi daivapauruṣagatijño deśakālasahāyasādhanasampannaḥ parākramavān rājā nātmano'narthamaniṣṭamaraṇaparājayādimāpādayatyevamasāvapi nātmano'narthamaniṣṭamāpādayet, dṛṣṭastvayamanartho'niṣṭo janmajarāmaraṇarogaśītoṣṇādiḥ śārīro mānasaśca śokabhayaviṣāderṣyāsūyādiḥ, tasmādayuktamasya jñatvamiti
sa yadi jñaḥ svatantraśca, nātmano'narthamaniṣṭamāpādayed vidvadrājavat
nanu tajjñatvādyayuktataivaiṣā samarthyate, yuktatvābhimatatve'pi cāyameva niyamaḥ kartrantaratvāpādanāya

naitadupapadyate anarthāniṣṭāpādanānupapattirjñasyātmanaḥ iti, kasmāt ? nidrāvadavasthāvṛtteḥ, nidrāvatyavasthā nidrāvadavasthā, tayā vṛttirnidrāvadavasthāvṛttiḥ, tasyā vṛtteḥ puruṣatāyā evāsvātantryāt, jñasyāpi svakṛtanidrāvadavasthāvṛttivaśādasvātantryāt

āhitavegavitaṭapātavat, yathā kaścit puruṣaḥ svayameva pūritavegastaṃ vegaṃ nivartayitumaśakto vitaṭe patati tathā svatantramapi jñamapi tat paraṃ kāraṇamātmano'niṣṭamanarthamāpādayet, ko doṣaḥ ? iti atra doṣakutūhalaṃ ced brūmaḥ --nanu tajjñatvetyādi, nanvevaṃ tvayā nidrāvadavasthāvṛttivaśādāhitavegavitaṭapātavadavasthā'svātantryādanarthāniṣṭānayanam iti bruvatā tajjñatvādyayuktataivaiṣā samarthyate, tena anayā pūritavegayā śīghragamanakriyayā vitaṭapāto bhaviṣyati ityajñātatvāt, jñātatve vitaṭapātaḥ svatantrasya nopapadyata iti sa eva doṣaḥ
yadyapi svātantryajñatvāvinābhāvibhavanabalopabṛṃhitamātmamayatvamevāsya sarvasya manyase tathāpi tu ayameva niyamaḥ kartrantaratvāpādanāya bhavatīti vākyaśeṣaḥ

kathaṃ kṛtvā tad bhāvyata iti cet, ucyate --bhavati karteti prāgabhihitākṣarārthanyāyaṃ tadīyamevoccārayati yāvadacetano'pi bhavatīti tvayaiva kāraṇāntarāstitvamevaṃ bruvatā samarthitaṃ bhavati kiñcidāsāmavasthānām, pacāviva jñājñasvatantrāsvatantrasvaviṣayaniyatakartṛkaraṇādhikaraṇakarmādiniyataśaktidarśanād devadattakāṣṭhasthālītandulodakādīnāṃ kāraṇenāvaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ teṣāṃ tathābhāvānyathābhāvābhāvāditi niyatirevaikā kartrī
na hi tasyāṃ kadācit kathañcit tadarthānyarūpyamekatvavyāghāti
anvāha ca— prāptavyo niyatibalāśrayeṇa yo'rthaḥ so'vaśyaṃ bhavati nṛṇāṃ śubho'śubho vā
bhūtānāṃ mahati kṛte'pi hi prayatne nābhāvyaṃ bhavati na bhāvino'sti nāśaḥ

kiṃ kāraṇam ? teṣāṃ tathābhāvānyathābhāvābhāvāt, devadatto'dhiśrayaṇodakasecanatandulāvapanaidho'pakarṣaṇādivyāpārasvātantrya eva niyato na jvalanasambhavanadhāraṇaviklittyādivyāpārasvātantrye, evaṃ śeṣāṇāmapi kāṣṭhādīnāṃ karaṇādisvavyāpāraviṣayasvātantryaniyamastathābhāvaḥ

tasmānniyatatvānniyamakārikāraṇāpekṣaniyamā eva bhāvāḥ, tacca kāraṇaṃ nānyadato bhavitumarhati niyaterityata āha --iti niyatirevaikā kartrī, itiśabdo hetvarthe, asmāddhetorniyamakārikāraṇāvinābhāvād bhāvaniyamasya niyatirevaikā kartrī ityastu nirdoṣā kalpanā
katham ? yasmād na hi tasyāṃ kadācit kathañcit tadarthānyarūpyamekatvavyāghāti
jñānātmakaikakāraṇavāde pṛthivyādyacetanamakāraṇānurūpamityasti vyāghāto'vasthāsu catasṛṣvapi kalpitāsu, kāraṇapūrvatvābhyupagamāt kāryāṇām
na hi niyaterniyamamātrasya kartryā bhāvānāṃ sārūpyavairūpyabhede'pi vyāghāto'sti
prāptavyo niyatibaletyādi, kṛte'pi yatne kāryavipattidarśanādakṛte'pi nidhyādidarśanasampattidarśanāt kāryasya kāraṇānurūpaguṇastadvairūpyavirodhaparihārasamartho'sti
kāraṇenāvaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ teṣāṃ tathābhāvānyathābhāvābhāvāditi niyatirevaikā kartrī
na hi tasyāṃ kadācit kathañcit tadarthānyarūpyamekatvavyāghāti
anvāha ca— prāptavyo niyatibalāśrayeṇa yo'rthaḥ so'vaśyaṃ bhavati nṛṇāṃ śubho'śubho vā
bhūtānāṃ mahati kṛte'pi hi prayatne nābhāvyaṃ bhavati na bhāvino'sti nāśaḥ
prāptavyo niyatibalāśrayeṇa yo'rthaḥ so'vaśyaṃ bhavati nṛṇāṃ śubho'śubho vā
bhūtānāṃ mahati kṛte'pi hi prayatne nābhāvyaṃ bhavati na bhāvino'sti nāśaḥ
ko'sau pratikārakaṃ kriyābhedaḥ pacādīnām ? adhiśrayaṇodakāsecanataṇḍulāvapanaidho'pakarṣaṇakriyāḥ pradhānasya kartuḥ pākaḥ
droṇaṃ pacatyāḍhakaṃ pacatīti sambhavanakriyā dhāraṇakriyā cādhikaraṇasya pākaḥ
droṇaṃ pacatyāḍhakaṃ pacatīti sambhavanakriyāṃ = grahaṇakriyāṃ dhāraṇakriyāṃ ca kurvatī sthālī pacati ityucyate
edhāḥ pakṣyanti ā viklitterjvaliṣyantīti jvalanakriyā karaṇasya pākaḥ
edhāḥ pakṣyanti ā viklitterjvaliṣyantīti jvalanakriyāṃ kurvanti kāṣṭhāni pacanti ityucyante
katamo'sau ? ayatnapratipādyatāguṇaḥ, sa ca mūrtāmūrtādyayuktaviruddhadharmāpattiparihāreṇeti taddarśayati --na ca mūrtāmūrtetyādi yāvad yatnapratipādyatvamastīti

tena tena prakāreṇa tathā tathā mūrtatvena amūrtatvena cetanatvena acetanatvena saukṣmyeṇa sthaulyena ca aiśvaryeṇa dāridryeṇa cetyādinā pravibhaktānāmarthānāṃ sarvaṃ vastu jñeyaṃ sadarthaḥ ityādinā cāpravibhaktānāṃ sarveṣāmarthānāṃ yathātathābhāvo yāthā teryatnapratipādyatvamasti
prayatnasādhyeṣvartheṣu kṛtakeṣvapi ca tadviṣayakriyāphalasya tathāniyatervyāpitā niyatikāraṇatvasya
paramārthato'bhedāsau kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ, bhedavadbuddhyutpattāvapi paramārthato'bhedāt, bālādibhedapuruṣatvavat

tathyam, tena yāthātathyena tasya tasyārthasya sarvasya niyamena tiṣṭhataḥ prayojakatvaṃ hetukartṛtvaṃ sthāpanam, taccaikarūpameva sarvatra tasyā niyateḥ, tasmāddhetostathātathāpravibhaktāpravibhaktasarvārthayāthātathyasthāpanaikarūpatvānniyaternedānīṃ niyamanamātraikavyāpārāyā niyaterhetutvapratipādanāya yatnaḥ kaścidāstheyaḥ
prayatnasādhyeṣvartheṣu kṛtakeṣvapi ca tadviṣayakriyāphalasya tathāniyatervyāpitā niyatikāraṇatvasya
paramārthato'bhedāsau kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ, bhedavadbuddhyutpattāvapi paramārthato'bhedāt, bālādibhedapuruṣatvavat
prayatnasādhyeṣvartheṣu kṛtakeṣvapi ca tadviṣayakriyāphalasya tathāniyatervyāpitā niyatikāraṇatvasya

syānmatam--niyatinibaddhatvāt sarvabhāvānāṃ kriyākriyāphalayoraniyama iti, tanna bhavati, tadviṣayasya ghaṭādiviṣayasya mṛtpiṇḍadaṇḍacakrādisādhanasya prayatnasādhyasya ghaṭātmanirvṛttirūpasya kriyāphalasya tena prakāreṇa niyaterniyatirevātra kāraṇamiti
idānīṃ tasyā niyateḥ svarūpaṃ cintyate--kiṃ tāvat teṣāmeva bhāvānāṃ svaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ pratibhāvaṃ bhinnaṃ niyatirucyate, uta abhedā sā ? iti
atra paramārthato'bhedāsau kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ, nāsyā bheda ityabhedā

athavā ko'sau bhedo nāma niyaterapi ? kriyāsādhyāsādhyārtharūpatvād bhāvānāṃ niyama iti cetanācetanatvādibuddhyutpattāvapi satyāṃ paramārthato niyatirityevābhinnatvādabhedā, bhedabuddhistu tadvikalpamātrabhāvāpekṣā
vi॰raṃ॰hī॰ vinānyatra kiyākriyākriyāniyata॰ pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ya॰
āha--kathaṃ paramārthato nāsti bhedo bhedabuddhyābhāsabhāve'syāḥ ? dṛśyamāne hi bhedabuddhyābhāsabhāve kiñcit kriyayā sādhyaṃ kiñcinneti kiñcit svata eva kiñcit parata iti
athavā paramārthatastu bheda evāstu satyapyabhedabuddhyābhāsabhāve satīti ācāryo dvidhāpi codite parihāramāha --kathamityādi
yadi bhedo'bhimatastatra kathaṃ paramārthato bhedaḥ ? abhedabuddhyābhāsabhāve'pyabhedābhyanujñānāt tvayaiva, abhedavadābhāsate bheda eveti

yadyekāntabuddhistvanmatena paramārthaviṣayatve tadā tadābhāsād dvidhāpi cābhedasyābhyanujñānādevā sā ca tadatadāsannānāsannā, tasyā eva tadatadāsannānāsannanānāvasthadravyadeśādipratibaddhabhedāt, meghagarbhavat
na kālādayaṃ vicitro niyamaḥ, varṣārātrādiṣvapi kvacidayathartupravṛtteḥ
na ca svabhāvāt, bālyakaumārayauvanasthavirāvasthāḥ sarvasvabhāvatvād yugapat syuḥ, bhedakramaniyatāvasthotpattyādidarśanānna svabhāvaḥ kāraṇam
kimiva ? vyavacchinnasthāṇupuruṣatvavat, paramārthataḥ sthāṇureva vā puruṣa eva veti vyavacchinne vastuni yathordhvatāsāmānyasyābhedasya darśanādabheda evaṃ sarvaniyatiṣu kriyā-kriyāphalarūpāsviti
sā ca tadatadāsannānāsannā, tasyā eva tadatadāsannānāsannanānāvasthadravyadeśādipratibaddhabhedāt, meghagarbhavat
na kālādayaṃ vicitro niyamaḥ, varṣārātrādiṣvapi kvacidayathartupravṛtteḥ
na ca svabhāvāt, bālyakaumārayauvanasthavirāvasthāḥ sarvasvabhāvatvād yugapat syuḥ, bhedakramaniyatāvasthotpattyādidarśanānna svabhāvaḥ kāraṇam
sā punarniyatirbhedābhedarūpā, kasmāt ? iti sakāraṇaṃ svarūpanirūpaṇamasyā ucyate --sā cetyādi
sā ca niyatistadeva, sarvaniyatiṣu tasyā evāviśeṣāt
iha ca svargādiṣu ca tathāniyaterāsannānāsannā ca

kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasyā eva tadatadāsannānāsannanānāvasthadravyadeśādipratibaddhabhedāt, sā ca asā ca āsannānāsannā ca nānāvasthā yeṣāṃ te tadatadāsannānāsannanānāvasthā dravyadeśādayaḥ, taiḥ pratibaddhāyāstasyā eva niyaterbhedāddravyāditvena
saiva niyatirdravyato ghaṭarūpeṇa sā bhavati, paṭarūpeṇāsā

kṣetrato yasmiṃścakramūrdhani kriyate tasminneva yatra vā bhūpradeśe tiṣṭhati grīvādideśe vā tatraiva nānyatreti, kālato yāvatkālena nirvartate yāvantaṃ vā kālaṃ tiṣṭhati sā kālaniyatiḥ, bhāvato yairvarṇākṛtyādibhiryathā bhavati tathaiveti niyatiḥ, evaṃ dravyadeśādipratibaddhabhedād vastuviracanā niyatyekatve'pi

kimiva ? meghagarbhavat, yathā meghā garbhaṃ gṛhṇanto yādṛg yāvacca jalaṃ gṛhṇanti yathā ca tādṛk tāvat tathaiva ca visṛjanti dravyataḥ, kṣetrato yatra gṛhṇanti deśe tatraiva nisṛjanti, kālato mārgaśiramāse gṛhītaṃ vaiśākhe nisṛjantītyādi, bhāvato yathā gṛhītaṃ kṣāramadhurādi tathaiva visṛjanti sattvauṣadhivanaspatiśoṣapoṣakarādīti
tadupasaṃharati --nābhāvibhāvo na bhāvināśa iti prāktanena vṛttena gatārtham
syānmatam--ayaṃ niyamaḥ kālāt, kālasya kramākhyatvāt pūrvottarādikālakramaniyatapariṇāmatvācca bhāvānāmiti

dṛśyate hyaṅkurakiśalayapatrapuṣpaphalagarbhaprasavādivyabhicāro vanaspatyādīnāṃ sattvānāṃ ca svataḥ prayogataśca varṣāśaraddhemantaśiśiravasantanidāgheṣu svapariṇāmakāleṣvapravṛttidarśanādasvakāleṣu ca kvacit pravṛttidarśanāt
yadyapi manyeta svabhāvāditi, tanna ca svābhāvādityādi yāvadabhyupagamavirodhaḥ
vanaspatisattvāderbālyakaumārayauvanasthavirāvasthāḥ sarvo'sāvasya svo bhāvaḥ svabhāva ityato bālādikāla eva tadanabhyupagame sarvāviveke'vasthāsvabhāvādyabhāvādabhyupagamavirodhaḥ
yathā loka ityekatva eva parvatādyākārāvagraho yathā jñānamekatve'pyanekabodhyākāraṃ bhavati anyathā jñānātmalābhābhāvāt tathā niyamātmakatvāt sā vrīhirityekasmin vastunyekā anekā cāṅkurādi bhavati
utpātādiṣvaniyamadarśanādaniyatikāraṇatvam, dṛṣṭaṃ hi prasavādivaikṛtamiti cet, na, atrāpi tathāniyativaśena...
yuvatādyavasthā yugapat syuḥ, na ca bhavanti
tasmād bālakāla eva yuvādiyugapadabhāve bhedakrameṇa niyatā yāstāsāmavasthānāmutpatteḥ sthiteścyuteśca darśanānna svabhāvaḥ kāraṇam
kiṃ tarhi ? niyatireva kāraṇama- bhyupagantavyam, tathā tu tena hetunā tena prakāreṇa dṛṣṭotpattyādyavasthābhedakramaniyamena tat tathāniyati vastu

tadanabhyupagame sarvaviveke sarvāvasthānāmaviveke'bhyupagamyamāne svabhāvādyabhyupagame sati tā avasthā na syuḥ, te cāvasthārūpāḥ svabhāvā na syurdevadattāderbālyādyāḥ suptādyā vā, tato'vasthāsvabhāvādyabhāvādabhyupagata eva svabhāvo na syāt
ādigrahaṇāt tattadavasthāsahavartinaḥ pāṇyādyavayavasvabhāvasya rūpādibāhyaguṇasvabhāvasya paṭujaḍatādyāntaraguṇasvabhāvasya vā'bhāvādabhyupagamavirodhaḥ
athavā ādigrahaṇāt kālasyāpi pūrvoktanyāyena yugapadabhāvena vā'bhāvādabhyupagamavirodhaḥ kālakāraṇino'pi
tasmādidaṃ prāptamabhyupagantuṃ tadviniyamo niyateranyato nāvatiṣṭhata iti
yathā loka ityekatva eva parvatādyākārāvagraho yathā jñānamekatve'pyanekabodhyākāraṃ bhavati anyathā jñānātmalābhābhāvāt tathā niyamātmakatvāt sā vrīhirityekasmin vastunyekā anekā cāṅkurādi bhavati
utpātādiṣvaniyamadarśanādaniyatikāraṇatvam, dṛṣṭaṃ hi prasavādivaikṛtamiti cet, na, atrāpi tathāniyativaśena...
tasyā eva niyaterekatvānekatvavirodhaparihārārthaṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha --yathā loka ityekatva eva parvatādyākārāvagrahaḥ
eka eva lokaḥ saritsamudramahīmahīdhragrāmārāmādibhirākārairavagṛhyamāṇo bhidyate tathā bhedābhedarūpeṇa niyatiḥ, etad bāhyaṃ nidarśanam
sā niyatirvrīhirityekasmin vastunyekā mūlādibhede vāṅkura ityevābhinnā
ekāpi satī bhinnā, anekāpi satī na bhinnā tathātathāniyatārthavaśāt
ekatvasyāvirodhena śabdatattve brahmaṇi samuccitā virodhinya ātmabhūtāḥ śaktayaḥ
na hi jñeyagato vṛkṣādyākārāvagraho jñānasyaikatvena virudhyate, nāsyākārāt tadākārasyātmabhedo'sti teṣāmekajñānatattvānatikramāt
atra bhidyate, bhedābhedarūpeṇa niyateretad bāhyaṃ nidarśanam

dravyadeśakālabhāvānāmutpātādiṣvaniyamadarśanādaniyatikāraṇatvam, dṛṣṭaṃ hi prasavādivaikṛtam, ādigrahaṇāt prasavanilayāhārakriyāprakṛtivaikṛtāni, naratiraścāṃ viparyayeṇa saṅkhyākṛtivarṇāvayavā vastusvabhāvavyatikramaśca niyativaśādeva
kiñcit sadasādhyam, kiñcidasadasādhyam, kiñcidasat sādhyam, kiñcicca sat sādhyam
sadapi cākāśaṃ bhūgandhavadanabhibhavaṃ santamasasthaghaṭavat pradīpādineva avyaṅgam

idaṃ tu tadvyavasthāviparītaniyati vandhyāputrādyasādhyameva, kriyā hi sādhaneṣu vartamānā santamarthaṃ sādhyamāviśati pratyarthaniyatatvāt sādhanānuṣaṅgasya, sādhyasyābhāvādvandhyāsutādeḥ strīpuṃsasamprayogakriyā kimāviśatu ? idaṃ punarasat sādhyaṃ ghaṭādi prāk tathā'vṛttam
idama- dijanmāni abhakṣyabhakṣitvaṃ grāmyāraṇyakajalasthalajanmanāṃ taccāriṇāṃ ca vasatyādiviparyayaḥ
ityevamādivaikṛtadarśanānna niyatireva kāraṇamiti cet, netyucyate, atrāpi tathāniyativaśenetyādi yāvadvyatikrama upalabhyata iti sāpi tādṛśī niyatireva kāraṇamiti
kiñcit sadasādhyam, kiñcidasadasādhyam, kiñcidasat sādhyam, kiñcicca sat sādhyam
sadapi cākāśaṃ bhūgandhavadanabhibhavaṃ santamasasthaghaṭavat pradīpādineva avyaṅgam

idaṃ tu tadvyavasthāviparītaniyati vandhyāputrādyasādhyameva, kriyā hi sādhaneṣu vartamānā santamarthaṃ sādhyamāviśati pratyarthaniyatatvāt sādhanānuṣaṅgasya, sādhyasyābhāvādvandhyāsutādeḥ strīpuṃsasamprayogakriyā kimāviśatu ? idaṃ punarasat sādhyaṃ ghaṭādi prāk tathā'vṛttam
atra abhakṣyabhakṣyatvam iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīno bhāti abhakṣyo grāmaśūkaraḥ, pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ ityādiprasiddheḥ, athavā narā abhakṣyāḥ, tiryañco bhakṣyāḥ ityartho jñeyaḥ
kiñcānyat, na kevalaṃ prasavādidharmavyatikrama eva, kiṃ tarhi ? vastusvabhāvavyatikramaśca niyativaśādeva
kiñcit sadasādhyamityādi caturbhaṅgī sphuṭārthatvānna vivriyate, sā coddiṣṭā nirdekṣyamāṇā ca
tathā ca puruṣo niyatereva tathā vṛttatvāt tatsādhyāsādhyatve pratipadyate
tatra sadasādhyatve nidarśanam --sadapi cākāśaṃ bhūgandhavadanabhibhavam, nāsyābhibhavo'stītyanabhibhavaṃ salilasekeneva na sādhyamityarthaḥ
santamasasthaghaṭavat pradīpādinevāvyaṅgam, kiṃ tat ? ākāśādi, sattvāt sādhyaṃ bhūgandhavaditi prāpte'pyasādhyameva
idaṃ tu strīpuṃsayogāt sādhyamavandhyāputravaditi prāpte tadvyavasthāviparītaniyati vandhyāputrādyasādhyameva niyativaśādevāsattvāt
kiṃ kāraṇam ? sādhanāviṣṭakriyāsādhyatvāt sādhyānāṃ sādhanāviṣṭāyāḥ kriyāyāstatrāveśābhāvaḥ, tatsādhanānāṃ sādhanaśaktiśūnyatvāt

tasmād vandhyāputrādīnāmasādhyatvaṃ strīpuṃsayogakriyayāpyasādhyatvena niyatatvāt, sādhyārthābhāve ca sādhanānāṃ sādhanatvābhāva iti taddarśayati --kriyā hītyādi, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmāt kriyā sādhaneṣu kāṣṭhādiṣu vartamānā santamarthaṃ sādhyaṃ vikledyatandulavipariṇāmātmakamodanādikamarthamāviśati pratyarthaniyatatvājjvalanādyupanidhānārtheṣu pratyekaṃ niyatatvāt kāṣṭhādisādhanānuṣaṅgasya, sādhyasyābhāvādvandhyāsutādeḥ sā strīpuṃsasamprayogakriyā kimāviśatu ? tasmāt tadvyavasthāviparītaniyati asādhyaṃ vandhyāputrādi

itara āha--yadyasat kathaṃ sādhyaṃ khapuṣpavaduktāsada nyat satatopalabdhiniyataṃ yaṣṭisādhanavadṛjutvena mṛddravyamūrdhvāditvakramāpādyaghaṭatvena bhedenaiva vā sat sādhyaṃ puruṣādi sthāṇvādiparigrahāpanayanena

etacca sādhyamānamanayaiva kriyayā sādhyate, etasyāśca etānyeva kārakāṇi, evaṃevaṃ ca niyatisthiteḥ kārakāntarasamavasthititulyatāyāmapi puruṣastathā pratipadya pratyarthaṃ sādhyavikalpānativṛtteśceti

atrocyate--naiṣa doṣaḥ, sato'nyadasat ityato'nyatravidhānapratiṣedhapakṣāśrayaṇād dravyārthavikalpatvānniyaterasattvābhāvādityata āha --prāk tathā avṛttaṃ tena ghaṭatvaprakāreṇāvṛttam, sacchabdasya vṛttyarthatvāt, astibhavatividyatipadyativartatayaḥ sannipātaṣaṣṭhāḥ sattārthāḥ iti vaca- nādasadityavṛttamityarthaḥ, mṛtpiṇḍādyavasthānakāle tatkāle'vyaktyā niyataṃ sādhyam
ādigrahaṇāt paṭakaṭādīti, etat kālabhedena upalabdhyanupalabdhibhyāṃ niyatam
nyat satatopalabdhiniyataṃ yaṣṭisādhanavadṛjutvena mṛddravyamūrdhvāditvakramāpādyaghaṭatvena bhedenaiva vā sat sādhyaṃ puruṣādi sthāṇvādiparigrahāpanayanena
etacca sādhyamānamanayaiva kriyayā sādhyate, etasyāśca etānyeva kārakāṇi, evaṃevaṃ ca niyatisthiteḥ kārakāntarasamavasthititulyatāyāmapi puruṣastathā pratipadya pratyarthaṃ
idamanyat satatopalabdhiniyatamityādi, tadvadidaṃ ca sadāvyaktiniyati sat sādhyamityabhisambandhaḥ
kiṃvat ? yaṣṭisādhanavadṛjutvena, yaṣṭirhi vidyamānairevāvayavaiḥ sadā vyaktā saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇa sādhyate satī sādhyate ṛjūkriyate

idamanyat satatopalabhyameva sat sādhyaṃ mṛddravyamūrdhvāditvakramāpādyaghaṭatvena, pūrvasminnudāharaṇe manāgākṛtyantarabhedena iha tvatyantabhinnākārabhedeneti viśeṣaḥ, taddarśayannāha — mṛdūrdhvāditvena bhedenaiva vā sat sādhyamiti
athavā bhedenaiva vā sat sādhyam, idaṃ cānyaditi vartate

yad buddhyaiva sādhyate na kriyayā parispandātmikayā vidyamānaṃ puruṣādi sthāṇvādiparigrahāpanayanena tadviṣayasaṃśayaviparyayaparigrahāpanayanena, nātra kiñcinnirvartate puruṣādi, kintu vidyamānamevānupalabdhamupalabdhyā sādhyate, eṣā tu niyatirjñānarūpaiveti pūrvavilakṣaṇā
॰nnāha mūrdhāditvaṃ ghatvena bhedenaiva pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
atra mṛdūrdhvāditvaghaṭatvena bhedenaiva ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
etāsāṃ kriyāṇāṃ tatsādhyānāṃ ca niyatikṛtatvapratipādanārthamāha --etacca sādhyamānamityādi
odanaviṣayeyaṃ pacikriyā ghaṭādiviṣayakriyāvilakṣaṇā, etaccodanādi sādhyamānamapyanyaviṣayagamanādikriyāvilakṣaṇayā'nayaiva pacikriyayā sādhyate nānyayeti kriyāniyatyā sādhyate
etasyāśca pacikriyāyā etānyeva kāṣṭhādīni kārakāṇi na mṛtpiṇḍadaṇḍādīnīti sādhyasādhanārthaniyatiḥ

evaṃ ca kṛtvā yathā arthagataprativiśiṣṭasādhyasādhananiyamābhivyaṅgyāyā niyateḥ sthitirvyavasthā tathā tasyāḥ sthiterhetoḥ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakatāmanumānaprasiddhāṃ kāryasya pratipadya buddhyā kārakāntarasamavasthititulyatāyāmapi daṇḍādikārakāntarāṇāṃ sādhyanirvartanasamavasthitestulyatāyāmapi satyāṃ pacikriyāsamavasthityā saha niyatiprasiddhereva balāt puruṣastathā pratipadya pratyarthaṃ kārakāṇi prayuṅkte, yathāsvasādhyārthamityarthaḥ
tāni ca kārakāṇi niyatāni tasyā eva niyatāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ
yathāprayoganiyamam, yo yaḥ prayoganiyama iti kārakāṇi prayuṅkte niyatāni yathāprayoganiyamamekavimardapravṛttāni parasparaniyatānugrahodbhāvanavṛttāni
tacca sa ca tāni ca niyatereva pravartante na vā
atastat kṛtamapi pūrvaniyatisthatvādakṛtaṃ vinaṣṭamapyavinaṣṭaṃ tathāniyatisthatvāt, evaṃ tu vinaśyed yadi sve sve viṣaye deśakālaviśiṣṭe prayuktānītyarthaḥ

ekavimardapravṛttāni ekaprayojanenābandhenānyonyāpekṣeṇa vyāpāreṇa pravṛttāni parasparāpekṣaṃ niyataṃ parasparānugrahamudbhāvayanti pravartante, ata ucyate --parasparaniyatānugrahodbhāvanavṛttānīti svaviṣayakriyāprasādhyamarthamabhinirvartayanti
teṣāṃ vṛttirviṣayastāni tatphalaṃ ca sarvaṃ niyatameva, tato niyatireva sarvasya kāraṇam
na tu tadupāyasiddheranyathā tatsiddhirasti, kāṣṭhajvalanādisādhanapacikriyānirvartyasyaudanasya na daṇḍacakrabhramaṇādisādhanāt tatsiddhirna vā ghaṭādyarthasya kāṣṭhajvalanādisādhyatāstīti
tacca sa ca tāni ca niyatereva pravartante na vā
atastat kṛtamapi pūrvaniyatisthatvādakṛtaṃ vinaṣṭamapyavinaṣṭaṃ tathāniyatisthatvāt, evaṃ tu vinaśyed yadi

niyamenoktalakṣaṇena anudbhūtānāmanabhivyaktavyāpārāṇāṃ bījāvasthāyāmaṅkurāditvena rūpādīnāṃ sammūrcchitānāṃ sāṅgatyena samudetya sthitānāṃ svaniyaterevābhivyaktirvarṇākṛtyādiniyatyā janiryā pūrvamanabhivyaktānāmabhivyaktiḥ sā siddhirityucyate
tatrāyaṃ mithyābhimānaḥ idaṃ mayā kṛtam iti puruṣasya
āha--kiṃ kāraṇaṃ mithyābhimāno nanu mayā kṛto ghaṭa iti ? tatkriyāvinābhāvāsiddhajanmatvād ghaṭasya yukto'bhimāna iti

atrocyate --tacca sa cetyādi, tatpravṛttyapravṛttyoḥ siddhyasiddhyośca vyabhicāradarśanāt tacca kāryaṃ ghaṭādi sa ca kartā kulālaḥ tāni ca kārakāṇi daṇḍādīni niyatereva pravartante na vā, tasya cikīrṣā kadācid bhavati kadācinna, cikīrṣurapyālasyādibhiḥ pravartate na vā, pravṛtto'pyakṛtvaiva ghaṭaṃ vinivartate'nyadvā karoti vighno vāsya bhavati
tathānyakārakāṇyapi vācyāni, tacca kāryaṃ kadācit sidhyati kadācinna, anyārthapravṛttāvanyat sidhyenna vā sidhyet
tathā ca dṛśyante kriyāṇāṃ vipattayo'pravṛttayaśceti lokaprasiddhaṃ vyabhicāraṃ darśayati
atastat kṛtamapi lokapratītyā pūrvaniyatisthatvādakṛtaṃ pūrvameva niyatyā tathā sthitatvāt
vinaṣṭamapyavinaṣṭaṃ tathā niyatyottarakālaṃ kapālāditvenāvasthitatvāt kapālāditvenaiva ghaṭasya vināśāt tantvāditvenāvināśāt
evaṃ tu vinaśyedityādi, yadi praviśīrṇo viśīrya viśīryamāṇo viśīrṇo vā tāṃ niyatiṃ kapālādikramāpattirūpaghaṭavināśāṃ nāpadyate kharaviṣāṇavadatyantābhāvībhavenna vā vinaśyed ghaṭatvenaiva tiṣṭhet
lakṣaṇato hyanyathātā vināśaḥ, sa ca niyateralaṅghyatvāt kapālādyavasthānarūpāyāḥ
ya॰ pratiṣu tu ayaṃ pāṭho nāstyeva

tathā cāmrabījāṅkurādīnāṃ vyavasthāvakāśakrameṇa vyavasthitapūrvarūpā eva pravṛttayasteṣāṃ teṣāṃ māyākārapatākikāvat, yāvadante niyatipravṛttaphalāvasthāmanubhūya punarbījameva, tasmādapi bījāt punarapi tathaiva
anyathā ca tathā tathā prādurbhāvavṛttayo yavatilabhasmādīnām
evaṃ ca vyavasthita evārthe'vyaktasyaivārthasya vyakteḥ sarvaṃ niyatameva
tasya svavyakteḥ sarvakālaṃ vyavasthitādarthādanyo mayā kṛta iti mithyābhimāna eṣaḥ

svayā niyatyā līnānāṃ mūlāṅkurapatranālakāṇḍaśākhā- praśākhāskandhapuṣpādīnāṃ vyavasthāvakāśakrameṇa vyavasthitapūrvarūpaiva pravṛttiḥ, raktaśyāmādivarṇānāmāmraphalasya tuvarāmlaṣāḍavādīnāṃ ca rasānāṃ teṣāṃ teṣāmiti avasthāyāmavasthāyāṃ ye ye bhavantyanye'nye teṣāṃ teṣāṃ vidyamānānāmeva niyatānām

kimiva ? māyākārapatākikāvat, yathā māyākāraḥ patākikā gulikādirūpīkṛtya pūrvagrastāḥ krameṇa svavadanānniṣkāśayati nānāvarṇanānākārāstathehāpyāmrabīje, yāvadante niyatipravṛttaphalāvasthāmanubhūya punarbījameva, tasmādapi bījāt punarapi tathaivetyaṅkurādipravṛttiṃ prāgabhihitāṃ darśayati

atrocyate--dāhaniyatyudaye'pi sā pratiniyataiva, anyathā ca tathā dṛśyanta iti vartate, kāstāḥ ? tathā tathā prādurbhāvavṛttayaḥ, keṣām ? yavatilabhasmādīnām, anyādṛg yavabhasma anyādṛk tilabhasmatyatilabhasmetyatrāpi prādurbhāvatirobhāvavṛttayo niyatā eva
tāśca puruṣakāreṇāpyalaṅghyāḥ, tattvāntareṇa siddhāḥ puruṣakāraṃ cāntareṇa siddhāḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? pākakālasyāpi niyatidarśanāt ṣaṣṭikāḥ ṣaṣṭirātreṇa pacyanta ityudāharaṇāni gatārthāni deśakālakartṛkaraṇādiniyatyaiva pākādidarśanāt
bhā॰ pratau tu tattvāntareṇa siddhāḥ iti pāṭho nāstyeva
evaṃ cetyupanayati, anenoktavidhinā vyavasthita evārthe'vyaktasyaivārthasya tatra vyakteḥ sarvaṃ niyatameva tat tat

tasya svavyaktervyatirekamateḥ puruṣasya sarvakālaṃ vyavasthitānniyatādarthādanyo mṛddravyād ghaṭo mayā kṛta iti mithyābhimāna eṣa ṣaṣṭikādayo vā kedārādisaṃskāravidhinā pācitā iti, yasmānna tu niyatau kiñcinnāsti, sarvaṃ vidyamānameva tirobhūtaṃ kriyayā vinā vā kriyayābhivyajyate kālādiniyatyanugṛhītam

kathamasti yadā bhūmyambvādervinā na bhavati kevalāyā eva bījaniyaterāmraphalapākādi ? kālātapavātādibhyaḥ pākaḥ, bhūmikhananādibhyaḥ phalādīnāmaprāpte'pi kāle pākadarśanāt, kāle cāpi na bhavati pāko dravyāntarasaṃyogastambhanādibhyaḥ
anyacca, tathā tathā jñāturicchānuvidhānena vastuniyatimatītya puṣpādīnāṃ varṇasaṃsthānādivaiparītyam
yaduktaṃ tvayā niyatau sarvamasti iti tat kathamasti yadā bhūmyambvādervinā na bhavati kevalāyā eva bījaniyaterāmraphalapākādi ? rūparasagandhasparśasaṅkhyāsaṃsthānāni ādigrahaṇāt
bhūmirambu vāyurātapaḥ kāla ityetāni bhūmyambvādīni, tad vyācaṣṭe --kālātapavātādibhyaḥ pākaḥ, tasmād bhūmyambukālavātātapādyapekṣatvānna bījaniyatāvastyaṅkurādi tatphalapākādi ceti
tathā akāle'pi kālaniyatervyabhicāro dṛśyate bhūmikhananādibhyaḥ phalādīnāmaprāpte'pi kāle pākadarśanāt, ādigrahaṇāt kodravapalālaveṣṭanavraṇakaraṇādibhiḥ

kāle cāpīti prāpte'pi pākakāle na bhavati pāko dravyāntarasaṃyogena stambhitānām, yathā śākhāyāṃ baddhāyāṃ vṛkṣāyurvedavidhānena dravyāntarasaṃyogenaiva drāvaṇādvā sahakāratailagrahaṇārthaṃ komalasya prāptagandhāvasthasya dravībhāvāt tailatvena, ādigrahaṇāt pakṣikhañjarīṭādisatkabhakṣaṇāt

anyaccetyādi, na kevalamātmasvarūpāparityāgenaiva pākābhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? anyacca tathā tathā, yathā yathā puruṣo jñātā svayamicchati tathā tathā tasya jñāturicchānuvidhānena vastuniyatimatītya puṣpādīnāṃ varṇasaṃsthānādivaiparītyam, yathotpalasya pārśve raktatā pārśve nīlatā, mātuliṅgaphalasya raktatādivarṇatā tadvāsitabījasya, tathā kūṣmāṇḍaphalasya ghaṭavardhitasya ghaṭākāratā
yoniprābhṛtādibhyaścānyathaiva sarvayonyutpattayaḥ, dvividhā yoniryoniprābhṛte'bhihitā--sacittā acittā ca
tatra sacittayonidravyāṇi saṃyojya bhūmau nikhāte dantarahitamanuṣyasarpādijātyutpattiḥ

iti niyamābhāvaḥ, itthaṃ kāle cāpākādakāle ca pākādarthāntarāpekṣatvāt puruṣecchāyatnānuvidhānācca niyamābhāvaḥ, niyamābhāvāt kṛtakatvaṃ pākādeḥ, kṛtakatvāccānityatvam, abhūtvā bhāvo bhūtvā cābhāva ityarthaḥ

atrocyate --na tathāniyatitvāt yathoktaṃ tvayā sāpekṣaniyatitvāt kālāpravṛttiniyatitvādakālapravṛttiniyatitvācca niyatyabhāvaḥ, taddarśayati --bījādiniyatireva hītyādi, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmāt rodhena hi teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ niyatā pravṛttiḥ
yadā hi bījaniyatirabhi tadā tasyā deśa udakastha eva aṅkurodbhāvane pravartamānaḥ sabhāvaka ityucyate, tadbhāvāṃśāpekṣayodakamapi sabhāvakamityucyate, anyadā tu viparyayaḥ

karaṇādīnāṃ kṣamatvākṣamatvasānnidhyā- saiva hi bījādiniyatirekaiva udakādiṣu vartate, kāle vāyāvātape puruṣe tadicchāprayatnayośca vartate, ādigrahaṇādudakādiniyatiśca bījādiṣu vartate'nyonyavyatihāreṇa, tanniyamānurodhena hi parasparaniyamānurodhena, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmādevaṃrūpā teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ niyatistasmāt teṣāṃ sarveṣāmitaretaraniyatyā niyatā pravṛttiranyonyāvinābhāvāt tathaiva pravartanta ityarthaḥ
rodhena hi teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ niyatā pravṛttiḥ
yadā hi bījaniyatirabhi tadā tasyā deśa udakastha eva aṅkurodbhāvane pravartamānaḥ sabhāvaka ityucyate, tadbhāvāṃśāpekṣayodakamapi sabhāvakamityucyate, anyadā tu viparyayaḥ
saha bhāvena vartata iti sabhāvakam, nirgato bhāvo'smāditi nirbhāvakam, kiṃ tat ? udakaṃ patitamiti

tadbhāvanā --yadā hi bījaniyatirabhi aṅkurābhivyakteryadābhimukhībhūtā bījaniyatirbhavati tadā tasyā niyaterdeśoṃ'śo bhāgo'vayavaḥ sa udakastha eva sannaṅkurodbhāvane pravartamānaḥ sabhāvaka ityucyate, tadbhāvāṃśāpekṣayā udakamapi sabhāvakamityucyate bhedavivakṣāyāṃ bahuvrīhisamāsāśrayaṇāt matublopādvā abhedopacārācca bhāva evodakamiti
sa ca bhāvo'ṅkurādirvanaspatyauṣadhyādeḥ, matuppratyayanirdeśo'pi bhedenopapadyate, tadyathā--asti asminnasya vā bhāvoṅkurabhāvo'ṅkurastasminnudake tasmāt tat sabhāvakamiti
anyadā tu viparyayaḥ, kṣārāmlādyudake'ṅkurādayo na santīti niyatatvād viparyayaḥ, tasmādabhāvakamucyate tajjalamiti
uṣarabhūmāvabhāvaḥ sasyādeḥ, pādasaukumāryāderbhāvaḥ, sukṛṣṭe kedārādau vā sarvabījānāmaṅkurādibhāvaḥ
pūrvavāyāvabhāvo'ṅkurādeḥ, bhāvastu mahiṣīkarpāsaprasūtyādeḥ; anyasya puṣpāderanyasya phalādermanuṣyāṇāṃ ca pūrvavāyāvabhāvaḥ, tadyathoktam— divāsvapnamavaśyāyaṃ prāgvātaṃ cātra varjayet
sasyānāmuttare vāyau na bhāvaḥ, prāvṛṣyuptānāṃ bhāvaḥ, vaiśākhādiṣvabhāvaḥ
prabhṛtigrahaṇena ātape'timṛdāvatitīkṣṇe cābhāvaḥ, same bhāvaḥ, ātapābhāve'pyabhāva eveti
kṣāraṃ dadhi divāsvapnaṃ prāgvātaṃ cātra varjayet
yaduktaṃ prāk tvayā puruṣasya jñāturicchānuvidhānena vastuniyativaiparītyam iti tannopapadyate, tatrāpi niyatereva kāraṇatvāt
kutaḥ ? puruṣo vyagro'vyagra iti niyatereva yato bhavati, sāpyāpekṣikī tādṛśī niyatireva
sarvajño'pi ca tāmevākhilāmanādimadhyāntāṃ svarūpeṇāvipariṇāmāṃ vastuniyatimekāmanekarūpāṃ bandhamokṣaprakriyāniyatisūkṣmāṃ paśyan niyatereva bhavatīti
karaṇādhikaraṇakartṛkarmasampradānāpādānānāṃ kṣamatvaṃ tatkriyāsādhanasamarthatvamakṣamatvamasamarthatvam, yathoktam --etat paraśoḥ sāmarthyaṃ yanna tṛṇena pā॰ vā॰ 1
ādigrahaṇāt prāptānāmapi karaṇādīnāmantare vighnā ityevamādeḥ kāraṇādaṅkurādyutpattyanutpattyorniyatireva kāraṇaṃ tathāniyatatvāditi

etena pākādidoṣāḥ pratyuktāḥ pratiṣiddhāḥ, yaduktaṃ tvayā kāle na pāko'kāle pāka ityādayo doṣā iti tadapi tathāniyatitvāt ityetenaiva na doṣāya kālākālayorapākena pākena ca teṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhāvānāṃ niyatatvāt saiva niyatistathā tathā niyataṃ bhavatīti
sarvajño'pi ca tāmevākhilāmanādimadhyāntāṃ svarūpeṇāvipariṇāmāṃ vastuniyatimekāmanekarūpāṃ bandhamokṣaprakriyāniyatisūkṣmāṃ paśyan niyatereva bhavatīti
yanna tṛṇena tat paraśośchedanam pā॰ vā॰
yat tat samāne udyamane nipātane ca paraśunā chidyate, na tṛṇena, tat paraśośchedanam
yo hi manyate udyamananipātanādevaitad bhavati cchinattīti, asitṛṇayośchedane na tasya viśeṣaḥ syāt, yadasinā chidyate tṛṇenāpi tacchidyeta
yadapi ca samyagdarśanajñānacāritratapobhirjñānāvaraṇādyaśeṣakarmakṣayāt kevalajñānaprāptiḥ sārvajñyaṃ pauruṣeṇa iti manyase tadapi mā maṃsthā niyatimantareṇeti
kathaṃ tarhi mantavyam ? sārvajñyaṃ niyatereva bhavatīti, tāmevāsau niyatimakhilāṃ paśyan sarvajño bhavatīti tayaiva ca niyatyā nānyatheti

sa hi bhavyābhavyasiddhādibhedeṣu puruṣeṣu gatisthityavagāhavartanārūparasādiśarīravāṅmanaḥprāṇādipariṇatirūpāmasaṅkīrṇāmanādimadhyāntāṃ kālatraye'pi anutpattimavināśāṃ svena rūpeṇāvipariṇāmāṃ lokasthityanatikrameṇāpracyutasvarūpāṃ vastuniyatiṃ bījādiniyatāṅkurādivastvātmikāmekāṃ sarvabhedeṣvabhinnāmanekarūpāṃ teṣu teṣu bhedeṣu tadrūpaniyatitvādanekāṃ bandhamokṣaprakriyāniyatisūkṣmāṃ jīvakarmaṇoranādyena sambandhena sambaddhayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhūtairmithyādarśanādibhirniyativaśāt santatyānādyo bandho bhavyeṣu bandhodvartanasamarthasamyagdarśanādibhāvaniyativivartād mokṣahetoramūrtasvabhāvasya jñānadarśanavīryasukhādisvātmanaḥ svātmani avasthānaṃ mokṣa ityetāṃ bandha-bandhaka-bandhanīya-bandhavidhānādyanekabhedaprabhedāṃ bandhaprakriyāṃ vratasamitiguptidharmā evaṃ tarhi tvaduktabhāvanayaiva yugapadayugapanniyatārthavṛtteḥ kāla eva bhavatīti bhāvitaṃ bhavati
iha yugapadavasthāyino ghaṭarūpādayo na kecidapi vastupravibhaktito yugapadvṛttiprakhyānātmakaṃ kālamantareṇa
evaṃ ghaṭo grīvādayastathāvṛttestathābhavanāt, mṛlloṣṭādayaḥ, pṛthivī mṛdādayaḥ, dravyaṃ pṛthivyādayaḥ, dravyādayo bhāvaḥ

ayugapadbhā- nuprekṣāparīṣahajayacāritrasaṃvarāṃ dvādaśavidhatapo'nuṣṭhānanirjarāṃ kṣetrakālagatiliṅgatīrthapratyekabuddhabuddhabodhitajñānāvagāhanāntarasaṅkhyālpabahutvādyupāyavyākhyeyāṃ kṛtsnakarmakṣayāvyābādhātyantaikāntasukhātmikāṃ ca mokṣaprakriyāṃ paramasūkṣmāṃ paśyannanantakālamavyābādhasukhaṃ tiṣṭhati
eṣā ca bandhamokṣaprakriyā diṅmātramupadarśitā atisūkṣmatvād bahuvaktavyatvācca nātra parīkṣākāle śakyā vaktum
tatto vi kosiyatarī ciṃtā baṃdhe ya mokkhe ya
vartanā pariṇāmaḥ kriyā paratvāparatve ca kālasya
evaṃ tarhi tvaduktabhāvanayaiva yugapadayugapanniyatārthavṛtteḥ kāla eva bhavatīti bhāvitaṃ bhavati
iha yugapadavasthāyino ghaṭarūpādayo na kecidapi vastupravibhaktito yugapadvṛttiprakhyānātmakaṃ kālamantareṇa
evaṃ ghaṭo grīvādayastathāvṛttestathābhavanāt, mṛlloṣṭādayaḥ, pṛthivī mṛdādayaḥ, dravyaṃ pṛthivyādayaḥ, dravyādayo bhāvaḥ
tatto vi kosiyatarī ciṃtā baṃdhe ya mokkhe ya
aparo dravyārtho vidhividhinayavikalpa āha--nāyamapi niyativādaḥ paritoṣakaraḥ, evaṃ tarhītyādi

yeyamuktā jñājñaṃ svatantrāsvatantraṃ vā na jñameva bhavitumarhati, kiṃ tarhi ? niyatyaiva yugapadayugapaccānekadhā kriyādikāryakāraṇabhāvaniyatametat iti bhāvanā'nayaiva tvayoktayā yugapadayugapanniyatarūpādibījāṅkurādyartheṣṭerna niyatireva bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? kāla eva bhavatīti bhāvitaṃ bhavati, aparasmin paraṃ yugapadayugapacciraṃ kṣipramiti kālaliṅgāni vai॰ sū॰ 2
6 iti vacanād yugapadayugapanniyatārthānāṃ vṛtterbhavanārthatvād vartanasya kālalakṣaṇatvāditi
tadbhāvanārthamāha --iha yugapadavasthāyino ghaṭarūpādayaḥ, te kiṃ parasparapravibhaktitaḥ svenaiva bhavanti uta kālasāmarthyāt ? iti

vasturūpeṇa tāvaccintyate--tatra tāvanna kecidapi vastupravibhaktito bhavantīti vākyaśeṣaḥ, rūparasagandhasparśaśabdebhyaḥ pravibhaktyā pravibhāgena tadrūpeṇa pravibhaktito vā kāraṇānna bhavati taiḥ sahopalabhyamānamapi tadvyatirekeṇābhāvāt

bhinnendriyagrāhyatvādeva ca teṣām aikyābhāvād yaugapadyaṃ nānātvaṃ ca siddham, na hyabhinnasya yaugapadyam, yugasya skandhayoḥ patanaṃ yugapadevamanyatrāpi anekāśrayaṃ yaugapadyam, ato rūpādayo yugapad vartanta ityeṣā vṛttiprakhyātirdṛṣṭā arthataḥ
śabdato'pi ca vartanaṃ kalanaṃ saṅkhyānaṃ prathanaṃ buddhyā śabdena vā nirūpaṇamiti vṛttireva
tasmāt kalanaṃ kāla ityakṣarārthānusāreṇa vartanaṃ kālaḥ, taṃ kālātmānaṃ yugapadvṛttiprakhyānātmakamantareṇa na te kecidrūpādayo yugapad bhavitumarhanti, tasmād rūpādayo yugapadityetat kālasāmarthyāt
sthūlā apyevaṃ ghaṭo grīvādayaḥ, tathāvṛtteryugapadvṛtteḥ, kasya ? kālātmana eva
pṛthivī mṛdādaya vino'pi bhavitukāmasya vartanādatiriktasya kasyacidapyanupapattyāpatteḥ kālātmakatā
niyatestu sarvātmakatvāt sarvākāratā syāt sadā sarvasya, kālābhāve'tītānāgatavartamānāviśeṣāt
iti svīkṣitamapi eva tathāvṛtteḥ, evaṃ mṛlloṣṭavajrāśmasikatādayaḥ
evaṃ dravyaṃ pṛthivyādayaḥ, pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśādayo yugapadvṛttayo dravyam
dravyādayo bhāvaḥ, dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ saprabhedānāṃ bhāva ityākhyā yugapad bhavanāt
evaṃ tāvad yugapadvṛttiḥ kāla eva bhavatīti bhāvitam
niyatestu sarvātmakatvāt sarvākāratā syāt sadā sarvasya, kālābhāve'tītānāgatavartamānāviśeṣāt
kramavṛttiniyatirapi kāla eva bhavatīti bhāvyate, tata āha --ayugapadbhāvino'pītyādi yāvadāpatteḥ

ayugapad bhavituṃ śīlamasyetyayugapadbhāvi, tasyāyugapadbhāvino bhavitukāmasya bhavanābhimukhasya bījāṅkurādervastuno yadi vṛttyātmakakālabhāvo nābhyupagamyate tato vartanādatiriktasya kasyacidapyanupapattirāpadyate vartanābhāvād vandhyāsutavat
tataścānupapattyāpatteḥ sati ca vartanātmake kāle tadupapatteḥ kālātmakatā
evaṃ tāvanniyatārthābhyupagamaḥ kālamantareṇa na bhavatīti yugapadayugapadvṛttyātmakaḥ kāla eva bhavatītyuktam
idānīṃ niyativādino doṣo'bhidhīyate --niyatestvityādi yāvat sadā sarvasya

ya uktastvayā svabhāvavādinaṃ prati bālyakaumārayauvanamadhyamādyavasthā yugapat syuḥ sarvākārasvabhāvatvāddevadattādeḥ, aṅkurapatrakāṇḍādyavasthāśca yugapat syurvrīhyādeḥ ityupālambhaḥ sa eva niyateḥ sarvātmakatvāt kasmāt sarvākāraniyataiva na bhavati iti svabhāvopālambhavanniyatyupālambho'pi tvāmapi prati niyativādinaṃ samānaḥ, sadā sarvakālaṃ sarvasya vastunastasya tasyeti, kālābhāve'tītānāgatavartamānāviśeṣāt, dṛṣṭā cātītānāgatānākāratā vartamānākāratā ca, vṛttyātmakakālābhāvād niyateścāviśeṣādatītānāgatānākāratāvad vartamānānākāratā syāt vartamānākāratāvadatītānāgatākāratāpi syāt, na ca dṛṣṭā atītānāgatākāratā vartamānānākāratā vā
syānmatam--atītānāgatākāratā vartamānākāratāvad niyatau vidyamānaiva tirobhūtatvānnopalabhyate, vartamānākāratā tvāvirbhūtatvādupalabhyata ityuktatvādanuttaramiti
atrocyate --api ca tathāpi naiva kālātikrama iti

evamapi tryākāratāyā yugapadvṛttāyāḥ krameṇāvirbhāvatirobhāvāvatītamanāgatamiti caitat sarvaṃ kālavāciśabdārthasāmarthyapratipāditaṃ kalanaṃ vartanaṃ bhavanamantareṇa na syāt, ataḥ kālasyānatikramaṇīyatā
etena prakāreṇa suṣṭhu parīkṣitamapi kālādṛte nānyat kāraṇamavasthānāṃ bālyādīnāmaṅkurādīnāṃ ca krameṇāvasthāpakaṃ rūpādīnāṃ vā yugapadavasthāpakamālakṣyate
tasmāttvayā niyatāna niyatānantaravyaktyaivābhyupagatamapi kālaṃ niyatimātragrāhadoṣeṇānicchatā tvayā ātmā guṇavatkālapakṣapātakṛtaguṇebhyo'panīyate
yadi niyatikṛtaivārthānāṃ pravṛttiḥ, idaṃ pūrvamidaṃ paścādidamidānīmidaṃ yugapaditi na yujyate sarveṣāṃ bījādau niyateḥ sannihitatvāt

kimiha pūrvādibhiḥ ? evamādivikalpa- ntaravyaktyaivābhyupagataḥ kālaḥ, saptāhaṃ kalalaṃ bhavati, tataḥ saptāhamarbudam, evaṃ peśī ghanam ityevamādikrameṇa garbhādiṣu pūrvoktāvasthānāṃ pūrvasyā anantarāvasthā abhivyajyata ityanayaiva niyatābhivyaktyā kālamabhyupagatamapi niyatimātragrāhadoṣeṇa svapakṣarāgāccānicchatā tvayā ātmā tebhyo guṇavatkālapakṣapātakṛtaguṇebhyo'panīyate
mā bhūd grāha ityukte'tiniṣṭhuratvāccittapīḍeti grāhavad grāha iti prāgvyākhyātagauṇaśabdenocyate
athavā grāho'bhiprāyaḥ, grāhayatīti grāhaḥ, tasyābhiprāyasya doṣeṇa svavacanābhyupagatamapi kālamapaśyan kālatattvavāditvāvāpyayaśodharmādiguṇagaṇādātmānamapanayasi
niyatānantaravyaktyaivābhyupagatamapi kālaṃ niyatimātragrāhadoṣeṇānicchatā tvayā ātmā guṇavatkālapakṣapātakṛtaguṇebhyo'panīyate
yadi niyatikṛtaivārthānāṃ pravṛttiḥ, idaṃ pūrvamidaṃ paścādidamidānīmidaṃ yugapaditi na yujyate sarveṣāṃ bījādau niyateḥ sannihitatvāt
naivamabhyupagantuṃ śakyaṃ niyatikṛtaivārthānāṃ pravṛttiriti, anantarābhihitadoṣasambandhāt kālakṛtatvasyoktatvācca

abhyupetyāpi niyatikṛtatvaṃ doṣaṃ brūmaḥ --idaṃ pūrvamidaṃ paścādidamidānīmidaṃ yugapaditi na yujyate, pūrvādayaḥ kālatrayavācinaḥ, yugapat ityabhinnakālavācī śabdaḥ, tattu kālamantareṇa lokaprasiddhaṃ vyavahārajātaṃ na yujyate

kāraṇāntaramapyāha --sarveṣāṃ teṣāṃ teṣāṃ bījādau niyateḥ sannihitatvāt, bīje mūlāṅkurapatranālādīnāṃ niyateḥ sannihitatvāt śukraśoṇitāvasthāyāmeva kalalārbudagarbhārbhakādīnāṃ niyateḥ sannihitatvāt pūrvādikramavṛttitā yugapadvṛttitā veti na yujyate
syānmatam--etadapi niyatereva yugapadvartanaṃ pūrvādikramavartanaṃ cetyādi, evakārāt kālādinirākaraṇam
neti, etaccāyuktam, nairarthakyāt, niyateḥ pūrvādīnāṃ vā nairarthakyāt
yadi niyatireva kāraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ paścādidānīṃ yugapaditi kālavāciśabdopādānaṃ tadarthāśrayaṇaṃ cānarthakam, tadarthābhāve sati niyatyaiva kṛtaprayojanatvāt

iha tu niyatyānarthakyameveti manyasva, kālaṃ pratyekārthavyāpārārthānāṃ pūrvādīnāmavaśyābhyupagamyatvāt taireva ca kṛtaprayojanatvāt kiṃ niyatyā prayojanam ? kimiha pūrvādibhiḥ ? ityādyakṣarairbhāvitārthatvād yadarthaṃ niyatirupādīyeta tannāstītyabhiprāyaḥ, tattu pūrvādibhiḥ kṛtameva, yat pūrvaṃ tad bījādi yat paścāt tadaṅkurādi ityetayoḥ pūrvāparaśabdayoḥ kramātmakālavācitvāditi
tannidarśayati --evamādivikalpavyavahāreṣu kāla eva vyavahāreṣu kāla eva bhavatīti bhāvitaṃ sarvasaṅgraheṇaiva vā

kramavyavahārasiddhyarthaṃ pūrvādaya āśrayaṇīyā eva, niyaterevāsiddhervyavahārāsiddhiranyathā, pūrvādiṣu tu samāśriteṣu niyatyā kiṃ kriyate ? tvannyāyena tu viduṣāṃ hitāhitaprāptiparihārārthāvācāropadeśāvanarthakau syātāṃ cakṣūrūpagrahaṇaniyativat, ayatnata eva tathāsiddheḥ
yatno'pi niyatita eveti cet, tataḥ sarvalokaśāstrārambhaprayojanābhidhānānarthakyāllokāgamavirodhau bhavatīti bhāvitam
kiñcānyat, sarvasaṅgraheṇaiva vā, yat kāraṇakāraṇaṃ tat pūrvam, yat kāryaṃ tat paścāt, kramavartināṃ bhāvānāṃ kāraṇakāryatvena saṅgrahāt pūrvāparayoḥ kāraṇakāryatvāt kālatvācca kāla eva bhavatīti
etasya kramavyavahārasya siddhyarthaṃ tvayānukramārthaṃ puruṣaṃ svabhāvamanyadvā kāraṇaṃ tatkāryaṃ cāśrityāpyavaśyaṃ pūrvādaya āśrayaṇīyā eva, niyatyādimātreṇa pūrvādyanapekṣeṇa vyavahārāsiddheḥ
niyaterevāsiddhervyavahārāsiddhiranyatheti, pūrvādibhirvinā bījādīnāmaniyatatvāt svabhāvavad niyatyabhāvaḥ, niyatyabhāvād vyavahārāsiddhiriti
mama punaḥ kālavādinaḥ pūrvādiṣu tu samāśriteṣu niyatyā kiṃ kriyate ? sidhyatyeva niyatyā vināpi kramavyavahāraḥ pūrvādibhireva kṛtatvādityarthaḥ
bhā॰ pratau tu etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭho nāsti
atra ><q>kālādinirākaraṇaṃ ceti, etaccāyuktam</q> ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
vyavahāreṣu kāla eva bhavatīti bhāvitaṃ sarvasaṅgraheṇaiva vā
kramavyavahārasiddhyarthaṃ pūrvādaya āśrayaṇīyā eva, niyaterevāsiddhervyavahārāsiddhiranyathā, pūrvādiṣu tu samāśriteṣu niyatyā kiṃ kriyate ?
tvannyāyena tu viduṣāṃ hitāhitaprāptiparihārārthāvācāropadeśāvanarthakau syātāṃ cakṣūrūpagrahaṇaniyativat, ayatnata eva tathāsiddheḥ

kiñcānyat, niyativāde tvannyāyena tu tvadīyenaiva nyāyena viduṣāṃ hitāhitetyādi, hitaprāptyartha ācāro laukikaḥ kṛṣivāṇijyasevādirodanapacanabhojanādiśca dṛṣṭārthaḥ, tadupadeśaśca etat kuru, idaṃ te śreyaḥ iti
ahitapratiṣedhārthaśca laukikaḥ kṣāraviṣakaṇṭakāgniśastrādiparihārārthaḥ, tadupadeśaśca bālādīnāṃ mā kārṣīḥ iti

tāvetāvācāropadeśāvanarthakau syātām, niyatyaiva yadyavaśyambhāvī artho'nartho vā kimācāropadeśābhyām ? kimiva ? cakṣūrūpagrahaṇaniyativat, yathā cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ paśyantaṃ puruṣaṃ niyatyā svabhāvato'nyena vā kenacit kāraṇena tvadabhimatena siddhatvāt puruṣakārādṛte yo bruyātbrūyāt cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ paśya mā drākṣīrjihvayā iti kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ syāt ? tathā niyatyā sidhyatsu asidhyatsu vā kiṃ yatnopadeśābhyām ? kiṃ kāraṇam ? ayatnata eva tathā siddherodanakavalādyāsyapraveśo'pi prakṣepayatnādṛte tvanmatena sidhyet, aprakṣipte kavale kṣutpratīkāraḥ syādityādi yojyam

syānmatam--yo'pyasau yatno niyatita evaiṣo'pi ācāropadeśarūpastṛptiprayojanaudanapacanāsyaprakṣepādirūpaśca tathā tathā niyatitvādityevaṃ cenmanyase, tataḥ sarvalokaśāstrārambhaprayojanābhidhānānarthakyāllokāgamavirodhau, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ lokavirodha āgamavirodhaśca, sarvalokasya sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ cārambhaprayojanayostadabhidhānasya cānarthakyam, bubhukṣāpratīkāraprayojana odanapākārambhaḥ bhāvasyānyathābhāvābhāvāt, kriyāyā evaudanatṛptyādiphalaprasūteḥ pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
evaṃniyaterevaivamiti cet, na, kālānarthāntarakriyāyā evaivaṃ kriyāniyatiriti saṃjñāmātre visaṃvādāt, kālānarthāntaratvāt kriyāyāḥ

niyatipratipādanaparikleśābhyupagamācca te'vaśyambhāvyavyabhicāradarśanaviparya- saha prayojanena tṛptyādinā tadupadeśavacanārambhaprayojanāni cānarthakāni loke, śāstreṣu ca dharmārthakāmamokṣāstadarthāśca śāstrārambhāstadupadeśāścānarthakāḥ prāpnuvanti

kiṃ kāraṇam ? bhāvasyānyathābhāvābhāvāt, yasmāt tenaiva bhāvino nābhāvaḥ, abhāvinaśca na bhāvaḥ, tasmād bhāvasyānyathābhāvābhāvāt sarvalokaśāstrārambhaprayojanābhidhānānarthakyam, tasmācca lokāgamavirodhau loke sarvāgameṣu cārambhaprayojanābhidhānānāṃ prasiddhatvāt
kriyāta evaudanasiddhiḥ, naudāsīnyena āsituḥ kadācinniyatereva kevalāyāḥ
siddhasya caudanasya phalaṃ tṛptiḥ, sāpi mukhe kavalaprakṣepagrasanādikriyāta eva bhavantī dṛṣṭā, odanajanyatṛptibalavarṇārogyādi phalaṃ cāntargatātmarasarudhirādivibhāgapariṇamanakriyātaḥ
tasyāśca kriyāprasādhyatṛptyādihetvodanasiddhaudanajanyatṛptibalavarṇārogyādiphalaprasūteḥ pratyakṣatvād niyatita eva iti vāde pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
evaṃniyaterevaivamiti cet, na, kālānarthāntarakriyāyā evaivaṃ kriyāniyatiriti saṃjñāmātre visaṃvādāt, kālānarthāntaratvāt kriyāyāḥ
evaṃvidhaivaiṣā niyatiḥ kriyāniyatirityucyate, asyāḥ kriyāniyatero- danatṛptyādiphalaprasūtiniyatiriti

etaccāyuktam, kālānarthāntarakriyāyā evaivaṃ kriyāniyatiriti saṃjñāmātre visaṃvādāt, abhyupagataṃ tāvat tvayā evaṃniyaterevaivam iti bruvatā kāṣṭhādisādhanasandarbhayā laukikyā pacikriyayaiva odanasiddhitṛptyādiphalaprasūtiniyatiriti, evaṃśabdasya tadarthatvāt
sā ca kriyāniyatiḥ kālakriyāparyāyatvāt kālaniyatiḥ, niyatikriyayoścaikārthatvāt

atrāha--evamapi kriyāsiddhau kālāsiddhiriti, atrocyate, tanna, kālānarthāntaratvāt kriyāyāḥ, kriyā kāla ityanarthāntaram, kālenaiva kriyākhyena evaṃniyatiriti bravatābruvatā sa eva kāla ityuktaṃ bhavati, kālakriyayoranarthāntaratvāt kālaniyatiḥ kriyāniyatiriti saṃjñāmātre visaṃvādāt pūrvavaditi

puruṣakālasvabhāvādidarśanānāṃ niyatyaivāvyabhicāriṇyā tadavinābhāvināmavyabhicārādeva tvayābhyupagatānāṃ paravādibhiśca sa sa evetyabhyupagatānāṃ tvayā punastadviparyayaḥ niyatireva kāraṇaṃ na kālādayaḥ iti pratipādanārthaṃ pravṛttiraṅgīkṛtā

yadi tāni darśanānyanayā tvadīyayā pravṛttyāpanīyante nāvaśyambhāvīni tāni, athāvaśyambhāvīnyeva nāpanīyante'nayāpi pravṛttyā tato niyatyarthaṃ paradarśanaviparyayamāpādayāmi ityayamabhyupagamo nivartate ityubhayathābhyupagamavirodhaḥ
tathā brāhmaṇasya vasante'gnyādhānam, vaṇijāṃ madyasya, īśvarāṇāṃ krīḍādīnām, niṣkramaṇaṃ kṛtvā yāvadvimokṣaṃ vimokṣaṇasya kālo yatīnām
yeyaṃ pakṣahetudṛṣṭāntādyavayavoccāraṇe pravṛttistayā svavacanaṃ paramatanirākaraṇasamarthamiti mataṃ pravṛttyupalabhyaṃ svata eva nāvaśyaṃ bhavatīti nirākriyate
athāvaśyaṃ svata eva bhavati, pravṛttiranarthikā pratipādanāsamarthavacanikā pravṛttivacanayoraniyatārthatvāt
hetuḥ pakṣadharmo heyārthapratipattiniyato'vaśyambhāvī pravṛttimantareṇa cet pravṛttiranarthikā, nāvaśyambhāvī cet niyatyabhāvaḥ

ataḥ prāgabhihitakālakāryatvāddhetoḥ sarvalokaśāstrārambhaprayojanābhidhānānāṃ sarvaśāstrārthatvāyeyaṃ punarbhāvanocyate --dharmārthakāmamokṣāḥ kālakṛtāḥ, evaṃ caturvargasādhyasādhanasambandhārthāḥ sarvaśāstrārambhāḥ kālasāmarthyādeva saphalā nānyatheti pratipadyasva
katham ? uktabhāvanāvat, uktā bhāvanā rūpādighaṭādiyugapadvṛttyātmakakālarūpaṃ bījāṅkurādipūrvottarakramavṛttyātmakakālarūpaṃ ca jagadaniyatapariṇati ceti
tasmāduktabhāvanāvadaniyaterdharmādyarthānāmācārāṇāṃ pūrvāparībhūtakriyātvāt kriyārthatvāccopadeśānāṃ kālasya ca pūrvāparībhūtasya kriyātvāt sārthakāḥ śāstrārambhāḥ
atra sarvaśāstrārthatvāyeyaṃ ityasya sthāne sārthakatvāyeyaṃ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atra॰ kṛtā eva, caturvarga॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

evaṃ ca kṛtvā kālakṛtatvāt kriyā-kriyāphalānāṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣārthaiḥ śāstraireva vihitāḥ kriyāḥ, tadyathā yathākramaṃ dharmādiṣu, brāhmaṇasya vasante'gnyādhānam, vasante brāhmaṇo yajeta, grīṣme rājanyaḥ, śaradi vājapeyena vaiśyaḥ ityādivacanāt

niṣkramaṇamityādi yāvad yatīnām, niṣkramaṇakālādārabhya yāvad vimokṣaṃ vimokṣaṇasya ātmakarmaviyogaphalasya mokṣasya kālo aniyatacetanācetanatvapṛthivyāditvena anādyanantavartanātmasvatattvānāṃ vṛtteḥ yatīnāṃ niṣkramaṇādeḥ kāla iti, yathoktam --appaṇo nikkhamaṇakālaṃ ābhoettā caittā rajjaṃ kalpasū॰ 112 ityādi
atra ābhoei ābhoettā ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

tae ṇaṃ samaṇe bhagavaṃ mahāvīre appaṇo nikkhamaṇakālaṃ ābhoei, ābhoittā ciccā hiraṇṇaṃ ciccā suvaṇṇaṃ ciccā dhaṇaṃ ciccā rajjaṃ ciccā raṭṭhaṃ evaṃ balaṃ vāhaṇaṃ kosaṃ koṭṭhāgāraṃ ciccā puraṃ ateaṃteuraṃ ciccā jaṇavayaṃ ciccā vipuladhaṇakaṇagarayaṇamaṇimottiyasaṃkhasilappavālarayaṇamāiaṃ saṃtasārasāvaijjaṃ vicchaḍḍaittā vigovaittā dāṇaṃ dāyārehiṃ paribhāittā dāṇaṃ dāiyāṇaṃ paribhāittā iti kalpasūtre pāṭhaḥ
tate ṇaṃ samaṇe bhagavaṃ mahāvīre teṇaṃ aṇuttareṇaṃ āhodhieṇaṃ nāṇadaṃsaṇeṇaṃ appaṇo nikkhamaṇakālaṃ ābhoeti

appaṇo 2 ttā ceccā hiraṇṇaṃ ceccā suvaṇṇaṃ ceccā dhaṇaṃ ceccā dhaṇṇaṃ ceccā raṭṭhaṃ evaṃ balaṃ vāhaṇaṃ kosaṃ koṭṭhāgāraṃ ceccā puraṃ ceccā jaṇavayaṃ ceccā viuladhaṇakaṇagarataṇamaṇimottiyasaṃkhasilappavālarattarayaṇamātīyaṃ saṃtasārasāvatejjaṃ vicchaḍḍaittā viggovaittā dāṇaṃ dāṃiyāṇaṃ paribhāettā iti daśāśrutaskandhasūtre pāṭhaḥ

tatkaraṇasamaye ca bhagavān kevalī antarmuhūrtamudīraṇāvalikāyāṃ karmaprakṣepavyāpārarūpamāvarjīkaraṇaṃ karoti, tataḥ samuddhātaṃ gacchati, tasya cāyaṃ kramaḥ, tadyathā--prathamasamaye tāvat svadehaviṣkaṣbhabāhalyopetam āyāmatastu ūrdhvādholokāntagāminaṃ jīvapradeśasaṃghātarūpaṃ daṇḍaṃ kevalajñānābhogataḥ karoti, dvitīyasamaye tu tameva daṇḍaṃ pūrvāparadigdvayaprasāraṇāt tiryaglokāntagāminaṃ kapāṭamiva kapāṭaṃ vidadhāti, tṛtīyasamaye tameva kapāṭaṃ dakṣiṇottaradigdvayaprasāraṇāt tiryaglokāntagāminameva manthānamiva manthānaṃ karoti, evaṃ ca lokasya prāyo pṛ॰ 188 bahu pūritaṃ bhavati, mathyantarāṇi ca apūritāni prāpyante jīvapradeśānāmanuśreṇigamanāditi
caturthasamaye tānyapi saha lokaniṣkuṭaiḥ pūrayati, tathā ca samasto'pi lokaḥ pūrito bhavati

nanu lokamadhye sthito yadā kevalī samudghātaṃ karoti tadā tṛtīye'pi samaye lokaḥ pūryata eva, kiṃ caturthasamaye'ntarapūraṇeneti ? naitadevam, lokasya madhyaṃ hi merumadhya eva sambhavati, tatra ca prāyaḥ samudghātakartuḥ kevalino'sambhava eva, anyatra ca samudghātaṃ kurvatastasya tṛtīyasamaye'ntarāṇi uddharantyeveti paribhāvanīyam
tadanantaraṃ ca pañcamasamaye yathoktakramāt pratilomaṃ mathyantarāṇi saṃharati, prasṛtān jīvapradeśān saṅkocayatītyarthaḥ
aṣṭame tu samaye daṇḍamapi saṃhṛtya śarīrastha eva bhavati
...daṃḍa kavāḍe ruyae loe cauro ya paḍiniyattaṃte
pūrvoktanyāyena prathame samaye daṇḍaḥ, dvitīye kapāṭaḥ, tṛtīye rucako manthā ityarthaḥ, caturthe tu lokaḥ sarvo'pyāpūryata ityevaṃ catvāraḥ samayāḥ
pratinivartamāne'pi samudghāte pūrvoktayuktyaiva catvāra eva samayā bhavantītyevaṃ kevalisamudghāto'ṣṭasāmayikaḥ
śeṣāstu samudghātāḥ sarve'pyantarmauhūrtikā ityetat sarvaṃ prāgeva bhāvitārthamiti gāthārthaḥ
kevalisamudghātasvarūpamabhidhīyate--tatra samyagapunarbhāvena utprābalyena karmaṇo hananaṃ ghātaḥ pralayo yasmin prayatnaviśeṣe sa samudghātaḥ
...ayaṃ kṛtakṛtyo'pi kevalī kimarthaṃ samudghātaṃ karotīti cet, ucyate--vedanīyanāmagotrāṇāmāyuṣā saha samīkaraṇārtham...uktaṃ ca--'āyuṣi samāpyamāne śeṣāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ yadi samāptiḥ
na syāt sthitivaiṣamyād gacchati sa tataḥ samudghātam
sthityā ca bandhanena ca samīkriyārthaṃ hi karmaṇāṃ teṣām
aniyatacetanācetanatvetyādi yāvat kalanaṃ kālaḥ, svarūpatadātmakatvabhāvanaiva vartate

athavā tṛṇādergavādyabhyavahṛtasya sukhaduḥkhādicaitanyāpatterdravyasya prāṇādyāpatterdravyaprāṇātipātādibhāvaḥ kālakramāgatapariṇativaśāt upaśamakṣayakṣayopaśamodayapariṇāmabhāvaiśca jīvapudgalayoranādyanantaśo vartanāt
kalanātmakaṃ rūpaṃ bhūyo bhūyo viparivartate dhruvādisarvanityalakṣaṇam
tasmādviśvavikalpavivartavartanāyāḥ kalanamasmadādyasarvajñaṃ prati anumānamātragamyamaviviktamamitapūrṇakoṣṭhāgāradhānyavat sarvajñaṃ ca prati viviktāyā vartanāyāḥ kalanaṃ kālaḥ

sa tathābhūtena kalanārthena vartanāmeva sāmānyamatyajan bhūto bhavati bhaviṣyaṃ- na kevalaṃ cetanācetanayoḥ paraspararūpāpattikṛtaiva vṛttiḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? acetanasyāpi pṛthivyāditvenāpi tathā, tadyathā--ekajātitvāt pudgalānāṃ pṛthivyudakajvalanapavanavanaspatyāditvena viparivartamānapariṇatīnāmanādyanantaśa eva vṛttirvartanam, tasyātmā svaṃ tattvaṃ yeṣāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ te paramāṇavaḥ, teṣāmanādyanantavartanātmasvatattvānāṃ vṛtteḥ kalanātmakaṃ rūpaṃ bhūyo bhūyo viparivartate'bhyāvartate, rūparasādibhedaparivartanavadguṇabhedenāpyekadvitrisaṅkhyeyāsaṅkhyeyānantaguṇabhāgahīnavṛddhakṛṣṇaśuklatvādinā vābhyāvṛttiḥ, ekāṃśasyāpi paramasūkṣmarūpādibhāvaparamāṇorapi anādyanantaśo'bhyāvṛttiḥ

atastadatītānāgatavartamānātmakamekaṃ kūṭasthamavicāli anapāyopajanavikāri avṛddhi vyayāyogītyādi ādigrahaṇāt, dhruvādisarvanityalakṣaṇametadeva kalanātmakaṅkāraṇamupapadyate, nāṇupuruṣaniyatyādinityatvam, pūrvāparībhāvātmakaviparivartakalanasya ādimadhyāvasānādarśanādevaṃlakṣaṇasya nityatvasya

tacca kalanaṃ dvividham, asmadādyasarvajñaṃ prati anumānamātragamyamaviviktaṃ sarvavastusāmānyamātragrahaṇam, amitapūrṇakoṣṭhāgāradhānyakalanavat, yathā dhānyamamitvā koṣṭhāgāre pūritaṃ kumbhaśatasahasrādyanyatamaparimāṇam ityuddeśato gṛhyate tathoddeśamātrato'tītānāgatavartamānavartanākalanamasmadādibhiḥ
sarvajñaṃ ca prati paramaniruddhe kāle samaye samaye vṛttāyāḥ viviktāyā vartanāyāḥ saṅkhyānaṃ kalanaṃ tat kālaḥ, kala saṅkhyāne pā॰ dhā॰ 497, 1866 iti pratīteḥ
yathoktam— jaṃ jaṃ je je bhāve pariṇamati payogavīsasādavvaṃ
taṃ taha jāṇāti jiṇo apajjave jāṇaṇā ṇatthi
kalanātmakaṃ rūpaṃ bhūyo bhūyo viparivartate dhruvādisarvanityalakṣaṇam
tasmādviśvavikalpavivartavartanāyāḥ kalanamasmadādyasarvajñaṃ prati anumānamātragamyamaviviktamamitapūrṇakoṣṭhāgāradhānyavat sarvajñaṃ ca prati viviktāyā vartanāyāḥ kalanaṃ kālaḥ
sa tathābhūtena kalanārthena vartanāmeva sāmānyamatyajan bhūto bhavati bhaviṣyaṃ-
॰ttiḥ vṛtaiva vṛtteḥ pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ vi॰
atra avṛddhyavyayayogītyādi iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīna iti bhāti, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 21 paṃ॰ 22
athavā nedameva nityalakṣaṇaṃ dhruvaṃ kūṭasthamavicālyanapāyopajanavikāryanutpattyavṛddhyavyayayogi yat tannityamiti
॰kaḥ ṣaṭkāraṇa॰ pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
jaṃ jaṃ je je bhāve pariṇamati payogavīsasādavvaṃ
taṃ taha jāṇāti jiṇo apajjave jāṇaṇā ṇatthi || āva॰ ni॰ 794 iti

sa eva kālastathābhūtena vartanārūpeṇa kalanārthena samādhikaraṇena tāṃ vartanāmeva sāmānyamabhinnāmatyajan bhūto bhavati bhaviṣyaṃśca iti viśeṣavyapadeśaṃ labhate, nānyaḥ kaścidakalanātmakaḥ padārtho niyatyādirasattvāt
sa eva tu kalanalakṣaṇo bhāvastridhā bhidyate tatsamādhikaraṇatvāt sattvātmakatvād ghaṭavat, na vyadhikaraṇo bhūto bhavati bhaviṣyaṃścākāla eva vyadhikaraṇo'tadrūpa eva
sa eva tu tridhā bhidyate, anyathānyasyābhāvāt
sa eva tathā kalayan vartanena kalayati, sa eva kalyate, tena tasmaitena ca tasmai cetyādi
evameva ca sa vartamānātītayoḥ kāraṇāvasthayoreva kāryākhyābhimukhyena gṛhyate ekatra meghādirekatra paṭādiḥpaṭādirekatra meghādiḥ
grahaṇavacca sa eva kriyate tathā vṛtteḥ kriyayā kalyate
kiṃ kāraṇam ? anyathānyasyābhāvāt, iha hyanyadanyathā na bhavati, yathā kusumaṃ khapuṣpaṃ na bhavati khapuṣpaṃ vā kusumaṃ na bhavati, ghaṭo vā paṭatayā na bhavati ghaṭatayā paṭo vā na bhavati
kiṃ tarhi ? tadeva tad bhavati, kusumameva kusumam, tadeva cānyathāpi bhavati yathā kusumameva mukulitārdhavikasitasamastavikasitajarattāmlānāditvādinā
evaṃ tāvat kāla eva bhāva ityabhedena bhavanaṃ vyākhyātam
kāraṇabhedenāpi sa eva tathā kalayan vartanena kalayatīti kalanasya kartṛtvamanubhavatīti kalanaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ
sa eva kalyate kriyate karma bhavatītyarthaḥ pūrvāparatayā kāryakāraṇabhāvāt
tena ca tasmai cetyādi tasyaiva kalanasya śaktibhedāt, tena kriyata iti karaṇatā, tasmai kriyata iti sampradānatā
sa eva tu tridhā bhidyate, anyathānyasyābhāvāt
sa eva tathā kalayan vartanena kalayati, sa eva kalyate, tena tasmaitena ca tasmai cetyādi
evameva ca sa vartamānātītayoḥ kāraṇāvasthayoreva kāryākhyābhimukhyena gṛhyate ekatra meghādirekatra paṭādiḥpaṭādirekatra meghādiḥ
grahaṇavacca sa eva kriyate tathā vṛtteḥ kriyayā kalyate
bhā॰ pratau tu idaṃ vākyameva nāsti
tasyaivedānīṃ kālasya tridhā bhinnasyāpyabhedopadarśanārthaṃ jñānena kriyayā caikyamucyate --evameva cetyādi jñānena tāvadekatvaṃ dṛśyate yāvadekatra meghādiriti

evameveti yathaiva kartṛkarmakaraṇādiśaktibhede'pyabhinnaḥ kālastathā sa vartamānātītayoḥ kāraṇāvasthayoreva saptamyanto'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ kāryākhyābhi- mukhyena gṛhyate kāryāṅgīkaraṇena tatprādhānyena tādātmyeneti yāvat, vartamānāvasthāyāṃ kāryākhyābhimukhyena atītāvasthāyāṃ cottarāvasthābhimukhyena sa eva kālo gṛhyate, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? kalyate jñāyate
yathāsaṅkhyamekatra paṭādirekatra meghādiḥ, vartamāne paṭādiratīte meghādiḥ
tadyathā--puruṣo hi pūrvāhṇe paṭaṃ paśyannaparāhṇe'pi paṭa evāyaṃ śvo'pyaparedyuruttaredyurapi paṭa eveti vartamānakāle'pi paṭameṣyatkāle'pi paṭameva manyate

meghe connatamātre varṣati ayaṃvarṣatyayam, tataḥ pralahībījamutpadyate, mūlāṅkurādi bhavati, tataḥ pralahīpoṇḍam, tataḥ karpāsaḥ, tataḥ sūtram, tataḥ paṭaḥ ityatītakāla eva eṣyatkālaṃ paṭaṃ manyate ityataḥ kāryākhyābhimukhyena sa eva kālo'tīto vartamānaścābhedena gṛhyamāṇo dṛṣṭastasmādabhinnaḥ
evaṃ jñānenaikyamāpādya kriyayāpyaikyamāpādayati atideśena --grahaṇavacca sa eva kriyate
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tathā vṛtteḥ, evaṃ hi vartanam, saiva hi kriyā yathā gṛhyate tathā kriyate'pyasāvevābhedeneti tatkārakārthaṃ darśayati --kriyayā kalyata iti
evaṃ tāvadatītavartamānayoḥ kāraṇayoḥ kāryākhyābhimukhyena grahaṇakaraṇābhyāmaikyam, ākhyāśabdaḥākhyā śabdaḥ śabdamātreṇaiva bhedāt

tayorapyanāgate, tayoḥ kāraṇayorapyanāgate kārye'tītavartamānayoḥ kāraṇākhyābhimukhyena tayorapyanāgate kāraṇākhyābhimukhyena kalyamānatā dṛśyate saṃyogatantvādyudakagarbhasarjanapācanādivartanapaṭatvavat
ata eva ca kalanameva hyekaṃ kāryakāraṇavṛttitvena viparivartituṃ kṣamamapuruṣakāramasvabhāvamaniyati saṃsāri anādi
puruṣavādinaḥ punaḥ paramātmanaḥ śuddhānna yujyate saṃsāro bandhābhāvāt
bandhābhāvaḥ kāryākhyābhimukhyakāraṇaikyavad grahaṇakaraṇayoḥ samānā kalyamānatā dṛśyate, tato'pyaikyameva

tadyathā— saṃyogatantvādyudakagarbhasarjanapācanādivartanapaṭatvavat, yathā tantūnāṃ saṃyogaṃ dṛṣṭvā rutakarpāsapralahīpoṇḍapralahīmūlāṅkurādijalasarjanapācanadhāraṇameghakalanāni vṛttāni tathā ca kriyanta iti tānyeva vartanāni paṭa ityeṣyatpaṭa eva tathā tantuvāyasya grahaṇakaraṇābhyāṃ pravṛttatvād vartamānātītapaṭatā dṛṣṭā ityaikyameva
ata eva ca kalanameva hyekaṃ kāryakāraṇavṛttitvena viparivartituṃ kṣamamapuruṣakāramasvabhāvamaniyati saṃsāri anādi
puruṣavādinaḥ punaḥ paramātmanaḥ śuddhānna yujyate saṃsāro bandhābhāvāt

etasmādeva kāraṇād vartanasyāpratīghātād vyāpitvācca kāraṇāntarāpekṣā nāsti, kalanameva hyekamananyasādhanaṃ svayameva kāryakāraṇavṛttitvena viparivartituṃ kṣamam, apuruṣakāraṃ cetanācetaneṣu vṛtterabhedāt, asvabhāvaṃ jīvājīvātmakapariṇatikramavivṛttyajasratvāt, aniyati tathānyathābhāvaviparivartavartanātmakatvādeva, saṃsāri rūpadvyaṇukatryaṇukādibhūmyambuvrīhyādyāhārarasarudhirādiviparivartanasvabhāvāntarasaṅkramaṇalakṣaṇatvāt saṃsārasya, ata evānādi, anāditvena dūramapakṣiptā niyatyādikāraṇāntarāpekṣā anena kalanena

tasmādanāditvāt kālavṛttiḥ, asyā eva kālavṛttereva kevalāyāḥ kāraṇāntaranirapekṣāyā hetoḥ yadapyucyate puruṣavādinā puruṣakriyāta eva sarvam iti tadasmādeva kālād bhavati na puruṣakārāt, anādīnāṃ yaugapadyādādimatāṃ paurvāparyayuktavṛttitvāt tayośca kālatvāt kila tenaiva puruṣavādinā kālasya samarthitatvādityata āha --puruṣavādyuktamuktikramārthaturīyavacanādeva, suṣuptāvasthā viśudhyantī suptāvasthā bhavati, suptāvasthā ca jāgradavasthā bhavati, jāgradavasthā viśuddhā satī turīyā muktyavasthā bhavatīti kālasāmarthyāt kramātmalābho ghaṭate, tasmāt suṣuptāderavasthāviśeṣavyavasthānasya anādikālapravṛttyātmakatvaṃ paramātmano vartanatattvasya asmanmata evameva ghaṭate, na puruṣavāde, kramākramavikalpābhāvāt

anyathā avasthācatuṣṭayasya ekasarvagatanityākramakāraṇātmakasya katamāvasthā prathamā dvitīyā tṛtīyā turīyā ceti ? kiñcānyat, vṛttikramāpāditakāryakāraṇāvasthayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvopapattermithyādarśanādibhiḥ sāmānyahetubhiḥ tatpradoṣanihnavādibhiśca viśeṣahetubhiḥ karmabandhaprakriyopapatteḥ saṃsārānāditā santānāvyavacche kāraṇābhāvādaśarīratvādakaraṇatvācca
yad yadatat tat tanna tanniyati dṛṣṭam, ghaṭapaṭavat

puruṣavādinaḥ punaḥ paramātmanaḥ śuddhāt kūṭasthādinityāt kāryakāraṇe dve api vyatītānna yujyate saṃsāro bandhābhāvāt, bandhābhāvaḥ kāraṇābhāvādaśarīratvādakaraṇatvācca, caśabdāt sarvagatatvādekatvānnityatvāccetyādayo'pi hetavaḥ, pradoṣādikāraṇābhāve pradoṣābhāvāt karmābhāva ityādi gatārthaṃ yāvat saṃsārānāditā
bhūtavratyanukampā dānaṃ sarāgasaṃyamādiyogaḥ kṣāntiḥ śaucamiti sadvedyasya

darśanaviśuddhirvinayasampannatā śīlavrateṣvanaticāro'bhīkṣṇaṃ jñānopayogasaṃvegau śaktitastyāgatapasī saṅghasādhusamādhivaiyāvṛttyakaraṇamarhadācāryabahuśrutapravacanabhaktirāvaśyakāparihāṇirmārgaprabhāvanā pravacanavatsalatvamiti tīrthakṛttvasya
yad yadatat tat tanna tanniyati dṛṣṭam, ghaṭapaṭavat
atrāha niyativādī--tasya saṃsārasyaiva tathāniyateḥ saṃsāro bhavati puruṣapudgalayoriti

atra brūmaḥ --nāpi tasya niyateḥ saṃsārānāditā, kasmāddhetoḥ ? atattvāt, tadbhāvastattvam, na tattvamatattvam, tasmādatattvāt tanniyaterna bhavati saṃsāraḥ, atattvaṃ cāsya saṃsārasya kvaciduparamābhyupagamāt, svahetoḥ sādhyāvinābhāvitvopapradarśanārthamāha --yad yadatat tat tanna tanniyati dṛṣṭam, yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭaniyatirna bhavati paṭo'pi ghaṭaniyatirna bhavati, tasmād ghaṭapaṭavadatattvānnāpi tasya niyateriti sādhūktam
yadi brūyāt--tasya svabhāvāt saṃsārānāditeti, etacca nāpi tasya svabhāvāt, atattvāt
idānīṃ kālavāde tadupapattirupavarṇyate --tasmāt tvanādivartanātmakatvādityādi yāvanna na yujyata iti
tasmāditi prastutāt kālāt saṃsārānāditā na na yujyata iti sambhantsyate

tuśabdo viśeṣaṇe, kālavāda evaitadupapadyate'nādisaṃsāritvam, yaugapadyaparyāyatvādanāditvasya yaugapadyasya ca kālaprabhāvāvinābhāvitvāt kalanavṛttiparyāyatvācca kālasyeti tatpradarśanārthaṃ hetumāha --anādivartanātmakatvāt kālasya, kālo hi yugapadanādivṛttyātmakaḥ
nanvidaṃ prāguktena viruddhaṃ pūrvaparāpūrvāparādivṛtterayaugapadyāditi cet, na, vartanasya yaugapadyāt, tadyathā --pṛthivyādivrīhyādivṛttītyādirdṛṣṭāntadaṇḍakaḥ

yathā pṛthivya svātmaviṣayakriyābandhasaṃsaraṇavajjīvapudgalayorabhinnavartanasvatattvayoḥ svata eva bandhakriyā saṃsārakriyā ca vartanābhedena rūpabhedena ca kālasyātmasvātmanyeva kriyā anātmasvātmani vā yugapadeva bandhasaṃsaraṇavihitā bandhasaṃsārānāditā na na yujyate
ityanādivartanāprabhedapūrvāparādikramād bhāvāntarāṇi krameṇa prāptāni bhūmyambvādiyogo bījodbhedo mūlamaṅkuraḥ...

mbuvāyvākāśapuruṣādayo yugapat sametā lokākhyāṃ labhamānā anādayaḥ, ta eva ca vrīhiyavagodhūmacūtapanasāditvena strīpuruṣamahiṣājagavayagavāditvena ca vartante sahaiva, bhūmyādivrīhyāditvena tādṛśyorvṛttivivṛttyoravyavacchedena sva evātmā viṣayo'syāḥ kriyāyāḥ sā teṣāṃ vrīhyādibhūmyādīnāṃ vṛttivivṛttiprabandhena ātmasvarūpaviṣayā kriyā, saiva ca bandhaḥ snigdharūkṣavṛttyā teṣāṃ saṃśleṣāt, anyānyarūpāpattiḥ saṃsaraṇam, tacca anādi yugapadubhayaṃ bandhanaṃ saṃsaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭam, tathā jīvapudgalayorabhinnavartanasvatattvayoḥ svasādhyebhya eva sādhanātmabhyaḥ hetukāryabhūtebhyaḥ kāraṇebhyaḥ parasparasaṃśleṣavartanebhya iva bhūmyādivrīhyādīnāṃ hetubhyaḥ svata eva bandhakriyā saṃsārakriyā ca vartanābhedena rūpabhedena ceti dṛṣṭāntaprasiddhārthavyākhyānam

dārṣṭāntikavyākhyānaṃ tu kālasyātmasvātmanyeva kriyā anātmasvātmani veti, kālasya abhinnavartanasvatattvasya bhūmyādivrīhyādibandhasaṃsaraṇavadeva ātmasvātmani jīvasvarūpe kriyā anātmasvātmani pudgalasvarūpe vā yugapadeva bandhasaṃsaraṇavihitā kālakṛtabandhasaṃsāravihitā tatkṛtā vidhāturanyasyābhāvāt, saiṣā saṃsāritā yugapadabhinnānādivṛttyātmikā jīvapudgalayoḥ parasparaṃ svātmaparātmavṛttikṛtabandhasaṃsārānāditā na na yujyate virodhābhāvādityabhiprāyaḥ

svātmaviṣayakriyābandhasaṃsaraṇavajjīvapudgalayorabhinnavartanasvatattvayoḥ svata eva bandhakriyā saṃsārakriyā ca vartanābhedena rūpabhedena ca kālasyātmasvātmanyeva kriyā anātmasvātmani vā yugapadeva bandhasaṃsaraṇavihitā bandhasaṃsārānāditā na na yujyate
ityanādivartanāprabhedapūrvāparādikramād bhāvāntarāṇi krameṇa prāptāni bhūmyambvādiyogo bījodbhedo mūlamaṅkuraḥ...
