atra heturucyate --ātyantikanidrāvigamarūpanirūpyatvāt, sarvatra sarvadā vāntamatīto'tyantaḥ, tatra bhava ātyantiko nidrāvigamaḥ, sa eva rūpaṃ tattvam, tena tattvena nirūpyatvāt, yathā nirūpitaṃ puruṣavādinaiva sarvaṃ sarvatra sadā sarvathā cetanātmakameveti siddho hetuḥ

ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? vinidrāvasthāsvātmavat, yathā vinidrāvasthāṃ caturthīṃ śuddhacaitanyātmānaṃ nātivartate proktarūpeṇa nirūpyatvāt puruṣastathā śeṣāvasthāsvapi taddharmatānativṛttyaiveti evameṣā vinidrāvasthaiva sarvatrāpāditā
na hyasāvitarātmikā, yathā suptādyavasthāsturīyāvasthaiva na tathā sā tadātmikā
kasmāt ? svavṛttityāgāpatteḥ, yadi sā vinidrāvasthā suptādyavasthāpi syāt tatastayā viśuddhāvasthā svavṛttistyaktā syāt, na tvasti svavṛttityāgo'vasthāsaṅkarasvarūpanirṇayābhāvādidoṣāt

ataḥ sā tanmātraiva, tasyāśca tanmātratve tu puruṣasyāpi tadavasthāmātratvamato vinidrāvasthāmātratvam, tadvajjāgradādyavasthānātmaka atha vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇo'pi puruṣaḥ sarvatvānna vinidrāvasthāmātra eva, vinidrāvasthāpi vinidrāvasthātmikā satī sarvatvānna vinidrāvasthāmātraiva syād vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇatvāt puruṣasvātmavat
tataśca pratyavasthaṃ tasyā eva sarvātmakatvāt tṛṇādyapi sarvagatamiti kiṃ puruṣaikatvaprakalpanayā ? atallakṣaṇatvādvā vinidrāvasthāyā abhāvaḥ, tataśca tattattvacaturavasthasarvātmakapuruṣābhāvaḥ

atha vinidrālakṣaṇaviparīto'pi puruṣaḥ puruṣa evāvadhāraṇabhedāt, vinidrāvasthā- tvam, tasmājjāgradādyavasthānātmakatvād vinidrāvasthāmātratvāt suptādidṛṣṭaśeṣāvasthāsu avṛtterasarvagatatvamiti cāvyāpitvadoṣaḥ puruṣakāraṇavādasya
na ca satyapi kevale prabhustava cintyeyamacintyavad gatiḥ || siddha॰ dvā॰ 4 | 22 iti
atha vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇo'pi puruṣaḥ sarvatvānna vinidrāvasthāmātra eva, vinidrāvasthāpi vinidrāvasthātmikā satī sarvatvānna vinidrāvasthāmātraiva syād vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇatvāt puruṣasvātmavat
tataśca pratyavasthaṃ tasyā eva sarvātmakatvāt tṛṇādyapi sarvagatamiti kiṃ puruṣaikatvaprakalpanayā ? atallakṣaṇatvādvā vinidrāvasthāyā abhāvaḥ, tataśca tattattvacaturavasthasarvātmakapuruṣābhāvaḥ
atha vinidrālakṣaṇaviparīto'pi puruṣaḥ puruṣa evāvadhāraṇabhedāt, vinidrāvasthā-

mā bhūt puruṣāsarvagatatvadoṣa iti vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇo'pi san puruṣaḥ sarvatvānna vinidrāvasthāmātra eva, kiṃ tarhi ? suptādivṛttirapītīṣyate, tato vinidrāvasthāpi vinidrāvasthātmikā satī sarvatvādeva na vinidrāvasthāmātraiva syāt, suptādyavasthāpi syādityarthaḥ
hetuḥ vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇatvāt puruṣasvātmavat, yathā puruṣo vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇatvāt sarvagata iṣyate tathā vinidrāvasthā''tmasthaiva syāt sarvagatā syāt, vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇā hi sāpīti

tataścetyādi, evaṃ ca satyanyo'pi doṣaḥ, avasthāmavasthāṃ prati pratyavasthaṃ vinidrāvasthāvṛtteḥ suptasuṣuptajāgradavasthāsvapi tasyā eva vinidrāvasthāyā evāviśeṣeṇa sarvagatatvāt suṣuptāvasthāpi tṛṇādi sarvagataṃ syāt sarvātmakatvād vinidrāvasthāvat, sarvātmakatvaṃ vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇatvāt puruṣavadityuktam

tasmāt tṛṇādyapi sarvagatamiti kiṃ puruṣaikatvaprakalpanayā ? kaḥ puruṣavādaviśeṣābhimānaḥ ? tṛṇamevedaṃ sarvaṃ yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam, yasmāt paraṃ nāparamasti kiñcit ityādi tenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ tṛṇena sarvam iti ca kasmānna paṭhyate ? iti
lakṣaṇaṃ viśeṣya arthāntarādavacchidya svarūpe'vasthāpakaṃ nīlotpalavat, tat punaḥ svātmanyasthitatvānnāsti lakṣaṇaṃ pratyavasthaṃ sarvātmasu vṛttatvāt
tato'tallakṣaṇatvādvā vinidrāvasthāyā abhāvaḥ syāt svātmanyasthitatvāt khapuṣpavat

tataśca tattattve, tāsāṃ tattvaṃ catasṛṇāmavasthānāṃ saiva, tattattve caturavasthā'bhāvaḥ, tā eva ca sarvam, tadabhāvāt sarvābhāvaḥ, sarvābhāvāt tadātmakasya sarvātmakasya puruṣasyāpyabhāva ityata āha --tataśca tattattvacaturavasthasarvātmakapuruṣābhāvaḥ, caitanyameva hi puruṣasyāvasthānāṃ ca lakṣaṇam, tadabhāve puruṣasyāvasthānāṃ cābhāve kimavaśiṣyate ?

atha mataṃ bhavataḥ--vinidrāvasthāpuruṣābhāvadoṣayoḥ parihāre sarvadoṣaparihāraḥ, sa cāvadhāraṇavaiparītyeneti, tadyathā --puruṣastu puruṣa eva vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇaviparīto'pi, kiṃ kāraṇam ? avadhāraṇe bhedāt
kathamavadhāraṇabhedaḥ ? ucyate --vinidrāvasthāsvātmani avadhāryamāṇe svātmani vinidrāvasthaiva lakṣaṇam, puruṣe tu lakṣaṇameva anyāsāmapyatyāgāt, sa hyanekarūpo mecakavat
na, uktavadavadhāraṇabhedasyānyāyyatvāt pratijñātavyāghātād ghaṭarūpāditvavat, puruṣatvaṃ prāguktamavasthānām, adhunā tu pṛthaksvātmānastā ucyanta iti tattvaṃ puruṣasya rūpādighaṭatvavat

yadā ca tāsāmeva tattvaṃ tatastāsāṃ vinidrāvasthaiva lakṣaṇaṃ nānyā kācidavastheti svātmano lakṣaṇatvamavasthāyā niyatam, sā tvanyāvasthātmano'pi lakṣaṇatvānna niyateti na vinidrāvasthāyāstāvadabhāvo'sti

puruṣasyāpyabhāvo nāsti, puruṣe tu lakṣaṇamevetyavadhāraṇād vinidrāvasthā lakṣaṇameva puruṣasya nālakṣaṇamiti puruṣo lakṣyatvenāniyato'nyābhirapyavasthābhirlakṣyatvādanyāsāmapyatyāgāllakṣaṇatvena puruṣasyeti bhedenāvadhāraṇam
yasmāt sa hyanekarūpo mecakavat puruṣaḥ, varṇasaṅkaro hi mecakaḥ, sa nīlo'pi pīto'pi śeṣavarṇo'pi tathā puruṣo vinidrāvasthālakṣaṇo'pi suptādyanyatamāvasthālakṣaṇo'pīti
svātmani vinidrāvasthaiva lakṣaṇam, puruṣe tu lakṣaṇameva anyāsāmapyatyāgāt, sa hyanekarūpo mecakavat
na, uktavadavadhāraṇabhedasyānyāyyatvāt pratijñātavyāghātād ghaṭarūpāditvavat, puruṣatvaṃ prāguktamavasthānām, adhunā tu pṛthaksvātmānastā ucyanta iti tattvaṃ puruṣasya rūpādighaṭatvavat
naitadupapannam, uktavadavadhāraṇabhedasyānyāyyatvāt, uktena tulyamuktavat tenaiva prāguktaprakāreṇa tenaiva nyāyenāvadhāraṇabhedasyāvasara eva nāsti, nyāyādanapetaṃ nyāyyam, na nyāyyamanyāyyam

kutaḥ ? pratijñātavyāghātāt, yadyavadhāraṇaṃ bhinnārthaviṣayamāśrīyate caitanyātmakaikapuruṣamayamidaṃ sarvam iti pratijñā hīyate, athaikapuruṣamayatvapratijñā paripālyate bhinnārthaviṣayādhārāvadhāraṇopapattirviśīryate, katham ? ghaṭarūpāditvavat, yathā ghaṭa eva rūpādayaḥ ityetasmin pakṣe na rūpādayo nāma kecit santi ghaṭādarthāntarabhūtāḥ, tatra rūpasvātmano rūpāvasthaiva lakṣaṇaṃ na rasādyavasthāpi, ghaṭātmanastu rūpāvasthā lakṣaṇameva itarāsāmatyāgāt iti ko'rthaḥ syād rūpādyabhāvāt ? tathehāpi vinidraikāvasthālakṣaṇapuruṣavyatiriktārthābhāvāditarāsāṃ suptādyavasthānāmabhāvādeva ko'vadhāraṇārthāvakāśaḥ ? ityavadhāraṇābhāvaḥ pratijñāvyāghāto vetyetadubhayaṃ pradarśayati --puruṣatvaṃ prāguktamavasthānām adhunā tu pṛthaksvātmānastā ucyante'vasthā iti prāguktavadavadhāraṇabhedasyānyāyyatvaṃ pratijñāvyāghātaśceti

iti tattvamiti asmāddhetoḥ pratijñāvyāghātādavadhāraṇabhedānyāyyatvāccobhayathāpīṣṭaviparītaṃ tattvamavasthātvaṃ puruṣasya avasthā eva puruṣaḥ, na puruṣa evāvasthāḥ ityetat prāptaṃ rūpādighaṭatvavat, yathā rūpādaya eva ghaṭaḥ ityetasmin pakṣe na ghaṭo nāma kaścit ityayamarthaḥ, tatra rūpameva, na rasaḥ ityādyavadhāraṇamupapadyate bhinnārthaviṣayatvāt tathā yadyavasthā eva puruṣa ityucyeta yujyetāvadhāraṇaṃ puruṣābhāve'vasthānāmeva bhinnānāmitarāvasthānivṛttyarthamekāvasthāvadhāraṇam, tat tu na yujyate caitanyātmakaikapuruṣamayatvapratijñāvyāghātāditi
kiñcānyat, yadā ca tāsāmeva tattvamityādi yāvallokavadeva tattvāpattiriti

yadā ca tāsāṃ bhāvastattvam, bhāva eva tāḥ, tābhireva bhūyate, bhedenāvadhāryamāṇatvād vinidrāvasthaiva vinidrāvasthāsvātmani lakṣaṇam, puruṣe tu sā lakṣaṇameva, na tu saiva lakṣaṇaṃ puruṣasyānyāsāmapyavasthānāṃ tallakṣaṇatvātyāgāt
tathā tathā tathetaretarātmasu abhāvādavadhāraṇabhedād bhinnabhinnārthatvānnanu tadeva sarvāsarvagatatvamiti lokavadeva tattvāpattiḥ

athāvikalpaśabdārthatvādalakṣaṇa eva na tvajñātatattvatvāt, kathaṃ tarhi caturavasthāvarṇanamanekātmakasarvagatatvabhāvanaṃ ca ? yadyasyaikaikā pratyekamavasthā na bhavati tato'sattvāt kuto'sya tadekatvāpattyātmikā avikalparūpatā ? na hi pṛthagavṛtte tathā tāsāmitaretarātmasu abhāvaḥ, avadhāraṇabhedāt

tathā tathā iti vacanāduttarottarabhedānāmapītaretarātmasu nāsti bhāvaḥ, tadyathā--rūpāvasthāsvātmani rūpāvasthaiva lakṣaṇam ghaṭasvātmani tu rūpāvasthā lakṣaṇameva rasādyavasthānāmapi tallakṣaṇatvātyāgāt, tathā pṛthivīloṣṭādīnāmitaretarātmasu abhāvālloṣṭāvasthāsvātmāvadhāraṇe loṣṭāvasthaiva loṣṭāvasthāsvātmā, pṛthvīsvātmāvadhāraṇe tu sā lakṣaṇameva, na tu saiva vajrādīnāmapyatyāgāditi sarvatrāstyavadhāraṇabhedaḥ

tato'vadhāraṇabhedāt tvaduktādeva tathā tathetaretarātmasu abhāvādavadhāraṇabhedādatyantaṃ bhinnārthatvam, ato bhinnabhinnārthatvāt sāmānyābhāvaḥ, sāmānyābhāvād viviktānekabhedāvasthāmātratvāt sarvamasarvagatam ghaṭo ghaṭa eva, rūpaṃ rūpameva, raso rasa eva, paṭaḥ paṭa eva ityādi prāptam

tato nanu tadeva darśanametadapyāpannaṃ yaduktaṃ yathālokagrāhameva vastu, śāstreṣvanarthako vivekayatnaḥ ityādi svaparaviṣayasāmānyaviśeṣanirākaraṇena laukikameva yathādravyakṣetrakālabhāvabhavanameva ca vastviti tadeva tattvam iti lokavadeva tattvāpattiriti
tathā tathetaretarātmasu abhāvādavadhāraṇabhedād bhinnabhinnārthatvānnanu tadeva sarvāsarvagatatvamiti lokavadeva tattvāpattiḥ

athāvikalpaśabdārthatvādalakṣaṇa eva na tvajñātatattvatvāt, kathaṃ tarhi caturavasthāvarṇanamanekātmakasarvagatatvabhāvanaṃ ca ? yadyasyaikaikā pratyekamavasthā na bhavati tato'sattvāt kuto'sya tadekatvāpattyātmikā avikalparūpatā ? na hi pṛthagavṛtte

tasya nirvikalpasyāvibhāgasya saṃsargabhedapariṇāmaśūnyasya meghastanitādikalpaśabdagocarātītasya mayūravirutavat saṅketād vyavahārānupātibhirvā śabdairanupalakṣyasya gorviṣāṇādivat svāṃśakalpanāmātrabhinnaśabdārthābhimānavikalpasya--na tu laukikavadajñāta- sāmānyaviśeṣavyavasthāvicārarūpasya--tattvasya kuto vā lakṣaṇam ? kuto'vasthā ? iti
etaccāyuktaṃ caturavasthāvarṇanāt, yadi tāścatasro'pyavasthā asatyā eva tadvarṇanaṃ khapuṣpasaurabhavarṇanavat kathamupapadyate ? iti
kiñcānyat, sarvagatatvabhāvanā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt, taddarśayannāha --anekātmakasarvagatatvabhāvanaṃ ca katham iti vartate

sarvaṃ gataṃ sarvagatam, sṛ gatau pā॰ dhā॰ 935, 1095, sarvam ityayameva sarvaśabdo gamanārthadeśāntaraprāptilakṣaṇāṃ kriyāṃ bhinnavikalpārthaviṣayāmāha yadanyacca anyacca tadaśeṣaṃ sarvam iti, tataśca tat tadaśeṣaṃ gataṃ sarvagatam, tadbhāvaḥ sarvagatatvamarthānekātmakatvāvinābhāvi, anekātmakaṃ hi sarvam, bhinnānekavikalpakṛtsnārthagataṃ sarvagatamityeṣā bhāvanā nirvikalpaikātmakatve na yujyata iti
kiñcānyat, nirvikalpatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt, yadyasyaikaiketyādi yāvad mecakātmake bhavataḥ

yadi asya puruṣasya ekaikā pṛthak pṛthagekāmekāṃ prati pratyekaṃ samāptā suptādyavasthā na bhavati tataśca ekaikasyā abhāvāt tā na santyeveti kṛtvā tāsāmasattvāt kuto'sya puruṣatattvasya tāsāmeva bhinnānāmekatvāpa rūpe mecakātmake bhavataḥ
tvaduktereva ca na sa lakṣyo nārtho na vastu, alakṣaṇatvāt, khapuṣpavat
tathā sa naiva ttyātmikā tat puruṣatattvamekamavikalpam ityavikalpatā syāt ? bhinnavikalpaikāpattyātmakatvādavikalparūpatāyāḥ sā vā'vikalparūpatā kutaḥ ? nāstyevetyarthaḥ
taddarśayati --na hi pṛthagavṛtte rūpe dve api sitāsite svena rūpeṇa mecake bhavataḥ, bhedātmalābhāvinābhāvyekāpattyabhāvāt
evamavasthā api pṛthak svarūpeṇāsiddhā nirvikalpaikarūpā na bhavitumarhantīti
tvaduktereva ca na sa lakṣyo nārtho na vastu, alakṣaṇatvāt, khapuṣpavat

kiṃ vā pārśvaśarakṣepeṇa bhayajananānuvṛttyā ? tameva puruṣaṃ nirākurmahe, tadyathā --asanneva tvasau evamavasthānāmasattve, kutaḥ ? anavasthātvādavasthāto'nyatvādanavasthātmakatvādavasthātvābhāvāt puruṣo vandhyāputravat
syānmatam--rūpādyavasthā'nātmakasya ghaṭasya avasthāvato'stitvavat suptādyavasthā'nātmakasya suptādicaturavasthāvataḥ puruṣasyāstitvamiti, etaccāyuktam, anavasthātve sati acaturātmakatvāt
athavā kimanena prayāsena upapattyantaraistadasattvapratipādanena ? nanu tvaduktereva ca na sa lakṣyastvatparikalpitaḥ puruṣo nāsau lakṣyaḥ, alakṣaṇatvāt

alakṣyatvamiṣṭatvādasādhyamiti cet, lakṣyatvanirākṛterarthanirākaraṇārthatvād nārtha iti brūmaḥ, artho'pi aryate ityalakṣaṇatvācchabdābhidheyo jñānajñeyo vā neti vinidrāvasthā'vinidrāvasthā vā syād na sa puruṣastallakṣaṇastadubhayābhāvāt
nirvikalpatvādevārtho'pi naiveti cet, nirvikalpajñānavad vastutvamapi na bhavati ityetatpratipādanārthatvādidameva gṛhāṇa --avastveva tat tvadiṣṭaṃ tattvamalakṣaṇatvāt khapuṣpavat

athācakṣīthāḥ --ata iti puruṣata itaścetyavasthātaḥ anyatarasya puruṣasyāvasthānāṃ vā parityāgaikānto na yuktaḥ, avasthātyāge lakṣaṇābhāvāt puruṣābhāvaprasaṅgāt, avasthāvataḥ puruṣasya vā tyāge'vasthānāmabhāvaprasaṅgāt
kiṃ tarhi ? tallakṣaṇatvātallakṣaṇatvābhyāmavācyaḥ sa puruṣa iti
etaccāyuktam, yasmāt tathā sa naiva syāt, eta syāt, vinidrāvasthayā sahaikatvānyatve pratyavacanīyatvāt, khapuṣpavat
yattu sat tad vinidrāvasthayā sahaikatvānyatve prati vacanīyam, yathā vinidrāvasthāsvātmā jāgradādyavasthāsvātmāno vā
ata eva anyataratyāgopādānāyuktatvādapi ca nanūbhayayuktatvavācyatvābhyupagama eva pitṛputravat
yadyapi ca puruṣasvātmaiva avasthā na tarhi nā, anavasthatvāt, khapuṣpavat

abhyu- syāmapi kalpanāyāṃ sa puruṣo'sanneva, kasmāt ? vinidrāvasthayā sahaikatvānyatve pratyavacanīyatvāt khapuṣpavat, vinidrālakṣaṇaḥ puruṣo na vinidrālakṣaṇo vā ityete dve anyatvānanyatve prati avacanīyatvādasan puruṣaḥ

na tadekaṃ nānyad vā vācyaṃ khapuṣpaṃ vinidrāvasthayā saha, kiṃ kāraṇam ? ekam iti tāvadavācyamasattvāt, anyat ityapyavācyamavinidrāvasthātve satyapyasattve nirupākhyatvād vāgbuddhigocarātikrāntatvāditi khapuṣpe dṛṣṭānte hetoḥ sādhyenāvinābhāvitvapradarśanam

yattu sat tad vinidrāvasthayetyādi vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyābhāve hetvabhāvopapradarśanam, mā maṃsthāḥ asmadiṣṭasamudayyavasthāsvātmani sati avacanīyatāyā darśanādanaikāntikatā iti vinidrāvasthāsvātmānaṃ jāgradādyavasthāsvātmanaśca nidarśayati anyānanyatve prati vacanīyatvāt--yathā vinidrāvasthā svātmano vinidrāvasthāto'nanyā jāgradavasthādisvātmabhyo'nyā, tathā tā api tasyā anyāḥ svātmabhyo'nanyāḥ satyaśca, na tathā puruṣaḥ, tasmādasanniti
yattu sat tad vinidrāvasthayā sahaikatvānyatve prati vacanīyam, yathā vinidrāvasthāsvātmā jāgradādyavasthāsvātmāno vā
ata eva anyataratyāgopādānāyuktatvādapi ca nanūbhayayuktatvavācyatvābhyupagama eva pitṛputravat
yadyapi ca puruṣasvātmaiva avasthā na tarhi nā, anavasthatvāt, khapuṣpavat

kiñcānyat, ata eva tvadabhihitāt kāraṇādanyataratyāgopādānāyuktatvādapi ca nanūbhayayuktatvavācyatvābhyupagama eva pitṛputravat, yathaikaḥ pitā putraścāvaśyaṃ nāsau svapituḥ putratvamantareṇa svaputraṃ prati pitṛtvamanubhavatīti na putratvaṃ tyajati nāpi putratvamevopādatte nāpi pitṛtvameva, tato'sau pitā ca putraśceti vaktavyastaddvayadharmayuktaśca dṛṣṭastathā sa puruṣo vinidrālakṣaṇālakṣaṇānyataratyāgopādānāyuktatvādeva tallakṣaṇātallakṣaṇadharmadvayayuktastaddharmadvayavācyaścāvaśyaṃ bhavitumarhati tadanyataratyāgopādānāyuktatvasya tadavinābhāvāt
evaṃ tāvat puruṣa eva avasthāḥ ityetadayuktam, avasthānāmabhāve'nekadoṣaprasaṅgāt
abhyupetyāpi puruṣasvātmatvamavasthānāṃ catasṛṇāṃ puruṣāsattvadoṣaṃ brūmaḥ --yadyapi cetyādi

yadyapi ca puruṣasvātmaiva catasro'pyavasthāstathāpi na tarhi nā, nedānīṃ puruṣo'sti, anavasthatvāt, nāsyāvasthāḥ santītyanavasthaḥ, tadbhāvo'navasthatvam, tasmādanavasthatvādavasthāsvarūpavyatiriktatvāt tacchūnyatvāt khapuṣpavat

athavā nāvasthā'navasthā, puruṣo'vasthā na bhavati, yo'vasthā na bhavati sa nāsti yathā khapuṣpam, avasthāśca tvayābhyupagatāścaturavasthāvarṇanānekātmakasarvagatatvabhāvanaikaikāvasthābhedābhedāpattyātmakā- vikalparūpābhyupagamāt tato'nyasya khapuṣpasthānīyatvāt

prāgavasthānāmeva sattvamabhyupagamya anavasthātve'caturātmakatvāt ityuktam, adhunā tu puruṣamevābhyupagamyānavasthātmakaṃ paraparikalpitameṣa doṣa ukta pagame'pi nuḥ avasthānāṃ catasṛṇāmapyaikyaṃ syāt puruṣasvātmatvāt puruṣavaditi
vinidrāvasthaiva hi jāgradavasthā vinidrāvasthāsvātmatvād vinidrāvasthāvat, evamitare api
suptāvasthaiva vinidrāvasthā suptāvasthāsvātmatvāt suptāvasthāvat, evamitare api
suṣuptāvasthaiva vinidrāvasthā suṣuptāvasthāsvātmatvāt suṣuptāvasthāvat, evamitare api
yaivānyāvasthā saivānyāpi iti vyākhyayorbheda ityasan puruṣo'navasthatvāt khapuṣpavat
anavasthasya tasya abhyupagame'pi nuḥ puruṣasya avasthānāṃ catasṛṇāmapyaikyaṃ syāt

kutaḥ ? puruṣasvātmatvāt, tvayā hyuktaṃ puruṣasvātmaivāvasthā nānyāḥ ityatastāsāmaikyaṃ tatsvātmatvāt puruṣavat, yathā hi puruṣasvātmatvāt puruṣa eka eva tathā tā apyavasthāstatsvātmatvādekamiti catuṣṭvābhāvāt catasro'vasthāḥ iti bahuvacanānupapattiḥ

tataścaikatvāt sarvatvena sarvathā sambhāvyo na bhavati puruṣaḥ, sṛ gatau pā॰ dhā॰ 935, 1095 iti sarvatvasyānekāśrayatvāt puruṣa eva sarvam iti yadāśrayāducyate tat sarvaṃ kimāśrayaṃ yaduktvā sarvaṃ puruṣasya sarvavyāpitā varṇyate ? tata āha --sarvatvasambhāvyābhāvāt sarvāvyāpitā puruṣasya prāptā vyācikhyāsitasarvavyāpitvavirodhinī
pagame'pi nuḥ avasthānāṃ catasṛṇāmapyaikyaṃ syāt puruṣasvātmatvāt puruṣavaditi
vinidrāvasthaiva hi jāgradavasthā vinidrāvasthāsvātmatvād vinidrāvasthāvat, evamitare api
suptāvasthaiva vinidrāvasthā suptāvasthāsvātmatvāt suptāvasthāvat, evamitare api
suṣuptāvasthaiva vinidrāvasthā suṣuptāvasthāsvātmatvāt suṣuptāvasthāvat, evamitare api
tat punarekatvaṃ vinidrāvasthāsvātmatvāt tāsām, puruṣasvātmatvāt parasparātmakatvaṃ ca siddham
tadidānīṃ bhāvyate --vinidrāvasthaiva hi jāgradavasthā, vinidrāvasthāsvātmatvāt, vinidrāvasthāvat
yathā vinidrāvasthā vinidrāvasthāsvātmatvād vinidrāvasthaiva tathā jāgradavasthāpi vinidrāvasthāsvātmatvād vinidrāvasthaivetītthaṃ vinidrāvasthayā sahaikyaṃ jāgradavasthāyāḥ
evamitare apīti, vinidrāvasthaiva suptāvasthā vinidrāvasthāsvātmatvād vinidrāvasthāvat, vinidrāvasthaiva suṣuptāvasthā vinidrāvasthāsvātmatvād vinidrāvasthāvat
tathā jāgradavasthaiva vinidrāvasthā jāgradavasthāsvātmatvājjāgradavasthāvat, asyāpi pūrvavad vyākhyā
evamitare apītyatideśaḥ, jāgradavasthaiva suptāvasthā jāgradavasthāsvātmatvājjāgradavasthāvat, jāgradavasthaiva suṣuptāvasthā jāgradavasthāsvātmatvājjāgradavasthāvat
evamitare apītyatideśaḥ, suptāvasthaiva jāgratsuṣuptāvasthe suptāvasthāsvātmatvāt suptāvasthāvat
evamitare apītyatideśaḥ, suṣuptāvasthaiva jāgratsuptāvasthe suṣuptāvasthāsvātmatvāt suṣuptāvasthāvat
evamavasthānāṃ pratyekaṃ viśeṣya parasparata aikyaṃ bhāvitam, sāmānyenāpi sarvopasaṃhāreṇocyate --yaivānyāvasthā saivānyāpi ekasvātmatvāt seveti
ekasvātmatvāt sā iveti puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam ityatideśābhāvo bhedābhāvāt

uktavadvā vyavasthānumatau puruṣātideśa- athavāvasthānāmapi pratyekaṃ bhedeṣu parasparātmatvāpādanena manuṣyatiryagamarādiṣu ghaṭapaṭatṛṇādiṣu caikyamunneyam itarātmakamitarat, itarātmatvāt, tatsvātmavat iti
ityasmāt kāraṇādekatvād yat proktaṃ sarvatvasambhāvyābhāvāt sarvāvyāpitā puruṣasyeti tadupanayati — puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam ityatideśābhāvo bhedābhāvāditi
puruṣeṇa vāsyāpratyakṣeṇa idaṃśabdavācyasya pratyakṣasyātideśaḥ, anena vā tasyāpratyakṣasyātideśaḥ sarvameva tanmayam iti
ekasvātmatvāt sā iveti puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam ityatideśābhāvo bhedābhāvāt
upa sāmīpye, sāmīpyena varṇanamupavarṇanaṃ viśeṣadharmeṇa na sāmānyadharmeṇa, sāmānyadharmasya dūratvāt
upavarṇanena bhinnāni rūpāṇyāsāṃ vinidrājāgratsuptasuṣuptatvādiviśeṣavarṇanena, taiśca rūpairbhinnairvyatikaraḥ saṅkaraśca tāsāṃ prāptāvitthamuktaikatvāt
tataśca dānaśīlatapoviśeṣairnarakāvāptiḥ, hiṃsādibhiḥ svargāvāptiḥ, svarge duḥkhānubhavanam, narake sukhānubhavanam, puruṣatattvājñānād muktiriti

ityetau vyatikarasaṅkarau prāptau, tābhyāṃ ca vyatikarasaṅkarābhyāṃ hetubhyāmatathātvaṃ vinidrāvasthāyā avinidrāvasthātvam, evaṃ śeṣāṇāmapyayathāsvasvarūpatvamāsāmavasthānām, tatsvātmatvāt puruṣasvātmatvāt puruṣasvātmābhinnavinidrādyavasthāsvātmatvāditi yāvat, tadevaikatvaṃ kāraṇamāha --tattatsvātmatvāditi, tāsāmatathātvamitthamuktam
asya ceti puruṣasyāpyatathātvameva apuruṣatvameva tatsvātmatvāt tatsvātmavaditi
etamarthamupasaṃharati --iti puruṣāvasthāvyavasthā'bhāvaḥ, itthaṃ puruṣasyāvasthānāṃ ca vyavasthā viśeṣya asādhāraṇena lakṣaṇenāvadhṛtya vyākhyā vyavasthā, tasyā abhāvaḥ svarūpasiddherabhāvāt

mā bhūdeṣa doṣaḥ puruṣasyāvasthānāṃ ca vyavasthāyā abhāvaḥ iti yadi pūrvoktavad vyavasthāṃ pṛthak pṛthag manyase puruṣasyāpi sarvāvasthāvyāpino'vasthānāṃ ca caitanyasamavasthānāvirbhāvatirobhāvotkarṣāpakarṣabhedabhinnānāṃ prāgvyākhyātasṛṣṭivat tataśca uktavad vā vyavasthānumatau satyāṃ puruṣātideśastyājyaḥ, puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam ityekapuruṣamayatvātisargastyaktavyo jāyate pṛthak pṛthak puruṣasyāvasthānāṃ ca svarūpavyavasthābhyupagame puruṣaikakāraṇa styājyaḥ

yo'sāveka eva puruṣaḥ sambhāvyate tasyāpyanekataivamāpadyate, yatsvarūpāvyatiriktalakṣaṇā avasthā vinā bhedenocyante sa puruṣo'pi puruṣeṇābhivyāptatvādanavasthitaikatvatattvapratiṣṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ ityatideśyaḥ syāt puruṣasvātmatvādavasthāvat

eṣa doṣo mā bhūditi tadatyāge yadarthamayamatideśo'tisargaḥ prāg vyākhyātaḥ puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam iti, kimarthamasāvatideśa iti cet, advaitaikāntārthaḥ advaitamekapuruṣamayam ityetatpratipādanārthaḥ, tasyaivāsiddhiradvaitaikāntasya

yo'sāveka eva puruṣaḥ sambhāvyate tasyāpyanekataivamāpadyate, yatsvarūpāvyatiriktalakṣaṇā avasthā vinā bhedenocyante sa puruṣo'pi puruṣeṇābhivyāptatvādanavasthitaikatvatattvapratiṣṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ ityatideśyaḥ syāt puruṣasvātmatvādavasthāvat
tat kathamiti cet, yo'sāveka eva tvayā puruṣaḥ sambhāvyate tasyāpyanekataivamāpadyate
evamiti tvadabhihitenaiva puruṣasvātmātideśādvaitena, kā punarbhāvanā ? ucyate --yatsvarūpetyādi yāvadavasthāvaditi

yasya svarūpaṃ yatsvarūpam, kasya svarūpam ? puruṣasya, kiṃ svarūpam ? nityasarvagatasarvātmakatvakāraṇatvādi, tadavyatiriktaṃ lakṣaṇamāsāṃ tā avasthāstadavyatiriktalakṣaṇāstatsvarūpapuruṣāvyatiriktalakṣaṇāstvayā vinā bhedenocyante tasmāt puruṣādabhinnā evocyante ityarthaḥ, tadyathā--puruṣa evāvasthāḥ, nāvasthā eva puruṣaḥ ityavadhāraṇabhedādeva bhedopadarśanena ca bhedo'bhyupagamyate, tata eva tasya tābhyo nānātvaṃ tāsāṃ ca tvadvacanādeva sidhyati, yathā ūrdhvagrīvādilakṣaṇo ghaṭaḥ, ghaṭa eva ūrdhvagrīvādayaḥ, na paṭo na paṭacāturaśryādayaḥ iti tasya tāsu tāsāṃ ca tasminnavadhāraṇānavadhāraṇābhyāṃ bheda eva sidhyati
na tvabhede'vadhāraṇabhedo'sti, yathā ghaṭasvātmaiva ghaṭaḥ, na ghaṭa eva ghaṭasvātmā iti
kiñca, sa puruṣo'pītyādi, evaṃ ca sati ekapuruṣamayatvātideśātyāge so'pi puruṣaḥ puruṣāntareṇābhivyāptaḥ puruṣasvātmatvādavasthāvaditi prāptaḥ

yathā vinidrādyavasthāḥ puruṣasvātmaiva nāvasthāntarātmikā iti kṛtvā puruṣeṇābhivyāptāstathā puruṣo'pi puruṣasvātmatvāt tadavinābhāvāt puruṣāntareṇābhivyāptaḥ syāt, tathā tadapi puruṣāntaraṃ puruṣasvātmatvāt tadvadeveti puruṣānekatvaṃ syāt, tasyāpi tathaivetyanavasthā ca, tataśca puruṣeṇābhivyāptatvādanavasthitaikatvapratiṣṭhaḥ puruṣa iti prāptam, anavasthitā ekatvena ekatve vā pratiṣṭhā'sya so'yamanavasthitaikatvapratiṣṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ syāt puruṣasvātmatvādavasthāvat, yathāvasthāḥ puruṣasvātmatvādanavasthitaikatvapratiṣṭhāstathā puruṣo'pi syāditi

tathā anavasthitatattbapratiṣṭhaḥ, tasya bhāvastattvamātmasvarūpam, anavasthitā tattvena tattve vā pratiṣṭhā'sya so'yamanavasthitatattvapratiṣṭhaḥ, na svarūpe pratiṣṭhitaḥ syāt puruṣaḥ, puruṣasvātmatvādavasthāvat
yathāvasthāḥ puruṣasvātmāno'navasthitātmasvarūpavyavasthāpratiṣṭhāḥ puruṣasvarūpavyavasthā eveṣyante, tatraiva tāsāṃ pratiṣṭhā, na svātmasu, tathā puruṣo'pi syāt
yathemāḥ suptādyavasthāḥ puruṣasvātmatvāt puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam ityatidiśyante tathā puruṣaḥ puruṣasvātmatvāt puruṣāntaramevāyam ityatideśyaḥ syāt
puruṣātideśāttu punaḥ svaparaviṣayakṛtabhedadvārānyatvāsambhavāt kasyacit kathañcidapyanyasyānupapattau tā api anyatvāpattivat pṛthak pṛthak puruṣaḥ

syānmatam--etaddoṣabhayādidaṃśabdavācyapratyakṣārthādanyaṃ puruṣamabhyupagamya etā evāvasthāḥ puruṣaḥ iti pratyakṣārthedaṃviṣayatayā puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam iti dṛśyaspṛśyādi atidiśyātatidiśyate, yathā ayaṃ devadatta eva iti ayaṃśabdavācyo hi devadattaḥ pratyakṣāpratyakṣatvayoḥ sa eva tathā puruṣa evedam iti

etaccāyuktam, yasmādasyāṃ pratyakṣārthedaṃviṣayatāyāṃ satyāmacetanavyaktamūrtānityādirūpārthapuruṣaparamārthatā prāpnoti, ādigrahaṇādasarvātmakakāryānekatvādirūpārthapuruṣaparamārthatāpi, na cetanāvyaktāmūrtanityasarvātmakasarvagatakāraṇaikarūpārthapuruṣaparamārthatāpi syāditi prasaṅgato'yaṃ doṣa āpāditaḥ
evaṃ tāvadanyānekatvaḥ puruṣa iti puruṣasvātmāparityāgena avasthābhedaṃ taddvāreṇoktvā uktaḥ
idānīmavasthānyatvadvāreṇaiva puruṣānekatvaṃ tvaduktavad brūmaḥ --avasthāstu anyatvānekatva eva puruṣa ityetat pratyātya ?bhedopanyāsavākyam, tadvacanasmāraṇena vicārārthopanyāsa ityarthaḥ
avasthāstu puruṣo'nyatvānekatve sati eva, yato'vasthāsvātmatvaṃ puruṣasyeṣyate tatastāsāmanyatvenānekaḥ anyo'nekaśceti vā
tat kathamiti cet, tvadukterevāvaśyamanyāstāḥ puruṣādanyā vinidrādyavasthāḥ tābhyaśca so'nya iti parasparāvadhikamanyatvaṃ sādhyate

tadrūpāpattyaniṣṭatvāditi hetuḥ, tayoścāvasthāvasthāvatostadrūpāpattyaniṣṭatvaṃ siddham, anyathāvasthānāṃ viśeṣitānāmanyatve sādhye puruṣapṛthaktvena tadasiddherāśrayāsiddhistadrūpāpattyaniṣṭatvaṃ vā'siddhamāśaṅkyeta
athavā puruṣo'vasthā iti cāviśeṣya parābhimataṃ vastūbhayamapi parasparato'nyaditi sāmānyena sādhyate itarasyetararūpāpattyā aniṣṭatvādityarthaḥ, avadhāraṇabhedāccetararūpāpattyaniṣṭatvamāpāditam
kimiva ? avasthāntaravat, yathā vinidrāvasthā suptāvasthārūpāpattyā neṣṭā tathā svato'nyāśceti

tadrūpāpattyaniṣṭatvāsiddhiḥ iti mā maṃsthā ityata āha --yato'vasthāsvātmatvamasya neṣyate puruṣasya, etadavasthārūpāpattyā puruṣāniṣṭatvādavasthādvāreṇa puruṣasya avasthānāṃ cānyatvānekatvaṃ tvaduktau caivamupapāditam

puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam iti puruṣatvenāvasthānāmatideśe'nyatvaṃ na sambhavatyeva, katham ? svaparaviṣayakṛtabhedadvārānyatvāsambhavāt, svaviṣayakṛto ghaṭasya rūpādīnāṃ pradhānasya sattvādīnāṃ caikavastugatānāmeva dharmāṇāṃ bhedaḥ, paraviṣayakṛtastu tayoreva vastvantarāt paṭādeḥ puruṣācca bhedaḥ, tadubhayabhedadvāramanyatvaṃ sambhāvyeta
tato'nyatvānupapattiḥ kasyaciditi vastunaḥ kathañciditi rūpādisattvādiprakāreṇa taddvārānabhyupagamādeva
tataḥ puruṣādanyasyānu atha puruṣalakṣaṇāpi vinidrāvasthā na puruṣaḥ, puruṣo'pi na tarhi puruṣaḥ puruṣalakṣaṇatvād vinidrāvasthāvat
iti puruṣābhāva eva, kuto'sya sarvagatatā ? tadabhāva eva tvadabhiprāya eva evaṃ pratipādyate, tadātmatvābhimatanirasanāt, uṣṇatvanirasanena agnyabhāvapratipādanavat
yattu yatnena alakṣaṇatvamuktamato nanūktavat tvayaiva sphuṭīkṛtamasattvaṃ sarva- papattau satyāṃ tā api catasro'vasthā anyatvāpattivat pṛthak pṛthak puruṣaḥ, catvāraḥ prabhedāḥ syuḥ puruṣāḥ
idamapi tvaduktivadeva, tat katham ? iti taducyate--yathā kenacidupapattiprakāreṇāsambhāvyamapyanyatvamucyate tathā tā apyavasthāḥ sambhāvanāpāditānyatvāḥ pṛthak pṛthak syuḥ
tataśca tāḥ puruṣasvātmatvāt parasparato'nyatvācca puruṣāḥ pṛthak pṛthak, vinidrāvasthā pratyekaṃ puruṣaḥ, evaṃ śeṣā api pratyekaṃ puruṣāḥ
atha puruṣalakṣaṇāpi vinidrāvasthā na puruṣaḥ, puruṣo'pi na tarhi puruṣaḥ puruṣalakṣaṇatvād vinidrāvasthāvat
iti puruṣābhāva eva, kuto'sya sarvagatatā ? tadabhāva eva tvadabhiprāya eva evaṃ pratipādyate, tadātmatvābhimatanirasanāt, uṣṇatvanirasanena agnyabhāvapratipādanavat
yattu yatnena alakṣaṇatvamuktamato nanūktavat tvayaiva sphuṭīkṛtamasattvaṃ sarva-

atha puruṣalakṣaṇāpi vinidrāvasthā na puruṣaḥ yadi pratyekaṃ puruṣatvaṃ tadbahutvaṃ ca doṣau dṛṣṭvā puruṣalakṣaṇāpi vinidrāvasthā puruṣo neṣyate tataḥ puruṣo'pi na tarhi puruṣo'stu puruṣalakṣaṇatvād vinidrāvasthāvat

evaṃ śeṣā apīti, yathā vinidrāvasthā pṛthak puruṣa ityāpādya tatparihārārthaṃ puruṣalakṣaṇatve sati apuruṣatvamāśaṅkya puruṣasyāpuruṣatvaṃ tadvat ityāpāditaṃ tathā pratyekaṃ suptādyavasthā api puruṣa ityāpādya tatparihārārthaṃ puruṣalakṣaṇatve sati apuruṣatvamāśaṅkya suptādyavasthānāṃ tadvat puruṣasyāpi puruṣātmano'puruṣatvamityāpādanīyam
iti puruṣābhāva eva, itthaṃ puruṣasyābhāva eva prasaktaḥ
kuto'sya sarvagatatā ? vidyamānasya hi sarvatvamasarvatvaṃ sarvagatatvamasarvagatatvaṃ veti vicāryaṃ syāt
athavā tvadabhipratamevaitat tadabhāvapratipādanam, nāsmadabhiprāyaḥ, evamityetena vidhinā

kutaḥ ? tadātmatvābhimatanirasanāt, yo yadātmatvenābhimato'rthastaṃ nirasyan vādī tamevārthaṃ nirasyan dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā uṣṇo na bhavatyagniḥ iti bruvannauṣṇyenāvinābhāvinamauṣṇyātmānamagnimeva nirasyati tathehāpi vinidrādyavasthālakṣaṇaṃ puruṣamuktvā puruṣasvātmaitāḥ puruṣānna bhinnāḥ santi iti tā nirākurvaṃstadātmānaṃ puruṣameva tvaṃ nirākaroṣīti tvadabhiprāya evāyaṃ puruṣābhāvaḥ
nābhiprāyamātrādevābhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? sphuṭameva tvayoktaṃ nāsti puruṣaḥ iti, tadyathā --yattu yatnenetyādi

sāmānyenāyaṃ nyāyo'vatāryate, bhāvanā tvasya viśeṣya vaktavyā--yathā avasthālakṣaṇaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣalakṣaṇā avasthā iti vātidiśyamānānāṃ parasparamekatvamanyatvamavaktavyatvamasattvaṃ ceti vikalpāḥ syuḥ savikalpatve, na punarete santi kalpanā'viṣayatvād vikalpātītanirvikalpaparamārthatvāccālakṣaṇatvaṃ tvayoktaṃ prāk, ato nanūktavat tvayaiva sphuṭīkṛtamasattvaṃ pratipādayitumiṣṭaṃ vacanenaiva sarvasyāpi, na kevalaṃ puruṣasyaiva, syāpi, vayamapi ca brūmaḥ--kuto'syāpattibhavanam, bhedatvenābhūtatvāt pariṇāmitvenābhūtatvād vandhyāputravat
vayamapi ca brūmaḥ, na kevalaṃ tvadvacanādevāsattvaṃ puruṣasya, tvadvacanasamarthanāya vayamapyasadeva sarvaṃ tvadiṣṭamiti brūmaḥ
kutaḥ ? tvanmate sarvasyābhāvāt, bhavanaṃ hi dvividhaṃ mayā vakṣyamāṇam--itaretarāpekṣadvaitavṛtti sannidhibhavanamāpattibhavanaṃ ca

tiṣṭhatu sannidhibhavanam, idamapi kuto'syāpattibhavanaṃ puruṣasya ? kathaṃ nāsti ? bhedatvenābhūtatvāt pariṇāmitvenābhūtatvād vandhyāputravat, yathā vandhyāputro bhedatvena pariṇāmitvena vā abhūtatvānnāsti tathā tvadiṣṭaṃ sarvamāpattiṃ nānubhavatītyasat

kimarthamitthaṃ viśeṣyate bhedena pariṇāmitvena vābhūtatvāt iti, na punaḥ abhedatvādapariṇāmitvāt ityucyate ? ucyate--bhedo na bhavatītyabhedo bhedādanyo vā syādevamapariṇāmītyabhedatvādapariṇāmitvāditi, nāsya bhedo'stītyabhedaḥ nāsya pariṇāmitvamityapariṇāmitvādabhedatvāditi bahuvrīhisamāso vā syāt
bahuvrīhistāvanna ghaṭate eva anyapadārthatvādanyasyārthasyābhāvāt, ataḥ samanvayābhāvaḥ, samanvayābhāvāt tadabhāvaḥ

tatpuruṣo'pi prasajyapratiṣedhapakṣe na ghaṭate nañaḥ kriyāpadasambandhino'samarthatvāt, tasmād bhedādanya iti paryudāsaḥ syāt, sa ca bahuvrīhitulya evārthata iti bhedatvenābhūtatvāt pariṇāmitvenābhūtatvāt iti sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ śaṅkāpohārthaṃ cetyuktam
bhinnānāṃ hi bhāvānāmavyabhicaritaikatvāpattīnāṃ sarvatvaṃ bhavati, na tvadiṣṭasyaikasyābhinnasyeti, tad vyācaṣṭe --avyabhicaritetyādi yāvad bhedabhāvaḥ sarvatvam
avyabhicaritamanekatvaṃ yasya tadidamavyabhicaritānekatvamekam, tasya gatiḥ pariṇāmastadāpattiḥ, saikatvāpattiranekena vinā na bhavatīti, yathā śukraśoṇitāderanekasyaikatvāpannasyādhyātmikasya
yathoktam— mātuoyaṃ pitusukkaṃ taṃ tadubhayasaṃsiṭṭhaṃ kalusaṃ kivvisaṃ tappaḍhamaṃ āhāramāhārettā jīvo gabbhattāe vakkamati
sattāhaṃ kalalaṃ hoti sattāhaṃ hoti abbudaṃ
abbudā jāyate pesī pesīto jāyate ghaṇaṃ
bhinnānāṃ vaiṣamyeṇa pariṇatānāṃ śukraśoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭāhārādīnāmaikyāpattyā hi sarvatvaṃ śarīrendriyādeḥ
tathā bāhyamapi sarvatvaṃ, bhūmyambvādivrīhitoyadeśakālādibhinnārthānāṃ vaiṣamyeṇa vipariṇāmamāpannānāmaikyāpattyā sarvatvaṃ dṛśyate, nānyatheti
hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmāditthaṃ bhinnārthāvyabhicaritaikagatiḥ sarvatvam, sa hi bhedabhāvaḥ sarvatvam, tasmānnābhinnasyaikasya sarvatvaṃ kasyacit
tasmāt sarvatvābhāvādayuktamucyate puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam iti
syāpi, vayamapi ca brūmaḥ--kuto'syāpattibhavanam, bhedatvenābhūtatvāt pariṇāmitvenābhūtatvād vandhyāputravat
mātuoyaṃ pitusukkaṃ taṃ tadubhayasaṃsiṭṭhaṃ kalusaṃ kivvisaṃ tappaḍhamaṃ āhāramāhārettā jīvo gabbhattāe vakkamati
imo khalu jīvo ammāpiusaṃyoge māūoyaṃ piusukkaṃ taṃ tadubhayasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kalusaṃ kivvisaṃ tappaḍhamayāe āhāraṃ āhārittā gabbhattāe vakkamai
sattāhaṃ kalalaṃ hoi sattāhaṃ hoi abbuyaṃ
abbuyā jāyae pesī pesīo vi ghaṇaṃ bhave
jīve ṇaṃ bhaṃte gabbhaṃ vakkamamāṇe tappaḍhamayāe kimāhāramāhārei ? goyamā ! māuoyaṃ piusukkaṃ taṃ tadubhayasaṃsiṭṭhaṃ kalusaṃ kivvisaṃ tappaḍhamayāe āhāramāhārei
sattāhaṃ kalalaṃ hoti sattāhaṃ hoti abbudaṃ
abbudā jāyate pesī pesīto jāyate ghaṇaṃ || tandulavai॰ 17 ityādi
yathā ca puruṣe tathetaradravyārtheṣvapi pratisvaṃ yojyaṃ vinidrāvasthāsthāne'bhedaikatvaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ kramayaugapadyādayo nidrādivad viśeṣalakṣaṇamiti vyākhyāya
eka eva sarvam ityetasyāmekasarvatāyām, sarvaikatāyāmiti vā pāṭhāt sarvaikapuruṣamayatāyāṃ pratyakṣata eva bhinnānekaikasarvatāyā darśanāt pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
grahaṇabhedādanumānavirodhaḥ, grahaṇabhede hi nyāyyo grāhyabheda iti, bhedatvapariṇāmitvādibhāvābhāve sarvatvāpattibhavanābhāvādvānumānavirodhaḥ

avikalpaśabdārthādityādi, avikalpaḥ śabdārthaḥ ityabhyupagamya vikalpavyavahārāṅgīkaraṇāccābhyupagamavirodhaḥ, sarvamekam iti vikalpadharmatvena dharmitvena ca tadubhayaviśeṣatvābhyāṃ ceṣṭasya tenaivābhyupagamena nirākaraṇādavikalpaśabdārthasyābhyupagatadharmadharmisvarūpaviśeṣobhayavirodhāḥ

asiddhādihetutā ca, hetoḥ anatiriktaparāparāṇīyojyāyorūpātmakatvāt ityādeḥ pratijñātaikapuruṣābhedāt tvayā asmābhiścoktena nyāyena puruṣābhāvād dharmyasiddherāśrayāsiddhiḥ, tvanmatenārthāntarābhāve'sādhāraṇatā, asmanmatena vipakṣa eva bhāvād viruddhatā sādhāraṇānaikāntikatā vā, sapakṣamabhyupagacchato vā te ghaṭādyavasthābhedād vṛkṣādidṛṣṭāntaṃ vṛkṣaḥ iti puruṣavyatiriktavṛkṣādyavasthābhedābhāve sādhyasādhanobhayadharmadharmyasiddhayo dṛṣṭāntadoṣāḥ, ādigrahaṇād yathāsambhavaṃ kalpanāṃ kṛtvā vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntadoṣā yojyāḥ
...vaidharmyeṇāpi dṛṣṭāntābhāsaḥ pañcaprakāraḥ, tadyathā--sādhyāvyāvṛttaḥ 1, sādhanāvyāvṛttaḥ 2, ubhayāvyāvṛttaḥ 3, avyatirekaḥ 4, viparītavyatirekaśceti
adhunātideśena niyatyādivādeṣvapi doṣāṃstānevāha — yathā ca puruṣe tathetaradravyārtheṣvapīti niyati-kāla-svabhāva-bhāveṣvapi svaṃ svaṃ prati pratisvaṃ pratyekaṃ yojyam

tamatideśopāyamācaṣṭe, tadyathā --vinidrāvasthāsthāne'bhedaikam, vinidrāvasthā sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ puruṣasya puruṣavāde suptādyavasthāvyāpitvāt, suptādyavasthā api viśeṣāstasya tadātmatvāditi yathā vyākhyātaṃ tathā niyatyādāvabhedaikatvaṃ niyatyādeḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇamatītānāgatavartamānabālyakaumārayauvanakramayaugapadyādayo nidrādivad viśeṣalakṣaṇamiti vyākhyāya vikalpadvayapratiṣedhastathaiva kartavyaḥ--atha kiṃ yā etā avasthāstā eva niyatyādiḥ ? uta niyatyādirevāvasthāḥ ? yadi tā eva niyatyādiḥ, samudayavādaḥ kṣaṇikavādo vijñānamātratāvādaḥ śūnyatāvāda ityādi
atha niyatyādaya evāvasthāḥ, tathā'bhedaikatvāvasthālakṣaṇatvādiḥ sa eva prapañco ityatastattvaṃ tāvat saṃvadati yadayaṃ bhavati so'sya bhāva iti, sarvagatatvanityatvadeśakālābhedāt
yastu bhavati sa kartaiveti sampradhāryam, bhavateḥ sannidhyāpattibhavanadvayārthatvādastibhavatividyatipadyativartatīnāṃ sannipātaṣaṣṭhānāṃ sattārthatvāt
astyādibhavanaṃ sannidhimātravṛttyeva āpattibhavanapṛthagbhūtam, yadupādānametadabhidhīyate--astirbhavantīparaḥ prathamapuruṣe'prayujyamāno'pyastīti gamyate, vṛkṣa ityastīti gamyate pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
ityato'smāt tattvaṃ tāvat saṃvadati, śeṣaṃ na saṃvadati sarvaṃ tvaduktam

katamat saṃvadatīti cet, yadayaṃ bhavati so'sya bhāva ityetat saṃvadati, tasya bhāvastattvaṃ yena bhūyate yo bhavati sa eva bhāvaḥ, kartṛlakṣaṇāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kṛtvā tasya bhāvaḥ sa bhāvaḥ, itīdamasmaddarśanena saha saṃvadati

kiṃ kāraṇam ? sarvagatatvanityatvadeśakālābhedāt, sarvagatatvena nityatvena ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ deśakālābhyāmabhedāt, taddhi bhavanaṃ deśe kvacinna na bhavatīti sarvagatatvādabhinnam, kālataḥ satataṃ bhavati na kadācinna bhavatīti nityatvādabhinnam
ityatastattvaṃ tāvat saṃvadati yadayaṃ bhavati so'sya bhāva iti, sarvagatatvanityatvadeśakālābhedāt
yastu bhavati sa kartaiveti sampradhāryam, bhavateḥ sannidhyāpattibhavanadvayārthatvādastibhavatividyatipadyativartatīnāṃ sannipātaṣaṣṭhānāṃ sattārthatvāt
astyādibhavanaṃ sannidhimātravṛttyeva āpattibhavanapṛthagbhūtam, yadupādānametadabhidhīyate--astirbhavantīparaḥ prathamapuruṣe'prayujyamāno'pyastīti gamyate, vṛkṣa ityastīti gamyate pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2

idaṃ punarna tāvadicchāmaḥ sampradhāryatvāt, yastu bhavati sa kartaiveti sampradhāryam, na hi kartarivihitatippratyayāntabhavatiśabdaśravaṇādeva kartṛtvam, akarturākāśāderapi bhavanādabhavanavyāvṛttimātrasattārthatvād bhavanasya, kāraṇaparyāyatvāt karoterakāraṇakāryamapi bhavatyeva bhavateḥ sannidhyāpattibhavanadvayārthatvādastibhavati-vidyati-padyati-vartatīnāṃ sannipātaṣaṣṭhānāṃ sattārthatvādityetadasvatantrasyāvyāpṛtasyāpi bhavane kāraṇamāha

bhavateḥ sannidhyāpattibhavanārthatvam, asti-vidyati-sannipātānāṃ sannidhimātrabhavanārthatvam, padyativartatyorāpattibhavanārthatvamiti bhāgaḥ savyāpāratvād nirvyāpāratvācca trayāṇāṃ bhavateḥ sāmānyabhavanavācitvāditi apariṇāmitvāt pariṇāmitvādakartṛtvāt kartṛtvācca viśeṣaḥ
asato bhavanābhāvādastyādibhavanaṃ sannidhimātravṛttyeva, sannidhimātrā vṛttirasyeti sannidhimātravṛtti tadastibhavanamāpattibhavanapṛthagbhūtaṃ tato'nyadīṣadbhinnamavyāpṛtamityarthaḥ

etaccāyuktam, tatraivānujñātatvāt, yadupādānametadabhidhīyata ityādi, idaṃ tu sannidhimātravṛttibhavanamevopādāyābhihitaṃ yatrāpyanyat kriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāpyastirbhavantīparaḥ prathamapuruṣe'prayujyamāno'pyastīti gamyate
bhavantī vartamānā vibhaktiḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñayoktā laḍityarthaḥ, tatparo'stiḥ asiḥ, as bhuvi pā॰ dhā॰ 1065 iti dhātuḥ, ikśtipau dhātunirdeśe pā॰ vā॰ 3
tadudāharati --vṛkṣa ityastīti gamyate, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? asti bhavati sannihitamityarthaḥ
vibhāgaḥ dvayoḥ savyāpāratvād ityapi pāṭho'tra sambhāvyate
āpattibhavanaṃ tu astibhavanaṃ sannihitatathāvṛtti kāraṇe kāryasya sattvāt, yathā ghaṭo bhavati nirvartate āpadyate
sā ca bhoktṛbhogyadvaitabhūtatāyāṃ sannidhisiddhiḥ, na tato nyūnatāyāmadhikatāyāṃ vā vyatirekābhāvāt
na jñeyamantareṇa jñātṛtvam, jñeyāsattvāt, khapuṣpajñatvavat, vaidharmyeṇa itarakusumajñatvavat
idamapi ceṣadbhinnaṃ sannidhibhavanameva tathāvṛtti, sannihitasya tathā vṛtterāpattibhavanam

athavā tathā vṛttirasya tathāvṛtti, sannihitaṃ ca tathāvṛtti ca taditi sannihitatathāvṛtti, kiṃ tat ? āpattibhavanam, kutaḥ sannihitameva tathā vartata ityucyate ? ucyate --kāraṇe kāryasya sattvāt, kāryaṃ hyaṅkurādi bījādau sannihitameva tathā tathā deśakālākāranimittavaśād vyaktyavyaktirūpeṇa vartate iti
tannidarśayati --yathā ghaṭo bhavatīti, pūrvamaghaṭatvena mṛttvena dṛṣṭaṃ sannihitameva mṛdi ghaṭabhavanaṃ vyaktamityarthaḥ

sāmānyatvāt sannidhibhavanasiddhistāvat sā ca bhoktṛbhogyadvaitabhūtatāyāṃ sannidhisiddhiḥ sannidhibhavanasiddhiḥ, taddhi sannidhibhavanaṃ dvaitabhūtatāyāṃ sidhyati nādvaitatāyāṃ darśitaikabhoktṛbhogyatvāyuktatvādidoṣād na tato nyūnatāyāṃ siddhiradhikatāyāṃ vā dvaitāt, tṛtīyasyābhāvāt
nyūnādhikānupapattau kāraṇamāha --vyatirekābhāvāditi, vyatirekaḥ pṛthaktvena ekasyaiva vṛttiḥ, vināpi bhāvaḥ
tadabhāvād nyūnatāyāmasiddhiḥ, yathā svāminā vinā bhṛtyasya bhṛtyena vinā vā svāminaḥ
ādhikye'pi vyatirekaḥ, yathā bhāvavyatiriktaṃ nāstīti tatheha bhoktṛbhogyavyatirekābhāvāt
tatpratipādanārthamupapattirucyate --na jñeyamantareṇa jñātṛtvam, bhogyasya jñeyatvācchabdādiguṇapuruṣopalabdhidvayapuruṣopabhogārthatvāttajjñeyamāpattibhavanam, tadantareṇa na jñāturjñātṛtvam
jñeyasyāsattvāditi vaiyadhikaraṇyāt jñasyādharmatvādasiddho heturiti cet, na, jñātṛjñeyayoḥ sambandhitvena sādhyayostadasattvasya dharmatvāt

vaidharmyeṇa itarakusumajñatvavat, yathā cūtādikhapuṣpetarakusumajñatvaṃ sajjñeyatvādupapadyate tathā tvadabhimatādvaitajñatvaṃ dvaite satyupapadyeta, tattraitasya jñātṛjñeyavyatirekābhāvāt tadantaḥpātitvāda draṣṭāramantareṇa jñeyatvam jñāturasattvāt, vandhyāsutajñeyaghaṭatvavat, vaidharmyeṇa itarasutajñeyaghaṭatvavat
na bhogyamantareṇa bhoktṛtvam, bhokturasattvāt, khapuṣpamakarandabhramaravat, vaidharmyeṇa itarakusumamakarandabhramaravat
na bhoktāramantareṇa bhogyam, bhokturasattvāt, vandhyāsutāyauvanavardhitakavat, vaidharmyeṇa itarasutāyauvanavardhitakavat
yadapi ca tathā tathā vartanaṃ bhavanaṃ rūpādau tadapi naikaikasmādapariṇāmino vā sattvamiti
evaṃ hi jñāturjñātṛtvam, yo hi sajjñeyaṃ jānīte sa tu mukhyo jñātā, yathā salilaṃ salilam iti vidvān
yaḥ punarasajjñeyaṃ vijānīte sa tu na jñātā, yathā mṛgatṛṣṇikāṃ salilam iti vidvān

evaṃ tāvat jñātaiva, na jñeyam ityetad darśanaṃ nirastamadvaitam, adhunā jñeyameva, na jñātā ityetannirasyate --na jñātāramityādi, jñātāramantareṇa, tatparyāyaṃ darśayati --upadraṣṭāramiti, jñātrā vinā na jñeyatvaṃ jñāturasattvāt, atrāpi pūrvavat asajjñātṛtvāt iti vā hetuḥ
viparyayeṇa vā pūrvavat sādhanadvayam, parasparāpekṣajñātṛjñeyatvasādhyatayā vā vaiyadhikaraṇyaparihāreṇa heturvācyaḥ

evameva hi jñeyasya jñeyatā bhavitumarhati yadi kenacidanupahatendriyajñānena jñāyate, yathā anupahatendriyabuddhipuruṣajñeyaghaṭavat madhyasthena tarkāgamakuśalena vipaścitā pramātrā vā jñeyaṃ sādhanaṃ yatheti

tathā na bhogyamantareṇa bhoktṛtvam, asadbhogyatvāt khapuṣpamakarandabhramaravat, vaidharmyeṇa itarakusumamakarandabhramaravat sadbhogyatvād bhoktṛtvamiti tatsādharmyeṇa vā, vaidharmyeṇa khapuṣpabhramaravat, parasparāvadhikaṃ vā pūrvavad bhoktṛbhogyatvasādhanam
atrāpi ca evameva hi bhokturbhoktṛtvamiti grantho draṣṭavyaḥ

tathā na bhoktāramantareṇa bhogyamasadbhoktṛtvād vandhyāsutāyauvanavardhitakavat, sadbhoktṛkaṃ bhogyatvāditarasutāyauvanavardhitakavat, pūrvavadevātrāpi vyākhyā yāvadevameva hi bhogyasya bhogyatvamiti
yugapadvā parasparasambaddhasattākau bhoktṛbhogyau, tatsambandhitvāt tayoḥ sambandhitvāditi ayamarthapradarśanahetuḥ, prayogahetustu sambandhitvāt ityeva

yathā sambandhī bhrātā sambandhinā itareṇa bhrātrā vinā na bhavati kanīyān jyāyasā jyāyān vā kanīyasā tathā bhoktṛbhogyau, yathā sadalaṅkārau dampatītyevamādidṛṣṭāntairbhoktṛbhogyasambandhitvasiddhiranyonyāvinābhāvinīti prāguktaṃ sannidhibhavanaṃ dvaite sati sidhyatīti
draṣṭāramantareṇa jñeyatvam jñāturasattvāt, vandhyāsutajñeyaghaṭatvavat, vaidharmyeṇa itarasutajñeyaghaṭatvavat
na bhogyamantareṇa bhoktṛtvam, bhokturasattvāt, khapuṣpamakarandabhramaravat, vaidharmyeṇa itarakusumamakarandabhramaravat
na bhoktāramantareṇa bhogyam, bhokturasattvāt, vandhyāsutāyauvanavardhitakavat, vaidharmyeṇa itarasutāyauvanavardhitakavat
yadapi ca tathā tathā vartanaṃ bhavanaṃ rūpādau tadapi naikaikasmādapariṇāmino vā

adhunetarat --yadapi ca tathā tathā vartanaṃ bhavanaṃ rūpādau tena tena prakāreṇa anyathānyathā cāpattibhavanaṃ rūpe rase gandhe sparśe pṛthivyādau gavādau ghaṭādau ca sakalajagadvartavivartarūpaṃ tadapi naikaikasmāt, ekameva ekamekaikaṃ puruṣādi, tasmādekasmādekasmānna bhavati
kiṃ tarhi ? yadanekamekaṃ tasmādanekasmādekasmād sannidhimātrabhavanāt, āpattitvāt, vrīhivat
tathā cakṣurādayo'pyādhyātmikā iti ā cakṣurādeḥ parārthā yāvacca rūpādidvyaṇukādayaḥ
bhedātmakena cānena bhavitavyaṃ kāraṇatvāt tantvādivat, parārthārthena ca śabdādyupalabdhyarthatvāt
kiṃ hi kāraṇaṃ rūpādi dṛṣṭamekaṃ svārthaṃ ca ? bhavati
apariṇāmino vā sannidhimātrabhavanāt na iti vartate

kutaḥ ? āpattitvāt āpattibhavanatvād vrīhivat, yathā vrīheranekaikasya rūparasādiparamāṇudvyaṇukādisaṅghātādyaṅkurādyāpattiraṅkurādervā bhūmyambvādideśakālādisaṅghātatvād vrīhyāpattistathaitadanekātmakaikamāpattibhavanam

nāpyadvaite, itthaṃ tāvat svaviṣayadvaite sati āpattibhavanam, paraviṣayadvaite satyevāpattibhavanamidamucyate --nāpyadvaite paraviṣayadvaitābhāve bhavatyāpattibhavanam, anarthakāpattyabhāvādevaikasyādvitīyasya kasmaicidarthamakurvataḥ
kintu saṅghātātmakatvāt parārthatvamiti sambandhaḥ, saṅghātātmakabhavanāt pārārthyam, saṃhatyakāriṇāṃ hi pārārthyaṃ nānarthakyaṃ na svārthatvaṃ nānyonyārthatvaṃ ca kevalam
dṛṣṭānto gṛhaghaṭapṛthivyādivat, yathā gṛhaghaṭapṛthivyādayaḥ saṅghātātmakāḥ svataḥ pṛthagbhūtapuruṣārthāḥ nānarthakā na svārthā nānyonyārthāḥ puruṣārthameva cānyonyārthāḥ strīśobhanārthālaṅkāravat

tathā cakṣurādayo'pyādhyātmikā iti dṛṣṭāntabāhulyāt parārthavyāpitāṃ darśayati, ityā cakṣurāderiti cakṣurādayo'pi sūkṣmādhyātmikā vivecyā yāvat parārthā yāvacca rūpādidvyaṇukādayaḥ, kimaṅga punargṛhaghaṭapṛthivyādayaḥ sthūlā grāmārāmādayaśceti ?
tathā cakṣurādayo'pyādhyātmikā iti ā cakṣurādeḥ parārthā yāvacca rūpādidvyaṇukādayaḥ
bhedātmakena cānena bhavitavyaṃ kāraṇatvāt tantvādivat, parārthārthena ca śabdādyupalabdhyarthatvāt
kiṃ hi kāraṇaṃ rūpādi dṛṣṭamekaṃ svārthaṃ ca ?
yat punariṣyata ekaṃ kāraṇaṃ puruṣādi iti tanna vayamabhyupemaḥ

tvanmatenāpyekaṃ cet kiñcit pārārthyakāraṇamiṣyate tadabhyupagamya bhedātmakena cānena bhavitavyamiti pratijānīmahe, kāraṇatvāt tantvādivat, tantukapālādayo hi kāraṇatvāt paṭaghaṭādīnāṃ kāryāṇāṃ rūpādituṭyaṃśvādisaṅghātarūpā anekātmakā eva kāraṇabhāvaṃ bibhrato dṛṣṭā nānyathā tathā tenāpi tvadiṣṭena kāraṇena bhavitavyamanekātmakena

parārthārthena ca bhavitavyam iti vartate, parasmai parārthaḥ, parārtho'rthaḥ kāryaṃ yasya kāraṇasya tena kāraṇena parārthakāryeṇa bhavitavyaṃ kāraṇatvāt tantvādivadeva, yathā devadattaśītatrāṇādyarthe paṭakāryāstantavastathā tena kāraṇena tvadiṣṭena bhavitavyam
sa katamo'rtha iti cet, ucyate --śabdādyupalabdhyarthatvāt, ādigrahaṇācchabdādyupalabdhirādirguṇapuruṣāntaropalabdhiranta ityādyantopabhogadvayaṃ puruṣasyārthaḥ, so'syāpattibhavanasya parārthārthaḥ
kiṃ hi kāraṇaṃ rūpādi dṛṣṭamekaṃ svārthaṃ ca ? iti kāraṇasyānekaikatvāvinābhāvaṃ pārārthyāvinābhāvaṃ ca svārthaikyābhāvaṃ ca darśayati, vipakṣa eva nāstītyabhiprāyaḥ
rūpādigrahaṇaṃ tu pakṣatvād rūpādīnāṃ saṅghātapārārthyapariṇāmitvaiḥ sannidhibhavanavailakṣaṇyaṃ darśayati
taditthaṃ dvaite tvanekātmikāyāḥ prakṛterātmabhiḥ sukhaduḥkhamohaiḥ pariṇāmānukrameṇārabdhāḥ śabdādayo'pi tadātmakā eva, tadātmakatvābhivyaktakāryatvāt, mṛtpiṇḍakāryaśivakādimṛttvavat

sukhātmakānāṃ ca śabdādīnāṃ prasādalāghavālāghavaprasavābhiṣvaṅgoddharṣaprītayaḥ kāryam, duḥkhātmakānāṃ śoṣatāpabhedopaṣṭambhodvegāpadveṣāḥ, mohātmakānāṃ varaṇasadanāpadhvaṃsanabaibhatsyadainyagauravāṇi, tasmāt sukhādīnāmātmatvenābhivyaktaṃ kāryameṣāṃ śabdādīnām

prakriyante vikārāstata iti prakṛtiḥ, pradhīyante'smin mahadādaya iti pradhānam, bahūnāṃ dhānaṃ bahudhānakam, amaraṇādavināśādamṛtam, ityādyanvarthanāmikāyāḥ prakṛteranekātmikāyā ātmabhiḥ sukhaduḥkhamohaiḥ prakāśapravṛttiniyamātmakaiḥ prāgabhihitācāryapavanapāṣāṇavat svapareṣāṃ nartikāparṇanāvāmātmanaśca pratipatticalanadharaṇakaraṇairiveti

te hi vaikārikataijasabhūtādivikārarūpāḥ sukhaduḥkhamohāḥ prakāśapravṛttiniyamātmakāḥ sattvarajastamolakṣaṇā guṇāḥ sāmyāvasthāyāṃ prakṛtiḥ ityucyante, vaiṣamyeṇa tu pariṇāmānukramamāpannāḥ parasparāvinirbhāgavṛttayo'ṅgāṅgibhāvena pariṇāmād vikārībhavantaḥ śabdādīnārabhante, tairmahadā- dinā pariṇāmānukrameṇārabdhāḥ śabdādayo'pi tadātmakā eva, śabdādipariṇāmānukramaṃ sādhanānuṣaṅgeṇa svayameva vakṣyati, tadātmakatvaṃ tāvat sādhyate, tadātmakā eva sukhādyātmakā eva śabdādayaḥ, tadātmakatvābhivyaktakāryatvāt, te sukhādaya ātmā tadātmā, tadbhāvastadātmakatvaṃ sukhādyātmakatvam, tadātmakatvenābhivyaktaṃ kāryaṃ yeṣāṃ te tadātmatvābhivyaktakāryāḥ śabdādayaḥ, tadbhāvāt tadātmatvābhivyaktakāryatvāt, mṛtpiṇḍakāryaśivakādimṛttvavat, yad yadātmatvenābhivyaktakāryaṃ vastu tat tadātmakameva dṛṣṭam, yathā mṛdaḥ kāryaṃ piṇḍaḥ, tasya kāryaṃ śivakaḥ, evaṃ krameṇa stūpakakuśūlakādi yāvad ghaṭaḥ kapālāni vā mṛdātmakānyeva kāryāṇi, maulasya kāraṇasyātmanā vinā uttarottareṣāṃ kāryāṇāmabhāvādādau madhye'vasāne ca mṛdātmakatvaṃ dṛṣṭamevaṃ śabdādayaḥ sukhādīnāṃ kāryam, śabdādikāryaṃ tvākāśādi, tatkāryaṃ ca gavādi ghaṭādi, sarvaṃ sukhādyātmakatvenābhivyaktaṃ tadātmakamiti grāhyam
kathaṃ sukhādyātmakatvena śabdādi kāryamabhivyaktamiti cet, sukhādyupalabdheḥ
sukhātmakānāṃ cetyādinā taddarśayati yāvadātmatvenābhivyaktaṃ kāryameṣāṃ śabdādīnāmiti gatārtham
yāni tairārabdhānītyādi yāvat sukhādimayā eva, pariṇāmānukrameṇa bhūtānāmākāśādīnāṃ śabdādibhiḥ sukhādimayairārambhaṃ darśayati

tatra śarīrādīnyādhyātmikānīti śarīrībhūtāni śabdādyārabdhāni bhūtādīni vaikārikārabdhāni cendriyāṇi trayāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ sanniveśaviśeṣāḥ sukhādimayā eva, tathā pṛthivyādayastanmayakāraṇārabdhatvāt
yad yanmayaiḥ kāraṇairārabdhaṃ tanmayaṃ tat, kārpāsikapaṭavat
anvāha ca--ajāmekāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ bahvīḥ prajāḥ sṛjamānāṃ sarūpāḥ
5 bhūtādīni bhūtādimayāni triguṇāni vaikārikārabdhāni ca śrotrādīnyekādaśendriyāṇi sarvāṇyeva trayāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ sanniveśaviśeṣāḥ, tatastanmayatā
bāhyāni ghaṭādīni rūpādisamūhatvāt teṣāṃ ca sukhādyātmakatvāt tanmayāni tadātmakānyeva
tathā pṛthivyādayastanmayakāraṇārabdhatvāditi mahadādeḥ sakalasya vikārasya brahmādistambāntasya ca jagataḥ sukhādimayakāraṇārabdhatvāt
dṛṣṭāntaḥ kārpāsikapaṭavaditi, kārpāsavikāraistantubhirārabdhaḥ paṭo'pi kārpāsika iti yathocyate tathā bhūtāni sukhādyārabdhaśabdādyārabdhāni sukhādyātmakāni

bhūtairārabdhāni punaḥ śarīrādīni, ghaṭādīni ādigrahaṇāt, paṭakuṭivat paramparārabdhatvāt, yathā kārpāsikatantvārabdhapaṭamayī kuṭirapi kārpāsikī ityucyate tathā sukhādyārabdhaśabdādyārabdhabhūtādyārabdhapṛthivyādigavādighaṭādisaritsamudramandarādīnyapi tadātmakāni
bhūtādīni vaikārikārabdhāni cendriyāṇi trayāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ sanniveśaviśeṣāḥ sukhādimayā eva, tathā pṛthivyādayastanmayakāraṇārabdhatvāt
yad yanmayaiḥ kāraṇairārabdhaṃ tanmayaṃ tat, kārpāsikapaṭavat

asampūrṇaśaktitā vā'prakarṣa iti kāraṇataiva na syāt tasya asampūrṇaśaktitvādupahatabījavat

yadā ca sudūramapi gatvā prāgavṛtterasatkāryatvaṃ mā bhūditi prakarṣaḥ pariṇāmādeva tadā yuvatvavadātmamātravṛttitvameva pariṇāmasyānyatra vṛttasyānyatrāpariṇāmakatvāt, nānyatra vṛtto'nyadanyathā karoti

nānayoḥ satvarajasoritaretarānugrāhitā utthāpyasāhāyakaśaktitvāt, sahāyabhāvaḥ sāhāyakam, tasmiṃstena tadeva vā śaktiḥ, sā utthāpyā yayostadānīmeva te vastunī utthāpyasāhāyakaśaktinī, tadbhāvādutthāpyasāhāyakaśaktitvād vātāhatanaudvayavat, yathā jale'nyonyābaddhe dve nāvau netaretaratrāṇāya tathā sattvarajasī

śibikāvāhakavaditaretarānugrāhitā kiṃ na bhavediti cet, na, utthāpyaviśeṣaṇāt, ayameva hi dṛṣṭānto glānaśibikāvāhakavat, yathā glāno'nutthāpito na śaknoti voḍhumutthāpyasāhāyakaśaktitvāt tathānutthāpite sattvarajasī na śaknutaḥ parasparaṃ pravartayituṃ svayamalabdhātmake iti prakarṣavṛtterabhāvaḥ, prakarṣavṛttyabhāvādasampūrṇaśaktitetyata āha --asampūrṇaśaktitā vā'prakarṣa iti itthaṃ kāraṇataiva na syāt tasya sattvasya asampūrṇaśaktitvādupahatabījavat, yathopahataṃ bījamasampūrṇāṅkurotpādanaśaktitvānna kāraṇamevaṃ sattvamapi syāt

abhyupetyāpi kāraṇatvaṃ sāmyāvasthāyāṃ sattvasya asadakaraṇāditaścānyato na tatsvarūpavyaktiḥ, tasya sattvasya prakāśanasvarūpaprakarṣo'nyato rajastamasoḥ puruṣato'nyato'nyato vā kutaścinna bhavati asadakaraṇādibhyo hetubhyaḥ, tadyathā --asadakaraṇād yathā mṛdi sadeva kāryaṃ ghaṭādi kriyate na khapuṣpādi, sa ca mṛdaḥ svātmaniyato ghaṭātmasvarūpavyaktiprakarṣo nānyataḥ puruṣādestantvādervāpattikāraṇād bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? svata eva bhavati, tathā sattvasvarūpavyaktiprakarṣo nānyato bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? svata eva
śaktasya śakyakaraṇāt kāraṇabhāvācca sat kāryam sāṅkhyakā॰ 9 ityetebhyo hetubhyaḥ sattvaguṇo'nyanirapekṣasvarūpavyaktiprakarṣa iti grāhyam
evaṃ sattvasya prakāśanaṃ tamasā saha yojyaṃ rajasaśca pravartanamiti
kiñcānyat, yadā ca sudūramapītyādi yāvat pariṇāmakatvāt
sudūramapi vicārādhvanā gatvā na prāgavṛtterasatkāryaparihāreṇa prakarṣaḥ pariṇāmavādādṛte, ataḥ pariṇāmaḥ prakarṣeṇa vṛtteḥ kāraṇameṣitavyam

yadā caivaṃ tadā pariṇāmābhyupagamena punarapyetadevāpannam--pariṇāmādātmanyeva vartate yuvatvavat, anyatra vṛttasya pariṇāmasyānyatrāpariṇāmakatvāt, jinadatte vṛttaḥ pariṇāmo na sādhudatte kaumārayauvanādi pravartayati kaumāraṃ vā yauvanaṃ vā, kiṃ tarhi ? jinadatta eva karoti, nānyatra vṛtto'nyadanyathā karoti yathā, tathā na sattve pravṛttiṃ kaścidanyaḥ kuryāt, svata eva pravarteteti

pūrvavadudāharaṇādevāpravṛttyātmakatvaṃ sukhasya, ko hi viśeṣo rajaḥpravartanādṛte kṣīradadhipariṇāmakālavat paścāt pravṛttaṃ pūrvaṃ ca na pravṛttamiti ? na, pariṇāmasya tatraivoktatvāt, prakāśātmaiva vṛttiḥ, itarathā sa prakāśo na sa tathā'pravṛttatvāt tathā'bhūtatvād ghaṭapaṭavat
yaiva ca pravṛttiḥ sa eva prakāśaḥ, tathāvṛttatvāt, ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat
pravartyapravartakatvāt pallavapavanavanneti cet, na, tadātmana eva pravṛttatvāt sannidhimātrāt pūrvavadapravartanāt
ya evāsau sattvasyātmā prakāśaḥ sa pravartakastathā-
nanvetat tvayābhyupagataṃ pūrvāvasthodāharaṇādeva pāścāttyāvasthā viśiṣṭā iti
anyathā hi ko viśeṣaḥ pūrvaparāvasthayo rajaḥpravartanādṛte ? tasmāt sa viśeṣo rajaḥpravartanādeva

ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? kṣīradadhipariṇāmakālavat, yathā kṣīrāvasthāto dadhitvapariṇāmāvasthā viśiṣṭā, pūrvaṃ kṣīrakāle na dadhyāsīt paścād bhūtamiti dṛṣṭam, prakarṣavṛttyā ca vinā na bhavatyayaṃ viśeṣastathā so'pīti
etanna, pariṇāmasya tatraivoktatvāt, nāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ parataḥ sidhyati, kutaḥ ? pariṇāmasya tatraiva sukhe'bhyupagamyāsmābhiruktatvāt

yasmāt prakāśātmaiva vṛttiḥ, prakāśasya yaḥ svātmā sa eva vṛttiḥ, prakāśasyaiva ca vṛttiḥ kālaḥ, sa ca tato'nanyaḥ, kṣīradadhipariṇāmāvasthayoḥ kālākhyatvāt kṣīradadhitvāpattiḥ kālabhedāt, sa ca pariṇāmaḥ sukhasvātmeti nānyat kāraṇaṃ mṛgyaṃ svātmana eva pariṇāmāt

itarathā sa prakāśo na saḥ, sa prakāśa eva yadi pravṛttiviśeṣo na syādanyātmā syāt sa eva prakāśātmā na syāt, tathā'pravṛttatvāt tena prakāśātmaprakāreṇāpravṛttatvāt, paryāyeṇa tamarthaṃ sphuṭīkurvannāha --tathā'bhūtatvādityarthaḥ
dṛṣṭānto ghaṭapaṭavat, yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavati tena prakāreṇābhūtatvāt paṭo'pi ghaṭo na bhavati tathā sa prakāśo'prakāśa eva syāditi

viparyayeṇa tatsvarūpasādhanamucyate --yaiva ca pravṛttiḥ sa eva prakāśo nānyaḥ kaścidartha iti pratijñā, tathāvṛttatvāt tathāpravṛttatvādityarthaḥ ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat, yathā ghaṭaprakāreṇa ghaṭātmanaiva vṛttatvād ghaṭa eva ghaṭasvātmā nānyat kiñcit tathā pravṛttireva prakāśa iti

syānmatam--yaiva pravṛttiḥ sa eva prakāśaḥ itya- yuktaṃ pravartyapravartakayorbhedāt, pravartyaṃ hi sattvaṃ pravartakaṃ rajaḥ, tasmāt pravartyapravartakatvāt tayorbhedaḥ pallavapavanavat, yathā pallavapavanau pravartyapravartakau parasparato bhinnau tathā sattvarajasī iti
etacca na, tadātmana eva pravṛttatvāt, tasyātmā tadātmā, tadātmanaḥ prakāśātmana eva pravṛttatvāt, sattvarajasorbhedāsiddheḥ pallavapavanavad bhedasādharmyābhāvādayukto'yaṃ dṛṣṭānta iti vakṣyati
rajo'pi hi itaratathāsvarūpāpādanādṛte kimanyat karoti ? evaṃ ca pallavavad raja evāpadyate tathā prakāśasya pravartyatvāt

tathāprakāśānatiriktatattvarūpatvādvā pravṛtteḥ kuto'pallavapavanabhedasādharmyam ? yujyate hi pallava- pravartanāt, iha rajaḥ sannihitamapi prāk sannidhimātrādevāpravartakaṃ svayamapravṛttaṃ sattvādhīnapravṛttitvāt, kintu pravartyamapravartanāt
kastarhi pravartakaḥ ? ucyate --ya evāsau sattvasyātmā prakāśaḥ

kathamiti cet, ucyate --tathāpravartyavyaktisvarūpaḥ, tena tena prakāreṇa śabdādinirvartyaprakāreṇa pravartyavyaktisvarūpaḥ prakāśo nartakācārya iva bhrūkṣepaṇādipravartanābhivyañjanātmanā nartakyāḥ pravartamānaḥ pravartakaḥ

kiṃ kāraṇam ? tathāvyāpāraṇāt, tena vyaktirūpeṇa pravartamānasya rajaso vyāpāraṇāt, sattvenaiva hi prakāśanarūpeṇa pravartamānena rajaḥ pravartyate, tasmāt sattvasyātmā prakāśastathāvyāpāraṇād rajasaḥ pravartaka iti tvadabhimatapravartakatvaviparyayāpattireva rajasaḥ pravartyatvāt sattvena sattvādhīnapravṛttitvāt sattvasyaiva pravartakatvāt pakṣadharmaviparītatā ceti

tacca sattvasya pravartakatvaṃ rajaḥpravṛttyātmarūpāpādanāt, rajaso hi pravṛttirātmā, tadeva rūpaṃ rajaḥpravṛttyātmarūpam, tadāpādyate sattvena, sattvāprakāśite pravṛttyabhāvāt, sattvāpāditaṃ pravṛttyātmakarūpaṃ rajaḥ, tasmād rajaḥpravṛttyātmarūpāpādanāt sattvaṃ pravartakam itaratathātmarūpāpādanād rajovat

rajo'pi hi ityādi, rajaso'pi hi pravartakatvamitthameva yujyate, rajo'pi hi yasmāt tvanmatena pravartamānamitarayoḥ sattvatamasostathāsvarūpāpādanādṛte kimanyat karoti ? pravṛttirūpamevāpādayat pravartakamitīṣyate, nānyathā
yathā tat pūrvaṃ prakāśaniyamātmabhyāmapravṛttayostayoḥ pravartanādeva pravartakamevaṃ sattvamitaratathāsvarūpāpādanāt pravartakamastu, ko doṣaḥ ?
evaṃ ca pallavavad raja evāpadyate tathā prakāśasya pravartyatvāt
tathāprakāśānatiriktatattvarūpatvādvā pravṛtteḥ kuto'pallavapavanabhedasādharmyam ? yujyate hi pallava-
evaṃ ca pallavavad raja evāpadyate, evaṃ ca kṛtvoktavidhinā pallavasthānīyaṃ pravartyaṃ raja eva na pravartakam, sattvameva ca pravartakaṃ pavanasthānīyaṃ na pravartyamityāpannam

kiṃ kāraṇam ? tathā prakāśasya pravartyatvāt, yasmāt tena prakāreṇa pravartyatvaṃ rajasaḥ prakāśena tasmād rajasaḥ prakāśena pravartyatvādityarthaḥ, uktaṃ hi --rajasaḥ pravṛttirātmarūpam, tadāpādayati prakāśaḥ prakāśāprakāśite rajaso'pravṛtteḥ iti
tasmāt prakāśena tathā pravartyatvād rajasaḥ sādhūktam --tadātmana eva pravṛttatvāditi

evaṃ tāvat sattvarajasorbhedamupagamya hetorasiddhirviparyayata uktā, naiva vā sattvavyatiriktaṃ rajo'bhyupema ityata āha --tathāprakāśānatiriktatattvarūpatvād vā pravṛtteḥ, vyākhyātaprakārasya prakāśasya tattvamatiricya nāsti pravṛtteḥ svarūpam, tata eva hetoḥ kuto'pallavapavanabhedasādharmyaṃ sattvarajasorabhinnatvāt pallavapavanayorbhinnatvāt ? vyatiriktatattvarūpaḥ pavanaḥ pravartayati pallavaṃ na tu tathāprakāśātiriktatattvarūpā pravṛttirasti
na tadrūpatvamatadvṛttitvāditi cet, na, rajaḥsvapravṛttivat tadātmana eva pravṛttatvāt, anyathā hi na prakāśetetyuktatvādanyathā tu pravṛttyabhāvāt

evaṃ caikaiva vinidrāvasthāpuruṣatvavat pravṛttiḥ pradhānamiti tanmātrameva tat pravṛttyāpattirūpanirūpyatvāt pravṛttisvātmavadityādi bhaṅgacakrāvartanam, iti dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyaṃ darśayati--yathehāpallavalakṣaṇaḥ pavano loke bhinna iti dṛṣṭaḥ apavanalakṣaṇaśca pallavaḥ, yujyate hi pallavavyatiriktatattvarūpaḥ pavanaḥ pallavamāghnan pravartayati pallavaṃ pallavaśca tenāhataḥ pravartyate tadvyatiriktatattva iti na tu tathāprakāśātiriktatattvarūpā pravṛtirasti ubhayoḥ śabdādyāvirbhāvamātraphalatvāt, ato vaiṣamyamiti
71 iti sūtreṇa ubhayorapi ṣaṣṭhītṛtīyāvibhaktyornyāyyatvād vṛttikṛtā asya padasya prakāśena iti vyākhyāne'pi na doṣaḥ
vyatiriktatattvarūpaḥ pavanaḥ pravartayati pallavaṃ na tu tathāprakāśātiriktatattvarūpā pravṛttirasti
na tadrūpatvamatadvṛttitvāditi cet, na, rajaḥsvapravṛttivat tadātmana eva pravṛttatvāt, anyathā hi na prakāśetetyuktatvādanyathā tu pravṛttyabhāvāt
evaṃ caikaiva vinidrāvasthāpuruṣatvavat pravṛttiḥ pradhānamiti tanmātrameva tat pravṛttyāpattirūpanirūpyatvāt pravṛttisvātmavadityādi bhaṅgacakrāvartanam,
॰rūpaḥ pallavaḥ pavanaḥ pallavamā॰ pā॰ vi॰ raṃ॰ hī॰
syānmatam--prakāśanamātraṃ sattvasya pravṛttirnirvartanaṃ tu rajasaḥ, tasmāt sattvasyāpravartakatvādatadvṛttitvānna pravṛttirūpatvamiti

etacca na, rajaḥsvapravṛttivat tadātmana eva pravṛttatvāt, yathā rajasaḥ svā pravṛttiḥ prāgavṛttāpi paścāt svata eva rajaḥsvātmanaḥ pravartamānā rajasā'vinābhūtatvāt tadatyāgena vṛttestadadhīnatvāt tadrūpaiva tadātmana eva pravṛttatvāt, tathā sattvaprakāśapravṛttyanatiriktatattvarūpā rajaḥpravṛttirnānyā prakāśādhīnatvāt tadavinābhāvāt tadaparityāgena vṛttestadātmana eva pravṛttatvāditi

kiñcānyat, anyathā hi na prakāśetetyuktatvāt, uktaṃ prāk sattvaṃ na prakāśeta apravṛttatvāt pūrvavat puruṣavadanagniprakāśavat apravṛttasvātmatvād vāndhyeyavat, iti tathaiva, anyathā tu pravṛttyabhāvāt prakāśāprakāśite rajaso'pravṛtteḥ, tasmād rajaso'pyanyathā vṛttyabhāvāt prakāśa eva pravṛttiriti
syānmatam prakarṣeṇa kāśanaṃ prakāśanamityādi tadeva yāvat pravṛttivaditi prāsaṅgikam
tatrāpi ca sattvasyāpi rajovadaparisamāptarūpatvādityādi akṣaraparivartena yathāyogaṃ yāvadutthāpyasāhāyakaśaktitvād vātāhatanaudvayavad glānaśibikāvāhakavad yāvacca upahatabījavaditi vācyam
evaṃ caikaiva vinidrāvasthāpuruṣatvavat pravṛttiḥ pradhānamiti tanmātrameva tat
evaṃ ca kṛtvā vinidrāvasthāyāḥ puruṣatvavat pravṛttereva pradhānatvamiti tanmātrameva tat pradhānaṃ pravṛttimātrameva
tadyathā--yathā vinidrāvasthaikalakṣaṇa eva puruṣa ātyantikanidrāvigamana pravṛttisvātmaiva vā trīṇīti puruṣāvasthāvat
rūpanirūpyatvād vinidrāvasthāsvātmavaditi tathā pravṛttyekalakṣaṇameva pradhānaṃ pravṛttyāpattirūpanirūpyatvāt pravṛttisvātmavat, na hyasāvitarātmikā svavṛttityāgāpatteḥ

atha pravṛttilakṣaṇamapi na pravṛttimātrameva pradhānaṃ sarvatvāt, na tu sarvāṇi ekasyaiva sarvatvāt, pravṛttirapi sarvatvāt pravṛttyātmikā satī na pravṛttimātraiva pravṛttilakṣaṇatvāt pradhānasvātmavat
tataśca pratiguṇaṃ tasyāḥ sarvātmakatvāt tṛṇādyapi sarvagatamiti kiṃ pradhānaikatvam iti kalpanayā ? atallakṣaṇatvādvā pravṛttiguṇābhāvaḥ, tataśca tattattvatriguṇasarvātmakapradhānābhāvaḥ

atha pravṛttilakṣaṇaviparītamapi pradhānaṃ pradhānameva avadhāraṇabhedāt, guṇasvātmani guṇa eva lakṣaṇam ityavadhāraṇam, pradhāne tu pravṛttirlakṣaṇameva itarayorapyatyāgāt, taddhyanekarūpaṃ mecakavat

na, uktavadavadhāraṇasyānyāyyatvāt pratijñātavyāghātād ghaṭarūpāditvavat, pradhānatvaṃ prāguktaṃ guṇānāmajāmekāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇām ityādi, idānīṃ pṛthaksvātmānasta ucyante iti tattvaṃ pradhānasya, na pradhānatvaṃ teṣām, rūpādighaṭatvapakṣavat
yadā ca teṣāmeva tattvaṃ tatasteṣāṃ tathā tathetaretarātmasu abhāvādavadhāraṇabhinnabhinnārthatvād nanu tadeva sarvāsarvagatatvamiti lokavadeva tattvāpattiḥ

atha sarvasarvātmakatvādavikalpaśabdārthatvādalakṣaṇameva kathaṃ tarhi triguṇavarṇanamanekātmakasarvagatatvabhāvanaṃ ca ? yadi asyaikaikaḥ pratyekaṃ guṇo na bhavati tato'sya kuto'sattvāt tadekatvāpattyātmikā avikalparūpatā ? na hi pṛthagavṛtte rūpe mecakātmake bhavataḥ
tvaduktereva ca na tallakṣyaṃ nārtho na vastu, alakṣaṇatvāt, khapuṣpavat
athāta itaścānyataropādānaparityāgāyuktatvāt tallakṣaṇābhāvādasyāvācyataiva, tathā tannaiva syāt pravṛttyā sahaikatvānyatve pratyavacanīyatvāt, na tadekaṃ nānyad vācyam, nirupākhyatvāt
yattu sat tat pravṛttyā sahaikatvānyatve prati vacanīyam, yathā pravṛttisvātmā prakāśaniyamātmāno vā anyataropagrāhaparityāgāyuktatvādapi ca nanūbhayayuktatvavācyatvābhyupagama eva pitṛputravat
yathaiva hi yadi puruṣasvātmā avasthāḥ na tarhi nā anavasthatvāt khapuṣpavaditi tathaiva yadi pradhānasvātmā guṇā na tarhi pradhānam, aguṇatvāt, khapuṣpavat
abhyupagame'pi tu pradhānasya guṇānāṃ trayāṇāmapyaikyaṃ pradhānasvātmatvāt pradhānavaditi sarvatvasambhāvyābhāvādeva sarvāvyāpitā
pravṛttiguṇa eva hi prakāśaguṇaḥ pravṛttisvātmatvāt pravṛttivat, evamitaro'pi
prakāśa eva pravṛttiḥ prakāśasvātmatvāt prakāśavat, evamitaro'pi
niyama eva ca pravṛttiḥ niyamasvātmatvād niyamavat, evamitaro'pi
ya eva cānyo guṇaḥ sa evetaro'pi ekasvātmatvāt sa iva iti prakṛtirevedaṃ sarvam ityatideśābhāvo bhedābhāvāt

upavarṇanabhinnarūpavyatikarasaṅkarābhyāṃ tvevamatathātvameṣāmasya ca tattatsvātmatvāditi pradhānaguṇa evaṃ caikaikapūrvakavādāpattereva kimanekātmakaikakalpanayā ? saṅghātapārārthyādibhistasya cetanādanyatve sthitācetanatvaikatvapariṇāmitvavṛtti uktavat sthāpitātma- vyavasthā'bhāva eva

tadatyāge yadarthamayamatideśo'dvaitaikāntārthastasyaivāsiddhiḥ, yat tadekameva sambhāvyate pradhānaṃ tasyāpyanekataivaivamāpadyate, yatsvarūpāvyatiriktalakṣaṇā guṇā vinā bhedenocyante tat pradhānamapi pradhānenābhivyāptatvādanavasthitaikatvatattvapratiṣṭhaṃ pradhānam ityatideśyaṃ syāt pradhānasvātmatvād guṇavat
evaṃ caikaikapūrvakavādāpattereva kimanekātmakaikakalpanayā ? saṅghātapārārthyādibhistasya cetanādanyatve sthitācetanatvaikatvapariṇāmitvavṛtti uktavat sthāpitātma-
pradhānātideśāt tu punaḥ svaparaviṣayakṛtabhedadvārānabhyupagame kasyacit kathañcidapyanyasyānupapattau te'pyanyatvāpattivat pṛthak pṛthak pradhānam
atha pradhānalakṣaṇāpi pravṛttirna pradhānaṃ pradhānamapi tarhi na pradhānaṃ pradhānalakṣaṇatvāt pravṛttivat
evaṃ śeṣāvapīti pradhānābhāva eva, kuto'sya sarvagatatā ? tadabhāva eva tvayābhiprāya evaṃ pratipādyate tadātmatvābhimatanirasanāduṣṇatvanirasanenāgnyabhāvapratipādanavat

kṛtaṃ bhaṅgacakrāvartanam, āpāditaṃ caikaikapūrvakamidaṃ nānekaikapūrvakam ityetadāpannamityāha --evaṃ caikaikapūrvakavādāpattereveti avadhāraṇārthatvādevakārasya, tataśca triguṇapradhānakāraṇakalpanānarthakyamityata āha --kimanekātmakaikakalpanayā ? yadi pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ pradhānamevaikaṃ prakāśaniyamapravṛttirūpeṇa pravartate pravṛttireva vaikā triguṇarūpā tataścobhayathāpyekaikakāraṇavāda eveti pṛthagātmakatriguṇakāraṇakalpanāvyākhyā āyāsamātram
tasmādekātmakaikameva vyaktyantarasahasrakaraṇāyānekākāraṃ bhavati, yathā prāgvarṇitapuruṣādikāraṇapūrvakānantaprabhedajagatsṛṣṭisamarthaṃ yat tadevāstu anekākāram, kiṃ triguṇam ityetāvatā ? iti
kiñcānyat, yadyapi tvaduktairhetubhiḥ saṅghātapārārthyādibhiḥ prakṛteranyaḥ puruṣaḥ sidhyati saṅghātaparārthatvāt triguṇādiviparyayādadhiṣṭhānāt

sāṅghyakā॰ 17 iti, tathāpi ca tasya kāraṇasya cetanādanyatve satyevaitāni svarūpāṇi sthitāni, cetanasya parasyārthe pravṛtteracetanasya bhoktṛtvād rūpādipariṇāmino'cetanatvācca tenaivācetanatvenaikatvaṃ sthitam, na hyācaitanyasya bhedo'sti, pariṇāmitvaṃ cāsya tata eva sthitam, āpattibhavanasya rūpādirūpasya pariṇāmākhyatvāt tasya ca sannidhibhavanādbhinnatvāt, yathoktaṃ tecceva te poggalā subbhigaṃdhattāe pariṇamaṃti te ceva te poggalā dubbhigaṃdha svatattvapravṛttitvāt kimiti na gamyate mayā vā kimiti nocyate sukhādananyadeva duḥkham, anātmatve'varaṇādyātmakatvāt, avadhāraṇena ca vakṣyamāṇasādhanāntarāpakṣiptānyatvo vipakṣābhāvaḥ sūcyate, sukhasvātmavat, anyasyābhāvāt
avaraṇādyātmakatvāt kuto'nyatva- ttāe pariṇamaṃti jñātādharma॰ tti

tatastasya saṅghātapārārthyādibhiścetanādanyatve sthitācaitanyaikatvapariṇāmitvāni vṛttayo'sya tadidaṃ kāraṇaṃ sthitācetanatvaikatvapariṇāmitvavṛtti, tacca sukhamiti vā duḥkhamiti vā moha iti vā paramāṇava iti vā kāraṇamityeva vā

uktavat, uktena tulyamuktavat, yathoktaṃ bhinnātmakatāyāṃ tu sattvaṃ na prakāśeta apravṛttatvādityataḥ prabhṛti yāvadeṣo'vadhiḥ, tadvaduktavadeva sthāpitātmasvatattvapravṛttitvāt, ātmasvatattvena sthāpitā'sya pravṛttirityataḥ kimiti na gamyate tvayā vakṣyamāṇasādhanavat ananye sukhaduḥkhe iti, kiṃ svapakṣarāgād mohādvā ? mayā vā kimiti nocyate ? tattvakathāyāṃ prastutāyāṃ kimanuvṛttyā āyatilopāyaśobhayādito vā ? iti

kiṃ punastat sādhanamiti cet, sukhādananyadeva duḥkham, anātmatve'varaṇādyātmakatvāt, varaṇa-sadanā-'padhvaṃsana-baibhatsyadainya-gauravāṇi varaṇādīni, varaṇādīnyasyātmā kāryaṃ tad varaṇādyātmakaṃ tamaḥ, na varaṇādyātmakamavaraṇādyātmakam, kiṃ tat ? duḥkham, tasyānātmatve sati avaraṇādyātmakatvāt sukhādananyatvameva

kimarthaṃ punaḥ ananyadeva ityavadhāryate ? ucyate --avadhāraṇena ca sukhādananyadeva ityanena vakṣyamāṇasādhanāntarāpakṣiptānyatvo vipakṣābhāvaḥ sūcyate, vakṣyamāṇaṃ sādhanaṃ sukhādananya eva moha iti, tenāpakṣiptamanyatvaṃ tamaso'pīti vipakṣābhāvaḥ so'nenāvadhāraṇena sūcyate
puruṣastu syāt sukhādanyatvād vipakṣaḥ, tato vyāvartanārtham anātmatve sati iti viśeṣaṇam
yathā'varaṇādyātmakatvāt sukhasvātmā sukhādananya evaṃ duḥkhamapyavaraṇādyātmakatvāt sukhādananyaditi

anyasyābhāvāditi hetoravyabhicāravyākhyānam, sukhādananyatvena duḥkhe sādhye'nātmatvaviśeṣaṇena ātmani niraste sādhanāntaraniraste tamaso'nyatve na kiñcit sukhādanyadasti, tasmādanyasya kasyacidabhāvād vipakṣa eva nāsti
cetano hyacetanasya bhokteti cetane'cetanasya bhoktṛtvaṃ nirbādhameva
॰ktāṃ taccaiva te poggala pariṇamaṃti te bhā॰
॰ktaṃ tacceva te ppoggala pariṇamaṃti te ya॰

svatattvapravṛttitvāt kimiti na gamyate mayā vā kimiti nocyate sukhādananyadeva duḥkham, anātmatve'varaṇādyātmakatvāt, avadhāraṇena ca vakṣyamāṇasādhanāntarāpakṣiptānyatvo vipakṣābhāvaḥ sūcyate, sukhasvātmavat, anyasyābhāvāt
evaṃ khalu sāmī ! subbhisaddā vi poggalā dubbhisaddattāe pariṇamaṃti, dubbhisaddā vi poggalā subbhisaddattāe pariṇamati
surūvā vi poggalā durūvattāe pariṇamaṃti, durūvā vi poggalā surūvattāe pariṇamaṃti
subbhigaṃdhā vi poggalā dubbhigaṃdhattāe pariṇamaṃti, dubbhigaṃdhā vi poggalā subbhigaṃdhattāe pariṇamaṃti
surasā vi poggalā durasattāe pariṇamaṃti, durasā vi poggalā surasattāe pariṇamaṃti
suhaphāsā vi poggalā duhaphāsattāe pariṇamaṃti, duhaphāsā vi poggalā suhaphāsattāe pariṇamaṃti
paogavisasā vi ya ṇaṃ pariṇayā vi ya ṇaṃ sāmī poggalā paṇṇattā
mohe'nyatvamiti cet, tannivartayiṣyate, vyākhyātārthasphuṭīkriyāyai codyottarapakṣau gatārthau na vivriyete

avaraṇādyātmakatvāt kuto'nyatvanivṛttiriti cet, syānmatam--varaṇādyātmakamoha nivṛttiriti cet, na, avaraṇādyātmakaśabdasya vidhipradhānaparyudāsātmakatvāt anapuṃsakavacanādapratiṣedhe'napuṃsakasuṭi sarvanāmasthānatvavat taṭastaṭaṃtaṭīstrīpuṃnapuṃsakāstrīpuṃnapuṃsakatvavadetat syādekasminneva liṅgatrayadarśanāt, avaraṇādyātmakatve'pyana- pratiṣedhādeva avaraṇādyātmakābhyāṃ sattvarajobhyāṃ mohasya pratiṣedhyasyānyatvaṃ siddham, tasmānna tadanyatvanivṛttiriti
etacca na, avaraṇādyātmakatvāt iti avaraṇādyātmakaśabdasya vidhipradhānaparyudāsātmakatvāt

naño hi dvayī gatiḥ--prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ paryudāsaśca, yathā brāhmaṇo na bhavatyabrāhmaṇa iti brāhmaṇasya nivṛttipradhānaḥ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ, brāhmaṇādanyo'brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyādiriti kṣatriyādividhānapradhānaḥ paryudāsaḥ, tathehāpi avaraṇādyātmakatvāt iti varaṇādyātmakād mohādanyadavaraṇādyātmakaṃ śoṣādiprasādādyātmakaṃ vidhīyate, varaṇādyātmakatvasya tu na vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ paryudāsātmakatvāt, na tu prasajyapratiṣedha iti

tadarthasamarthanārthaṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha --anapuṃsakavacanādapratiṣedhe'napuṃsakasuṭi sarvanāmasthānatvavat, yathā napuṃsakādanyatra suṭ sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñaṃ bhavatīti strīpuṃsayoḥ suṭaḥ sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñā vidhīyate, napuṃsake tu śiḥ sarvanāmasthānam pā॰ 1
41 iti vidhyantaravihitā suṭaḥ sarvanāmasthānatā na vihitā na niṣiddhā, tathehāpi varaṇādyātmakatvasya na vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ śoṣaprasādādyātmakatvavidhānāditi

nivṛttiriti cet, na, avaraṇādyātmakaśabdasya vidhipradhānaparyudāsātmakatvāt anapuṃsakavacanādapratiṣedhe'napuṃsakasuṭi sarvanāmasthānatvavat taṭastaṭaṃtaṭīstrīpuṃnapuṃsakāstrīpuṃnapuṃsakatvavadetat syādekasminneva liṅgatrayadarśanāt, avaraṇādyātmakatve'pyana-
bhā॰ pratau tu etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭho nāstyeva
...śi sarvanāmasthānaṃ suḍanapuṃsakasyeti cejjasi śeḥ pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, kuṇḍāni tiṣṭhanti vanāni tiṣṭhanti
...yattāvaducyate śi sarvanāmasthānaṃ suḍanapuṃsakasyeti cejjasi śipratiṣedhaḥ iti na apratiṣedhāt
nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedho napuṃsakasya neti, kiṃ tarhi ? paryudāso'yaṃ yadanyannapuṃsakāditi, napuṃsake na vyāpāraḥ, yadi kenacit prāpnoti tena bhaviṣyati, pūrveṇa ca prāpnoti

syānmatam--vaiṣamyādadṛṣṭānto'yam, sambandhinaḥ suṭaḥ sarvanāmasthānavidhāne napuṃsakānapuṃsakaviṣayatvāvirodhād yujyeta sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñā, viṣayasya tu napuṃsakānapuṃsakatvavirodhavad varaṇāvaraṇādyātmakatvānupapattiriti

etadapi ca na vaiṣamyāya, atrāpi tattulyatvāt, taṭastaṭaṃtaṭīstrīpuṃnapuṃsakāstrīpuṃnapuṃsakatvavadetat syāt ekasminneva liṅgatrayadarśanāt, dṛṣṭaṃ hi taṭe liṅgatrayaṃ taṭaṃ taṭastaṭī ityekasminneva, yadā ca napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ tadā na straiṇaṃ na pauṃsnam, puṃstve na strītā na napuṃsakatā, strītve netaradvayatā, ityastrīpuṃnapuṃsakatvaṃ ca tathā varaṇāvaraṇādyātmakatvamastu, ko doṣaḥ ? sarūpaikaśeṣākaraṇamanukaraṇatvād liṅgatrayavyaktyarthamityadoṣaḥ
na tulya॰ pā॰ ḍe॰ līṃ॰ vi॰

evaṃ tarhi sukhaduḥkhayorapi varaṇādyātmakatvādavaraṇādyātmakatvāsiddhireva avaraṇādyātmakatvasiddhau vā'nanyatvāsiddhiriti cet, netyucyate, avaraṇādyātmakatve'pyananyatvād varaṇādyātmakatvasya, avaraṇādyātmake api sukhaduḥkhe varaṇādyātmakatvato'nanye, tasmādabhinne varaṇādyātmake eva prasādaśoṣādikāryabhede'pi kāraṇatvānātmatvapariṇāmitvādibhyaḥ
kimiva ? avaraṇasadanādimohātmakatvavat, yathā nyatvād varaṇādyātmakatvasya avaraṇasadanādimohātmakatvavat, vakṣyamāṇavacca varaṇādyātmakatve'pyananyatvādavaraṇādyātmakatvasya prāpitatvāt
śakyate hi vaktuṃ ghaṭaḥ kaṭādananyaḥ, tantvanātmakatvāt, kaṭasvātmavat, vaidharmyeṇa paṭavat

mohātmakāni varaṇādanyāni sadanādīni varaṇātmakamohātmakānyapi avaraṇātmakāni, yathā vā moho varaṇavilakṣaṇasadanāpadhvaṃsanabaibhatsyadainyagauravadharmāpi varaṇātmaka eva kāryakāraṇayorabhedād bhedācca, anyathā paunaruktyānarthakye granthadoṣau vyapadeśyavyapadeśābhāvadoṣaśca syuḥ, neṣyante ca tathā
yathā caitat tathā sukhaduḥkhe prasādaśoṣādayaśca varaṇāvaraṇādyātmakāḥ syuḥ

kiñcānyat, vakṣyamāṇavacca varaṇādyātmakatve'pyananyatvādavaraṇādyātmakatvasya prāpitatvāt, vakṣyati hi sukhādananyat tamaḥ prakāśādananyo niyama iti ca, tatra tamaso varaṇādyātmakatve prasādaśoṣādikāryādekasmādeva sukhādananyatvaṃ sādhayiṣyate, tamaso'pyatastasmādananyatvād varaṇādyātmakamapyavaraṇādyātmakaṃ tamaḥ sattvarajovat
kiñcānyat, avaraṇādyātmakatvasya varaṇātmake satyevānantaraṃ prāpitatvāt tathā vakṣyamāṇatvāditi
...śi sarvanāmasthānaṃ suḍanapuṃsakasyeti cejjasi śeḥ pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, kuṇḍāni tiṣṭhanti vanāni tiṣṭhanti
...yattāvaducyate śi sarvanāmasthānaṃ suḍanapuṃsakasyeti cejjasi śipratiṣedhaḥ iti na apratiṣedhāt
nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedho napuṃsakasya neti, kiṃ tarhi ? paryudāso'yaṃ yadanyannapuṃsakāditi, napuṃsake na vyāpāraḥ, yadi kenacit prāpnoti tena bhaviṣyati, pūrveṇa ca prāpnoti
śakyate hi vaktuṃ ghaṭaḥ kaṭādananyaḥ, tantvanātmakatvāt, kaṭasvātmavat, vaidharmyeṇa paṭavat

itara āha --asādhanamidaṃ sarvatulyatvāt prasiddhiviruddhasiddhyatiprasaṅgāt, prasiddhiviruddhānāmapyarthānāṃ siddhirevaṃ sati prasajyate, arthāntaradharmanivṛttyā tadātmatvāpādanāt, tadyathā --śakyate hi vaktuṃ ghaṭaḥ kaṭādananyaḥ, tantvanātmakatvāt, yastantvanātmakaḥ sa kaṭādananyaḥ, yathā kaṭasvātmā, yaḥ kaṭādanyaḥ sa tantvanātmako na bhavati yathā paṭa iti vaidharmyeṇa paṭavadityuktam
ācārya āha --atha sarvatulyatā kathaṃ doṣaḥ, svamatena paramatena ? iti praśnaḥ ubhayathāpyadoṣaḥ iti manyamānasya

yadi te svasminneva mate doṣastatastava prasiddhivirodhadoṣāsaktirmamābhimataiva tvatprativādino mama tu sarvānanyatvāpādanamabhimatameva bhāvapakṣavat, yathā bhāvavidhividhinayamate'nantarātīte sarvānanyatvamiṣṭam, etasyodāharaṇamātratvādutkrameṇa svabhāvakālaniyatipuruṣapakṣavacca vakṣyamāṇavidhiniyamavacca yathāsvamabhimatā eva

na kevalaṃ parābhimatereva, kiṃ tarhi ? api ca svamate'pi sarvānanyatvam, sukhādyanvayamātratvāt sarvasya nanu ghaṭaḥ kaṭādananyaḥ, sukhaduḥkhamohānvitametad bāhyādhyātmikabhedarūpaṃ jagadicchataste traiguṇyajātyanucchedena sarvaṃ sarvātmakameva traiguṇyānvayānatirekāt ko hi sattvādyatiriktaḥ ? yadi sattvarajastamotiriktaṃ kiñcit syāt sarvasarvātmakavāde doṣaḥ syāt, na tvasti, tasmāt tavaivādoṣaḥ
atha sarvatulyatā kathaṃ doṣaḥ, svamatena paramatena ? tava doṣāsaktirabhimataiva tvatprativādinaḥ, bhāvapakṣavat
svamate'pi sukhādyanvayamātratvāt sarvasya nanu ghaṭaḥ kaṭādananyaḥ, ko hi sattvādyatiriktaḥ ? satkāryavādatyāgo vā tatrābhāvāt samudayakṣaṇikaśūnyavādāpatteḥ
rūpādīnāṃ cāpyanena nyāyena ananyatvāt pratyudāharaṇābhāva eva te
bhinnātmakatāyāṃ sattvaṃ sattvameva na syāt prakāśo vā prakāśa eva, tathā'niyatatvāt anyathā prakāśanābhāvāt, rajovat pravṛttivat

tataśca satkāryavādatyāgo vā tatrābhāvāt, yadi sattvādiguṇe mṛdādau kaṭādirna syāt triguṇo'pi tathā ghaṭo'pi mā bhūt, ato'san ghaṭaḥ paścādutpannastatra prāgabhūta iti asatkāryavādaḥ satkāryavādatyāgaśca prāptaḥ
ata eva ca śūnyavādāpattiḥ, anirdeśyasvabhāvatvāt, khapuṣpavat
rūparasagandhasparśasaṅkhyāsaṃsthānādīnāṃ ghaṭādiṣu dṛṣṭānāmanyatvād vipakṣo'sti ityāśaṅkethāḥ, tatrāpi rūpādīnāṃ cāpyanenetyādi yāvat pratyudāharaṇābhāva eva te

rūpaṃ rasādananyat agandhādyātmakatvād rūpasvarūpavadityādi prasiddhiviruddhasiddhyatiprasaṅgo'pi, te tvatprativādino doṣāsaktirabhimataiveti tadeva yāvad bhāvapakṣavaditi, punaśca svamate'pi sukhādyanvayamātratvādityādi yāvat samudāyakṣaṇikaśūnyavādāpatteriti samānaścarcaḥ
evaṃ sukhādananyad duḥkhamityetad bhāvitam, tamo'nanyat iti bhāvyam, tadapi yathā ca prakāśādabhinnā pravṛttistathā niyamo'pyabhinnaḥ prakāśāt

prakāśānatiriktatāpradarśanārthaṃ niyamalakṣaṇamāha— prakāśasvātmatvapratilambha eva hi tanniyamaḥ, prakāśasya svātmā prakāśanameva, tadbhāvaḥ prakāśasvātmatvam, tatpratilambha eva hi tadātmalābha eva hi tanniyamaḥ, rūpasya rasasya vā prakāśyasvarūpavyaktirniyamaḥ, na hi chinnābhranabhasīva nirāśrayaḥ kaścinniyamo'sti ? tatparyāyakathanaṃ niyamaḥ prakāśānanyatā prakāśasvarūpamātram, etanniyamalakṣaṇaṃ nirucyate, nānyaḥ prakāśād bhinno niyama iti, tatra doṣadarśanāt

ko doṣa iti cet, ucyate --bhinnātmakatāyāṃ prakāśād niyamasya sattvāt tamasaśca sattvaṃ sattvameva na syāt prakāśo vā prakāśa eva na syāditi vartate, tathā'niyatatvāt, guṇāntararūpāpattirahitasya sattvasya prakāśasya cāguṇāntarātmano'guṇāntarātmāpattirahitatvādityarthaḥ
śabdo hi śabdatayā prakāśamāno rūpādyātmavyāvṛttasvarūpeṇa niyata eva prakāśate, anyathā prakāśanābhāvād vyaktyabhāvādityarthaḥ
dṛṣṭāntau yathāsaṅkhyaṃ rajovat tadvā prakāśa iti na syāt, aniyatatvāt, vandhyāputravat puruṣavat
nanu prakāśātmakatvādeva sattvasya agneriva kuḍyādinā tamasā niyamyatvamananyathāvṛttatā
evaṃ hi kāryaṃ kāraṇe sad yadi tat tatra niyatamananyathāvṛtti, tatra sannidhivartateḥ sattārthatvāt
pravṛttivat, yathā prakāśātmanā aniyatatvād rajaḥ sattvaṃ na bhavati pravṛttiśca prakāśo na bhavati tathā sattvaṃ sattvaṃ na syāt prakāśaḥ prakāśo na syāditi

na kevalaṃ guṇāntararūpāpattirahitasya svātmāpratilambha eva, kiṃ tarhi ? mūlata eva sattvameva tadvā prakāśa iti na syādityastitvameva nirākriyate, aniyatatvāt, yadi tat svata evāniyataṃ tato nāsti tat sattvaṃ vandhyāputravat na ca tat prakāśātmakaṃ puruṣavaditi pūrvavad yathāsaṅkhyaṃ dṛṣṭāntau
tadvā prakāśa iti na syāt, aniyatatvāt, vandhyāputravat puruṣavat
nanu prakāśātmakatvādeva sattvasya agneriva kuḍyādinā tamasā niyamyatvamananyathāvṛttatā
evaṃ hi kāryaṃ kāraṇe sad yadi tat tatra niyatamananyathāvṛtti, tatra sannidhivartateḥ sattārthatvāt

nanvityanujñāpane, prakāśātmakatvādeva pradīpavat sattvasya sarvatodiggatāniyataprakāśasya mahadahaṅkārādisparśarūpādipiṇḍaśivakādipūrvottaravyaktyabhimukhatāyāṃ satyāṃ prakāśanasya sati niyāmake kuḍyādau agneriva kuḍyādinā āvaraṇena niyamyatvam, nāva iva vā sarvadiggamanarodhinā lambanapāṣāṇena guruṇeva dvidhāpi pradeśāntaraprāptirodhinā tamasā prakāśasya dṛṣṭaniyamyatvavad niyamyatvam, tacca ananyathāpravṛttatā, evameva te pravartitavyaṃ nāto'nyatheti
atrocyate --yadyaniyato'sāvasaṃstarhi yadi svayamevāniyataḥ prakāśo'saṃstarhyasau aniyatatvād vāndhyeyavat

kāryaṃ kāraṇe'sti ityetad darśanamevameva ghaṭate yadi tat tatra niyatamiti, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? ananyathāvṛttītyuktaṃ bhavati, yathā vartitavyaṃ tathaiva vartate nānyathā, svātmanaiva ca vartate nānyena kenacid vartyate
tacca ananyathā vṛttirasya tadidamananyathāvṛtti kāryaṃ kāraṇe saditi śakyamabhyupagantum

kiṃ kāraṇam ? tatra sannidhivartateḥ sattārthatvāt, tatra kāraṇe sannidhyartho vartatiḥ sattārthaḥ sannihito vartate iti, asti-bhavati-padyati-vidyativartatayaḥ sannipātaṣaṣṭhāḥ sattārthāḥ ityatra vartateḥ sannidhibhavanārthavācitvād vartate niyataḥ sannihito'stītyarthaḥ
niśabdasyādhikārthatvādadhiko yamo niyamaḥ so'tra vivakṣitaḥ, na sannidhimātravṛttiḥ

ko'sāvadhiko yamaḥ ? tamo'nugrahād yaḥ, sa cānanyathāvyaktirūpatā, tamasānugṛhītasya sattvasya śabdādirūpeṇa rūpāntaranivṛttyānanyathāvṛttirūpatā śabdo'yaṃ na raso na na, tamaso'pi sattvavat pṛthagaparisamāptarūpatvāt, tamaso'pi hi tathā prakāśanaṃ vyaktiriti prakāśātmakasattvānugrahād bhavati, aniyataṃ ca kathamanyaniyamane pravarteta ? ityādiḥ pūrvavad grantho yāvad na, pariṇāmasya tatraivoktatvāt
itarathā sa prakāśo na saḥ, tathā'niyatatvāt tathā'bhūtatvāt, ghaṭapuruṣavad ghaṭapaṭavadvā
ya eva niyamaḥ sa eva prakāśaḥ, tathāniyatatvāt tathāpravṛttatvāt, ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat
tasmāt sattvaṃ tamonugṛhītaṃ tathā prakāśate na svata eva tasmādanyaḥ prakāśānniyama iti
etaccāsat, tamaso'pi sattvavat pṛthagaparisamāptarūpatvāt, sattvaprakāśananiyamane svayaṃ sattvaprakāśanākāṅkṣitvāt tamastvanmatenāparisamāptameva tamoniyamanāpekṣaprakāśātmakasattvavat
tadvyākhyānaṃ tamaso'pi hītyādi, tamaḥ sattvaprakāśarūpavyaktiṃ sattvaprakāśanapratilabdhatathāniyati kuryād nāprakāśitatathāniyativyakti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasya tathā vyakteḥ sattvaprakāśanapratilabhyatvāt

yasmāt tathā prakāśanaṃ vyaktiriti itiśabdasya hetvarthatvād niyamanayogyatayā hi tamasaḥ prakāśanaṃ sattvasya vyaktiḥ, sā ca prakāśātmakasattvānugrahād bhavati nānyatheti sattvāprakāśitatamoniyamanāparisamāptarūpatvam, prakāśā- nanugrahe satyaniyatatvāt

na ca svayamaniyataṃ niyamayitumanyaṃ samarthaṃ vandhyāputravadityata āha — aniyataṃ ca kathamanyaniyamane pravarteta ? ityādirata uttaraḥ prāgatītagranthātideśaḥ evaṃ tu nānayorityādipūrvottarapakṣaprapañcātmako yāvanna pariṇāmasya tatraivoktatvāditi
tadyathā --evaṃ tu nānayoritaretarānugrāhitā, utthāpyasāhāyakaśaktitvāt, vātāhatanaudvayavad glānaśibikāvāhakavat
asampūrṇaśaktitā vā'prakarṣaḥ aniyama ityarthaḥ, iti kāraṇataiva na syādasampūrṇaśaktitvādupahatabījavat

yadā ca sudūramapi gatvā prāgavṛtterasatkāryatvaṃ mā bhūditi prakarṣaḥ pariṇāmādeva tadā pariṇāmasyānyatra vṛttasyānyatrāpariṇāmakatvād yuvatvavadātmamātravṛttitvameva, nānyatra vṛtto'nyadanyathā karoti pariṇāmitvāt

evaṃ tarhi pūrvavadudāharaṇādevāpravṛttyātmakatvaṃ sukhasya niyatarūpeṇāpravṛttyātmakatvamityarthaḥ, ko hi viśeṣastamaḥpravartanādṛte kṣīradadhipariṇāmakālavat pūrvaṃ na pravṛttaṃ paścācca pravṛttamiti ? na, pariṇāmasya tatraivoktatvādityeṣa granthaḥ samāno'trāpi

na, tamaso'pi sattvavat pṛthagaparisamāptarūpatvāt, tamaso'pi hi tathā prakāśanaṃ vyaktiriti prakāśātmakasattvānugrahād bhavati, aniyataṃ ca kathamanyaniyamane pravarteta ? ityādiḥ pūrvavad grantho yāvad na, pariṇāmasya tatraivoktatvāt
itarathā sa prakāśo na saḥ, tathā'niyatatvāt tathā'bhūtatvāt, ghaṭapuruṣavad ghaṭapaṭavadvā
ya eva niyamaḥ sa eva prakāśaḥ, tathāniyatatvāt tathāpravṛttatvāt, ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat
śabdasya ākāśaguṇatvāt nā'nākāśādirvā iti ya॰ pratipāṭhaḥ samīcīno'tra bhāti

ata uttarastu grantho'rthataḥ samānagamaniko'pi viśeṣya likhyate bhāvanārthaṃ viśeṣaṇātulyatvāt, tadyathā — prakāśātmaiva tu niyamaḥ itarathā sa prakāśo na saḥ, tathā'niyatatvāt, tathā'bhūtatvādityasyaivārthakathanaṃ prāktanavyākhyānavat

rūpādisvarūpaniyatārthaprakāśanāt prakāśaḥ prakāśaḥ syād nānyatheti, tvanmatena ghaṭapuruṣavat, yat tathā aniyataṃ tanna prakāśaḥ, yathā ghaṭaḥ puruṣe na niyato ghaṭe ca puruṣaḥ, yo yaḥ prakāśaḥ sa tathāniyata eva yathā rūparasādi
evaṃ tāvat, prakā niyamyaniyāmakatvād naulambanapāṣāṇavanneti cet, na, tadātmana eva tathāniyatatvāt sannidhimātrāt pūrvavadaniyamanāt

ya evāsau sattvasyātmā prakāśaḥ sa niyāmakaḥ, tathāniyamavidheḥ, itarakartṛvat, tamoniyamātmarūpāpādanāditaratathā- śasya rūpāntaranivṛttirūpaṃ niyamamantareṇa prakāśanābhāvapradarśanād niyamātmakatvamuktam, idānīṃ ya eva niyamaḥ sa eva prakāśa iti tayorananyatvāpādanam, tathāniyatatvāt tena prakāreṇa niyatatvāt rūpaprakāśanarūpeṇa rasādyātmanivṛttyā prakāśasya niyatatvāt, tathāpravṛttatvādityasyaivārthakathanaṃ vṛttiniyativyaktīnāmaikārthyāt, ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat, yat tathāniyataṃ yat tathāvṛttaṃ yat tathāvyaktaṃ tadeva tat, yathā ghaṭa eva ghaṭasvātmā
