yat punastadeva na bhavati na tat tathāniyataṃ tathāvṛttaṃ tathāvyaktaṃ vā, yathā puruṣaḥ
niyamyaniyāmakatvād naulambanapāṣāṇavanneti cet, na, tadātmana eva tathāniyatatvāt sannidhimātrāt pūrvavadaniyamanāt
ya evāsau sattvasyātmā prakāśaḥ sa niyāmakaḥ, tathāniyamavidheḥ, itarakartṛvat, tamoniyamātmarūpāpādanāditaratathā-
tasmād niyamyaniyāmakatvabhedād naikatvaṃ sattvatamasoḥ naulambanapāṣāṇavat, yathā nauḥ pravartamānā niyamyate lambanapāṣāṇena niyāmakena, tayoścānyatvamevaṃ sattvatamasoriti

etacca na, tadātmana eva tathāniyatatvāt, tasyaivātmā sa eva vātmā tadātmā, tasyaiva prakāśātmano niyatatvāt, tasmādeva tenaiva vātmanā prakāśātmana eva niyatatvāt, sattvatamasorbhedābhāvād naulambanapāṣāṇavad bhedasādharmyābhāvādayukto dṛṣṭānta iti vakṣyate

tadvyākhyānārthamāha --sannidhimātrāt pūrvavadaniyamanāt, iha tamaḥ sannihitamapi prāk sannidhimātrādevāniyāmakaṃ svayamaniyatatvāt sattvādhīnaniyatitvāt, kintu niyamyamaniyamāt, kastarhi niyāmakaḥ ? ucyate --ya evāsau sattvasyātmā prakāśaḥ sa niyāmakaḥ
kathamiti cet, ucyate--yasmāt tathāniyamyavyaktisvarūpaḥ, tena prakāreṇa śabdādiniyatiniyamyavyañjanasvarūpaḥ sa eva prakāśa eva
kutaḥ ? tathāniyamavidheḥ, tena hi prakāreṇa niyamasya vidhiḥ śabdasvarūpeṇa prakāśamānasya śabdasya rūpādyanātmanā niyatā prakāśamānatā niyamavidhiḥ, tasmāddhetoḥ prakāśa eva niyamaḥ

dṛṣṭānta itarakartṛvat kumbhakārādivat, yathā mṛddravyaṃ piṇḍaśivakādibhāvenābhivyajyamānaṃ tathā tathā prakāśayatā kartrā kumbhakāreṇa niyamakāriṇā nirvartyate niyamyate niyate rūpe'vasthāpyate nāprakāśamānamapravartamānaṃ ca satkāryavādābhyupagamādasadakaraṇādihetusāmarthyācca, tasmāt sa kartā prakāśasthānīyo niyāmakaḥ piṇḍaśivakāderniyamyasya tathā prakāśastamasaḥ
kutaḥ ? tamoniyamātmarūpāpādanāt, sattvenaiva hi tathā tathā prakāśamānena tamaso niyamarūpamāpādyate mṛda iva tathā prakāśayatā kartrā kumbhakāreṇa tadātmalābhahetutvāt
tatastvadabhimataniyāmakatvaviparyayāpattiḥ, tamaso niyamyatvāt sattvādhīnaniyatitvāt sattvasyaiva niyāmakatvāt pakṣadharmaviparītatā sattvāpādyaniyamātmarūpatā prasaktā, sattvāprakāśite niyamābhāvāt
sattvāpāditaṃ hi tamaso niyamātmarūpam, tasmāt tamoniyamātmarūpāpādanāt sattvaṃ niyāmakam, itaratathārūpāpādanāt tamovat

tamo'pi hi itaratathāsvarūpāpādanādṛte kimanyat karoti ? evaṃ ca nauvat tama evāpadyate tathā prakāśasya niyamyatvāt tathāprakāśānatiriktatattvarūpatvādvā niyamasya kuto'naulambanapāṣāṇabhedasādharmyam ? bhede lambanapāṣāṇo nāvaṃ niruṇaddhīti yujyate, na tu tathāprakāśātiriktatattvarūpo moho niyāmako'sti
na tadrūpatvamatadvṛttitvāditi cet, na, tamaḥsvaniyamavat tadātmana eva niyatatvāt
anyathā sattvaṃ sattvameva na syādityuktatvādanyathā tu niyatyabhāvāt

tamo'pi hi ityādi, tamaso'pi hi niyāmakatvamevameva yujyate tvanmate yadītarayoḥ sattvarajasorātmarūpāpādanaṃ kuryāt, anyathā itaratathāsvarūpāpādanādṛte tamaḥ kimanyat karoti ? tayorhi sattvarajaso- rātmarūpāpādanameva, ātmarūpamāpādayanniyāmakamityucyate
yathā tamaḥ pūrvaṃ prakāśapravṛttyātmabhyāmaniyatayoḥ sattvarajasostathāniyamanād niyāmakamevaṃ sattvamapītaratathāniyamātmarūpāpādanād niyāmakamastu, ko doṣaḥ ?

evaṃ ca nauvat tama evāpadyate tathā prakāśasya niyamyatvāt tathāprakāśānatiriktatattvarūpatvādvā niyamasya kuto'naulambanapāṣāṇabhedasādharmyam ? bhede lambanapāṣāṇo nāvaṃ niruṇaddhīti yujyate, na tu tathāprakāśātiriktatattvarūpo moho niyāmako'sti
na tadrūpatvamatadvṛttitvāditi cet, na, tamaḥsvaniyamavat tadātmana eva niyatatvāt
anyathā sattvaṃ sattvameva na syādityuktatvādanyathā tu niyatyabhāvāt
evaṃ ca sattvasyaivoktavidhinā niyāmakatvād nausthānīyaṃ niyamyaṃ tama eva syāt, na niyāmakam
lambanapāṣāṇasthānīyaṃ sattvameva niyāmakam, na niyamyaṃ syāt
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tathā prakāśasya niyamyatvāt, yasmāt tenoktaprakāreṇa prakāśena niyamyatvaṃ mohasya tasmāt tamasaḥ sattvena niyamyatvādityarthaḥ
tasmāt prakāśāprakāśite tamaso niyatyabhāvāt tamasaḥ prakāśena tathā niyamyatvāt tadātmana eva tathāniyatatvāditi sādhūktam
evaṃ tāvat sattvatamasorbhedamabhyupetya viparyayāpattyā niyamyaniyāmakatvādityasya hetorasiddhiruktā

naiva vā sattvavyatiriktaṃ tamo'bhyupema ityata āha --tathāprakāśānatiriktatattvarūpatvād vā niyamasya śabdaprakāreṇā'rūpādiprakāreṇa ca yaḥ prakāśastadanatiriktatattvarūpatvānniyamasyābhivyakteḥ kuto'naulambanapāṣāṇabhedasādharmyam ? na nauranauḥ, kaḥ ? lambanapāṣāṇaḥ, tasya nāvo bhedaḥ, tatsādharmyamanaulambanapāṣāṇabhedasādharmyam, tattu kutaḥ sattvatamasorbhedasādharmyam ? bhedābhāvādityarthaḥ
tato dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ sādharmyābhāvādayuktamiti vaiṣamyaṃ darśayati --bhede sati lambanapāṣāṇo nauvilakṣaṇo nāvaṃ pravartamānāṃ niruṇaddhīti yujyate
na tu tathāprakāśātiriktatattvarūpo moho niyāmako'sti etayoḥ śabdādyāvirbhāvamātraphalatvāt, ato na yujyate
syānmatam--prakāśanamātraṃ sattvasya vṛttirniyamanaṃ tu tamasaḥ, tasmāt sattvasyāniyamanādatadvṛttitvād vṛttibhedācca na niyamanaṃ sattvasya tamasaśca na prakāśanamityasti bheda iti

etacca na, tamaḥsvaniyamavat tadātmana eva niyatatvāt, yathā tamasaḥ svo niyamaḥ prāgavṛttaḥ paścāt svata eva tamaḥsvātmanaḥ pravartamānastamasā vinā abhūtatvāt tadatyāgena vṛttestadadhīnatvāt tadrūpa evaṃ tadātmana eva pravṛttatvāt tathā sattvaprakāśapravṛttyanatiriktatattvarūpastamoniyamaḥ sattvāvyatiriktaḥ prakāśā syānmatam--prakarṣeṇa kāśanaṃ prakāśanaṃ...

evaṃ caika eva vinidrāvasthāpuruṣatvavad niyamaḥ pradhānamiti tanmātrameva tat, niyamāpattirūpanirūpyatvāt, niyamasvātmavadityādi bhaṅgacakrāvartanaṃ niyamasvātmaiva vā trīṇyapīti puruṣāvasthāvad yāvat sukhādananyad duḥkhamiti
atra tu sukhādananya eva mohaḥ, anātmatve'śoṣādyātmakatvāt, sukhasvātmavadityādi sākṣepaparihāraṃ pūrvavat pravṛttisthāne niyamaṃ kṛtvā
dhīnatvāt tadavinābhāvāt tadaparityāgena pravṛttestadātmana eva pravṛttatvāditi
kiñcānyat, anyathā sattvamityādi, yadi svata eva niyamo na syāt tato'nyathā sattvaṃ sattvameva prakāśo vā prakāśa eva na syāt tathā'niyatatvād rajovat pravṛttivat
mūlata eva tadvā prakāśa iti na syādaniyatatvād vandhyāputravat puruṣavadityuktatvāditi tathā
anyathā tu niyatyabhāvāt, prakāśāprakāśite tamaso niyatyabhāvādaniyatasya cābhāvāt prakāśa eva niyama iti

evaṃ caika eva vinidrāvasthāpuruṣatvavad niyamaḥ pradhānamiti tanmātrameva tat, niyamāpattirūpanirūpyatvāt, niyamasvātmavadityādi bhaṅgacakrāvartanaṃ niyamasvātmaiva vā trīṇyapīti puruṣāvasthāvad yāvat sukhādananyad duḥkhamiti
atra tu sukhādananya eva mohaḥ, anātmatve'śoṣādyātmakatvāt, sukhasvātmavadityādi sākṣepaparihāraṃ pūrvavat pravṛttisthāne niyamaṃ kṛtvā

syānmatam--prakarṣeṇa kāśanaṃ prakāśanamityādi yāvat pravṛttivaditi prāsaṅgikaṃ tadeva codyam, tatrottaramapi sattvasyāpi tamovadaparisamāptarūpatvādityādi akṣaraviparyāsena yathāyogākṣaropanyāsaṃ yāvat utthāpyasāhāyakaśaktitvād vātāhatanaudvayavad glānaśibikāvāhakavad yāvacca upahatabījavaditi vācyam, tasmādidaṃ vyākhyātārtham --niyāmakābhāvasya cāparyāptatvenoktatvāt
evaṃ caika eva vinidrāvasthāpuruṣatvavadityādi yāvad bhaṅgacakrāvartanamiti prāguktaṃ bhaṅgacakramāvartya vyākhyeyamiti tadevātidiśati samānatvāt

tatra tu pravṛttireva pradhānaṃ pravṛttyāpattirūpanirūpyatvāt pravṛttisvātmavaditi pravṛttimātratve pradhānabhaṅgacakrakamāvartitam, iha tu pravṛttisthāne niyamaṃ kṛtvā pradhānasthāne pradhānameva ca kṛtvā bhaṅgacakrāvartanaṃ tadvadeva kāryam
punaśca niyamasvātmaiva vā trīṇyapīti puruṣāvasthāvad bhaṅgacakrāvartanaṃ dvitīyaṃ likhitaṃ yathā tathātra pravṛttitraiguṇyavad niyamatraiguṇyaṃ likhitaṃ draṣṭavyamiti
atra tu viśeṣaḥ sukhādananyo moha iti pratijñā, hetuḥ --anātmatve'śoṣādyātmakatvāditi, dṛṣṭāntaḥ sukhasvātmavaditi
ityādi sākṣepaparihāraṃ pūrvavaditi avadhāraṇena coktasādhanāntarāpakṣiptānyatvo vipakṣābhāvaḥ sūcyata ityādisarvātītavyākhyānaprapañcātideśaḥ
na cāpīdamekata eva tattvamityādītyuttarasya vikalpotthāpanagranthasya sambandhaḥ

sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvāt sāmānyaviśeṣabhedabhāvāt, yathā vṛkṣa iti sāmānyaṃ kadamba iti viśeṣaḥ, yathātra kadambo niyamād vṛkṣaḥ, vṛkṣastu syāt kadambo'nyo vetyekatastattvaṃ kintūbhayato'nanyatvādabhinnatvādekatvāt...
evaṃ tvanabhyupagame idaṃ nirūpyam--asti pradhānaṃ bhedānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvāt
etat kathaṃ nirūpyate ? iti anekātmakatvakāraṇakalpanā asadvāda eva, sambhāvyavikalpānupapannārthatvāt, taduktasatyatvānupapannārthasarvoktānṛtatvapakṣavat
tathā yadi sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvaḥ syāt syādekata eva tattvam, na tu tatheha sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ sāmānya- viśeṣabhāvo'stīti

kintūbhayato'nanyatvādabhinnatvādekatvādityādinā sattvarajastamasāmekatvāpādanārthaḥ pūrvavat sarva eva prakramabhedaiḥ sa eva tathaiva granthaḥ pravṛttyā prakāśaviśeṣitayā mohaviśeṣitayā ca neyaḥ, tathā ca bhāṣya eva sulikhitatvānna vivriyate

sannihitāpattibhavanasattārthatvamayathārthaṃ syādityatra tu viśeṣaḥ, āpattibhavanaṃ sannidhibhavanāvinābhāve yujyate, nānyathā, yadi tadrūpādi bīje na sannihitasannihitaṃ tato'ṅkurasyāsattvādyāpattiḥ syāt, sat kāryaṃ kāraṇe ceti dvaividhyaṃ ca bhavanasyaivameva yujyeta āpattyanāpattibhedāditi, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat
sattvena tamasā ca saha bhāvanāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ punaśca tathaiva tamaso'pi sattvena rajasā tadvadeva bhāvanāgrantho niravaśeṣo likhita ācāryeṇaiveti na vivṛṇmahe, sa evānusartavyaḥ

sarvatra ca bhedacodyeṣu pravartyapravartakatvāt pallavapavanavanneti cet, na, tadātmana evetyādi tadeva sattvarajaḥsaṃyoge'pi, prakāśārthiprakāśabhedād nartakīnartakācāryavanneti cet, na, tadātmana evetyādi sattvarajaḥ saṃyogesattvarajaḥsaṃyoge sattvatamaḥsaṃyoge ca, niyamyaniyāmakatvād naulambanapāṣāṇavanneti cet, na, tadātmana evetyādi sattvatamaḥsaṃyoge rajastamaḥsaṃyoge ca tatra prakāśanapravartananiyamanavacanāni ca yathopapatti yojyāni
kuto'pallavapavanabhedasādharmyam, kuto'nartakīnartakācāryabhedasādharmyam, kuto'naulambanapāṣāṇabhedasādharmyam ? iti copanayeṣu dvayaṃ dvayaṃ dvayordvayorguṇayoḥ sambhavitvāccodayitvā parihāryamiti
evaṃ tāvat sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ prakāśapravṛttiniyamātmakānāmananyatvāt ekātmakaikakāraṇapūrvakatvam iti sādhvabhyadhāmeti
evaṃ tvanabhyupagame idaṃ nirūpyam--asti pradhānaṃ bhedānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvāt
etat kathaṃ nirūpyate ? iti anekātmakatvakāraṇakalpanā asadvāda eva, sambhāvyavikalpānupapannārthatvāt, taduktasatyatvānupapannārthasarvoktānṛtatvapakṣavat

evamekātmakaikakāraṇānabhyupagame sāṅkhyairidaṃ nirūpyam, katamat ? yat tad bhinnātmakatvaṃ parigṛhya prayukte kāryakāraṇavīte'bhihitam --asti pradhānaṃ bhedānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvāt, ādhyātmikānāṃ bāhyānāṃ ca bhedānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ, ādhyātmikānāṃ kāryātmakānāṃ vakṣyāmaḥ sattvarajastamāṃsi trīṇi śabdādyātmabhirvyavatiṣṭhamānāni parasparārthaṃ kurvantītyevamādi, etat kathaṃ nirūpyate ? vakṣyamāṇeṣu vicāravikalpeṣu yathā yathocyate tathā tathānupapattireveti itiśabdahetvarthatvād nirūpaṇābhāva evetyabhiprāyaḥ

tadvicāroddeśārthaṃ sādhanamāha --anekātmakatvakāraṇakalpanā asadvāda eva sambhāvyavikalpānupapannārthatvāt, anupapannasambhāvyavikalpārthatvādityarthaḥ, ye'tra sambhāvyante vikalpāste'nupapannārthā iti vakṣyati, tasmādayamasadvāda eva
dṛṣṭāntaḥ --taduktasatyatvānupapannārthasarvoktānṛtatvapakṣavat, tenaivoktastaduktaḥ sarvamanṛtam iti pakṣaḥ, sa evoktastadukto vā

asau satyaśced yaducyate sattvarajastamāṃsi trīṇi śabdādyātmabhirvyavatiṣṭhamānāni parasparārthaṃ kurvanti, sattvaṃ śabdakāryaṃ prakhyāya śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānaṃ rajastamasoḥ śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ khyāpayati

atra prakāśātmakena sattvena prakāśātmakayoreva rajastamasoḥ śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānena śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttirvyaktiḥ prakhyāpyate, utāprakāśātmakayoḥ ? yadyaprakāśātmake rajastamasī śabdātmabhāvāya prakhyāpyete tataḥ sattvaṃ puruṣasyāpi tarhi śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ prakhyāpayiṣyati śabdatvāyainaṃ pravartayiṣyati, aprakāśātmakena tenāpi śabdabhāvāya pravartitavyaṃ prakāśakārakopapatteḥ rajastamobhyāmiva

na tarhi sarvamuktamanṛtam, asya satyatvāt sarvoktāntaḥpātitvācca, athāsatyamidaṃ na tarhi sarvasyoktasyānṛtatvamanenānṛtena pratipādyate'syānṛtasyāpramāṇatvādityubhayathāpyasadvādastṛtīyavikalpābhāvācca tatheyamapi triguṇamekaṃ kāraṇam ityanekātmakaikakāraṇakalpanā asadvāda iti

yaducyate sattvarajastamāṃsi trīṇi śabdādyātmabhirvyavatiṣṭhamānāni parasparārthaṃ kurvanti, sattvaṃ śabdakāryaṃ prakhyāya śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānaṃ rajastamasoḥ śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ khyāpayati

atra prakāśātmakena sattvena prakāśātmakayoreva rajastamasoḥ śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānena śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttirvyaktiḥ prakhyāpyate, utāprakāśātmakayoḥ ? yadyaprakāśātmake rajastamasī śabdātmabhāvāya prakhyāpyete tataḥ sattvaṃ puruṣasyāpi tarhi śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ prakhyāpayiṣyati śabdatvāyainaṃ pravartayiṣyati, aprakāśātmakena tenāpi śabdabhāvāya pravartitavyaṃ prakāśakārakopapatteḥ rajastamobhyāmiva
dṛśyatāṃ paṃ॰ 20, pṛ॰ 290 paṃ॰ 21, pṛ॰ 291 paṃ॰ 6

tat punaḥ katamad vacanam ? iti tat pradarśayannāha --yaducyate sattvarajastamāṃsītyuddeśavākyaṃ yāvat parasparārthaṃ kurvantīti, nirdeśavākyaṃ ca sattvaṃ śabdakāryamityādi yāvat pravṛttiṃ prakhyāpayatīti etadasadvādadharmeṇa pakṣīkṛtaṃ vākyam
atra ca dvayaṃ sambhāvyate tṛtīyābhāvāt, taddarśayati --prakāśātmakenetyādi yāvat prakhyāpyata ityayameko vikalpaḥ

sattvaṃ prakāśātmakaṃ sat tadātmakayoreva rajastamasoḥ śabdātmanā vyavasthā'neneti svayaṃ śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānaṃ tenātmanopakurvat tayoḥ śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ prakhyāpayati, pravṛttiḥ prakhyāpyate
pravṛttiṃ prakhyāpayati ityetadeva sphuṭīkartukāmaḥ pravṛttiḥ prakhyāpyate iti vibhaktiviparyāsena vivṛṇoti ākhyātenābhihitakarmakatvāt prathamayā
dvitīyastu utāprakāśātmakayoriti rajastamasoraprakāśātmakayorvā tat sattvaṃ śabdakāryaṃ prakhyāya śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānaṃ śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ khyāpayati ? iti praśnaḥ
prakāśātmakayorityeṣa vikalpo na ghaṭata eva, sattvarajastamasāṃ jātyantaratvābhyupagamāt prakāśapravṛttiniyamakāryatvabhedāt sukhaduḥkhamohātmakabhedācca rajastamasī na prakāśātmake iti

yadyaprakāśātmake rajastamasī śabdātmabhāvāya prakhyāpyete tatastadvat sattvaṃ puruṣasyāpi tarhi śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ prakhyāpayiṣyati, tadarthavivaraṇam --śabdatvāyainaṃ pravartayiṣyati, śabdatvapariṇāmenainaṃ pariṇamayiṣyatītyarthaḥ

sattvena śabdakāryaprakhyātinā śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānena puruṣaḥ śabdātmabhāvāya pravartyate'bhivyajyate vyavasthāpyate ca, aprakāśātmakatvāt, yad yadaprakāśātmakaṃ tat tat sattvena śabdakāryaprakhyātinā śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānena śabdātmabhāvāya pravartyaṃ vyaṅgyaṃ vyavasthāpyaṃ ca dṛṣṭaṃ yathā rajastamaśca, vipakṣābhāvād vyāvṛttiravācyā
tatsādhanavyākhyānadvāreṇa sādhanāntaropanyāsadvāreṇa vā granthaḥ aprakāśātmakenetyādiḥ yāvad athocyeta--aprakāśatvānnaikāntaḥ śakyate kartum
puruṣaḥ sattvānna prakāśate, aprakāśakatve sannihitaprakāśakārakatvāt, pradīpeneva viyat
rajastamasī ca prakāśyete, aprakāśakatvāt, pradīpeneva pṛthivī
api ca naiva viyato'prakāśakatvam, yasmād rūpādipṛthagbhūtapṛthagvipariṇatiṣu pṛthivyādiṣu nāprakāśanaṃ ghaṭate bodhya- rajastamobhyāmiveti

apiśabdād rajastamobhyāmapi tenāpi ca puruṣeṇāprakāśātmakena śabdabhāvāya pravartitavyaṃ prakāśitavyaṃ vyavasthātavyamityete pravṛttiprakāśaniyamāḥ puruṣakāryāḥ syuḥ, sa pravartate prakāśate vyavatiṣṭhate pariṇamatītyarthaḥ
yad yadaprakāśakatve satyupapannaprakāśakārakaṃ tena tena śabdabhāvāya prakāśitavyaṃ pravartitavyaṃ vyavasthātavyaṃ yathā rajasā tamasā ca
athavā rajastamaśca yathā pravartata ityādi yathābhivyaktārthānurūpaṃ vyākhyātavyamiti
puruṣaḥ sattvānna prakāśate, aprakāśakatve sannihitaprakāśakārakatvāt, pradīpeneva viyat
rajastamasī ca prakāśyete, aprakāśakatvāt, pradīpeneva pṛthivī
api ca naiva viyato'prakāśakatvam, yasmād rūpādipṛthagbhūtapṛthagvipariṇatiṣu pṛthivyādiṣu nāprakāśanaṃ ghaṭate bodhya-
etasya sādhanasyānaikāntikatvodbhāvanārthaṃ sādhanadvāreṇa paramatamāśaṅkyāha, athocyeta--aprakāśatvād naikānta ityādi sopasaṃhārahetukaprakāśanāprakāśanasādhane yāvat prakāśe iti
aprakāśatvād naikāntaḥ śakyate kartumiti, ayaṃ heturna śakya aikāntikaḥ kartum, yasmācchakyate vaktumitthamapi --puruṣaḥ sattvād na prakāśate na vyajyata iti
kasmāt ? aprakāśakatve sannihitaprakāśakārakatvāt, yadaprakāśakatve sannihitaprakāśakārakaṃ tadaprakāśamānaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā pradīpeneva viyat
rajastamasī ca prakāśyete aprakāśakatvāt pradīpeneva pṛthivītyetat pūrveṇa sādhanena vyākhyātārthaṃ sat sannihitaprakāśakārakatvāditi na viśeṣyate
yathā ca viyatpṛthivyoraprakāśatvasāmānye satyeva kārakasānnidhye'pi prakāśāprakāśau dṛṣṭāvevaṃ puruṣasyāprakāśātmakatve'pyaprakāśataiva rajastamasoḥ sattvasya prakāśataiveti viśeṣo'stviti
atrocyate --evaṃ tāvad vikalpasamajātitvādanuttarameva, prayatnānantarīyakatve satyeva mūrtāmūrtatvādiviśeṣavad ghaṭaśabdayoranityo nityaśceti viśeṣaḥ syāt iti vacanavat
kiñcānyat, etadapi ca naiva viyato'prakāśakatvaṃ tvanmatenaiva śabdātmanā prakāśamānatvādasti
yadapi ca rūpaviṣayāprakāśanaṃ pṛthivyādiṣvetadapi ca naivāprakāśanaṃ ghaṭate yasmād rūpādītyādi yāvannāprakāśatve prakāśanamiti

yasmāditi heturvakṣyamāṇārthaḥ, nāprakāśanaṃ ghaṭata iti sādhyam, rūpādiriti rūparasagandhāstejombhobhūmiṣu, tebhyaḥ pṛthagbhūtāvākāśānilau śabdasparśātmakau, rūpādipṛthagbhūtābhyāṃ kha-vātābhyāṃ pṛthagbhūtā vipariṇatiryeṣāṃ teṣu rūpādipṛthagbhūtapṛthagvipariṇatiṣu pṛthivyādiṣu pṛthivyabādiṣu tejorahiteṣu vidyamānaḥ prakāśakatvaprakāśaḥ svagato vipari- ṇatastirobhūtaḥ, kintu prakāśyaprakāśo'styāvirbhūtatvāt, atasteṣāṃ prakāśyataiva
viyatpṛthivīviśeṣopapattivacca te eva pravartete na puruṣa ityastu nāma, prakāśātmake tarhi rajastamasī śabdabhāvāya pravṛtteḥ sattvavat, vaidharmyeṇa puruṣavat

asatkāryavāditā cātisphuṭaiva, sattve pravṛttiniyamayorabhūtayoḥ śabdātmavyavasthānavacanādabhyupagamāt, rajastamasoḥ prāgasato jātyantarakāryabhūtasya prakāśanasyā- vajrādiṣu prakāśatā ca dṛśyata eva, tasmāt kharapṛthivyādiṣu prakāśatā svagataprakāśavipariṇāmād vidyamānaprakāśakataiva bodhyabodhakamanuṣyaprakāśyaprakāśakatvavat, jñānasvabhāva eva hi manuṣyaḥ prakāśātmā prakāśyo bodhyo bodhakaśca dṛṣṭaḥ, na kuḍyādiracetanaḥ, tathā pṛthivyādayaḥ
etaccāyuktam, yasmāddhetuhetumattve'pi tayoḥ sūriśiṣyayordvayorapi pratyekaṃ nāprakāśatve prakāśanamiti
tasmād viyatpṛthivyorapi prakāśakatvasāmyād dṛṣṭāntābhāve puruṣasya rajastamasośca viśeṣāpādanāsiddhiḥ

athāpi tvadanuvṛttyā viyatpṛthivīviśeṣopapattimabhyupemaḥ puruṣasyāprakāśakatve sati apravartanādi rajastamasośca pravartanādi tathāpi te viyatpṛthivīviśeṣopapattivacca te eva pravartete rajastamasī na puruṣa ityastu nāma, naivāstītyabhiprāyaḥ

kintvayamanyaste doṣo'niṣṭa āpadyate --prakāśātmake tarhi rajastamasī, sattvavilakṣaṇe na bhavata ityarthaḥ, kutaḥ ? śabdabhāvāya pravṛtteḥ, sattvavat, yacchabdabhāvāya pravartate tat prakāśātmakaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā sattvam, vaidharmyeṇa puruṣavaditi, yat prakāśātmakaṃ na bhavati na tacchabdātmabhāvāya pravartate yathā tava puruṣa iti
sādhanadharmayukte dṛṣṭānte dharmāntaravikalpāt sādhyadharmavikalpaṃ prasajato vikalpasamaḥ
kriyāguṇahetukaṃ kiñcidkiñcid guru yathā loṣṭaḥ, kiñcicca laghu yathā vāyuḥ
evaṃ kriyāhetuguṇayuktaṃ kiñcit kriyāvat syāt, yathā loṣṭaḥ, kiñcidakriyam, yathā ātmā, viśeṣo vā vācyaḥ
viyatpṛthivīviśeṣopapattivacca te eva pravartete na puruṣa ityastu nāma, prakāśātmake tarhi rajastamasī śabdabhāvāya pravṛtteḥ sattvavat, vaidharmyeṇa puruṣavat
asatkāryavāditā cātisphuṭaiva, sattve pravṛttiniyamayorabhūtayoḥ śabdātmavyavasthānavacanādabhyupagamāt, rajastamasoḥ prāgasato jātyantarakāryabhūtasya prakāśanasyā-

kiñcānyat, --asatkāryavāditā'tyantāniṣṭā prasaktā evamanabhyupagame iti vartate, sā cāsatkāryavāditā'tisphuṭaiva, katham ? sattve pravṛttiniyamayorabhūtayoḥ śabdātmavyavasthānavacanādabhyupagamāt, sattvasya kāryaṃ prakāśa eveṣṭo na pravṛttiniyamau jātyantarabhūtarajastamaskāryatvāt, tau tatrāsantau punastasya kāryāvabhyupagatau, kutaḥ ? vyavasthānavacanāt sattvaṃ śabdakāryaṃ prakhyāya śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānamiti bruvatābhyupagamāditīti

tadā yadi tat sattvamapravṛttamaniyataṃ vā pūrvavadapravṛttatvādaniyatatvācca tayostathārūpāṃ śabdātmikāṃ pravṛttiṃ na prakhyāpayed naiva vā syād vandhyāputravadityuktatvāt vyavasthānasya ca prakāśapravṛttiniyamātmakasya prāgasataḥ sattvaviṣayasyārambhāvasthāyāṃ sāmyāvasthāvilakṣaṇāyāmabhyupagatatvādasatoḥ pravṛttiniyamayoḥ sattvābhyupagamādatisphuṭā
kiñcānyat, rajastamasorityādi yāvat prakāśanasyābhyupagamāditi, asatkāryavāditā'tisphuṭaiveti vartate
tairyathāsvamakāraṇasadbhiḥ prakāśādibhirārabdhaṃ kāryamapi bhrāntimātram, tvaduktahetusāmarthyādeva tanmayārabdhatvādasadātmakaṃ hi tat kārpāsikatantvārabdhapaṭakārpāsikatvavat
tanmayatanmayaṃ ca asadātmakaṃ tanmayatanmayārabdhatvāt kārpāsikapaṭakuṭerapi kārpāsikatvavad rūpādisukhādimayatvavat

vākye rajastamasoḥ śabdabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ prakhyāpayatīti vacanāt tayo rajasi tamasi ca prāgasataḥ prakāśasya jātyantarakāryabhūtasya tadānīṃ prakhyāpanādasato'bhivyaktirutpattirvābhyupagatā, yadi te rajastamasī tathā pratipadyete vyavatiṣṭhete pravartete vā tataḥ sattvena prakāśitaṃ syāt ācāryeṇeva nartakyāḥ prāgapratipannāyā apravṛttāyā avyavatiṣṭhamānāyāḥ
tasmāt prakāśo'pi tayoḥ prāgasan paścājjāta ityasatkāryavāditā

sedānīṃ vaiśeṣikā- satkāryavāditayā tulyeti bhāvyate --pṛthagbhūtatattvetyādi, pṛthagbhūtaṃ tattvamātmā kāryaṃ tadbhāvo yasya sa pṛthagbhūtatattvo guṇaḥ, sa evāśrayaḥ kāraṇaṃ ca, tasmiṃstasmin guṇe sattve rajasi tamasi ca vaiśeṣikakalpitapaṭādikāryasya ca tantvādiṣu parasparasaṃyogāpekṣeṣvasato bhavanavat prakāśapravṛttiniyamānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ sattve pravṛttiniyamayorasatoḥ prakāśaniyamayośca rajasi pravṛttiprakāśayośca tamasyasatāṃ parasparāpekṣapravṛttiṣu sattvādiṣūtpattirbhavanamuktaṃ bhavati
prāgasantaḥ prakāśapravṛttiniyamāḥ śabdādyārambhakāla utpannā iti pratipadyasva pṛthagbhūtatattvakāraṇāśrayābhivyakteḥ vaiśeṣikābhitatantvāśrayapaṭavat
tairyathāsvamakāraṇasadbhiḥ prakāśādibhirārabdhaṃ kāryamapi bhrāntimātram, tvaduktahetusāmarthyādeva tanmayārabdhatvādasadātmakaṃ hi tat kārpāsikatantvārabdhapaṭakārpāsikatvavat
tanmayatanmayaṃ ca asadātmakaṃ tanmayatanmayārabdhatvāt kārpāsikapaṭakuṭerapi kārpāsikatvavad rūpādisukhādimayatvavat
atra tat syāt ityapi pāṭho bhavet, tat iti śabdena ca rajastamo vā grāhyam

uktanyāyena te sattvādiṣu prakāśādayaḥ kāraṇeṣvasantaḥ, yathāsvam yo yaḥ svo yathāsvam, prakāśaḥ sattve nāsti itarāpekṣa utpannaḥ, evamitarāvapīti tairakāraṇasadbhiḥ prakāśādibhirārabdhaṃ parasparāśrayaṇena vyaktaṃ pravṛttaṃ niyataṃ ca yat kāryaṃ triguṇaṃ śabdādi tadapyalātacakravad bhrāntimātraṃ na paramārthato'stītyāpannam, tvaduktahetusāmarthyādeva tanmayārabdhatvādasadātmakaṃ hi tat, tvayaivoktaṃ hi yacca yanmayairārabdhaṃ tadātmakaṃ taditi śabdādīnāṃ sukhādyātmakatvaṃ śabdādyārabdhānāṃ bhūtānāṃ bhūtārabdhānāṃ ca śarīrādighaṭādīnām, tasmād vayamapi tathaiva brūmaḥ--śabdādi asadātmakaṃ tanmayairārabdhatvāt kārpāsikatantvārabdhapaṭakārpāsikatvavat, yathā kārpāsikaistantubhirārabdhaḥ paṭaḥ kārpāsika ityucyate tathā śabdādyasanmayaṃ tanmayaprakāśādyārabdhatvāditi
tanmayatanmayaṃ ceti yadapi ca bhūtādi śarīrādi ghaṭādi sarvamasadātmakaṃ tanmayatanmayārabdhatvāt kārpāsikapaṭakuṭerapi kārpāsikatvavaditi
śabdasyāsanmayatve sādhye rūpādisukhādimayatvamudāharaṇam, rūpādīnāmapi tathaivāsanmayatvaṃ śabdādisukhādimayatvadṛṣṭāntenāpādyamiti
athocyeta--evameva tatkāraṇatvaṃ tatra ca śabdādikāryasattvam, śuklaraktakṛṣṇatantvātmikāyā rajjoḥ kāryāyāstantukāraṇatvavat
nanvevaṃ yathāsmaduktavadvaikatvaṃ rajastamasī api sattvameva, prakāśakāraṇatvāt, sattvasvātmavat
atha tvanmatena, sarvavyaktavyāpi cāsatkāryatvaṃ pratiguṇaṃ prakāśādyordvayoḥ kāryātmanoḥ prāgabhūtatvāt
athocyeta--evameva tatkāraṇatvam, teṣāṃ sattvādīnāṃ kāraṇatvamevameva yujyate

tatra ca teṣu sattvādiṣu kāraṇeṣu śabdādikāryasattvamevameva yujyate pratisvaṃ prakāśādikāryāṇāṃ śuklaraktakṛṣṇatantvātmikāyā rajjoḥ kāryāyāstantukāraṇatvavat, yathā pratyekaṃ śuklādiguṇāstantavastrayo'pi triguṇāmekāṃ rajjumārabhamāṇāḥ kāraṇatvaṃ nātivartante tatasteṣu sata eva traiguṇyasyāvirbhāvād rajjoḥ satkāryatvaṃ tathā sattvādikāraṇatvaṃ śabdādisatkāryatā ceti

evameva iti yadetad vacanaṃ tasya dvayī gatiḥ, yathāsmaduktavadekātmakaṃ kāraṇamanekākāraviparivṛtti puruṣavadityabhyupagamāditi taddarśayati sakāraṇam — yathāsmaduktavadvaikatvaṃ rajastamasī api sattvameva, prakāśakāraṇatvaṃ ca tayoryathāprāgvyākhyātaṃ siddham, ata eva tasyāṃ gatau doṣaḥ sa eva puruṣādyanyatamaikakāraṇavādābhyupagama iti

itara āha--eṣā gatirastu, ko doṣaḥ ? iti, atra doṣakutūhalaṃ ced brūmaḥ --sarvavyaktavyāpi cetyādi, tadeva hyasatkāryatvamitthaṃ bhāvanāntareṇāpādyate, sarvavyaktaṃ śabdādi tantupaṭādi ca vyāpituṃ śīlamasya tadasatkāryatvaṃ sarvavyaktavyāpi, kasmāddhetoḥ ? pratiguṇaṃ prakāśādyordvayoḥ kāryātmanoḥ prāgabhūtatvāt, guṇaṃ guṇaṃ prati pratiguṇaṃ sattve dvayoḥ pravṛttiniyamayoḥ prāgabhūtatvādeva kāryātmanoḥ tathā rajasi prakāśaniyamayoḥ tamasi prakāśapravṛttyoḥ kāryātmanorabhūtatvāt anyaguṇakāraṇakāryātmanāmanyatra vyaktipravṛttiniyatikāryāṇāmasatāmutpattervyavasthānavacanāt prakhyāpanavacanācca abhyupagatatvāt
na kevalaṃ vaiśeṣikavadeva, kiṃ tarhi ? bauddhavadvā asatkāryatvam, varaṃ hi vaiśeṣikāsatkāryatulyatvaṃ tadasatkāryatvasya kāraṇaiḥ saha kañcit kālaṃ tiṣṭhata iti tairiṣṭatvāt

idaṃ bauddhāsatkāryatulyameva te prāptam, kutaḥ ? tathābhūtavastunirmūlotpattitvāt, tena prakāreṇa bhūtaṃ vastu śabdo rūpam ityādinā, tathābhūtavastuno nirmūlā utpattiḥ, tadbhāvāt tathābhūtavastunirmūlotpattitvāt

kimarthaṃ punarnirmūlotpattitvāditi siddhe tathābhūtavastugrahaṇam ? dṛṣṭāntadvayenārthadvayapradarśanārtham, tadyathā --dvitīyakṣaṇaghaṭavat, yathā kṣaṇaḥ kṣaṇāntare'nutpanna evottarasmin pūrvo nirudhyate uttaraśca tadanantaramutpadyate nirmūlaḥ nāmonnāmau tulāntayoriva asatkāryāḥ śabdādayaḥ, kāraṇatvāt, anyaguṇātmakasukhapravṛttyādivat itarānupakṛtāvidyamānaprakāśāditrayasukhādikāraṇavat
atha prakāśātmakayoreva rajastamasoḥ śabdabhāvāya vyavatiṣṭhate sattvaṃ tata ekātmakaikakāraṇatvam, tacca neṣyate
tato yathaiva kāraṇe kāryasya sattvād ghaṭenaiva ghaṭaḥ kriyate tadātmavyaktiprati- ityuktatvāt

tatsahacaritaṃ ca ghaṭādi vastu pūrvasmin niruddhe pāścātyasya pāścātyasyotpādābhyupagamād nirmūlotpattyeveti ubhayaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyaṃ cobhayam, tatsādharmyādidamapi sattvādiprakāśādikāryaṃ śabdādi sāṅkhyamatamiti yojyam
atha prakāśātmakayoreva rajastamasoḥ śabdabhāvāya vyavatiṣṭhate sattvaṃ tata ekātmakaikakāraṇatvam, tacca neṣyate
tato yathaiva kāraṇe kāryasya sattvād ghaṭenaiva ghaṭaḥ kriyate tadātmavyaktiprati-

evaṃ prakāśādyasatkāryatve siddhe sarvavyaktāsatkāryatvasādhanam --asatkāryāḥ śabdādayaḥ kāraṇatvāt, yad yat kāraṇaṃ tat tadasatkāryaṃ dṛṣṭam, anyaguṇātmakasukhapravṛttyādivat, anyo guṇaḥ sattvād rajaḥ, tasyātmā sukham, tacca svayaṃ sāmyāvasthāyāmekaprakāśātmakāryamapi sad jātyantararajaskāryapravṛttyātmakamārambhāvasthāyāmiṣṭaṃ tryātmakaśabdādyātmavyavasthānavacanāt, tathā niyamātmakamapi ādigrahaṇāt

ataḥ sukhaṃ sattvaguṇaṃ prāgasatpravṛttiniyamakāryaṃ paścāt tatkāryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca tadvacchabdādayo'satkāryāḥ kāraṇatāṃ ca bibhratīti, evamanyaguṇaduḥkhaprakāśaniyamavat anyaguṇamohaprakāśapravṛttivadityekaikameva dṛṣṭāntaṃ kṛtvā yojyam

etasyārthasya sphuṭīkaraṇārthamāha --itarānupakṛtāvidyamānaprakāśāditrayasukhādikāraṇavaditi, itareṇa rajasā tamasā cānupakṛtau prāgasantau pravṛttiniyamau paścāt tadupakārajanitau sukhe kāraṇe dṛṣṭau, ādigrahaṇādevaṃ duḥkhe prakāśaniyamāvitarānupakṛtau prāgasantau paścāt tadupakārajau tathā mohe'pīti

yadyevaṃ neṣyate tataḥ pratyekamitarānupakṛtavidyamānaprakāśāditrayasvakāryā vā sukhādayaḥ, kāraṇatvāt, śabdādi- vat tantvādivadveti, svaśabdādekasyaiva sattvaguṇasya trayo'pi prakāśādaya ātmīyā eva kāryāstathetarayośceti puruṣādivāda evaiṣa saṃjñāmātravipratipatteriti
evaṃ tāvadaprakāśātmakayo rajastamasoḥ śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānena tatprakhyātinā sattvena tadātmaprakhyāpane doṣā uktāḥ

yadi caivaṃ satkāryavādasyotkhātamūlatvaprasaṅgabhayādasatkāryavādasya pratiṣṭhitamūlatvaprasaṅgabhayācca neṣyate'yaṃ vikalpaḥ aprakāśātmakayoḥ iti tataḥ prakāśātmakayoḥ ityastu, tatrāpi ca doṣaṃ vaktukāma idamāha --atha prakāśātmakayorityādi yāvanneṣyata iti gatārtham

kāraṇe kāryasya sattvād ghaṭenaiva ghaṭaḥ kriyate iti, mṛtpiṇḍaghaṭenorddhvagrīvakuṇḍalauṣṭhapṛthukukṣibudhnādighaṭaḥ kriyate prakāśyate, karoteḥ prakāśārthatvāt, yathā pṛṣṭhaṃ kuru pādau kuru, tacca karaṇaṃ vimalīkaraṇaṃ prakāśanamityarthaḥ, kāraṇe kāryasya sata eva prakāśanāt sarpasphaṭāṭopamukulatvavad dīrghakuṇḍalakībhāvavacca, tatra yathā sarpeṇaiva sarpaḥ kriyate tathehāpi niyatasvasādhanakramasamāveśāt kāraṇaghaṭena kāryaghaṭo'bhivyajyate tathābhūtavyaktiśaktisthūlatāpattyā mṛda eva ghaṭatvāt tathaiva sattvena sattvameva prakāśyate śabdādiprakāśena apṛthagbhūtaprakāśāditattvamākāśādi prakāśyate śabdādipravṛttyā śabdādiniyamena pravartyate niyamyate ca
apṛthagbhūtatattvenaiva sattvena prakāśena pravṛttisattvena anapekṣayā ghaṭenaiva mṛdā ghaṭaḥ pṛthukukṣyādyākārāḥ kriyante'tyantabhinnenānyenānyasyākaraṇāt

kiñcānyat, tadātmavyaktipratiniyatasvasādhanakramasamāveśāt, ghaṭātmatvasya vyaktiḥ prāganupalabhyasya paścādupalabdhiḥ, sā pratiniyatānāmātmīyānāṃ kulāladaṇḍādīnāṃ tatkramasya ca kālākhyasādhanatvāt piṇḍaśivakādibhāveṣu yathāvasthaṃ vyāpriyamāṇānāṃ krameṇa vyāpārādityarthaḥ

kathaṃ vyajyate iti cet, ucyate --tathābhūtavyaktiśaktisthūlatāpattyā, pṛthukukṣyādiprakāreṇa vyaktiśaktirasyāṃ mṛdi śaktimatyāṃ sūkṣmāvasthānāduttarakālaṃ deśakālādyavabandhāpagamāt sthūlatāpattyā indriyagrāhyatayā nirmārjyadarpaṇasvarūpopalabdhivat karmaiva sad vastu kartṛ bhavati, mṛda eva ghaṭatvāt, mṛdeva hi ghaṭo bhavati, ghaṭamātmānamātmanā avasthāntaramātraviśiṣṭamavasthāntaramātraviśiṣṭena karoti, kartureva karmatvābhyupagamāt

kulāladaṇḍādīnāṃ tarhi sādhanatvābhāvaḥ svayameva mṛdaḥ kartṛkarmatvābhyupagamād ghaṭasyaiveti cet, na, ata eva tatsādhanatvād vīraṇādito'karaṇādasadakaraṇādihetubhyo mṛdyeva santaṃ ghaṭaṃ kulālacakradaṇḍādayo'bhivyañjayantaḥ kartṛkaraṇasampradānāpādānādhikaraṇādibhāvaṃ pratilabhante tadviṣayameva na vīraṇādiviṣayaṃ na tantvādiviṣayam, tadātmagatavyaktiśaktipratiniyatasvasādhanakramasamāveśādeva tāni ca kāraṇāni parasparopajanitakāryasādhanaśaktīni ekaprabandhena pravartamānāni kārakāṇi ityucyante, nānyaviṣayāṇi
tasmāt kulālādīnāmapi tathaiva kartṛtvādibhāvopapatteḥ ghaṭenaiva ghaṭaḥ kriyate iti sādhūktam

niyatasvasādhanakramasamāveśāt kāraṇaghaṭena kāryaghaṭo'bhivyajyate tathābhūtavyaktiśaktisthūlatāpattyā mṛda eva ghaṭatvāt tathaiva sattvena sattvameva prakāśyate śabdādiprakāśena apṛthagbhūtaprakāśāditattvamākāśādi prakāśyate śabdādipravṛttyā śabdādiniyamena pravartyate niyamyate ca
evaṃ dṛṣṭāntamātmanaivātmānaṃ prakāśayati karotīti pratipādya dārṣṭāntikaṃ pratipādayati --tathaiva sattvenetyādi

yathā kāraṇe kāryasya sattvād ghaṭenaiva ghaṭaḥ kriyata ityuktaṃ tathā kāraṇe kāryasya sattvāt sattvena sukhaprakāśādikāraṇātmanā tadātmakaṃ sattvameva prakāśyate mṛdghaṭāvasthāvat, taddarśayati --śabdādiprakāśenāpṛthagbhūtaprakāśāditattvam, kiṃ tat ? ākāśādi, rūpādyapṛthagbhūtatattvāyā mṛdo ghaṭe tadapṛthagbhūtatattvaghaṭādiprakāśavat prakāśāpṛthagbhūtena prakāśāpṛthagbhūtatattvaṃ prakāśyata ityarthaḥ, prakāśāpṛthagbhūtāveva pravṛttiniyamāvapīti taddarśayati --śabdādipravṛttyā śabdādiniyamena, tadapyākāśādi yathā prakāśāpṛthagbhāvāt prakāśyate tathā pravartyate niyamyate ceti

tad vistareṇa paryāyaśabdānvākhyānena bhāvayati— apṛthagbhūtatattvenetyādi, apṛthagbhūtatattvatvādeva tena sattvena prakāśena pravṛttisattveneti prakāśapravṛttyoraikyaṃ darśayati, evakāreṇāvadhāraṇārthena tataḥ pṛthagbhūtārthābhāvaṃ ca darśayati
āvirbhāvena pravṛttyā pravṛttisattvena pravṛttisattvamevānapekṣā svavyaktirāvirbhāvaḥ pravṛttiḥ
tathā niyamasattvenānapekṣeṇa svaśaktyā āvirbhāvena svaniyatyā niyamasattvamevānapekṣā svavyaktiḥ
prakāśa eva pravṛttirniyamaśca, pravṛttirevetaradvayam, niyama evetaradvayam

sattvasattvenaiva sattvasattvaṃ prakāśyate vyaktipariṇāmena vyaktībhavatītyuktaṃ svaśaktyā, yaduktaṃ bhavati prakāśenāpṛthagbhūtatattvena sattvena ityādiparyāyaistaduktaṃ bhavati pravṛttisattvena pravṛttyā svaśaktyā vyaktirāvirbhāvaḥ, janī prādurbhāve pā॰ dhā॰ 1149, prāduḥ prākāśye, prakāśo janma abhivyaktirityanarthāntaram prakāśātmakayoreva rajastamasoḥ iti vacanādapṛthagbhūtaṃ tattvaṃ prakāśādīnāmarthāntaranirapekṣamiti

yathā prakāśa eva pravṛttiriti darśitaṃ tathā pravṛttireva prakāśa iti darśayati --āvirbhāvena pravṛttyā pravṛttisattvena pravṛttisattvamevānapekṣā svavyaktiḥ, svataḥpṛthagbhūtaprakāśaniyamānapekṣā svātmābhivyaktirityarthaḥ

tathā niyamasattvena anapekṣeṇetyādinā granthena prakāśapravṛttyanarthāntarabhūto niyama eva sattvaṃ rajaścetyata āha --svaśaktyāvirbhāvena svaniyatyā, kā ca sā ? niyamasattvamevānapekṣā svavyaktiḥ pūrvavat svapravṛttiḥ svaniyama ityeko'rtha iti prāgupapāditatvāt prakāśa eva pravṛttirniyamaśca, yasmāt prakāśamānaḥ pravartate niyataścārtha iti
evaṃ pravṛttirevetaradvayam, yasmāt pravartamānaṃ prakāśate niyataṃ ca, niyama evetaradvayam, niyato hyarthaḥ prakāśate pravartate ca, tasmādihāpi tadeva bhāvitamaikyamiti
āvirbhāvena pravṛttyā pravṛttisattvena pravṛttisattvamevānapekṣā svavyaktirāvirbhāvaḥ pravṛttiḥ
tathā niyamasattvenānapekṣeṇa svaśaktyā āvirbhāvena svaniyatyā niyamasattvamevānapekṣā svavyaktiḥ
prakāśa eva pravṛttirniyamaśca, pravṛttirevetaradvayam, niyama evetaradvayam

kathaṃ tarhyekameva prakāśapravṛttiniyamabhedapratyayavyapadeśabhāg bhavati ? ityatrocyate --ata eṣāmekapuruṣavṛttaśyāmāyatākṣapralambabāhutvavat, yathaikasmin puruṣe pravṛttāni tadavyatiriktāni śyāmatvamāyatākṣatvaṃ pralambabāhutvamityetāni bhinnānīva tadbhedapratyayavyapadeśabhāñji bhavanti tathaikavastvityādinopasaṃharati, ekasya vastunaḥ svatattvabhūtānāṃ tadabhidhānaprayojanānāṃ sattvarajastamasāṃ tatkāryāṇāṃ ca prakāśanapravṛttiniyamānāmavyatirekaikavṛttitā
iti parisamāptyarthaḥ, evaṃ tāvadetayā bhāvanayāpāditaikyānāṃ sattvādīnāṃ sattvasvātmatvenaiva kartṛkarmatvavṛttiruktā parasparasvarūpāpādanena bhedamabhyupagamya

idānīṃ phalābhedānnaiva bheda iti pratipādayiṣyannāha --sattvasattvenaiva sattvasattvaṃ prakāśyate, trayāṇāmapi sattvarūpatvasyāpāditatvāt sattvasattvaṃ rajaḥsattvaṃ tamaḥsattvamiti bhidyate, tasyābhedaḥ phalābhedādāpādyate'dhunā

yat tat sattvaṃ sattvameva bhavati nānyad bhavati rajastamo vā tat sattvasattvaṃ tena sattvasattvenaiva prakāśyate vyajyate tadeva sattvasattvasyaiva bhavanaṃ vyajyate sphuṭīkriyate, pūrvavat kartṛkarmabhāvo'vasthāvaśāt
taddarśayati --vyaktipariṇāmena, mṛtsattve yad vidyamānaṃ sattvasattvaṃ ghaṭaprakāśasattvaṃ tenaiva tad vyajyate bhavati, sato hi bhāvaḥ sattvam

evameva ca sattvaprakāśena sattvaprakāśaḥ prakāśyate rajaḥprakāśastamaḥprakāśaśca rajaḥprakāśena svapariṇāmena, sadeva hi sattvena pariṇamati nāsat, yathoktam --atthittaṃ atthitte pariṇamati bhagavatīsū॰ 1
yaduktaṃ bhavati vyaktībhavati iti taduktaṃ bhavati sattvasattvena sattvasattvaṃ prakāśyate iti
sattvasattvam iti ca viśeṣaṇaṃ rajaḥsattvatamaḥsattvābhyām, tayorapi tvanmataprasiddhyā satyapi bhede'smaduktavadabheda evetyabhinnaphalatvādaikyamāpādyam
kiṃ kāraṇam ? yasmāt sato hi bhāvaḥ sattvam, yasmāt sadeva sad bhavati tasmāt tadeva sattvasattvaṃ tattvaṃ tadbhāvaḥ pariṇāma ityanarthāntaram, tadbhāvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tattvārtha॰ 5
taddhi pravartamānaṃ na kiñcidapekṣata iti pravṛttiniyamānapekṣeṇa sattvasattveneti
evaṃ rajaḥsattvena sattvasattvaṃ prakāśyata iti vartate
pūrvavad vyaktiriti prakāśaikārthyam, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? vyaktipravṛttipariṇatyā prakāśanapravartanapariṇāmena tayaiva pravṛttyātmikayā vyaktyaivetyuktaṃ bhavatītyaikyaṃ darśayati

evaṃ tamaḥsattvenetyādi vyaktiniyamapariṇāmena ityakṣaraviparyāsamātreṇa bhedādarthaikyāpādanaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvad vyaktyaivetyuktaṃ bhavatīti, sattvenaiva vyaktyātmanā pravṛttena niyatenāvaśyaṃ bhavitavyam, anyathā tatsvarūpābhāvādityuktatvāt
evameva ca rajaḥsattvena sattvasattvaṃ prakāśyate, vyaktirvyaktipravṛttipariṇatyā pravṛttyaivetyuktaṃ bhavati, sato hi bhāvaḥ sattvam
tathā rajaḥsattvena rajaḥsattvaṃ prakāśyate, vyaktipravṛttipariṇatirvyaktipravṛttipariṇatyā pravṛttyaivetyuktaṃ bhavatīti tathaiva gamanīyam
tathā rajaḥsattvena tamaḥsattvaṃ prakāśyate, vyaktiniyatipariṇatirvyaktipravṛttipariṇatyā pravṛttyaivetyuktaṃ bhavatīti
tathā tamaḥsattvena sattvasattvaṃ prakāśyate vyaktiniyatipariṇatyā niyamenevetiniyamenaiveti, niyato hi bhāvo vyajyate pravartate
tathā tamaḥsattvena rajaḥsattvaṃ prakāśyate, vyaktipravṛttiniyatirniyatipravṛttipariṇatyā niyatyaivetyuktaṃ bhavati
tathā tamaḥsattvena tamaḥsattvaṃ prakāśyate vyaktiniyatipariṇatyā niyatyaivetyuktaṃ bhavatīti tadeva bhāvitam

evameva cetyādi, yathā sattvarajastamasāṃ navadhā vikalpā uktāstathā sattvaprakāśena sattvaprakāśaḥ prakāśyata iti sattvaprakāśena rajaḥprakāśastamaḥprakāśaśceti trayaḥ rajaḥprakāśena sattvaprakāśo rajaḥprakāśastamaḥprakāśaśceti trayaḥ tamaḥprakāśena sattvaprakāśo rajaḥprakāśastamaḥprakāśa iti trayo vikalpāḥ, prakāśyate pravartyate niyamyate ityanenaiva sattvaprakāśo rajaḥprakāśastamaḥprakāśaśca tamaḥprakāśena sattvaprakāśo rajaḥprakāśastamaḥprakāśaśca prakāśyate pravartyate niyamyate iti trayo'pyarthā aikyamāpādanīyāḥ
granthena trayo'pyarthā aikyamāpādanīyāḥ, pratyekaṃ navasvapi yojyā ityarthaḥ

eṣa dārṣṭāntiko'pyartho vyākhyātaḥ, sa idānīṃ dṛṣṭāntena sādharmyeṇopasaṃhriyate --sarvāpyeṣā mṛdghaṭavyaktiśaktisthūlateva yathā prāgupavarṇitā kāraṇe kāryasya sattvād mṛdyanabhivyaktāyā ghaṭavyaktiśakteḥ sthūlatā ūrdhvagrīvādivyaktendriyagrāhyatā sā ekaiva tathā sattvaprakāśādiprapañcā vyaktirekaiva, ekārthaviṣayā sattvamiti vā raja iti vā tama iti vā pradhānamiti vā yathecchasi tathāstu sarvathāpyekasya kāraṇākhyasya vastunaḥ sūkṣmasya sthūlataiva vyaktiriti tadviṣayā vyāvarṇyate
iti vicāraparisamāptyarthaḥ, yat pratijñātaṃ sattvaṃ prakāśātmakayośced rajastamasoḥ śabdabhāvāya vyavatiṣṭhate tata ekātmakaikakāraṇatvamiti tat sādhvabhyadhāmeti
evameva ca sattvaprakāśena sattvaprakāśaḥ prakāśyate rajaḥprakāśastamaḥprakāśaśca rajaḥprakāśena
se nūṇaṃ bhaṃte ! atthittaṃ atthitte pariṇamai natthittaṃ natthitte pariṇamai ? haṃtā goyamā ! jāva pariṇamai
jaṃ ṇaṃ bhaṃte atthittaṃ atthitte pariṇamai natthittaṃ natthitte pariṇamai taṃ kiṃ payogasā vīsasā ? goyamā payogasā vi taṃ vīsasā vi taṃ

jahā te bhaṃte ? atthittaṃ atthitte pariṇamai tahā te natthittaṃ natthitte pariṇamai ? jahā te natthittaṃ natthitte pariṇamai tahā te atthittaṃ atthitte pariṇamai ? haṃtā goyamā ! jahā me atthittaṃ atthitte pariṇamai tahā me natthittaṃ natthitte pariṇamai, jahā me natthittaṃ natthitte pariṇamai tahā me atthittaṃ atthitte pariṇamai
atra niyatena cāvaśyaṃ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
sattvaprakāśo rajaḥprakāśastamaḥprakāśaśca tamaḥprakāśena sattvaprakāśo rajaḥprakāśastamaḥprakāśaśca prakāśyate pravartyate niyamyate iti trayo'pyarthā aikyamāpādanīyāḥ
tathā yaducyate--rajaḥ śabdakāryaṃ pravartya śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānaṃ tadbhāvāya itarayoḥ pravṛttiṃ karoti pravartayati
atrāpi tathaiva anugantavyaṃ prakāśasthāne pravṛttiṃ kṛtvā sattvasthāne rajaḥ prakhyāpanasthāne pravartanaṃ nartakācāryasthāne ca vāyum
tathā tamaḥ śabdakāryaṃ niyamya śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānaṃ tadbhāvāyetarayoḥ pravṛttiṃ vyavasthāpayati niyamayati
atrāpi tathaiva doṣāpādanamanugantavyaṃ prakāśasthāne niyamaṃ kṛtvā sattvasthāne tamaḥ prakhyāpanasthāne niyamanaṃ nartakācāryasthāne ca lambanapāṣāṇam
atra ॰sya sataḥ sthūla॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
tathā yaducyate rajaḥ śabdakāryamityādigranthasyāpi samānadauṣṭyāpādanārtho'tideśaḥ bhāṣye eva sulikhitātideśopāyatvād na vivriyate
viśeṣaṇavinyāsopāyaśca sulikhita eva prakāśasthāne pravṛttiṃ kṛtvetyādi sarvamanugantavyaṃ yāvad vāyumiti
tathā tamaḥ śabdakāryamityādi tathaivānugantavyaṃ yāvad lambanapāṣāṇamiti
evaṃ samāpitaprasaṅga idānīṃ sādhanamāha --atastrīṇyapyekamityādi yāvad varaṇāditamastvavaditi
sattvarajastamāṃsi trīṇyapi prakāśapravṛttiniyamātmakāni jātyantarābhimatānyekaṃ vastutaḥ tritvasyātantratvād bhinnamapyabhinnamiti pakṣārthaḥ
trīṇyapi ca parasya siddhāni dharmitvena asmākaṃ ca vastuśaktitvabhedenetītthaṃ sādhyate, anyathā trīṇī caikaṃ ca iti virudvaṃ syāt

apṛthagbhūtasamavasthānasvarūpabhedātmakatvāt, bhūtaṃ bhavanaṃ bhāvo bhūtiriti bhāve niṣṭhāvidhānādapṛthagbhavanamasya saṅgatyā ekībhāvenāvasthānasya tadidamapṛthagbhūtasamavasthānam, tadeva svarūpaṃ bhedāścātmā yeṣāṃ tāni sattvādīni apṛthagbhūtasamavasthānasvarūpabhedātmakāni, tadbhāvāt
kṣīrodakavad deśakālābhedena sahabhavane'pi saṅgatyaikyāvasthānasvarūpatvaviśeṣaṇāt kvacit kadācit pṛthagbhavanābhāvādityuktaṃ bhavati

dṛṣṭāntaḥ --varaṇāditamastvavat, yathā varaṇasadanāpadhvaṃsanabaibhatsyadainyagauravāṇāṃ parasparato bhinnānāṃ chādanastambhanaviśaraṇārocanaviṣādādhogamanadharmāṇāṃ bhedātmakatve satyapi mohātmakatamaḥsvārūpyānatikrameṇaikyamapṛthagbhavanasamavasthānasvarūpabhedātmakatvāt tathāsmādeva hetoḥ sattvādīnyekamiti

atrāha --apṛthagbhavanasamavasthānetyādi jātyantaratvasādhanāni yāvad gururityubhābhyāmanya iti, nanūktamanvayavīta eva, atrāha--kathaṃ punaretadupalamyate sukhaḥdukhamohā jātyantarāṇi iti, atrocyate--sukhaṃ laghvapravṛttiśīlaṃ prakāśakaṃ dṛṣṭam, sukhāśca karaṇaprakāśāḥ, tasmāt pravṛttiniyamābhyāmanye
tathā duḥkhaṃ calamaprakāśakaṃ pravṛttiśīlaṃ dṛṣṭam, duḥkhāśca karaṇapravṛttayaḥ, tasmāt prakāśaniyamābhyāmanyāḥ
tathā moho gururaprakāśako dṛṣṭaḥ, mūḍhāśca karaṇaniyamāḥ, tasmāt prakāśapravṛttibhyāmanya iti
asya granthasyārthavyākhyānaṃ sādhanaireva kriyate— sattvarajastamāṃsi jātyantarāṇi, lakṣaṇabhedāt, cetanaśarīravat
lakṣaṇabhedaḥ sattvaṃ laghvapravṛttiśīlaṃ dṛṣṭamityādi tatsādhanairbhāṣye sulikhitamiti na vivṛṇmahe
sattvaṃ laghu prakāśakamiṣṭamupaṣṭambhakaṃ calaṃ ca rajaḥ
atra nayacakravṛttau sāṅkhyakārikāvṛttiyuktidīpikādiprācīnagrantheṣu ca sāṅkhyamatanirūpaṇaprasaṅge kāryakāraṇātmakaśabdaprayogo bahuṣu sthāneṣu dṛśyate
kintu pūrvāparasambandhavicāraṇayā tadvyākhyāvalokanena ca tatra kāryakaraṇātmaka iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīna iti bhāti, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 12 paṃ॰ 17, pṛ॰ 228-- 2
sāṅkhyamate hi prakṛtervikārabhūtāḥ padārthāḥ kāryakaraṇabhedena dvidhā vibhaktāḥ

tathā ca tadgranthaḥ--āha--karaṇaṃ pratyācāryavipratipatteḥ, ekādaśavidhamiti vārṣagaṇāḥ, daśavidhamiti tāntrikāḥ pañcādhikaraṇaprabhṛtayaḥ, dvādaśavidhamiti patañjaliḥ, tasmād bhavataḥ katividhaṃ karaṇamabhipretamiti vaktavyametat
pañca karmendriyāṇi pañca buddhīndriyāṇi mano'haṅkāro buddhiścetyetat sarvaṃ puruṣārthopayogi karaṇam...
tatra vaktavyam kā kriyā kiṃ ca tat kriyate yadapekṣya buddhyādīnāṃ karaṇatvamiti? ucyate, yaduktaṃ kā kriyā ityatra brūmaḥ--na tannirvartyamihābhipretam daṇḍādivat
dhāraṇaṃ buddhīndriyāṇi kurvanti, viṣayasannidhāne sati śrotrādivṛttestadrūpāpatteḥ
apara āha--āharaṇaṃ karmendriyāṇi kurvanti, dhāraṇaṃ mano'haṅkāraśca, prakāśanaṃ buddhīndriyāṇi buddhiśceti
yattūktaṃ kiṃ kāryamiti, ucyate --kāryaṃ ca tasya daśadhā, daśeti pañca viśeṣāḥ pañca aviśeṣāḥ
tadapyata eva kāryaśabdaṃ labhate --āhāryaṃ dhāryaṃ prakāśyaṃ ca, taddhi āhartavyaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ prakāśayitavyaṃ ca ataḥ kāryamityucyate, na nirvartyatvāt
...vyākhyātaṃ karaṇaparva, kāryaparva idānīṃ vaktavyam, tasya ca purastāduddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ--kāryaṃ ca tasya daśadhā pañca viśeṣāḥ pañca aviśeṣā iti
āha--yadyevaṃ tasmādidameva tāvaducyatāṃ ke viśeṣāḥ ke'viśeṣā iti
yāni tanmātrāṇi pañca ahaṅkārādutpadyante iti prāgapadiṣṭaṃ te khalu aviśeṣāḥ
ucyate--yāni khalu tebhyo bhūtāni pañca pañcabhyaḥ utpadyante ete smṛtā viśeṣāḥ kā॰ 38, pṛ॰ 140
kāryaṃ ca tasya daśadhā'' hāryaṃ dhāryaṃ prakāśyaṃ ca
iti sāṅkhyakārikā anyathā vyākhyātā dṛśyate, tadyathā--trayodaśavidhaṃ karaṇaṃ kiṃ karotītyatrocyate--āhārakaṃ dhārakaṃ prakāśakaṃ ca
atrāhakiṃ tadasti yasyāharaṇaṃ dhāraṇaṃ prakāśanaṃ ca kriyate ? atrocyate--kāryaṃ ca tasya daśadhā''hāryaṃ dhāryaṃ prakāśyaṃ ca
śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ pañca vacanādānaviharaṇotsargānandāstu pañca, ete daśa viṣayāḥ kāryamityucyate
taṃ daśavidhaṃ viṣayaṃ buddhīndriyaiḥ prakāśitamarthaṃ karmendriyāṇi āharanti dhārayanti ca
tadyathā-tamaḥsthitaṃ ghaṭaṃ dīpena prakāśitaṃ hasta ādatte dhārayati
--je॰ sāṅkhyakā॰ vṛ॰ B, māṭharavṛttāvapi etadarthaka eva pāṭhaḥ
trayodaśavidhaṃ karaṇaṃ kiṃ karotītyatrocyate--? dhāraṇaṃ karmendriyāṇi kurvanti, prakāśaṃ buddhīndriyāṇi kurvanti
tadāharaṇadhāraṇaprakāśakaraṃ kiṃ tadasti yasyāharaṇaṃ dhāraṇaṃ prakāśaṃ karaṇaṃ karotītyatrocyate--kāryaṃ ca tasya daśadhā''hāryaṃ dhāryaṃ prakāśyaṃ ca
kāryamiti śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ pañca vacanādānaviharaṇotsargānandāstu pañca, ete daśa viṣayāḥ kāryamityucyate
taṃ daśavidhaṃ viṣayaṃ buddhīndriyaiḥ prakāśitaṃ karmendriyāṇi āharanti dhārayanti ceti
tatrāharaṇaṃ dhāraṇaṃ ca karmendriyāṇi kurvanti prakāśaṃ buddhīndriyāṇi
katividhaṃ kāryaṃ tasyeti taducyate--kāryaṃ ca tasya daśadhā
tasya karaṇasya kāryaṃ kartavyamiti daśadhā daśaprakāraṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhākhyaṃ vacanādānaviharaṇotsargānandākhyametad daśavidhaṃ kāryam
buddhīndriyaiḥ prakāśitaṃ karmendriyāṇi āharanti dhārayanti ceti
śabdādayaḥ pañca viṣayāḥ vacanādayaḥ pañca vṛttayaḥ etāni daśa tatkāryāṇi
tatra tribhirāhṛtaṃ pañcabhirbuddhīndriyaiḥ prakāśitaṃ pañca karmendriyāṇi dhārayanti
tatra karmendriyāṇi vāgādīni āharanti yathāsvamupādadate svavyāpāreṇa vyāpnuvantīti yāvat
...kāryaṃ ca tasya trayodaśavidhasya karaṇasya daśadhā--āhāryaṃ dhāryaṃ prakāśyaṃ ca
karmendriyāṇāṃ vacanādānaviharaṇotsargānandā yathāyathaṃ vyāpyāḥ, te ca yathāyathaṃ divyādivyatayā daśeti āhāryaṃ daśadhā
evaṃ dhāryamapyantaḥkaraṇatrayasya prāṇādilakṣaṇayā vṛttyā śarīram, tacca pārthivādipāñcabhautikam, śabdādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ samūhaḥ pṛthivī, te ca pañca divyādivyatayā daśeti dhāryamapi daśadhā
evaṃ buddhīndriyāṇāṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhā yathāyathaṃ vyāpyāḥ, te ca yathāyathaṃ divyādivyatayā daśeti prakāśyamapi daśadheti
śabdasparśaguṇo vāyustau ca rūpaṃ ca tejasi
te rasaśca jale jñeyāste ca gandhaḥ kṣitāvapi
tathā karaṇākhyāḥ śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuḥ jihvā ghrāṇaṃ pādaḥ pāyuḥ upasthaḥ hastaḥ vāk manaḥ ahaṅkāraḥ buddhiriti
iti pāśupatasūtrasya pañcārthabhāṣye Trivandrum Sanskrit Series, No 143.
etena ādhyātmikānāṃ kāryakāraṇātmakānāṃ bhedānāṃ sukhaduḥkhamohamayatvaṃ bodhyaṃ samanvayadarśanāt

katham ? laghutvaprakāśāpravṛttiśīlatvānyapyekam, apṛthagbhūtasamavasthānasvarūpalakṣaṇabhedātmakatvād varaṇādibhinnalakṣaṇatamastvavat, tathaiva vyākhyeyaṃ lakṣaṇaśabdādhikyena, vigrahastu tatsvarūpameva lakṣaṇam, sa eva bhedo yasyeti
sukhaṃ mohād guroranyat, laghutvāt, lohapiṇḍādiva arkatūlaḥ ...
sukhaṃ mohād guroranyat, laghutvāt, lohapiṇḍādivārkatūlaḥ, duḥkhādanyat pravṛttiśīlāt, apravṛttiśīlatvāt, ākāśādiva vāyuḥ
mohaḥ sukhaduḥkhābhyāmagurubhyāmanyaḥ, gurutvāt, pṛthivyā iva agniḥ
duḥkhamohau sukhāt prakāśakādanyau, aprakāśakatvāt, pradīpādiva ghaṭaḥ
itara āha --nāpṛthagbhūtatetyādi hetvasiddhipratipādanasādhanāni lokaprasiddhadṛṣṭāntāni yāvat pradīpādiva ghaṭa iti
loṣṭadṛṣṭānto vakṣyate sukhaduḥkhamohaiḥ puruṣabhogyairanyonyato'nyairupeta ityatideśasādhanoktikāla uttaratra

apṛthagbhūtasamavasthānasvarūpamasiddham, tat kathamiti cet, sādhanairevocyate --sukhaṃ mohād guroranyadityādi subodhatvānna vyākhyeyaṃ parasparānyatvasādhanakadambakaṃ yathābhāṣyalikhitamanugantavyam
punaścetyādi, etasmādanye sādhanaprapañcāt sukhatvāt duḥkhatvād mohatvādityādayo'pyanyatvahetavaḥ syuḥ, ādigrahaṇāt prasādādayo'pīti

tatprayogadigupapradarśanārthamāha --śarīrendriyagata ātmaikadeśastadekadeśabhūtābhyāṃ rajastamobhyāmanyaḥ, kāryabhūtasya śarīrasya kāraṇabhūtānāṃ cendriyāṇāmādhyātmikānāmekadeśastadātmabhūtatvaṃ gatastadātmabhūtābhyāṃ rajastamobhyāmanyaḥ, sukhatvāt, loṣṭavat, yathā loṣṭo bhogyo hi puruṣasya bhokturupayogārthapravṛtteḥ kapotonnayanārthakṣepaṇādānādiṣu sukhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃdṛṣṭaṃ ṣṭaṃḥ ? calanapīḍanādiṣu duḥkhaṃ loṣṭo nu kapoto nu ityādisaṃśayaviparyayādiṣu mohaḥ
tasmāt sukhaṃ duḥkhamohābhyāmanyad loṣṭavat, loṣṭa iva loṣṭavat
evaṃ duḥkhamohāvityatideśaḥ, duḥkhaṃ śarīrendriyagataṃ tadātmaikadeśabhūtābhyāṃ sattvatamobhyāmanyad duḥkhatvālloṣṭavat, mohaḥ sattvarajobhyāmanyo mohatvālloṣṭavaditi
ete hetavo'siddhā evāvadhāraṇe iti vakṣyati, siddhatve'pi aprasiddhasādhyadharmasamanvayāḥ pṛthagbhūtasukhādyātmakasattvādilaghvāditūlaloṣṭādivastvabhāvāt, sarvasya traiguṇyāvyatirekācca
na caiṣāṃ vipakṣād vyāvṛttirasti, tūlaloṣṭādereva vipakṣatvena vyavasthānāt
viviktaikasukhātmakāddhi vastuno'nyad viviktaduḥkhādyātmakaṃ syād vipakṣaḥ, tattu nāsti sarvasya triguṇaikātmakatvāt, na puruṣo'sattvāt tasyāpi sukhādanyatvāditi
tataśca tūlaloṣṭāderapi vipakṣatvāt tataśca laghutvādihetūnāmavyāvṛtteraprasiddhasādhyadharmavyāvṛttayaste hetava iti viruddhatvaṃ hetudoṣaḥ
sādhyasādhanobhayānanvayo dharmyasiddhiśca sādharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ, sādhyāvyāvṛttādidoṣaśca vaidharmyadṛṣṭānta iti darśayati
ṇicchayato savvalahuṃ savvaguruṃ vā ṇa vijjae davvaṃ
punarapi śiṣyaḥ prāha--kathametadavasīyate ekaika ākāśapradeśo'nantairagurulaghuparyāyairupetaḥ ? ucyate--iha dvividhaṃ vastu, rūpidravyamarūpidravyaṃ ca
tatra rūpidravyaṃ caturdhā, tadyathā--guru, laghu, gurulaghu, agurulaghu ca
etadapyucyate vyavahārataḥ, niścayataḥ punardvividhameva gurulaghu agurulaghu ca
tathā cāha --ṇicchayato savvaguruṃ savvalahuṃ vā ṇa vijjae davvaṃ

niścayataḥ niścayanayamatena na kiñcid dravyaṃ sarvaguru ekāntaguru, yadi syādekāntaguru tata ekāntenaiva patanadharmi syāt, na ca patati tasmānna vidyate sarvaguru, nāpi sarvalaghu ekāntalaghu, yadi syādekāntalaghu tato na kadācit patati, atha kadācit patati tasmānna sarvalaghvapi
vyavahārataḥ vyavahāranayamatena punaryujyate sarvaguru sarvalaghu ca
keṣu ? ityāha--bādaraskandheṣu bādaratvapariṇāmapariṇateṣu anantaprādeśikeṣu skanṣeṣu, nānyeṣu sūkṣmapariṇāmapariṇateṣu
tatra guru dravyaṃ yathā--ayaspiṇḍaḥ, laghu yathā--arkatūlam, gurulaghu yathā--vāyuḥ, agurulaghu paramāṇvādi

niścayataḥ punarevaṃ dvividhadravyabhāvanā--paramāṇvāderārabhya saṅkhyātapradeśātmako'saṅkhyātapradeśātmako yaścānantapradeśātmakaḥ sūkṣmaskandhaḥ kārmaṇaprabhṛtika ete agurulaghavaḥ, bādarāḥ skandhā audārikavaikriyāhārakataijasarūpā gurulaghavaḥ
davvaṃ, leṭṭhuṃ dīvo vāū vomaṃ jahāsaṃkhaṃ
nicchayao savvaguruṃ savvalahuṃ vā na vijjae davvaṃ
vavahārato tu jujjati bāyarakhaṃdhesu ṇa itaresu || bṛhatkalpa॰ 65

kiñcānyat, svata evānumānanirākṛtasvapakṣapratyakṣīkaraṇārthāśca ete hetavaḥ iti vartate, asti pradhānaṃ bhedānāmanvayadarśanāt iti prakramya sukhaduḥkhamohānvitā ādhyātmikā bāhyāśca śabdādayaḥ kāryātmakāstrayāṇāmekakāryabhāvāt, tadārabdhāścākāśavāyvanalāmbhobhūmayo bhūtākhyāstairyagyonamānuṣadaivāni śarīrāṇīndriyāṇi ca tadātmakānidarthāni trayāṇāmekakāryabhāvāt sukhādyanvitānyeva candanaśakalādivat ityevamādyanumānasiddhaṃ traiguṇyam anyat sukhaṃ duḥkhamohābhyāṃ laghveva ca ityevamādipakṣaṃ nirākaroti tasya svapakṣasyānumānanirākṛtasyānyāviditasya sarvalokāpratyakṣasya sataḥ pratyakṣīkaraṇārthā ete hetavaḥ saṃvṛttā itītthamanumānaviruddhapratijñādoṣodbhāvanavakroktireṣā
laghutvāt ityādayo hetavaḥ kimavadhāritārthā utānavadhāritārthāḥ ? iti sampradhāryametat, laghveva sukhaṃ na guru na calaṃ vā, tathānyeṣāmapi calatvādīnāṃ calameva gurveva pravṛttiśīlameveti

yogino'pi ca sutarāṃ patanameva syāt, śilābaddhaśilāvat

niṣkṛṣya avadhārya cayataḥ jñānataḥ paramārthanayato vā sarvathā laghu sarvaṃ vā laghu na vidyate tathā sarvaguru dravyam, paramāṇudvipradeśādyasaṅkhyeyāntānāṃ keṣāñcidanantapradeśānāṃ ca skandhānāṃ śeṣadravyāṇāṃ cāgurulaghutvāt, tataḥ paramanantānantapradeśānāṃ bādarāṇāmāpekṣikalaghugurupariṇāmitvāt, vyavahāranayena tu yujyate laghutvaṃ gurutvaṃ vā anyonyasmāt laghurgururveti
vātaṃ rātīti vātarā badarapramāṇā bādarā vā skandhāḥ sthūlā ityarthaḥ
yogino'pi ca sutarāṃ patanameva syāt, śilābaddhaśilāvat
ayamapi laghuguru॰ iti pāṭhaḥ kathañcit saṅgacchata eva, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 301 ṭi॰ 1
atyantagurutāyāmityādi nirapekṣaikāntagurutāyāmetadeva patet patanakriyameva syāt na tiṣṭhed norddhvaṃ gacched gurutvāt, dṛṣṭānto vakṣyamāṇaḥ

syānmatam--patedeva guru yadi pratibandhī na syāt, asti tu saṃyogaḥ pratibandhī patanasya phalasyeva vṛntamiti, ato viśeṣayāmaḥ --saṃyogabhāve'pi patanapratibandhyaviṣahyagurutvāditi, pratibandhinā yad viṣahyaṃ na bhavati guru tat patedeva, sa cāsya nāsti pratibandhī tvayaikāntagurutvābhyupagamāt
tantupratibandhānivāryapātopalavat, ekena tantunā pratibandhinā satyapi saṃyogabhāve tadaviṣahyagurutvāt patatyeva yathopalastathaitat patedeva sukhaṃ laghutvaśūnyagurutvāditi

yogino'pi cetyādi, yo'pi cāsya yogī pratibandhakastasyāpi ca yoginaḥ pratibandhino gurutvāt tatpatanopacayahetutvāt sutarāṃ patanameva syāt patedeva tenāpi hi saha śilābaddhaśilāvaditi pātahetutvaṃ draḍhayati

athavā mā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityatyantalaghutvamiṣyate tato'tyantalaghutāyāṃ na kadācidapi patanaṃ syāt, pātākhyo bhāva eva na syāt tasyotpattikāraṇābhāvāt, tacca kāraṇaṃ gurutvaṃ patanasya, tadabhāvāt khapuṣpavat na syāt
syānmatam--dṛṣṭaviruddhamucyate gurulaghutvadarśanāt arkatūlo laghurgururlohapiṇḍaḥ iti dṛṣṭatvāditi

eṣa na doṣaḥ, yasmāt vavahārato tu jujjati ityuktatvādityata āha — kanyānudaravattu vyavahāro'yamapekṣākṛto bādaraskandhaviṣaya iti, yathā anudarā kanyā ityanyāsāmudaravatīnāmudareṇa sadṛśamudaramasyā nāstītyudaravatyeva anudarā ityucyate vyavahāratastathā bādaraskandheṣu laghugurutve
yadapi ca lohapiṇḍārkatūlodāharaṇaṃ tadapi tattulyāpekṣikalaghugurutve eva sādhayatītyata āha — evamevāpekṣiketyādi yāvadanavasthitaikatve
alpavācini kani lohapiṇḍakaḥ palamātrapramāṇo'rkatūla atha mamātra kim ? dravyaṃ caitadevaṃ laghugurutvāpekṣayā tadeva dṛṣṭam, na guṇāḥ
sattvādayo guṇāstvime laghutvādilakṣaṇā mayocyante, dravyatā teṣāṃ sandrāve ekatvāpattau bhavati
ā adyāpi yadi guṇasandrāvo dravyamiṣyate tatastavāpyetaddravyameva, kuto'syāsandrāvaḥ ? sattvādayo guṇā laghutvādilakṣaṇāstatsandrutilakṣaṇaṃ dravyameva, śabdādibhāvena vyavasthānāt, śabdādisvātmavat
anāpannatadrūpasya asandrutasya śabdādibhāvāpattikālo vyavasthānaśabdenocyata bhārāllaghīyān palaśatikā tulā, viṃśatistulā bhāraḥ iti paribhāṣitatvāt

atra atha mā ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

kutaḥ ? apravṛttiśīlatvād vāyuvadākāśavaditi pṛthaktvābhāvād darśayati, yathā vāyurākāśaṃ vā sukhātmakaṃ duḥkhāt pravṛttiśīlādananyat tathehāpītyādigrahaṇād duḥkhaṃ sukhādananyadapravṛttiśīlāt, pravṛttiśīlatvāt, yadyat pravṛttiśīlaṃ tat tadapravṛttiśīlādananyad vāyvākāśavat
tathā duḥkhaṃ mohādananyadacalāt, calatvāt, ghaṭaparvatādiduḥkhavat; tathā sukhāt prakāśakādananyat, aprakāśakatvāt, pradīpaghaṭādiduḥkhavat
evaṃ ca sukhatvād duḥkhatvād mohatvāt prasādādikāryatvādityādayo'pyananyatvahetava eva
pratyekamitaraguṇasvarūpānanyatvaṃ pratijñāya tattadrūpavinivṛttihetuto yat kiñcid vastūdāhṛtya sādhyam, sarvasya loṣṭāderlaghuprakāśetarādiparasparāpṛthagbhūtaguṇātmakatvāt

nanvevaṃ viruddhāvyabhicārivadubhayāniścayaḥ, na, uktatvāt, bhāvitatvācca sadā lloṣṭavat, sattvarajobhyāmananyo mohatvālloṣṭavat
tathā śarīrendriyagata ātmaikadeśastadekadeśabhūtābhyāṃ rajastamobhyāmananyaḥ prasādakāryatvālloṣṭavat, evaṃ lāghavaprasavādibhyaḥ
tathā sattvarajobhyāmananyo varaṇatvāt, evaṃ sadanādibhya iti
evaṃ tāvad yathāhetvaikāntikatvaṃ prati ta evānyatvahetavaḥ ananyatvahetavaḥ ityuktāstvatprayuktalakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyaviśeṣaṇapakṣa- viracanayā laghvādaya eva
kṣaṇyaviśeṣaṇapakṣaviracanāṃ bhedalakṣaṇābhimatebhya eva hetubhyo'bhedasiddhiḥ śakyā āpādayituṃ sphuṭenaiva nyāyādhvanā--sukhaṃ mohādananyat, apuruṣatve'calatvāt, mohasvātmavat
mohaḥ sukhādananyaḥ acalatvāt sukhasvātmavat, duḥkhādananyaḥ aprakāśakatvāt duḥkhasvātmavat
nanvevaṃ viruddhāvyabhicārivadubhayāniścayaḥ, na, uktatvāt, bhāvitatvācca sadā

lakṣaṇabhedahetūnāṃ sukhaṃ mohād guroranyallaghutvād mahālohapiṇḍārkatūlavat ityādiviśeṣaṇamantareṇa bhedo na śakyaḥ sādhayitumiti tadracanākusṛtiryathā tvayā kriyate tathaiva mayā kṛtā, kintu tāṃ muktvāpi lakṣaṇabhedavailakṣaṇyaviśeṣaṇapakṣaviracanāṃ sattvādibhedalakṣaṇābhimatebhya eva tvaduktebhyo laghvādihetubhyo'bhedasiddhiḥ śakyā āpādayituṃ sphuṭenaiva nyāyādhvanā bhrāntijananena vinetyarthaḥ
tadyathā --sukhaṃ mohādananyat, apuruṣatve'calatvāt, mohasvātmavat, apuruṣatvaviśeṣitaḥ acalatvāt iti hetuḥ puruṣādacalād vyāvartyate mā bhūdanaikāntika iti

yadyapi nyāyamukhagranthaḥ saṃskṛtabhāṣāyāṃ nopalabhyate samprati tathāpi Yuen-Chwang ityanena 130॰ varṣebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ vihitaṃ cīnabhāṣānuvādamavalambya Giuseppe Tucci ityanena vihite English> bhāṣānuvāde nimnalikhitaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate--Some object: the reason: because it is audible</q> is not asādhāraṇa, as you assume, but it must be a valid reason when we discuss against a vaiśeṣika who thinks that soundness is eternal.
My reply is that this argument can be valid until the opponent has not indicated that the reason of non-eternity is the fact of being product etc.
But if validity can be reached in either way, since contradiction regarding one and the same object is inadmissible, this kind of reason proves to be a doubtful reason.

Moreover in this world the force of direct perception and of authority of the scripture AGAMA is stronger than any argument and therfore we must search after truth on the basis of these two means of knowledge, p.
itaścātulyamāvayoḥ --bhāvitatvācca guṇeṣu sadā sandrāvasya, bahudhā bhāvitaṃ hi sadā sattvādayo guṇāḥ sandrutā eva pradhānamahadahaṅkārādisarvāvasthāsu na jātu pṛthagbhūtasamavasthāśceti

kiñcānyat, viruddhāvyabhicāriṇi coktam, viruddhāvyabhicāriṇyapi na parasparanivāritavyāptitvamātrāt saṃśaya eva, kiṃ tarhi ? pratyakṣāgamabalīyastvāt tata eva niścayo'nviṣyatenveṣyate iti hyuktam, tayorviruddhāvyabhicāriṇoḥ pakṣadharmayoryaḥ pratyakṣīkṛtārthenāgamena balīyān pratyakṣasaṃvādinā pratyakṣeṇāgamena ca janitabalādvā pratyakṣeṇaivāgamenaiva vā yathāprasiddhi yo balīyāṃstata eva niścayo'nviṣyatanveṣyate ityādivyākhyāvikalpeṣu pratyakṣāgamena ghaṭādiṣu prasiddhasādhyānityatvānvayasya kṛtakatvahetorbalīyastvāt tato'nitya iti niścayaḥ syāt, na tu śrāvaṇatvasya śabdatve pratyakṣīkartuṃ śakyo'nvayaḥ śabdatvasyāprasiddhatvāditi, tadvat kimiha sādharmyamiti cet, ucyate --balīyastvaṃ mā maṃsthāstvadīyā hetavo balīyāṃsaḥ, asmatpakṣasādhanatvāyeto viparivartayituṃ śakyatvāt

kiṃ tvānmātrādeva viparivartanam ? trailakṣaṇyāt ? trailakṣaṇyāccet, ādilakṣaṇa- cāsmaddhetūnāmādyahetubhāvanāt, bhinnātmakatāyāṃ tu ityādi prakramya anātmatve sati avaraṇādyātmakatvādityādibhirādyahetubhiḥ pratyakṣāgamabalīyastvamāpāditam
mā maṃsthāstvadīyā hetavo balīyāṃsaḥ, asmatpakṣasādhanatvāyeto viparivartayituṃ śakyatvāt
kiṃ tvānmātrādeva viparivartanam ? trailakṣaṇyāt ? trailakṣaṇyāccet, ādilakṣaṇa-
itara āha --mā maṃsthāstvadīyā hetavo balīyāṃsaḥ avaraṇādyātmakatvādayaḥ iti
tadyathā--pūrvahetavastāvadabalāḥ, yataḥ śakyante ta ito'pi sutarāṃ puruṣanivṛttyarthamanātmatvaviśeṣaṇādṛte'pi viparivartayitum
tadyathā--sukhādanyad duḥkhaṃ prasādādyanātmakatvāt puruṣavat, asamarthasamāsenāgamakenāpyarthaṃ gṛhītvā nañivoktyanusāreṇoktam
caśabdād duḥkhādanyau sukhamohau śoṣādyanātmakatvāt puruṣavat, tathaiva vyākhyā, dve sādhane samasyokte mohādanye sukhaduḥkhe varaṇādyanātmakatvāt puruṣavaditi tathaiveti
atrocyate --kiṃ tvānmātrādeva viparivartanam ? trailakṣaṇyāt ? iti praśnaḥ
syānmatam--na tvānmātrāt, kiṃ tarhi ? trailakṣaṇyāccedevaṃ cenmanyase, tadayuktam; yasmādādilakṣaṇameva nāsti, iha pakṣadharmatvameva tāvannāsti yadādhāreṇa śeṣadvayam
kathaṃ pakṣadharmo nāstīti cet, yasmād na meva nāsti, na hyanātmanāṃ nāma dharmaḥ kaścidasti, na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ nānyat
nanvanyapadārthaviṣayatvād bahuvrīheḥ nāsti prasādādyātmā varaṇādyātmā vā sa ko'pyanyaḥ syāt saddharmavān
evamapi yathā sthūlaśirā rāhuḥ ityatra asata ākhyā rāhoḥ śirovyatiriktasya
asadākhyayā vyapadeśivadbhāvaṃ kṛtvā vyavahāro dṛṣṭastathedamapi syāt
dharmisvarūpavirodhastāvat— ātmano'nanyadeva duḥkham, prasādādyanātmakatvāt, ātmasvatattvavat, anyathā sukhānyatvaprasādādyanātmakatvānupapatteḥ

tataśca prakṛti- hyanātmanāṃ nāma dharmaḥ kaścidasti, yadi prasādādyātmā na bhavatītyanātmakaṃ duḥkhamucyate, atha ātmaiva nāstītyanātmakamityucyate, dvidhāpyasiddhaṃ duḥkhasyānātmakatvaṃ dharmyasiddhyāpatteḥ
kathamiti cet, ucyate — na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ nānyad mohaḥ puruṣo vā, tvatparikalpitaṃ duḥkhaṃ prasādādyanātmakatvāt khapuṣpavat syāditi dharmyabhāvādapakṣadharmatvam
iha samānārthena vākyena bhavitavyaṃ samāsena ca
yaścehārtho vākyena gamyate mahatkaṣṭaṃ śritaḥ iti nāsau jātucit samāsena gamyate mahatkaṣṭaśritaḥ iti
yatra ca gamako bhavati, bhavati tatra vṛttiḥ, tadyathā--devadattasya gurukulam, devadattasya guruputraḥ, devadattasya dāsabhāryā iti

yadyagamakatvaṃ hetuḥ, nārthaḥ samarthagrahaṇena, ihāpi bhāryā rājñaḥ, puruṣo devadattasya iti yo'rtho vākyena gamyate nāsau jātucit samāsena gamyate bhāryā rājapuruṣo devadattasya iti, tasmānnārthaḥ samarthagrahaṇena
idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--ayamastyasamarthasamāso nañsamāso gamakaḥ, tasya sādhutvaṃ mā bhūt akiñcitkurvāṇam, amāṣaṃ haramāṇam, agādhādutsṛṣṭam iti
etadapi nāsti prayojanam, avaśyaṃ kasyacid nañsamāsasyāsamarthasamāsasya gamakasya sādhutvaṃ vaktavyam— asūryaṃpaśyāni mukhāni, apunargeyāḥ ślokāḥ, aśrāddhabhojī brāhmaṇaḥ, alavaṇabhojī brāhmaṇaḥ iti
suḍanapuṃsakasyetyetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati--etasya vā asamarthasamāsasya nañsamāsasya gamakasya sādhutvaṃ bhavati nānyasyeti
kiṃ yo'śrāddhaṃ bhuṅkte so'śrāddhabhojī ? kiṃ cātaḥ ? yadāsāvaśrāddhaṃ na bhuṅkte tadāsya vratalopaḥ syāt, tadyathā--sthāyī yadā na tiṣṭhati tadāsya vratalopo bhavati
evaṃ tarhi ṇinyantena samāso bhaviṣyati, na śrāddhabhojī aśrāddhabhojīti
naivaṃ śakyam, svare hi doṣaḥ syāt aśrāddhabhojī 6
evaṃ tarhi naña evāyaṃ bhujipratiṣedhavācinaḥ śrāddhaśabdenāsamarthasamāsaḥ na bhojī śrāddhasyeti
kāni ? asūryapaśyāni mukhāni, apunargeyāḥ ślokāḥ, aśrāddhabhojī brāhmaṇaḥ, suḍanapuṃsakasya 1
meva nāsti, na hyanātmanāṃ nāma dharmaḥ kaścidasti, na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ nānyat
nanvanyapadārthaviṣayatvād bahuvrīheḥ nāsti prasādādyātmā varaṇādyātmā vā sa ko'pyanyaḥ syāt saddharmavān
evamapi yathā sthūlaśirā rāhuḥ ityatra asata ākhyā rāhoḥ śirovyatiriktasya
asadākhyayā vyapadeśivadbhāvaṃ kṛtvā vyavahāro dṛṣṭastathedamapi syāt
dharmisvarūpavirodhastāvat— ātmano'nanyadeva duḥkham, prasādādyanātmakatvāt, ātmasvatattvavat, anyathā sukhānyatvaprasādādyanātmakatvānupapatteḥ

nanu bahuvrīheranyapadārthaviṣayatvāt tatsūcanasamāsāntakappratyayāntatvādanātmakaśruteḥ nāsti prasādādyātmā varaṇādyātmā vā citragudevadattavat sa ko'pi varaṇādibhyaḥ prasādādibhyaścānyaḥ sanneva, nāsaddharmavān dharmī pakṣo bhavitumarhatīti
nāsyavaraṇādyātmā prasādādyātmā vā ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt
॰nyaḥ sanneva, nāsan, dharmavān ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt

sthūlaṃ śiro'sya sthūlaśirā rāhuḥ, kapo'tantratvād bahuvrīhereva tantratvāt, tasya cānyapadārthatvavyabhicāraṃ darśayati tadguṇasaṃvijñānapakṣāśrayaṇena, bhavati bahuvrīhau tadguṇasaṃvijñānamapi pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
24 iti vacanāt, na hi sthūlaśirolakṣitastadvyatirikto rāhurasti citragavaviśiṣṭadevadattavat, tadeva hi sthūlaṃ śiro rāhuḥ, tadvadasata ākhyā rāhoḥ śirovyatiriktasya

ākhyā vyapadeśaḥ sthūlena śirasā vyapadeśena citrābhiriva vyapadeśino devadattasya vyatiriktasya, tadvadavyatiriktasyāpi rāhostayākhyayā vyapadeśivadbhāvaṃ kṛtvā vyavahāro dṛṣṭo'sato'pi tathedamapi syāt
tasya vyapadeśivadbhāvavyavahārasyānabhyupagame uktopapattyā dṛṣṭamimasadākhyayā vyapadeśivadbhāvavyavahāramanabhyupagacchataste dharmadharmisvarūpavirodhau doṣau bhavataḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? anyathā sukhānyatvaprasādādyanātmakatvānupapatteḥ, puruṣatvāpattimantareṇa sukhasya duḥkhādanyatvaṃ varaṇādyanātmakatvaṃ puruṣayorapyekataiva
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityanātmaviśeṣaṇatvāt tadvattvadvat, tathā sati yathā kim ? dṛṣṭāntaḥ idaṃ tat iti nidarśayituṃ na śakyate
yacca sukhādananyat tadanātmatve na prasādādyanātmakaṃ na laghvādyanātmakaṃ ceti nidarśayituṃ na śakyate
duḥkhasya vā sukhādanyatvaṃ prasādādyanātmakatvaṃ mohasya tābhyāmanyatvaṃ prasādādiśoṣādyanātmakatvaṃ ca nopapadyate bhāvitanyāyatvāt sukhaduḥkhamohānāmaikyavṛttitvasya

kiñcānyat, yo'pi dharmasvarūpavirodhaḥ so'pītthamucyate, tadyathā --dharmasvarūpavirodho'pi caivameva, yathā puruṣatvāpattau sukhādīnāṃ sukhādyātmaparityāgena dharmisvarūpavirodhaḥ tathā pauṃsnāpattau trayāṇāmaikyāpattau cānyadharmasvarūpavirodhaśca
tataśca prakṛtipuruṣayorapyekataiva, tasmāddhetoḥ puruṣatvāpatterananyatvāpatteśca prakṛtiḥ puruṣādanyā pumān vā prakṛteranya iti nopapadyate
tato'smadabhīṣṭam ekameva kāraṇam ityetad darśanaṃ sādhīyaḥ

evaṃ duḥkhamohayorapi, yathā sukhaṃ duḥkhādanyat ityetat kiṃ tvānmātrāt ? trailakṣaṇyāt ? ityataḥ prabhṛti yāvat prakṛtipuruṣayorapyekataiva ityuktaṃ tathā duḥkhaṃ sukhamohābhyāmanyat, mohaḥ sukhaduḥkhābhyāmanyaḥ ityeteṣvapi caturṣu sukhaṃ mohādanyat iti ca sādhane sa eva grantho yojya iti
tadyathā--śuklavāsasamānaya lohitoṣṇīṣāḥ pracaranti iti tadguṇa ānīyate tadguṇāśca pracaranti
tadyathā--citravāsasamānaya lohitoṣṇīṣā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti iti tadguṇa ānīyate tadguṇāśca pracaranti
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityanātmaviśeṣaṇatvāt tadvattvadvat, tathā sati yathā kim ? dṛṣṭāntaḥ idaṃ tat iti nidarśayituṃ na śakyate
yacca sukhādananyat tadanātmatve na prasādādyanātmakaṃ na laghvādyanātmakaṃ ceti nidarśayituṃ na śakyate
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityanātmaviśeṣaṇatvāt tvadvat

etaddoṣaparihārārthaṃ yathā tvayā anātmatve sati avaraṇādyātmakatvāt sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyad mohavat ityādyabhihitaṃ tathāhamapi anātmatve sati laghutvāt sukhaṃ duḥkhādanyad mohavat ityābravīmīti, ato dharmadharmisvarūpavirodhau prakṛtipuruṣadoṣaśca neti
evaṃ sati yathā kiṃ sukhādanyat ātmānaṃ muktveti
dṛṣṭāntaḥ idaṃ tat iti nidarśayituṃ na śakyate idaṃ tat sukhāt puruṣāccānyad vastviti samanvayasyābhāvaḥ, yadanātmatve sati laghutvādidharma tat sukhāt puruṣāccānyaditi vastvantarābhāvāt
taddarśayannāha --na hi sukhādanyadasti kiñciduktavadapuruṣam ? puruṣavyatiriktaṃ hi sarvaṃ parasparāviviktasukhādisvatattvamevetyuktam

ata eva cānyatvena pakṣīkṛte sukhādau puruṣavyatiriktasapakṣābhāvāt sukhāderapi sukhādanyasya vipakṣatvād vipakṣāddhetorvyāvṛttyarthaṃ yaducyate yacca sukhādananyat tadanātmatve na prasādādyanātmakaṃ na laghvādyanātmakaṃ ceti nidarśayituṃ na śakyate, na ca mohādi sukhādanyanna bhavatītyaśakyaṃ darśayitumiti vipakṣāvyāvṛttirapi
ato vipakṣa eva sattvād viruddhāśca te hetava ityabhiprāyaḥ
atha tu yad vibhaktasvatattvaṃ duḥkhamohābhyāṃ sukhādanyanna bhavati tat prasādādyanātmakamapi na bhavati yathā sukham

tathā sati tathāniyamavat tathāpravartanāt tathāvyakteśca niyamapravṛttiprakāśātmakaṃ sukhameveti aikyaṃ mohādīnāmabhyupagataṃ tvayaiveti ko vādārtha ubhayorapi ? tatraiva tvavaraṇādyātmakatvādivad vidoṣā laghvādihetavo'pi sukhādāvapi ca viparihārapakṣīkṛte'pi ca
evaṃ ca sthite sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyat, laghutvādapravṛttiśīlatvāt prakā-

atha mataṃ tava yad vibhaktasvatattvaṃ duḥkhamohābhyāṃ tat sukhaṃ sukhādanyanna bhavati tat prasādādyanātmakamapi na bhavatīti viviktasvarūpasya sukhasya duḥkhādanyatvāt prasādādyātmakatvācca tadeva śakyate vaidharmyeṇa nidarśayitum
ata eva ca tamaḥ sukhādanyad viviktasvarūpamaprasādātmakamapuruṣaṃ ceti sādharmyadṛṣṭāntaśca syāditi
atrocyate— tathā satītyādi yāvat ko vādārtha ubhayorapi ? iti

evaṃ sati tena prakāreṇa niyamo'yaṃ yat sukhādanyanna bhavati tat prasādādyanātmakamapi na bhavatyeveti etena prakāreṇa niyamavat sukhamevānanyat prasādādyātmakaṃ bhavati ceti tathā tasya vastunaḥ pravartanāt tathāvyakteśca niyamapravṛttiprakāśātmakaṃ sukhameveti tadabhyupagamenaivaikyaṃ mohādīnāmāpannamasmin sādhane, etadabhyupagamavacca śeṣasādhaneṣvapi duḥkhādanyat sukhaṃ mohaśca ityevamādiṣu yad yadanātmatve duḥkhādanyanna bhavati tacchoṣādivaraṇādyanātmakamapi na bhavati ityevaṃ niyamād vyakteḥ pravṛtteścaikyaṃ mohādīnāmabhyupagataṃ tvayaivetītaretaraikatvābhyupagamaḥ
itiśabdo hetvarthe, ityataḥ ko vādārthaḥ vādaprayojanamubhayorāvayoḥ ? tvayaivaikyābhyupagamānna vādārthastava mamāpi pratipannārthapratipādanavaiphalyāditi
evaṃ tāvadavaraṇādyātmakatvādihetavaḥ prathamoktānanyatvapakṣasyaiva sādhakā anātmatvaviśeṣaṇā api nānyatvapakṣasyeti pratipāditāḥ
tatraivānanyatvapakṣa eva tvavaraṇādyātmakatvādivad vidoṣā laghvādihetavo'pi, nānyatvapakṣe, tatra sadoṣā evetyabhiprāyaḥ

nanu laghvādayo'nanyatvahetava uktā eva, kiṃ punaranuśayena ? iti, atrocyate — sukhādāvapi ca na sattvādiṣveva, tatrāpi ca viparihārapakṣīkṛte'pi ca, na yathā tvayā sukhaṃ mohād guroranyat iti parihārapakṣīkṛte caiva
paradharmeṇāpidukhaṃ sukhādananyat laghutvāt ityetenāpi, na kevalam anātmatve calatvādevetītthaṃ viśiṣṭena pratipādanavidhinā ananyatvahetava iti
apiśabdāt svadharmeṇa sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyallaghutvāt ityādibhiḥ sukarapratipādanamevetyarthaḥ
paradharmeṇa tāvat sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyat calāprakāśakatvāt, calamaprakāśakaṃ pravṛttiśīlaṃ duḥkham iti vacanād duḥkhadharmeṇa sukhaṃ tato'nanyaditi sādhyate
avibhaktāśeṣaguṇātmakaloṣṭavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ prāgupavarṇitaḥ, avibhaktāḥ sukhaduḥkhamohātmakasattvarajastamoguṇātmako loṣṭa iti tritvaikyānatikramācca ta evāśeṣaguṇāḥ, tadātmako loṣṭaḥ śakatvāt
paradharmeṇa calatvādaprakāśakatvāt pravṛttiśīlatvāt tatsaṃyogācca, evaṃ mohādapi
eta eva sarva ityanayā diśā abhyūhyāḥ svaparadharmāḥ prasādādayaśca
calāprakāśātmakatvād duḥkhādananya iti sa eva loṣṭo dṛṣṭānto bhāvitasukhādyekātmakatvāt
evaṃ ca sthite'svadharmeṇāpi loṣṭādyarthānāṃ sukhādyekātmakatve sthite'nanyatve laghutvādihetavo'pi sādhakā iti taddarśayati--sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyallaghutvāt loṣṭavaditi vartate
etāni ca catvāri sādhanāni, pratyekaṃ trīṇi tānyeva samuditānyekamiti
evaṃ mohādapīti, mohāt sukhamananyat ityatrāpi ta eva hetavastāvantaḥ
paradharmeṇa sukhasya duḥkhadharmābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ dve samudāyenaikamiti trīṇi--calatvādaprakāśakatvāccalāprakāśakatvāditi
evaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyad gurutvādaprakāśakatvāt tatsaṃyogācceti mohadharmebhyastribhyaḥ
evaṃ mohādapīti tebhya eva mohadharmebhyastribhyo mohādapyananyat sukhamiti

dvābhyāmapyananyat sahitābhyāmiti duḥkhamohābhyāmananyat sukhaṃ laghutvādityādibhyastebhya eva hetubhyohetubhyaḥ, dvitricaturādisaṃyogena tat pratyekaṃ cānugantavyamityata āha --eta eva sarva ityanayā diśābhyūhyāḥ, na kevalameta eva laghutvādayaścalatvādayo gurutvādayo vā svaparadharmā hetavaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? svaparadharmāḥ prasādādayaśca, prasādalāghavādayaḥ śoṣatāpabhedādayo varaṇasadanāpadhvaṃsanādayaśca

evameva caita eva duḥkhamohayorapīti sukhāt parasparataścānanyatvaṃ yojyaṃ pratijñānāṃ ca pratyekaṃ dvitrisaṃyogena ceti sukhasya duḥkhād mohād dvābhyāṃ cānanyatayā tisraḥ, evaṃ duḥkhasya tisraḥ, mohasya tisraḥ, trayāṇāṃ parasparato'nanyatayaikaiveti daśa pratijñāḥ
etāsu sukhadharmā laghvādayaḥ, duḥkhadharmāścalādayaḥ, mohadharmau gurvaprakāśau, pratyekaṃ dvikādisaṃyogena saptatyadhikaṃ śataṃ sādhanānām
lāghavagaurave tvapanīya prasādādiśoṣādivaraṇādīnāṃ ca hetvagraṃ pañcaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi pañca śatāni ca ṣaṭtriṃśāni

kiñcānyat, na kevalameta eva hetavaḥ, anye'pyacetanatvetyādi samāsadaṇḍakamadhye yāvaccharīrādyāpattitvādiprakṛtidharmaiḥ sāmānyabhūtai nanvevaṃ svavacanavirodhādi, na, tavātmana evopālambhāt, pradhāna...
iti sphuṭameva sukhaṃ sadā vyaktaśabdasparśarūparasagandhamevetyabhyupagamyatāṃ tebhya eva laghvādihetubhyo viyadādivat

raviśeṣitaiśca apuruṣatve sati sattvāt prameyatvāt sarvagatatvādakṛtakatvādityādi vā yāvat kiñcidihāsti sarvaṃ tadananyatve trilakṣaṇatāṃ pratipadyate dharmajātamityataḥ kutaḥ saṅkalanā ? na śakyameva saṅkalayituṃ pratyekadvitricaturādisaṃyogadharmānantyāditi svapakṣasādhanahetusaulabhyaṃ darśayati bhāvitatraiguṇyaikātmakaloṣṭādivastunyāyavyāpitvāditi
paradharmeṇa calatvādaprakāśakatvāt pravṛttiśīlatvāt tatsaṃyogācca, evaṃ mohādapi
eta eva sarva ityanayā diśā abhyūhyāḥ svaparadharmāḥ prasādādayaśca

laghutvāt, apravṛttiśīlatvāt, prakāśakatvāt, laghvapravṛttiśīlatvāt, laghvaprakāśakatvāt, apravṛttiprakāśātmakatvāt, laghvapravṛttiprakāśātmakatvāt iti saptānāṃ sukhadharmāṇāṃ calatvāt, aprakāśakatvāt, pravṛttiśīlatvāt, calāprakāśakatvāt, calapravṛttiśīlatvāt, aprakāśakapravṛttiśīlatvāt, calāprakāśakapravṛttiśīlatvāt iti saptānāṃ duḥkhadharmāṇāṃ gurutvāt, aprakāśakatvāt, gurvaprakāśakatvāt iti mohadharmāṇāṃ ca trayāṇāṃ saṅkalanayā saptadaśānāṃ hetūnāṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyat ityādibhirdaśabhiḥ pratijñābhirguṇane saptatyadhikaṃ śataṃ sādhanānāṃ labhyate
sukhānāṃ śabdasparśarasarūpagandhānāṃ prasādalāghavaprasavābhiṣvaṅgoddharṣaprītayaḥ kāryam, duḥkhānāṃ śoṣatāpabhedopaṣṭambhoṃdvegāpadveṣāḥ, mūḍhānāṃ varaṇasadanāpadhvaṃsanabaibhatsyadainyagauravāṇi
iti pūrvaṃ pṛ॰ 12 paṃ॰ 18--20 vyāvarṇitebhyo'ṣṭādaśabhyo dharmebhyo lāghavagauravayorapanayane kṛte'vaśiṣṭānāṃ ṣoḍaśānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ dvikādisaṃyogena ca iyaṃ hetvagrasaṅkhyā bodhyā
nanvevaṃ svavacanavirodhādi, na, tavātmana evopālambhāt, pradhāna...
iti sphuṭameva sukhaṃ sadā vyaktaśabdasparśarūparasagandhamevetyabhyupagamyatāṃ tebhya eva laghvādihetubhyo viyadādivat

itara āha --nanvevaṃ svavacanavirodhādīti, sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyat iti pratyakṣaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ pratipuruṣaṃ svānubhavena pṛthaktvasiddheḥ śarīravikārādibhiranumeyatvācca lokaprasiddherabhyupagatatvācca tvayāpi svavacanena ca sukhaṃ duḥkham iti pṛthaguccāraṇāt svavacanābhyupagamalokaprasiddhipratyakṣānumānavirodhadoṣā ananyatvapratijñāyā iti
etaccāyuktam, tavātmana evopālambhāt, yasmādeva punaḥ svasiddhānta eva svavacanādivirodha unnīyate tvayā ātmana eva, na mama, māmuddiśyātmano'pariparihāreṇa vacanavakratayocyate

pradhānamekaṃ sukhaduḥkhamohātmakatvādabhinnaguṇātmakaṃ sāmyena cāvasthitamiti kasyāyaṃ svavacanavirodhaḥ ? tathā parasparamupakurvanti sattvādayaḥ śabdādibhāvena ca vyavatiṣṭhante pratyekaṃ sukhādyātmaneti sukhāditryātmakatvaṃ na ghaṭādāvekasminneva ceti tvayaivābhyupagatatvādaikyaṃ nānyatvokteśceti kasya svavacanādivirodhadoṣāḥ ? iti svasthena cetasā cintyatām, mama tu tvaddoṣodbhāvanaparaprayāsatvādadoṣaḥ, evamasmaddoṣotkīrtanadvāreṇa svadoṣotkīrtanamevaitad bhavata iti

kiñcānyat, hetuviruddhatoktāvapyevameva, yathoktamete hetavaḥ saprapañcāḥ saviśeṣaṇanirviśeṣaṇāḥ pratijñādoṣodbhāvanadvāreṇa viruddhāvyabhicāryudbhāvanadvāreṇa caite'smatpakṣasyānanyatvasya sādhakā iti tathā hetuviruddhatāpyanyatvapakṣe prāgvyākhyātasamanvayavyāvṛttyabhāvavidhinā ananyatvapakṣa eva darśanāditi
yadabhilaṣyate tvayā pradhānaṃ nāma guṇasāmyāvasthānaṃ kiñcidastīti tannābhilaṣaṇīyam
sukhaṃ sadā vyaktaśabdasparśarūparasagandhamevetyabhyupagamyatāṃ sphuṭameva, kimanyāpadeśena paradoṣābhidhānena vā ? tattvavādinaiva bhavitavyamṛjunā

tebhya eva laghvādibhyo hetubhyo viyadādivat, yathā ākāśavāyyagnyabbhuvaḥ pañca mahābhūtāni vyaktaśabdādibhāvāni tathā sukhamiti laghvādibhya eva hetubhyaḥ pṛthivyāmiva śabdādayaḥ pañcāpi śeṣeṣvapi caturṣu bhūteṣu vyaktā ityabhyupagamyatām
pariṇativiśeṣāttu hiṅgugandhavat sūpe lavaṇarasavaccāpsu kasyacideva pratyakṣatā śabdāderna śeṣasyābhibhavādibhiriti
svamatena tu vyaktaśabdasparśarūparasagandhavatpratijñāyāṃ viyadvarjānyudāharaṇānīti, sparśarasagandhavarṇavantaḥ pudgalāḥ trayaviṣayasamanvaya...
ākāśasyāvagāhopakārasya naite dharmāḥ santīti vādaparameśvaramatam, ato viyadvarjānyudāharaṇāni ityuktam

tasmādeva ca vītāvītānāṃ sukhāditraiguṇyakāraṇapūrvakatvānumānasyānumānābhāsatetyata āha --trayaviṣayasamanvayetyādi yāvad vītānām, vyavahārasamprasiddhetyādi yāvacca hetutvāvadhāraṇārthānāṃ cāvītānāmatathārthatvāditi

teṣāṃ vītāvītānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tadyathā— prāganumānaṃ saprabhedaṃ vyākhyāya teṣāṃ yadetat sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ śeṣavadeṣa heturatīndriyāṇāṃ bhāvānāṃ samadhigame, tasya prayogopacāraviśeṣād dvaividhyam, vītavīta āvīta iti sāmānyena, viśeṣeṇa tu svarūpād vītasiddhiḥ, yadā hetuḥ parapakṣamavyapekṣya svenaiva rūpeṇa kāryasiddhāvapadiśyate tadā vītākhyo bhavati

pariśeṣādāvītasiddhiḥ, yadā nedamato'nyathā sambhavati asti cedam tasmāt pariśeṣato heturevāyam ityavadhārya kāryasiddhāvapadiśyate tadā āvītākhyo bhavatīti prayogalakṣaṇam, svalakṣaṇaṃ tvasya parapakṣapratiṣedhena svapakṣaparigrahakriyā āvīta iti
vītasya āvītasya vā bhāvaḥvākyabhāvaḥ pañcapradeśaḥ--pratijñā hetuḥ dṛṣṭānta upasaṃhāro nigamanamiti
tatra sādhyāvadhāraṇaṃ pratijñā, sādhanasamāsavacanaṃ hetuḥ, tannidarśanaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, sādhyadṛṣṭāntayorekakriyopasaṃhāraḥ, pratijñābhyāso nigamanamiti
purastād vītasya prayogaṃ nyāyyaṃ manyante paścādāvītasyeti
tayorlakṣaṇamāmananti— yadā hetuḥ svarūpeṇa sādhyasiddhau prayujyate
tatra yadā hetuḥ parapakṣamanapekṣya yathārthena svarūpeṇa sādhyasiddhāvapadiśyate tadā vītākhyo bhavati
yadā tu svasādhyādarthāntarabhūtānāṃ prāsaṅgikāṇāṃ kṣepamapohaṃ kṛtvā pariśeṣataḥ sādhyasiddhāvapadiśyate tadā'vītākhyo bhavati
tadyathā--na cet paramāṇupuruṣeśvarakarmadaivakālasvabhāvayadṛcchābhyo jagadutpattiḥ sambhavati pariśeṣataḥ pradhānāditi tadā punaravītākhyo bhavati
sādhyate'neneti sādhanaṃ liṅgam, samāsaḥ saṃkṣepaḥ, sādhanasya samāsavacanaṃ sādhanasamāsavacanam
sādhanagrahaṇaṃ tadābhāsapratiṣedhārtham, na hi tāni sādhanaṃ saṃśayaviparyayahetutvāt
yastu tasya sādhyasahabhāvitvalakṣaṇaḥ prapañcaḥ so'vayavāntarāṇītyuktaṃ bhavati
udāharaṇaṃ tvatra nitanni ?darśanaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, tasya sādhanasya sādhyena sahabhāvitvanidarśanaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, tadyathā— saṃhatyakāriṇāṃ parārthatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā śayanāsanarathacaraṇānām
...sādhyadṛṣṭāntayorekakriyā upasaṃhāraḥ upanayaḥ, sādhyasya cakṣurādipārārthyalakṣaṇasya dṛṣṭāntasya ca śayanāderekakriyā upasaṃhāraḥ
tatrārthāntarabhūtatvāt sādhyadṛṣṭāntayorañjasā naikakriyā upapadyate, tenaiva tasyānidarśanādityato dharmasāmānyād yathedaṃ tathedamityekakriyā upacaryate
yathā śayanādayaḥ saṃhatatvāt parārthā evaṃ cakṣurādibhirapi parārthairbhavitavyam
vītaḥ, tasya purastāt prayogaṃ nyāyyamācāryā manyante
kiṃ kāraṇam ? avītalakṣaṇāvirodhāt, avītasya hi lakṣaṇaṃ pariśeṣataḥ sādhyānugrahaḥ
tatrānvayādinā svarūpeṇānadhigate pradhānalakṣaṇe dharmiṇi parapakṣapratiṣedhamātreṇa upasaṃhāre kriyamāṇe pariśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ bādhyate

kasmāt ? iha pratiṣedhamātramādāvucyate, tena yathā hetuvirodhāt paramāṇvādibhyo na vyaktamutpadyate tathā hetvabhāvāt pradhānādapi notpadyate iti śakyaṃ kalpayitum, atastadvyavacchedo'pi cāvītād gamyate, tathā sati kaḥ pariśeṣaḥ syāt ? svarūpeṇa tu paricchinne dharmiṇi upasaṃhāro yathāvadavakalpate--na cet paramāṇvādibhya utpadyate pariśeṣataḥ pradhānādeva vyaktamutpadyate
iti siddhaṃ sāmānyato dṛṣṭādanumānādatīndriyāṇāmarthānāṃ samadhigama iti

yadyapi prāyaḥ sarvatra sāṅkhyādidarśanagrantheṣu avītaśabdasyaiva prayogo dṛśyate nayacakravṛttau tu sarvatrāpi āvītaśabdaprayoga evopalabhyate tathāpi āvītaśabdaprayogaḥ śuddha eva pratīyate kumārilabhaṭṭaviracite mīmāṃsāślokavārtike'pi āvītaśabdasyaiva prayogāt, tadyathā--tato'pyāvītahetubhiranaikāntika iti akṣaracatuṣṭayādhikenārdhaślokenāha --pakṣīkuryād yadā sarvāṃstadāpyāvītahetubhiḥ

ye hi vipakṣavyatirekeṇaivārthaṃ pratipādayanti te'trāvītahetavo'bhidhīyante, yathā prāṇādayo nirātmakebhyo ghaṭādibhyo nivṛttā jīvaccharīre dṛśyamānāstadvyavacchedenaiva sātmakatvamavagamayantītyarthaḥ
iti mīmāṃsāślokavārtikasya jayamiśrabhaṭṭaviracitāyāṃ śarkarikāvṛttau apohavāde, kā॰ 166
prayogaśca--asti pradhānaṃ bhedānāmanvayadarśanāt, ādhyātmikānāṃ bhedānāṃ kāryakāraṇātmakānāmekajātisamanvayo dṛṣṭa iti candanaśakalādidṛṣṭāntaṃ vakṣyati
sāmānyapūrvakāṇāṃ ca bhedānāmityādi ekajātisamanvayapradarśanārthasukhāditriguṇaikajātisamanvayaṃ kāryātmakānāṃ tatsanniveśaviśeṣatvaṃ pakṣīkṛtya ekakāryatvāt iti hetumāha tathottaratropasaṃhārāt
tairārabdhānyākāśādīni bhūtāni ekottaraguṇavṛddhyā tatkāryatvāt tatsamanvayācca tatpūrvakāṇi
ādhyātmikānāṃ bhedānāṃ kāryakāraṇātmakānāṃ caikajātisamanvayo dṛṣṭa ityevamādiḥ sādhanaprapañcaḥ
iti sāṅkhyakārikāyā yuktidīpikāvṛttau, kā॰ 6, pṛ॰ 49 paṃ॰ 11
iha yena bhedānāṃ samanugatistasya sattvaṃ dṛṣṭam
...iha śabdasparśarūparasagandhānāṃ sannidhāne svasaṃskāraviśeṣayogāt sukhaduḥkhamohākārāḥ prāṇināṃ buddhaya utpadyante
teṣāṃ dharmārmo' ?nvayaḥ, tasmāt samanvayadarśanāt paśyāmo'sti pradhānam
je॰ sāṅkhyakā॰ vṛ॰ B, kā॰ 15, māṭharavṛttāvapi kiñcitpāṭhabhedena evameva
sāmānyatastrayaḥ sukhaduḥkhamohāḥ, kāryakaraṇaviśeṣataḥ ṣoḍaśa bhāvāḥ pañca bhūtāni ekādaśendriyāṇi cetyādi rūpaparimāṇam
pravṛttiparimāṇaṃ dvidhā hitāhitaprāptiparihārārthatvāt, dharmādiprayojanatvāccaturdhā, dhṛtisadācāra-kāmasukha-kutūhala-vinivṛttiprayojanaṃ pañcadhā prāṇādilakṣaṇācceti pravṛttiparimāṇam
adṛṣṭaṃ kāryakaraṇasāmarthyaṃ prabhuśaktiḥ sādhanasānnidhyaṃ vibhuśaktiśceti dvidhā
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ jarāyvaṇḍaṃ ca, tat ṣaṭkośikam, pṛthivyā udbhijjam, pṛthivyudakasaṃśokāt saṃśokajamityadṛṣṭaphalaparimāṇam
dṛṣṭaphalaparimāṇaṃ karaṇāni pravartamānāni kriyānte sāmānyataścaturṇāṃ śaktyādīnāmanyatamaṃ pratyayaṃ kurvanti

siddhirūhena sādhanaṃ tārakam, śabdena sutāram, adhyayanena tārayantam, vātādīnyādhyātmikānyabhyatītya kriyayā tāraka-sutāra-tārayantānāmanyatamena pramodam, mānuṣādyādhibhautikātyayena tattrayānyatamenaiva pramuditam, śītādyādhidaivikātyayena tattrayānyatamenaiva modamānam, yadā kuśalasaṃsṛṣṭavyapāśrayāt sandehātikramāt tadanyatamena ramyakam, daurbhāgyātikrameṇa sadāpramuditamityaṣṭau siddhayaḥ
bāhyāśca viṣayanirvedajāḥ pañca viṣayeṣvarjanarakṣaṇakṣayasaṅgahiṃsādoṣadarśanāt sutārasupārasunetrasumārīcottamābhayākhyā iti nava tuṣṭayaḥ
tathā tuṣṭiviparītanāmāno' nāmbhasikyādayo nava atuṣṭaya ityaśaktiraṣṭāviṃśatividhā
itthaṃ rūpa-pravṛttiphalaparimāṇamādhyātmikānāṃ kāryakāraṇātmakānāṃ bhedānāṃ nirdiṣṭam, anena tairyagyonamānuṣadaiveṣvapi saprapañceṣu jñeyam

tasmāt parimitatvāt saṃsargapūrvakā bhedāḥ, vrīhāviva saṃsṛṣṭā mūlāṅkuraparṇanālakāṇḍaprasavatuṣaśūkapuṣpakṣīrataṇḍulakaṇabhāvāḥ yathā vā śukraśoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭāḥ kalalārbudamāṃsapeśiśarīravyūhabālyakaumārayauvanasthāvirā bhāvā iti
rūpaṃ punarmahānahaṅkāraḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi ekādaśendriyāṇi pañca mahābhūtāni
viśeṣataḥ pañca karmayonayo dhṛtyādyāḥ prāṇādyāśca pañca vāyavaḥ
adṛṣṭaṃ brahmādau stambaparyante saṃsāre karmapratilambha ityetad vyaktam
sāṅkhyagrantheṣu prāṇādivṛtterhetornirūpaṇaprasaṅge dhṛtyādīnāṃ kiñcinnāmabhedena itthaṃ nirūpaṇamupalabhyate--prāṇādyā vāyavaḥ pañca
...kutaḥ punariyaṃ prāṇādivṛttiḥ pravartata iti ? ucyate--sā karmayonibhyaḥ
mahataḥ pracyutaṃ hi rajo vikṛtamaṇḍasthānīyāḥ pañca karmayonayo bhavanti--dhṛtiḥ śraddhā sukhā vividiṣā avividiṣeti
āha ca--vāci karmaṇi saṅkalpe pratijñāṃ yo nanu ? rakṣati
dānaṃ pratigrahaḥ śaucaṃ śraddhāyā lakṣaṇaṃ smṛtam
sukhārthī yastu seveta vidyāṃ karma tapāṃsi vā
