prāyaścittaparo nityaṃ sukhāyāṃ sa tu vartate
viṣayasatattvaṃ punaḥ sarvaviṣayiṇī dhṛtiḥ, āśramaviṣayiṇī śraddhā, dṛṣṭānuśravikaviṣayiṇī sukhā, vyaktaviṣayiṇī vividiṣā, avyaktaviṣayiṇī avividiṣā
guṇasamanvayastu rajastamobahulā dhṛtiḥ, sattvarajobahulā śraddhā, sattvatamobahulā sukhā, rajobahulā vividiṣā, tamobahulā avividiṣeti
sūkṣmā mātāpitṛjāḥ saha prabhūtaistridhā viśeṣāḥ syuḥ
tatra sūkṣmā nāma ceṣṭāśritaṃ prāṇāṣṭakaṃ saṃsarati
tatraiva aśitapītābhyāṃ saha aṣṭau kośānapare vyācakṣate
yathā kośakāraḥ kośenāveṣṭito'svatantraḥ evaṃ sūkṣmaśarīraṃ saprāṇametairāveṣṭitamasvatantraṃ tat tat karmopacinoti
pratyayasarga iti, pratyayaḥ padārtho lakṣaṇamiti paryāyāḥ
pratyayānāṃ sargaḥ pratyayasargaḥ padārthasargo lakṣaṇasarga ityarthaḥ
athavā pratyayo buddhiḥ niścayo'dhyavasāya iti paryāyāḥ, tasya sargo'yamataḥ pratyayasargaḥ pratyayakāryaṃ pratyayavyāpāra ityarthaḥ
athavā pratyayapūrvakaḥ sargaḥ pratyayasargaḥ buddhipūrvaka ityuktaḥ
ucyate --ūhaḥ śabdo'dhyayanaṃ duḥkhavighātāstrayaḥ suhṛtprāptiḥ dānaṃ ca siddhayo'ṣṭau
tatroho nāma yadā pratyakṣānumānāgamavyatirekeṇābhipretamarthaṃ vicāraṇābalenaiva pratipadyate, sā ādyā siddhiḥ tārakamityapadiśyate--tārayati saṃsārārṇavāditi tārakam
yadā tu svayaṃ pratipattau pratihanyamāno gurūpadeśāt pratipadyate sā dvitīyā siddhiḥ sutāramityapadiśyate
yadā tvanyopadeśādapyasamarthaḥ pratipattumadhyayanena sādhayati sā tṛtīyā siddhiḥ tārayantamityapadiśyate
tadetat tāraṇakriyāyā āśrayatve'pi avyāvṛttatvād mahāviṣayatvāt tārayantamityapadiśyate
ta ete trayaḥ sādhanopāyairābrahmaṇaḥ prāṇino'bhipretamarthaṃ prāpnuvanti
tatra cādhyātmikānāṃ vātādīnāṃ siddhipratyanīkānāmāyurvedakriyānuṣṭhānena vighātaṃ kṛtvā pūrveṣāṃ trayāṇāmanyatamena sādhayati sā caturthī siddhiḥ pramodamityabhidhīyate
katham ? nivṛttarogā hi prāṇinaḥ pramodanta iti kṛtvā
yadā tvādhibhautikānāṃ mānuṣādinimittānāṃ siddhipratyanīkānāṃ sāmādinā yatidharmānuguṇena vopāyena pūrveṣāṃ trayāṇāmanyatamena sādhayati sā pañcamī siddhiḥ pramuditamityabhidhīyate
katham ? anudvigno hi pramudita iti kṛtvā
yadā tu śītādīni ādhidaivikāni dvandvāni siddhipratyanīkāni svadharmānurodhena pratihatya pūrveṣāṃ trayāṇāmanyatamena sādhayati sā ṣaṣṭhī siddhirmodamānamityabhidhīyate
katham ? dvandvānupahatā hi prāṇino modanta iti kṛtvā
suhṛtprāptiḥ, yadā tu kuśalaṃ saṃspṛṣṭaṃ sanmitramāśritya sandehanivṛttiṃ labhate sā ramyakamiti saptamī siddhirapadiśyate
ramyo hi loke sanmitrasamparkaḥ, tasya saṃjñāyāṃ ramyameva ramyakam
dānam--yadā tu daurbhāgyaṃ dānena atītya pūrveṣāṃ trayāṇāmanyatamena sādhayati sā aṣṭamī siddhiḥ sadāpramuditamityabhidhīyate
subhago hi sadā pramudito bhavati, tasmād daurbhāgyanivṛttiḥ sadāpramuditam
etāsāṃ saṃśrayeṇābhipretamarthaṃ yataḥ saṃsādhayantītyataḥ pūrvācāryāgataṃ mārgamārurukṣustatpravaṇaḥ syāditi
tuṣṭistu sannihitaviṣayasantoṣāccikīrṣitādarthādūnena nivṛttiḥ sāmānyata ekaiva, pratyarthamanantā--śatena tuṣṭaḥ sahasreṇeti
śāstre tu bāhyādhyātmikānāṃ sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ prāptiṣvapagameṣu vā vyavasthālakṣaṇā upāyanavatvāt nava tuṣṭayo bhavanti
ādhyātmikā iti śarīraśarīriṇorviśeṣamupalipsamānena yoginā yadānātmani ātmabuddhiravasthāpyate sā khalu ādhyātmikā siddhiḥ tuṣṭiḥ santoṣaḥ kṣema ityarthaḥ
adhyātmānaṃ jñāpayanti ityādhyātmikāḥ, prakṛtyākhyā upādānākhyā kālākhyā bhāgyākhyā ceti catasrastuṣṭaya ādhyātmikāḥ
yathā kaścit prakṛtimātraṃ vetti, na jānīte nityā vā anityā vā cetanā vā acetanā vā saguṇā vā aguṇā vā sarvagatā vā asarvagatā veti
etān dharmānna vetti, kevalamastitvamātreṇa tuṣṭaḥ pravrajitaḥ, tasya nāsti mokṣa eṣā prakṛtyākhyā tuṣṭiḥ

upādānākhyā yathā kaścit tridaṇḍakuṇḍakamaṇḍalukṛṣṇājinākṣasūtrādīnāmupādānaṃ kṛtvā prabravīti mama mokṣo bhaviṣyatīti, evaṃ tuṣṭo jñānāgamaṃ na karoti tasya nāsti mokṣa ityeṣā upādānākhyā dvitīyā tuṣṭiḥ
kālākhyā yathā--kaścidanabhigatatattvajño bravīti kālena mokṣo bhaviṣyatīti jñānāgamaṃ na karoti, kiṃ jñānena ? iti, evaṃ santuṣṭasya nāsti mokṣa ityeṣā kālākhyā tṛtīyā tuṣṭiḥ
bhāgyākhyā yathā--kaścidanabhigatatattvajño bravīti bhāgyena mokṣo bhaviṣyatīti jñānāgamaṃ na karoti, kiṃ jñānena ? iti santuṣṭasya mokṣo nāstīti eṣā bhāgyākhyā caturthī tuṣṭiḥ
kasmāt ? amitaṃ hi pradhānatattvaṃ bhāti jagadvījabhūtatvāt
kathaṃ punaretat salilam ? sati upādāne vikāro līyata iti
kathaṃ punarayaṃ kāla ogha ityucyate ? salilaughavat sarvābhyāvahanāt
yathā hi śīrṇānāmapi tṛṇalatādīnāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ prāpya punarāpyāyanaṃ bhavati evameva sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhāgyavipariṇāmāt punarāpyāyanaṃ bhavati

tatrārjanaṃ nāma śabdasparśarūparasagandhān viṣayān nimittaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣipaśupālanavāṇijyādiṣu pravartate, tatra viṣayopārjane kleśaprayāsādi duḥkhaṃ matvā viṣayebhya uparamati, uparataśca tuṣṭiṃ labhate, eṣā pañcamī tuṣṭiḥ
rakṣaṇaduḥkhaṃ yathā arjitānāṃ dhanadhānyānāṃ rājacaurādibhyo yad rakṣaṇaṃ tadapi duḥkhaṃ kartumityuparataśca tuṣṭiṃ labhate, eṣā ṣaṣṭhī tuṣṭiḥ
kṣayaduḥkhaṃ yathā arjitānāṃ rakṣaṇe kṛte'pyupabhujyamānāḥ kṣīyanta iti matvā uparataśca tuṣṭiṃ labhata ityeṣā saptamī tuṣṭiḥ
yathārjitarakṣaṇakṣayādīnāṃ pratīkāre'pi kṛte indriyāṇāṃ vaitṛṣṇyaṃ nāstīti sañcintya viṣayebhyo viramati uparataśca tuṣṭiṃ labhate, eṣā aṣṭamī tuṣṭiḥ
arjanarakṣaṇakṣayātṛptīnāṃ pratīkāre'pi kṛte arjanādivṛttena hiṃsāmantareṇa bhūtoparodhaṃ vinā na śakyante viṣayā upārjayitumato viṣayebhya uparataśca tuṣṭiṃ labhate, eṣā navamī tuṣṭiḥ
evametābhistuṣṭibhirajñānād mokṣo nāstīti kevalena vairāgyeṇa tuṣṭiḥ
evametā ādhyātmikāścatasro bāhyāḥ pañca nava tuṣṭayo vyākhyātāḥ
āsāṃ tuṣṭīnāṃ navānāmiha saṃjñā bhavanti--ambhaḥ salilam ogho vṛṣṭiḥ sutāraṃ supāraṃ sunetraṃ marīcikam uttamāmbhasikamiti
sukhārthaṃ ca pravṛttasya bhūyiṣṭhaṃ duḥkhamevetyetasmād darśanād mādhyasthyaṃ labhate sā pañcamī tuṣṭiḥ sutāramityabhidhīyate
kathaṃ punaḥ sutāramityucyate ? sukhamanena upāyena taranti viṣayasaṅkaṭamiti sutāram
kathaṃ punaḥ supāramityucyate ? sukhamanena pāraṃ viṣayārṇavasya prayāntīti
kathaṃ punaḥ sunetramityucyate ? sukhamanena ātmānaṃ kaivalyāvasthāṃ nayantīti sunetram
kathaṃ sumārīcamityucyate ? arcateḥ pūjārthasya śobhanamarcitaṃ viṣayasaṅganivṛttasya yogino'vasthānaṃ bhavati
katham ? uttamaṃ hi prāṇināṃ sarvebhyo bhayebhyo hiṃsābhayamiti tadapagamāt uttamābhayamiti
iha loke kaścid devadatto vairāgyeṇa gṛhīto yajñadattamāhūya prabravīti bho yajñadatta duḥkhito'smi, kiṃ karavāṇi ? iti
sa tenoktaḥ --sāṅkhyajñānasyādhigamaṃ kuru, tvaṃ duḥkhāntaṃ yāsyasīti

evaṃ yajñadattenokto devadatto'bravīt--nāhaṃ śaknomi sāṅkhyajñānasyādhigamaṃ kartuṃ yasmād badhiro'smi gurorvacanaṃ na śṛṇomi, śuśrūṣāyāmasamarthaḥ kuto jñānasyādhigamaṃ kariṣyāmīti ? evamevāndhyamūkatvonmādādayaḥ indriyopaghātā viṣayāya ?grahaṇe asamarthā bodhyāḥ
atrāha--ke te buddhivadhāḥ kiyantaśceti ? saptadaśa vadhā buddheviparyayāt tuṣṭisiddhīnām
te ca saptadaśa vadhāḥ tuṣṭisiddhiṣu vyākhyāyamānāsu vyākhyāsyante

tatra bādhiryaṃ śrotrasya, āndhyaṃ cakṣuṣaḥ, aghratvaṃ nāsikāyāḥ, mūkatā vācaḥ, jaḍatā rasanasya, unmādo manasaḥ, kauṣṭhyaṃ tvacaḥ, kauṇyaṃ pāṇeḥ, klaibyamupasthasya, udāvartaḥ pāyoḥ, paṅgutā pādayoḥ, ityevamindriyavadhā ekādaśa
tatra bāhyakaraṇavaikalyaṃ saha manasā ekādaśaprakāram, saptadaśavidhaṃ buddhivaikalyam, ete'śaktibhedāḥ
tatra aśreyasi pravṛttasya pratyayāvare śreyobhimāna ādyo viparyayastama ityabhidhīyate bhautikeṣu ākāreṣu śiraḥpāṇyādiṣu ātmagraho yo'yaṃ vyūḍhoraskaḥ sitadaśanastāmrākṣaḥ pralambabāhuḥ so'hamiti
tathā śravaṇasparśanarasanaghrāṇavacanādānaviharaṇotsargānandasaṅkalpābhimānādhyavasāyalakṣaṇāsu karaṇavṛttiṣu ahaṃ śrotā draṣṭā cetyevamādirādyakālapravṛtto grahaḥ pūrvasmādavaro moha ityucyate
...bāhye tu viṣaye mamedamityabhiniveśaḥ pūrvasmādavaraḥ mahāmohaḥ ityucyate
saṃsargapūrvakatve hi saṃsargasya ekasminnadvaye'sambhavāt nānātvaikārthasamavetasya nānākāraṇāni kalpanīyāni

tathā parimitānāṃ bhedānāṃ mūlāṅkurādīnāṃ saṃsargapūrvakatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāhyādhyātmikānāṃ bhedānāṃ parimitatvāt saṃsargapūrvakatvamanumimānasya sattvarajastamasāmapi saṃsargapūrvakatvaprasaṅgaḥ, anumitatvāviśeṣāt

yadā sūkṣmaśarīramutpattikāle māturudaraṃ praviśati mātuḥ rudhiraṃ pituḥ śukraṃ tasya sūkṣmaśarīrasya upacayaṃ kurute, mātuḥ kalalārbudaghanamāṃsapeśīgarbhakaumārayauvanasthāvirādayo'nnapānarasanimittā niṣpādyante, tena ucyate--kāryāśrayiṇaśca kalalādyā iti
śabdādyātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānāni sattvarajastamāṃsi prakāśapravṛttiniyamaiḥ parasparārthaṃ kurvanti
sattvaṃ śabdādyātmanāśabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānaṃ tadbhāvāyetarayoḥ pravṛttiṃ khyāpayati, evaṃ rajaḥ pravartayati, tamo niyamayati
śabdādyārabdhāni pṛthivyādīni ārambhotkrameṇa dhṛtisaṅgrahapaktivyūhāvakāśadānaiḥ parasparārthaṃ kurvanti
yacca yasya viṣayaṃ prakhyāpayati arjayati pāti saṃskaroti upadhatte vā tat kāraṇamitarat kāryam
sthānasādhanātmaprakhyātyupabhogaiḥ karaṇārthaṃ karoti kāryam, karaṇaṃ vṛddhikṣatabhagnasaṃrohaṇasaṃśokaparipālanaiḥ kāryārthaṃ karoti
evaṃ bāhyādhyātmikānāṃ daivamānuṣatairyagyonānāṃ saprapañcānāmanyonyopakāraḥ rakṣā-saṅgraha-sevana-pūjana-poṣaṇasthiti-śuśrūṣādivikalpā varṇāśramādīnāṃ yojyāḥ
pṛ॰ 260268 ṭi॰ 1 madhye varṇitaṃ sṛṣṭyārambhakramaṃ parityajya atra tu pṛthivyā ādau upādānāt ārambhotkrameṇa iti pāṭhaḥ saṅgataḥ pratīyate
atra asvārasye tu ārambhāt krameṇa iti pāṭhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ, krameṇa dhṛtisaṅgrahapaktivyūhāvakāśadānaiḥ iti ca yojyam
sahabhāve tu teṣāmupakāro na pratiṣidhyate, tadyathā pṛthivyādīnāṃ dhṛtisaṅgrahapaktivyūhāvakāśadānaiḥ
pañca mahābhūtāni kṛtāni--ākāśamavakāśane, bhūmirviharaṇe, āpaḥ piṇḍīkaraṇe śuddhau ca, agnirāhārapacane, vāyurvyūhane
ucyate--guṇānāṃ tāvat sattvarajastamasāṃ prakāśapravṛttiniyamalakṣaṇairdharmairitaretaropakāreṇa yathā pravṛttirbhavati tathā prītyaprītiviṣādātmakāḥ sāṅkhyakā॰ 12 ityetasmin sūtre vyākhyātam
pṛthivyādīnāṃ dhṛtisaṅgrahapaktivyūhāvakāśadānairgavādibhāvo devamānuṣatiraścāṃ yathartuvidhānejyāpoṣaṇābhyavahāraṃ saṃvyahārasaṃvyavahāretaretarādhyayanaṃ varṇānāṃ svadharmapravṛttiviṣayabhāvaḥ

manuṣyaśarīraṃ hi paśupakṣimṛgasarīsṛpasthāvaropayogena dhriyate, evaṃ vyāghrādiśarīramapi manuṣyapaśumṛgādiśarīropayogena, evaṃ paśupakṣimṛgādiśarīramapi sthāvarādyupayogena, evaṃ daivaśarīramapi manuṣyopahṛtacchāgamṛgakapiñjalamāṃsājyapuroḍāśasahakāraśākhāprastarādibhirijyamānaṃ tadupayogena, evaṃ devatāpi varadānavṛṣṭyādibhirmanuṣyādīni dhārayatītyasti parasparārthatvamityarthaḥ
brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ varṇānāṃ brahmacāri-gṛhastha-vānaprastha-yatīnāmāśramiṇāṃ ca kāryāṇi varṇitāni vaiśeṣikadarśanapraśastapādabhāṣye draṣṭavyāni dharmanirūpaṇe
tadyathā--prāk pravṛtteḥ śaktyavasthānamanumīyate pravṛttyupalabdheḥ, pravṛttikāle'vasthānamapavargadarśanāt, pravṛttyuttarakālāvasthānaṃ pravṛttivyatirekeṇāvasthānadarśanāt
evamādyantavad vyaktamupalabhya vyaktaśaktyavasthāsti, anavasthitaśakterādyavasānābhāvāt khapuṣpavat, avasthitaśaktereva tadbhāvād mṛdaḥ piṇḍādibhāvavat
iha yāvatī kācilloke pravṛttirupalabhyate sā sarvā śaktitaḥ
tadyathā— kumbhakārasya daṇḍādisādhanavinyāsalakṣaṇāyāśca śakteḥ sannidhānād ghaṭakaraṇe pravṛttiḥ, asti vyaktasya ceyaṃ kāryatvāt tadbhāvena pravṛttiriti
yat punaretaduktaṃ tāvadeva pradhvaṃsa iti, atra brūmaḥ--na, kāryaniṣṭhādarśanāt
yadi pravṛttisamakālameva pradhvaṃsaḥ syāt kāryaniṣṭhaiva na syāt, tannimittatvāt kāryasya
jalabhūmyoḥ pāriṇāmikaṃ rasādivaiśvarūpyaṃ sthāvareṣu dṛṣṭam, tathā sthāvarāṇāṃ jaṅgameṣu, jaṅgamānāṃ sthāvareṣu, sthāvarāṇāṃ sthāvareṣu, jaṅgamānāṃ jaṅgameṣu

jātyanucchedena sarvaṃ sarvātmakam, deśakālākāranimittāvabandhāt tu na samānakālamātmābhivyaktiḥ, te manyāmahe jalabhūmyorapyetat pāriṇāmikaṃ rasādivaiśvarūpyam, anyeṣāṃ ca bhūtānāmanyapariṇāma iti, evaṃ tadapyanyasyetyavaśyaṃbhāvī avibhāgaḥ
yatra cāvibhāgastat pradhānam, vaiśvarūpyasyāvibhāgakāraṇapūrvakatvāt, mayūrabarhavaicitryasyeva tadaṇḍakarasapūrvakatvam
tasmādasti pradhānamiti ebhiḥ pañcabhirvītaiḥ samanvayaparimāṇopakāraśaktipravṛttivaiśvarūpyagatyākhyaiḥ sāmānyasaṃsargaikakartṛśaktimacchaktyavibhāgasaṃjñaṃ pradhānaṃ siddham
ata evaikatvamarthavattvam, parārthatvaṃ saṃhatya kāriṇāṃ pārārthyācchayanādivat
pradhānasya ādyantapuruṣārthopalabdhyanantaraṃ nivṛttiḥ vrīhyudakagatyā raṅganartakīvadveti pradhānapuruṣasaṃyogavibhāgāvittham
iha yad viśvarūpaṃ tasyāvibhāgo dṛṣṭaḥ, tadyathā--salilādīnāṃ jalabhūmī, viśvarūpāśca mahadādayaḥ, tasmādeṣāmapyavibhāgena bhavitavyam
āha--kiṃ punastad vaiśvarūpyaṃ ko vā viśvarūpa iti ? ucyate--vaiśvarūpyamiti viśiṣṭamavasthānamācakṣmahe astamitaviśeṣatvamavibhāga iti
viśeṣasya sāmānyapūrvakatvāditi yo'rthastaduktaṃ bhavati avibhāgād vaiśvarūpyasyeti
yathā jalabhūmyorapyetad rasādivaiśvarūpyaṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ jaṅgameṣu jaṅgamānāṃ sthāvareṣviti
tena manyāmahe--asti pradhānaṃ yatra mahadādi liṅgamavibhāgaṃ gacchati, ityevamavaśyambhāvī avibhāgaḥ
iti je॰ sāṅkhyakā॰ vṛttau B, kiñcicchabdabhedena māṭharavṛttau ca, kā॰ 15
yatrotho ?ktam--jalabhūmyoḥ pāriṇāmikaṃ rasādivaiśvarūpyaṃ sthāvareṣu dṛṣṭam, tathā sthāvarāṇāṃ jaṅgameṣu jaṅgamānāṃ sthāvareṣu iti
jalasya hi rasarūpasparśaśabdavataḥ bhūmeśca gandharasarūpasparśaśabdavatyāḥ pāriṇāmikaṃ vanaspatilatāgulmādiṣu mūlaphalaprasavapallavādigatarasādivaiśvarūpyaṃ dṛṣṭam
so'yamanevamātmikāyā bhūmeranīdṛśasya vā jalasya na pariṇāmo bhavitumarhati, upapāditaṃ hi nāsadutpadyate iti
tathā sthāvarāṇāṃ jaṅgameṣu manuṣyapaśumṛgādiṣu rasādivaicitryaṃ dṛṣṭam
evaṃ jaṅgamānāṃ pāriṇāmikaṃ sthāvareṣu dṛṣṭam, rudhirāvasekāt kila dāḍimīphalāni tālaphalamātrāṇi bhavanti

nanu sarvaṃ cet sarvātmakaṃ hanta bhoḥ sarvasya sarvadā sarvatra sarvathā sannidhānāt samānakālīnā bhāvānāṃ vyaktiḥ prasajyeta, na khalu sannihitāvikalakāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vilambitumarhatītyata āha--deśakāleti

yadyapi kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ tathāpi yo yasya kāryasya deśaḥ yathā kuṅkumasya kaśmīraḥ teṣāṃ sattve'pi pañcālādiṣu na samudācāra iti na kuṅkumasya pañcālādiṣu abhivyaktiḥ, evaṃ nidāghe na prāvṛṣaḥ samudācāra iti na tadā śālīnām, evaṃ na mṛgī manuṣyaṃ prasūte, na tasyāṃ manuṣyākārasamudācāraḥ iti
evaṃ nāpuṇyavān sukharūpaṃ bhuṅkte, na tasmin puṇyanimittasya samudācāra iti
iti pātañjalayogadarśanasya vyāsapraṇītabhāṣyopari vācaspatimiśraviracitāyāṃ tattvavaiśāradyāṃ vṛttau 3
te ityavyayaṃ tataḥ ityarthe vartata iti bhāti, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 11 paṃ॰ 27
te ityavyayasya tataḥ ityarthe dṛśyate bahuśaḥ prayogaḥ pātañjalamahābhāṣye'pi, tadyathā--abrahmadattaṃ brahmadatta ityāha
yathākramaṃ samanvayāt sāmānyaṃ parimāṇāt saṃsargaḥ upakārāt ekakartā śaktipravṛtteḥ śaktimacchaktiḥ vaiśvarūpyagatyā ca avibhāgaḥ sidhyati
daśa mūlikārthāḥ, tathāhi-- astitvamekatvamathārthavattvaṃ pārārthyamanyatvamatho nivṛttiḥ
yogo viyogo bahavaḥ pumāṃsaḥ sthitiḥ śarīrasya ca śeṣavṛttiḥ
tatra bhedānāṃ parimāṇāt kā॰ 15 ityebhiḥ pañcabhirvītairhetubhiḥ pradhānasyāstitvamekatvamathārthavattvaṃ ca siddham
tadviparītastathā ca pumān kā॰ 11 iti pradhānapuruṣayoranyatvaṃ siddham
raṅgasya darśayitvā kā॰ 59 iti nivṛttiḥ siddhā
puruṣasya darśanārtham kā॰ 21 iti saṃyogaḥ siddhaḥ
prāpte śarīrabhede kā॰ 68 iti viyogaḥ siddhaḥ
je॰ sāṅkhyakā॰ vṛ॰ B, tathā māṭharavṛttau kā॰ 72
pārārthyaṃ ca tathā'naikyaṃ viyogo yoga eva ca
tasmācca viparyāsāt kā॰ 19 iti puruṣasyākartṛtvamityete daśa mūlikārthāḥ
je॰ sāṅkhyakā॰ vṛ॰ A, B, māṭharavṛ॰, kā॰ 66
raṅgasya darśayitvā nivartate nartakī yathā nṛtyāt
eteṣāmeva pañcānāṃ vītānāṃ pariśuddhyarthāḥ pañcaiva āvītāḥ
evamebhiḥ pañcabhirvītaiḥ pradhānasya parigrahaṃ kṛtvā punarāvītaiḥ kariṣyāmaḥ
tasyāsya pratipakṣāḥ sarvaikāntinaḥ puruṣeśvarāṇupravādāḥ vikārapuruṣā vaināśikāśca

teṣāṃ vaināśikapratiṣedhamagre vakṣyāmaḥ, kasmāt ? kiñcid vaināśikā hītara ityataḥ prabhṛtyupakramya anupalabdhernāstīti dvitīyasya śiraso'nabhyupagatasyāsata utpattyabhāvād vyabhicāraprasaṅge gate yāvadanāgate'pi kāle na bhaviṣyatīti
kiñcānyat, yadi vyaktasyāsata utpattirbhavati arthārthibhistṛṇapāṃśuvālukāḥ muktāmaṇirajatasuvarṇāni kriyeran, kasmāt ? abhāvakriyā gurukāryā bhāvakriyā laghvīti
kiñcānyat, yadi vyaktasyāsata utpattiryonyabhāvādekatvaprasaṅgaḥ, pradhānābhāvāt sāmānyamātramidaṃ vyaktaṃ nirviśeṣamityetat prasajyeta
kasmāt ? sāmānyapūrvakatvād viśeṣāṇām, sāmānyapūrvakā hi loke viśeṣā dṛṣṭāḥ, tadyathā--kṣīrapūrvakā dadhimastudrapsanavanītaghṛtāriṣṭakilāṭakūrcikābhāvāḥ
na tvasati bhāvaḥ kaścidasti yatpūrvakā vyaktaviśeṣāḥ syuḥ
tasmāt sāmānyamātramidaṃ vyaktaṃ nirviśeṣamityetat, na tvidaṃ tādṛk
je॰ sāṅkhyakā॰ vṛ॰ A, māṭharavṛ॰, kā॰ 16
kasmāt ? satāṃ hyarthānāṃ loke parimāṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tulāmāna-hasta-vyāma-rajjvātmopacayaiḥ, na tvasati bhāvaḥ kaścidasti yaḥ pratipadyamānaḥ parimāṇe'vatiṣṭheta
tasmād niṣparimāṇamidamavyavasthitamityetat prasajyeta, na tvidaṃ tādṛk, tasmād nedaṃ vyaktamasata utpadyate
atra paro brūyāt--viśeṣamātrasya darśanādasata utpattiḥ, tadyathā --ākāro gauravamityādidharmabhedāditi

tatrottaram --tādrūpyeṇopakārādadoṣa iti dharmabhedapariṇatyā lokavṛttāntanayanādityupakārabhedapradarśanāt kāryakāraṇabhāvavītasyāvītatvaleśaṃ ca spṛśatīti tasmādeva granthādavagantavyaṃ yāvat purastād vyākhyātam, yathā --tairyagyonamānuṣadaivāni parasparārthaṃ na kurvīranniti

tatra yaduktaṃ bhūtānāṃ tatsamūhānāṃ ca vyāvṛtterviśeṣamātramidaṃ vyaktam, tasmādasata utpadyate iti, etadayuktamiti punarasatsamanvayāśaṅkāṃ nirasya prapañcena yāvat tasmād yuktametat--yonyabhāvād bhedaprasaṅga iti
ācāryeṇāpi tathaiva vyavasthā-tulyajātisamanvayādītyuktaṃ tenaiva krameṇa ādigrahaṇāt trayaḥ śeṣā apyāvītāḥ sūcitāḥ
ākāro gauravaṃ raukṣyaṃ varaṇaṃ sthairyameva ca
snehaḥ saukṣmyaṃ prabhā śauklyaṃ mārdavaṃ gauravaṃ ca yat
śaityaṃ rakṣā pavitratvaṃ santāndhānaṃ caudakā guṇāḥ
ūrdhvagaṃ pāvakaṃ dagdhṛ pācakaṃ laghu bhāsvaram
pradhvaṃsyojasvi ca jyotiḥ pūrvābhyāṃ saca ? vilakṣaṇam
saṃhatānāṃ tu yat kāryaṃ sāmānyaṃ te gavādayaḥ
tatrākārādibhirdharmaiḥ pṛthivyā lokasya copakriyate bhūtāntarāṇāṃ ca
tatra ākārāt tāvad gavādīnāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ cākāranirvṛttiḥ, gauravādeṣāmavasthānam
sthairyād vṛttiḥ dhṛtiḥ ? prajānāṃ bhūtāntarāṇāṃ ca
tathā ūrdhvagatyādibhirdharmamātre'pi tejasā lokasya copakriyate bhūtāntarāṇāṃ ca
tathā tiryakpātādibhirdharmaiḥ vāyunā lokasya copakāraḥ kriyate bhūtāntarāṇāṃ ca
ākṣepanodanābhyāmutkarṣaḥ, prathanaṃ gharmāmbhasaḥ, vyūhaśca śarīre rasādīnāṃ dhātūnāṃ ca, agneścopadhmānamabhighātaścākāśasya
tathā sarvatogatyādibhirdharmaiḥ nabhasā lokasyopakāraḥ kriyate bhūtāntarāṇāṃ ca

eta eva ākāro gauravaṃ raukṣyam ityādayaḥ prathamatṛtīyacaturthapañcamaṣaṣṭhaślokāḥ kiñcitpāṭhabhedena pātañjalayogadarśanavaiyāsikabhāṣyopari vācaspatimiśraviracitāyāṃ tattvavaiśāradyāṃ vṛttau vijñānabhikṣuviracite yogavārtike ca samupalabhyante

tatra kāryakāraṇavītasya āvītastāvat --kiñcānyat, kāryakāraṇayośca vyaktamidaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā kāryarāśiṃ kāraṇarāśiṃ ca kṛtvā na asata utpattiḥ sambhavati iti vākyaśeṣaḥ, kramayaugapadyapravṛttyasambhavāt
tathā yugapadapyabhūtavinaṣṭayoranapekṣatvāt kharaviṣāṇavat kriyādimadhyāvasāneṣu asattvādeva pravṛttyasambhavaḥ
yadārabhyate tat kriyate niṣṭhāṃ ca gacchatīti loke dṛṣṭam, tat parasparāpekṣāmantareṇa na sambhavati cakrākṣavadityuktam
kiñcānyat, nirbījamakasmādutpadyamānaṃ vyaktamanekadeśatvād bhedānāmasambaddhamutpadyeta, sambaddhaṃ cotpadyate, tasmānnedamasata iti śaktivītasya āvītaḥ

śeṣastu prasaktānuprasaktavicāreṇa saṃsthānamādimaddharmamātraṃ śabdādīnāṃ vināśyavināśinām, evaṃ liṅgamādimaddharmamātraṃ sattvādīnāṃ vināśyavināśinām, tasmin vikārasaṃjñā , tatra yaduktaṃ vikārasya vināśitvāt pradhānasya vināśitvam iti etadayuktam, guṇavyatiriktaguṇapravṛttikāraṇābhāvādākasmikyāḥ pravṛtterabhāvāccetyādibhiḥtyādiḥ pratyabhijñānārthakriyāhetukāryaniyamādibhiśca hetubhiratyantāsadutpattivināśapratiṣedhārthaḥ sarvo grantho vaiśvarūpyāvibhāgagativītasyāvīto draṣṭavya iti

evameṣāṃ pradhānāstitvaikyādisādhanārthaṃ vītānāṃ tatsadbhāvasya anyathā vyaktāsambhavasya vā darśanena tryātmakayonihetutvamavaśyamityetadavadhāraṇārthānāṃ cāvī anyaḥ punarāha--na sarvasarvātmakatvaparigraho nyāyyaḥ, anyathā bhavanadvaitaparigrahād vidhyubhayanayaikāntopapatteḥ
anāpannatvādibhyo nāsti vandhyāputravat sannidhiḥ, padyativartatyarthapravṛttatvādeva sattāyāḥ
na hi dravyādisadbhedavat padyativartatyoḥ sattāviśeṣatvena upādānam, sattārthāḥ ityaviśeṣeṇa vacanāt
tānāmatathārthatvamuktavidhinā pratipāditam, ekatvaṃ puruṣavadapariṇāmitvaṃ ca sukhādīnām
tasmādatathārthatvādanumānābhāsatvādete'rthā nopapannāḥ, tadyathā— bhinnaguṇatvaṃ vaiṣamyātmakatvaṃ vipariṇāmaḥ punaḥ sāmyāpattiśceti

tannirmūlatvāt puruṣārthena hetunā prayuktā pravṛttirityetadapi vitatham, tadvitathatvāt tadviṣayaḥ pratyayo'pyajñānameva, tadajñānatvāt jñānaprāpyapuruṣārthābhāvo'pīti samastatannrārthavighaṭanameveti kimavaśiṣyate vārṣagaṇe tantre ? subhāṣitābhimatastyājyo'yamanupapannaparokṣārthavādaḥ
yadyupapadyeta parokṣārthamapi taṃ gṛhṇīyāma, na tūpapannaḥ
śeṣastu sarvo grantho vaiśvarūpyāvibhāgagativītasyāvīto draṣṭavya iti vakṣyamāṇena anvayaḥ
yathā--saṃsthānamādimaddharmamātraṃ śabdādīnāṃ vināśyavināśinām, evaṃ liṅgamādimaddharmamātraṃ sattvādīnāṃ guṇānāṃ vināśyavināśinām
idaṃ ca vākyaṃ vyāsabhāṣye'pi kutaścidanyagranthāduddhṛtamiva pratibhāti
asya vācaspatimiśrapraṇītā vyākhyā--vimardavaicitryameva vikāravaicitrye hetuṃ prakṛtau vikṛtau ca darśayati--yatheti
yathā saṃsthānaṃ pṛthivyādipariṇāmalakṣaṇaṃ ādimad dharmamātraṃ vināśi tirobhāvi śabdādīnāṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhatanmātrāṇāṃ svakāryamapekṣya avināśinām atirobhāvinām
vijñānabhikṣuviracitāyāṃ yogavārtikākhyāyāṃ vyākhyāyāṃ tvittham— guṇinityatve'pi guṇānāṃ vimardamudāharati--yatheti
yatheti na dṛṣṭānte, kintūdāharaṇe, saṃsthānamiti, arthavināśenāvināśināṃ śabdāditanmātrāṇāṃ pañcabhūtarūpaṃ saṃsthānaṃ dharmamātramādimat, ityato vināśītyarthaḥ
evamahaṅkārādayo ghaṭādayaśca svavināśenāvināśināṃ kāraṇānāṃ dharmamātrāṇi vināśina iti bodhyam

iti sāṅkhyakārikāyā māṭharavṛttau sāṅkhyatattvakaumudyādiṣu ca pañca karmendriyāṇi, pañca buddhīndriyāṇi pañca tanmātrāṇi mano buddhirahaṅkāraḥ ityevamaṣṭādaśavidhaṃ mahadādi sūkṣmaparyantaṃ liṅgaṃ varṇitamasti, yuktidīpikādivyākhyāsu tu iyaṃ kārikā anyathā vyākhyātāsti
anyaḥ punarāha--na sarvasarvātmakatvaparigraho nyāyyaḥ, anyathā bhavanadvaitaparigrahād vidhyubhayanayaikāntopapatteḥ
anāpannatvādibhyo nāsti vandhyāputravat sannidhiḥ, padyativartatyarthapravṛttatvādeva sattāyāḥ
na hi dravyādisadbhedavat padyativartatyoḥ sattāviśeṣatvena upādānam, sattārthāḥ ityaviśeṣeṇa vacanāt
puruṣārtha eva heturna kenacit kāryate karaṇam sāṅkhyakā॰ 31
na sarvasarvātmakatvaparigraho nyāyyaḥ, anyathā bhavanadvaitaparigrahād vidhyubhayanayaikāntopapatteḥ
tatra bhavati bhāvadvaitam, bhavato bhāvasya bhāvyabhavitṛtvābhyāṃ bhedābhyāṃ bhāvopapattiḥ ityetat pratipādayiṣyate
tatra tāvad yaḥ sannidhirna hi sa sannidhimātravṛttirasti, kutaḥ ? anāpannatvāt, āpattiranāvirbhūtasyāvirbhāvaḥ, tata āha --anāvirbhūtatvāt, anāvirbhavanamapravartanam, apravartanaṃ cāniyamaḥ

athavā āpattirvipariṇāmo bhāvāntareṇopalabdhiḥ, āvirbhāvo vyaktiḥ, pravṛttiḥ santataḥ pariṇāmaprabandhaḥ, niyatasvarūpatvamavigatadravyārthabhāvasthitiḥ, ebhyo viparyayo'nāpannatvādiḥ, tebhyo hetubhyo'nāpannatvādisvarūpebhyo nāsti vandhyāputravat sannidhiḥ

nanūktam --astibhavatyādiṣu asti-vartatī sannidhivācinau, bhavati-vidyatī sāmānyabhavanavācinau, padyatirāpattibhavanavācī iti, satyamuktam, ayuktaṃ tūktam, astyādīnāṃ sannipātaṣaṣṭhānāṃ sattārthavācitvāt sarve'pyamī sattārthamevāviśeṣeṇa bruvate
sā ca sattā padyati-vartatyekārthaivetyata āha --padyati-vartatyarthapravṛttatvādeva sattāyāḥ
etaccāyuktam, yasmād na hi dravyādisadbhedetyādi yāvadupādānamiti gatārtham
kuto jñāyate iti cet, sattārthā ityaviśeṣeṇa vacanāt, asti-bhavati-vidyati-padyati-vartatayaḥ sannipātaṣaṣṭhāḥ sattārthāḥ ityaviśeṣeṇoktatvāt siddhasenasūriṇā

yadyapi cāpattibhavananirūpaṇaṃ pradhānameva bhavati mahadādivikārāpattyā, tena kila bhūyata iti tadapi na, tasyāpi bhāvyamānatvād bhāvayitāramantareṇānupapatteḥ anāpannasya ca asattvāt, asvatantratvāt, śabdādivat
bhavati kartā yaḥ svatantraḥ, pravartanavṛttatvāt, tathābhavanavṛttatvāt tantupaṭavat
āpattibhavanamapi nāsti, kathamiti cet, yadapi cāpattibhavananirūpaṇaṃ sāṅkhyaiḥ kriyata iti vākyaśeṣaḥ

pradhānameva bhavati mahadādivikārāpattyā, yasmāt tena kila bhūyata iti, itiśabdahetvarthatvād mahadādibhāvamāpadyata ityasmāt kāraṇāt pradhānameva bhavati, tenaiva bhūyate sattvādimayatvād viśvasyeti
kilaśabdaḥ kṣepe, evaṃ kila teṣāṃ matamiti, sa ca kṣepo'nupapadyamānatvāt
kathamiti cet, ucyate --tadapi na, tasyāpi bhāvyamānatvād bhāvayitāramantareṇa bhāvyatvānupapapatteḥ, svata eva na bhavatītyarthaḥ
tacced vyāpṛtaṃ dvitīyena vyāpṛtatareṇa vinā na pravartitumarhati, anāpannatvāt, anāpannasya ca sannidhimātrasyāpāditāsattvāt
tasmādanāpannasya ca svata evāpattyabhāvāttaduktāpattibhavanaṃ nopapadyata iti
kiṃ kāraṇamanupapannamiti cet, asvatantratvāt, anyatantraṃ hi tat pradhānākhyamacetanatvāt
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? śabdādivat, yathā śabdādayaḥ sattvarajastamomayatvādasvatantrāstadātmakena pradhānena bhāvyante'nyena vyāpṛtā api vyāpārayitrā tathā pradhānamapi
kasmāt ? pravartanavṛttatvāt, pravartayataḥ kriyā pravartanam, tena pravartanena vṛttatvāt pravartayitṛtvena vṛttatvādityarthaḥ
pravartayaddhi kāraṇaṃ tadbhāvamāpadyate, śabdādi yathā pravartayat sattvarajastamolakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ śabdādibhāvamāpadyate tvanmatena

tathābhavanavṛttatvāt, tena pravartyamānarūpeṇa bhavanam, tena vṛttatvāt pravartayitāramantareṇābhavanādavṛttatvāt, tantupaṭavat, yathā tantavaḥ paṭaṃ pravartayantaḥ paṭasya kāraṇamityucyante paṭaśca tantukāryaṃ taiḥ pravartyatvāt

nanvete pradhānaśabdādipaṭādidṛṣṭāntā advaitavādaṃ samarthayantīti, ucyate--pravartayitṛtvamātrasādharmyāt tadabhyupagamya bhedena nidarśyate, anyathā puruṣādivadadvaitābhyupagame vidhyubhayaikāntotthānābhāvāt
bhāvyabhāvakabhedaprasiddheśca abhāvitasyāsattvād vandhyāputravadaṇudharmādayo'pi bhāvyamānā eva syurityetatsādharmyād dṛṣṭāntāḥ śabdādayaḥ

yadyevaṃ prastutaṃ dharmādharmāvaṇavo vā kāraṇamastyeveti siddhatvāt kimanumitena kāraṇena iti cet, netyu dharmādharmāṇvādīnāmapi ca tantvaṃśvādivat pūrvapūrvaśaktatāratamyena sannihitatadvidhaśaktiḥ prativiśiṣṭabuddhiḥ svatantro'bhiprāyapravṛttyāpatteḥ pravartayitṛtvāt kāraṇam, śaktimatpravṛttinivṛttiviniyogeṣu svātantryāt, adhikṛtapaktṛvat

sambhavanadhāraṇajvalanavikledanavyāpāreṣu sthālīkāṣṭhataṇḍulādīnāṃ pravṛttinivṛttiviniyogeṣu svātantryāducyate--devadatta eva pacati, tena pacyate, sa pacati, tena pacanaṃ kriyate, prayojanamātrārthatvāt kriyāyāḥ
sākṣādvā bhavitṛvat, yathā ca sambhavanadhāraṇa- cyate --dharmādharmāṇvādīnāmapi ca tantvaṃśvādivadityādi yāvat prativiśiṣṭabuddhiḥ

yathā paṭastantupūrvakaḥ, tantavoṃ'śupūrvakāḥ, aṃśavastuṭipūrvakāḥ, tuṭīnāmapi pravartane śaktāstataḥ pūrve pūrve yāvacchatāṇukaḥ, tato'pi pūrve pūrve yāvad dvyaṇukaḥ paramāṇurityanumīyate śabdādito yāvat pradhānam, tathā aṇvādīnāmapyacetanānāṃ pravartakau dharmādharmau
evaṃ pūrvapūrvaśaktatāratamyena īśvaraḥ sannihitatadvidhaśaktiḥ dharmādharmāṇvādipradhānaśabdādestathā tathā tathā viniveśane sannihitā yasya śaktiḥ so'sti

kātra tadvidhaviniveśanaśaktirmukhyā tasyeti cet, ucyate--prativiśiṣṭā buddhiḥ, ato'sau prativiśiṣṭabuddhirviśiṣṭabuddhibhyo'pi sthapatikulālādibhyaḥ, pratikartṛ viniveśanapravṛttinivṛttiviniyojaneṣu jñatvāt svātantryācca teṣāṃ bhāvānāmīṣṭe, na te tasyeśate nāpyātmanaḥ na ca parasparam, ajñāsvatantratvābhyām
sa tu prativiśiṣṭabuddhitvāt svatantraḥ, tasyābhiprāyeṇaiva pravṛttimāpadyante dharmādharmāṇvādayaḥ

so'pi cābhiprāyapravṛttyāpatterna sannidhimātravṛttiḥ, atasteṣāṃ pravartayitā, pravartayitṛtvāt kāraṇaṃ śaktimat sa eva, teṣāṃ śaktimatāmapi bhāvyatvenāsvātantryāt tasyaiva tatpravṛttinivṛttiviniyogeṣu svātantryāt jagatsargasthityantarālapralayamahāpralayeṣu, pravartanaṃ prāgaudāsīnyena sthitānāṃ dharmādīnāṃ sṛṣṭeḥ pravartanam, pravṛttānāṃ punarupasaṃhārād nivartanam, viniyogo daiva-mānuṣa-tairyagyona-sarit-samudrādi-tanu-karaṇādyavayavavibhāgavinyāsaḥ, viṣṇumanvādīnāmadhikṛtapuruṣāṇāmapi ihatyaparameśvarābhiprāyānurodhena pravartamānādhikṛtarājasthānīyādipuruṣāṇāmiva tasyaiva pravartayitṛtvāt
tadvyākhyānārtham— sambhavanadhāraṇetyādi yāvat prayojanamātrārthatvāt kriyāyā iti
yathā hi rājñā niyuktaḥ sūpakāraḥ sthālīkāṣṭhataṇḍulādīnāṃ sambhavanadhāraṇajvalanavikledanavyāpāreṣu pravṛttinivṛttiviniyogeṣu svātantryāt tattadātmā bhavati tatheśvara iti

athavā kartṛkarmakaraṇādhikaraṇasampradānāpādānāni pratikārakaṃ pacādīnāṃ kriyābhedād yathāsvaśakti svātantryāt kartṝṇi, yathā adhikaraṇaṃ sthālī nidarśanamātraṃ sambhavanadhāraṇe kurvatī pacati ityucyate, jvalanaṃ kurvanti kāṣṭhāni pacanti ityucyate, adhiśrayaṇodakāsecanataṇḍulāvapanaidho'pa rohaṇādisamarthaṃ tathā bhavat pṛthivyudakādi vrīhirjāyate bhavati ca bhavati

karṣaṇādikriyāḥ kurvan devadattaḥ pacati ityucyate, ityādi pratikārakaṃ svātantrye satyapi upakramaprabhṛtyapavargaparyavasānāsu kriyāsu tasyaiva svātantryāt sambhavanādipratyakṣatāyāmapi pacanaśaktimatāmapyadhikaraṇādīnāṃ devadattasya pravartayitṛtvādevocyate devadatta eva pacati iti, nānyāni anīśvaratvāt
tāṃ mukhyāṃ kartṛśaktiṃ darśayati --tena pacyate tṛtīyayā kartari vihitayā sa pacatīti vā prathamayā tatra vihitatippratyayasamānādhikaraṇatayā
punarapi sphuṭīkaraṇārthamāha --tena pacanaṃ kriyata iti yāvaduktaṃ bhavati tāvaduktaṃ bhavati tena pacyate sa pacati iti
kutaḥ ? prayojanamātrārthatvāt kriyāyāḥ, prayojanaṃ paravyāpāraṇam, vikledavyāpāraṇārthāḥ sambhavanajvalanādikriyāḥ, tāsāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ devadattāyattatvāt sa pacati tena pacyata ityuktam

dharmādharmāṇvādīnāmapi ca tantvaṃśvādivat pūrvapūrvaśaktatāratamyena sannihitatadvidhaśaktiḥ prativiśiṣṭabuddhiḥ svatantro'bhiprāyapravṛttyāpatteḥ pravartayitṛtvāt kāraṇam, śaktimatpravṛttinivṛttiviniyogeṣu svātantryāt, adhikṛtapaktṛvat

sambhavanadhāraṇajvalanavikledanavyāpāreṣu sthālīkāṣṭhataṇḍulādīnāṃ pravṛttinivṛttiviniyogeṣu svātantryāducyate--devadatta eva pacati, tena pacyate, sa pacati, tena pacanaṃ kriyate, prayojanamātrārthatvāt kriyāyāḥ
atra kāraṇaṃ śaktimatāṃ sa eva ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
rohaṇādisamarthaṃ tathā bhavat pṛthivyudakādi vrīhirjāyate bhavati ca bhavati
tadvarṇanam --yathā ca sambhavanetyādi yāvad bhavati ca bhavati, na kevalaṃ pacatyādibāhyakriyāviṣayameva prayojyatvam, kiṃ tarhi ? vrīhyādibhavanādyantaḥkriyāviṣayamapi prayojanam
tathā bhavat pṛthivyudakādi bāhyaṃ vrīhirjāyate bhavatītyantarbhavanam

sambhavanadhāraṇasamarthā pṛthivī, rohaṇasamarthamudakam, ādigrahaṇād varddhanasamarthā vāyukālādayaḥ, taiḥ kāritasya vrīhibhavanasya pratyakṣatāyāmapi satyāṃ vrīhirjāyate bhavati antaḥsanniviṣṭasvātantryāt tasyaiveśvarasya prayojakatvāducyate --bhavati ca bhavatīti, bhavanamapi bhavadeva bhavatīti svarūpamātra- lābho'pi tadvaśādityarthaḥ

yathāsaṅkhyaṃ sattvasya prakāśapravṛttistamaso niyamapravṛttiścāstyevetyuktaṃ sattvaṃ śabdātmanā pravartamānamityādiparasparopakāravīte, prakāśādilakṣaṇasya sattvasya pravṛttirguruvaraṇalakṣaṇasya tamasaśca pravṛttiryathāsaṅkhyam itarayoḥ khyāpayati vyavasthāpayati iti vacanāt
rajastu pravṛttilakṣaṇameva pravartakamiṣṭaṃ viśeṣataḥ, satyapi pravṛttisāmānye karoti pravartayati iti vacanāt

dṛṣṭāntabāhulyapradarśanaṃ pratisiddhāntaparidṛṣṭādṛṣṭādeḥ pravartayitṛtvakhyāpanārtham, siddhāntaṃ siddhāntaṃ prati pratisiddhāntaṃ teṣu teṣu vaiśeṣikādisiddhānteṣu kalpitānāṃ parito'numānairdṛṣṭānāmapyadṛṣṭāṇupradhānaviṣṇvādīnāṃ pravartayitā īśvara iti dārṣṭāntikopanayanāt
kaḥ punarīśvarasya kāraṇatve nyāyaḥ ? ayaṃ nyāyo'bhidhīyate--pradhānaparamāṇukarmāṇi prāk pravṛtterbuddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhitāni pravartante, acetanatvāt, vāsyādivaditi
yathā vāsyādi buddhimatā takṣṇā adhiṣṭhitamacetanatvāt pravartate tathā pradhānaparamāṇukarmāṇi acetanāni pravartante

tatra pradhānakāraṇikāstāvat puruṣārthamadhiṣṭhāyakaṃ pradhānasya varṇayanti puruṣārthena prayuktaṃ pradhānaṃ pravartate, puruṣārthaśca dvedhā bhavati śabdādyupalabdhiḥ guṇapuruṣāntaradarśanaṃ ceti, tadubhayaṃ pradhānapravṛttervinā na bhavatīti
yāvat pradhānaṃ mahadādibhāvena na pariṇamate tāvanna śabdādyupalabdhirasti na guṇapuruṣāntaropalabdhiriti hetvabhāvāt pradhānapravṛttirayuktā
athāsti, nāsadātmānaṃ labhate na sannirudhyata iti ? evaṃ ca sati vidyamānaḥ puruṣārthaḥ pradhānaṃ pravartayatīti na puruṣārthāya pradhānasya pravṛttiḥ
na hi loke yad yasya bhavati sa tadarthaṃ punaryatata iti
satataṃ ca pravṛttiḥ prāpnoti kāraṇasya sannihitatvāditi, puruṣārthaḥ pravṛtteḥ kāraṇamiti puruṣārthasya nityatvāt satataṃ pravṛttyā bhavitavyamiti
atha vidyamāno'pi na pravartayati na tarhi puruṣārthaḥ kāraṇamiti
yasyābhāvāt pradhānaṃ na pravartate yasya ca bhāvāt pravartate tat kāraṇamiti
...yadā bhavantaḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ sāmyāvasthāṃ prakṛtiṃ varṇayanti sā kuto nivartata iti vaktavyam
na cānivṛttāyāṃ sāmyāvasthāyāṃ vaiṣamyeṇa śakyaṃ bhavitum
athāṅgāṅgibhāvasyāniyamād vaiṣamyaṃ bhavati iti ? atrāpi bhavantaṃ paryanuyuñjmahe--kathaṃ sāmyenāvasthitamadhikaṃ hīnaṃ ca bhavati, nāpūrvopacayo vidyate na pūrvahānamastīti
...so'yaṃ pradhānavādo yāvad yāvad vicāryate tāvat tāvat pramāṇavṛttaṃ bādhate iti
ye paramāṇūn puruṣakarmādhiṣṭhitān jagataḥ kāraṇatvena varṇayanti tān pratīdamucyate--paramāṇavaḥ pravartanta iti satataṃ pravṛttyā bhavitavyam
atha kālaviśeṣāpekṣāḥ pravartante, paramāṇubhiḥ kālo vyākhyātaḥ
yathā acetanatvāt paramāṇavo buddhimantamadhiṣṭhātāramapekṣante tathā kālo'pīti, na hi tatrācetanatvaṃ nivartata iti
yathaiva paramāṇavaḥ svatantrāḥ pravartanta iti sādhyaṃ tathā kṣīrādyacetanaṃ svatantraṃ pravartata iti
yadi kṣīrādi svatantraṃ pravarteta mṛteṣvapi pravarteta, na tu pravartate, ato'vagamyate buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ tadapi
evaṃ yāvad yāvadacetanaṃ pravartate sarvaṃ tat cetanādhiṣṭhitamiti
ayamaparo hetuḥ--buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ mahābhūtādi vyaktaṃ sukhaduḥkhādinimittaṃ bhavati rūpādimattvāt turyādivaditi
iti sa eva bhavati, itthamīśvara eva bhavati paramārthataḥ

sarvavyaktipravṛttyātmakatvāt, sarvāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ pravṛttaya ātmā'sya sarvavyaktipravṛttyātmakaḥ tadviśiṣṭabuddhiśaktyāvāsarūpatvāt tāsām, evameva cāsyāṣṭamūrtitocyate kṣiti-jala-pavana-hutāśana-yajamānā-''kāśa-soma-sūryākhyāṣṭamūrttitāsya svaśaktyāvāsarūpatvāt tāsu sa eva bhavati sā sā ca
kiñcānyat, pravṛttiphalaprakarṣāpakarṣābhāvaprasaṅgādīśvara eva kāraṇaṃ nādṛṣṭādi na pradhānādītyata āha — itarathetyādi yāvad dṛṣṭau ca tau

yadyadṛṣṭāṇvādeḥ pradhānādervā pravṛttayaḥ phalāni vā syuḥ kriyāṇāṃ pūrvakṛtakarmaphalapreritānāṃ tadanurūpatvāt phalānāṃ ca phalapreritakarmānurūpatvād manuṣyanirvartanīyā eva svabhāvamārdavā nyeva pravartante, sambhūyaikārthakāritvāt, takṣādhiṣṭhitarathadārugaṇavat
cetanānadhiṣṭhitakṣīradadhimeghādivadanekānta iti cet, na, adṛṣṭakartṛkaviṣayapratijñārthāvyatirekāt śabdānityatvasādhane pratijñāntarnītajaladhidhvanyanityatvavat

dikriyāḥ kṛtvā manuṣya eva punarapi syāt, mā bhūt sarāgasaṃyamādidevagatinirvartanīyakriyāsambandhī tadanurūpavaikriyaśarīrādilabdhyutkarṣabhāvaḥ, tathā bahvārambhaparigrahādinirayāyuḥsaṃvartanīyakarmabhāk tadanurūpaduḥkhaikarasanārakatvanikṛṣṭaphalānubhāvī vā mā bhūt, parasparānurūpaśālibījāṅkurādihetukāryabhāvaprabandhavad viśiṣṭaviśiṣṭabuddhisvatantrakāraṇapreraṇābhāvāt svānurūpakāryakāraṇānubandhasāmarthyābhyupagamācca nādṛṣṭād na pradhānādervaiṣamyaṃ syāt, dṛṣṭaṃ ca vaiṣamyamadhyayanavidyāgamānadhigamādi, utkarṣāpakarṣayoranyadato na vimardakṣamaṃ kāraṇamastīśvarakāmacāreraṇādṛte, tadabhiprāyasyāpratighātasya pravṛttiḥ kāmacāraḥ, tena preraṇaṃ bhāvānāṃ pravartanaṃ svācārāṇāmapyaniṣṭaphalasambandho durācārāṇāmiṣṭaphalasambandhaḥ, tasmāt sarvamīśvarapravartitaṃ pravartate, nānyathā
cetanānadhiṣṭhitakṣīradadhimeghādivadanekānta iti cet, na, adṛṣṭakartṛkaviṣayapratijñārthāvyatirekāt śabdānityatvasādhane pratijñāntarnītajaladhidhvanyanityatvavat

yathāprakriyaṃ śarīrāṇīndriyāṇi bhuvanaṃ ca sādhayitumadhitiṣṭhadbhiradṛṣṭaiḥ preritāḥ paramāṇavo vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ pravṛttāni sattvādīni pradhānena sāṅkhyānāmanyeṣāṃ vā bhūtāni kāla-svabhāva-niyatyādyadhiṣṭhitānītyabhimatāni pravartyāni sapravartakāni viśiṣṭacetanādhiṣṭhitānyeva pravartanta iti pratijñā

sambhūyaikārthakāritvāditi hetuḥ, sambhūyakāritvaṃ pūrvapūrvaśaktatāratamyakāraṇānumānokteḥ, paramāṇusattvādayaḥ sambhūya tanvāditvenāvasthitāḥ paraspareṇa sambhūya gamanābhyavaharaṇasukhaduḥkhānubhavarūpādyupalabdhisattvaguṇādhāratādi kāryaṃ kurvanto dṛśyante, tat siddhameṣāṃ sambhūyaikārthakāritvam
takṣādhiṣṭhitarathadārugaṇavat, rathārtho dārusaṅghāto rathadārugaṇaḥ, sa takṣṇā viśiṣṭacetanenādhiṣṭhitastathaitāni
tathā'cetanatvāt, tatheti tasyāmeva pratijñāyāṃ acetanatvāt ityupacayahetuḥ, sa eva rathadārugaṇo dṛṣṭāntaḥ, vakṣyamāṇo vā turyādivaditi

athavā sthitvā pravṛttesturyādivat, yathā turivemaśalākānalikārajjvañcanikāsūtrādīni prāgapravṛttāni kañcit kālaṃ sthitvā pravartamānāni viśiṣṭakuvindabuddhyadhiṣṭhitāni paṭaniṣpattyai pravartante tanukaraṇabhuvanāni tatheti

etacca na, adṛṣṭakartṛkaviṣayapratijñārthāvyatirekāt, adṛṣṭo'syāḥ kartā viṣayaḥ seyamadṛṣṭakartṛkaviṣayā pratijñā, tasyāḥ pratijñāyāstanukaraṇabhuvanadharmikāyāḥ prativiśiṣṭabuddhyadhiṣṭhitatvasādhyadharmaṇaḥ kṣīradadhimeghādidharmiṇāmapṛthaktvāt pratijñāntaḥpātitvād vipakṣābhāve hetuvyabhicārābhāvād sthitvāpravṛttacetanānadhiṣṭhiteśvaravadanekānta iti cet īśvarasya vā cetanādhiṣṭhitatā tasyāpi cānyādhiṣṭhitatetyanavasthā
ucyate ca tvayā cetanānāmapīśvarādhiṣṭhānaṃ puruṣavādanirasanāya--ajño janturanīśo'yamātmanaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ
īśvaraprerito gacchet svargaṃ vā śvabhrameva vā

nānekāntaḥ, śabdānityatvasādhane pratijñāntarnītajaladhidhvanyanityatvavat, yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñāte kṛtakatvaṃ deśakālābhyāmanavarate jaladhidhvanau puruṣādibhedena cānavarate sāmādiśabde ca dṛṣṭatvādanekānta iti vacanaṃ tadābhāsacodanam, udanvatsāmādiśabdānāmapyupādānabhedabhinnānām śabdaḥ iti śrotragrāhyatvābhedena pratijñātānāṃ śabdatvānatikramāt pakṣāntarnītatvāt, tadanityatvaṃ kṛtakatvāvinābhāvi śabdādanyasya nityasya kṛtakasyādarśanācca jāyate, deśakālopādānabhedabhinnasyābhede'pi satyupalabhyadharmaṇo'nupalabhyatvācchabdavyaktidharmitvācca jātyuttaraṃ ca, tasmādanuttaramiti
sthitvāpravṛttacetanānadhiṣṭhiteśvaravadanekānta iti cet īśvarasya vā cetanādhiṣṭhitatā tasyāpi cānyādhiṣṭhitatetyanavasthā
īśvaraprerito gacchet svargaṃ vā śvabhrameva vā || mahābhā॰ vana॰ 30 | 28
syānmatam--yatheśvaraḥ svayaṃ prāgapravṛttān sthitvā pravartayannapi cetanāntareṇānadhiṣṭhitaḥ pravṛttaśca tathā tanvādīni sthitvā pravṛttāni syurityanekāntaḥ
īśvarasya vā cetanādhiṣṭhitatetyādi, evamanaikāntikatvānicchāyāṃ vā cetanādhiṣṭhito'sāvīśvaraḥ prāptaḥ sthitvā pravṛtteradṛṣṭāṇupradhānādivat, ato'nyeśvaratā grahādhiṣṭhitastrīpuruṣādivat
etacca na, cetanādhiṣṭhitapravṛttitvasādhyadharmatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ, cetanādhiṣṭhitapravṛttitvaṃ hi sādhyate dharmaḥ, sa cācetanānāmeva taddharmiviṣayatvāt, cetanānāṃ siddhatvāt prayojanābhāvācca
tanukaraṇabhuvanasādhanapravṛttādṛṣṭāṇupradhānādīni hyacetanāni dharmīṇi cetanādhiṣṭhitatvadharmeṇa viśiṣṭāni sādhyanta iti pratijñāviṣayājñānādadoṣa iti

devadattādayastarhi cetaneśvarānadhiṣṭhitāḥ pravartante, sāmarthyādacetanadharmiviṣayaṃ cetanādhiṣṭhānaṃ sādhyata iti pratijñāviṣayavyavasthāyāṃ cetanānāṃ devadattādīnāṃ cetaneśvareṇādhiṣṭhānaṃ na prāpnoti, tato devadattādivaccetanānadhiṣṭhitānāṃ tanvādisādhanārthādṛṣṭāṇupradhānādīnāmanekāntaḥ
ucyate ca tvayā iṣyata eva tvayā cetanānāmapīśvarādhiṣṭhānam, yathā— ajño janturanīśo'yamātmanaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ
īśvaraprerito gacchet svargaṃ vā śvabhrameva vā
28 puruṣavādanirasanāyeti ślokavacanaprayojanamāha, mā bhūt puruṣakāraṇavādaprasaṅgaḥ tadavasthamātraṃtadavasthāmātraṃ tanvadṛṣṭapradhānāṇvādi iti, ata uktaṃ bhavatā ajño janturanīśo'yamiti
īśvaraprerito gacchet svargaṃ vā śvabhrameva vā || mahābhā॰ vanapa॰ 30 | 28
na, prāg viśiṣṭabuddhicetanapratijñānāt, viśiṣṭabuddhitvamapi cāsyārthānāmarthakriyāyogyatvena sanniveśakatvāt
dharmāntaraikyāpattirhi pariṇāmaḥ kāryatvād rathādivad viśiṣṭabuddhimadvihitaḥ ityāśayako mūlapāṭhaḥ syāditi sambhāvyate

tat kutaḥ siddhamiti cet, ucyate— viśiṣṭabuddhitvamapi cāsyārthānāmarthakriyāyogyatvena sanniveśakatvāt, tanvādīni viśiṣṭabuddhipūrvakāṇi arthakriyāyogyatvena sanniviśiṣṭāsanniviṣṭāvayavatvāt, sthānagamanaśayanāsanāhārādiprayojanāni hi tanvādiṣu kriyante tatkriyāyogyāvayavasanniveśāt sthapatibuddhipūrvakaprāsādavat
sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ netareṣām iti śvetāśvataropaniṣadi pāṭhaḥ

nahi praśastaśubhavarṇagandharasasparśasya lakṣmīnilayasya jalāśayālaṅkaraṇasya kamalasya grahaṇadhāraṇopabhogādisādhanabhūte nāle kenacidasūyayā mā grahīt kaścit iti kaṇṭakāḥ kṛtāḥ, nīlotpalanālādiṣvapyatiprasaṅgāt
na ca mayūracandrakāṇāmindracāpavarṇapratispardhivicitravarṇatā kṛtā kuḍyādiṣu citrakareṇeva kenacid viśiṣṭabuddhinā, citrakaravetanadānādyabhāvaprasaṅgāditi
atrocyate --na, dadhimeghādivaduktottaratvāt, kṣīradadhimeghādivat padmanālakaṇṭakamayūracandrakādīnāṃ tanvādivaccādṛṣṭakartṛkaviṣayapratijñārthāvyatirekādanaikāntika- tvābhāva ityuktottarametat
evaṃ tāvat sāmānyena viśiṣṭabuddhipūrvakatoktā, prastutakāpilamatāpekṣayā caivaṃ pratijñāyate --laghuprakāśetyādi yāvat pācakādhiṣṭhitānalodakaudanasādhanavaditi

yathā parasparapratyanīkayoragnyudakayorapratyanīkatvavidhāyinā viśiṣṭabuddhinā pācakenādhiṣṭhitayoḥ satyapi mithaḥ pratyanīkatve tadbuddhivaśavartinoḥ saṃhatyakāritvādodanasādhanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathā laghuguruṇoḥ prakāśavaraṇayoḥ pravṛttiniyamayośca mitho viruddhayorapi saṃhatya mahadādibhāvenaikārthakāritvād viśiṣṭabuddhipūrvakateti
syānmatam--sattvarajastamasāmevāṅgāṅgibhāvaḥ puruṣārthamuddiśya pravṛttānāṃ vaiṣamyavipariṇāmād mahadādi anvāha ca--eko vaśī niṣkriyāṇāṃ bahūnāmekaṃ bījaṃ bahudhā yaḥ karoti
tamātmasthaṃ ye'nupaśyanti dhīrāsteṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām

tadvyācaṣṭe --dharmāntaraikyādi, pariṇāmo hi dharmāntaraniṣedho dharmāntarāvirbhavanaṃ ca, taddvayabhūtaṃ kāryam, sa tu pariṇāmaḥ kāryatvāt pūrvavat pratijñārthāvyatirekād rathādivat so'pi viśiṣṭabuddhimadvihitaḥ
eko vaśī niṣkriyāṇāṃ bahūnāmekaṃ bījaṃ bahudhā yaḥ karoti
tamātmasthaṃ ye'nupaśyanti dhīrāsteṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām || śvetāśva॰ 6 | 12
eko'dvitīyaḥ pradhāno vā vaśī jñatvasvātantryābhyām niṣkriyāṇāmajñāsvatantrāṇām, paratantrā jñā api hi niṣkriyā eva
bahūnāmanantānāṃ pradhānāṇvādīnāṃ karmakaraṇasampradānāpādānādhikaraṇapradhānaśaktīnāmanantānāmapi pravartayitṛtvāt svavaśīkartuṃ śaktatvād vaśīti
ekaṃ bījaṃ pradhānaṃ mahadādivipariṇatyā bahudhā brahmādistambāntānantabhedabhinnajagattayā yaḥ karoti sṛjati adhitiṣṭhati ātmābhiprāyānurūpyeṇa tathā tathā vyavasthāpayati

tamīśvaraṃ svato bhinnasya bhāvyabhavanasya pradhānādisaṃjñasya bhāvayitāramātmasthamātmani sthitaṃ kṣityādyaṣṭamūrtisarvagataṃ sarvatra tāsāṃ sadbhāvād ye'nupaśyanti tatprasādādeva tajjñānānusāreṇa yogābhyāsaprasādakrameṇa
ko yogaḥ ? pratyāhārastathā dhyānaṃ prāṇāyāmo'tha dhāraṇā
amṛtanādopa॰ 6 tatrendriyāṇāṃ viṣayebhyo manasaśca pratyāharaṇaṃ pratyāhāraḥ
tatra recaka āntaraṃ vāyuṃ bahirniṣkāśayati nāsikādvāreṇa
dhāraṇā yathābhyāsaṃ hṛdayādiṣu pradeśeṣu manaso'vasthāpanam, yathā pūrvaṃ nābhau tato hṛdaye kaṇṭhe nāsikāgre bhruvormadhye lalāṭe mūrddhanīti

tarkaḥ śūnyāgāragirikandarādyekānte śucau deśe śarīramṛju āyasya dantāgrāṇi jihvāgreṇa sandhāya palyaṅka-svastika-vīrāsanādyāsanaṃ samapādādisthānaṃ vā āsthāya dhyāyato me samādhirbhavatīti tarkayet anenetthaṃ kṛtena kriyāviśeṣeṇa āhāra-vihāra-svādhyāyādinā dhyānasamādhirbhavati iti tadupāyavicāra ūhastarkaḥ

anena yogena sarvatra kṣityādimūrtimīśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā paścād bhāvitātmā tamātmasthameva paśyati--yadatra mama śarīre kaṭhinaṃ sā pṛthivī parameśvaramūrtiḥ, yad dravaṃ tajjalam, ūṣmā tejaḥ, calaṃ vāyuḥ, śuṣiramākāśam, yaccaitanyaṃ sa yajamānaḥ, cakṣuḥ sūryaḥ, jihvā somo ayaṃ vidherubhayabhāk
vidhirvyākhyāto lokavadanapavādapravṛttiḥ, tasya utsargāt sa vidhīyate, sarvasarvātmakatvād nirapavādaḥ pravartata eva
sādṛśyasāmānyaṃ ca śabdārthaḥ, sarvasarvātmakatve'pi ca sṛṣṭyarthavattvād nāvikalpaḥ
vākyamapi ca pṛthak sarvapadam, tasmāt sarvasarvātmakatvādeva
mano vetyanyeṣvapi avayaveṣu yathāsambhavaṃ ye'nupaśyanti te dhīrāḥ śāśvatīṃ śāntimāpnuvanti tenaiveśvareṇa sāyojyaṃ nirvāṇaṃ mokṣamityarthaḥ
tarkaḥ samādhirityeṣa ṣaḍaṅgo yoga ucyate || amṛtanādopa॰ 6
tarkaścaiva samādhiśca iti amṛtanādopaniṣadi atrismṛtau ca tṛtīyacaraṇaḥ
atra vāśabdasya kiṃ prayojanamiti na jñāyate
tasya sārthakatve kaścana pāṭho'tra truṭita iti sambhāvyate
nābhikande ca hṛnmadhye kaṇṭhamūle ca tāluke
bhruvormadhye lalāṭe ca tathā mūrdhani dhārayet
vidhirvyākhyāto lokavadanapavādapravṛttiḥ, tasya utsargāt sa vidhīyate, sarvasarvātmakatvād nirapavādaḥ pravartata eva
sādṛśyasāmānyaṃ ca śabdārthaḥ, sarvasarvātmakatve'pi ca sṛṣṭyarthavattvād nāvikalpaḥ
vākyamapi ca pṛthak sarvapadam, tasmāt sarvasarvātmakatvādeva
nayasvarūpākhyānārthamāha --ayaṃ vidherubhayabhāk, ubhayaṃ vidhiṃ niyamaṃ ca bhajata ityubhayabhākū

punaḥ saṅkṣepeṇa vyācaṣṭe --anapavādapravṛttiḥ, na kañcidarthamayamapaharati kiṃ na etena yadi sāmānyaṃ yadi viśeṣaḥ ? ityādi, tasya vidherutsargād vidhānāt sa vidhirvidhīyate, kasmāt ? sarvasarvātmakatvād nirapavādaḥ pravartata eva, pravartate, na kvacid vyāhanyate, ayaṃ hi nayaḥ sarvaṃ sarvātmakam itīcchati yat prāk sūcitaṃ sannidhyāpattivyākhyāne tadevātrāpi vakṣyate, niyamaḥ sannidhiprayojyasatorapravṛtteḥ, yāvetāvanantaroktau sannidhirbhavati āpattibhavanasahāya īśvarapravartyo vā prayojyaḥ pradhānādṛṣṭāṇvādirbhāvaḥ tayordvayorapyapravṛtterasattvam
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tayorasatsattvāt, tadubhayaṃ hyasadeva sadityucyate svatantrasya karturjñasyaiva bhavanāt tadvilakṣaṇasyābhavanāpannasyāpravṛttasyāsattvāt khapuṣpavat
śabdārtho'dhunā --sādṛśyasāmānyaṃ ca śabdārthaḥ, vākyārthasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt padārtha iti gamyate

sadṛśasanniveśamānairmīyata iti samānam, samānaṃ dṛktvaṃ yatra draṣṭṝṇāṃ tat sadṛśam, sadṛśaṃ samānam, samānabhāvaḥ sāmānyaṃ jāti-liṅga-pratyayā-'bhidhāneṣviti, nānyāpoho na samānavastvatiriktatattattvādi vā tadanupapatteḥ

nanu sāmānyamavikalpātmakaṃ puruṣaniyatyādi sarvasarvātmakatvāditi pūrvavādaprasaṅga iti cet, netyucyate, sarvasarvātmakatve'pi ca sṛṣṭyarthavattvāt, jagatsṛṣṭilakṣaṇotsargavyāpitvāt tadarthavattvādasya nayasya nāvikalpaḥ iti sambhantsyate prakṛtaśabdārthaḥ, abhihitanyāyena sattvādiśabdāditanvādivikalpapratyayasya satyārthatvādadvaitapratyayasyāsatyārthatvāditi padārtha uktaḥ
vākyārtho'dhunā — vākyamapi ca pṛthak sarvapadamiti, vākye'vadhārite tadarthāvadhāraṇasaukaryāt

1 ityādiṣu vākyalakṣaṇavikalpeṣu asya nayasya matena pṛthak sarvaṃ padaṃ vākyam, vākyārthaḥ pṛthak pṛthak sarvapadārtha iti, yathā devadatta ! gāmabhyāja śuklām ityatraikaikaṃ padaṃ saṅgrahadeśatvād dravyārthaḥ
dravyamapi guṇasandrāvaḥ, guṇānāmekībhāvena dravaṇaṃ tenāpi tadvaśitvāt
upanibandhanamasya duvihā paṇṇavaṇā paṇṇattā--jīvapaṇṇavaṇā ajīvapaṇṇavaṇā ca prajñāpanāsū॰ 1
jīvā ceva ajīvā ceva, evaṃ rayaṇappabhā jāva īsīpabbhārā samayāvaliyādi

vākyam, kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasmāt sarvasarvātmakatvādeva, yasmāddevadatto'pi gavātmako'bhyājātmakaśca tathā pravartanāt tattadāpatteḥ, tānyapi tatheti tasmāt sarvasarvātmakatvāt pṛthak pṛthak sarvaṃ padaṃ vākyamiti
etasya vidhyubhayanayasya dravyārthabhedo'rthaḥ pūrvaviruddhatvānnayānāmavikalpārthād vidhividhinayād vikalpārthadravyārthatayā bhidyate
dravyamapi guṇasandrāvaḥ, guṇānāmekībhāvena dravaṇaṃ tenāpi tadvaśitvāt
upanibandhanamasya duvihā paṇṇavaṇā paṇṇattā--jīvapaṇṇavaṇā ajīvapaṇṇavaṇā ca prajñāpanāsū॰ 1
jīvā ceva ajīvā ceva, evaṃ rayaṇappabhā jāva īsīpabbhārā samayāvaliyādi
se kiṃ taṃ pannavaṇā ? pannavaṇā duvihā pannattā, taṃ jahā--jīvapannavaṇā ya ajīvapannavaṇā ya
ārṣoktānāṃ nayānāṃ kasminnantarbhāvaḥ ? ityata āha --saṅgrahadeśatvād dravyārthaḥ, saṅgrahanayasyāpi śatadhā bhedāt taddeśastadekadeśo dravyaśabdārthaḥ
katamasmin vigrahe iti cet, ucyate --dravyamapi guṇasandrāvaḥ

tadvyākhyā--sam ekībhāve, dru gatau pā॰ dhā॰ 945, tasmād guṇānāmekībhāvena dravaṇam, kāraṇe kāryasya sattvāt satāmeva sukhādīnāṃ rūpādīnāṃ pṛthak pṛthak sannihitānāmaikyagamanājjīvapudgalapariṇāmaḥ saṅgamanam
āha--vidhyubhayanayatvāt sannihitatadvidhaśaktīśvarapṛthaktvādaṇvādīnāṃ tadekaikasarvātmakatvācca teṣāṃ bhavatu ekībhāvaḥ, mā bhūdīśvarasyeti
netyucyate, tenāpi tadvaśitvāt sannihitatacchaktināpi saheśvareṇaikībhāve tacchaktivyakternānyatheti
asti ityucyate, upanibandhanamasya--duvihā paṇṇavaṇā paṇṇattā jīvapaṇṇavaṇā ajīvapaṇṇavaṇā ceti
athavā kimidaṃ bhaṃte ! loetti pavuccati ? goyamā ! jīvā ceva ajīvā ceva, evaṃ rayaṇappabhā jāva īsīpabbhārā samayāvaliyādi
nanvevaṃ tvaduktā evopapattayaḥ sarvaprāṇīśvaratvaṃ sādhayanti, sukhādyātmasaṃvedyalakṣaṇatvāt karmaṇaḥ sukhādyadṛṣṭāṇūnāmapi ca karmatvāt karmapravartanābhyupagamāt

nanu ityanujñāpane, nanu tvaduktā evopapattayaḥ pratyekaṃ sarvaprāṇīśvaratvaṃ sādhayanti, bāhyādhyātmikasukhaduḥkhamohamātratvājjagataḥ sadasadvedyamohāntarāyabhedānāṃ sukhāditrayavipākaphalatvānativṛttestadātmasaṃvedyalakṣaṇatvāt karmaṇaḥ, sukhādisaṃvedanenaiva hi tatkāraṇabhūtaṃ karma svakāryeṇa phalena lakṣyate'numīyate sāmānyatodṛṣṭānumānena deśāntara- prāptyā iva ādityagatiḥ
ataḥ kāraṇe kāryasya sattvāt kārye kāraṇopacārāt sukhādayaḥ karma, annaprāṇatvavat
adṛṣṭaṃ dharmādharmākhyaṃ parairiṣṭameva karmeti, ātmāpi karma, katham ? taccādṛṣṭamātmano rāgādikarmavipākapariṇatyavasthasya prayogapariṇāmāt karmatāmāpannam
punarapi sukhād rāgādi, tataḥ punaḥ karma, tataḥ sukhādi phalam
tacca jīvapariṇāmātmasātkṛtakārmaṇayogyaparimāṇaparamāṇusamūha evātmasthamekībhūtaṃ cātmanā, yathoktam— yogaiḥ sakṛt svayogād mūrtaḥ san bāhyamarthamādatte
āttasya cānubhavanaṃ bandhaṃ prati sa ca tato'nanyaḥ

karma hi pratiprāṇi niyatakartṛkaṃ svavipākasukhāditvena saṃvedyam, tenāṇūnāmeva karmatvapariṇāmāpannānāmātmaikībhāvena vedanaṃ saṃvedanam, tena ca puruṣeṇa teṣāṃ tathā prayojanāt kartṛtvam, ataḥ sukhādyadṛṣṭāṇūnāmapi ca karmatvādityāha
prāk pratipāditaṃ hi dvyaṇukatryaṇukādisaṃyogaiḥ pṛthivyudakavrīhyaṅkurādiparivṛttirūpeṇātmanasteṣāṃ caikatvaṃ sarvasarvātmakatvaṃ ca
tasmāt karmakāraṇāṃ jagatpravṛttiṃ sādhayanti tvaduktā evopapattayaḥ
itaśca karmapūrvakaṃ jagat, karmapravartanābhyupagamāt sarvaprāṇinām, karmavaśādeva hi prāṇinaḥ śubhāśubhajātikularūpādyutkarṣāpakarṣāḥ
rāgādi phalaṃ phalādi tataḥ punaḥ karmaya॰
yogaiḥ sakṛt svayogād mūrtaḥ san bāhyamarthamādatte
āttasya cānubhavanaṃ bandhaṃ prati sa ca tato'nanyaḥ
sarvaprāṇināṃ kartṛtvāt kartureva bhavitṛtvābhyupagamāt tasyaiva bhavituśca prayojanāt sarveśvaratā
īśvarāttu karmaṇaḥ pravartanaṃ kiṃ sataḥ, asataḥ ? tadyadyabhūtasya tato'dvaitaṃ tasyāpi tadātmakatvāt
bhūtasya cet, prāgapi tadasti, tacca īśvarātmaiva tathābhūtestathāpravṛttestadāpatteḥ, tathāpi sutarāmadvaitam tadātmakatvādeva
atha yasmai pravartyate yathā tasmāt tarhi tat tathābhūtaṃ tadvaśāt tatheśvarapravṛtteḥ, tatastasya pravartane sa eveśvaraḥ
sa tathā kriyate tena na yathā svayamicchati

mā bhūvannakṛtābhyāgamakṛtapraṇāśakartrantaraphalasaṅkrāntyādayo doṣā iti sadasadācārāḥ prāṇina eva kartāro bhoktāraścābhyupagantavyāḥ, anyathā hitāhitaprāptiparihārārthānāṃ śāstrāṇāmānarthakyaprasaṅgāt

syānmatam--nanvīśvaraḥ prayoktṛtvāt kartetyuktam, netyucyate, tasyaiva bhavituśca prayojanāt, sarvaḥ prāṇī pratyekaṃ bhavitā prayojayati ātmanā ātmānaṃ svakṛtakarmavipākātmakarāgadveṣabhayagauravādidharmacoditaḥ

tasmāt tanvādipradhānāṇvādiṣu satsvapi pravartyeṣu teṣāmeva karmasādbhūtānāṃ prāṇināṃ bhavitṛtvāt tattadāpatteḥ sarvaprāṇināṃ svātantryāt karmavaśapreritakāryakāraṇabhāvena satatabhavanāt tathāpravartakasyaikaikasya sarvātmakatvāt sarveśvaratā iti sādhūktam
utpaśyatāmeva hi daivasiddhimutsāhinaṃ śrīrbhajate manuṣyam || iti
idānīṃ tvadiṣṭeśvarakāraṇatve tu doṣā ucyante --īśvarāt tvityādi

idaṃ cintyam--īśvarāt karmaṇaḥ pravartanaṃ kiṃ sataḥ, asataḥ ? kiṃ cātaḥ ? tadyadyabhūtasya karmaṇa īśvaraḥ pravartakaḥ tataścādvaitaṃ puruṣādivādavat prāptaṃ tasyāpi tadātmakatvāt karmaṇo'pīśvarātmakatvādīśvarasyaiva karmatvenotpatteḥ
bhūtasya cet, atha bhūtasya karmaṇa īśvarāt pravṛttistata etat prāptam --prāgapi tat karmāsti, kāraṇe kāryasya sattvāt
tacceśvarātmaiva, tanukaraṇādibhāvyavat tathābhūtestathāpravṛttestattadāpatterityādibhiryuktibhiḥ, tathāpi sutarāmadvaitaṃ tadātmakatvādeva puruṣāvasthāvadīśvarabhāvyatadātmakāṇvādibhavanavad vā
athācakṣīthāḥ--na tat karmeśvarātmakam, kiṃ tarhi ? yasmai prāṇine śubhamaśubhaṃ vā naranārakatiryagamaravicitrabhedarūpeṇa yena yena prakāreṇa pravartyate teneśvareṇa tattatprāṇyātmakaṃ taditi

atrocyate — tasmāt tarhi tat tathābhūtam, pratyekaṃ prāṇinaḥ kāraṇāt tasmāt tasmāt tathā tathā bhūtamityarthaḥ, atha tatkṛtamapi puruṣakārarājaprasādavadīśvarāpekṣaṃ pravartate, kṛtatāṃ prati tāvat svātantryaṃ siddhaṃ tasyaiva, tatkṛtaṃ hi karmaiva īśvaraprasādamutpādayati

tvadabhimateśvarastu yadi svatantraḥ karmānapekṣaśca pravartayati tataḥ pratipuruṣaniyāmakakarmābhāve'nupapannasthānavigrahendriyopabhogābhyudayapratyavāyāpavargādiviśeṣamidaṃ jagat syāt, tulyakāraṇatvāt, paṭatāntavatvavat
tadvaśāt tatheśvarapravṛtteḥ, tatastasya pravartane sa eveśvaraḥ, kṛtaṃ tvadiṣṭamīśvarākhyamātmavaśena tathā pravartayatastasya tasya prāṇina īśvaratvam, neśvarasya tathā pravartyatvāt karmakaravat
atha tatkṛtamapi puruṣakārarājaprasādavadīśvarāpekṣaṃ pravartate, kṛtatāṃ prati tāvat svātantryaṃ siddhaṃ tasyaiva, tatkṛtaṃ hi karmaiva īśvaraprasādamutpādayati

tvadabhimateśvarastu yadi svatantraḥ karmānapekṣaśca pravartayati tataḥ pratipuruṣaniyāmakakarmābhāve'nupapannasthānavigrahendriyopabhogābhyudayapratyavāyāpavargādiviśeṣamidaṃ jagat syāt, tulyakāraṇatvāt, paṭatāntavatvavat
atha matam--prāṇibhiḥ kṛtamapi karma īśvarakṛtameva, īśvaravaśāt pravartamānatvāt
tadyathā--dvayoḥ puruṣayostulyapuruṣakārayorapi rājā ekasyaiva prasīdati netarasyeti phalaṃ rājavaśena dṛṣṭaṃ na puruṣakarmavaśena tatheśvaravaśāt tatkarmapravṛttiriti
atrocyate --kṛtatāṃ prati tāvat svātantryaṃ siddhaṃ tasyaiva prāṇitoṣiteśvareṇa prāṇyanuṣṭheyakarmapratyayaprasādotpatteḥ, tatra ca rājño nimittamātratvāt

puruṣakṛtakarmajanyaprasādarājavadeva īśvarasyāpyanyatarapuruṣakṛtakarmapratyayaprasādotpādanāt karmasvātantryam, tatkṛtaṃ hi karmaiveśvaraprasādamutpādayati anyatareṇa kṛtaṃ netareṇetyarthaḥ, anyatarapuruṣakṛtakarmapratyayasyeśvaraprasādasya tenotpādyatvāt tasmāt puruṣakarmāpekṣatvādīśvarapravṛtteḥ karmaprādhānyaṃ pravṛttau phale ceti
syānmatam--rājavadeva karmaṇaḥ pravṛttau tatphaladāne ceśvaro'pekṣyatvāt pradhānaṃ kāraṇamiti
etacca na, yasmād dravyādipañcaketyādi yāvat pratyakṣavat
dravyaṃ kṣetraṃ kālaṃ bhāvaṃ bhavaṃ cāpekṣya hi karmaṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ kṛtānāṃ ca phalaṃ pratyakṣata upalabhyate
sa eva puruṣaḥ kartā dravyaṃ dātā deyaṃ vā dravyaṃ vastrasuvarṇādi
kṣetraṃ grāmanagarāraṇyaraṇabhūmyādi yatra tat prāpyate phalam
kālaḥ kasmiṃścit kāle divā rātrau pūrvāhṇe'parāhṇe sadyaścirādveti
atra prayogaḥ--paratrāpi prāṇikṛtaphalaṃ pratiniyatadravyādyapekṣam, sukhādikriyāyāḥ phalatvāt, dravyādipañcakāpekṣasevādiphalavat
tasmād dravyādipañcakāpekṣamapi karma phaladāne svatantraprāṇiniyateḥ pradhānam
atra prāṇino vineśvareṇa ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

astu tāvadīśvarasya svātantryaṃ karmānapekṣā ca tasya jagadutpādanārthaṃ pradhānādi pravartayataḥ, prāṇināṃ karmākāraṇatve tadanapekṣāyāṃ ca doṣa ucyate--tadyathā tataḥ pratipuruṣetyādi, puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ prati dravyādipañcakatvena niyāmakaṃ niyataṃ yadi karma na syāt īśvara evāviśiṣṭo hetuḥ syāt īśvarākhyasya kāraṇasyāviśiṣṭatvādaviśeṣaḥ syāt
kīdṛg viśeṣa iti cet, ucyate--sthānavigrahendriyopabhogalakṣaṇo viśeṣo na syāt
kasmāt ? tadviśeṣaheto anapekṣā ca kiṃ karmaṇaḥ sataḥ, asataḥ ? yadyasata eva, kim ? kriyāvilopaḥ
karmābhāve ca prāṇināṃ sadā muktatvāt tanvādisṛṣṭirīśvarasyānarthikā
atha tu vidyamānāveva dharmādharmau nāpekṣate sa tato'kṛtābhyāgamakṛtapraṇāśau doṣau syātām, ākṣīṇoditakarmāśayabandhamokṣābhyām
sa tu viśeṣo dravya-kṣetra-kāla-bhāva-bhavāpekṣaniyateḥ pratipuruṣaṃ ca niyāmake karmaṇi tatpañcakāpekṣavipāke sati viśiṣṭe syāt
dṛṣṭaśca so'smadabhīṣṭapratiniyatadravyādivipākakarmaprāṇigaṇeśvaratve sati yujyate--keṣāñcidabhyudayaḥ keṣāñcit pratyavāyaḥ keṣāñcidapavarga iti

atra prayogaḥ --anupapannasthānavigrahendriyopabhogābhyudayapratyavāyāpavargādiviśeṣamidaṃ jagat syāt, tulyakāraṇatvāt, paṭatāntavatvavat, yathā paṭastantukāraṇatvāviśeṣāt tāntavaḥ na mārtikaḥ sauvarṇo veti jātyākṛtivarṇādyaviśiṣṭastathedaṃ jagat syāt, na tu bhavati
anapekṣā ca kiṃ karmaṇaḥ sataḥ, asataḥ ? yadyasata eva, kim ? kriyāvilopaḥ
karmābhāve ca prāṇināṃ sadā muktatvāt tanvādisṛṣṭirīśvarasyānarthikā
atha tu vidyamānāveva dharmādharmau nāpekṣate sa tato'kṛtābhyāgamakṛtapraṇāśau doṣau syātām, ākṣīṇoditakarmāśayabandhamokṣābhyām
davvaṃ khittaṃ kālaṃ bhavaṃ ca bhāvaṃ ca saṃpappa
jātiḥ paṭatvam, ākṛtiḥ saṃsthānam, varṇo nīlādiḥ
abhyupetyāpi karmānapekṣāṃ tatra doṣaṃ brūmaḥ --anapekṣā cetyādi

kiñcātaḥ ? yadyasata eva dharmādharmayorasatorevānapekṣā, kimiti praśnaḥ, tataḥ kimiti cet, ucyate --kriyāvilopaḥ, asatorhi tayoḥ khapuṣpakharaviṣāṇayoriva kāpekṣā ? tataśca hitāhitaprāptiparihārārthāḥ sarvāḥ kriyā vilupyeran, iṣyante ca tāḥ, yasmāduktaṃ ca vaḥ śāstre--yogaṃ sādhayiṣyannityādi gatārthaṃ yāvad nidrātandrāpramādālasyarahitaśca syādityādi ityācāravidhāyigranthasmāraṇam
kiñcānyat, karmābhāve cetyādi yāvad nirmūlatā, akarmatvāt prāṇinaḥ sadā muktāḥ syuḥ

atha tu vidyamānāveva dharmādharmāvabhyudayapratyavāyaniḥśreyasakriyāyāṃ nāpekṣate sa īśvaraḥ svatantratvāt prayojanābhāvācca tayoḥ vidvadvyākhyānādikriyāsu balīvardānapekṣaṇavaditi manyase tato'kṛtābhyāgamakṛtapraṇāśau doṣau syātām
yāvatkṣīṇakarmaṇo'pi bandhābhyudayapratyavāyasambandhī akṛtābhyāgamaḥ syāt, kutaḥ ? dharmādharmanirapekṣatvāt svabhāvapuruṣādivādimatavat
uditātyantāśubhakarmāśayasya nārakāderapi muktyabhyudayasambandhī kṛtapraṇāśaḥ syāt dharmādharmanirapekṣatvāt puruṣasvabhāvādivādimatavadeva, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
atha karmāpekṣaḥ pravartate tatastānyeva karmāṇi īśvarāṇi, teṣāṃ tasyāpi tathā bhāvayitṛtvāt
na sa tāni tathā bhāvayati, tathā bhāvyamānatvāt, anāpannasyāsattvāt kharaviṣāṇavat, asvatantratvācchabdādivat
bhavati kartā svatantraḥ, tathā pravartanavṛttatvāt, tantupaṭavat
īśvarasyāpi ca karmaṇi vṛtteḥ sarva eva puruṣaḥ sannihitatadvidhaśaktiḥ prativiśiṣṭabuddhipramāṇīkṛtakriyaḥ svatantraḥ tathāpravṛttyāpatteḥ ā īśvarāt pravartayitṛtvāt
athaivaṃvidhāniṣṭāpattivyāvṛttyarthaṃ karmāpekṣaḥ pravartate iti manyase tatastānyeva karmāṇi kartṝṇi svatantrāṇi bhavitṝṇi īśvarāṇi

kasmāddhetoḥ ? teṣāṃ tasyāpi tathā bhāvayitṛtvāt, yasmāt tamapīśvaraṃ tena tena prakāreṇa bhavantaṃ bhāvayanti tānyeva karmāṇi, na sa tāni karmāṇi tathā bhāvayati, kutaḥ ? tathā bhāvyamānatvāt pradhānena śabdādivaditi vakṣyamāṇadṛṣṭāntatvāt
yathā ca pṛthivyudakādīn vrīhireva tathā bhāvayati pṛthivyādyapekṣo'pi tathāpatteḥ, na pṛthivyādayastathānāpatteḥ; evaṃ karmāṇyeveśvarāṇi tathā bhāvayitṛtvāt, na tvadiṣṭeśvarastathā bhāvyamānatvāditi
etaccāyuktam, teṣāmasattvāt, asattvaṃ ca anāpannasyāsattvāt khara- viṣāṇavaditi sannidhibhavanadūṣaṇe prakrāntameva nyāyaṃ darśayati

asvatantratvācchabdādivaditi eṣa dṛṣṭāntaḥ sarvatra pradhānakāraṇatvasādharmyeṇopāttaḥ kāpilān prati, yathā pradhānasvātantryāt tatkāraṇatvaṃ gamayati śabdādi ārātīyakāraṇatvābhāvaṃ cāsvātantryāt teṣāmiti nāvyaktamiti vyaktamityeva vā pradhānatā bhavatīti yathā tvayaivoktaṃ tathaiveśvaro'svatantratvāt karmāpekṣatvādakāraṇaṃ tānyeva kāraṇānīti gamayati tābhireva tvaduktābhirupapattibhiḥ
ato yaduktaṃ tvaduktā evopapattayaḥ sarvaprāṇīśvaratāṃ sādhayantīti tat sādhu
tadbhāvayannāha — bhavati kartetyādi prāgvyākhyātārthānyeva bhavatyekārthapadāni yāvat tantupaṭavaditi
yathā tantava eva paṭaniṣpādanena bhavantastathāpravartanavṛttatvāt paṭakāraṇāni tathā puruṣā eva kartāra iti
atra na vyaktamityavyaktamityeva vā ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
athavā nāvyaktamityeva vyaktamityeva vā ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
īśvarasyāpi cetyādi tāsāmevopapattīnāmitomukhatāṃ bhāvayati anenāpi granthena

yathā tvayā prāgupapāditaṃ bruvatā pūrvapūrvaśaktatāratamyena sannihitatadvidhaśaktirviśiṣṭabuddhiriti tathehāpi tābhirevopapattibhistaireva ca tantvaṃśvādibhirdṛṣṭāntaiḥ karmaṇi vṛtteḥ karmaniṣṭhatvāt sṛṣṭyatiśayaprakarṣasya karmaṇāṃ puruṣatvāt sarva eva puruṣaḥ sannihitatadvidhaśaktiḥ prativiśiṣṭabuddhipramāṇīkṛtakriyaḥ, prativiśiṣṭabuddhinā tenaiśvareṇātenaiveśvareṇānyaiśca śāstrakārairviśvadṛśvabhirapi pramāṇīkṛtāstatkriyāstatkriyāphalaparijñānārthatvācchāstrakāraprabhṛtīnāṃ siddhaśāstrāṇāmanatiśaṅkyatvācca

sa ca svatantraḥ, tathāpravṛttyāpatteḥ tena prakāreṇa karmiprāṇipravṛtti- vadīśvarasyāpi pravṛttyāpatteḥ, eśvarāt pravartayitṛtvāditi, ā īśvarāt yāvadīśvarastāvat pravartayitṛtvā kāraṇam, śaktimatpravṛttyapravṛttidarśanāt...paktrādivat, yāvadevamevāsya sarvatvāt sarvamūrtitā
karmāpekṣatve'pi neśvaravaiyarthyam, tadabhāve pravṛttyabhāvāt, dārvādyapekṣarathakāravaditi cet, na, itaratrāpi tulyatvāt
tadyathā--īśvarāpekṣatve'pi na karmavaiyarthyam, tata eva, rathakārāpekṣarathadāruvat
pravartayitṛtvācceśvarasya tathā pravartakaṃ karma, karmaṇaḥ puruṣaḥ, iti puruṣa eveśvaraḥ
yathā rathakāre upādānopakaraṇāsāmarthyavaikalyayoḥ dīśvarasya pravartyatvāt kāraṇāni sarvapuruṣāḥ

śaktimatpravṛttītyādi, īśvarasyāpi teṣāmeva śaktimatāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ śaktisākalyasannidhyasannidhyoḥ pravṛttyapravṛttidarśanāditi tadevopapattijātaṃ smārayati yāvat paktrādivaditi, ādigrahaṇād rajovat pravṛttivadityādi, pūrvavadeva granthaṃ cātidiśati --yāvadevamevāsyayāvadevamevāsya sarvatvāt sarvamūrtitā, evameva cāsya kṣityādyaṣṭamūrtitocyate ityetasmādavadherārātīyo granthaḥ sarvo draṣṭavyastābhirevopapattibhiḥ sarvaprāṇīśvaratve tadvadeveti

punarapi cotkarṣāpakarṣadarśanādityādirīśvarasargasādhanārtho granthaḥ pravṛttyanubhavaphaletyādistadvadeva yāvat puruṣādṛte'pravṛttereva utkarṣāpakarṣau na nirbījeśvarakāmacāreraṇāditi karmakāraṇatvārtho gatārthaḥ
karmāpekṣatve'pi neśvaravaiyarthyam, tadabhāve pravṛttyabhāvāt, dārvādyapekṣarathakāravaditi cet, na, itaratrāpi tulyatvāt
tadyathā--īśvarāpekṣatve'pi na karmavaiyarthyam, tata eva, rathakārāpekṣarathadāruvat
pravartayitṛtvācceśvarasya tathā pravartakaṃ karma, karmaṇaḥ puruṣaḥ, iti puruṣa eveśvaraḥ
yatra yadabhāve pravṛttyabhāvaḥ pravartakasya tatreśvarasyāpyavaiyarthyaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā rathakārapravṛttau rathārthaṃ dārvādyapekṣaṇamiti cenmanyase, tanna, itaratrāpi tulyatvāt
tat kathamiti cet, prayogata eva darśyate viparyayasiddhiḥ, tadyathā--īśvarāpekṣatve'pi na karmavaiyarthyam, tata eva hetoḥ, rathakārāpekṣarathadāruvaditi viruddhaikāntikaḥ

tacca pravartayitṛtvaṃ karmaṇaḥ siddhamuktavidhinā pravartyatvaṃ ceśvarasya, tathā pravartakaṃ karma, karmaṇaḥ puruṣaḥ pravartata iti prakṛtatvād gamyate, itiśabdo hetvarthe, tasmāt puruṣa eveśvaraḥ sarva iti
evaṃ karmeśvaratāpi tu, yathaivaṃ tathottaratra bhāvayiṣyate
kiñcānyat, pratihanyate ca tvadabhimateśvaraḥ sāpekṣapravṛttitvād rathakāravat
asya sādhanasya vyākhyā --yathā rathakāra ityādi, upādānaṃ dāru, upakaraṇāni vāsyādīni, teṣāmasāmarthyaṃ vaiguṇyaṃ satāmeva vaikalyaṃ tvanyatamābhāva eva, tatra pratighāto dṛṣṭaḥ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ

tathetyādi dārṣṭā pratighātastathā apacitakuśalamanujighṛkṣataḥ upacitakuśalaṃ copajighāṃsatastasya yadyapratighātaḥ syāt syāt svātantryam, na tu bhavati, puruṣakṛtakarmapratyayena īśvarapravṛttipratighātadarśanāt

yattūcyate--sargādau apratihatasvaśaktivaśādeva śarīrādīnyutpādya pratibuddhānāṃ prāṇināṃ dharmādharmamaryādāmupadiśati, madhyakāle ca teṣāṃ svamaryādānuṣṭhānānurūpeṇa phalena iṣṭenāniṣṭena vā anugrahaṃ karoti, ayamanugraha eva teṣāṃ tadṛṇamokṣaṇavat, mokṣamārgopasevinaśca sāyojyaṃ gamayati, antakāle ca śarīrendriyabhūtavat kuśalākuśale saṃhṛtya pralayakṣapāyāṃ svāpayati, yadapi cākāṅkṣyate tasya sarvajñatvaṃ sarvakāri- ntikam, sāpekṣapravṛttitvasādharmyānugamenopanayanaṃ rathakāre kāryam, vaidharmyeṇa tu darśayati --apacitakuśalamanujighṛkṣata ityādinā

puruṣamapacitaśubhakarmāṇamanugrahītumicchatastadviparītaṃ copahantumicchatastasyeśvarasya yadyapratighātaḥ syāt syāt svātantryam, na tu bhavati, apekṣyasya karmaṇaḥ svakṛtakarmavaśasya pratyayena tadvaśena īśvarasya pravṛttipratighātadarśanāt
na cedevamiṣyate, śubhakarmāṇaṃ duḥkhenetaraṃ ca sukhena yojayet
tathā ca akṛtābhyāgamakṛtapraṇāśau syātām ityuktam, tacca neṣṭam
tasmāt puruṣakarmapratyayena īśvarapravṛttipratighāto'sti, pravṛttipratighātācca naiśvaryaṃ tasya pratighātyatvāt pṛthagjanavadityanīśvaraḥ sa iti
pratighātastathā apacitakuśalamanujighṛkṣataḥ upacitakuśalaṃ copajighāṃsatastasya yadyapratighātaḥ syāt syāt svātantryam, na tu bhavati, puruṣakṛtakarmapratyayena īśvarapravṛttipratighātadarśanāt

yattūcyate--sargādau apratihatasvaśaktivaśādeva śarīrādīnyutpādya pratibuddhānāṃ prāṇināṃ dharmādharmamaryādāmupadiśati, madhyakāle ca teṣāṃ svamaryādānuṣṭhānānurūpeṇa phalena iṣṭenāniṣṭena vā anugrahaṃ karoti, ayamanugraha eva teṣāṃ tadṛṇamokṣaṇavat, mokṣamārgopasevinaśca sāyojyaṃ gamayati, antakāle ca śarīrendriyabhūtavat kuśalākuśale saṃhṛtya pralayakṣapāyāṃ svāpayati, yadapi cākāṅkṣyate tasya sarvajñatvaṃ sarvakāri-

tadyathā --sargādau dharmādharmavikalānāṃ śarīrendriyaviṣayotpādane nirapekṣo'pratihatasvaśaktivaśādeva śarīrādīnyutpādayati, tāṃścotpādya buddhānāṃ suptotthi- tānāṃ dharmādharmamaryādāmupadiśati tapodānayajñādi kuruta, mā kārṣṭa hiṃsānṛtasteyāgamyāgamanādīni iti, tayośca dharmādharmayoḥ sīmācchedena vyavasthāṃ maryādāmupadeśena vyavasthāpayati
madhyakāle ca teṣāṃ prāṇināṃ yathāsvaṃ dharmādharmamaryādāmanutiṣṭhatāmanuṣṭhānānurūpeṇa phaleneṣṭena aniṣṭena vā viṣayopabhogalakṣaṇenānugrahaṃ karoti yadā tadā sāpekṣo'pratihatasvaśaktivaśādeva
syānmatam--dharmānuṣṭhānaphalopabhogena iṣṭenānugraho yujyate, kathamadharmānuṣṭhānaphalopabhogenāniṣṭena yuktaḥ ? ityatrocyate --ayamanugraha eva teṣāṃ tadṛṇamokṣaṇāditi
tānātmanā saha yuṅkte iti sayuk, tadbhāvaḥ sāyojyaṃ teṣāmīśvarasādbhāvaḥ, taṃ gamayati nayati

punarapyantakāle ca śarīrendriyabhūtavat, yathā śarīrendriyāṇi bhūtākhyāṃśca viṣayānupasaṃharati tathā kuśalākuśale teṣāṃ dharmādharmāvapi saṃhṛtya tān puruṣān sargāhani saṃsṛtavatastena dharmādharmaphaleneṣṭāniṣṭopabhogātmakena divasavyāyāmapariśramābhibhūtān bālakān putrakāniva pitā sarvapuruṣān saṃsārahetubhūtadharmādharmānupasaṃhṛtya pralayakṣapāyāṃ svāpayatītyante'pi nirapekṣo'prati tvāt tadapi naiva, asyānarthakārthapravṛttabālādipravṛttivadajñakriyāsādharmyād dharmādharmopadeśapravṛtteranarthakārthaviṣayatvāt
yasyābhāve yasyābhāvo yasya ca bhāve yasya dhruvo bhāvastat kāraṇam, itarat kāryam
na ca dharmādyabhāve śarīrāderabhāvaḥ, sargādau śarīrādinirvṛttyabhyupagamāt
na ca dharmādibhāve dhruvaḥ śarīrāderbhāvaḥ, adattaphalakuśalākuśalasaṃhārādantakāle
yathā copadeśe'nabhijñatvaṃ tasya tathā prāṇināmapyanugrahakriyāyāmanugrahakriyāyā api yadā hatasvātantryaḥ sa eveṣṭaḥ
tasmādubhayathāpi apekṣyānapekṣya ca tadaiśvaryasiddheradoṣa eva doṣābhimatyā tvayodbhāvita iti parapakṣaḥ
yasyābhāve yasyābhāvo yasya ca bhāve yasya dhruvo bhāvastat kāraṇam, itarat kāryam
na ca dharmādyabhāve śarīrāderabhāvaḥ, sargādau śarīrādinirvṛttyabhyupagamāt
na ca dharmādibhāve dhruvaḥ śarīrāderbhāvaḥ, adattaphalakuśalākuśalasaṃhārādantakāle
atha sarvajñatvaṃ kathaṃ tasya siddhaṃ yenāsau niḥśreyasābhyudayakāmānāṃ bhaktiviṣayatāṃ yāyādityāha--sarvakartṛtvasiddhau cetyādi

iha hi yo yasya kartā bhavati sa tasyopādānādīni jānīte, yathā kulālaḥ kumbhādīnāṃ kartā tadupādānaṃ mṛtpiṇḍamupakaraṇāni ca cakrādīni prayojanamudakāharaṇādi kuṭumbinaṃ ca sampradānaṃ jānīta ityetat prasiddham, tatheśvaraḥ sakalabhuvanānāṃ kartā sa tadupādānāni paramāṇvādilakṣaṇāni tadupakaraṇāni dharmādharmadikkālādīni vyavahāropakaraṇāni sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyalakṣaṇāni sampradānasaṃjñākāṃśca puruṣān jānīte iti
yathā copadeśe'nabhijñatvaṃ tasya tathā prāṇināmapyanugrahakriyāyāmanugrahakriyāyā api yadā
atra vayaṃ brūmaḥ--tatkāritvāt tajjñatvamiti yat sarvajñatvamākāṅkṣyate tadapi naiva
karmaṇāmeva tannirapekṣa-- pravṛttau tasya pratighātādanaiśvaryaṃnaiśvaryam, sṛṣṭaprāṇisaṃsārakāle sargādyantayośca akṛtābhyāgamakṛtapraṇāśādidoṣāstadavasthā evetyaparihṛtadoṣatvād na kiñcidetat

anyo'pi ca doṣaḥ --yadapi cākāṅkṣyate tasya sarvajñatvaṃ sarvakāritvāt karaṇasya jñānāvinābhāvāt sarvaṃ cet karotyavaśyaṃ sarvamasau vettīti sarvakāritvāt sarvajña iti, tadapi naivopapadyate, asyānarthakārthapravṛttabālādipravṛttivadajñakriyāsādharmyādajño'sau bālavadasamīkṣitapravṛttitvādityetadanayā kalpanayāsmākaṃ tvayā pratyakṣīkriyate, kiṃ kāraṇam ? dharmādharmopadeśapravṛtteranarthakārthaviṣayatvāt, anarthakau dharmādharmāvarthau hyasya dharmādharmamaryādopadeśasya

na ca tayordharmādharmayoḥ śarīrādikāraṇatvam, vināpi dharmādharmamaryādayā sargādau prabhusṛṣṭeḥ śarīrādinirvṛttyabhyupagamāt, dharmādharmamaryādāyāṃ satyāmeva ca pralayakāle śarīrādyabhāvābhyupagamācceśvarasāmarthyādeva
kiṃ tat kāraṇalakṣaṇamiti cet, ucyate --yasyābhāve ityādi gatārthaṃ yāvaditarat kāryamiti

kathaṃ tadayoga iti cet, ucyate --na ca dharmādyabhāva ityādinā granthena tayoḥ kāraṇābhimatayorabhāve'pi śarīrādeḥ kāryasya bhāvaṃ bhāve'pi cābhāvamupadeśasāphalyānabhijñatvaṃ ca darśayati yāvadadattaphalakuśalākuśalasaṃhārādantakāle iti gatārthatvād na vivriyante'kṣarāṇi
kiñcānyat, yathā copadeśa ityādi yāvat kriyāyā api anabhijñatvamiti vartate
na kevalamupadeśānabhijñatvameva tasya, kiṃ tarhi ? prāṇināmanugrahakriyānabhijñatāpi iti tadatidiśati
evaṃ ca tat sādhveva yattvāśaṅkyate tvayā ādyantavad madhye'pi īśvaraprādhānyādīśvaravaśādeva pravṛttau phalasaṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ, tatprasaktau kriyāvilopaḥ, tataśca sarvanirmokṣaḥ sarvānirmokṣo vā iti

bhāvyate iti cet, ucyate --yadā tadedaṃ vyāmūḍhyaivetyādirbhāvanāgranthaḥ yāvadupabhogavibhājanānugraha- kriyayā'tigarīyasyā kimiti vartate ? tasmin hi kāle prāṇināmandhalakavat pravṛtterīśvarasyaiva teṣāṃ śarīrādyutpādayāmi, dharmādharmamaryādāṃ praṇayāmi, tatra pravartayāmi, tatphalairanubadhnāmi, tān prāṇinaḥ phalānurūpamiṣṭamaniṣṭaṃ copabhogaṃ vibhajyānugṛhṇāmi ityevamādikā yānugrahakriyā tayānugrahakriyayā kliśyamānasyānekapuruṣastrīnapuṃsakajanasādhāraṇasyeva bhṛtakasyātikleśaḥ
evaṃ ca tat sādhveva yattvāśaṅkyate tvayā ādyantavad madhye'pi īśvaraprādhānyādīśvaravaśādeva pravṛttau phalasaṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ, tatprasaktau kriyāvilopaḥ, tataśca sarvanirmokṣaḥ sarvānirmokṣo vā iti
kiñcānyat, anugraho'pi viparyayeṇocyate ananugraha eva san anugrahaḥ iti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? duḥkhahetuduḥkhātmakatvābhyām, duḥkhahetutvādiṣṭopabhogasya hiṃsādyātmano'rjana-rakṣaṇa-kṣaya-saṅgadoṣe duḥkhātmakatvācca aniṣṭopabhogasya, duḥkhātmakatvāccānanugraha evāsau
dṛṣṭāntaḥ --viṣakṛtabhojanakleśanavat, yathā kaścit krūramūrkhanṛpatiḥ svavaśān bhṛtyān viṣamiśramāhāraṃ bhojayan anugṛhṇāmi vaḥ iti brūyāt tathā tvadabhimateśvaro'pīti

yaccoktaṃ duḥkhamapi tadṛṇamokṣaṇavadanugraha eva iti, etadapyayuktam, saṃsāramocakavyādhacaṇḍālādimāritasattvānugrahaprasaṅgāt sattvanikāyakalikaluṣakṛtātmopanipātanena ajñābodhe sattvānugrahavadajñānaprasaṅgācca

tatsāyojyagamane'pyevam, īśvareṇa kila sāyojyaṃ mokṣaḥ, svātmanā sāyojyaṃ gamayannapyasau prāṇigaṇamatikleśabhājanameva karoti sṛṣṭasaṃsārakliṣṭeśvaratvasyoktalakṣaṇasyāmokṣaśabdābhidheyatvādalamaiśvaryeṇa mokṣeṇa ca tādṛśā sadā sarvapuruṣavyāpārodvahanāyāsātmanā

evaṃ ca tad yattvāśaṅkyate tvayā ādyantavadityādinā granthena vineśvareṇa kilaite doṣāḥ itīṣṭāste sahāpīśvareṇa tathaivaiva bhavantīti taddarśayannāha --sādhvevetyādi gatārthaṃ hetuhetumadbhāvapratipādanakrameṇa yāvat tatprasaktau kriyāvilopaḥ
kutaḥ ? īśvaraprādhānyāduktānantaradoṣācceti dharmādharmakriyāḥ prāṇināṃ na syuḥ phalābhāvādīśvaravaśādeva ādyantamadhyeṣu phalasaṅkarāt
tataśca sarvaprāṇināṃ nirmokṣaḥ niḥśeṣamokṣastadvaśādeva sarvānirmokṣo vā proktaproktaprāpta? iti

yattu sarvaśāstrakriyāvilopaparihārārthaṃ karmādyupasarjanatayā īśvaraprādhānyakāraṇye prokte ādau sa eva svaśaktita eva sākṣād vyāpriyate śarīrādyutpādane dharmādharmamaryādāṃ copadiśati, tadanu dhyānāt puṇyamutpādya dharmādharmamaryādāyāḥ paripālakān brahmādīnādhikārikān viniyuṅkte, ante ca dharmādharmau saṃhṛtya śarīrādivat kuśalākuśalāśayakalaṅkaśuddhaṃ svāpayati
idamanyathaivodgrāhyate īśvarakarmaṇoḥ pradhānopasarjanabhāvābhyupagamād dvaitam, bhāvyate tvanyathā sa eva svaśaktita eva ityavadhāraṇādadvaitārthabhāvanāt sākṣādevāprayojanena kasyacit
pratyupasaṃhriyate tu dvaitādvaite dve api tyaktvā
tataśca sargādau sthānādyātmake sukhaduḥkhe'pi na syātām, aniyataviṣayatvāt, pralayavat
katham ? iti tad bhāvayatyuttareṇa granthena --ādau sa eva svaśaktita evetyādinā yāvaccharīrādivat kuśalākuśalāśayakalaṅkaśuddhaṃ svāpayatīti gatārthaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ
dharmādharmamaryādāyāḥ paripālakān brahmādīnādhikārikān viniyuṅkte iti viśeṣaḥ
anyathā tāvat pratijñāyate īśvarakarmaṇoḥ pradhānopasarjanabhāvābhyupagamād dvaitam, bhāvyate tu sādhyahetuvyākhyānaṃ kriyate anyathā

kathamiti cet, sa eva svaśaktita evānyanirapekṣa ityavadhāraṇādadvaitārthabhāvanāt, adṛṣṭādīnāṃ tacchaktīnāṃ ca svato vyatiriktānāṃ nirāsena sākṣādevāprayojanena kasyacit kañcidapyanyamaprayojayan sākṣāt svaśaktita eva ityavadhārayatā cādvaitameva bhāvyate bhavatā
katamā sā bhāvanā iti cet, tadanu dhyānāt puṇyamutpādya ityeṣāpyadvaitabhāvanaiveti
evaṃ tāvat pratijñātaṃ dvaitam, advaitaṃ bhāvitamityuktam
pratyupasaṃhriyate tu dvaitādvaite dve api tyaktveti pratijñātabhāvite dvaitādvaite api tyaktvā
tatrādvaitasya tyāgastāvad dharmādharmamaryādāsthāpanavacanena kṛta iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
kā maryādā ? ucyate — maryādā nāma anatikramasthānamiti maryādālakṣaṇamāha

viṣayatastu sukhaduḥkhapravṛttisīmā, ityati viṣaye sukhamiyati duḥkhamiti dharmādharmayoḥ sīmani svake svake vyavasthāpanam, dharmasya sukhapravṛtticchedena adharmasya duḥkhapravṛtticchedena ayamasmādanyaḥ, ayamitarasmādanyaḥ iti sīmāvibhāgaḥsīmā vibhāgaḥ
tataḥ kimiti cet, tataśca sargādau sthānādītyādīti, sthānavigrahendriyaviṣayāḥ sthānādayaḥ, tadātmake sukhaduḥkhe'pi na syātām
kasmāt ? aniyataviṣayatvāt, aniyatau hi viṣayau tadā sukhaduḥkhayoḥ avidyamānasthānāditvādavidyamānadharmādharmatvācca
dṛṣṭāntaḥ --pralayavat, yathā pralaye dharmādharmābhāvādevāniyataviṣaye sukhaduḥkhe, tataścāsatī, tadvat sargādāvapi syātāmiti
kiñcānyat, ante ca syātām sukhaduḥkhe iti vartate
athocyeta--ata eva na sukhādipravartanātmikā dharmādharmamaryādā, kiṃ tarhi ? dharmo'yamadharmo'yamiti

dhāraṇāddhānādvā dharma ityarthasyābhāve kathamasau dharmaḥ, tadviparyayo vā kathamadharmaḥ ? atha tu tasya rucereva sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā tato dharmādharmamaryādāvacanamanarthakam, sadaiva īśvaraśaktimātravaśādeva yathā tathā yasya kasyacit siddheḥ, ādyantavat
athavā niyataviṣayavattvāt, vyavasthāpitadharmādharmamaryādatvāt sukhaduḥkhe tadā niyataviṣaye, tasmāt tadāpi syātāṃ madhyamakālavat sṛṣṭyuttarakālavadityarthaḥ
tadviparyayeṇa vā sādhanam --madhye vā na syātāṃ sukhaduḥkhe niyataviṣayatvāditi vartate, antavaditi
athocyeta--ata eva na sukhādipravartanātmikā dharmādharmamaryādā, kiṃ tarhi ? dharmo'yamadharmo'yamiti
dhāraṇāddhānādvā dharma ityarthasyābhāve kathamasau dharmaḥ, tadviparyayo vā kathamadharmaḥ ?
atha tu tasya rucereva sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā tato dharmādharmamaryādāvacanamanarthakam, sadaiva īśvaraśaktimātravaśādeva yathā tathā yasya kasyacit siddheḥ, ādyantavat
atra niyataviṣayatvāt ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt, dṛśyatāṃ paṃ॰ 16
syānmatam --ata eveśvarasyaiva kāraṇatvād na sukhādipravartanātmikā dharmādharmamaryādā tatsamarthanāsamarthetyarthaḥ, īśvarasyaiva sukhaduḥkhayoḥ pravartakatvāt

yadi sā na pravartayati sukhaduḥkhe dharmādharmamaryādā kimarthamasau tāṃ vyavasthāpayatīti cet, ucyate, svarūpasaṃjñāvyavasthāpanamasau tayorlokavyavahārārthaṃ karotītyata āha --kiṃ tarhi ? ayaṃ dharmo'yamadharma ityetāvadupadeśeneti
atrācārya uttaramāha --etadapi tulyaṃ pūrveṇa, asattvāt, sargādāvantavanna syātāmaniyataviṣayatvāt, ante ca syātāṃ niyataviṣayatvādvā madhyavat, madhye vā na syātāmantavaditīdameva doṣajālaṃ prāptam

kiṃ kāraṇam ? dhāraṇāddhānādvā dharma iti nirukteryadi maryādāṃ dhārayati prāṇināṃ sukhe caitān dhatte tato dharma ityetasyārthasyābhāve kathamasau dharma ucyate ? tadviparyayo vā kathamadharma iti tadviparītārthābhāve ? tasmāt sukhasthānādidhāraṇāddharmaḥ, sukhakāraṇaṃ hyavyabhicāri tadiṣyate, yasyābhāve yasyābhāvo yasya ca bhāve yasya dhruvo bhāvastat kāraṇamitarat kāryamiti kāraṇasya dharmasya kāryasya ca sukhasyāvyabhicārāt
syānmatam --tasyeśvarasya rucerevecchātaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā na dhāraṇadhāna- pravṛttyātmakatvāddharmasyānyasya vā kasyaciditi
atrocyate --dharmādharmamaryādāvacanamanarthakam, yaduktaṃ pratibuddhānāṃ prāṇināṃ dharmādharmamaryādāmupadiśyottarakālaṃ svamaryādānuṣṭhānānurūpyeṇa ityādi tat sarvamanarthakaṃ saṃvṛttam
tatsādhanārthaṃ hetumāha sadṛṣṭāntam --sadaivetyādi yāvad yasya kasyacit siddherādyantavaditi

sargasyādau madhye'vasāne ca sadaiva sarvakālamīśvaraśaktimātravaśādevānyasya kāraṇasyābhāve'pi yathā tathā yena vā tena vā prakāreṇa sukhasya duḥkhasya veṣṭāniṣṭaśarīrāderaniyamena yasya kasyacit mārakasyāhiṃsakasya vā siddherdharmādharmākāraṇatvam
sākṣādvyāpāro hyaiśvaryam, tasmāt tadavyāhatavṛtteḥ kiṃ dharmādinā, kimādhikārikaiḥ ? atha tairvinā śaktirvyāhanyate tasya tarhi vyāhataśaktitvāttvevamanīśvaratā itaravat

nanu pradhānopasarjanadvaitapratijñānāt tatsaṃvādena bhāvanārthaṃ sargādau sākṣādvyāpāra ucyate upasarjanena vināpi pradhānasya pravṛttisadbhāvāt citrācāryasyeva śiṣyeṇa vināpi tathā'dṛṣṭādyabhāve'pīśvarasya
na kevalamadvaitatyāga eva, kiṃ tarhi ? tathā dvaitamapi tyaktam

sākṣādvyāpāro hyaiśvaryam, tad vyācaṣṭe --tasmāt tadavyāhatavṛtteḥ tasya sarvaiḥ prakāraiḥ sarvakālaṃ sarvadeśe vā'vyāhatā vṛttirasya, atastadavyāhatavṛttitvāt kiṃ dharmādinā ? ādigrahaṇādadharmeṇa kim ? sthānavigrahendriyaviṣayairvā prāṇināṃ sukhaduḥkhāśrayaiḥ prāṇibhirvā kiṃ kriyate ? na kiñcidityabhiprāyaḥ
atha manyase tairvinā śaktirvyāhanyate tasyeśvarasya tatastarhyasya vyāhataśaktitvāt tvevamanīśvaratā kāryāntarāśakteḥ śramādvā itaravaditi pṛthagjanavadityarthaḥ
katham ? pradhānamupasarjanaṃ ca dvaitaṃ pratijñātam, tasyaivārthasya saṃvādeneśvaraḥ pradhānaṃ na karmetyetadbhāvanārthaṃ sargasyādau svaśaktitaḥ sa eva sākṣād vyāpriyate ityucyate
kasmāt ? upasarjanena vināpi pradhānasya pravṛttisadbhāvāt citrācāryasyeva śiṣyeṇa vināpīti

yathā śiṣyamapradhānaṃ grāhayitvā citrakarmāgrāhayitvā vā prāyeṇa tena vinā saha vā citrakarmaṇi citrakarācāryaḥ pravartata eva svaprādhānyāt sannidhyasannidhyorapi śiṣyasya pravartakatvādevamīśvaro'pyadṛṣṭādisannidhyasannidhyoḥ pravartate pradhānatvāditi bhāvyatvādudgrāhitadvaitānurūpabhāvanopasaṃhārātmakatvād na kaściddoṣa iti
ādiṃ karotyādikaraḥ, sa eva ca kartā, tasyaiva kartṛtvāt
ko'sāvādiriti cet, ucyate --avyajyamānaprakāravyaktirādiḥ, sata evārthasyāvyaktasya kenacit prakāreṇa vyaktirādiḥ
kutaḥ ? ādānāditi ādānamādiḥ ityakṣarārthaniruktimāha hetuṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ ca ādityodayāditvavaditi, yathā ādityasyodayamadhyāhnāstamayatvaprakāreṇa divasavibhāgānāṃ vidyamānānāṃ vyaktirevaṃ tatra
prayojanaparamārthatvād bhavitṛtvasya, yaḥ prayojayati paramārthataḥ sa kartā bhavitā ādikaratvaṃ ca yathā vrīhau sambhāvyate, avrīhermṛdādervrīhitvena ādikaratvāt
tathā prāk pṛthivyādīnāmapyādikaratvaṃ paścādapi tathā, tadāditvād vrīheḥ tathābhivyakteḥ tatprayuktatvāt
kasmāt pṛthivyeva na bhūto vrīhiḥ ? ko vā bravīti pṛthivī na bhūta udakādiśca vrīhiriti vrīhyādi vā pṛthivyādi na bhūtamiti, tatprayuktatvāt ? itaścetaśca tadātmakatvāt tadavyatiriktatvāt tat tadeva
bhūkṛñoḥ sarvadhātvarthatvāt, na prayojyaḥ, ityasmāt kāraṇād ya ādikaraḥ sa kartā, yaśca kartā sa bhavati, bhūkṛñoḥ sarvadhātvarthavyāpitvāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yataḥ prakārāntareṇābhivyañjayan bhāvāntarasyādikaratvād bhavati vastu tata ekaikasya sarvatvam, na sarvasyaikatvaṃ parasparāpekṣābhivyañjanenādikaratvāditi
ādikaratvaṃ ca yathā vrīhau sambhāvyate, avrīhermṛdādervrīhitvena ādikaratvāt
tathā prāk pṛthivyādīnāmapyādikaratvaṃ paścādapi tathā, tadāditvād vrīheḥ tathābhivyakteḥ tatprayuktatvāt
kasmāt pṛthivyeva na bhūto vrīhiḥ ? ko vā bravīti pṛthivī na bhūta udakādiśca vrīhiriti vrīhyādi vā pṛthivyādi na bhūtamiti, tatprayuktatvāt ? itaścetaśca tadātmakatvāt tadavyatiriktatvāt tat tadeva
asmiṃścārthe vyāpakaṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha sphuṭīkaraṇārtham --ādikaratvaṃ ca yathā vrīhau sambhāvyata iti

tadvyākhyā --avrīhermṛdādervrīhitvenādikaratvāditi, mṛtsalilavātākāśānāmavrīhīṇāṃ vrīhiprakāreṇābhivyaktiṃ kurvan vrīhirādikaraḥ, etamarthaṃ hetutvena vyāpārayati siddhaṃ kṛtvā pañcamyā vrīhitvenādikaratvāditi

tathā prāgityādi, evaṃ ca kṛtvā vrīhitvāt prāgapi pṛthivyabvāyvākāśānāmapyādikaratvaṃ paścādapi tena prakāreṇa tathā vrīhivadeva, tadāditvād vrīheḥ, te ādiḥ pṛthivyādayo vrīheḥ prāk paścācceti teṣāmādikaratvam tena prakāreṇābhivyakteḥ
kiñcānyat, tatprayuktatvād vrīheḥ, te hyasya prayoktāraḥ, yo yasya prayoktā sa tasya kartā yathā ādityodayāditvamityata āha--tatprayukto vrīhiḥ
kasmāt pṛthivyeva na bhūto vrīhiḥ, pṛthivyeva udakameva vāyureva vā ākāśameva vā, tatprayuktatvāt ādikaratvādādityodayāditvavat ? iti

atrocyate --ko vā bravīti--pṛthivī na bhūta udakādiśca vrīhiriti tatprayuktatvāt vrīhyādi vā pṛthivyādi na bhūtamiti tatprayuktatvāt ? vrīhirapi pṛthivyabvāyvākāśādi bhavati, pṛthivyudakavāyvākāśādyapi ca vrīhimāṣāmrajambvādi bhavati, tatkṛtāhāro'pi pṛthivyādi vrīhyādi; pṛthivyādyapi tatkṛtāhāraḥ, tatkṛtāhāraśarīrendriyabuddhyādi tatkṛtamanuṣyatiryaṅnārakadevādi ca, tatkṛtāhāravrīhipṛthivyādi ca tatkṛtāhāraśarīrendriyabuddhimanuṣyādi sarvaṃ parasparataḥ sarvātmakaṃ bhavati, tatprayuktatvāt tathābhivyaktestadādikaratvādityādihetubhiḥ
diṅmātrapradarśanārthaṃ tadvyāpitvapradarśanārthaṃ cāha --itaścetaśceti, yadi vrīhito vrīherādikaratvam atha pṛthivyāditaḥ pṛthivyāderādikaratvamiti tānyevodāharaṇāni
tata āha --tadātmakatvāt tadavyatiriktatvāt tat tadeveti tasya tasya prakārasya hetutvaṃ dṛṣṭāntatvaṃ ceti
puruṣaḥ karmayogyānāṃ pudgalānāṃ karmatvena ādikaraḥ, tathāvidhopayogagateḥ prayojanaparamārthatvād bhavitṛtvasya
tadapi ca karma ādikaram, bāhyamapi ghaṭādi ādikaram
evaṃ dṛṣṭāntabhūtaṃ prastutanyāyaprasādhitaṃ sarvasarvātmakavādaṃ prathayitvā dārṣṭāntikaṃ puruṣakarmavādamīśvarakāraṇanirākaraṇāyāha --puruṣakarmasvapyevamevetyādi
puruṣaḥ kartā karmayogyānāṃ pudgalānāṃ karmatvena ādikaraḥ
