ke karmayogyāḥ pudgalāḥ ? ucyate--paramāṇuvargaṇā agrahaṇavargaṇā, agrahaṇavargaṇā dvipradeśavargaṇā, evaṃ daśapradeśādisaṅkhyeyapradeśavargaṇāḥ
grahaṇayogyāyogyatvaṃ cātisthūlasūkṣmāyogyatvāt svedeneva paramāṇuśarkarāṇāṃ, yogyatvācca madhyamaparimāṇānām
tatra yā grahaṇayogyāḥ pudgalato vargaṇāḥ tāśca mānena siddhānāmanantatamabhāgaḥ abhavyasiddhīnāmanantaguṇāḥ
taduparyekaparamāṇau prakṣipte dvitīyāpyaudārikayogyā evamekaikavṛddhānyanantānantāni sthānāni audārikakāraṇatvena grahaṇayogyāni

jaghanyādutkarṣasthānamasaṅkhyeyaguṇam, yasmāt paramparopanidhayā prathamasthānādārabhyānantasthāneṣu teṣu teṣu dviguṇatā bhavati tasmādasaṅkhyaguṇaṃ saṅkhyeyaguṇaṃ vā, anantaropanidhayā tu rūpādhikameva
evaṃ rūpādhikavṛddhyā tānyapyanantānantāni sthānāni pūrvavat, jaghanyādutkṛṣṭamasaṅkhyeyaguṇam, ko guṇakāraḥ ? śreṇyasaṅkhyatamabhāgaḥ
audārikaśarīrayogyebhyo vaikriyaśarīrayogyānyasaṅkhyeyaguṇāni, tato'saṅkhyeyaguṇānyāhārakayogyāni, tāvadasaṅkhyeyaguṇāni grahaṇāgrahaṇāni pūrvasmāt pūrvasmāt
taduparyāhārakotkṛṣṭe rūpe prakṣipte jaghanyamagrahaṇaṃ taijasasya, jaghanyādutkṛṣṭamanantaguṇam, ko guṇakāraḥ ? abhavyebhyo'nantaguṇaḥ siddhānāmanantatamabhāgaḥ
antaraṃ tu grāhyāṇāṃ jaghanyādutkṛṣṭo viśeṣādhikaḥ sarvatra, ko viśeṣaḥ ? tasyaivānantabhāgaḥ
agrāhyāṇāṃ tu jaghanyādutkṛṣṭo'nantaguṇaḥ, ko guṇakāraḥ ? siddhānāmanantatamabhāgaḥ abhavyebhyo'nantaguṇaḥ

evaṃ- vidhaiḥ pudgalaiḥ sarvatra loke'vagāḍhagāḍhanicite karmatayā pariṇamayya tadyogyān kāyavāṅmanaḥkarmalakṣaṇānāṃ trayāṇāṃ yogānāṃ kāyayogena gṛhṇāti tenaiva kārmaṇaśarīratayā pariṇamayati puruṣaḥ svavīryeṇa yogākhyena, vāṅmanaḥprāṇāpānatayā pariṇamayya kāyayogenaiva vāṅmanaḥprāṇāpānatayālambya visṛjati
yathoktam— jogehi tadaṇurūvaṃ pariṇamayati geṇhitūṇa paṃcataṇū
karmapra॰ gā॰ 17 tathā manasā vācā kāyena vāpi yuktasya vīryapariṇāmaḥ
jīvasyātmani yaḥ khalu sa yogasaṃjño jinairdṛṣṭaḥ
yathoktam— ūṣmaguṇaḥ san dīpaḥ snehaṃ vartyā yathā samādatte
ādāya śarīratayā pariṇamayati cāpi taṃ sneham
yathā cātmani akarmaṇāṃ karmatvena ādikaratvaṃ tathā karmaṇāmapi ātmana ādikaratvaṃ tathābhivyakteḥ tatprayuktatvāt
kasmāt ātmaiva na karmabhūtaḥ ? ko vā bravīti na karmabhūto'sau karmāṇi cātmabhūtāni neti tathāvidhopayogagatestatprayuktatvāt...
rūkṣayati ruṣyato nanu vaktraṃ snihyati ca rajyataḥ puṃsaḥ
tasmādātmā kartā karaṇayuktaḥ karmatvena ādikaraḥ, pūrvavat prayojanaparamārthatvād bhavitṛtvasya

kimātmaivādikaraḥ ? netyucyate, tadapi ca karma ādikaram, tadapi ca jñānāvaraṇādikarma grahaṇayogyamaudārikādiśarīrabhedādivipākaṃ pudgalaḥ, kiṃ bhavati ? naranarakadevatiryaggatisaṅgrahabhavanavāsyādyanekaprabhedasarvātmaśarīrāṇāṃ tatsambaddhātmanāṃ cādikaraṃ bhavati
na kevalamādhyātmikamevādikaram, kiṃ tarhi ? bāhyamapi ghaṭādi ādikaraṃ sarvādikaram

āha--kimarthaṃ punaretā vargaṇāḥ prarūpyante ? ucyate--kucikarṇasya gomaṇḍalādhipatergāvastāsāṃ parasparaṃ viśeṣasya yadupalakṣaṇaṃ parijñānaṃ tadaupamyāt taddṛṣṭāntād vineyānāmasaṃmohārthaṃ dravyādivargaṇābhiḥ, ādiśabdāt kṣetravargaṇābhiḥ kālavargaṇābhiḥ bhāvavargaṇābhiśca samastamapi pudgalāstikāyaṃ vibhajya tīrthakaragaṇadharādayaḥ pradarśayanti iti gāthākṣarārthaḥ
atha bhāvārtha ucyate--iha bharatakṣetre magadhajanapade prabhūtagomaṇḍalasvāmī kucikarṇo nāma gṛhapatirāsīt
sa ca tāsāṃ gavāmatibahutvāt sahasrādisaṅkhyāparimitānāṃ pṛthak pṛthaganupālanārthaṃ prabhūtān gopālāṃścakre
te ca tāsu parasparaṃ mīlitāsu goṣu ātmīyā ātmīyāḥ samyagajānantaḥ santo nityaṃ kalahamakārṣuḥ

tāṃśca tathānyonyaṃ vivadamānānupalabhyāsau teṣāmavyāmohārthaṃ kalahavyavacchittaye śuklakṛṣṇaraktakarburādibhedabhinnānāṃ gavāṃ pratigopālaṃ sajātīyagosamudāyarūpā bhinnā vargaṇā vyavasthāpitavāniti eṣa dṛṣṭāntaḥ
athopanaya ucyate--iha gomaṇḍalaprabhukalpastīrthakaro gopatulyebhyaḥ svaśiṣyebhyo gosamūhasamānaṃ pudgalāstikāyaṃ tadasaṃmohārthaṃ paramāṇvādivargaṇādivibhāgena nirūpitavāniti
bindunā bindunā hanta bhriyate hi sarovaram
bhavyā mama na te bhavyā ityayudhyanta te bahiḥ
kṛṣṇāḥ kasyāpi kasyāpi raktāḥ pītāśca kasyacit
bhuñjāno dadhipayasī so'vasat teṣu ca kramāt
anvahaṃ vardhayāmāsa goṣṭhe goṣṭhe sa godhanam
hā dhenavo hā navatarṇakāśca hā śākvarāḥ vaḥ kva kadā ca lapsye
pāugge vālaṃbati bhāsāṇamaṇattaṇe khaṃdhe || karmapra॰ gā॰ 17

svakīyayogānurūpaṃ karmadalamiha asmiṃlloke nirantaraṃ vyavasthitaṃ svapradeśaiḥ gṛhītvā jīvāḥ pariṇamayanti svapradeśairekīkurvanti, yathā mṛtparamāṇavaḥ payāṃsi tadgatāḥ pūrpakaparamāṇavo ghṛtādyātmani sthāpayantītyarthaḥ

bhāṣānapānamanasa ucitaṃ ca dravyajātaṃ vargaṇārūpamavalambayanti yogānurūpameva, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? bhāṣāyogyaṃ dravyamavalambya jīvaḥ pradeśaistato bhāṣāṃ visṛjati, yathā mandaśaktiḥ kareṇa yaṣṭimavalambya bhramati, nadyāṃ vā alābvādi gṛhītvā tarati, kūpādvā rajjamavalambya samuttarati
evamānapānamapi, tatpudgalāvaṣṭambhato jīvaḥ pradeśaiḥ svayogānurūpaṃ visṛjati, manoyogyāni dravyāṇyavalambya svapradeśaistataḥ svaśaktyanurūpaṃ cintayatīti gāthārthaḥ
manasā vācā kāyena vāpi yuktasya vīryapariṇāmaḥ
āha ca--maṇasā vayasā kāeṇa vā vi juttassa vīriyapariṇāmo
jīvassa appaṇi jo sa jogasanno jiṇakkhāo
manasā karaṇena yuktasya jīvasya yogo vīryaparyāyo durbalasya yaṣṭikādravyavadupaṣṭambhakaro manoyogaḥ,...evaṃ vāgyogo'pi, evaṃ kāyayogo'pi
jīvasyātmani yaḥ khalu sa yogasaṃjño jinairdṛṣṭaḥ
kārikeyaṃ samuddhṛtā siddhasenasūriviracitāyāṃ tattvārthasūtraṭīkāyām, a॰ 7, pṛ॰ 70
ūṣmaguṇaḥ san dīpaḥ snehaṃ vartyā yathā samādatte
ādāya śarīratayā pariṇamayati cāpi taṃ sneham
yathā cātmani akarmaṇāṃ karmatvena ādikaratvaṃ tathā karmaṇāmapi ātmana ādikaratvaṃ tathābhivyakteḥ tatprayuktatvāt
kasmāt ātmaiva na karmabhūtaḥ ? ko vā bravīti na karmabhūto'sau karmāṇi cātmabhūtāni neti tathāvidhopayogagatestatprayuktatvāt...
svayogavartyā iti siddhasenasūribhistattvārthasūtraṭīkāyāmuddhṛtāyāmasyāṃ kārikāyāṃ pāṭhaḥ, a॰ 5, pṛ॰ 343
rūkṣayati ruṣyato nanu vaktraṃ snihyati ca rajyataḥ puṃsaḥ
iti malayagirisūribhiruddhṛttāyāmasyāṃ kārikāyāṃ pāṭhaḥ prajñāpanāsūtravṛttau, pṛ॰ 455
iti malayagirisūribhiḥ prajñāpanāsūtravṛttāvuddhṛtāyāmasyāṃ kārikāyāṃ pāṭhaḥ, pṛ॰ 455
poggalakammaṇimittaṃ jīvo vi taheva pariṇamati || iti

viparyayeṇāpi bhāvayitukāma āha --yathā cātmani akarmaṇāmityādi pūrvavat sacodyaparihāraṃ gatārthaṃ yāvat ko vā bravīti na karmabhūto'sau karmāṇi cātmabhūtāni neti tathāvidhopayogagatestatprayuktatvādityādibhirhetubhiḥ
tasmāt sarvasarvātmakatvāt ko'nya īśvaraḥ ? kā vānyā prakṛtiḥ ? iti

kāraṇamāha --acetanajñānāvaraṇetyādi, acetanāni jñānadarśanāvaraṇavedyamohāyurnāmagotrāntarāyākhyāni saprabhedāni karmāṇi pudgalātmakānyatyudīrṇānyapyātmano'kṣarānantatamabhāgamupayogasvābhāvyād nāvṛṇvanti, śeṣaṃ keṣāñcidāvṛṇvanti ekendriyanigodasūkṣmāparyāptakādīnām, karmaṇāṃ kṣayopaśamavaicitryāt
athaivaṃ neṣyate tato naivātmā badhyeta karmaṇā tatphalabhūtaiśca tanvādibhirna yujyeta vikarmatvād muktavat
prakṛtīśvarādisṛṣṭivaśādeva na badhyeta na yujyeta ca tanvādibhiḥ, amūrtatvāt, ākāśavat
savvajīvāṇaṃ pi ya ṇaṃ akkharassa aṇaṃtatamo bhāgo ṇiccugghāḍitao
taṃ pi jadi āvarijjejja teṇa jīvo ajīvataṃ pāve
suṭṭhu vi mehasamudae hoi pabhā caṃdasūrāṇaṃ
nandīsū॰ 42 tathāṃ svalpaṃ rajo hi kaluṣaṃ ca nabhaḥ karoti rāhurgṛṇoti śaśinaṃ balavāṃśca somaḥ
paṅko vināśayati vāriguṇaprakṛṣṭiṃ doṣā muhūrtarabhasā balavān svabhāvaḥ
kevalinastu vigatasarvāvaraṇavighnamohatvād yadyapyupayogāvaraṇābhāvāt tathāvidhopayogagatirasiddhā tathāpi vedyāyurnāmagotrakarmacatuṣkatatprayuktatvādihetusadbhāvādanyonyādikaratvaṃ siddham

etanna, kasmāt, pālanapūraṇapuruṣatvāt, pṛpālanapūraṇayoḥ pā॰ dhā॰ 1086, pālayati sukhaduḥkhādivipākāṃstāṃstān pudgalānātmabhāveneti pālyate taistathāvidhopayogagatyeti vā puruṣaḥ, pūrayati tāṃstaiḥ pūryata iti vā puruṣaḥ
pumāṃsaṃ gilati puṃsā vā gilyata iti pudgalaḥ, pūraṇād galanād vā pudgala iti niruktibhede'pyarthaikyāt puruṣapudgalaśabdayorindraśakravadekārthatvādadoṣaḥ
athaivaṃ neṣyate tato naivātmā badhyeta karmaṇā tatphalabhūtaiśca tanvādibhirna yujyeta vikarmatvād muktavat
prakṛtīśvarādisṛṣṭivaśādeva na badhyeta na yujyeta ca tanvādibhiḥ, amūrtatvāt, ākāśavat
savvajīvāṇaṃ pi ya ṇaṃ akkharassa aṇaṃtatamo bhāgo ṇiccugghāḍitao
ṇāṇaṃ tu akkharaṃ jeṇa kharati ṇa kayāi taṃ tu jīvāto
tassa u aṇaṃtabhāgo na varijjati savvajīvāṇaṃ
yena kāraṇena na kadācidapi tad jñānaṃ jīvāt kṣarati bhraṃśamupayāti tena kāraṇena jñānamakṣaramucyate
kathametadavasīyate na kadācidapi jñānaṃ jīvāt kṣarati iti ? ata āha--tasya akṣarasya anantabhāgo'tiprabalenāpi jñānāvaraṇodayena saṃsārasthānāṃ sarvajīvānāṃ nāvriyate
uktañca--savvajīvāṇaṃ pi ya akkharassa aṇaṃto bhāgo ṇiccugghāḍio nandīsū॰ 42 iti
kena punarācchādyate yena jñānasyānantabhāgo nityāpāvṛtaḥ ? ityāha--ekkekko jiyadeso nāṇāvaraṇassa huṃta'ṇaṃtehiṃ

jinān kevalajñānino muktvā śeṣāṇāṃ sarvajīvānāmekaiko jīvapradeśo jñānāvaraṇīyasya karmaṇo'nantaiḥ avibhāgaiḥ avibhāgaparicchedaiḥ, yeṣāṃ tato'pyadho vibhāgaḥ kartuṃ na śakyate te'vibhāgaparicchedāḥ, tairāvṛtaḥ
yadyevaṃ kathamanantabhāgo jñānasya nityāpāvṛtaḥ ? ityāha--jati puṇa so vi varijjejja teṇa jīvo ajīvayaṃ gacche
suṭṭhu vi mehasamudae hoti pabhā caṃdasūrāṇaṃ

yathā suṣṭhu atiśayenāpi meghasamudaye jāte tathāsvabhāvatvāt candrasūryāṇāṃ prabhā bhavati tathā pratyakṣata upalabdheḥ, evamekaikasya jīvapradeśasya anantairjñānāvaraṇāvibhāgaparicchedairāvaraṇe'pi tathāsvabhāvatvād jñānasyānantabhāgo nityoddhāṭita eva
yadi punaḥ so'pyāvriyeta tata ekāntato niścetanatvājjīvaḥ ajīvatāṃ gacchet ajīvo bhūyāt, ghaṭavat
taṃ pi jadi āvarijjejja teṇa jīvo ajīvataṃ pāve
suṭṭhu vi mehasamudae hoi pabhā caṃdasūrāṇaṃ || nandīsū॰ 42
svalpaṃ rajo hi kaluṣaṃ ca nabhaḥ karoti rāhurgṛṇoti śaśinaṃ balavāṃśca somaḥ
paṅko vināśayati vāriguṇaprakṛṣṭiṃ doṣā muhūrtarabhasā balavān svabhāvaḥ

athaivaṃ neṣyate yathā mayoktaṃ karmakarmiṇoranyonyādikaratvaṃ yadi na syāt īśvaravaśāt, svabhāvādeḥ prakṛtyādervā kutaścit saṃsāravaicitryaṃ syāditīṣyate tato naivātmā badhyeta karmaṇā saṃsārabījabhūtena śubhāśubhena, tataśca tatphalabhūtaiḥ śarīrendriyasthānaviṣayaiḥ śubhāśubhairna yujyeta vikarmatvād muktavat
yadi tvadṛṣṭābhāve'pyasāvīśvarastataste muktānāmapi tanvādīni asau kuryāt, īśvaratvāt, sargādivat
evaṃ ca kṛtvā tadapi sarvamasambaddhaṃ yat karmakāraṇaikāntina āhuḥ
ta itthamāhuḥ--yadi pravartayitṛtvāt puruṣakāraḥ kāraṇaṃ syāt tataḥ pradhānamadhyamā- mukto vā badhyeta, tata eva, tadvat
tadapi nopapadyate, prakṛtīśvarādisṛṣṭivaśādeva na badhyeta tanukaraṇādibhiḥ, na yujyeta bhuvanena ca, amūrtatvādākāśavat
ākāśaṃ vā badhyeta yujyeta ca tanvādibhiḥ, tata eva, tvadabhimatapuruṣa iva
yadi tvadṛṣṭābhāve'pyasāvīśvarastataste muktānāmapi tanvādīni asau kuryāt, īśvaratvāt, sargādivat
evaṃ ca kṛtvā tadapi sarvamasambaddhaṃ yat karmakāraṇaikāntina āhuḥ
ta itthamāhuḥ--yadi pravartayitṛtvāt puruṣakāraḥ kāraṇaṃ syāt tataḥ pradhānamadhyamā-

tanna ceditthamādikaratvamicchasi tato'pi tvadanuvṛttyābhyupagate'pyadṛṣṭākhyakarmābhāve'pi mayā doṣa ucyate --asāvīśvarastataste muktānāmapi abhūtatathāvidhahetūnāmakarmaṇāṃ tanukaraṇāni bhuvanāni cāsau kuryāt, īśvaratvāt, sargādivat
tathā pralayakāle'pi sarveṣāṃ kuryāt, tata eva, tadvat
madhye vā na kuryāt, īśvaratvāt, pralayakālavat
karmātmaikyasarveśvaratvābhyām, aṇava eva karma, ta eva sukhādayaḥ,
tasmādadṛṣṭāt sṛṣṭiḥ pradhānāt sṛṣṭiḥ pṛthagaṇubhyo'dṛṣṭacoditebhyo vā sṛṣṭiḥ iti vādāntaraparikalpaṃ tyaktvā asmaduktakarmātmaikyasarvasarvātmakasarveśvaratvābhyupagamo'vaśyambhāvī

ekatvāt kasya dvitīyasya kena saha sambhūyaikārthakāritā ? kiṃ tadacetanaṃ cetanāt pṛthagbhūtam ? satatasampravṛttapūraṇa-pālana-galana-puṃgaraṇādidharmatvācca kā sthitvā pravṛttiḥ ? ityasiddhārthatvād viśiṣṭacetanādhiṣṭhitatvaṃ tanvādīnāṃ na sādhayitumalamiti
yadapi viśeṣyoktaṃ mithaḥ pratyanīkasambhūyaikārthakāritvāditi tadasattvaṃ tu pūrvoktameva ṇicchayato savvalahumityādigāthayā

kathaṃ punaste karmaikāntavādina āhuḥ ? kathaṃ vā tadasambandhaḥ ? ityatastatpradarśanārthaṃ tāvat puruṣakāraṃ nirākurvantaḥ karma samarthayantaḥ ta itthamāhuriti tadupapattīrdarśayati, yathā --yadi pravartayitṛtvāt puruṣakāraḥ kāraṇaṃ syāditi puruṣakāra eva kāraṇaṃ na karmāpīti cenmanyasa ityekāntaṃ sūcayati tata idamaniṣṭaṃ puruṣakārakāraṇaikāntinaste prāptam
katamadaniṣṭam ? ucyate --pradhāna dhamabhinnāḥ siddhayo'siddhayo vā nānā na syuḥ, utkarṣārthikāraṇaikatvāt
saprabhedāstāḥ siddhayo'siddhayaśca nānājātīyā na syuḥ, avyatiriktakāraṇatvāt, tulyatantupaṭavat
cetanāmātrasāro hi puruṣakāraḥ śaktiḥ, na ca sa paśutve vartamāno manu- madhyamādhamabhinnāḥ siddhayo'siddhayo vā nānā na syuḥ, tāśca dṛṣṭāḥ, na hi dṛṣṭād gariṣṭhamanyat pramāṇamasti

kasmānnānā na syuriti cet, ucyate --utkarṣārthikāraṇaikatvāt, ātmotkarṣārthī puruṣa eva kāraṇaṃ na karmāpi kāraṇamiti puruṣakārakāraṇaikāntavādamāśaṅkate, puruṣakārasyaikatvamutkarṣārthipuruṣakāraikatvam, utkarṣārthinaḥ puruṣasya kriyā kāraḥ, tasyaikatvāt pradhānamadhyamādhamabhedabhinnāḥ svācāradurācāravikalpadvayaprabhedakṛtā lokaprasiddhāḥ puruṣakārā na sidhyanti, eka evotkṛṣṭaḥ prāpnoti
tataśca tatsādhyānāmapi phalabhūtānāṃ pradhānamadhyamādhamānāṃ śubhāśubhānāṃ bhedā na prāpnuvanti, ekaivotkṛṣṭā siddhiḥ prāpnoti, na madhyamādhame sabhede siddhī syātām

nāpi ca puruṣakārāṇāmasiddhayaḥ syuḥ, tāśca dṛṣṭā iti tadupasaṃhṛtya sādhanamāha --saprabhedāstāḥ siddhayo'siddhayaśca nānājātīyā na syuravyatiriktakāraṇatvāt tulyatantupaṭavaditi puruṣakārasyaiva kāraṇatvāt tadvyatiriktakāraṇābhāvād bhavataḥ puruṣakāraikāntavādinaḥ karmānapekṣatvāditi
dhamabhinnāḥ siddhayo'siddhayo vā nānā na syuḥ, utkarṣārthikāraṇaikatvāt
saprabhedāstāḥ siddhayo'siddhayaśca nānājātīyā na syuḥ, avyatiriktakāraṇatvāt, tulyatantupaṭavat
cetanāmātrasāro hi puruṣakāraḥ śaktiḥ, na ca sa paśutve vartamāno manu-
dvividhā ca pravṛttiḥ ekasya puruṣakārasya sādhyā asādhyā ca itarasya
atra eka eva kāraṇam ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
itthaṃ parapakṣe doṣamuktvā svapakṣasādhanamāha --kāryātirekāttu kāraṇātireka iti karmaiva pravartayitṛ

itiśabdo hetvarthe, kāryāṇāmanekabhedānāṃ siddhīnāmasiddhīnāṃ ca parasparato'tiriktatvāt kāraṇātirekeṇāvaśyaṃ bhavitavyam, tacca kāraṇaṃ karmaiva puruṣasya tvadabhimatasya pravartayitṛ pravartakamanekabhedamiti grahītavyam
tasya kāryanānātvānumitasya kāraṇasāmānyasya karma iti saṃjñā kriyate, puruṣakārasya puruṣādīnāṃ ca kāraṇānāṃ nirākṛtatvāt
tasya siddhyasiddhibhedakāryaliṅgādanumānaṃ deśāntaraprāptyanumeyādityagateriva, dvividhā cetyādinā talliṅgāsiddhiparihārārthaṃ yāvaditarasyeti gatārtham, prasiddhaṃ liṅgamityarthaḥ

tatretyādi, tatra etasmin kāraṇavaicitryānumānaliṅge kārye tvadiṣṭapuruṣavyāpārasyāvatāra eva nāstītyāvayorlokasyeva prasiddhe kāryaliṅge tvadabhimatakāraṇāsambhavo'smanmatakāraṇasambhava eveti ca darśayati

cetanāmātrasāro hi puruṣakāraḥ śaktiḥ, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yato'syaiṣā śaktiḥ etāṃ cādhātuma śakto'sāviṣṭe manuṣyatve paśutve vartamāna iti svaśaktyādhānāsāmarthyaṃ darśayati --na ca sa ityādi, satyapi caitanye tāṃ svāṃ caitanyaśaktiṃ karmabalākṛṣṭanikṛṣṭa ṣyatve svacaitanyaśaktimādhātuṃ samarthaḥ, manuṣyaḥ sanna tajjñānaṃ paśau, tasyāpi karmalabhyatvāt
yāyo'pi ca puruṣaḥ so'svatantraḥ, karmaparavaśatvāt, vetālāviṣṭaśavaśarīravat, upakramaprabhṛti...

ato yathāhāraviśeṣābhyavaharaṇakhalarasādivibhajanādyasañcetitakriyāsu asvatantra eva tāḥ karmakṛtāḥ puruṣo matkṛtā ityabhimanyate, tatkāryatāyāṃ hi tāsāṃ kadācidakaraṇābhāvādihaiva amṛtatvaprasaṅgaḥ tathā kāyendriyanirvartane'pyaniṣṭaśarīrendriyādirna syāt, iṣṭasyaiva karaṇaṃ svātantryāt syāt
tadatirekeṇa ka ātmani pratipadyeta ? paśvajñānakuśaktau vartamāno na viśiṣṭeṣṭamanuṣyacaitanye sthāpayituṃ śakta iti, viparyayeṇa manuṣyaḥ sanna tajjñānaṃ paśau ādhātuṃ samarthaḥ iti vartate

tasyātmano yat svatattvam iti tvayā pratarkitaṃ tanna śaknoti karmavaśīkṛto yonijātyantarastho yonijātyantare'nyatrādhātum, kutaḥ ? tasyāpi karmalabhyatvāt, paśormanuṣyasya vā caitanyasya karmavaśādeva tathābhāvāt manuṣyaḥ paśurvā svajātināmakarmodayādeva bhavatītyarthaḥ, tadudayasya kāraṇāntaradurnivāratvāt
tatra dṛṣṭāntamāha --api tarhi gaṅgāyā ityādi, sambhāvanayaitaducyate, api caitat sambhāvyam--devavikriyotpātādinā gaṅgāsrotasyanyathāsnotasyānyathā pravṛttasya karmaṇo'nyathā pravartanamiti
evaṃ tāvadabhyupagamya svatantraṃ cetanaṃ puruṣakāraṃ ca tasyoktam
ṣyatve svacaitanyaśaktimādhātuṃ samarthaḥ, manuṣyaḥ sanna tajjñānaṃ paśau, tasyāpi karmalabhyatvāt
yāyo'pi ca puruṣaḥ so'svatantraḥ, karmaparavaśatvāt, vetālāviṣṭaśavaśarīravat, upakramaprabhṛti...

ato yathāhāraviśeṣābhyavaharaṇakhalarasādivibhajanādyasañcetitakriyāsu asvatantra eva tāḥ karmakṛtāḥ puruṣo matkṛtā ityabhimanyate, tatkāryatāyāṃ hi tāsāṃ kadācidakaraṇābhāvādihaiva amṛtatvaprasaṅgaḥ tathā kāyendriyanirvartane'pyaniṣṭaśarīrendriyādirna syāt, iṣṭasyaiva karaṇaṃ svātantryāt syāt
naiva vābhyupagacchāma etat sarvaṃ kiñcit karmavyatiriktam, kutaḥ ? tattvacintāyāṃ karmavyatiriktakāraṇānavasthānādityetad darśayati --yāyo'pi cetyādi yāvad vetālāviṣṭaśavaśarīravaditi

karmavetālāviṣṭo hi puruṣo'svatantra iṣṭāniṣṭatulyapravṛttiḥ paravaśatvāt puruṣasya, upakramaprabhṛti ityādi yāvajjahyāditi tatsvātantryābhāvapratipādanārtho nimeṣopakramādārabhya maraṇāpavargāvasāna iti gatārthaḥ

māturojaḥ pituḥ śukrañca prathamāhāraḥ, tataḥ sattāhaṃ kalalaṃ bhavati tandulavai॰ 17 ityādinā krameṇa śarīrendriyādikāraṇāhāraḥ prāṇanādiyātrāsamarthaḥ, tasya ca khalarasādibhāvena vibhajanam, ityādyasañcetitāvyaktakriyāsu asvatantra eva garbhādiṣu suptaśca
tāstu kriyāḥ karmakṛtāḥ puruṣo matkṛtā ityabhimanyate, tathā bhāsamānatvāt
tatkāryatāyāṃ hi puruṣakārakāryatāyāṃ hi tāsāṃ kriyāṇāṃ kadācidakaraṇābhāvāt prāṇasthitihetvanuparamaṇād maraṇābhāvaḥ, tasmādihaivāmṛtatvāya kalpeteti dṛṣṭeṣṭavirodhadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ
puruṣakārakāryanirvartane ca dharmādyanuṣṭhānaviṣayopabhogādau iṣṭasyaiva karaṇaṃ svātantryāt syāt

etadapi ca na mantavyam akāraṇamapi karma sahāyāpekṣatvāt, phalopahārāya svāminayodyogāvapekṣyau amātyādiprakṛtiśca iti, yatastānyapi hi svāmidharmādharmarajjuyatinibaddhāni, tadāyattatvāt tadbhogyatvāt...
yadi tāni svāmidharmādharmarajjuyatinibaddhāni na syustataḥ sarvāviśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ
yo'pi svāmipuruṣakāraḥ so'pyadharmaphalatvāt karmaiva, kleśatvāt, jvaravat
tasmāt sarvameva tat karmaṇa eva hetoḥ, nātmanaḥ, karmaṇaḥ iti pañcamyā hetvarthe vihitatvāt
tadatirekeṇa ka ātmani pratipadyeta ? tasmādevaṃ vidvān ka ātmani etadanupapadyamānaṃ karmavyatirekeṇa abhyupagacchet ? nābhyupagacchatyeva vidvānityabhiprāyaḥ

etadapi ca na mantavyam akāraṇamapi karma sahāyāpekṣatvāt, phalopahārāya svāminayodyogāvapekṣyau amātyādiprakṛtiśca iti, yatastānyapi hi svāmidharmādharmarajjuyatinibaddhāni, tadāyattatvāt tadbhogyatvāt...
yadi tāni svāmidharmādharmarajjuyatinibaddhāni na syustataḥ sarvāviśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ
yo'pi svāmipuruṣakāraḥ so'pyadharmaphalatvāt karmaiva, kleśatvāt, jvaravat
yathoktam— ālasyād yo nirutsāhaḥ sa kiñcinnāśnute phalam

ato bhārotpāṭavat, yathā bhāraṃ samudvahan puruṣaḥ sahāyamutkṣeptāraṃ nikṣepakaṃ cāntareṇa svayameva na śaknoti voḍhumiti kāraṇamakāraṇaṃ ca dṛṣṭastathā karma puruṣakāramantareṇeti kāraṇamakāraṇaṃ ceti
ālasyād yo nirutsāhaḥ sa kiñcinnāśnute phalam
etadapi ca na mantavyamakāraṇamapītyādinā tameva pūrvapakṣaṃ vyācaṣṭe
bhārotpāṭāpekṣabhāro- dvāhavadatra kiṃ sahāyaṃ karmaṇo'pekṣyamiti cet, ucyate --phalopahārāyetyādi, phalamupahariṣyataḥ karmaṇastatsvāminaḥ karturnayodyogāvāntarāvapekṣyau, bāhyā svāmātyādiprakṛtiḥ

kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam evaṃ na mantavyam ? ucyate --yatastānyapi hi svāmidharmādharmarajjuyatinibaddhānītyādi yāvat tantupaṭavat sahetudṛṣṭāntakena padavākyena amātyādīnāṃ dharmādharmakāryatvamāpādya karmakāraṇāvadhāraṇāt puruṣakāraṃ nirākaroti tadāyattatvāt tadbhogyatvādityādinā hetusaulabhyaṃ ca darśayati

yadapi coktaṃ svāminayodyogāvapekṣyau iti svāmipuruṣakāraḥ so'pyadharmaphalatvāt karmaiva, na puruṣakāro nāma karmātirikto'stītyavadhāraṇārthaṃ prākpratijñātaṃ samarthayati, kleśatvāt, kleśo hi cintāvyāyāmarūpaḥ, manaḥśarīrāyāsātmakatvāt, jvaravat
athaitamadharmaphalaṃ necchasi na tarhi duḥkhamadharmaphalamiti prāptam, tatkarmaṇaḥ prāṇātipātāderdharmaphalaprāptiriṣṭaprāptiriti prāptam, dharmādharmaphalaviparyayāt
yadā ca puruṣasya pravṛttau nāsti kartṛtvaṃ tadā dravatīti dravyaṃ kartṛsādhanaṃ na bhavati
athaitaṃ puruṣakārasaṅkleśamadharmaphalaṃ necchasi prajñotsāhayuktasya praśastatveneṣṭatvālloke tato na tarhi duḥkhamadharmaphalamiti prāptaṃ śirorogādi, kleśatvāt, nayodyogapuruṣakāravat
yathoktam— anarthapāṇḍityamadhītya yantritaḥ suteṣu dāreṣu ca nityaśaṅkitaḥ
niśāsu jāgarti hinasti bāndhavān namo'stu rājyāya varaṃ daridratā

atha prasiddhivirodhadoṣabhayād duḥkhamadharmaphalamiti tvayānujñāyate tatsācivyakriyāyāśca hiṃsāderduḥkhasādhanatāṃ gatatvāt tatkarmaṇo hetoḥ prāṇātipātāderdharmaphalaprāptiḥ, kāsau ? iṣṭaśarīrendriyaviṣayasukhasamyagjñānārogyādiprāptiḥ ityetat prāptam; śubhāśubhayoriṣṭāniṣṭaviparyayaphalābhyupagamāt dharmād nayodyogau duḥkhaṃ vā ityuktatvādata eva prāptam, adharmaphalād duḥkhāt sukhaṃ dharmaphalamiti prāptam
kiṃ tat ? iti taddiṅmātraṃ pradarśayati --iṣṭaprāptiriti iṣṭaśarīrendriyādiprāptirityetat prāptam
kiṃ kāraṇam ? dharmādharmaphalaviparyayāt ityataḥ puruṣakāranairarthakyaṃ ca yādṛcchikatvāviśeṣāt
ato yaduktaṃ karmaiva kāraṇaṃ puruṣakārasyāpi karmaphalatvāt iti śreyān pakṣaḥ
anarthapāṇḍityamadhītya yantritaḥ suteṣu dāreṣu ca nityaśaṅkitaḥ
niśāsu jāgarti hinasti bāndhavān namo'stu rājyāya varaṃ daridratā || iti
yathā yathā pūrvakṛtasya karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ nidhānasthamivopatiṣṭhate
tathā tathā pūrvavidhānusāriṇī pradīpahasteva matiḥ pravartate
abhyupagamyāpi puruṣakāraṃ doṣaṃ brūmaḥ--sa nirhetukaḥ sahetuko vā syāt ? kiñcātaḥ ? sa ca puruṣakāro yadyahetuko muktānāmapi syād nayodyogalakṣaṇaḥ na ceṣṭasteṣām

atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti saheturiti brūyāt tataḥ sahetuścet karmaṇa evācetanāt, śubhādapi puruṣakārāt sevādikādanarthāvāpteraśubhādapi prāṇātipātāderarthāvāpterdharmādharmaphalasaṅkarokteranumātuṃ śakyata etat abuddhipūrvakādacetanakarmavaśādevaitacchubhāśubhavaicitryam
kiṃ kāraṇam ? yuktikṣamahetvantarābhāvāt, vicāritaniṣiddhatvāt puruṣa-niyati-kālasvabhāvādihetvantarāṇāṃ nātrānyad vimardakṣamaṃ kāraṇamastyanyadato daivākhyāt karmaṇaḥ
yasmin kāle evaṃ ca kṛtvā puruṣasya pravṛttau sādhyāyāṃ nāsti kartṛtvamiti siddhe karmaṇa eveti ca siddhe tadā tasmin kāle dravatīti dravyaṃ kartṛsādhanaṃ na bhavati svatantrasya karturanupapatteḥ

karmaparigrahaviśeṣastu, tuśabdo viśeṣāvadhāraṇārthaḥ, karmasādhanamupapannārthaṃ dravyaṃ drūyata dravyaṃ kriyate, karmapuruṣeṇaiva karmapuruṣaḥ kriyate, yathā vrīhiṇaiva vrīhiḥ kriyate, kāryeṇaiva bījavrīhiṇāṅkuravrīhiḥ
ta itthamāhuḥ— evaṃvādinaste punaḥ kāryalakṣaṇatvāt karmaṇo'kṣarārthācca karmavyatiriktaḥ kartā asti, ghaṭasyeva kulālaḥ
nanu sudūramapi gatvā vrīherapyāvartakatvāt svarūpabhedādakṣarārthācca nirvivādakṛtakatvāt karmaṇaḥ kartureva bhāvaḥ tacchakteḥ
tadidānīṃ nirūpyate --bhogyena karmapuruṣeṇa tena dravyaṃ kriyate
kimuktaṃ bhavati ? karmapuruṣeṇaiva karmapuruṣaḥ kriyata ityuktaṃ bhavati
tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ --yathā vrīhiṇaiva vrīhiḥ kriyata iti
kāryeṇaiva bījavrīhiṇāṅkuravrīhiriti tadvyākhyā, evaṃ tāvadavadhāraṇena kartrartho nirākṛtaḥ, karmaikāntavāda upapāditaḥ, cetanācetanaikyāt sarvasarvātmakatvāccāyukta īśvaro'nyo heturiti ceti
dravyaṃ kriyate, karmapuruṣeṇaiva karmapuruṣaḥ kriyate, yathā vrīhiṇaiva vrīhiḥ kriyate, kāryeṇaiva bījavrīhiṇāṅkuravrīhiḥ
ta itthamāhuḥ— evaṃvādinaste punaḥ kāryalakṣaṇatvāt karmaṇo'kṣarārthācca karmavyatiriktaḥ kartā asti, ghaṭasyeva kulālaḥ
nanu sudūramapi gatvā vrīherapyāvartakatvāt svarūpabhedādakṣarārthācca nirvivādakṛtakatvāt karmaṇaḥ kartureva bhāvaḥ tacchakteḥ
na kevalaṃ kartṛsādhana eva doṣaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? karmaikāntavādo'pyayuktaḥ
tatpradarśanārthamāha --evaṃvādinaste punaḥ kāryalakṣaṇatvāt karmaṇaḥ, kāryaṃ karma, yat kriyate tat karma, karturīpsitatamaṃ karma pā॰ 1
tasmāt karmaṇo'nyaṃ kartāraṃ karmavyatiriktamantareṇa karmābhāvād ghaṭasyeva kulālo'vaśyaiṣyaḥ kartā
prayogaśca--svatovyatiriktacetanakartṛkaṃ tvadiṣṭaṃ karma, kāryatvāt kriyamāṇatvāt, ghaṭavaditi

atrottaraṃ paraḥ nanu karmaṇaiva kariṣyata iti svata eva karmaṇā karma kriyate na tadvyatiriktena kartretyuktaṃ prāg dṛṣṭānte vrīhiṇaiva vrīhiḥ kāryeṇa bījavrīhiṇā kāryo'ṅkuravrīhiḥ kriyata ityuktaṃ mayeti smārayati
itara āha --nanu sudūramapi gatvetyādi, vicārya vicāryāpyātmavyatiriktapuruṣāvinābhāvitvāt karmaṇastvayāpyetadabhyupagantavyaṃ karmavādinā--karmavyatiriktaḥ kartā puruṣo'stīti
kasmāt ? vrīherapyāvartakatvāt, asyāpi vrīhidṛṣṭāntasya kṣityudakākāśavātāṅkurādyāvṛttirūpatvāt teṣāṃ ca svarūpabhedāt svataḥpṛthagbhūtakartravinābhūtaṃ karma sidhyati ato viparyayasādhanatvamiti
kiñcānyat, akṣarārthācca, kriyata iti karma karturīpsitatamaṃ karma pā॰ 1

tatastasya kṛtakatvaṃ nirvivādam, tasmācca nirvivādakṛtakatvāt karmaṇaḥ kartureva bhāvaḥ svatantrasya, puruṣa eva bhavati, kartureva bhāvaḥ sarvasyeti pañcamīnirdeśād vā puruṣādeva sarvaṃ bhavati kāraṇāt
evaṃ ca tvaduktahetoreva karmavyatiriktapuruṣasiddheḥ karmaṇaśca tadvyatiriktasya siddherāvartakavaidharmyeṇa karmaṇaḥ kṛtakatvaṃ kartrarthāntarabhūtasyāvadhāraṇaṃ ca yuktam
kutaḥ ? tacchakteḥ, tasmādeva hi kartuḥ puruṣāt karmaṇaḥ kṛtakatvaśaktiḥ, karturvā puruṣasya karaṇaśaktiḥ, na vrīhiṇaiva vrīhivadāvartakatveneti
na hi sa kriyamāṇaḥ, karmaṇo'svatantratve sati alabdhātmavṛttitvādabhavanamābhūtadevadattavat
karmapravṛttimātratvāt tathā śāstrārthasya asmadupadeśādikriyāṇāṃ ca prati-
na hi sa kriyamāṇa ityādi yāvadābhūtadevadattavaditi tadeva bhāvayati

asvātantryācca kuto bhavanam ? dṛṣṭāntaḥ--ābhūtadevadatto garbhopakramāvasthāyāṃ kāryāyāmalabdhātmavṛttitvādasvatantraḥ asvatantratvādakartā, akartṛtvācca na bhavati kāryāvasthāvyatirekeṇa yathā devadattaḥ tathā kāryāvasthāyāṃ karmāpi kriyamāṇaṃ na bhavet, aniṣṭaṃ caitat tvayāpi
tasmāt karmābhavati, tacca pṛthagbhūtapuruṣabhavanādṛte na bhavatītyasti puruṣaḥ

katham ? yathākramaṃ hitaprāptyahitaparihārāvarthau sarvaśāstrāṇām, tābhyāṃ ca hitāhitaprāptiparihārārthābhyāṃ niruktīkṛtasatyatvāni pramāṇāntarasaṃvādena cikitsitādīni śāstrāṇi, yathā— kaṭukaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke vīryoṣṇaścitrako mataḥ
tadvad dantī, prabhāvāt tu virecayati sā naram
na ceṣyate tannirākaraṇaṃ kasyacit pramāṇāntarasaṃvādinaḥ śāstrasya prāmāṇyadarśanāt

tvadupadeśādikriyāṇāṃ ca dṛṣṭārthānāṃ nirākaraṇam evamiti vartate, karmakāraṇaikānte punaḥ puruṣasya svatantrasya tatkriyāyāścābhāve parapratipādanārthaṃ tacchaktiyuktaśabdoccāraṇakriyā na syāt karmata eva pravṛtteḥ

ādigrahaṇādodanasya mukhasaṃyojanādikriyāśca na syuḥ, karmapravṛttimātratvāt tatpratipattyapratipattyoḥ, tvadupadeśārthapratipattiḥ karmata eva parasya, sa pratipadyate vināpyupadeśena, na pratipadyate vā satyapyupadeśe
tadvad dantī, prabhāvāt tu virecayati sā naram || carakasaṃ॰ 1 | 26 | 68

syānmatam--yaducyate śāstranirākaraṇamevaṃ tvadupadeśādinirākaraṇaṃ ca karmaṇo'svatantratve satyalabdhātmavṛttitvādābhūtadevadattavadabhavanam, nirvivādakṛtakatvāt kartureva bhāvastacchakteḥ, vrīherapyāvartakatvāt svarūpabhedāt puruṣa eva bhavati, ityādi sarvaṃ nopapadyate, karmata eva bhavati ityupapadyate karmapravṛttimātratvāt tathā śāstrārthasyāsmadupadeśādikriyāṇāṃ ca pratipattyapratipattyoḥ karmapravṛttimātratvāt prājñapuruṣapratipattivad balīvardādyapratipattivacca
tasmāt sarvāṇyetāni karmaṇa eva hetorbhavanti pūrvoktanyāyavaccintāvyāyāmādiśārīra pattyapratipattyoḥ sarvāṇyetāni karmaṇa eveti cet, atha tadādikarma kutaḥ ? brūyāstvam--oṃ puruṣādeveti
karmata eva na, vrīhivaidharmyeṇākartṛkatvāt, ātmādivat, notkṣepaṇavat
kathamasambaddham ? yasmānna śubhamaśubhaṃ vā rūpādi iṣṭakāraṇamaniṣṭakāraṇaṃ vā ekāntena kiñcidasti
eka eva mānasakleśaphalatvāt tasya, iti cedāśaṅkāyām, evaṃ cenmanyase
tatastvamidamasi tāvat praṣṭavyaḥ --atha tadādikarma kutaḥ ? iti
tannecchatā tvayā vaktavyam--kutastadādikarma yata etat sarvaṃ pratipattyapratipattikleśādi ? iti tvadabhiprāyākarṣaṇārthaḥ praśnaḥ, kiṃ tadapi karmaṇa eva uta puruṣāt ? iti

brūyāstvam--oṃ puruṣādeveti, evaṃ nāmāstu, ko doṣaḥ gatyantarābhāvāt, karmata eva ityabhiprāyaḥ syādityatra brūmaḥ --na, vrīhivaidharmyeṇākartṛkatvāt, vrīherapyāvartakatvāt kartṛtvamupayāti, nāsāvato vrīhirakṛtakaḥ, akartṛkatvāt, tataścākriyamāṇatvānnopapadyate karmaṇaḥ karmatvaṃ tasyādikarmaṇaḥ
kimiva ? ātmādivat, yathā ātmākāśakāladigādīni na kenacit kriyanta ityakarmāṇi tathā ādikarmāpi syāt
notkṣepaṇavaditi vaidharmyadarśanam, yathā utkṣepaṇaṃ karma tadvyatiriktenotkṣeptrā vinā na bhavati tathedamiti
pattyapratipattyoḥ sarvāṇyetāni karmaṇa eveti cet, atha tadādikarma kutaḥ ? brūyāstvam--oṃ puruṣādeveti
karmata eva na, vrīhivaidharmyeṇākartṛkatvāt, ātmādivat, notkṣepaṇavat
kathamasambaddham ? yasmānna śubhamaśubhaṃ vā rūpādi iṣṭakāraṇamaniṣṭakāraṇaṃ vā ekāntena kiñcidasti
evaṃ puruṣakāravādinā karmavādī dūṣitaḥ, karmavādinā ca prāk puruṣakāravādī

tasmād yaduktam evaṃ ca kṛtvā tadapi sarvamasambaddhaṃ yat karmakāraṇaikāntina āhuḥ, yacca puruṣakārakāraṇaikāntina āhustadapi sarvamasambaddhaṃ parasparadūṣitatvāt iti tadubhayamidānīṃ naikaṭyenāpyasambaddhamiti pratipādayitukāmaḥ praśnayati --kathamasambaddhamiti paravacanena svavacanena caikatvāt tayoḥ pṛthak karmapuruṣakārābhāvādevāsambaddhamiti tatpratipādayiṣyannāha --yasmād na śubhamaśubhaṃ vetyādi yāvat kāya iti
ayaṃ tāvad dṛśyamānaḥ kāyaḥ puruṣo vāstu yatte'bhirucitam, na me kaścidatra pakṣapātaḥ

tacca yasmād na kiñcidatra śubhamevāśubhameva vā bāhyamapi kāyād bhinnamabhimataṃ rūpādi iṣṭasya sukhasya kāraṇaṃ citra-mayūra-srak-candana- bhramararutādi aniṣṭasya vā duḥkhasyātivivarṇahuṇḍasaṃsthānākārakaṇṭakaśivārutādi

sarvamapyetadiṣṭakāraṇamapyaniṣṭakāraṇamapi śubhamapyaśubhamapi iti gṛhāṇa dravyakṣetrakālabhāvapuruṣāntarasaṃyogaviśeṣāśrayapariṇāmaviśeṣāpatteḥ surabhi-madhura-sukhasparśa-surūpa-suśabdetarabhāvamupalabhyate abhakṣitabhakṣitamodakavat pakvāpakvāmraphalavat padmakesaranālavat jātājātavipannāvipannasurādivat svasthāsvasthastrīpuruṣagītarutādivat
yathoktamārṣe --tecceva poggalā subbhigaṃdhattāe pariṇamaṃti te ceva te poggalā dubbhigaṃdhattāe pariṇamaṃti jñātādharma॰ ityādi
tasmād na śubhamaśubhaṃ vaikāntena kiñcidasti bhinnajāti
kiṃ tarhi ? tadeva śubham tadevāśubham, tata eva ca iṣṭakāraṇamaniṣṭakāraṇaṃ ca, yathā tridoṣaghnamodakādi pramāṇā hyayaṃ pudgalakāyaḥ
nanvannodakaśubhāśubhate prativiśiṣṭāpaśadayogakṛte, na, ekaikasya sarvarūpadravyabhavanaparamārthatvāt tadeva tat, tatparamārthatvāt, tadvat

pramāṇakālākālāhāritamiti svasthasarpadaṣṭāhāritaviṣavadvā tathaika eva hyayaṃ pudgalakāyaḥ, pudgala uktaniruktikaḥ, kāyaḥ śarīraṃ citatvād rogādiduḥkhanivāsatvādvā sarvo'pi bāhyābhyantaro mūrtadravyasaṅghātaḥ kāyaḥ rūpādisaṅghātatvāt paramāṇorapi
pudgalasya pudgalasyeva vā kāya iti vigraha-samāsau

athavā pṛthak parikalpanayānayā kim ? indriyapratyakṣābhimataḥ śarīrākhyaḥ pudgalakāyaḥ svasaṃvedyajñānātmakaḥ kriyādiliṅgānumita ātmakāyo vā so'yameka eva, na hyatra kācid bhedabuddhiḥ kāryā bandhapariṇāmaikyāpatteretannayadarśanāt
eka eva śubhāśubhādidharmā iti sādhyasya kāyasya vakṣyamāṇāhāradṛṣṭāntasāmyamāpādya hetutvena tatsādharmyamāha --bhoktṛbhogyātmakavipariṇāmavṛttitvāditi

yadi puruṣakāravādimatena bhoktā, athāpi karmavādimatena bhogyaḥ, tasmāt kāyo bhoktṛbhogyātmakaḥ, tasya vipariṇāmo vṛttirasyeti kāyaḥ sambadhyate bhogyasya bhokturvā vipariṇāma iti, śukraśoṇitaṃ jananyāhṛtānnarasādi cādyuttarakāraṇamasya śarīrasya tadubhayaṃ bhoktṛ bhogyaṃ ca anyonyabhāvāpatteḥ, tathā caturvidho'pyāhāro'śanādirāhartrāhāryabhāvād bhoktṛ bhogyaṃ ca, tacca śubhāśubheṣṭāniṣṭakāraṇameveti, kāyacaitanyayorvaikyapariṇāmāpannasyaiva bhoktṛbhogyapariṇāmavṛttitvaṃ siddham, ata āhāravacchubhāśubhādidharmatāsyeti, yathā āhāraḥ śubhaścāśubhaśca dṛśyate saṃskṛtāsaṃskṛtaḥ, saṃskṛto'pyaśubha eva saṃskriyamāṇānnādyaśubhatvāt, saṃskārakābhimatakarpūrāderapi kālāntare daurgandhyādidarśanāt, sarvapudgalānāṃ prāguktavidhinā śubhāśubhatvavat pudgalatvādāhāraḥ śubho'śubhaśceti tathā kāya iti
athavā cetanācetanayorātmaśarīrayoraikyapariṇāmāt tadeva bhoktṛ bhogyaṃ cetyanenaivāhāradṛṣṭāntena sambaddhaṃ pratyekamapi sādhayatyetad dharmadvayamityata āha --bhoktṛtvād bhogyatvāditi
athavā sukho'pi duḥkho'pi sa eva kāyaḥ, sukhastāvad duḥkhatvādāhāravat, duḥkhaḥ sukhatvādāhāravat, yat paraṃ pratyasiddhaṃ taditareṇa siddhena dharmāntareṇa sādhyam
nanvannodakaśubhāśubhate prativiśiṣṭāpaśadayogakṛte, na, ekaikasya sarvarūpadravyabhavanaparamārthatvāt tadeva tat, tatparamārthatvāt, tadvat

prativiśiṣṭakarpūrādyekāntaśubhadravyayoge sati jalādi aśubhagandhamapi sat surabhīkriyate adhikaguṇābhibhavabhāvanayā, evamaśucyapaśadadravyayoge sati tadutkṛṣṭagandhābhibhavāt tadbhāvanayā karpūrādyapi tadgandhībhavadupalabhyate
athavā tadeva vinaṣṭaṃ śubhataḍākādigatamalpaṃ śuṣyacchuṣyat karpūragandhaṃ bhavadupalabhyate, nālikeraphalāni surabhīṇi santi pūtībhavanti dṛśyante
vīpsayā vyāptiṃ sarvarūpadravyabhavanasya bhāvakasya bhāvyasya ca darśayati yathā cātra pariṇāmyapariṇāmakapariṇamyapariṇamakabhāvādekatvaṃ tathātmakarmaṇorapi
ātmā pariṇamayati tathābhavanasāmarthyād gatijātyādinā pudgalān pudgalāścātmānaṃ mithyādarśanāditvena, anyonyapariṇāmakatvādanāditvamekatvam
sarvaśubhāśubheṣṭāniṣṭakāraṇatvādirūpo hi dravyabhavanaparamārthaḥ, evaṃ hi bhavadeva bhavaddravyaṃ paramārthato bhavati, nānyathā
yathoktam --egamegassa ṇaṃ bhaṃte jīvassa egamege jīve mātittāe ityādipraśnaḥ yāvat ājātapuvve

vyākaraṇam --gotama ! asaī aduvā aṇaṃtakhutto, evaṃ savvajīvāṇa vi egajīvo, egajīvassa vi savvajīvā, tathā savvapoggalā egajīvassa savvajīvāṇaṃ ca āhārattāe usāsattāe bhāsattāe sarīrattāe iṃdiyattāe maṇattāe āṇāpāṇattāe ityādyārṣe aikyāpattau jñāpakaṃ sarvajñoktatvāt
ātmā pariṇamayati tathābhavanasāmarthyād gatijātyādinā pudgalān pudgalāścātmānaṃ mithyādarśanāditvena, anyonyapariṇāmakatvādanāditvamekatvam

atrānumānam --tadeva taditi pratijñā mātṛtvādibhāvena yad bhavati śarīrādibhāvena vā tadekaikaṃ sarvarūpamityarthaḥ, tatparamārthatvāt tadvat, etaduktaṃ bhavati--tat tatsvarūpāpannabhavanaparamārthatvāt tat tatsvarūpavat

yatsvarūpamidaṃ bhavati karpūraṃ śarīramannādi vā tat tadevetyarthaḥ, yacca yadeva na bhavati na tat tatparamārthaṃ yathā khapuṣpaṃ kharaviṣāṇaṃ vā, bhavanmatyānyat tat tadanyasvarūpāpatteḥ, syādaheyasyāntaraṅgasya tattvam syād bahiraṅgasya cānyatvamiti tadeva hyanyatvābhimatamasmāmatam, asmā--bhistasyaiva tadrūpatvamiti sādhyate
abhyupetyāpi anyathātve'pi tadanatirekātmakatvāt tadeva tat iti vartate
tasmāt tasya vānatirekaḥ, sa ātmāsyeti tadanatirekātmakam, yad yadanatirekātmakamanyathātve'pi tadeva tad dṛśyate

kimiva ? tantuyajñopavītavat, tantvanatirekātmakatvād yajñopavītasya valitasyānyathātve'pi tantvātmakatvameva tathā sukhādiṣu bhāvanīyam, tadanatirekātmakatvaṃ ca bhāvitārthameva te cceva te poggalā subbhigaṃdhattāe jñātādharma॰ ityādinā
evaṃ ca tadeva taditi sarvaṃ sarvasya bāhyasya pariṇāṇamyasya pariṇamayituśca tattvam
yo'dhikaguṇasya tādguṇyaṃ pratipadyate sa pariṇāmī yo'dhikaguṇo nyūnaguṇatvamāpādayati sa pariṇāmaka ityucyate vyavahārataḥ
niścayatastu pariṇāmipariṇāmakāvāvirbhāvatirobhāvamātrabhedau svata eva ityasya nayasya darśanam, pariṇāmaśca dravyamātram, dravyaṃ ca bhavye pā॰ 5
104, yad yad bhavati sa paramārtho'syeti, tadapyevaṃ bhāvitaṃ kṣīrāderyāvacca ghaṭādestāvad boddhavyam
tad vyācaṣṭe --ātmā yadapi ca rūpādi tadapyātmana eva tattvam, upayogātmakatvāt tadavyatirekalabhyarūpatvāt, matyādivat

rūpādīnāṃ deśakālādibhedena agṛhyamāṇatvāda- pariṇayamatītyādinā yāvadanāditvamekatvamiti pariṇāṇamyapariṇāṇamakayoraniyatadeśakālabhāvādirūpatāṃ darśayati tathābhavanasāmarthyād gatijātyādinā pudgalāniti, upayogalakṣaṇa ātmā gatijātiśarīrāṅgopāṅgādyanubhavanopayogātmatayā tān pudgalān pariṇamayatīti ātmanaḥ pariṇāmakatvaṃ teṣāṃ pariṇāṇamyatvam
sa ca mithyādarśanodayādibhāvo bhavabhrāntihetuḥ, tadvaśasya saṃsaraṇāt
etasya karmakarmidvayasyānyonyapariṇāmakatvādanāditvamekatvameva, ekatvaśabdena paryāyabhūtena tattvaṃ vyācaṣṭe saṃsārasya karmakarmisambandhajatvāt tasya ca sambandhasyānāditvāt
yathoktam --puvviṃ bhaṃte ! aṃḍae pacchā kukkuḍī ? ityādi praśnaḥ
vyākaraṇam --rohā ! puvviṃ pi ete pacchā vi ete, do vi ete sāsatā bhāvā, aṇāṇupuvvī esā rohā ! bhagavatīsū॰ 1
yadapi ca rūpādi tadapyātmana eva tattvam, upayogātmakatvāt tadavyatirekalabhyarūpatvāt, matyādivat
āha--yaduktaṃ tvayā karpūrodakādyacetanānāṃ pariṇāmyapariṇāmakabhāvādekatvaṃ cetanācetanayośca jīvakarmaṇoriti tadyuktam
kintu rūpādi upayogībhavadātmā bhavati ātmāpi rūpādībhavati tatpariṇāmāt ityetannopapadyate svabhāvāvināśāditi
yadapi ca bahirbhinnaṃ viṣayajātamupayoganimittabhūtaṃ rūpādi tadapyātmana eva tattvam
kuto rūpādyapi ātmana eva tattvamiti cet, ucyate --upayogātmakatvāt, matyādicakṣurdarśanādibhedaprabheda upayoga ātmā'sya rūpāderviṣayasya so'yaṃ tadātmakaḥ

kathaṃ rūpāderviṣayasyopayogātmakatvamiti cet, ucyate --tadavyatirekalabhyarūpatvāt, rūpaṃ raso gandha ityādiviṣayasvarūpākāreṇopayogena avyatirikta ekībhūta evopalabhyate rūpādirviṣayo nānyathā, anyathā viṣayasvarūpānavadhāraṇāt
yad yadupayogātmakaṃ tat tadātmana eva tattvam, yathā matyādicakṣurdarśanādibheda upayoga iti
syānmatam--rūpādīnāṃ deśabhedena yugapadavasthāyināṃ rūpaṃ raso gandha ityādayaḥ parasparato deśabhinnā iti gṛhyante
tasya deśasya paramāṇuśo bhede na rūpaṃ raso gandho vopalabhyate, deśasambandhena tūpalabhyamānā bhavanti

tathā kṣaṇabhede prathamakṣaṇe'nyad rūpaṃ dvitīyakṣaṇe'nyaditi gṛhyate ced na rūpaṃ nāma kiñcit syāt tanniṣṭhasya kālasya rūpagrahaṇāśrayasambandhābhāvādityabhavanātmakā bhavanātmakatvād nirvastutvāpatteḥ dravyameva tathātathābhavanalakṣaṇaṃ satyaṃ cakṣurādipratyayopayogāpadeśena bhavati bhāgineyādyapadeśaviśiṣṭaikatvasatyapuruṣavat
yaccopayogasvatattvaṃ matyādi tadapi pudgalātmatattvam, rūpādyātmakatvāt, aṇvādivat
upayogalakṣaṇa ātmā rūpādyātmakeṣu pudgaleṣu upayuktaḥ rūpādyātmaka eva, sarvātmanā grāhye upayogamayān mṛtpiṇḍaḥ śivakāditāyāmiva so'cetana eva syāt paṭe'nupayujyamānaghaṭādivat
ādigrahaṇād bhāvabhedena ekaguṇadviguṇatriguṇakṛṣṇādibhedena agṛhyamāṇatvād viśiṣṭasya sāmānyasyaiva grahaṇāt
tataśca nirvastutvāpatteretat pratipattavyam --dravyameva tathātathābhavanalakṣaṇaṃ satyaṃ na rūpādayo nāma keciditi
tathā tatheti rūparasādiprakāreṇa bhavati śyāmaraktatāditadbhedaprakāreṇa ceti satyam, dravyaṃ ca bhavye pā॰ 5
kathaṃ punastad dravyamabhinnaṃ sad rūpādibhedena bhavatīti cet, cakṣurādipratyayopayogāpadeśena bhavati

cakṣurādipratyayā ityadhipatyālambanahetusamanantarapratyayāḥ, te nimittamasyopayogasya jñānadarśanākhyasya sa cakṣurādipratyayopayogaḥ, tadapadeśena rūpādi bhavati jñānāpadeśena cakṣūrūpādipratyayenetyarthaḥ

dṛṣṭāntaḥ --bhāgineyādyapadeśaviśiṣṭaikatvasatyapuruṣavat, yathaika eva puruṣo'nekasambandhistrīpuruṣāpekṣāpadeśaviśiṣṭo bhāgineyo mātulo bhrātā patiḥ pitā devaraḥ śvaśuraḥ putro bhrātrīya ityādirbhavati devadatta eka ityeva ca satyastathā dravyamekameva rūpādi bhavati cakṣurādyapadeśāditi sādhūktamekameva sarvātmakamiti
itaḥ pūrvaṃ kaścana pāṭho'tra truṭita iti bhāti
bhavanātmakatvād nirvastutvāpatteḥ dravyameva tathātathābhavanalakṣaṇaṃ satyaṃ cakṣurādipratyayopayogāpadeśena bhavati bhāgineyādyapadeśaviśiṣṭaikatvasatyapuruṣavat
yaccopayogasvatattvaṃ matyādi tadapi pudgalātmatattvam, rūpādyātmakatvāt, aṇvādivat
upayogalakṣaṇa ātmā rūpādyātmakeṣu pudgaleṣu upayuktaḥ rūpādyātmaka eva, sarvātmanā grāhye upayogamayān mṛtpiṇḍaḥ śivakāditāyāmiva so'cetana eva syāt paṭe'nupayujyamānaghaṭādivat
idānīmupayogasyāpi paudgalātmyamucyate — yaccopayogasvatattvaṃ matyādi tadapi pudgalātmatattvamiti pakṣaḥ

sa hyupayogalakṣaṇa ātmā paramāṇudvyaṇukatryaṇukādiṣu rūpādyātmakeṣu pudgaleṣu upayujyate kṛtsno vyāpriyate sārvātmyena vyāpta upayuktaḥ samāpta ityarthaḥ, rūpādyātmaka eva, apradeśasaṅkhyeyāsaṅkhyeyānantapradeśapudgalavat tadupayogāt tatpariṇāmāt tadeva taditi pūrvoktanyāyācca

yadyevaṃ rūpādyātmakatvamātmano nābhyupagamyate'saṅkhyātapradeśasyāpi rūpādimadekadravyopayoge tādātmyaṃ grāhye yātīti tato'saṅkhyātapradeśo'pi nanvevaṃ pudgala eva ātmā prāptaḥ, tasyopayogātmanaḥ pudgalatvāt, kuto'sya rūpādyātmakatā ? na, upayogātmakatvādeva rūpādīnāmapyuktavat
anena sarvamapi karmakāraṇaikāntavādimataṃ puruṣakārakāraṇaikāntavādimataṃ ca asambaddhaṃ boddhavyam, itaretarātmakatvāt
sarvātmanā sārvātmyena sarvaiḥ pradeśairgrāhye dravye upayogamayān upayogamagacchan anupayujyamāno'cetana eva paṭānupayujyamānaghaṭādivat syāditi sambhantsyate

kathaṃ punarupayogaṃ yān yāyāt ? mṛtpiṇḍaḥ śivakāditāyāmiva, yathā mṛtpiṇḍaḥ kṛtsnaḥ śivakādibhāve sārvātmyena vyāpāraṃ gacchati tathā yadi na gacchedātmā grāhye tatastādātmyamapratipadyamānaḥ so'cetana eva syāt paṭe'nupayujyamānaghaṭādivaditi yathākramaṃ vaidharmyeṇa sādharmyeṇa ca dṛṣṭāntau
cetano hyupayogalakṣaṇastadabhāvādacetanaḥ syāditi eṣa doṣo rūpādyātmakatvābhāve syādātmana upayogalakṣaṇasya
itaśca ātmā pudgalasvatattva eva, ātmasvatattvetyādi yāvad bhāvāvyatiriktarūpatvācca

ātmanaḥ svatattvamaudayiko bhāvaḥ, udaye bhava audayikaḥ, kasya ? karmaṇo jñānāvaraṇīyāderaṣṭavidhasyāpi, sa ca tadudayapravṛttito'pṛthagbhūto'vyatirikto bhāvaḥ svaṃ tattvamātmanaḥ, tadavyatiriktarūpaścātmā, tasmādātmasvatattvajñānāvaraṇādyudayapravṛttyavyatiriktarūpatvāccātmā pudgalātmatattva eva tādātmyapratipatteḥ rūpādyātmakaparamāṇvādivadityarthaḥ

ataḥ paraṃ rūpādyātmakatvamātmano nābhyupagamyate'saṅkhyātapradeśasyāpi ityadhikaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu atra upalabhyate, kintu bhā॰ pratau ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ paṃ॰ 25 madhye yadyevaṃ ityataḥ paraṃ dṛśyate, tatraiva ca sa ucitaḥ
etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu atra nāsti
nanvevaṃ pudgala eva ātmā prāptaḥ, tasyopayogātmanaḥ pudgalatvāt, kuto'sya rūpādyātmakatā ? na, upayogātmakatvādeva rūpādīnāmapyuktavat
anena sarvamapi karmakāraṇaikāntavādimataṃ puruṣakārakāraṇaikāntavādimataṃ ca asambaddhaṃ boddhavyam, itaretarātmakatvāt

nanu bhoḥ ! tvaduktena vidhinā etenaiva pudgala evātmā prāptaḥ tasyopayogātmanaḥ pudgalatvāt, yo'yaṃ pudgalopayogaḥ rūpaṃ rasaḥ ityādijñānātmanaḥ sa cātmopayoga eva upayogavyatiriktasya rūpāderabhāvādupayogasya rūpādyātmakatvādupayogarūpatvācca rūpādīnām
tasmāt kuto'sya ātmano rūpādyātmakatā ? iti prastutasyopayogasya matyādeḥ pudgalātmatvamuparuṇaddhi eṣa vicāra iti
naiṣa doṣaḥ, rūpādyātmakatā ātmanaḥ, rūpādīnāṃ copayogātmakatā
tasmād rūpādīnāmapyupayogātmakatvāduktavat pudgalo'pyātmā ātmāpi pudgala eveti rūpādyātmakatvamātmano na doṣāya

evaṃ ca kṛtvā puruṣasya rūpādimatpudgalātmakatvāt pudgalasyāpi upayogātmakapuruṣātmakatvāt taducyate karmaiva kāraṇam, puruṣakāra eva kāraṇam ityavadhāritamubhayamapyekāntagatamasambaddhaṃ boddhavyamiti
pratyekapratyuktibhāvanādik tu pravartayitṛtvāt puruṣaśca kāraṇamutkarṣārthī, tasyaivoktavat sarvatvāt karmāpi
puruṣakārāṇāṃ ca tatsādhyānāṃ ca siddhayo'siddhayaśca nānā syureva, puruṣasyaivāvyatiriktabhinnakāraṇatvāt, ahibhogavistaraṇakuñcanavat
athaivaṃ neṣyate tato'sau bhavet paśuvad manuṣyatvenāpi
idānīṃ pratyekapratyuktibhāvanādik tu, tuśabdo viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, yugapatpratyuktidiktaḥ pratyekapratyuktidig viśiṣyate
karmaikāntavādapratyuktidik tāvat pravartayitṛtvāt puruṣaśca kāraṇamutkarṣārthī, caśabdāt karma ceti, ekāntapratiṣedhasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt
utkarṣamarthayatītyutkarṣārthī, utkarṣa evārthaḥ so'syāstīti vā, arthāccāsannihite pā॰ vā॰ 5
135 iti iniḥ, sa cotkarṣo bāhyo dhanadhānyamitrabhūmyādisampat, āntarastvārogyajñānādisampat, kṛtārthasya tadarthārambhoparamādasannihitārtho'rthīti

kasmāt puruṣaśca kāraṇamiti cet, ucyate --tasyaivoktavat sarvatvāt vrīhiṇaiva vrīhiḥ kriyate ityādinyāyo- ktavadasāveva puruṣaḥ prāṇādimāṃścetanaḥ karmāpi, apiśabdād nokarmāpi prāṇāpānabhāṣāmanodravyādipudgala ādhyātmiko bāhyo'pi rūpādipudgalaścetano yasmāt tasmāt sa eva pravartayitā
tasyaivāsmin pakṣe karmādisarvasarvatvāt kiṃ tadanyat karma ? iti tasyaiva karmatāpi, apiśabdāt puruṣatāpi pudgalatāpi
tasmādeva yaduktaṃ pradhānamadhyamādhamāḥ puruṣakārāsteṣāṃ ca siddhayo'siddhayaśca pradhānamadhyamādhamā nānā na syuḥ iti tadayuktamuktam
puruṣakārāṇāṃ ca tatsādhyānāṃ ca siddhayo'siddhayaśca nānā syureva, na na syuḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? utkarṣaparamparāyā bahuprabhedāyā api ā mukteḥ puruṣasyaivāvyatiriktabhinnakāraṇatvāt
sa evāvyatirikto bhinnaśca kāraṇam, tasyaiva sarvaprabhedātmakatvād bhinnatvam, teṣāṃ ca karmanokarmabāhyarūpādibhedapudgalānāṃ puruṣopayogātmakatvādavyatiriktatvam
tasmāt puruṣakāranānātvaṃ tatsādhyasiddhyasiddhinānātvāni ca syureva, sa caika eva kāraṇaṃ syādeva

ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? ahibhogavistaraṇakuñcanavat, yathā ahiḥ sphaṭāṭopakuṇḍalakīkaraṇādyayugapadavasthāyidharmai rūpādibhiryugapadavasthāyibhiśca bhinno'pyavyatiriktābhinnāhitvasatyastadavyatiriktabhinnakāraṇatvāt pravartayitā tathā pāṇyādisaṅghātasahavartī puruṣa upayogātmā gatyādyutkarṣārthī teṣu yugapadayugapadbhāviṣu puruṣa eva satya iti
tathānatirekātirekāt karmāpi pravartayitṛ, yathā puruṣaḥ pudgalātmakarmadharmaprabhedabhinno'pyavyatiriktaḥ pravartayitā tathā karmāpi tadanatiriktātiriktakāraṇatvāt pravartayitṛ

kiñca, cetanācetana- paramārthatvācca puruṣasyaiveṣṭāniṣṭavidhiṃ prati vyāpāraḥ, sa eva hi puruṣaścetano'cetanaśca, kutaḥ ? iṣṭā evaṃ ca avibhaktadvyātmakatāyāṃ dvividhaḥ karmākhyapuruṣakārasya pravṛttiprabandhaḥ sādhyo'sādhyaśca tīvramandādihetūpasevanasañcitatvāt sādhyāsādhyavyādhivat, calanīyo'vicālyaśca baddhābaddhamūlatvād vṛkṣa-haṭavat, nikācitānikācitāvayavatvādayaḥśalākākalāpavat
utkarṣāpakarṣāviṣṭāniṣṭau, tayorvidhiḥ tatprāptyupāyaḥ pramādāpramādau, tau ca dṛśyete
athaivaṃ neṣyate tvayā, yadi ca puruṣaścetanaśaktireveṣyate tato'sau bhavet paśuvad manuṣyatvenāpi gamyāgamyabhakṣyābhakṣyādyaviśeṣajño yathā paśurbhavatyalpacetanastathā manuṣyatve'pi bhavet
kṛmyādivad manuṣyo'pi jaḍaḥ syāt, manuṣyavat kṛmirapi paṇḍitaḥ syādityādi
tasmāt karmāpi cetanaṃ puruṣo'pyacetanaḥ, taccobhayamavibhaktamiti grāhyam

evaṃ ca avibhaktadvyātmakatāyāṃ dvividhaḥ karmākhyapuruṣakārasya pravṛttiprabandhaḥ sādhyo'sādhyaśca tīvramandādihetūpasevanasañcitatvāt sādhyāsādhyavyādhivat, calanīyo'vicālyaśca baddhābaddhamūlatvād vṛkṣa-haṭavat, nikācitānikācitāvayavatvādayaḥśalākākalāpavat

evaṃ ca kṛtvā tasyaiva tu uditavadavibhaktadvyātmakatāyāṃ cetanācetanaikātmatāyāṃ satyāṃ dvividhaḥ pravṛttiprabandhaḥ phalapariṇāmaprabandhaḥ prāgbhavīyakarmākhyapuruṣakārasya sādhyo'sādhyaśca, tatsañcayahetubhūtopādānakālapariṇāmadvaividhyāt

taddarśayati --tīvramandādihetūpasevanasañcitatvāditi, tīvreṇa yogapariṇāmena sañcitaṃ karma tīvrānubhāvasthitipradeśaṃ baddhapuṣṭanikācitaṃ sukhaduḥkhaphalamupakramitumaśakyatvādasādhyamavaśyaṃ vipacyate
sādhyāsādhyavyādhivat, yathā vyādhirjvarātisārādirnidānamandatīvratvābhyāṃ sādhyo'sādhyaśca bhavati tathā karmākhyapuruṣakārapravṛttiprabandhaḥ

prathamo baddhamūlo vṛkṣavat, dvitīyo haṭavadabaddhamūlaḥ, duḥkhaviśleṣyaḥ sukhaviśleṣyaścetyarthaḥ, nikācitānikācitāvayavatvāt, pariṇamanamapi ca karmaṇaḥ puruṣakārasya viṣayo na ca viṣayaḥ kvacit, aprāptaprāptavipariṇāmāvasthatvāt, puṣpatugdṛḍhaphalavat
evaṃ ca kṛtvā kriyāsahāyaśca sa phalaṃ prayacchati ekaśca, sāpekṣānapekṣaśaktitvāt, bhārotpāṭavat

kimiva ? ayaḥśalākākalāpavat, yathā sūtramātropanibaddhā ayaḥśalākā ekaśalākāpakarṣamātraprayāsena sarvāḥ pracyavante, prataptasampṛktaprahatāḥ saṅgharṣaṇādṛte na śakyāḥ pṛthak kartum, tathā karmavidhiḥ
aṭṭhame kammappavāe puvve kammaṃ paṇṇavijjati, jīvassa ya kammassa ya kahaṃ baṃdho ? tattha te bhaṇaṃti baddhaṃ puṭṭhaṃ ṇikāiyaṃ

baddhaṃ jahā suikalāvo, puṭṭhaṃ jahā ghaṇaṇiraṃtarāto kayāo, ṇikāīyaṃ jahā tāveūṇa piṭṭiyā, evaṃ kammaṃ rāgadosehiṃ jīvo paḍhamaṃ baṃdhai, pacchā taṃ pariṇāmaṃ amuṃcaṃto puṭṭhaṃ kareti, teṇeva saṃkiliṭṭhapariṇāmeṇa taṃ amuṃcaṃto kiṃci ṇikāeti
ṇikāīyaṃ ṇiruvakkamaṃ, udaeṇa ṇavari veijjai, annahā taṃ ṇa veijjati

iti uttarādhyayanasūtrasya śāntisūriviracitāyāṃ ṭīkāyāṃ tṛtīyādhyayane goṣṭhāmāhilanihnavavāde; etādṛśa eva pāṭho nemicandrasūriracitāyāmuttarādhyayanasūtravṛttāvapi, kintu tatra baddhaṃ jahā suikalāvo taṃtubaddho, puṭṭhaṃ jahā kiṭṭeṇa ghaṇaniraṃtarāo kayāo iti viśiṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ
jai taṃ kāhisi bhāvaṃ jā jā dicchasi nārio
yadi tvaṃ kariṣyasi bhāvaṃ prakramād bhogābhilāṣarūpaṃ yā yā drakṣyasi nārīstāsu tāsu iti gamyate, tataḥ kim ? ityāha--vātāviddho haṭhaḥ vanaspativiśeṣaḥ, sa iva asthitātmā bhaviṣyasi
pariṇamanamapi ca karmaṇaḥ puruṣakārasya viṣayo na ca viṣayaḥ kvacit, aprāptaprāptavipariṇāmāvasthatvāt, puṣpatugdṛḍhaphalavat
evaṃ ca kṛtvā kriyāsahāyaśca sa phalaṃ prayacchati ekaśca, sāpekṣānapekṣaśaktitvāt, bhārotpāṭavat

tasyāpi pūrvakarmaṇaḥ tīvramandādihetūpasevanasañcitasya phaladānamihatyapuruṣakārasya kṛṣyadhyayanasevāvāṇijyādyanuṣṭhānasya viṣayo na ca viṣayaḥ kvaciditi, aprāptaprāptavipariṇāmāvasthatvāt, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ svayamaprāptavipariṇāmāvasthaṃ puruṣakāravipariṇāṇamyaṃ puruṣakāreṇa vipācyate viṣayatvamānīyate udīraṇākaraṇenodīryate, prāptavipariṇāmāvasthaṃ tu vaiyarthyānna viṣayīkriyate puruṣakāreṇa na vipācyate nodīryate svayameva vipakvatvāt
kimiva ? puṣpatugdṛḍhaphalavat, puṣpatokaṃ dṛḍhaphalaṃ ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ dṛṣṭāntau
yathā dṛḍhaphalaṃ svayameva vipacyamānaṃ na pācyate puruṣakāreṇa, puṣpatokaṃ tu vṛkṣāyurvedavidhinā vipācyate

athavā puṣpatokasyaivotpannasya dṛḍhaṃ phalamasya bhāvīti dṛḍhaphalaṃ tādṛkchaktyaivotpannamiti tasyaiva bhavati tacchaktivirahitasya na bhavatīti tadevāprāptapākakālaṃ kadalakāmrādiphalaṃ kodravapalālādiveṣṭitaṃ nikhātaṃ vā pārśvadhūmādibhirvipācyate, netaradavaśyaṃ vināśīti
athavā aprāptavipariṇāmāvasthaṃ puṣpatokamatimṛdutvādupakrameṇāpi na pācyate pācanāyogyatvāt kuthyati vilīyate vā, dṛḍhaphalaṃ tu pācanayogyaṃ prāptakālatvāt pācyate
tokam tugiti ca tauteḥ ke kiki ca iti haimadhātupārāyaṇe
tuṃk vṛttyādāvityasmāt kik pratyayo bhavati, kakāraḥ kitkāryārthaḥ, ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, tuk apatyam
evaṃ ca puṣpatugiti phalaviśeṣaḥ puṣpajanyaṃ vā phalamityarthaḥ

evaṃ ca kṛtvā kriyāsahāyaśca sa phalaṃ prayacchati ekaśca sahāyībhūtāyāḥ kriyāyā api tacchaktimātratvāt, kriyāsahāyasya puruṣakārasya phalapradānaṃ sāpekṣānapekṣaśaktitvāt, bhārotpāṭavat, yathā bhāramutpāṭayan kaścit puruṣaḥ svayamevotpāṭayati, kaścit punaḥ sahāyāpekṣaḥ, evaṃ puruṣakāro'pi phalapradāne sahāyāṃ kriyāmapekṣate kaścit kaścinneti sopakramasya kriyāpekṣā na nirupakramasya
tatra sopa evamanayaiva diśā puruṣakāraikāntavādaḥ pratiṣedhyaḥ
yatraikasya svātantryaṃ tatra tatpradarśitatattvasya itarasyāpīti bhāvanīyam

tathāvagāhādilakṣaṇairastikāyaiḥ kramasya karmātmātmana ityādi yāvat tṛṇadāhavadveti tasyaiva sahaikībhūtasya ātmanaścetanācetanatvena puruṣātmanetyādinā sāpekṣān udayopaśamakṣayopaśamakṣayān avasthāviśeṣān darśayati sodāharaṇān
yatraikasya svātantryaṃ tatra tatpradarśitatattvasya itarasyāpīti bhāvanīyam
atrāha--caturgatāvapi saṃsāre kiṃ vyavasthitā sthitirāyuṣa utākālamṛtyurapyastīti
anapavartanīyāni punardvividhāni--sopakramāṇi nirupakramāṇi ca, apavartanīyāni tu niyataṃ sopakramāṇīti

tatra ye'pavartyāyuṣasteṣāṃ viṣaśastrakaṇṭakāgnyudakādyaśitājīrṇāśaniprapātodbandhanaśvāpadavajranirghātādibhiḥ kṣutpipāsāśītoṣṇādibhiśca dvandvopakramairāyurapavartyate, apavartanaṃ śīghramantarmuhūrtāt karmaphalopabhogaḥ, upakramo'pavartananimittam
atrāha--yadyapavartate karma, tasmāt kṛtanāśaḥ prasajyate yasmānna vedyate
athāstyāyuṣkaṃ karma mriyate ca tasmādakṛtābhyāgamaḥ prasajyate, yena sati āyuṣke mriyate tataścāyuṣkasya karmaṇa āphalyaṃ prasajyate, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
atrocyate--kṛtanāśākṛtābhyāgamāphalyāni karmaṇo na vidyante, nāpyāyuṣkasya jātyantarānubandhaḥ
kintu yathoktairupakramairabhihatasya sarvasaṃdohena udayaprāptamāyuṣkaṃ karma śīghraṃ pacyate tadapavartanamityucyate, saṃhataśuṣkatṛṇarāśidahanavat

yathā hi saṃhatasya śuṣkasyāpi tṛṇarāśeravayavaśaḥ krameṇa dahyamānasya cireṇa dāho bhavati, tasyaiva śithilaprakīrṇopacitasya sarvato yugapadādīpitasya pavanopakramābhihatasya āśu dāho bhavati, tadvat

yathā vā saṅkhyānācāryaḥ karaṇalāghavārthaṃ guṇakārabhāgahārābhyāṃ rāśiṃ chedādevāpavartayati na ca saṅkhyeyasyārthasyābhāvo bhavati, tadvadupakramābhihato maraṇasamuddhātaduḥkhārtaḥ karmapratyayamanābhogayogapūrvakaṃ karaṇaviśeṣamutpādya phalopabhogalāghavārthaṃ karmāpavartayati, na cāsya phalābhāva iti

kiñcānyat, yathā vā dhautapaṭo jalārdra eva saṃhataścireṇa śoṣamupayāti sa eva ca vitānitaḥ sūryaraśmivāyvabhihataḥ kṣipraṃ śoṣamupayāti, na ca saṃhate tasmin prabhūtasnehāgamo nāpi vitānite'kṛtsnaśoṣaḥ, tadvad yathoktanimittāpavartanaiḥ karmaṇaḥ kṣipraṃ phalopabhogo bhavati na ca kṛtapraṇāśākṛtābhyāgamāphalyāni
sopakramaṃ nirupakramaṃ ca karma, tatsaṃyamādaparāntajñānamariṣṭebhyo vā 3
āyurvipākaṃ karma dvividhaṃ sopakramaṃ nirupakramaṃ ca
tatra yathā ārdravastraṃ vitānitaṃ laghīyasā kālena śuṣyet tathā sopakramam
yathā ca tadeva sampiṇḍitaṃ cireṇa saṃśuṣyed evaṃ nirupakramam
yathā cāgniḥ śuṣke kakṣe mukto vātena samantato yuktaḥ kṣepīyasā kālena dahet tathā sopakramam
yathā vā sa evāgnistṛṇarāśau kramato'vayaveṣu nyastaścireṇa dahet tathā nirupakramam
tadaikabhavikamāyuṣkaraṃ karma dvividhaṃ sopakramaṃ nirupakramaṃ ca
anayaiva diśā anayaiva puruṣakāra ityāpādyoktanyāyena tadeva vastu karmasaṃjñāmātreṇa bhāvayitvā puruṣakāraikāntavādaḥ pratiṣedhyaḥ

tadyathā --karma ca kāraṇaṃ pravartayitṛtvāt sukhaduḥkhotkarṣāpakarṣavikalpānubhavāvaśyambhāvi, tasya caikasya uktavat sarvatvādupayogatvāt puruṣatāpi ityādi sarvamaśeṣaṃ yojanīyam, yat pareṇānabhyupagatamanyataraditarat taditarasminnāpādyamiti, tata āha --yatraikasya svātantryaṃ tatra tatpradarśitatattvasya itarasyāpīti bhāvanīyamiti bhāvanopāyaṃ pradarśayati sāmānyena
avagāhādidravyaṃ yathā viyadādi evamātmādyapi, tasyaiva tathābhūteḥ, udakādivrīhitvaśivakādighaṭatvavat

na kevalaṃ karmātmanorevābhinnaikyam, kiṃ tarhi ? yathā cātra tattvaṃ karmātmanoḥ sarvaprabhedeṣu vṛttaṃ bhāvitamasmābhistathā avagāhādilakṣaṇairastikāyaiḥ avagāhagatisthitilakṣaṇairākāśadharmādharmākhyaiḥ saha karmātmavicāroktāt pravartakapravartyanyāyād bhāvanīyamiti vartate
yathā pravartaka eva pravartya ityuktaṃ tathā avagāhādi pravartakaṃ pravartyaṃ cobhayamekameva karmātmavaditi
punarapi tadbhāvanārthamāha --taddravyatvāt, yad yad yaddravyaṃ tat tat tattattvam, yathā prāg bhāvitaṃ pṛthivyādi vrīhyādi
pṛthivyādivat taddravyatvamasiddhamiti cet, netyucyate, avagāhādidravyaṃ yathā viyadādi evamātmādyapi, yathāvagāhopakāraguṇamākāśaṃ gatisthityupakāraguṇau dharmādharmāvevamātmaparamāṇvādidravyamapi
kuto hetoḥ ? tasyaiva tathābhūteḥ, tadeva hyātmapudgaladravyaṃ tathā tathāvagāhagatisthitirūpeṇa bhavati

kimiva ? udakādivrīhitvaśivakādighaṭatvavat, yathodakapṛthivyākāśavātabījāṅkurādaya eva vrīhībhavanti yugapadbhāvino bhāvāḥ yathā ca kramabhāvinaḥ śivaka-sthāsaka-kuśūlakādaya eva ghaṭībhavanti tathā ātmādyapyavagāhādi, avagāhādi viyadādi, viyadādyavagāhādi, avagāhādyātmādi ca bhavatīti tasya tasya taddravyatvam, taddravyatvāt pravartakapravartyaikyanyāyo'vasthitaḥ
avagāho'vagāhamānādātmāṇvāderavibhaktaḥ avagāhyamapyākāśamavagāhadharmasya svaliṅgasya pṛthagasiddheravagāhakādavibhaktaṃ dravyārthavivakṣāyāṃ paryāyasyābhāvāt
tat punaranyatra prativādimate mithyāgrāhotthāpitetyādi yāvat sarvagatetarābhimatadravyamiti

kāryadravyaṃ paṭādi kāraṇadravyāt tantvāderanyat tantvādi ca kāryādanyat, evaṃ guṇāḥ paṭaraktaśyāmatvādayaḥ paṭāt kāraṇakāryākhyāḥ parasparataśca, karmāpyutkṣepaṇādi kriyāvaddravyasamavetaṃ sarvagatāsarvagatadravyād guṇebhyaḥ parasparataśca, dravya-guṇa-karmabhyaḥ parasparataścānye sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyā itītthaṃprabhedaṃ tadevāsmaduktaṃ bhavanaṃ mithyāgrāhotthāpitaṃ kaiścit

yaiścetthaṃ vikalpitaṃ tān prati sarvagatetarābhimatadravyasvarūpamutkṣepaṇādi, ādigrahaṇād rūparasādiguṇagaṇaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyāśca, tacca sarvagatāsarvagatadravyaṃ parasparato'nyonyānyatarasvarūpamātramiti pratijñārthaḥ
tadavyatiriktatvāditi hetuḥ, anantaroktavidhinā ca tadavyatiriktatvaṃ siddham
tatsvarūpamātraṃ tadavyatiriktam anayoḥ śabdayoḥ ko'rthabheda iti cet, na kaścidetannayadarśanena, aparastu śabdabuddhyādibhedamicchatīti tanmatā vyatiriktatvāt ghaṭaghaṭabhavanavat
evaṃ pacikriyāpi pṛthivyādikāṣṭhādisvatattvapratiniyatā kvacidapyanatikrāntadravyasvarūpā pṛthivyādikāṣṭhādidravyamātraṃ bhavanameva
tacca yadasau bhavati sa tasya bhāvaḥ puruṣādiniyamacetanācetanavikalpadvaitaviśeṣaṇavinirmuktaḥ
anena hi pravartayitṛtvāt sarvaprabhedena bhūyate, na na bhūyate'pi abhāvena prāgabhāvādinā, tadātmāna- pekṣayaitaduktam
dṛṣṭāntaḥ ghaṭaghaṭabhavanavat, yathā ghaṭa eva ghaṭabhavanaṃ na tato'nyat tatastadavyatiriktam
yadyanyat syād ghaṭo na bhaved bhavanādanyatvād bhavanavyatiriktatvāt khapuṣpavat, bhavanaṃ vā tasya na syāt tato'nyatvāt paṭabhavanavaditi
ato ghaṭamātraṃ ghaṭabhavanaṃ tadavyatiriktaṃ ca evaṃ sarvagatetaradravyamātramutkṣepaṇādīti
evaṃ pacikriyāpi pṛthivyādikāṣṭhādisvatattvapratiniyatā kvacidapyanatikrāntadravyasvarūpā pṛthivyādikāṣṭhādidravyamātraṃ bhavanameva
tacca yadasau bhavati sa tasya bhāvaḥ puruṣādiniyamacetanācetanavikalpadvaitaviśeṣaṇavinirmuktaḥ
anena hi pravartayitṛtvāt sarvaprabhedena bhūyate, na na bhūyate'pi abhāvena prāgabhāvādinā, tadātmāna-

kāṣṭhādipṛthivyādisvatattve pratiniyatā pacikriyāyā vṛttiḥ pūrvoktasarvapariṇatyāvṛttirūpatvādanyonyasvarūpāpatteśca teṣāmaikyāpattiśceti anatikrāntaṃ dravyasya svarūpaṃ deśe kāle vā yayā pacikriyayā sā kvacidapyanatikrāntadravyasvarūpā

pacikriyāvṛttiḥ pūrvoktasarvapariṇatyāvṛttirūpatvādanyonyasvarūpāpatteśca teṣāmaikyāpattiśceti anatikrāntaṃ dravyasya svarūpaṃ yayā pacikriyāyā vṛttiḥ pūrvoktasarva pariṇatyāvṛttirūpatvādanyonyasvarūpāpatteśca teṣāmaikyāpattiśceti anatikrāntaṃ dravyasya svarūpaṃ yayā pacikriyayā iti dvirbhūto bhā॰ pratau pāṭhaḥ

tacca bhavanaṃ yadasau bhavati sa tasya bhāvaḥ, na tato'nyaḥ, svabhāvasambandhārthastu ṣaṣṭhyapadeśaḥ kraśayatyacetasaḥ iti vacanāt svārthābhidhāyinyevābhede kartṛlakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī--dravyasya bhavanaṃ dravyameva bhavatīti

sa ca bhāvaḥ puruṣādiniyamacetanācetanavikalpadvaitaviśeṣaṇavinirmuktaḥ, puruṣa evedam, niyatireva, kāla eva ityādi cetanamacetanaṃ ca bhavatītyanena vikalpena dvaitamidaṃ manuṣyādi ghaṭādi ceti viśeṣyate yat puruṣādivāde jāgratsuptādyavasthābhedena kramayaugapadyādibhedena vā tena viśeṣaṇena vinirmuktaḥ sa bhāvo nirviśeṣaṇa eva sarvātmakaḥ, ghaṭādi paṭo bhavati vrīhirudakam manuṣyo nabho dharmādharmādi, paṭo'pi ghaṭo vrīhyudakādi, ityaviśeṣeṇa sarvaṃ bhavatyevaikaikamiti tadeva hi bhavanaṃ yat sarvātmakamasadvyāvṛttārtham, na hyasannāma kiñcidasti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? yasmādanena pravartayitṛtvāt sarvaprabhedena vrīhyudakākāśāṅkurādinā bhūyate, na na bhūyate'pīti dviḥ pratiṣedhād bhavanamevābhāvavyāvṛttyā niyamyate bhavatyeva, na na bhavati iti
kena punarna bhavati ? abhāvena prāgabhāvādinā, asmin hi naye na kenacit prakāreṇa kiñcinna bhavatīti prākpradhvaṃsānyātyantābhāvā na santyeva
kutaḥ ? tadātmānatiriktatvāt, sa sa ātmā tadātmā tasyātmā vā tadātmā, tato'natiriktatvāt
yad yad yadātmānatiriktaṃ tasya tasya prāgabhāvādyabhāvaḥ, tenāpyātmanā bhavatyevetyarthaḥ
bhūtvā na bhavati abhūtvā ca bhavati, anyathā'bhāvatvāpatteḥ
acetana iti ca cetanādanya ātmaivoktaḥ paryudāsavācitvānnañaḥ, nocyate cetano na bhavatyacetana iti cetanā na bhavatyacetanā iti jñānādi na bhavatyajñānādirvā iti

kimiva ? bālakumārādivat, yathā bālaḥ kumāro yuvā madhyamaḥ sthaviro vā iti devadatta eva tena tena prakāreṇa bhavati bālakāle kaumārābhāvena kaumāre'bālabhāvena yajñadattādyanyābhāvena kharaviṣāṇādyatyantābhāvena ca sarvaḥ sarvadā sarvatra sarvathā ca bhavati sa eva devadattastattadātmakastathā sarvadravyabhavanamiti

bhūtvā na bhavatyabhūtvā ca bhavatīti, mṛtpiṇḍakāle na na bhavati ghaṭastadavyatiriktātmakatvād devadattabālakumārādivat, kapālakāle na na bhavati ghaṭaḥ tadavyatiriktātmakatvād devadattabālakumārādivat

yadyevaṃ neṣyate tvayā prāgabhāvādināpi bhavatyeva iti, tatastasya devadattādervastuno bālakumārādisarvāvasthātmaparityāge kiṃ tad devadattākhyaṃ vastu ? kāstāstadvyatiriktā bālādyavasthāḥ ? ityabhāva āpadyate
bhūtvā na bhavati abhūtvā ca bhavati, anyathā'bhāvatvāpatteḥ
acetana iti ca cetanādanya ātmaivoktaḥ paryudāsavācitvānnañaḥ, nocyate cetano na bhavatyacetana iti cetanā na bhavatyacetanā iti jñānādi na bhavatyajñānādirvā iti
atrāha--na cetano'cetanaḥ iti nañā pratiṣedhavācinā sambandhādacetanarūpeṇa cetanasya bhāvābhāva iti
atra brūmaḥ --acetana iti ca cetanādanya ātmaivoktaḥ paryudāsavācitvād nañaḥ, nātyantābhāvavācitvāt

sa ko'nyaścetanādanya ātmaiva iti cet, ucyate--sparśāsparśādidharmaṇastasyaivopayogādyasparśarūpādanyena rūpeṇa sa eva sparśādimān jñānāvaraṇādikarmarūpa ātmā, tena cetanādanyenācetana iti cetana evoktaḥ, na tu bhavanmatātyantacetanābhāvarūpeṇa, prasajyapratiṣedhākhyasya vikalpāntarasyābhāvād nocyate cetano na bhavatyacetanaḥ iti
tathā cetanā na bhavatyacetanā iti nocyate'jñānādi jñānadarśanavīryādi na bhavatīti, kiṃ tarhi ? cetanāyā anyā'cetanā, kā sā ? sparśādīti
tathā jñānādi na bhavatītyajñānādi nocyate, kiṃ tarhi ? jñānāderanyadajñānādi sparśādyeva

acetanā'jñānayorbhūya udāharaṇaṃ cetanātmano dravyasya nirdeśenāparituṣṭasya parasya tadabhipretaparyāyanirdeśena pratipādanārtham, ajñānādirveti, kiyatī vodāharaṇamālā kriyate ? yo'pyajñāna-saṃśaya-viparyayajñānādirjñānād bhinna ityabhimato dharmakalāpaḥ so'pi jñānājñānātmātmarūpāderbhinna eveti tatrāpi na tu jñānādirna bhavatyajñānādirityucyate, kiṃ tarhi ? jñānāderanya evājñānādirityātmaiva ajñānādirūpeṇocyate iti
yadyeṣa nyāyo neṣyate tataḥ tathā sarvato vyāvṛtterayuktaḥ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ, svato'pi vyāvṛtteḥ khapuṣpavadasattvāt
anyatvācca tattva eva prāgabhāvādivyāvṛtterbālakumārādivat tattva evatattvameva cetanā
ato rūpādimadapyātmā, cetanatvāt, abhimatātmavat, tasyaiva tathābhūtatvādā mukteḥ
evaṃ ca kṛtvā jñānaṃ na jñānaṃ pudgalātmakatvād rūpādivat, ajñānamapi ca jñānaṃ tata eva tadvat, cetano'cetanaḥ, acetanaścetana ityādi

yadyeṣa nyāyo neṣyate'nyaḥ sa prasajyapratiṣedha iṣyate cetano na bhavatyacetana ityādiriṣyate tvayā tata evaṃ sati tathā tena prakāreṇa sarvato vyāvṛttiḥ, ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavatīti paṭo'pi ghaṭo na bhavatīti parasparavyāvṛttivat sarvabhāvavyāvṛtteścetanācetanayorvyāvṛttiḥ
tataśca sarvato vyāvṛtterayuktaḥ prasajyapratiṣedho nirviśeṣavyāvṛttyarthatvād naña iti
syānmatam--svatastvavyāvṛttirbhaviṣyati ghaṭavaditi cet, ucyate --svato'pi vyāvṛtteḥ, svato'pi tarhi vyāvṛttaṃ tat paraparikalpitaṃ vastu prāpnoti sarvato vyāvṛttatvāt khapuṣpavat
tasmāt sthitametat--asattvaprasaṅgāt prasajyapratiṣedhābhāvācca prāgabhāvādivyāvṛtteranyatvamarthaḥ bālaḥ kumāro na bhavati ityādiṣu
tata upasaṃhriyate maula eva anyatvācca tattva eva prāgabhāvādivyāvṛtterbālakumārādivat tattvameva cetaneti
sā punaridānīṃ cetanā kiṃsvarūpā ? iti vācyā, ucyate --jñānadarśanādisaṃvedanā, sākārānākāropayogau saprabhedau jñānadarśanagrahaṇena gṛhītau, ādigrahaṇena sukhaduḥkharāgadveṣabhayādisaṃvedanā gṛhītā

sāpi ca nirvṛttyupakaraṇalabdhitattva upayogātmā, indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ nirvṛttiḥ pakṣmapuṭakṛṣṇasārāditvena niṣpattiḥ, upakaraṇaṃ tu masūrakātimuktakakadambakṣuraprānekākāratayā pradeśānāṃ niṣpattiḥ, etannayadarśanena vāñjanapādābhyaṅgapradīpādyapyupakārakamupalabdheḥ sarvamupakaraṇam

labdhiḥ punarnirvṛtteḥ prāk paścāccātmanā pūrvopāttaṃ tadyogyanāmakarmodayajaṃ dravyaṃ jñānadarśanāvaraṇayorvīryāntarāyasya ca kṣayakṣayopaśamau, tattattva upayogo jñānadarśanasvatattvavyaktiḥ, sa eva cātmā
tataḥ kimiti cet, ato rūpādimadapyātmā, yadetad rūparasādidharma mūrtapaudgalamādhyātmikamindriyapāṇyādyavayavātmakaṃ śarīraṃ tadapi ātmaiva
kimiva ? abhimatātmavat, yathā śuddhopayogalakṣaṇaḥ kevalī ātmā cetanatvāt tathendriyādyapi rūpādimaditi

tat samarthayati --tasyaiva tathābhūtatvādā mukteḥ, sa eva hi dravyakevalī saṃsārāvastha upayogātmā tathābhūto nirāvaraṇajñānadarśanaḥ saṃvṛtto'bhimatātmā, tasmādā muktestasyaiva tathābhūtatvādihāpi saṃsāre sa eveti rūpādimataḥ puruṣasya muktasya copayogātmakatvādaviśeṣa eva
evaṃ ca kṛtvā jñānaṃ na jñānaṃ pudgalātmakatvād rūpādivat, pudgalātmakatvaṃ ca jñānasyānantaraṃ evaṃ cāyaṃ saṅgraheṣu dravyaprakṛtinayaḥ
dravyamapi dravati yāti na vicchidyate bhinnarūpavyāptyā
nanu karmasādhanavyākhyānena tenaiva kartṛsādhanatvameva vyavasthāpitam, dravyeṇaiva dravyaṃ kriyate vrīhivat iti kartari tṛtīyayā kartṛsādhanatvābhyupagamāt
etasmiṃśca naye dravyameva śabdārtho nityaḥ sarvātmakaḥ
ajñānamapi ca jñānaṃ tata eva tadvat, cetano'cetanaḥ, acetanaścetana ityanekadhā sarvasarvātmakatāṃ bhāvayati
ityādigrahaṇānnidarśanamātrametad bhāvitam, anayā diśā sarvatra bhāvanīyamiti
dravyamapi dravati yāti na vicchidyate bhinnarūpavyāptyā
nanu karmasādhanavyākhyānena tenaiva kartṛsādhanatvameva vyavasthāpitam, dravyeṇaiva dravyaṃ kriyate vrīhivat iti kartari tṛtīyayā kartṛsādhanatvābhyupagamāt
etasmiṃśca naye dravyameva śabdārtho nityaḥ sarvātmakaḥ
āha--ārṣokteṣu nayeṣu katamo'yam ? iti, atrocyate --evaṃ cāyaṃ saṅgraheṣu
saṅgrahaḥ śatavikalpaḥ, ekkeko ya satavidho satta ṇayasatā havaṃti te cevaṃ āvani॰āva॰ ni॰ 759 iti vacanāt
teṣu saṅgraheṣu ayaṃ vidhiniyamanayo draṣṭavyo ya evaṃ varṇitaḥ
te'pi ca saṅgrahāḥ saṅgraheṇa trividhā bhavanti dravya-sthitanayaprakṛtayaḥ
dravyaprakṛtayaḥ karma-puruṣakārādyekāntavādāḥ, sthitaprakṛtayaḥ puruṣa-kāla-niyatyādivādāḥ, nayaprakṛtayaḥ prakṛtīśvarādikāraṇavādāḥ
teṣu cāyaṃ nayaḥ sthitaprakṛtīnāṃ puruṣa-kāla-niyati-svabhāvanayānāṃ virodhinorīśvaranayasya pradhānanayasya cādhiṣṭhātṛpradhānākhyayorvipakṣo dravyaprakṛtinayo vidhiniyamabhaṅgo draṣṭavyaḥ
sa ca saṅgrahaikadeśatvād dravyārthaḥ, niyamātmakatvāt paryāyāṃśasparśitve'pi saṅgrahaikadeśatvād dravyārtha evāyamiti

dravyaśabdo'pi kartṛsādhanaḥ, dravyamapi dravatītyādiparyāyaśabdaistadarthaṃ vyācaṣṭe, dravati yāti na vicchidyate bhinnarūpavyāptyā bhinnāni rūpāṇi cetanācetanāni vrīhipṛthivyādīni devamanuṣyādīni ca sākalyena vyāpnotyeva na kiñcidapi tyajatīti

codaka āha --nanu karmaṇi karmasādhanatvamuditam, karmakāraṇavyākhyāne'yaṃ dravyaśabdaḥ karmasādhana evoktaḥ drūyata iti dravyam iti, karmavādaśca vidhiniyamabhaṅga ityuktam, tat kathamadhunā'vadhāryaṃ dravatīti dravyaṃ kartṛsādhanamucyata iti
atra vidhiniyamanayo brūte pūrvoktameva smārayan --nanu karmasādhanavyākhyānena tenaiva kartṛsādhanatvameva vyavasthāpitamiti

tat kathamiti cet, ucyate --dravyeṇaiva dravyaṃ kriyate vrīhivaditi kartari tṛtīyā dravyeṇa iti, tayā kartṛsādhanatvābhyupagamāt prāgasmābhiḥ puruṣakarmapṛthivīvrīhyādīnāmātmanaivātmanaḥ kartuḥ karmatvasya ca vistareṇa varṇitavat satyāṃ karmatāyāmapi kartṛtvaṃ dravyatvāditi sāmānyārthasyāvicchedāt svātantryāt
etasmiṃśca naye dravyameva śabdārthaḥ, na paryāyārthaḥ padārtha ityarthaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--ataḥ paraṃ śabdārthavyavahāro nivartate nirvikalpatvāt, vyavahārātīto'yamarthaḥ
tatra kiṃ satyam ? vikalpa iti svayameva pṛṣṭvā vyācaṣṭe
na kadācidapyatra pṛthivī nāmāsti aśmasikatāmṛlloṣṭavajrādīn vimucya, ta eva hi vikalpāḥ pṛthivī, na pṛthivyeva te
vikalpe kiṃ satyam ? jñānam, te'pi ca vikalpā jñānādanye na santi, jñānameva ātmakarmalakṣaṇaṃ caitanyaṃ tathā tathā vijṛmbhate, caitanyasyaiva vyavahāramārgapātitvāt
jñāne kiṃ satyam ? om, avati rakṣati pātiyāti prīyate tṛpyati cetanācetanabhede satyapyevamādidhātvarthātmanā vipariṇamamānaṃ karmātmatayaikaṃ bhavati yena yathā parikalpyate tat tathānuvartata ityom
sa eṣa paramārthaḥ, tadetat tattvaṃ paramaṃ brahma bṛhaditi

tasyārthaṃ kathayati etaduktaṃ bhavati--ataḥ paraṃ śabdārthavyavahāro nivartate nirvikalpatvāditi, iyaṃ śabdārthavyavahāragatiryāvannirvikalpaṃ jñānamevaitaditi, ataḥ paraṃ brahma iti yat paraṃ tattvaṃ tatra jñānamapi nirvikalpaṃ sad na kramate, taddarśayati --vyavahārātīto'yamarthaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--ataḥ paraṃ śabdārthavyavahāro nivartate nirvikalpatvāt, vyavahārātīto'yamarthaḥ
ūrdhvapadanamutpādaḥ āvirbhāva ityarthaḥ, vinaśanaṃ vināśastirobhāva ityarthaḥ

katham om ityeṣo'nvayavyatirekarahitaḥ śabdārtho bhavitumarhatīti cet, ko brūte'nvayavyatirekarahita iti ? yasmādatrānuvṛttivyāvṛttī anantaroktapṛthivyādidhātuvikalpajñānasatyatvānuprabandhasāmarthyopahitarūpe, pṛthivyādidhātūnāmacetanābhimatānāṃ vikalpasatyānāṃ cetanakarmātmanokarmābhimatānāṃ ca jñānasatyasvarūpapuruṣatvena vānvitavyatiriktānām om iti karmātmaikyāpattyā tatsatyatvānuprabandhena śaktyupadhānaṃ nityamevetyanvayavyatirekavānevāyaṃ śabdārtha iti
te cānuvṛttivyāvṛttī yo yo bhāgo yathābhāgaṃ prasiddhimabhidhānābhidheyavyavahārātmikāṃ karma iti puruṣaḥ iti karmapuruṣakāra iti eka eva iti vā prasiddhiṃ gacchata iti

atrotpādavināśaśabdāvapi tatsthitarūpāveva nāsadudbhavātyantavināśarūpāviti, tadvyācaṣṭe --ūrdhvapadanamityādi gatārtham, yathāsaṅkhyamāvirbhāvatirobhāvasvarūpayorapi bhāvābhidhāyitvādavasthita evārtha utpadyate vinaśyatīti cocyate tathā vākyārtho'pi ca pṛthak sarvaṃ padam, sarvasarvātmakatvāt
nibandhanamapyasya ārṣam--je ekaṇāme se bahuṇāme ācārāṅgasū॰ 1

anityaghaṭādiśabdā apīti, anityaḥ pradhvastaḥ ityādayo ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ ityādayaśca śabdāḥ pṛthivyādilakṣaṇā api nātyantamutpannamabhūtaṃ vārthaṃ bruvate, kiṃ tarhi ? svatattvabījaṃ dravyamevāvicchinnamāhuḥ, svatattvaṃ yadabhūtvā bhavati bhūtvā ca na bhavati tadanityam, samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle ktvāpratyayavidhānāt
sa eva tu dṛśyādṛśyapariṇāmābhyāṃ bhavati na bhavatīti svatattvasya anityatvasya bījaṃ dravyamevārthaḥ
ghaṭādi tāvattadanityatvam, tasya bījamavasthitaṃ dravyaṃ sāmānyameva aṅkurādervrīhivat
tadevāvicchinnaṃ mahāpṛthivīvadanutpādavyayayogi avṛddham avicāli kūṭasthaṃ dhruvaṃ nānyaditi padārthaḥ
vākyārtho'pi ca pṛthak sarvaṃ padam, sarvasarvātmakatvāt
nibandhanamapyasya ārṣam--je ekaṇāme se bahuṇāme ācārāṅgasū॰ 1
vākyārtho'pi ca pṛthak sarvaṃ padam, pratyekaṃ padaṃ vākyam devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklām ityatra devadatta evetarapadārthaparisamāpteḥ karmavibhaktyante gośabde ca tathāparisamāpteritarapadārthānām

na caitāḥ svamanīṣikā ucyante, kintu nibandhanamapyasya darśanasya ārṣamasti yato'sya darśanasya vinirgama iti taddarśayati --je ekaṇāme se bahuṇāme, yadekasya bhāvaḥ tat sarvasyāpi yat sarvasya tadekasyāpi
atra yadekasya nāma tat sarvasyāpi ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
iti caturtho'ro nayacakrasya samāptaḥ prathamaśca mārgo nemirityarthaḥ | ardhamekapustakaṃ samāptam || cha
kintvidaṃ dravyamevārthaḥ iti virudhyate'bhyupagamena svavacanena vā tadavayavena vā, yat tad bhavati tasya bhāvatvādapi, ato'nyathā'sattvāt khapuṣpavat, ubhayam--dravyaṃ bhāvaśca
evamanantaranayenābhihite bravītyuttaraḥ --satyametad yaducyate tvayā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ iti
kintvidaṃ dravyamevārthaḥ iti virudhyate, dravyaṃ ca bhavye pā॰ 5

104, dravatīti dravyaṃ drūyata iti vā dravyamiti kartṛkarmasādhanavyutpattimātrabhede satyapi arthabhedābhāvāt sarvasarvātmakatvācca dravyameva pṛthivyādivrīhyādibhāvena bhavati nānyaḥ kaścidbhāvo'sti ityetadavadhāraṇaṃ virudhyate, kena saha virudhyate ? abhyupagamena, yasmāt tvayaivābhyupagataṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ dravyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ iti bhavanalakṣaṇasya prakṛtyarthasya sādhyasya dravyalakṣaṇena pratyayārthena sādhanena kartrā viśeṣaṇāt taddvyarthatābhyupagateti, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayośca bhedāt dravyamevārthaḥ iti pūrvo'bhyupagamo virudhyate, itarathā vaiyarthyaṃ paunaruktyaṃ vā syād dravyaṃ bhavati iti

athavā prakṛṣṭakālenābhyupagamena virudhyate iti kiṃ citramāyatyām ? kintu svavacanena vā virudhyate iti vartate, vāśabdasya vikalpārthatvāt samuccayārthatvādvā abhyupagamena svavacanena ca virudhyata iti, ata āha --tadavayavena vā, bhavati iti dravyam iti vā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhedānupādāne'pi ekasminneva pade prakṛtipratyayārthabhedopādānāt, bhū sattāyāṃ prakṛtiḥ, laṭpratyayaḥ kartari, tau prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtaḥ pradhānopasarjanabhāvena, yathā rājapuruṣau puruṣārthamiti, tathā dravyamityatrāpi dru gatau pā॰ dhā॰ 945 kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam pā॰ 3

kiṃ kāraṇam ? yat tadbhavati tasya bhāvatvādapi, yat tat tvadiṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ tad bhāvo'pi kriyāpi, kriyā bhāvaḥ pravṛttiriti paryāyāḥ, bhāvasyāpi bhāvāt bhavatīti bhāvaḥ iti vyutpatteḥ dravyam iti bhavati iti ca vacanād bhavanasya dravyād bhinnatvāt
ato'nyathā'sattvāt, yadi dravyaṃ bhāvo'pi na syāt kriyāpi na syāt tatastadasat syādabhāvatvādakriyatvāt khapuṣpavaditi
tasmād dravyakriyayoḥ sattvād yaduktaṃ tvayā dravyamātramutkṣepaṇādi iti tadasat

tatra sammūrcchitasarvaprabhedanirbhedaṃ bījaṃ dravyam, tathābhavanavinābhūtasannidhivastutvavyaktiḥ kriyā, pravṛttiḥ kriyā bhāvaḥ, vadanagataniyatakramākārarūpaparimāṇamāyākārakapatākikāsantānaniṣkālavat, māyākārakavad dravyādanutpādavyayātmakāt pṛthivyādermūlādayaḥ, yathāsvaṃ patākikāmālāvat kriyātmānaḥ

tasmācca na ekaṃ sarvam anantaranayadarśanam, na sarvamekaṃ puruṣaniyatyādivikalpavidhividhinayadarśanam, nāpi vidhyubhayadarśanaṃ kartrakartṛbhūtaṃ prakṛtipuruṣamidam, nādhiṣṭhātradhiṣṭheyamidamitīśvarakāraṇaṃ pradhānopasarjanabhūtaṃ prāṅnirdiṣṭam, kiṃ tarhi ? ubhayaṃ kartṛ bhavanasya pradhānaṃ ca tulyabalatvādasya bhāvo bhavatīti sāmānyena, kiṃ punastadubhayamityata āha --dravyaṃ bhāvaśca
atra bhāvaśabdaḥ kriyāvacanaḥ kriyā bhāvo dhātuḥ pā॰ vā॰ 1
tasmāddvayaṃ dvayaṃ sarvaṃ ghaṭapaṭādi bhavati pacatyādivat

tatra sammūrchitasarvaprabhedanirbhedam, sammūrchitāḥ saṃsṛṣṭāḥ avinirbhāgena sarve prabhedāḥ pacipaṭhibhujigamyāsiśayyādayaḥ kṛṣṇagauradanturahrasvadīrghatādayaśca yasmiṃstat sammūrchitasarvaprabhedaṃ tat sarvatra svarūpasamavasthānād nirbhedaṃ ca tadagṛhītataraṅgādiprabhedasaraḥsalilavat tat teṣāṃ bījamāśrayo dravyamityetad dravyalakṣaṇam

tathābhavanavinābhūtasannidhivastutvavyaktiḥ kriyā, tena prakāreṇa pacipaṭhigamyādinā bhavanaṃ tathābhavanam, tena bhavanena vinābhūtaḥ sannidhiḥ śaktimanmātrāvasthā śaktyanabhivyaktiryasya vastunastat tathābhavanavinābhūtasannidhivastu, tasya bhāvo vastutvam, tadvyaktiḥ vastuśaktyabhivyaktiḥ kriyā ityetat kriyālakṣaṇam
tasya dvayasya svatantrasya bhāvasya nidarśanam --vadanagatetyādi yāvad niṣkālavaditi
māyākārakavadane vyavasthitaḥ kramo yāsāmākārā rūpāṇi parimāṇāni ca tā māyākārakapatākikāḥ, tāsāṃ santānasya niṣkālavat

pṛthak tayoḥ svarūpavyākhyānārthamāha --māyākārakavad dravyādanutpādavyayātmakāt pṛthivyādermūlādaya iti jagad dārṣṭāntikaṃ dṛṣṭāntena māyākārakeṇa samīkurvan dravyaṃ vyācaṣṭe kriyāṃ ca yathāsvaṃ patākikāmālāvat kriyātmāna iti ca
yā yā svā yathāsvaṃ patākikāmālā avyavacchedena nīlapītādivarṇā hrasvadīrghāditanusthūlādisaṃsthānapramāṇā niyatā eva krameṇa niṣkasanti tathā pacati gacchati ityādikriyā dravyād devadattāderiti
tato'nyā api ca tāstena vinā na bhavanti, so'pi tābhirvinā na bhavati, atha ca niyatākārarūpaparimāṇāstāḥ sa ca tatpariṇatavyaktiriti dvayamapi bhavatīti
atra pṛthak ca tayoḥ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
evaṃ tasminneva dravyakriyātmani vastunyantarbhāvāt padārthāntarakalpanāvaiyarthyam kriyāmātratvād guṇādyāśritapadārthānām

dravyajātibhedaparikalpanāvaiyarthyaṃ ca sarvadravyāṇāṃ kriyāvattvāditi tatpradarśanārthamāha— dravyavaddravyasaṃyojanaviyojanotkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇāditathābhavanaviśeṣaṇasamavayanādayo bhavanameva dravati jānāti icchati dveṣṭi dhvanati yatate saṃyunakti viyunakti śvetate ityādi

pṛthivyādisaṃyojanaviyojanotkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇatathābhavanaviśeṣaṇasamavayanādibhavanena vinā na dravyabhedāḥ sambhavanti yāvadantyaṃ dravyam, pṛthivyādinā vinā na saṃyojanaviyojanotkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇatathābhavanaviśeṣaṇasamavayanādayo na mūlādibhāvo veti dravyabhāvaparigrahaḥ

evaṃ ca kṛtvoktam--na hi kiñcit svasminnātmani muhūrtamapyavatiṣṭhate vardhate yāvadanena adravyadravyavaddravyasaṃyojanetyādayaḥ, guṇādayastāvat kriyaiva iti prāguktam, adhunāpyucyate taddvāreṇa jātyabhedaśca
tasya dvividhasyāpi dravyasya jātibhedābhāvaḥ, yasmāt saṃyojanaṃ prāptiḥ kriyā pariṇatilakṣaṇā, saiva saṃyogo guṇo'ṇvākāśādīnām, ātmākāśāderapi pariṇamanakriyāvattvāduktavadakriyasyāsattvāt
evaṃ viyojanaṃ vibhāgaḥ kriyāmātraṃ na guṇaḥ
tathā rūpyate'kṣibhyāmiti rūpam, rasyate jihvayeti rasaḥ, evaṃ gandhasparśaśabdā anye ca saṅkhyādayo neyā buddhyā saṅkhyāyamānatvāt
tathābhavanamiti sattāsāmānyaṃ dravyasyaiva samānasya bhavanam, yat samānena bhūyate
viśeṣaṇamiti viśeṣaḥ kriyaiva yena nīlādinā gamanādinā kriyāmātreṇa dravyasya viśeṣeṇa bhavanaṃ sa sa viśeṣaḥ
samavayanaṃ sambandhaḥ, so'pi saṃyoga eva, sam ityekībhāvenāvayavānāmavasthānaṃ tantvādīnāṃ paṭāditvena samavāya iheti kāryakāraṇayorekībhavanam
ādigrahaṇād yāvatsamavāyidravyaṃ bhedāt samavāyānantyaṃ darśayati ṣaṭpadārthaparimāṇābhāvaṃ ca pariṇāmadharmānantyāt kriyāguṇādipadārthānantyācca
bhavanameva bhāva eva kriyaiva, na guṇādayaḥ santīti bhavanaśabdena kriyāṃ darśayati
idānīṃ dravyaṃ darśayitukāma āha --dravatītyādi yāvacchvetata ityādi kārakaṃ tallakāreṇa kartṛvācinā drujñeṣidviṣidhvaniyatisaṃyujiviyujiśvitīnāṃ sādhyānāṃ kriyāviśeṣāṇāṃ sakartṛkāṇāmabhidhānāt
dravyavaddravyasaṃyojanaviyojanotkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇāditathābhavanaviśeṣaṇasamavayanādayo bhavanameva dravati jānāti icchati dveṣṭi dhvanati yatate saṃyunakti viyunakti śvetate ityādi

pṛthivyādisaṃyojanaviyojanotkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇatathābhavanaviśeṣaṇasamavayanādibhavanena vinā na dravyabhedāḥ sambhavanti yāvadantyaṃ dravyam, pṛthivyādinā vinā na saṃyojanaviyojanotkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇatathābhavanaviśeṣaṇasamavayanādayo na mūlādibhāvo veti dravyabhāvaparigrahaḥ
evaṃ ca kṛtvoktam--na hi kiñcit svasminnātmani muhūrtamapyavatiṣṭhate vardhate yāvadanena

ādau tāvad bhavanena kriyayā bhāvena vinā na dravyabhedāḥ sambhavanti pṛthivyādayo yāvadantyaṃ dravyaṃ paramāṇudravyamiti, pṛthivyādinetyādi yāvanna mūlādibhāvo vetyuktānāmeva dravyabhedānāmabhāve saṃyojanādayaḥ kriyābhedā na santītyādi tenāniṣṭāpādanam
tasmād dravyabhāvaparigraho yukta ityupanayati, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt
evaṃ ca kṛtvetyādi yāvadapāyena vā yujyata iti bhāṣyakāreṇa sāṅkhyādāhṛtyokto jñāpakagranthaḥ vardhitavyamapāyena vā yujyate pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1

na hi kaścidartho dravyaṃ svasminnātmani nirbhedanirupākhye muhūrtamapi avatiṣṭhate, apiśabdād yāvat samayamapi nāvatiṣṭhate, vardhate yāvadanena vardhitavyam, yāvadanena apetavyaṃ tāvadeva apāyena yujyate, sannihitavyaktiyuktatvāt
yadi tu dravyamityevākriyamabhaviṣyat tato nābhaviṣyat, prāk tadā vā paścācca so'yamasminneva dravyakriyātmakavastuvāde ghaṭate, na paramataikāntadravyapariṇāmavāde nāpi satatapravṛttakṣaṇikavāde

tad vyācaṣṭe --na hi kaścidartho dravyam, na hi kiñcit iti prāptasya sāmānyanapuṃsakanirdeśasya arthaḥ iti pu~lliṅgena viśeṣya vyākhyānam, yathoktam --avyakte guṇasandehe napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ prayoktavyam, jāyamānaṃ hi dvayameva jāyate--pumān strī vā, tathāpi vaktāro bhavanti--kimasya jātam ? iti pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1

punarapi cārthaśabdaparyāyamāha --dravyamiti bhāṣyakāramatenaiva, svasminnātmani dravyātmanītyarthaḥ, nirbhedanirupākhye gamanaspandananimeṣonmeṣādibhedavirahite tasya bhedavirahitasya nirupākhyatvāt, taddhi dravyaṃ dharmarahitamupākhyātumaśakyam, anupākhyatvāccāsadeva syāt, atastad muhūrtamapi nāvatiṣṭhate pariṇatikriyāvirahitam
tad vyācaṣṭe --apiśabdād yāvat samayamapi nāvatiṣṭhate nālikālavastokaprāṇocchvāsaniḥśvāsakramahānyā, tataḥ paraṃ sūkṣmakālābhāvāt
etena svātmanyanavasthānavacanena vṛddhihānisatatasampravṛttirūpaṃ sarvaṃ vastu iti dravyapratyākhyānameva kṛtam

vardhate yāvadanena vardhitavyamiti tu punaḥ yat parimāṇamasya yāvat iti niyataparimāṇāṃ vṛddhiṃ padmādīnāmiva sādhikasahasrayojanāt parato na bhūtāṃ kadāciditi darśayatā tasyaiva dravyasyāvasthitasyāvasthāviśeṣa eva vṛddhiriti darśitaṃ bhavati

tathāpāyo'pi, yāvadanenāpetavyaṃ tāvadevāpāyena yujyata iti yāvacchabdārthamadhikṛtaṃ bhāvayati, yathā sūkṣmanigodāparyāptakajīvasyāvaraṇāntarāyakṣayopaśamakṛtayogopayogasvarūpasyākṣarānantatamabhāgopalambhamātre'vaśyamavatiṣṭhate jñānadṛṣṭyāvaraṇavīryāntarāyodayajanitopaghātayogopayogahāniḥ, na tataḥ paraṃ hīyate, anyathā tasyajīvatvaprasaṅgāditi
tasmād yāvadvacanād dravyamevāvasthitaṃ vardhate'paiti vā, na ca vṛddhyapāyarahitasamavasthitatve satyapi, ityeṣo'sya granthasyārthaḥ
tasmādayamapi grantho dvyātmakadarśanenaiva netuṃ śakyate, nānyatheti pratipattavyam

kiṃ kāraṇam ? sannihitavyaktiyuktatvāt, sannihitasya avasthitaśaktereva vyaktirāvirbhāvaḥ salilasekena bhūmigandhasya, tasyā vyakteryuktatvāt dravyaṃ ca kriyā ca bhavati iti grāhyam, anyathā tadayukterasatkāryavādaprasaṅgādasambhavācca
vardhitavyamapāyena vā yujyate pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1

na hi kaścidartho dravyaṃ svasminnātmani nirbhedanirupākhye muhūrtamapi avatiṣṭhate, apiśabdād yāvat samayamapi nāvatiṣṭhate, vardhate yāvadanena vardhitavyam, yāvadanena apetavyaṃ tāvadeva apāyena yujyate, sannihitavyaktiyuktatvāt
na hīdaṃ kaścidapi svasminnātmani muhūrtamapyavatiṣṭhate vardhate yāvadanena vardhitavyamapacayena vā yujyate
yadi tu dravyamityevākriyamabhaviṣyat tato nābhaviṣyat, prāk tadā vā paścācca

katham ? yadi tu dravyam ityevākriyamabhavanamabhaviṣyad vṛddhivyayarahitamapariṇāmaikāntarūpaṃ yadyabhaviṣyat tato nābhaviṣyaditi kriyātipattau ḷṅ, na bhavanamevāpadyata iti na bhavatyevetyarthaḥ, kriyā bhavanaṃ pravṛtti apravṛttatvāt, khapuṣpavat
ātmādyapi ca pravṛttameva, dravyatvāt, tantuvad bījavat
tathā ca caitanyādilakṣaṇatā ātmādestathābhavanapravṛttisāmarthyāt satyapi dravyatvatulyatve

atha tu pravṛttirityevādravyā tato naiva syāt sā prāk paścāt tadā vā'dravyatvā- rityarthaḥ, yadi na pravarteta na pariṇamet na kriyāpi syāt dravyaṃ prāk kenacid gamanādiprakāreṇāvṛttam tadā vā iti sāmānyakālavācinā śabdena idānīmapi nirdeśakāle tadapravartamānam paścāccaiṣyatkāle'pyapravartiṣyamāṇaṃ na syādityarthaḥ, apravṛttatvāt
kimuktaṃ bhavati ? prāg nāsīt idānīmapravṛttatvāt khapuṣpavat
idānīṃ na syāt prāgapravṛttatvāt khapuṣpavat, paścānna bhaviṣyati idānīmapravṛttatvāt khapuṣpavadevetyabhūtaṃ tat syād dravyaṃ kriyāśūnyatvāt pariṇāmaśūnyatvādapravṛttatvādityarthaḥ
bhavadeva hi bhavati, pravartamānameva hi kenaciddharmeṇa mṛdiva śivakādinā bhavati, na nirupākhyam
yadi nirupākhyamapi syāt khapuṣpamapi syāt, khapuṣpamapi vā'bhaviṣyad bhavati bhaviṣyati ca tvadabhimatadravyavat abhavadbhavanāditi akriyabhavanādityarthaḥ
ātmādyapi ca pravṛttameva, dravyatvāt, tantuvad bījavat
tathā ca caitanyādilakṣaṇatā ātmādestathābhavanapravṛttisāmarthyāt satyapi dravyatvatulyatve
atha tu pravṛttirityevādravyā tato naiva syāt sā prāk paścāt tadā vā'dravyatvā-
syānmatam, anaikāntikametat--abhavadbhavanāt khapuṣpamapi bhaved dravyavat, dravyamapi mā bhūdapravṛttatvāt khapuṣpavaditi
