etaccāyuktam, tadvipakṣatvāsiddheḥ, yasmād ātmādyapi ca pravṛttameva dravyatvāt tantuvad bījavaditi
yathā tantavastantvavasthāyāṃ paṭāvasthāyāṃ ca pravṛttatvād bhavantyeva tathā ātmādayaḥ, evaṃ bījameva hyaṅkurādibhāveṣu pravṛttameva tathātmādaya iti dṛṣṭāntadvayopādānād nyāyavyāpitā pradarśyate
tasmāt tena tena prakāreṇa pariṇamamānaṃ pravartamānaṃ vastu bhavatītyucyate, svena svena ca pāriṇāmikena prakāreṇa bhavati pariṇamatīti
satyapi tulye dravyatve'styeva jīvadravyāṇāmajīvadravyāṇāṃ ca bhavanaviśeṣaḥ

tadyathā--jīvadravyasya caitanyavīryāmūrtyasaṅkhyātapradeśāvagāhādistathābhavanapravṛttisāmarthyam, ajīvadravyeṣvapi pudgalānāṃ rūparasādikarmadoṣakarmādi tathābhavanasāmarthyam, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ ca dharmādharmākāśakālānāṃ gatisthityavagāhavartanāstathābhavanasāmarthyāni

evaṃ tāvad dravyasya kriyāvirahitasyābhāva uktaḥ, tayaiva yuktyā kriyāyā api vinā dravyeṇāsattvamityata āha --atha tu pravṛttirbhūtirityevādravyā pratikṣaṇapravṛttyuparamalakṣaṇā bhūtirityeva, evetyavadhāraṇādadravyā dravyavirahitā kriyaivetyarthaḥ, tato naiva syāt sā pūrvavat prāk paścāt tadā vā'dravyatvādabhūtatvāt khapuṣpavaditi tathaiva vyākhyeyaṃ nirbījatvādasthitatvādityādiparyāyaistriṣvapi kāleṣu sādhanāni dabhūtatvād nirbījatvādasthitatvāt...
ata eva ubhayaniyamaḥ--prakṛtipara eva pratyayaḥ prayoktavyaḥ, pratyayaparaiva prakṛtiḥ
bhavadeva hi bhavati dravyārthata iti sthitirūpaṃ dravyārthabhavanamācaṣṭe
etadanicchato'sthitabhavanasādharmyāt khapuṣpamapi vā syādadravyatvād bhāvavat kriyāvat, aniṣṭāpādanametat
bhūtārthasāmarthyādeva hi pravṛttiḥ, dravyārthasāmarthyādeva yasmāt pravṛttiḥ kriyā, na nirbījetyarthaḥ
atrottaramāha --guṇādyapi ca dravyameva vṛttatvāt tantvādivat tantubījamṛdādivaditi prāgvat, iha tu dravyabhavanamantareṇa pravṛttyabhāva iti pradarśyopaneyamiti viśeṣaḥ
ata eva ubhayaniyamaḥ--prakṛtipara eva pratyayaḥ prayoktavyaḥ, pratyayaparaiva prakṛtiḥ
kimayaṃ pratyayaniyamaḥ--prakṛtipara eva pratyayaḥ prayoktavyo'prakṛtiparo neti, āhosvit prakṛtiniyamaḥ--pratyayaparaiva prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā pratyayaparā neti ?
tatra pratyayaniyame sati prakṛterniyamo na prāpnoti, apratyayikāyāḥ prakṛteḥ prayogaḥ prāpnoti...
astu tarhi prakṛtiniyamaḥ, prakṛtiniyame pratyayāniyamaḥ, prakṛtiniyame sati pratyayasya niyamo na prāpnoti,...
siddhametat, katham ? ubhayaniyamāt, ubhayaniyamo'yam--prakṛtipara eva pratyayaḥ prayoktavyaḥ pratyayaparaiva ca prakṛtiriti
hi pravṛttiḥ dravyārthasāmarthyādeva hi pravṛttirdravyārthasāmarthyādeva pra॰
iti dravyakriyālakṣaṇaṃ dvaitamuktvā akṣarārthanyāyenāpi pratipādayiṣyannāha --bhavatīti bhāva iti

atra bhuvaśca itīṣṭyā kartari ṇapratyayaṃ kecidāhuḥ, iha tu bhūyata iti bhāve ghañūpratyayaḥ, sa ca yena bhūyate sa bhāva ityarthasāmarthyād yo bhavati sa eva sambadhyata iti bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ityuktam

sa ca kartā, kartā ca dravyam, tasmād bhāvaśabdo dravyavācī, kriyāvācitvamapi yato'sau bhavatīti bhāvaḥ, yasmāddhetoryena prakāreṇa yato dharmeṇa dharmād vā bhavati taddravyaṃ sa bhāva iti, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvād bhavati ityetad yato bhavati bhāvaḥ sā kriyā
kutaḥ punarbhavatīti bhavati ? bhavanasambandhād bhavatīti bhavati tasya dravyasya tasmāt tad bhavanaṃ bhāvaḥ sā kriyā pravṛttirbhavanamityarthaḥ
vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam, tena jalacare grāhaḥ, jyotiṣi grahaḥ
bhavateśca iti kāśikā, bhavo devaḥ saṃsāraśca, bhāvāḥ padārthāḥ
ata evetyādi tasyobhayārthatvadarśanasya dṛḍhīkaraṇārthaṃ yāvat pratyayaparaiva prakṛtirityuttānārtham

kvippratyaye cidādīnāṃ prathamaikavacane prakṛtimātraprayojanadarśanāt adhunā ityādiṣu ca pratyayamātraśravaṇād ubhayārthavattvapradarśanāya ca ko'sau bhāvo nāma ? yat tad bhūyate kenāpi, nocyate— yo'sau bhavati ko'pi, asvaśabdopādānasādhyabhāvatvād bhāvasya
kasya bhāvaḥ ? vyabhicaratīti cet, ata eva tadarthagateranyatra cobhayaprayogadarśanādanumīyate dvyarthateti
vyutpādanakāle'pi prakṛtyarthavyutpattiranyathā anyathā pratyayārthavyutpattiḥ śāstre'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kriyate
tat kimarthamiti cet, ubhayārthavattvapradarśanāya cetyādi yāvat ko'pīti
ko'sau bhāvo nāma ? iti praśnopakramaṃ vyutpādyate kriyā, yat tad bhūyate kenāpi, bhūyate iti bhāve lakāravidhānāt yat tat iti ca bhavanameva prakṛtyartho nirdiśyate
nocyate--yo'sau bhavati ko'pīti, yena bhūyate yo'sau bhavati kartā pratyayārthaḥ sa nocyate tasmin praśne

asmaduktānukārād yathoktamanyairdravyabhāvayoruktikriyālakṣaṇe bhedopapradarśane svaśabdopādānasiddhabhāvaṃ sattvam, asvaśabdopādānasādhyabhāvo bhāvaḥ ityetaduktikriyāśrayaṃ sattvabhāvayoḥ pṛthaktvam iti
prasiddhaṃ hi loke śāstreṣu ca--kriyāvācakamākhyātaṃ dravyābhidhāyakaṃ nāmeti, svabhāvasiddhaṃ dravyaṃ hi kriyā caiva hi bhāvyate pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1
1 tathā pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhāvamākhyātena ācaṣṭe upakramaprabhṛtyapavargaparyavasānaṃ pariniṣpannaṃ nāmnā mūrtaṃ sattvaṃ yathāsaṅkhyaṃ vrajati pacati vrajyā paktiḥ nirukta॰ 1
tasmād ghaṭapaṭādiśabdā dravyasya svaśabdāḥ, pacatigacchatyādayaḥ kriyāyāḥ, bhāvaśabdaśca dvayorapi dṛṣṭaḥ

tatrāsvaśabdasya dravyavācino ghaṭadevadattāderupādānena sādhyo bhāvaḥ sādhyatvam, yāsāvanumānagamyā kriyā na śakyā sādhanāt pṛthag darśayituṃ garbhavad nirluṭhitā sā parataḥ sādhanata eva yathā ātmānaṃ labhate tathābhidhāne'pītyasvaśabdopādānasādhyabhāvo bhāvaḥ kriyetyarthaḥ
pṛthak sarveṣāmiti cet, ekaśeṣe pṛthagvibhaktyupalabdhiḥ prāpnoti
kimucyate ekaśeṣe pṛthagvibhaktyupalabdhiḥ iti ? yāvatā samayaḥ kṛtaḥ na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā, na ca kevalaḥ pratyayaḥ prayoktavyaḥ iti
tadāśrayatvāt prāpnoti, yatra hi prakṛtinimittā pratyayanivṛttiḥ tatrāpratyayikāyāḥ prakṛteḥ prayogo bhavati--agnicit somasuditi yathā
yatra ca pratyayanimittā prakṛtinivṛttiḥ tatrāprakṛtikasya pratyayasya prayogo bhavati--adhunā iyāniti yathā
idamaḥ saptamyantāt kālavācinaḥ svārthe adhunāpratyayaḥ syāt
ubhayārthavattvapradarśanāya ca ko'sau bhāvo nāma ? yat tad bhūyate kenāpi, nocyate— yo'sau bhavati ko'pi, asvaśabdopādānasādhyabhāvatvād bhāvasya
atra ubhayārthatvapradarśanāya iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīno bhāti, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 382 paṃ॰ 9
etatsamānārthikā carcā pātañjalamahābhāṣye itthamupalabhyate--luptākhyāteṣu copasaṅkhyānaṃ kartavyam, niṣkauśāmbiḥ nirvārāṇasiḥ
siddhaṃ tu kvāṅsvatidurgativacanāt prādayaḥ ktārthe iti
kimidaṃ tadarthagateriti ? tasyārthastadarthaḥ, tadarthasya gatistadarthagatiḥ, tadarthagateriti yasyārthasya kauśāmbyā sāmarthyaṃ sa nisocyate
athavā so'rthastadarthaḥ, tadarthasya gatistadarthagatiḥ, tadarthagateriti yo'rthaḥ kauśāmbyā samarthaḥ sa nisocyate
kathaṃ punarjñāyate--ayaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ, ayaṃ pratyayārtha iti ? siddhaṃ tvanvayavyatirekābhyām
ko'sāvanvayo vyatireko vā ? iha pacati ityukte kaścicchabdaḥ śrūyate pacchabdaścakārāntaḥ, atiśabdaśca pratyayaḥ
artho'pi kaścid gamyate viklittiḥ kartṛtvamekatvaṃ ca
paṭhati ityukte kaścicchabdo hīyate kaścidupajāyate kaścidanvayī; pacchabdo hīyate paṭhśabda upajāyate atiśabdo'nvayī
artho'pi kaściddhīyate kaścidupajāyate kaścidanvayī, viklittirhīyate paṭhikriyopajāyate kartṛtvaṃ caikatvaṃ cānvayī
te manyāmahe yaḥ śabdo hīyate tasyāsāvartho yo'rtho hīyate, yaḥ śabda upajāyate tasyāsāvartho yo'rtha upajāyate, yaḥ śabdo'nvayī tasyāsāvartho yo'rtho'nvayī
atra ubhayārthatvapradarśanāya iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīno bhāti, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 382 paṃ॰ 9
evaṃ tarhi karmasādhano bhaviṣyati bhāvyate yaḥ sa bhāvaḥ iti
kriyā caiva hi bhāvyate, svabhāvasiddhaṃ tu dravyam
kriyā nāmeyamatyantāparidṛṣṭā aśakyā kriyā piṇḍībhūtā nidarśayitum, yathā garbho nirluṭhitaḥ
ko'sāvanumānaḥ ? iha sarveṣu sādhaneṣu sannihiteṣu kadācit pacati ityetad bhavati, kadācinna bhavati
yasmin sādhane sannihite pacati ityetad bhavati sā nūnaṃ kriyā
athavā yayā devadatta iha bhūtvā pāṭaliputre bhavati sā nūnaṃ kriyā
yo'sau bhavati, nocyate--yat tad bhūyate kenāpi, svaśabdopādānasiddhabhāvatvāt sattvasya
liṅgādimattvādaliṅgādimattvācca bhavato bhavanasya ca ubhayameva bhāvaḥ
tadviparyayeṇa tu dravyabhāvasya praśnaprativacane dṛṣṭe vyutpādanakāle
tadyathā --kasya bhāvaḥ iti praśnaḥ, kasya kriyā pravṛttiḥ ? kartari ṣaṣṭhīṃ kṛtvā
tadanurūpaṃ prativacanamapi --yo'sau bhavatīti yo bhavitā kartaiva vā dravyalakṣaṇaḥ sa ucyate
kiṃ bhūyate na bhūyate kenāpi ? iti anirdiṣṭakārakaṃ hi bhāvasāmānyameva bhāvasyābhinnatvāt
kiṃ kāraṇam ? svaśabdopādānasiddhabhāvatvāt sattvasya, svaśabdenaiva pṛcchayate--kasya bhāvaḥ ? ko bhavatītyarthaḥ
na pṛcchayate--kiṃ bhūyate na bhūyate kenāpi ? iti
prativacanamapi tathocyate--yo'sau ko'pi bhavatīti tasya bhāvaḥ sa bhavati tena bhūyate iti
nocyate--yat tad bhūyate kenāpīti, aviśadaṃ bhavanamātraṃ na vyākriyate tasyāpṛṣṭatvāt
liṅgādimattvādaliṅgādimattvācca bhavato dravyasya bhavanasya ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ bhinnaṃ vastu bhavad-bhavanabhūtaṃ dvidhā
vastutvenaikatvaṃ vastutvaikatvam, tasya gatiḥ āpattiḥ, vastutvenaikatvamāpannā kriyā svarūpato'nyaiva, dravyakriyāsvarūpabhinnamekaṃ vastvityarthaḥ
kasmāt ? aliṅgasaṅkhyatvāt, na liṅgasaṅkhye yasya tadidamaliṅgasaṅkhyaṃ bhavanam
taddhi vastutvenaikatvaṃ gataṃ sad dravyeṇa sahānanyadapyanyadeva iti pratijñārtho'nena sādhyate aliṅgasaṅkhyatvāt iti hetunā

dṛṣṭāntaḥ --plakṣādiva bhinnārthānāmekasambandhiviṣayaścārthaḥ, yathā plakṣaśca dhavaśca ityatra caśabdaḥ plakṣadhavayoranyayoḥ samuccetāpi samuccayamekameva sambandhinaṃ viṣayīkṛtya vṛttatvādananyatve'pi satyanyasyaivārthasya vācakastathā dravyakriyātmakavastutvaikatvānyatvamiti
atrāha--dravyādanyatvena pakṣīkṛtāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ samuccayanakriyaiva yadi dṛṣṭāntatvenocyate sādhyatvādadṛṣṭāntaḥ

atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti dravyāntarasamuccayo yadi dṛṣṭānta ucyate tathāpi dravyārthatyāgaḥ plakṣadhavasamuccayākhyādisarvasattārthasaṅgrahārthatvād svarūpato'nyaiva, aliṅgasaṅkhyatvāt, plakṣādiva bhinnārthānāmekasambandhiviṣayaścārthaḥ
atha dravyārthaṃ mā tyākṣamityekameveṣyate punarapi dṛṣṭāntābhāvaḥ dravyād bhinnasyārthāntarasyābhāvāditi
prātipadikārtho hi kriyāsambandhī antaraṅgatvāt kriyāyāḥ, na padārtho bahiraṅgatvāt
yathā putramicchati putrīyatīti dvitīyā bahiraṅgakarmābhidhāyinī putrasya iṣiṇāntaraṅgeṇa sambaddhatvāt, uktaṃ ca --prātipadikānāṃ kriyākṛtāḥ sambandhā bhavanti pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
50 ityeṣiturdevadattasya putreṇābhisambandho na padārthena vibhaktyantena, padāntarasannidhau tu tadvyaktiḥ kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1
1 iti vacanāt, kriyayā sambandhamitvā karmāditvametīti pūrvameva kriyayā sambandhaḥ

yadi ca kriyāsambandhavat prātipadikāvasthāyāmeva samuccayādisambandho'pi syāt tataḥ prātipadikārthātirekāt sambodhanavad yatnāntaravidheyā prathamā syāt, dvitīyādayaśca na syuḥ, karmādyadhike hi prātipadikārthe tā vidhīyante
yadi tu samuccayādyādhikye karmādyastīti dvitīyādayaḥ syustataḥ karmādyādhikye'pi prātipadikārtho'stīti prathamaiva syāt
ataḥ padārthottarakālabhāvini vākyārtha upajāyamāne tasyopakurvantaścādayaḥ padairabhisambadhyanta ityata ucyate --bhinnānāṃ padārthānāmiti kriyāsambandhavyudasanārtham
29, casya ca ko'rthaḥ ? samuccayo'rtho'nvācayaḥ samāhāra itaretarayogaśca padārthottarakālabhāvinaḥ
tatra samuccayaḥ gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ śakuniṃ paśumaharaharnayamāno vaivasvato na tṛpyati surayā iva durmadīti

ye ca dravyāṇāṃ guṇānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ ca dṛśyante yathā ghaṭaśca paṭaśceti rūpaṃ ca rasaśceti hasati tiṣṭhati ramate vetyādayaḥ padārthottarakālabhāvinaḥ samuccayavikalpādayaḥ na te dravyaṃ na kriyā na guṇaḥ, kintu dravyasyaiva kriyātvād vīrapuruṣaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyaikātmavad vastutvaikatvagatyananyānyatvabhājo dharmāḥ pravṛttireveti sādhu bhavati devadattādau yat triliṅgaṃ tanna bhavati bhavane, tathā ekasmin dvayorbahuṣu vā bhavatsu yāḥ saṅkhyāstā na bhavanti
napuṃsakaṃ ca bhavanasyāvyaktatvāt, kimapi dṛśyate iti tathā trikālaviṣayād dravyādanyo bhāvo na ca tena vinā kārakaḥ trikāla- sambandhaḥ
yathātra vīraśabdaḥ puruṣasāmānādhikaraṇyād vastutvenaikatvaṃ gatastathā puruṣaśabdo'pi vīrasāmānādhikaraṇyāt, anyathā vaiyadhikaraṇyād ghaṭapaṭādivadasambandhādidoṣāḥ syuḥ
atha ca vīro viśeṣaṇaṃ puruṣo viśeṣya iti parasparato bhinnārthatvamanayoḥ, itarathā sāmānādhikaraṇyāt tādātmyāt paunaruktyādidoṣāḥ syuḥ

evaṃ plakṣādipadatvena dṛṣṭāntaparipūrṇatve satyuttarakālabhāvinaścārthasyaikasambandhiviṣayatvaṃ plakṣadhavādyupāttaikasamuccayagocaratvamityananyatvam, anyatvaṃ tu plakṣadhavayorevāsau samuccaya iti, tathā dravyādaliṅgasaṅkhyo bhāvo vastutvaikatvagatirananyo'nyaśceti
itthaṃ vā vyākhyāne'nyatvaikānto dravyārthatyāgo'nvayatyāgaśceti parihṛtā doṣāḥ
atra tasmādubhayaṃ vastu, taccaikamiti ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
aliṅgasaṅkhyatvāt iti hetoḥ sādhyenānugamapradarśanārthaṃ samuccayaścārtho dṛṣṭāntatvena atra vivakṣita iti bhāti
cārtha ityucyate, caścāvyayam, tena samāsasyāvyayasaṃjñā prāpnoti
naiṣa doṣaḥ, pāṭhenāvyayasaṃjñā kriyate, na ca samāsastatra paṭhyate

nedaṃ vācanikam--aliṅgatā'saṅkhyatā vā, kiṃ tarhi ? svābhāvikametat, tadyathā--samānamīhamānānāṃ cādhīyānānāṃ ca kecidarthairyujyante'pare na; na cedānīṃ kaścidarthavāniti sarvairarthavadbhiḥ śakyaṃ bhavituṃ kaścidvā'narthaka iti sarvairanarthakaiḥ
tatra kimasmābhiḥ śakyaṃ kartum yat prāk samāsāccārthasya liṅgasaṅkhyābhyāṃ yogo nāsti samāse ca bhavati
prātipadikānāṃ kriyākṛtā viśeṣā upajāyante tatkṛtāścākhyāḥ prādurbhavanti--karma karaṇamapādānaṃ sampradānamadhikaraṇamiti
vaivasvato na tṛpyati surāyā iva durmadī
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na sidhyati ? asamarthatvāt
yadi dravyaṃ padārthaḥ, na bhavati tadā sāmarthyam bhedābhāvāt
atha hi guṇaḥ padārthaḥ, bhavati tadā sāmarthyam
anyo hi vīratvaṃ guṇaḥ, anyo hi puruṣatvam
nānyatvamastītīyatā sāmarthyaṃ bhavati, anyo hi devadatto gobhyaścāśvebhyaśca, na caitasyaitāvatā sāmarthyaṃ bhavati
ko vā viśeṣo yad guṇe padārthe sāmarthyaṃ syād dravye ca na syāt ? eṣa viśeṣaḥ--ekaṃ tayoradhikaraṇam, anyaśca vīratvaṃ guṇaḥ anyaḥ puruṣatvam
sādhu bhavati devadattādau yat triliṅgaṃ tanna bhavati bhavane, tathā ekasmin dvayorbahuṣu vā bhavatsu yāḥ saṅkhyāstā na bhavanti
napuṃsakaṃ ca bhavanasyāvyaktatvāt, kimapi dṛśyate iti
tathā trikālaviṣayād dravyādanyo bhāvo na ca tena vinā kārakaḥ trikāla-
ataḥ paramaliṅgasaṅkhyatvaprasādhanāyottaro granthaḥ sādhu bhavatītyādiryāvad bhavatsu yāḥ saṅkhyāstā na bhavantīti

ekasmin dvayorbahuṣu vā devadattādibhavitṛṣu liṅgasaṅkhyābhedavatsu yat triliṅgaṃ saṅkhyāścaikatvādyāstā na bhavanti bhavane napuṃsakaliṅgamekavacanameva cānumīyate tadviśeṣaṇe sādhuśabde śrūyate ca sādhu bhavantaṃ paśya ityādi kārakādivyatireke'pi
tasmādanyad bhavanaṃ bhavadbhyo devadattādibhyaḥ svarūpataḥ satyapi vastutvaikatve
syānmatam--kimarthaṃ napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ prathamaikavacanaṃ ca ? ityatrocyate --pratyayaparaprakṛtivyavasthayā tu prathamaikavacane, kiṃ kāraṇam ? atikramakāraṇābhāvāt
avaśyaṃ ca pratyayaparā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā, prātipadikārthaliṅgaparimāṇavacanamātre prathamā pā॰ 2
46 iti sattāmātre'pi prathamāvidhānāt tato'tiriktārthāsambhavāt prathamātilaṅghane phalābhāvāt vacanasya ca nāntarīyakatvāt sattāmātrārthakāraṇatvāt kāraṇāntarābhāvāt, kāraṇāddhi tadatikramaḥ syāt
napuṃsakaṃ ca bhavanasyāvyaktatvāt, avyakte guṇasandehe napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ prayoktavyamiti
kiṃ tathā loke dṛṣṭamiti cet, ucyate --kimapi dṛśyate iti, yathā hastyaśvanarādisamūhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vaktāro bhavanti--kimapi dṛśyate, itiḥ pradarśane, etadeva vākyamudāharaṇatvena pradarśayati

tena prakāreṇa tathā yathā pūrvaṃ vastutvaikatvagatyananyadanyat iti pakṣīkṛtya sādhitaṃ tathātrāpi trikālaviṣayād dravyādanyo bhāvo na ca tena vinā kāraka iti pakṣaḥ, dravyeṇa vinā na svayaṃ kārako bhāvaḥ, tatsahavṛttirevānyatve'pītyarthaḥ
tvāt, dravyaṃ trikālaviṣayam kriyā tu trikālā gamanagantṛvat, vartamāna eva devadatte gantari gatitraikālyam agamad gacchati gamiṣyati iti tathā abhūd bhavati bhaviṣyati iti

bhāvasya dravyādanyatvena tadapṛthakkārakatvena ca sādhyatvād bhāvagamanayorekārthatvād dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyaikadeśa iti cet, devadattagamanayostraikālyātraikālyābhyāṃ bhedasiddherdravyabhāvayorapi tadvat, yugapadayugapattattvakhaghaṭavat

atha dravyārthabhedatvādasya kathamidaṃ prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvātmakaṃ traikālyam ? kasmāt ? trikālatvāt, trayaḥ kālā asyeti trikālaḥ, ko'sau ? bhāvaḥ kriyālakṣaṇaḥ, abhūd bhavati bhaviṣyati ityupaneṣyamāṇatvād bhedena tribhirapi kālairabhisambandhadarśanād bhāvasya trikālatvaṃ siddhatvāddhetuḥ

dravyaṃ trikālaviṣayamiti, bhāvasya tridhā bhinnakālatve'pi ekarūpatvād vartamānatvenāvatiṣṭhamānaṃ tatsambandhi dravyaṃ tāṃstrīnapi viṣayīkarotīti trikālaviṣayam ityucyate, triṣvapi kāleṣu tadeva bhavatītyarthaḥ
atrikālaṃ dravyaṃ trikālaviṣayamiti kriyā tu trikālā vartamānaviṣayetyuktaṃ bhavati
tadvyācaṣṭe --vartamāna eva devadatte gantari, evakāro'vadhāraṇe, triṣvapi kāleṣu ganturvartamānaikakālatāmavadhārayati
gatitraikālyam, gamanasya trayo'pi kālā anavadhāritaikarūpā dṛṣṭāḥ
tvāt, dravyaṃ trikālaviṣayam kriyā tu trikālā gamanagantṛvat, vartamāna eva devadatte gantari gatitraikālyam agamad gacchati gamiṣyati iti tathā abhūd bhavati bhaviṣyati iti

bhāvasya dravyādanyatvena tadapṛthakkārakatvena ca sādhyatvād bhāvagamanayorekārthatvād dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyaikadeśa iti cet, devadattagamanayostraikālyātraikālyābhyāṃ bhedasiddherdravyabhāvayorapi tadvat, yugapadayugapattattvakhaghaṭavat

syānmatam --bhāvasya dravyādanyatvena tadapṛthakkārakatvena ca sādhyatvād bhāvagamanayorekārthatvād dravyād bhavanapṛthaktvāsiddhivad ganturgamanapṛthaktvāsiddherdṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyaikadeśa ityetasyāṃ vicikitsāyāṃ kathaṃ sādhanamiti cet, ucyate --devadattagamanayostraikālyātraikālyābhyāṃ bhedasiddherdravyabhāvayorapi tadvaditi sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ sādhyasādhanatvābhyāṃ vivakṣitatvādadoṣaḥ tadvicikitsāyāmapi tulyatvāt, yugapadayugapattattvakhaghaṭavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, tasya bhāvastattvam, tadeva bhavatītyarthaḥ

nanūktaṃ dravyabhede dravyārthatyāgaḥ, atyāge'nvayābhāvaḥ iti, naiṣa doṣaḥ, yugapadayugapattattvaviśeṣaṇādātmādisarvaikyād yugapattattvaṃ khaṃ dravyārthātmābhedāt khādeḥ dravyātmaiva vā'yugapattattvo ghaṭaḥ, tathā traikālyātraikālyavastvanyānanyatve dravyabhāvayoḥ
atha matam --dravyārthabhedatvādasya nayasya dravyārthasya ca nityatvāt kathamidaṃ prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvātmakaṃ traikālyaṃ yujyata iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
yat prāg nāsīdadhunā bhavati tad vartamānamityucyate, tacca prāgabhūtam, yadvinaṣṭamatītaṃ pradhvastamabhūtam, yad bhaviṣyati tadapi prāgabhūtamidānīmabhāvāt, aṅkuraghaṭakapālādidarśanāt
tacca pūrvāparakālatulyatvād nityasya na yuktam, nerdhruve tyab na, pravṛttinityatvāt
kūṭasthasya dravyasya taṃ tamātmānaṃ paryanubhavataḥ dhrauvyaṃ kauṭasthyaṃ ca
itarasya tu tathā tathābhivyajyamānasya akauṭasthyaṃ satatasampravṛttirūpaṃ nityatvaṃ ca
ata eva bhūtābhūtabhāktvaṃ dravyādanyo bhāvaḥ ityasyārthasya sādhanam
vyatikrāntyavyatikrāntibhāktvād bhinnau kriyādravyabhāvau, tadyathā--kṛtaḥ kaṭo devadattena, kṛtaḥ karmaṇā vibhāgaḥ
kriyā vyatikrāmati, vibhāgaḥ karma ca na vyatikrāmataḥ śabdārthasya piṇḍitatvāt
dravyasyaiva vā traikālyābhyupagame bhāvasya dravyārthavādatyāga iti

atrocyate --na doṣaḥ, pravṛttinityatvāt, nātrāpi dravyārthatyāgaḥ pravṛttinityatvāt, bhavanapravṛttirbhāva ityarthaḥ, sā ca pravṛttirnityā sadā pravṛttervastuno bhāvo'pi nitya eveti na dravyārthatyāgo nātraikālyamiti
kūṭasthasya dravyasya taṃ tamātmānaṃ paryanubhavataḥ dhrauvyaṃ kauṭasthyaṃ ca
itarasya tu tathā tathābhivyajyamānasya akauṭasthyaṃ satatasampravṛttirūpaṃ nityatvaṃ ca
ata eva bhūtābhūtabhāktvaṃ dravyādanyo bhāvaḥ ityasyārthasya sādhanam
vyatikrāntyavyatikrāntibhāktvād bhinnau kriyādravyabhāvau, tadyathā--kṛtaḥ kaṭo devadattena, kṛtaḥ karmaṇā vibhāgaḥ
kriyā vyatikrāmati, vibhāgaḥ karma ca na vyatikrāmataḥ śabdārthasya piṇḍitatvāt
atrocyate--vastuno dravyabhavanātmakasyobhayatvādeva nityatvasyāpi dvitvaṃ siddhaṃ yathā prāgupavarṇitaṃ na hi tadeva nityamityādi yāvat tadapi hi nityaṃ yasmiṃstattvaṃ na vihanyate pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1

paspaśā॰ iti uktatvāt, idānīmapi taddvitvaṃ pradarśyate --kūṭasthasyetyādi, dravyaṃ hi kūṭasthaṃ nityaṃ pūrvāparakālatulyatvāt, tasya kūṭasthasya dravyasya sarvaprabhedanirbhedasya bījabhūtasya gamanasthānādisarvātmakatvenāvasthitasya taṃ tamātmānaṃ paryanubhavataḥ tatparyanubhavanātmatvādeva dhrauvyaṃ kauṭasthyaṃ ca yujyate

itarasya tu bhāvasya tathā tathābhivyajyamānasya paryanubhūyamānasya krameṇa yugapadvā satatapravartanātmano bhāvasya pravṛtterakauṭasthyaṃ satatasampravṛttirūpamavyavacchinnabhavanātmakaṃ nityatvaṃ ceti nityatvasyāpi dvitvam iti sādhūktam

etasmādeva nityatvadvitvādanyadidamapi kāraṇaṃ bhūtābhūtabhāktvaṃ dravyādvaidharmyamasyāḥ pravṛtteranyatvakāri dravyādanyo bhāvaḥ ityasyārthasya sādhanam, dravyavilakṣaṇo bhāvaḥ ityatra heturityarthaḥ
bhūtābhūtā kriyā, dravyaṃ bhavadeva, vṛttā vartamānā ca kriyā, dravyaṃ vartata evetyarthaḥ

athavā bhūtaṃ dravyamabhūtaṃ karaṇaṃ sthitaṃ gataṃ ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ, vyatikrāntyavyatikrāntibhāktvād bhinnau kriyādravyabhāvau, tadyathā--kṛtaḥ kaṭo devadattena, devadattaḥ kaṭakaraṇakāle karaṇoparame ca kaṭasyaikarūpa eva, kriyā tu vīraṇasaṃyogāvasthāyāmavyatikrāntā kaṭaniṣpattyuttarāvasthāyāṃ vyatikrāntā

tathā kṛtaḥ karmaṇā vibhāga iti dvitīyamudāharaṇaṃ kartṛkarmasamavāyitvāt kriyāyāḥ pacibhidivat, vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntena tu karturīpsitatamaṃ karma pā॰ 1-4-49, kriyaiva tu vaiśeṣikasya, ihāviśeṣeṇa vibhāgahetuḥ kriyā, vibhāgaśca santatyanuparamād devadatte dravye karmaṇi vā karaṇalakṣaṇayā pravṛttyā bhavitavyamavicchedena, sā ca tadatadbhavanasvarūpā

yathā ca saṃyogavibhāgaphalaṃ karma gamanaṃ gantuḥ padārthāntaram, tatsambandhaṃ cāntareṇa gamanaṃ na bhavati tathā gamanādyapi karaṇasambandhamantareṇa na bhavati, anyato bhinnaṃ svatattvād dravyādvā na syāt karmeti na syāt
tathā bhavadvā kṛtam iti vyapadeśaṃ na janayet, karaṇasambandhābhāvāt, ākāśādivat
tathā ca tat sad asatkāraṇamiti nityaṃ syāt

dravyavadavasthita iti vivakṣitaṃ tasya, vibhāgaḥ kaṭakartuścalanātmakasya karmaṇa īpsitatamatvāt karma calanena dravyaṃ deśāntaraṃ prāpayatā kriyata iti sā kriyā vyatikrāmati, vibhāgaḥ karma ca na vyatikrāmataḥ, śabdārthasya piṇḍitatvād nāmatvādityarthaḥ
dṛṣṭaśca vartamānayoḥ karmavibhāgayoḥ dravyayoravyatikrame karaṇasya kriyāyā vibhāgaviṣayasya vyatikramaḥ

na caikasmin vyatikramāvyatikramau yugapad bhavataḥ virodhāt pramāṇāntarāpekṣāmantareṇa, tasmādetadanumeyaṃ tatra devadatte dravye kaṭasya kartari karmaṇi vā kartari calane vīraṇānāṃ kaṭe vā karmaṇi karaṇalakṣaṇayā pravṛttyā bhavitavyamavicchedena

sā ca pravṛttiḥ kriyā tadatadbhavanasvarūpā, tasmin dravye'tasmiṃśca karaṇe bhavanamasyāḥ pravṛtteḥ svarūpam, tayā ca vyatikramāvyatikramavibhāgatayā dvirūpayā'vaśyamavyavacchinnayā'kūṭasthayā pravṛttibhavanātmikayā bhavitavyamiti
devadatte dravye karmaṇi vā karaṇalakṣaṇayā pravṛttyā bhavitavyamavicchedena, sā ca tadatadbhavanasvarūpā

yathā ca saṃyogavibhāgaphalaṃ karma gamanaṃ gantuḥ padārthāntaram, tatsambandhaṃ cāntareṇa gamanaṃ na bhavati tathā gamanādyapi karaṇasambandhamantareṇa na bhavati, anyato bhinnaṃ svatattvād dravyādvā na syāt karmeti na syāt
tathā bhavadvā kṛtam iti vyapadeśaṃ na janayet, karaṇasambandhābhāvāt, ākāśādivat
tathā ca tat sad asatkāraṇamiti nityaṃ syāt

saṃyogavibhāgāḥ karmaṇāṃ kāryaṃ sāmānyam, gurutvaprayatnasaṃyogānāmutkṣepaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyam vai॰ sū॰ iti vacanād deśāntarasaṃyogaṃ dravyasya deśāntaravibhāgaṃ ca gamanakarmārabhate gurutvādijanakaṃ cotkṣepaṇaṃ karma

tasmāt saṃyogavibhāgaphalaṃ karma gamanaṃ gantuḥ padārthāntaram, tayoḥ saṃyogavibhāgayostatkāraṇasya ca karmaṇo yāvaddravyabhāvābhāvād vaiśeṣikamatavat padārthāntaratāyāṃ satyāṃ ganturgamanena sambandhaḥ, tatsambandhaṃ cāntareṇa gamanaṃ na bhavati, gacchati devadattaḥ iti hi gamanasambandhād dṛṣṭam, vyatilaṅghitagamanaśca gataḥ ityucyate, tasmāt tadvyatikramamantareṇa gatam iti na bhavati

tathā gamanādyapi karaṇasambandhamantareṇa na bhavatīti kriyā sidhyati, anyato bhinnamiti svatattvāt karmatvāt dravyādvā karmatvasya svatattvasyāśrayo na syāt karmeti na syāt, kriyamāṇatvāddhi tat karma karaṇe sati, karaṇavyatikrame ca kṛtam iti na syāt
karmaṇi tu bhinne dravyāt svatattvādvā syāditi

tathā bhavadvetyādinā karaṇaṃ bhavadapi svasambandhavyatikramamantareṇa kṛtam ityetaṃ vyapadeśaṃ na janayet, tacca dṛṣṭam, kiṃ kāraṇaṃ na syāditi cet, karaṇasamba yathā ca karma kriyayā vinā na bhavati tathā karaṇamapi bhavanavyaktimantareṇa naiva bhavet, tathā bhavanasambandhavyatikramamantareṇa bhūtamiti na syāt
tataśca prāgādinirviśeṣaṇaṃ nāsti bhavanasambandhavyatikramābhāvāt khapuṣpavat, asatkāraṇatvādvā, abhūtabhavanasambandhavyatikramatvāt
tataḥ kiṃ syāt ? tathā ca tad bhavat karma sattvāt kāraṇāsambandhācca sadasatkāraṇamiti nityaṃ syāt, nityalakṣaṇayogāt
kiṃ nityalakṣaṇamiti cet, ucyate --sadakāraṇavattannityam vai॰ sū॰ 4
evaṃ tāvat karma gamanādi karaṇasambandhād bhavati ityupapāditam
yathā ca karma kriyayā vinā na bhavati tathā karaṇamapi bhavanavyaktimantareṇa naiva bhavet, tathā bhavanasambandhavyatikramamantareṇa bhūtamiti na syāt
tataśca prāgādinirviśeṣaṇaṃ nāsti bhavanasambandhavyatikramābhāvāt khapuṣpavat, asatkāraṇatvādvā, abhūtabhavanasambandhavyatikramatvāt
yathā ca gamanādi karma kriyayā vinā na bhavatyuktavidhinā tathā karaṇamapi bhavanavyaktimantareṇa bhavanakriyāvirbhāvena vinā naiva bhavet, na bhavitumarhatītyarthaḥ
tathā bhavanasambandhavyatikramamantareṇa bhūtamiti na syāt, tatsambandhe bhavati iti bhavati tatsambandhavyatikrame ca bhūtam iti

pūrvaḥ pūrva uttarottarakāryakāraṇabhāveneti kriyāsambandhaprabandhaṃ pradarśayati tataśca prāgādinirviśeṣaṇamityādi bhavanasambandhe tadvyatikrame cāsati prākpradhvaṃsetaretaraśaktisaṃyogādyabhāvābhāvādabhāvabhedarahito nāstyabhāva ityanarthāntaramiti aviśeṣeṇaiko'tyantābhāva eva syādabhāvaḥ bhavanasambandhavyatikramābhāvāt khapuṣpavaditi, yathā khapuṣpaṃ bhavanasambandhābhāvāt tadvyatikramābhāvācca na bhavedevaṃ sarvaṃ ghaṭādi syāditi
asatkāraṇatvādvā, tadā hi vastuno bhavanakāraṇaṃ yo'sau karaṇasambandho bhavanasambandhaśca sa nāsti tadvyatikramo veti satkāraṇābhāvādakāraṇatvādatyantābhāva eva syāt khapuṣpavat sarvaṃ ghaṭādi

tadupasaṃhṛtya hetumāha --abhūtabhavanasambandhavyatikramatvāditi, gatisthityādikaraṇabhavanasambandhavyatikramasadbhāvād gacchati tiṣṭhati karoti bhavati gatasthitakṛtabhūtavyaktyātmakadevadattavastu bhavadupalabhyate nānyatheti

atrocyate --vyatikramaśca tṛṇakarmādau, tṛṇatantvādīnāṃ kriyāstṛṇakarma, ādigrahaṇāt saṃyogaḥ, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ kaṭavibhāgādibhavanabhūtatāyām, atrāpi ādigrahaṇāt paṭavibhāgasaṃyogādayo gṛhītāḥ, bhavanasya bhūtatāyāmevaṃlakṣaṇasya bhavati vyatikramaḥ tṛṇaṃ kaṭo bhavati, gamanakarma vibhāgo bhavati saṃyogaścānyena
syānmatam--kathaṃ tṛṇaṃ kaṭo bhavati, karma vibhāgo bhavati ityetaducyate ? iti
atrocyate, atrāpi nanūktam --dravyaṃ kriyā ca dvayameva sarvamidamiti saṃyogādi sarvaṃ guṇakriyātvapratipādanāt tasya bhavanasya bhūtatā vyatikrama iti
yadi dravyavat kriyāpi vastunastattvaṃ syāt tatastayā vinā naiva vastu syāt, tattvāt, devadattabālādivat ghaṭarūpādivat
dṛṣṭaṃ caitad gamanādikriyayā vināpi devadattākhyaṃ vastu
antareṇāpi tu kriyāṃ bhavatyeva vastu, tasmāt tato'nyat tadantareṇāpi bhāvāt ghaṭapaṭavat
dṛśyate hi devadatte gacchatyadhṛtiṃ karoti yajñadattaḥ
yadi dravyapāramārthyavat kriyāpi syāt gamanavat kriyātvāt sthānamapi paramārtha evameva cetyādi
evaṃ kṛtvā bhāvakriyāśrayaḥ, bhāva eva kriyā bhāvakriyā
dravyaṃ bhāvaḥ, sa eva ca kriyā, dravyasya vā kriyā

tadāśrayo dravyabhavanāśrayo'yaṃ kārakāṇāṃ karmādibhāvaḥ karmakaraṇādibhāvaḥ, na niyatarūpaḥ vicitrakriyābhavanasambandhād bhavati, devadattaḥ pacati odanaṃ kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyām, odano bhavati, kāṣṭhāni jvalanti sandhukṣanti, sthālī dhārayatītyadhiśrīyate ityevamādidarśanāt
na hi kiñcijjātiviśeṣayogād gotvādiyogādivat karmatvakaraṇatvādhikaraṇatvādiyogāt karmaivedaṃ karaṇamevādhikaraṇameva niyataṃ nānyadapi bhavatīti

kiṃ tarhi ? aniyataśaktiviṣayam, śaktīnāṃ kārakatvāt, tadeva hi dravyamanyayā kriyayā pramārṣṭi netre iti netrādi karma bhavati, anyayā karaṇam netreṇa paśyati iti, anyayādhikaraṇam netre'ñjanaṃ tiṣṭhati ityādi
tasmāt sarvaprabhedanirbhedaṃ bījaṃ vastu dravyaṃ tattvam, tadbhedibhavanavyaktiḥ kriyā
vastutastu atra asatkāraṇabhāvā॰ iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīno bhāti, asatkāraṇatvāt ityarthaḥ
yadi dravyavat kriyāpi vastunastattvaṃ syāt tatastayā vinā naiva vastu syāt, tattvāt, devadattabālādivat ghaṭarūpādivat
dṛṣṭaṃ caitad gamanādikriyayā vināpi devadattākhyaṃ vastu
antareṇāpi tu kriyāṃ bhavatyeva vastu, tasmāt tato'nyat tadantareṇāpi bhāvāt ghaṭapaṭavat
dṛśyate hi devadatte gacchatyadhṛtiṃ karoti yajñadattaḥ
yadi dravyapāramārthyavat kriyāpi syāt gamanavat kriyātvāt sthānamapi paramārtha

yadītyādi evamanicchato doṣaḥ, yadi dravyavat kriyāpi vastunastattvam ātmā svarūpaṃ syāt tatastayā vinā kriyayā naiva vastu syāt, tattvāt tadātmatvāt svarūpatvāt, yad yattattvaṃ yadātmāsvarūpaṃ vā na tat tena vinā bhavati devadattabālādivat, yathā devadattatattvā bālādayo'vasthāviśeṣāḥ kramabhāvino na tena vinā bhavanti tathaitadapi vastu kriyayā vinā na syāt, ghaṭarūpādivaditi ghaṭatattvā rūpādayo yugapadbhāvinastena vinā na bhavanti tathā kriyayā vinā tad vastu na syāditi viśeṣaḥ
dṛṣṭaṃ caitad gamanādikriyayā vināpi devadattākhyaṃ vastvityaniṣṭāpādanametat
doṣadarśanādapi vastu bhavatītyetadarthaṃ sādhanamāha --antareṇāpi tu kriyāṃ bhavatyeva vastu tasmād vinā bhāve doṣadarśanāt tato'nyat kriyāto'nyad vastu iti pratipattavyam

na kevalaṃ doṣadarśanādeva, kiṃ tarhi ? anyatvaheturapyastītyata āha — tadantareṇāpi bhāvāt, yad yadantareṇāpi bhavati tat tato'nyat ghaṭapaṭavat, yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭamantareṇa bhavan paṭādanyaḥ paṭaśca ghaṭamantareṇāpi bhavaṃstato'nyastathā kriyāmantareṇāpi bhavad vastu tato'nyaditi
tannidarśanāntaraṃ vicārāntarāspadamapyāha --dṛśyate hi devadatte gacchatyadhṛtiṃ karoti yajñadatta iti
atra yajñadattasyādhṛtikāraṇaṃ gamanaṃ devadattākhyād vastuno'nyat pūrvottarakālatulye'pi tasmin yato'dhṛtirbhavati, tasmād na kriyā vastunastattvam

yadi yathā devadattākhyasya vastuno dravyaṃ paramārthastathā kriyāpi syāt gamanavat kriyātvāt sthānamapi paramārtha iti prāgeva sthānakriyayā gamanavirodhinyā devadatto' iti tasya gamanaṃ naiva syāt, devadattāvaruddhadeśe yajñadattavat
atha gamanatattva eva devadatta iṣyate tathāpi gamanakriyāparamārthadevadattatvāt sthānaṃ naiva syāt iti yānasthānayorabhāvāt pūrvavaddhṛtiḥ satatamadhṛtirvā syāt tathā
tathā bhavane'pi yathā devadatte gacchati adhṛtirasya tathā tadātmatvād yāvaddevadattamadhṛtiprasaṅgaḥ tatkālavat, devadatta evāsyādhṛtinimittamiti
sthityātmakatvādvāsya gacchatyapi devadatte yajñadattasya dhṛtireva sadā syāt sthānakālavat
tataśca tayāvaruddhatvāt tasya devadattasya gamanaṃ naiva syāt, kadācidapi na gacched devadatta ityarthaḥ

devadattāvaruddhadeśe yajñadattavat, yathā devadattākhyaṃ vastu devadattatvenāvaruddhamiti tadvirodhino yajñadattatvasyānavakāśāt tatra yajñadattatvaṃ naiva jātu bhavati tathā devadatte sthānenāvaruddhe gamanaṃ naiva jātu syāditi

atha mā bhūd yajñadattādhṛtikāraṇasya devadattagamanasyābhāva iti gamanatattva eva devadatta iṣyate tathāpi gamanakriyāparamārthadevadattatvāt sthānaṃ naiva syāt kadācidapi, gamanenāvaruddhatvād devadattasya devadattatvāvaruddhadevadatte yajñadattatvavadeva

itiśabdo hetvarthe, tataśca hetoryānasthānayorabhāvāt, yānābhāvāt tāvat pūrvavaddhṛtiryathā prāg gamanotpattergamanāsattvādadhṛtyabhāvaḥ tathā gamanābhāvād gacchatyapi devadatte yajñadattasyādhṛtyabhāvaḥ devadattasattvāt gamanakāle'pi, gamanābhāve yathā yajñadattasya dhṛtirbhavatyevaṃ satatamadhṛtirvā syāditi
iti tasya gamanaṃ naiva syāt, devadattāvaruddhadeśe yajñadattavat
atha gamanatattva eva devadatta iṣyate tathāpi gamanakriyāparamārthadevadattatvāt sthānaṃ naiva syāt iti yānasthānayorabhāvāt pūrvavaddhṛtiḥ satatamadhṛtirvā syāt tathā
tathā bhavane'pi yathā devadatte gacchati adhṛtirasya tathā tadātmatvād yāvaddevadattamadhṛtiprasaṅgaḥ tatkālavat, devadatta evāsyādhṛtinimittamiti
sthityātmakatvādvāsya gacchatyapi devadatte yajñadattasya dhṛtireva sadā syāt sthānakālavat
bhavatu vā gamanaṃ sthānaṃ vetyabhyupagamyāpi doṣa ucyate

tatra gamane tāvad yathā devadatte gacchatyadhṛtirasya tathā tadātmatvād yāvaddevadattamadhṛtiprasaṅgaḥ, yathā devadattagamanakāle yajñadattasyādhṛtiheturdevadatto gamanātmatvāt tathā yāvajjīvam ātmano yāvadāyuryajñadattādhṛtihetureva syāt gamanātmatvāt tatkālavaditi tasya devadattasya gatiparamārthatvād vastutvāvasthānācca devadattasya gamanātmanaḥ pūrvottarakālatulyatvāt
atastadvivaraṇārthamāha --devadatta evāsyādhṛtinimittamiti, iti— śabdo hetvarthe, yato devadatto gamanātmaiva tasmāt satatamadhṛtiprasaṅgaḥ
gativirodhinyāḥ sthitereva vā bhāve sthityātmakatvād vāsya devadattasya gacchatyapi devadatte yajñadattasya dhṛtireva sadā syāt sthānakālavad devadattasadbhāvāditi
atrāpi yadi dravyapāramārthyavadityādigrantho dhṛtyadhṛtiyajñadattaśabdoccāraṇena yathāsambhavaṃ yojyaḥ
bhedajñānavyavahārau tu śabdabhedadravyapravṛttitattvānurūpyāt, śabda- hi vastusvarūpam, dhṛtyadhṛtikriye ca tadavyatirikte
tato devadattayānasthānayorapi devadattāvyatirekāt tadvad yāvaddevadattaṃ gamanaṃ sthānaṃ veti dhṛtirevādhṛtireva vā syād yajñadattatattvavat, virodhinaḥ kriyāntarasyābhāvāt pūrvavat
tasmādetena kriyāyā api nityatvādityāha --na, tadatadbhavanāvicchedātmakapravṛttinityatvasyākūṭasthatvāt, tadbhavanamatadbhavanaṃ tadatadbhavanaṃ ca sarūpaikaśeṣāt tadatadbhavanam
tadatadbhavanaṃ bhavanasahite te eva sthānagamane tathā dhṛtyadhṛtī

tasyāviccheda ātmā yasyāḥ pravṛtteravicchedātmikāyāḥ sā tadatadbhavanāvicchedātmakapravṛttiḥ, tasyā nityatvam, tadakūṭasthaṃ kūṭasthadravyanityatvavilakṣaṇam, tadbhāvāt tadatadbhavanāvicchedātmakapravṛttinityatvasyākūṭasthatvād bhavanamevedaṃ gatidhṛtisthityādi, etā yānasthānadhṛtyadhṛtyādikāḥ parasparavirodhinyaḥ kriyāstā etā bhavanameva satatasampravṛttirūpabhavanātmakatvād bhavadbhavanavilakṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ ca pravṛttibhavanamātramevetyabhinnaṃ kriyāmātram
ato dravyaṃ kriyā cobhayaṃ nityaṃ bhāvaḥ
syānmatam--kriyābhedābhāvād bhedajñānavyavahārābhāvaḥ syāt, dṛśyete bhedajñānaṃ bhedavyavahāraśceti

etaccāyuktam, tasmād bhedajñānavyavahārau tu gacchati tiṣṭhati dhṛtiṃ karotyadhṛtiṃ vā na vā iti dvāvapyetau śabdabhedadravyapravṛttitattvānurūpyāt, śabdo bhedo yasyā dravyapravṛtteḥ sā śabdabhedadravyapravṛttiḥ, na śabdo'nyo dravyāt, pravṛttiḥ kriyā guṇo'pi kriyeti prāguktam
rūparasagandhasparśabhedāyāḥ pravṛtteḥ śabda- bhedā pravṛttiranyā, tasyāstattvaṃ varṇātmakatvādi rūpam, tadānurūpyācchabdabhedapravṛttitattvānurūpyād bhedajñānaṃ bhedavyavahāraśca bhavati
śaktimato dravyasya śaktayo yugapadbhāvinyo rūparasādayaḥ kriyā eva, gamanasthānādikriyāstu kramabhāvinyaḥ
sarvathā sarvadā bhāvāt kvacit kiñcid vivakṣyate

yathā devadatto gacchati ityatra devadattaśabdo dravyāṃśaviṣayaniyataśaktitvād gatyādīn nopātte na vā vyudasyati tathākhyātamapi devadattaṃ nopātte na vā vyudasyati kriyāṃśaviṣayaniyataśaktitvāt nāmākhyātayorniyatavastubhāgābhiniveśitvāt, tadanupātyayaṃ bhedapratyayaḥ

gacchatiśabdena vivakṣāpi ca tāsāṃ śabdaśaktīnāṃ yathānurūpaṃ prativiṣayaniyatapratyāyanavṛttitvāt, satyapi sarvasarvātmakatve dravyārthanayasya varṇātmakaghaṭaśabdaśakteḥ pṛthukukṣyūrdhvagrīvādyākārapratyāyane niyatā vṛttirnānyatra, rūpādidravyaśaktipravṛttibhedaniyatendriyagrāhyatvavacchabdaśaktipravṛttibhedād bhedajñānavyavahārāvityarthaḥ
tadvyācaṣṭe --nityapravṛttītyādinā, nityapravṛtteḥ kramaprāptyā viśiṣṭo yo vastubhāgastadabhiniveśibhirabhidhānaiḥ sarvasya vasturūpasyābhidhātuṃ śabdairayogyatvāditi
tannidarśayati --yathā devadatto gacchatītyādi yāvad na vā vyudasyatīti gatārtham

tathākhyātamapītyādi tadvadeva gatārthaṃ yāvat kriyāṃśaviṣayaniyataśaktitvāditi, nāmākhyātayorniyatavastubhāgābhiniveśitvāditi tadeva kāraṇam, tadanupātyayaṃ bhedapratyaya ityupasaṃharati, dravyaśaktyaṃśaniyataśabdapravṛttyanupāti bhedajñānamityarthaḥ

tathaiva gatisthitidhṛtyadhṛtyādibhedavyavahārāḥ sarvabhedaparyanubhavārthatvād nityapravṛtteḥ yāsau satatasampravṛttiḥ sā sarvān gamanādīn bhavanabhedān paryanubhāvayāmi dravyam iti pravartate, yadi tān nānubhavet kriyābhedān dravyaṃ tato na te syuḥ tenāparyanubhūyamānatvāt khapuṣpavat
sarvabhedaṃ nirbhedaṃ bījaṃ dravyam iti ceṣyate
tadvā dravyaṃ na syāt bhedāparyanubhavanāt khapuṣpavat, evaṃ tad dravyaṃ bījaṃ syād yadi tān bhedān paryanubhavet
sarvathā sarvadā bhāvāt kvacit kiñcid vivakṣyate || vākyapa॰ 3 | 7 | 2 iti
kathaṃ punaretadavagamyate śaktiḥ sādhanam, na punardravyam ityāśaṅkyāha --śaktimātrāsamūhasya viśvasyānekadharmaṇaḥ
sarvadā sarvathā bhāvāt kvacit kiñcid vivakṣyate
ghaṭādayo bhāvā viśvaśabdavācyāḥ, te ca tattadudakāharaṇādikāryasādhikānāṃ śaktīnāṃ samūharūpāḥ
ata eva tāḥ śaktayaḥ tatra mātrā bhāgāḥ iti śaktisamāhāramātraṃ ghaṭādayaḥ
tāśca śaktayo'nekavidhāḥ, kāścit svahetoreva daivāt bhavanti, āśrayādināśaṃ matveva na ca vinaśyanti yathā bodhapradīpānāṃ prakāśaśaktayaḥ
kāścit pauruṣe'pyantaḥsthitā eva āśraye nirudhyante yathā bābo ?dhādiśaktayaḥ, tā hi samabhyāsena dṛṣṭadravyopayogena jāyante
anyāḥ satyo vā aparapuruṣaprayatnena vidhvaṃsyante, yathā viṣasya māraṇaśaktiḥ bījasya aṅkurajananaśaktiḥ
anyāḥ prabhāvātiśayavatā viparivartyante, yathā yoginā sarvabhāvānāṃ rūpaparivṛttirādhīyate
kāścit kālaparivāsena vyajyante yathā dharmādharmaśaktiḥ phaladāne ityādyanekavidhamunneyam
evamanekasvabhāvatve śaktisamudāyasya vicitre kārye yathāśakti bhedavivakṣāyāṃ pratiniyatasādhanabhāvopapattiḥ
dravyasya tu sādhanatve tasyaikarūpatvāt kāryavaicitryaṃ na syādityarthaḥ

pradhānakriyāyā ekaikaśaktisādhyatvābhāvāt samudāyagrahaṇam, guṇakriyāpekṣayā tu pratyekaṃ śakteḥ sādhanatā, tasyāśca pradhānakriyāpekṣayā vaicitryāt karmākarmādivirūpatāyā vā pratyekaṃ sādhanatve'pi samudāyagrahaṇaṃ śaktīnāṃ sādhanatvena āsāṃ bhedāt ekasya kāryabhedopapattivyākhyāpanārtham

tena anekaśakterapi padārthasya satyeva tathā sthāne'pi kācicchaktiḥ kvacidudbhūtā vivakṣyate iti ghaṭaṃ paśya, ghaṭenodakamānaya, ghaṭe udakaṃ nidhehi ityādikarmakaraṇādibhāvo niyamena upapadyata iti na kārakasāṅkaryaprasaṅgaḥ
dravyasya tu ekasvabhāvatvāt karmakaraṇāditvaṃ nopapadyate iti garbhīkṛteyamatra śaktiḥ śakteḥ sādhanatve boddhavyā
iti vākyapadīyasya tṛtīyakāṇḍe sādhanasamuddeśe helārājakṛtāyāṃ vyākhyāyām

yathā devadatto gacchati ityatra devadattaśabdo dravyāṃśaviṣayaniyataśaktitvād gatyādīn nopātte na vā vyudasyati tathākhyātamapi devadattaṃ nopātte na vā vyudasyati kriyāṃśaviṣayaniyataśaktitvāt nāmākhyātayorniyatavastubhāgābhiniveśitvāt, tadanupātyayaṃ bhedapratyayaḥ

āha--yathānantaroktaṃ devadattaśabdo gatyādīn nopādatte na ca vyudasyati aṃśaniyatatvācchabdaśaktīnāṃ pravṛttatvācca tathā vastunāpi devadattena gatyādayaḥ kimanupāttāvyudastāḥ ? netyucyate viśeṣaḥ — devadattavastunetyādi, devadattaśabdenānupādīyamānāpi hi gatirvastunā tena upāttaiva aṃśaniyatyabhāvād viśeṣahetośca

ko viśeṣaheturiti cet, ucyate --tadātmatvāt, gatyādyātmako hi devadattaḥ tatparyanubhavanāt, yad yadātmakaṃ tena tadupāttam, agninevauṣṇyam, yathā agnerauṣṇyamātmetyagninopāttaṃ tathā devadattena gatiriti
arthopanipātitvāttu vacaso devadattaśabdenāpi gatyādi na nopāttam, arthavat tadbhavanārthatvāt
devadattaśabdo hi dvitīyādivinābhūtaḥ kevale kartaryeva prayujyate, kartā ca kriyāyāḥ sādhanatvāt kriyāsu tathā tathā vartamānastathā tathā śabdo'pi tattadarthavācī
yathāhurantataḥ--astirbhavantīparaḥ prathamapuruṣe'prayujyamāno'pyastīti gamyate, vṛkṣaḥ astīti gamyate pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
evaṃ tāvad devadattavastunā gatirupāttā na devadattaśabdena iti viśeṣa uktaḥ
kiṃ gacchatiśabdena gacchatyarthena ca devadattārtha upātto na ? ityatrocyate --gacchatiśabdena ca devadatta upātta iti, pu~lliṅgaṃ devadattābhisambandhāt
śabdena cedartha upātto'rthena gacchatilakṣaṇena devadattārtha upātta eva tadātmatvāditi viśeṣaḥ

yathā na, tadatadbhavanāvicchedātmakapravṛttinityatvasyākūṭasthatvād bhavanamevedaṃ gatisthitidhṛtyadhṛtyādi iti gamyādipravṛttibhavanena bhavadbhavanamupāttameva ubhayātmatvād vastuno dravyakriyātmadvairūpyāt arthena gantrādyupāttaṃ devadattādi gamayatītyuktaṃ kriyāyā dravyabhedaparyanubhavātmakatvāditi tathā śabde'pyeṣa vidhiḥ --gacchatiśabdenetyādi, gacchatiśabdena ca devadatta upātta uktavadubhayavastutvāt prāk śabdasya dravyabhedaparyanubhavanapravṛttyātmatvāditi
evaṃ tāvat sarvasarvātmakadravyārthanayatvādasato bhedān kalpitānāśritya bhedajñānavyavahārāvuktau, paramārthatastu arthopanipātitvāt tu vacasa ityādi
devadattaśabdenāpi gatyādi na nopāttam, upāttameva, arthavat
kutaḥ ? tadbhavanārthatvāt, tasya bhavanaṃ tadbhavanaṃ gatyādibhavanamevārtho devadattaśabdasyeti devadattārtheneva gatyādyartho'pyupātta iti gṛhāṇa

yadā svārtha-dravya-liṅga-saṅkhyā-karmādivāci prātipadikaṃ, vibhaktayastadabhivyañjikāḥ, vivakṣāvaśācca kārakaviśeṣāśrayaṇam, karmādīnāmapi kārakatvāt kartṛtvamiṣṭameva iti siddhāntastadā viśeṣānāśrayaṇe'pi dvitīyādivinābhūto devadattaśabdaḥ kevale kartaryeva prayujyate, kartā ca kriyāyāḥ sādhanatvāt kriyāmantareṇa na bhavati, kriyāśca āsiśayitiṣṭhatyādayaḥ, tāsu tāsu svayamasau kartā tena tena prakāreṇa vartamānastathā tathā śabdo'pi tattadarthavācī
yathāhurantata iti jñāpakam, vicārāvasāne vaiyākaraṇairetad niścitam --astirbhavantīpara ityādi
prathamamadhyamottamāntamanyadapi kriyāpadaṃ bhavatyeva diṅmātrolliṅganāt tvamasi ahamasmi tiṣṭhati tiṣṭhasi tiṣṭhāmi ityādīnāṃ niyamābhāvāt, kriyāpadena vinā na bhavati ityeṣa hi niyamaḥ
devadattaśabdo na devadattakartrarthapratyāyanārtho nānarthakaḥ, arthapratyāyanārthatvād vacanapravṛtteḥ

devadattaśabdena devadattārtho vijñāyamāna evānūdyate sa gacchati iti vidhānāya, gatividhānaṃ sthānaviparītadevadattakartṛkagamanapratipādanāya yo gacchati sa devadattaḥ iti tathā yo'sau sa gacchati iti
tathā cedamānarthakyaṃ paunaruktyaṃ ca avibhaktavidhyanuvādārthaṃ vaktāraṃ prati
prathamapadopādānasannihitārthavyañjanaṃ dvitīyapadaṃ tatsannidhimātreṇa tathā pratipattuḥ śroturupakārakaṃ nānyasya

sa eṣa upāttagatyartho devadattaśabdo na devadattakartrarthapratyāyanārtho nānarthakaḥ samyakpratyavekṣāyāmiti vartate, tasyā arthapratyāyanārthatvād vacanapravṛtteḥ arthaṃ pratyāyayiṣyāmi iti vacanaṃ pravartate tasmānnānarthakam, samīkṣyakāryuktitvāt
pramāṇāntaropalabdhatvācca devadattasya na devadattavācakaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? devadattaśabdena devadattārtho vijñāyamāna evānūdyate, jñātārtho hyanuvādo vidhyaṅgatvāt
kimartho'nuvāda iti cet, sa gacchatīti vidhānāya, devadattaviśiṣṭagatividhānāya
devadattānuvādo gatividhānārtho'stu, gatividhānaṃ kimarthamiti cet, ucyate --sthānaviparītetyādi
adhyārūḍhadevadattakartṛsādhanaṃ sthānaviparītaṃ gamanaṃ vivakṣitam, tatpratipādanāya devadattaṃ gatikartṛtvena adhyārohayāmi iti prayujyate
tannidarśayati --yo gacchati sa devadatta iti tathā yo'sau sa gacchati iti devadatto gatikriyāyāḥ karteti ajñātārthasya jñātārthenānūdyamānena vidhānād dravyakriyāvācinoścābhinnārthatvācca vastutaḥ
evaṃ sati paunaruktyamiti cet, abhyupagamyate tathā cedamityādi

evaṃ ca kṛtvā devadattaḥ ityukte viśiṣṭakriyātmakakartṛnirdeśād gatergatatvād gacchatiśabdo'narthakaḥ punaruktaṃ ca tathā gacchatiśabdādeva viśiṣṭakartṛkagamanavacanād devadattārthagaterdevadattaśabdo'pi

tau ca ānarthakyapaunaruktyadoṣau na vibhaktavidhyanuvādārthaṃ vaktāraṃ śrotāraṃ vā prati bhavataḥ, kaṃ tarhi prati ? ucyate --avibhaktavidhyanuvādārthaṃ vaktāraṃ prati, avibhakto vidhirayamavijñātārthatvācchabdaḥ anuvādo'yaṃ vijñātārthatvād vidhyaṅgatvācca ityavivektāraṃ vaktāraṃ śrotāraṃ vā''sādya ānarthakyaṃ paunaruktyaṃ vā syādanyatarasyaivānayoḥ, na vivektāraṃ vaktāraṃ śrotāraṃ vā āsādya ānarthakyaṃ paunaruktyaṃ vā syādanyatarasyaivānayorvivektāraṃ vidhyanuvādārthau iti
syānmatam--astu svayaṃ niścitadravyakriyātmakaikavastuvidhyanuvādārthaṃ vacanaṃ vaktāraṃ prati, kathaṃ punaḥ śroturiti cet, ucyate--tasyāpi prathamapadopādānetyādi yāvacchroturupakārakamiti
prathamaṃ padamatra devadattaḥ iti gacchati iti vā yathāvivakṣaṃ prayuktam

prathamapadamupādānamasya so'rthaḥ prathamapadopādānaḥ, prathamapadopāttārthameva dvitīyapadam udgrāhitārthavivaraṇārthatvād bhāṣyagranthavat, nādita eva tadarthajñānasya kārakaṃ tathāvyaktavyañjanatvāt pradīpavat

sannihitaśca dvitīyapadābhidheyābhimataḥ, tasya vyañjanaśabdo dvitīyapadam, tatsannidhimātreṇa prayogamātreṇa prāk pratipanna evābhivyajyate so'rthastenetyarthaḥ, tathā pratipattuḥ śroturiti vakturabhiprāyamūhituṃ samarthasya gṛhītasaṅketasyetyarthaḥ upakārakaṃ pratipattyādhānasamarthaṃ, nānyasyeti avibhaktavidhyanuvādārthasyākṛtasaṅgītervā
na sa punaḥ śabdāparādho yadasau tadarthaṃ na pratipadyate, yathā--na hi sa sūryasyāparādho yadenamulūko na paśyatīti
prathamapadopāttārthameva dvitīyapadam udgrāhitārthavivaraṇārthatvād bhāṣyagranthavat, nādita eva tadarthajñānasya kārakaṃ tathāvyaktavyañjanatvāt pradīpavat

atra prayogaḥ --prathamapadopāttārthameva dvitīyapadam, udgrāhitārthavivaraṇārthatvāt, udgrāhito gamanabhavanābhisambandhī devadattaḥ, tadvivaraṇārtho gacchatiśabdaḥ, devadattaḥ ityukte āgṛhītagatirapi na pareṇa jñāyata ityuktatvāt
yadudgrāhitārthavivaraṇārthaṃ padaṃ tat pūrvapadopāttārthameva dṛṣṭam, bhāṣyagranthavat, yathā vṛddhirādaic pā॰ 1
1 iti sūtreṇaivopāttamarthaṃ bhāṣyagranthe padāni vivṛṇvanti--vṛddhiḥ itīyaṃ saṃjñā bhavati ādaicvarṇānāmiti, sādhvanuśāsanādivicārādhāreṇa sūtreṇaivopāttatvāt
sūtreṣveva hi tat sarvaṃ yad vṛttau yacca vārtike
na hi sūtrata eva śabdān gratipratipadyate
nanu coktam--na kevalāni carcāpadāni vyākhyānam--vṛddhiḥ, āt, aijiti
kiṃ tarhi ? udāharaṇaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ vākyādhyāhāra ityetat samuditaṃ vyākhyānaṃ bhavatīti
etadupari kaiyaṭaviracite bhāṣyapradīpoddyote pūrvārdhamātramasya ślokasya uddhṛtaṃ dṛśyate
syānmatam--prathamapadopāttārthaṃ cet prathamapadoccāraṇakāla eva tathā pratipattuḥ śroturupakārakaṃ syāt tenaiva vyaktatvāditi

atrocyate--kasyacid bhavatyapi, keṣāñcid nādita eva tadarthajñānasya kārakam, tathāvyaktavyañjanatvāt, tena prakāreṇa vyaktastathāvyaktaḥ, devadattaśabdoccāraṇamātreṇa śrotuḥ viśiṣṭakriyāviṣayakartṛko devadattaḥ ityetāvat tāvadādhīyate buddhau tasmāt tathāvyaktaḥ, tasya vyañjano gacchatiśabdaḥ nāpūrvaṃ kiñcidāha tadanuvāditvāt, atastathāvyaktavyañjanatvāt pradīpavat, yathā pradīpaḥ prāgabhivyaktaṃ ghaṭamapavarakasthaṃ vyanaktīti nādita eva tadarthajñānasya kārakaḥ tathātra vākye gacchatiśabdo'pīti
athavā dravyārthavāde kumbhakāro'pi vidyamānameva ghaṭaṃ tathābhivyanakti nāvidyamānamutpādayati pradīpavat

tasmāt kumbhakārasyāpi vyaktavyañjanatvāt piṇḍādyavasthāyāmapi vyakta eva ghaṭaḥ kriyākramābhivyaktipratyakṣatvāt pradīpābhivyaktaghaṭavat, tathā devadatto gacchati ityatrāpi vyaktavyañjanatvād nādita eva tadarthajñānasya kāraka iti
etaccihnāntargataḥ ॰va tathā pratipattuḥ ityata ārabhya śroturapi bhavantī dṛṣṭā ta॰ pṛ॰ 399 paṃ॰ 10 ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratiṣu itaścāsiddhiḥ svavi॰ pṛ॰ 40॰ paṃ॰ 18 ityanantaraṃ vartate
tathā ca vināpi tathābhūtaśabdasannidhiṃ pūrvaśrutaśabdopāttārthavṛttireva, tathāniyatatvāt, yathā praviśa piṇḍīmiti
vakturvivakṣāyāmanyathoktyānarthakyāt arthaprakaraṇādyāpādanācca ante nāmnaḥ kartṛtvapratipattiḥ śroturapi bhavantī dṛṣṭā
athavā dṛśyante hi vākyeṣu vākyaikadeśān prayuñjānāḥ padeṣu ca padaikadeśān
vākyeṣu tāvadvākyaikadeśān praviśa, piṇḍīm, praviśa, tarpaṇam iti
padeṣu padaikadeśān devadatto dattaḥ, satyabhāmā bhāmā iti
praveśanakriyā karma yogyamākṣipati, tatra piṇḍyāṃ praveśāsaṃbhavād gṛhapratipattiḥ
evaṃ piṇḍīmiti karma yogyāṃ kriyāmākṣipadbhakṣaṇakriyāṃ prakaraṇavaśāt pratyāyayati, evaṃ saṃprasāraṇādityetannirvṛttārthamākṣepsyatītyarthaḥ
yathā ca padaikadeśaprayogastathā siddhe śabdārthasaṃbandhe ityatra pratipāditam
tattadvākyasya vākyārthe śaktigrahaṇakāle tattadekadeśasyāpi tattadvākyārthe śaktigrahaḥ, padaikadeśasya padārtha iveti śaktyaiva bodhaḥ
ityetasya--ityetadarthakasya, saṃprasāraṇādutpanno yastasmādityasyeti saṃprasāraṇasya yatkāryaṃ tasyeti ca vākyasyārthe ityarthaḥ
kintu lokavyavahāre'pi prasiddhistathā dṛṣṭeti tad darśayitumāha --tathā ca vināpītyādi yāvat praviśa piṇḍīmiti iti

evaṃ ca kṛtvā tathābhūtasyānuvādamātrabhinnārthasya śabdasya sannidhimantareṇāpi pūrvaśrutaśabdopāttasyārthasya vṛttireva tathāniyatatvāt, tathā hi tacchabdavṛttirniyatā yathā kvacidaśrūyamāṇadvitīyapado'pi tatpadārthaviṣayapratipattiheturbhavati tathaiva ca pratipattāro dṛśyante, yathā praviśa piṇḍīm ityatra praviśaśabdaśravaṇāt praveśayogyaṃ prakaraṇādibhiḥ suṣiraṃ gṛhādi karmapadamatra iti piṇḍīm iti ca karmapadaśravaṇādanantaroktapraviśyasambhavāt tadyogyabhakṣikriyākartṛkarmakam iti pratipadyante
yathā devadattaśabdopāttārthavācī gacchatiśabdastathā gacchati iti ca tipā upātta eva kartā, kiṃ kāraṇam ? laḥ kartari ca iti kartari vihitalakārādeśatvāt tipaḥ
ko'sau kartā iti cet, ucyate--sa ca devadatta eva viśiṣṭaḥ, viśiṣṭakartṛviṣayagamanavivakṣitatvāt

athavā gacchatiḥ svāṃśopāttārthaviṣayaka eva tacchabdavyavasthāpyasvarūpatvāt, yo yacchabdavyavasthāpyasvarūpaḥ śabdaḥ sa svāṃśopāttārthaviṣayaka eva dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā ghaṭaśabdavyavasthāpyordhvatvādiriti

evamanicchato doṣa ucyate --vakturvivakṣāyāmanyathoktyānarthakyāditi, devadattakartṛviṣayāṃ gatiṃ pratipipādayiṣatā hi vaktrā gacchatiḥ prayukto yadi tamevārthaṃ na brūyāduktervācyaḥ ko'rthaḥ syāt ? ityānarthakyaṃ prāptamiti

kiñcānyat, arthaprakaraṇādyāpādanācca, saṃsargaviprayogasāhacaryavirodhārthaprakaraṇaliṅgaśabdā anayā ca śabdārthagatibhāvanayā bhavanamevedamekarūpaṃ devadattabhedaṃ gatisthityādibhedaṃ vā bhavati, tena tathā bhūyata iti
sarvatra pravṛttisambhave kenacit phaloddeśena kārakavatyāḥ parigrahārthaṃ viśeṣagrahaṇam

sarvabhāveṣu hi pravṛttirasti sahabhāvibhirasahabhāvibhiśca viśeṣaiḥ pratyāśrayaṃ sahitā prādurbhāvatirobhāvātmikā ntarasannidhyaucitīdeśakālavyaktisvarādisāmarthyabhedairarthasyānavagamyamānasya vaktrabhiprāyānuvartibhirvyākhyātṛbhirviśeṣe'vasthāpanaṃ dṛṣṭam, tacca tenaiva śabdenopāttārthatve ghaṭate nānyatheti

tathā śrotrāpyaśruto'pi gṛhyate sa iti gacchati ityukte ko gacchati ? devadattaḥ iti ante'vasāne nāmnaḥ kartṛtvapratipattiḥ, yadyapi tipā upāttaṃ kartṛtvaṃ tathāpi yāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ gatvā nāmapadārtha eva kartā iti pratipattiḥ śroturapi bhavantī dṛṣṭā, tasmāddhetostasyā dṛṣṭāyāḥ pratipatteḥ, kveva ? vaktṛvat, vaktarīva vaktṛvat, yathā vaktari pratipattiḥ prāgupajātā gacchatiṃ devadattakartṛviṣayaṃ prayuñje'ham iti śroturapīti
evamupapattyantaraṃ śabdārtho'pi dravyakriyā- tmakavastuviṣaya iti bhāvitam

anayā ca śabdārthagatibhāvanayā bhavanamevedamekarūpaṃ devadattabhedaṃ gatisthityādibhedaṃ vā bhavati, tena tathā bhūyata iti
sarvatra pravṛttisambhave kenacit phaloddeśena kārakavatyāḥ parigrahārthaṃ viśeṣagrahaṇam
sarvabhāveṣu hi pravṛttirasti sahabhāvibhirasahabhāvibhiśca viśeṣaiḥ pratyāśrayaṃ sahitā prādurbhāvatirobhāvātmikā
etayāpi śabdārthagatibhāvanayāsmadvyākhyātayā loke dṛṣṭayā bhavanamevedamekarūpaṃ devadattabhedaṃ gatibhedaṃ sthitibhedaṃ dhṛtyadhṛtihasanakathanādibhedaṃ vā bhavati sarvatra vyakterbhavati

yasmāt tena tathā bhūyata iti, itiśabdahetvarthatvād yasmādekameva bhavanaṃ devadattadravyarūpaṃ gatisthityādikriyārūpaṃ ca bhavati, tenaiva tena tena rūpeṇa bhūyate, na bhavanaśūnyamanyat kiñcidasti, bhavanameva bhavatīti
bhavanamevāviśiṣṭaṃ sarvatra kriyā ityāpādite tadamṛṣyatā idaṃ vaiyākaraṇena kriyālakṣaṇamabhidhīyate --pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā ityetajjyāyaḥ kriyālakṣaṇam, na satatasampravṛttimātram
tatra kārakāṇām ityetasya vyākhyānamudbhūtaśabdaiḥ kārakasyaiva kriyātvaṃ mā vijñāyi bhavatā, kārakapṛthagbhūtā gṛhyatām iti bhedadarśanārthā ṣaṣṭhī
viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ punaḥ kimarthamiti cet, tata āha --sarvatra pravṛttisambhava ityādi

kenacit phaloddeśeneti sāṃvyavahārikamodanādiphalamuddiśyate, kārakavatyā iti svāśrayapṛthagbhūtakaraṇādisādhanavatyā ityarthaḥ, sarvā hi kriyā kartṛsamavāyinī karmasamavāyinī vā syāt pacatibhinattivat phalavatīti evaṃrūpāyāḥ pacipaṭhigamyādeḥ parigrahārthaṃ bhidyādeśca viśeṣagrahaṇamiti

pravṛttimātraparigrahe tvatpakṣe doṣa ucyate --sarvabhāveṣu hi pravṛttirastītyādi, rūpādibhiḥ sahabhāvibhirasahabhāvibhirgatisthityādibhiśca viśeṣaiḥ pratyāśrayaṃ vastuni vastuni sahitā yuktaiva sā pravṛttiḥ, prādurbhāvatirobhāvātmiketi rūpamasyāḥ kathayati, pracayāpacayaphaleti kāryasya pravṛttimāha kriyāyāṃ pracayāpacayaphalā ityuktaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa--sarvasya muhūrtamapyanavasthānāt kiṃ phalaṃ laukikam ? viśeṣāstūpajāyamānāḥ svāśrayāt kārakāntarāṇyapekṣante, yathā vikledastaṇḍulāśrayaḥ kāṣṭhādīnyapekṣate
bhāvaśca kriyā iti yaducyate tanna sidhyati
pravṛttisāmānyasya kutaḥ kriyātvaṃ phaloddeśakārakasambandhābhāvāt, gacchatyādivyāpirūpatā vā pravṛttiviśeṣatvenābhūtatvāt kārakavat, vaidharmyaṃ tadbhedavat
tathā ca dravyadvitīyatāpi naiva pravṛttisāmānyasya, asattvāt, khapuṣpasyeva
asattvaṃ ca adravyatve sati agatyāditvāt khapuṣpavat

gṛhītvoktaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇeti tasyāḥ sarvatra vastuni sambhavantyāḥ svarūpaphalasadbhāvapradarśanārthamuktamiti granthaṃ yojayati, sarvasya muhūrtamapyanavasthānāt kiṃ phalaṃ laukikaṃ sāṃvyavahārikam ? iti vyavahārākṣamatāṃ darśayati
viśeṣagrahaṇasāmarthyāt punarviśeṣāstūpajāyamānāḥ pacyādaya odanādiphalāntarahetavaḥ svāśrayāt kārakāntarāṇyapekṣante
tadupanayati --tatra yā pravṛttirityādi gatārthaṃ yāvad na pravṛttisāmānyamiti
iti viśeṣagrahaṇasāphalyaṃ vyākhyātaṃ bhavati pravṛttisāmānyasyākriyātvaṃ ca
pracayāpacayaphalā ityuktaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa--sarvasya muhūrtamapyanavasthānāt kiṃ phalaṃ laukikam ? viśeṣāstūpajāyamānāḥ svāśrayāt kārakāntarāṇyapekṣante, yathā vikledastaṇḍulāśrayaḥ kāṣṭhādīnyapekṣate
bhāvaśca kriyā iti yaducyate tanna sidhyati
pravṛttisāmānyasya kutaḥ kriyātvaṃ phaloddeśakārakasambandhābhāvāt, gacchatyādivyāpirūpatā vā pravṛttiviśeṣatvenābhūtatvāt kārakavat, vaidharmyaṃ tadbhedavat
tathā ca dravyadvitīyatāpi naiva pravṛttisāmānyasya, asattvāt, khapuṣpasyeva
asattvaṃ ca adravyatve sati agatyāditvāt khapuṣpavat

bhāvaśca kriyetyādi yāvat kutaḥ kriyātvaṃ phaloddeśakārakasambandhābhāvāt ? yaducyate dravyaṃ ca kriyā ca iti yannyāyabalena tvayocyate dravyakriyātmako bhāva iti tanna sidhyati tvadabhipretakriyābhāvāsiddherityarthaḥ
tatpratipādanārthamāha — gacchatyādivyāpirūpatā vā iti kutaḥ iti vartate

gatyādivyāpinī na bhavati tvadiṣṭapravṛttisāmānyalakṣaṇā kriyā pravṛttiviśeṣatvenābhūtatvāt, yad yat pravṛttiviśeṣatvenābhūtaṃ tat tad gacchatyādīn na vyāpnoti yathā kārakaṃ kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣatvenābhūtamakriyā, akriyātvaṃ cāvayoḥ siddhamiti dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādharmyeṇa
vaidharmyaṃ tadbhedavaditi, yā yā kriyā sā sā pravṛttiviśeṣatvena bhūtā yathā gacchatitiṣṭhatyādikriyābhedāḥ dravaṇa-patana-sarpaṇa-riṅgaṇādayo vā gamanaviśeṣāḥ

evaṃ ca kṛtvā dravyaṃ kriyā ca dvau bhāvāviti dravyasya bhāvasya dvitīyo bhāvaḥ kriyā ityetadapi pravṛttisāmānyakriyāvādino nopapadyate tasyāḥ kriyāyāstvadiṣṭāyā asattvāt khapuṣpasyeva, yathā khapuṣpamasattvād dravyasya dvitīyaṃ na bhavati tathā pravṛttisāmānyamiti
asattvamasiddhaṃ pravṛttisāmānyasyeti cet, asat tadadravyatve sati agatyāditvāt khapuṣpavat, agatyāditvaṃ ca tadavyāpitvāditi
tasmāt pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā na pravṛttisāmānyam iti vaiyākaraṇapakṣaḥ
abhyupagatā tāvadasmadabhimativat sarvabhāvaviṣayā pravṛttirbhāvānāmātmā phalāntarahetuhetubhāvāvibhaktavṛttiḥ sarvabhāveṣvityukteḥ
yathā ca viśeṣāḥ phalanirvṛttau kārakāntarāṇyapekṣante tathā mṛdbhavanasyāpi ghaṭaphalanirvṛttau kārakāntarāpekṣā, kartā kumbhakāro'sya daṇḍādinā udakādyāhṛtyai atataḥ śālāyāṃ ghaṭaṃ karoti
mālavanagare sapta varṣaśatāni āma eva ghaṭo varṣe
nanu tvayāpi pravṛttiviśeṣakriyāvādinā pravṛttisāmānyameva kriyā ityetadabhyupagatamasmadabhimativat

katham ? iti taddarśayati --sarvabhāvaviṣayā pravṛttirbhāvānāmātmeti, ādāveva tāvadabhyupagataṃ tvayā na hi kiñcit svātmani muhūrtamapyavatiṣṭhate vardhate yāvadanena vardhitavyamapāyena vā yujyate iti bruvatā sarvabhāvānāṃ satatasampravṛttirātmā svarūpamiti, sa cābhyupagamo'smanmatisāmyāt pravṛttisāmānyakriyātvaṃ samarthayati, kiṃ kāraṇam ? phalāntarahetuhetubhāvāvibhaktavṛttiḥ sarvabhāveṣvityukteḥ, phalaṃ bījādipravṛtterhetubhūtāyā aṅkurādi, tato'nyāni phalāni phalāntarāṇi tadanubandhajanmāni parṇa-nāla-kāṇḍa-tuṣa-śūka-kṣīra-taṇḍulādīni krameṇa, hetavaḥ pūrve pūrve yathāsvam, tato'pi pūrve pūrve'ntaritā hetuhetavaḥ, ta eva bhāvāḥ kriyātmānaḥ, tairevāvibhaktā vṛttirvartanaṃ satatasampravṛttiḥ sarvabhāveṣvityuktatvāt
kathamuktam ? na hi kiñcit svātmani ityādivacanāt sarvabhāveṣu bījāṅkuramṛtpiṇḍādiṣūktam

kiñcānyat, yadapi coktaṃ kenacit phaloddeśena pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kārakāṇām iti sa ca viśeṣaḥ sahabhāvino rūpādayo'sahabhāvino gamanasthānādayaśca taiḥ pratyāśrayaṃ yuktā tadātmikā ca ityanenāpi vacanena sāmānyapravṛttereveti kriyātvamuktaṃ bhavati

kiṃ kāraṇam ? anantaroktaviśeṣadvayasannidhānāt sarvatra teṣāmeva ca viśeṣāṇāṃ sāmānyapravṛttyātmakānāmodanādyuddeśyaphalarūpatvāt sannidhānācca phalāntarahetutvāt teṣāmeva, ta eva hyodanādiphalāntarahetavo nānyaḥ kaścit, ataḥ pravṛttiviśeṣātmikāpi saiva sāmānyapravṛttireveti

yadapi coktaṃ viśeṣāstūpajāyamānā ityādistadanantarokto grantho yāvad na pravṛttisāmānyaṃ lokavyavahārānaṅgatvāditi, atrocyate--ihāpi samānakalpatvād na doṣaḥ, viśeṣagrahaṇānarthakyaṃ ca parapakṣa ityata āha--yathā ca viśeṣā ityādi pravṛttiviśeṣasāmānyalakṣaṇayoḥ kriyayoraviśeṣāpādanagrantho gatārthaḥ
pacerodanaphalanirvṛttau kārakāntarāpekṣāvat mṛdbhavanasyāpi ghaṭaphalanirvṛttau kārakāntarāpekṣeti piṇḍādiṣu sarveṣu bhavanameva kumbhakārādīni mṛdo'nyāni kārakāṇyapekṣata ityarthaḥ

kālo'pi keṣā- ñcit kārakamiti taddarśayannāha --mālavanagare sapta varṣaśatānīti, tatra āma eva ghaṭo varṣe pradarśyate pradarśyate saṅgopyate ca godohe vā taḍāgādau; tasyaiva kṣaṇamapyanavasthānamudake prakṣiptasya
gatyabhāvo'pravṛttirgatinivṛttiriti cet, atha nirupākhyameva gatyabhāvamātrasthānaṃ tat prāpnoti abhāvatvādapravṛttatvāt khapuṣpavat
saṅgopyate ca saṅgopitasārāṇi dravyāṇi iti khyāpanārthaṃ, godohe vā taḍāgādāviti, tasyaiva āmasya kṣaṇamapyanavasthānamudake prakṣiptasyeti ca kārakaviśeṣāpekṣāpradarśanam
pradarśyate saṅgopyate ca godohe vā taḍāgādau; tasyaiva kṣaṇamapyanavasthānamudake prakṣiptasya
gatyabhāvo'pravṛttirgatinivṛttiriti cet, atha nirupākhyameva gatyabhāvamātrasthānaṃ tat prāpnoti abhāvatvādapravṛttatvāt khapuṣpavat
yadapyuktaṃ pravṛttisāmānyaṃ pravṛttiviśeṣatvenābhūtatvāt kārakavad gacchatyādivyāpi na bhavati iti tadapi nānumānam, asiddhahetutvāt

pravṛttisāmānyasya pravṛttiviśeṣatvenābhūtatvamasiddhaṃ pravṛttiviśeṣasvarūpatvādeva, tatsāmānyasya pravṛttiviśeṣasvarūpatvaṃ ca sarvatra bhavanasyāvicchinnatvāt tadavinābhāvācca gatyādiviśeṣāṇāṃ bhavanasvātmavaditi tannyāyamanusmārayannāha --pravṛttiviśeṣatvenābhūtatvādyasiddhatāpi caivamuktaiva
yadapyuktam --asattvād dravyadvitīyatāpi naiva pravṛttisāmānyasyāsattvaṃ ca khapuṣpavadagatyāditvāditi, atrocyate--agatyāditvācca nāsattvaṃ hetvasiddherevoktavad gatyādisvarūpatvāt satatabhavanasyeti

etaccihnāntargatapāṭhasthāne pravṛttiviśeṣatvenābhūtatvamasiddhaṃ pravṛttiviśeṣasvarūpatvādeva tatsāmānyasya pravṛttiviśeṣatvenābhūtatvamasiddhaṃ pravṛttiviśeṣasvarūpatvātsāmānyasya iti dvirbhūtaḥ pāṭhaḥ pratiṣu
abhyupagamyāpi agatyādihetusiddhimanaikāntikatvaṃ brūmaḥ --nanvagamanasthānaṃ cākāśam agacchadatiṣṭhacca vyoma bhavati astyeva
tatra kimagatyāditvādasat syāt khapuṣpavat ? utākāśavat sat syāt ? iti sandehahetuteti
syānmatam--agatyastu, kathamasthānamākāśam nityasthitatvāt ? tasmāt agatitvāt iti saṃśayahetutā syāt, asthānatvāt ityayukteti
atrocyate--asyāpyasthānatvameva, yasmāt paṭhyate ṣṭhā gatinivṛttau pā॰ dhā॰ 928, pravṛttāyā gateryā nivṛttiḥ pratibandhaḥ sā sthitirvakṣyamāṇavat
na cāsya pravṛttagaterākāśasya pratibandho jātu pragatadevadattagatinivartanavat
asthānam iti ca sthānādanyad gamanādi ucyate na sthānasyātyantābhāva eva, tasmādākāśamapyasthānagamanaṃ saccetyanaikāntikahetutā tadavasthaiva sādhanayoranayoriti
syānmatam--nanvabhāvo gatergatinivṛttirapravṛttiḥ, tasmād gatyabhāvamātratvāt sthiterabhāvatvād nāsthānaṃ na sthānavadeva cākāśaṃ gaterevābhāvāditi
upākhyā saṃjñā, nirgatopākhyaṃ nirupākhyaṃ tvatparikalpitagatyabhāvamātrasthānaṃ tat prāpnoti, abhāvatvāt
ākāśādi ca pravṛttaṃ sthānavadasthānaṃ ceti vakṣyāmaḥ
gativiśeṣaṇasāmarthyāditi cet, tadevedamasmadiṣṭaṃ sthānasya sattvaṃ gatyabhāvasya gativiśeṣaṇayogāt siddham
gativiśeṣaṇasāmarthyāpāditasthityādyuttarabhāvasatyatvāt ata eva ca sarvātmakabhavanasvatattvamālambya tatsvābhāvyāt pūrvottarabhāvayorekasyābhivyaktyā itarasya anabhivyaktyā ca bhavanaṃ bhāvaḥ
virodhibhāvaprādurbhāve hi bhāvāntaranivṛttiḥ bhāva eva virodhibhāvaprādurbhāvatvādeva, yathā jāgaraṇena svapno nivartyate
na hi kriyāntaramanyaṅgīya kriyāntaraṃ prādurbhavatīha kiñcit
ihāpi ca gatibhavanamanyaṅnīya na sthitibhavanaṃ prādurbhavati
syānmatam--yadi sarvathā sthānaṃ nivṛttirabhāvaḥ ityaviśeṣya brūyāṃ khapuṣpavad nirupākhyaṃ syāt, kiṃ tarhi ? gatyā viśiṣṭaṃ sthānaṃ gatinivṛttiḥ iti brūmaḥ

atrocyate --tadevedamasmadiṣṭaṃ sthānasya sattvaṃ gatyabhāvasya sthityabhāvasya gamanasya sattvavad gativiśeṣaṇayogād bhavanmataviruddhaṃ siddham, tasmiṃśca siddhe sthāne tadvad gatisthityādi sarvakriyāpadābhidheyaṃ bhāvaḥ satyameva nāsaditi siddham
tasmācca gativiśeṣaṇasāmarthyāpāditasthityādyuttarabhāvasatyatvāt ata eva ca sarvātmaketyādi yāvad bhavanaṃ bhāva iti

yeyaṃ niruktiḥ bhavanaṃ bhāvaḥ iti sāpyetasmādeva kāraṇād gatisthityādisarvātmakameva bhavanasvatattvamālambya tadaparityāgena tatsvābhāvyāt tattadbhavanānubhavasvabhāvatvāt pūrvasya gatibhāvasya uttarasya ca sthitibhāvasya athavā pūrvasya sthitibhāvasya uttarasya ca gatibhāvasya yathāvivakṣākramaṃ yathāpariṇatikramaṃ ca yathāsambhavamekasyābhivyaktyā itarasyānabhivyaktyā ca bhavanaṃ bhāva iti nirucyate
syānmatam--virodhino bhāvasya uttarasya sthityādeḥ prādurbhāvād gatervināśaḥ gatervā prādurbhāve sthiteḥ, sa cābhāvo vināśaḥ pākajotpattivaditi

atrocyate--yo'pyabhāvābhimato vināśo virodhibhāvaprādurbhāve hi bhāvāntaranivṛttiritīṣṭaḥ, sa ca bhāvāntarānabhivyaktistasya bhāvāntarasya sthiteranyasya gatyādeḥ gatervānyasya sthityāderbhāva eva nābhāvaḥ, virodhibhāvaprādurbhāvatvādeva
yathā jāgaraṇena svapno nivartyate, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? nivartyate'nabhivyaktiṃ nīyata ityucyate

yathā jāgaraṇena svapno'nabhivyaktiṃ nīyate tathā svapnena jāgaraṇam, jāgrato'pi ca suptavad manda-mandatara-mandatamacaitanyadarśanāt suptasyāpi jāgrata ivābhivyaktavyaktataravyaktatamasvapnadarśanāt tadeva hi caitanyaṃ tīvramandāvaraṇodayakṣayopaśamāpekṣaṃ nidrā-nidrānidrā-pracalā-pracalāpracalādibhedaṃ paṭu-paṭutara-paṭutamendriyādibhedaṃ ca dṛśyate
ata āha --na hi kriyāntaramanyaṅgīyetyādi gatārthaṃ yāvadiha kiñciditi
syādetat--yathā bhuktikriyāyā nivṛttistṛptiphalāvasānā, prayojanābhāve kārakānabhisambandhād bhujernivṛttirna kriyāntarabādhanāt evametadapi syāt
bubhukṣāṃ hi bādhitvā bhuktiḥ pravartate, bhuktiṃ ca bādhitvā tṛptiḥ pravartate, kriyācakrakāṇyetāni
atha dravyamātraṃ sthitiḥ dravyasyāvirodhād gatāvapi syāt
yatastu khalu virodhyavirodhibhāvā vācyavastusthitiḥ tasmād bhavanānanyatva eva gativirodhinī sthitiḥ

yathā tu bhuktikriyāyā nivṛttistṛptiphalāvasānā tat prayojanamuddiśya kārakapravṛtteḥ, tasmiṃścāvasite prayojane kārakāṇi na pravartante, tasmāt kārakānabhisambandhād bhujernivṛttiḥ na kriyāntarabādhanāt
evaṃ gatirapi prāptiphalāvasānā prayojanābhāve kārakānabhisambandhād nivartate na kriyāntarabādhanāt
ataḥ saṃśemahe--kiṃ svapnajāgaraṇavat kriyāntaranyaṅnayane kriyāntarodbhāvastādātmye satyeva syāt ? utātyantanivṛttireva gateḥ phalāvasānabhujikriyāvat ? iti
atrocyate— atrāpi tu mā maṃsthāḥ bhujinivṛttirabhāva eva iti, kiṃ tarhi ? phalaṃ tṛptiḥ kriyāntaraṃ pravṛttereva kriyātvāt, bubhukṣāṃ hi bādhitvetyādi yāvat kriyācakrakāṇyetānīti

etaduktaṃ bhavati--kriyāntaraprādurbhāvena vinā na kriyānivṛttirnāpi pūrvakriyānyakkaraṇamantareṇa kriyāntaraprādurbhāvaḥ, bubhukṣābhuktitṛptikriyācakravat pūrvapūrvabādhayā uttarottaraprādurbhāvāt samānametadapīti
tasmād nābhāvo gatinivṛttiḥ, bhāva eva sthitiriti

sthiterbhāvatvānabhyupagame dvayī gatiḥ sthitiśabdasya syāt tṛtīyavikalpābhāvāt--yadvā sthityabhidhānamavastukam ? yadvā dravyamātraviṣayaṃ syāt ? kiñcātaḥ ? idamato bhavati doṣajātam--avastukatve vivakṣāśabdayorapravṛttiprasaṅgaḥ, yadyavastuviṣayaṃ sthitiśabdavacanaṃ vaktumicchā vivakṣā sā svaniścitamarthaṃ paraṃ pratyāyayāmīti jāyate, arthābhāvācca na syāt
tathā ca abhidhīyate'nenetyabhidhānaṃ sthitiśabdaḥ, tasyābhāvaḥ syādarthābhāvāt, kākavāsitādivadanarthakaṃ vā tat syāditi

atha dravyamātraṃ sthitiḥ dravyasyāvirodhād gatāvapi syāt, yathā devadattasadbhāvād gatyavirodhācca devadatto gacchati ityatra devadattābhidhānaṃ pravartate tathā devadattastiṣṭhati gacchati ca ityetadabhidhānaṃ pravarteta, ubhayatra dravyasyaiva sattvāt viśeṣābhāvācca

yatastu khalvityādi, virodhyavirodhibhāvā vācyavastusthitiḥ, gatisthityoḥ parasparavirodhād devadattadravyeṇa sahāvirodhād bhāvāveva gatisthitī dravyavat, grantho gatārtho yāvad bhavanānanyatva eva gativirodhinī sthitiriti
bhavanānanyatva iti dravyabhavanādananyaiva gatiḥ sthitirveti pravṛttibhavanānanyatva eveti yathāprakrāntamupasaṃharati

syādetat--sthityā virodhavat khapuṣpādinā gatyabhāvenāpi virodhaḥ, tatra tadvirodhitvāt tadavinābhāvitve kuta etad bhāvaviṣayameva abhāvaviṣayamevaitaditi vā kutaḥ ? yadyabhāvo'pi bhāvena abhāvena vā bhāvo virudhyate tāvubhau bhāvāveva tarhi virodhitvāt yatkiñcidvat
evaṃ khapuṣpādyasattāvāciśabdānāṃ bhāvārthatvam, yathā tiṣṭhati pacati itya-

gaterabhāvo gatyā virudhyate prakāśābhāveneva tamasā prakāśaḥ, yathā tvanmatenaiva nanu prāg gatireva kriyāntaraprādurbhāvenānabhivyaktiṃ nīyamānā bhāva eva ityuktam, tatra sthityā virodhavat khapuṣpādinā gatyabhāvenāpi virodhaḥ
tatra tadvirodhitvāt tadavinābhāvitve iti gatirabhāvāvinābhāvinī syāt tadvirodhitvāt, yacca yadvirodhi tat tenāvinābhāvi dṛṣṭam, yathā--gatiḥ sthityā
evaṃ tadavinābhāvitve sati kuta etad bhāvaviṣayameva etadabhidhānaṃ sthitiḥ iti ? khapuṣpādiḥ ityabhāvaviṣayamevaitaditi vā kutaḥ ? viśeṣo vātra vācya iti

tat kathaṃ bhāvyate ? iti taducyate --yadyabhāvo bhāvena abhāvena vā bhāvo virudhyate tāvubhau yo virudhyate yena ca virudhyate bhāvāveva tarhi virodhitvāt yatkiñcidvaditi udāharaṇasaulabhyaṃ darśayati ahinakulādivad ghaṭapaṭādivad ghaṭakapālādivadvā sarvatra sahānavasthānalakṣaṇaviroghadarśanād deśataḥ kālato veti

yadapi ca tvayā sthityabhidhānamabhāvaviṣayamiti manyate tasyāpīyamupapattiḥ syād bhavantī, tadyathā— gatyabhāvamātraviṣayatvaṃ cānutpadyamānasthitirgatinivṛttiriti, tathā ca kalpyamānāyāmanutpadyamānasthitau gatinivṛttau, gatisthityādi ekabhūtaṃ bhavanaṃ prāguktanyāyakam, tenāvinābhūtaṃ dravyam, tasya vināśo'tyantamabhāvaḥ, tadviṣayaṃ sthānam ityabhidhānaṃ syāt, na caivaṃ dravyasya kūṭasthanityatvād bhavitumarhati
tasmādeva ca tadaniṣṭabhayāt pratipattavyam--gatinivṛttiḥ sthitirnābhāvaḥ, tathā khapuṣpādiśceti
anantaraṃ khapuṣpādirapi prasaṅgato'bhihito yo'sāvabhāvābhimatastatrāpi abhāvaḥ iti ca nāpadārtha ucyate, kiṃ tarhi ? nañaḥ paryudāsavācitvād bhāvādanyo bhāva iti bhāvaviśeṣaḥ, abrāhmaṇakṣatriyādivat
evaṃ khapuṣpādyasattāvāciśabdānāṃ bhāvārthatvam, evamasadbhāvābhimateṣvapi sadarthaviṣayatvamiti nyāya nyathābhavanaṃ tathā vinaśyati ityādi
khapuṣpādīnāmapi nanu tathā abhavanam, anyathā na tu abhavanam
evaṃ ca eka eva pūrvāparībhūto bhāvaḥ pravṛttirityucyate sa ca evāntarbhāvitasvaprabhedatvāt pravṛttiviśeṣa ityucyate, bhujiviśeṣavat, yathā bhujāveva dravyakṣetra- vyāpitāṃ darśayati

idaṃ tu tāvat prakṛtaṃ bhāvyate --yathā tiṣṭhati, pacati ityanyathābhavanam, anyena prakāreṇa parispandapariṇatasya dravyasya tataḥ prakārādanyena aparispandapariṇatiprakāreṇa bhavanaṃ tiṣthati āste śeta ityādi, taṇḍulādikaṭhinadravyamṛdūbhavanaṃ pacatyādi
yathaitāḥ kriyāḥ anyathābhavanamātrabhedāḥ pravṛttisāmānyaṃ bhavanaṃ nātivartante tathā vinaśyati pradhvaṃsate nitiṣṭhati ityādayo'pi bhavanaprakārāḥ pravṛttisāmānyaṃ bhāvatvaṃ ca nātivartante
ye'pyatyantābhāvābhimatāḥ khapuṣpādiśabdavācyāsteṣāmapi nanu tathā abhavanam, anyena prakāreṇa na tvabhavanam, bhavanameva, nātyantābhavanamityarthaḥ
katham ? agatisthitiḥ, gateranyā sthitiragatisthitiḥ, na tu gatyabhāvamātram, gatereva prakārāntaratā
kiṃ kāraṇam ? sati niyatatvāt prakārāṇām, prakāratvāt sanneva khapuṣpādiḥ, yo yaḥ prakāraḥ sa sanneva, yathā gatinivṛttiḥ sthitiruktanyāyā satī

kathaṃ khapuṣpādeḥ prakāratā iti cet, ucyate--khapuṣpasya ca samavāyarūpeṇānabhivyaktiḥ aśokakusumādiprakāreṇābhivyaktiriti prakāratvānativṛtteḥ, dravyakriyayoḥ sarvātmakatvādasmin dravyārthanayabhede sarvaṃ dravyaṃ kriyā ca gamanādi, dravyabhedānāṃ gamanādikriyābhedānāṃ coktavad bhavanadvayābhedāt katamat khaṃ katamadvā puṣpāṇāṃ vikasanamanyat ? iti devadattagamanabhavanadvayatvavat tadapīti khapuṣpādirapi bhāvaḥ
khapuṣpādīnāmapi nanu tathā abhavanam, anyathā na tu abhavanam
evaṃ ca eka eva pūrvāparībhūto bhāvaḥ pravṛttirityucyate sa ca evāntarbhāvitasvaprabhedatvāt pravṛttiviśeṣa ityucyate, bhujiviśeṣavat, yathā bhujāveva dravyakṣetra-

evaṃ ca kṛtvā gamanasthānādikramabhāvinīnāmapi kriyāṇāṃ satatasampravṛttitādātmyānatikramādeka eva pūrvāparībhūto bhāvaḥ pravṛttirityucyate, evameva ca tadupapadyate yaduktaṃ pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhāvamākhyātenācaṣṭe vrajati pacati nirukta॰ 1
kasmāt sa bhāvaḥ pravṛttirityucyate ? brūmaḥ--prakarṣeṇa vartanāt

sa ca prakarṣaḥ sadā sarvaprabhedānubhavanarūpaḥ, sa ca evāntarbhāvitasvaprabhedatvāt pravṛttiviśeṣa ityucyate rūpādigatyādīn svaprabhedān antarbhāvayanneva bhāvaḥ sāmānyabhavanalakṣaṇo bhavan, bhedānāṃ parasparato viśeṣāviśeṣau bhedānusyūtatvāt, na tvadiṣṭaḥ kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ sāmānyapravṛtterbhinnaḥ kaściditi
tadvyākhyānam --yathā bhujāvevetyādi yāvat prakāramātraṃ bhidyata iti
aśana-pāna-khādya-svādyādidravyabhedena kālabhāvabhedena prakāramātraṃ bhidyate evaṃ gatisthityorastimriyatyorvā
evaṃ ca bhujigatisthitipaktyādīnāmapi tathā tathā sarvabhāvavyāpitā, bhāṣatijānātiśvetatyādīnāmapi pūrvottaravyaktyavyaktibhavanaikatvāt

kāṃsapātryāṃ pāṇau śarāve veti kṣetrabhedena prathamadvitīyagrāsādinā dinarātryādinā sāyaṃprātarāśādinā vā kālabhedena tīvramandakṣudhitaglānauṣadhasvasvarasāyanādibhāvena ca prakāramātreṇaiva bhidyate na bhujitvena
na hi teṣu prakārabhinneṣu kaścidabhujirbhavati akriyā vā
kintu sarvo'pyasau bhujirūpānatikramād bhujireva, atha ca parasparataḥ prakāramātrabhedād bhidyante tathā sāmānyapravṛttireva pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ, vartaterastyarthasya sarvagatisthityādibhedātmakatvāt
evaṃ gatisthityorastimriyatyorveti virodhibhāvaprādurbhāvo'pi sāmānyabhavanasyaiva prakāramātrabhinnasya vispanditamiti tannigamayati --sarvaiva vā'sāviti yāvat kriyaiva
tasmādasti-bhavati- vidyati-padyati-vartatīnāmekārthatvāt prakārabhedācca tato nāsāmānyaḥ pravṛttiviśeṣo bhujisāmānyamātraprakārabhinnabhujiviśeṣavaditi
evaṃ ca bhujigatisthitipaktyādīnāmapi tathā tathā sarvabhāvavyāpitā, bhāṣatijānātiśvetatyādīnāmapi pūrvottaravyaktyavyaktibhavanaikatvāt

na kevalamastyādaya eva sarvadhātvarthavyāpitvāt sāmānyapravṛttimātratvabhāvanāyāṃ nidarśanam, kiṃ tarhi ? bhujigatisthitipaktyādīnāmapi tathā tathā sarvabhāvavyāpitā, bhuktestāvad bhujerabhyavaharaṇārthasya upayogaparyāyatvāt upayogasyāpattyarthatvāt āpatteḥ pariṇāmārthatvāt pariṇāmasya vṛttisattābhavanārthatvāt
tathā gatirapi sarvabhāvavyāpinī gamana-calana-spandana-pariṇāmādyekārthatvāt, dravati droṣyati dudrāveti druḥ, drorvikāro dravyam, dravyaṃ ca bhavye pā॰ 5
ārṣe'pi yathā --paramāṇupoggale ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! kiṃ eyati veyati calati phaṃdati khobhati khubhati taṃ taṃ bhāvaṃ pariṇamati ? haṃtā gotamā ! tadeva jāva pariṇamati bhagavatīsū॰ 5
sthitirapi tiṣṭhatyāste'sti svarūpaṃ na tyajati pariṇamati tathā tathā bhavatītyarthaḥ

pacati-kṛṣati-likhatyādayaḥ paktyādayaḥ, teṣāmapi paktyādīnāmastyādyaviśeṣaḥ pākasya kriyāphalatvāt kriyāyāśca hetuphalarūpābhinnapariṇatitvāt pacyate pacatyātmānaṃ bījamaṅkurībhavati jāyate'sti vipariṇamati ityādyekārthatvāt
yathā kṛṣi-vilikhatī tathātmanaḥ śirāṃ darśayati tathā tathā sarvabhāvavṛtteḥ kaṇḍūyata ityādyekārtham

syānmatam--astu bhujyādīnāṃ sarvabhāvavyāpitā gatisthitisattāvipariṇāmādyanatikramāt, paṭhi-hasi-vidi-śviti-gaḍyādīnāṃ kathamiti cet, ucyate --bhāṣatijānātiśvetatyādīnāmapi pūrvottaravyaktyavyaktibhavanaikatvāt evaṃ ca tathā tathā yadapyādinaigamanayadarśanamanavabudhya pūrvanayanipāti sthitisvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ kriyate sā tu dravyāvasthāviśeṣo gativat pratipattavyā iti atrāpi yatnaprasādhitakriyārthāntaratvatyāgaḥ avyaktadravyāvasthātvāt
yat tad dravyaṃ tato'nanyā kriyā, tadavasthātvāt, devadattabālakumārādivat
bhāṣa vyaktāyāṃ vāci pā॰ dhā॰ 612 jñā avabodhane pā॰ dhā॰ 1508 śvitā varṇe pā॰ dhā॰ 742 gaḍi vadanaikadeśe pā॰ dhā॰ 65, 361 ityevamādīnāṃ pūrvoktapūrvāparībhūtavyaktyavyaktilakṣaṇabhavanaikatvāt
ekameva hi pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhavanaṃ gatisthityādivat kriyātvādityuktam
pūrvamabhāṣamāṇo gacchaṃstiṣṭhannudāsīno vā paścād bhāṣate, tathā paśyati jānāti icchati dveṣṭi prayatate smaratītyādiṣu tulyaścarcaḥ
tasmānna kācidapūrvāparībhūtā kriyāsti, kriyātvācca sarvadhātvarthāḥ sarvadhātvarthavyāpinaḥ iti sādhūktam
paramāṇupoggale ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! eyai veyai jāva taṃ taṃ bhāvaṃ pariṇamai ? goyamā ! siya eyai veyai jāva pariṇamai, siya ṇo eyai jāva ṇo pariṇamai

yadapyādinaigamanayadarśanamanavabudhya pūrvanayanipāti sthitisvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ kriyate sā tu dravyāvasthāviśeṣo gativat pratipattavyā iti atrāpi yatnaprasādhitakriyārthāntaratvatyāgaḥ avyaktadravyāvasthātvāt
yat tad dravyaṃ tato'nanyā kriyā, tadavasthātvāt, devadattabālakumārādivat
evaṃ tāvat pravṛttisāmānyameva kriyā pravṛttiviśeṣa ityuktam, adhunā lakṣaṇāntaraṃ parīkṣyam, ata āha --yadapyādinaigametyādi
ṇegehiṃ miṇati māṇehiṃ ṇegamo esa tassa ṇeruttī
āva॰ ni॰ 755 ityevamādinayalakṣaṇe dravyakriyātmakadvitvādyanekadhā gamo naigama iti niruktyapekṣayā dravyakriyādvitvātmakavastuvāda ādinaigamanayadarśanam, tritvādidarśanānāṃ dvitīyādinaigamatvāt
etad darśanamanavabudhya pūrvanayanipāti saṃgrahanayaṃ nipatituṃ śīlaṃ yasya nirūpaṇasya tadidaṃ sthitisvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ kriyate saṅgrahanayadarśanānupāti

prathamād vidhibhaṅgād vyavahāranayādārātīyā ye'tītāḥ pūrvanayāste saṅgrahanayabhedāḥ, tadanupāti yaduttaraṃ kriyālakṣaṇaṃ sthityudāharaṇadvāreṇocyate tatsvarūpanirūpaṇāya tadaviditanayaviṣayavivekairevocyate
kathaṃ punastaiḥ sthitisvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ kriyate ? ucyate --sā tu dravyāvasthāviśeṣo gativat pratipattavyā ityevaṃ nirūpyate
yathā gatirdravyasyāvasthāviśeṣo bālakumārādivad dravyādananyā tathā sthitiriti

atrāpi lakṣaṇāntare doṣa ucyate avikalpite ka iti cet, ucyate — yatnaprasādhitakriyārthāntaratvatyāgaḥ, prāk tvayā yatnena prasādhitamuktivastukriyālakṣaṇābhidhānena dravyādarthāntaraṃ kriyā iti tasya tyāgo doṣaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? avyaktadravyāvasthātvāt, iha hyavasthāśabdenāvyaktāḥ kramabhāvino bālakumārādayo dharmā dravyasyaiva devadattāderaṃśā evocyante, te cāṃśāstadavayavatvāt tato'nanye
eṣa prayogeṇaivodbhāvyate --yat tad dravyaṃ tato'nanyetyādi gatārthaṃ yāvadabhyupagamavirodha iti
ṇegehiṃ miṇati māṇehiṃ ṇegamo esa tassa ṇeruttī
ṇegehiṃ māṇehiṃ miṇaittīi tti ṇegamassa neruttī
sesāṇaṃ pi ṇayāṇaṃ lakkhaṇamiṇamo suṇaha vocchaṃ
śilāputrakaśarīravanneti cet, na, avasthāśarīraśabdaprayogānarthakyāt atrāpi śarīrāvasthākriyātvāt
vyutpattāvapi kartari ṣaṣṭhīyaṃ dravyasyāvasthā iti, sā yadviṣayaṃ dravyasya kartṛtvaṃ tāmātmano'kriyātvāt tadanyagativicalanapratibandhātmikāmavasthāṃ darśayati

tadvyācaṣṭe --tatra tāvadavyutpattau avasthāyāstato'nyatvam, dravyādanyāvasthā, tatsvādiviṣayaśabdavācyatvāt, tasya svasvāmisambandhādiṣaṣṭhīviṣayeṇāvasthāśabdena vācyatvaṃ dravyasya, itarathā dravyaśabdo'vasthāśabdo vānarthakaḥ syāt, iha yadviśeṣavācino'pi śabdasya vācyārtho'nya ityavaśyamabhyupagantavyam, devadattāśvavat, yathā devadattāśva ityukte devadattasya svamaśvaḥ so'sya svāmīti tena svāmiviṣayeṇa aśvaśabdena tasya devadattasya vācyatvāt tato'nyatvaṃ dṛṣṭamevaṃ dravyāvastheti
syānmatam--yathā śilāputrakasya śarīram ityatra śilāputrakādananyasminnapi śarīre svādiviṣayaśabdavācyatvadarśanādanaikāntikateti

etacca na, avasthāśarīraśabdaprayogānarthakyāt, yadyananyacchilāputrakācchilāputrakaśarīraṃ śilāputraka eva śarīraṃ śarīrameva śilāputrakaḥ iti ghaṭakuṭaśabdavat paryāyamātratvāt pratītapadārthakaṃ śrotāraṃ prati anyataraprayogānarthakyaṃ syād gatārthatvāt
tasmādatrāpi śilāputrakeṇa śīryate, śarārutvāccharīramiti śarāru bhavati, tena śarāruṇā bhūyata iti dravyakriyābhidhānaṃ nātivartate
tathā ca dravyāvasthā dravyamavatiṣṭhate dravyeṇāvasthīyate ityavasthānasya kriyātvānativṛttestato'nyatvameva
vyutpattāvapi sāmāsikapadatvāt samāsasya ca ṣaṣṭhīsamāsatvāt ṣaṣṭhyāśca kartari vihitatvāt kartari tu ṣaṣṭhīyaṃ dravyasyāvasthā iti dravyamavatiṣṭhata ityādi prāgvat
sā ṣaṣṭhī yadviṣayaṃ dravyasya kartṛtvaṃ yāṃ kriyāṃ sādhayat sādhanaṃ kartṛ bhavati tad dravyaṃ tato'rthāntarabhūtāṃ tāmavasthānakriyāṃ darśayatīti sambhantsyate

kiṃ kāraṇam ? ātmano'kriyātvāt tasya dravyasya svayamakriyātvāt, kriyāmantareṇa kartuḥ kartṛtvābhāvāt kartari ṣaṣṭhī na syāt, tatastasmād dravyādanyatra gatiranyasya gatirdravyād vicalanaṃ tvanmanorathānuvṛttestu balādeva atyājyābhimatatattvadravyaśabdārthavaśād dravyādarthāntarabhūtāyā gatisthityādikriyāyā āpattiḥ, bhavati bhavanaṃ vā dravyam iti bhavyārthatvāt prakṛtipratyayārthavyutpatterdravyakriyayoḥ siddhiḥ kartṛbhāvanānātvāt
yat punaretaduktam aviśiṣṭadeśasaṃyogā vā sthitiḥ iti tanna yuktaṃ vāśabdavarjyam, dvābhyāmavirodhāt
parispandapariṇatiḥ pūrvasyā audāsīnyāvasthāyāḥ pracyutiḥ kriyāntaratvāvasthāto vā
tayoranyagativicalanayoḥ pratibandha ātmā'syā avasthānakriyāyāḥ sānyagativicalanapratibandhātmikā, tāṃ darśayati ṣaṣṭhīti
athavā tadanyagatiriti tasmiṃścānyasmiṃśca niyamena gatirvicalanam, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat
pūrvasmin vyākhyāne bhedo'nayoḥ--gatirdeśāntaraprāptiḥ, calanaṃ svakṣetre'pi vyāpṛtateti
tasmād vyutpattāvavyutpattau ca yadi dravyaṃ tataḥ avasthā iti virudhyate
kālasādhanayogī bhāva ityetayoḥ krādiṣvavyāpteralakṣaṇamiti taireva nirākṛtamiti

tvanmanorathānuvṛttestu balādeva atyājyābhimatatattvadravyaśabdārthavaśād dravyādarthāntarabhūtāyā gatisthityādikriyāyā āpattiḥ, bhavati bhavanaṃ vā dravyam iti bhavyārthatvāt prakṛtipratyayārthavyutpatterdravyakriyayoḥ siddhiḥ kartṛbhāvanānātvāt
yat punaretaduktam aviśiṣṭadeśasaṃyogā vā sthitiḥ iti tanna yuktaṃ vāśabdavarjyam, dvābhyāmavirodhāt
bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānādikālayogī bhāvaḥ, kartṛkarmādisādhanayogī bhāvaḥ iti lakṣaṇadvayamatra kriyāyā vivakṣitam
dravyasyāvasthāmātraṃ kriyā, nārthāntaram ityeṣa sāṅkhyamatānuvartino bhavataḥ parapratyayo manorathaḥ sa nopapadyate, sarvatra dravyakriyātmakabhāvāpattibhāvāduktavat

athāpi tvanmanorathamanuvṛtya dravyamātradarśanābhimukhībhūyāpi avasthāśabdaṃ śrūyamāṇamapi ujjhitvā yadyapi tvaduparyanukampādravīkṛtacetaso na kiścid brūmaḥ, tathāpi balādevopapattereva atyājyābhimatatattvadravyaśabdārthavaśāt, atyāgārhamabhimataṃ tattvaṃ tava sāṅkhyasya ca dravyamevārthaḥ, tadabhidhāyino dravyaśabdasya vaśāt tadarthavaśācca punarapi sāraṃ sāraṃ dravyādarthāntarabhūtāyā gatisthityādikriyāyā āpattiḥ, sā kriyāpannā, kasmāt ? bhavati bhavanaṃ vā dravyamiti bhavyārthatvāt, dravyaṃ ca bhavye pā॰ 5
104, bhavyaśabdaśca kartari bhāve vāstu, tathā dravyaśabdo'pi
tatra dravyaśabdasya bhavyārthatvāt prakṛtipratyayārthavyutpattiravaśyambhāvinī, tataśca prakṛtipratyayārthavyutpatterdravyakriyayoḥ siddhiḥ, prakṛtyarthasya kriyātvāt pratyayārthasya dravyatvāt

kathaṃ vyutpattiriti cet, ucyate--sādhyasādhanabhedāt, yad bhūyate sā kriyā, yad bhavati tad dravyam, yat tad bhavatā vastunā bhūyate sa prakṛtyartho bhāvaḥ, yat tad bhavati tat kartṛ, tasmāt kartṛbhāvanānātvād dravyakriyānānātvāt syāt, nānyathā
tasmād nayotthānaprakṛtād dravyaśabdārthavaśād bhavyabhavatyādiśabdavaśācca balādeva dvitvasiddhiriti sādhūktam
yat punaretaduktam aviśiṣṭadeśasaṃyogā vā sthitiḥ iti lakṣaṇaṃ tanna yuktaṃ vāśabdavarjyam, tatrāpi vāśabdasyānarthakyaṃ vikalpārthāsambhavāt

kasmāt punastadayuktam ? dvābhyāma yadapi ca dvitīyaṃ viśeṣagrahaṇaprayojanamabhidhīyate--sarvadā sarvabhāvānāṃ pravṛttisamanvayād devadattaḥ ityapi nāpravṛttikaṃ vastu, sarvabhedasambandhānuguṇyāttu nāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ tasmānna kriyā ityevamarthaṃ viśeṣagrahaṇam

yathā tatra pravṛttisāmānyanivṛttyarthe viśeṣagrahaṇe tathehāpi devadattādidhātutvanivṛttyarthe virodhāt, kriyā dravyādarthāntaram ityanena darśanenāvirodhāt, uktivastukriyālakṣaṇena dravyakriyāśrayeṇa ca prāguktena ca nyāyena cāvirodhāditi

yadapi ca dvitīyaṃ viśeṣagrahaṇaprayojanamabhidhīyate--sarvadā sarvabhāvānāṃ pravṛttisamanvayād devadattaḥ ityapi nāpravṛttikaṃ vastu, sarvabhedasambandhānuguṇyāttu nāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ tasmānna kriyā ityevamarthaṃ viśeṣagrahaṇam
yathā tatra pravṛttisāmānyanivṛttyarthe viśeṣagrahaṇe tathehāpi devadattādidhātutvanivṛttyarthe

evaṃ tāvat pravṛttisāmānyakriyātvanivṛttyarthaviśeṣagrahaṇaprayojane doṣābhidhānaṃ kṛtam, adhunedamapi viśeṣagrahaṇaprayojanaṃ dūṣyate --yadapi ca dvitīyaṃ viśeṣagrahaṇaprayojanamabhidhīyate sarvadetyādi

kutaḥ ? pravṛttisamanvayāddhetoḥ devadatta ityapi nāpravṛttikaṃ nākriyaṃ vastu tena śabdenābhidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? sapravṛttikamevocyate, yathā pacatyādīnāṃ kriyāvacanatvamevaṃ devadattādīnāṃ dravyavācitvābhimatānāmapi vācyasyārthasya pravṛttyā sattayā gatyādisarvabhavanātmikayā samanvitatvam
tataḥ pacatyādivad devadattādayo'pi śabdāḥ kriyāvacanāḥ, tasmāt kriyāvacano dhātuḥ pā॰ vā॰ 1
1 iti dhātusaṃjñāste'pi syuḥ, viśeṣagrahaṇasāmarththāt punarviśeṣo na bhavatīti nivartyate

kasmāt punardevadattādayo viśeṣā na bhavantītyucyate --sarvabhedasambandhānuguṇyāt tu nāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ, sarvairhasipaṭhigamyādibhirbhedairdevadattabhavanapravṛtteḥ sambandhenānuguṇatvāt pravṛttisāmānyamevedaṃ bhavanavat satyapi bhavadbhavanabhāvaviśeṣe tuśabdasya viśeṣārthatvāt

tasmād na kriyeti devadattāderakriyātvamupasaṃharati itiśabdasya samāptyarthatvāt, evamarthaṃ viśeṣagrahaṇamiti prakṛtopasaṃhāraḥ, pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā na pravṛttisāmānyamiti na bhavanamātraṃ nāpi devadatta ityupasaṃhārārthaḥ
asyāpi viśeṣagrahaṇasya sadoṣatvamucyate --idamapi tyaktadravyārthotthānam, idaṃ hi viśeṣagrahaṇaprayojanavyākhyānamutthāna eva dravyārthatyāgaṃ kurute
