sarvadā sarvabhāvānāṃ pravṛttisamanvayāt iti hetuvacanena devadatta iti nāpravṛttikam iti nāmavācyārthasvarūpavacanena ca pravṛttimātramevedaṃ na dravyaṃ nāmeti dravyārthasya prāgabhyupagatasya tyāgaḥ kṛto bhavati anenāpi viśeṣagrahaṇaprayojanavacanena dvitīyeneti
na kevalaṃ dravyārthatyāga eva doṣaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? prāgvyākhyātaviśeṣagrahaṇaprayojanatulyadoṣānubandhaṃ cedam
kathamiti cet, ucyate --yathā tatretyādi grantha upasaṃhṛte doṣāsaktyā codyameva uttaratvena samarthayati

bhāṣyakāreṇa kārakavatyāḥ phaloddeśinyāḥ kriyātvaṃ pratipādya upasaṃhṛtaṃ tasmāt pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā, na pravṛttisāmānyamiti, tatra doṣa āsajyate--yadi pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā pravartate, īhate, ceṣṭate ityādīnāṃ dhātusaṃjñā na prāpnoti, kriyāvacanānāmeva dhātutvāt teṣāṃ cākriyātvāt pravṛttiviśeṣakriyātvādityeṣa doṣo yathā tatra pravṛttisāmānyanivṛttyarthe viśeṣagrahaṇe tathehāpi devadattādidhātutvanivṛttyarthe viśeṣagrahaṇe vṛtādīnāṃ dhātusaṃjñā naiva prāpnoti akriyāvacanatvād devadattavat, asvaśabdopādānasādhyabhāvādilakṣaṇavacanaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt
yathā ca tatrocyate— naiṣa doṣaḥ, viśeṣa iti bhavataḥ kva sampratyayaḥ ? ya upādīyamāno'nyaṃ nivartayati
yadyevaṃ vṛtādayo'pyupādīyamānā viśeṣān nivartayanti, tathā coktam--sāmānyamapi yathā viśeṣastadvat pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
evamihāpi pratyu- viśeṣagrahaṇe vṛtādīnāṃ dhātusaṃjñā naiva prāpnoti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? akriyāvacanatvād devadattavat, tadarthasyākriyātvādakriyāvacanatvam, tadarthasyākriyātvaṃ sarvabhedasambandhānuguṇyāt
sa vā devadattaḥ kriyā syāt sarvabhedasambandhānuguṇatvāt vṛtādivat, aniṣṭaṃ caitaditi
kiñcānyat, pravṛttisāmānyanivṛttyarthe devadattādidravyanivṛttyarthe ca viśeṣagrahaṇe dvidhāpi asvaśabdopādānasādhyabhāvādilakṣaṇavacanaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt

yaduktam asvaśabdopādānasādhyabhāvo bhāvaḥ iti bhāvalakṣaṇam, bhāvādigrahaṇāt svaśabdopādānasiddhabhāvaṃ sattvam iti dravyalakṣaṇamuktita eva pṛthagiti, vastuto'pi liṅgasaṅkhyādimadaliṅgasaṅkhyatvaṃ ca dvayoḥ pṛthaktvaṃ tathā trikālātrikālaviṣayatvaṃ bhūtābhūtabheda ityādi pṛthaktvalakṣaṇavacanamanarthakaṃ dvayorapi kriyātvāditi
viśeṣagrahaṇe vṛtādīnāṃ dhātusaṃjñā naiva prāpnoti akriyāvacanatvād devadattavat, asvaśabdopādānasādhyabhāvādilakṣaṇavacanaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt
yathā ca tatrocyate— naiṣa doṣaḥ, viśeṣa iti bhavataḥ kva sampratyayaḥ ? ya upādīyamāno'nyaṃ nivartayati
yadyevaṃ vṛtādayo'pyupādīyamānā viśeṣān nivartayanti, tathā coktam--sāmānyamapi yathā viśeṣastadvat pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
yathā ca tatrocyate naiṣa doṣa ityādi

evaṃ doṣe'bhihite syānmataṃ pravṛttisāmānyanivṛttyarthaviśeṣagrahaṇaprayojanadoṣaṃ pariharāmīti viśeṣa iti bhavataḥ kva sampratyaya iti praśnopakramaṃ doṣavādinaiva parihāramabhidhāpayiṣyataste, doṣavādī kila brūyāt --ya upādīyamāno'nyaṃ nivartayatīti
paro brūyāt --yadyevaṃ vṛtādayo'pyupādīyamānā viśeṣān nivartayantīti, tairhi gacchatyādayo viśeṣā nivartyante na gacchati na śete na bhuṅkte vartata eva asti bhavati vidyata eva kevalamiti
tasmādupādīyamānā gamanādīn viśeṣān nivartayanti vṛtādayaḥ, tiṣṭhatyādivat
tathā coktaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa --sāmānyamapi yathā viśeṣastadvaditi jñāpakamidam, iti vartatyādirviśeṣa eva upādīyamānatve viśeṣanivṛttihetutvāt tiṣṭhatyādinivṛttihetugacchatyādivat
tataścaiṣāṃ siddhā dhātusaṃjñā vṛtādīnāmiti yathaiṣa sāmānyapravṛttinivṛttyarthe viśeṣagrahaṇe parihāra evamihāpi pratyucyeta dravyanivṛttyarthe'pi viśeṣagrahaṇe parihāra ucyeta pratyucyeta

sarvadā sarvabhāvānāṃ pravṛttisamanvayād devadattaḥ ityapi nāpravṛttikaṃ vastu, tasmāt tannivṛttyarthaṃ sarvabhedasambandhānuguṇyāt tu nāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ ityetadarthe'pi viśeṣagrahaṇe devadattasya kriyātvaṃ syāt, vṛtādīnāṃ tadvadakriyatvādvā dhātusaṃjñā mā bhūt, svaśabdopādānasiddhatādivacanānarthakyaṃ cetyādidoṣāpādane kṛte sa eva parihāra ucyate tvayā --viśeṣa iti bhavataḥ kva sampratyayaḥ ? ityādi yāvat siddhā dhātusaṃjñā
atra ceti doṣā॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
evaṃ cocyamāne nanvasmaddhṛdaya eva dṛṣṭam, nanvasmābhirapyabhihitaṃ pravṛttireva pravṛttiviśeṣa iti
evaṃ devadattasya kriyātvaṃ syāt, anyanivartanapravṛttiviśeṣatvāt, pacādivṛtādivat
vṛtādayo'pyakriyāḥ, tacchabdānāmadhātusaṃjñā ca syāt, sarvabhedasambandhānuguṇaviśeṣatvāt, devadattavadeva
evaṃ ca kṛtvā pravṛttimātrasya pravṛttiviśeṣatvād viśeṣagrahaṇamanarthakamubhayorapi vyākhyāvikalpayoḥ
yat punarucyate na vayaṃ vastunyasahabhāvatāṃ nivṛttiṃ brūmaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? pacati...
pacati ityukte pacatiśabdaḥ kriyāntaranivṛttivijñānamādadhāti, ayaṃ ca dharmo vṛtādīnāmapyaviśiṣṭaḥ
evaṃ parihāradvaye'pi samānamuttaramidamucyate --evaṃ cocyamāne nanvasmaddhṛdaya eva dṛṣṭam
nanu ityanujñāpane, anujñātaṃ tvayaitad yadasmaddhṛdayakṣetra uptasya darśanabījasya tvadvacanasalilasekena phalamabhivyaktam

tadvivṛṇoti smārayan --nanvasmābhirapyabhihitaṃ pravṛttireva pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ iti, yaducyate vṛtādisāmānyamupādīyamānaṃ gamanādiviśeṣaṃ nivartayatīti tadyujyeta yadi vṛtādisāmānyavyatirekeṇa gamanādiviśeṣaḥ syāt, sa tu sāmānyameva ityuktam
tasmād na sāmānyaṃ viśeṣābhāvādupādīyamānaṃ viśeṣān nivartayitumarhati khapuṣpādiviśeṣāniva
tadupasaṃharati --evaṃ ca kṛtvā pravṛttimātrasyetyādi gatārthaṃ yāvadanarthakamubhayorapi vyākhyāvikalpayoriti
evaṃ tāvad viśeṣagrahaṇamanarthakam, na kevalamanarthakameva, kiṃ tarhi ? anarthārthamapītyata āha --na cāphalameva, aniṣṭakṛdapīti

tadaniṣṭakṛttvaṃ sādhanenaiva bhāvyate --evaṃ devadattasya kriyātvaṃ syāt, anyanivartanapravṛttiviśeṣatvāt pacādivṛtādivaditi, pravṛttiviśeṣatvamanyatvaṃ tannivartanaṃ ceti dravyādanyasya pravṛttisāmānyavyatiriktasyārthasyābhāvādevāyuktam, abhyupagamyāpi doṣaḥ--devadattaḥ kriyā syāt, anyanivartanatve sati viśeṣapravṛttitvāt, sa gacchatyādiviśeṣanivartano yajñadattādiviśeṣanivartanaśca sāmānyatvāt, upādīyamānatve sati anyanivartanatvāt pravṛttiviśeṣaśca
tataśca pacatyādivad vartatyādivacca kriyā, kriyātvāt tadvācinaḥ śabdasya dhātusaṃjñā, pūrvaprakrāntanyāyakrameṇa pacyādivad vṛtyādayaḥ, tadvad devadattādaya iti sarvaṃ kriyaivetyāpannam

pacādīnāṃ ca gamanādisarvadhātvartha- vyāpitvasya prāgupapāditatvāt siddhahetutvāt sādhīyaḥ sādhanamidamapi, caśabdasūcitatvādanantarodāhṛtadvividhakriyāvāciśabdaprakṛtatvācca sarvanāmaśabdatā ca syāt
yat punarityādi yāvadayaṃ ca dharmo vṛtādīnāmapyaviśiṣṭa iti

pacādiviśeṣanivartakatvād vṛtādayo dhātusaṃjñā bhavanti ityukte parasyāśaṅkā syāt naiva nivartayanti pacādīn vṛtādayaḥ, virodhābhāvaśca vṛtādyantarbhāvāt pacādīnām, ato viśeṣanivartakatvābhāvād na dhātusaṃjñā vṛtādayaḥ syuḥ ityā ayaṃ ca dharmo vṛtādīnāmapyaviśiṣṭaḥ

śaṅkya tatpratisamādhānaṃ punarucyate--na vayaṃ vastunyasahabhāvatāṃ nivṛttiṃ brūmaḥ, nivṛttiratrāsmābhirnārthadharmaprakalpitā vivakṣitā, kiṃ tarhi ? śabdadharmaprakalpitā vivakṣitā, arthagatā hi nivṛttirasahabhāvajanitā ghaṭapaṭādivadekatrāsambhavāt, śabdagatā tu vijñānapravṛttinivṛttimātrakṛtā sā, devadatte sannihitasattādravyatvagatisthitivṛttyavṛttyādisarvadharmasambandhinyapi gacchati devadattaḥ ityukte tiṣṭhati āste śete ityādikriyākalāpaṃ nivartya devadattaṃ gacchatiśabdo gamanenaiva sambandhayati tadviṣayaikavijñānādhānahetutvāt, na tathā vastuni nivṛttiḥ sambhavati satatasannihitasarvadharmātmakatvād devadattasya

tadudāharati --kiṃ tarhi ? pacatītyādi gatārtham, udāhṛtārthasaṃvādī dārṣṭāntiko'rthaḥ --ayaṃ ca dharmo vṛtādīnāmapyaviśiṣṭaḥ, vartate, īhate, ceṣṭate ityādayo'pi śabdāḥ kriyāntaranivṛttivijñānādhānadharmiṇo na vastugatān dharmān nivartayitumalam, śabdānāṃ buddhipravṛttinivṛttikriyāyāṃ prabhutvād vastupravṛttinivṛttyorapravṛttatvāditi

avasitaprayojanamidaṃ vacaḥ, tvayaiva bastupravṛtteḥ sarvapravṛttiviśeṣasahitāyā evābhyanujñātatvād bhāvitatvācca, sambhāvanaiva hi na, vastupravṛttiḥ sarvapravṛttiviśeṣātmiketyatītavicāreṣu vistareṇa caritārthametat

kathaṃ ? viśeṣavān vāgvyavahāro viśeṣāntarapravṛttinivṛttiviṣayo na vastunyatyantanirbhedātmake prabhavati iti bhāvayatā bhavataiva subhāṣitatvāt kimasmābhirvācyaṃ vṛtādīnāṃ pacādīnāṃ vā dhātusaṃjñā prāpnoti na prāpnotīti ? sarveṣāṃ dhātūnāmasmadabhimatapravṛttisāmānyakriyāvacanatvānativṛttervastuvyavahāre śabdavyavahāre veti na kiñcid na prasidhyati
tvayā tu punarasadarthaviṣayatvād bhrāntijñānaṃ śabdārthaviṣayaṃ vyavasthāpitaṃ vastvasaṃsparśādityalaṃ prasaṅgena

prakṛtamucyate --evamayaṃ sa ubhayanayo yo'sau mayā ādāvuddiṣṭo vidhiniyamātmaka ubhayanaya iti, vidhiśca niyamaśca sarvatra dravyaṃ kriyā ceti vidhiniyamam, dvandvaikavadbhāvāt, sa eṣa nirdiṣṭaḥ pratyakṣīkṛtaste
kasya punarayamārṣābhihitānāṃ nayānāṃ bheda ityatrocyate --naigamadeśatvād dravyārtho'yam, na paryāyārthaḥ
dravyaparyāyasaṅgṛhītānāṃ bahubhedānāṃ madhye dravyārthabhedeṣu naigama-saṅgraha-vyavahāreṣu yo naigamo'nekabhedastasyaikadeśo'yaṃ tadbheda ityarthaḥ
ekkekko ya satavidho satta ṇayasatā havaṃti te cevaṃ āvani॰ 226 iti vacanāt
ikkikko ya sayaviho satta nayasayā havaṃti emeva

dravyaśabdaḥ kiṃsādhano'trābhipreta iti cet, ucyate --dravyamapi bhāvasādhanam, yat tad drūyate kenāpi yo dravati gacchati satataṃ pravartate tasya yad dravaṇaṃ gamanaṃ satatapravṛttiḥ sa bhāvastad bhavanam, tatsādhano dravyaśabdaḥ, kartṛsādhanāvinābhāvibhāvasādhanavyākhyānasya sopapattikasya vistareṇa kṛtatvāt saiva dvyarthatā uktavat, dravyakriyātmakadvyarthatā parasparāvinābhāvinī karaṇādīnāṃ tadavyatiriktasvarūpatvāt sarvatra ghaṭapaṭādibījāṅkurādiṣu ca sarvaikātmyasya subhāvitatvāditi
vākyamākhyātaśabda iti, ākhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakavākyamekamiti vākyam,ākhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃvākyamekatiṅ pā॰ vā॰ 2
tadartha uktaḥ vākyārtha uktaḥ ubhayabhāk dravyakriyādvyātmakavastu bhajate vākyārtha iti vistareṇokto'nena vidhiniyamabhaṅgena naigamaikadeśadravyārthena
nayavinirgamasūtram--atthittaṃ atthitte pariṇamatīti, astitvaṃ bhāvo bhāve'stitve pariṇamati
bhāvo bhāva eva satataṃ vartate paritaḥ samantād namati pariṇamati taṃ taṃ bhāvamāpadyate sadā kartṛsahita eva
tā yadi bhāvasya tato dravyamanavasthamiti dravyaprabhedāsambhavaḥ
bhāva eva tu sa tathābhūta āpadyate, tadbhedasya tadātmakatvāt, mṛdvat
pravṛttibhāvavacanāt tu pravṛttāveva vyatirekasambhavād bhāvādeva sarvasya kṛtatvād
evaṃ vidhiniyamabhaṅgāre dravyakriyātmakavāde saṃhṛte ṣaṣṭhanaya āha --nanvevamityādi vicārāśrayaṃ doṣāpādanasādhanam
ubhayamapi dravyaṃ kriyā ca ityavastu anupapannasvāvasthatvāt, anupapannāḥ svā avasthā asya, tadbhāvādanupapannasvāvasthatvāt khapuṣpavaditi
kāstāḥ svā avasthāḥ ? ucyate --svā avasthāḥ sthityutpattivināśāḥ

tāśca dravyasya vā syuḥ kriyāyā vā ? kiñcātaḥ ? tā yadi bhāvasya tāḥ sthityādayaḥ prāguktatathābhūtasannihitavastutvavyaktilakṣaṇāyāḥ kriyāyā iṣyante'vasthā iti tato dravyamanavasthaṃ prāptam, anavasthālakṣaṇatvādubhayoranyatarakalpanāvaiyarthyādavasthāvyatiriktalakṣaṇābhāvāt

bhavatu dravyamanavastham, ko doṣa iti cet, ucyate --dravyamanavasthamiti dravyaprabhedāsambhavaḥ prāptaḥ, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvādanavasthatvādityarthaḥ, dravyaprabhedā rūpādigatyādivivartāḥ, te na sambhavanti anavasthatvādasattvāt khapuṣpasyeva
tataśca yaduktaṃ dravyasya lakṣaṇaṃ tasya hāniḥ
katamasya iti cet, ucyate, sarvaprabhedanirbhedaṃ bījam ityasya

tataḥ kiṃ prāptam ? bhāva eva tu sa tathābhūta āpadyate, dravyabhūtā kriyaiva āpadyate, kasmāt ? tadbhedasya tadātmakatvāt, sthityutpattivināśā hi dravyabhedābhimatā dravyasyaivavyasya cedātmāno bhavanti, tata etadarthādāpannam--kriyāyā ātmeti, kriyaiva ca dravyaṃ saṃjñāmātrabhedāt
mṛdvaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā mṛdbhedāḥ piṇḍaśivakādayo mṛdātmakāḥ santo mṛdbhūtā eva tathā sthityādayo dravyabhūtabhāvabhedā eveti dravyābhāve'rthāpattyā sthityādayaḥ kriyāyā bhedā ityāpannāḥ
yadapi ca kalpitaṃ pravṛttisāmānyavyatirekeṇa kārakavatyā odanādiphaloddeśinyāḥ parigrahārthaṃ viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ tadapi na kāryam

kasmāt ? pravṛttibhāvavacanāt tu matpakṣe pravṛttāveva vyatirekasambhavaḥ, dravyabhāvatyāgād dvayavibhāgavacanaṃ vyartham, tataśca tathābhavanavinābhūtasannidhānamapi nirmūlam, sarvanirmūlatā caivam, avyaktirapi asannihitatvāt khapuṣpavat

athocyeta--sannihitatathābhūtavastutattvavyakti dravyameva sthityādisvāvasthamastu, evaṃ tarhi sarvaprabhedanirbhedatvamasatyaṃ dravyasya kriyāyāścākriyātvamavyañjakatvāt prāgeva tathābhūtavyaktivyarthatvāt
athaitaccedubhayaṃ necchati tato'vibhāgāvasthatvād dravyamavibhāgāvasthaṃ tadvya- pravṛttisāmānyameva bhāvaḥ ityuktatvād viśeṣāstatraiva sambhavanti
ato'sya vyatirekasambhavād yadapi odanādi phalaṃ tadapi pravṛttisāmānyameva
tasmād bhāvādeva kriyāyā eva sarvasyeṣṭasya kṛtatvād dravyaṃ bhāvaḥ ityetat tyaktam
tattyāgād dvayavibhāgavacanaṃ vyartham, dravyaṃ kriyā ca vastu ityubhayābhyupagamo mūlata eva vighaṭate
tataśca tathābhavanena pravṛttilakṣaṇena vinābhūtasya sannidhānamapi nirmūlam
tataśca yadi dve api dravyakriye vibhakte na staḥ tatastayorlakṣaṇamanupapannam, ataśca vibhāgena lakṣaṇābhāvāt tayorabhāvaḥ khapuṣpavat
tadabhāvāt kriyā kutaḥ tathābhavanakriyāsannidhilakṣaṇaṃ dravyaṃ pravṛttisāmānyaṃ vā kutaḥ tathābhavanavinābhūtatvāt khapuṣpavadeveti
sarvanirmūlatā caivamiti sannidhinirmūlatvāt kriyāyā avyaktirbhedānāmavyaktiśca tayā vinetyata āha --avyaktirapi asannihitatvāt khapuṣpavat
dravyabhāvatyāgād dvayavibhāgavacanaṃ vyartham, tataśca tathābhavanavinābhūtasannidhānamapi nirmūlam, sarvanirmūlatā caivam, avyaktirapi asannihitatvāt khapuṣpavat

athocyeta--sannihitatathābhūtavastutattvavyakti dravyameva sthityādisvāvasthamastu, evaṃ tarhi sarvaprabhedanirbhedatvamasatyaṃ dravyasya kriyāyāścākriyātvamavyañjakatvāt prāgeva tathābhūtavyaktivyarthatvāt

syānmatam--bhāvasya prāguktavat sthityutpattilayā akalpamānāḥ samanantaroktadoṣadarśanāt, sannihitatathābhūtavastutattvavyakti dravyameva uktavat sammūrcchitasarvaprabhedaṃ sthityādisvāvasthamastu, tāśca sthityādyavasthāḥ kriyayābhivyaktiṃ nīyanta iti
atrocyate --evaṃ tarhi sarvaprabhedanirbhedatvamasatyaṃ dravyasya, te hi sthityādibhedā dravyasyaiva saṃvṛttā iti nirbhedatvoktirvyāhanyate
kiñcānyat, kriyāyāścākriyātvam, sannihitatathābhūtavastutattvavyaktiḥ kriyeṣyate, te hi bhedāḥ kriyayābhivyajyante ced bhedāḥ prāgapi kriyābhivyakteḥ santi, tathābhūtatvāt kriyāyā vyaktikaratvābhāvaḥ
tasmāccāvyañjanāt kriyā dravyavat kharaviṣāṇavadvā na kriyeti
tataśca dravyasyādravyatvāt kriyāyāścākriyātvādaśeṣapakṣadhvaṃsitvam, anupapannasvāvasthatvād dravyasya kriyāyāśca khapuṣpavadabhāva iti

athaitaccedubhayaṃ dravyanirbhedāsattvādadravyaṃ sannihitatathābhūtavastuvyaktyabhāvādakriyātvaṃ ca necchati bhavān sarvavastutyāgabhayāt tato'vibhāgetyādi, avibhāgāvasthatvāt, vibhāgā bhedāḥ sthityādyavasthāḥ, tadabhāvād dravyamavibhāgamityasadāpannam, mā bhūd dravyasya bhedātmakasyādravyatvamiti kriyāyāścākriyātvamavyañjakatvāt prāgeva tathābhūtavyaktivyarthatvād mā bhūditi kimāpannam ? dravyamavibhāgāvastham
tadvya- ñjikā kriyā, tato yadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati yugapadayugapadbhāvipṛthivyādibhedāvibhāgadravyasvāvasthatvāt
astviti cet, tato'ṅkurotpattau tasyaiva vināśitvādanutpanno'vinaṣṭaśca sarva eveti svavacanādivirodhāḥ, tathā cāṅkurapatrādinirākaraṇādapi ca lokādivirodhāḥ
ñjikā kriyeti, kriyāyāścāvibhāgāvasthadravyaviṣayayathāsannidhivyaktikriyātvādavibhāgasyaiva sannihitasya vyañjikā hi kriyā
tataḥ kimiti cet, tato yadeva utpadyate tadeva vinaśyati, ūrddhvapattirutpattirātmalābhaḥ pratyakṣopalabdhiḥ, vividhamadarśanaṃ vināśo'nupalabdhirabhāvaḥ
ekarūpatvācca vastunastadabhivyañjanācca kriyāyā utpattivināśayorapyabhedād yadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati

yadā cāvibhāgāvasthaṃ dravyam kriyā ca tadvyañjikā ca tadāmī yugapadbhāvinaḥ pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśakālādibhedā rūparasagandhasparśasaṅkhyāsaṃsthānādibhedāśca ye cāyugapadbhāvino mṛtpiṇḍaśivakādibhedāste sarve'pyavibhāgāvasthāmātramityāpannāḥ

tasmāt sarvabhedānāmavibhāgāvasthāmātratvādutpattirvināśa ityapyayugapadbhāvinau bhedau tayośca avibhāgāvasthadravyatvam, tataścaikyam, ekatvācca yadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati iti sādhūktaṃ deśakālādibhedābhāvāt
ñjikā kriyā, tato yadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati yugapadayugapadbhāvipṛthivyādibhedāvibhāgadravyasvāvasthatvāt
astviti cet, tato'ṅkurotpattau tasyaiva vināśitvādanutpanno'vinaṣṭaśca sarva eveti svavacanādivirodhāḥ, tathā cāṅkurapatrādinirākaraṇādapi ca lokādivirodhāḥ
atra yathāśabdaprayogo'pi sādhureva bhāti, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 310-- 2

syānmatam--ekatvādutpattyādibhedaikyād yadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati ityastu, tarhi ko doṣa ityatra doṣakutūhalaṃ ced brūmaḥ--yadi bījāṅkurādyayugapadbhāvināmapi pṛthivyādiyugapadbhāvibhedamūlatvād yadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati tato'ṅkurotpattau tasyaiva vināśitvamiti doṣa udāharaṇena sphuṭīkriyate, yasmād bījocchūnamūlādipūrvabhedānāṃ patranālādyuttarabhedānāṃ ca vināśāvasthatvāt aṅkura evaikaḥ iti satyaṃ tato'ṅkurotpattāvaṅkura eva vinaśyati, tataśca dṛṣṭeṣṭaviruddhāvanutpattyavināśadoṣau syātām, aṅkurotpattau tasyaiva aṅkurasyaiva vināśitvād na bījaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ nāṅkura utpannaḥ, vinaṃṣṭurutpattuścābhedāt
bhede tu sati yujyeta bījaṃ vinaṣṭamaṅkura utpannaḥ iti
sa cotpannaśced na vinaṣṭaḥ, vinaṣṭaśced notpanna ityubhayāvyavasthānād notpanno na vinaṣṭa iti

astu nāmānutpanno'vinaṣṭaśca, kiṃnāmako mamāyaṃ doṣo nyāyalakṣaṇokta iti cet, ucyate--naika eva, kiṃ tarhi ? sarva eveti svavacanādivirodhāḥ, utpadyate ced na vinaśyati vinaśyati ced notpadyate, tvayā cocyate--yadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyatīti, deśakālādibhedābhāve kathamūrddhapadanavividhādarśanabhedena tadeva iti cābhedena nirdeśo viruddhārthaḥ ? ataḥ svavacanavirodhaḥ
utpadyamānaghaṭavadutpadyamānatvād na vinaśyati vinaśyattvācca notpadyate bhinnaghaṭavadityanumānavirodhaḥ

tathā cāṅkurapatrādinirākaraṇādapi ca lokādivirodhā iti vyākhyānamanantaroktasyārthasya kṣaṇikavādātiśayo'taḥ, tadyathā--tatra hi utpādādanyo vināśakṣaṇaḥ jātasya vināśāt, iha tu utpāda eva vināśaḥ prasaktaḥ kriyārthakālarahitadravyotpādāditvāt
nanu pṛthivīdravyatvābhede sta utpādavināśau tatkālau ca tadaṃśabījāṅkurabhedā- lokapratītidvāreṇa sukhapratipādyatvāditi gatārtham
vacanadvāreṇa tu prācyaṃ vākyam, uktyāśrayatvādeṣāṃ doṣāṇāmiti
kṣaṇikavādātiśayo'taḥ, tadyathā--tatra hi utpādādanyo vināśakṣaṇaḥ jātasya vināśāt, iha tu utpāda eva vināśaḥ prasaktaḥ kriyārthakālarahitadravyotpādāditvāt
nanu pṛthivīdravyatvābhede sta utpādavināśau tatkālau ca tadaṃśabījāṅkurabhedā-
na kevalameta eva doṣāḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? anityatādoṣaśca
sa ca kṣaṇikavādaṃ vātilaṅghya anityatvadoṣo'tiśayena vartata iti
ata ityasmādeva hetoḥ, kasmāt ? yadeva utpadyate tadeva vinaśyati ityabhyupagamāt

tatra hi kṣaṇikavāde na hi yadeva utpadyate tadeva vinaśyati, kiṃ tarhi ? kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇika ityutpādādanyo vināśakṣaṇaḥ utpatturvinaṃṣṭuścetyabhyupagamyate, bhinnasya kālasya kṣaṇākhyatvāt, tasmiṃśca kāle jātasya vināśād, na jāyamānasya
sa hi kṣaṇikavādī naikamevotpādakṣaṇaṃ vināśakṣaṇaṃ cecchati ekasyotpattibhaṅgāsaktibhayāt
kṣaṇānāṃ kṣaṇavartināṃ ca bhedāt jātasya iti ca nāśanaṃṣṭṛkṣaṇānāṃ ca bhedaṃ sūcayati

iha tu yadeva utpadyate tadeva vinaśyati iti vāde utpāde eva vināśaḥ prasaktaḥ kriyārthakālarahitadravyotpādāditvāt, kriyāśabdavācyo'rthaḥ kriyaiva vārthaḥ kriyāprayojano vā kālaḥ kriyārthakālaḥ, sa eva te vaiyākaraṇasyeṣṭaḥ, yadyapyanyeṣāmanyathā, yathoktam --pariṇāmavatī kriyaiva kālaḥ ityādi
tādṛgvidhakālarahitaṃ dravyaṃ kriyātmakakālavinābhūtaṃ tadeva utpādo vināśo'vasthānaṃ cetīṣṭatvāt kṣaṇikavādātiśāyī ayaṃ kṣaṇikavādastvadīya iti sādhūktam
nānityavāde'pi tiṣṭhati anavasthānādutpādādīnām, kiṃ tarhi ? śūnyavādatā vā, yathā prāguktaṃ sarvasyāṅkurānutpādāvināśavadanavasthānamapīti śūnyatāsādhanaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvat khapuṣpavaditi

syānmatam--pṛthivīdravyatvaṃ śivakādiṣvabhinnam, tasmiṃścābhinne tadutpādavināśayoścābhede satyeva pṛthivīdravyatvenānutpannāvinaṣṭatve satyaikye ca sta utpādavināśau tatkālau ca, tasyaiva pṛthivīdravyatvasya cāśābhyāṃ bījāṅkurākhyābhyāṃ bheda ityasti bhedaḥ kārakasadbhāvādityutpattirasti tathā vināśastatkālau ca, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvādevaṃ bhedasyā- bhedasya ca vyāghāto nāsti, tasmāt tadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati pṛthivīdravyatvābhedāt tadaṃśabījāṅkura diti bhedasyābhedasya cāvyāghātaḥ
evaṃ tarhi pṛthivītvajātimātramabhinnaṃ dravyaikatvavighātakam, bījasya aṅkurasya ca nānātvam
tataśca yathā bījamaṅkurāt pṛthageveṣyate tathā pāṃśvāditvamapi pārthivatvād bhinnameṣitavyamiti bhedanirbhedadravyanirmūlanam
api ca tvayaivāpāditaṃ bhedabahutvaṃ dravyaikatvavighāti, tatparihārārthamutthitena pārthivatvamapi nānaivotthāpitam
bhedakaṃ cābhedakādanyadabhedakaṃ ca bhedakāt, bhedakatvādabhedakatvāt, yathā dravyakriye
nanu ghaṭa utpadyamāna eva śivakatvena piṇḍatvena vinaśyati iti sa evotpadyate bhedāt tatkālau ca sta iti nānityaśūnyate doṣāviti
atrocyate --evaṃ tarhītyādi yāvad na tadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyatīti
ayamidānīmasmatparikalpito bheda evāpatitastavāpi aśmasikatāmṛlloṣṭavajrādibhede sati pṛthivī nāma na kadācidanyāsti tadvyatirekeṇa, kintu pṛthivītvajātimātramabhinnaṃ tadbhedavyāpi

tacca dravyamekam ityasya tvatpakṣasya vighātakaṃ jātimātramabhinnaṃ śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ bhinnamiti sidhyati, bījasya aṅkurasya ca nānātvam, bījād vinaśyato'nyo'ṅkura utpadyamānatvāt, vinaṃṣṭurmṛtādanya iva devadatto yajñadattādutpadyamāna iti
tasmād na tadeva utpadyate tadeva vinaśyati, anyanivṛttyarthāvadhāraṇasya bhedasatyatve sati ānarthakyāt

yathā aṅkurādikāleṣu bhinneṣvapi vrīhitvasāmānyābhede sati pṛthageva bījamaṅkurādiṣyate mā bhūt pūrvokto'nutpādādidoṣa iti tvayā tathā pāṃśvāditvamapi pāṃśumṛtpiṇḍāditvamapi pārthivatvād bhinnameṣitavyam
tataḥ kimiti cet, brūmaḥ --iti bhedanirbhedadravyanirmūlanam, ityasmāt pāṃśvāditvabhedābhyupagamāt sarvaprabhedanirbhedaṃ dravyaṃ na bhavati
evaṃ tarhi pṛthivītvajātimātramabhinnaṃ dravyaikatvavighātakam, bījasya aṅkurasya ca nānātvam
tataśca yathā bījamaṅkurāt pṛthageveṣyate tathā pāṃśvāditvamapi pārthivatvād bhinnameṣitavyamiti bhedanirbhedadravyanirmūlanam
api ca tvayaivāpāditaṃ bhedabahutvaṃ dravyaikatvavighāti, tatparihārārthamutthitena pārthivatvamapi nānaivotthāpitam
bhedakaṃ cābhedakādanyadabhedakaṃ ca bhedakāt, bhedakatvādabhedakatvāt, yathā dravyakriye
nanu ghaṭa utpadyamāna eva śivakatvena piṇḍatvena vinaśyati iti sa evotpadyate
katamena vacanena iti cet, pārthivatvādekatvamutpatturvinaṃṣṭuśca netaradravyāṃśābhyāṃ bījāṅkurābhyām, tābhyāṃ cānekatvam ityanena vacanenāpāditam
katham ? yaccodito'si bījāṅkuranānātvaṃ kṣaṇikātiśayaḥ śūnyavāditā ca bhavataḥ iti tatparihārārthamutthitena nanu pṛthivīdravyatvābheda ityādinā vacanena pārthivatvamapi nānaivotthāpitam

kathamiti taducyate--abhedakaṃ pārthivatvam, bījādi bhedakam, bhedakaṃ cābhedakādanyat abhedakaṃ ca bhedakāt, bhedakatvāditi svabhāvabhedaṃ hetutvenāha, itaśca asmādanyadabhedakatvāditi, ubhayordṛṣṭānto dravyakriye, yathā dravyāt sarvabhedanirbhedādanyā tathābhūtavastutvavyaktilakṣaṇā kriyā kriyātaśca dravyam, tathā ca pārthivatvamabhedakatvād bījāderbhedakād bhinnasvabhāvaṃ tadvad bhedakatvāt nānā syāt kriyāyā iva dravyamiti
āha --nanu ghaṭa utpadyamāna ityādi yāvad ghaṭatvenotpadyata iti
yat tvayoktaṃ yadeva utpadyate sa eva vinaśyati, tathā ghaṭatvena vinaśyan ghaṭatvenotpadyate śivakatveneva vinaśyaṃśchatrakatvena
ayamaparihāra uktottaratvāt, śivakenaivotpattau śivakenaiva vinaṃṣṭavyaṃ tato'bhinnatvāt ghaṭotpādavat
evaṃ tvanutpattau vināśasyāpyabhāvād ghaṭādibhavanābhāvaḥ, bhavanasambandhavyatikramābhāvāt sarvamabhūtaṃ nāstītyevamādyāpadyate

athocyeta--aikya eva mṛtkumbhāvasthayoḥ mṛddravyasyaiva bhavanasya tathāniyatā tadeva vinaśyati tatrānutpattyavināśasvavacanavirodhādikṣaṇikavādātiśayaśūnyatādoṣā na sambhavanti pratyakṣavacanādīnāṃ tathātvāt, yasmād ghaṭa utpadyamāna eva śivakatvenotpadyamānaḥ piṇḍatvena vinaśyati pūrvottarakālayorapi saddravyapṛthivīmṛttvābhedavad ghaṭābhedāt piṇḍāvasthāyāṃ śivakādyavasthāyāṃ mṛdādiyāvatparamāṇvavasthāyāṃ kapālādiyāvatparamāṇvavasthāyāṃ ca ghaṭa eva iti sa evotpadyate sa eva vinaśyati, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt uktahetvarthatvāt tasmād ghaṭa eva piṇḍatvenotpadyamānaḥ śivakatvena vinaśyatiṃ, tasmād nānutpattyādidoṣāḥ

yathā ca piṇḍatvenotpadyamānaḥ śivakatvena ghaṭa eva vinaśyati tathā punarghaṭatvena vinaśyan ghaṭatvenotpadyate, kimiva ? śivakatveneva vinaśyaṃśchatrakatvena, yathā śivakatvānantaraṃ chatrakatvaṃ jāyamānaṃ tadotpannaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ ca tathā deśāntarabhāvāntarāntaritaghaṭavināśaghaṭasambhavayorapi abhedo vastutvādibhyaḥ piṇḍaśivakatvavaditi
sa eva vinaśyati, tathā ghaṭatvena vinaśyan ghaṭatvenotpadyate śivakatveneva vinaśyaṃśchatrakatvena
ayamaparihāra uktottaratvāt, śivakenaivotpattau śivakenaiva vinaṃṣṭavyaṃ tato'bhinnatvāt ghaṭotpādavat
evaṃ tvanutpattau vināśasyāpyabhāvād ghaṭādibhavanābhāvaḥ, bhavanasambandhavyatikramābhāvāt sarvamabhūtaṃ nāstītyevamādyāpadyate
atra pratiṣu ghaṭatvenotpadyate iti pāṭhaḥ pratīkatvena ṭīkāyāmupalabhyate, agre tu yadyapi ghaṭatvena vinaśyan paṭatvenotpadyate...
...deśāntarabhāvāntarāntaritaghaṭavināśapaṭasambhavayorapi iti pāṭha upalabhyate tathāpi tatra paṭaśabdasthāne ghaṭaśabda evocita iti bhāti
yadi tu nedaṃ rocate tarhi atrāpi paṭatvenotpadyate iti agre'pi ca ghaṭatvena vinaśyan paṭatvenotpadyate...
athocyeta--aikya eva mṛtkumbhāvasthayoḥ mṛddravyasyaiva bhavanasya tathāniyatā

atrocyate --ayamaparihāra uktottaratvāt, nanvatroktameva prāgaṅkurasyaiva vināśitvādidoṣajātam, tasya piṇḍaśivakasaṃjñāmātrapṛthakkṛtāduktimātrabhedād na parihāro bhavati, yasmādarthato yadeva śivakotpattau śivakenaiva vināśaḥ iti tadeva aṅkurotpattāvaṅkureṇaiva vināśaḥ ityuktam
tato'yaṃ te doṣo balādāpātyate — śivakenaivotpattau śivakenaiva vinaṃṣṭavyamiti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tato'bhinnatvāt, yato yadabhinnaṃ tadutpattau tenaiva vinaṃṣṭavyam, yathā tvaduktānantaraghaṭotpādavaditi

evaṃ cedutpattirneṣyate tasyaivāvasthitasya ghaṭasya naivotpattirasti atyantaṃ ghaṭākhyād bhāvādanyatvāt khapuṣpavat, anutpannasya ca vināśābhāvaḥ khapuṣpavadeva, vināśasyāpyabhāvād ghaṭādibhavanābhāvaḥ, apiśabdādutpatterapyabhāvād ghaṭādīnāmutpattivināśaśūnyatvād bhavanābhāvaḥ astitvābhāvaḥ, utpattivināśau hi bhavanasambandhaḥ, tadvyatikramasya cābhāvāt sarvamabhūtaṃ nāstītyevamādi āpadyate
yathā satyevaikye mṛtkumbhāvasthayoḥ sarvasarvātma eva bhavanabhāgā abhivyajyante tāṃśca bhāvo'pi tathābhivyanakti tathā utpattisthitivināśā abhinnasyaivāvasthāḥ syuḥ

nanvasmābhirapīdamuktam--ananyatvād dravyasvāvasthātve sati avirodhāt pūrvottarābhāvādabhibhavaikyānāpatteravidyamānapārthakyāt kasyacid vyaktyavyaktī nopapadyete, kuta utpādādiḥ ? api ca lokapratītavyaktidharmaviparītatvādutpādādyabhāvaḥ, kriyāsvāvasthā- katvād bhinnayorapyabhedaḥ tathā bījāṅkurādibheda ityabhiprāyaḥ

yathā mṛdaḥ kumbhāvasthā yugapadbhāvināṃ rūparasādīnāmayugapadbhāvināṃ ca śivakādīnāṃ niyatāni bhavanāni, mṛddravyasyaiva kartṛbhavanasya rūpādiśivakāditvena tena prakāreṇa niyatā eva bhavanabhāgā māyākārakapatākikāvad nāniyatābhivyaktayo'bhivyajyante prathamabhavanaśabdasya kartṛbhavanārthatvāt
tāṃśca bhavanabhāgān kriyāpi tathābhivyanakti nānyathā, bhāvaśabdasya dvitīyasya kriyāvācitvāt
yadi bhinnasya mṛtkumbhādyayugapadavasthā rūpādipṛthivyādiyugapadavasthā vā syuḥ tāstasya mṛddravyasyaiva na syuḥ, kasmāt ? anyatareṇāvaruddhāvakāśatvād ghaṭapaṭādivat
eva bhavanabhāgā abhivyajyante tāṃśca bhāvo'pi tathābhivyanakti tathā utpattisthitivināśā abhinnasyaivāvasthāḥ syuḥ
nanvasmābhirapīdamuktam--ananyatvād dravyasvāvasthātve sati avirodhāt pūrvottarābhāvādabhibhavaikyānāpatteravidyamānapārthakyāt kasyacid vyaktyavyaktī nopapadyete, kuta utpādādiḥ ?
nanvasmābhiste eva nopapadyete ityuktaṃ vyaktyavyaktī ityabhisambadhyate tathāniyatabhavanabhāgadravyāvasthāyā vyañjanamavyañjanaṃ veti

taccānanyad dravyameva, tasya ca sthityutpattivināśā ananye, kiṃ kāraṇam ? tvayābhyupagatānāṃ sthityādīnāṃ dravyasvāvasthātvāt, dravyasyaiva svāvasthāḥ sthityādayaḥ parasparato'nanyāḥ iti hi samāśritastvayāyaṃ pakṣaḥ, parasparabhinnasthityādīnāṃ dravyasvāvasthātve sarvapakṣārthadhvaṃsitvabhayāt
tasmād dravyasvāvasthātvādavirodhaḥ sthityādīnām, na yathā svapnajāgaraṇayorvirodhaḥ
ananyatvācca pūrvamidam, uttaramidam iti kramābhāvaḥ, tataḥ pūrvottarābhāvāt kaḥ kenābhibhūto yenaikyamāpadyeran sthityādayaḥ yata etat syāt iyamanayā kriyayābhivyajyate'vasthā neyam iti ca
kasmāt ? avidyamānapārthakyāt, pṛthaksiddhānāṃ hi aikyāpattiḥ syāt sati avirodhe tantupaṭatvavat
tasmādabhibhavaikyānāpatteḥ pūrvottarābhāvāt dravyasvāvasthātve sati avirodhādananyatvāt kasyacid vyaktyavyaktī nopapadyete

loke hi pūrvavṛttivyatirikto vyañjakaḥ prasiddho'nyaḥ udakāñjanadīpādiyogo bhūgandhacakṣurindriyaśaktyabhivyaktighaṭādidarśanaheturyathāsaṅkhyam, yujikriyāsādhanabhūyogi ca dravyabhedaniṣedhād dravyamātrābhyupagamād vyaktidharmatyāgād vyaktikāraṇābhāvāt
ahetuto vā vyaktāvavyakterapi tadvatteti nityameva vyaktiravyaktirvā sarvasya syāt

bhūdakādidravyajātamupalabhyate yathā na tu tathā taddravyavyatiriktam, yadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati iti dravyaṃ ca svāvasthā'vibhāgaṃ bruvatā tvayā na tato'nyaḥ saṃyogaḥ saṃyogī vābhyupagamyate dravyakriyāpṛthagbhūtaḥ dravyasvāvasthāmātratvādutpādādīnām

kiṃ kāraṇam ? kriyāsvāvasthādravyabhedaniṣedhāt, utpādādayaḥ kriyāyāḥ svāvasthāḥ ityetaṃ pakṣaṃ dravyasyāpi parasparabhinnāḥ santyo'vasthāḥ ityetaṃ ca pakṣaṃ yasmād niṣiddhavanto vayaṃ dravyanirmūlatvādidoṣāt
ahetuto vā vyaktāvavyakterapi tadvatteti nityameva vyaktiravyaktirvā sarvasya syāt
etaccāyuktam, ahetuto vā vyaktau avyakterapi tadvatteti, tena tulyaṃ tadvat, tadbhāvastadvattā, vyaktivadbhāva ityarthaḥ

tataḥ kimiti cet, ucyate --iti nityameva vyaktiravyaktirvā sarvasya syāt nirhetukatvāt mṛdavasthāyāṃ ghaṭāvyaktivad ghaṭāvasthāyāmavyaktirghaṭasya syāt, ghaṭāvasthāyāṃ ghaṭavyaktivad mṛdavasthāyāṃ vyaktiḥ syāt, mṛtpiṇḍe ghaṭavyaktivad gagane'pi syāt, viyatyavyaktivad mṛdyapyavyaktirvā syādityādi
iti haribhadrasūriviracite śāstravārtāsamuccaye samuccitāyāṃ kārikāyāṃ pāṭhaḥ

syānmatam--yathā tvayoktaṃ na tathā bhavitumarhati pariṇāmābhyupagamāt, avasthitasya dravyasya dharmāntaranivṛttau dharmāntarāpattiḥ pariṇāmaḥ, tasmād mṛtpiṇḍaśivakādipariṇāmaiḥ sthityutpattivināśā bhaviṣyanti, na nirhetukāḥ
tasmādeva pariṇāmād vyaktyavyaktī ca sta iti

ya ete'smābhirbhāvasvāvasthātvapakṣe dravyasvāvasthātvapakṣe ca bhinnābhinnātmakadvaidhe doṣā uktāste tulyā eva pariṇāmapakṣe'pi draṣṭavyāḥ pariṇāmāvasthayoḥ śrutimātrabhedāt, utpattiprādurbhāvatvāt vināśanivṛttitvāt avasthitasya iti ca svaśabdenaiva sthitivacanāt
pariṇāmoccāraṇena ca nanvevamubhayamapi avastu ityādirādito grantho yojyo yāvadayamevāvadhiriti
tulanā--atha ko'yaṃ pariṇāmaḥ ? avasthitasya dravyasya pūrvadharmanivṛttau dharmāntarotpattiḥ pariṇāmaḥ
atha vināśasāmānādhikaraṇye doṣadarśanāt tadevotpadyate tadevāvatiṣṭhate, atrāpi tathā vā sarvathā vā avatiṣṭhamāne utpattiḥ kutaḥ, utpadyamāne vāvasthānam ? iti svavacanādivirodhāḥ pūrvavat

evaṃ tāvadutpādavināśayoḥ saṃyogenāyaṃ vikalpaḥ saprasaṅgaparihārapracarco'bhihitaḥ tathā vakṣyamāṇeṣūtpādasthitisaṃyoge sthityutpādasaṃyoge sthitivināśasaṃyoge vināśotpādasaṃyoge vināśasthitisaṃyoge trikādisaṃyogeṣu ca samānaḥ pracarco draṣṭavyaḥ yadeva utpadyate tadeva vinaśyati ityataḥ prabhṛti yāvadayamavadhiriti, granthayojanayā yojayiṣyate
samānapracarco draṣṭavyaḥ ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt, samānapracarco vikalpaḥ ityāśayaḥ
utpādavināśaikādhikaraṇye doṣadarśanād nirdoṣoya'miti vikalpāntaramāśrīyate --tadeva utpadyate tadevāvatiṣṭhata iti

atrāpi na nirdoṣameveti brūmaḥ, atrāpi hi dvayī gatiḥ tenāpi utpattiprakāreṇāvatiṣṭhamāne yadvā utpādenaivāvatiṣṭhamānaṃ tadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati ceti yadvā sthityutpattivināśaprakāraiḥ sarvathāvatiṣṭhamānaṃ tadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati ca ityucyate ? yadi tathotpādenaiva avatiṣṭhamānamutpadyate vinaśyatītyucyate tata utpādenaivāvasthitatvāt kimiti punarutpadyate ? atha sarvathāpyavatiṣṭhamānamutpadyata iti ucyeta tatastryātmakaṃ sat kathamutpadyate ? utpattirūpasya cāvasthitatvād notpadyata iti utpattirdvidhāpi kuta iti, asambhava ityarthaḥ

yadyutpadyate kathamavatiṣṭhate ? yadyavatiṣṭhate kathamutpadyate ? iti svavacanavirodhaḥ pūrvavaditi, yathāṅkurotpattivināśaikādhikaraṇyodāharaṇe svavacanādivirodhāstathātrāpyutpattisthitisāmānādhikaraṇye yojyā iti
syānmatam--yathā svatattvānumatāṃśutantuvattu, vyāpnotīti vyāpī, aviśeṣitatvāt sarvasya vyāpyasya kāryasya vyāpakaṃ kāraṇamucyate vyāpīti
vyāpinaḥ svatattvameva ityanumatoṃ'śustvayāpi dravyārthavādāśrayiṇā, vyāpi svatattvamasyeti vā vigrahaḥ, sa ca vyāpisvatattvānumatoṃ'śureva tanturvyāpyaḥ, kāraṇamayatvāt kāryasya
kimuktaṃ bhavati ? yathāṃśumayastanturatoṃ'śureva tanturiti dṛṣṭāntaḥ aṃśurapi tantustanturapyaṃśuriti vā, tathā bījamayo'ṅkuro bījamevāṅkuraḥ aṅkuro'pi bījaṃ bījamapyaṅkura iti vā dārṣṭāntikaḥ

tad varṇayati --pradīrghadravyetyādi, prakṛṣṭadīrghatvasya drāghīyaso dravyasya mervāderiva pūrvottaratayā sthityutpattivināśāvasthā vyāpisvatattvānumatabījāṅkuratvādaya iti, asmin prakalpe tadevotpadyate tadevā iti prakalpe bījasyāṃśūnāṃ vā anutpādyavināśitvād nityatvādaṅkuratantvanupapattireveti ta eva virodhāḥ pūrvastambanityatvādvā bījānupapatteḥ
stambottarabījotpattestu aṅkuravat sthitibhinnotpattitvāt sarvasya dravyātmano'nityatā'vyāpitā ca pūrvādyabhāva eva vā'bhedatvāt
athocyeta--yaduktaṃ bhavati yadevotpadyate tadevāvatiṣṭhata iti taduktaṃ bhavati utpattirūpamevāvasthānamiti khapuṣpavailakṣaṇyenaivamevocyate
evaṃ sati yadevotpadyate vatiṣṭhate ityutpattisthitisāmānādhikaraṇye svavacanādivirodhā na santi, tasya vastuno'vasthāmātrabhinnasyānutpannāvināśinaḥ sthitasyaivotpādāditi

atrocyate--etasminnapi prakalpe bījasya dārṣṭāntikasya aṃśūnāṃ vā dṛṣṭāntabhūtānāṃ vāśabdādanyasya vā kasyacid vastunaḥ pradīrghasya anutpāditvādavināśitvācca nityatvam, nityatvāt sthitireva notpādavināśāviti kuto'ṅkuro bījāt ? kutoṃ'śubhyastantuḥ ? ato'ṅkuratantvanupapattireveti
tataḥ kimiti cet, iti ta eva virodhāḥ, utpattyabhāvāt pūrvavat svavacanādivirodhāstadavasthā eveti

pūrvastambanityatvādvā bījānupapatteḥ ta eva virodhāḥ iti vartate, nanu tvaduktenaiva nyāyena vyāpisvatattvānumatapūrvastambabījatvaṃ pradīrghadravyasthitatvaṃ ceti pūrvastambasyānutpādyavināśitvād nityatvam, nityatvād bījānupapattiḥ, ato'pi tadeva utpadyate tadevāvatiṣṭhate iti svavacanādivirodhā iti dūṣaṇaṃ nyāyasya vyāpitāṃ darśayati
iti prakalpe bījasyāṃśūnāṃ vā anutpādyavināśitvād nityatvādaṅkuratantvanupapattireveti ta eva virodhāḥ pūrvastambanityatvādvā bījānupapatteḥ
stambottarabījotpattestu aṅkuravat sthitibhinnotpattitvāt sarvasya dravyātmano'nityatā'vyāpitā ca pūrvādyabhāva eva vā'bhedatvāt
athocyeta--yaduktaṃ bhavati yadevotpadyate tadevāvatiṣṭhata iti taduktaṃ bhavati utpattirūpamevāvasthānamiti khapuṣpavailakṣaṇyenaivamevocyate
atha mā bhūvannete doṣā iti stambāduttarakālaṃ bījotpattiriṣyate tataḥ stambottarabījotpattestu hetoḥ aṅkuravadityādi
yathāṅkuro bījādutpadyamānaḥ sthitādanya utpadyate pūrvadoṣabhayāt pūrvastambācca bījaṃ tathā sarvamapi sthitibhinnotpatti, tasmāt sthitibhinnotpattitvāt sarvasya dravyātmano'nityatā'vyāpitā ca
yathāṅkuro bījādisthitādutpanno'nityo'vyāpī ca tathā tvadabhyupagatapradīrghadravyātmano'pyanityatvamavyāpitvaṃ ca syāt tathaiva

kiñcānyat, evaṃ pūrvādyabhāva eva vā'bhedatvāt, pūrvamidaṃ bījādi, uttaramidamaṅkurādi ityetasya vā'bhāvaḥ, kasmāt ? abhedatvāt, abhinnaṃ hi tadvastu dravyaṃ na kriyā, vyāpisvatattvabījāṅkurādiprādurbhāvasya kriyāviṣayatvāt tasya pradīrghatvakalpanābhrāntitvāt kiṃ pūrvam ? kimuttaram ? iti pūrvottarasthityutpattikalpavacanānupapattiḥ

syāt parihārārthavyākhyāśaṅkā— tadevotpadyate tadevāvatiṣṭhate ityanena vacanena kimuktaṃ bhavati ? iti tadācaṣṭe --yaduktaṃ bhavati yadevotpadyate tadevāvatiṣṭhata iti taduktaṃ bhavati ityarthaṃ kathayatyanena vacaneneti
sa punarayamartha evaṃ kathito bhavati --utpattirūpamevāvasthānamiti kathito bhavati
yadi notpadyetāvasthitābhimataṃ nāvatiṣṭheta anu tadevāvatiṣṭhate ityutpattirevāvasthānamityāpannam, uktasthitityāgāt, ataśca kṣaṇikatvāpattiḥ, ubhayātyāgābhimatau vānekāntāpattiḥ
athocyeta--utpādapūrvatva ete doṣā mā bhūvanniti tadeva vinaśyati tadevotpadyate
atrāpi yadeva vinaśyati bījaṃ tadevotpadyata ityaṅkurāprādurbhāva eva prāpta iti pūrvavat svavacanādivirodhāḥ tatpūrvapatrādyapohācca lokādivirodhāḥ
tadeva vinaśyati tadevotpadyate iti kṣaṇikavādātiśayanādi ca pūrvavat
tasmādanutpannamasthitaṃ khapuṣpādi, tadvailakṣaṇyena yadeva utpadyate tadevāvatiṣṭhate, nānutpattikamavatiṣṭhate, tasmādutpattyanumitamevāvasthānaṃ dravyasyeti

itthaṃ tarhīdaṃ vyākhyānaṃ saṃvṛttam--yadeveti yasmādityarthaḥ avyayatvād yacchabdasya, yata evotpadyate tata evāvatiṣṭhata iti prāguktotpattṛsthātraikyavadutpattisthityaikyāpattiḥ, ata utpattirevāvasthānamityāpannam, kiṃ kāraṇam ? uktasthitityāgāt, utpattireva sthitirityanumimānena sthitirutpattireva kṛteti yoktā vyāpisvatatvānumatāṃśutantuvat tu pradīrghadravyapūrvottarāvasthā sthitiriti sā tyaktā syāt, tattyāgādutpattirevāvasthānam, na sthitirnānā kācidityataśca kṣaṇikatvāpattiḥ, utpadyata utpadyata eva nāvatiṣṭhate kiñciditi sarvaṃ kṣaṇikam ityuktaṃ bhavati
syānmatam--kṣaṇikatvadoṣo mā bhūditi kenacit prakāreṇa sthitam, utpadyate kenacit itīṣyata iti
tataśca ubhayātyāgābhimatau vānekāntāpattiḥ, yadi sthityutpattī na tyakte tvayā tataste'bhyupagamavirodhinī syādvādaprakriyā anekāntavastutattvā āpadyata iti
etaccihnāntargataḥ ॰rthavyākhyā॰ ityata ārabhya athocyeta utpādavināśapūrvatāyāmityā॰ pṛ॰ 427 paṃ॰ 18 ityetatparyantaḥ pāṭho vi॰ raṃ॰ hī॰ pratiṣu nāsti
tadevāvatiṣṭhate ityutpattirevāvasthānamityāpannam, uktasthitityāgāt, ataśca kṣaṇikatvāpattiḥ, ubhayātyāgābhimatau vānekāntāpattiḥ
utpatteśca kṣaṇikatvāpattiḥ ityapi mūlaṃ syāt, dṛśyatāṃ ṭi॰ 7
athocyeta--utpādapūrvatva ete doṣā mā bhūvanniti tadeva vinaśyati tadevotpadyate
atrāpi yadeva vinaśyati bījaṃ tadevotpadyata ityaṅkurāprādurbhāva eva prāpta iti pūrvavat svavacanādivirodhāḥ tatpūrvapatrādyapohācca lokādivirodhāḥ
tadeva vinaśyati tadevotpadyate iti kṣaṇikavādātiśayanādi ca pūrvavat
prāptaḥ, tataśca pūrvavat svavacanādivirodhāḥ ityapi mūlaṃ syāt

yadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati, yadevotpadyate tadevāvatiṣṭhate ityubhayorutpādapradhānayorvikalpayorye doṣāstānaparihāryān pratyuccāryānumatya cāsau tau vikalpau tyaktvā vikalpāntare nirdoṣe manyamānaḥ śrayeta vināśapradhāne
asminnapi vikalpe doṣa ucyate--loke tāvat pratyakṣādiprasiddham aṅkurotpattau bījaṃ vinaśyati

tava punaryadeva vinaśyati bījaṃ tadevotpadyate nāṅkura ityaṅkurāprādurbhāva eva prāptaḥ, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt tataśca pūrvavat svavacanādivirodhāḥ, tatpūrvapatrādyapohācca lokādivirodhāḥ, aṅkurābhāve'ṅkurapūrvāṇāṃ patrakāṇḍanālapuṣpaphalaśūkādīnāmuttareṣāṃ loke pratyakṣādipramāṇaprasiddhānāmaṅkurāpalāpavadapalāpāllokādivirodhāḥ, pūrvavad vacanalokadvārābhyāṃ doṣābhidhānamiti
tadevetyādi, tadeva vinaśyati tadevotpadyate iti vacanenānanyabhūtasyaikasminneva kāle vināśa utpādaśceti kṣaṇikavādātiśayaḥ pūrvavat, bhinnakālavināśotpādo hi kṣaṇikavādaḥ, sa cānenātiśayyate
atrāpi tathā vā sarvathā vā avatiṣṭhamāne kuto vināśo vināśe vāvasthānam ? iti ta eva svavacanādivirodhāḥ kṣaṇikavādātiśayanādi ca pūrvavat
athocyeta--utpādavināśapūrvatāyāmete doṣā mā bhūvanniti tadevāvatiṣṭhate tadevotpadyata ityucyeta
atrāpi tathā vā sarvathā vā utpadyamāne'vasthānaṃ kutaḥ, avatiṣṭhamāne votpattiḥ ? iti ta eva svavacanādivirodhāḥ kṣaṇikavādātiśayanādi
atha yadevāvatiṣṭhate tadeva vinaśyati, atrāpi tathā vā sarvathā vā vinaśyati kuto'vasthānam, avasthāne vā vināśaḥ ? iti pūrvavat svavacanādivirodhāḥ kṣaṇikavādātiśayanādi śūnyatā vā
ananvayagocaravyatirekamātropalabdheśca tadevāvatiṣṭhate tadeva vinaśyati iti pūrvavat ta eva svavacanādivirodhāḥ

athotpādaikādhikaraṇya ityādi dvitīyavikalpe vināśapradhānasthitipakṣe'nantarodgrāhite'pi uktavadeva doṣāḥ sthānābhidhānena tu yojyāḥ, yojanādikpradarśanaṃ tu tathā vā sarvathā veti sthitiprakāreṇa vinaśyet utpattisthitivināśaprakāreṇa vā vinaśyet iti vikalpyate

utpattipradhānavikalpābhihitadoṣavadatrāpi vināśaprādhānyena sthityā saha yojitaṃ tathā vā sarvathā vā vinaśyati avatiṣṭhamāne kuto vināśaḥ ? vināśe vā kuto'vasthānam ? iti ta evādhikṛtāḥ svavacanādivirodhāḥ kṣaṇikavādātiśayanādi ca pūrvavat
athocyeta--utpādavināśapūrvatāyāmityādi pūrvavaduccārya doṣāṃścānumatya tyaktvā caturo'pi vikalpānimau nirdoṣau vikalpāvityāśrayet
tatrādyastāvat tadevāvatiṣṭhate tadevotpadyata ityucyetetyādi yāvat kṣaṇikavādātiśayanādīti pūrvavadatrāpi vyākhyā kāryā avatiṣṭhamāne ityuccāraṇena tu yojya iti
vyākhyāyā vivakṣitatve tu yojyā ityeva samīcīnaḥ pāṭhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ
atha yadevāvatiṣṭhate tadeva vinaśyatīti sthitipūrvadvitīyavikalpe'pi vyākhyānaṃ tadeva yojyaṃ yāvat kṣaṇikavādātiśayanādīti gatārthaṃ śūnyatā veti
asmin vikalpe'nyathāpi doṣābhidhitsayāha — avatiṣṭhate vānvaya ityādi yāvat svavacanādivirodhā iti
ananvayagocaretyādi, avasthānamanvayaḥ, vyatireko vināśaḥ, anvayaśūnyo vyatireka evānanvayaḥ, sa eva gocaro vyatirekaḥ, arthaśūnyo vināśa eva ityarthaḥ
tanmātropalabdheśca sarvatraiva bījāṅkurapatrādau tadevāvatiṣṭhate tadeva vinaśyati itītthamapi vyapa- deśo na sambhavatīti pūrvavat ta eva virodhā anenāpi prakāreṇeti
na kevalaṃ pakṣadoṣā eva, kiṃ tarhi ? avasthitārthavināśābhyupagamenānena bhavato'śeṣasādhanāvayavā tathāvyavasthānavināśāt
tathāvyavasthānāvināśe eva hi sapakṣamapi tat syāt agniratra dhūmāt iti yathā, vināśe'vasthānaviparītavṛttitvāt
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tathāvyavasthānavināśāt, yathā sphuṭitapṛṣṭhatvāt kharaṃ kharaviṣāṇam ākāśasphoṭavaditi vacanavat

tadvaidharmyeṇa sādhanavyavasthāṃ darśayati --tathāvyavasthānāvināśa eva hi sapakṣamapi tat syāt, taddhi sādhanaṃ sādhanaṃ bhavat pakṣeṇa sahāpi satyeva vyavasthitasyārthasyāvināśe bhavitumarhati, nāvināśe

kimiva ? agniratra dhūmāt iti yathā, yathā hi dhūmo dhūmarūpeṇa vyavasthito vyavasthite evāgnau agnitayā tadvattayā ca pradeśe, yadyubhayavyudāsānugṛhītasamudāyārthasādhyatā yadi dharmaviśiṣṭadharmisādhyatā sarvathā vyavasthitasya vastuno vyāpyo dhūmāṃśo vyāpakena agnyaṃśena vyāptastamaṃśaṃ vyavasthita eva vyavasthitaṃ gamayati avinaṣṭamavinaṣṭo'vinaṣṭasyeti syāt sādhanatvaṃ sādhyatvaṃ ca

tvanmate tu punarvividhādarśane vināśe'tyantābhāve'nyabhavanarūpe vā viparītātmake tvayeṣṭayāvasthayāvaśyaṃ vinaṃṣṭavyamityavasthānaviparītavṛttitvāt anyathābhavanarūpatvādasya dhūmākhyasyāṃśasya pakṣadharmatvamasiddham
athavā avasthānaviparītavṛttitvāditi, tvanmatenetthaṃ viruddhatā, manmatasaṃvādena tu tvadīyasarvahetuviruddhatā

avasthānavināśadvayarūpa evāgnistvayābhyupagataḥ, tatra yāvantamaṃśamagnitvavyavasthānarūpaṃ spṛśati tāvatā agnyantare sapakṣe ca dṛṣṭaḥ yāvantaṃ ca vināśarūpaṃ spṛśati tāvatā agnitvavyavasthānābhāve tadviparīte vā vipakṣe dṛṣṭaḥ tasmādanaikāntika iti hetudoṣāḥ
tasyaivāgneravasthānavināśadvyaṃśasya tadvataḥ pradeśasya ca dvyaṃśasya vyavasthānāṃśamātre darśanād vanaspaticaitanye svāpavadavyāpipakṣadharmaśca sādhanaṃ tadvṛttyavṛttyoḥ
tathāvyavasthānāvināśe eva hi sapakṣamapi tat syāt agniratra dhūmāt iti yathā, vināśe'vasthānaviparītavṛttitvāt
avṛkṣavyavacchinnasyāpi svārthasya nānumānāya nābhidhānāya syād vṛkṣaśabdaḥ, na prabhavatītyarthaḥ

tadekadeśavartitvāt, svārthasya dharmiṇaḥ pakṣasyānumeyasyābhidheyasya ekadeśe vartituṃ śīlamasya dharmaḥ sādhu vā vṛttirasyeti tadekadeśavartī, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? avyāpipakṣadharmatvāt samastānumeyāvṛttitvādityarthaḥ

avanaspativyavacchinnacaitanyasādhanārthasvāpavat, yathā cetanā vanaspatayaḥ iti pratijñāyāṃ svāpāt iti heturdharmiṇo vanaspaterekadeśe śirīṣādau vartamāno'pi tālādiṣu avartamāno na caitanyānumānāya prabhavati avyāpitvāt tathā vṛkṣaśabdo'pi avṛkṣavyāvṛttyartho vṛkṣasvārthāṃśavṛttirnānumānāya nābhidhānāya prabhavati
tathā trikādiyogabhaṅgeṣvapi vācyā ityatidiśati, uktadikpātitvāt teṣāmapi vikalpānām

tatraikastrikasaṃyogaḥ--yadevotpadyate tadevāvatiṣṭhate vinaśyati ceti prathamaḥ, yadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyatyavatiṣṭhate ceti dvitīya ityutpattipradhānau dvau trikasaṃyogau, tathā vināśapradhānau sthitipradhānau ca

athavā yadevotpadyate tadevotpadyate vinaśyati ityanutpattidoṣaparihārārthamutpattisvarūpaṃ vināśasamānādhikaraṇamavadhārayan vikalpayet, tathā śeṣeṣvapīti atra pakṣe'mī doṣā ityanyadutpadyate'nyad vinaśyatītyādi yathāvastubījāṅkurakarmādyātmadharmāṇusthūlapṛthivyādivat
utpādenābhibhavād vināśasya utpādasya prādurbhāvād avasthānasyotpādena sahabhāvādanyonyābhibhavodbhavamithunavṛttayo hi guṇāḥ sattvarajastamobhidhānā utpattivināśasthityākhyā bhavantīti
tathā catuṣkasaṃyogāḥ pañcakasaṃyogāḥ ṣaṭkasaṃyogāśca sambhavanto yojyāḥ

yāvadyogamiti sakalakaraṇopāyena yāvanto bhaṅgāstāvanta ityarthaḥ, yāvanti vā darśanānyarthataḥ sambhavanti taddarśanānusāreṇa tāvanto bhaṅgāḥ kāryā ityarthaḥ, abhihitasāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattidoṣadiśā bhaṅgopacayāśrayeṇa doṣopacayamapi vardhayadbhirvyākhyeyamityupāyaṃ darśayati
atra pakṣa iti dravyasyāvasthāmātraṃ sthityādayo na bhinnāśca parasparata ityasmin pakṣe'mī doṣā iti tasmād viparyayo'stviti tadupasaṃharati --ityanyadutpadyate'nyad vinaśyatītyādi

ādigrahaṇāt anyad vinaśyati anyadutpadyate, anyadutpadyate'nyadavatiṣṭhate, anyad vinaśyati anyadavatiṣṭhate, anyadavatiṣṭhate'nyadutpadyate, anyadavatiṣṭhate'nyad vinaśyati ityādibhaṅgāḥ sambhavanto grāhyāḥ

yathāvastubījāṅkurakarmādyātmadharmāṇusthūlapṛthivyādivat, yad yad vastu yathāvastu, bījamanyad vastu vinaśyati aṅkuro'nya utpadyate dravyam, karma gamanamutpadyate sthānaṃ vinaśyati, ādigrahaṇād nirṇayabuddhyādirguṇa utpadyate saṃśayabuddhyādirvinaśyati, ātmākāśakāladiṅmanodravyāṇi notpadyante na vinaśyanti avatiṣṭhanta eva, tathāṇavo'pi, paṭādi sthūlamutpadyate piṇḍādi vinaśyati, dharmo'bhiṣecanādikarmaṇotpādya utpadyate guṇaḥ saṃskāraprayatnādiśca kāraṇa- vināśādibhiśca vinaśyati, na vibhutvādiriti
evaṃ śrutismṛtividhibhyo dharmo bhavatītyuktvā idānīmeṣāṃ dharmasiddhau prakāraviśeṣamāha, tathāhi --dṛṣṭānāṃ dṛṣṭaprayojanānāṃ dṛṣṭābhāve prayogo'bhyudayāya vai॰ sū॰ 96
1, śrutismṛtiparidṛṣṭānāṃ snānādīnāṃ dṛṣṭasya malāpakarṣāderanabhisandhāne prayogo'bhyudayāya bhavati
2, viśiṣṭadeśakālāpekṣeṇa ambhasā yaḥ śarīrasya saṃyogastadabhiṣecanaṃ snānam
brahmaśabdenātmā, brahmaṇi caraṇamātmamanasoryaḥ saṃyogaḥ stryādiparihārarūpo brahmacaryam
śāstravidhinā grāmānnirgatāto'niḥsṛtyo'raṇyaprasthito vāvanaprasthaḥ, tasya karma vānaprasthāṃsthyam ? stham ?
diṅgiyamādayo'nye viśeṣāḥ, diṅgiyamaḥ prāṅmukho'nnāni bhuñjīta, nakṣatraniyamaḥkṛttikāsvādadhīta, mantraniyamo devasya tveti nirvapati, kālaniyamo vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta
evametat sarvaṃ dṛṣṭaprayojanatiraskāreṇa prayujyamānaṃ dharmāya sampadyata iti
iti puṇyanāmadheyamuniśrīpuṇyavijayamahodayasakāśāllabdhāyāṃ hastalikhitāyāṃ prācīnatamāyāṃ candrānandaviracitāyāṃ vaiśeṣikasūtravṛttau P pṛ॰ 24 A
2 etādṛśī sadasatkāryaviṣayikā carcā prathamāre pṛ॰ 160--171, navamāre pṛ॰ 478-- 2, daśamāre pṛ॰ 506-- 2 --509-- 2 ca dṛśyate
yat tat sat tato'nyat kāryam, tadatulyavikalpatvāt, ghaṭapaṭavat
kathamatulyavikalpatā ? iha kāryakāraṇayordvayorapi sattvaṃ kāryāsattvameva vetyetad vikalpadvayaṃ syāt, itarayorabhyupagatapratipakṣatvād vādābhāvāt
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 435 paṃ॰ 15, pṛ॰ 434 paṃ॰ 5, 506-- 2, tulanā--pṛ॰ 160 paṃ॰ 4, 478-- 2
yat sat tato'nyat kāryam ityapi pāṭho'tra syāditi bhāti
tad yadi tāvadubhayasattvaṃ tata upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatve tadātmakasattvāviśiṣṭatvāt kāraṇasvātmavat kāraṇāvirbhāvavad nityaṃ kāryāvirbhāvaḥ syāt

atrānumānaṃ kāraṇakāryanānātve'bhidhīyate --yat tat sat tato'nyat kāryam, tadatulyavikalpatvāt, ghaṭapaṭavat, yat tvayā kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ ca sadityabhimataṃ tatra bījādeḥ puruṣādeśca kāraṇāt tanubhuvanādyaṅkurādi kāryamanyadityabhiprāyaḥ
pakṣīkriyate tu sat ityabhimatād vastuno'nyat tat kāryamiti
viśeṣahetuḥ --tadatulyavikalpatvāditi, satā tenātulyo vikalpo'syeti kāryamabhisambadhyate, tasya tvayā kāraṇādananyatveneṣṭatvād nāśrayāsiddhidoṣo hetoḥ
ghaṭapaṭavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭenātulyavikalpo loke pṛthukukṣibudhnavṛttordhvagrīvādyākārādivikalpaḥ paṭāccaturasradīrghādisaṃsthānādivikalpādanyo dṛṣṭastathā kāryaṃ sato'nyaditi
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 435 paṃ॰ 15, pṛ॰ 434 paṃ॰ 5, 506-- 2, tulanā--pṛ॰ 160 paṃ॰ 4, 478-- 2
yat sat tato'nyat kāryam ityapi pāṭho'tra syāditi bhāti
atra catvāro bhaṅgāḥ sambhāvyante--yo vā kāraṇaṃ sat kāryaṃ ceti, yo vā kāraṇaṃ sat kāryamasat, kāryaṃ sat kāraṇamasat, kāryamasat kāraṇaṃ ceti vā
tadyathā --iha kāryakāraṇayordvayorapi sattvaṃ kāryasattvameva vā ityetad vikalpadvayaṃ syāditi kāraṇaṃ sat kāryaṃ ca sat, kāraṇamasat kāryaṃ sat ityetau vikalpau bhavitumarhato netarāviti

kasmāt ? itarayorabhyupagatapratipakṣatvād vādābhāvāt, abhyupagataḥ pratipakṣo yasmin yena vā vādinā so'bhyupagatapratipakṣo vikalpo vādī vā, tadbhāvādabhyupagatapratipakṣatvāt, kiṃ bhavati ? vādābhāvo bhavati avasitaprayojanatvāt, paraścedabhyupagacchati kimiti vādaḥ kriyate ? tau ca vikalpau sat kāraṇamasat kāryam, asat kāraṇamasat kāryaṃ ca iti yadi tvamabhyupagacchasi avasitaprayojanaḥ syāmaham, ato vādābhāvādidaṃ vikalpadvayaṃ syāditi
pā॰ vinānyatra ॰mahamahaṃ ? tatovādā॰ ḍe॰ vi॰ raṃ॰
kiñcātaḥ ? ucyate --tad yadi tāvadubhayasattvam, kāryasattvaṃ kāraṇasattvaṃ ca ityayaṃ vikalpaḥ parīkṣyate, tiṣṭhatu tāvadasat kāraṇaṃ sat kāryamiti vikalpaḥ

atrobhayasattve kāraṇāvirbhāvavat kāryāvirbhāvaḥ syāditi pakṣārthaḥ sambadhyate, upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatve sati tadātmakasattvāviśiṣṭatvāt kāraṇasvātmavat, yathāvaraṇātidūrātisāmīpyādyanupalabdhikāraṇavirahe sati sattvātmakaṃ kāraṇamāvirbhavati nityaṃ mṛdādi tathānupalabdhikāraṇāsattve sati tadātmakasattvāviśiṣṭakāryamāvirbhaved nityamiti

etena sattve'pi āvirbhāvānāvirbhāvakṛtaṃ vailakṣaṇyamāpadyate kāraṇakāryayoḥ, tataśca sadvi virbhāvavad nityaṃ kāryāvirbhāvaḥ sacca kāryamiti niścitaṃ tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāraṇam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvāt khapuṣpavat
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāraṇasattvaniścayo na nivartate āvirbhāvātmakaṃ ca tat na tarhi anāvirbhāvātmakatvāt kāryaṃ sat khapuṣpavat
itarathā hi nityamevāvirbhavet sattvāt kāraṇavat, kāraṇaṃ vā nāvirbhavet anāvirbhāvakasattvāviśiṣṭatvāt kāryavat
atha na kāryānityaprādurbhāvavat kāraṇaprādurbhāvaḥ sacca kāraṇamiti niścitaṃ tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāryam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvāt khapuṣpavat, itaraḥ kāraṇavat
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāryasattvaviniścayo na vyāvartate anityāvirbhāvātmakaṃ ca tat na tarhi āvirbhāvātmakatvāt kāraṇaṃ sat, na tvevaṃ bhavati
ataḥ kāraṇaṃ sat, upalabhyatva āvirbhāvakatvāt, kṛtavat
kṛtamapi kāraṇavat sat, upalabhyatve āvirbhāvakatvāt, kāraṇavadeva
na tu kāryaṃ sat, upalabhyatve āvirbhāvānupalabdhyātmakatvāt, khapuṣpavat
sattve vā viśeṣo vaktavyaḥ, aviśeṣe vailakṣaṇyānupapatteḥ
sato hi ghaṭāt paṭo vilakṣaṇaḥ saṃśca dṛṣṭaḥ, khapuṣpamasat, tatra sandehaḥ--kiṃ khapuṣpavadasat kāryaṃ syāt ? ghaṭavilakṣaṇapaṭavat sat syāt ? iti
atrocyate --na, itaretarāsattvavailakṣaṇyāt, ghaṭaḥ paṭātmanā nāsti paṭo'pi ghaṭātmanā nāstyeveti asattvāṃśābhyāmeva vailakṣaṇyamanayoḥ, ato vipakṣāsiddheḥ sapakṣa eva vṛtternānaikāntikaḥ
śeṣo granthaḥ satkāryavādaviparyayeṇa tulyagamatvāduktānusāreṇohyo yāvadanāvirbhāvakasattvāviśiṣṭatvāt kāryavaditi prathamacakrakaṃ kāryasattvaprasaṅgena
virbhāvavad nityaṃ kāryāvirbhāvaḥ sacca kāryamiti niścitaṃ tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāraṇam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvāt khapuṣpavat
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāraṇasattvaniścayo na nivartate āvirbhāvātmakaṃ ca tat na tarhi anāvirbhāvātmakatvāt kāryaṃ sat khapuṣpavat
itarathā hi nityamevāvirbhavet sattvāt kāraṇavat, kāraṇaṃ vā nāvirbhavet anāvirbhāvakasattvāviśiṣṭatvāt kāryavat
atha na kāryānityaprādurbhāvavat kāraṇaprādurbhāvaḥ sacca kāraṇamiti niścitaṃ tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi sat kāryam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvāt khapuṣpavat, itaraḥ kāraṇavat
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāryasattvaviniścayo na vyāvartate anityāvirbhāvātmakaṃ ca tat na tarhi āvirbhāvātmakatvāt kāraṇaṃ sat, na tvevaṃ bhavati
ataḥ kāraṇaṃ sat, upalabhyatva āvirbhāvakatvāt, kṛtavat
kṛtamapi kāraṇavat sat, upalabhyatve āvirbhāvakatvāt, kāraṇavadeva
na tu kāryaṃ sat, upalabhyatve āvirbhāvānupalabdhyātmakatvāt, khapuṣpavat
sattve vā viśeṣo vaktavyaḥ, aviśeṣe vailakṣaṇyānupapatteḥ
atha na kāryānityaprādurbhāvavadityādi kāraṇasattvaprasaṃgacakrakaṃ dvitīyaṃ yāvadupasaṃhāragranthaḥ --ataḥ kāraṇaṃ sat, upalabhyatva āvirbhāvakatvāt, kṛtavaditi kṛtaghaṭavadityarthaḥ
syānmatam--kṛtaṃ ghaṭādikāryamakṛtāt kāryāt kāraṇāccānyad vilakṣaṇaṃ ca tat tasmādasaditi
etacca na, viśiṣṭaṃ kṛtamapi kāraṇavat sat, upalabhyatve āvirbhāvakatvāt, kāraṇavadeveti upalabhyatvaviśeṣaṇamāvaraṇādyabhāvaprakāśādyupalabdhipradarśanamiti
yathā ghaṭābhāva eva paṭo'ghaṭastathā viśeṣo'pi kalpyamāno'satvāṃśadvāreṇa syād nānyathetyaviśeṣād vailakṣaṇyānupapattiriti dvitīyaṃ cakrakaṃ samāptam
athaitat sāmyamubhayasattvād mā bhūdityanyatarasattvaṃ kāryāsattvābhyupagamaparihāreṇa kāryameva sat iti

atra kāryasamīpe evakāra ityanyatra pratiyogini sattve niyamaḥ sattvaṃ kārye eva niyataṃ nānyat sat iti, tataśca na kāraṇaṃ sat, tathā ca sato'saditi asataśca saditi saṃjñā kriyate, kāryasattvaṃ kharaviṣāṇādisattvatulyam, nāmamātre visaṃvādaḥ
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 509-- 1, pṛ॰ 165 paṃ॰ 2, pṛ॰ 168 paṃ॰ 5
athocyeta--sarvathā sattvādekakāraṇatayā na kaścid viśeṣo'sti, yadeva kāraṇakāle kāryasattvaṃ tadeva kāraṇasattvamapīti nāvadhāraṇakṛto doṣo nāpi pūrvastulyatvāpattidoṣaḥ

evamapyekatvād viśeṣābhāvaḥ, tato yathaiva kāraṇamanupādānasiddhaṃ sāmānyamantarbhāvitāśeṣaviśeṣasattvātmakamevaṃ kāryasyānupādānasiddhatvāt sāmānyatvādantarbhāvitāśeṣaviśeṣasattvātmakatvāt kāryamapi kāraṇavadevākramaṃ syāt
pūrvadoṣaparihāreṇānyatarasattvaparigrahe kāryamasat iti necchato'vaśyaṃ kāryameva sat ityavadhāraṇapakṣaḥ syāt
sa ca satkāraṇapratiṣedhavādaviparyayeṇa doṣābhidhānavadihāpi kāryo yāvad nāmamātre visaṃvāda iti
evaṃ ca sati kāryāsattvanivṛttyekāntatyāgāccābhyupagamavirodha ityādi gatārthaṃ tathaiva
atha kāryameva sat ityavadhāryamāṇa ete doṣā iti sattvaṃ nāvadhāryate kāryamastyeva kāraṇamapyasti itīṣṭatvāditi cet, availakṣaṇyādikṛtāḥ pūrvadoṣā eva

pakṣadvayoktadoṣaparihārārthamitthaṃ kalpayet --sarvathā sattvāt sarvapiṇḍaśivakaghaṭādiprabhedābhedādekakāraṇatā, tayā na kaścid viśeṣo'sti, yathaikasyaivāheḥ saṃvarte vivarte vā'bhinnasya kāraṇasya kāraṇatā, nāheḥ pṛthagbhūtau saṃvartavivartau tathā tathā tasyaivāvasthānāt, nāpyahiḥ saṃvarto vivarto vā na bhavati tatheti

iti nāvadhāraṇetyādyupanayaḥ, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvād yadi kāryameva sat atha kāraṇameva sat ityucyeta yadi sadeva kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ ca ityucyate sarvathā tasya kāraṇasya svasaṃvartavivartaikarūpatvād nāvadhāraṇakṛto doṣo'sti paramatāpekṣatvādavadhāraṇasyāpi
anekaṃ hi tulyamatulyaṃ vā syāt idamanena tulyaṃ ghaṭādi paṭādi vā iti
nirastapūrvāparībhāvātmani kārye katarad bhinnaṃ kāraṇaṃ nāma ? kāraṇātmakabhāvitakāryatvādvā katarat kāraṇam ? iti
tataḥ kim ? tata iti yathaiva atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa itīṣyata evākramaṃ kāraṇe kāryasya sannihitatvādahivat
yadi kramavadahyādi kāraṇaṃ syāt na syāt kramavattvāt khapuṣpavat
tasmādakramameva sarvam, kāraṇatvādeva kāraṇasvātmavat tathā bhedenābhavadapi sadeva
khapuṣpamapi tarhi sat kāraṇaṃ ca syādanupalabhyatvāt kāryavat
kāraṇaṃ vā asat kāryaṃ ca tathānupalabhyatvāt khapuṣpavadeva

yadi tu na kāraṇānupādānasiddhatvavat kāryamanupādānasiddhaṃ saditi ca niścayo na vyāvartate tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi kāraṇaṃ sat, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvāt khapuṣpa- kāraṇamanupādānetyādi yāvadakramaṃ syāditi

viśeṣābhāvāt kāraṇavat kāryamanupādānasiddham, anupādānasiddhatvāt sāmānyam, sāmānyatvāccāntarbhāvitāśeṣaviśeṣasattvātmakameva, tasya kāryasya sāmānyatvādanupādānasiddhatvādantarbhāvitāśeṣaśivakasthāsakośakuśūlaghaṭādiviśeṣasattvātmakatvāt kāryamapi kāraṇavadevākramaṃ syāt, upalabhyate ca krameṇa prāk piṇḍaḥ paścācchivaka ityādi
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa itīṣyata evākramaṃ kāraṇe kāryasya sannihitatvādahivat
yadi kramavadahyādi kāraṇaṃ syāt na syāt kramavattvāt khapuṣpavat
tasmādakramameva sarvam, kāraṇatvādeva kāraṇasvātmavat tathā bhedenābhavadapi sadeva
khapuṣpamapi tarhi sat kāraṇaṃ ca syādanupalabhyatvāt kāryavat
kāraṇaṃ vā asat kāryaṃ ca tathānupalabhyatvāt khapuṣpavadeva
yadi tu na kāraṇānupādānasiddhatvavat kāryamanupādānasiddhaṃ saditi ca niścayo na vyāvartate tadvailakṣaṇyānna tarhi kāraṇaṃ sat, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvāt khapuṣpa-
syānmatam--iṣyata evākramaṃ kāraṇam, ahāviva saṃvartavivartasadbhāvāt kāraṇe kāryasya sannihitatvāt
yadi kramavadahyādi kāraṇaṃ syāt na syāt kramavattvāt akramatvābhāvādityarthaḥ, akramāt kāraṇādatyantavilakṣaṇatvāt khapuṣpavat
yugapatsannihitasarvadharmakaṃ kāraṇamahyādīṣṭam, no cet saṃvartavivartāvahāvivākāśe'pi syātāmubhayorakramatulyatvāt
tasmād viyati abhūtairahi- saṃvartavivartādibhiḥ sahaivākramameva ahirātmarūpabhūtaiḥ, tasmāt kāraṇatvādakramameva sarvamahyādikāraṇasvātmavat

kimarthaṃ tarhi kāraṇavad na bhedena bhedā gṛhyante tadaiva iti cet, ucyate --kāraṇatvādeva kāraṇasvātmavat, ahiḥ saṃvartavivartādibhedenābhavannapi kāraṇatvenaivākramarūpeṇa bhavannapi sa evāsti gṛhyata eva sattvāt tadeva kāraṇaṃ tathā tathā tathā gṛhyata ityartha iti
atrocyate--etadapi asat anumānāntaravirodhāt, khapuṣpamapi tarhi sat syāt anupalabhyatvāt kāryavat
kāraṇaṃ ca syāt khapuṣpam, anupalabhyatvāt, kāryavat
kāraṇatve vā tathābhedenābhūtatvāt sat khapuṣpaṃ syāt kāryavat
athaivaṃ neṣyate kāraṇamasat kāryaṃ ca sat tvadiṣṭaṃ tathānupalabhyatvād bhedena kramabhāvinā ahisaṃvartavivartādiprakāreṇānupalabhyatvādityarthaḥ khapuṣpavadeveti
na caivamādīṣṭam, tasmādanupādānasiddhaṃ kāraṇaṃ sat, upādānasiddhaṃ kāryamasacca sad bhavati
atra akramameva aherā॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

yathā kāraṇamanupādānasiddhaṃ sattvāt tathā kāryamanupādānasiddhaṃ sattvāt ityetad neṣṭamupādānasiddhameveṣṭam, asattvāpattibhayāt sat iti ca niścayo na vyāvartate bhavatastatastadvailakṣaṇyāt upādānasiddhatvavailakṣaṇyād na tarhi kāraṇaṃ sat

na, saviśeṣaṇāsattvā- dantarbhāvitāśeṣaviśeṣasattvātmakatvāt, asat, kāryavailakṣaṇyāt khapuṣpavadityādi pūrvavaccakrakadvayapravartanamupādānānupādānavilakṣaṇatvādivacanena āvirbhāvānāvirbhāvātmakatvādivacanavad netavyam--
yat tat sat tato'nyat kāryam, tadatulyavikalpatvāt ghaṭapaṭavad dravyakriyāvadvā
kathamatulyavikalpatā ? iha kāryakāraṇayordvayorapi sattvaṃ kāryasattvameva vetyetad vikalpadvayaṃ syāt, itarayorabhyupagatapratipakṣatvād vādābhāvāt
tad yadi tāvadubhayasattvaṃ tatastadātmakasattvāviśiṣṭatvāt kāraṇasvātmavadupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatve yathā kāraṇasyānupādānopalabdhiḥ tathā kāryasya syāt
atha na kāraṇānupādānavat kāryānupādānaṃ sacca kāryamiti niścitam, tadvailakṣaṇyād na tarhi sat kāraṇamasat sadvilakṣaṇatvāt khapuṣpavat, itaraḥ kṛtaghaṭavat
athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāraṇasattvaniścayo na nivartate anupādānātmakaṃ ca tat, na tarhyananupādānātmakatvāt kāryaṃ sat khapuṣpavat
itarathā hi nityamevopādīyeta sattvāt kāraṇavat, kāraṇaṃ vopādānavat syāt upalabhyasattvāviśiṣṭatvāt kāryavat iti prathamacakrakam
atra yat sat tato'nyat krāryam ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atha na kāryānityopādānavat kāraṇopādānam, sacca kāraṇamiti niścitaṃ tadvailakṣaṇyād na tarhi sat kāryam, asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvāt khapuṣpavat, itaraḥ kāraṇavat

athaivamapi vailakṣaṇye kāryasattvaviniścayo na vyāvartate upādānātmakaṃ ca tat na tarhi anupādānātmakatvād gandharvanagaravat kāraṇaṃ sat, na tvevaṃ bhavati, ataḥ kāraṇaṃ sat upalabhyatve'nupādānātmakatvāt kṛtavat, kṛtamapi vā kāraṇavat
sattve vā viśeṣo vaktavyaḥ, aviśeṣe vailakṣaṇyānupapatteḥ
viśeṣonnayane'pi viśeṣasyāsadāśrayatvāt tato'nyatvameva, tatrāsattvameva aghaṭapaṭavat iti dvitīyacakrakapravartanaṃ kṛtamiti

yadyevamasat kāryaṃ cedutpadyate tato'sattvādāyatyāmapi bījamṛtpiṇḍādyavasthānakālāduttarakāle'pyaṅkuro nāvirbhavecchivakādi ghaṭādi ca kāryamasattvāt khapuṣpavat, khapuṣpamapyāyatyāṃ vā prādurbhavet asattvāt aṅkuraghaṭādivadityetadaniṣṭaṃ prasaktam
etacca na, saviśeṣaṇāsattvāt, yo'yaṃ heturaniṣṭāpādanārthamuktaḥ asattvāt iti eṣo'siddhaḥ, abhūtaṃ nāstītyanarthāntaram vai॰ sū॰ 9
ata eva prakaraṇacintā--kiṃ ghaṭādi kāryamasadāvirbhavedalātacakravat, utetaracakravat sadāvirbhavet ? anaikāntikatvāt
evaṃ tarhi mayāpi śakyaṃ vaktum--yat tadasat tato'nyat kāryam tadvikalpāsamarthatvād ghaṭapaṭavadityādi
yadyevamahamapi bravīmi satkāryasādhanānyapyaśakyāni nivartayituṃ sopanayasaprapañcānāṃ vaktuṃ yuktatvāt

ananyacandrāditvavat, yathā nāstyanyaścandramā iti dvitīyacandrābhāvādananyo'yameveti sāmānyāt pratiṣidhyate candramāḥ tathā nāsti ghaṭo gehe mṛtpiṇḍe kapālāvasthāyāṃ vetyādīnyasattvāni saviśeṣaṇāni ananyacandrāditvanidarśanasūcitāni teṣāṃ ca satāmevāsatāmāyatyāmāvirbhāvadarśanāditi

9, prākpradhvaṃsopādhyabhāvebhyo yadatyantābhāvarūpaṃ śaśaviṣāṇādi tad abhūtaṃ, nāsti iti paryāyaśabdābhyāmavyatiriktamucyate, nāsya paryāyaśabdairarthāntaratā kathyate, ato'sya paryāyaśabdairevopadarśanaṃ lakṣaṇam, nāsya deśakālādiniṣedhaḥ
anyatra tu nāsti ghaṭo geha iti sato ghaṭasya gehasaṃyogapratiṣedhaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 9
10, nāsti ghaṭo'smin deśe kāle veti deśādiniṣedho ghaṭādeḥghaṭāderna svarūpato niṣedhaḥ kriyata iti
nāstyanyaścandramā iti sāmānyāccandramasi niṣedhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ T vai॰ sū॰ 9
11, nāsti dvitīyaścandramāḥ iti saṅkhyāpratiṣedhena sāmānyāccandratvākhyāccandramā nivartyate iti kṛtvā candratvaṃ sāmānyaṃ nāstītyuktaṃ bhavati
deśakālabhāvasāmarthyopādhīnāmabhāve tadatyantāsata eva prabhedaścandratvasāmānyaniṣedha iti varṇayanti
ata eva prakaraṇacintā--kiṃ ghaṭādi kāryamasadāvirbhavedalātacakravat, utetaracakravat sadāvirbhavet ? anaikāntikatvāt
evaṃ tarhi mayāpi śakyaṃ vaktum--yat tadasat tato'nyat kāryam tadvikalpāsamarthatvād ghaṭapaṭavadityādi
yadyevamahamapi bravīmi satkāryasādhanānyapyaśakyāni nivartayituṃ sopanayasaprapañcānāṃ vaktuṃ yuktatvāt
atra ananyacandrādivat ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 320-- 1
yasmāt prakaraṇacintā sa nirṇayārthamapadiṣṭaḥ prakaraṇasamaḥ nyā॰ sū॰ 1

7 iti, yasmādeva āvirbhavad dvividhaṃ dṛṣṭam--sadasacca, tadyathā--alātacakrādyasat, sacca rathādicakrādi, tatra sandehaḥ --kiṃ ghaṭādi kāryamasadāvirbhavedalātacakravat utetaracakravat sadāvirbhavet ? iti
yata eva saṃśayo na tata eva hi nirṇayaḥ, anaikāntikatvāt
yasmāt prakaraṇacintā sa nirṇayārthamapadiṣṭaḥ prakaraṇasamaḥnyā॰ sū॰ 1

7, vimarśādhiṣṭhānau pakṣapratipakṣāvanavasitau prakaraṇam, tasya cintā vimarśāt prabhṛti prāg nirṇayād yat samīkṣaṇam, sā jijñāsā yatkṛtā sa nirṇayārthaṃ prayukta ubhayapakṣasāmyāt prakaraṇamanativartamānaḥ prakaraṇasamo nirṇayāya na prakalpate
prajñāpanaṃ tu--anityaḥ śabdo nityadharmānupalabdheriti, anupalabhyamānanityadharmakamanityaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sthālyādi
yatra samāno dharmaḥ saṃśayakāraṇaṃ hetutvenopādīyate sa saṃśayasamaḥ savyabhicāra eva
yā tu vimarśasya viśeṣāpekṣitā ubhayapakṣaviśeṣānupalabdhiśca sā prakaraṇaṃ pravartayati, katham ? viparyaye hi prakaraṇanivṛtteḥ, yadi nityadharmaḥ śabde gṛhyeta na syāt prakaraṇam
so'yaṃ heturubhau pakṣau pravartayannanyatarasya nirṇayāya na prakalpate
atra anekāntāt, aikāntiko hi hetuḥ syāt ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 168 paṃ॰ 4

satkāryavādī pūrvābhihitasatkāryavādopapattibhirviruddhāvyabhicāricikīrṣayāha — evaṃ tarhi mayāpi śakyaṃ vaktum, tadyathā --yat tadasat tato'nyat kāryam tadvikalpāsamarthatvād ghaṭapaṭavadityādisatkāryasādhanaprapañco'tītaḥ so'tra draṣṭavya iti pūrvapakṣaḥ
uttaramatra vaktuma- śakyam, yathātrāsatkāryasādhanāni anivartyāni tathā satkāryavādasādhanānyapīti

yadyevaṃ bravīṣīti pratyuccāryāha ahamapi bravīmi-- evamapi satkāryasādhanānyapyaśakyāni nivartayitum, sopanayasaprapañcānāṃ vaktuṃ yuktatvāt, yathā tvayopanayasahitāni pratyavasthānasahitāni ca pūrvottarapakṣaprasaṅgena, satkāryāsatkāryavādayostulyaṃ samarthanamiti bhavato yadi matiḥ tatho bhayavādasiddhiḥ, ubhayoranyatarasya vā niṣedhe pramāṇābhāvāt
nanvevaṃ tathārthasthitisatyatvāt sarvavādanāthānekāntavādāśrayaṇaṃ kṛtam, tadatatsamarthavikalpatvāt, ekapuruṣapitṛputrādivat
na ca tena saha kasyacid virodhaḥ, tasmādayamārādhyaḥ śaraṇaṃ ca
yat tad bhūyate dravyeṇa tasya sarvagatatvaṃ nityatvaṃ cotsargaḥ, bhūtābhūtabhedātmakastasyaivāpavādaḥ, tasya ca vidhānam, ityeṣa ubhayavidhirna bhavati
etaccāyuktam, ubhayoranyatarasya vā niṣedhe pramāṇābhāvāt, jñānābhidhānayoḥ pramāṇayordvirūpārthaviṣayatvādasadviṣayayoraprāmāṇyāt
nanvevaṃ tathārthasthitisatyatvāt sarvavādanāthānekāntavādāśrayaṇaṃ kṛtam, tadatatsamarthavikalpatvāt, ekapuruṣapitṛputrādivat
na ca tena saha kasyacid virodhaḥ, tasmādayamārādhyaḥ śaraṇaṃ ca
yat tad bhūyate dravyeṇa tasya sarvagatatvaṃ nityatvaṃ cotsargaḥ, bhūtābhūtabhedātmakastasyaivāpavādaḥ, tasya ca vidhānam, ityeṣa ubhayavidhirna bhavati
tataḥ kim ? iti cet, ucyate --nanvevaṃ tathārthasthitisatyatvāt sarvavādanāthānekāntavādāśrayaṇaṃ kṛtam tvayā iti vākyaśeṣaḥ

kutaḥ ? tadatatsamarthavikalpatvāt, tasmiṃścātasmiṃśca vikalpe samarthatvāt, kāraṇe kāryaṃ sadananyat, asadanyat iti vā pakṣe samartho vikalpo'syeti anantaroktavikalādeśahetudvayasamāhāraikarūpo'yaṃ hetuḥ pakṣadvayasādhanasamarthaḥ

ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? ekapuruṣapitṛputrādivat, yathaika eva puruṣo'pekṣāviśeṣopanītaiḥ pitṛputrabhrātṛbhāgineyamātulādibhiranyairanyo'nanyaśca tena tena prakāreṇa saṃścāsaṃśca kāraṇakāryanityānityādiparyāyārpaṇīyaśceti

na ca tena saha kasyacid virodhaḥ, tasmāt parityaktapakṣarāgairanabhiniviṣṭairātmahitagaveṣibhiḥ kuśalairanyathā hitaprāptyasambhavāt āśrayaṇīyaḥ iti paricchidyāyamārādhyaḥ śaraṇaṃ ca nayasamūhātmakatvādananyasādhāraṇotsāha-prabhu-mantraśaktiyuktabharatacakravartivad vijigīṣubhiriti
yadyasau sarvairārādhyaḥ śaraṇaṃ ca vādānāṃ kimarthaṃ vādibhiḥ saha vyudyate ? dṛṣṭaśca vivādaḥ, tasmād vivāditvāccheṣavādivadanārādhyo'śaraṇaṃ tavāpi ca darśanāt tena saheti
atrocyate--mama tena sahāvirodha eva tavāpi ca, kintu vayaṃ tvatpratipattyaikāntavastvanupapatterbrūmaḥ, vayaṃ tvadanugrahārthaṃ tvadanuśāsina iti na doṣaḥ
tavāpi ca tena saha virodhadarśanāt ityāśayaḥ
idānīṃ naigamanaya ubhayavidhirātmamatasvarūpaṃ vaktukāmaḥ paramataṃ prāgdūṣitaṃ pratyuccārayannitthamupasaṃharati — yat tad bhūyata ityādi

yat tad bhavati tena bhavatā yad bhūyate dravyeṇa tasya bhavanasāmānyaṃ kṣetrataḥ sarvagatatvaṃ kālato nityatvaṃ ca sarvātmakaṃ tasya utsarjanaṃ vidhānaṃ sa eva vidhiḥ prāguktaḥ, paścād dvitīyaḥ pravṛttyātmakabhūtābhūtabhedātmakastasyaivāpavādaḥ, tasya ca vidhānam ityeṣa ubhayavidhistvayeṣṭa eva na bhavati
ārabdhadravyaguṇānāṃ karmaṇaścānityatvāt prāguktebhyo dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ parasparataḥ svajātiprabhedebhyaśca kāraṇakāryatayā cānyatvamityapavādaḥ
kastarhīti cet, sattādravyatvādīti yāvad nityatvaṃ cotsarga iti
sattā mahāsāmānyam, dravyatvaṃ pṛthivyādiṣu sāmānyam, ādigrahaṇād guṇatvakarmatve ca rūpādigamanādiṣu ca sāmānyaviśeṣāstadbhedāḥ

gaganādīni ākāśātmadikkāladravyāṇi vibhaktasarvagatāni, dravyāṇāmeṣāṃ sarvavyāpitā sarvagatatvamaṇvādisahitanityatvaṃ ceti teṣāṃ dravyāṇāmaṇūnāṃ ca nityatvaṃ kālavyāpitā pārthivādicaturvidhāṇudravyāṇāṃ ceti
ādigrahaṇād manodravyasahitānāmiti vibhutvaparimaṇḍalatvādiguṇasahitānām, te ca guṇāstāni ca dravyāṇi nityānītyarthaḥ
atra vibhutvāt sarvagatāni iti pāṭhaḥ syāt

pārthivāpyataijasavāyavyaiścaturvidhairaṇubhiḥ saṃyogāpekṣaiḥ samānajātīyaiḥ samānajātīyāni dvyaṇukādīni tadādyuttaravṛddhyā mahāpṛthivyādiparyantāni ārabdhāni, dravyāṇi dve bahūni vā dravyāntarāṇyārabhante caturvidhānyeva, yeṣāmevādhikṛtamārambhasāmarthyaṃ tairārabdhe kāryadravye tatsamavetā niyamata eva guṇāśca guṇāntaramārabhante iti vacanāccitrādaya ārabdhaguṇāḥ, teṣāmubhayeṣāmārabdhadravyāṇāmārabdhaguṇānāṃ cānityatvāt prāguktebhyo viśeṣaḥ tathā karmaṇaśca saprabhedasya

evaṃ tāvad nityānityasarvagatāsarvagatabhedenānyatvam, punaśca dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ parasparataḥ dravyebhyo guṇānāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca guṇebhyo dravyāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca karmabhyo dravyāṇāṃ guṇānāṃ ca parasparata iti svajātiprabhedebhyaścānyatvam, dravyajāteḥ parasparataḥ pṛthivyā udakādibhyaḥ udakasya pṛthivīsahitebhyo'nyebhyaḥ, evaṃ jvalanapavanagaganadikkālātmamanasāmitarebhyo'nyatvamiti sattāsamavāyasāmānyaviśeṣāntyaviśeṣebhyaścānyatvaṃ nityebhyo'nityānāṃ cetyapavādaḥ, tathā kāraṇakāryatayā ca, dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ dravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyam vai॰ sū॰ 1
17 ityādi saṃyogavibhāgāḥ karmaṇāṃ kāryam vai॰ sū॰ 1
dravyāṇi dve bahūni vā ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
samavāyikāraṇāni dravyāṇi svātmavyatiriktaṃ kāryadravyamārabhante, ākāśādyantyāvayavidravyāṇi tu dravyaṃ nārabhante, tulyajātīyānāṃ mūrtikriyārūpādimatāṃ dvayorbahūnāṃ vā kāraṇānā kāryārambhakatvāt
9, guṇau ca guṇāśceti pūrvavat, yathā tanturūpādayaḥ svāśrayasamavete paṭadravye rūpādiguṇānātmavyatiriktānārabhante
iti candrānandaviracitāyāṃ vaiśeṣikasūtravṛttau P pṛ॰ 7 B
॰ścānyat nityebhyo nityānāṃ cetyapavādaḥ tayoḥ kāraṇakāryatayā ca pra॰
vaidharmyāntaramapi — dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ dravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyam vai॰ sū॰ 1
17, sāmānyaśabdaḥ samānaparyāyaḥ, kṣityādīni trayāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ samānam, ākāśādīnāṃ kevalaguṇakāraṇatve'pi ekaikasyānekaguṇatvādākāśādīni samānaṃ guṇeṣu kāraṇam, mano'ntyāvayavidravye guṇakarmaṇām

1 iti vākyebhyaḥ saṃyoga eva dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ samānaṃ kāraṇaṃ nānyo guṇaḥ, tathāhi--tūlapiṇḍasya vegavatā tūlena saṃyogāt karma, dvitūlakadravyam, tatra ca parimāṇaṃ mahadutpadyate'nye guṇā yathāyogam
19, svāśrayamanyato vibhajya āśrayāntareṇa saṃyojayati ataḥ saṃyogavibhāgānāṃ samānaṃ kāraṇaṃ karma
20, yadi khalu dravyasya kāraṇaṃ karma bhavet tathā sati kṛtvāpi saṃyogaṃ na nivarteta, nivṛtte tu karmaṇi kevalasya saṃyogasyopalambhāt manyāmahe na dravyakāraṇaṃ karma
21, gurutvadravatvanodanābhighātasaṃyuktasaṃyogāḥ svāśraye parāśraye ca karmakāraṇam, prayatnādṛṣṭau tu parāśraye eva
tatra tāvat karma na svāśraye karmakāraṇam, niṣkriyadravyānupalabdhiprasaṅgāt
aparaṃ vaidharmyam — dravyāṇāṃ dravyaṃ kāryaṃ sāmānyam vai॰ sū॰ 1
22, sajātīyānāṃ dvayorbahūnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dravyaṃ tantūnāmiva paṭaḥ samānaṃ kāryam
dvitvaprabhṛtayaśca saṅkhyāḥ pṛthaktvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgāśca vai॰ sū॰ 1
asamavāyāt sāmānyaṃ karma kāryaṃ na vidyate vai॰ sū॰ 1
24, anekasmin dravye ekasya karmaṇaḥ samavāyaniṣedhād na dravyāṇāṃ dvibahūnāṃ karma samānaṃ kāryamasti
25, dvayorbahūnāṃ vā asamavāyikāraṇānāṃ saṃyogānāṃ dravyaṃ samānaṃ kāryam, tantusaṃyogānāmiva paṭaḥ
26, dvayorbahūnāṃ vā kāraṇarūpāṇāṃ kāryadravyāśritaṃ rūpaṃ samānaṃ kāryaṃ yathā ghaṭarūpaṃ kapālarūpāṇām, evaṃ rasādīnām
27, ādityaraśmīnāmagurutvāt parvate tathābhūtaprayatnābhāvāt loṣṭasya ca hastenāsaṃyuktatvādanutkṣepaṇamiti gurutvādīnāmutkṣepaṇaṃ samānaṃ kāryam
28, ubhayakarmajā ye saṃyogā vibhāgāśca te karmaṇāṃ samānaṃ kāryam
29 iti yasmin prakaraṇe dravyādīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ samānaṃ varṇitaṃ tasmin kāraṇasāmānye dravyakarmaṇāṃ yataḥ karmākāraṇamuktamatastānyapyasya kāryaṃ sāmānyaṃ na bhavantīti
iti candrānandaviracitāyāṃ vaiśeṣikasūtravṛttau P pṛ॰ 8 B--9 B
kriyā hi prāgabhūtanirvṛttyarthā anekadravyatāyāṃ bhavati, adṛṣṭavaśādaṇuṣu karma-

yadapyuktaṃ tvayā yathābhūtasannihitavastuśaktivyaktiḥ kriyā dravyābhede sarvabhedaprabhedanirbhedaṃ bījaṃ dravyam iti ca tanna bhavati, yasmāt kriyā hi prāgabhūtanirvṛttyarthā, jagatpralayakāle ca kā tvadiṣṭavyāpāralakṣaṇā kriyā madiṣṭādṛṣṭacoditāṇugatakarmaṇyasati ? sā hyadṛṣṭacoditāṇukarmajanitā dharmanirvṛttyarthā jagatsṛṣṭyarthā ca syāt, karmaiva ca naḥ kriyā, na hi sā nirvṛttameva nirvartayituṃ krīḍitamevāstu iti nirarthakaṃ vā pravartate

sā cānekadravyatāyāṃ satyāṃ bhavati, anekadravyatvaṃ cādṛṣṭacoditāṇukarma antareṇa na bhavitumarhati, kasmāt ? adṛṣṭavaśādaṇuṣu karmasambhavād dvyaṇukādyanekadravyotpatteḥ tatsamavāyācca, tataścānekāṇukṛtāgnyūrdhvajvalanādilokasthitikarasarvakāryopapatteḥ naikasya kasyacit khavad nityasya kriyāsti
bhedabījamātradravyaśaktivyaktau vā na kaścidupakāro'styasya jagataḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? yasmāduktam --aṇumanasoścādyaṃ karmetyadṛṣṭakāritam vai॰ sū॰ 5
na cedetadevamiṣyate yadā adṛṣṭaparigṛhīteṣvaṇuṣu karma na sambhavād dvyaṇukādyanekadravyotpatteḥ
na cedetadevamiṣyate tadā caikyena tadekaṃ dravyaṃ niṣkriyatvānna kiñcidārabheta, tataśca tadapi na bhavedeva karma, dvyaṇukādyanekadravyadravyābhūteḥ kriyānirviṣayataiva syāt

ārabdhadravyabhūtāvapi ca tadabhāvāllakṣaṇā- bhavati tadā caikyena stimitagaganavat tadekaṃ dravyaṃ niṣkriyatvād na kiñcidārabheta, tataścārambhābhāvāt tadapi na bhavedeva karma, karma hyārambhasvarūpaṃ kalpyate, tasya svarūpābhāvāt khapuṣpavadabhāvaḥ, tadabhāvād dvyaṇukādyanekadravyaṃ dravyaṃ na bhavet, tadabhūteḥ kriyānirviṣayataiva syāt, yadyanekadravyaviṣayā na bhavati ārambhābhāvādanekadravyatvānupapattereva aṇvākāśādyekadravyaviṣayāpi na bhavatyeva sā tvadiṣṭā asmadiṣṭakarmavilakṣaṇā teṣāṃ nityaikastimitagaganavadārambhābhāvāt, aguṇavato dravyasya guṇārambhāt karmaguṇā aguṇā akriyāścāsmanmatena tvanmatenāpi guṇādīnāṃ kriyātvāt kriyāyāśca dravyapradhānāyā niṣkriyatvādeveti kriyānirviṣayatā suṣṭhūcyate
atra yathāśabdaprayogo'pi sādhuriti pratīyate, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 418 paṃ॰ 5
yathā nodanābhighātasaṃyuktasaṃyogādṛṣṭebhyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ karma tathā tejaso vāyośca, etadaniyataṃ karma
niyataṃ tu --agnerūrdhvajvalanaṃ vāyośca tiryakpavanamaṇumanasoścādyaṃ karmetyadṛṣṭakāritāni vai॰ sū॰ 5

14, agneravasthāne tiryag vā gamane pacyamānasyābhasmībhāvaḥ syādapāṃvādapākāt ?, tathā vāyoratiryaggamane pūyamānadravyāṇāṃ pavanābhāvaḥ agneścāprabodhaḥ, vinaṣṭaśarīrāṇāmātmaṇāṃ sargādau pṛthivyādiparamāṇuṣvādyaṃ parasparopasarpaṇakarma na syāt, tathā labdhabhūmīnāṃ yogināṃ kalpānte abhisandhāya prayatnena manaḥ śarīrād vyatiricyāvatiṣṭhamānānāṃ sargādau navaśarīrasambandhāya manasa ādyaṃ karma na bhavet adṛṣṭādṛte
tasmādagnerūrdhvajvalanaṃ vāyośca tiryakpavanamaṇūnāṃ copasarpaṇakarma manasaścādyaṃ karma etāni prāṇināmadṛṣṭena kṛtāni
hastakarmaṇā manasaḥ karma vyākhyātam vai॰ sū॰ 5
15, yathātmasaṃyogaprayatnābhyāṃ haste karma tathātmamanaḥsaṃyogāt prayatnācca manasaḥ karma, etat sadehasya karma, tatra jāgrata icchādveṣapūrvakāt prayatnāt prabodhakāle tu jīvanapūrvakāt
yataḥ saṃyogo yogaḥ sa ca karmakāryaḥ ato yogāṅgaṃ karma, yogamokṣau ca karmādhikāre'pyucyete --ātmendriyamano'rthasannikarṣāt sukhaḥdukhe tadanārambhaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 5
16, yato hetorātmendriyamano'rthasannikarṣo jñānakāraṇatvena sukhaduḥkhe janayati atastadanārambhaḥ tasya sannikarṣasyānārambho'nutpattirucyata iti
tathāhi --ātmasthe manasi śarīrasya sukhaduḥkhābhāvaḥ sa yogaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 5

17, yadā hi ātmani mano'vasthitaṃ nendriyeṣu tadā catuṣṭayasannikarṣasyānārambhāt tatkāryayoḥ sukhaduḥkhayorabhāvarūpo vidyamānaśarīrasyātmano vāyunigrahāpekṣa ātmano manasā saṃyogo yogaḥ, yogāṅgaṃ prāṇāyāmakarma kiṃ noktam ? kāyakarmaṇā ātmakarma vyākhyātam vai॰ sū॰ 5
18 iha ātmaśabdena vāyuḥ, yathā ātmasaṃyogaprayatnābhyāṃ haste karma tathātmavāyusaṃyogāt prayatnācca prāṇāyāmakarma

19, maraṇakāle pūrvaśarīrād manaso niḥsaraṇamapasarpaṇam, śarīrāntareṇābhisambandho manasa upasarpaṇam, śukraśoṇitāt prabhṛti garbhasthasya mātrā upayuktenānnapānena nāḍyānupraviṣṭena sambandho'śitapītasaṃyogaḥ, kalalārbudamāṃsapeśīghanaśarīrādibhirekasminneva saṃsāre ye sambandhāste kāryāyā ?ntarasaṃyogāḥ, te tānyapasarpaṇādīni adṛṣṭainaiva kriyante, na prayatnena
tadabhāve saṃyogābhāvo'prādurbhāvaḥ sa mokṣaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 5
20, evaṃrūpasya anādyapasarpaṇādinimittasya adṛṣṭasyābhāve jīvanākhyasya ātmamanaḥsaṃyogasyābhāvo'nyasya ca śarīrasyāprādurbhāvo yaḥ sa mokṣaḥ
tamovṛttata ? tvāt sarvasya jñānānutpattau tamo hetuḥ, tat punaḥ dravyaguṇakarmavaidharmyād bhā'bhāvamātraṃ bhā'bhāvaḥ T tamaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 5
21, vināśitvena nityairdravyairvaidharmyādamūrtatvāsparśatvaprakāśavirodhairanityadravyairvaidharmyānna dravyaṃ tamaḥ, na ca guṇaḥ karma vā āśrayānupalabdheḥ
kuta etat ? tejaso dravyāntareṇāvaraṇācca vai॰ sū॰ 5
22, tejasaḥ savitṛprakāśāderbahiḥsadbhāvāt parvataguhādau ca dravyāntareṇāvṛte abhāvād manyāmahe--tejaso'bhāvamātraṃ tama iti
bāhyaṃ pradīpādinivartyam, avidyātmakaṃ tu jñānajyotiṣā, ityuktau yogamokṣau
iti candrānandaviracitāyāṃ vaiśeṣikasūtravṛttau P pṛ॰ 21 B--22 B
na cedetadevamiṣyate tadā caikyena tadekaṃ dravyaṃ niṣkriyatvānna kiñcidārabheta, tataśca tadapi na bhavedeva karma, dvyaṇukādyanekadravyadravyābhūteḥ kriyānirviṣayataiva syāt
evaṃ tāvat kriyā dravyaṃ nārabhata ityuktam
idānīṃ tvadiṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ ca bhavye pā॰ 5
104 rambhānārambhādibhedāccānyatvādevānyatvam, guṇakarmaṇāṃ tadabhūteḥ dravyebhyo viśeṣaḥ bhavatyeva bhavati dravyam ityayuktamiti vakṣyāmaḥ
katham ? abhyupetyāpyārabdhadravyaṃ kāraṇe kāryasyāsattvād varṇitavarṇitopapattivat kāraṇadravyebhyo'nyatvāt kāryadravyāṇāṃ na hi tadeva dravyaṃ bhavatīti
athavāyamapyapavādavidhiḥ --ārabdhadravyabhūtāvapi ca pūrvadravyebhyaḥ kāraṇabhūtebhyaḥ kāryabhūtānāmanyatvād guṇakarmatvādinā tasyaiva vā'bhāvād dravyasyeti
15 ityādi guṇalakṣaṇam, ekadravyādi karmalakṣaṇam, itthaṃ lakṣaṇabhedād nānaiva dravyaguṇakarmāṇīti

dravyeṣvapyanārambhakebhyo gaganādibhyaḥ pṛthivyādyārambhakanānātvam, guṇānāmapi saṃyogavibhāgarūpādīnāmārambhakāṇāṃ vibhutvādyanārambhakebhyo nānātvam, karmaṇo'vayavidravyasaṃyogavibhāgārambhiṇo'nārambhakebhyo bhedaḥ, tadabhāvāt
guṇakarmaṇāṃ tadabhūteriti dravyameva dravyaṃ bhavati, na guṇā na karmāṇi, guṇānāmaguṇākarmatvāt karmaṇaścāguṇākarmatvād dravyebhyo viśeṣaḥ
anāra anārabhyatvācca śabdasyetarebhyo viśeṣaḥ sāmānyādīnāṃ ca
yaducyate yadayaṃ bhavati svayameva yadanena bhūyate sa evāsya bhāva iti naiṣa bhāvaḥ
anyenānyena bhūyate so'nya evāsya bhāvaḥ yena ca bhūyate so'pi cāsya bhāvaḥ
bhāve'pyubhayatā ubhayotsargāt, dvividho hi bhāvaḥ--svabhāvaḥ saṃbandhaśca

bhyatvāccākāśaguṇasya śabdasyetarebhyo viśeṣaḥ sāmānyādīnāṃ ceti sāmānyasya sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāmantyaviśeṣāṇāṃ cetarebhyo'nārabhyatvāt, samavāyasya cāśrayitve satyapi parasparataśca svāśrayasya svānurūpapratyayādhānahetutvādityevamādiviśeṣahetusadbhāvāt sarvamanyadeva
vaidharmyāntaramapi --kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇamiti dravyalakṣaṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1
14, utkṣepaṇādikaṃ karma kriyā yathāsambhavaṃ yasmin samavāyena vartate tat kriyāvat anyatrākāśakāladigātmabhyaḥ
guṇā rūpādayo yatra yathāsambhavaṃ vartante tad guṇavat, ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānāmiheti yataḥ sa samavāyaḥ, sa yasyāsti tat samavāyi, kāraṇaṃ ca tadaideva, samavāyino vā kāryasya kāraṇam
tatra kṣityādīni trayāṇāṃ dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ samavāyikāraṇam, ākāśādīni guṇānām, mano'ntyāvayavidravye guṇakarmaṇām
dravyāśrayī aguṇavān saṃyogavibhāgeṣvakāraṇamanapekṣa iti guṇalakṣaṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1

15, dravyamāśrayatīti dravyāśrayī, aguṇavān nirguṇaḥ, saṃyogavibhāgeṣvakāraṇamanapekṣa iti sāpekṣakāraṇam, tathāhi--aṅgulyorākāśasaṃyogo dvyaṅgulākāśasaṃyoge kartavye dvyaṅgulotpattimapekṣate, aṅgulyoḥ parasparavibhāgo dvyaṅgulākāśavibhāgaṃ prati kāryavināśamapekṣate, evaṃ saṃyogavibhāgavibhāgalakṣaṇa eva guṇaḥ saṃyogavibhāgeṣu sāpekṣaḥ kāraṇam
ekadravyamaguṇaṃ saṃyogavibhāgeṣu anapekṣaṃ kāraṇamiti karmalakṣaṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1

16, ekamasya karmaṇo dravyamāśrayaḥ, na dve, ekameva vā-dravye vartata ityekadravyam, nāsya guṇāḥ santītyaguṇam, saṃyogavibhāgeṣu kāryeṣu svasyāśrayasya anyato vibhajyāśrayāntareṇa saṃyojanādutpādyādyavināśyānapekṣayā saṃyogavibhāgeṣvanapekṣaṃ kāraṇamiti
vaidharmyāntaramāha --kāryāvirodhi dravyaṃ kārāṇāvirodhi ca vai॰ sū॰ 1

11, vināśo virodhaḥ pratibandhaḥ, kvacit dravyādinā kāryeṇa kāraṇadravyaṃ samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇābhyāṃ ca na virudhyate, tathāhi--aṅgulidravyaṃ kāryaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ janayiṣyat tadarthena karmaṇā tatkṛtena saṃyogena tato jātena dvyaṅgulena na virudhyate nāpi samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇābhyāṃ parva-tatsaṃyogābhyāṃ vā, mano'ntyāvayavidravyāṇi guṇakarmabhiḥ kāryaiḥ ākāśādīni guṇaiḥ, nityatvādeṣāṃ na kāraṇaḥṇa ? ṇaiḥ ?virodhaḥ

12, kāryakāraṇobhayānubhayairavirodhī virodhī ca paramāṇudvyaṇukādyantyāvayavidravyeṣu rūpādayaḥ kāraṇairavirodhinaḥ yathāsambhavaṃ rūparasagandhasparśā akāryakāraṇabhūtā avirodhinaḥ paraspareṇa virodhina ādyamadhyāntyaśabdāḥ kāryobhayakāraṇaiḥ, adṛṣṭaḥ kāryeṇa, sparśavaddravyasaṃyogena vegaprayatnau, saṃyogavibhāgau sukhaduḥkhe icchādveṣau parasparato'kāryakāraṇabhūtau virudhyete, jñānaṃ saṃskārasantānapratipakṣaiḥ saṃskāro jñānamadaduḥkhādibhiriti yathāsambhavametad draṣṭavyam
13, saṃyogavibhāgasaṃskārāṇāṃ kāryāṇāṃ madhyāt saṃyogenaiva karma virudhyate, na vibhāgasaṃskārābhyāṃ saṃyogānutpattiprasaṅgāt
iti candrānandaviracitāyāṃ vaiśeṣikasūtravṛttau P pṛ॰ 7 B--8 A
yaducyate yadayaṃ bhavati svayameva yadanena bhūyate sa evāsya bhāva iti naiṣa bhāvaḥ
anyenānyena bhūyate so'nya evāsya bhāvaḥ yena ca bhūyate so'pi cāsya bhāvaḥ
bhāve'pyubhayatā ubhayotsargāt, dvividho hi bhāvaḥ--svabhāvaḥ saṃbandhaśca

sa ca dravyādibhyaḥ padārthāntaraṃ bhāvavallakṣaṇabhedāt, yathā bhāvasya dravyatvādīnāṃ svādhāreṣu ātmānurūpapratyayakartṛtvāt svāśrayādibhyaḥ parasparataścārthāntarabhāvaḥ tathā samavāyasyāpi pañcasu padārtheṣu iha iti pratyayadarśanāt tebhyaḥ padārthāntaratvamiti

tataḥ kim ? tatastvaduktadravyasvarūpalakṣaṇabhavanānupapattiḥ, sarvaprabhedanirbhedaṃ bījaṃ dravyam, tasyaiva dravyasya tathābhūtasannihitaśaktivyaktirbhāvaḥ ityevaṃsvarūpalakṣaṇasya bhavanasyānupapattiḥ, dravyabhavanabhinnabhavanātmakatvād guṇādīnāṃ dravyāntarāṇāṃ sattāsamāvāyādyāśritapadārthānāṃ ca
itiśabdo hetvarthe, tasmāt kāraṇādubhayasyāpi sāmānyasya dravyabhavanasyaikarūpasyotsargasya kriyābhavanasya cāpavādasya bhūtābhūtādibhedasyābhāvaḥ
kathaṃ tarhi tayorbhāva iti cet, ucyate--dravyādiṣaḍbhedasya saprabhedasyaiva pṛthakpṛthaksvarūpasyaiva viśeṣadharmakasya bhāvaḥ
āśritatvaṃ cānyatra nityadravyebhyaḥ praśastapā॰ bhā॰, āśritatvaṃ ca paratantratayopalabdhiḥ, na samavāyalakṣaṇā vṛttiḥ samavāye tadabhāvāt
idaṃ cāśritatvaṃ caturvidheṣu paramāṇuṣu ākāśakāladigātmamanaḥsu nāstītyata āha--anyatra nityadravyebhya iti

yadapi ca tat svasanmātraṃ svarūpasattvaṃ tadapi nātmanaiva, yaducyate--yadayaṃ bhavati svayamevārthāntaranirapekṣaṃ svatantram, vibhaktyantareṇa tadeva vyaktīkaroti --yadanena bhūyate iti, svabhāvasambandha ityarthaḥ, ayaṃ tvayeṣṭaḥ sa evāsya bhāva iti, naiṣa punarbhāvo bhavati
kastarhi ? anyenānyena bhūyate'nyāpekṣeṇa ca tathā tadbhinnena so'nya evāsya bhāvo bhāvaḥ
yena ca bhūyate so'pi cāsya bhāvaḥ, sadvyapadeśārhasya dravyādeḥ sato'pi bhāvaḥ, na kevalaṃ sattaiva, yatsambandhād bhavati iti bhavati sāpi sattā bhāvaḥ sacca dravyādi bhavatītyarthaḥ
atra 2 ca tathā ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt, tathā ca anyāpekṣeṇa anyāpekṣeṇa ca tathā ityapi pāṭhaścintyaḥ
bhāve'pyubhayatā ubhayotsargāt, sattāyāmapi ubhayatā sāmānyaviśeṣatā, sotsṛjyate niyamyate ca, so'pi hyutsṛjyate ca bhāvaḥ sarvagataḥ iti, niyamyate svagata eva iti
