sattāntarasambandhanirapekṣasadbhāve'sati mā bhūt sambandhānavasthā, dvividho hi bhāva iti sarvasya vastuna utsargāpavādau pṛthak svabhāvaḥ svarūpasattā, sambandhaḥ sambandhasattā yatsambandhād dravyaguṇakarmasu saditi bhavati
na tu bhavatyeva bhāvaḥ san, dravyaguṇakarmavat sattāsvatattvāsamavāyāt
daṇḍavattu arthāntarāpekṣatvād dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ sattādisambandhānurūpapratyayahetutvaṃ sāmānyādīnām, na tvagṛhīte viśeṣaṇe viśeṣye buddhiranupravartate
tadvyākhyā --svabhāvaḥ sambandhaścetyādi gatārthaṃ yāvad dravyaguṇakarmasu sat iti bhavati, svarūpasattā nārthāntaramapekṣate sambandhasattā tvapekṣata ityarthaḥ
svabhāvaḥ svarūpasattā, sambandhaḥ sambandhasattā yatsambandhād dravyaguṇakarmasu saditi bhavati
na tu bhavatyeva bhāvaḥ san, dravyaguṇakarmavat sattāsvatattvāsamavāyāt
daṇḍavattu arthāntarāpekṣatvād dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ sattādisambandhānurūpapratyayahetutvaṃ sāmānyādīnām, na tvagṛhīte viśeṣaṇe viśeṣye buddhiranupravartate
daṇḍavattu arthāntarasambandhānurūpapratyayanimittatvād viśeṣaṇānāṃ sattādisambandhānurūpapratyayahetutvaṃ sāmānyādīnām, na tvagṛhīte viśeṣaṇe viśeṣye buddhiranupravartate ityapi mūlapāṭhaḥ sambhavet

na tu bhāvaḥ sattā san, dravyaguṇakarmavat sanna bhavati sadbhāvasāmānye'pi bhāvānāṃ pratisvaṃ svabhāvabhedāt, dravyaguṇakarmasadvaidharmyāt sanna bhavati na dravyaṃ bhavati na ghaṭādirbhavati, dravyatvaghaṭatvādisambaddhadravyādighaṭādivad na sa dravyādi bhavatītyarthaḥ

kiṃ kāraṇam ? sattāsvatattvāsamavāyāt, sattāsamavāyo dravyatva-guṇatva-karmatva-ghaṭatvādisvatattvasamavāyo vā sattāyā yato nāsti, te hi dravyādayaḥ sattāsvatattvasamavāyāt saddravyaghaṭādivyapadeśārhā bhavantīti

eṣo'pi viśeṣaḥ kimarthaṃ sattāsvatattvasamavāyād dravyādi sad bhavati na punardravyādisamavāyāt sattādisvatattvāni dravyādīni bhavanti iti cet, ucyate--svarūpasattayā satāmapi sāmānya-sāmānyaviśeṣa-viśeṣa-samavāyānāmasattvāt svasadbhāvādeva satāṃ sambandhasadbhāvaśūnyānāṃ sattādīnāmitarebhyo viśeṣaḥ, sa tu sambaddhadravyādīnāmastīti darśayati --daṇḍavat tvarthāntaretyādi gatārthaṃ yāvad viśeṣye buddhiranupravartate iti

viśeṣaṇasvarūpapratyayanimittatvād viśeṣaṇānāṃ sattādisambandhānurūpapratyayahetutvaṃ sāmānyādīnāṃ svāśrayeṣu daṇḍanimittadaṇḍipratyayavat dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ na tvagṛhīte viśeṣaṇe, śvaityādiviśeṣapratyayasya evameva hyubhayasyaivobhayaprādhānyasyāpi vidhiḥ, na tu dravyakriyayoḥ ubhayaprādhānyābhāvāt tathābhūtārthaviṣayatvāt sannidhānasya vyakterapi tadbhavanatantratvāt

evameva hyubhayasyaivobhayaprādhānyasyāpi vidhiryathāsmābhiruktaḥ tathaiva sāmānyasya viśeṣasya ca vidhiḥ sambhavati, atyantaviśeṣarūpatvāt padārthaṣaṭkabhedānām, tathā sāmānyaviśeṣadvayavidhirapi bhavitumarhati, na tu pūrvanayeṣṭo dravyakriyayoḥ, ubhayaprādhānyābhāvādasvātantrye kartṛtvābhāvāditi

asmābhistvadanukampayā abhyupagate'pi kartṛtve svatantrabhavanātmake dravyasyaiva prādhānyamiti tadvidhānāt kriyāyāḥ prādhānyāvidhānāt, bhaved dravyaṃ kartṛ svātantryāt, na kriyā prādhānyābhāvāt ityevaṃ yuktyā prāpte'pi tvadanukampayā tayoḥ kartṛtve vābhyupagate'pi na bhavitumarhati ubhayaprādhānyābhāvādityarthaḥ

kiṃ kāraṇamubhayaprādhānyaṃ nāsti iti cet, ucyate --tathābhūtārthaviṣayatvāt sannidhānasya, dravyaṃ hi sannihitabhavanamiṣyate tathātathābhavadbhāvābhimukhasannihitaghaṭādibhavanagehavat, gehasannihitaghaṭavat sarvathā teṣāṃ kriyāvyaṅgyābhimatānāṃ dravye sannidhānābhyupagamāt pradīpeneva gehe sannihitānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ kriyayā na kiñcit prayojanam, sambhāvyamānamapi prayojanamabhivyaktimātraṃ syāt, tasyā vyakterapi tadbhavanatantratvāt dravyabhavanasyaiva pradhānasyopakāramātrārthatvād vyakteraprādhānyamiti
tuśabdo viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, evaṃ hyasau viśiṣṭārthādhikārāparityāgenaiva sāmānyaviśeṣayorvidhiriti

kīdṛśa iti cet, tannidarśayati --ārabdhānārabdhetyādi saprabhedasaṭpadārthaparasparānyatvapradarśanārtho grantho yāvat karmaṇi tu svabhāvasambandhasadbhāvābhyāmiti prāyo gatārthaḥ, tathāpi kiñciducyate--pārthivādiparamāṇudvyaṇukādyārabdhānāmapi svabhāvabhedād deśakālābhede'pi nānātvam, paramāṇvākāśādīnāmanārabdhānāṃ ca tata eva, bhāvasambandhābhivyaṅgyābhede'pi sati ārabhyāṇāṃ ca kādācitkatvāditareṣāṃ nityatvād viśeṣaḥ
bhāvasattvasya sattāsattvasya svabhāvasadbhāve'pi viśeṣaḥ, kasmāt ? atyantavyañjanasvātantryāt, itare vyajyante sa tu vyanaktyeveti
anyathābhūteḥ, evamanyena prakāreṇa bhavanāt sarvatra sannihitameva bhavati ityabhāvāt anyathābhūteriti
yadyevaṃ bhāvavyañjanāsvātantrye satyeva na syāt, naiva syāt sattā sambandharahitatvāt khapuṣpavat, bhāvo hi sadbhāvasadvyañjanasvātantryābhāvāt khapuṣpavad na syāditi
etānyapi dravyāṇi itaretarābhāvātmanā na santi, asatāmeva kāladigātmamanodravyāṇāmitaretarāsatāmeva bhāvādisambandhāt tathā tathānyatā, anyatve eva asati sattvam
na cāsyānyasmāt sadabhidhānapratyayau svaparaprakāśahetutvāt pradīpavat, svasadbhāvena sata evāsattvaṃ sambandhasadbhāvābhāvāt, aguṇaguṇavat
kiñcit tu bhavatyeva bhavati paramāṇvākāśakāladigātmamano- sattāsambandhāt sattvaṃ bhavati dravyatvasambandhād dravyatvaṃ bhavati
tataśca sattāto dravyatvāccānyonyataśca tena tena prakāreṇānyatā, anyatva evetaretarāsatāṃ bhāvādisambandhādanyatva eva asati sattvamanyatva eveti
evaṃ bhāvo'satāṃ sambandhāt sattvaṃ janayati dravyādīnāmityuktam, tathā kiṃ bhāvasya sambandho'nyena janyate ? netyatrocyate --na cāsyetyādi

sa hi svayaṃ sambandhādanyeṣāṃ sadabhidhānapratyayaheturnānyasmāt sadabhidhānapratyayau labhate, svaparaprakāśahetutvāt, pradīpavat, na hi pradīpo ghaṭādiprakāśanasamarthaḥ svaprakāśane ghaṭādīnapekṣate tathā sattāpi
tasmāt tasya svabhāvasadbhāvena sata evāsattvaṃ sambandhasadbhāvābhāvāt, netaretarāsattvāt, yathā guṇo'guṇaḥ iti nāsya guṇo'stītyaguṇa ucyate guṇaḥ, na tu guṇo na bhavatīti
evaṃ sāmānyaṃ sāmānyameveti gatārtham, evaṃ tāvat svata eva bhāvaḥ sattāntarānapekṣaḥ san

yo'pyasau svabhāvasadbhāvaḥ kāryadravyādīnāṃ parato bhāvasambandhādādheyastasmādevāsanniti na, kiṃ tarhi ? tanna bhavatīti bhavatyeva, abhūtvā bhāvāt bhūtvā cābhāvāt kāryasya svasadbhāvenaivāsat sad bhavati sadapyasad bhavatīti tasya svasadbhāvasya kāryasya sadasadbhāvadvairūpyaṃ tadatatsamarthavikalpatvāt, ekapuruṣapitṛputratvādivaditi bhāvitameva
idaṃ punarbhavatyeva bhavati svasadbhāvādeva nābhūtvā na sattāsambandhāt paramāṇvākāśakāladigātmamanodravyādi, ādigrahaṇāt samavāya dravyādi
karmaṇi tu svabhāvasadbhāvena karmatvasambandhasadbhāvena cetarebhyo bhedābhedau

evaṃ dravyaguṇayordravyatvaguṇatvasambandhasadbhāvāt svabhāvasadbhāvāccetyevamādisādharmyavaidharmyābhyāṃ ṣaṭsu padārtheṣu viśeṣā eva vaiśeṣikaṃ viśeṣaprayojanaṃ vā vaiśeṣikamiti vidhiniyamayorvidhirupapadyate, na tu tvadiṣṭaikavastuvidhiniyamavidhiriti
atra na saddravyādi ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atra viśeṣaḥ, sa tu sambandho dravyādīnāmastīti ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
buddhiridānīṃ nirūpyate --dravyeṣu jñānaṃ vyākhyātam vai॰ sū॰ 8
1, ṣaṇṇāṃ padārthānāṃ madhyād dravyeṣveva jñānaṃ vyākhyātam, yathotpadyate sannikarṣāt na tathā guṇādiṣu
tasya mana ātmā ca vai॰ sū॰ 8
2 mana ātmā ca jñānasya kāraṇaṃ vyākhyātam
idānīṃ guṇādiṣu jñānamāha --jñānanirdeśe jñānaniṣpattiruktā vai॰ sū॰ 8
yataḥ guṇakarmasu asannikṛṣṭeṣu jñānaniṣpatterdravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāraṇakāraṇaṃ ca vai॰ sū॰ 8

4, guṇakarmaṇāṃ yato dravyaṃ samavāyikāraṇaṃ tatasteṣu sākṣādindriyeṇa asannikṛṣṭeṣu vijñānaniṣpatteḥ kāraṇasya sannikarṣasya tadeva dravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ na guṇakarmāṇi, tasmād guṇakarmasu saṃyuktasamavāyaṃ jñānam, caśabdo hetau
sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu sāmānyaviśeṣābhāvāt tata eva jñānam vai॰ sū॰ 8
5, sāmānye sattādau viśeṣeṣu cāntyeṣu taddarśināṃ dravyasannikarṣādeva jñānamutpadyate, na sāmānyaviśeṣebhyaḥ teṣu tadabhāvāt
anyatra tu sāmānyaviśeṣāpekṣaṃ dravyaguṇakarmasu vai॰ sū॰ 8
6, dravyaguṇakarmasu dravyendriyasannikarṣāt sāmānyācca sādeḥsattādeḥ ? sāmānyaviśeṣācca dravyatvādeḥ saditi dravyamityādi ca jñānamutpadyata iti
iha sūtre sāmānyaṃ sattā, viśeṣā dravyatvādayaḥ, pūrvasūtre'nyathā
7, cakṣuḥsannikarṣād yajjñānaṃ dravye sāmānyaviśeṣāpekṣaṃ viṣāṇī iti, guṇāpekṣaṃ śuklaḥ iti, karmāpekṣaṃ gacchati ityutpadyata iti
dravyādīnāṃ ca viśeṣaṇatvāt pūrvamupalambhaḥ, tena viśeṣaṇabuddheḥ kāraṇatvaṃ viśeṣyabuddheḥ kāryatvam
guṇakarmasu guṇakarmābhāvād guṇakarmāpekṣaṃ na vidyate vai॰ sū॰ 8
8, guṇe guṇakarmaṇorabhāvāt karmaṇi ca guṇakarmanimittaṃ guṇakarmasu jñānaṃ na bhavatīti
dravyādau jñānasya pūrvotpattāvaniyamaḥ, yathā samavāyinaḥ śvaityācchvaityabuddheḥ śvete buddhiste kāryakāraṇabhūte vai॰ sū॰ 8
9, śvetaguṇasamavāyinaḥ śvetaśvaityasāmānyāt śvaityasāmānyajñānācca śvetaguṇajñānaṃ jāyate, sāmānyaguṇasambandho'pi draṣṭavyaḥ, ato viśeṣaṇabuddhiḥ kāraṇaṃ viśeṣyabuddhiḥ kāryam
10, aṇutvād manaso yaugapadyābhāvāt satyapi krame ghaṭapaṭajñānayorna kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvāyogāt
11, gauḥ śuklā gacchatīti ca dravyaguṇakarmasu jñānānāṃ krameṇāpi jāyamānānāṃ na kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatā'bhāvādityasya pūrvoktasya kāraṇasyāviśeṣāt
ato dravyajñānaṃ na guṇakarmabuddhyoḥ kāraṇam, guṇakarmabuddhī api na parasya kāraṇam
biśeṣaṇanyāyābhāve tu ayameṣa kṛtaṃ tvayā bhojayainamiti buddhyapekṣam vai॰ sū॰ 8
12, ayam iti sannikṛṣṭe eṣaḥ iti ca kiñcidviprakṛṣṭe pratyayaḥ, kṛtaṃ tvayā iti karmakartṛpratyayoyau, bhojayainam iti kartṛkarmapratyayau
sannikṛṣṭāpekṣo viprakṛṣṭe pratyayaḥ, kṛtam iti karmāpekṣaḥ kartari, bhojaya iti kartrapekṣakṣaḥ karmaṇi
kutaḥ sāpekṣā iti cet, dṛṣṭeṣu bhāvādadṛṣṭeṣvabhāvāt vai॰ sū॰ 8

itthamaṣṭāveva vākyavikalpā matabhedena sampadyante iti boddhavyam
yatpunaranena bhartṛhariṇā vṛttāvuktam udāharaṇamātrametat, anyānyapi vākyalakṣaṇāni darśayiṣyati iti tad vārtikakārīyavākyalakṣaṇāderantarbhāvamanapekṣyeti mantavyam
uddiṣṭānāṃ ca vākyalakṣaṇānāṃ yathānyāsamagre kārikābhireva darśitakrameṇa svarūpamunmīlayiṣyatīti nārtha iha tatpradarśanena
vākyalakṣaṇaprasaṅgena ca tathā vākyārthasya sambandhasya ca matabhedaṃ darśayiṣyati
tatrākhaṇḍapakṣe triṣvapi lakṣaṇeṣu pratibhā vākyārthaḥ, yathā darśayiṣyati vicchedagrahaṇe'rthānāṃ pratibhā'nyaiva jāyate
avaśiṣṭeṣu pañcasu lakṣaṇesu madhyādākhyātaśabdo vākyamityasmin pakṣe kriyā vākyārthaḥ, yathā vakṣyati kriyā kriyāntarād bhinnā vākyapa॰ 2
phalaṃ prasūyeta yataḥ sā kriyā vākyagocaraḥ
saṅghātapakṣe kramapakṣe ca saṃsargo vākyārthaḥ, sa ca sambandhe sati yat tvanyadādhikyamupajāyate
44 ityādinā prakārāntareṇābhihitānvayapakṣe pratipādyamāne kāryānumeyaḥ sambandho rūpaṃ tasya na vidyate
46 ityanena ślokena viśeṣaviśrāntaḥ padānāmevārtho vākyārtha iti lakṣyate
padamādyaṃ pṛthak sarvapadaṃ sākāṅkṣamityasmiṃstu pakṣadvaye saṃsṛṣṭa eva prathamataraṃ prakramyate vākyārthaḥ, yathā nirūpayiṣyati--teṣāṃ tu kṛtsno vākyārthaḥ pratibhedaṃ samāpyate
114 ityanena prayojanaṃ vākyārthatvena pradarśitam, tat keṣāñcid mate sarvalakṣaṇasādhāraṇamiti na prayojanaṃ vākyārtho vākyalakṣaṇeṣu pṛthag vibhajyate
tadevaṃ pratibhā, saṃsargaḥ, saṃsargavaśānnirākāṅkṣo viśeṣāvasthitaḥ padārtha eva, saṃsṛṣṭa evārthaḥ, kriyā, prayojanaṃ ca iti ṣaḍ vākyārthā ihopadarśitāḥ
saṃsarge saṃsargavaśād viśeṣāvasthite padārthe ca vākyārthe'bhihitānvayaḥ
pratibhāyāṃ tvekarasaiva pratipattiriti na tatra kācidabhihitānvayacarcā
vidhiniyogabhāvanāsaṃjñāstu vākyārthā na nirūpitāḥ, yasmād bhāvanākriyayoḥ paryāyatā prāyaśo lakṣyate, kevalaṃ prakṛtyarthapratyayārthatāyāmatra vaiyākaraṇamīmāṃsakayorvivādaḥ
kiñca, bhāvanā sakarmikaiva akarmikāpi kriyeti satyapi bhede sādhyatvāviśeṣādabheda evānayoḥ

yathā dhātvartharūpā kriyā sādhyabhūtaiva tathā bhāvanāpīti kathamavāntarabhedād bhedo'nayorbhavet ? vidhiniyogau tu liṅloṭkṛtyānteṣveva vākyeṣvarthāvityasarvaviṣayatvādanādṛtāviheti na tatpradarśanaṃ kṛtam

tattadanādivākyārthavikalpāhitavāsanāprabodhajanmā kramavadbhirivākramairbahīrūpatayā adhyastaiḥ padārthaiścitrīkṛta iva vikalpaviśeṣollikhyamāna ākāro bahīrūpatayā adhyasto nirvibhāga eva śākyānāṃ vākyārtha iti prāyaśaḥ pratibhāsodara evāsau mantavyaḥ

vākyamapi tattadanādivākyavikalpāhitavāsanāprabodhajanma kramavadbhirivākramaiḥ padaiścitrīkṛta iva bahīrūpatayā adhyasyamāno viśiṣṭavikalpollikhyamāna ākāraviśeṣa eva bahīrūpatayā adhyasta iti prāyaśo buddhyanusaṃhṛtirityasya sodarameveti na tanmatānusāreṇa vākyavākyārthayorihāsaṃgraho veditavyaḥ

naiyāyikādīnāṃ tu pūrvapūrvavarṇasmṛtisacivo'ntyo varṇo naśyadavasthānubhavaviṣayīkriyamāṇaḥ padaṃ yathā, tathaiva pūrvapūrvapadasmṛtisacivamantyameva padaṃ naśyadavasthānubhavaviṣayīkriyamāṇaṃ vākyamiti prāyaśaḥ saṅghātapakṣa evāntarbhavati
tathā pūrvapūrvapadārthasmaraṇasacivenāntyena padenopajanyamānā pratītirvākyārtha iti prāyaśaḥ saṃsargapakṣa evāsyāntarbhāva iti na tadasaṅgraheṇāvyāptiratra vaktavyā
athātrānavayave ekasmin sphoṭātmake vākye pratibhālakṣaṇe ca vākyārthe vākyavākyārthayoradhyāsarūpaḥ sambandhaḥ, tadvakṣyati— vākyavṛttasya vākyārthe vṛttiḥ vākyapa॰ 2
avaśiṣṭeṣu pakṣeṣu vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇo yogyatākhya eva śabdārthayoḥ sambandho mīmāṃsakadṛṣṭyā
śākyadarśanānusāreṇa tu vijñānavādanayena bauddhe śabdārthe sarvatra kāryakāraṇabhāva eva, bāhyārthavāde tu tatra saṅketalakṣaṇo'sau boddhavyaḥ
sambandheṣu madhyādatra adhyāsameva darśayiṣyati, padakāṇḍe tu sarvānabhidhāsyati

tatra vaiyākaraṇasyākhaṇḍa evaiko'navayavaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭalakṣaṇo vākyam, pratibhaiva vākyārthaḥ, adhyāsaśca sambandha iti padara ?vādipakṣadūṣaṇaparaḥ paraṃ ṭīkākāro vyavasthāpayatītyasya kāṇḍasya saṃkṣepaḥ
rataṇappabhā puḍhavī kiṃ sāsatā, asāsatā ? gotamā ! siyā sāsatā siyā asāsatā
se keṇaṭṭheṇaṃ bhaṃte ! evaṃ vuccati--siyā sāsatā siyā asāsatatti ? gotamā ! davvaṭṭhayāe sāsatā, vaṇṇapajjavehiṃ gaṃdhapajjavehiṃ rasapajjavehiṃ phāsapajjavehiṃ saṃṭhāṇapajjavehiṃ

pūrvaṃ pṛ॰ 3 paṃ॰ 14--16 nayacakravṛttikṛtā ullikhitaṃ jīvājīvābhigamasūtrapāṭhamanusṛtyaivātra ayaṃ mūlapāṭho nirdiṣṭaḥ, kintu atra asya nayasya yato nirgamastannirgamasūtram --imā ṇaṃ bhaṃte rataṇappabhetyādi yāvat saṃṭhāṇapajjavehiṃti iti nayacakravṛttau pāṭhadarśanāt davvaṭṭhayāe sāsatā, asāsatā vaṇṇapajjavehiṃ gaṃdhapajjavehiṃ rasapajjavehiṃ phāsapajjavehiṃ saṃṭhāṇapajjavehiṃ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
āhitabījāyāmiti, bījāni śaktayaḥ, tā ādhīyante tasyāṃ śaktidvāreṇa
dhvaninā saha iti, tasmin kāle śabdo'vadhāryata iti sambandhaḥ
āvṛttaparipākāyāmiti, āvṛttaḥ paripāko yasyā iti, paripākaḥ kāryotpādanaṃ prati viśiṣṭa ātmalābhaḥ
yataḥ pratidhvanivibhāgaṃ viśeṣapratipatteḥ tasya vṛttilābhaḥ, antyadhvanikāle cāvasthānāt kālāntarāvabhāso'pyasti
sa tu bījānāmapi paripāko buddheravyatirekād bījānāṃ buddhereva sambandhitvenopāttaḥ, na tu buddheḥ paripākaḥ
tathāhi--śaktayaścetaḥ saṃskurvanti viśiṣṭaṃ janayantīti saṃskāraśabdoktāḥ tadrūpabhāvanaṃ ca bhāvanā, yataścetanenākāreṇa bhāvayanti
tena saṃskāraścāsau bhāvanā ca bījaṃ ceti samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ
paricchedeti sphoṭaparicchedopāyāḥ saṃskārādayaḥ, teṣāṃ vṛttilābho viśiṣṭakāryonmukhatā
prāpteti, yogyataivātra paripākaḥ, sa prāpto yayā sphoṭaparicchedasamartheti yāvat
nādairdhvanibhirāhitabījāyām, āhitaṃ bhāvanābījaṃ yasyāṃ sā tathoktā
āvṛttaparipākāyāmiti, āvṛtto'bhyastaḥ paripāko yasyāḥ sā tathoktā, prathamena dhvaninā kiñcid bhāvanābījamāhitaṃ tena ca kaścit paripākaḥ kāryajananaśaktiviśeṣaḥ, evaṃ dvitīyeneti
yadyapi paripākā bhinnāstathāpi jātimāśritya āvṛttavāco yuktiḥ aṣṭakṛtvo brāhmaṇā bhuktavantaḥ itivat
āvṛttetyasya anyā vyākhyā--āvṛtto'vadhāraṇavighnabhūtasya rāgādikaṣayasya paripākaḥ paripācanaṃ yasyāmiti, āvṛttena vā āvṛttyā kaṣāyaparipāko yasyāmiti
buddhāvantaḥkaraṇe śabdo'vadhāryate antyena dhvaninā saha yadā antyo dhvaniravadhāryate tadā gauḥ ityevaṃ śabdo'pyavadhāryate ityarthaḥ
athavā antyena dhvaninā saha pūrvanādairāhitabījāyāṃ buddhau paścimadhvanyanantaraṃ śabdo'vadhāryate gaurityekaṃ padamiti, yadavadhāraṇaṃ samastavarṇaviṣayaṃ smaraṇamityācakṣate
paramārthatastu pratyakṣajñānamevaitat dhvanisaṃskṛtaśrotrendriyajanitatvāt, na hyanyathā sphuṭaprakāśa upapadyata iti
naitāḥ svamanīṣikā ucyante, kiṃ tarhi ? asya nayasya yato nirgamastannirgamasūtram--imā ṇaṃ bhaṃte rataṇappabhetyādi yāvat saṃṭhāṇapajjavehiṃti
etamevāgamaṃ bhedavacanāditi hetutvenāha nayacakrakāraḥ, asāsatā jīvājīvābhi॰ 3
varṇādiparyāyādiṣu varṇaḥ paryavaḥ samantād bhavitā ekavākyabhāvāt varṇasyaiva parito bhavanād gamanācca

paryāyaśabdasya parigamanārthasya paryavaśabdasya bhāvavācino grahaṇād varṇādiparigamanāni yasmin samantato bhāvo vā, avaterdhātorbhāvārthasya rakṣaṇādidaṇḍake pāṭhāt, varṇādaya eva paryāyāḥ paryavā iti karmadhārayo vā sarūpaikaśeṣatvāt saṅgṛhītasamāsadvayatvāt, samantād gamanatvāt samantād bhāvitvācca paryāyāṇāṃ paryavāṇāṃ ca, atra kenārthena paryāyaparyavārthayorekasyoktau dvitīyasyāpi saiva niruktiḥ ? iti manyamāna āha --varṇaḥ paryavaḥ samantād bhavitā ekavākyabhāvāt dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ saprabhedānāṃ sattāsamavāyasambandhapradhānānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭarūpāṇāmekavākyabhāvāditi, bahuvrīhiṃ darśayati --varṇasyaiva parito bhāvād gamanācceti
varṇādiparyāyādiṣu varṇaḥ paryavaḥ samantād bhavitā ekavākyabhāvāt varṇasyaiva parito bhavanād gamanācca
adhunopalabhyamāneṣu jīvājīvābhigamasūtragrantheṣu saṃṭhāṇapajjavehiṃ iti pāṭho nopalabhyate, kintu pūrvamavaśyamāsīt, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 3 paṃ॰ 16
adhunā tu adholikhitaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate--imā ṇaṃ bhaṃte
rayaṇappabhā puḍhavī kiṃ sāsayā asāsayā ? goyamā ! siya sāsatā siya asāsayā
se keṇaṭṭheṇaṃ bhaṃte ! evaṃ vuccai siya sāsayā siya asāsayā ? goyamā ! davvaṭṭhayāe sāsatā, vaṇṇapajjavehiṃ gaṃdhapajjavehiṃ rasapajjavehiṃ phāsapajjavehiṃ asāsatā
iyaṃ bhadanta ! ratnaprabhā pṛthivī kiṃ śāśvatī aśāśvatī ? bhagavānāha --gautama ! syāt kathaṃcit kasyāpi nayasyābhiprāyeṇetyarthaḥ śāśvatī
seśabdaḥ athaśabdārthaḥ, sa ca praśne, kena arthena kāraṇena bhadanta ! evamucyate yathā syāt śāśvatī syādaśāśvatīti ? bhagavānāha --gautama ! davvaṭṭhayāe ityādi, dravyārthatayā śāśvatīti

tatra dravyaṃ sarvatrāpi sāmānyamucyate, dravati gacchati tān tān paryāyān viśeṣāniti vā dravyamiti vyutpatterdravyamevārthaḥ tāttvikaḥ padārtho yasya na tu paryāyāḥ sa dravyārthaḥ dravyamātrāstitvapratipādako nayaviśeṣaḥ, tadbhāvo dravyārthatā, tayā dravyamātrāstitvapratipādakanayābhiprāyeṇeti yāvat śāśvatī, dravyārthikanayamataparyālocanāyāmevaṃvidhasya ratnaprabhāyāḥ pṛthivyā ākārasya sadā bhāvāt

varṇaparyāyaiḥ kṛṣṇādibhiḥ gandhaparyāyaiḥ surabhyādibhiḥ rasaparyāyaiḥ tiktādibhiḥ sparśaparyāyaiḥ kaṭhinatvādibhiḥ aśāśvatī anityā, teṣāṃ varṇādīnāṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ kiyatkālānantaraṃ vā anyathābhavanāt atādavasthyasya cānityatvāt

na caivamapi bhinnādhikaraṇe nityānityatve, dravyaparyāyayorbhedābhedopagamāt, anyathā ubhayorapyasattvāpatteḥ, tathāhi śakyate vaktuṃ paraparikalpitaṃ dravyamasat paryāyavyatiriktatvād bālatvādiparyāyaśūnyavandhyāsutavat, tathā paraparikalpitāḥ paryāyā asantaḥ dravyavyatiriktatvāt vandhyāsutagatabālatvādiparyāyavat
kva kadā kena kiṃrūpā dṛṣṭā mānena kena vā ?
ava rakṣaṇagatikāntiprītitṛptyavagamanapraveśaśravaṇasvāmyarthayācanakriyecchādīptyavāptyāliṅganahiṃsādahanabhāvavṛddhiṣu iti paṭhitatvāt iti navamārasamāptau nayacakravṛttau vakṣyate
mudrite pāṇinīyadhātupāṭhe tu 601 ava rakṣaṇagatikāntiprītitṛptyavagamapraveśaśravaṇasvāmyarthayācanakriyecchādīptyavāptyāliṅganahiṃsādānabhāgavṛddhiṣu iti pāṭha upalabhyate
kathaṃ punastatparigamanaṃ paryavanaṃ ca ? iti tad bhāvayituṃ sopapattikaṃ sanidarśanamāha --varṇebhya evetyādi yāvad gṛhyanta iti
varṇebhya eva rūpādibhyo guṇāntaraṃ citravarṇo raktaśyāmapāṇḍvādiḥ eva varṇāntaraṃ tadārambhaniyamādeva pṛthivyādiṣu bhavati samantād gacchati vā

tāni prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsātmakāni gṛhyante, tasmāt tairvarṇādiparyavairaśāśvatī, varṇa eva ca paryavo guṇaḥ yathāsambhavaṃ śyāmādiḥ saṃyogavibhāgapṛthaktvaparatvāparatvādiśca, taiḥ pākajo vā tadārambhaniyamādeveti, yathoktam --yeṣāmadhikṛtamārambhasāmarthyam iti, pṛthivyādiṣu varṇāntaraṃ bhavati samantād gacchati vā
tāni varṇādiparyavāḥ paryāyā vā ghaṭādīni vā dravyāṇi ārabdhāni tairapyanyārabdhadravyāṇi prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsātmakāni varṇādyanātmakānyeva mṛtpiṇḍādyavasthānāni ghaṭādīni kapālādīni ca gṛhyante
karmadhāraye vā varṇa eva ca paryavo guṇo yathāsambhavamityādi, guṇā ime, taiḥ aśāśvatī iti ca vartate varṇādiparyavairiti sambandhaḥ
yathāsambhavamārabdhānārabdhadravyagatāḥ kecicchyāmādayo'nārabdhacaturvidhāṇugatāḥ tadārabdhadravyāntare kāraṇaguṇapūrvāścaturvidhe, pārthiveṣveva raktādyāḥ pākajāḥ, gandhādibhiśca

saṃyogavibhāgau sakriyeṣu, pṛthaktvaṃ sarvadravyeṣu, paratvāparatve digdeśakālāpekṣe talliṅge, ādigrahaṇād gandhaśabda-jñānādayo'sādhāraṇaguṇāḥ pṛthivyākāśātmādīnām, ekatvādisaṅkhyāḥ sarvadravyasādhāraṇā eva, gandhādibhiriti tṛtīyānirdeśādebhiścāśāśvatī
yathā hi śuklādirviśeṣo rūpasya tathā citraṃ rūpādiviśeṣa eva, yadyapi śuklādiśabdairna vyapadiśyate tathāpi svaśabdena vyapadeśādastitvam
atha viruddhānāṃ nīlādīnāṃ kathamekarūpārambhakatvam ? yathā śuklānāmiti
yathā hi bahūni śuklarūpāṇyekaṃ śuklarūpamārabhanta ityupalabdham, tathā nīlādīnāmapi citrarūpārambhakatvaṃ dṛṣṭatvādabhyupagantavyam
kathametaditi cet, ucyate--yathāvayavairavayavyārabdhastathāvayavarūpairavayavini rūpamārabdhavyam, avayaveṣu na śuklameva rūpamasti nāpi śyāmameva, kintu śyāmaśuklaharitādīni
na ca teṣāmekaṃ rūpamevārabhate nāparāṇītyasti niyamaḥ, pratyekamanyatra sarveṣāmapi sāmarthyadarśanāt
na ca parasparaṃ virodhena sarvāṇyapi nārabhanta evetyapi yuktam, citrarūpasyāvayavinaḥ pratīterarūpasya dravyasya pratyakṣatvābhāvācca
na cāvavayavarūpāṇi samuccitānyatra citradhiyā pratīyante tairevāvayavī pratyakṣa iti kalpanāprāmāṇyam, anyatrāpi tathābhāvaprasaṅgenāvayavirūpocchedaprasaṅgaḥ
tasmāt sambhūya tairārabhyate, taccārabhyamāṇaṃ vividhakāraṇasvabhāvānugamācchyāmaśuklaharitātmakameva syāt citram iti ca vyapadiśyate
eva varṇāntaraṃ tadārambhaniyamādeva pṛthivyādiṣu bhavati samantād gacchati vā
tāni prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsātmakāni gṛhyante, tasmāt tairvarṇādiparyavairaśāśvatī, varṇa eva ca paryavo guṇaḥ yathāsambhavaṃ śyāmādiḥ saṃyogavibhāgapṛthaktvaparatvāparatvādiśca, taiḥ
idānīṃ rūpādīnāha — uktā guṇāḥ vai॰ sū॰ 7
tatra pṛthivyāṃ rūparasagandhasparśā dravyānityatvādanityāḥ vai॰ sū॰ 7
4, ghaṭādeḥ pārthivasya vināśāt tadgatānāmapi rūpādīnāṃ vināśa āśrayavināśāt
5, agnisaṃyogācca pārthiveṣu paramāṇuṣu rūpādīnāṃ vināśaḥ kārye samavetānāṃ tvāśrayavināśādeva
6, yasmācchyāmādiguṇebhyo vyatiriktaṃ guṇāntaramutpadyate tataḥ pūrve paramāṇuguṇā vinaṣṭāḥ guṇavati guṇānārambhāt
7, etena guṇāntaraprādurbhāvena nityeṣu paramāṇuṣu rūpādīnāmanityatvamuktaṃ pārthiveṣveva, yataḥ apsu tejasi vāyau ca nityā dravyanityatvāt vai॰ sū॰ 7
8, salilānalānilaparamāṇurūpādayo nityā āśrayanityatvāt virodhiguṇāntarāprādurbhāvācca nāgnisaṃyogād vināśaḥ
9, anityeṣu salilādiṣu anityā rūpādaya āśrayavināśe teṣāmapi vināśāt
10, anityāyāṃ kāryarūpāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ kāraṇaguṇapūrvā rūpādayo jāyante, nityāyāṃ tu paramāṇusvabhāvāyāṃ pākajāḥ pākādagnisaṃyogājjātāḥ
apsu tejasi vāyau ca kāraṇaguṇapūrvāḥ pākajā na vidyante vai॰ sū॰ 7
11, kārye udakādyavayavini samavāyikāraṇarūpe rūpādaya ārabhyante, pākajāstu jalādyaṇuṣu naiva santi virodhiguṇāntarābhāvāt
aguṇavato dravyasya guṇārambhāt karmaguṇā aguṇāḥ vai॰ sū॰ 7
12, aguṇasya dravyasyaivotpannasya kāraṇaguṇairguṇā janyante na guṇakarmaṇām, aśeṣāvayavaguṇaikārthasamavāyābhāvāt karmatvavat
13, agnisaṃyogānnivṛtteṣu śyāmādiṣu pākajā jāyante iti te'pi guṇarahite siddhāḥ
saṃyogavati saṃyogārambhavad guṇavati pākajā iti cet, na, ekadravyavattvāt vai॰ sū॰ 7
14, ekadravyavantaḥ pākajāḥ, te kathaṃ tatraivārabhyeran viruddhatvāt ? saṃyogasya tu saṃyogavatī ārambho na duṣyati anekadravyatvāt
kāla idānīṃ kathyate --aparasmin paraṃ yugapadayugapacciraṃ kṣipramiti kālaliṅgāni vai॰ sū॰ 2

tatra pareṇa dikpradeśena saṃyukte yūni paratvajñāne jāte sthavire cāpareṇa dikpradeśena saṃyukte'paratvajñānotpattau kṛṣṇakeśādivalīpalitādiparyālocanayā yena nimittena yūni aparatvajñānaṃ sthavire ca paratvajñānaṃ jāyate sa kālaḥ
tathā tulyakāryeṣu kartṛṣu yugapat kurvanti, ayugapat kurvanti iti yataḥ pratyayo jāyate sa kālaḥ
tathaikakriyāphalamuddiśya odanākhyaṃ bhūyasīnāmadhiśrayaṇādikriyāṇāṃ prabandhapravṛttau tulyakartari ciramadya kṛtam, kṣipramadya kṛtam iti yataḥ pratyayau bhavataḥ sa kāla iti
12, mūrtaṃ dravyamavadhiṃ kṛtvā yata etad bhavati idaya ?masmāt pūrvetyādipratyayaḥ tad diśo liṅgam

...sarveṣāmanukūlatayā vedanīyaṃ sukham, sarveṣāṃ pratikūlatayā vedanīyaṃ duḥkham, icchā kāmaḥ, krodho dveṣaḥ, kṛtiḥ prayatnaḥ, vihitakarmajanyo dharmaḥ, niṣiddhakarmajanyastvadharmaḥ, buddhyādayo'ṣṭāvātmamātraviśeṣaguṇāḥ
idānīṃ saṅkhyādīnupakramate, bhedavyavahārahetuḥ saṅkhyā, sādhunā rūpādivyatiriktetyetadarthamāha --rūparasagandhasparśavyatirekādarthāntaramekatvaṃ tathā pṛthaktvam vai॰ sū॰ 7
tayornityatvānityatve tejaso rūpasparśābhyāṃ vyākhyāte vai॰ sū॰ 7

2, yathā dravyanityatvāt tejaḥparamāṇurūpasparśau nityau evamekatvaikapṛthaktve nityadravyavartinī nitye, yathā cānitye tejasi dravyānityatvāccānityau rūpasparśau tathaiva kāryavartinī anitye ekatvaikapṛthaktve
iti ṣaṣṭho nayo naigamabhedo dravyāstikāntaḥpātī parisamāpta itiśabdasamāptyarthatvāt, vidhiniyamavidhyara iti nāmanirdeśo'yaṃ nayacakravibhāgavinyastaścakrāra ivāra iti
25, ekadikkau piṇḍau dikkṛtayoḥ paratvāparatvayoḥ kāraṇam, ekakālau vartamānakālasambaddhau kālakṛtayoḥ paratvāparatvayoḥ kāraṇam
dikkālapradeśaiḥ saṃyogāt sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭabuddhyapekṣayā sannikṛṣṭe'paratvaṃ viprakṛṣṭe ca paratvam
eṣu ca paryavaśabdo bhāvavacanaḥ, paryāyaśabdaḥ samantādgativacanaḥ
viśeṣeṇa tu yathādarśanameva vidhyādiṣu pratyekaṃ vyākhyātasvarūpabhedamanugantavyaṃ sarvagatisāmānyamatyajadbhiḥ
atra eṣu ca samantād bhavanāt paryavaḥ, samantād gamanāt paryāyaḥ

ayaṃ cetyatītān pañcaitaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ sampiṇḍya ekasya triśatabhedasya saṅkṣepeṇa ṣaḍ bhedāḥ, tatra 1vidhiḥ 2vidhividhiḥ 3vidhividhiniyamaṃ 4vidhiniyamaḥ 5vidhiniyamaṃ ṣaṣṭhaścāyaṃ 6vidhiniyamavidhiriti ṣaḍbhedo dravyāstika upavarṇitaḥ, ṣaḍapyete bhedā dravyāstikasyaivetyarthaḥ
eṣu ca ṣaṭsu nayeṣu paryavaśabdo bhāvavacanaḥ samantād bhavanāt paryavaḥ sarvātmanā bhavanāt
paryāyaśabdaḥ samantādgativacanaḥ, samantād gamanāt paryāyaḥ, dravyasya varṇādyātmanā parito gamanāt

ayaṃ ca vigrahārthaḥ ṣaṇṇāmapi sāmānyena draṣṭavyaḥ, viśeṣeṇa tu yathādarśanameva vidhyādiṣu pratyekaṃ vyākhyātasvarūpabhedamanugantavyaṃ sarvagatisāmānyamatyajadbhiḥ, sarvasya sarvātmakatvāt ekasya sarvātmakatvāt ekaikasya sarvātmakatvāt sarvasya caikaikātmakatvāt sarvagatimeva yathādarśanamāha
dravyaśabdārthastatra tatra vyākhyāta eva yathādarśanaṃ dravyaprādhānyāt, paryāyopasarjanādihānte paryāyaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ
khapuṣpasattvasyāśrayo nāstīti cet, na, itaratrāpi tulyatvāt
ghaṭasya mṛdo'tattvād ghaṭādisattvasyāpyāśrayo nāstyeva utpatsyamānasya asataḥ sattāsamavāyitvāt

idānīṃ paryāyanayaprathamaśirāpradidarśayiṣayā anantaranirdiṣṭavaiśeṣikobhayavidhinirācikīrṣayā cottaraḥ samanantarānulomatvāt pūrvaviruddhatvānnivṛttaniranuśayatvācca nayānāmasatkāryavādameva dūṣayitumāha --yadyasadityādi

āstāṃ tāvadasmanmatam, pūrvanayamatenaivaitat tvaddarśanamanupapannamiti brūmaḥ, dravyārthikanayānāṃ sannihi tabhavitṛkabhavanābhyupagamād nāsat kāryamutpattumarhati, asannihitabhavitṛkatvāt, khapuṣpavat
ṣaṭpadārthasaṃsargavādasya sattāsamavāyabalena pravṛttatvāt sattāsamavāyonmūlanāt tantrasyaivonmūlanamityabhiprāyeṇāyaṃ sattāsamavāyavicāraprastāva iti
atra votpadyatāmasannihitabhavitṛkatvāt ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt, tulanā pṛ॰ 351-- 2
syānmatam--kāraṇadravyeṣvāśrayabhūteṣu satsveva sattāsamavāyāt kāryaṃ prāgasat paścādutpadyate, khapuṣpaṃ tu nirāśrayatvād notpatsyate kāryavaidharmyāditi
etacca na, itaratrāpi tulyatvāt, kāryamapi hi nirāśrayamasattvādeva khapuṣpavat, ato na kaścit kāryakhapuṣpayorvi- śeṣaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? ghaṭasya kāryasya mṛdo'tattvāt, mṛddravyasya piṇḍādirūpairbhavitṛṇo na tattvaṃ tvanmate piṇḍādi kāryamasattvāt

tvanmatenaivotpatsyamānasya piṇḍaghaṭādeḥ kāryasya niḥsattāsamavāyasyā'sataḥ sattāsamavāyitvāt sattāsamavāyitvābhyupagamāt utpannaṃ hyāśrayamāśrayantyāśrayiṇaḥ sattādayaḥ iti siddhāntāt tasyāṃ hyavasthāyāṃ athāśrayisamavāyādṛte'pi kāryaṃ svenaivāstitvenotpannamāśrayo bhavati khapuṣpavaidharmyeṇa, evaṃ tarhi tasya svata eva sataḥ kiṃ tadatiriktasattāsambandhakalpanayā prayojanam ? kāryakhapuṣpayorāśrayakṛtaviśeṣābhāvo vā
yadyasat sad bhavati, viśeṣaheturvaktavyaḥ--khapuṣpaṃ kasmānnotpadyate ? ghaṭādi kasmādutpadyate ? athocyeta--kāraṇavadakāraṇaviśeṣāt
yadyakāraṇaṃ notpadyate tatpuruṣavācyaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ notpadyata eva kāraṇamevotpadyate iti sa eva kāraṇavādaḥ parigṛhītaḥ syāt
atha bahuvrīhisamāsāśrayaṇam, tannotpadyate'vidyamānakāraṇatvād ghaṭavat; svayamasataḥ kāryasyāśrayatvābhāvāt khapuṣpamutpannamāśrayantvāntyāśrayiṇa ityaho paramatākiṅkaratvaṃkiṃkatvaṃ bhavatāmiti
sattāyāḥ samavāyābhāve ca kutaḥ kāryotpattiḥ ? iti

athāśrayisamavāyādṛte'pi kāryaṃ svenaivāstitvenotpannamāśrayo bhavati khapuṣpavaidharmyeṇa, evaṃ tarhi tasya svata eva sataḥ kiṃ tadatiriktasattāsambandhakalpanayā prayojanam ? kāryakhapuṣpayorāśrayakṛtaviśeṣābhāvo vā
yadyasat sad bhavati, viśeṣaheturvaktavyaḥ--khapuṣpaṃ kasmānnotpadyate ? ghaṭādi kasmādutpadyate ?
yadyakāraṇaṃ notpadyate tatpuruṣavācyaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ notpadyata eva kāraṇamevotpadyate iti sa eva kāraṇavādaḥ parigṛhītaḥ syāt

athaitasmāt khapuṣpatulyatvāpattidoṣabhayāt sattāyā āśrayiṇyāḥ samavāyādṛte'pi sat kāryaṃ tadāśrayabhūtaṃ svenaivāstitvena svabhāvasattayaivotpannamāśrayo bhavati kadācidapyanutpatsyamānasya khapuṣpasya vaidharmyeṇetīṣyate, tata evaṃ tarhītyādi, iṣyata evaitadasmābhiḥ svenaiva mahimnā tat sat iti, na tu tvayā

tvayā caivamasmābhiriveṣyamāṇe kharaviṣāṇādyasadvilakṣaṇasya tasya kāryasya svata eva sataḥ kiṃ tadatiriktasattāsambandhakalpanayā prayojanam ? na kiñcit tena kalpitenetyarthaḥ, sattāsambandhānarthakyam, ataḥ sarvadravyaguṇakarmādikāraṇasamavāyikāryasaṃsargavādo nivartate tasmādeva

tadaniṣṭānabhyupagame yo mayā prāguktaḥ kāryakhapuṣpayorāśrayakṛtaviśeṣābhāvo vā, tatra tulye tayorasattve kāryamevotpadyate khapuṣpameva notpadyata iti ko viśeṣahetuḥ ? tadvyaktiḥ --yadyasadityādi gatārthaṃ yāvad ghaṭādi kasmādutpadyata iti, ityataḥ kāryakhapuṣpayoraviśeṣadoṣastadavasthaḥ
athānyathaitaddoṣaparihārārthamucyeta--kāraṇavadakāraṇaviśeṣāt, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ sakāraṇaṃ ghaṭādi khapuṣpamakāraṇamityasti viśeṣaḥ, kāraṇaiḥ samavāyyasamavāyibhirghaṭādi sambadhyate na tu khapuṣpādīti

sa eva svābhiprāyaṃ vivṛṇoti --yadyakāraṇaṃ notpadyate tatpuruṣavācyamiti na bhavati kāraṇamityakāraṇam itthaṃ tatpuruṣasamāsaścediṣṭaḥ tataḥ kāryaṃ notpadyata eva kāraṇamevotpadyate, tasyaiva vidhividhyādiprācyanayadarśanāt kāryatayotpādāt sa eva kāraṇavādaḥ parigṛhītaḥ syāt, sa ca mayā neṣṭaḥ
atha yasya na kāraṇaṃ tadakāraṇamiti bahuvrīhisamāsāśrayaṇaṃ tannotpadyate kāryaṃ tasyāṃ bahuvrīhikalpanāyāmavidyamānakāraṇatvāt khapuṣpavat
ghaṭavaditi vaidharmyam, yathā ghaṭa utpadyate na tatheti

tataḥ kim ? tato'nutpannatvāt tadanāśrayaḥ sattāyāḥ, sattānāśrayatvāt tatsambandhābhāvācca na evaṃ tarhi sarvāsattvaprasaṅgaḥ paramāṇvādīnāmakāraṇatvādanutpannatvādanāśrayatve sattāsamavāyābhāvaḥ, teṣāṃ hyāśrayatve sattvasamavāya iṣṭaḥ, tataḥ sattāsamavāyābhāvāt kāraṇānāṃ paramāṇvādīnāmabhāvāt kāryasya kāryasamavāyināṃ ca khapuṣpād na kaścid viśeṣa iti sarvaśūnyateti sarvavirodhāḥ
athocyeta--nityotpannatvāt svasadbhāvenaiva santi paramāṇvākāśādīni, kāryadravyaguṇakarmaṇāmeva sattāsamavāyāt sattvamiti
evaṃ tarhi ākāśaparamāṇvādiṣu anupanipātisvarūpatvādātmābhedācca na kenacit sambandho'syāḥ syāt
asati ca sambandhe yathā sattā satī eva padārthatvāt svarūpasadbhāvācca tathā tānyapi dravyaguṇa- satkāryamiti
atrocyate --evaṃ tarhi sarvāsattvaprasaṅga ityādi yāvat sarvaśūnyateti sarvavirodhā iti
paramāṇavo'kāraṇatvād viyadādīni ca notpadyante, anutpannatvādanāśrayaḥ sattāyāḥ, tadanāśrayatve sattāsamavāyābhāvaḥ, teṣāṃ hyāśrayatve sattvasamavāya iṣṭa iti tadvaidharmyaṃ darśayati

tataśca sattāsamavāyā- bhāvāt khapuṣpavat kāraṇānāṃ paramāṇvādīnāmabhāvaḥ, tadabhāvāt kāryamakāraṇatvādanādhāraṃ kva samavaitu ? tasmāt kāraṇāsamavāyitvāt khapuṣpāt tasya na kaścid viśeṣaḥ, ataḥ prāguktāviśeṣadoṣastadavasthaḥ kāryasamavāyibhiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ sahitasya kāryasyedānīṃ prāpitastvayaiva, kārye samavetānāṃ rūpādighaṭatvādyutkṣepaṇādīnāṃ kāryasamavāyināṃ ceti vigrahāntarāt
tataḥ kimiti cet, ucyate --iti sarvaśūnyatā, iti sarvabhāvā na santīti bruvataḥ paramaśūnyavāditā bhavataḥ itiśabdanigamanārthatvāt

kāraṇākāraṇakāryākāryavirodhāvirodhalakṣaṇabhedasūtrāṇāṃ sadādyaviśeṣasūtrasya ca sattāsamavāyaprāṇotthānatvāt kimavaśiṣṭaṃ syācchāstrasya tannānātvaprayojanasya vaiśeṣikākhyasya kāryakāraṇakhapuṣpāviśeṣāditi

evaṃ tarhi sarvāsattvaprasaṅgaḥ paramāṇvādīnāmakāraṇatvādanutpannatvādanāśrayatve sattāsamavāyābhāvaḥ, teṣāṃ hyāśrayatve sattvasamavāya iṣṭaḥ, tataḥ sattāsamavāyābhāvāt kāraṇānāṃ paramāṇvādīnāmabhāvāt kāryasya kāryasamavāyināṃ ca khapuṣpād na kaścid viśeṣa iti sarvaśūnyateti sarvavirodhāḥ
athocyeta--nityotpannatvāt svasadbhāvenaiva santi paramāṇvākāśādīni, kāryadravyaguṇakarmaṇāmeva sattāsamavāyāt sattvamiti
evaṃ tarhi ākāśaparamāṇvādiṣu anupanipātisvarūpatvādātmābhedācca na kenacit sambandho'syāḥ syāt
asati ca sambandhe yathā sattā satī eva padārthatvāt svarūpasadbhāvācca tathā tānyapi dravyaguṇa-
itthaṃ prāgasataḥ sakāraṇasya kāryasya khapuṣpāviśeṣo mā bhūditi athocyeta--nityotpannatvādityādi
svasadbhāvenaiva santi pṛthivyādicaturvidhaparamāṇvākāśakāladigātmamanāṃsi dravyāṇi sattāsamavāyau guṇāśca vibhuparimaṇḍalādayaḥ

yathākāśaparamāṇvādiṣu nopanipatituṃ śīlamasyāḥ sattāyāstathā kāryadravyaguṇakarmasvapi sattāsvarūpatvādanupanipātisvarūpatvam, anupanipātisvarūpatvāccātmābhedastasyāḥ sarvaparamāṇvākāśādiṣvagaganādipadārtheṣvātmābhedācca na kenacit sambandho'syāḥ syāt

asati ca sambandhe yathā sattā sattādravyatvaguṇatvādisambandhābhāve satyeva padārthatvāt svarūpasadbhāvācca svātmasvarūpaṃ svātmani ādadhāti ityevaṃsvarūpā tathā sattādisamavāyamantareṇa tānyapi kāryadravyaguṇakarmāṇi bhavantu ākāśaparamāṇvādivat sattāvacceti kiṃ tadvyatiriktasattādravyatvādisamavāyakalpanayā ? tasmāddhetuphalavandhya karmāṇi bhavantu tatpadārthatvavaditi sattāsambandhāt santi dravyādīnītyayuktam
iti sattāsambandhāt santi dravyādīni ityayuktam, tasmāt sattāsambandhād dravyaṃ sad guṇaḥ san karma saccetyayuktam

ādigrahaṇād dravyatvābhisambandhād dravyāṇi pṛthivyādīni, guṇatvābhisambandhād guṇā rūpādayaḥ, karmatvābhisambandhāt karmāṇi gamanādīni ityayuktam, itiśabdasya nigamanārthatvād evaṃ tāvad yat pratyajñāsiṣmahi --asannihitabhavitṛkatvāt khapuṣpavat kāryamasaditi pūrvanayadarśanenaiva tadupāpīpadāmeti
karmāṇi bhavantu tatpadārthatvavaditi sattāsambandhāt santi dravyādīnītyayuktam
ita uttaramasmādeva nyāyāt kaṭandyāṃ ṭīkāyāṃ ca yat pūrvapakṣitaṃ tadeva samarthayitumāha --tato'nupapannavikalpatvādityādi uddeśavākyam
sattāsambandhāt santi, dravyatvād dravyāṇi, guṇatvād guṇāḥ, karmatvāt karmāṇi, rūpatvād rūpam, ādigrahaṇāt pṛthivītvādibhyaḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ, rasatvādibhyo rasādayaḥ, gamanatvādibhyo gamanādaya ityādi
ekadravyamaguṇaṃ saṃyoga-vibhāgeṣvanapekṣaṃ kāraṇamiti karmalakṣaṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1

14-16 ityādinā dravyādīnāṃ nānātvaṃ virodhyavirodhyārambhānārambhakāryakāraṇādibhiśca, sattādibhyaśca tribhyaḥ sa1danityaṃ2 dra3vyavat kā4ryaṃ kā5raṇaṃ sā6mānyaviśeṣavaditi dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmaviśeṣaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 1
7 iti ṣaḍaviśeṣamukhena viśeṣābhidhānaṃ sattāsamavāyabījaṃ sarvatra tat sarvamayuktaṃ vaktum
kasmāt ? anupapannavikalpatvāt, sarvavākyānṛtatvavat, yathā sarvaṃ madīyaṃ tvadīyamanyadīyaṃ ca vākyamanṛtam iti bruvāṇasya tasya vākyaṃ satyamanṛtaṃ satyānṛtaṃ vā syāt ? sarvathā nopapadyate
yadi tad vākyamapyanṛtaṃ satyānṛtaṃ vā tataḥ sarvavākyānṛtatvapratipādanāsamartham svayamapramāṇatvāt, apramāṇatvamasatyatvāt

atha satyaṃ na tarhi sarvamanṛtam, tasya sarvāntaḥpātitvāt tatsatyatvavaccheṣasyāpi satyatvāt sarvathānupapannaṃ vākyamevaṃ sattāsamavāyāt sat ityādisadādyaviśeṣalakṣaṇavirodhārambhādi iha prāk sattāsambandhāt satāṃ vā asatāṃ vā sadasatāṃ vā dravyādīnāṃ satkarī sattā ? na tāvadasatāṃ satkarī sattā śaśaviṣāṇādīnāmapi satkaratvaprasaṅgāt
prāk tat sattāsambandhāt kimātmakamiti svarūpāvadhāraṇaṃ kāryam, anyathā'sattvāt
ubhayadoṣaprasaṅgācca, yadasat tat kharaviṣāṇatulyam, yat sat tatra sattāsambandho vyarthaḥ, sadasatorvaidharmyāt kārye sadasattā na vai॰ sū॰ 9
viśeṣadharmāpādanavākyāni nopapannāni, sarvapadārthānāṃ vaiśeṣikīyāṇāṃ sattāsamavāyamūlaviśeṣātmakatvād dravyādikāryotpattivicāraprakṛteśca tadeva vicāryate tatprāṇatvād vaiśeṣikīyatantrasyeti
atra samavāyikāraṇamiti dravyalakṣaṇam ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 440 ṭi॰ 5
vijñātasādharmyavaidharmyāṇāṃ ca dravyādīnāmabhyudayaniḥśreyasahetutvāt sādharmyaṃ tāvat kathayati sadanityaṃ dravyavat kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavaditi dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmaviśeṣaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 1
7, sad dravyaṃ san guṇaḥ sat karma iti sattā trayāṇāmaviśeṣaḥ tathaiva anityatvamanyatrākāśādibhyaḥ

kāraṇatvaṃ kāryajanakatvaṃ trayāṇāmaviśeṣaḥ, kṣityādīni dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ samavāyikāraṇam, ākāśādīni guṇānām, mano'ntyāvayavidravye guṇakarmaṇām, guṇāstu rūparasagandhānuṣṇasparśasaṅkhyāparimāṇaikapṛthaktvasnehaśabdā asamavāyikāraṇam, buddhisukhaduḥkhecchādveṣaprayatnadharmādharmabhāvanā nimittakāraṇam, saṃyogavibhāgauṣṇyagurutvadravatvavegā ubhayathā kāraṇam, paratvāparatvadvitvadvipṛthaktvapārimāṇḍalyādayo'kāraṇam, karmāṇi saṃyogavibhāgeṣvasamavāyikāraṇam
sāmānyāni ca tāni dravyatvādīni viśeṣāśca ta iti sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ, tadvattā trayāṇāmaviśeṣaḥ
iha prāk sattāsambandhāt satāṃ vā asatāṃ vā sadasatāṃ vā dravyādīnāṃ satkarī sattā ? na tāvadasatāṃ satkarī sattā śaśaviṣāṇādīnāmapi satkaratvaprasaṅgāt
prāk tat sattāsambandhāt kimātmakamiti svarūpāvadhāraṇaṃ kāryam, anyathā'sattvāt
ubhayadoṣaprasaṅgācca, yadasat tat kharaviṣāṇatulyam, yat sat tatra sattāsambandho vyarthaḥ, sadasatorvaidharmyāt kārye sadasattā na vai॰ sū॰ 9
syānmatam--kathaṃ punaranupapannavikalpatvaṃ sattāsamavāyasya ? iti, atrocyate --iha prāk sattāsambandhāt satāṃ vetyādivikalpatrayopanyāso gatārthaḥ, evaṃ bhavanmataṃ syāt
nāpi satāmiti vaiyarthyāpādanaṃ bhūtatvāt sattāvaditi gatārtham
prakāśitaprakāśanavaiyarthyavaditi dvitīyamudāharaṇaṃ lokasiddhaṃ śāstrasiddhāt sattodāharaṇād bhedenopanyastamiti viśeṣaḥ

na vaiyarthyadoṣa evāsmin vikalpe, kiṃ tarhi ? satāṃ ca punaḥ sattāsambandhāt sattvādanavasthāprasaṅgāditi, vidyamānānāmeva punarapi sattāsambandhāt sattveṣṭau sattāyā api tatsattvābhidhānapratyayakaryāḥ sattāntarasambandhāt sattvam, tasyā api tathetyanavasthā syāt
tacca dravyādi pūrvaṃ sattāsambandhāt kimātmakam ? iti svarūpāvadhāraṇaṃ kāryam
tasyāmavasthāyāṃ sattāsambandhaśūnyatvād naivāsti tat, anavadhṛtātmakatvāt, khapuṣpavat
atra prāk sattā॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt, evaṃ sati mūlamapi prāk sattāsambandhāt tat kimātmakam iti kalpanīyam
athavā aikātmyānupapatteriti anārhatanayena prakāśatamasorivātyantavaidharmyāt sat sopākhyam asad nirupākhyam tayoḥ sadasatorvaidharmyādekatra na yujyate sadasattvam
ghaṭakhapuṣpavaditi, ghaṭaḥ sopākhyaḥ sattvāt, asattvāt khapuṣpaṃ nirupākhyamiti vaidharmyādekatvābhāvastayorevaṃ sadasadātmakaṃ kāryamityayuktam
tadvyācaṣṭe --yadasat tat kharaviṣāṇetyādi yāvat tvanmatasiddhānupapattirevāyaṃ vikalpa iti
asatpakṣe khapuṣpādaviśeṣaḥ, satpakṣe sattāsambandha nanvaguṇādivad dravyādīnāṃ sattāsambandhaḥ pratiṣidhyate na tu svarūpasadbhāva iti sattā naivāsatāṃ satkarī
eṣa vikalpo'nupapanna iti tvayaiva tarhi kṛtam
evamapi naivaitat, sattāsambandhāt prāk svabhāvasadbhūtakāryāsattvapratipādanadvāreṇāyaṃ vicāraḥ prastuta eva

nanu sa prāgviṣayāsatsatkaratve śaśaviṣāṇādisatkaratvaprasaṅgastadavasthaḥ, dravyādīnāṃ svata evāstitve sattāsambandho vyarthaḥ syādato'satsatkaratvameva sattāyāḥ, vaiyarthyam, sadasatorvaidharmyāt kārye sadasattā na vai॰ sū॰ 9
nanvaguṇādivad dravyādīnāṃ sattāsambandhaḥ pratiṣidhyate na tu svarūpasadbhāva iti sattā naivāsatāṃ satkarī
eṣa vikalpo'nupapanna iti tvayaiva tarhi kṛtam
evamapi naivaitat, sattāsambandhāt prāk svabhāvasadbhūtakāryāsattvapratipādanadvāreṇāyaṃ vicāraḥ prastuta eva
nanu sa prāgviṣayāsatsatkaratve śaśaviṣāṇādisatkaratvaprasaṅgastadavasthaḥ, dravyādīnāṃ svata evāstitve sattāsambandho vyarthaḥ syādato'satsatkaratvameva sattāyāḥ,
sikatābhyo'nutpatterdadhnaḥ kṣīrāccotpatteḥ pratyakṣeṇa cāgrahaṇāt sadasat kāryaṃ kāraṇe
sadasatorvaidharmyāt kārye sadasattā na vai॰ sū॰ 9
48, prāg niṣpatterniṣpattidharmakaṃ nāsat upādānaniyamāt, kasyacidutpattaye kiñcidupādeyaṃ na sarvaṃ sarvasyetyasadbhāve niyamo nopapadyate iti
na sadasat, sadasatorvaidharmyāt, sat ityarthābhyanujñā asat ityarthapratiṣedhaḥ, etayorvyāghāto vaidharmyam, vyāghātādavyatirekānupapattiriti

astu tāvat satāmeva satkarī satā nāsatām, yathā mathā prāgukto dṛṣṭāntaḥ svabhāvasadbhāvapratipādanārthaṃ bhāvasya yathā nāsya guṇo'stītyaguṇo guṇa eva sannaguṇa ityucyate tathā svabhāvasadbhāvasanneva bhāvo nāstyasya sannityasannucyate na tu svayamasanniti, tathā dravyādayo'pi santaḥ, teṣāṃ tu sattayā saha sambandhaḥ pratiṣidhyate na tu svarūpasadbhāva ityato naivāsatāṃ satkarī sattā, kiṃ tarhi ? satāmeva

atrocyate --eṣa vikalpo'nupapanna iti tvayaiva tarhi kṛtam, evaṃ bruvatā tvayaiva tarhi asatāṃ satkarī sattā na bhavati ityetadasmadanuṣṭheyamanuṣṭhitam, ato'sya siddhatvādatra vayaṃ niścitāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ
kintvasatāmeva sattāsambandhaḥ syād vā na vā ? iti vicāryam

sattāsambandhāt prāk tadviṣayo dravyādi kāryaṃ tat svabhāvenaiva kiṃ sat ? uta sattāsambandhāt sat ? ityetasmin sandehe svabhāvasadbhūtasya kāryasyāsattvapratipādanadvāreṇāyaṃ vicāraḥ prastuta eveti kathaṃ prastutaparityāgena parihāro yujyata ityabhiprāyaḥ

yo'yamasmābhiḥ prāgudgrāhitaḥ yadyasat sad bhavati ityādinopapattigranthena aguṇaguṇasthānīyasattāyā evābhāva iti yadyavidyamānaṃ dravyādiviṣayaṃ sattā svayamasatī santaṃ kuryāt śaśaviṣāṇādīn vandhyāputrādiḥ sataḥ kuryādityeṣa prasaṅga āpipādayiṣitastadavasthaḥ
etadanicchato dravyādīnāṃ svata evāstitve sattāsambandho vyarthaḥ syādityeṣa vā doṣaḥ nirviṣayatvāt sattāsambandhasya, aniṣṭaṃ taccāpyevamanupapannamasatsatkaratvam
prāgutpatteriti cet, siddhasādhanametat, tadā teṣāṃ sattāsambandhānabhyupagamāt
yathā viśeṣaṇasya daṇḍasya nāsatā daṇḍinā sambandhastathā sattāyā api
atha sambadhyate, sattāyā eva hi sāmarthyāt tasyā ādhārībhavati saddravyādi, caitat
ato'satsatkaratvameva sattāyā ityeṣa eva vikalpo bhavitumarhati
prāgutpatteriti cet, siddhasādhanametat, tadā teṣāṃ sattāsambandhānabhyupagamāt
yathā viśeṣaṇasya daṇḍasya nāsatā daṇḍinā sambandhastathā sattāyā api
atha sambadhyate, sattāyā eva hi sāmarthyāt tasyā ādhārībhavati saddravyādi,

anupapannavikalpatvāt ityasya sādhanasyāvayavārthāḥ satāmasatāṃ sadasatāṃ vā dravyādīnāṃ satkarī sattā iti vikalpāḥ, teṣu nāsatāṃ satkarī ityasya vikalpasya upapāda- nārthaṃ yāni sādhanāni vyutpāditāni pūrvapakṣīkṛtya vyāvartitāni ca, teṣu yo'ntyo vyutpattivikalpaḥ suṣṭhu vyutpādya vyāvartitaḥ pūrvapakṣa ityabhimataḥ so'pyevamanupapanna iti vicāraparyantasyottarasyānupapattau tuṣakaṇḍavat sarvavicāranairarthakyāt pūrvapakṣa evottarapakṣo bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ
yat tāvaduktam --nāsatāmityādi pūrvapakṣo yāvat satkaratvaprasaṅgāditi atra prakrāntaṃ praśastamatinā — na, sādhyenānabhisaṃbandhādityuttaraṃ yāvadasādhanatvamityeṣa prathamo vyutpattivikalpaḥ
pratijñāviśeṣo vetyādi dvitīyo gatārthaḥ sottaro yāvat prativiśiṣṭatvam
atha dravyādīnāmityādistṛtīyaḥ sottaro yāvat teṣāmasattvamasiddham, dravyādyabhyupagame sattvāditi
atra codyam --prāgutpatteriti cet, prāgutpatterna santi dravyādīni, tasmādasattvaṃ siddhamiti
eteṣu triṣu vyākhyāvikalpeṣu asārabuddhyā nāsatā sambadhyate sattā, viśeṣaṇatvāt, daṇḍavat
yathā viśeṣaṇasyetyādi sādhanavyākhyā yāvat sattāyā apīti

atha sambadhyata ityādinā yāvat tadavastha iti pūrvapākṣika eva paramatamāśaṅkyottaramāha --atha tava matamasadapi dravyādi sambadhyate sattādheyasvarūpatvāt tatpratipādyasattvāt sattāyā eva hi hetubhūtāyāḥ tadvacchaśaviṣāṇādibhirapi sambadhyeteti śaśaviṣāṇādīnāmapi satkaratvaprasaṅgastadavasthaḥ
nanu asat ityatra naña uttarapadābhidheyanivāraṇārthatvāt satpratiṣedhārthatvāt kathamasya sātmakatvam ? na, anekāntāt, aputrabrāhmaṇavadaguṇaguṇavat
yathā nāsya putro'stītyaputro brāhmaṇaḥ nāsya guṇo'stītyaguṇo guṇaḥ tathehāpi nāsya sadityasat
na ca tadapi nirātmakaṃ śaśaviṣāṇavat, sattāsambandhādṛte'pi yathā parapakṣe pradhānādīnāṃ sātmakatvaṃ tathehāpi syāt
dvividho hi bhāva uktaḥ svabhāvasadbhāvaḥ sambandhasadbhāvaśca itaretarāsatāṃ sātmakānāmeva saviśeṣaṇāsattvādananyacandrādivadityādi pūrvam
ato dravyādi sat, tattu svakāraṇeṣu samavetaṃ vastveva, sattāsambandharahitamapi sātmakameva, na kharaviṣāṇādivad nirātmakam
tasmād yuktaḥ sattāsambandho dravyādīnām, na khapuṣpādīnāmiti
nanu asat ityatra naña uttarapadābhidheyanivāraṇārthatvāt satpratiṣedhārthatvāt kathamasya sātmakatvam ? na, anekāntāt, aputrabrāhmaṇavadaguṇaguṇavat
yathā nāsya putro'stītyaputro brāhmaṇaḥ nāsya guṇo'stītyaguṇo guṇaḥ tathehāpi nāsya sadityasat
na ca tadapi nirātmakaṃ śaśaviṣāṇavat, sattāsambandhādṛte'pi yathā parapakṣe pradhānādīnāṃ sātmakatvaṃ tathehāpi syāt
atrāha --nanvasadityādi yāvat kathamasya sātmakatvamiti dravyādernirātmakatvāpādanārtho grantho gatārthaḥ uttarapadābhidheyanivārakatvāt satpratiṣedhārthaḥ, satpratiṣedhārthatvādanātmakamiti

atrottaram --na, anekāntādityādi yāvat tathehāpi nāsya sadityasaditi laukikaśāstrīyadṛṣṭāntadvayena vyabhicārapradarśanārtho bahuvrīhisamāsāśrayeṇa aputrabrāhmaṇavadaguṇaguṇavaditi ca gatārtho granthaḥ
evamanātmakatve'sthite tasyā vyabhicāra ucyate --na ca tadapi nirātmakamityādi, vaidharmyeṇa śaśaviṣāṇavaditi
athavā sattāsambandhāt sātmakamityevamucyamāne pradhānādivat sattāsambandhādṛte'pi sātmakatvadarśanādityavyāpitā tathehāpi syāditi
atra evamananātmakatve sthite ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atra tasyā ityasya sattāyāḥ ityarthaḥ syāt
atra asvārasye tu tasya iti pāṭhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ

tvatpakṣe dṛṣṭāntābhāva iti cedityādi pūrvapakṣīkṛtya taduttaram --sāmānyādivadvetyārabhya yāvat sāmānyādivadeva sātmakaṃ na ghaṭādivat sātmakamiti vāśabdāvadhāraṇārthatvavyākhyānasahito granthaḥ vaiśeṣikapakṣe sattāsambandharahitasātmakadṛṣṭāntābhāve codite sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyānāṃ sātmakatvavat syāditi sātmakaṃ na ghaṭādivat sātmakam
sāmānyādīnāṃ sātmakatvamasiddhamiti cet, na, svarūpabhinnatve sati abhinnavāgbuddhivyavahāraviṣayatvād yad viśeṣaṇaṃ tat sāmānyam
atrāpyuttare bahveva sampradhāryam, atyantanirātmakatvānabhyupagamāt iti vacanena sadasattvayorapi vikalpavattvaṃ varṇyate--kiñcitsat samastasaditi, evamasadapi
saṃpūrṇaniratiśayasvātmana eva tu sattvād nirūpyam--katamat tat kva vā kiñcitsattvamasattvaṃ vā ? etarhi nirūpyate--nanvidameva tadekasattāsadasadapi asamarthagavavat
tatparihāraḥ — na, svarūpabhinnetyādi yāvad viśeṣaṇaṃ tat sāmānyamiti dṛṣṭāntasādhanam

chatravastrakambalādiviśeṣaṇaiśchatrivastrikambalināṃ sātmakairātmarūpapratyayakarairviśeṣaṇatvavat svarūpabhinnatve sati abhinnavāgbuddhivyavahāraviṣayatvād viśeṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ sātmakaṃ cetyantamuttarametaditi
sāmānyādīnāṃ sātmakatvamasiddhamiti cet, na, svarūpabhinnatve sati abhinnavāgbuddhivyavahāraviṣayatvād yad viśeṣaṇaṃ tat sāmānyam
atrāpyuttare bahveva sampradhāryam, atyantanirātmakatvānabhyupagamāt iti vacanena sadasattvayorapi vikalpavattvaṃ varṇyate--kiñcitsat samastasaditi, evamasadapi
saṃpūrṇaniratiśayasvātmana eva tu sattvād nirūpyam--katamat tat kva vā kiñcitsattvamasattvaṃ vā ? etarhi nirūpyate--nanvidameva tadekasattāsadasadapi asamarthagavavat
atra uttaram ityanena anvaye gatārtham iti gatārthaṃ ca iti vā pāṭhaḥ sādhureva, granthaḥ ityanena anvaye tu gatārthaḥ iti vā gatārthaśca iti pāṭho'vaśyaṃ kalpanīyaḥ
sāmānyaṃ dvividhaṃ paramaparaṃ ca svaviṣayasarvagatamabhedātmakamanekavṛtti ekadvibahuṣu ātmasvarūpānugamapratyayakāri svarūpābhedenādhāreṣu prabandhena vartamānamanuvṛttipratyayakāraṇam
atrāpyuttare vahneva sampradhāryam, asmān pratyetadapyuttaraṃ na niścalamevetyabhiprāyaḥ

yasmādetadapyuttaraṃ dravyādīnāṃ śaśaviṣāṇavadatyantanirātmakatvānabhyupagamabalena saprasaṅgamutthāpitaṃ śaśaviṣāṇādīnāmapi satkaratvaprasaṅgastadavasthaḥ ityataḥ prabhṛti samānapracarcam, anyadapyatra vakṣyāmaḥ --atyantanirātmakatvānabhyupagamāt ityanenaiva tāvadvacanena sadasattvayorapi vikalpavattvaṃ varṇyate, dvidhā sat--kiñcitsat samastasaditi, evamasadapītyābhyāṃ vikalpābhyām

sampūrṇaniratiśayasvātmana eva tu sattvāt, tuśabdaḥ paramatavyāvartanārthaḥ, yadyapi mataṃ parasya--sadasatorvikalpavattvamastu, ko doṣa ? iti, tanna bhavati, sat sattaraṃ sattamamiti sato'tiśayābhāvāt kuto vikalpaḥ sattve ? tasmāt sampūrṇameva sattvamevamasattvamapi
tato nātyantānātmakaṃ sātmakaṃ ca ityayuktaṃ vaktumityabhiprāyaḥ
astu vā vikalpavat sattvamasattvaṃ ca, tat punarnirūpyaṃ tvayā katamat tat svarūpataḥ kva vāśraye kiñcit sattvamasattvaṃ vā ? iti vikalpyam
atrāha --etarhi nirūpyate, kimatra nirūpyam ? nanvidameva tadekasattāsadasadapi, ekayā svabhāvasattayā sat tadevāsat sambandhisattayeti
kimiva ? asamarthagavavat, yathā gokāryāsamartho gaureva sannagaurityucyate nāsau gaurna bhavati tathedamapi dravyādi sadevāsaditi
evaṃ tarhi sāmānyasattāyāḥ sattā avyaktiḥ kiñcitsatī na sampūrṇā satī ekasadbhāvatvāt svasattāvat, svabhāvasadbhāvatvāt asamavetasattākāni dravyādīni yathā
sā asarvagatā ca vyaktireva vā na bhavati ekajātīyāpetasvarūpatvāt ghaṭavat
ubhayāsampūrṇatāyāṃ ca tad na sat asattvāt khapuṣpavat, nāsat sattvād ghaṭavat, na sadasat sadasattā'bhāvāt
sāmānyākhyāyāḥ sattāyāḥ sāmānyasattāyāḥ sattā, sā cāvyaktiḥ dravyādivyaktirahitā kiñcitsatī, na sampūrṇā satī svabhāvasattāmātreṇa satī sambandhisattayā na satī, satī cāsatī ca vikalpavatītyarthaḥ
kasmāt ? ekasadbhāvatvāt, yadekasattayā sat tat saccāsacca dṛṣṭam, tadyathā --svasattāvat, yathā dravyādi svabhāvasattayā sadekayā sambindhisattayā asat tathā mahāsattāpi syāditi
eṣa eva hetvartho'nyayā vācocyate --svabhāvasadbhāvatvāt, asamavetasattākāni dravyādīni yatheti gatārthametadaniṣṭāpādanam
sā sāmānyasattā asarvagatā ca svaviṣayasarvagatā na bhavatītyetadapi doṣāpādanam, na sarvasvaviṣayānuvṛttirityarthaḥ
vyaktireva vā dravyādivyatiriktā na bhavatīti doṣāpādanapratijñāntaram
ubhayatraika eva hetuḥ --ekajātīyāpetasvarūpatvāditi, ekaprakāramekajātīyam, prakāravacane jātīyar pā॰ 5
tata ekajātīyādapetaṃ vyāvṛttaṃ svarūpaṃ yasyāḥ sā ekajātīyāpetasvarūpā, tadbhāvādekajātīyavyāvṛttasvarūpatvād ghaṭavat sajātīyāsajātīyavyāvṛttasvarūpatvādityarthaḥ
yathā ghaṭa ekaprakārebhyo vyāvṛttasvarūpo deśakālavarṇākārādibhirviśiṣṭatvād ghaṭāntarasvaviṣayavyāpī ca na bhavati vyaktireva ca na bhavati tathā sattāpi syāditi
16, saptamyantāt kāle ityeva, hasyāpavādaḥ, asmin kāle etarhi
21, karhi kadā, yarhi yadā, tarhi tadā, etasmin kāle etarhi
evaṃ tarhi sāmānyasattāyāḥ sattā avyaktiḥ kiñcitsatī na sampūrṇā satī ekasadbhāvatvāt svasattāvat, svabhāvasadbhāvatvāt asamavetasattākāni dravyādīni yathā
sā asarvagatā ca vyaktireva vā na bhavati ekajātīyāpetasvarūpatvāt ghaṭavat
ubhayāsampūrṇatāyāṃ ca tad na sat asattvāt khapuṣpavat, nāsat sattvād ghaṭavat, na sadasat sadasattā'bhāvāt
prakāravati cāyam, thāl tu prakāramātre, paṭuprakāraḥ paṭujātīyaḥ
22 itivad bhāvapradhāno brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ, tasya jātiśabdena saha bahuvrīhiḥ, brāhmaṇatvajātyādhārabhūtaḥ piṇḍa ityarthaḥ
brāhmaṇajātiriti, ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ bhāvapradhānena saha karmadhārayo vā
jātervyañjakamiti, badhyate jātirasminniti bandhu, śṛsvṛsnihi uṇā॰ 10 ityādinā adhikaraṇe upratyayaḥ
rūḍho'pi bandhuśabda āptaparyāyaḥ puṃliṅgo'sti tathāpi sa neha gṛhyate bandhuni iti napuṃsakanirdeśāditi bhāvaḥ
vastuno dravyādeḥ sāmānyasya vā sattvenāsattvena ca kiñcitsamastatvābhyāmasampūrṇatāyāṃ punarapi tad nirūpyameva kiṃ sadasampūrṇam, utāsat, āhosvit sadasat ? iti

tatra yadi tāvat sat tat sad na bhavati, kasmāt ? asattvāt khapuṣpavat, ubhayā yo'pi cāsacchabdasya nāsya sadityasadaguṇaguṇavat satsattāsambandharahitamityarthaḥ so'pyanupapanno vikalpaḥ kṛttaddhitāntarūpārthaviprakṛṣṭāntaratvāt
atha nāsya saditi sattāpi svabhāvasattayā satī yasya nāsti tadapyasad dravyādi ucyate gurutvā bhāvād guṇāgurutvavat
etadeva nanu prastutam, sadādayaḥ ṣaḍaviśeṣā dravyādīnāmeva trayāṇāṃ na sāmānyādīnāmityuktvā sāmānyādīnāṃ sattvamucyamānaṃ sadityasaditi ca svavacanavirodhāya
nāsat na ca tadasat sattvād ghaṭavat, sattvamapi nāsiddhamubhayāsampūrṇatveṣṭereva
na sadasat, nāpi tat sadasadubhayarūpamityarthaḥ, tvanmatenaiva sadasatorvaidharmyāt kārye sadasattā na vai॰ sū॰ 9
kiñcānyat, sadasattābhāvāt, yathā sattāsambandhāt sad bhavati tathā sadasattāsambandhāt sadasat syāt asattāsambandhādasad vā syāt, na caivaṃ bhavitumarhatyadṛṣṭāniṣṭatvāt

ahaṃ punarevaṃ tarkayāmi tvayā nopalakṣitā sadasadvaidharmyanirākaraṇāyaiva tu prāya iyaṃ pratipattirbhavataḥ kiñcitsat samastasaditi tathā kiñcidasat samastāsaditi bruvataḥ, ubhayāsampūrṇatāyāṃ tadeva saccāsacceti sadasatoḥ sādharmyameva, na vaidharmyamiti pratipannatvāditi
yo'pi cāsacchabdasya nāsya sadityasadaguṇaguṇavat satsattāsambandharahitamityarthaḥ so'pyanupapanno vikalpaḥ kṛttaddhitāntarūpārthaviprakṛṣṭāntaratvāt
atha nāsya saditi sattāpi svabhāvasattayā satī yasya nāsti tadapyasad dravyādi ucyate gurutvā bhāvād guṇāgurutvavat
etadeva nanu prastutam, sadādayaḥ ṣaḍaviśeṣā dravyādīnāmeva trayāṇāṃ na sāmānyādīnāmityuktvā sāmānyādīnāṃ sattvamucyamānaṃ sadityasaditi ca svavacanavirodhāya
kiñcānyat, naita eva doṣāḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? yo'pi cāsacchabdasyetyādi yāvat satsattāsambandharahitamityartha iti pūrvapakṣapratyuccāraṇam
yo'pyasau nāsya sadityasadaguṇaguṇavaditi tasya bahuvrīhisamāsāśrayāt sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyaiḥ sadbhiḥ śūnyaṃ sattayā na sambaddhaṃ tasmādasacchabdasya sadarthavācitvameveti vikalpa iti

tatrottaramucyate --so'pyanupapanno vikalpaḥ kṛttaddhitāntarūpārthaviprakṛṣṭāntaratvāt, bhavatyasti veti sat kṛdantarūpam, arthaścāsya dravyabhūtaḥ, sato bhāvaḥ satteti taddhitāntaṃ rūpam, arthaścāsya yasya guṇasya bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśastadabhidhāne tvatalau pā॰ vā॰ 5

119 iti sato'sādhāraṇaṃ svarūpaṃ sadantaravyāpi sāmānyaṃ ceti śabdato'rthataścātyantabhedādanayoḥ kathaṃ sattā sat syāt yadabhāvād nāsya sadityasad dravyādi bhaṇyeta ? evaṃ tāvat saduktau naiva sattoktiḥ

atha mā bhūcchabdārthaviprakṛṣṭatvāt kṛcchabdena taddhitārthānabhidhānācchabdārthasaṅkaradoṣa iti sattāpi svabhāvasattayā satī tasyāḥ sattvāt, sā yasya nāsti tadapyasad dravyādi ucyate, yathā guruguṇābhāvādaguru dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karma cocyate gurutvābhāvād guṇāgurutvavat tathā sadabhāvasattābhāvatulyatvādasadityucyamānamadoṣamiti
atrocyate --etadeva nanu prastutam, sadanityaṃ dravyavat kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavaditi dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmaviśeṣaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 1

8 iti sadādayaḥ ṣaḍaviśeṣā dravyādīnāmeva trayāṇāṃ na sāmānya yattu sat tatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ tadasyāstyeva, tat kimiti matvoktaṃ nāsya sat tadidamasad dravyādi kāryamiti ? yattvasya nāsti samavetaṃ tadapekṣya na yuktaṃ vaktuṃ nāsya sat tadidamasat iti
na hi khapuṣpaṃ yasya nāsti so'sannityucyate, saṃstu satvāṃśca niyamād bhavati pratiṣedhadvayārthatvāt
viśeṣasamavāyānāmityaviśeṣābhidhānadvāreṇa trayāṇāṃ tribhyo nānātvaṃ parasparataśca lakṣaṇādinā vyācikhyāsitaṃ bhavatā
asmābhiśca dravyavyatiriktaguṇādyabhāvāt sāmānyādyabhāvācca sattvenāviśeṣa eva, viśeṣe vānyatarad dravyāditrayaṃ sāmānyāditrayaṃ vā khapuṣpatulyaṃ syādityāsañjitaṃ proktadvāreṇa vādaprastāvāditi
tatra sadādiṣaḍaviśeṣo dravyāditrayaviṣaya eva na sāmānyāditrayaviṣaya ityuktvā sāmānyādīnāṃ sattvamucyamānaṃ sadityasaditi ca svavacanavirodhāya sadā maunavratiko'smi iti vacanavat
yattu sat tatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ tadasyāstyeva, tat kimiti matvoktaṃ nāsya sat tadidamasad dravyādi kāryamiti ? yattvasya nāsti samavetaṃ tadapekṣya na yuktaṃ vaktuṃ nāsya sat tadidamasat iti
na hi khapuṣpaṃ yasya nāsti so'sannityucyate, saṃstu satvāṃśca niyamād bhavati pratiṣedhadvayārthatvāt

yat tu satyaṃ mukhyaṃ sat tatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ dravyādikāryasyāśrayaḥ paramāṇutantukapālādi ghaṭapaṭādipariṇāmikāraṇaṃ tadasyāstyeva bījabhūtaṃ sādhayiṣyamāṇaṃ tat, tat kimiti matvoktaṃ matvarthasattvādinā bahuvrīhiṇā nāsya sadasti tadidamasad dravyādi kāryamiti ? tasya mukhyasya sato'stitvādayuktaṃ vaktum, na ca sad na bhavatyasat iti tatpuruṣeṇa dravyādikāryasyāsattvāditi vā
nanūktam--sāmānyaṃ samavāyisat, tadasya nāsti yatsambandhād dravyādikāryaṃ sadvyapadeśaṃ labhate iti tadapekṣayoktam asat1 iti
atrocyate --yattvasya nāsti samavetamiti sāmānyaṃ tadapekṣya na yuktaṃ vaktuṃ nāsya sat tadidamasat iti

yasmāt tat sadeva na bhavatyāvayorapi matena, tvanmatena tāvat sadaviśeṣābhāvāt sāmānyāditrayasya dravyādereva sadādyaviśeṣāt, asmanmatena dravyādivyatiriktasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyāsattvādeva tasyaiva vivādasya prastutatvāt tasyāsattvād dravyādi kathaṃ nāstyasya sat tadidamasat iti bahuvrīhiṇā vaktuṃ śakyam
kiṃ tarhi yuktaṃ vaktum ? nāsyāsat tadidamanasaditi, tasmādasad yasya nāsti tat sadeva anasadityarthaḥ
tannidarśanam --na hi khapuṣpaṃ yasya nāsti so'sannityucyata iti, sāmānyāpekṣayā napuṃsakanirdeśe prāpte puṃliṅganirdeśo'rthasāmānādhikaraṇyāduttānārthaḥ
saṃstu satvāṃśca niyamād bhavati, sannasyāstīti satvān yathā gaurasyāstīti gomān bahuvrīhiḥ sadapekṣa eva satyevārthe yujyate nānyatheti tathā tatpuruṣe'pi yojyametadeva vaidharmyanidarśanam
kasmāt ? pratiṣedhadvayārthatvāt, yathā pratiṣedhadvayamarthavadeva dṛṣṭam anaguḥ iti tathā dviḥ pratiṣedhasya prakṛtyarthāpatteḥ nāsyāsat ityukte satvāneva bhavitumarhati, nāsan sadarthatvāt
nanu tadevedaṃ bhavanaṃ vicāryate, tasyaiva dvaividhyasyāsmān pratyasiddhiḥ, uktavat
kasmāt khapuṣpaṃ dalamakarandādiṣu kāraṇeṣu na samavaiti ? adravyatvāt abhūtatvāt asannihitatvāt
yathā ca dravyādīni prāk santi sattayābhisambadhyante tathotpattyavasthāyāḥ

atrāha --nanu dvividhabhāvatvāt sattvāsadvacane'pi na doṣaḥ, svabhāvasat sambandhisaditi ca dvividhaṃ saduktam, tasmāt sattāyāḥ sāmānyākhyāyā api svabhāvasattvamastīti nāsya sat tadidamasaditi vaktuṃ yujyata eveti

atrocyate--nanu tadevedaṃ bhavanaṃ vicāryate, kimekavidhameva niratiśayamasmanmatavat ? uta tvanmatavat kiñcitsat samastasaditi svabhāvasat sambandhisaditi ca ? tasyaiva dvaividhyasyāsmān pratyasiddhiḥ
uktavat, yathānantaramevoktam--na kiñcitsat samastasannāma svabhāvasat sambandhasannāma veti vikalpajātaṃ sato'stīti
athavā khapuṣpamapyasannihitabhavitṛkatvāt kāryavad bhavedityatītaṃ sarvamevoktaṃ tat sampūrṇaniratiśayaṃ sattvamasattvaṃ cetyetasya pratipādanārthamiti
atra kenacit pṛcchyeta --kasmāt khapuṣpaṃ dala-kesara-makarandādiṣu kāraṇeṣu na samavaiti ? iti
kasmād nirbījam ? iti cet, abhūtatvāt, atīte'dhunānāgate kāle na bhūtaṃ hi tat, bhūtaśabdasya trikālavācitvādākāśabhūtavat, asattvādakāraṇatvādakāryatvādityādyarthaḥ
tat kuta iti cet, asanni- hitatvāt, yat satataṃ bhavati tat sannihitam, sannihitameva hi bhavati, asannihitaṃ naiva bhavati, vandhyāputra iva vandhyāyāṃ bījādhānādibhāvenāsannihitaḥ
punaḥ pṛcchet kaścit --kasmāccampakapuṣpaṃ dalādiṣu tu samavaitīti
atrānumānam--yasyāmavasthāyāmutpannamātrāṇi dravyādīni santyeva sattayābhisambadhyanta itīṣyante tasyā avasthāyāḥ prāgapi santīti pratijñā

tasyāmavasthāyāṃ sattayābhisambadhyamānatvāt, yasyāmavasthāyāṃ sattayābhisambadhyante tasyā avasthāyāḥ prāgapi santyeva dṛṣṭāni yathā utpattyuttarakālaṃ sattayābhisambadhyamānāni utpattyavasthāyāṃ tānyeva

tathotpattyavasthāyāḥ prāgapi syuriti abhūtakriyāguṇavyapadeśamutpattyavasthamapi kāryaṃ tataḥ prāgapi sat sattayā sambandhitvāt tatkāla prāgapi syuḥ sattāsambandhitvāt bhavanāt idānīṃ bhāvāt ākāśavat
anyathābhūtatvād neti cet, anyathābhavane'pi tadananyathābhavanameva mṛttantvāditadbhāvānatikramāt sajātīyāsajātīyetarasvabhāvabhūtatvāt sucirādapi tattattvāt dṛḍhībhūtaghaṭavat

yadapi coktaṃ nāsya putro'stītyaputra iti putrāntarasambandhaḥ pratiṣidhyate iti idamapi nātigamitārtham, atrāpi hi putrāntarasambandho na pratiṣidhyate naña uttarapadābhidheyanivāraṇārthatatpuruṣasamāsasambhavasāmarthyāt, bahuvrīhāvapi putrātmatva- dravyādivat
kimuktaṃ bhavati sattāsambandhitvāt iti ? ata āha --bhavanāt, abhūtakriyāguṇavyapadeśābhimatāvasthaṃ kāryaṃ tataḥ pūrvamapi vastusvarūpameva, nābhāvaḥ, idānīṃ bhāvāt ākāśavaditi tadvyaktyartham
idānīmapi na sattayā sambadhyeta kāryam, prāgasattvāt, khapuṣpavaditi viparyayeṇāniṣṭāpādanasādhanam
prāgapi syuḥ sattāsambandhitvāt bhavanāt idānīṃ bhāvāt ākāśavat
anyathābhūtatvād neti cet, anyathābhavane'pi tadananyathābhavanameva mṛttantvāditadbhāvānatikramāt sajātīyāsajātīyetarasvabhāvabhūtatvāt sucirādapi tattattvāt dṛḍhībhūtaghaṭavat

yadapi coktaṃ nāsya putro'stītyaputra iti putrāntarasambandhaḥ pratiṣidhyate iti idamapi nātigamitārtham, atrāpi hi putrāntarasambandho na pratiṣidhyate naña uttarapadābhidheyanivāraṇārthatatpuruṣasamāsasambhavasāmarthyāt, bahuvrīhāvapi putrātmatva-
anyathābhūtatvād neti cet, pratyakṣaṃ tantubhyo'nyathā paṭabhavanāt pratyakṣaviruddhaṃ prāgapi sat kāryam iti vacanamiti cet, tad na, pratyakṣamanyathābhavane'pi tadananyathābhavanameva pratyakṣataḥ

hetorasya vyākhyā --sajātīyāsajātīyetarasvabhāvabhūtatvāt, ghaṭasya sajātīyāni ghaṭāntarāṇi, asajātīyāni paṭādīni, tebhya ubhayebhya itaraḥ anyo ghaṭaḥ sajātīyāsajātīyabhinno deśakālākārapramāṇarūpādibhedāt
nanvevaṃ sajātīyāsajātīyabhinnatve svakāraṇebhyo'pi bhinnatvāt prāgasattvameva prāptaṃ kāryasyeti
etaccāyuktam, svabhāvabhūtatvāt iti viśeṣyoktatvāt svasamavāyikāraṇabhūtaparamāṇudvyaṇukādirūparasādyātmakapariṇāmasvabhāvenaiva bhūtatvāditi tadbhāvānatikrama evaivaṃ vyākhyāto bhavati

kiñcānyat, sucirādapi tattattvāt; deśakālākārādibhede satyapi mṛdaḥ piṇḍādyavasthāsu mṛdavasthāgatarūpādisvarūpānativṛtteḥ paramāṇurūpāditattva eva ghaṭaḥ, tasmādanyathābhavane'pi tadananyathābhavanameva

kimiva ? dṛḍhībhūtaghaṭavat, yathā mālavanagare ghaṭo dṛḍhībhūta ārdrādi-sāmiśuṣka-nava-yuva-madhyama-purāṇādyavasthāsu anyathābhavane'pi ghaṭatvamanatikrāman saptasu varṣaśateṣu nīteṣvapi sa eva tathā bhavati evaṃ tadapi kāryaṃ dravyādīti
kiñcānyat, yadapi cetyādi pūrvapakṣapratyuccāraṇaṃ yāvat pratiṣidhyata iti
tad vivriyate--yadapi sata evāsattvapratipādanārthaṃ dṛṣṭāntatvenoktam--nāsya putro'stītyaputraḥ, na tu putro na bhavatīti, tasyānyaputratvāditi
tadapi nātigamitārthamiti dākṣiṇyavacanametat, mā niṣṭhuraṃ vocamiti
kathamagamitārtham ? yasmādatrāpi putrāntara meva pratiṣidhyate nañā ataddravyatvāt svayaṃ putrībhāvapariṇāmaśūnyatvāt khapuṣpavat
7 sambandho na pratiṣidhyate, anyasya svāmiputrāderdṛṣṭatvāt tasya putro'stīti bahuvrīhisamāsārthasya pratyakṣaviruddhasyāsambhavāt

kiṃ tarhi vaktavyam ? naña uttarapadābhidheyanivāraṇārthatatpuruṣasamāsasambhavasāmarthyāt, yathā bhikṣāṃ dehi iti gṛhabahirantaḥsthayoryācakadāyakayoryācñādānasambhavavat ko bhikṣāṃ dadāti ? iti praśne pratyākhyānadānasambhavavat gavākṣe gāvaḥ ityādityakiraṇasambhavavadvā uttarapadābhidheyasambhavaḥ svayamevāsau putro na bhavati ityuktaṃ bhavati, tacca vakṣyate
abhyupagamya bahuvrīhiṃ bahuvrīhāvapi putrātmatvameva pratiṣidhyate nañā na putrāntarasambandhaḥ

kasmāt ? ataddravyatvāt, tad dravyaṃ tat kāraṇaṃ tad bījaṃ pariṇāmi asya tadidaṃ taddravyam, na taddravyamataddravyam, tadbhāvādataddravyatvāt svayaṃ putrībhāvapariṇāmaśūnyatvāt svayaṃ svaputratvenānutpitsutvādityarthaḥ
yathoktam --agaṇirūpitā agaṇipariṇāmitā agaṇisarīreti vattavvaṃ siyā bhagavatīsū॰ 5

tānyeva pituḥ yadapyuktam aguṇo guṇaḥ iti tadapi guṇabhūto'yamartho na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? svatantraṃ dravyameveti guṇasandrāvavāde guṇabhāvo guṇasya pratiṣidhyate na guṇasambandho yugapadayugapadbhāvitā, bhavanalakṣaṇadravyatvāt, saṅgrahavādavadvā
hṛdayādabhijāyase iti, prajñāpi saiva putrasya yā pituḥ, aśvādiprajñāyā manuṣyādiṣvabhāvāt
meva pratiṣidhyate nañā ataddravyatvāt svayaṃ putrībhāvapariṇāmaśūnyatvāt khapuṣpavat
ātmā tvaṃ putra māvithajānītha sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam
sa tvamaṅgakaṣāyo'si digdhaviddhāmiva mādayemāmamūṃ mayīti iti bṛhadāraṇyakopaniṣadi pāṭhaḥ 6
ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam
atra ॰dāpakayoḥ iti pāṭhābhirucau ॰dāpakayoryācñādāpanasambhavavat iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīna eva

aha bhaṃte ! odaṇe kummāse surā ee ṇaṃ kiṃsarīrāti vattavvaṃ siyā ? goyamā ! odaṇe kummāse surāe ya je ghaṇe davve ee ṇaṃ puvvabhāvapannavaṇaṃ ṣaḍucca vaṇassaijīvasarīrā tao pacchā satthātīyā satthapariṇāmiā agaṇijjhāmiyā agaṇijjhūsiyā agaṇiseviyā agaṇipariṇāmiyā agaṇijīvasarīrāti vattavvaṃ siyā
surāe ya je dave davve ee ṇaṃ puvvabhāvapannavaṇaṃ paḍucca āujīvasarīrā, tao pacchā satthātīyā jāva aṇagikāyasarīrāti vattavvaṃ siyā
ee ṇaṃti etāni, ṇamityalaṅkāre, kiṃsarīratti keṣāṃ śarīrāṇi kiṃśarīrāṇi ? surāe ya je ghaṇetti, surāyāṃ dve dravye syātām--ghanadravyaṃ dravadravyaṃ ca
tatra yad ghanadravyaṃ puvvabhāvapannavaṇaṃ paḍuccatti atītaparyāyaprarūpaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya vanaspatiśarīrāṇi, pūrvaṃ hi odanādayo vanaspatayaḥ
tao pacchatti vanaspatijīvaśarīravācyatvānantaram agnijīvaśarīrāṇi iti vaktavyaṃ syāditi sambandhaḥ
kimbhūtāni santi ? ityāha--satthātīyatti, śastreṇa udūkhalamuśalayantrakādinā karaṇabhūtena atītāni atikrāntāni pūrvaparyāyamiti śastrātītāni
satthapariṇāmiyatti śastreṇa pariṇāmitāni kṛtāni navaparyāyāṇi śastrapariṇāmitāni
tataśca agaṇijjhāmiyatti, vahninā dhyāmitāni śyāmīkṛtāni svakīyavarṇatyājanāt
tathā agaṇijjhūsiyatti agninā śoṣitāni pūrvasvabhāvakṣapaṇāt, agninā sevitāni vā juṣī prītisevanayoḥ pā॰ dhā॰ tudādi॰ 8 ityasya dhātoḥ prayogāt
athavā satthātītā ityādau śastramagnireva, agaṇijjhāmiyā ityādi tu tadvyākhyānameveti

yadapyuktam aguṇo guṇaḥ iti tadapi guṇabhūto'yamartho na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? svatantraṃ dravyameveti guṇasandrāvavāde guṇabhāvo guṇasya pratiṣidhyate na guṇasambandho yugapadayugapadbhāvitā, bhavanalakṣaṇadravyatvāt, saṅgrahavādavadvā

yadapyuktaṃ dvitīyamudāharaṇaṃ tatraiva aguṇo guṇaḥ iti śāstrīyaṃ tadapi guṇabhūto'pradhāno dravyāśrayī upasarjana itīṣṭo'yamartho na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? svatantraṃ pradhānaṃ dravyameveti, uttarapadābhidheyanivāraṇārthatvād nañaḥ
na tu nāsya guṇo'stītyaguṇo guṇaḥ, tasya hi rūpādeḥ parasparato'nyarasādiguṇakasya guṇasadbhāvāt
sattvādervā guṇasandrāvavāde guṇavattvād guṇabhāvo guṇasya guṇatvameva pratiṣidhyate, na guṇasambandhaḥ

sa ca dṛṣṭo guṇasambandhaḥ yugapadayugapadbhāvitā, yugapadbhāvitā rūparasagandhasparśasaṅkhyānādīnāṃ guṇānāṃ sambandhaḥ, ayugapadbhāvimṛtpiṇḍaśivakasthāsakādīnāmayugapadbhāvitā, kṛṣṇanīlaśuklaraktādivarṇādibhedānāmayugapadbhāvitādi śeṣaguṇānāmiti
kasmāt ? bhavanalakṣaṇadravyatvāt, dravyaṃ ca bhavye pā॰ 5
104 bhavatīti dravyaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavanasambandhayogyam, guṇāḥ sandrutyaiva tiṣṭhanti bhavanti dravantīti guṇayanti guṇyante drūyante jñāyante cetyeka evārtha iti
saṅgrahavādavadvā, yathā vā saṅgrahanayavāde sarvasya sarvātmakatvāt ta eva rūpaparamāṇvādidravyaviśeṣāḥ svajātyaparityāgena yugapadayugapacca bhavanti dravanti drūyate bhūyate tairevetyuktam
yathoktam--atthittaṃ atthitte pariṇamatīti ṇatthittaṃ ṇatthitte pariṇamati bhagavatīsū॰ 1
etadanusāreṇa sa ca dṛṣṭo guṇasambandhaḥ, yugapadbhāvitā rūparasagandhasparśasaṅkhyānādīnāṃ guṇānāṃ sambandhaḥ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
tathā svavacanavirodhādeḥ sadapyasaditi, yadapi sat iti dravyādi kāryamiṣṭaṃ tadapi svavacanavirodhāderdoṣādasadeva jāyata iti pakṣaḥ
sattayā sambandhamanubhūya sat ityabhidhānaṃ pratyayaṃ ca labhate kāryam, viśeṣaṇasvarūpābhidhānapratyayabhāktvād viśeṣyasya, daṇḍanimittadaṇḍyabhidhānapratyayabhāgdevadattavat
sattāsambandhaśca sannihitālliṅgāt sadabhidhānapratyayadarśanādanumīyate, ataḥ sattāsambandhāt sad bhavati ityuktaṃ bhavatīti paramatasamarthanameva tāvadetat
tasmāt sattāsambandhena bhāvyamānaṃ sad bhavati, bhāvyamānaṃ sad bhavati, yacca bhāvyamānaṃ sad bhavati tadārambhakebhyo bhavati dravyādyārabdhadravyāntarādivad bhāvyamānabhavitṛtvāt
sattāpi yadi dravyāderbhāvikā tataḥ kāraṇam, bhāvakatvāt, ārambhakavat

sati sattāntarādhānād neti cet, na, tulyatvāt, evamapi kāraṇameva te sattā sati sattāntarādhāyitvāt paṭasattādhāyitantusaṃyogavat, vṛttasattvātiriktasattvakāraṇa- parata ātmānaṃ labhate na svata ityarthaḥ
tataḥ kim ? tata idaṃ bhavati --yacca bhāvyamānaṃ sad bhavati tadārambhakebhyo bhavati kāraṇadravyādibhya ityarthaḥ

sādhyānugatasādhanavacanāt sādharmyadṛṣṭānta eṣaḥ, tannidarśanaṃ hetunā'vyavahitaṃ pratipattilāghavārtham --dravyādyārabdhadravyāntarādivaditi, yathā dravyaguṇakarmabhirdravyaguṇāntarāṇyārabhyante, karma ca guṇaiḥ saṃyogavibhāgaprayatnagurutvasaṃskārādṛṣṭaiḥ, tathā sattayā ārabhyate tat sat kāryam
asat tat iti ca bruvataḥ svavacanavirodho'numānavirodhaśca, pratyakṣābhyupagamarūḍhivirodhā api yojyāstathaiva
evaṃ tāvad dravyādikāryamutpattyavasthāyāṃ svata evāsti itīṣṭamapi sattāsambandhād bhavitṛtvāt asadeva ityuktam
bhā॰ pratau tu etadantargataḥ pāṭho nāstyeva
bhāvyamānaṃ sad bhavati, yacca bhāvyamānaṃ sad bhavati tadārambhakebhyo bhavati dravyādyārabdhadravyāntarādivad bhāvyamānabhavitṛtvāt
sattāpi yadi dravyāderbhāvikā tataḥ kāraṇam, bhāvakatvāt, ārambhakavat
sati sattāntarādhānād neti cet, na, tulyatvāt, evamapi kāraṇameva te sattā sati sattāntarādhāyitvāt paṭasattādhāyitantusaṃyogavat, vṛttasattvātiriktasattvakāraṇa-
na kevalaṃ dravyamevāsat tadā, kiṃ tarhi ? sattāpi ca nāsti ityāpādayiṣyate hetusadbhāvena kāraṇatvādibhyaḥ
kāraṇatvāt tāvat --sattāpi yadi dravyādeḥ kāryasya bhavato bhāvikā tata uktavidhinā kāraṇam, bhāvakatvāt bhāvayitṛtvādityarthaḥ, tasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ pā॰ 6

ārambhakavaditi paṭasya tantvādivaditi vakṣyate, iha tu sāmānyena yathārambhakāḥ paramāṇavastatsamavāyinaḥ saṃyogavibhāgā adṛṣṭādiguṇāśca sāpekṣā nirapekṣāḥ kriyāścādṛṣṭādihetukāḥ kāraṇāni bhāvakāni yathāsambhavaṃ dvyaṇukādikāryadravyāṇāṃ guṇānāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca tathā sattāpi kāraṇamiti

syānmatam--svayamutpanne samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇārabdhe dravyādau kārye svabhāvataḥ satyeva sattāntaraṃ sambandhisattvamādhīyate tayā sattayā, tasmād nārambhikā sā, anārambhakatvāccā'kāraṇamaṇvādivat, ato vaiṣamyaṃ dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ, bhāvakatvaṃ vā tasyā nāstīti

abhyupetyāpyabhāvakatvaṃ sati sattāntarādhāyitvaṃ ca sattāyāḥ evamapi kāraṇameva te sattā, sati sattāntarādhāyitvāt, paṭasattādhāyitantusaṃyogavat, yathā tantubhiḥ parasparasaṃyogāpekṣairārabdhe paṭe sati tatsaṃyogaḥ sattāsamavāyajaṃ sambandhisattvamādadhānaḥ kāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ tathā sattāpi syāditi
syānmatam— ārambhakāḥ paramāṇavo na saṃyogaḥ, tasmād vaiṣamyamiti
etaccāyuktam, saṃyogasyāpyārambhakatveṣṭeḥ kāraṇatvamātrasādhanād vā na doṣa iti
athavā vṛttasattvātiriktasattvakāraṇatvāt kāraṇameva sattā iti tvāt tantvādivat

ata eva ca nāsya sat tadidamasat iti svānvayavṛtti sattvavyatirekavṛtti ca nirūpitamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ niṣkalaṃ sattvaṃ yasya tad dravyādi sidhyatyeva, tadarthamabhidhānapratyayahetunā anyena sattādinā nārthaḥ, svata eva siddhaprayojanatvāt
tatra dravyādivyatiriktasya sadabhidhānapratyayahetoranavakāśaḥ svata eva siddhābhidhānapratyayatvāt, sattādivat, ākāśādivat
svagataputratvasaṃsiddhānvayavyatirekā- vartate, yasmād vṛttasya niṣpannasya kāraṇāntaraiḥ svabhāvasataḥ tato'tiriktaṃ sambandhisattvaṃ karoti sattā tasmāt kāraṇameva
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? tantvādivat, yathā vṛttasattvaṃ tantutvaṃ tadatiriktapaṭasattvakaraṃ kāraṇaṃ ca tathā satteti

athavā yathā vṛttasya tantubhirārabdhasya paṭasya janmottarakālamapi sattvaṃ kurvantastantava eva saṃyogāpekṣāḥ kāraṇaṃ paṭasyeṣyante tathā sattāpi vṛttasattvātiriktasattvakaratvāt kāraṇameva syāt, ādigrahaṇāt kapālavīraṇādidravyāṇyudāhartavyānīti
aṇvādivat iti vaidharmyadṛṣṭānto'tra vivakṣita iti bhāti

ata eva ca nāsya sat tadidamasat iti svānvayavṛtti sattvavyatirekavṛtti ca nirūpitamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ niṣkalaṃ sattvaṃ yasya tad dravyādi sidhyatyeva, tadarthamabhidhānapratyayahetunā anyena sattādinā nārthaḥ, svata eva siddhaprayojanatvāt
tatra dravyādivyatiriktasya sadabhidhānapratyayahetoranavakāśaḥ svata eva siddhābhidhānapratyayatvāt, sattādivat, ākāśādivat
tathā ca dravyādyanyatamadeva tat, sāmānyaṃ sattākhyaṃ dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karma vā, nānyat syāt
yaddhi kāraṇaṃ tad dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karma vā, nāto'nyad dṛṣṭam, yathā tantavastatsaṃyogāśca tatkriyāśca
tasmāt sāmānyaṃ sadanityaṃ dravyavat kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavacca dravyādivat, ato dravyādīnāmeva sadādiṣaḍaviśeṣā iti vyākhyā vyarthā

etasmādeva dravyādyanyatamasvarūpatvāt sattāyāḥ sāmānyākhyāyāḥ nāsya sat tadidamasat iti vigṛhya asya ityanvayāt na iti ca vyatirekād dravyaguṇakarmākhyasya trayasya sato'vadhāraṇārthaṃ pratiṣedhavācinā nañā vyavacchedyaṃ sattvamabhyupagamya svānvayavṛtti sattvavyatirekavṛtti ca nirūpitamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ niṣkalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ svarūpato'vadhāritaṃ ca sattvaṃ yasya tad dravyādi dravyāntarādisadvyatirekeṇa svānvayena ca yathā vyākhyātaṃ sidhyatyeva
tasmāt tadarthaṃ dravyādyavadhāraṇārthamabhidhānapratyayahetunānyena sattādinā nārthaḥ na prayojanaṃ svata eva siddhaprayojanatvādityuktopasaṃhāraḥ

dravyādivyatiriktasya sadabhidhānapratyayahetordravyādāvanavakāśaḥ, svata eva siddhābhidhānapratyayatvāt, yatra svata eva siddhābhidhānapratyayatvaṃ tatrānyasya sadabhidhānapratyayahetornāvakāśo'sti yathā sattāsamavāyaviśeṣeṣviti
athavāśrayāśrayiṇoḥ pāratantryasvātantryavyākhyākusṛtipratyutthānaṃ mā kārṣīd vaiśeṣika iti nirāśaṅkamākāśādivaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, dikkālākāśadravyāṇi hi dikkālādimukhyasāmānyaśūnyānīti
anvaya bhidhānapratyayo devadattaḥ putra eva sūnvanapekṣaputratvaḥ, evamatra svabhāvasiddhereva dravyāditvaṃ netarasattvāt

tadyathā--vācā gamite viniyogārtho na kṛta iti tadarthaṃ pradīpaprakāśa upādīyate, tasyopādānaṃ na vyartham, na ca punastasyānyaḥ prakāśaḥ prakāśanārtha upādīyate, tathehāpi dravyādikāryeṇa upabhogakriyā nāsti ityasat aśaktasadasattvāt vyatirekayuktāvabhidhānapratyayāvaśvarathavadanvayavyatirekābhidhānapratyayau, tau svagatena putratvena saṃsiddhau yasmin so'yaṃ svagataputratvasaṃsiddhānvayavyatirekābhidhānapratyayo devadattaḥ putra eva sūnvanapekṣaputratvaḥ svasūnumanapekṣya vyākhyātavidhinā puruṣāntarasya pituḥ putra eva sannaputraḥ svasūnvabhāvāditi yathā putra evāputra ityucyate
svabhāvasadbhāvasiddhereva dravyāditvam, netarasattvāt na sambandhisattvāditi, vicāraphalaṃ nigamyate --evaṃ sadaviśeṣavicāradvāreṇa sattāyā nirākaraṇaṃ kṛtam
bhidhānapratyayo devadattaḥ putra eva sūnvanapekṣaputratvaḥ, evamatra svabhāvasiddhereva dravyāditvaṃ netarasattvāt

tadyathā--vācā gamite viniyogārtho na kṛta iti tadarthaṃ pradīpaprakāśa upādīyate, tasyopādānaṃ na vyartham, na ca punastasyānyaḥ prakāśaḥ prakāśanārtha upādīyate, tathehāpi dravyādikāryeṇa upabhogakriyā nāsti ityasat aśaktasadasattvāt
dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karma ityatrāpi dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvasāmānyaviśeṣanirapekṣāvabhidhānapratyayau svata eva dravyādīnāṃ sulabhau vyākhyātavaditi, tatrāpi tulyapracarcatvāt

etena satsatkaratvapakṣe'pi sākṣātkṛtameva vaiyarthyam, nāsya sadityasatpakṣe yathābhihitaṃ vicārāvasāne --nāsataḥ satkarī sattā saddravyādivyatiriktasya sattādravyatvādestatsadabhidhānapratyayahetoranavakāśaḥ svata eva siddhābhidhānapratyayatvāt sattādivaditi tathā tadeva satāṃ dravyādīnāṃ satkarī sattā ityatrāpīti pratyakṣīkṛtamasmākaṃ tvayaiva vaiyarthyam, sattāsambandhasya svata eva siddhatvāditi

anavasthādoṣaparihārārthaḥ pratisamādhānavikalpaḥ --naiṣa doṣo dṛṣṭāntādityādi, dṛṣṭāntastadyathā--vācā gamite prakāśite ghaṭa iti jñānamātrādhāne kṛte tāvatā jalādyāharaṇādikriyāviniyogārtho na kṛta iti tadarthaṃ ghaṭagrahaṇadhāraṇādyarthaṃ ca pradīpaprakāśa upādīyate, tasya vākprakāśādanyaprakārasya pradīpaprakāśasyopādānaṃ na vyarthaṃ na ca punastasyānyaḥ pradīpo'nyo vā prakāśaḥ prakāśanārtha upādīyate

upanayaḥ --tathehāpi dravyādikāryeṇa vastūdbhūtiprakāśamātreṇa svakāraṇotpāditamātreṇa vākprakāśitaghaṭasthānīyena dravyādeḥ kāryasyopabhogakriyā nāsti, puruṣopabhogārthāśca sarvāḥ kriyā ityataḥ kāraṇādasat, aśaktasadasattvāt aśaktasya svakāryakaraṇe sata evāsattvāt, kṣutpratīkārāśaktāsadvrīhivat, vicitropabhogasiddhyarthaṃ bhinneṣu abhinnābhidhānapratyayavyavahārasiddhyarthaṃ ca sattvaviśeṣaṇena sambandhaḥ arthavatprakāśanāvasthāvat' iti pratisamādhānavikalpaḥ so'pyanupapanno'vasthādṛṣṭāntāsattvāt anekāntatvāt

vākprakāśaprakāśakapradīpavat pradīpaprakāśasyāpi indriyaprakāśyatvāt tasyāpi bahuprabhedopakaraṇaprakāśyatvāt teṣāmapi labdhiprakāśyatvāt labdherapyupayogaphalāyā- aṅkurāvasthāyāmiva vrīherakaṭhināvasthāyāmiva vā kṣutpratīkārāśaktāsadvrīhivat

vicitropabhogasiddhyarthaṃ ghaṭapaṭakaṭādibhiḥ parasparavyatiriktairjaladhāraṇatvaktrāṇapracchādanādyupabhogasiddhyarthaṃ bhinneṣu ghaṭādiṣu deśakālādibhiḥ samānajātīyeṣu abhinnābhidhānapratyayavyavahārasiddhyarthaṃ ca sāmānyānviteṣu sattvaviśeṣaṇena prakārāntareṇa saṃbandhaḥ, arthavata eva vākprakāśasya punaḥ prakāśane pradīpaprakāśasyeva vākprakāśitaghaṭaviṣayasyāvasthāvadanavasthādoṣābhāvavacceti yo'yaṃ pratisamādhānavikalpaḥ so'pyanupapanna ityādi taduttaraṃ yāvat pradīpādiprakāśanavaditi
kasmādanupapanna iti cet, ucyate --avasthādṛṣṭāntāsattvāt, asāveva pradīpadṛṣṭāntaḥ avasthāvān ityabhimato'vasthāvān na bhavati, anekāntatvāt, ekāntarūpo hi niścito'rtho dṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt syāt
tvadudgrāhitasyārthasya tu na hi vyarthatvaikāntānugataṃ prakāśanam, yadi pradīpasya prakāśāntareṇa prakāśanaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt tatraivāvasthā syāt, sā tu nāsti

yasmād vākprakāśaprakāśakapradīpavat pradīpaprakāśasyāpi indriyaprakāśyatvāt, indriyeṇa hi pradīpo'pi prakāśyate vākprakāśaprakāśakapradīpavadindriyeṇānupalabdhasyāgṛhītasya ghaṭādervicitropabhogāsiddheḥ

kimindriye'vasthā syāt ? netyucyate, tasyāpi bahuprabhedopakaraṇaprakāśyatvāt, tadapi hīndriyaṃ nirvṛttyupakaraṇa yogyātmopāttendriyaparyāptyākhyapudgaladravyaprakāśyamañjana-pādābhyaṅga-nasya-pathyabhojana-pradīpādibāhyadravyaprakāśyaṃ jñānātmātmaprakāśyaṃ ca

sāpi labdhirātmanaḥ praṇidhānākhyena vīryeṇāpanīte jñānāvaraṇādikāluṣye jīvasyopayogalakṣaṇasya prasādamātraṃ jñānamupayogastena prakāśyate labdherapyupayogaphalāyāstatpra statprakāśyatvāt tasyāpi bāhyopayogyadravyopayogaprakāśyatvādanavasthā
so'pi hi jaṃ jaṃ je je bhāve pariṇamati paogavīsasādavvaṃ
taṃ taha jāṇāti jiṇo apajjave jāṇaṇā ṇatthi
āvani॰ 794 iti bāhyavastupariṇāmānurūpopyogāt tatprakāśya upayogo'pītyataḥ paraṃ punaruktaṃ bhavati prakāśyaprakāśaka prakāśyaḥ prakāśaḥ atadrūpabhāvādhigamyatvāt
pradhānamapi caivaṃ syād bhavatparikalpitā sattā viśvarūpopabhogapratipādanārthatvāt puruṣārthatvād guṇatrayavat
kāryamapi te prāgapi sadeva prāpnoti, aśaktasadasattvenādhyāsyamānatvāt satkriyamāṇatvāt, utpannamātradravyādivat
yadvā na tat satkriyate na bhāvyate vā kenacidarthāntareṇa, sadbhūtatvāt, sattādivat
sattāpi cāśrayasya dravyāderatadrūpasya pratyayenātmānaṃ labhate, tena prakāśyate, vākprakāśāvagamitasyārthasya pradīpādinā prakāśanavat, na svata evetyanavasthādoṣo'trāpi tadavasthaḥ

kṣutpratīkārāśaktāsadvrīhivat, vicitropabhogasiddhyarthaṃ bhinneṣu abhinnābhidhānapratyayavyavahārasiddhyarthaṃ ca sattvaviśeṣaṇena sambandhaḥ arthavatprakāśanāvasthāvat' iti pratisamādhānavikalpaḥ so'pyanupapanno'vasthādṛṣṭāntāsattvāt anekāntatvāt
vākprakāśaprakāśakapradīpavat pradīpaprakāśasyāpi indriyaprakāśyatvāt tasyāpi bahuprabhedopakaraṇaprakāśyatvāt teṣāmapi labdhiprakāśyatvāt labdherapyupayogaphalāyā-
atra deśakālākārādibhiḥ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 468 paṃ॰ 17
tathāhi --nayacakravṛttikāramatena tatsvarūpaṃ prāg varṇitameva, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 183 paṃ॰ 19--20, pṛ॰ 372 paṃ॰ 19--21
asya siddhasenagaṇikṛtā vyākhyā--"dvividhānīndriyāṇi bhavanti sāmānyataḥ dravyamayāni dravyātmakāni dravyendriyāṇi, bhāvendriyāṇi tu bhāvātmakāni ātmapariṇatirūpāṇīti
atra ca pudgaladravyamevānantapradeśaskandhamātmaprayogāpekṣamāyatate nirvṛttyupakaraṇarūpatayā, sarvāṇīndriyāṇi anantapradeśāni asaṅkhyeyātmapradeśādhiṣṭhitāni ca dravyātmakāni bhavanti
itaratra dvaye ātmapariṇāmo bhāvaḥ prayatnamātiṣṭhate iti
uktamindriyaṃ dravyabhāvabhedato dvividham, adhunā svarūpato nirūpayitukāma āha, tatra nirvṛttyupakaraṇe dravyendriyam tattvārthasū॰ 2
17, tatra ityanena bhāṣyakāraḥ sūtraṃ sambandhayati, tatra dvitaye dravyendriyaṃ tāvannirdhāryate svarūpabhedābhyām
ubhayametat pudgalapariṇāmarūpamapi sat indriyavyapadeśamaśnute bhāvendriyopayogakāraṇatvāt, yasmāddhi tatsācivyaṃ bhāvasyaivolliṅgane samāyāti
ātmabhāvapariṇāmasya bhāvino yat sahāyatayā kṣamaṃ dravyaṃ tadiha dravyendriyaṃ prasthadāruvadeṣitavyam

nirmāṇanāma nāmakarmāntargataḥ karmabhedo vardhakisthānīyaḥ karṇaśaṣkulyādyavayavasanniveśaviśeṣaracanāyāmāhitanaipuṇaḥ, tathā audārikādiśarīratrayāṅgopāṅganāmakarmabhedo yadudayādaṅgāni upāṅgāni ca niṣpadyante śiroṅgulyādīni, etat karmadvayamubhayarūpadravyendriyaprasādhanāya yatate
bhāṣyabhāvanā caivaṃ kāryā--nirvṛttiḥ kiṃrūpā ? ityata āha--aṅgeti
aṅgopāṅganāmnā prativiśiṣṭena karmabhedena nirvartitāni janitāni ghaṭitāni indriyadvārāṇi indriyavivarāṇi
indriyaśabdena cātra bhāvendriyamupayogarūpaṃ vivakṣitam, tasya indriyasya dvārāṇi avadhānapradānamārgāścitrāḥ
śaṣkulyādirūpā bahirupalabhyamānākārā nirvṛttirekā, aparā tu abhyantaranirvṛttiḥ
nānākāraṃ kāyendriyamasaṅkhyeyabhedatvāt, asya cāntarbahirbhedo nirvṛtterna kaścit prāyaḥ
tatrādyaṃ svakāyaparīmāṇaṃ dravyamanaśca, śeṣāṇi aṅgulāsaṅkhyeyabhāgapramāṇāni sarvajīvānām
tathā cāgamaḥ--phāsiṃdie ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! kisaṃṭhie paṇṇatte ? goyamā ! nāṇāsaṃṭhāṇasaṃṭhie
jibbhiṃdie ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! kisaṃṭhie paṇṇatte ? goyamā ! khurappasaṃṭhie
ghāṇiṃdie ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! kisaṃṭhie paṇṇatte ? goyamā ! atimuttayacaṃdakasaṃṭhie paṇṇatte
cakkhuriṃdie ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! kiṃsaṃṭhie paṇṇatte ? goyamā ! masūrayacaṃdasaṃṭhie paṇṇatte
soiṃdie ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! kiṃsaṃṭhie paṇṇatte ? goyamā ! kalaṃbuyāpupphasaṃṭhie paṇṇatte prajñāpanāsū॰ 191, abhyantarāṃ nirvṛttimaṅgīkṛtya sarvāṇyamūni sūtrāṇyadhītāni
bāhyā punarnirvṛttiścitrākāratvānnopanibaddhuṃ śakyā, yathā manuṣyasya śrotraṃ bhrūsamaṃ netrayorubhayapārśvataḥ, aśvasya mastake netrayorupariṣṭāt tīkṣṇāgram, ityādijātibhedād bahuvidhākārā
imameva cātikrāntabhāṣyārthaṃ paryāyāntareṇa spaṣṭayati bhāṣyakāraḥ--karmaviśeṣasaṃskṛtāḥ śarīrapradeśāḥ
athavā aṅgopāṅganāmaivopāttamatītabhāṣye, na tu nirmāṇakarma, tadupādānāyedamucyate— karmaviśeṣetyādi

karmaviśeṣo nāmakarma, tasyāpi viśeṣaḥ aṅgopāṅganāma nirmāṇakarma ca, ābhyāṃ karmaviśeṣābhyāṃ saṃskṛtā viśiṣṭāvayavaracanayā niṣpāditā nirvartitāḥ audārikādiśarīrāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ pradeśāḥ prativiśiṣṭā deśāḥ karṇaśaṣkulyādayaḥ pradeśāḥ
