karmaviśeṣaṃ nāmagrāhamācaṣṭe, nirmāṇanāma ca aṅgopāṅgaṃ ca nirmāṇanāmāṅgopāṅge, madhyavyavasthito nāmaśabda ubhayaṃ viśeṣyatayākṣipati, te karmaṇī pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasyā nirvṛtteḥ sā nirmāṇanāmāṅgopāṅgapratyayā, mūlaguṇanirvartanā uttaraguṇanirvartanāpekṣayocyate

uttaraguṇanirvartanā hi śravaṇayorvedhaḥ pralambatāpādanam, cakṣurnāsikayorañjananasyābhyāmupaskāraḥ, tathā bheṣajapradānājjihvāyā jāḍyāpanayaḥ, sparśanasya vividhacūrṇagandhavāsapragharṣādibhirvimalatvakaraṇam

nirvṛttau satyāṃ kṛpāṇasthānīyāyāmupakaraṇendriyamavaśyamapekṣitavyam, tacca svaviṣayagrahaṇaśaktiyuktaṃ khaṅgasyeva dhārā chedanasamarthā, tacchaktirūpamindriyāntaraṃ nirvṛttau satyāmapi śaktyupaghātairviṣayaṃ na gṛhṇāti
tasmānnirvṛtte śravaṇādisaṃjñake dravyendriye tadbhāvādātmano'nupaghātānugrahābhyāṃ yadupakāri tadupakaraṇendriyaṃ bhavati
tacca bahirvarti antarvarti ca, nirvṛttidravyendriyāpekṣayā asyāpi dvaividhyamāvedyate
yatra nirvṛttidravyendriyaṃ tatropakaraṇendriyamapi na bhinnadeśavarti tasyeti kathayati tasyāḥ svaviṣayagrahaṇaśakternirvṛttimadhyavartinītvāt
etadeva sphuṭayati--nirvartitasya niṣpāditasya svāvayavavibhāgena yadanupahatyā anugraheṇa copakaroti grahaṇamātmanaḥ svacchatarapudgalajālanirmāpitaṃ tadupakaraṇendriyamadhyavasyanti vidvāṃsaḥ
āgame tu nāsti kaścidantarbahirbheda upakaraṇasyetyācāryasyaiva kuto'pi sampradāya iti
atha etadanusāriṇī haribhadrasūrikṛtā vyākhyā--anantaroktāni pañcāpīndriyāṇi dvividhāni bhavantīti sūtrasamudāyārthaḥ
caḥ samuccaye, dvividhametad dravyendriyaṃ bhāvendriyopakaraṇatvād dravyātmakatvācceti

...ihāṅgopāṅganāma audārikādiśarīratrayāṅgopāṅganirvartakaṃ yadudayādaṅgopāṅgānyutpadyante śiroṅgulyādīni, nirmāṇanāma cātra vardhakisthānīyaṃ karṇaśaṣkulyādyavayavasaniveśaviśeṣaracanāyāmāhitanaipuṇyamiti ācāryāḥ
taditthamaṅgopāṅganāmnā prativiśiṣṭena karmaṇā nirvartitāni janitāni...indriyadvārāṇi indriyavivarāṇi bhāvendriyāvadhānadvārāṇīti bhāvaḥ
etāni ca nānāsaṃsthānādīni, tathā cāgamaḥ--phāsiṃdie ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! kiṃsaṭhie paṇṇatte ?...

...kalaṃbuāpupphasaṃṭhie paṇṇatte prajñāpanāsū॰ 191, abhyantarāṃ nirvṛttimaṅgīkṛtya sarvāṇyamūni sūtrāṇyadhītāni, bāhyā punarnirvṛttiścitrākāratvānnopanibaddhuṃ śakyā aśvamanuṣyādīnāṃ bāhyaśrotrādibhedāditi

karmaviśeṣasaṃskṛtā iti, karmaviśeṣo nāmakarma, tasyāpi aṅgopāṅganāma nirmāṇakarma ca, ābhyāṃ saṃskṛtā viśiṣṭāvayavaracanayā nirvartitāḥ śarīrapradeśāḥ audārikādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ prativiśiṣṭā deśāḥ karṇaśaṣkulyādaya iti

nirmāṇanāma ca aṅgopāṅgaṃ ca nirmāṇanāmāṅgopāṅge, te pratyayaḥ kāraṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathāvidhā mūlaguṇanirvartanetyarthaḥ, nigamanametat nottaraguṇanirvartanā, sā hi karṇayoḥ vedhapralambatāpādanaṃ cakṣurnāsikayorañjananasyābhyāmupakāraḥ brāhmyādiyogājjihvāyāḥ sparśasya gandhādibhirvimalatvakaraṇamiti
ityartha ityevamartho'syāḥ pravacanajñairākhyāta iti vyākhyātā nirvṛttiḥ

tatra abhyantaraṃ khaṅgasthānīyāyā nirvṛttestaddhārāśaktikalpaṃ svacchatarapudgalajālaniṣpāditaṃ tadabhinnadeśameveti, yadadhikṛtyāha--nirvartitasyetyādi, nirvartitasya niṣpāditasya svāvayavavibhāgena nirvṛttīndriyasyeti gamyate, anupaghātānugrahābhyāmupakārīti, yadanupahatyā upagraheṇa copakaroti tadupakaraṇendriyamiti
tathāhi— nirvṛttau satyāmapi śaktyupaghāte na viṣayagrahaḥ, bāhyopakaraṇaghāte ca niyamataḥ śaktyupaghāta iti tatprādhānyato bāhyamabhyantaraṃ cetyāha
iṣṭāniṣṭaviṣayopalabdhābdhya ?rthāni bhokturātmano yānyamūnīndriyāṇi teṣāmuktasāmarthyaviśeṣādupanipatitabhedānāṃ pratyekaṃ bhedapratipattyarthamāha --dvividhāni tattvārthasū॰ 2
ayaṃ vidhaśabdaḥ prakāravācī gṛhyate, vidha-yukta-gata-prakārāḥ samānārthā iti
dvau vidhau yeṣāṃ tāni dvividhāni dviprakārāṇītyarthaḥ
kau ca dvau prakārau ? dravyendriyaṃ bhāvendriyamiti
karmaṇā yā nirvartyate niṣpādyate sā nirvṛttirityupadiśyate
teṣu ātmapradeśeṣu indriyavyapadeśabhāk yaḥ pratiniyatasaṃsthāno nāmakarmodayāpāditāvasthāviśeṣaḥ pudgalapracayaḥ sa bāhyā nirvṛttiḥ
labdhirnāma gatijātyādināmakarmajanitā tadāvaraṇīyakarmakṣayopaśamajanitā ca indriyāśrayakarmodayanirvṛttā ca jīvasya bhavati
sā pañcavidhā, tadyathā-sparśanendriyalabdhiḥ rasanendriyalabdhiḥ ghrāṇendriyalabdhiḥ cakṣurindriyalabdhiḥ śrotrendriyalabdhiriti
eṣāṃ ca satyāṃ nirvṛttāvupakaraṇopayogau bhavataḥ, satyāṃ ca labdhau nirvṛttyupakaraṇopayogā bhavanti nirvṛttyādīnāmekatarābhāve'pi viṣayālocanaṃ na bhavati
labdhiḥ pratisvamindriyāvaraṇakṣayopaśamaḥ, svaviṣayavyāpāraḥ praṇidhānaṃ vīryamupayogaḥ, etadubhayaṃ bhāvendriyamātmapariṇatilakṣaṇaṃ bhavati
lābho labdhiḥ prāptiḥ, nāmaśabdo vākyālaṅkārārthaḥ, athavā labdhiriti yadetad nāma abhidhānaṃ tasyāyamarthaḥ--gatijātyādināmakarmajanitā labdhirucyate

gatijātī ādiryasya tad gatijātyādi, gatijātyādi ca tannāmakarma ca gatijātyādināmakarma, tena janitā nirvartitā manuṣyagatināmodayād manuṣyaḥ tathā pañcendriyajātināmodayāt pañcendriya ityato manuṣyatvapañcendriyatvādilābhe pratisvaṃ tadāvaraṇakarmakṣayopaśamo nirvarttyate, tasya kṣayopaśamasya gatijātiprabhṛtināmakarma kāraṇatvānnidiṣṭamācāryeṇa
ādigrahaṇena yat tadatra nāntarīyakaṃ śarīrādikṣayopaśamalabdhernāmāntaḥpāti tat sakalamādīyate
apare tu āyuṣkamapi tadāśrayatvāt kāraṇamācakṣate kṣayopaśamasya
tasyāḥ khalu rūpādigrahaṇapariṇaterāvaṇīyamāvārakamācchādakam, bāhulakāt kartari vyutpattiḥ, tadāvaraṇīyaṃ ca tat karma ca tadāvaraṇīyakarma, matijñānadarśanāvaraṇakarmetyarthaḥ
tasyobhayasya kṣayopaśamo'bhihitalakṣaṇaḥ, tajjanitā ca tanniṣpāditā cetyarthaḥ
nanu ca kṣayopaśama eva labdhiruktā, tena janitā anyā kā bhavellabdhiḥ ? ucyate--matijñānadarśanāvaraṇakṣayopaśamāvasthānirvṛttau yo jñānasadbhāvaḥ kṣāyopaśamikaḥ so'tra labdhirucyate
kathaṃ kṛtvoktaṃ prāk kṣayopaśamo labdhiriti ? kāraṇe kāryopacāramālambya naḍvalodakaṃ pādarogavadityabhihitamato na doṣāya
punaḥ pratyāsannatamakāraṇanirdidikṣayā bhāṣyakṛt pratanute grantham--indriyāśrayakarmodayanirvṛttā ca jīvasya bhavatīti

indriyāṇyāśrayo'vakāśo yeṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ tānīndriyāśrayāṇi karmāṇi yāvanti kānicid nirmāṇāṅgopāṅgādīni yairvinā tāni na niṣpadyante tadudayena tadvipākena nirvṛttā janitā ātmano labdhirudbhavati, svacche hi darpaṇatale pratibimbodayo bhavati, na malīmase, tathā nirmāṇāṅgopāṅgādibhiratyantavimalatadyogyapudgaladravyanirmāpitānīndriyāṇi tasyāḥ kṣayopaśamalabdheratulaṃ balamupayacchanti kāraṇatāṃ bibhratīti

spṛṣṭiḥ sparśanam, sparśanaṃ ca tadindriyaṃ ceti sparśanendriyam, etadeva labdhiḥ sparśanendriyalabdhiḥ śītoṣṇādisparśaparijñānasāmarthyamanabhivyaktamupayogātmaneti yāvat, evaṃ jihvendriyādilabdhayo'pi vācyāḥ
ucyate--na khalu sarva upayogo labdhinirvṛttyupakaraṇendriyakṛtaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? sa evaikastritayanimitta ityata āha--upayogaḥ sparśādiṣu
sparśarasagandhavarṇaśabdeṣu grahaṇarūpo vyāpāra upayoga gṛhyate sparśanendriyādinimittaḥ, nāvadhyādyupayogaḥ
sparśādiviṣayo matijñānavyāpāraḥ pratiniyataviṣayānubhavanamupalambhanamiti, anena śeṣajñānavyudāsamādarśayati, matijñānopayoga eva labdhinirvṛttyupakaraṇāpekṣaḥ pravartate na śeṣa iti
paramāṇurapi hi sarvātmanopayujyate dvyaṇukādiskandhapariṇāme, tataśca so'pyupayogalakṣaṇaṃ prāpnotītyata āha bhāṣyakāraḥ--uktametadupayogo lakṣaṇamiti
abhihitametadupayogaścaitanyapariṇāmo jīvasya vaiśeṣikaṃ lakṣaṇam, kaḥ paramāṇvādiṣvatra prasaṅgaḥ ? atyantāsambandha eva
tamevopayogaṃ paryāyataḥ kathayati caitanyalakṣaṇaṃ viśeṣavyākhyānadarśanadvāreṇa upayoga ityādi
etadutkīrtayati--spaṣṭo hi matijñānopayogo mānasopayogāvaśyambhāvī dravyendriyādyapekṣaśca, nāvadhyādyupayogastatheti
āyoga iti svaviṣayamaryādayā sparśādibhedanirbhāso jñānodayaḥ sparśanendriyādijanmā abhidhīyate
tadbhāva iti, upayogalāñchano jantuḥ tacchabdenāmṛśyate, tasya bhāvaḥ sparśanādidvārajanma jñānamātmano bhūtirudbhava iti yāvat

eṣāmiti vyākhyātasvarūpāṇāṃ nirvṛttyupakaraṇalabdhyupayogendriya ṇāmayaṃ pravṛttikramo yaduta nirvṛttiḥ prāk, tasyāṃ satyāmupakaraṇamupayogaśca bhavati nirvṛttyāśrayatvādupakaraṇasya taddvārajanmatvāccopayogasya

etacca nirvṛttyāditraya labdhīndriyapūrvakaṃ darśayati--śrotrādikṣayopaśamalabdhau satyāṃ nirvṛttiḥ śaṣkulyādikā bhavati, yasya tu labdhirnāstyevaṃprakārā na khalu tasya prāṇinaḥ śaṣkulyādayo'vayavā nirvartyante, tasmāllabdhyādayaścatvāro'pi samuditāḥ śabdādiviṣayaparicchedamāpādayanta indriyavyapadeśamaśnuvate, ekenāpyavayavena vikalamindriya nocyate na ca svaviṣayagrahaṇasamarthaṃ bhavati
nirvṛttyupakaraṇalabdhyupayogānāmanyatamābhave ekenāpyaṅgena vikale sati samudāye na jātucit śabdādiviṣayasvarūpāvabodho bhavatyātmanaḥ vikalakaraṇatvāt...
upayogaḥ sparśādiṣu iti kecid bhāṣante sūtramidaṃ na bhavati, bhāṣyameva sūtrīkṛtya kecidadhīyate
tadetadayuktam, avigānena sūtramadhye'dhyayanāt prativiśiṣṭācāryasampradāyagamyatvād vivaraṇācca niścīyate sūtrateti
yatsannidhānādātmā dravyendriyanirvṛttiṃ prati vyāpriyate sa jñānāvaraṇakṣayopaśamaviśeṣo labdhiriti vijñāyate
taduktaṃ nimittaṃ pratītya utpadyamāna ātmanaḥ pariṇāma upayoga ityupadiśyate
jaṃ jaṃ je je bhāve pariṇamati paogavīsasādavvaṃ
evaṃ ca nayavigappajāyaparūvaṇaṃ sotūṇa vāulito sīso āha--bhagavaṃ ! kimettha tattaṃ ? ataḥ siddhāṃtato bhaṇṇati--jaṃ jaṃ...

tattha gurū bhaṇati sommamuha ! jaṃ jiṇo jāṇati taṃ tattaṃ; kiṃ puṇa jiṇo jāṇati ? bhaṇṇati--jaṃ jaṃ kiṃci vatthuṃ, je je kei bhāve, taṃ taṃ vatthuṃ te te savve bhāve va pariṇamati, savvaṃ vatthuṃ savvabhāvapariṇāmitti jaṃ bhaṇitaṃ, tathāhi--eko bhāvaḥ sarvabhāvasvabhāvaḥ sarve bhāvāḥ sarvabhāvasvabhāvāḥ
eko bhāvastattvato yena dṛṣṭaḥ sarve bhāvāstattvatastena dṛṣṭāḥ
payogavīsasatti, kei bhāve paogato pariṇamati kei vīsasā, taṃ pariṇāmi vatthuṃ tahā savvabhāvapariṇāmippagāreṇa jāṇāti, jaṃ puṇa apajjavataṃ tattha jāṇaṇā ṇatthitti
yān yān bhāvān ghaṭādīn pariṇamati prayogavisrasādravyam, tatra prayogeṇa ghaṭādīn visrasā abhrendradhanurādīn, dravyameva tadutprekṣitaparyāyaṃ kaṭakakeyūrāṅgadādivyapadeśārhasuvarṇavat
api ca, tat tat tathaiva anvayapradhānaṃ paryāyopasarjanaṃ jānāti paricchinatti jinaḥ
apajjave jāṇaṇā ṇatthitti, aparyāye nirākāre tathāpariṇatirahite ityarthaḥ, jāṇaṇā ṇatthitti parijñā nāsti
na ca te paryāyāstatra vastusantaḥ, dravyameva tathākāravat
prayogaścetanāvato vyāpāraḥ, visrasā svabhāvaḥ, tābhyāṃ niṣpannaṃ dravyaṃ prayogavisrasādravyamucyate

tatra prayogavisrasādravyaṃ kartṛ yān yān kṛṣṇaraktapītaśuklatvādīn bhāvān paryāyān pariṇamati pratipadyate taṃ tahatti vīpsāpradhānatvād nirdeśasya tat tat tathā tena tena rupeṇa pariṇamad dravyameva jānāti jinaḥ kevalī, na punastadatiriktān paryāyāniti bhāvaḥ, teṣāmutprekṣāmātreṇaiva sattvāt, na hyutphaṇaviphaṇakuṇḍalitādyavasthāyāmapi sarpādidravyasya svasvarūpavyatiriktaḥ ko'pi paryāyaḥ saṃlakṣyate, sarvāvasthāsu avicalitasvarūpasya sarpādidravyasyaiva saṃlakṣaṇāditi

yadi paryāyā na vidyante tarhi kathamucyate je je bhāve pariṇamai ? ityāśaṅkyāha--apajjave jāṇaṇā natthitti, aparyāye paryāyarahite vastuni kevalyādīnāṃ parijñā nāstīti manyāmahe, kevalamutprekṣāmātreṇaiva te paryāyāḥ, na punardravyavyatirekiṇaḥ kecanāpi vāstavāste vidyante
yat yat ātmamṛdādikaṃ vastu yān yān bhāvān paryāyān vijñānaghaṭādīn pariṇamati tadātvena pratipadyate prayogato visrasāto vā

tat sarvamutprekṣitaparyāyaṃ dravyameva utphaṇaviphaṇatvakuṇḍalitādiparyāyasamanvitasarpadravyavat, tathāhi--na tatra kevana utphaṇatādayaḥ sarpadravyātiriktāḥ paryāyāḥ santi pramāṇenānupalabdheḥ gaganakusumasya muvulitārdhamuvulitatvādiparyāyavat
kiñca, tad dravyaṃ tathaiva anvayaparyāyopasarjanaṃ jānāti paricchinatti jino bhagavān kevalī
kasmāt paryāthopasarjanaṃ jānāti, na tu paryāyarahitamityata āha--apajjave jāṇaṇā natthitti
aparyāye paryāyarahite yato jāṇaṇā parijñā kevalyādīnāmapi nāsti tataste utprekṣāmātreṇa vyavahriyante, na tu paramārthataḥ santi, tato dravyameva tāttvikam
vistareṇa tvasyā āvaśyakaniryuktigāthāyā artho nimnilikhitābhyo jinabhadragaṇikṣamāśraṇaviracitaviśeṣāvaśyakabhāṣyagāthābhyo'vaseyaḥ--jaṃ jāhe jaṃ bhāvaṃ pariṇamai tayaṃ tayā tao'ṇannaṃ
na suvaṇṇādannaṃ kuṃḍalāi taṃ ceya taṃ tamāgāraṃ
jai vā davvādanne guṇādao nūṇa sappaesattaṃ
davvapariṇāmamettaṃ pajjāo so ya na kharasiṃgassa
tadapajjavaṃ na najjai jaṃ nāṇaṃ neyavisayaṃti
taṃ taha jāṇāti jiṇo apajjave jāṇaṇā ṇatthi || āvani॰ 794
pradhānamapi caivaṃ syād bhavatparikalpitā sattā viśvarūpopabhogapratipādanārthatvāt puruṣārthatvād guṇatrayavat
kāryamapi te prāgapi sadeva prāpnoti, aśaktasadasattvenādhyāsyamānatvāt satkriyamāṇatvāt, utpannamātradravyādivat
yadvā na tat satkriyate na bhāvyate vā kenacidarthāntareṇa, sadbhūtatvāt, sattādivat

sāṅkhyaparikalpitaṃ sakalajagatkāraṇaṃ pradhānādiparyāyaṃ syād bhavatā vaiśeṣikeṇa parikalpitā sattā viśvarūpopabhogapratipādanārthatvāt puruṣārthatvād guṇatrayavat, yathā sattvarajastamonāmakaṃ puruṣārthaṃ pravartamānaṃ puruṣasya viśvarūpamupabhogaṃ pratipādayituṃ pravartamānaṃ pradhānameva na tato'nyad vyatiriktaṃ kiñcit tadvikāratvādevaṃ sattāpi pradhānameva syāt
kiñcānyat, kāryamapi ta ityādi yāvad dravyādivaditi
kāryamapi tava dravyādi janmakālāt prāgapi sadeva prāpnotītyetadapyaniṣṭāpādanam
athaivaṃ neṣyate na tat satkriyate dravyādyutpannamātraṃ na bhāvyate vā kenacidarthāntareṇa, sadbhūtatvāt, sattādivaditi, ādigrahaṇād dravyatvādisāmānyaviśeṣa-viśeṣa-samavāyavat
yadi tat kāraṇasamavetaṃ svata eva sanna bhavati asadeva tarhi tat, svato nirupākhyatvāt avyapadeśyatvāt tathā'viśiṣṭatvāt khapuṣpavat asat syāt
kāryamapi vā prāk sadutpatteḥ, ebhya eva, utpannamātradravyādivat
na tatsattā sattāntaramapekṣate, dravyādīnāmutpannānāṃ svabhāvasattā sambandhisattāṃ nāpekṣate sattāsambandharahitatve'pi sattātmakatvāt, atyantānupravṛttasattāvat mahāsāmānyavadityarthaḥ
anarthasattā, arthaḥ iti dravyaguṇakarmasu saṃjñāniyamādanarthāḥ sāmānya-viśeṣa-samavāyāḥ, teṣāmanarthānāṃ yā sattā sāpi cānyatrānādheyā anāśritetyarthaḥ
yadi tat kāraṇasamavetaṃ svata eva sanna bhavati asadeva tarhi tat, svato nirupākhyatvāt avyapadeśyatvāt tathā'viśiṣṭatvāt khapuṣpavat asat syāt
kāryamapi vā prāk sadutpatteḥ, ebhya eva, utpannamātradravyādivat
14, vināpyarthatvena sāmānyena triṣveva dravyādiṣu tatra prasiddhyarthaśabdaḥ prasiddhyārthaśabdaḥ ? prasiddho'rthaśabdaḥ ? prasiddhyarthamarthaśabdaḥ ? paribhāṣyate

kveva ? yathā sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu vinā sāmānyāntareṇa yathā sattādiṣu sāmānyeṣu sāmānyaṃ sāmānyam iti jñānaṃ tathā viśeṣeṣu viśeṣāntarābhāve'pi viśeṣo viśeṣaḥ iti taddarśināṃ vijñānamevaṃ dravyādiṣu vināpyarthatvena pāribhāṣiko'rthaśabdaḥ
indriyāṇyucyante, tāni ca na pañcātmakāni, yataḥ dravyeṣu pañcātmakaṃ pratyuktam vai॰ sū॰ 8
15, yato dravyeṣvārabdhavyeṣu pañca bhūtāni ārambhakāni na vidyante api tu yāni ārabhante ca vāri tāni svāṃ svāṃ jātimārabhante
evamindriyāṇyapi pratiniyatabhūtakāryāṇi, tathāhi --bhūyastvād gandhavattvācca pṛthivī gandhajñāne vai॰ sū॰ 8
16, gandhajñānaṃ ghrāṇam, tasminnārabdhavye pṛthivī kāraṇaṃ bhūyastvāt, śarīrāpekṣayā tu bhūyastvam
bhūyastvaṃ ca ghrāṇe pṛthivyāḥ, pādādinā gandhopalabdhyabhāvāt
gandhavattvācca, yataśca svasamavāyinā gandhena ghrāṇendriyaṃ gandhamabhivyanakti atastasya gandhavatī pṛthivyeva kāraṇam, bhūtāntarāṇi tu saṃyogīni svalpānyeva
tathāpastejo vāyuśca rasarūpasparśajñāneṣu rasarūpasparśeṣu T rasarūpasparśaviśeṣāt vai॰ sū॰ 8

17 iti, svasamavāyinā madhurāpākajena rasena rūpeṇa śuklabhāsvareṇa sparśena apākajānuṣṇāśītena yato rasana-nayana-sparśanāni rasarūpasparśānabhivyañjanti ato rasavattvād rūpavattvāt sparśavattvācca bhūtāntarairnimittairanabhibhūtatvena bhūyastvācca triṣvindriyeṣu yathāsaṅkhyamāpastejo vāyuśca samavāyikāraṇāni draṣṭavyāni
ākāśa tu svata eva śrotraṃ karṇaśaṣkulyāvacchinnaṃ, na prakṛtiranārambhakatvāt
yadi kāraṇeṣu samavetamātraṃ kāryaṃ svata eva sanna bhavati, sattāsambandhāt sad bhavati, sadeveti sadeva na bhavati, aguṇaguṇatvādivadasadapīti, yadyevamiṣyate tata evamāpannam --asadeva tarhi tat
kutaḥ ? svato nirupākhyatvāt, nirupākhyatvāt iti siddhe svataḥ iti viśeṣaṇaṃ vedanādīnāṃ svasaṃvedyānāṃ nirupākhyānāṃ sattvāt tadvadanaikāntikatā mā bhūditi
taddhi vedanādyasādhāraṇarūpeṇa nirupākhyamapi svata eva vastvātmanaiva sāmānyātmanā aṃśāntareṇa pararūpeṇa ca vyāvṛttena sopākhyamiti

tathā vividhaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ vā apadeśyo vyapadeśyaḥ, na vyapadeśyaḥ prakārāntareṇa vedanādivad vyapadeśyo na bhavatītyarthaḥ, khapuṣpavailakṣaṇyena tathā'viśiṣṭatvāditi viśeṣaṇena hi sadādinā vastveva sāmānyāṃśādinā vedanādi sambadhyate nāvastviti evaṃ sādharmyāt khapuṣpavadasat syāditi gatārtham
etadanabhyupagame kāryamapi vā prāk sadutpatteḥ, ebhya eva hetubhyaḥ svato nirupākhyatvāt ityādibhyaḥ, utpannamātradravyādivat
॰ti sadeveti sadeva iti kathañcid dvirbhūtaścet pāṭhastarhi sattāsambandhāt sad bhavati, sadeva na bhavati, aguṇaguṇatvādivadasadapīti iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīna iti pratibhāti
atra ca svātmanaiva ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt

yadapi ca kartrādikārakavyāpāraphalamutpannaṃ vastumātramaśeṣaviśeṣaṇavinirmuktaṃ kāraṇasamavetamityātmāvadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā coditaṃ vastumātrasya niratiśayatvāt sattvādiviśeṣaṇasambandhaniyamānupapattiḥ iti tat tathaiva, sattādyasambandhāt kāraṇasamavetasarvakāryātiśayābhāvāt sattādiviśeṣaṇasambandhaniyamānupapattireva
yattulyajātīyāvayavārabdhaṃ vastumātraṃ kāryaṃ tad dravyatvena sambadhyate
yattu kāraṇaguṇārabdhaṃ vastumātraṃ kāryaṃ tad guṇatvena sambadhyate

kartrādīnāṃ kārakāṇāṃ samavāyināmasamavāyināṃ ca mṛdādīnāṃ devadattadaṇḍādīnāṃ ca yo vyāpāraḥ sametya svakāryārambhaḥ, tasya phalaṃ ghaṭādi kāryamutpannaṃ vastumātram, tasyātmāvadhāraṇaṃ kāryamityataḥ prāgudgrāhitārthanirākāṅkṣīkaraṇārthamāha --aśeṣaviśeṣaṇavinirmuktaṃ sattva-dravyatvaguṇatva-karmatvādibhiḥ sarvairviśeṣaṇairvinirmuktaṃ sambandhisadbhāvaśūnyaṃ svabhāvasadbhāvamātraṃ yat taducyate kāraṇasamavetaṃ tadātmā itītthamātmāvadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā svayameva yaccoditam--vastumātrasya niratiśayatvāt sattvādidravyatvādiviśeṣaṇasambandhaniyamānupapattiḥ, na hi tasyāmavasthāyāmidaṃ dravyam, mayā dravyatvenātraiva nilayanīyaṃ na guṇakarmatvābhyām iti dravyatvasya nilayananiyamakāraṇaṃ nāsti, atiśayābhāvādeva
tat tathaivetyādi tvaduktameva kāraṇamiti tadevoccārayati yāvadanupapattireveti
na hi tasyāmavasthāyām idaṃ dravyam, mayā dravyatvenātraiva nilayanīyaṃ na guṇakarmatvābhyām iti dravyatvasya nilayananiyamakāraṇamasti ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
etasya parihārārthaṃ yat tu pratyucyate--na, kāraṇasāmagrye viśeṣasadbhāvāditi
tadvyākhyānaṃ --yat tulyajātīyāvayavetyādi yāvad dravyatvena sambadhyata iti dravyatvanilayananiyamaḥ
yattu kāraṇaguṇetyādi, tairārabdhe kāryadravye niyamata eva guṇā guṇāntaraṃ tatrasthā ārabhante iti vacanāt tadārabdhe guṇāntare kārye guṇatvaniyamanāt guṇatvena sambadhyate
yat punargurutvādibhiḥ svāśraye yatrāśraye gurutvaṃ samavetaṃ tatra saṃyogābhāve patanakarmārabhyate, ādigrahaṇāt prayatnanodanābhighātasaṃyogavegāḥ karmārabhante
svāśrayasaṃyogasahitairveti taireva gurutvādibhiḥ svāśraye āśrayāntare karma ārabhyate tad vastumātraṃ kāryaṃ karmatvena sambadhyate ityastyatiśayaḥ
etad nidarśanamātram, sarvatra kāraṇasāmagryaniyāmakasadbhāvāt pratiniyata eva kapitthaphalavṛntādau gurutvena karmaṇyārabdhe tatsaṃyukte kīṭe patanamārabhyate āśrayāntare
taccārabdhaṃ vastumātraṃ karma kāryamitarābhyāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ karmatvena sambadhyate
anena yattadutpannaṃ vastumātraṃ tat svata eva parasparato viśiṣṭamiti sphuṭīkṛtam
'avi- gamanatvādiṣvapyanayā yuktyā sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu kāraṇasāmagryasya niyāmakasyātiśayinaḥ sadbhāvāt pratiniyata eva sambandho draṣṭavyaḥ
atra gurutvam ityasya kartṛtvavivakṣāyām ārabhate iti yathāśrutapāṭho'pi sādhureveti dhyeyam
tatra ātmasaṃyogaprayatnābhyāṃ haste karma vai॰ sū॰ 5
1, svāśrayasaṃyogāpekṣitvāt prayatnasya kriyārambhe ātmahastasaṃyogaḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam
2, tatheti saṅkhyāmātrātideśaḥ, tena hastamusalasaṃyogo musalakarmaṇaḥ kāraṇaṃ pūrvādhikṛtaśca prayatnaḥ
na tu ātmahastasaṃyogo'samavāyikāraṇaṃ musalakarmaṇi, ātmasaṃyuktahastasaṃyogādeva tatsiddheḥ
abhighātaje musalakarmaṇi vyatirekādakāraṇaṃ hastasaṃyogaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 5

3, vegavaddravyasaṃyogo'bhighātaḥ, ulūkhalābhighātādutpanne musalasyotpatanakarmaṇi akāraṇaṃ hastamusalasaṃyogaḥ pūrvaprayatnasyābhighātād vinaṣṭatvāt, utpatatu musaladravyam itīcchāyā abhāvāt prayatnāntarasyābhāvaḥ, saṃyogasya ca karmārambhe sāpekṣakāraṇatvāt prayatnarahito hastamusalasaṃyogo na kāraṇamutpatanasya

4, yathaiva hastamusalasaṃyogo musalotpatanakarmaṇi na kāraṇaṃ tathātmahastasaṃyogo'pi hastotpatanakarmaṇi na kāraṇaṃ saṃyogasya sāpekṣakāraṇatvāt musalena sahotpatatu hastaḥ iti abhisandherabhāvena prayatnasya cābhāvāt
kutastayorutpatanamiti cet, musalābhighātāttu musalasaṃyogāddhaste karma vai॰ sū॰ 5
6, ātmeti śarīraikadeśaḥ, yathā caitadapratyayaṃ haste musale ca karma tathaiva hastāvayavasaṃyogād hastagatavegāpekṣād hastotpatanakāle'vayave tasminnapratyayaṃ karma jāyate
nodanaviśeṣābhāvād nordhvaṃ na tiryag gamanam vai॰ sū॰ 5
8, nudyate'neneti nodanaṃ vegaprayatnāpekṣaḥ saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ, prerakaprayatnābhāve nodanābhāvād nordhvaṃ tiryag vā kevalād gurutvād musalādergamanakarma bhavati
9, atra idaṃ kṣipāmi iti icchāviśeṣajaḥ prayatna utpanno hastāderdravyasya dravyāntareṇa saṃyogaṃ nodanākhyaṃ janayati
11, yad garbhasya spandanādikarma tadātmaśarīraikadeśasaṃyogājjīvanapūrvakaprayatnāpekṣād bhavatīti sapratyayam, mātuḥ kāryāvaskaropasarpaṇakarma garbhasyāpratyayamātmasaṃyogādadṛṣṭāpekṣād bhavatīti
12, vyāsakte manasi yad dagdhasya hastādervikṣepaṇaṃ tadapi jīvanapūrvakaprayatnāpekṣādātmahastasaṃyogād bhavatīti nāpratyayam
prayatnābhāve gurutvāt suptasya patanam vai॰ sū॰ 5
13, śarīravidhārakaprayatnābhāve suptasyāṅgānāṃ patanaṃ gurutvād bhavati tadābhisandherabhāvāt
14, vegāpekṣād vāyutṛṇasaṃyogāt tṛṇādīnāṃ karma, teṣāṃ prayatnābhāvāt
15, maṇīnāṃ taskaraṃ prati gamanaṃ sūcīnāṃ vā ayaskāntaṃ prati dharmādharmakṛtamityarthaḥ
iṣāvayugapat saṃyogaviśeṣātkaṣāḥ karmānyatve hetuḥ vai॰ sū॰ 5
16, nodanādādyaṃ karma, saṃskārād bahūni karmāṇi iṣāvutpadyante
ekasmiṃstu karmaṇi prathameṇaivākāśasaṃyogena vinaṣṭatvāt karmaṇa uttarasaṃyogavibhāgā notpadyeran, tasmādiṣāvanekaṃ karma
nodanādādyamiṣoḥ karma karmakāritācca saṃskārāduttaraṃ tathottaramuttaraṃ ca vai॰ sū॰ 5
17 jyāśarasaṃyogaḥ prayatnāpekṣo jyāgatavegāpekṣo vā nodanam, tata ādyamiṣoḥ karma nodanāpekṣaṃ saṃskāraṃ karoti, nirapekṣaṃ tu saṃyogavibhāgau
tataḥ saṃyogād vinaṣṭe karmaṇi nodane vibhāgād vinivṛtte ādyakarmajasaṃskāra uttaramiṣau karma karoti, tathottaramuttaraṃ paunaḥpunyenetyarthaḥ
ādhyātmikeṣu tatsambandheddheṣu ca karmāṇyuktvā mahābhūtakarmāṇi vyācaṣṭe — nodanādyabhighātāt saṃyuktasaṃyogācca pṛthivyāṃ karma vai॰ sū॰ 5

1, samastān vyastāṃśca gurutvadravatvavegaprayatnāna pekṣamāṇo yaḥ saṃyogaviśeṣo nodanādavibhāgahetoḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇaṃ tad ? nodanam, tathāhi--papādādibhirnudyamānāyāṃ paṅkākhyāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ karma jāyate
vegāpekṣo'bhighātādabhihanyamānasya vibhāgahetoḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇaṃ saṃyogo'bhighātaḥ, tathāhi--rathādibhirabhighātāt pṛthivyekadeśeṣu dṛśyate karma
saṃyuktasaṃyogācca, nudyamānābhihanyamānābhyāṃ ca saṃyukteṣu bhavanti karmāṇi
2, yat khalu viruddhakriyavāyusaṃyogāt sarvasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ kampādi karma prajānāṃ śubhāśubhasūcanāyotpadyate tat sarveṣāmeva śubhāśubhasūcanād viśeṣeṇādṛṣṭakāritam
apāṃ saṃyogābhāve gurutvāt patanam vai॰ sū॰ 5
4, sasyānāṃ samṛddhaye vināśāya vā sarvajanānāmadṛṣṭena janitaṃ patanakarma adṛṣṭakāritamucyate
7, nodanāccitradaṇḍādibhirārohaṇam, pīḍanād vastrādibhiḥ, pīḍyamānanudyamānābhyāṃ ca saṃyukte
8, vṛkṣamūle niṣiktānāmapāṃ vṛkṣopari gamanamadṛṣṭena kriyate iti
apāṃ saṅghāto vilayanaṃ ca tejasaḥ saṃyogāt vai॰ sū॰ 5
9, apāṃ saṅghātaḥ kāṭhinyaṃ divyena tejasā saṃyogāt, divyabhaumābhyāṃ tu vilayanam
10, asti divyāsu apsu tejaḥ ityatra tejasaḥ avasphūrjathurabhrānniḥsaraṇaṃ liṅgamiti
11, tā agniṃ garbhaṃ dadhire vabhūṣā iti ca vaidikaṃ vākyaṃ divyāsvapsu tejaso liṅgam
apāṃ saṃyogād vibhāgācca stanayitnuḥ vai॰ sū॰ 5
viruddhadikkriyābhyāṃ vāyubhyāmapāṃ preryamāṇānāṃ taraṅgāṅgībhūtānāṃ parasparābhighātākhyāt saṃyogācchabdaḥ
pṛthivīkarmaṇā tejaḥkarma vāyukarma ca vyākhyātam vai॰ sū॰ 5
13, yathā nodanābhighātasaṃyuktasaṃyogādṛṣṭebhyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ karma tathā tejaso vāyośca
āśrayāntare karma ārabhyate tad vastumātraṃ kāryaṃ karmatvena sambadhyate ityastyatiśayaḥ
etad nidarśanamātram, sarvatra kāraṇasāmagryaniyāmakasadbhāvāt pratiniyata eva
anena yattadutpannaṃ vastumātraṃ tat svata eva parasparato viśiṣṭamiti sphuṭīkṛtam

tvadīyenaivaitena parihāravacanena yat tadutpannaṃ kāryaṃ vastumātrābhimataṃ tat svata eva kāraṇasāmagryātiśayādeva parasparato viśiṣṭaṃ na sattādravyatvādi- sambandhanamapekṣyeti sphuṭīkṛtam, tenaiva vastubhāvanena viśiṣṭena sattādiviśeṣaṇasambandhakṛtyasyāviśeṣaviśeṣābhidhānapratyayahetoḥ pratiprāpitatvāt
tatra viśeṣasadbhāvastāvadāhatya bherīmabhyupagataḥ sarvatra kāraṇasāmagryaniyāmakasadbhāvāt pratiniyataḥ sāmānyaviśeṣasambandho draṣṭavyaḥ ityupasaṃhāravacanāt

tulyajātīyasaṃyogārabhyakāryatvāviśeṣasya dravyatvanilayanaviṣayaviśeṣaṇavarṇanadvāreṇa guṇārabdhaguṇāntaraviṣayanilayanaguṇatvavarṇanadvāreṇa gurutvādyārabdhatadāśrayāśrayāntarasamavetakarmaviṣayakarmatva śeṣaviśeṣaṇavinirmuktamapi na bhavati' ityetadapi tvayaiva bhāvitam, tulyajātīyāvayavasaṃyogādibhinnāviśeṣaviśiṣṭavastusvatattvapradarśanādasti hi...
punarapi ca kāraṇasāmagryā aviśeṣeṇa yogādabādiṣvapi tulyajātīyādyavayavasaṃyogādapi dravyatvaṃ bhāvitam
tulyajātibhede'pi ca aviśeṣaviśeṣaṇāvinirmuktatvaṃ vastunaḥ, dvayorbahuṣu vā iti vacanāt
nilayanadvāreṇa ca sarvadravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ niyataviṣayasvajātigataviśeṣavarṇanādaviśeṣo'pyāhatya bherīmabhyupagata iti draṣṭavyam
śeṣaviśeṣaṇavinirmuktamapi na bhavati' ityetadapi tvayaiva bhāvitam, tulyajātīyāvayavasaṃyogādibhinnāviśeṣaviśiṣṭavastusvatattvapradarśanādasti hi...
॰dasti hi parasparātiśayo dravyādīnām, tato netarad netaratra ityāśayo bhāti
punarapi ca kāraṇasāmagryā aviśeṣeṇa yogādabādiṣvapi tulyajātīyādyavayavasaṃyogādapi dravyatvaṃ bhāvitam
tulyajātibhede'pi ca aviśeṣaviśeṣaṇāvinirmuktatvaṃ vastunaḥ, dvayorbahuṣu vā iti vacanāt
aviśeṣaviśeṣaṇavinirmuktamapi na bhavati ityetadapi tvayaiva bhāvitam
tulyajātīyāḥ tulyaprakārā avayavāḥ, teṣāṃ pārthivādīnāṃ gandhādimattvaprakārāṇāṃ saṃyogairdravyaṃ pārthivaṃ kāryaṃ jāyate, ādigrahaṇād guṇakarmaṇorapi svakāraṇasānnidhyaprakāratā prāguktā
taiḥ saṃyogādibhirbhinnatve'pyaviśeṣo dravyādīnāmityanenāviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭamitaravilakṣaṇaṃ vastunaḥ svatattvaṃ pradarśitaṃ tvayā
tasmāt tatpradarśanādasti hītyādyupasaṃhāragrantho gatārtho yāvad netarad netaratreti

na kevalameṣa evāviśeṣaḥ sajātīyagataḥ sphuṭīkṛtastvayā, kiṃ tarhi ? tadvijātīyeṣvapi dravyatvaṃ tathā kāraṇasāmagryā aviśeṣeṇa yogādabādiṣvapi āpyeṣvapi kāraṇasāmagryāstulyatvāt tulyajātīyādyavayavasaṃyogādapi dravyatvaṃ bhāvitam, tulyajātyavayavasaṃyogāviśeṣāt
ādigrahaṇāt tejovāyvavayavasaṃyogādapīti, atulyajātīyānāmapi tulyajātīyasaṃyogārambhāviśeṣāt ityuktatvāt sphuṭīkṛtamaviśeṣaviśeṣaṇamiti
kiñcānyat, tulyajātibhede'pi cetyādi yāvad dvayorbahuṣu veti vacanāditi
yāpīyamavāntarajātirghaṭatvapaṭatvādyākhyā pṛthivītvajātibhedaḥ tasminnapi ca sati aviśeṣaviśeṣaṇenāvinirmuktatvaṃ vastunaḥ
evaṃ tāvat sambandhyantaranirapekṣe vastumātre eva viśeṣāviśeṣaviśeṣaṇasambandhaḥ pratiprāpta ityuktam
jātikalpanāvacca yaduktaṃ vastumātramāvirbhūtamuktavad niyāmakatayā aviśeṣaviśeṣavṛttimātreṇa sāmānyaviśeṣeṇa sambadhyate tata etadāpannam--svata eva vṛttaṃ vastu dravyādipratyayatvādinā sambadhyate
tasmādeva tu sāmānyasyāpi prakāśakaṃ tadeva, tadāśrayatvāt sāmānyaviśeṣādīnām
etad nidarśanamātram, sarvatra tu ghaṭatvādāvapi kāraṇasāmagryaniyāmakasadbhāvādeva tattvam

yathā bhavatā jātiranyānākāṅkṣā vastumātre vṛttena prakāśena svata eva prakāśate tathā kāraṇasamavetadravyādītyetasyārthasya pradarśanārthaṃ yaduktam--vastumātramāvirbhūtamiti, uktavad niyāmakatayeti sarvatra kāraṇasāmagryaniyāmakasadbhāvādityanenoktanyāyena svenaiva mahimnā vastu niyatatvād viśeṣaṇena dravyatvādinā sambadhyate

tacca dravyatvādi aviśeṣaviśeṣavṛttimātraṃ sāmānyaviśeṣaḥ, aviśeṣeṇa prāguktena viśeṣeṇa ca vṛttiryasya tadidamaviśeṣaviśeṣavṛtti dravyatvādi, tatparimāṇaṃ tanmātram, tenāviśeṣaviśeṣavṛttimātreṇa sāmānyaviśeṣeṇa sambadhyate vastumātraṃ tadāvirbhūtamiti
tataḥ kim ? iti cet, tata etadāpannam--svata eva vṛttaṃ vastu dravyādipratyayatvādinā sambadhyate viśeṣaṇaṃ vyatiriktamanapekṣya siddhaṃ prakāśate svata eva, prakāśāntareṇa nārtha ityuktaṃ bhavati
uktādeva nyāyāt sāmānyasyāpi prakāśakaṃ tadeva vastumātramāvirbhūtam, tadāśrayatvāt sāmānyaviśeṣādīnām

yadapyuktaṃ vicitropabhogakriyāprasiddhyarthaṃ sattādravyatvādisambandhaḥ kalpyate iti so'pyanenaiva pratipāditaḥ, pradīpavad bhūtād vastunaḥ prakāśāntaranirapekṣāt tasmādeva pravibhaktaviṣayānvayāt, pravibhakto viṣayo dravyatvasya kāraṇasāmagryaviśeṣastulyajātīyāvayavasaṃyogādiḥ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakramaḥ svāśrayāśrayāntarakriyārambhiguṇādikṛtaḥ tasya kāraṇakāryādipravibhāgād vyatirekāt sadanityādyaviśeṣānvayācca tādṛkpravibhaktaviṣayānvayāt tasmādeva vastuno vicitropabhogakriyāprasiddherbhinneṣvabhinnavyavahāraprasiddheśceti dviprakāraṃ puruṣārthaṃ darśayati
anayośca puruṣārthayoruktavad vastuta eva siddherna viśeṣaṇa- sambandhaḥ kalpyaḥ, sattādravyatvādiviśeṣaṇasambandho na yuktaḥ kalpayitumānarthakyāditi

etad nidarśanamātram, tadbhedānāmapi sambandhakalpanānarthakyamuktanyāyenetyato'tidiśati --sarvatra tu ghaṭatvādāvapi ādigrahaṇād gotvamanuṣyatvādiṣu kāraṇasāmagryaniyāmakasadbhāvādeva tattvaṃ ghaṭatvagotvamanuṣyatvādi svata eva, na sāmānyaviśeṣāt tvatkalpitāt, iti tvadvacanādeva vastuta eva sarvaṃ tvadiṣṭaṃ pratiprāptaṃ nārthāntarasambandhāt
tadeva ca viśeṣaṇasyāpi sattādeḥ prakāśakamiti sthitam

idaṃ tu prasphuṭataraṃ viśeṣaṇasambandhaprakāśaṃ vastu tatsambandhaniyamāya tvayaivābhyupagatamiti darśayituṃ vacanaṃ yaduktam--athavā viśeṣaṇasambandhamantareṇāpi vastumātrāṇāṃ parasparātiśayo'sti tena viśeṣaṇasambandhaniyamasiddhiḥ iti
codyaparihāro'pi caivaṃ prasiddhimasmaduktāmeva sandarśayati--kathaṃ parasparātiśaya iti cet, kathaṃ prāk...
kathaṃ prāk sattāsambandhād dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ parasparato'tiśayaḥ syāt; na, dṛṣṭāntāt, yathā parapakṣe sattāsambandhādṛte'pi sattvarajastamasāṃ parasparato'tiśayastathehāpi syāt ityāśayo bhāti
yathā sāmānyādi svata evāsti arthāntarasambandhanirapekṣaṃ tathā dravyādyapi svata eva syāt ityāśayo'tra bhāti
na dravyādi anyādheyasvaprakāśaṃ nādheyasattvādi nāpratipūrṇasattvādi sattvāt
viśeṣaṇasya sattādravyatvādeḥ sambandhaḥ prakāśo'sminniti viśeṣaṇasambandhaprakāśaṃ vastu
tena vastunaiva prakāśyate viśeṣaṇamiti tadeva vastu prakāśanam
tena ca vastunā nāpekṣitaḥ sāmānyena saha sambandhaḥ, sāmānyameva vastunā saha sambandhamapekṣata iti tatsambandhaniyamāya tvayaivābhyupagatamiti darśayituṃ vacanopanyāsaḥ

katamasya vacanasyopanyāsaḥ ? ucyate— yaduktaṃ vastvātmāvadhāraṇe kṛte'tiśayābhāvād viśeṣasambandhābhāva iti codite vikalpāntareṇa parihāravacanaṃ tad vyaktataraṃ vastvevārthāntaranirapekṣaṃ viśeṣaṇānāmapi prakāśakamiti

tadyathā --yaduktam athavā viśeṣaṇasambandhamantareṇāpi vastumātrāṇāṃ parasparātiśayo'sti, tena viśeṣaṇasambandhaniyamasiddhiḥ ityetad vacanaṃ yathoktakāraṇasāmagryasadbhāvaviśeṣāviśeṣanyāyaprāṇakamiti
etasmiṃścārthe yaccoditam --kathaṃ parasparātiśayaḥ iti cediti, tasya vyākhyā --kathaṃ prāgityādi gatārthaṃ yāvadatiśayaḥ syāditi
asya codyasya parihāraḥ so'pi caivaṃ prasiddhimasmaduktāmeva sandarśayati
tadvyākhyā — yathā parapakṣa ityādi yāvadatiśayastathehāpi syāditi gatārtham

yadi paramate sattvarajastamasāṃ parasparātiśayo'sti, tava kim ? ityatrāśaṅkāniṣedhārthaṃ svasamayodāharaṇamapi caitamevārthaṃ draḍhayatīti svavacanaṃ tadvacanapradarśanam --yaducyate sāmānyādivadvetyādi savyākhyānaṃ gatārthaṃ sopanayaṃ yāvat sasvata eva syāditi

atra prayogāḥ --na dravyādi anyādheyasvaprakāśam, nānyenādheyo'sya dravyādeḥ prakāśa iti pakṣaḥ, nādheyasattvādiviśeṣaṇaṃ dravyādi nāpratipūrṇasattvādiviśeṣaṇamiti vā pakṣaḥ, sattvāt, yat sad na tadanyādheyasvaprakāśaṃ nādheyasattvādi nāpratipūrṇasattvādi dṛṣṭam, sāmānyādivat, yathā sāmānya sātmakatvāt pratyekaṃ sattvāt svabhāvasadbhūtatvāt sāmānyādivat
tasmād na satāmapi dravyādīnāṃ satkarī sattā vyarthatvāt iti sādhūktam
nāpi sadasatāṃ satkarī sattā abhūtatvāt sadasadātmakatvasya tvanmatenaiva khapuṣpavat
yā tu tvayoktopapattiḥ sadasadaikātmyānupapatteḥ iti sā nopapattiḥ, tvanmatenaiva sadasadaikātmyopapatteḥ
atyantāviruddhatvāt sadasadātmakaṃ kāryaṃ prāk sattāsambandhādapi, sāmānyādidravyāditadatatsadasadvat
viśeṣasamavāyāḥ santo nānyaprakāśā nādheyasattvādayo nāpratipūrṇasattvādayaḥ tathā dravyādīni
evaṃ sātmakatvāt pratyekaṃ sattvāt svabhāvasadbhūtatvāditi hetavaḥ, mūlahetoreva paryāyavācino vā
evamanabhyupagame asadeva vā syāt sattvasamavāyalabhyasadbhāvatvāt, sattvasamavāyena labhyaḥ sadbhāvo'syeti dravyādyutpannamātraṃ trayamabhisambadhyate
kāryavaditi kāraṇāvasthāyāṃ yat kāryaṃ sa dṛṣṭāntaḥ
nanvevaṃ sattvasamavāyalabhyasadbhāvaṃ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ kāryaṃ na bhavatīti cet, na, tvayaiva niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvābhyupaga- mena parihṛtatvāt
tasmād na satāmapi dravyādīnāṃ satkarī sattā vyarthatvāt iti sādhūktam
nāpi sadasatāṃ satkarī sattā abhūtatvāt sadasadātmakatvasya tvanmatenaiva khapuṣpavat
yā tu tvayoktopapattiḥ sadasadaikātmyānupapatteḥ iti sā nopapattiḥ, tvanmatenaiva sadasadaikātmyopapatteḥ
atyantāviruddhatvāt sadasadātmakaṃ kāryaṃ prāk sattāsambandhādapi, sāmānyādidravyāditadatatsadasadvat
sāmānyādīni svātmanā santyeva sambandhasadbhāvenāsanti, dravyādīni ca kāryāṇyutpannamātrāṇi svasantyapi na bhavanti ityāśayaḥ pratibhāti

yaccedaṃ kiṃ gaurgotvenābhisambadhyate athāgauḥ iti codyaṃ tanna pratisamādhānārhaṃ niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvāditi svakāraṇaiḥ sattādibhiści piṇḍasyābhisambandha evātmalābho na pūrvaṃ tasya gorūpatā agorūpatā vā iti praśastapādabhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ vyomavatyāṃ karmanirūpaṇe
tasmād na satāmapi dravyādīnāṃ satkarī sattā vyarthatvāditi sādhūktamiti prastutadoṣoktyupapattyupasaṃhāraḥ
evaṃ tāvadasatāṃ satāṃ ca dravyādīnāṃ satkarī na bhavati sattā ityuktam
kiñcānyat, nāpi sadasatāṃ satkarī sattā, santaścāsantaśca dravyādayaḥ sadasanto dvyātmakāḥ, teṣāṃ sadasatāṃ sadabhidhānapratyayakarī sattā syāditi parasyābhipretaṃ syāt tadapi na ghaṭate

kasmāt ? abhūtatvāt sadasadātmakatvasya tvanmatenaiva khapuṣpavat, sattāsambandhāt prāg dravyādi kāryaṃ sadasadapi na bhavati asadeva tat svato nirupākhyatvādityādihetubhiḥ pūrvavat sattāsambandhalabhyasattvāt
tasmādabhāvāt khapuṣpavat sattayā na sambadhyate tvanmatenaiva, nāsmanmatenāpyasti

yā tu tvayoktopapattiḥ sadasattvābhāve sadasadaikātmyānupapatteḥ iti sā nopapattiḥ tvanmatenaiva sadasadaikātmyopapatteratyantāviruddhatvaṃ tayoḥ, atyantāviruddhatvāt sadasadātmakaṃ kāryaṃ prāk sattāsambandhādapi

tadyathā --sāmānyādidravyāditadatatsadasadvat, yathā sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyākhyaṃ nanvevaṃ tadavyavahṛteḥ prāgabhāvabhedavadabhūtatvameva, atha yadetadabhūtatvaṃ tat kiṃ bhūtasya āhosvidabhūtasya ? yadi bhūtasya tataḥ sadasadaikātmyopapattireva
vastutrayaṃ svabhāvasat svenātmanāsti tatsat, sambandhasadbhāvena nāstītyatadasat, saccāsaccetyatyantamaviruddhatvāt sadasat tvanmatenaiva
tathā dravyaguṇakarmākhyaṃ kāryatrayamutpannamātraṃ sāmānyādivat tadatatsadasaditi siddham
tasya dṛṣṭāntadvayasya vyākhyā sāmānyādīni svātmanetyādi gatārthā yathākramaṃ yāvat svasantyapi na bhavanti
tasmāt tvanmatenaiva sadasadaikātmyānupapatterasattvaṃ nāsti, upapattereva sattvaṃ siddham
tat punarasattvaṃ kathaṃ tarhi ? iti, ucyate--abhūtatvāditi sādhūktamiti
nanvevaṃ tadavyavahṛteḥ prāgabhāvabhedavadabhūtatvameva, atha yadetadabhūtatvaṃ tat kiṃ bhūtasya āhosvidabhūtasya ? yadi bhūtasya tataḥ sadasadaikātmyopapattireva

itara āha --nanvevaṃ tadavyavahṛteḥ prāgabhāvabhedavadabhūtatvameva, yathā tasyotpannamātraghaṭadravyādeḥ prāk kuśūla-kosa-sthāsaka-śivaka-piṇḍa-mṛdavasthābhirabhāvabhedairjalādyāharaṇādivyavahāro nāstīti tatra ghaṭāsattvaṃ tathā tadavyavahṛterabhūtatvameva prāk sattāsambandhāt sadasadātmakasya kāryasya, ko doṣaḥ ? iti
atredaṃ sampradhāryam --atha yadetadabhūtatvamityādi vikalpadvayopanyāsena praśno gatārthaḥ
tatrottaram --yadi bhūtasya dravyāderutpannamātrasyāvyavahārādabhūtatvamiṣyate tadeva bhūtaṃ vastvātmanā tadeva cābhūtamavyavahārātmanetyataḥ sattvāsattvāvirodhiteti sadasadaikātmyopapattireva

athābhyupagamaviruddhamaikātmyaṃ mā bhūditi abhūtatvamiṣyate tato dravyāderabhāvaheturvācyaḥ kāryasya, kena hetunā tadabhūtaṃ kāryaṃ svakāraṇeṣu samavetamutpannamātramasmaduktāvirodhahetuṃ avyavahārayogyatvāt sadapyasat ityetaṃ muktvā ? syānmatam--ahetuta evābhūtaṃ tadabhāve kāraṇābhāvāt khapuṣpādivaditi
etaccāyuktam, yasmāt ahetuto'bhavane niṣkāraṇato'sattve kṣaṇikaśūnyatādivyutpattivadabhāva eva syāt iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
yathā pūrvavastuni niruddhe paścāduttaramutpadyamānaṃ nirhetukamiti prāptaṃ kṣaṇikavāditvam, tasyāpyutpannasyāhetuta eva vināśāśaṃsanāt
taccādravyatvād nirbījatvāt khapuṣpavadatyantābhāvaḥ syāt tathedamapi syāt, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
na cet pūrvavaditi, mā bhūdeṣo'tyantābhāvadoṣa iti sahetukakāryābhūtatvābhyupagame'smaduktasadasadaikātmyopapattireva prāpnoti
evaṃ tāvat prāk sattāsambandhāt sadasat kāryamiti pratipāditam
yadāpi sattayā sambaddhaṃ tadāpi sadasat tvanmatenaiva
yat tat kāryaṃ sattayā sambaddhaṃ sadityabhidhīyate nanu tat svasattayaiva sat na sattāsattayā
sattāpi āśrayapratilambhāt satī eva abhivyajyate kāraṇakāryākāraṇākāryanityānityasambandhyasambandhijātimadajātibhedāt tantusamavāyavat
ata idaṃ jainendratvameva pratipadya prajñāpya ca aviviktaprajñān prati saṃvriyate

kiñcānyat, tiṣṭhatu tāvat prāk sattayā sambandhāt kāryasya sadasattvam yadāpi sattayā sambaddhaṃ tadāpi sadasat tvanmatenaiva, tadyathā --yat tat kāryaṃ sattayā sambaddhaṃ sadityabhidhīyate sattayā viśeṣaṇabhūtayā viśeṣyate daṇḍeneva daṇḍī viśeṣyatvāt nanu tat svasattayaiva sat labdhātmalābhameva daṇḍaviśiṣṭadevadattavat, na sattāsattayā, na hi daṇḍasambandhād devadatto'san san kriyate, kiṃ tarhi ? sanneva daṇḍitvavyapadeśabhāg bhavati svasattayā san daṇḍisattayā cāsaṃstadeti sadasan
tathā satkāryaṃ sattāsambandhakāle sadeva svasattayā khapuṣpādyavastuvaidharmyāt
tathā sattāpi na vastusattayā asatī satī kriyate, kiṃ tarhi ? āśrayapratilambhāt satyevābhivyajyate
tadubhayaṃ vastusattayā sadeva sattādi dravyādi ca sambandhisattayā nāstītyarthaḥ
dravyādi vastu kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca, sattā tvakāryamakāraṇaṃ ca, nityā sattā, dravyādyanityam, sambandhi dravyādi, sattā asambandhinī, jātimad dravyādi, ajātiḥ sattā ityebhyo bhedebhyo bhinnatvāt
tantusamavāyavat, yathā tantavaḥ kāraṇādidharmāṇastathā dravyādayaḥ, yathā samavāyo'kāraṇādidharmā tathā satteti
kiñcānyat, itaretarābhāvādivarṇanaiśca tvayaiva sarvatra sadasadaikātmyopavarṇanameva kṛtam iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
4 itītaretarābhāvavarṇanaṃ ghaṭaḥ sanneva svātmanā paṭādyātmanā nanu mayā vigṛhyaivātra vādaḥ saiddhārthīyamatāvalambinaṃ tvāmevoddiśya
yaducyate saiddhārthīyaiḥ 'upādānaniyamadarśanāt sat kāryaṃ tilatailavat tatkriyādyasattva- nāstīti

ata idaṃ jainendratvameva sadasadvāditvaṃ pratipadya bahudhā prajñāpya ca mā bhūdṛjujaneṣvaviviktaprajñeṣu jainānāmeva gauravaṃ tattvajñāḥ iti mama ca lāghavam atattvajñaḥ iti tvayaivaṃ tānaviviktaprajñān prati saṃvriyate gūhyate
idānīmanumānaṃ vyācikhyāsustasya viṣayaṃ darśayati --kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvādasat vai॰ sū॰ 9
1, na tāvat kāryaṃ prāgutpatteḥ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate
nāpyanumānena, sati liṅge tasya bhāvāt, liṅgābhāvaśca tadīyayoḥ kriyāguṇayoranupalabdheḥ, na cānyad vyapadeśaśabdasūcitaṃ liṅgamasti, tasmāt prāgutpatterasat
2, sadbhūtaṃ ca kāryaṃ pradhvastamuttarakālamasadeva, na satastirodhānaṃ kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvādeva
madhye tu asataḥ sat kriyāguṇavyapadeśāśa ?bhāvādarthāntaram vai॰ sū॰ 9
3, pradhvaṃsāt pūrvamutpatteruttarakālamasato'rthāntarabhūtaṃ vastu sat ityucyate kriyāguṇavyapadeśānāṃ bhāvāt
4, sadapi vastu bhāvāntaraniṣedhena gauraśvo na bhavatīti, kāryākaraṇena nāyaṃ gauryo na vahati asat ityupacaryate
5, sataśca vastuno yadanyadatyantābhāvarūpaṃ prāgupādhipradhvaṃsābhāvāviṣayaṃ śaśaviṣāṇādi tadapyasadeva
asatāmaviśeṣāt prāgasati kathaṃ kārakapravṛttirnānyatreti cet, na, viśeṣagrahaṇāt, tatra asaditi bhūtapratyayābhāvād bhūtapratyakṣābhāvād T bhūtasmṛtervirodhipratyakṣatvācca jñānam vai॰ sū॰ 9

6, pradhvaṃsāsati sa ? asaditi jñānaṃ bhūtasya vastunaḥ pūrvavadidānīṃ darśanābhāvāt tasya ca bhūtasya vastunaḥ smaraṇād virodhinaśca kapālādergrahaṇād vināśaṃ parikalpyotpadyate, anyathā kathamiva na dṛśyeta tathātvasyāviśeṣāt
prāgabhāve tu tathābhāve bhāvapratyakṣatvācca tathā'bhāve bhāvapratyakṣatvācca ? vai॰ sū॰ 9

7, mṛtpiṇḍāvasthāyāṃ prāgabhāve ghaṭaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣajñānaṃ nābhūt, idānīṃ tu ghaṭaviṣayaṃ virūddhaṃ vijñānamudabhūt smaryate cābhāvāvasthā, tasmādidānīmayaṃ bhāvaḥ samabhūt pūrvamasyābhāva eva cāsīditi prāgabhāve asat iti niścayajñānam

8, yathā hi sthālyāṃ ghaṭa ityutpannavijñānasya kāraṇāntaritasamyakpratyaya utpadyate nāyaṃ ghaṭaḥ, sthālīyam iti tadapi ghaṭapratyayasyābhāvāt tasya ca smaraṇād viruddhasya ca sthālyāderdarśanād boddhavyam
tathā sāmānyato darśanād rātrisnānāderdharmatve sambhāvite adharma ityutpadyata iti cetanācetanātīndriyabhedenodāharaṇatrayam
iti candrānandaviracitāyāṃ vaiśeṣikasūtravṛttau P pṛ॰ 30 B--31 A
nanu mayā vigṛhyaivātra vādaḥ saiddhārthīyamatāvalambinaṃ tvāmevoddiśya
yaducyate saiddhārthīyaiḥ 'upādānaniyamadarśanāt sat kāryaṃ tilatailavat tatkriyādyasattva-

atra candrānandaviracitavṛttiyute vaiśeṣikasūtre asaditi bhūtapratyayābhāvād bhūtasmṛtervirodhipratyakṣatvācca jñānam iti pāṭhaḥ, vaiśeṣikasūtramūlamātraPpratau tu asaditi bhūtapratyakṣābhāvād bhūtasmṛtervirodhipratyakṣatvācca jñānam iti pāṭhaḥ, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 489 ṭi॰ 6
śaṅkaramiśraviracitopaskārasahite vaiśeṣikasūtre tu asaditi bhūtapratyakṣābhāvād bhūtasmṛtervirodhipratyakṣavat iti pāṭhaḥ
atra tathā'bhāve bhāvāt iti samīcīnaṃ bhāti
atra candrānandaviracitavṛttisahite vaiśeṣikasūtre vaiśeṣikasūtramūlamātra Ppratau ca tathābhāve bhāvapratyakṣatvācca iti pāṭhaḥ, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 489 ṭi॰ 6
śaṅkaramiśrapraṇītopaskārasahite vaiśeṣikasūtre tu tathā'bhāve bhāvapratyakṣatvāccavai॰ sū॰ 9

7, sāmānyavācyapyayam abhāvaśabdaḥ prakaraṇāt prāgabhāvaparaḥ, yathā pradhvaṃse pratyakṣajñānaṃ tathā prāgabhāve'pi, kutaḥ ? bhāvapratyakṣatvāt, bhāvasya vyūhyamānavīraṇādeḥ pratyakṣatvāt pratyakṣeṇa viṣayīkriyamāṇatvāt
cakārāt pratiyogismaraṇaṃ uktaṃ ca tarkaṃ samuccinoti
atrāha--nāhaṃ jainendratvamabhyupaimi, na cāviviktaprajñān prati saṃvṛṇomi
nanu mayā vigṛhyaivātra vādaḥ sadasatorvaidharmyāt kārye sadasattā na vai॰ sū॰ 9
te hi saiddhārthīyāḥ sadasadekātmatvaṃ vastuno'bhilaṣanta itthamupapattiṃ brūyuḥ, tadyathā --upādānaniyamadarśanāt sat kāryaṃ tilatailavat, tatkriyādyasattvadarśanādasad vīraṇeṣviva ghaṭo mṛdyapīti
itarathā atyantāsatkāryavāde na syādupādānaniyamaḥ khapuṣpasyeva, atyantasati ca tantvavasthāyāmeva paṭe darśanādasat, dṛṣṭaṃ tāvat...
..., itarathā tantupāṃsvādiṣvaviśeṣaḥ prāgapi vyāpārābhāvaśca syāt, dṛṣṭā tu kriyā...
..., ubhayaikānte doṣadarśanāt sadevāsadeva veti cāyukta ekāntaḥ, sadasadātmakatvāt kāryasya upādānaniyamaḥ kriyā ca yujyate' iti, tanna, vikalpānupapatteḥ
sadevāsat sadasat svenaivātmanā saccāsacca anyenātmanā sad...ghaṭātmanā cāsat ? na tāvat...
atra sato'satpratipakṣatvamasiddhaṃ tadaṅgatvāt tadātmakatvāt tatpravṛttitvāt ghaṭorddha- paṭārthā kuvindasya kriyā na syāt
upādānaniyamatadarthavyāpārau sadasattve kāryasya hetū, dṛṣṭaṃ tāvadityādinā samarthayati
aniṣṭaṃ cāpādayati--tathānicchataḥ tantupāṃsvādiṣvaviśeṣaḥ syādupādānamevānupādānameva vā, labdhātmapadārthakārakavyāpārābhāvavat prāgapi vyāpārābhāvaḥ syāditi ca yathāsaṅkhyam
sadevāsadeva veti cāyukta ekāntaḥ, sadasadātmakatvāt kāryasya satpakṣamāśrityopādānaniyamo yuktaḥ, asatpakṣamāśritya kriyā yukteti
sadevāsat sadasadityādi pratyuccāraṇaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa vikalpadbayena sopapattikaṃ svenaivātmanā saccāsacca anyenātmanā saditi yāvad ghaṭātmanā cāsaditi
siddhārtho nāma narendraḥ, tasya sutaḥ śramaṇo bhagavān mahāvīraḥ vardhamānaḥ ityaparābhidhānaḥ, tanmatāvalambinaṃ jainamityarthaḥ
..., itarathā tantupāṃsvādiṣvaviśeṣaḥ prāgapi vyāpārābhāvaśca syāt, dṛṣṭā tu kriyā...
..., ubhayaikānte doṣadarśanāt sadevāsadeva veti cāyukta ekāntaḥ, sadasadātmakatvāt kāryasya upādānaniyamaḥ kriyā ca yujyate' iti, tanna, vikalpānupapatteḥ
sadevāsat sadasat svenaivātmanā saccāsacca anyenātmanā sad...ghaṭātmanā cāsat ? na tāvat...
atra sato'satpratipakṣatvamasiddhaṃ tadaṅgatvāt tadātmakatvāt tatpravṛttitvāt ghaṭorddha-
dṛṣṭaṃ tāvat paṭārthitāyāṃ tantūnāmevopādānaṃ na tu pāṃsvādīnām, evaṃ paṭārthaśca kuvindasya vyāpāro dṛṣṭaḥ ityāśayo bhāti
dṛṣṭā tu kriyā paṭārthā kuvindasya tantūnāmeva copādānam; tasmādupādānaniyamatadarthavyāpārābhyāṃ sadasat kāryam
atra kiṃ yenaivātmanā sat tenaiva asat, āhosvit āpekṣikaṃ sadasattvam anyenātmanā mṛdādinā prāk sad ghaṭādi kāryaṃ ghaṭātmanā cāsat ? iti vikalpadvayasyāśayo bhāti
na tāvad yenaivātmanā sat tenaivātmanā asat, sadasatorvaidharmyāt
yaduktam --sadasatorvaidharmyāt kārye sadasattā na vai॰ sū॰ 9
9, sattvapratipakṣo'sattvamasattvapratipakṣaśca sattvam, sat sopākhyam asannirupākhyam, tayorvaidharmyāt ekasmin kārye sadasattvaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ
dvitīyāvibhaktyantatve tu hetū samarthayati ityanvayo jñeyaḥ
na tāvadityādi prathamaṃ tāvad vikalpaṃ vyavasthāpya sūtreṇa dūṣaṇamāha savyākhyānaṃ sopavarṇanaṃ yāvadasattvapratipakṣaśca sattvamiti gatārtham
mā maṃsthāḥ so'siddha iti, atastatpradarśanārthamāha --sat sopākhyamityādi vaidharmyasphuṭīkaraṇaṃ yāvat sadasattvaṃ na bhavatītyartha iti suvyākhyātam
dvitīyavikalpasya svarūpaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ tatparihārādikaṃ ca jñātuṃ dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 499, 50॰
atrācārya uttaramāha --atra tvatsādhane sato'satpratipakṣatvaṃ virodho vaidharmyamasiddham
kutaḥ ? tadaṅgatvāt, aṅgamavayavastadekadeśaḥ, yad yasyāṅgaṃ sa tasya pratipakṣo na bhavati, yathā ghaṭasyorddhagrīvāditva grīvāditvavat
tathā tantupaṭādyapi kramabhāvi sadasat, tathā yugapadbhāvi khamapi, ito'pīto'pi
itaśca pratipakṣo na bhavati, tadātmakatvāt, sa ātmā'sya bhāvasyābhāva ātmā, tadbhāvāt tadātmakatvāt, ghaṭorddhagrīvāditvavadeva
itaśca, tatpravṛttitvāt, sa evābhāvo'sya sataḥ pravṛttiḥ, tenābhāvarūpeṇa bhāvaḥ pravartata ityarthaḥ
athavā aṅgamātmā, ātmā ca pravṛttirityaikārthyameveti vyākhyānaṃ tadaṅgatvasya
tathā tantupaṭādyapi kramabhāvi sadasat, tathā yugapadbhāvi khamapi, ito'pīto'pi
bhavan san bhavatīti sattvaṃ nāma bhavata eva nābhavataḥ

bhavanaṃ ca kīdṛśam ? abhāvānuviddham, iti taddarśayati --pratyekavastvityādi daṇḍako yāvat sadasadātmakaḥ, ekamekaṃ prati pratyekaṃ vastunaḥ svarūpaṃ pratipattuṃ pratyekavastusvarūpapratipattyarthaṃ tatpravṛttaṃ ghaṭākhyaṃ śivakādivyāvṛttaṃ paṭādivyāvṛttaṃ ca, tasmāt tadeva ghaṭākhyaṃ ghaṭātmanā pravṛttaṃ bhavati, paṭaśivakādyātmanā vyāvṛttaṃ na bhavati
evaṃ tāvad yugapadbhāvirūpādibhāvenāpi bhavan sa ghaṭo nābhāvena svāṅgātmapravṛttisvarūpeṇa vinā bhavatītyuktaṃ dravyakṣetrāpekṣam
kālabhāvāpekṣamapyucyate--sa eva ca bhavitā ghaṭaḥ svato'tyantāvibhaktavṛttiparyanubhavaḥ tāmātmano vṛttiṃ prāk paścācca parito'nubhavati
arthāntarabhūtakṣaṇabhaṅgavilakṣaṇaśca prāk paścādidānīṃ ca bhavanād bhavanasya pravartanasya dravyārthato'tyantamabhinnatvāt kṣaṇabhaṅgavāde'tyantaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'nyatvābhyupagamāt tadvilakṣaṇa iti

nanvevaṃ dravyārthabhavanasyābhedādabhavanaṃ niravakāśameveti, etacca na bhavatītyata āha --atītānāgatavartamānabhinnabhavanasadasadekakriyaḥ, yānyatītāni bhavanānyanāgatāni ca tāni vartamānabhavanād bhinnāni deśakālākāranimittādibhedāt, tebhyaśca vartamānabhavanam, parasparavilakṣaṇatvācca paraspararūpeṇa na santi, atha ca bhavanakriyaikaiva sarvāṇi tānyucyante

katham ? ākāśavat, yathā tavāpyākāśaṃ śabdādisamavāyināṃ ghaṭādisaṃyogināṃ cādhārabhūtamekamavicchinnabhavanamapi teṣu ghaṭapaṭaśabdādibhavanādhāratayā bhidyamānatvād bhedābhedābhyāṃ saccāsacca ityeṣaṇīyam, anyathā teṣāṃ ghaṭaśabdādīnāṃ saṅkaraprasaṅgāt, tathāsmanmatenāpyavagāhasāmānyād bhavatyeva aṅgulighaṭādyavagāhairbhedādasacca, tathoktabhāvano ghaṭo dravyādi kāryaṃ ceti
yathākāśaṃ tathā bhūtatvāt tantupaṭādyapi itarathā naiva bhaved vastu apūrvatvāt khapuṣpavat, vaidharmyeṇa campakapuṣpavat, aparatvādabhedatvādavartamānatvāt vāndhyeyavat kṣaṇikavādavat,
yadapi ca sat sopākhyamasad nirupākhyamiti tadapi nopapadyate sato'pyanupākhyatvāt
ko hi prativastu pratikṣaṇasattvena sadupākhyātuṃ śaknoti ? asādhāraṇatvāt kramabhāvi sadasat
yathā ca tat tantupaṭādi kramabhāvi tathā yugapadbhāvi khamapi sadasad bhinnābhinnaṃ ca ito'pi ito'pīti ubhayātmakatvaṃ pradarśyata iti
bhavan san ghaṭo ?, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 492 paṃ॰ 10
itarathā naiva bhaved vastu apūrvatvāt khapuṣpavat, vaidharmyeṇa campakapuṣpavat, aparatvādabhedatvādavartamānatvāt vāndhyeyavat kṣaṇikavādavat,
yadapi ca sat sopākhyamasad nirupākhyamiti tadapi nopapadyate sato'pyanupākhyatvāt
ko hi prativastu pratikṣaṇasattvena sadupākhyātuṃ śaknoti ? asādhāraṇatvāt
evaṃ sadasadātmakatvamanicchato vastunaste naiva bhaved vastu apūrvatvāt nirbījatvāt, nāsya pūrvamiti bahuvrīhisamāsāśrayeṇa na pūrvamapūrvaṃ prāgasattvāditi tatpuruṣāśrayeṇa vā, khapuṣpavat
vaidharmyeṇa campakapuṣpavat, mūlāṅkurādibhavanena pūrvasyaiva sataścampakasya puṣpībhavanāt
tasmād vartamānameva na syāt, tataścāvartamānatvādapi naiva syāt, vāndhyeyavat kṣaṇikavādavaditi ca khapuṣpakṣaṇabhaṅgavailakṣaṇyaprastuterudāharaṇadvayametat
sata evaṃ caṃpakasya pā॰ ḍe॰ vi॰
itaśca na naikātmyaṃ sadasatoraikātmyameva, dviḥ pratiṣedhasya prakṛtyāpatteḥ

kutaḥ ? vidhipratiṣedhaikaviṣayatvāt, vidhiḥ anvayaḥ, pratiṣedho vyatirekaḥ, tāvubhāvekaviṣayau ityetat pratyekavastusvarūpapratipattyarthatadatatpravṛttivyāvṛttisadasadātmaka iti avibhaktasvarūpaparyanubhavo'tītānāgatavartamānabhinnabhavanasadasadekakriyaḥ ityādivacanāt siddham

tasmāt sadasadaikātmyameva bhāvitaikātmyacetanācetanatvavat, yathā ca cetanācetanayorvidhipratiṣedhaikaviṣayatvena bhāvayitvā cetano'cetana ityuktaṃ tathehāpi dravyādisadasadaikātmyād nāsti sadasatoḥ pratipakṣateti
sadasatoḥ pratipakṣatvabhāvanārthaṃ vaidharmyamucyate tvayāṃ sat sopākhyamasad nirupākhyamiti tadapi nopapadyate, sato'pyanupākhyatvāt

ko hītyādi, vastuni vastuni rūparasādau yo yo'sādhāraṇa ātmā pūrvakṣaṇe uttare ca kṣaṇe vilakṣaṇastasya bhāvaḥ sattvam, tena sattvena prativastu pratikṣaṇasattvena ca sad vastu tadupākhyātuṃ kenacidaśakyam, asādhāraṇatvāt, yadasādhāraṇaṃ na tadupākhyātuṃ śakyate svasukhādiparyanubhavavat
syānmatam— na brūmaḥ sat sopākhyameva iti, yato'sya vyabhicāra ucyate
kiṃ tarhi ? sat sopākhyaṃ nirupākhyaṃ svasukhādipayanubhavavat ?
atha ca nirupākhyatāyāmapi naiva tadasat sāmānyasopākhyatvāt
...viśeṣaṇasambandhaḥ kalpyaḥ, atha ca na tadasad nirupākhyatvāt, sadasadeva tu sopākhyanirupākhyatvāt sāmānyavat, sopākhyaṃ nirupākhyaṃ ca sadasattvāt sāmānyavat
sāmānyaṃ svasat na sāmānyasad vastuvaditi sadevāsat sāmānyam
sopākhyaṃ svaparapratyayābhidhānādhānāt nirupākhyaṃ ca vastuvaditi sopākhyameva nirupākhyam, vastuni viparyayaḥ
vā syāt, nirupākhyaṃ tvasadeva, tat satā sādharmyaṃ na bhajata iti

etadapi nopapadyate vyabhicārādityata āha --atha ca nirupākhyatāyāmapi naiva tadasat sāmānyasopākhyatvāt, upa sāmīpye, sāmīpyenākhyā upākhyā pratyāsattyetyarthaḥ, saha upākhyayā sopākhyam, yadapyasādhāraṇaṃ sukhādiparyanubhavādi tadapi sāmānyenopākhyāyate--kimapi sukhaṃ duḥkhamityādi
tasmāt kenacidātmanā sadevāsat sopākhyaṃ ceti nāsti sadasatorvaidharmyam

athavā sāmānyasopākhyatvāt, yathā sāmānyaṃ svenātmanā sopākhyaṃ svasattayā, na viśeṣaṇātmanā sāmānyāntareṇa, na tu dravyādivastuvat, iti sat sopākhyaṃ nirupākhyamasacceti dṛṣṭatvāt tavaivaikatra sadasatornāsti vipakṣatā
atha ca nirupākhyatāyāmapi naiva tadasat sāmānyasopākhyatvāt
...viśeṣaṇasambandhaḥ kalpyaḥ, atha ca na tadasad nirupākhyatvāt, sadasadeva tu sopākhyanirupākhyatvāt sāmānyavat, sopākhyaṃ nirupākhyaṃ ca sadasattvāt sāmānyavat
sāmānyaṃ svasat na sāmānyasad vastuvaditi sadevāsat sāmānyam
sopākhyaṃ svaparapratyayābhidhānādhānāt nirupākhyaṃ ca vastuvaditi sopākhyameva nirupākhyam, vastuni viparyayaḥ

kiñcānyat, api ca tvayāpītyādi, tvatkalpanayaiva sadasat ityetat pradarśayitumidamucyate, prāgvyākhyātārtha evaiṣa grantho yāvad viśeṣaṇasambandhaḥ kalpya iti, iha tu prāg viśeṣaṇasambandhād vidyamānameva nirupākhyamitīṣṭaṃ tvayaiva ityetasyārthasya pradarśanārthamupanyastaḥ, ata āha --atha ca na tadasad nirupākhyatvāditi nirupākhyatvasya sati dṛṣṭatvād vyabhicara uktaḥ
asacca tat sambandhāsattvāt tasyāmavasthāyām, sopākhyaṃ ca taduttarakālaṃ sattāsambandhopākhyatvāt
evaṃ sopākhyanirupākhyatvāvirodhamāpādya prastutakāryasadasattvāvirodhe sādhanamāhācāryaḥ --sadasadeva tu sopākhyanirupākhyatvāt sāmānyavaditi
athavā sopākhyaṃ nirupākhyaṃ ca sadasattvāt sāmānyavaditi sadasattvaikātmye sādhye sopākhyanirupākhyatvaṃ hetuḥ sopākhyanirupākhyatve ca sadasattvaṃ proktanyāyena tvayaivābhyupagatatvāt
sāmānyadṛṣṭāntasya sadasatsopākhyanirupākhyatvaikātmyaṃ darśayati --sāmānyaṃ svasat svasattayā sat na sāmānyasad vastuvat sambandhasattayetyarthaḥ
yathā tvanmatenaiva sāmānyena sambandhād dravyaguṇakarmākhyaṃ vastu sambandhasadiṣyate na tathā sāmānyaṃ sāmānyasya sāmānyāntarasambandhābhāvāt
...hetūpādānakriyāniyamābhāvaḥ, asmin punaḥ sadasatkāryapakṣe dvidoṣatā pāpīyasī iti, tanna, parihṛtapūrvadoṣatvāt
sāmānyam, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt evaṃ sāmānyasya sadasattvaikātmyam

tadeva ca sopākhyaṃ svaparapratyayābhidhānādhānāt, svātmani sambandhini ca pratyayamabhidhānaṃ cādhatte satī sattā santi dravyaguṇakarmāṇi iti ca sāmānyam tadeva nirupākhyaṃ ca, nāsyopākhyāsti, vastuvat, vastuna iva sambandhisāmānyādupākhyā nāsti sāmānyādeḥ sāmānyādyantarābhāvāt
vastuni viparyaya iti, dravyāditraye vastuni svato nirupākhyatā sāmānyena sopākhyatā, svatastvasattvaṃ sambandhyantarāt sattvaṃ ca sattāto viparītam
...hetūpādānakriyāniyamābhāvaḥ, asmin punaḥ sadasatkāryapakṣe dvidoṣatā pāpīyasī iti, tanna, parihṛtapūrvadoṣatvāt
tatra hi atyantāsatkāryapakṣe upādānaniyamasya atyantasatkāryapakṣe ca kriyāyā abhāvaprasaṅgāt sadasatkāryapakṣayorhetūpādānakriyāniyamābhāvaḥ ityāśayo bhāti

tasmāt tābhyāṃ dharmābhyāṃ bhinnau viruddhau ca ityabhimatābhyāmeva pratipadyatāṃ bhavān, sopākhyanirupākhyatvāt sāmānyādidravyādivat, sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyāḥ sāmānyādayaḥ, dravyaguṇakarmāṇi dravyādīni, sāmānyādayaśca dravyādīni ca yathā santi asanti ca sopākhyanirupākhyāni ceti sopākhyanirupākhyatvaṃ sadasattvaikātmye hetuḥ, sadasattvamapi sopākhyanirupākhyatvaikātmye tathaiva hetustvanmatenaiva
idānīṃ syādvāde paroktān doṣān parihartukāma āha --yattūktamityādi
ṭīkāyāṃ praśastamatau syādvādinaṃ prati pūrvadoṣapāpīyastvād na ityuktau doṣau, tatra sadasatkāryapakṣayoḥ sāṅkhyavaiśeṣikeṣṭayoryathāsaṅkhyaṃ kriyānupapattyupādānaniyamābhāvadoṣau
yathoktam --upādānaniyamasyāsati sati ca kriyāyā abhāvaprasaṅgāt sadasat kāryam iti doṣadvayaṃ bruvato jainasya pūrvadoṣapāpīyastvaṃ kiletthamucyate

vai॰ sū॰ praśastamatiṭīkā, tadyathā--tatra hītyādi, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ pratyekadoṣapradarśanagrantho gatārtho yāvaddhetūpādāna- kriyāniyamābhāva iti, hetavo daṇḍādyā ghaṭasya, mṛdupādānam, kriyā kulālavyāpāra iti
asmin punaḥ sadasatkāryapakṣe dvidoṣatā pāpīyasī sadasatpakṣābhyāmekaikadoṣābhyām, sattvāt kāryasya ghaṭārthāyāḥ kriyāyā abhāvaḥ, asattvādupādānaniyamābhāvaḥ ityetaddvidoṣatvāt pāpīyāneṣa pakṣa iti
atrācārya āha --tanna, parihṛtapūrvadoṣatvāt, parihṛtāvasmin sadasadekātmakakāryapakṣe pūrvoktau kriyā'bhāvopādānaniyamābhāvadoṣāviti

tatra hi satkāryapakṣe kriyā kiṃ virudhyate ? sāṅkhyo yadasau ekāntena sanneva ghaṭaḥ ityāha tatastasya kriyā niṣpannasya na yujyate kartavyābhāvāt kṛtavat iti kriyā'bhāvadoṣo bhavati, na punaḥ syādvādinaḥ

yadi tvasau syādādinā kartavyatvamapi vidadhīta tataḥ ka enamevaṃ brūyāt ? asatkāryapakṣe'pi upādānaniyamaḥ kiṃ virudhyate ? yadasau ekāntena asadeva kāryam iti hetūpādāneṣu sannihitasya kriyābhivyaṅgyasyārthasyoparyavajñayā brūyāt tasya 'paṭārthitāyāṃ tantūpādānaniyamo na
tat pareṇaivābhivācayati praśnapūrvakam --tatra hi satkāryapakṣe kriyā kiṃ virudhyate kena hetunā ? sāṅkhyo yadasāvekāntenetyādi yāvat kṛtavaditi
dravyārthato hi mṛtpiṇḍe ghaṭo'sti na paryāyataḥ

sāṅkhyastu sanneva ghaṭaḥ kāryatvaparyāyanirapekṣa ityāha tatastasya kriyā karaṇaṃ niṣpannasya sarvathā vidyamānasya na yujyate kartavyābhāvāt kṛtavat niṣpannaghaṭavadityevaṃ tasya satkāryavādinaḥ kriyā'bhāvadoṣo bhavati, na punarākāṅkṣitakartavyaparyāyadravyārthavādinaḥ syādvādinaḥ syāt sanneva mṛtpiṇḍe ghaṭaḥ kenaciddharmeṇāsannapi iti vadataḥ parihṛtapūrvoktasatkāryaikāntavādadoṣatvāt

yadi tvasau sāṅkhyo'pi syādādinā kartavyatvamapi vidadhīta syādvādivat kathaṃcit kutaścit ityādinānekāntavācinā viśeṣaṇena viśeṣya sadeva kāryam iti tataḥ ka enamevaṃ brūyāt ? ko vādī susamīkṣitavākyaguṇadoṣo'pi kriyā'bhāvadoṣaste prāptaḥ kartavyatvābhāvāt kṛtavat iti vaktuṃ śaknuyāt parihṛtapūrvadoṣaṃ vādinaṃ sāṅkhyamanyaṃ vābhyupetānekāntavādamiti
atra satkāryaikāntavādinaḥ ityapi pāṭhaḥ samīcīno bhāti
asatkāryapakṣe'pītyādi, vaiśeṣikaṃ pratyasatkāryavādinamupādānaniyamābhāvadoṣa ukto yo'yaṃ sa kiṃ virudhyate ? iti pūrvavat praśnopakramaṃ bhāṇayati

yadasāvekāntenetyādi, yadasau vaiśeṣikaḥ paryāyārthāśrayeṇa kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvādasadeva kāryam iti dravyārthato hetuṣu turyādiṣūpādāneṣu ca tantuṣu sannihitasyāvyaktasya kriyāmantareṇa kriyayābhivyaṅgyasya paṭākhyasyārthasya upari avajñayā anapekṣya taṃ brūyāt tasya paṭarthitāyāṃ tantūpādānaniyamo na yujyate tatrāsattvāt tṛṇādivat, yathā tṛṇādyupādānaṃ paṭārthitāyāṃ na yuktaṃ tatra tasyāsattvādevaṃ tantūpādānamapītītthamasatkāryaikāntavāde'pyupādānaniyamābhāvadoṣaḥ, so'nekāntavāde syādādiviśiṣṭe nāsti syādasat kāryam iti dattasattāvakāśamapi vadataḥ
tathā yadi vaiśeṣiko'pi viśeṣya brūyāt ka enaṃ kiñcidapi brūyāt ? na tadā tasya vādino viśeṣitānvayavyatirekadharmadharmivyavasthasya tilatuṣaśatabhāgamātramapi vācyamastīti
jadi taṃ tahā purillo dāeṃto keṇa jivvaṃto || sanmati॰ 3 | 58
yatrānumānaviṣayatayābhyupagamyamāne sādhye dūṣaṇavādino'vakāśa eva na bhavati tadeva sādhyaṃ hetuviṣayatayā abhyupagantavyamiti darśayannāha --heuvisayovaṇīyaṃ jaha vayaṇijjaṃ paro niyattei
jai taṃ tahā purillo dāiṃto keṇa jippaṃto

hetuviṣayatayopanītamupadarśitaṃ sādhyadharmilakṣaṇaṃ vastu pūrvapakṣavādinā anityaḥ śabdaḥ ityevaṃ yathā vacanīyaṃ paro dūṣaṇavādī nivartayati siddhasādhyatānanugamadoṣādyupanyāsena ekāntavacanīyasya taditaradharmānanuṣaktasya anekadoṣaduṣṭatayā nivartayituṃ śakyatvāt, yadi tat tathā dvitīyadharmākrāntaṃ syātśabdayojanena purillaḥ pūrvapakṣavādī adarśayiṣyat tato'sau naiva kenacidajeṣyata
tataścāsau tathābhūtasya sādhyadharmiṇo'pradarśanāt pradarśitasya caikāntarūpasyāsattvāt tatpradarśakaḥ sannasatyavāditayā nigrahārha iti
iti abhayadevasūriviracitāyāṃ jesalamerasthāyāṃ likhitāyāṃ sanmativṛttau, pṛ॰ 226
yujyate tatrāsattvāt tṛṇādivat, ityupādānaniyamābhāvadoṣaḥ, na punaḥ syādvādinaḥ
tathā yadi vaiśeṣiko'pi viśeṣya brūyāt ka enaṃ kiñcidapi brūyāt ? evamayaṃ pūrvaśreyastvārtha ādyudgrāhaḥ
yat punaridamabhidhīyate--sadbhāgasyopādānaniyamaḥ asadbhāgasya kriyā ca yujyate, tau ca vastuni sta eveti cet, na, viparyayaprasaṅgāt
kuta etat sadbhāgasyopādānaniyamo'sadbhāgasya kriyā ca, na tūbhayābhāvaḥ iti ? tasmāt pūrvadoṣapāpīyastvameveti ityāśayo'tra bhāti

tasmānna staḥ syādvādinaḥ pūrvadoṣau, kutaḥ pāpīyastvam ? tābhyāṃ vā śreyastvamevetyata āha --evamayaṃ pūrvaśreyastvārthaḥ, pūrvāmyāṃ vādāmyāṃ śreyaso vādasya bhāvaḥ pūrvaśreyastvam, tadevārtho'syodgrāhasyeti so'yamā- dyudgrāhaḥ pūrvaśreyastvārthaḥ parihṛtadoṣavacanāvakāśaḥ tasminnādyudgrāhe pratijñānirdeśe darśita eva mayā syāt sat kāryaṃ syādasat kāryam iti
yat punaridamityādi pūrvapakṣaḥ parasya yāvat pūrvadoṣapāpīyastvameveti

jainenāyaṃ parihāraḥ pūrvadoṣapāpīyastve'bhihitaḥ sadasatkāryavādinā --sadbhāgasyopādānaniyamaḥ mṛdi sattvād ghaṭasya mṛdupādānaniyamaḥ tasya cāsadbhāgasya kriyā ca ghaṭasya yujyate sadasadaṃśayoranyatarāśrayeṇa, tau cāṃśau vastuni sta eveti cedityāśaṅkāyām, evaṃ cenmanyase iti ārhatīyaṃ parihāramāśaṅkyottaramāha--etacca na, viparyayaprasaṅgāt, viparyayaḥ sadbhāgamāśritya kriyāprasaṅgo'sadbhāgamāśrityopādānaniyamaprasaṅgaḥ, aniṣṭau ca te jainasya, ekasyobhayātmakakaikavastutve viśeṣahetvabhāvāt upādānaniyamasyāsati sati ca kriyāyā abhāvaḥ ityetayorhetvoritaretarāṃśavyāvartitayorabhāvādapakṣadharmatā
ekaṃ hi vastu saccāsacca, tasmin satyubhayātmake kuta etadityādi gatārthaṃ viparyayaprasaṅgāpādanaṃ viśeṣahetvabhāvād hetuheyaniyamābhāvāt
atra vastu sadasacca ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atrācārya āha --etadapi na kiñcit, nottarasya gandho'pyastītyarthaḥ

kasmāt ? kāryatvādeva, kriyate iti hi kāryam, tasmin kārye upādānakriyayoḥ svaviṣayaniyatau bhāvāveva, nābhāvaḥ, svo viṣayaḥ svaviṣayaḥ, upādānasya satyeva niyamaḥ, tasya tatra niyatatvād bhāvo viṣayaḥ, kriyāyāḥ punarasatyeva bhayātmakatvāt, ekapuruṣaniyatapitṛputratvavat
sadbhāgamāśritya ca kriyāyā abhāva eva sarvasya sarvātmakatvāt tathātvādatyantamasato'bhāvāt
yattūcyate--sadasatorvaidharmyāt kārye sadasattā na vai॰ sū॰ 9

te copādānakriye sve sve viṣaye niyate iti kathaṃ jñāyate ? ekasyobhayātmakatvāt, sadasadātmakaṃ hyekaṃ kāryaṃ mayābhyupagataṃ tvayā ca doṣābhidhitsayā, tasmādekasyobhayātmakatvāt, yad yadubhayātmakamekaṃ tasya tasya svaviṣayaniyatatā dṛṣṭā, ekapuruṣaniyatapitṛputratvavat
na hyekasyetyādi dṛṣṭāntavyākhyānaṃ yāvad na tūbhayābhāva iti
ubhayaikatvameva ca viśeṣahetuḥ, tasya svaviṣayaniyatatvād nāsti viparyayaprasaṅgaḥ
sadbhāgamāśritya ca kriyāyā abhāva eva sarvasya sarvātmakatvāt tathātvādatyantamasato'bhāvāt
na hyekasya puruṣasya pitṛputratvaniyamo nāsti, svaputramapekṣya pitṛtvam, svapitaramapekṣya ca putratvam, na tūbhayābhāvaḥ
evamatrāpi ubhayātmakaikavastutvāt upādānakriyayoḥ svaviṣayaniyatatvād nāsti viparyayaprasaṅgaḥ
yattūcyate--sadasatorvaidharmyāt kārye sadasattā na vai॰ sū॰ 9

abhyupetyāpi viparyayaprasaṅgam api ca viparyayaprasaṅgāpattāvapyevaṃvidhārthataiva anekāntasiddheḥ na pāpasya gandho'pi, sadasadātmano vastuno yo'sau paryāyārtho'sadbhāgo mṛdi ghaṭābhāvastamāśrityopādānaniyamābhāva eva

prāgutpatteḥ kāryamasadeva samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇasānnidhye jāyate, na tasyopādānenārthaḥ kaścit, utpannaṃ sat sattayābhisambadhyate dravyaguṇakarmākhyam, dravyatvena dravyam, guṇatvena guṇaḥ, karmatvena karmetyebhirbhāvaiḥ sāmānyākhyairlabhyaṃ svarūpaṃ vāsyeti naiva kāryasyopādānaniyamo'sti ityanekāntaḥ sidhyati
sadbhāgamāśritya ca kriyāyā abhāva eva, yo ghaṭasya kāryasya sattvameva dravyārthato vāñchati tasya kriyāyā nāstyeva prayojanam, naiva kriyāsti, ityaniyamaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasya vādinaḥ sarvasya sarvātmakatvāt, mṛtpiṇḍo hi yugapadayugapadbhāvisarvadharmātmakaḥ

tena prakāreṇa tathā dravyārthavādaprakāreṇa, tathābhāvastathātvaṃ sarvasarvātmakatvam, tasmāt tathātvādasad nāma kiñcinnāstyato'tyantamasato'bhāvāt pratyekanayavivakṣāyāmanyatarāśraya itarasyābhāvād na hyatra viśeṣahetunārtha eva
yattūcyata ityādi yāvat saptamyabhidhānena darśayatīti sūtrārthaḥ kaṭandyāṃ vyākhyātaḥ
rvirodhādekasminneva kārye sadasacchabdayorekādhikaraṇabhāvena prayogo nāsti, sadevāsat ityanusandhānaṃ nāstyekādhikaraṇabhāvena iti saptamyabhidhānena darśayati vai॰ sū॰ kaṭandī 9
--etadapi na kiñcit, ekaikārthe tattvātmani itaretarabhūtābhūtatattvaṃ jagad vṛttāvṛttaparyāyārthāvibhaktadravyārthabhāvanāyāṃ sadevāsat kiṃ nūbhayapratyapekṣābhāvayitavyasvātmani

yadapyuktam--āpekṣikaṃ sadasattvam, prāgutpatteḥ mṛdātmanā sat kāryaṃ ghaṭātmanā cāsat, niṣpanne'pi ghaṭe mṛttvadarśanād mṛdupādānopapattiḥ, ghaṭātmanā cāsattvād ghaṭārthakriyopapattirityevaṃ kila ārhata āha
atrottaram--na, asatkāryatvasiddheḥ, evaṃ tarhi mṛdātmanaḥ kartavyatvābhāvād ghaṭātmanaḥ kartavyatvādasadeva kāryam
tasmānna prāgutpatteḥ sadasat kāryam vai॰ sū॰ kaṭandī iti

--atra na sadasatorvaidharmyāt iti kimuktaṃ bhavati ? parasparavirodhāt samānādhikaraṇabhāvenaikasmin prāgutpatteḥ saccāsacca tadeva iti sadasacchabdārthayorvirodhādekasminneva kārye kutaḥ sattvaṃ prāgutpatteḥ ? kiṃ tarhi ? asattvameveti sadasacchabdayorekādhikaraṇabhāvena prayogo nāstīti
tad vyācaṣṭe --sadevāsat ityanusandhānaṃ nāstyekādhikaraṇabhāveneti buddhyā nirdhāraṇaṃ nāsti, tadabhāvāt prayogo'nupapannaḥ
eṣo'rthaḥ kārye sadasattā na iti saptamyabhidhānena darśitaḥ, anyathā kāryaṃ sadasanna iti lāghavārthaṃ brūyāt

ekasminnekasmin ghaṭapaṭādāvarthe tattvātmani itaretarabhūtābhūtatattvaṃ jagat, ghaṭātmanā ghaṭo'sti paṭātmanā nāsti, paṭo'pi tatheti svenātmanā bhūtatvamabhūtatvaṃ cetarātmanā, tasmād bhūtābhūtatattvaṃ jagaditi vyāpitāṃ darśayati, na kevalaṃ kāryameva sadasaditi

tathā vṛttāvṛttābhyāṃ piṇḍaśivakaparyāyārthābhyāṃ kramabhāvibhyāmavibhakto dravyārtha ekaḥ, tasya bhāvanā mṛtpiṇḍa eva śivakībhavati, śivaka eva ca sthāsakībhavatītyādi yāvad ghaṭo yāvacca pāṃśuryāvacca paramāṇurityavasthāsu piṇḍātmanā bhavati śivakādyātmanā na bhavatīti piṇḍo bhāvābhāvātmakastathā śivako'pi śivakātmanā bhavati na piṇḍātmanā, tathottarāsvapyavasthāsu itaretarābhāvasvarūpeṇa svena ca bhāvarūpeṇa sadasadeva, saccāsat vai॰ sū॰ 9

kinnūbhayetyādi, kiṃ punaryugapadbhāvināmayugapadbhāvināṃ ca paryāyāṇāṃ rūparasādīnāṃ śivakādīnāṃ ca pratyapekṣayā bhāvayitavyo yasya vastunaḥ svātmā tasmin bhāvayitavye ? niḥsandigdhameva tadā sadevāsadapītyarthaḥ
kaṭandī nāma kaṇādaviracitavaiśeṣikasūtrāṇāṃ kācit prācīnā vyākhyā
bho bho lakṣmaṇa ! vaiśeṣikakaṭandīpaṇḍito jagad vijayamānaḥ paryaṭāmi
iti murārikaviviracite anargharāghavanāṭake pañcamāṅke rāvaṇasya vacaḥ
rvirodhādekasminneva kārye sadasacchabdayorekādhikaraṇabhāvena prayogo nāsti, sadevāsat ityanusandhānaṃ nāstyekādhikaraṇabhāvena iti saptamyabhidhānena darśayati vai॰ sū॰ kaṭandī 9
--etadapi na kiñcit, ekaikārthe tattvātmani itaretarabhūtābhūtatattvaṃ jagad vṛttāvṛttaparyāyārthāvibhaktadravyārthabhāvanāyāṃ sadevāsat kiṃ nūbhayapratyapekṣābhāvayitavyasvātmani

yadapyuktam--āpekṣikaṃ sadasattvam, prāgutpatteḥ mṛdātmanā sat kāryaṃ ghaṭātmanā cāsat, niṣpanne'pi ghaṭe mṛttvadarśanād mṛdupādānopapattiḥ, ghaṭātmanā cāsattvād ghaṭārthakriyopapattirityevaṃ kila ārhata āha
atrottaram--na, asatkāryatvasiddheḥ, evaṃ tarhi mṛdātmanaḥ kartavyatvābhāvād ghaṭātmanaḥ kartavyatvādasadeva kāryam
tasmānna prāgutpatteḥ sadasat kāryam vai॰ sū॰ kaṭandī iti
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 491 paṃ॰ 15, pṛ॰ 50॰ paṃ॰ 12, paṃ॰ 17
atra na pūrvapakṣe nottarapakṣe kiñcit satyam ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt
mṛdātmanā ghaṭasya prāgutpatteḥ sattvam, niṣpattyuttarakālamapi mṛttvadarśanāt, tadātmakatvād mṛdupādānopapattiḥ
pūrvapakṣo nottarapakṣaḥ satyaḥ, ko hi nāma so'nekāntavādī evaṃ brūyāt--prāgutpatteḥ mṛdātmanā sat kāryaṃ ghaṭātmanā cāsaditi ? evaṃ hi mṛdo'kāryatve...
anyena mṛdātmanā bhavati svena ca ghaṭātmanā na bhavatītyevaṃ bruvan pratyakṣādiviruddhaṃ mattonmattakādivat syāt
mṛdātmanaḥ kartavyatvābhāvāt, kriyate iti hi kāryam, na ca mṛt kriyate, ghaṭo hi kriyate, sa cāsanniti
pūrvapakṣo nottarapakṣaḥ satyaḥ, ko hi nāma so'nekāntavādī evaṃ brūyāt--prāgutpatteḥ mṛdātmanā sat kāryaṃ ghaṭātmanā cāsaditi ? evaṃ hi mṛdo'kāryatve...
anyena mṛdātmanā bhavati svena ca ghaṭātmanā na bhavatītyevaṃ bruvan pratyakṣādiviruddhaṃ mattonmattakādivat syāt
evaṃ hi mṛdo'kāryatve'nekāntavādatyāgādekāntavādābhyupagamācca vaiśeṣikād bauddhādvā ko bhedaḥ
ayameva pāṭhaḥ punarapi agre bhā॰ pratau, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 503 ṭi॰ 1
evaṃ cobhayatrāpi bhā॰ pratau sadasadasat iti pāṭhadarśanāt tadanusāreṇa tasmānna prāgutpatteḥ sadasat, asat kāryam ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atra na pūrvapakṣa ityādi ācāryo brūte
atraivaṃ pūrvottarapakṣayorna kiñcit satyam, prāgatīteṣu pūrvapakṣo'pi kaścit satyaḥ syād vikalādeśavaśārpaṇāt, yathā sadbhāgamāśrityopādānam asadbhāgamāśritya kriyābhāva ityādiḥ
iha tu na pūrvapakṣo nottarapakṣaḥ satyaḥ
pūrvapakṣāsatyatvaṃ tāvat ko hi nāma so'nekāntavādītyādi
evaṃ hyasatkāryaikāntavāda evāvasthāpitaḥ, tadasatkāryamavasthāpya ko'nekāntavādī evaṃ brūyāt ? ityādi, prāgityādi tasyaiva pratyuccāraṇaṃ yāvad ghaṭātmanā cāsaditi, na brūyādevetyabhiprāyaḥ
yadi brūyādanekāntavādatyāga ekāntavādābhyupagamaśca kṛta iti taddarśayati --evaṃ hi mṛdo'kāryatve ityādi gatārtho yāvat ko bheda iti
ya evaiṣa vaiśeṣiko bauddho vā syādārhato'pīti
tataḥ kimarthaṃ vivadetābhyupagamyāsattvaikāntaṃ mṛdātmanā sad ghaṭātmanā cāsatkāryam iti ? tathāpi bhrāntimapi na brūte

kiñcānyat, atyantāsamīkṣitabhāṣiṇaikāntavādināpi na tulyatāmetyasau, ghaṭādanyasyā mṛdo ya ātmā tenātyantamanyo ghaṭo bhavati svena ca ghaṭātmanā na bhavatītyevaṃ bruvan pratyakṣādiviruddhaṃ mattonmattakādivat syāt, so'pi caikāntavādī pratyakṣādiviruddhaṃ kiñcit pariharatīti

deśato bhedo rūparasādīnām, kālato bhedaḥ piṇḍaśivakādīnām, sa bhedo lakṣaṇameṣāṃ sahāsahāvasthāyināmubhayeṣāṃ paryāyāṇāṃ te deśakālabhedalakṣaṇobhayaparyāyāḥ, tatparimāṇaṃ deśakālabhedalakṣaṇobhayaparyāyamātram, tadbhāvāt tanmātratvādevamanena prakāreṇāyamasadvāda eva syāt, rūpaṃ rasādanyat, tadapi vibhajyamānaṃ kṛṣṇam, punarapyekaguṇakṛṣṇamityādi ā ca paramāṇuśo vibhāgādasadeva rūpam, evaṃ rasādayaḥ, tathā piṇḍādayo itthaṃ punaḥ ko'nekāntavādī brūyāt āpekṣikamṛdātmasattvamasadvādivat
itthaṃ punaḥ ko'nekāntavādī brūyāt yathāsāvasadvādī brūte--rūpaṃ rasātmanā nāsti raso'pi rūpātmanā kṛṣṇādyapi śuklādyātmanetyādi ? na brūyādevetyarthaḥ

kiṃ kāraṇam ? dhṛtisaṅgrahapaktivyūhāvakāśadānātmakapṛthivyādyātmakatvād mṛdāderghaṭādeśca kathaṃ mṛdamekāmapekṣya mṛdātmanaivāsti ityāpekṣikamṛdātmasattvamasadvādivat kaḥ kuśalo brūyāt iti sambadhyate
atra prayogaḥ --āpekṣikamṛdātmasadviśeṣaṇāt tvasadabhidhānamevedam mṛdātmanā sad ghaṭātmanā cāsat iti vacanam

kutaḥ ? abhidheyasvatattvanirasananiyatatvāt, abhidheyasya mṛtpiṇḍasya svaṃ tattvaṃ deśabhinnarūparasasaṃsthānādi kālabhinnarūparasaśivakādipāṃsvādi dhṛtyādilakṣaṇabhinnapṛthivyādi ca, mṛdātmanaivāsti ghaṭo na rūpādiśivakādyabādisvatattvairiti tānyasya svatattvāni santyeva nirastāni syuḥ, tannirasane niyatatvādasya vākyasya
yad yad vākyamabhidheyasvatattvanirasananiyataṃ tat tadasadabhidhānaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā anuṣṇo'gniḥ ityuktiḥ
atra āṅ abhividhau, tato yāvat paramāṇuśo vibhāgāt ityartha iti bhāti
atra ॰mityādi ā para॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
syānmatam--nāvadhārya mṛdātmanaiva sat, nānyena iti brūmaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? mṛdātmanā tāvat san ghaṭo yadi rūpādipiṇḍādiśivakādyabādyātmabhirapi bhaved bhavatu nāma tadātmatvāt, ko doṣaḥ ? iti

atra brūmaḥ --avyudāse tu ghaṭātmanāpi sanneva tadbhāvatvāt, te bhāvā rūpādiśivakādyabādivrīhyādayo ghaṭādayaścāsyā mṛdaḥ, tadbhāvabhāvastadbhāvatvam, tasmāt tadbhāvatvāt ghaṭātmanā prāk kāryamutpatteḥ sat tadātmatvād ghaṭātmatvāt apiśabdāt sarvātmakatvācchivakādipāṃ śvādivrīhyādyātmanāpi sat
tathā cāsatkāryatvānuktiḥ, satkāryoktireva kṛtā tathā vadateti

dvyātmakaṃ vastutattvam ityetasyārthasya pratyakṣīkaraṇārthaṃ jaināḥ syādvādina ekamevātmānaṃ paramārthaṃ dravyārthataḥ sattvāt paryāyārthato'sattvāt tadubhayalakṣaṇamupavarṇayanti tādṛg vastu iti pratipāditatvāt
khapuṣpavadanyathā'sambhavāt ubhayarūpaikātmyābhāvādekarūpasya dravyārthātmanaḥ paryāyārthātmano vā nirbhedatvāt nirbījatvācca khapuṣpavadabhāvaprasaṅgāt sadasadrūpa evātmā vastuna iti

mṛdaḥ piṇḍaśivakādayaḥ kramabhuvaḥ, sahabhuvaḥ rūparasādayaśca bhinnāḥ, triṣu mṛdādirūpādyatītānāgatavartamānabhedābhedārthaṃ paryāyaśabdaṃ sarvābhedabhedārthaṃ mṛdātmānaṃ dravyārthaparyāyārthaṃ ghaṭātmānaṃ ca dravyārthaparyāyārthaṃ ca
idamapi ca kuto mṛda eva darśanam, na punardhṛtyādivat saṅgrahādidarśanam...

anirdeśyaṃ ca ? kuta etat asattvād ghaṭātmanā asadeva kāryam iti, na punarmṛttattvaghaṭasattvāt tattva evānubhavakramaprāpteḥ tatpratyagrāditvavad ghaṭasattvam ? yadapi cocyate--na, asatkāryatvasiddheḥ

evaṃ tarhi mṛdātmanaḥ kartavyatvābhāvād ghaṭā- kāleṣu mṛdādayaḥ vartamānāśca raktatvādayo vṛtta huṇḍādayaśca, te ca bhinnā apyabhinnāḥ svāṃ mūrtimanatiyartamānatvāditi bhedābhedārthameva dravyaśabdaṃ varṇayanti
paryāyaśabdaṃ sarvābhedabhedārthaṃ teṣveva trikālavartamānakālavartiṣu jātiṃ bhindantaṃ varṇayanti
kiṃ tarhi ? vastusvarūpanirūpaṇamapi kriyate, tadyathā --mṛdātmānaṃ dravyārthapayāryārthaṃ varṇayantīti sambadhyate

tayoryathākramaṃ vyākhyā dravyaṃ hītyādi dravyārthasya yāvad dravyārthaghaṭo'tyantasanniti, ghaṭasyaiva pūrvottarāvasthā mṛdādivrīhibījādimūlādirbhavatīti prāgapi bhāvitārtham, paryāyastvityādi paryāyārthasya yāvadasanniti tadviparyayeṇa gatārtham
mṛdādirūpādyatītānāgatavartamānabhedābhedārthaṃ paryāyaśabdaṃ sarvābhedabhedārthaṃ mṛdātmānaṃ dravyārthaparyāyārthaṃ ghaṭātmānaṃ ca dravyārthaparyāyārthaṃ ca
idamapi ca kuto mṛda eva darśanam, na punardhṛtyādivat saṅgrahādidarśanam...
anirdeśyaṃ ca ? kuta etat asattvād ghaṭātmanā asadeva kāryam iti, na punarmṛttattvaghaṭasattvāt tattva evānubhavakramaprāpteḥ tatpratyagrāditvavad ghaṭasattvam ?

yaducyate --niṣpanne'pi ghaṭe mṛttvadarśanād mṛdātmakasyopādānamiti, eṣo'pi viśiṣṭapārthivamṛttvadarśanenaikāntaḥ kutaḥ sambhavati saṅgrahapaktivyūhāvakāśadānadharmajalānalānilagaganavyudāsena dhṛtyādidharmapṛthivyātmakataiveti ? tat pradarśayati --na punardhṛtyādivat saṅgrahādidarśanamityādi tasmin vastuni vidyamānasarvadharmadarśanāni yāvadanirdeśyaṃ ceti
tasmād na mṛda eva darśanamubhayathāpi yadi mṛdi mṛdātmadarśanam atha ghaṭe mṛdātmadarśanamiti
yadapyucyate --ghaṭātmanā cāsattvāt kriyopapannetyevaṃ kila ārhata āha
naivamārhato brūte --ghaṭātmanā'sattvādasadeva kāryamiti, kiṃ tarhi ? sannapi ghaṭa iti brūte mṛttattvaghaṭasattvāt

taddarśayati --asattvād ghaṭātmaneti kuta etat, na punarmṛttattvaghaṭasattvāt, tat punaḥ sattvaṃ mṛttattvasya ghaṭasya tattva evānubhavakramaprāpteḥ kramajanmaghaṭaparyāyānubhavaḥ krameṇa prāpyate tattve dravyārthato'vasthitasvarūpa eva vastuni mṛdākhye, tatpratyagrāditvavat, yathā ghaṭasya pratyagreṣanmadhyamamadhyapurāṇatādibhāvā ghaṭatattve vyavasthitasyaiva tathaiva mṛttattva evānubhavakramaprāpteḥ ghaṭasattvam
etasya pūrvapakṣasyottarābhiprāyeṇocyate --na, asatkāryatvasiddheriti tmanaḥ kartavyatvādasadeva kāryam
tasmānna prāgutpatteḥ sadasat kāryam vai॰ sū॰ kaṭandī iti
mṛda ātmaiva ghaṭātmā, tattyāge tatsvarūpānupapatteḥ, atītānāgatavartamānavicitraviśeṣādhyāsisvabhāvasadbhūtamṛttvavat atītānāgatavartamānavicitraviśeṣādhyāsisvabhāvasadbhūtaghaṭavad vā
yāvat tasmānna prāgutpatteḥ sadasat kāryamiti gatārtham
atrottaramācārya āha --etadapi naiva, asatkāryatvasiddhivat satkāryatvasiddherityupakramya bhāvanā yāvat satkāryatvamiti

yathā mṛdbhāvādapracyutasya ghaṭasya mṛdbhāvenānutpādyāvināśyasya sata eva ghaṭavivakṣayā kartavyatvādasattvamiṣṭaṃ tvayā tathā'kartavyatvāt satatamapracyutasyākṛtakasya ghaṭādiśivakādikartavyātmano mṛttattvasya mṛttattvavivakṣayā kartavyatvābhāvāt sadeva kāryam iti kasmād neṣyate ?
tasmānna prāgutpatteḥ sadasat kāryam vai॰ sū॰ kaṭandī iti
mṛda ātmaiva ghaṭātmā, tattyāge tatsvarūpānupapatteḥ, atītānāgatavartamānavicitraviśeṣādhyāsisvabhāvasadbhūtamṛttvavat atītānāgatavartamānavicitraviśeṣādhyāsisvabhāvasadbhūtaghaṭavad vā
na hi ghaṭatāyāmityādi, śivakādivad mṛttattvasya ghaṭasya mṛttattvasyābhāve yadyavasthānaṃ syādasan ghaṭaḥ prāk paścājjāyata iti syāt, tattu nāsti, yasmād mṛda ātmaiva ghaṭātmā
kasmāt ? tattyāge tatsvarūpānupapatteḥ, yattyāge yatsvarūpānupapattiḥ sa tasyaivātmā

atītānāgatetyādi yāvad mṛttvavat, yathā mṛtpiṇḍasyātītānāgatavartamāneṣu kāleṣu ye viśeṣāḥ śītoṣṇatvādayaḥ sārdraśuṣkakhaṇḍitaśakalādayaśca vicitrāstānadhyāste svabhāvo yasya mṛttvasya tat tatsvabhāvam, sa eva sadbhāvaḥ paramārthaḥ, sa eva paramārtho bhūtaṃ mṛttattvaṃ tān viśeṣān vihāya na pravartate te'pi ca taditi sa evātmā viśeṣāṇāṃ mṛttvasya ca tathā ghaṭātmā mṛda evātmā
mṛda ātmā ghaṭasyātmā ghaṭasyātmā mṛda ātmeti dvidhāpi pratijñāyate tenaiva hetunā anenāpi dṛṣṭānteneti

kāryasadasadātmakaikavastupratipādanātmakena tadekāntapratiṣedhātmakena ca yatnena nityānityādyekāntavādaḥ sarvaḥ pratiṣiddho boddhavyaḥ upādānaniyamasyāsati sati ca kriyāyā asambhavād nityānityaikanānākāryakāraṇasarvāsarvagatatvādirasyādvādaḥ
nityatvenānityatvamanityatvena ca nityatvamekāntarūpaṃ bādhyate, sāpekṣaṃ ca sarvaṃ sidhyati, tadyathā--sadā sattvād nityatvam, sadā sattvaṃ dravyārthāt, naikāntānityatvamataḥ
sadā cāsattvādanityatvam, sadā cāsattvaṃ paryāyārthatvāt, ataśca naikāntanityatvamiti
kasyacidutpattaye kiñcidupādeyaṃ na sarvaṃ sarvasyetyasadbhāve niyamo nopapadyata iti
samarthasya karaṇe'dhikāraparigrahāt sa iti cet, samarthasyaiva kāryakriyāyām ...
kartṛ kāraṇam, karma kāryam iti kriyānimittakau śabdau, tatra prāk prasiddhavyāpārayogyadravyopādānaṃ tat kriyānimittam, na kāryasattvanimittam
atra syādvādī kila pṛcchati --athāsya vyāpāraniyamaḥ kuta ityādi yāvad na sidhyati
kasyacidutpattaye kiñcidupādeyaṃ na sarvaṃ sarvasyetyasadbhāve niyamo nopapadyata iti
yat punaruktaṃ prāgutpatteḥ kāryaṃ nāsadupādānaniyamāditi, buddhisiddhaṃ tu tadasat nyā॰ sū॰ 4
50, idamasyotpattaye samarthaṃ na sarvamiti prāgutpatterniyatakāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ buddhyā siddhamutpattiniyamadarśanāt
yat punaretat nāsadupādānaniyamāditi, buddhisiddhaṃ tu tadasat nyā॰ sū॰ 4
idamanena śakyaṃ nirvartayituṃ nedamanena ityevaṃ buddhisiddhaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtvā yad yasyotpattaye samarthaṃ tat tasyopādīyate na sarvaṃ sarvasya, na sarvasmāt sarvamutpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭamiti
athotpattiniyamena kāryaniyamena kāryakāraṇaniyamaṃ pratipadyate tenāpi kāryakāraṇaśabdayorartho vācyaḥ, kimuktaṃ bhavati kāraṇamiti kimuktaṃ ca bhavati kāryamiti
nanu karotīti kāraṇaṃ kriyata iti kāryam
atha vidyamāneṣvapi karotyartho dṛṣṭa iti manyase yathā keśān kuru, pṛṣṭhaṃ kuru iti
na tat, vidyamānānāṃ hi racanāviśeṣaḥ kriyate paścāt, pṛṣṭhasyāpi malāpagamo'vidyamānaḥ, iti na vidyamāne kāraṇārthaṃ jātvapi paśyāma iti
yaccoktamupādānaniyamāditi tatra yadi puruṣasyopādānaniyamaḥ paṭārthī tantūnevopādatte na vīraṇaṃ kaṭārthī vīraṇamiti tatastadupādānānāṃ tatra tatra kārye sāmarthyaparijñānāt
50 iti tadasadbhāvi kāryamanenaiva kāraṇena janyate nānyenetyanumānād buddhisiddhamevetyarthaḥ

athāsatkāryapakṣe tantava eva paṭasyopādānaṃ na vīraṇādītyayaṃ niyamo na syāditi brūṣe tadayuktam, asattvāviśeṣe'pi svakāraṇādutpannaṃ kiñcideva kiñcit kāryaṃ janayituṃ samarthaṃ nānyadityayaṃ svabhāvaviśeṣādupapadyata iti iti vācaspatimiśraviracitāyāṃ nyāyavārtikatātparyaṭīkāyām
atra vaiśeṣikapakṣa āśaṅkyate --samarthasya karaṇe'dhikāraparigrahāt sa iti cet
etasya vyākhyā --samarthasyaiva kāryakriyāyāmityādi kāraṇanidarśano grantho gatārtho yāvadasadeva kāryamiti etat kilopādānaniyamakāraṇatvena uttaramasatkāryavādinaḥ

atrācāryastaduttaramāha --ekībhāvagatārthasya samarthatvāt satkāryatvameva, nanu tvayaiva samarthasya karaṇe'dhikāraparigrahādupādānaniyamaḥ iti bruvatā satkāryatvaṃ sabharthitam, saṅgatārthaṃ samartham, ekībhāvaṃ gato yo'rthaḥ sa samarthaḥ sādhyena sādhanākhyaḥ, tadbhāvādekībhāvagatārthasya samarthatvāt satkāryatvameva nāsatā kharaviṣāṇena saha kasyacit sāmarthyaṃ tasya vā kenacidupapadyata iti

atha kathaṃ tantuturyādereva kāraṇatvenopādānaṃ paṭanirvṛttau, na pāṃśuvāsyādeḥ ? tasyaiva samarthatvāt tathā tathā paṭādikāryaṃ tantuṣu vartate tathā aṃśuṣu tathā pakṣmatuṭireṇuparamāṇuṣu tathā turyādiṣvapi, pāṃsvādiṣvapi ca, kāraṇakāraṇatvādaṇuvat
nayacakravṛttipāṭhasya samañjasatve tu atha kathaṃ tantuturyādi eva paṭanirvṛttau kāraṇam, na pāṃśuvāsyādi ? ityapi mūlaṃ syādatra
asya vyākhyānam --atha kathaṃ tantuturyādi yāvat kāraṇakāraṇatvādaṇuvat vaiśeṣikameva pṛcchaṃstenaiva vyākhyāpayati

turyādereva kāraṇatvenopādānaṃ paṭanirvṛttau na pāṃśuvāsyāderiti karaṇādhikāraparigrahādeva satkāryatvaṃ tasyaiva samarthatvāt tathā tathā tena tena prakāreṇa tattanniyatanijaśaktiyuktārthasamarthatvāt, paṭādi kāryaṃ tantuṣu vartate, tantukāraṇeṣu tathāṃśuṣu prakārāntareṇa paṭakāraṇabhāvaṃ bibhratsu, tathā pakṣmatuṭi-reṇu-paramāṇūnāmapi yathāsvaśakti prakārāntaraiḥ paṭakāraṇatvāt pāramparyeṇa tatra tatrāstyeva paṭaḥ tatsamavāyavyaṅgyatvāt tadātmakatvācca

asamavāyipaṭo'pi saṃyogavyaṅgyatvāt saṃyogidravyebhyaḥ saṃyogasyābhinnatvād dvyaṇukatryaṇukādyanantapradeśaskandhasaṃyogatvapariṇatadravyābhedāt ta eva paramāṇavaḥ paṭaḥ, yathā saṃyogiṣu paṭakāraṇeṣu tadātmakatvāt paṭatvaṃ tathā tatkāraṇaparamāṇūnām
tathā turyādiṣvapi, turi-vema-śalākā'ñcanikā-vilekhanikādīnāṃ kuvindaprayatnotthāpitavyāpārāṇāṃ paṭatvaṃ tadātmakatvād dravyābhedāt
pāṃsvādiṣvapi ca bhūmyambumārutānalākāśabījasaṃyoganiṣpādyakarpāsātmakatvāt paṭatvaṃ siddham, tatkāraṇakāraṇatvāt paramāṇuvat
evaṃ tāvat kāryasadasattvapratiṣedho na sidhyati pratiṣedhahetvayukteḥ sadasattvaikātmyasādhanasausthityapradarśanācca sadasadeva kāryamiti
ādiśabdasya antaśabdasya ca parasparamabhisambaddhatvād dvyaṇukatryaṇukādi ityatra ādiśabdaḥ, anantānta ityatra ca anantaityanantaram antaśabdaḥ, iti vivakṣāyāṃ bhā॰ pratipāṭho'pi sādhureveti dhyeyam
samavātikāraṇaṃ paṭasya tantavaḥ, taṃtusu paḍo samaveta iti
ahavā nimittakāraṇaṃ ca naimittikakāraṇaṃ ca, kaḍassa vīraṇā nimittaṃ, naimittikāni puruṣaprayatnarajjukīlakādīni
kiñcānyat, yo'pyupacayaheturityādi tena kila sadasattvaniṣedhaṃ kṛtvā kāryāsattvasādhanārthamupacayaheturuktaḥ, tadyathā--prāg niṣpatteśca kāryasyābhāvāt
kriyā tvaktrāṇādikā paṭasya tantvavasthāyāṃ guṇāśca saṃyogapariṇāmādayaḥ vyapadeśaśca śabdāntaraṃ liṅgaṃ vā na santi, tasmāt kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvāt prāgutpatterasat kāryaṃ khapuṣpavaditi
asyāpyupacaya vat' iti asyāpi viruddhatvam, sadeva bhavati kāryam, prāgabhūtakriyāguṇavyapadeśatvāt, sattā'sambandhidravyādivat
anaikāntikatā ca, asati ca khapuṣpādau satica jātamātre kāryatraye dṛṣṭatvāt
prabhūtasya triprakārā niṣpattiḥ niyatā niścitā adhikā vā bhavanameva hetorviruddhatvaṃ doṣa ityācārya āha
ayameva te upacayahetuḥ parapakṣasādhanāya, sadeva bhavati kāryaṃ jāyate vyajyata utpadyate, prāgabhūtakriyāguṇavyapadeśatvāt, sattā'sambandhidravyādivat, saviśeṣaṇaṃ svapakṣasādhanaṃ vedam

yathā dravyaguṇakarmākhyaṃ kāryatrayaṃ svabhāvasat tvanmatenaiva yāvat sattayā na sambaddhaṃ tāvat kriyāguṇavyapadeśabhāg na bhavati atha ca vidyate svakāraṇeṣu samavetamātraṃ tathedaṃ samavetakāryamityasmanmatasiddhiḥ
anaikāntikatā ca kriyā-guṇa-vyapadeśābhāvāt ityasya hetorasati ca khapuṣpādau sati ca jātamātre kāryatraye dṛṣṭatvāt asadeva iti sandigdham
vat' iti asyāpi viruddhatvam, sadeva bhavati kāryam, prāgabhūtakriyāguṇavyapadeśatvāt, sattā'sambandhidravyādivat
anaikāntikatā ca, asati ca khapuṣpādau satica jātamātre kāryatraye dṛṣṭatvāt
prabhūtasya triprakārā niṣpattiḥ niyatā niścitā adhikā vā bhavanameva
