nanu mayā prāg niṣpatterasat kāryaṃ kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvāt ityuktam sadeva tu dravyaṃ na kāryam
nanu niṣpattirutpattirabhūtvā bhāvaḥ avyaktasad vyaktasad bhavati ityuktaṃ bhavati
anupanilīnasattvaṃ ca dravyāditrayaṃ jātamātraṃ sattāsāmānyena sad bhavati
niṣpattiśabdo hi bhavanasya sattāyā vācakaḥ ityāśayaḥ syāditi bhāti
prāgutpatterasat kāryamabhūtakriyāguṇavyapadeśatvāt khapuṣpavat syāt, upajātamātradravyādivat sat syāt ? iti tvatsādhanamapi saṃśayakārīti cet

syādayaṃ prasaṅgo yadyaviśeṣya kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvāt sat kāryam ityetāvad brūyām, kiṃ tarhi ? prāgabhūtakriyāguṇavyapadeśatvāt iti mayā viśeṣyoktam, yasya prāgabhūtaḥ kriyāguṇavyapadeśaḥ paścād bhaviṣyati tat sadeva, yathā tadevotpannamātradravyādi, na tu yasya prāk paścāt iti kālāvibhāgenaivāsattvaṃ khapuṣpāderiti
atrāha --nanvityādi yāvat sadeva tu dravyaṃ na kāryamiti
mayā prāg niṣpatterasat kāryam iti kālaviśiṣṭaṃ yāvadanutpannaṃ tāvad nāsti iti pratijñāya kriyādyabhāvāt iti heturuktaḥ, sa tu niṣpanne dravye nāsti, tasmāt sādhanadharmavaikalyādayukto dṛṣṭānta iti
nanu niṣpatteḥ prāk ityukte'pi niṣpatterutpattyabhūtvābhāvādisamānārthatvādavyaktasad vyaktasad bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati
tadyathā--anupanilīnasattvaṃ ca tad dravyāditrayaṃ jātamātraṃ sattopanilayanāt prāganiṣpannaṃ sattāsāmānyena sat sattāsamavāyāt sad bhavati vyaktasad bhavatītyeṣo'rtho niṣpattiśabdasyeti
tadvyākhyānam --prabhūtasya prārabdhabhavanasya triprakārā niṣpattiḥ, tadyathā --niyatā niścitā adhikā vā

yathā sattāsambandhādeva dravyādau kārye niyatā niścitā sattvāntarebhyo viviktatvāt sattāyāḥ adhikā punarbhavanāt, evamupādānaniyamasvasattāniyatā taṇḍulavicayavat kriyāyā vyāpāreṇa niścitā yugapadayugapatparyāyakramatathābhūteradhikā niṣpattirihāpi

tadyathā--sattāsambandhādeva dravyādau kārye niyatā kāraṇasamavāyasya sāmānyasya ca nityatvāt, niścitā dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvaghaṭatvarūpatvotkṣepaṇādisattvāntarebhyo viviktatvāt sattāyāḥ, adhikā punarbhavanāt kāryasya tvanmatenaiva kāraṇasamavāye janmābhyupagamāt
evaṃ tāvad dṛṣṭāntasya kāryadravyāditrayasya niṣpattistrirūpā vyākhyātā

dārṣṭāntikakāryasyādhunā --upādānaniyamasvasattāniyatā, mṛdādyupādānaniyamena ghaṭādeḥ svasattā vidyate, tayā sattayā niyatā mṛdyeva ghaṭaniṣpatteḥ, tattvato'sau ghaṭatvena niścitā paṭatvādivyāvṛttyā, tadyathā — tandulavicayavat, vicitā niścitāstaṇḍulāḥ kacavarādyapanayanena svarūpaparigraheṇa ca, kriyāyā vyāpāreṇa parispandena aniṣpatteḥ sakāśād niścitā apanītā ghaṭaniṣpattiḥ svarūpaparigraheṇetyarthaḥ

adhikā yugapadayugapatparyāyakramatathābhūteḥ, ye prāg yugapadbhāvino rūpādipṛthubudhnādiparyāyāḥ piṇḍaśivakādayo nava-madhyama-purāṇatādayaścāyugapadbhāvinaḥ teṣāṃ krameṇa śivakādikaraṇavidhinā tathābhūteḥ tena prakāreṇa bhavanādadhikā niṣpattirihāpīti
tasmād dṛṣṭāntabhūtasya dravyāditrayasya kāryasya niṣpattivadavyaktasad vyaktasad bhavatīti samānamupādāne sataḥ kāryasyeti gatamānuṣaṅgikam

yathā sattāsambandhādeva dravyādau kārye niyatā niścitā sattvāntarebhyo viviktatvāt sattāyāḥ adhikā punarbhavanāt, evamupādānaniyamasvasattāniyatā taṇḍulavicayavat kriyāyā vyāpāreṇa niścitā yugapadayugapatparyāyakramatathābhūteradhikā niṣpattirihāpi
tasmāt sadasata eva kriyāguṇāḥ, tadbhāvāt sadasatkriyāguṇatvāt sadasata eva kriyā-guṇavyapadeśāḥ

anyathā hetuśaktyupādānānāmabhidhānamātraprasaṅgaḥ, yadyasadeva kāryaṃ syāt hetordaṇḍādeḥ mardanādiyogyatāyāḥ śakterupādānasya ca mṛdaḥ, ghaṭādau mṛdevopādīyate na tantvādiriti, eṣāṃ kharaviṣāṇādivadabhāve ayamasya daṇḍādihetuḥ, iyamasya śaktirmārdavādirmṛddravyasya, mṛdeva ghaṭasyopādānam iti vacanamātramevedaṃ sarvaṃ syāt, nārthaḥ kaścit, khapuṣpādiniṣpattyarthakriyāhetvādyabhāvavadasattvāviśeṣāt
yadi tu sadeva kāryaṃ syāt tatrāpi sa eva doṣa ityata āha --yasya tu vidyamāna evārtha ityādi gatārthaṃ yāvadeteṣāmarthānāmabhāvādabhidhānamātraprasaṅgaḥ niṣpādyaniṣpādakatvāviśeṣāditi
niṣpādyo tasmādaikāntikapakṣayorayuktatvād yuktametat prāk sadasadeva prādurbhavatīti
yadapi coktam--vikalpatrayānāśrayād vikalpāntarāśrayaṇācca vikalpānupapatteḥ iti na doṣaḥ, niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvāt

niṣṭhā kāraṇasāmagryavyāpāra- ghaṭaḥ, niṣpādakāḥ kulāladaṇḍādayaḥ, kulālamṛddaṇḍādyastitvavad ghaṭāstitvāt kiṃ daṇḍādinā hetunā kriyate, na vā turyādinā ? mṛda eva mārdavādiśaktirna vajrādeḥ, mṛdevopādānaṃ ghaṭasyāniṣpannatvāt na tu niṣpannaghaṭa iti viśeṣo nāsti, sattvāviśeṣāt
tataḥ kimāyātam ? idamāyātam--asatkāryāyuktatvavat satkāryatvamapyaikāntikaṃ na yuktam
yadapi coktam--vikalpatrayānāśrayād vikalpāntarāśrayaṇācca vikalpānupapatteḥ iti na doṣaḥ, niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvāt
tasmādaikāntikapakṣayostayorayuktatvād yuktametat pratipattuṃ prāk sadasadeva prādurbhavatīti syādvādina upasaṃharanti
ekāntapakṣayordoṣadarśanādanekāntapakṣe cādoṣadarśanāt sadasadeva kāryamavyaktasad vyaktasad bhavatīti sthitametat--tridhāpi vikalpānupapatteḥ sattayā na sambadhyate kāryamiti
etadvikalpapakṣatrayaparihāreṇa nirdoṣābhimataṃ vikalpāntaramāśritya yaducyate tvayā vikalpānupapatteḥ iti nāsau doṣaḥ, vikalpatrayānāśrayād vikalpāntarāśrayaṇācca
kā niṣṭhā ? ityata āha --niṣṭhā kāraṇa kālaḥ prāgasato vastubhāvaḥ niṣṭhānaṃ samāptiḥ...

tayorekakālatvam, svakāraṇasattāsambandha eva niṣṭhākālaḥ, kutaḥ ? samavāyasyaikatvāt, yasminneva kāle pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchat kāryaṃ kāraṇaiḥ sambadhyate samavāyasambandhena ayutasiddhihetunā tasminneva kāle sattādibhirapi, tasmādapravibhāgāt prāk kāryotpatterasataḥ sadādiranāspado vikalpaḥ
kathaṃ cāvastunaḥ kāraṇaiḥ sattayā vā sambandhaḥ ? yadi tasya syāt khapuṣpasyāpi syāt
sāmagryavyāpārakālaḥ, kāraṇānāṃ samavāyyasamavāyināṃ tantu-saṃyoga-daṇḍādīnāṃ sāmagryā avyāpārakālaḥ paṭaniṣpattau turyādivyāpāroparamakāla ityarthaḥ
tameva vyācaṣṭe --prāgasato vastubhāvaḥ paṭādivastujanma niṣṭhānaṃ samāptirityādiparyāyaiḥ
sambandhaḥ kaḥ ? ityata āha --sambandhaḥ svakāraṇasattāsamavāyaḥ, svakāraṇeṣu tantuṣu kāryasya paṭasya sattayā ca samavāyaḥ

taddarśayati — svakāraṇasattāsambandha eva niṣṭhākālaḥ, svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca kāryasya yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa eva niṣṭhākāla iti pratijñāya kutaḥ iti hetuṃ paripṛcchaya hetumāha --samavāyasyaikatvāt, samavāyo hi sambandhaḥ, sa caiko dvayorapi, nitiṣṭhata eva sambandhāt kāraṇasattādibhiḥ

taddarśayati --yasminneva kāle pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchat kāryamātmānaṃ labhamānaṃ paṭākhyaṃ kāraṇaistantvādibhiḥ sambadhyate samavāyasambandhena samavāyā- khyena sambandheneti ayutasiddhihetunā saṃyogād yutasiddhihetorasya viśeṣaṃ darśayati, tasminneva kāle sattādibhirapi sambadhyate iti vartate
ya eva kāraṇaiḥ kāryasya samavāyaḥ sa eva sattādravyatvādibhirapyekaḥ samavāyaḥ kālasyābhinnatvāt

tasmādapravibhāgaḥ, tad yasmād nāstyatra kālapravibhāgo niṣṭhāsambandhayoḥ tasmāt prāk ityetadeva nopapadyate kāryotpatterasataḥ sadādiranāspado vikalpa iti, satā kāryeṇāsatā sadasatā vā sattāyāḥ sambandha ityarthābhāvāt kimāśrayo'sau vikalpaḥ syāt ? iti tāṃstrīnapi vikalpānanāśritya niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvavikalpo nirdoṣa āśrīyatāmiti
...gavi agavi vṛttyabhāvāditi cet, atha manyase yadidaṃ gotvaṃ goṣu anuvṛttipratyayakāraṇaṃ tat kiṃ gavi vartate āhosvidagavi ? yadi tāvad gavi, prāg gotvayogād gaurevāsāviti vyarthaṃ gotvam
na gavi gotvaṃ nāgavi, prāg gotvayogānnāsau gaurnāpyagauriti

kiṃ kāraṇam ? ubhāvetau viśeṣyapratyayau na viśeṣaṇasambandhamantareṇa bhavataḥ, na ca prāg gotvayogād vastu vidyate na cāvidyamānaṃ gaurityagauriti ca śakyaṃ vyapadeṣṭum, yadaiva vastu tadaiva gotvenābhisambadhyate ityanāspado vikalpaḥ
etena sattāsambandhasya sadasadvikalpo vyākhyātaḥ, na sataḥ sattāsambandho nāsataḥ, yadaiva tad vastu tadaiva sattayā sambaddhamiti sadasadāśrayo doṣo'nupapanna iti
athāstu sāmānyādāvupacaritaṃ dravyādau mukhyaṃ sat sat iti jñānam, sattāsambandhastu vikalpate--kiṃ sattā satām, athāsatām ? iti
yadi satām, atha sattāsambandhāt pūrvaṃ sattvaṃ sattāsambandhena vinā ceti
vineti cet, kiṃ sattayā ? athāsatāṃ sattāsambandhāt sattvamiti, apāramārthikaṃ tarhi sattvamupādhyapekṣitvāt, saditi cāsatāṃ sattāsambandhena sattvaṃ kharaviṣāṇādīnāmapi sattvaṃ syāt asattvāviśeṣāt
tathā sattāyāścāsattvena tadyogānna dravyādiṣu sattvaṃ syāt, svarūpeṇa ca sattve dravyādiṣu tathā prasaṅgaḥ, sattāsambandhena cānavastheti
tatra yattadavocāma kiṃ satāṃ sattāsambandhāt sattvamathāsatāmiti tadasat, niṣpādasambandhayorekakālatvāt
tathāhi--padārthānāṃ svakāraṇasattāsambandha evotpattiḥ, na pūrvaṃ sattvam, satkāryavādapratiṣedhāt
na cāsatāṃ svakāraṇasattāsambandhābhyupagame kharaviṣāṇādiṣu tathābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ, tadutpattikāraṇābhāvasya tadabhāvenaiva niścayāt
...atha kimidaṃ kāryatvaṃ nāmeti ? svakāraṇasattāsambandhaḥ, tena satā kāryam iti vyavahārāt
abhūtvā bhavanamityeke, atrāpi abhūtvā paścād bhavanaṃ svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca sambandha eveti
...yaccedaṃ kiṃ gaurgautvenābhisambadhyate, athāgauḥ ? iti codyaṃ tanna pratisamādhānārhaṃ niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvāditi
svakāraṇaiḥ sattādibhiśca piṇḍasyābhisambandha evātmalābhaḥ, na pūrvaṃ tasya gorūpatā agorūpatā vā tatsattvasyaivāsambhavāt

tayorekakālatvam, svakāraṇasattāsambandha eva niṣṭhākālaḥ, kutaḥ ? samavāyasyaikatvāt, yasminneva kāle pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchat kāryaṃ kāraṇaiḥ sambadhyate samavāyasambandhena ayutasiddhihetunā tasminneva kāle sattādibhirapi, tasmādapravibhāgāt prāk kāryotpatterasataḥ sadādiranāspado vikalpaḥ
kathaṃ cāvastunaḥ kāraṇaiḥ sattayā vā sambandhaḥ ? yadi tasya syāt khapuṣpasyāpi syāt
eṣo'pi vikalpo nopapadyate, tadanupapatterna doṣaparihāraḥ kṛtaḥ
kathamanupapanno'yaṃ vikalpa iti cet, asambandhāt, asambandho'pyavastutvāt, khapuṣpasyāvastunaḥ kenacit sambandho nāsti tathā prāgutpatterasataḥ kāryasya sambandho nāsti

tasya ca kāryasya pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchato'sattvādavastutvam, kathaṃ cāvastunaḥ kāraṇaiḥ sattayā vā sambandhaḥ ? pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchat ityutpadyamānamasadevālabdhātmakatvāt tat kāryaṃ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā vā na sambadhyate avastutvāt khapuṣpavat

yadi tasya syāt khapuṣpasyāpi syāt, yadi kāryaṃ pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchadaniṣpannamasat kāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca sambadhyate tataḥ khapuṣpamapi pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchat svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca sambadhyeta, avastu- tvāt kāryavat
tasmādayamapi vikalpaḥ asat sattayā sambadhyate ityetadvikalpāntaḥpātyeveti
sambandhakāle tantuvad vastubhāvāt, bhavadeva ca sambadhyate pariniṣṭhānasambandhayorekakālatvāt

punarapīdaṃ tadavasthameva, loke hi sambadhyamānānāṃ sattvaṃ dṛṣṭam, na hi śaśaviṣāṇasya sambadhyamānatā dṛṣṭā, na hi pariniṣṭhāyāḥ sambandhād vā sattvam, yadi syāt tadā hi śaśaviṣāṇamapi niṣṭhāṃ gacchat sambadhyeta, kāryamapi vā na sambadhyeta

samānatvānneti cet, sati asati ca sambandhādarśanatulyatvāt, yathā'sataḥ khapuṣpādeḥ samavāyasambandhena dvividhena svakāraṇasattādibhiḥ sambadhyamānatā na dṛṣṭā tadvat sato'pi sambadhyamānatā na dṛṣṭā; nahi sambadhyamānamaviśiṣṭamihādhikṛtam
syānmatam--nanu sambandhakāle'sti kāryamutpadyamānameva vastu bhavati, paṭakāraṇaṃ tantava iva
bhavadeva ca pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchat sambadhyate pariniṣṭhānasambandhayorekakālatvāt, pariniṣṭhitaṃ sambaddhaṃ ca ityekaḥ kālaḥ, kālapravibhāgābhāvaḥ
tasmāt sambandho vastuna eva kāryasya nāvastuna ityuktamiti
yutasiddhirasambaddhasya vidyamānatā, na punaḥ kāryaṃ kāraṇāsambaddhaṃ vidyate, jātaḥ sambaddhaścetyekaḥ kālaḥ

atrocyate --punarapīdaṃ tadavasthameva, niṣpadyamānāvasthāyā utpatteḥ pūrvakālatvāt prāgutpatteśca kāryasyāsattvādasataḥ sambadhyamānatā khapuṣpāderiva kā ? no cet, tasyāmavasthāyāṃ kāryaṃ sadeva syāt svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca sambadhyamānatvāt niṣpannakāryavat
loke hi sambadhyamānānāṃ sattvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti sādharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ
na hi śaśaviṣāṇasya sambadhyamānatā dṛṣṭeti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ, tadā na sambadhyate kāryam asattvāt, khapuṣpavadityaniṣṭāpādanānumānaṃ vā
na hi pariniṣṭhāyāḥ sambandhād vā sattvamiti, na hi pariniṣṭhā sambandho vānyatra dṛṣṭāvapi sattvamasataḥ kurutaḥ khapuṣpādeḥ, sata eva niṣṭhāsambandhadarśanāt
yadi niṣṭhāyāḥ sambandhād vā sattvaṃ syāt tadā hi śaśaviṣāṇamapi niṣṭhāṃ gacchat sambadhyeta niṣṭhitaṃ ca sambaddhaṃ ceti bhavet, asattvāt, kāryavat
kāryamapi vā pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchat svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca na sambadhyeta, asattvāt, khapuṣpavat
tadeti ca tvaduktavad niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvābhyupagamāvasthāyāṃ khapuṣpādyakāryasyāpi tadvadekalāle niṣṭhāsambandhau syātāṃ svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā cetyaniṣṭāpādanametaditaścetaśca
samānatvānneti cet, syānmatam--naitadaniṣṭāpādanaṃ ghaṭate, kasmāt ? satyasati ca sambandhādarśanatulyatvāt

asya vyākhyā --yathā'sataḥ ityādi yāvadihādhikṛtamiti, yathaiva asataḥ khapuṣpādeḥ samavāyasambandhena dvividhena svakāraṇasambandhena sattāsambandhena ca sambadhyamānatā na dṛṣṭā, ādigrahaṇād dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvādibhiśceti dṛṣṭāntaḥ
tadvadityādi dārṣṭāntikaṃ gatārtham, na hi sambadhyamānamaviśiṣṭaṃ yat kiñcidihādhikṛtam, svakāraṇasvasattādivacanāditi
atra brūmaḥ--sambandha eva sa na bhavati, satsu abhūtatvāt, śaśaviṣāṇavat
yadi tvātmātmīyayoḥ paṭavyañjanayoḥ sadbhāve kāraṇāni tantavaḥ, sambadhyeraṃstena paṭena
ta eva tantavaḥ pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchantaḥ sambadhyanta iti kālāvibhāgaḥ kāryakāraṇasattāsambandhasya
tadā te yadi tantava ityeva, puruṣādikāraṇamātravādavadayaṃ vādaḥ syāt
satkāryavādo'pi na pratipūryeta, tantvākuṇḍalanavat pūrvottarakālatulyatvāt sambandhānarthakyaṃ pariniṣṭhā'pariniṣṭhā'viśeṣaśca
atra brūmaḥ--sambandha eva sa na bhavati, satsu abhūtatvāt, śaśaviṣāṇavadityaniṣṭāpādanasādhanenāsatsatoḥ sambandhasyātulyatā pradarśyate
svakāraṇaiḥ svasattayā ca kāryasya sambandhaḥ prāgapi sata eveti

tadarthasādhanaṃ cedam --vidyamānaviṣayeṇaiva tena samavāyasambandhena bhavitavyam, sambandhatvāt, yathā saṃyogo dve aṅgulī vidyamāne eva viṣayīkurute sambandhaśabdavācyatvāt tathā samavāyo'pi kāryakāraṇe vidyamāne eva viṣayīkurute dvyādiparādhīnavṛttitvāditi
svakāraṇāni svasattā ityatra svaśabdasya ātmā-''tmīya-dhanaparyāyasya ihātmani ātmīye yathāvivakṣaṃ vṛttiḥ syāt, sa ca kāryo'rthaḥ
tayoḥ paṭavyañjanayoḥ sadbhāve kurvanti kāryaṃ paṭamiti kāraṇāni tantavaḥ sambadhyeraṃstena paṭena, sa tu nāsti paṭaḥ, tadabhāve kiṃviṣayaṃ kāraṇānāṃ kartṛtvamityarthaḥ

vyañjanasadbhāvakartṛtvanirviṣayāḥ ta eva tantavaḥ pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchantaḥ sambadhyante khapuṣpeṇeva kāryakāraṇanirapekṣāḥ pariniṣṭhitāḥ sambaddhāśceti kālāvibhāgaḥ kāryakāraṇasattāsambandhasyetyetadāpannam
tataḥ ko doṣa iti cet, ukto'satā sambandhābhāvaḥ

punarapītthamucyate --tadā te yadi tantava ityeva kāryābhāvāt kāraṇatvavyāpāravimukhāḥ kevalaṃ tantava iti puruṣādikāraṇamātramevedam itivādavadayaṃ vādaḥ syāt, kuto'satkāryavādaḥ ? satkāryavādo'pi sāṅkhyābhimataḥ prakṛtyantarlīnā vikārāḥ iti so'pi na pratipūryeta, stimitasaraḥsalilavad gaganavadvā nirvyāpārakāraṇamātravādābhyupagamāt na pratipūryeteti, mā vocaṃ na pratipūryata eva iti niṣṭhuramiti sānunayamucyate

kimiva ? tantvākuṇḍalanavat, yathā tantūnāmākuṇḍalīkṛtānāṃ puñjitānāmityarthaḥ, kuvindatanana-pāyana-prasāraṇa-vayanādikriyānirapekṣāṇāṃ kāraṇatvaṃ nāsti, tatrātyantaṃ paṭakāryādarśanāt, na hi kuṇḍaliteṣu paṭo dṛśyate, tathā kāraṇamātramasampūrṇasatkāryametat, pūrvottarakālatulyatvāditi, evaṃ nirvyāpārapūrvottarakālatulyatantumātratāyāṃ paṭākhyasya kāryasya kaścid gandho'pi nāsti, atastena sambandhānarthakyaṃ kāraṇānāṃ tantūnāṃ khapuṣpeṇeva
kiñcānyat, pariniṣṭhāpariniṣṭhāviśeṣaśca, doṣopacayaḥ, khapuṣpavat kārya tataḥ svakāraṇasattāsambandhadvayatantupaṭadvayasānāthyaṃ nānekāntānāśrayaṇe

asatsambandhaparihārārthaṃ ca niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvāt ityetadeva vākyaṃ sabhāṣyaṃ praśasto'nyathā vyācaṣṭe--sambandhaśca sambandhaśca sambandhau, niṣṭhāyāḥ syātyantamasattvāt kāraṇānāṃ cātyantaṃ pūrvottarakālatulyatvādākāśavat kiṃ kathaṃ pariniṣṭhitaṃ tiṣṭhati na parinitiṣṭhati ? sarvaṃ hi sarvadā sarvathā pariniṣṭhitamapariniṣṭhitaṃ vā syādityaviśeṣaḥ
svo jñātāvātmani svaṃ triṣvātmīye svo'striyāṃ dhane
asatsambandhaparihārārthaṃ ca niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvāt ityetadeva vākyaṃ sabhāṣyaṃ praśasto'nyathā vyācaṣṭe--sambandhaśca sambandhaśca sambandhau, niṣṭhāyāḥ
parinitiṣṭhati na parinitiṣṭhati ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt

atha mā bhūvannete doṣā iti paṭo'pi kenacid nyāyena tantuṣvasti ityabhyupagamyate so'pyabhyupagamavirodhāyaikāntavādinaste'nekāntavādābhyupagamo jāyata ityata āha --tataḥ svakāraṇasattāsambandhadvayatantupaṭadvayasānāthyaṃ nānekāntānāśrayaṇe, paṭasya kāryasya svakāraṇaistantubhiḥ svasattayā ceti dvau sambandhau tāveva kāryaṃ kāraṇāni ca dvāvarthāviti tadeva taccatuṣṭayam, avyaktasan paṭaḥ tantvavasthāyāṃ tantubhiḥ svakāraṇaiḥ svasattayā ca sambaddhaḥ kuvindādikārakavyāpārottarakālaṃ vyaktasan bhavati paṭātmanā pariṇateriti dravyaparyāyātmakasyādvādaparameśvarāśrayaprabhāvalabhyametad vacanasāmarthyaṃ nānyatheti

niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvāt ityetadeva vākyaṃ sabhāṣyamasatsambandhadoṣaparijihīrṣayā vidvasyan praśasto'nyathā vyācaṣṭe --sambandhaśca sambandhaśca sambandhau, niṣṭhāyāḥ sambandhau niṣṭhāsambandhau, na niṣṭhā ca sambandhaśceti
niṣṭhitaṃ niṣṭhā, kārakaparispandād vastubhāvamāpannamavyapadeśyādhāraṃ kāryaṃ niṣṭhitaṃ niṣṭhā ityucyate, tasya svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca yugapat sambandhau bhavataḥ
bhāṣyamapi pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchad gatam ityetamarthaṃ darśayati, vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā pā॰ 3
yathā kārakāntaramutpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kārakavyāpārād vastubhāvamāpannamavyapadeśyādhāraṃ nirvṛttaṃ sat svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca sambadhyate tathā paṭākhyam
kiñca, niṣṭhitasya kāryasya kāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca sambandho yutasiddhasambandhaḥ, kāryasya kāraṇebhyo'nyatra pariniṣṭhitatvāt

kartrādīnāṃ kārakāṇāṃ kuvinda-turi-vemādīnāṃ parispandād vastubhāvaṃ vastubhavanamāpannaṃ niṣpannamavyapadeśyādhāram, avyapadeśya ādhāro'sya tantvādiḥ samavāyi- hetuḥ, iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ itīhapratyayābhidhānakāraṇasya samavāyasambandhasya nimittabhūtaṃ paṭākhyaṃ kāryaṃ niṣṭhitaṃ niṣṭhā ityucyate
tasya niṣṭhitasya svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca yugapat sambandhau bhavataḥ
idaṃ tu dhyeyam --vākyamidaṃ bhāṣyaṃ cedaṃ kena kadā ca viracitamiti na samyag vijñāyate

kaṇādaviracitavaiśeṣikasūtrāṇāṃ saṅkṣiptavyākhyānarūpo vākyanāmakaḥ kaścid grantha āsīt, tadupari kenacid viracitaṃ bhāṣyamāsīt, tadupari ca praśastamativiracitā kācit ṭīkā āsīditi tu pūrvāparagranthaparyālocanayā pratīyate, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 517 paṃ॰ 9
yattu praśastapādabhāṣyamidānīmupalabhyate tatra naiveyaṃ carcā dṛśyate, ataḥ praśastapādabhāṣyādavaśyaṃ bhinnamevaitad bhāṣyam
kiñcānyat, praśastapādabhāṣyaṃ na sākṣād vaiśeṣikasūtrāṇāṃ vyākhyānabhūtaṃ kintu svatantra eva nibandhaḥ

tattvasaṅgrahapañjikā-prameyakamalamārtaṇḍa-nyāyakumudacandrādiprācīnagrantheṣu ca tasya padārthapraveśakanāmnaiva ullekhaḥ, vādi devasūriviracitasyādvādaratnākare pṛ॰ 920 tu praśastakarabhāṣyanāmnāpi nirdeśaḥ, anyagrantheṣu kevalaṃ bhāṣyanāmnāpi nirdeśaḥ, samprati tu praśastapādabhāṣyanāmnaiva prācuryeṇa vyavahāraḥ
evaṃ praśastapādabhāṣyakartuḥ praśastaḥ, praśastakaraḥ, praśastadevaḥ, praśastakaradevaḥ, praśastapādaḥ ityādīni bahūni nāmāni upalabhyante
praśastamatiḥ ityapi tasyaiva nāmāntaraṃ syāditi pratibhāti

idaṃ tvavadheyam --tattvasaṅgrahapañjikāyāṃ sanmatitarkavṛttau prameyakamalamārtaṇḍa-nyāyakumudacandrādiṣu ca praśastamaterbahūni vacāṃsi uddhṛtāni dṛśyante, kintu tatra tattvasaṅgrahapañjikāyāṃ viśeṣaparīkṣāyāṃ samavāyaparīkṣāyāṃ ca yat praśastamatermatamuddhṛtaṃ tadeva kevalamupalabhyate yathākṣaraṃ praśastapādabhāṣye, aparāṇi tu praśastamatervacāṃsi naivopalabhyante praśastapādabhāṣye

ata evaṃ sambhāvyate--ekastāvad vaiśeṣikasūtrāṇāṃ vākyatadbhāṣyayośca vyākhyānabhūto granthaḥ praśastamatinā vyaraci, aparastu vaiśeṣikamatavarṇanaparaḥ svatantra eva nibandhastena viracito yaḥ samprati praśastapādabhāṣyanāmnā sarvalokaprasiddha iti dhyeyam
niṣṭhitaṃ niṣṭhā, kārakaparispandād vastubhāvamāpannamavyapadeśyādhāraṃ kāryaṃ niṣṭhitaṃ niṣṭhā ityucyate, tasya svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca yugapat sambandhau bhavataḥ
bhāṣyamapi pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchad gatam ityetamarthaṃ darśayati, vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā pā॰ 3
yathā kārakāntaramutpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kārakavyāpārād vastubhāvamāpannamavyapadeśyādhāraṃ nirvṛttaṃ sat svakāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca sambadhyate tathā paṭākhyam
kiñca, niṣṭhitasya kāryasya kāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca sambandho yutasiddhasambandhaḥ, kāryasya kāraṇebhyo'nyatra pariniṣṭhitatvāt
bhāṣyamapīti asya vākyasya vyākhyāgrantho'pyayaṃ pariniṣṭhāṃ gacchad gatamityetamarthaṃ darśayati
kena punarlakṣaṇena gataṃ sad gacchadityucyate ? brūmaḥ --vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā pā॰ 3
kimiva ? ityato nidarśanamāha --yathā kārakāntaramutpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭamiti, kārakādanyat kārakaṃ kārakāntaramutpadyamānamutpannamityarthaḥ
kasmāt ? dṛṣṭam ityakṣigocarāpannārthanirdeśāt, itarathā dṛṣṭaṃ na syāt, utpadyamānasyānutpannatve'kṣigocaratvānupapatteḥ

tat punaḥ katamat ? kārakavyāpārād devadatta-sthālīkāṣṭhādīnāṃ vyāpārād vastubhāvam ātmalābhamāpannaṃ pūrvavadavyapadeśyādhāraṃ nirvṛttaṃ sadodanādyākhyaṃ svakāraṇaistaṇḍulādibhiḥ sattayā ca sambadhyate tathā paṭākhyamiti
atra brūmaḥ --tadapi na, samavāyikāraṇatvavirodhāt svavacanavirodho'bhyupagamavirodhaśca doṣāvitthaṃ bruvataḥ
kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇaṃ dravyamuktam, samavāyino dravyāntarasya guṇakarmaṇoścārambhakatvāt

yadi punarvastubhāvaṃ gataṃ kāryaṃ dravyāditrayaṃ kāraṇaiḥ sattayā cābhisambadhyate tato'nārambhakāṇi akāraṇāni ca tantvādikāraṇadravyāṇi syuḥ, tataśca svavacanamabhyupagamaśca nivartete samavāyināṃ kāryāṇāṃ dravyam iti

etāvapi svavacanābhyupagamavirodhau, yasmāt kāryakāraṇaguṇaguṇivyaktyākṛtīnāmayutasiddhaḥ samavāyaḥ sambandha ukto'bhyupagataśca, idānīṃ niṣṭhitasya kāryasya kāraṇaiḥ sattayā ca sambandho'bhyupagataḥ, sa ca yutasiddhasambandhaḥ, kāryasya kāraṇebhyo'nyatra pariniṣṭhitatvād ghaṭākāśavat

tasmādadoṣaḥ vai॰ sū॰ praśastamati॰ iti, so'pyaparihāraḥ, icchāmātratvāt svoktopapattiviruddhārthatvāt tadasambaddhatvāt anyatra pariniṣṭhitatvāt tantuṣviva ghaṭasya tatrāpravṛttatvāt tatrānārambhāt tadasambaddhotpattitvāt
yadi tasya anyatra samavāyo'bhyupagamyeta syādayaṃ doṣaḥ, na tu tathābhyupagamyate, tasmādadoṣaḥ ityāśayo'tra bhāti
akāraṇatvāditi cet, paṭādyapi motpādi akāraṇatvāt khapuṣpavat, tadvotpadyatām
kāryasya cotpattivat khapuṣpaṃ kasmānnotpadyate ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt
yathā tantvādīni teṣvasataḥ sato'pyakāraṇāni kāryasya tathā sarvatra kāraṇaṃ
yattūcyata ityādi yāvat tasmādadoṣa iti dravyasamavāyikāraṇatvanivṛttidoṣaparihāro yo'bhihitaḥ samavāyikāraṇatvanivṛttiriti cedityāśaṅkya --na, anyatrāsamavāyāditi
tadvyākhyānaṃ yadi tasyetyādi sulikhitatvād na vivriyate

so'pyaparihāra icchāmātratvāt, kāryasya niṣṭhitasya kāraṇaiḥ sambandhoktiranyatrasamavāyākhyāyinī na, anyatrāsamavāyāt ityuttaravākyaṃ viruṇaddhi, taccetaravirodhi, tato'nupapatterviruddhārthatvādicchāmātraṃ te vaco na parihāra ityata āha --svoktopapattiviruddhārthatvāt, viruddhārthatvamasambaddhatvāt taiḥ kāraṇaiḥ kāryasya, tadasambaddhatvamanyatra pariniṣṭhitatvāt, kimiva ? tantuṣviva ghaṭasya, yathā tantuṣu ghaṭasyāniṣṭhitatvādanyatra kapāleṣu niṣṭhitatvāt tantubhirasambaddhatvamevaṃ dravyādikāryasya
tadasiddhamiti cet, na, tatrāpravṛttatvāt tantuṣviva ghaṭasya iti vartate

tatrāpravṛttatvamanyatra pravṛttatvaṃ ca tatrānārambhāt, tatra cānārambhaḥ tadasambaddhotpattitvāt, taiḥ kāraṇairasambaddhasya paṭasyotpatteriṣṭatvāt tavaiva ārambha-pravṛtti-niṣṭhāstantuṣu paṭasya na santi ghaṭasyevākāśasyeva khapuṣpasyeva vā

akāraṇatvāditi cet, niṣkāraṇaṃ ca khapuṣpam, paṭādi sakāraṇam, tasmād dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyādayuktamidamaniṣṭāpādanamiti cet, ucyate --paṭādyapītyādi, paṭādyapi kāryaṃ motpādi, akāraṇatvāt, khapuṣpavat
yathā tantvādīnīti, tantvādīnāṃ kāraṇatvaṃ kāryeṇa sambandhādṛte nāsti, tasmāt teṣvasataḥ yathāyogaṃ svasyaiva kāryasya nāsato nānyakāryasya vā asambandhāt
ekībhāvena gatiḥ ayaḥ avagatyā samavāyaḥ kāraṇasatkāryaikatvalakṣaṇaḥ
vyapadeśyādhāraṃ dravyādikāryaṃ samavetaṃ ca svakāraṇaiḥ prāgapi, pariniṣṭhitatvāt, vibhuparimaṇḍalaviyadādivat

sato'pyakāraṇāni kāryasya atyantāsataḥ khapuṣpasyeva ghaṭasyeva vā kāraṇāntarasādhyasyetyuktamupanayati --sarvatra kāraṇamityādi, karoti iti kāraṇaṃ kartṛsādhanam, khapuṣpādi ghaṭādi vā tantubhirna kriyate tatastatrākāraṇāni, paṭastu kriyate tasmāt tasya kāraṇāni, yo yo yogo yathāyogaṃ svasyaiva kāryasya tantavaḥ paṭasya kapālāni ghaṭasya, nāsato nānyakāryasya vā, kasmāt ? asambandhāt, kāryakāraṇabhāvaśca sambaddhatve sati bhavati, tasmādsti sambandhaḥ prāgapi kāryotpattestatkāraṇaiḥ sambandho'sti
kathaṃ tat kāryaṃ tad nitiṣṭhati kāraṇairasambaddham ? tasmāt kāryamavyaktasad vyaktasad bhavati sambaddhaṃ ca sadā svakāraṇaiḥ ityanumīyate
yathāyogaṃ svasyaiva kāryasya nāsato nānyakāryasya vā asambandhāt
ekībhāvena gatiḥ ayaḥ avagatyā samavāyaḥ kāraṇasatkāryaikatvalakṣaṇaḥ
vyapadeśyādhāraṃ dravyādikāryaṃ samavetaṃ ca svakāraṇaiḥ prāgapi, pariniṣṭhitatvāt, vibhuparimaṇḍalaviyadādivat

sam ityekārthībhāvavācyayamupasargaḥ, ekībhāvena bandhaḥ sambandhaḥ anekaṃ kāraṇākhyaṃ vastu sadekameva kāryākhyaṃ bhavati paraspareṇa badhyate tamarthamāha, anekasarvātmakatvāt anekasya tantvādeḥ pratisvamātmānamaparityajya sarvaikasaṅghātabhava- nena paṭādikāryākhyena pariṇateḥ

ekībhāvena gatiḥ gamanapariṇatirayaḥ, ava apagamane, avagatyā apagamanena prācyasaṃsthānādidharmāṇāṃ tyāgena dravyaparyāyābhyāṃ tantutvāparityāgena paṭatvapariṇāmaḥ sambandhaḥ samavāya ityakṣarārthānusāreṇoktvā vastuni sphuṭīkartumāha --kāraṇasatkāryaikatvalakṣaṇaḥ, kāraṇeṣu viprakīrṇeṣu satkāryamekatvamāpanneṣu paṭībhavad vyāktiṃ yātītyeṣa paramārthaḥ
eṣa dravyaparyāyātmakasyādvādaparamārthavādaṃ mā prapatsye'ham ityakasmādbhayāt svapakṣarāgasamutthāt parapakṣadveṣācca tvayedamamārgapramardanamasthāne śaktikṣayāyaivaṃ kriyate
tat punaḥ kimarthamārabhyate ? iheti yataḥ kāryakāraṇayoḥ sa samavāyaḥ vai॰ sū॰ 7
29 iti ihabuddhyabhidhānābhyāṃ kāryakāraṇagatābhyāṃ samavāyo'numīyate, so'tra na sambhavati kāryasyāsattvāt, tasmādavyapadeśyādhārakāryasambandhakalpanā kriyate
ayamutpathagamanakleśo nirarthakaśca, so'pi ca mithyābhidhāna eva
avyapadeśyādhāraṃ dravyādikāryamasamavetaṃ vā kāraṇaiḥ prāgutpatteriti mā maṃsthāḥ, manyatāṃ tu tatraivāstīti

tathā ca mantavyam — vyapadeśyādhāraṃ dravyādikāryaṃ samavetaṃ ca svakāraṇaiḥ prāgapi nirvṛttestvanmatenaiva pariniṣṭhitatvād yo'pi ca parihāro'bhihitaḥ--na, asyāsaṃyogāt, na hi kāraṇasambandhibhiḥ kāryasya saṃyogo'sti vai॰ sū॰ praśastamati॰, so'pi na parihāraḥ, uktavadasaṃyogāsiddhatvāt
tattvopanilayanāt sadādyabhidhānārthaṃ kāraṇasamavetasya vastuna uttarakālaṃ sattāsambandha iti bahūnāṃ matam

vastūtpattikāle eva iti tu vākyakārābhiprāyo'nusṛto vastubhāvamāpannatvāt, vibhuparimaṇḍalaviyadādivat, yathā vibhutvaparimāṇānyākāśakāladigātmadravyāṇi pariniṣṭhitatvād vibhutvaguṇasamavetāni vyapadeśyādhārāṇi ca tathā dravyādikāryam, parimaṇḍalaparimāṇāḥ paramāṇavaḥ parimaṇḍalatvena samavetā vyapadeśyādhārāśca dvyaṇukādikārye, vibhutvaparimaṇḍalatvaguṇayorvāśrayabhūtayorvākāśaparamāṇvordvyaṇukādivyapadeśyādhāratvaṃ samavetatvaṃ ca siddhaṃ tathā dravyādikāryasyeti
yo'pi ca parihāro'bhihitaḥ--na, asyāsaṃyogāt, na hi kāraṇasambandhibhiḥ kāryasya saṃyogo'sti vai॰ sū॰ praśastamati॰, so'pi na parihāraḥ, uktavadasaṃyogāsiddhatvāt
tattvopanilayanāt sadādyabhidhānārthaṃ kāraṇasamavetasya vastuna uttarakālaṃ sattāsambandha iti bahūnāṃ matam

tad vyācaṣṭe --na hi kāraṇasambandhibhiḥ kāryasya saṃyogo'sti, yathā dvayoraṅgulyorākāśe yujyamānayoḥ saṃyogasya dvyaṅgulākāśasaṃyogakāraṇasya sambandhinyoryutasiddhayoḥ saṃyogo na tathā kāraṇasambandhibhiḥ kāryasya dravyādeḥ kaiścit saṃyogo'sti yato yutasiddhidoṣa āpadyeta pṛthaksiddhayoriva
saṃyogajaḥ kāraṇākāraṇayoḥ saṃyogāt kāryākāryagataḥ, yathā aṅgulyākāśasaṃyogābhyāṃ dvyaṅgulākāśasaṃyogaḥ
vibhāgajastu aṅgulyoranyonyavibhāgād vinaṣṭamātre dvyaṅgule'ṅgulyākāśavibhāgaḥ, kāraṇākāraṇayorvā hastākāśayorvibhāgāccharīrākāśavibhāgaḥ
yutasiddhyabhāvāt kāryakāraṇayoḥ saṃyogavibhāgau na vidyete vai॰ sū॰ 7
15, kāryakāraṇayoḥ paraspareṇa saṃyogavibhāgau na vidyete, yathā ghaṭakapālayoḥ, yutasiddhyabhāvāt
yutasiddhirdvayoranyatarasya vā pṛthaggatimattvam, sā ca nityayoḥ, yutāśrayasamavetatvaṃ vā'nityayoḥ tvagindriyapārthivaśarīrayośca
na ca ghaṭakapālayoḥ yutāśrayasamavāyaḥ, ghaṭasya teṣveva samavetatvāt
iti candrānandaviracitāyāṃ vaiśeṣikasūtravṛttau P pṛ॰ 27 B--28 A
yadi tatra pariniṣṭhitaṃ pravṛttamārabdhaṃ kathaṃ tenāsambaddham ? ityādinā prapañcena sambaddhameva ityuktaṃ sambandhasamavāyaśabdārthavyākhyānena ca
yadi tatrotpannatādyasiddhiḥ sambandhāsiddhiśca syāt syādasaṃyogaḥ, tataḥ parihāraśca yutasiddhidoṣasya syāt
so'pi na ityetāvanmātrasya mūlapratīkatve so'pi na, na parihāraḥ iti bhā॰ pratipāṭho'pi saṅgaccheta

idānīṃ sūtrakāramataṃ samarthayatāṃ vākya-bhāṣya-ṭīkākārāṇāṃ matāni samāhṛtya pradhānānugāmitvāccheṣāṇāṃ sūtrakāramatamevetthaṃ dūṣayitumāha--tattvopanilayanāt sadādyabhidhānārthaṃ kāraṇasamavetasya vastuna uttara bhāṣyakāraiḥ
siddhasya vastunaḥ svakāraṇaiḥ svasattayā ca sambandha iti prāśastamato'bhiprāyaḥ
evaṃ vaktari vā śāstrakāre sarveṣāmanuvartitvāt sa evānāpto'satyavādī vetyetadapi syāt
yat punaḥ dravyādīnāṃ svata evābhidhānapratyayaviṣayatvaṃ sattvāt sattādivat
yathā sattādeḥ sadabhidhānapratyayau svata eva, na sattāyogāt, evaṃ dravyādīnāmapi sadabhidhānapratyayau svata eva, na sattāyogāt ityukte ucyate--naitat, atādātmyāt
dravyādīnāmasadātmatvāt sattānimittaṃ sadabhidhānādi daṇḍanimittādaṇḍadaṇḍitva- kālaṃ sattāsambandha iti bahūnāṃ matam
siddhasya vastunaḥ svakāraṇaiḥ svasattayā ca sambandha iti prāśastamato'bhiṃprāyaḥ

kimiva ? kumārabrahmacāripitṛtvavat, yadi pitā kathaṃ kumārabrahmacārī ? atha kumārabrahmacārī kathaṃ piteti ? idameva codāharaṇamanyatreti, svoktopapattyabhyupagamaviruddhārthatvādiṣvapyetadevodāharaṇaṃ vācyamiti

sarveṣāṃ vākya-bhāṣya-ṭīkākārāṇāṃ śāstrakāramatānuvartitvāt sa evānāpto'satyavādī vetyetadapi syāditi lokānuvṛttyā sāśaṅkamivocyate, mā bhūt tīrthakaragauravākṛṣṭamatibhiḥ anāpta eva iti niṣṭhuravacanakupitaiḥ saha tadbhaktaiḥ kalaha iti
siddhasya vastunaḥ svakāraṇaiḥ svasattayā ca sambandha iti prāśastamato'bhiprāyaḥ
evaṃ vaktari vā śāstrakāre sarveṣāmanuvartitvāt sa evānāpto'satyavādī vetyetadapi syāt
yat punaḥ dravyādīnāṃ svata evābhidhānapratyayaviṣayatvaṃ sattvāt sattādivat
yathā sattādeḥ sadabhidhānapratyayau svata eva, na sattāyogāt, evaṃ dravyādīnāmapi sadabhidhānapratyayau svata eva, na sattāyogāt ityukte ucyate--naitat, atādātmyāt
kiñcānyat, sadādivikalpānupapattiśca tadavasthaiva uktavat, niṣṭhāsambandhayorekakālatvāt iti bruvatāpi kiṃ kāryasya sattayā sambandhaḥ sato'sataḥ sadasato vā ? ityupālambhānna mocita evātmā
tadyathā--kāryasya kiṃ sattayā sambandho niṣṭhitasyāniṣṭhitasya niṣṭhitāniṣṭhitasya ? iti samānapracarcatvāt na śabdāntaramātroccāraṇād doṣaparihāraḥ
dravyādīnāṃ svata evābhidhānapratyayaviṣayatvaṃ sattvāt, svataḥ sattvāt, svabhāvasattvādityarthaḥ

kimiva ? sattādivadityādi savyākhyānamaniṣṭāpādanasādhanaṃ vaiśeṣikaṃ prati gatārthaṃ yāvad na sattāyogādityukte ucyate parihāraḥ kila kāṇādaiḥ --naitat, atādātmyāt, sa ātmā yasya tat tadātma sattādi, tadbhāvastādātmyam, tadvaidharmyādatādātmyād dravyādīnām, tadvyākhyā yāvadabhidhānādīti gatārtham
daṇḍanimittādaṇḍadaṇḍitvavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā daṇḍo'syāstīti daṇḍī iti daṇḍitvamadaṇḍadaṇḍino daṇḍanimittamevaṃ dravyāderasadātmanaḥ sattānimittaṃ sadabhidhānādīti
atra vayaṃ sampradhārayāmaḥ--kathamidaṃ tādātmyam ? kiṃ sato bhāvāt uta satkaratvāt ? tad yadi tāvat svato bhavanaṃ tataḥ sarveṇāpi satā bhūyate svata evetyuktam
yathā ca sattāyāṃ svata eva sadabhidhānapratyayau tadātmatvāt evaṃ dravyādau dravyatvādau ca tadātmatvaṃ sadabhidhānapratyayakāraṇaṃ sarvatra sati
daṇḍe'pi ca tādātmyādeva daṇḍābhidhānapratyayasiddhau svata eva daṇḍini daṇḍyabhidhānapratyayau tādātmyena vinā na bhavataḥ
yathā ca svata eva bhavati daṇḍaḥ tādātmyāt sattāvat evaṃ daṇḍyapi ityāśayaḥ syāt
yathā ca sattā svata eva bhavati tādātmyāt evaṃ daṇḍo'pi ityapi vāśayaḥ syāt
atra vayaṃ sampradhārayāmastvayā saha --kathamidaṃ tādātmyam ? kiṃ sato bhāvāt, yat sad bhavati tat tasya satastādātmyamātmalābhaḥ svarūpānubhavanam ? uta satkaratvam ? iti
tad yadi tāvat sato bhavanaṃ tataḥ sarveṇāpi satā bhūyate sattādinā dravyādinā vā svata evetyuktam
atha satkaratvāt tādātmyāt sad bhavatīti, tat prāk pratyuktam
svataḥ siddhasya dravyādeḥ sattā satkarī na bhavati vaiyarthyāt, asato'sattvāt khapuṣpavat, sadasataḥ sambhavābhāvādityuktam
dravyāderdravyatvādeśca svata eva sadabhidhānapratyayau tadātmatvāt sattāvaditi
sataśca dravyādestadātmatvaṃ sadātmatvaṃ dravyādeḥ, evaṃ dravyatvaguṇatvasattādinityaikasarvatrageṣu sāmānya-sāmānyaviśeṣaśūnyeṣvapi sadabhidhānapratyayau

yo'pi daṇḍitvavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ so'pi tādātmyādeva daṇḍasya bhavanātmatvādeva daṇḍābhidhānapratyayasiddhau satyāṃ svata eva daṇḍini devadatte daṇḍī ityabhidhānaṃ pratyayaṃ ca kurvati tāvabhidhānapratyayau tādātmyāt ityanenārthena vinā na bhavataḥ, ato'smadiṣṭamarthaṃ sādhayati, itarathā daṇḍikuṇḍalyaviśeṣaḥ syāt
sādhanaṃ cātra--daṇḍo'pi svarūpābhidhānapratyayakārī svata eva, tādātmyāt, sattāvat, tathā daṇḍyapi tata eva tadvat
yathā cetyādi, evaṃ ca sati daṇḍatvasāmānyaviśeṣanirapekṣaḥ svata eva bhavati daṇḍaḥ, tādātmyāt, sattāvaditi siddham
vaiśeṣiko daṇḍamapi daṇḍatvād daṇḍavyatiriktād manyate daṇḍābhidhānapratyayabhājam
ācāryo bravīti --anudāharaṇaṃ tarhi daṇḍī, daṇḍād daṇḍyabhāvāt
daṇḍasya svato'siddhatvād daṇḍī na sidhyati, parataḥ sattvasiddhyarthaṃ codāhriyate daṇḍī, daṇḍāsiddheḥ kutastatsiddhiḥ ? iti
cet, itaretarāśrayamidam, daṇḍatvatattvād daṇḍasiddhiḥ, daṇḍaviśeṣaṇasādhitadaṇḍisiddheḥ punardaṇḍatvatattvasiddhiḥ
yadi daṇḍādeva, svataḥ siddhāt siddha ityuktam
atha daṇḍatvāt, daṇḍatvī bhavatu, mā bhūddaṇḍī, ātmāntarasaṅkāntiścaivam
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ--svata eva bhavati, tadabhāve'sāmānyātmakatvameva sarvasya syāt

yadapyuktam 'atadātmatvād dravyādīnāṃ sadabhidhānapratyayau sattāyogāt, na daṇḍatvopapāditadaṇḍād daṇḍīti cet, daṇḍatvasāmānyaviśeṣād daṇḍaḥ sidhyati, daṇḍād daṇḍīti, tata udāharaṇasiddhirviśeṣaṇādeva viśeṣyasiddheḥ, evaṃ cenmanyase, idamāpatitam--daṇḍatvatattvād daṇḍaḥ sidhyati, daṇḍatvatattvaṃ punardaṇḍaviśeṣaṇasādhitadaṇḍitvasiddheḥ sidhyati, tadidamitaretarāśrayaṃ jāyate, itaretarāśrayāṇi ca na prakalpante, tadyathā naurnāvi baddhā netaratrāṇāyeti tatpratipādanārtho granthaḥ --itaretaretyādirgatārtho yāvat tattvasiddhiriti
cet, itaretarāśrayamidam, daṇḍatvatattvād daṇḍasiddhiḥ, daṇḍaviśeṣaṇasādhitadaṇḍisiddheḥ punardaṇḍatvatattvasiddhiḥ
yadi daṇḍādeva, svataḥ siddhāt siddha ityuktam
atha daṇḍatvāt, daṇḍatvī bhavatu, mā bhūddaṇḍī, ātmāntarasaṅkāntiścaivam
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ--svata eva bhavati, tadabhāve'sāmānyātmakatvameva sarvasya syāt
daṇḍī iti ca devadattaḥ sa daṇḍatvād daṇḍād vā katham ? iti nirdhāryam
sa yadi daṇḍādeva, svataḥ siddhāt siddha ityuktam
atha daṇḍatvāt daṇḍatvamasyāsti iti daṇḍatvī bhavatu, mā bhūd daṇḍī, yuktaṃ tāvad daṇḍād daṇḍī, na tu daṇḍatvāt, svata eva ca bhaveddaṇḍī
kiñcānyat, ātmāntarasaṅkrāntiścaivam, daṇḍatvādātmāntaraṃ daṇḍo daṇḍī ca, daṇḍād daṇḍatvadaṇḍinau, daṇḍino daṇḍadaṇḍatve, daṇḍaḥ svata evābhavan daṇḍatvād bhavaṃstadātmā bhavati, evaṃ daṇḍyapīti

vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ--yat tad daṇḍena bhūyate tasyaiva daṇḍatvāt yaddaṇḍo daṇḍo bhavati tadeva daṇḍo bhavati ātmānaṃ labhate bhāvāntaraviviktaṃ yat tena bhūyate tadeva bhavanaṃ daṇḍatvaṃ na tadvyatiriktād, na daṇḍatvatattvāt
tadabhāve'sāmānyātmakatvameva sarvasya syāt, yadi sā daṇḍadaṇḍyādivyaktiḥ svata eva na bhavati sattā-dravyatva-daṇḍatva-daṇḍitvāditattvād bhavati svata eva abhavantī nāstyeva sā khapuṣpavat
tataścāsāmānyameva sattādi syāt, taccāniṣṭam, svata eva bhavataḥ samānasyābhāvāt sāmānyameva sāmānyaṃ na syāt
tasmāt svata eva daṇḍo bhavati svata eva ca sadabhidhānapratyayau, na sattāyogāt
yathā daṇḍe evaṃ satyapītyādi gatārthaṃ sādhanam
atra na devadatto bhavati ityapi pāṭho bhāvāntaravaiviktyasūcanārthaṃ syāt
tathāca yaddaṇḍo daṇḍo bhavati na devadatto bhavati ityapi vivakṣitaṃ syāt
yadapyuktam--atadātmatvādityādi asattātmakatvād dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ sadabhidhānapratyayau sattāyogāt, na svata iti
tadapi na, atadātmakatvādityādiranaikāntikatvāt anaikāntikatvapratipādanārtho grantho yāvad dravyatvādivaditi
tasya bhāvanā --dravyatvādīnāmatādātmye dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvaghaṭatva svataḥ' iti, tadapi na, atadātmakatvāt...dravyatvādivat
dravyatvādīnāmatādātmye svataḥ sadabhidhānapratyayau, ekaikatvāt, ātmavat, dravyatvādiṣu svato bhavantyāḥ sattāyāḥ sadabhidhānaṃ dṛṣṭamevaṃ dravyādīnāmapi svata eva
sattāsambandhābhāve'pi asaṅkhyayorapi guṇatvakarmatvayorekābhidhānapratyayavat sadabhidhānapratyayau dravyatvādiṣvaupacārikau syātāmiti cet, dravyādiṣvapyaupacārikau syātāṃ tulyatvāt
manuṣyasiṃhatvādivat tathā añjasā anupapatterneti cet, tataste svapakṣe eva doṣavidhānam
yat punaridamucyate--sattāyāṃ siddha iti cet,...ātmānamātmanā na yuktama- rūpatvotkṣepaṇatvādīnāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāmasattātmakatve svataḥ sadabhidhānapratyayau, na sattātaḥ
ekameva dravyatvaṃ sarvadravyeṣu, dravyatvāntarāniṣṭeḥ tatra sattāyogo neṣyate, anupravṛttyabhāvāt
tathāpi ca sat ityabhidhīyate pratīyate ca, evaṃ guṇatvādīnyapi
tasmādekaikatvāt svataḥ sattvamātmavat sattāvadityarthaḥ, sa ca dṛṣṭāntaḥ svato dravyatvādibhavane
tasya varṇanā --dravyatvādiṣu bhinneṣu svato bhavantyāḥ sattāyāḥ ekasyāḥ sadabhidhānaṃ dṛṣṭamevaṃ dravyādīnāmapi svata eveti sādhanenopapādito'rthaḥ
dravyatvādīnāmatādātmye svataḥ sadabhidhānapratyayau, ekaikatvāt, ātmavat, dravyatvādiṣu svato bhavantyāḥ sattāyāḥ sadabhidhānaṃ dṛṣṭamevaṃ dravyādīnāmapi svata eva
atadātmakatvāt ityanaikāntikaḥ atadātmakatve'pi svataḥ sadabhidhānapratyayadarśanāt dravyatvādivat ityāśayo bhāti
sattāsambandhābhāve'pi asaṅkhyayorapi guṇatvakarmatvayorekābhidhānapratyayavat sadabhidhānapratyayau dravyatvādiṣvaupacārikau syātāmiti cet, dravyādiṣvapyaupacārikau syātāṃ tulyatvāt
manuṣyasiṃhatvādivat tathā añjasā anupapatterneti cet, tataste svapakṣe eva doṣavidhānam
yat punaridamucyate--sattāyāṃ siddha iti cet,...ātmānamātmanā na yuktama-
yathā daṇḍe evaṃ satyapi svata eva sadabhidhānapratyayau tādātmyāt, na sattāyogāt ityāśayo bhāti

guṇatvamekaṃ karmatvamekam ityekābhidhānapratyayau asaṅkhyayorapi guṇatvakarmatvayoraupacārikau dṛṣṭau tathā sadabhidhānapratyayau dravyatvādiṣvaupacārikau syātāmiti ko doṣaḥ ? atrocyate --dravyādiṣvapītyādi tulyatvāpādanamaupacārikatvena gatārtham

āha --manuṣyasiṃhatvādivat tathāñjasā'nupapatterneti cet, yathā śauryakrauryādidharmāḥ siṃhe mukhyāḥ siddhāḥ santo manuṣye śakyā upacarituṃ nāsiddhāstathā dravyādiṣūpacaritau syātāṃ yadyanyatrāñjasā siddhau sadabhidhānapratyayau, na tu tau kvacit siddhau, bhāktavyavahāraśca āñjasādṛte nāsti, tasmād dravyādiṣveva mukhyāviti evaṃ cenmanyase tataste svapakṣa eva doṣavidhānam

etat punaḥ sa eva praṣṭavya iti, svabhāvasattāpekṣau sadabhidhānapratyayāvicchatāṃ kiṃ naḥ sattāsambandhakalpanayā ? tava punaḥ sattāsambandhādicchato duṣpratipādaṃ bhāvasattāvyatiriktatādātmyavādinaḥ, tasmāt tvamevāsi praṣṭavya iti
atadātmakatvāt ityanaikāntikaḥ atadātmakatve'pi svataḥ sadabhidhānapratyayadarśanāt dravyatvādivat ityāśayo bhāti
yat punaridamucyate--sattāyāṃ siddha iti cediti sabhāṣyaṃ gatārtham
iyaṃ punarāśaṅkā kaṃ prati yuktā ? dravyādivyatiriktāṃ sattāṃ svata eva siddhāṃ tadātmikāmicchantam, sa punarnānyo vaiśeṣikāt, tasmā bhiyoktum...
asattātmanāṃ dravyādīnāṃ mukhyau sadabhidhānapratyayau kathaṃ yuktau manorathavat ?...
...daṇḍitvadaṇḍatvavat svata eva satoḥ tatsambaddhatvāt satvataḥ sattvāt sattvavat sadeva svam
tasmāt sarvasya sato'tādātmyābhāvāt sadātmaiva sarvamiti bhāktatvanivṛttyādyabhāvaḥ sattādivacca svataḥ sattvam
yataścaivaṃ tasmāt sato bhāvaḥ satteti vyutpattirdravyādyavyatiriktasattārthaiva dātmānamātmanā na yuktamabhiyoktumityuddhaṭṭanāgrantho gatārtho yāvat tadyoganimittamiti
yadā vetyāderārabhya yāvat tadyoganimittamityevaṃprakāra uddhaṭṭanāgranthaḥ pūrvamāste

nanūttaramapyetadayuktaṃ na, dravyādiṣvañjasā siddhiḥ ityādi vakṣyamāṇamasambaddham, atadātmanimittasya satpratyayasyānupapatteḥ asattātmanāṃ dravyādīnāṃ mukhyau sadabhidhānapratyayau kathaṃ yuktau ? iti etadācāryavacanamantare patitaṃ parasyākauśalakhyāpanārtham
manorathavaditi vaiśeṣikasya manoratha eva dravyādivyatiriktā satteti yadi bhavet, syāt

dravyādibhāktatvanivṛttiḥ, svataḥ sattvaṃ sattādivacca ityetasya vacanasya vyāghātaḥ ityetaddoṣadvayadarśanāditi vaiśeṣikeṇokte ācārya āha --naiva tvityādi, daṇḍitvaṃ daṇḍatvaṃ ca yathā svata eva satoḥ tatsambaddhatvāt sattāsambaddhatvādityarthaḥ satvataḥ sattvāt sattvavat sadeva svam, satvataḥ sataḥ sattvāt ātmatvāt svataḥ sattvādityarthaḥ
evaṃ tāvad nyāyo yaduta sadeva sat, sattvameva sat, na sadvyatiriktā sattā, na sattāto'nyat sat

tasmāt sarvasya sato nāstyatādātmyamasadātmatvam, tadabhāvāt sadātmaiva sarvamiti bhāktatvanivṛttyādyabhāvaḥ, nāyaṃ doṣa ityarthaḥ, sattādivacca svataḥ sattvamiti, ādigrahaṇād dravyatva-guṇatva-karmatvavat
asattātmanāṃ dravyādīnāṃ mukhyau sadabhidhānapratyayau kathaṃ yuktau manorathavat ?...
...daṇḍitvadaṇḍatvavat svata eva satoḥ tatsambaddhatvāt satvataḥ sattvāt sattvavat sadeva svam
tasmāt sarvasya sato'tādātmyābhāvāt sadātmaiva sarvamiti bhāktatvanivṛttyādyabhāvaḥ sattādivacca svataḥ sattvam
naiva tu dravyādibhāktatvanivṛttiḥ, svataḥ sattvaṃ sattvādivaccetyetasya vacanasya vyāghātaḥ ityetaddoṣadvayam ityāśayo bhāti
yataścaivaṃ tasmāt sato bhāvaḥ satteti vyutpattirdravyādyavyatiriktasattārthaiva

yathā daṇḍasambandhāt prāg daṇḍī jātyādibhirlakṣaṇaiḥ svataḥ siddhatvāt san, daṇḍo'pi prāg daṇḍisambandhād vṛttadrāghimādinā lakṣaṇena svataḥ siddhatvāt san, ato daṇḍayogād daṇḍītyetannyāyyam, tathā nīladravyayogācchāṭhyādi nīlamityetannyāyyam, tathoṣṇaguṇayogānna prāgagneranyad viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ sadbhāvasya prakhyāpakamastīti asannagniḥ, uṣṇasyāpi prāgagniyogādasattvaṃ nirāśrayaguṇābhāvāt
na cāsatoḥ sambandho dṛṣṭa iṣṭo vā
yataścaivamityādi, yasmāt svata eva sattā dravyādīnāṃ yuktā tasmāt sato bhāvaḥ satteti yā śabdavyutpattirbhedaṣaṣṭhyāpādanārthā sā dravyādyavyatiriktasattārthaiva jñāyate satāṃ bhāvaḥ satteti
tato dravyādīnāmakāraṇatvādidoṣaprasaṅgāt kuto'nupapannatā mamātra nipatitā ? mama tu dravyādīnāmekatvānnānupapannam

kartṛṇā'kartṛṇā vā kārakeṇa yo bhavati sa eva bhāvaḥ sāmānyam, sa eva viśeṣo'nyabhavananirapekṣaḥ kartā bhavadbhavanāt, tadeva dravyaṃ guṇaḥ, sa eva kriyā, sa eva viśeṣo bhāvāntarād viśiṣyamāṇatvāt, vakṣyamāṇavacca sa eva samavāyaḥ
tadvyākhyānam --yat tat sadbhirityādi gatārthaṃ yāvat sadityabhidhānapratyayakāraṇaṃ sarvatreti
yat tat sadbhirbhūyate yad bhavanti santaḥ sā sattā sadityabhidhānapratyayakāraṇaṃ sarvatra ityāśayo bhāti
tato dravyādīnāmakāraṇatvādidoṣaprasaṅgāt kuto'nupapannatā mamātra nipatitā ? mama tu dravyādīnāmekatvānnānupapannam
dravyādīnāṃ svataḥ sattvaṃ sattādivat na tu sattāyogāditi cet, na, sattādivat svataḥ sattve dravyādīnāmakāraṇanityāsambandhājātimattvaprasaṅgāt

kartṛṇā'kartṛṇā vā kārakeṇa yo bhavati sa eva bhāvaḥ sāmānyam, sa eva viśeṣo'nyabhavananirapekṣaḥ kartā bhavadbhavanāt, tadeva dravyaṃ guṇaḥ, sa eva kriyā, sa eva viśeṣo bhāvāntarād viśiṣyamāṇatvāt, vakṣyamāṇavacca sa eva samavāyaḥ
na dravyādanye guṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyāḥ santi, dravyasyaivobhayapariṇāmakāraṇāpekṣasya guṇaḥ karma sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaḥ samavāya ityevamādiparyāyāntareṇa pariṇāmaḥ

ata idamapītyādi pūrvottarapakṣau savyākhyānau gatārthau vaiśeṣikasyaiva yāvadupanayaḥ, tatra yaduktaṃ svataḥ sattvam iti etadayuktamiti, ācāryo yathaitadapratyayodgrāhaṃ bhavati tathāha --atra hi sattādivadityādi
sarvamidaṃ tvadanuvṛttyā tvāṃ pratipādayitumucyate, na mama sattā dravyādivyatiriktā kācidasti kartari ṣaṣṭhī ityuktatvāt

dravyādīnāmakāraṇatvādidoṣāḥ prasaktāḥ, tato'nupapannam ityeṣā tatprasaṅgāt kuto'nupapannatā mamātra nipatitā abhyāgatā, tvanmatena tu sattāmabhyupagamya mayā sattādivad dravyādīnāmaniṣṭāpādane kṛte ? mama tu dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyānāṃ caikatvānnānupapannamiti
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ iti kartari, bhavanaṃ bhāvaḥ iti bhāve, ityādikārakavivakṣāyāṃ yo bhavati sa eva bhāvaḥ sāmānyam, deśakālādibhede'pi bhavanatulyatvāt

sa eva viśeṣo'nyabhavananirapekṣaḥ kartā, uktavat kartari ṣaṣṭhī iti bhavato bhavanād bhavadeva bhavati, tadeva dravyaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavadbhavanādeva, kalanaṃ guṇanaṃ guṇaḥ yugapadayugapatparyāyatvena bhavanāt, sa eva bhāvaḥ kriyā bhavanaṃ bhāva iti, sa eva viśeṣo bhāvāntarād viśiṣyamāṇatvāt anyanirapekṣatvāt sadasadātmakatvāt sattvenāsattvena ca tasyaiva viśiṣyamāṇatvāt, vakṣyamāṇavacceti kāraṇākāraṇādyaikyamanantaraṃ vakṣyate, sa eva samavāyaḥ

evameveti bhavataḥ kartṛtvena tasyaiva kāraṇatvam, tadekībhāvagatyā kāryatvāpatteḥ pratipāditena vidhinā sambandhābhāvaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ samavāyavyākhyānāt, sahāsattveneti anenaivāsattva ca sambandhavattvād nityatvāsattve na staḥ
athavā akāraṇanityāsambandhājātīni dravyādīni, svataḥ sattvāt, sāmānyādivat
kāraṇādi ca sāmānyādi, svataḥ sattvāt, dravyādivat
yadapi ca coditaṃ yadyekaḥ samavāyo dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvādiviśeṣaṇaiḥ saha mapi pratyākhyātam, sadasadātmakatvāt
kartṛtvāt saṃyuktameva kāryeṇeti nāsaṃyogaḥ, kāryakāraṇapratipādanāt nāsamavāyo'sti, tābhyāṃ ceti saṃyogasamavāyābhyāṃ sambandhavattvād nityatvāsattve na staḥ
ajātimanti tviti pratipādyata eva, dravyavyatiriktāyāḥ pratiṣiṣitsitatvāt
athavā akāraṇanityāsambandhājātīni dravyādīni, svataḥ sattvāt, sāmānyādivat
kāraṇādi ca sāmānyādi, svataḥ sattvāt, dravyādivat
yadapi ca coditaṃ yadyekaḥ samavāyo dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvādiviśeṣaṇaiḥ saha
yathā pramāṇataḥ kāraṇānupalabdhernityo bhāva ityuktaṃ tathā samavāyo'pīti
na hyasya kiñcit kāraṇaṃ pramāṇata upalabhyata iti
kayā punarvṛttyā dravyādiṣu samavāyo vartate ? na saṃyogaḥ sambhavati, tasya guṇatvena dravyāśritatvāt
yathā dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ sadātmakasya bhāvasya nānyaḥ sattāyogo'sti evamavibhāgino vṛttyātmakasya samavāyino nānyā vṛttirasti
iti praśastapādabhāṣye samavāyanirūpaṇe saṃyogasamavāyābhyāmasambandhavato nityasya sattārahitasya ca bhāvasya udāharaṇatvenollekhaḥ
asya praśastapādabhāṣyasya nyāyakandalī vyākhyā--kiṃ punarayamanitya āhosvinnitya iti saṃśaye satyāha--sambandhyanityatve'pīti
yathā sambandhinoranityatve saṃyogasyānityatvaṃ na tathā samavāyinoranityatve samavāyasyānityatvaṃ bhāvavadakāraṇatvāditi
yukto hi sambandhivināśe saṃyogasya vināśaḥ, tadutpāde sambandhinoḥ samavāyikāraṇatvāt
samavāyasya tu sambandhinau na kāraṇam, sambandhimātratvāt
yathā ca tau na kāraṇaṃ tathopapāditam
kimasambaddha eva samavāyaḥ sambandhinau sambandhayati sambaddho vā ? na tāvadasambaddhasya sambandhakatvaṃ yuktam, atiprasaṅgāt
sambandhaścāsya na saṃyogarūpaḥ sambhavati, tasya dravyāśritatvāt
tat kathamasya vṛttirityāha--kayā punarvṛttyā dravyādiṣu samavāyo vartata iti
vṛttyabhāvānna vartate ityetad na, tādātmyād vṛttyātmakatvāt svata evāyaṃ vṛttiriti
kṛtako hi saṃyogaḥ, tasya vṛttyātmakasyāpi vṛttyantaramasti, kāraṇasamavāyasya kāryalakṣaṇatvāt
samavāyasya vṛttyantaraṃ nāsti, tasmādasya svātmanā svarūpeṇaiva vṛttirna vṛttyantareṇetyarthaḥ
kāraṇādi ceti, kāraṇānityasambandhajātimattvāni sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyānām, svataḥ sattvāt dravyādivat svasatsattvādityarthaḥ
tadātmatvāt, yad yadātma tat svataḥ sat sattādivadityuktam
ubhayamiti kāraṇākāraṇanityānityasambandhāsambandhajātimadajātimattvāni dravyādīnāṃ sāmānyādīnāṃ ca sarvasya vastutvād dvyātmakatvaṃ bhavatyevetaretararūpaikabhavanāviśeṣāt

niṣṭhāyāḥ sambandhasya ca sattayaikakālatvapratipādanārthaṃ samavāyasyaikatvādekaḥ sambandhaikatvāt padārthasaṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ iti, sa tadavastha eva, bahūnāṃ sambandhināmekasambandhabhāvāt, vāgādigavādyabhidhānavat vyavasthānābhāvāt sarvasya sarvā- kālaḥ ityuktvā punaratra yo doṣaścoditaḥ saṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ iti sa tadavastha eva duṣparihāraḥ

bahūnāṃ sambandhināmekasambandhabhāvāditi hetuḥ, bahavo hi sambandhina ekasambadhībhūtāḥ, tatasteṣāṃ saṅkaraḥ, vāgādigavādyabhidhānavat, yathā gauḥ ityukte vāg-dig-bhū-raśmyādibhirekasya gośabdasya vāgādiśabdaparyāyatvāt tattadātmāsau tattadarthapratipādanāt tattatsambandhāt amuṣyaivedaṃ sambandhi iti nirdhārya vyavasthāpayitumaśakyatvāt sarveṣāṃ daśānāmiṣṭaḥ kāraṇakāryādhāraḥ samavāyo'pi tathādheyo dravyatveneva guṇatvakarmatvā This page consists merely of footnotes.
katham ? samavāyasyaikatvād dravyatvena guṇakarmaṇoḥ sambandhād dravyabhāvaḥ, guṇakarmabhāvayorhāniḥ

dibhiśca sambandha ihaliṅgāviśeṣād viśeṣaliṅgābhāvāccaikaḥ samavāyaḥ, tasmād dravyatvasambandhād yathā dravye dravyabuddhiṃ tathā guṇe karmaṇi ca dravyabuddhiṃ kuryāditi sarvasya sarvābhidhānapratyayau syātāmiti sāmānyena saṅkaradoṣa uktaḥ
sambandhaikatvāt padārthasaṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ iti, sa tadavastha eva, bahūnāṃ sambandhināmekasambandhabhāvāt, vāgādigavādyabhidhānavat vyavasthānābhāvāt sarvasya sarvā-
gaurudake dṛśi svarge diśi paśau raśmau vajre bhūmāviṣau giri
sattānirākaraṇaprastāve'pi prasaṅgāgataḥ samavāya ācāryaśrīmallavādinā itaḥ paraṃ mahatā pracarcena nirākṛtaḥ
pūrvapakṣirūpeṇa praśastamatimuddiśya cāyaṃ vivādo granthakṛtā vihita iti pūrvāparasandarbhaparyālocanayā pratibhāti
praśastamaternāmagrahaṇapūrvakametādṛśaḥ samavāyasambandhī pūrvapakṣaḥ tattvasaṅgrahapañjikāyāmapi samavāyaparīkṣāvasare uddhṛtaḥ kamalaśīlena

etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ --tattvasaṅgrahapañjikāyāṃ praśastamaternāmagrāhamuddhṛtaḥ samavāyasambandhī granthaḥ praśastapādabhāṣye samavāyanirūpaṇe sampūrṇatayā upalabhyate, etacca nimnalikhitapraśastapādabhāṣyatattvasaṅgrahapañjikāpāṭhāvalokanena vyaktībhaviṣyatyatraiva ṭippaṇe
tattvasaṅgrahe vaiśeṣikābhimataṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāṃ bahutroddhṛtaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ praśastapādabhāṣye dṛśyata ityapi dhyeyam
nayacakre tu samavāyaparīkṣāyāmuddhṛtasya pūrvapakṣasya kaścidaṃśaḥ praśastapādabhāṣye upalabhyate, kaścittu nopalabhyate
ata evaṃ sambhāvyate --vaiśeṣikasūtropari praśastamativiracitāyāḥ samprati luptaprāyāyāḥ ṭīkāyā eva mallavādinā uddhṛtaḥ syāt pūrvapakṣaḥ, tattvasaṅgrahe tu praśastapādabhāṣyāditi
yadyekaḥ samavāyo dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvādiviśeṣaṇaiḥ saha sambandhaikatvāt padārthasaṅkaraprasaṅga iti, na, ādhārādheyaniyamāt
katham ? dravyeṣveva dravyatvam, guṇeṣveva guṇatvam, karmasveva karmatvamiti
iha iti samavāyanimittasya jñānasyānvayadarśanāt sarvatraikaḥ samavāya iti gamyate
yathā kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyogaikatve bhavatyāśrayāśrayibhāvaniyamaḥ tathā dravyatvādīnāmapi samavāyaikatve'pi vyaṅgyavyañjakaśaktibhedādādhārādheyaniyamaḥ iti
asya śrīdharabhaṭṭakṛtā nyāyakandalī vyākhyā--kimayameka āhosvidanekaḥ ? ityatrāha--na ca saṃyogavannānātvamiti

yathā sat sat iti jñānasya lakṣaṇasya sarvatrāviśeṣādavailakṣaṇyād viśeṣe bhede lakṣaṇasya pramāṇasyābhāvācca sarvatraiko bhāvastadvat iha iti pratyayasya lakṣaṇasya sarvatrāvailakṣaṇyād bhede pramāṇābhāvācca sarvatraikaḥ samavāyaḥ
samavāyasyaikatve ya eva dravyatvasya pṛthivyādiṣu yogaḥ sa eva guṇatvasya guṇeṣu karmatvasya ca karmasu
tatra yathā dravyatvasya yogaḥ pṛthivyādiṣvastīti teṣāṃ dravyatvaṃ tathā tadyogasya guṇādiṣvapi sambhavāt teṣāmapi dravyatvam
yathā ca guṇatvasya yogo rūpādiṣvastīti rūpādīnāṃ guṇatvaṃ tathā tadyogasya dravyakarmaṇorapi sambhavāt tayorapi guṇatvaṃ syāt
na samavāyasadbhāvamātreṇa dravyatvam, kintu dravyatvasamavāyāt, dravyatvasamavāyaśca dravyeṣveva na guṇakarmasu, ato na teṣāṃ dravyatvam
svatantra iti, saṃyogavat sambandhāntareṇa na vartata ityarthaḥ
dravyeṣveva dravyatvaṃ vartate guṇeṣveva guṇatvaṃ karmasveva karmatvamityevamādi kasmāt tvayā jñātamityarthaḥ
tathā karmatvanimittasya pratyayasya karmasvanvayo dravyaguṇebhyaśca vyatireko dṛśyate
sama vāyāviśeṣe kuta evāyaṃ niyamo dravyatvasya pṛthivyādiṣveva samavāyo guṇatvasya rūpādiṣveva karmatvasyotkṣepaṇādiṣveva nānyatretyata āha--yatheti

saṃyogasyaikatve'pi kuṇḍadadhnorāśrayāśrayibhāvasya niyamo dṛṣṭaḥ śaktiniyamāt kuṇḍamevāśrayo dadhyevādheyaṃ na tu kuṇḍamādheyaṃ dadhi vādhāraḥ tathā samavāyaikatve'pi dravyatvādīnāmādhārādheyaniyamo vyaṅgyavyañjakaśaktibhedāt
kimuktaṃ syāt ? dravyatvābhivyañjikā śaktirdravyāṇāmeva, tena dravyeṣveva dravyatvaṃ samavaiti nānyatreti
atha tattvasaṅgrahapañjikāsthā carcā uddhriyate--"ihabuddhyaviśeṣācca yogavanna vibhidyate
evaṃ tāvad vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ matena ihabuddhiliṅgānumeyaḥ samavāyaḥ
naiyāyikamatena tu ihabuddhipratyakṣagamya eva, tathāhi--te akṣavyāpāre sati iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ ityādipratyayotpatteḥ pratyakṣatvamācakṣate
sa cāyaṃ samavāyo yathā saṃyogaḥ sambandhiṣu bhinnaḥ tathā nāyaṃ bhidyate, kiṃ tarhi ? bhāvavat sattāvat talliṅgāviśeṣād viśeṣaliṅgābhāvāt sarvatraika eva samavāyaḥ
yaccoktam ihabuddhyaviśeṣāt ityādi tatrāha --yadyekaḥ samavāyaḥ syāt sarveṣveva ca vastuṣu
asti cāsau kapāleṣu tasyeti na tatheti kim
āśritaḥ samavāyena sa kapāle'pi nāsti kim
yadyekastrailokye samavāyaḥ syāt tadā kapāleṣu paṭa ityādayo'pi dhiyaḥ prasūyeran aśvādiṣu ca gotvādirvidyata ityevaṃ syāt
tathāhi--tantuṣu paṭa iti yatsamavāyabālāt pratītirupavarṇitā sa samavāyastasya paṭasya kapālādiṣvapyastīti kimiti tathā pratītirna bhavet
syādetat--na kapāle paṭa āśritaḥ, tena tathā pratyayo na bhavatīti
yatastantuṣvapi paṭa āśrita iti yatsamavāyabalādupavarṇyate sa samavāyaḥ kapāleṣu kiṃ nāsti, yena tatra tantuṣviva paṭo'stīti tadbuddhirna bhavet ?

kintu ya eva tantuṣu paṭasya samavāya iti nirdiśyate sa eva paṭasya samavāyaḥ kapāleṣu, tat kathaṃ saṅkaro na syāt ? tat tasmāt dhīranavadhiḥ avadhirahitā bhavet, tataśca dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvādiviśeṣaṇaiḥ sambandhasyaikatvāt pañcapadārthavibhāgo na syāt
dravyeṣveva hi tajjātiḥ karmasveva ca karmatā
sa hyāha--yadyapyekaḥ samavāyastathāpi pañcapadārthasaṅkaro na bhavati, ādhārādheyaniyamāt
tathāhi— dravyeṣveva dravyatvam, guṇeṣveva guṇatvam, karmasveva karmatvamiti
yadyevaṃ tarhi samavāyaḥ pratipadārthaṃ bhinnaḥ prapnotītyata āha --iheti samavāyotthavijñānānvayadarśanāt
iheti samavāyanimittasya pratyayasya sarvatrābhinnākāratayā anvayadarśanāt sarvatraikaḥ samavāya iti gamyate
satyapi caikatve dravyatvādinimittānāṃ dhiyāṃ pratiniyatādhārāvacchedenotpatteḥ vyatirekasyānanvayalakṣaṇasya darśanād dravyatvādijātīnāṃ vyatireko vijñāyate tena pañcapadārthasaṅkaro na bhavati
kathaṃ punaḥ sambandhāviśeṣe'pyamīṣāmādhārādheyapratiniyamo yujyata ityāha— tadyathā kuṇḍadadhnośca saṃyogaikye'pi dṛśyate
yathāhi kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyogaikatve'pi bhavatyāśrayāśrayipratiniyamaḥ tathā dravyatvādīnāṃ samavāyaikatve'pi vyaṅgyavyañjakaśaktibhedādādhārādheyapratiniyama iti
na hyasmākaṃ rūpatvādīnāṃ rūpādiṣvādheyaniyamaḥ siddhaḥ, kintu bhavatāmeva
sa ca sarvatra samavāyamekameva abhyupagacchatāṃ durghaṭa ityādiprasaṅgāpādanaṃ kriyate
tathāhi--dravye eva dravyatvam ityevaṃ yo niyama iṣyate sa samavāyabalādeva, tasya ca dravyatvāderyaḥ samavāyaḥ sa eva guṇādiṣvapyasti guṇatvādijātyā teṣāṃ sambandhatvāt
yadi nāma sambandhastathāpi sa eva tatra samavāyo'stīti kathamavasīyate ityāha--eka evetyādi
anyatheti, yadi dravye dravyatvasya yaḥ samavāyaḥ sa eva guṇādiṣu guṇatvādīnāṃ na bhavet tadā saṃyogavat pratyādhāraṃ samavāyo bhidyate
yaccoktaṃ dravyatvādinimittānām ityādi tatrāha --dravyatvādinimittānāṃ vyatireko na yujyate
dravyatvādīti, na hyavikale nimitte sati kāryasya vyatireko'bhāvo yuktaḥ, atatkāryatvaprasaṅgāt
tataśca dhiyāṃ vyatirekāyogāt tasyāpyādhārādheyabhāvasya niyamo na yuktaḥ
nanu dravye eva dravyatvamāśritaṃ sthitamityādivyapadeśato niyamo bhaviṣyatītyāha --tadāśritatvasthānādi tasmādevābhidhīyate
tasmādeva hi samavāyādāśritatvādivyavasthānamupavarṇyate bhavadbhiḥ, tasya ca sarvatrāviśiṣṭatve kathameṣa niyamo yokṣyate
tasmādetadapyāśritatvādi na tasyādhārādheyabhāvasya niyāmakaṃ yuktam, ādhārādheyabhāvena sahaikayogakṣematvādeṣām
tathāhi--yata eva dravyatvaṃ dravye samavetaṃ tata eva tena tad vyajyata ityucyate
yasmānnityānāmapi sattādīnāṃ samavāya iṣṭaḥ; na ca nityānāmutpattiryuktā
etadeva na hītyādinā samarthayate --na hi dīpādisadbhāvājjāyante yādṛśā ime
yaścāpi dadhikuṇḍasaṃyogo dṛṣṭāntatvenoktaḥ so'pyasmākamasiddha iti darśayati --kuṇḍadadhnośca saṃyoga ekaḥ pūrvaṃ nirākṛtaḥ
bhavatu nāma saṃyoga ekaḥ, tatrāpi tulya eva prasaṅga iti darśayati--na cāsāvityādi
tasmāditi saṃyogāt dadhni kuṇḍam ityādibuddhiprasaṅgo'tiprasaṅgaḥ saṃyogasya nimittasya nirviśiṣṭatvāt
gaurudake dṛśi svarge diśi paśau raśmau vajre bhūmāviṣau giri
gaurudake dṛśi svarge diśi paśau raśmau vajre bhūmāviṣau giri
katham ? samavāyasyaikatvād dravyatvena guṇakarmaṇoḥ sambandhād dravyabhāvaḥ, guṇakarmabhāvayorhāniḥ
18 iti, ekaśabdena abhedaḥ kathyate, na tu saṅkhyā
liṅgyate'neneti liṅgaṃ pratyayaḥ, yena liṅgena sat sat iti pratyayena pratīyate sattā tasya sarvatrāviśiṣṭatvād viśiṣṭasya ca pratyayasyābhāvādabhinnā sattā
30, yathaikadravyavattvānna dravyaṃ bhāvo guṇakarmasu ca bhāvānna karma na guṇa evaṃ samavāyo'pi
31 iti, yathā salliṅgāviśeṣādeko bhāvastathā ihaliṅgāviśeṣādekaḥ samavāyo vṛttirahito nityo niravayavaśceti saptamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
padārthānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ dravyādīnāṃ lakṣaṇavyavasthānasyābhāvāt ṣaḍapi padārthā nivartante iti

samavāyasyaikatvād dravyatvena guṇakarmaṇoḥ sambandhād dravyabhāvo dravyatvavat, tayośca svarūpasya guṇatvasya karmatvasya ca hāniriti doṣau, tattvaviśeṣaṇabhedāddhi tadbhedaḥ syācchatridaṇḍivaditi vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ, chatraviśiṣṭaśchatrī, daṇḍaviśiṣṭo daṇḍī, na tatheha dravyatvasya kvacid bhedo'sti
atra dravyabhāvo dravyavat iti pāṭho yadvā dravyabhāvo dravyatvaṃ dravyavat iti pāṭhaḥ syāditi sambhāvyate
kāryakāraṇādhārādheyasamavāyāt tau bhaviṣyata iti cet, tayorguṇakarmaṇorguṇakarmabhāvanivṛttau dravyabhāvasambandhe guṇakarmaṇāmanāśrayatvād dravyasya dravyabhāvanivṛttiḥ

kāryakāraṇādhārādheyasamavāyasyaikatvād guṇakarmaṇordravyībhūtatvād guṇakarmabhāvanivṛttau guṇakarmaṇāmanāśrayatvād na dravyaṃ kriyāvadādilakṣaṇaṃ na guṇakarmāṇi tathālakṣaṇānīti dravyasyāpi dravyabhāvanivṛttiḥ

kāraṇamādhāraśca dravyam, ādheye kārye ca guṇakarmaṇī, tayorbhinnayoḥ kāryakāraṇayorādhārādheyayośca samavāyāt tau guṇakarmabhāvau bhaviṣyata iti cet evaṃ cenmanyase, mā maṃsthāḥ, atrottaram --tayorguṇakarmaṇorityādi yāvat prathamadravyabhāvanivṛttiriti tāvadupadeśavacanam, uparitano granthastadvyākhyā, guṇakarmaṇorguṇakarmabhāvanivṛttidvāreṇa dravyasya dravyabhāvanivṛttirākhyāyate

tadyathā--ya uktaḥ kāryakāraṇādhārādheyasamavāyastasyaivaikatvāt yo dravyabhāvena guṇakarmaṇoḥ samavāyaḥ sa ekastena dravyeṇa sambandhāt te guṇakarmaṇī dravyamevaikaṃ karoti, tato guṇakarmaṇī nivartete, tannivṛttau dravyamāśrayyabhāvād nāśrayo na ca kāraṇaṃ samavāyināṃ guṇakarmaṇāmabhāvāt, tato dravyasya dravyalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1
ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānāṃ yaḥ sambandha ihapratyayahetuḥ sa samavāyaḥ

dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣāṇāṃ kāryakāraṇabhūtānāmakāryakāraṇabhūtānāṃ vā ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhāvenāvasthitānām ihedam iti buddhiryato bhavati yataścāsarvagatānāmadhigatānyatvānāmaviṣvagbhāvaḥ sa samavāyākhyaḥ sambandhaḥ

katham ? yathā iha kuṇḍe dadhi iti pratyayaḥ sambandhe sati dṛṣṭastathā iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ, iha vīraṇeṣu kaṭaḥ, iha dravye guṇakarmaṇī, iha dravyaguṇakarmasu sattā, iha dravye dravyatvam, iha guṇe guṇatvam, iha karmaṇi karmatvam, iha nityadravye'ntyā viśeṣāḥ iti pratyayadarśanādastyeṣāṃ sambandha iti jñāyate
atha samavāyanirūpaṇārthamāha--ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānāṃ yaḥ sambandhaḥ iha pratyayahetuḥ sa samavāyaḥ
ke te'yutasiddhāḥ yeṣāṃ sambandhaḥ samavāyo bhavedata āha--dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣāṇāmiti

ihedam iti buddhiryataḥ kāraṇād bhavati yataścāsarvagatānāṃ niyatadeśāvasthitānāmadhigatānyatvānāmadhigatasvarūpabhedānāmaviṣvagbhāvo'pṛthagbhāvo'svātantryaṃ sa samavāyaḥ bhinnayoḥ parasparopaśleṣasya sambandhakṛtatvopalambhāt
yathā iha kuṇḍe dadhi iti pratyayaḥ kuṇḍadadhnoḥ sambandhe sati dṛṣṭaḥ tathā iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ ityādipratyayānāṃ darśanādastyeṣāṃ tantupaṭādīnāṃ sambandha iti jñāyate
iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ ityādipratyayāḥ sambandhanimittāḥ, abādhitehapratyayatvāt, iha kuṇḍe dadhi iti pratyayavat

na guṇakarmāṇi tathālakṣaṇānīti,itiśabdo hetvarthe, yasmād na santyeva tādṛglakṣaṇāni guṇakarmāṇi teṣāmāśrayiṇāṃ samavāyināmabhāvāt tannivṛttau dravyasyāpi dravyabhāvanivṛttiḥ, guṇavat yacca 'na, bahūnāmekatvāt
bahūnāṃ dravyādīnāmekaḥ samavāyaḥ, na tu dvayordvayoḥ...
samavāyikāraṇaṃ kriyāvadadravyamanekadravyaṃ vā dravyaṃ syāt, taccetthaṃ nādravyaṃ nānekadravyaṃ sambhavati
tasmād guṇakarmaṇāṃ guṇakarmabhāvanivṛttau dravyabhāvasambandhe sati guṇakarmaṇāmanāśrayatvād dravyasya dravyabhāvanivṛttiriti dravyapadārthanivṛttiruktā

athavā tvadiṣṭena dravyatvena sarvagatena sambandhe sati guṇasya karmaṇo vā dravyaṃ dravyatvena sambaddhamiti dravyībhāvaḥ, tadbhāvād guṇakarmaṇī na dravyāśrite, tato dravyalakṣaṇāyukterdravyabhāvanivṛttiḥ, kiṃ dravyalakṣaṇamiti cet, ucyate --kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1

14 iti, tattu kāryakāraṇādhārādheyasamavāyasyaikatvād guṇakarmaṇordravyībhūtatvāt kriyāvadādilakṣaṇaṃ nāsti, yasmād na tu guṇakarmāṇi tathālakṣaṇānīti guṇasya dravyāśrayyādilakṣaṇatvāt ekadravyādilakṣaṇatvāt karmaṇaḥ
tataśca dravyasyāpītyādi āśrayābhāvād guṇakarmābhāvamāpādya āśrayyabhāve'pi dravyasyāśrayasyābhāva iti gatārtham
bahūnāṃ dravyādīnāmekaḥ samavāyaḥ, na tu dvayordvayoḥ...
bahūnāṃ dravyādīnāmekaḥ samavāyaḥ, na tu dvayordvayoḥ
dvayordvayoryathā saṃyogaḥ, na tathā dvayordvayoḥ samavāyaḥ

ādhārādheyabhāvena bhede sati saṃyogavad dvivṛttitvāt samavāyasya tataścānityatvaṃ syāt iti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā parihāramāha vaiśeṣikaḥ --na, bahūnāmekatvāt, bahūnāṃ dravyādīnāmekaḥ samavāya iti svarūpavarṇanaṃ dvivṛttipratiṣedhārtham
na tu dvayordvayorityādi saṃyogena vaidharmyaṃ samavāyasya' iti, etenāpi saṅkaraprasaṅgastadavastha eva bahūnāmekasamavāyābhyupagamāt

etenānityatvaparihāravacanenāpi saṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ sāmānyena vyavasthānābhāvāt sarvatra sarvādheyavṛttau sarvābhidhānapratyayasaṅkaraḥ viśeṣya ca padārthalakṣaṇavyavasthānāsambhavāt ṣaṭvadārthanivṛttirvetyādiruktaḥ tadavastha eva dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ, bahūnāmekasamavāyābhyupagamāt, tataḥ saṅkarāduktāt ṣaḍapi padārthā nivartitāḥ, tannivṛttau samavāyyabhāvāt samavāyanivṛtte- stasyāsataḥ khapuṣpasyeva kuto nityatvamanityatvaṃ vā ?
yathā pramāṇataḥ kāraṇānupalabdhernityo bhāva ityuktaṃ tathā samavāyo'pīti
na hyasya kiñcit kāraṇaṃ pramāṇata upalabhyata iti
asya nyāyakandalī vyākhyā pṛ॰ 523 ṭi॰ 2 ityatra draṣṭavyā
asya praśastapādabhāṣyamatasya khaṇḍanaṃ tattvasaṅgrahapañjikāyāmitthamasti--"yaccoktaṃ kāraṇānupalabdhernityaḥ samavāyaḥ iti tatrāha— nityatvenāsya sarve'pi nityāḥ prāptā ghaṭādayaḥ
yadi hi samavāyo nityaḥ syāt tadā ghaṭādīnāmapi nityatvaprasaṅgaḥ svādhāreṣu teṣāṃ sarvadāvasthānāt
tathāhi--samavāyāstitvādevaiṣāṃ svādhāreṣvavasthānamiṣyate, sa ca samavāyoḥ nitya iti kimiti sadā'mī na santiṣṭheran
te naśyanti kriyādyāśca yogāderiti cenna tat
svādhāre samavāyo hi teṣāmapi sadā mataḥ
syādetat--ghaṭādīnāṃ ye svārambhakāvayavāsteṣāṃ vibhāgād vināśādvā ghaṭādīnāṃ vināśaḥ, yathā ghaṭasyodveṣṭanapākāvasthayoḥ kriyādayaḥ sparśavaddravyasaṃyogādibhyo vinaśyanti
tathā buddherbuddhyantarād vināśaḥ śabdasya śabdāntarāditi paraprakriyā
tena satyapi samavāye'vasthitihetau sahakārikāraṇāntarābhāvād virodhipratyayopanipātācca na nityatvaprasaṅgo ghaṭādīnāmiti parasya bhāvaḥ
naitad yuktam, yatasteṣāmapi svārambhakāvayavānāṃ kapālādīnāṃ svārambhakeṣvavayavāntareṣu samavāyaḥ, teṣāmapyanyeṣvanyeṣu yāvat paramāṇuravaśiṣyate
tataśca sarveṣāṃ svārambhakeṣvavayaveṣu samavāyaḥ sarvadāstyeveti kuto vināśo vibhāgo vā
na kevalaṃ tadārabdhānāṃ dravyāṇām, kriyādīnāṃ ca iti apiśabdena darśayati
yadi tu svārambhakāṇāmavayavānāṃ vināśo'bhyupagamyeta tadā niyatamasya samavāyasyāpi vināśaḥ prāpnoti
sambandhināṃ vā sthitiḥ prāpnoti, avinaṣṭasambandhatvāt, anuparatasaṃyogadravyadvayavat
evaṃ manyate--yadi prathame hetau vinaṣṭāśeṣasambandhitvāditi hetvartho'bhipretaḥ tadā pakṣaikadeśāsiddhatā hetoḥ
na hyaśeṣāṇāṃ sambandhināṃ vināśaḥ kvacidasti, pralaye'pi paramāṇvādīnāmavaśiṣyamāṇatvāt
yadyevaṃ saṃyogasyāpyanayā nītyā nityatvaṃ prāpnotītyāśaṅkya paraḥ pratividhatte--na bhedata iti
saṃyogo hi pratisaṃyogi bhidyate, tenāsyānityatvaṃ yuktam, samavāyastu ihapratyayanibandhanasyābhinnatvādeka eva jagati, tenāsyānityatvamayuktamanyatrāpi sambandhyantare tasyopalabhyamānatvāt
yadyevamityādinā pratividhatte--yadyevaṃ ye vinaśyanti ghaṭādyāḥ samavāyinaḥ
pūrvavat te sthitā eva prāpnuvanti ghaṭādayaḥ
ataḥ prāgapi tadbhāvānna te vṛttāḥ syurāśraye

tathāhi--ye te vinaśyanti ghaṭādayaḥ svakāraṇādisamavāyinasteṣāṃ svakāraṇeṣu vṛttyātmako yo'sau samavāyaḥ kalpitaḥ sa eva kiṃ teṣu vinaṣṭeṣu sambandhyantareṣvasti āhosvidanya eva yathā saṃyogo bahutvaṃ vā pratisaṃyogi bhidyate

tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣaḥ tadā prāgavasthāvadapracyutapravṛttitvādavasthitā eva ghaṭādayaḥ prāpnuvanti, teṣāṃ vā ghaṭādīnāmanavasthāne'navasthitapravṛttitvānnāvasthitiḥ samavāyasya prāpnoti, anyathā na vṛttyātmakaḥ syāt
tathābhūtasya ca svatantrasyānupakāriṇo vṛttiḥ samavāya iti vā nāmakaraṇe saṃjñāmātrameva syāt, na tu vastutathābhāvaḥ
tatheti tadvṛttyātmaka ityevam, tataḥ saṃjñāmātrānvayo doṣaḥ, taṃ darśayati--ata ityādi

prāgapi sambandhināśāt, avinaṣṭasambandhyavasthāyāmapītyarthaḥ, te ghaṭādayaḥ svāśraye vṛttāstasya samavāyasya bhāvāt sadbhāvabalānna sidhyeyuḥ, paścādiva vinaṣṭasamavāyikāraṇavat paramārthato vṛttyabhāvāt
athānya eveti dvitīyaḥ pakṣastadā saṃyogādivat samavāyabahutvaṃ prāpnoti
tataśca na samavāyo bhedavān ityasyābhyupetasya hāniḥ
" iti jesalamerasthāyāṃ tattvasaṅgrahapañjikāyāṃ samavāyapadārthaparīkṣāvasare, atra sthūlākṣaranirdiṣṭaḥ pāṭho jesalamerasthahastalikhitapustakānusāreṇa jñeyaḥ
samavāyasya' iti, etenāpi saṅkaraprasaṅgastadavastha eva bahūnāmekasamavāyābhyupagamāt
katham ? dravyeṣveva dravyatvam, guṇeṣveva guṇatvam, karmasveva karmatvam iti vai॰ sū॰ praśastamati॰
etadapi pratyuktaṃ sarvatraikatve samavāyasya ādhārādheyaniyamābhāvāt, dvivṛttitva eva hi dravyādiṣu dravyatvādīni pratiniyatāni
sarvatra tāvad dravyadravyatvādisamavāye dvivṛttitvaṃ sambandhidvayaviśiṣṭābhidhānapratyayatvāt kuṇḍadadhyādisaṃyogavat
iha iti samavāyanimittasya jñānasyānvayadarśanāt sarvatraikaḥ samavāya iti gamyate
yathā kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyogaikatve bhavatyāśrayāśrayibhāvaniyamaḥ tathā dravyatvādīnāmapi samavāyaikatve'pi ādhārādheyaniyamaḥ syāt ityāśayo bhāti, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 524 ṭi॰ 3
yadi sarvātmakaḥ samavāyo dravyādyādhāra eka eva tadā kimiti saṅkaro na syāt ? nāpi ca dvivṛttitvanivṛttiḥ samavāyasya ityāśayo bhāti
dravyaguṇayoḥ dravyakarmaṇoḥ dravyadravyatvayoḥ guṇaguṇatvayoḥ karmakarmatvayośca samavāyaḥ ityabhidhānapratyayau dṛśyete
tathā ca ādhārādheyabhāvena bhede saṃyogavad dvivṛttitvāt samavāyasyānityataiva
yadyapyeka ityādi tadvyākhyā yāvat karmasveva karmatvamiti, sarvatra caikaḥ samavāyaḥ ityanena dvivṛttitvaparihāreṇānityatvamapi parihṛtamiti vaiśeṣikaḥ
ācārya āha --etadapi pratyuktamityādi gatārthaṃ yāvat pratiniyatānīti
yattūcyate--avagamyatāṃ tāvadityādi idaṃ tasya doṣaparihāraprāṇasarvasvamanvayavyatirekābhyāmaniyamātiprasaṅgābhāvabhāvanaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvat samavāyaikatve'pyādhārādheyaniyamaḥ syāditi

atrācārya āha — idamapītyādi, svavādenaivottaramārgo vihito'sya vacanasya tvayā ihedam vai॰ sū॰ praśastamati॰ ityādinā samavāyalakṣaṇaṃ vyācakṣāṇena ādhārādheyasambandhajñānalakṣaṇatvāt kāryakāraṇayoścādhārādheyabhāvāt sambandhinoḥ kuṇḍadadhidṛṣṭāntena ca subhāvito'yamarthaḥ, tenaiva vayaṃ brūmaḥ --na tu tathetyādi, na tu tathā saṅkarābhāvo ghaṭate uttaraprakāreṇa, kuṇḍadadhisaṃyogadṛṣṭānte yadi dadhimadhūdakādibhirbahubhirādheyaiḥ kuṇḍādhāraḥ saṃyukto bhavati tataḥ kimiti saṅkaro nāsti ? tathā yadi sarvātmakaḥ samavāyo dravya-guṇa-karma-dravyatva-guṇatva-karmatva-sattādyādhāra eka eva bhavati tadā kimiti saṅkaro na syāt ? nāpi ca dvivṛttitvanivṛttiḥ samavāyasya yataḥ saṃyogād vaidharmyamucyate tvayā dvayordvayoḥ ityādinā

tatra sādhanam--sarvatra tāvad dravyadravyatvādisamavāye dvivṛttitvaṃ tvayaivopavarṇyate, sādhayāmaścaitad dvivṛttitvaṃ sambandhidvayaviśiṣṭābhidhānapratyayatvāt kuṇḍadadhyādisaṃyogavat, yathā kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyoge dadhnā kuṇḍena vā viśiṣṭe tannimittamabhidhānaṃ pratyayaśca dṛśyate dadhikuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍadadhi veti taddvivṛttitvaṃ ca tathā samavāye'pi dravyaguṇayorityādi dvivṛttivarṇanam
tasmāt tvatpūrvapakṣitadoṣāsaṅgastadavasthaḥ samavāyasyetyata āha --tathā cetyādi yāvadanityataiveti gatārtham
dravyaguṇayoḥ dravyakarmaṇoḥ dravyadravyatvayoḥ guṇaguṇatvayoḥ karmakarmatvayośca samavāyaḥ ityabhidhānapratyayau dṛśyete
tathā ca ādhārādheyabhāvena bhede saṃyogavad dvivṛttitvāt samavāyasyānityataiva
...jñānamityādi, anena svapakṣe pratyakṣavirodha udgrāhyate tvayā, na hi...
...evaṃ te samavāyaikatve dravyeṣvapi guṇajñānaṃ syād guṇajñānakāraṇatvāt samavāyasya guṇavat
yattvidamabhidhīyate dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ dravyatvādibhiḥ parasparavyatiriktairniyamād dravyeṣveva dravyajñānam ityādi, anena svapakṣe pratyakṣavirodha udgrāhyate tvayā
na hi samavāyaikatve'viśiṣṭatvād vyatireko niyamaścāsti, ato dravyeṣveva dravyajñānaṃ na syāt
ekatve yo'yaṃ dravyasya dravyabhāvena sambandhaḥ sa eva guṇasyāpīti dravyasyāpi guṇatvam
tasya dravyasya guṇabhāvena sambaddhatvād guṇībhūtatvād guṇānāśrayatvādabhāva iti guṇabhāvanivṛttirguṇasya tallakṣaṇānupapatteḥ
dravyāśrayī aguṇavān saṃyogavibhāgeṣvakāraṇamanapekṣa iti guṇalakṣaṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1
tasya dravyasya guṇabhāvena sambaddhatvād guṇavad dravyabhāvanivṛttiḥ ityāśayo bhāti
yattvidamityādi paroktameva granthamatidiśati yāvajjñānamityādi, dravyādīnāmādhārāṇāṃ dravyatvādibhirādheyaiḥ parasparavyatiriktairviśeṣaṇairniyamo bhavati svatattvānurūpapratyayotpatteriti
katham ? na hītyādinā bhāvayati, hiśabdo hetvarthe, yasmāt samavāya ekastasmād dravyādidravyatvādibhiraviśiṣṭatvād vyatireko niyamaśca nāsti, ato dravyeṣveva dravyam iti jñānaṃ na syāt
tasya vyākhyā --evamityādi, evaṃ te samavāyaikatve dravyeṣvapi guṇajñānaṃ syādaviśiṣṭatvād guṇeṣviva
kiṃ kāraṇam ? guṇajñānakāraṇatvāt samavāyasya, kimiva ? guṇavaditi, guṇeṣviva guṇavat iti sādhanam
tadeva vyācaṣṭe --ekatve yo'yamityādi yāvad dravyasyāpi guṇatvam

yadi dadhimadhūdakādīnāṃ kuṇḍasaṅkīrṇānāmaviveke niyamena ayamasyaiva svabhāvaḥ ityaśakyamavadhārayituṃ saṃyoge dadhikuṇḍameva, madhukuṇḍameva, udakakuṇḍameva vā iti ekatvāt saṃyogasya sarveṇāpi sambandhāt, tathātrāpi yo dravyabhāvena sambandhaḥ sa eva guṇasyāpi iti etasmāt kāraṇāt prāptaṃ guṇatvaṃ dravyasyāpi guṇabhāvaḥ, dravyaṃ guṇo bhavatītyarthaḥ
guṇatvābhisambandhācca tasya dravyabhāvahāniḥ, evaṃ guṇabhāvāpattau dravyabhāvo hīyata iti pararūpatāmāpādya svarūpatyāgamāpādayati

tad dravyaṃ guṇabhāvena sambaddhamato guṇībhūtaṃ nāśrayo guṇāntarasyeti, dravyamanāśritasya ca guṇasyābhāvaḥ, tato guṇānāśrayasya dravyasyāpyabhāvaḥ, tadabhāvādasati dravye kasya guṇaḥ ? iti guṇabhāvanivṛttirguṇasya tallakṣaṇānupapatteḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? ityādi kāraṇapraśnapūrvake pūrvavadatrāpi dravyatvāpattiguṇatvatyāgau dve anavasthāne
evaṃ dvikasaṃyogena caturviśatiranavasthācakrakāṇi bhavanti tathā kāryakāraṇayoḥ...
nanu sarvagatatvāt samavāyasya svatattvenāpi sambandhāt tattvaṃ sidhyati
nanvata eva saṅkara ucyate paratattvenāpi sambandhādatattvamapīti
evaṃ ca svaviṣayasarvagatāni tattvāni samavāyasya sarvagataikatvābhyāṃ sarvagatāni prāptāni
ato dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ vyavasthitānāmabhāvāt na dravyeṣu dravyajñānaṃ guṇeṣu guṇajñānaṃ karmasu karmajñānam
tathā yo'yaṃ guṇasya karmatvenetyādi karmaṇā saha pararūpāpattiḥ svarūpatyāgaśca dve anavasthāne lakṣaṇāyogadvāreṇa savyākhyāne gatārthe yāvad na guṇakarmaṇī tathālakṣaṇe iti lakṣaṇābhāvāpādanam

tayoralakṣaṇatvādasattvāt, tayorguṇakarmaṇoralakṣaṇatvādasattvaṃ khapuṣpavat, tadasattvādāśrayatvopalakṣyadravyābhāvaḥ, guṇakarmaṇorupalakṣaṇayorāśrayiṇorabhāvādvāśrayo dravyaṃ nāsti auṣṇyābhāve'gnyabhāvavat upalakṣaṇābhāvāt khapuṣpavadvā
tasmiṃścāsati dravye nirāśrayayorguṇakarmaṇorabhāvād dravyasya cābhāvādāśrayiṇāṃ dravyatvādīnāmapyabhāvaḥ, uktaṃ hi --utpannamāśrayamāśrayantyāśrayiṇaḥ iti
evametāni dvikasaṃyogena dravyasya guṇena saha karmaṇā ca dve, guṇasya dravyeṇa karmaṇā ca saha dve, karmaṇo dravyeṇa guṇena ca saha dve, iti ṣaṭ cakrakāṇi
dravyatvena guṇasya karmaṇaśca dve, guṇatvena dravyasya karmaṇaśca dve, karmatvena dravyasya guṇasya ca dve, iti ṣaṭ
evaṃ dravyatvasya karmaṇā guṇena ca guṇatvasya dravyeṇa karmaṇā ca karmatvasya dravyeṇa guṇena ca ṣaṭ cakrakāṇi
dravyasya guṇatvena karmatvena ca, guṇasya dravyatvena karmatvena ca, karmaṇo dravyatvena guṇatvena ca ṣaṭ, tānyapi dvādaśa
kasmāt ? tathā kāryakāraṇayorityādi yāvad guṇasyetyāderiti hetuṃ vyākhyātamevopanayati
samavāyasya sarvagatatvāt svatattvenāpi sambandho'sti, dravyasya dravyatvaṃ svatattvam, evaṃ śeṣayorapi śeṣadvayam
sarveṇa saha samavāyasadbhāvāt svenāpi tattvena sambandhāt tadbhāvastattvaṃ dravyabhāvo guṇabhāvaḥ karmabhāvo vā sidhyatīti
atrocyate --nanvata eva saṅkara ucyate paratattvenāpi sambandhādatattvamapīti
iti hetvarthe, yasmāt paratattvenāpi sambandhastasmāt tadbhāvo'pi atadbhāvo'pīti saṅkaradoṣāvimokṣaḥ, apiśabdena tvaduktenaiva samarthitatvāt
samavāyanimittasya tattvasya svavṛttipratilambhādeva lokasiddhivad bhedabhāvāt kārakaśaktita eva tu kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyogaikatve'pyādhārādheyaniyamaḥ

svaviṣayasarvagatāni hi tattvānīṣyante tatsamavāyasya sarvagataikatvābhyāṃ tānyadhunā sarvagatāni prāptāni, tato'bhyupagamavirodho jāyata iti śeṣapadārthābhāva ucyate, ato dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmityādi prāktana eva grantho yāvat karmasu karmajñānamiti

tatra vyavasthitalakṣaṇānāmabhāvāt iti lakṣaṇābhāvadvāreṇa nirākaraṇam, iha tu vyavasthitānāmabhāvāt iti saha tattvairlakṣaṇaiśca teṣāṃ nirākṛtatvāditi viśeṣaḥ ādheyajñānabhedanimittaniyamanirākaraṇadvāreṇa ceti
samavāyanimittasya tattvasya svavṛttipratilambhādeva lokasiddhivad bhedabhāvāt kārakaśaktita eva tu kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyogaikatve'pyādhārādheyaniyamaḥ
yadapyuktaṃ yathā kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyogaikatve'pyādhārādheyaniyamastathā samavāyaikatve'pi dravyādīnāmādhārādheyabhāvaniyamaḥ iti tadapi naiva
yadyapyaparicchinnadeśāni sāmānyāni bhavanti tathāpyupalakṣaṇaniyamāt kāraṇasāmagrīniyamācca svaviṣayasarvagatāni, antarāle ca saṃyogasamavāyavṛttyabhāvādavyapadeśyānīti
asya vyākhyā--svaviṣaye sarvatra sāmānyaṃ samavaiti nānyatreti yat pūrvamuktaṃ tatra kāraṇamāha— yadyapīti

yadyapi sāmānyāni yatra tatropajāyamānena piṇḍena sambandhādaparicchinnadeśāni aniyatadeśāni tathāpi upalakṣaṇasya abhivyañjakasyāvayavasaṃsthānaviśeṣasya niyamād niyatatvāt piṇḍotpādakakāraṇasāmagrīniyamācca svaviṣaye sarvatra samavayanti nānyatra
etaduktaṃ bhavati--sāsnādisaṃsthānaviśeṣo gotvasya vyañjakaḥ, kesarādisaṃsthānaviśeṣo'śvatvasya, viśiṣṭagrīvādisaṃsthānaviśeṣaśca ghaṭatvasya, pratītiniyamāt
ete ca saṃsthānaviśeṣāḥ na sarveṣu piṇḍeṣu sādhāraṇāḥ, api tu pratiniyateṣu bhavanti
tatra yadyapi sarvaṃ sāmānyaṃ sarvatropajāyamānena svaviṣayeṇeva piṇḍāntareṇāpi sambaddhuṃ kṣamate tathāpi yasyābhivyañjakaṃ yatra piṇḍe sambhavati tasya tatraiva samavāyo nānyatra
eṣa hi tantvādīnāṃ kāraṇānāṃ svabhāvo yadetairutpādyamāne dravye paṭatvameva samavaiti nānyat
eṣa hi mṛtpiṇḍādīnāṃ mahimā yat taiḥ kriyamāṇe dravye ghaṭatvameva samavaiti nānyat

na tāvat sāmānyamanyataḥ samāgatya sambadhyate niṣkriyatvāt, tatrāpi yadi pūrvaṃ nāsīt tatropajāyamānena piṇḍenāsya sambandho na syāt, dṛśyate ca sarvatropajāyamānena piṇḍena sambandhaḥ, tasmāt sarvaṃ sarvatrāstīti kasyacid mataṃ nirākurvannāha--antarāle saṃyogasamavāyavṛttyabhāvādavyapadeśyānīti
antarālamiti ākāśaṃ vā digdravyaṃ vā stimitavāyurvā mūrtadravyābhāvo vā, teṣu gotvādisāmānyānāṃ na saṃyogo nāpi samavāyaḥ
na cāsambaddhānāmeva teṣāmavasthāne pramāṇamasti, ato'ntarāle na sāmānyāni vyapadiśyante, na santītyarthaḥ
kathaṃ tarhi tatropajāyamānena piṇḍena sambadhyante ? kāraṇasāmarthyāt

saṃyogo hyanyataḥ samāgatasya bhavati tatraivāvasthitasya vā bhavati, tasmād vilakṣaṇastu samavāyo yatra yatraiva piṇḍotpattau kāraṇāni vyāpriyante tatra tatraiva kāraṇānāṃ sāmarthyāt piṇḍe'nyato'nāgatasya tatrāsthitasyāpi sāmānyasya bhavati vastuśakteraparyanuyojyatvāt

yadapi pareṇoktaṃ yathā kuṇḍadadhisaṃyoge dadhyevādheyam, kuṇḍamevādhāraḥ iti niyamastathā dravyamevādhāro guṇakarmādyevādheyam, dravyaguṇakarmāṇyevādhāro dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvānyevādheyāni iti, tadapi naiva, kuṇḍadadhyādhārādheyabhāvasamavāyānāmapyekatvāt, tatrāpi tvanmatenādhārayoḥ kuṇḍadadhnorādheyayośca kuṇḍatvadadhitvayostayostattvayordravyatvādīnāṃ ca tattvānāṃ ye samavāyāsteṣāmapyekatvāt samavāyibhedopacaritabhedānāmāñjasyenaikatvāt pūrvoktavidhinā tadavasthaḥ saṅkaradoṣaḥ
yadyasaṅkareṇa niyamena cārthaḥ vayameva spaṣṭataraṃ brūmaḥ, tadyathā --samavāyanimittasyetyādi

samavāyasya yad nimittaṃ tattvaṃ kuṇḍadadhnoḥ kuṇḍatvaṃ dadhitvaṃ ca tasya svata evātmapratilambhaḥ, tayośca lokasiddhivad tvamevāttha na samānatvāt iti tathehāpi samānamuttaram--samavāyaikatve'pi kārakaśaktereva niyamabhedaḥ

bhedaḥ svavṛttipratilambhādeva, tvanmate'pyākāśakālayoriva dadhikuṇḍayorlokena pratipanno bhedo nārthāntarāt tathā tato vayamapi lokaviruddhaṃ mā vocāmeti lokasiddhivad bhedabhāvāt kārakaśaktita eva tu pratipadyate bhedasiddhiṃ saṃyogapariṇāmakṛtaṃ sadapyaikyamanādṛtya tayoḥ saṃyogaikatve'pyādhāraśaktiḥ kuṇḍasya ādheyaśaktirdadhna iti niyamamasaṅkīrṇamācakṣmahe
avaśyaṃ caitadevam, tvayā samavāyamapi kalpayitvaitadeva pratipattavyam; tvadvacanaprāmāṇyādeva
yathā tvamevāttheti saṃyogaikatve'pi kārakaśaktita eva kuṇḍadadhnorādhārādheyaniyamo bhinna ityuttaramāttha
kiṃ taduttaramiti cet, ucyate --na, samānatvāditi, tathehāpi samānamuttaram --samavāyaikatve'pi kārakaśaktereva niyamabhedaḥ
tvamevāttha na samānatvāt iti tathehāpi samānamuttaram--samavāyaikatve'pi kārakaśaktereva niyamabhedaḥ
samavāyaikatve'pi kārakaśaktereva ādhārādheyaniyama iti na dravyādiṣu sarvatra dravyatvādi samavaiti, kintu kasmiṃścideva ityāśayo bhāti
yattūcyate--vyaṅgyavyañjakatvabhedād dravyadravyatvādīnāṃ bhedo ghaṭapradīpavaditi tadādhārādheyabhedaniyamād na saṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ ityāśayo bhāti
etacca vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāve dravyadravyatvādīnāṃ pṛthak siddhe sati syāt, na tu siddhaḥ, siddhe hi tasmiṃstadādhārādheyabhedaniyamo'pi syāt, tataśca asaṅkaraḥ syādevam ityāśayo bhāti
samavāyasyaikatve kuṇḍadadhisaṃyogavad ādhārādheyabhedaniyamābhāvāt tadavastha eva saṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ ityāśayo bhāti
vyaṅgyavyañjakatvabhedāt dravyadravyatvādīnāṃ bhedo ghaṭapradīpavaditi parihārāntaraṃ gatārthaṃ yāvad na saṅkaraprasaṅga iti vaiśeṣikasya

ācāryavacanaṃ tu etacca vyaṅgyavyañjaketyādi, syādetadevam yadi dārṣṭāntikasya dravyadravyatvādervyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvaḥ pradīpaghaṭadṛṣṭāntavat pṛthak siddhaḥ syāt, na tu tadātmabhedaniyamaḥ siddhaḥ, siddhe hi tadādhārādheyabhedaniyamo'pi syāt, tadarthodbhāvanaṃ yāvadasaṅkaraḥ syādevamiti
tasya hetorasiddhipratipādanārthaṃ cāha --samavāyasyetyādi, uktottaramevaitat, ādhārādheyabhedaniyamābhāvasya tulyatvād dṛṣṭāntasādharmyaṃ na bhajata etaditi prāg vistareṇa vyākhyātārthatvāt
tadeva smārayati --tathā yadi ya evetyādi yāvad guṇakarmabhāvavinivṛttiriti sarvaṃ sarvavikalpaṃ prapañcanīyamiti pūrvoktārthātideśaḥ
ā kutaḥ ? iti cet, ucyate--asmād granthāvadheḥ
yathāsvārthamiti yo yaḥ svārtho yathāsvārthaṃ dravya-guṇa-karma-dravyatva-guṇatva-karmatvasaṃyogāvyavasthānacakrakāṇyeva vyākhyeyāni pūrvavaditi
yat punaridamāśaṅkitaṃ samavāyaikatvaṃ pañcatvavyavahāreṇa virudhyate iti, tadevameva

...bhaviṣyati iti, idaṃ nirmūlameva vyaṅgyasyādhārasya vā'niyamāt kutastadvyaṅgyo vyañjako vādheyo'rthaḥ ? kuto vāśrayāṇāṃ vaicitryam ? ajalacandravadekatvāt samavāyasya bhāvasya ca jalacandreṇa sādharmyābhāvāt kuto nānātvopacāraḥ ? bhāvo vā kutaḥ ?
yathā bhāvasyaikatve'pi jalacandravadāśrayaviśeṣād nānātvopacāraḥ tathā samavāyasyaikatve'pi vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvabhedādādhārādheyaniyamādāśrayaviśeṣāt pañcatvavyavahāro bhaviṣyati ityāśayo bhāti
sāmānyaṃ bhāvaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ, yat tat tena bhūyate sā sattā, viśeṣo'pi pratyayārthaḥ saḥ
samavāyaikatvaṃ pañcatvavyavahāreṇa virudhyate iti yadāśaṅkitaṃ tvayā tadevameva mamāpi pratibhāti virudhyata eveti

yat punaridaṃ pratyucyate tasyāśaṅkitasyottaraṃ vaiśeṣikeṇa --na, āśrayaviśeṣād bhāvavadityādi, dravyādisadbhāvatrayaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, pratidṛṣṭāntaśca jalacandraḥ, tathā samavāyaikatve'pītyādi dārṣṭāntikaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvad bhaviṣyatīti

asyottaramāhācāryaḥ --idaṃ nirmūlameva, vyaṅgyasyādhārasya vā'niyamāt pūrvoktādāśraya evāsiddho vyañjako vyaṅgyo vā tvadiṣṭaḥ, kutastadvyaṅgyo vyañjako vādheyo'rthaḥ ? kuto vāśrayāṇāṃ vaicitryam, samavāyaikatve ṣaṭpadārthanivṛtteḥ subhāvitatvāt ? ajalacandravad vyomacandravadekatvāt samavāyasya bhāvasya ca sattākhyasya jalacandreṇa saha sādharmyābhāvāt kuto nānātvopacāraḥ, chāyāmātratvācca jalacandrasyābahutvādvā ? bhāvo vā kutaḥ, bhāvo'pi dravyādivyatirikto nāstyevaikaḥ tanmūlatvādvivādasya ityalamativikāśinyā saṅkathayā

evaṃ svabhāvasat-sambandhasadvastubhāvabhedavādivaiśeṣikamatanirākaraṇaprapañcenaitadāyātamiti tad darśayati --evametadityādi ubhayamubhayabhāk ityasya nayasya svarūpam, yat tat sāmānyaṃ tadapi vidhīyate niya- myate yo'pi viśeṣaḥ so'pi vidhīyate niyamyate ceti

tad vyācaṣṭe'kṣarārthaṃ pradarśayan prakṛtipratyayārthābhyām — sāmānyaṃ bhāvaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ, tad darśayati --yat tat tena bhūyate sā sattā, bhū sattāyām pā॰ dhā॰ 1 iti pāṭhāt sāmānyam, tat kiṃ prakṛtyarthamātrameva ? na ityucyate, viśeṣo'pi pratyayārthaḥ sa tasyaiva bhavitṛtvavācipratyayārthatvāt sa eva prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayārtho'pītyuktaḥ

yo'sau bhavati kartṛvācipratyayārthaḥ sa viśeṣaḥ sāmānyamapi bhavati sattā bhāvaḥ bhavanātmakatvāt bhavanaṃ sāmānyamantareṇa tasyākartṛtvādabhavitṛtvāt sa eva pratyayārthaḥ prakṛtyarthānatikrameṇa vṛtta iti
viśeṣo'pi nivṛttiḥ paryāyo vyatireko dharmo'nyatvaṃ niyamo'bhāvaḥ
viśeṣo'pi nivṛttiḥ paryāyo vyatireko dharmo'nyatvaṃ niyamo'bhāvaḥ
pratisvaṃ ghaṭādi mṛdādi kāraṇamapekṣate nirviśeṣatve...iti svāvayavabhedeṣu sadasattvena vṛttiḥ
kaṇṭhaḥ svātmanā bhavati na kapālādyātmanā kapālāni svātmanā bhavanti na kaṇṭhādyātmanā iti svāvayavabhedeṣu sadasattvena vṛttiḥ

syānmatam--vidhividhinayamatavadekatvāpattiḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayoriṣṭā, saiṣā tvaduktanyāyenaivaṃ tvekatvāpattirapīti sā mā bhūt iti sarvavikalpabhāvaikatvavyudāsena viśeṣalakṣaṇamanayoḥ paryāyādibhirvibhaktaṃ vaktukāma āha --sāmānyaṃ pravṛttirityādi yāvad vidhirbhāva iti tathā viśeṣo'pītyādi yāvad niyamo'bhāva iti dvāvetau bhāvābhāvau paryāyabhedāt
