etadubhayaṃ pūrvavad vidhividhyaravikalpapuruṣādivādavat ekamevedam ityevaṃvidhaṃ bhāvamanāpadyamānaṃ sāmānyamapi sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaśca bhavataḥ viśeṣo'pi viśeṣaḥ sāmānyaṃ ca bhavata iti
tad darśayati --pravṛttau nivṛttirityādi, ubhayamanyonyāvinābhāvi bhāvo vastvityarthaḥ
bhāvābhāvarūpaṃ bhavanaṃ sad vastu, tasya sato bhāvaḥ sattā, yat satā bhūyate satataniyameneti prakṛtipratyayārthayorubhayorubhayaṃ niyamo vidhiśca
tāveva darśayati yena iti pratyayārthaṃ yathā iti prakṛtyarthaṃ ca, yena hītyādi kartrā kriyāyāṃ niyatena niyatāyāṃ bhavanamāha

yadi a ?syetyādi anyathāniṣṭāpādanaṃ yāvat khapuṣpavaditi bhavananiyamena ātmalābho bhavata uktaḥ, tataścāvaraṇena bhavitṛniyamena bhavanātmalābha ityetadubhayamubhayatra vidhirniyamaśceti sāmānyenoktam
dravyato ghaṭo bhavannātmānuvṛttyā paṭādivyāvṛttyā ghaṭāntaravyāvṛttyā ca bhāvābhāvātmabhyāṃ bhavati
kṣetrato gṛhe ghaṭo na bahirna maṃnaya ? iti svakṣetre bhavan parakṣetre kṣetrāntare cābhavan bhavati

kālato vartamāne kāle bhavannatītānāgatayoḥ kālāntarayorabhavan śivakastūpakādibhiḥ pūrvairuttaraiśca kapālādibhirabhavan śivakāvasthāyāmeva vā piṇḍastūpakābhyāṃ pūrvottarābhyāmabhavan śivakatvena bhavan bhavati ityucyate

athavā bhāvataḥ śivakādibhirākārairdharmairvartamānairyurayu ?gapadbhāvibhiryugapadbhāvibhiśca rūparasādibhirbhavan bhāvāntarairupayogādibhiścābhavan bhavatīti sadasattvam, evaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ bhāvā-'bhāvātmakatvam
atra maṇḍape iti pāṭhaḥ syāt, madhye iti vā bhavet ?
tadabhāve na bhavati bhāvābhāvabhāva eva ca bhavati
tathā ghaṭapaṭādidravyakṣetrakālabhāvabhāvābhāvasattāyā ghaṭasāmastye'pi na kaścid viśeṣaḥ, vastutvāt, asāmastyavat
tathā ghaṭastāvadastyeva kriyāguṇavyapadeśavattvāt paṭarathavat, sarvasarvasamavāyāsattvād yogyasyaiva yogyeṣu samavāyāt, yathā rūpe ghaṭaḥ, tathā rasādiṣvapi bhāvanīyaṃ

pratisvaṃ ghaṭādi mṛdādi kāraṇamapekṣate, ādigrahaṇāt paṭādi tantvādyapekṣate, nirviśeṣatva iti kāraṇāntarānapekṣatvāt svakāraṇāpekṣatvācca bhāvābhāvatvenāviśeṣaḥ, kaṇṭhaḥ svenātmanā bhavati kapālādyātmanā na bhavati, kapālāni svātmanā bhavanti na kaṇṭhādyātmaneti bhāvābhāvādyātmanā parasparataścāsatsu satsu ca bhedaṃ bhedaṃ prati vṛttatvāt iti svāvayavabhedeṣu sadasattvena vṛttiḥ
tasyārthasya bhāvanā --tadbhāvābhāvātmako ghaṭa iti tadabhāve na bhavati bhāvābhāvābhāve na bhavati bhāvābhāvabhāva eva ca bhavati tadbhāva eva bhavatītyarthaḥ
aśuddho'yaṃ khaṇḍito vā pāṭha iti bhāti
prativastu pravṛtteḥ vastuni vastuni vṛttiḥ ? pratipattivad vastupravṛtteḥ vastunivṛttiḥ ?
etasyaivārthasya bhāvanārthaṃ sādhanamāha --tathā ghaṭapaṭādidravyakṣetrakālabhāvabhāvābhāvasattāyā ghaṭasāmastye'pi na kaścid viśeṣa iti pratijñā
yathaivetyādi cāturvidhyena dṛṣṭāntavarṇanā gatārthā yāvad guṇāvṛttyanāvṛttibhedeṣviti
tatraikaguṇasattvaṃ dviguṇāsattvam, dviguṇasattvamekaguṇāsattvam, śuklasattvaṃ kṛṣṇāsattvam, kṛṣṇasattvaṃ śuklāsattvamityādi
bhāvābhāvātmakatvāviśeṣe sāmastyāsāmastyaviśeṣaḥ ka iti cet, ucyate --vivakṣayā vaiṣa viśeṣa ubhayorapi sāmastyāsāmastyayoḥ

kasmāt ? tattvāt, tadbhāvastattvaṃ bhāvābhāvatvam, tasmāt tattvāt bhāvābhāvatvād vivakṣāviśeṣādevaiṣa viśeṣaḥ samasto ghaṭaḥ, asamastaḥ kaṇṭhakapālādiḥ ityādi prāguktaṃ cāturātmyam, sakalādeśavaśād vikalādeśavaśācca pratipādanopāyatvāt evaṃ bhāvābhāvātmakatvaṃ sarvasya sakalādeśena bhāvitam, vikalādeśena pratyekaṃ bhāvayiṣyāmaḥ
tatra bhāvātmakatvaṃ tāvat --tathā ghaṭastāvadastyeva kriyāguṇavyapadeśavattvāt, udakādyāharaṇaṃ kriyā, guṇo rūpādi, vyapadeśo liṅgaṃ heturapadeśaḥ liṅgam ityādiśabdo vā

vaidharmyeṇa sarvasarvasamavāyāsattvāditi bhāvanāhetuḥ, na hi sarvaṃ sarvatra samavaiti tantuṣu ghaṭaḥ kapāleṣu vā paṭaḥ, tasmāt sarvasarvasamavāyāsattvād yogyasyaiva yogyeṣu samavāyāt pratyekaṃ sattvāt
atha punarevaṃ na syāt tato'sāvasannevāpadyeta sikatāsviva tailam
na ca tathā sthitau ghaṭo na bhavati, rūparasayorghaṭabhāvāt
tathā ca ekabhavanātmakatvāt ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat tadviśeṣa eva viśeṣo nābhāvaḥ pṛthivīsāmānye satyeva ūrddhatvavistṛtatvādiḥ

astyeva iti vartate, yathā rūpe ghaṭaḥ guṇasamudāyavādadarśanena, rūpaṃ vā iti guṇamātravāde tadādhāro vā ityavayavivāde yathā rūpe ghaṭo'styeva ityādi tathā rasādiṣvapi bhāvanīyamekaikasmin vṛttatvāt
atha punarevaṃ na syāt tato'sāvasannevāpadyeta sikatāsviva tailam
na ca tathā sthitau ghaṭo na bhavati, rūparasayorghaṭabhāvāt
tathā ca ekabhavanātmakatvāt ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat tadviśeṣa eva viśeṣo nābhāvaḥ pṛthivīsāmānye satyeva ūrddhatvavistṛtatvādiḥ
nanu ghaṭaviśeṣā rūpādayo yathā bhāvaviśeṣaḥ tathā pṛthivyapi mṛdādiḥ itarathā nirmūlatvāt
tathā ca rūpādayo mṛdādayaśca ghaṭasya pṛthivyāśca bhāvaviśeṣa eva ekabhavanātmakatvād ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat
na caivamaviśeṣaḥ, tadviśeṣa eva pṛthivīsāmānye satyeva urddhatvavistṛtatvādiḥ etādṛśamapi mūlamatra syāt

atha punarevaṃ na syāt paṭarathādisādharmyeṇa khapuṣpavailakṣaṇyena vaikaikasmiṃstileṣviva tailaṃ tato'sāvasannevāpadyeta, kimiva ? sikatāsviva avidyamānaṃ yathā sikatāsu pratyekaṃ samudāye'pi tailaṃ nāstyeva tathā ghaṭo rūpādāvekaikasminnasattvādasannāpadyeta, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
evaṃ sāmastyena ghaṭādyastitvaṃ rūpādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ sattvāt, itarathā rūpavad raso'pi rūpaṃ syāt svarūpāsattvāt, na ca rūpavad raso'pi rūpaṃ bhavati rūpaṃ vā rasavad raso bhavati dṛṣṭaviruddhatvāt
yasmād rūpameva rūpaṃ rasa eva raso bhavati netarabhāvamāpadyate tasmādrūpādayaḥ santi
evaṃ tarhi rūpādimātratvād na ghaṭa iti syādāśaṅkā, sā mā bhūt, na ca tathā sthitau ghaṭo na bhavati

yathā parasparavyāvṛttātmatve satyapi rūpādayo bhavantīti sthitiḥ, tathā sthitau evaṃ sthite tathā ghaṭo'pi bhavati, na na bhavati, rūparasayorghaṭabhāvāt tayoritaretarābhūtayoreva ghaṭatvāt tayorādhārabhūtayorvā ghaṭatvāt
tadupanayati --asāmastyena vā bhāvābhāvātmaka eva ghaṭa iti
nanu ghaṭetyādi vaiśeṣiko viśeṣaṃ bhāvātmakameva vāñchan vyāvṛttyātmakaṃ viśeṣaṃ nirākurvannāha

yathā rūpādiṣvādhāreṣu ghaṭo bhavati rūpādaya eva vā siddhāntāntaradarśanena ghaṭo na nirmūlastathā pṛthivyapi mṛdādiḥ mṛdaśma-sikatā-loṣṭa-vajra-vṛkṣa-gulma-latā-'vatāna-vīrudādiṣu tadātmikā, tasyā eva te viśeṣā rūpādaya iva ghaṭasya nābhāvo viśeṣaḥ, itarathā nirmūlatvādabhāvaviśeṣatve ghaṭasya rūpādīnāṃ cāsattvamāpannaṃ khapuṣpavat, na ca tadiṣṭam
evaṃ nyāyād rūpādayo mṛdādayaśca ghaṭasya pṛthivyāśca viśeṣo bhāva ityuktam
ekabhavanātmakatvāditi hetuḥ ekameva bhavanamekasyaiva vā bhavanamātmā'sya iti vigrahaḥ, yadekabhavanātmakaṃ tad nābhāvaviśeṣaḥ
dṛṣṭāntaḥ — ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat, yathā ghaṭa eva ghaṭasvātmā, nānyat khapuṣpādyasat
syānmatam--aviśeṣastarhi prāpta naikabhavanātmakatvaṃ pṛthivībhūterapi, tasyā api bhāvābhāvātmakatvāt
nanu dravyamapi guṇaḥ iti na bhavati
yadi sat ityeva bhavati kena viśeṣahetunā sadeva sarvam iti bhavati, na dravyameva iti ? yatastu...
yadyevam, tarhi bhavati ityukte'pi na bhavati nārthaḥ ityevoktaṃ bhavati ekabhavanātmakatvād mṛdādirūpādīnāṃ ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat, aniṣṭaṃ caitaditi
atrocyate --na caivamaviśeṣaḥ, ghaṭasvātmana eva deśakālarūpādiviśeṣavadātmanyeva bhāvaviśeṣadarśanāt
ko'sau pṛthivyādiviśeṣa iti cet, ucyate --pṛthivīsāmānye satyeva ūrddhatvavistṛtatvādiviśeṣo nābhāvaḥ, tathā ghaṭo'pi mṛdekabhavanātmakākāraviśeṣo bhāva eva na paṭādyabhāva iti
nanu dravyamapi guṇaḥ iti na bhavati
yadi sat ityeva bhavati kena viśeṣahetunā sadeva sarvam iti bhavati, na dravyameva iti ? yatastu...
yadyevam, tarhi bhavati ityukte'pi na bhavati nārthaḥ ityevoktaṃ bhavati
atrācārya āha--tvadabhimataṃ naikabhavanātmakatvaṃ pṛthivībhūterapi, kuto ghaṭaghaṭasvātmanaḥ ? kasmāt tasyā api pṛthivībhūteḥ bhūmibhavanasya bhāvābhāvātmakatvāt

tannidarśayati --nanvityādi, pṛthivībhavanamudakāgnyādyabhavanam, etadevāsya mūlamabhāvaviśeṣabhavanam, tanmūlatvāt kimityasyāsattvāpattiḥ ? evamabhāvaviśeṣarahitabhāvaviśeṣasiddhau māṃ prati na kiñcid nidarśanamastītyabhiprāyaḥ

para āha --na, uktopanyāsavad dravyam iti bhavanāt, pṛthivī dravyabhavanāvinābhāvenaiva bhavati, pṛthivyudakādi pṛthivyudakādiṣu vā dravyam, itarathā nirmūlatvādityādiḥ sa eva grantho yathāyogaṃ vācyaḥ
atrottaram --nanu dravyamapi guṇaḥ iti na bhavatītyabhāvāvinābhāvibhavanavacanam
na, sat iti bhavanāditi sattvabhavanavyāptyā bhāvasyaiva viśeṣa iti pūrvavat

yadi sat ityeva bhavati sattvāviśeṣād dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmavyatirekāt paryāyamātratve kena viśeṣahetunā sadeva sarvam iti bhavati, na dravyameva iti ? dṛṣṭaṃ cedam, dravyameva na bhavati, guṇakarmaṇorapi sadbhāvāt
guṇakarmābhāvād dravyaṃ saditi bhavati, guṇakarmaṇī ca tadabhāvāt satī bhavataḥ
na ca dravyādivyatirekeṇa sad nāma kiñcidasti ityuktatvād dṛṣṭaviruddhamucyate tvayeti
atra vayaṃ brūmaḥ --yatastvityādi caṭakamarkaṭikayā abhāvāvinābhāvibhāvapratipādanaṃ yathā tantuṣu paṭa iti gatārtham

evaṃ tāvad bhāvaikāntapakṣavyāvartanadvāreṇābhāvasahito bhāva uktaḥ, ataḥ paramabhāvaikāntapakṣavyāvartana- dvāreṇa bhāvasahita evābhāva ityetat pratipādayiṣyate --yadyevamityādi abhāvaikāntavādinaṃ bhāvaikāntavādī parito bhavanābhāvāt khapuṣpavat
...asattvaṃ pakṣadharmo'narthatvaikānte, paṭaḥ kaṭādirna bhavati nāpi rūpādiḥ
kaṭo'pi kaṭa iti bhavanneva ghaṭapaṭau na bhavati
nanu guṇo'pi guṇaḥ iti bhavanneva kaṭapaṭau na bhavati
na, vyavasthitopakārisvarūpatvāt, upālabhate, yadi ghaṭo bhavati ityukte'pyabhāva evokto bhavati paṭo na bhavati iti tarhi bhavati ityukte'pi na bhavati nārthaḥ ityevoktaṃ bhavatīti prāptam

syānmatam --nanu paritaḥ paṭādāvabhavanneva kaṭaḥ sidhyati, tasmādanaikāntika iti cet, na, vipakṣābhāvāt, nanu paritovacanenetyādi, paritovacanaṃ sarvatrārtham, tena svātmano'pyabhavanamuktaṃ bhavati, tasmād nānaikāntikatā

tathetyādirasya nyāyasya prāptipradarśanārtho daṇḍako yāvadasattvaṃ pakṣadharmo'narthaṃtvaikānta iti prāgvyākhyāto'rthaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ kapāle nāstītyādi, tasya nidarśanam paṭaḥ kaṭādirna bhavati nāpi rūpādiriti, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
...asattvaṃ pakṣadharmo'narthatvaikānte, paṭaḥ kaṭādirna bhavati nāpi rūpādiḥ
kaṭo'pi kaṭa iti bhavanneva ghaṭapaṭau na bhavati
nanu guṇo'pi guṇaḥ iti bhavanneva kaṭapaṭau na bhavati
nanvevaṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ parasparāvabaddhatve'vyavasthitasvarūpatvādanavasthā syāt parasparāvabaddhanaudvayavat ityāśayo bhāti
raṃ॰hī॰ vinānyatra iti na tarhi pā॰ ḍe॰ vi॰

atra bhāvābhāvavādī uttaramāha --nanu parito'pyabhavanameva tvaduktaṃ sādhayati asmadiṣṭaṃ bhāvamapi, tadyathā --kaṭo'pi kaṭa iti bhavanneva ghaṭapaṭau na bhavati, ghaṭatvapaṭatvādyabhāvaḥ kaṭasya kaṭātmabhavanāvinābhāvīti bhāvabhavanād na mucyate
itara āha--bhavan na, guṇa ityabhavanāt, atrāpi guṇābhāvānuviddha eva kaṭabhāvaḥ guṇatvenābhavanāt
nanu guṇo'pītyādi guṇa iti vidhinā bhavanneva kaṭa iti na bhavati viśeṣeṇa niyamena vyāvṛttyeti
itara āha --na, dravyam ityabhavanāt, atrāpi dravyābhāvānuviddhastvadabhimato guṇabhāva iti
atrocyate --yadi na bhavatyevetyādi caṭakamarkaṭikayā dravyaguṇayorbhāvābhāvatvamāpādya kaṭāderdravyaviśeṣasyāpādayati gatapratyāgatanyāyena, tato ghaṭasyāpi yāvad ghaṭa iti bhavatīti
evameva bhāvābhāvavādinaṃ pratyapi tadviparyayeṇetarabhāvanayā ekāntavādināṃ vidhyādinayānāṃ mateṣu parihāraḥ kāryaḥ
athavā taccodyasyātrāvakāśa eva nāsti, tenāpi ubhayobhayanayena sarvaikāntavādināṃ sunivartitatvāt sakalavikalādeśābhyāṃ bhāvābhāvatvasiddheriti
nanvevamityādi idamapyanyaccodyaṃ vikalādeśapakṣe ubhayobhayavādinaṃ pratyaniṣṭāpādanaṃ sādhanena gatārthaṃ dhṛtyādivṛttajagadavasthāvat
pṛthivyādīnāmanityatve'pi arthabhavanāvicchedād vyavasthitopakāritvaṃ siddhamanavasthānābhāvaśca svatvaparatvābhyāṃ tathā bhāvābhāvayoḥ
yadi tu bhāvābhāvayorna parasparāvabaddhatvaṃ tataḥ paṭasyābhāve ghaṭabhāvābhāvaḥ bhāva eva abhāvatulyatvāt, paṭavat
yadi tvasau paṭaḥ paṭatvadravyatvābhyāṃ na bhavet, na paṭo bhavet, paṭatvadravyatvābhyāma- yāvat parasparāvabaddhanaudvayavaditi pūrvapakṣaḥ

nityatve pṛthivyādīnāṃ vyavasthitatvaṃ parasparopakāritvaṃ ca dhṛtisaṅgrahapaktivyūhāvakāśadānakriyābhiḥ siddham, tato'navasthā naivāstītyatra kā cintā ? kintu anityatve'pyarthabhavanāvicchedāt satatabhavanasyāvicchedād bhāve vyavasthitopakāritvasya dhṛtyā bhūmiritareṣāmātmanaścopakurute jalaṃ saṅgraheṇa agniḥ paktyā vāyurvyūhena sarveṣāmavakāśadānādākāśamityavasthitopakārisvarūpatvaṃ siddhamanavasthānābhāvaśca, akṣarārtho bhāṣye gamitaḥ, svatvaparatvābhyāmiti svarūpasiddhau pararūpasiddhau ca teṣāṃ parasparāvabaddhatve satyapyanavasthā nāsti, tathā bhāvābhāvayoriti, yo'sau bhavati ghaṭaḥ sa paṭo na bhavati, yadasau paṭo bhavati tad ghaṭo na bhavati, ghaṭo bhavanneva paṭo na bhavati, paṭo bhavanneva ghaṭo na bhavati, tathā bhavati na bhavati cetyapi jñeyam, parasparāvabaddhavyavasthitopakārisvarūpatvād nānavastheti
pṛthivyādīnāmanityatve'pi arthabhavanāvicchedād vyavasthitopakāritvaṃ siddhamanavasthānābhāvaśca svatvaparatvābhyāṃ tathā bhāvābhāvayoḥ
yadi tu bhāvābhāvayorna parasparāvabaddhatvaṃ tataḥ paṭasyābhāve ghaṭabhāvābhāvaḥ bhāva eva abhāvatulyatvāt, paṭavat
yadi tvasau paṭaḥ paṭatvadravyatvābhyāṃ na bhavet, na paṭo bhavet, paṭatvadravyatvābhyāma-
paṭasyābhāve ghaṭabhāvābhāvastvadiṣṭavighātyāpadyate, ko'sau ? bhāva eva, kasmāt ? abhāvatulyatvāt paṭavadityabhāvaikāntapakṣe doṣaḥ
atra nayacakravṛttau ko'sau bhāva eva iti pāṭhasya ko'sau bhāva eva ? na kaścidapi bhāvaḥ ityabhiprāyaśced vivakṣitastadā mūle'pi paṭasyābhāve ghaṭabhāvābhāvaḥ, abhāvatulyatvāt, paṭavat

evamantaritadravyatvasattvādiguṇatvādisāmānyaviśeṣābhyāṃ bhāvābhāvātmakatā, nāntaritābhyāmeva, kiṃ tarhi ? nanu tasya sākṣādevābhavanamubhayataḥ, sāmānyato dravyatvena svena viśeṣato'nyadravyatvena paṭagatena guṇatvena ca ghaṭasyābhavanāt, tathā tadviparyayeṇa paṭasya, paṭaghaṭagatayośca dravyatvayorbhedāt tadbhedavat tadvyatiriktadravyatvasyābhāvāt
nanvata evedamityādinā bhāvayati yāvad dravyāditvena ceti
ghaṭo guṇatvena paṭadravyāditvena ca sākṣānna bhavati ghaṭadravyatvena bhavati, paṭaḥ paṭadravyatvena sākṣād bhavati guṇatvena ghaṭadravyatvena ca sākṣānna bhavatīti bhāvābhāvātmakatvamevānayoḥ
yadi tvasāvityādi aniṣṭāpādanasādhanamabhyupagame, yadi paṭaḥ paṭatvadravyatvābhyāṃ na bhavet, na paṭo bhavanāt, ghaṭavad guṇavadvā
bhavet paṭatvadravyatvābhyāmabhavanāt ghaṭavad guṇavadvā, ghaṭo guṇo vā naiva na bhavet tata eva tadvat
etasyārthasya bhāvanā --yatastvityādi yāvat tata evetarābhyāṃ bhavatīti
tadyathā nīlotpalādivat, siddhe sati ārambho niyamārthaḥ, yathā raktanīlatvayoḥ siddhayoranyatarābhāvenānyatarabhāvena cotpalaṃ niyamyate raktameva, nīlameva vā iti tathā ghaṭaḥ paṭa iti veti

atha dāhaḥ sarvatra, kasmānnādāhaḥ ? ato na dāhaḥ
na śuklaḥ kṛṣṇībhavati, ubhayorbhinnakālāvasthatvāt pratyutpannaviṣaye nivṛttaparyāyānabhisambandhāt

bhāvato'saṃyata ityādi, anādikālasambaddhadarśanacāritramohanīyodayajāyā avirateḥ pṛthagbhāvaḥ pravrajyā prakarṣavrajanaṃ viratiḥ, sā kathamasaṃyate ghaṭate ? evameveti ekasya bhāvābhāvātmakatvādhikārānuvṛttyā bhāvataḥ siddha-bhavyakālabhedādayuktamityudāharati
yata uktaṃ nayavidbhiḥ ṛjusūtrasvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ kurvadbhiḥ--palālaṃ na dahatyagnirbhidyate na ghaṭaḥ kvacit
na śūnyānnirgamo'stīha na ca śūnyaṃ praviśyate
tathā ca nayavidbhiḥ ṛjusūtranayanirūpaṇaṃ kurvadbhiridamuktam--palālaṃ na dahatyagnirbhidyate na ghaṭaḥ kvacit
nāśūnye na śūnyād ? niṣkramo'stīha na ca śūnyaṃ praviśyate
ṛju vartamānasamayaṃ vastu svarūpāvasthitatvāt, tadeva sūtrayati paricchinatti nātītānāgatam, tasyāsattvena kuṭilatvāt
tasya vacanaṃ padaṃ vākyaṃ vā, tasya vicchedo'ntaḥ sīmeti yāvat
tasya ca pūrvāparaparyāyairvivikte ekaparyāya eva prarūpayato vacanaṃ vicchidyate ekaparyāyasya paraparyāyāsaṃsparśāt
uktaṃ ca tanmatamarthaṃ prarūpayadbhiḥ--palālaṃ na dahatyagnirdahyate na giriḥ kvacit
palālaparyāyasya agnisadbhāvaparyāyādatyantabhinnatvāt yaḥ yaḥ palālo nāsau dahyate yaśca bhasmabhāvamanubhavati nāsau palālaparyāya iti
"tatra ṛjusūtraḥ kuṭilātītānāgataparihāreṇa vartamānakṣaṇāvacchinnavastusattāmātram ṛju sūtrayati anyato vyavacchinatti sūtrapātavat
yadi syātāmatītānāgate na tarhi mṛtaputrikā yuvatiḥ putrakamuddiśya rudyāt na ca putrārthinī yoṣit aupayājikādi viśiṣṭadevatāsannidhau vidadhyāt

taddhi vastu vartamānakṣaṇāvasthāyyeva, na jātucit tataḥ paraṃ sattāmanubhavati, nāpi atītakālāsāditātmalābhaṃ kiñcit tatrānveti, svakāraṇakalāpasāmagrīsannidhāvutpadya svarasabhaṅguratāmavalambante tatkṣaṇamātrāvalambinaḥ sarvasaṃskārāḥ

evaṃ ca sati ya ete kartṛbhūtadravyaśabdasannidhau kriyāśabdāḥ prayujyante yathā devadattaḥ pacati paṭhati gacchatīti karmabhūtadravyaśabdasannidhau vā yathā ghaṭo bhidyate ghaṭaṃ vā bhinattityevamādayo na yathārthāḥ
katham ? yato nāmaśabdena avikṛtarūpasya dravyasyābhidhānāt kriyāśabdena ca vikārasya pratipādyatvāt, na ca vikārāvikārayoraikādhikaraṇyamasti viruddhatvāt
arthapratyāyanāya hi prayuktaḥ śabdo viruddhamarthaṃ pratipādayan naiva samyagjñānamādhatte, ayathārthatvāt, mṛgatṛṣṇāyāṃ salilaśabdavaditi
uktārthasaṃvādī ca śloko gītaḥ purāvidā--palālaṃ na dahatyagnirbhidyate na ghaṭaḥ kvacit
palālaṃ dahyata iti yad vyavahārasya vākyaṃ tad virudhyate
atravākye vākyārthapratipattaye padārthapravibhāgakāle palālaśabdo viśiṣṭākāradravyavacano nāmaśabdaḥ, taddhi dravyaṃ yāvat tasminnevākāre vartate tāvadeva palālaśabdavācyam
anyadā tu palālabhāvena tasyābhāva eva, tadbhāvenābhāvāt, paṭavat

tasmāt sthirarūpamavyāpāramudāsīnamavikṛtaṃ palālaśabdena vastu pratipāditam, kathaṃ tadeva dahyate ityanena śabdenocyeta, kriyāśabdasya vikārābhidhāyitvāt ? na hi sa evārtho vikāraścāvikāraśca bhavitumutsahate
yadi hi tat palālaṃ na tarhi tadeva dahyate, avipariṇatatvāt, prāgavasthāvat
vipariṇamamānaṃ ca palālameva tanna bhavati, vipariṇāmaśabdasya bhāvāntaravācitvāt
tasmād yāvat tat palālaṃ tāvanna dahyate yadā dahyate tadā palālaṃ na bhavatītyato naitāvekasyārthasya pratyāyanāya samyagjñānopajanakāraṇam, śabdāntarāpattyasahiṣṇutvāt pramattagītāvetāviti
palālaṃ na dahatyagnirbhidyate na ghaṭaḥ kvacit
kaṣāyo bhaiṣajyam ityatra ca sañjātarasaḥ kaṣāyo bhaiṣajyam, na prāthamikakaṣāyo'lpo'nabhivyaktarasatvādasya viṣayaḥ
pacyamānaḥ pakvaḥ, pakvastu syāt pacyamānaḥ syāduparatapāka iti
tathā pratiṣṭhante'sminniti prasthaḥ, yadaiva mimīte, atītānāgatadhānyamānāsambhavāt
kumbhakārābhāvaḥ, śivakādiparyāyakaraṇe tadabhidhānābhāvāt, kumbhaparyāyasamaye ca svāvayavebhya eva nirvṛtteḥ
sthitapraśne ca kuto'dyāgacchasi iti ? na kutaścit ityayaṃ manyate tatkālakriyāpariṇāmābhāvāt
asya hi nayasyāvibhāgo vartamānasamayo viṣayaḥ agnisambandhanadīpanajvalanadahanāni asaṅkhyeyasamayāntarālāni yato'sya dahanābhāvaḥ
kiñca, yasmin samaye dāhaḥ na tasmin palālam bhasmatābhinirvṛtteḥ, yasmiṃśca palālaṃ na tasmin dāha iti
yat palālaṃ tad dahatīti cet, na, sāvaśeṣāt
samudāyābhidhāyināṃ śabdānāmavayaveṣu vṛttidarśanādadoṣa iti cet, na, tadavasthatvāt, ekadeśadāhābhāvasyoktatvāt

yadi sa kumbha eva mṛdavasthāyām, na kriyate, bhūtatvāt, anyamṛdvat
athābhūtaḥ, na kriyate saḥ, abhūtatvāt, khapuṣpavat

athavaikamevodāharaṇaṃ dravyādicaturvidhatvaṃ yojayati ityāha --kumbhaṃ karoti ityādāvapyāha, mṛnmardanakāle'pyāha kumbhaṃ karomi iti kumbhakāraḥ, apiśabdāt karaṇakāle nirvṛttyuttarakāle ca kṛtaḥ kumbha iti
na tathā ghaṭate, yathā loko vadati iti vartate
yadi sa kumbha evānirvṛtto'pi mṛdavasthāyām, na kriyate, bhūtatvāt, yad bhūtaṃ tanna kriyate, yathā anyā mṛt
athābhūtaḥ kriyata iti manyase, na kriyate saḥ, abhūtatvāt, khapuṣpavat
athocyeta--satyam, prāgabhūtaḥ, idānīṃ kriyate, kriyamāṇaśca bhavatīti
atrāpi yadyabhūto na tarhi kumbhaḥ sa kriyate, bhūtatve'pi kṛtakaraṇavaiyarthyānna kriyate
athābhūto'pi kumbha ucyate, pṛthivyapi te kumbha iti prāptā
kathaṃ tarhi so'kriyamāṇaḥ kumbho jātaḥ ? ko vā bravīti jātaḥ iti, dravyādito janmavināśasamatvāt ? sa na jāyate iti kiṃ śakyo vaktum ? om,
athocyeta pakṣadvayānāśrayaṇena parihārasamarthaṃ matvā pakṣāntaraṃ saṃśritya satyaṃ prāgabhūta idānīṃ kriyate, kriyamāṇaśca bhavatīti
atrāpi bhūtābhūtatvavikalpadvayānativṛttiḥ, yadyabhūto na tarhi kumbhaḥ saḥ, paṭādivat kumbhatvenābhūtatvād na kriyate nāpi kumbhaḥ iti vaktavyaḥ
bhūtatve'pi paṭādivacca sānnidhye kṛtakaraṇavaiyarthyād na kriyate
athābhūto'pi piṇḍādiḥ svapakṣe rāgād lokānuvṛttyā vā kumbha ucyate pṛthivyapi te kumbha iti prāptā kumbhatvenābhūtatvāt tvadiṣṭakriyamāṇakumbhavat
tad bhāvayati --na ca kasyāñcidapyavasthāyāmityādi yāvat kriyeti
dravyataḥ sarvapradeśātmakasya paramāṇumātre'varuddhatvānna kriyā, dravyāntare tvabhāvādabhāvaḥ

kṣetrato budhnamadhyordhvādibhāgāvaṣṭabdhakṣetravāditvāt katamo ghaṭaḥ kriyate ? kālataḥ pratikṣaṇamanyānyapradeśaspandāvarodhāt, bhāvataḥ sarvasaṃsthānarūpādisamāhārātmakatve ghaṭasya bhāvaṃ bhāvaṃ prati pṛthaktvāt kā kriyā ? yasmāt kriyamāṇameva tu kriyate mṛdāharaṇādīti caturdhāpyetadudāharaṇam
apara āha --kathaṃ tarhi so'kriyamāṇaḥ kumbho jātaḥ, kriyāyā abhāvādakriyamāṇo'kriya- māṇatvāt kumbho jāyate khapuṣpavaditi prāptam, aniṣṭaṃ caitat, lokaprasiddhyuparodhitvāditi

atrocyate — ko vā bravīti jātaḥ iti ? ahaṃ tu lokamevāyuktavādinaṃ manye, dravyādito janmavināśasamatvāt, ya eva jātaḥ sa eva vinaṣṭo yatraiva tatraiva yadaiva tadaiva yathaiva tathaiveti bhāvābhāvayorbhāvo bhavanam, sa eva bhāvābhāvabhāvo vastu sadasadātmakabhavanam, vastutvāt pūrvābhāva eva bhāvo'sya piṇḍādeḥ, pūrvabhāvasyābhāvo vināśaḥ, sa eva uttarottaro bhāvo janma iti janmavināśayorlakṣaṇam, tayostulyatvād dravyāditaḥ
sa bhāvābhāvātmako'rtho na jāyata iti kiṃ śakyo vaktum ? iti
omityucyate, sa na jāyate iti vinaśyattvāt, pūrvavat
na vinaśyati ityapi śakyaṃ vaktuṃ jāyamānatvāduttaravat
etadudāharaṇaṃ nirvartyakarmaviṣayāsu vikāryakarmaviṣayāsu ca kriyāsu, sarvāsvapi tāsveṣaiva vārtā
dravyaśabdeṣvapi bhāvābhāvātmakatvāt sarvabhāvānāṃ kutaḥ tattvopanipāti vacanam ? bhrūkṣepādivattu svābhiprāyasūcanaṃ kṛtasaṅketānāṃ kriyate
kasmāt ? vinaśyattvāt, ghaṭāvasthā hi janma, sā vinaśyadavasthaiva uktanyāyāt, pūrvavaditi tvadiṣṭānantarāghaṭāvasthāvat
na vinaśyati ityapi śakyaṃ vaktuṃ jāyamānatvāduttaravat ghaṭāvasthāvaditi
atra ॰vādakriyamāṇatvāt kuto iti ॰vādakriyamāṇo'kriyamāṇatvāt kuto ityapi vā pāṭho'pi syāt
na vinaśyati ityapi śakyaṃ vaktuṃ jāyamānatvāduttaravat
etadudāharaṇaṃ nirvartyakarmaviṣayāsu vikāryakarmaviṣayāsu ca kriyāsu, sarvāsvapi tāsveṣaiva vārtā
dravyaśabdeṣvapi bhāvābhāvātmakatvāt sarvabhāvānāṃ kutaḥ tattvopanipāti vacanam ? bhrūkṣepādivattu svābhiprāyasūcanaṃ kṛtasaṅketānāṃ kriyate
etadudāharaṇaṃ nirvartyaghaṭādikarmaviṣayāsu karaṇapacanādikriyāsu, vikāryapalālādiviṣayāṣu ca dahanādikriyāsu, sarvāsvapi tāsveṣaiva vārtā--nāsti kācit kriyeti

grāmaṃ gacchati ityādiprāpyakarmikāsu kathamiti cet, prāpyakarmakriyāsvapi ca kāsuciditi gacchatipravrajatyādiṣu bhāvitam, kāsucit tu himavadādityaśravaṇadarśanādiṣu yadyapi naiṣā vārtā, śabdaghaṭaśravaṇadarśanādiṣveṣaiva vārtā

kiñca, kṛta-dagdhagatādiśabdaiśca ktapratyayāntairyāḥ kriyā ucyante tāsāṃ niṣṭhitatvād bhūtakālavihitatvācca ktasya kiñcinniṣṭhitaṃ kiñcidaniṣṭhitaṃ mṛtpalālādi karma iti kṛtākṛtatvānupapatteḥ sutarāṃ prayogābhāva iti suṣṭhūcyate --yathā loko vadati na tathā ghaṭata iti
nirvartyaṃ vā vikāryaṃ vā prāpyaṃ vā yat kriyāphalam
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 126 ṭi॰ 15, atra gacchativrajatyādiṣu ityapi pāṭhaḥ sambhavet
evaṃ manyate--yatra kaścit kriyākṛto viśeṣa upajāyate tannyāyyaṃ karmeti
na ceha kaścit kriyākṛto viśeṣa upajāyate
ihāpi na syāt--ādityaṃ paśyati, himavantaṃ śṛṇoti, grāmaṃ gacchati
iha mā bhūt--ādityaṃ paśyati, himavantaṃ śṛṇoti, grāmaṃ gacchatīti
evaṃ tāvadutpannaśabdānāṃ kriyāvācināmākhyātānāṃ nāmnāṃ pācakādīnāṃ śuklādiguṇaśabdānāṃ ca nirviṣayatā nirarthakatetyarthaḥ

dravyaśabdeṣvapītyādi yāvad vacanamiti sarvabhāvā bhāvābhāvātmakā ityuktaṃ vistarataḥ, tadvācyabhimatānāṃ śabdānāmuktanyāyena tadasaṃsparśāt kutaḥ tattvaṃ bhāvābhāvātmakaṃ vastūpanipatituṃ vacanasya śīlaṃ dharmaḥ sādhukāritā vā kasyacit ? iti
evaṃ tarhi śabdārthavyavahārahāniriti cet, na ityucyate, asti śabdārthasaṃvyavahāraḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñi atra cānyāpohaḥ śabdārthaḥ
āha hi--śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutiḥ abhidhatte ityucyate

bhrūkṣepādivattu akṣinikocaiḥ pāṇivihārairbhrūkṣepādibhiścāṅgavikāraiḥ svābhiprāyasūcanaṃ kṛtasaṅketānāṃ kriyate, abhipretārthaparyāyamātratvāt tāsāṃ kriyāṇām, tathā śabdasyāpi abhidheyābhimatārthaparyāyamātraparamārthatvāt tadarthapratipattyupāyaḥ śabdo bhrūkṣepādivat
na vācakaḥ śabdaḥ, puruṣāṇāṃ kṛtasaṅketānāṃ pratipattyupāyaḥ, akṛtasaṅketānāṃ tu śabdagaḍumātrasampratyayanimittatvāt
evaṃ vastuno bhāvābhāvātmakasyānirdeśyatvāt paramārthasyāvācakaḥ, saṃvṛtisatastu vyavahārasya vācaka ivopalakṣaṇabhūtaḥ śabdaḥ
āha hi--śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutiḥ abhidhatte ityucyate
uddyotakarastu pramāṇayati--devadattasya rūparasagandhasparśapratyayā ekānekanimittāḥ, mayeti pratyayena pratisandhīyamānatvāt, kṛtasamayānāmekasmin nartakībhrūkṣepe yugapadanekapuruṣāṇāṃ pratyayavat

asyāyamarthaḥ--yathā kila nartakībhrūbhaṅgānantaramasmābhirvastrāṇi prakṣeptavyāni ityevaṃ kṛtasamayānāṃ bahūnāṃ nānākartṛkāḥ nānābhūtāḥ pratyayāḥ nimittasya bhrūbhaṅgasyaikatvād mayā dṛṣṭo mayā dṛṣṭaḥ iti pratisandhīyante tathehāpi nānāviṣayāḥ pratyayā nimittasyaikatvāt pratisandhāsyante
antareṇa khalvapi śabdaprayogaṃ bahavo'rthā gamyante'kṣinikocaiḥ pāṇivihāraiśca
yadadhikṛtyāha vikalpayonayaḥ śabdā vikalpāḥ śabdayonayaḥ iti
vyākhyā-- yadadhikṛtyāhācāryaḥ--vikalpayonayaḥ vikalpakāraṇāḥ śabdāḥ vikalpāḥ śabdayonaya iti
vyākhyā-- yathoktaṃ bhadantadinnena--vikalpayonayaḥ śabdā vikalpāḥ śabdavikalpāḥ śabdayonaya ityādi
bauddhācāryadiṅgāgasyaiva bhadantadinnaḥ iti nāma iti dhyeyam, dṛśyatāṃ ṭi॰ 9
nayamatena vastusvarūpaṃ śabdārthasambandhaṃ cāvadhārya śabdārtho'dhunāvadhāryate --atra ca vidhiniyamavidhiniyamabhaṅge'nyāpohaḥ śabdārthaḥ
yasmādāha --śabdāntarārthetyādi, śabdādanye śabdāḥ śabdāntarāṇi, teṣāmarthānapohate ghaṭaśabdaḥ paṭādiśabdānāṃ svato'nyeṣāṃ vyavahārānupātāt
svārthe kurvatī śrutiḥ iti vacanena bhāvābhāvātmakamarthaṃ darśayati
abhidhatte ityucyata iti, na paramārthato'bhidhatte'rthātmano'nabhilāpyatvāt saṃjñāparamārthatvāt abhidhatte ivābhāti lakṣayan saṅketavaśādarthamiti eṣa padārthaḥ
śabdābhyāsavāsanājanitā'rtheṣu pratibhā vākyebhyo jāyate tiraścāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ca yathābhyāsaṃ svajātiniyatā svapratyayānukāreṇa śūra-kātarādīnāmiva ayamṛjusūtradeśatvāt paryāyāstikaḥ
bauddhamate apohaḥ śabdārthaḥ, pratibhā ca vākyārthaḥ iti vijñāyate, tathāhi--apohaḥ padārthatvena kalpitaḥ
dinnaḥdinnakaḥdattakaḥ iti ca diṅgāgasya nāmāntarāṇyapi santi
saṃskṛtabhāṣāyāṃ datta iti dattaka iti ca rūpam, tayoreva prākṛtabhāṣāyāṃ yathākramaṃ dinna iti dinnaka iti ca rūpaṃ bhavati
tatra prācīnajainaprantheṣu nayacakravṛttau pṛ॰ 63 paṃ॰ 5, pṛ॰ 96 paṃ॰ 6, pṛ॰ 545 ṭi॰ 1, anekāntajayapatākāvyākhyāyāṃ pṛ॰ 1
24 dattaka iti, anyatra ca bahuṣu sthāneṣu diṅgāga iti tridhāpi nāmanirdeśo dṛśyate
prācīneṣu cīnadeśīyagrantheṣu ca dinna iti dinnaka ityapi ca diṅgāgasya nāma upalabhyate, dṛśyatāṃ On Yuan-chwang's Travels in India by Thomas-watters, Part II.

tena ācāryadiṅgāgasyopari yad uddyotakareṇoktam--yadi śabdasyāpoho'bhidheyo'rthastadābhidheyārthavyatirekeṇāsya svārtho vaktavyaḥ, atha sa evāsya svārthastathāpi vyāhatametat anyaśabdārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatte ityucyate iti
asya hi vākyasyāyamarthastadānīṃ bhavati abhidadhānā abhidhatte iti nyā॰ vā॰ 2

na cānyāpohamātraṃ śabdārthaḥ, vidhinirapekṣasya vyatirekasyāprasiddheranvayasya ca vyatirekaśūnyasyānupalabdheḥ parasparāpekṣābhyāmanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ sarvatrārthādhigateḥ vyatirekasyaiva prādhānyam ityayuktam
tathā cāha dattakabhikṣureva--arthāntarāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutiḥ abhidhatte ityucyate
hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yathā vṛkṣaśabdo'vṛkṣaśabdanivṛttiṃ svārthe kurvan svārthaṃ vṛkṣalakṣaṇaṃ pratyāyayatītyucyate
evaṃ ca nivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ vastu śabdārthaḥ, na nivṛttimātram, alakṣaṇīyameva ca syānnivṛttimātram, avastutvāt, kharaviṣāṇakuṇṭhatīkṣṇatādivarṇanavat
atra ca na prāg vidhinā ghaṭaṃ gṛhītvā paścādanyāpohaṃ karoti, nāpyanyāpohaṃ kṛtvā paścād ghaṭaṃ kālabhedena gṛhṇāti
krameṇa hi grahaṇe hrasiṣṭhatvāt kṣaṇikatvācca sarvabhāvānāṃ dhvanerjñānasya ca na yuktaṃ vyāpāradvayānuṣṭhānam
evaṃ tarhi ghaṭagrahaṇamanyāpohaśca yugapadubhayaṃ siddham, yathā saviturudaye santamasavidalanaṃ svarūpaprakāśanaṃ ca svabhāvāt
evaṃ sati ubhayamabhidheyaṃ sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaścetyavaśenāpi pratipattavyamanyāpohaśabdārthavādinā
anvayavyatirekayostulyakakṣatvād vidheyaubhaya ?mapi pradhānamevāstu, na hi dvayorarthayordhavakhadiravad yugapadupāttayorekasya guṇabhāvakalpanā śreyasī
nanu cānvayasya prādhānye'bhyupeyamāne prayatnānantarīyakatvamavyāptasapakṣaṃ sad naivānityatvaṃ gamayet

kena cedamuktaṃ vyāptasapakṣaṃ gamayati, avyāptasapakṣaṃ na gamayati iti ? etāvattu ucyate--anvayanirapekṣo na gamayati vyatirekaḥ, nāpi vyatirekanirapekṣo'nvayaḥ pratipādako'rthasya, parasparāpekṣatāyāṃ ca śibikodvāhakādivat sarvatra prādhānyaṃ kvacid vivakṣāvaśādvā anyatarasya guṇapradhānakalpaneti, yathāha dvādaśaśatikāyām-- yadapyuktam aprasaktasya kimarthaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ ? iti, naivaitat pratiṣedhamātramucyate, kintu tasya vastunaḥ kaścid bhāgo'rthāntaranivṛttyā loke gamyate yathā viṣāṇitvādanaśvaḥ iti
yathaiva sāmānyamucyate tathā viśeṣo'pītyubhayamatra mukhyaṃ vācyamityataḥ sāmānyaviśeṣātmakamevābhidheyam
sa eva cāyaṃ samānarūpapratibhāsī bhedo nirdiṣṭa ācāryadiṅgāgena
kathamityāha--arthāntaravyāvṛttyā tasya vastunaḥ kaścid bhāgo gamyata iti, tathā śabdo'rthāntaranivṛttiviśiṣṭāneva bhāvānāha ityādinā
ādigrahaṇāt śabdārthāntarāpohaṃ kurvatī śrutirabhidhatta ityādiparigrahaḥ pṛ॰ 251...ācāryadiṅgāga āha...
yadi vācyaḥ, anaikāntikaḥ śabdārthaḥ anyāpohaḥ śabdārthaḥ iti
yadi ca śabdasyāpoho nābhidheyārthaḥ, abhidheyārthavyatirekeṇa svārtho vaktavyaḥ
atha sa evāsya svārthaḥ tathāpi vyāhatam anyaśabdārthāpohaṃ svārthe kurvatī śrutiḥ abhidhatta ityucyate iti
"paramārthatastu vākyārtha eka eva, sarvo'pi śabdaḥ pratibhāyā eva heturiti tatsvarūpamidānīṃ prastāvayitumāha --abhyāsāt pratibhāhetuḥ sarvaḥ śabdo'paraiḥ smṛtaḥ
118 aparairācāryaiḥ sarvaḥ yaḥ kaścicchabdaḥ sa pratibhāhetuḥ jaḍānāmapi pratibhāheturityāha--bālānāmityādi
āstāṃ viditasamayasya kiṃ na bhaviṣyatyasau pratibhāhetuḥ
ye'pyaviditasaṅketā amī bālā jaḍaprāyā vā tiryañcaḥ teṣāmapyanādivāsanāvaśāt tadarthaḥ pratīyamāno dṛśyate śabdaḥ
tathā ca jaḍānāmapi prāṇināṃ niyatapadaḥ śabdaḥ sambodhanāyodīryate
tena pratiniyatajātyanusāreṇa niyataiva kācit pratibhā prabodhyate iti tanmūla eva sarvaḥ kaścit teṣāṃ vyavahāraḥ
anenaitaducyate yadiyaṃ pratibhā sarvaprāṇisaṃvedyā śabdanimittā sakalavyavahāramūlabhūtā'napahnavanīyā
tatrābhyāsaḥ kimidānīntana uta janmāntarabhāvī ? tasya ca kiṃ svarūpamityāśaṅkyāha --anāgamaśca so'bhyāsaḥ samayaḥ kaiścidiṣyate
sa cābhyāso'nāgama idānīntano na bhavati, na hi bālasya tadaivopadiṣṭaṃ kenacit, iti janmāntarabhāvyeva
sa ca samaya iṣyate saṅketasvarūpo'sāviṣyata iti svarūpamevāsya sphuṭayitumāha --anantaramidaṃ kāryamasmādityupadarśakaḥ
yathā kaśābhighātamātrasamanantarameva vājino'tiyānti aṅkuśābhighātena ca gajāḥ, evamanye'pi prāṇino'nādivāsanābhyāsavaśena pratibhātaḥ samucitavyavahāraṃ kurvanto lokayātrāṃ nirvāhayantīti sthitam
evamakhaṇḍameva vākyam, pratibhā ca vākyārtha iti samāśrayaṇīyam
144, devadattādipadebhyo vicchinnebhyastadarthānāṃ vicchedenaiva grahaṇe pratyayavelāyāmekā pratibhā padārthamativyatiriktaiva jāyate
anye tvāhuḥ--abhyāsāt pratibhāhetuḥ śabdo na tu bāhyārthapratyāyaka iti, darśayati--abhyāsādityādi
śabdasya kvacid viṣaye punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttidarśanamabhyāsaḥ
sā prayogadarśanāvṛttisahitena śabdena janyate, prativākyaṃ pratipuruṣaṃ ca sā bhidyate
sa tu tasyā aparimāṇo bhedaḥ śabdavyavahārasyānantyānna śakyate vidhātumityata āha --samāsata iti
atra dṛṣṭāntamāha-- bālānāṃ ca tiraścāṃ cetyādi

yathaiva hyaṅkuśābhighātādayo hastyādīnāmarthapratipattau kriyamāṇāyāṃ pratibhāhetavo bhavanti tathā sarve'rthavatsammatā vṛkṣādayaḥ śabdā yathābhyāsaṃ pratibhāmātropasaṃhārahetavo bhavanti, na tvarthaṃ sākṣāt pratipādayanti
anyathā hi kathaṃ parasparaparāhatāḥ pravacanabhedā utpādyakathāprabandhāśca svavikalpoparacitapadārthabhedadyotakāḥ syuriti

yathā hi khalu kaśāṅkuśābhighātādayo'nabhidhāyakā api vājigajādīnāmabhyāsāt svataḥ pravṛttinivṛttihetumarthapratibhāsāṃ pratibhāṃ bhāvayantaḥ pravartakā nivartakāśca tathā saṅkṣepataḥ sarvaḥ śabdo vyutpannānāmavyutpannānāṃ ceha janmanītyarthaḥ
ayaṃ ca prāgbhavīyo'bhyāso'vaśyābhyupeya ityatra dṛṣṭāntamāha--bālānāṃ ca tiraścāṃ ca yathā'rthapratipādane

sādhyasādhanetikartavyatāvacchinnāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pratipattāvanukūlāṃ tatpratipattyā kārye'nuṣṭhānalakṣaṇe kartavye sahakāriṇīṃ kartavyamiti prajñāṃ pratibhāmadhyagīṣmahi pṛ॰ 247 iti maṇḍanamiśraviracitavidhivivekasya vācaspatimiśrakṛtāyāṃ nyāyakaṇikāyāṃ vyākhyāyām
ayaṃ punarnayaḥ katamaḥ śāstravihitānāmiti cet, ṛjusūtradeśatvāt paryāyāstikaḥ
upanibandhanamapyasya ārṣam--ātā bhaṃte ! poggale, ṇo ātā ? gotamā ! siyā ātā nayasya śatadhā bhedābhyupagamādṛjusūtradeśo'yamṛjusūtrabhedaḥ, ekkekko ya satavidho satta ṇayasatā havaṃti evaṃ tu
bitiyo vi a ādeso paṃca ṇayasatā havaṃtevaṃ
ṛju praguṇaṃ sūtrayati tantrayata iti ṛjusūtraḥ, sūtrapātavadṛjusūtra iti vā
pari samantādeti gacchatiti paryāyaḥ, so'stīti matirasyeti paryāyāstikaḥ
upanibandhanamapyasya ārṣam--ātā bhaṃte ! poggale, ṇo ātā ? gotamā ! siyā ātā
ekkekko ya satavidho satta ṇayasatā havaṃti evaṃ tu
ekkekko ya satavidho paṃca nayasatā havaṃti evaṃ tu
bitio vi a ādeso satta ṇayasatā havaṃtevaṃ pra॰
atra ekkekko ya sayaviho satta ṇayasayā havaṃti evaṃ tu
aṇṇovi ya āeso paṃca sayā huṃti u nayāṇaṃ
iti pāṭho haribhadrasūrīṇāṃ malayagirisūrīṇāṃ cābhipreta iti āvaśyakaniryuktivyākhyāvalokanādavasīyate
tathāhi tadvyākhyā--anantaroktanaigamādinayānāmekaikaśca svabhedāpekṣayā śatavidhaḥ śatabhedaḥ, sapta nayaśatāni bhavanti evaṃ tu
anyo'pi cādeśaḥ pañca śatāni bhavanti tu nayānām, śabdādīnāmekatvāt ekaikasya ca śatavidhatvāditi hṛdayam
apiśabdāt ṣaṭ catvāri dve vā śate
tatra ṣaṭ śatāni naigamasya saṅgrahavyavahāradvaye praveśāt ekaikasya ca śatabhedatvāt
śatadvayaṃ tu naigamādīnāmṛjusūtraparyantānāṃ dravyāstikatvāt śabdādīnāṃ ca paryāyāstikatvāt tayośca śatabhedatvāditi gāthārthaḥ
jinabhadragaṇikṣamāśramaṇaviracite viśeṣāvaśyakabhāṣye tu ikkikko ya sayaviho satta nayasayā havaṃti emeva
annovi ya āeso paṃceva sayā nayāṇaṃ tu
bitio vi ya ādeso paṃca sayā
naṇu kimiti ? tinni vi saddanayā ego ceva, teṇa paṃca sayā, ṇegamasaṃgahavavahāraujjusuyasaddā ettha udāharaṇaṃ, ettha ekko u sayabheda iti paṃca sayā api
ṇegamo duviho saṃgahito ya asaṃgahito ya
saṃgahito saṃgahaṃ paviṭṭho, asaṃgahito vavahāraṃ paviṭṭho, ekkokko ya sayaviho, evaṃ cha ssayā
ahavā cattāri mūlanayā--negamo saṃgahito saṃgahaṃ paviṭṭho, asaṃgahito asaṃgahaṃ paviṭṭho, teṇa saṃgahavavahāraujjusuyasaddā cattāri ṇayā, te vibhajjamāṇā ekkekko sayaviho, evaṃ cattāri nayasatā
ahavā do mūlanayā--davvaṭṭhiyo ya pajjavaṭṭhiyo ya, ekkekko sayaviho evaṃ do ṇayasayā
udāharaṇaṃ--vāvahāriyaṇayasya kālato bhamaro, ṇecchatiyaṇayassa paṃcavanno jāva aṭṭhaphāso
ahavā do mūlaṇayā--appiyavavahārito ya aṇappiyavavahārito ya
udāharaṇaṃ--jīvo nārakatvenārpitaḥ jīvatvenānarpitaḥ, evaṃ tiryagmanuṣyadevatvenāpi bhāvyaḥ
bitiyo vi a ādeso paṃca ṇayasatā havaṃtevaṃ || āva॰ ni॰ 759
ṛju praguṇaṃ sūtrayati tantrayata iti ṛjusūtraḥ
yathā ṛjuḥ sūtrapātaḥ tathā ṛju praguṇaṃ sūtrayati tantrayati ṛjusūtraḥ
ṛju prāñjalaṃ vartamānaparyāyamātraṃ sūtrayati prarūpayati iti ṛjusūtraḥ
pari samantādityādinā paryāyāstikaśabdārthaṃ savyutpattiṃ svayameva vyācaṣṭe
pari samantādeti gacchatiti paryāyaḥ, so'stīti matirasyeti paryāyāstikaḥ
kimetāḥ svamanīṣikā ucyante, āhosvidasya nayasya nibandhanamastyārṣam ? iti, asti ityucyate, paramāṇupoggalāle, siyā ṇo ātā
se keṇaṭṭheṇa bhaṃte ! evaṃ vuccati--siyā ātā paramāṇupoggale siyā ṇo ātā ? gotamā ! appaṇo ādiṭṭhe ātā parassa ādiṭṭhe ṇo ātā bhagavatīsū॰ 12
pudgalānāmātmā svarūpaṃ no ātmā pararūpamiti bhāvābhāvau vidhiniyamāviti praśno gautamasya indrabhūtergaṇadharasya
vyākaraṇaṃ bhagavānāha --gautama ! siyā ātā paramāṇupoggalāle siyā ṇo ātā, bhavatyapi na bhavatyapi
kenārthena syādātmā paramāṇupudgalaḥ, syānno ātmā ? iti vivṛṇoti tameva
bhagavānāha --gotamā ! appaṇo ādiṭṭhe ātā ātmanā svarūpeṇa ādiṣṭe arpite vivakṣite ātmā bhāvo vidhiḥ svarūpam
parassa ādiṭṭhe ṇo ātā, parasya ādiṣṭe no ātmā avṛttirabhāvo niyama iti
tathā dvipradeśikādiskandhāḥ ākāśādyastikāyā ghaṭapaṭādayaścārthā yathā vistaraśo vyākhyātamiti
se keṇaṭṭheṇa bhaṃte ! evaṃ vuccati--siyā ātā paramāṇupoggale siyā ṇo ātā ? gotamā ! appaṇo ādiṭṭhe ātā parassa ādiṭṭhe ṇo ātā bhagavatīsū॰ 12
āyā bhaṃte ! rayaṇappabhā puḍhavī, annā rayaṇappabhā puḍhavī ? goyamā ! rayaṇappabhā puḍhaghī siya āyā, siya no āyā, siya avattavvaṃ āyāti ya no āyāi ya

se keṇaṭṭheṇaṃ bhaṃte ! evaṃ vuccai--rayaṇappabhā puḍhavī siya āyā siya no āyā siya avattavvaṃ ātāti ya no ātāti ya ? goyamā ! appaṇo ādiṭṭhe āyā, parassa ādiṭṭhe no āyā, tadubhayassa ādiṭṭhe avattavvaṃ rayaṇappabhā puḍhavī āyāti ya no āyāti ya
se teṇaṭṭheṇaṃ taṃ ceva jāva no ātāti ya
...āyā bhaṃte ! paramāṇupoggale, anne paramāṇupoggale ? evaṃ jahā sohamme kappe tahā paramāṇupoggalevi bhāṇiyavve

vyākhyā--ātmādhikārād ratnaprabhādibhāvānāmātmatvādibhāvena cintayannāha--āyā bhaṃte ityādi, atati satataṃ gacchati tāṃstān paryānityātmā, tataśca ātmā sadrūpā pṛthivī, annatti anātmā asadrūpetyarthaḥ
siya āyā siya no āyatti, syāt satī syādasatī, siya avattavvaṃti ātmatvena anātmatvena ca vyapadeṣṭumaśakyaṃ vastviti bhāvaḥ, kathamavaktavyamityāha— ātmeti ca noātmeti ca vaktumaśakyamityarthaḥ
appaṇo āiṭṭhetti ātmanaḥ svasya ratnaprabhāyā eva varṇādiparyāyaiḥ ādiṣṭe ādeśe sati tairvyapadiṣṭā satītyarthaḥ noātmā anātmā bhavati, pararūpāpekṣayā'satītyarthaḥ

tadubhayassa āiṭṭhe avattavvaṃti tayoḥ svaparayorubhayaṃ tadeva vobhayaṃ tadubhayam, tasya paryāyairādiṣṭe ādeśe satī tadubhayaparyāyairvyapadiṣṭetyarthaḥ, avaktavyam, avācyaṃ vastu syāt, tathāhi--na hyasau ātmeti vaktuṃ śakyā, paraparyāyāpekṣayā anātmatvāt tasyāḥ
nāpyanātmeti vaktuṃ śakyā, svaparyāyāpekṣayā tasyā ātmatvāditi
avaktavyatvaṃ cātmānātmaśabdāpekṣayaiva, na tu sarvathā, avaktavyaśabdenaiva tasyā ucyamānatvāt, anabhilāpyabhāvānāmapi bhāva-padārtha-vastuprabhṛtiśabdairanabhilāpyaśabdena vā'bhilāpyatvāditi
pudgalo nāma ātmā ityapi pāṭho'tra cintyaḥ
āyā bhaṃte ! dupaesie khaṃdhe, anne dupaesie khaṃdhe ? goyamā dupaesie khaṃdhe siya āyā 1
siya avattavvaṃ āyāi ya no āyāti ya 3
siya āyā ya no āyā ya 4
siya āyā ya avattavvaṃ āyāti ya no āyāti ya 5
siya no āyā ya avattavvaṃ āyāti ya no āyāti ya 6
se keṇaṭṭheṇaṃ bhaṃte ! evaṃ taṃ ceva jāva ā yāti ya no āyāti ya ? goyamā ! appaṇo ādiṭṭhe āyā 1
tadubhayassa ādiṭṭhe avattavvaṃ dupaesie khaṃdhe āyāti ya no āyāti ya 3
dese ādiṭṭhe sabbhāvapajjave dese ādiṭṭhe asabbhāvapajjave duppaesie khaṃdhe āyā ya no āyā ya 4
dese ādiṭṭhe sabbhāvapajjave dese ādiṭṭhe tadubhayapajjave dupaesie khaṃdhe no āyā ya avattavvaṃ āyāti ya no āyāti ya 6
se teṇaṭṭheṇaṃ taṃ ceva jāva no āyāti ya
sevaṃ bhaṃte sevaṃ bhaṃtetti jāva viharati
tatrādyāstrayaḥ sakalaskandhāpekṣāḥ pūrvoktā eva, tadanye tu trayo deśāpekṣāḥ
tatra ca goyametyata ārabhya vyākhyāyate--appaṇotti svasya paryāyaiḥ ādiṭṭhetti ādiṣṭe ādeśe sati ādiṣṭa ityarthaḥ, dvipradeśikaskandhasya ātmā bhavati 1
tadubhayasya dvipradeśikaskandhatadanyaskandhalakṣaṇasya paryāyairādiṣṭo'sāvavaktavyaṃ vastu syāt, katham ? ātmeti cānātmeti ceti 3

tathā dvipradeśatvāt tasya deśa eka ādiṣṭaḥ, sadbhāvapradhānāḥ sattānugatāḥ paryavā yasmin sa sadbhāvaparyavaḥ, athavā tṛtīyābahuvacanamidam, svaparyavairityarthaḥ, dvitīyastu deśa ādiṣṭaḥ asadbhāvaparyavaḥ paraparyāyairityarthaḥ, paraparyavāśca tadīyadvitīyadeśasambandhino vastvantarasambandhino veti
tataścāsau dvipradeśikaḥ skandhaḥ krameṇātmā ceti no ātmā ceti 4
tathā tasya deśa ādiṣṭaḥ sadbhāvaparyavo deśaścobhayaparyavaḥ tato'sāvātmā cāvaktavyaṃ ceti 5
tathā tasyaiva deśa ādiṣṭo'sadbhāvaparyavo deśastūbhayaparyavastato'sau no ātmā cāvaktavyaṃ ca syāditi 6
saptamaḥ punarātmā ca no ātmā cāvaktavyaṃ cetyevaṃrūpo na bhavati dvipradeśike, dvyaṃśatvādasya
bhāvābhāvabhāvanāyāṃ yadi bhāvo vidhirabhāvo viśeṣaḥ, sa ca parābhāva iṣṭo na svarūpasyaiva viśeṣaḥ, tatastadabhāve svatvaṃ paratvaṃ cāvyavasthitaṃ paratvābhāvaviśeṣatulyatvāt
tataśca dvayorapītaretarātmāpatteḥ svaparaviśeṣatvābhāve bhāvābhāvayorbhedenopanipāto na syāt svato'pyasattvaṃ parataśca sattvaṃ syāt

idamiha sampradhāryam--kimetau bhāvābhāvau dvāvapi pradhānau, bhāvaḥ pradhānaṃ viśeṣa upasarjanam, viśeṣaḥ pradhānaṃ bhāva upasarjanam, ubhayamupasarjanam ? yadi dvāvapi pradhānau tatastayoraṅgāṅgibhāvo na syāt parasparānapekṣatvādaparārthatvāt pradhānatvād vijigīṣuvat
ghaṭo ghaṭabhāvena svenaiva bhavati na paṭādibhāvena nābhāvena vā,

yadi bhāvābhāvātmakaṃ vastviti bhāvo vidhirabhāvo viśeṣaḥ, sa ca parābhāva iṣṭo na svarūpasyaiva bhāvasya viśeṣo niyama iti, tatastadabhāve svagataviśeṣābhāve parasyāpi svagataviśeṣābhāve svatvaṃ paratvaṃ cāvyavasthitam, paratvābhāvaviśeṣatulyatvāt
svaṃ svaṃ na bhavati parābhāvaviśeṣatvāt paravat, parābhāvaviśeṣatvaṃ vastutvāt svavat svabhāvaviśeṣaśūnyatvāt
paramapi paraṃ na bhavati svabhāvaviśeṣaśūnyatvāt svavat, parābhāvaviśeṣatvāt pūrvavat pakṣe dharmasiddhiḥ
tataśca dvayorapi svaparayoritaretarātmāpatteḥ svasya svatvaṃ parasya ca paratvam ityeṣa viśeṣo nāsti
sati ca svaparaviśeṣatvābhāve bhāvābhāvayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayorbhedenopanipāto na syāt
na syāt iti sambhāvanayā, mā mukhaniṣṭhuraṃ vocamiti
naikyāpattireva, kiṃ tarhi ? saṅkaro'pītyata āha — svato'pyasattvaṃ bhāvitārthameva, apiśabdāt parato'sattvaṃ tvadabhyupagatameva, parataśca sattvaṃ syāt, aniṣṭaṃ caitat

kiñcānyat, idamiha sampradhāryam--kimetau bhāvābhāvau dvāvapi pradhānau vijigīṣū ivānyonyanirapekṣau, bhāvaḥ pradhānaṃ viśeṣa upasarjanam, viśeṣaḥ pradhānaṃ bhāva upasarjanam, ubhayamupasarjanam ? iti
caturṣu vikalpeṣu trīn vikalpān vyudasya bhāvopasarjanaṃ viśeṣapradhānaṃ nayasyāsya mataṃ samarthayiṣyāmaḥ
tatra tāvad yadi dvāvapītyādi ubhayaprādhānye'niṣṭāpādanaṃ yāvad vijigīṣuvaditi
śibikāvāhakavat tulyaśaktīnāmapyarthānāmaṅgāṅgibhāva iti cet, na, śibikāvāhakavat pradhānabhūtasyānyasya kasyacit sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ prayojayiturabhāvāt
uttarabhāvaḥ prayojayiteti cet, na, tadā'bhūtatvāt utpannasyāpi tadātmakatvāt śibikāvāhakavadasvatantratvāt

itarasya pradhānasyārthaṃ sādhayitumaṅgaṃ pravartamānamaṅginamapekṣate, aṅgyapyaṅgamityaṅgāṅgibhāvaḥ, sa na syāt parasparānapekṣatvāt tayoḥ, parasparānapekṣatvamaparārthatvāt, aparārthatvaṃ pradhānatvāt, yathā vijigīṣoḥ
tato virodhādekatra pravṛttyabhāvād vastu bhāvābhāvātmakaṃ na bhavatīti
śibikāvāhakavat tulyaśaktīnāmapyarthānāmaṅgāṅgibhāva iti cet, na, śibikāvāhakavat pradhānabhūtasyānyasya kasyacit sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ prayojayiturabhāvāt
uttarabhāvaḥ prayojayiteti cet, na, tadā'bhūtatvāt utpannasyāpi tadātmakatvāt śibikāvāhakavadasvatantratvāt
kathaṃ tarhi bhavatīti cet, ghaṭo ghaṭabhāvena svenaiva bhavati svabhavanaprādhānyena, na paṭādibhāvena uktasaṅkara-viśeṣāsattvadoṣabhayāt, nābhāvena vā paṭāderātmano vā, uktadoṣādeva
paṭo'pyevameva, svenaiva paṭabhāvena bhavati na ghaṭabhāvenābhāvenaiva vā

na hetvasiddhiḥ, śibikāvāhakānāmiva pradhānabhūta īśvaro yathā prayojayitā saṃhatyakāriṇāmaṅgāṅgibhāvaheturasti vahanakriyāyāṃ na tathā kaścit sāmānyaviśeṣayorghaṭādeḥ piṇḍaśivakādeśca pradhānabhūto'nyaḥ kaścit prayojayitāsti

uttarabhāvaḥ prayojayiteti cet, piṇḍasyottaro bhāvaḥ śivakādiḥ, sa prayojayitā pradhānabhūtaḥ, tasyāpi sthāsaka-kośaka-kuśūlakādiruttaro yāvat paścimo ghaṭaḥ punarāvṛttyā iti evaṃ cenmanyase tadapi na, tadā'bhūtatvāt, uttarasya bhāvasya tasmin kāle'nutpannatvādasataḥ prayojakatvābhāvāt kutaḥ pradhānatvaṃ khapuṣpasyeva ? kiñcānyat, abhyupetyāpi tadutpattimutpannasyāpi tadātmakatvāt mṛtpiṇḍādyātmakatvāduttarottarabhāvasya svabījādabhinnatvāt pūrva evottaraḥ, sa kathamātmānameva prayojayitumarhati ? bhedamabhyupagamyāpi śibikāvāhakavadasvatantratvāt paravaśavartitvādapravartakatvaṃ pūrvottarayordiktaḥ kālato vā bhinnayorapi bhāvābhāvayorapradhānatvādīśvarāpreritaśibikāvāhakavat
yathā saṃhatyakāriṇoḥ sanmitrayoḥ parasparamatānuvartinorarthavaśādekasyopasarjanatā itarasya prādhānyamiti cet evaṃ cenmanyase, tadapi na, vakṣyamāṇetyādi yāvadabhāvāditi
bhaviturviśeṣasyaiva prādhānyam sāmānyasya bhavanasyaivopasarjanatvamityubhayaniyamenārthavattvaṃ bhāvaśabdasya nānyathā iti vakṣyate'sya nayasya matam
athopasarjanāveva bhāvābhāvau tatastayoḥ pradhānenānyenāvaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ pravartayitrā, tadabhāve pravṛttyabhāvāt
na ca pradhānopasarjanabhāvena vinā dṛśyate bhoktṛbhogyaśarīrāhārādivastupravṛttiriti tayoreva pradhānopasarjanatā
athopasarjanāveva bhāvābhāvau tatastayoḥ pradhānenānyenāvaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ balavatāśrayabhūtena dvayoriva rājapuruṣayornṛpatinā pravartayitrā, tadabhāve pravṛttyabhāvāt

etāvatī ca pravṛttiḥ sāmānya-viśeṣayorbhavantī bhavet, sarvathā cānupapannā, bhāvābhāvayoreva paryāyamātratvāt tattvānyatvādidharmāṇāṃ vastvantarābhāvāt, bhāvaḥ sāmānyaṃ pravṛttirdravyaṃ vidhiranvayo dharmī iti paryāyāḥ, abhāvo viśeṣo'nyatvaṃ nivṛttiḥ paryāyo niyamo dharmaḥ iti paryāyāḥ, guṇaguṇyādikalpanāsvapi bhāvābhāvatvavyatiriktārthāsambhavād dvidhaiva syāt
taccetthaṃ vastu parīkṣyamāṇaṃ caturdhāpi na ghaṭate
tadapi na ca pradhānena vinā upasarjanam asti iti vartate, bhṛtakādiriva svāminā
atra yathāśrute balavatā āśrayabhūtena iti padacchedo vidheyaḥ
etadapi na ca pradhānopasarjanabhāvenetyādi yāvad vastupravṛttiriti
śarīrameva bhoktṛ cetanādhiṣṭhitam, tadarthamupasarjanamāhārādi, ādigrahaṇād vastraśayyāsanagṛhādi, āhārārthaṃ śālyādi, śālyādyarthaṃ salilādi
yathaitad bhoktṛbhogyādi guṇapradhānabhāvenaiva pravartate na vinā teneti
dṛśyate ca vastunaḥ pravṛttiritthaṃ pratyakṣīkṛtamiti tayoreva bhāvābhāvayoḥ pradhānopasarjanatā guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ, tṛtīyavastvabhāvāt
itiśabdasya hetvarthatvādetasmāt kāraṇādevamavasthite katarat kathaṃ niyatamityubhayaniyama ucyate, tadyathā --bhavat pradhānaṃ kartṛsādhanaṃ pratyayārthaḥ
ko bhavatīti cet, ucyate --bhavati viśeṣaḥ, sa eva bhavati iti bhāvaḥ ṇapratyayāntena kartṛvācinā śabdenocyate pūrvanayavyākhyāvyutpattivat

arthataḥ prakṛtyarthavivakṣāyāmapi kartrarthaprādhānyād bhāvasādhanatve'pi kartrartha evocyate, atastatpradarśanārthamāha --yat tena bhūyate, kimuktaṃ bhavatīti cet, ucyate --yadasau bhavati bhavanamāpadyate bhavanakriyāmanubhavati svarūpapratilambhe guṇabhūtaṃ kriyātvaṃ pratipadyamāno'rtho viparivartata ityuktaṃ yat tena bhūyate yadasau bhavati naṭaparamārthanṛpatvavat
tena bhūyate cet khapuṣpamapi bhavet bhavanasya dravyatvāpatteḥ
na tu bhavanamaviśeṣaṃ kvacidapi bhavad dṛṣṭam, viśeṣeṇa tu bhavitrā vaśīkṛtaṃ dṛṣṭam, kriyā-ghaṭa-vrīhi-devadattādau kāraka-rūpādi-mūlādi-bālādibhedaṃ dṛśyata eva
iha viśeṣaḥ pradhānaṃ bhāvaḥ, sāmānyamupasarjanam, śibikāvāhakayāneśvarayānavat, viśeṣabhavanameva bhāvabhavanam

kimiva ? naṭaparamārthanṛpatvavat, yathā naṭaḥ paramārthato naṭa eva san rājaveṣadhārī rājakriyāsvājñāpanādiṣu ca vartamāno naṭatvapradhānastadviśeṣaparamārtha evaṃ ghaṭākhyo viśeṣo jaladhāraṇādibhavaneṣu vartamāno ghaṭatvapradhānastadviśeṣaparamārtho bhavatīti bhavitā ghaṭaḥ kartā, tena kartrā bhavitrā bhūyate sa eva bhavanībhavati na bhavanena na kartrā bhūyate, na bhavanaṃ ghaṭo bhavati, upasarjanatvāt kartṛ bhavituṃ na śaknoti
tena bhavanena bhūyate cet khapuṣpamapi bhavet, yadyabhavad bhavet abhavitrā bhavanamanubhūyeta khapuṣpeṇāpyanubhūyeta
na hyabhavitṛtvāt khapuṣpaṃ bhavanamanubhavati tathā bhavanamabhavitṛtvād nānubhavatītyarthaḥ

kasmād nānubhavati bhavanaṃ bhavanamiti cet, ucyate --bhavanasya dravyatvāpatteḥ, dravyaśabdasya kartṛpratyayāntatvād bhavati iti dravyaṃ bhavyaṃ kṛtyalyuṭo bahulaṃ kartari iti lakṣaṇād yadi bhavati dravyaṃ syāt
yat tena bhūyate yadasau bhavati naṭaparamārthanṛpatvavat
tena bhūyate cet khapuṣpamapi bhavet bhavanasya dravyatvāpatteḥ
na tu bhavanamaviśeṣaṃ kvacidapi bhavad dṛṣṭam, viśeṣeṇa tu bhavitrā vaśīkṛtaṃ dṛṣṭam, kriyā-ghaṭa-vrīhi-devadattādau kāraka-rūpādi-mūlādi-bālādibhedaṃ dṛśyata eva
iha viśeṣaḥ pradhānaṃ bhāvaḥ, sāmānyamupasarjanam, śibikāvāhakayāneśvarayānavat, viśeṣabhavanameva bhāvabhavanam
bhavatā bhūyate iti mūlasattve tu bhā॰ pāṭho'pi saṃgacchate'tra
bhavatā bhūyate iti mūlasattve tu bhā॰ pāṭho'pi saṃgacchate'tra
dravyaśabdo nipātyate bhavye'bhidheye, druśabdādivārthe yat pratyayo nipātyate
kṛtyasaṃjñakāḥ pratyayā lyuṭ ca bahulamartheṣu bhavanti, yatra vihitāstato'nyatrāpi bhavanti
evaṃ tarhi bhavitāpyabhavanaḥ khapuṣpavad na syāditi tulyamaniṣṭāpādanam
yathā bhavitrā vinā bhavanaṃ nāsti, tadviśiṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭam, tathā bhavitāpi bhavanena vinā nāsti, tadviśiṣṭo dṛṣṭa iti

etacca na tu bhavanamaviśeṣaṃ sāmānyamātraṃ kvacidapi bhavad dṛṣṭam, viśeṣeṇa tu bhavitrā vaśīkṛtaṃ dṛṣṭam, satyametat, vayamapi na brūmaḥ--bhavanaṃ nāstyeveti, kiṃ tarhi ? viśeṣapradhānaṃ svopasarjanaṃ tu dṛṣṭamiti na tulyatvamanayoḥ
kva tad dṛśyata iti cet, ucyate --kriyāghaṭetyādi
kriyāyāṃ kārakaṃ kartā, ghaṭe rūpādiḥ, vrīhau mūlādiḥ, devadattādau bālādiḥ, ete bhedā yasya tad bhavanasāmānyaṃ bhedapradhānaṃ dṛśyate loke viśeṣeṇopasarjanīkṛtaṃ pradhanena

ityubhayam asmāt kāraṇād vidhirniyamaśca niyamyete sāmānyamupasarjanameva viśeṣa eva pradhānam iti vidhiniyamau niyatau, na yathā pūrvatrobhayamate kāmacāro vā vidhirvidhīyate niyamyate ca niyamo vidhīyate niyamyate ceti tulyakakṣau, anantarātītanayamatavadubhayaṃ cobhayam--bhāvo'pi bhāvo asya paryāyanayabhedatvāt sarvadravyārthabhavanaṃ pratipakṣaḥ
nāmadravyārthabhavanaṃ tāvat--nāma kāraṇaṃ dravyaṃ tadeva kāryaṃ bhavanātmakatvāt
ghaṭasya hi kumbhakāracetanā kāraṇam; na amūrtātmā akaraṇāt
kumbhakāro hyātmāntaḥ- bhavatyabhāvaśca, abhāvo'pi abhāvo bhavati bhāvaśceti, saṅkaradoṣāt
ihetyasmin naye svarūpaṃ ghaṭo viśeṣaḥ, na paṭādyabhāvaḥ
sa eva viśeṣaḥ pradhānaṃ bhāvaḥ, sāmānyaṃ kriyā bhavanaṃ prakṛtyartha upasarjanamapradhānam

kimiva ? śibikāvāhakayāneśvarayānavat, yathā śibikāvāhakānāṃ yānamīśvarayānārthatvādapradhānam ataḥ śibikāvāhakāḥ yānti iti nocyante tairuhyamāna īśvara eva pradhānatvāt yāti ityucyate tathā sāmānyena bhavatāpyapradhānena bhavitā ghaṭa eva bhavati iti prādhānyāducyate
nāmadravyārthabhavanaṃ tāvat--nāma kāraṇaṃ dravyaṃ tadeva kāryaṃ bhavanātmakatvāt
ghaṭasya hi kumbhakāracetanā kāraṇam; na amūrtātmā akaraṇāt
abhāvo'pi bhāvo bhavatyabhāvaśca ityapi pāṭho'tra bhavet
atra ॰yāne īśvara yānavat ityapi pāṭho bhavet
tatra vidhyādayo dravyārthabhavanabhedā vyākhyātā dūṣitāśca samanantarānulomāḥ pūrvaviruddhā nivṛttaniranuśayāḥ iti nyāyakrameṇa
tatra nāmadravyārthabhavanaṃ tāvat svarūpataḥ namayati prahvīkaroti sarvamātmasvabhāveneti nāma, kāraṇaṃ karotīti, dravyaṃ prāgvyākhyātārtham
bhavata eva vā yad bhavanaṃ tad dravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ nāma ityucyate
bhavatyeva bhavatyavasthitaṃ viśvasya kāraṇaṃ prāguktapuruṣādikāraṇavadekameva nāma śabdaḥ

āha--karotīti kāraṇamuktam, kāryābhāvāt kiṃ kriyate yat kurvat tat kāraṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ syāt ? tasmāt kāryābhāvāt kāraṇatvābhāvaḥ, kāraṇatvābhāvāt svalakṣaṇābhāvāt khapuṣpavadasaditi; ucyate --tadeva kāryakāraṇameva nāma kāryaṃ nāsat
sa hi śabdo bhavanātmakaḥ, bhavanāni avasthāviśeṣāḥ svapnādivat puruṣasya bālādivadvā piṇḍādirūpādivadvā ghaṭasya
tasmāt sa eva kāraṇaṃ svāvasthāviśeṣāṇāṃ kāryāṇāmiti
asyoddiṣṭasya kāryakāraṇabhāvasya nirūpaṇārthamudāhṛtya ghaṭaṃ ghaṭasya hītyādyārabhate
ghaṭasya hi kāryasya yasmāt kumbhakāracetanā kāraṇaṃ kumbhakaraṇasamarthaśarīrasahitā, cetanārahitasya akaraṇāt
ātmā tarhi kāraṇamastu cetanatvāditi cet, tad na amūrtātmā, akaraṇāt

tataḥ kim ? kumbhakāraśarīraṃ kartṛtvād mūrtatvād mṛdādyātmakatvād ghaṭasya mūrtasya kāraṇaṃ sambhāvyeta, mṛtsalilādyātmakatvādvā ghaṭasya mṛtsalilādyeva kāraṇaṃ sambhāvyeta, yadastu tadastu kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca, sarvathā caitanyarahitasya mūrtadravyasya ghaṭasajātīyasyāpi mūrtirahitasyāpi vā cetanasyāsajātīyaghaṭakāraṇatvāsambhavād mūrtacaitanyātmakaḥ kumbhakāraḥ pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśātmānaḥ saṃhatya kumbhakārākhyā bhavanti
tacca sarvamapi caitad nāmaiva śabda eva, śabdabrahmaṇa evaikasya viparivartasvarūpaṃ pṛthivyātmādi mūrtāmūrtabhedaprabhedaṃ jagat
akāraṇatvāt ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ tu yathāśrutaḥ akāraṇāt ityapi pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ
akāraṇatvāt ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ tu yathāśrutaḥ akāraṇāt ityapi pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ
saṃniviṣṭaśabdānubaddhacaitanyasvarūpatvācchabdātmakaḥ, tadanurūpapravṛttayo'pi tadātmikāḥ, na tadabhāve pravartate tantuvāyavat
ye'pyavyaktacetanāḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāśca te'pi śabdābhyāsavāsanājanitāntarniviṣṭasvānurūpacaitanyāḥ, hitāhitapravṛttivyāvṛttivṛttatvāt, kumbhakāravat
apara āha--śabdasvatattvamākāśam, ākāśaguṇo vā śabdaḥ śrotragrāhyasyārthasya śabdasaṃjñatvāditi kecit pratipannāḥ
tat kayopapattyedamucyate--śabda eva sarvamiti ? atrocyate --kumbhakāro hītyādi

hiśabdo hetvarthe, kumbhakārastāvadātmāntaḥsanniviṣṭaśabdānubaddhacaitanyasvarūpatvācchabdātmakaḥ, tadanurūpāntaḥśabdānubaddhacaitanyapreritapiṇḍaśivakādyanukramapravṛttayaḥ kriyā api tadātmikāḥ, tatpravṛttitvāt, mṛtpravṛttyātmakaghaṭavat tadbhāve bhāvāt tadabhāve cābhāvāt, vaidharmyeṇa na tadabhāve, tadanurūpāntaḥsanniviṣṭacaitanyābhāve na pravartate tantuvāyavat

atrocyate--kimatra sādhyam ? siddhamevaitat, na hi kācidapi cetanā'śabdāsti anādikālapravṛttaśabdavyavahārābhyāsavāsitatvād vijñānasya caitanyameva hi paśyantyavasthānaṃ madhyamāvaikharyoravasthayorutthāne kāraṇaṃ nāma ityucyate, kāraṇātmakatvāt kāryāṇām
etaditi vyākaraṇam, adbhutamāścaryaṃ paraṃ padamiti sambandhaḥ
trayyā iti trayo'vayavā vaikharyādayo yasyā iti trayī
paraiḥ saṃvedyaṃ yasyāḥ śrotraviṣayatvena pratiniyataṃ śrutirūpaṃ sā vaikharī śliṣṭā vyaktavarṇasamuccāraṇā prasiddhasādhubhāvā bhraṣṭasaṃskārā ca
tathā yā'kṣe yā dundubhau yā veṇau yā vīṇāyāmityaparimāṇabhedā
sā tu sūkṣmaprāṇavṛttyanugatā kramasaṃhārabhāve'pi vyaktaprāṇaparigrahaiva keṣāñcit

sā calācalā pratilabdhasamādhānā ca āvṛtā viśuddhā ca sanniviṣṭajñeyākārā pratilīnākārā nirākārā ca paricchinnārthapratyavabhāsā saṃsṛṣṭārthapratyavabhāsā praśāntasarvārthapratyavabhāsā cetyaparimāṇabhedā
syānmatam--śabdavyavahārānabhijñeṣvapyavyaktacetaneṣu vijñānotthāpitapravṛttisambhave vyabhicaratīti cet, na ityucyate, ye'pyavyaktacetanā ityādi

kṛmi-pipīlikādīnāṃ jaṅgamānāṃ vratatī-trapu-sīsakacitakarṇikādīnāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca śabdābhyāsavāsanājanitāntarniviṣṭasvānurūpacaitanyāstitvaṃ pratijñāyate hitāhitapravṛttivyāvṛttivṛttatvāt kumbhakāravat, hitāhitayoḥ pravṛttivyāvṛttī nimittasaptamī sambandhaṣaṣṭhī vā, hitāhitapravṛttinivṛttyorvṛttatvāt, itthambhūtalakṣaṇā tṛtīyā vā hitāhitapravṛtti jñāpi tathopaśrūyate--savvajīvāṇaṃ pi ya ṇaṃ akkharasa aṇaṃtabhāgo ṇiccugghāḍitao nandīsū॰ 42

ato yathaiva kumbhakārakaraṇaśabdacetanāvaicitryavṛttitāratamyādhyāsanasamupahitarūpā ghaṭatā nāmnaḥ sākṣād bhavati tathā tathā, tathā tatprabhavameva kumbhakāraśarīramṛdādi śabdopayogātmayogavakratā'vakratādeḥ, rūpādimadarthaviracanātmakatvāt vyāvṛttibhyāṃ vṛttatvāt
stambhādyāśrayopasarpaṇaṃ hitapravṛttivṛttatvaṃ gartāgnyādibhayādanyato gamanamahitavyāvṛttivṛttatvaṃ ceti siddho heturvanaspatiṣvapi

kṛmyādīnāṃ tu trāsa-stambha-bhrānti-palāyita-gatāgatādikriyā bhayādyavinābhāvinyaḥ siddhā eva, ato hitāhitapravṛttivyāvṛttivṛttatā vidyate śabdānuviddhacaitanyāvinābhāvinī yathā kumbhakāre, tasmāt teṣūbhayeṣu sādhyate
suptadagdhādiṣu tu jaṅgameṣu vyaktameva pāṇiprasphoṭanādi kriyāliṅgam, tena vijñānamavinābhāvitvāt siddhameva, śabdānuviddhatvaṃ tu sādhyata iti
naitat svābhipretopapattibalādeva, kiṃ tarhi ? bhagavadarhadājñāpi tathopaśrūyate--savvajīvāṇaṃ pītyādi
vallī tu vratatī latā iti amarakośe
jñāpi tathopaśrūyate--savvajīvāṇaṃ pi ya ṇaṃ akkharasa aṇaṃtabhāgo ṇiccugghāḍitao nandīsū॰ 42

ato yathaiva kumbhakārakaraṇaśabdacetanāvaicitryavṛttitāratamyādhyāsanasamupahitarūpā ghaṭatā nāmnaḥ sākṣād bhavati tathā tathā, tathā tatprabhavameva kumbhakāraśarīramṛdādi śabdopayogātmayogavakratā'vakratādeḥ, rūpādimadarthaviracanātmakatvāt
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 190 paṃ॰ 7, pṛ॰ 351 paṃ॰ 4, ṭipṛ॰ 67 paṃ॰ 7
taṃ pi jati āvarijjejja teṇa jīvo ajīvataṃ pāve
suṭṭhuvi mehasamudae hoi pabhā caṃdasūrāṇaṃ || nandīsū॰ 42
ato yathaivetyādi uktārthopasaṅgraharūpeṇa dṛṣṭāntadaṇḍako yāvat sākṣād bhavati tathā tatheti

kumbhakāraḥ śabdānuviddhacetanātmakaḥ, tatkriyāpi tadātmikā vicitrā piṇḍaśivakādyarthaparispandabhedā śabdacetanaiva, tasyā vaicitryeṇa vṛttestāratamyena uttarottarotkarṣaparamparayā adhyāsanam, tena samupahitaṃ rūpamasyā ghaṭatāyāḥ sā kumbhakārakaraṇaśabdacetanāvaicitryavṛttitāratamyādhyāsanasamupahitarūpā ghaṭatā, sā sākṣād nāmno bhavati tathā tathā tena tena prakāreṇa piṇḍaśivakādirūpādipṛthubudhnādinā ceti dṛṣṭāntaḥ

dārṣṭāntiko'rtho'dhunā --tathā tatprabhavameva śabdacetanāprabhavameva kumbhakāramanuṣyaśarīraṃ mṛdādi mṛtsikatā-loṣṭa-vajrā-'śma-śilādipṛthivīkāyatiryakśarīraṃ ca, ādigrahaṇādaptejo-vāyu-vanaspatitiryakśarīraṃ devaśarīraṃ nārakīyaṃ ca

śabdātmaka upayogaḥ śrutajñānaṃ vyaktāvyaktam, tatsambandhādvadyaḥ kāyavāṅmanaḥkarmayogaḥ śubho'śubho vā sa āśravaḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ, ekendriyādijātināmnastiryagbhedasya yogavakratā visaṃvādanaṃ ca, tadviparītaṃ yogāvakratvamavisaṃvādanaṃ ca śubhasya manuṣya-devapañcendriyajātyādināmnaḥ, ādigrahaṇādavisaṃvādanagrahaṇāt
kumbhakāraśarīramṛdādi tathā tathā tatprabhavameva iti vartate
uktamidaṃ prakriyāyuktyā, na punarhetunā śabdānuviddhacaitanyātmakatvamiti cet, etarhi brūmaḥ --rūpādimadarthaviracanātmakatvāt, rūpa-rasa-gandha-śabda-sparśa kumbhakārakāryavat
nāmna eva ca prabhāvād ghaṭasya ghaṭatvam, na bahirnimittāpekṣam
tathāhi— skandanādinimittānāmanupapattāvapi jīvasyājīvasya vā nimittanirapekṣā saṃjñā kriyate skando rudra indra iti
pratyakṣatvāt sarvalokaprasiddhaśabdābhidheyatvācca tadbhūtāḥ pratyakṣāśca gopālādayo mukhyayā ca vṛttyocyante tasmāt ta eva te

saṅkhyā--saṃsthānādayo rūpādayaḥ, te yasya santi so'rtho rūpādimadarthaḥ, tasya viracanā parasparasambandhānurūpyeṇa ghaṭanā, sa evātmā yasya svarūpaṃ manuṣyatiryagaṅgopāṅgādināmanirvṛttakumbhakāraśarīramṛdāderiti dharmitvena sambadhyate

kumbhakārakāryavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā hi ghaṭapiṭharādi kulālakāryaṃ tena tena mṛnmardanādiprakāreṇāntaḥsanniviṣṭaśabdānuviddhakumbhakārapravṛttyā nirvartitatvāt tatprabhavaṃ tadātmakaṃ kumbhakārapravṛttyātmakaṃ rūpādimadarthaviracanātmakatvāt tathā kumbhakāraśarīramṛdādyapyantaḥ sanniviṣṭaśabdānuviddhacaitanyapravṛttyātmakamiti
nāmna eva ca prabhāvād ghaṭasya ghaṭatvam, na bahirnimittāpekṣam
tathāhi— skandanādinimittānāmanupapattāvapi jīvasyājīvasya vā nimittanirapekṣā saṃjñā kriyate skando rudra indra iti
pratyakṣatvāt sarvalokaprasiddhaśabdābhidheyatvācca tadbhūtāḥ pratyakṣāśca gopālādayo mukhyayā ca vṛttyocyante tasmāt ta eva te
atrāha--pratyakṣata eva daṇḍādibahirnimittādṛte ghaṭānirvṛtteḥ kathamidamavadhāryate--nāmnaḥ sākṣād bhavati, na daṇḍādibhya iti ? atrocyate --nāmna eva cetyādi
daṇḍādīnāṃ satāmapyakiñcitkaratvācchabdacaitanyasyaiva prabhāvāt tatpreritaprayatnaparispandajanitaniṣpattighaṭākhyasya vastunastadvastutvaṃ ghaṭatvaṃ nāmna eva mahimno labhyate na bahirnimittāpekṣam

tatpravṛttīnāmapi sthāne sthāne śabdacetananiyojitānāmātmalābhāt tadātmatvam, itarathā teṣāmatadātmatve svarūpapravṛttireva durlabhā, kuto ghaṭasya ghaṭatvaṃ vastutvam ? tasmāt sarvakārakasānnidhye'pi karturaudāsīnye tadabhāve vā kriyāyāḥ kāryasya cābhāvaḥ ghaṭaudanapaṭavāgādeḥ, ataḥ śabdaprabhāvaprabhavaṃ sakalaṃ jagaditi

hiśabdo nidarśane, evaṃ ca kṛtvā skandarudrendrāḥ skandir śoṣaṇe, rudir aśruvimocane, idi paramaiśvaryai pā॰ dhā॰ iti skandanena nimittena skandaḥ, rodanena rudraḥ, indanena indraḥ ityeteṣāṃ nimittānāmanupapattāvapi gopaśupālāderjīvasyājīvasya vā kāṣṭhakuḍyapāṣāṇādernimittanirapekṣā saṃjñā kriyate skando rudra indraḥ iti, gopālādīnāmeva taistaiḥ śabdaiḥ samadhyāropavaśāccocyate
syānmatam--bhavatīti bhavo roditīti rudra indatīti indra iti devatāviśeṣāḥ tannimittabhūtārthabhājaḥ santyapratyakṣāḥ samayāntaraprasiddhāḥ, tanmukhyapravṛtteritaratropacāro bhaviṣyatīti
etaccāyuktam, pratyakṣatvādityādi yāvat ta eva te

apratyakṣāste bhava -kārtikeyādayaḥ samayāntaraprasiddhaśabdaparikalpagamyā na sarvalokaprasiddhaśabdābhidheyā yathā gopālādayaḥ pratyakṣāḥ sarvalokaprasiddhaśabdābhidheyāśceti teṣāṃ sattvaṃ tacchabdātmakatvaṃ cāpratyakṣamamupacāragamyaṃ cetyetebhyaḥ kāraṇebhyastadbhūtāḥ skandādiśabdabhūtāḥ pratyakṣāśca gopālādayo mukhyayā ca vṛttyocyante tasmāt ta eva te, gopālādaya eva skandādayaḥ, na samayāntaraparikalpitāḥ santīti
tasmācchabdaśaktiprabhāvādeva saṃjñā ye'pi ca te samayāntaraparikalpitāḥ skandarudrendrāḥ teṣu ekasminnitarasaṃjñayorapi pravṛttinimittasadbhāvāt trayo'pi parasparasaṃjñānirdeśyāḥ syuḥ
athānyatamanimittamātraṃ tattvamiṣyate iṣṭārthavivakṣayā evaṃ tarhi vivakṣiteṣṭārthaviṣayavyavaharaṇādantarniviṣṭaśabdānubaddhacaitanyanimittaḥ saṃjñāvyavahāro'bhyupagataḥ, bahirnimittaṃ tu tyaktam
nimittapratyayena saṃjñāpravṛttau yāvatsambhavaṃ saṃjñāsanniveśe bhāvakādayo'pi te prāptāḥ
tathā ca yāvat kiñcid bhavananimittagrastaṃ tasya sarvasyendraskandādirarthaḥ sarvadhātubhvarthatvāt paryāyo ghaṭakuṭaśabdavat
abhyupetyāpi samayāntaraparikalpitānāṃ skandādīnāmastitvaṃ nimittaniyamābhāvadoṣa ucyate --ye'pi ca ta ityādi

skande'pi rodanamindanaṃ ca staḥ, ataḥ sa rudra indro vā kiṃ na bhavati ? tathā rudre'pi skandanendane indre'pi rodanaskandane tataḥ sa itara itaraḥ sa kiṃ na bhavati ? ekasminnitarayorapi saṃjñayoḥ pravṛtternimittamastyeva

atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityanyatamadeva nimittamekaṃ tattvamiṣyate'saṅkīrṇasaṃjñāvyavahārārthaṃ skanda eva, na rudro nendraḥ itīṣṭārthavivakṣayā evaṃ tarhi anyatamanimittamātratattvayā'vadhṛtayā saṃjñayā vivakṣiteṣṭārthaviṣayavyavaharaṇādantarniviṣṭaśabdānubaddhacaitanyanimittaḥ saṃjñāvyavahāro'bhyupagataḥ, bahirnimittaṃ tu tyaktamiti doṣaḥ, tuśabdādaniṣṭasamparigraheṣṭatyāgau viśeṣayati
skandir gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ 979, rudir aśruvimocane 1067, idi paramaiśvarye 63 --pā॰ dhā॰
ye'pi ca te samayāntaraparikalpitāḥ skandarudrendrāḥ teṣu ekasminnitarasaṃjñayorapi pravṛttinimittasadbhāvāt trayo'pi parasparasaṃjñānirdeśyāḥ syuḥ
athānyatamanimittamātraṃ tattvamiṣyate iṣṭārthavivakṣayā evaṃ tarhi vivakṣiteṣṭārthaviṣayavyavaharaṇādantarniviṣṭaśabdānubaddhacaitanyanimittaḥ saṃjñāvyavahāro'bhyupagataḥ, bahirnimittaṃ tu tyaktam
nimittapratyayena saṃjñāpravṛttau yāvatsambhavaṃ saṃjñāsanniveśe bhāvakādayo'pi te prāptāḥ
tathā ca yāvat kiñcid bhavananimittagrastaṃ tasya sarvasyendraskandādirarthaḥ sarvadhātubhvarthatvāt paryāyo ghaṭakuṭaśabdavat

yadi skandanādinimittapratyayena saṃjñāpravṛttistato yāvatsambhavaṃ yāvanti nimittāni bhavana-karaṇa-śayana-bhāṣaṇa-caṅkramaṇa-vartana-pariṇamanādīni sambhavanti tāvadbhirnimittaiḥ saṃjñāsanniveśe sati rodanād rudro bhavanād bhavo bhāvakaḥ karaṇāt kāraka ityādisarvavyapadeśabhāktvād bhāvakādayo'pi te prāptāḥ
tataśca tathā ca yāvadityādi, yat parimāṇamasya yāvat, yāvadeva kiñcid bhavananimittagrastaṃ sarvamityarthaḥ
tasya sarvasya ghaṭapaṭāderindraskandādirarthaḥ sarvadhātvarthānāṃ bhvarthatvāt paryāyaḥ, tadvācinaśca paryāyaśabdā eva
sarva eva sarvaḥ, ghaṭaḥ skandaḥ, paṭaḥ skandaḥ, skandavaidyo'pi skandaḥ

ceṣṭā-kauṭilyādyabhisandhyanabhisandhipūrvakaparispandārthatvāt pariṇatyartha evamapi tu sthite'rthapratipādanārthatvācchabdaprayogasya sarvasarvābhidhānalakṣaṇāvyavasthāvyāvartanārthaṃ bahirnimittanirapekṣaṃ saṃjñāmātrasanniveśitaṃ skandāditvamabhyupagantavyam
evaṃ hi saṅketamātratvācchabdārthasambandhasya mukhyārthāḥ sarvadeśabhāṣā ityetadayatnasiddham
iti cetanācetanabhedasya samastasyāsya jagato bhāvakaṃ nāma
ghaṭasya dravyaṃ tvāt sarveṣāṃ jñāna-gatyarthānāṃ skandana-śoṣaṇa-visaraṇa-rodanendana-sadana-stambhanādyarthānāṃ yāvatāṃ yasminnarthe sambhavastasya tasya tathārthatve sarvasarvatvam
vasanād vastuvāstunī, śayanasthānāsanādyekārthatvācca gatinivṛtti-paryāyāṇāṃ śeṣadhātūnāṃ ca vastvarthānativṛtteḥ katamad dravyaṃ katamena nimittena nābhidhīyate ? tataḥ sarvasarvatvam
skandavadyo'pi iti pāṭho'tra sambhavet, ghaṭaḥ skandaḥ paṭaḥ skandaḥ skandavat, yopi skandaḥ sa skandaḥ iti ca tasyāśayo jñeyaḥ
evaṃ hi saṅketamātratvācchabdārthasambandhasya mukhyārthāḥ sarvadeśabhāṣā ityetadayatnasiddham
iti cetanācetanabhedasya samastasyāsya jagato bhāvakaṃ nāma
syānmatam--evaṃ tarhi sutarāmatiprasaṅgāpādanadvāreṇa tvayaiva sarvasya bahirnimittāpekṣatvaṃ samarthitam, tvatpakṣe'pi ca sarvasarvābhidhānātiprasaṅgo durnivāra iti

etaccāyuktamuktanyāyenaiva, evamapi tu sthita ityādi yāvat skandāditvamabhyupagantavyamiti svapratipipādayiṣitārthapratipādanārthatvācchabdaprayogasya prasakte'pi sarvasarvatve sarvasarvābhidhānalakṣaṇā'vyavasthā prāptaiva, sā mā bhūditi tadvyāvartanārthaṃ skandādiśabdāḥ kasmiṃścidarthe bahirnimittanirapekṣāḥ saṃjñāmātratvena sanniveśitāḥ santo niyamena tamevārthamabhidadhatīti prāptam, itarathā sarvasarvatve sarvābhidhānāvyavasthā'vaśyambhāvinī
tasmāt saṃjñāsanniveśānna me kaścid doṣa iti

evaṃ ca kṛtvā saṅketamātratvācchabdārthasambandhasya mukhyārthāḥ sarvadeśabhāṣā ityetadayatnasiddham ghaṭaḥ kuṭaḥ kumbhaḥ kṣīraṃ payaḥ pāli dugdham agnirāturaḥ kicu maṅgalaḥ ityādīnāṃ ca saṅketavaśādabhidhitsitaikārthavācitvaṃ siddham, niyatanirapekṣatvāt saṅketasya svopayogapratipādanasamarthatvācca teṣāṃ teṣāṃ śabdānāṃ ḍitthādivat
idamapyabhiyuktānāmata eva smaraṇamupapannam, nānyathā, yathā --anekārthā dhātava iti gatārthaṃ yāvad dṛśyatām

iti cetanācetanetyādi, anena prakāreṇa yaduktaṃ nāma taccetanācetanabhedasya kumbhakāra-ghaṭādeḥ pṛthivyādi-manuṣya-nārakatiryak-siddha-paramāṇu-kālākāśādeḥ samastasyāsya jagato bhāvakaṃ nāma samastaṃ jagad nāmno bhavati iti bhāvitam
tasmādeva ghaṭo bhavati, ghaṭasya dravyaṃ kāraṇam, ghaṭaṃ bhāvayati nāma, ghaṭasya tato nāma, ghaṭasya tato bhavanāt, mṛdvat
anayā yathā ghaṭo bhavati tathā nāmnā ghaṭo bhavati ghaṭakriyātmakatvaṃ vā bhāvakatvam
tathā ca yadi nāmno ghaṭotpattau dravyatvaṃ syāt tato ghaṭārthino bhavatu ghaṭa iti prabravīran
tasmāt pravṛtti-nivṛttikāraṇamarthārthināṃ tadabhāvārthināṃ ca kṣāyopaśamiko bhavanāt, tato bhavati iti pratipāditatvāt siddho hetuḥ
yad yato bhavati tat tasya kāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā mṛd mṛdo bhavato ghaṭasya kāraṇaṃ tathā nāma ghaṭasya kāraṇamityetamarthamupanayati --anayetyādi
yathā ghaṭasya mṛd dravyaṃ bhavati tathā nāmetyarthaḥ
ghaṭakriyātmakatvaṃ vā bhāvakatvaṃ nāmna iti vartate, śabdo dravyabhāvaṃ ghaṭakaraṇātmakatvāt pūrvoktāt pratipadyate, tasmād ghaṭaṃ bhāvayati nāma, nāmno ghaṭo bhavatītyarthaḥ
kathamañjirañcatyarthe'pi vartate ? anekārthā api dhātavo bhavanti
anayā yathā ghaṭo bhavati tathā nāmnā ghaṭo bhavati ghaṭakriyātmakatvaṃ vā bhāvakatvam
tathā ca yadi nāmno ghaṭotpattau dravyatvaṃ syāt tato ghaṭārthino bhavatu ghaṭa iti prabravīran
tato'rthārthinastadabhāvārthinaśca bhavatu mā bhūditi vā prabravīran ityapi mūlamatra sambhavet

athavā rūpādyupayogo rūpādijñānam, tasya bhavanamantarniviṣṭaśabdānubaddhaṃ tacchabdātmakam, rūpaṇād rūpam, rasyata iti rasaḥ, ghrāyata iti gandhaḥ, śrotragrahaṇaṃ śabdaḥ iti lakṣaṇāt tasyopayogasya śabdātmakatvād rūpādīnāṃ ca tadātmakatvācchabdo rūpādirapi bhavati
eṣo'pi nāmadravyārthabhāvo niyataḥ upasarjanatveneṣyate na prādhānyena, prādhānyena tu viśeṣo niyata ityuktaḥ
na brūmaḥ-- śabdo nimittamātravyāpṛto jñānopakārī nāsti iti
jñānasyaiva pradhānasyopakārakatvena vartate jñānenaiva cotthāpyate, arthapratyāyanārthatvācchabdaprayogasya
yasmāt pratyakṣameva na nāmnaḥ śabdācchrotrābhighātakārād ghaṭādi bhavati, na śabdaḥ kāraṇaṃ ghaṭasya tato'nutpatteḥ
tatastu śabdācchrotrābhighāta evotpadyate, tasmācchabdaḥ śrotrābhighāte heturna ghaṭe na jñāne
yadi śabdasya ghaṭotpattau dravyatvaṃ syāt tato ghaṭārthino bhavatu ghaṭa iti prabravīran; arivināśārthinaśca rājāno vijigīṣavo na hastyaśvaṃ bibhṛyuḥ, parabalameti mā bhūt iti vā brūyuḥ
tasmāt pravṛtti-nivṛttikāraṇamarthārthināṃ tadabhāvārthināṃ ca kṣāyopaśamiko bhāvaḥ jñānāvaraṇakṣayopaśamanimittaṃ jñānamityarthaḥ, tata eva pravṛttinivṛttidarśanāt
kṣāyopaśamiko bhāvaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'nyatvād dravyārthatāṃ tyaktvā bhavati kṣaṇikatvāt
tenāpi viśeṣeṇaiva bhūyate, viśeṣa eva bhavati, uktaśabdārthavyutpattirbhavati, bhavat pradhānaṃ bhāva ityupakramya yāvad bālādibhedaṃ dṛśyate eva ityakṣarārtho gataḥ
vastvarthataśca bhāvitam --sāmānyamupasarjanaṃ viśeṣaḥ pradhānaṃ bhāvaḥ śibikāvāhakayāneśvarayānavaditi
se kiṃ taṃ davvāvassayaṃ ? 2 duvihaṃ paṇṇattaṃ taṃ jahā--āgamao a noāgamao a sū॰ 12

se kiṃ taṃ āgamao davvāvassayaṃ ? 2 jassa ṇaṃ āvassaetti padaṃ sikkhitaṃ ṭhitaṃ jitaṃ mitaṃ parijitaṃ nāmasamaṃ ghosasamaṃ ahīṇakkharaṃ aṇaccakkharaṃ avvāiddhakkharaṃ akkhaliaṃ amiliaṃ avaccāmeliyaṃ paḍipuṇṇaṃ paḍipuṇṇaghosaṃ kaṃṭhoṭṭhavippamukkaṃ guruvāyaṇovagayaṃ, se ṇaṃ tattha vāyaṇāe pucchaṇāe pariaṭṭaṇāe dhammakahāe no aṇupehāe
...se kiṃ taṃ āgamato davvasuaṃ ? 2 jassa ṇaṃ suetti payaṃ sikkhiyaṃ ṭhiyaṃ jiyaṃ jāva ṇo aṇuppehāe
sa hi bhāvāgamaḥ, yasmāt kṣāyopaśamikabhāvo jñānaṃ bhāvāgama ucyate tasmāt sa pradhānaṃ bhavati, maryādayābhividhinā ca gamo'vabodhaḥ, tataḥ śabdasyāgamatvam, tata utthāpyate śabdo jñānāt
tathāhyāhuriti śabdadravyāgamatve jñāpakamārṣam --āgamato jāṇaye aṇuvayutte davvasutamiti
itaśca jñānameva pradhānam, yasmāt tata eva cāsyotpattiḥ śabdasya jñānādevotpattiḥ, vakturjñānenotthāpitatvāt, jñānameva śabdasya kāraṇam
pravṛtto'pi śabdaḥ paratantro jñānārthatvāt; paratantro jñānotpādanārthatvācchrotarītyata āha --pravṛttiśca tādarthyena

tanmūlotpatti-tadarthatvābhyāṃ jñānaṃ pradhānamityetasminnarthadvaye dṛṣṭāntaḥ --śibikāvāhakayāneśvarayānavaditi vaitanikānāṃ yānaṃ yātrāpreritamīśvareṇa pravṛttamapīśvarayānārtham, ato'pi dvidhāpīśvaraprādhānyavad jñānaprādhānyamiti

sāmīpyena sarvātmanā yoga upayogaḥ rūpādyarthasamīpe sarvātmapradeśānāṃ tatpravaṇatā, śabdopayogātmayogavakratā'vakratādestiryag-manuṣyanāmanirvartitaṃ mṛdādi kumbhakārādi ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ bhavati rūpādimadarthaviracanātmakatvāt kumbhakārādikāryavad nāmno bhavati, ātmā buddhyā samarthyārthān mano yuṅkte vivakṣayā
pā॰ śikṣā 6 ityādi sarvaṃ tvaduktopapattijātamupayogaviśeṣabhavanaprādhānyaṃ sādhayati, tatkāryatvācchabdasya, upa athocyeta--sāmānyamaviśeṣaḥ, ubhayoḥ parasparakāraṇatvāviśeṣatvāt
atha kasmādupayoga eva nāmatvamāpadyate ? iti upayogatvaprāpternāmnaḥ sarvatra viśeṣapradhānatvam
tasyāpi vā nāmaśabdasya uraḥprabhṛtītyādinā nāmadravyārthaṃ hitvā dravyadravyārtho'ṅgīkṛtaḥ mūrtadravyābhyupagamāt
nāmaśabdo yogasya śabdaḥ kāryam, sa eva kāraṇamupayogasya kumbhakāraśarīrāderiti tatkāraṇaṃ taditi tvayaiva prāg bhāvitaṃ vistareṇaitat
ātmā buddhyā samarthyārthān mano yuṅkte vivakṣayā | pā॰ śikṣā 6
atha kasmādupayoga eva nāmatvamāpadyate ? iti upayogatvaprāpternāmnaḥ sarvatra viśeṣapradhānatvam
tasyāpi vā nāmaśabdasya uraḥprabhṛtītyādinā nāmadravyārthaṃ hitvā dravyadravyārtho'ṅgīkṛtaḥ mūrtadravyābhyupagamāt
sāmānyamaviśeṣaḥ, tadbhavanamātratvaṃ na viśeṣa ityetadāpannamiti bhāvito'rtha ubhayoḥ parasparakāraṇatvāviśeṣatvāditi
upayoga eva nāmatvamāpadyata iti viśeṣasyopayogasya prādhānyamupayogatvaprāpternāmnaḥ

tasyāpi vā nāmaśabdasyetyādi, nāmaśabdaḥ iti vīṇā-veṇu-tālaśabdādibhyo viśiṣyate prakṛtatvādaupayogitvācca tasya uraḥprabhṛtītyādinā nāmadravyārthaṃ hitvā tvayā dravyadravyārtho'ṅgīkṛtaḥ, tadyathoktam— ātmā buddhyā samarthyārthān mano yuṅkte vivakṣayā
ārṣamapi jñāpakam, noāgamato dravyaṃ śarīramuktam, tadyathā— aho ṇaṃ imeṇaṃ sarīrasamussaeṇaṃ sāmāietti padaṃ āghavitaṃ paṇṇavitaṃ ityādi
ata āha --mūrtamamūrtasya dravyaṃ na bhavati pariṇāmikāraṇamityarthaḥ
yathā mūrtamamūrtasya kāraṇaṃ na bhavati ityayamabhyupagamaḥ tathā nāmaśabdasya mūrtatvādamūrtopayogakāraṇyaṃ na yujyate
ātmā buddhyā samarthyārthān mano yuṅkte vivakṣayā
116svavṛttau bhartṛhariṇāpi samarthyārthān iti pāṭhenāyaṃ śloka uddhṛtaḥ
mārutastūpari caran mandraṃ janayati svanam || 7 || pā॰ śikṣā
mārutastūrasi caran mandraṃ janayati svaram--pā॰ śikṣā
se kiṃ taṃ noāgamao davvāvassayaṃ ? 2 tivihaṃ paṇṇattaṃ, taṃ jahā--jāṇayasarīradavvāvassayaṃ bhaviasarīradavvāvassayaṃ jāṇayasarīrabhaviasarīravatirittaṃ davvāvassayaṃ sū॰ 15

se kiṃ taṃ jāṇayasarīradavvāvassayaṃ ? 2 āvassaetti payatthāhigārajāṇayassa jaṃ sarīrayaṃ vavagayacutacāvitacattadehaṃ jīvavippajaḍhaṃ sijjāgayaṃ vā saṃthāragayaṃ vā nisīhiāgayaṃ vā siddhasilātalagayaṃ vā pāsittā ṇaṃ koī bhaṇejjā --aho ṇaṃ imeṇaṃ sarīrasamussaeṇaṃ jiṇadiṭṭheṇaṃ bhāveṇaṃ āvassaetti payaṃ āghaviyaṃ paṇṇaviyaṃ parūviaṃ daṃsiaṃ nidaṃsiaṃ, jahā ko diṭṭhaṃto ? ayaṃ mahukuṃbhe āsī, ayaṃ ghayakuṃbhe āsī, se taṃ jāṇayasarīradavvāvassayaṃ sū॰ 16
se samāsao cauvvihe paṃ॰, taṃ॰ ṇāmasāmāie ṭhavaṇāsāmāie davvasāmāie bhāvasāmāie
syānmatam--kathaṃ mūrtaḥ śabdo yato'syāmūrtajñānakāraṇyaṃ na bhavediti
tad nāma nopayogasya dravyaṃ mūrtatvād mṛdvat
uktaṃ hi--na hi mūrtamamūrtatvaṃ nāmūrtameti mūrtatām
mūrta iti pratipadyatām, kuḍyādipratihatagatitvāt, yasya gatiḥ kuḍyādibhiḥ pratihanyate tad mūrtaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā loṣṭādīti
upayogo na mūrtadravyahetukaḥ, amūrtatvāt, ākāśavat, na hyākāśaṃ mṛdādidaṇḍādimūrtadravyasya kāryamiti sādharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ
mṛdvaditi vaidharmyeṇa, yad mūrtadravyahetukaṃ na tadamūrtaṃ yathā mṛditi
athavā nāmūrtasya dravyaṃ nāmaśabdaḥ, mūrtatvāt, mṛdvat
yadamūrtasyāvagāhāderdravyaṃ na tad mūrtam, yathā ākāśamiti
na hi mūrtamamūrtatvaṃ varṇādimat pudgaladravyaṃ mūrtaṃ sadavarṇādyātmakatvamamūrtatvaṃ na gacchati na tathā pariṇamati jīvā-''kāśa-dharmā-'dharmatvaṃ na yāti
dravyaṃ triṣvapi atītānāgatavartamāneṣu kāleṣu, na kadācidityarthaḥ, yasmād nātmabhāvam, yāvaddravyabhāvī yo dharmaḥ sa ātmabhāvaḥ, tamātmabhāvaṃ na kadācit parityajati dravyamiti
tad nāma nopayogasya dravyaṃ mūrtatvād mṛdvat
nātmabhāvaṃ tyajati pararūpaṃ nāpnoti ityetadayuktam, anyonyānugatasvaparatvāt kṣīrodakavat
vatkaraṇaṃ nirvṛttyupakaraṇendriyajñānavat tanvātmadravyavacca iti pratyekaṃ parisamāpyate

dravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ mūrtamamūrtasya jñānasya, dvividhaṃ dravyendriyam--nirvṛttirupakaraṇaṃ ca, nirvṛttiḥ pakṣmapuṭa-kṛṣṇasārādidravyaniṣpattiḥ, nirvṛttamupakaroti ityupakaraṇaṃ masūrakākārāścakṣurmadhyapradeśāḥ prakāśāñjanādayaścopakaraṇāni

tathā tanvātmavat ityasya vyākhyā --śarīrādikaraṇād bhavāntarātmanaḥ, kāyāditrividhayogakāryaṃ śarīrāṅgopāṅgādināmakarma, tasya karaṇāt tanvādi bhavāntare janmāntare ya ātmā tasya dravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavati
atra svarūpatvāt iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīno bhāti
āgataṃ tarhyetad yo'rtho dravyaṃ so'svatantro viśeṣeṇa tathā tathā bhāvyate, jñānamātmā ca viśeṣa eva bhavati
tatra yadi sendriyāṇi matiśrutāvadhimanaḥparyāyajñānāni tatasteṣāmindriyakṛtatvādajñānatvāt kevalameva ekaṃ jñānaṃ syāt
ātmanaśca aśarīrasyaiva svatantrasya kartṛtvāt aśarīreṇa siddhakevalinā kṛtaṃ karmaanveṣyaṃ syāt
na hastādimadrāgikṛtamapi syāt karma, tasyaiva saṃsāritveṣṭeḥ...
tathā ākāśaghaṭayoranāvṛtyāvṛtyātmakatvāt kuto ghaṭākāśamākāśaghaṭo vā ? evaṃ kutaḥ sānyonyānugamarūpatā ?
atrocyate --āgataṃ tarhyetadityādi yāvad viśeṣa eva bhavatīti

yo'rtho dravyaṃ sāmānyaṃ viśeṣo vā prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayārtho vā bhavanaṃ bhāva iti yo'stu so'stu sarvathā so'svatantro viśeṣeṇa jñānena tathā tathā bhāvyate dravyendriyādi tat sarvātmanā jñānamātmā ca viśeṣaḥ sa bhāvayati
yadyapi bhavat sāmānyaṃ bhāvastathāpyupasarjanam, viśeṣaḥ pradhānamityuktaṃ bhavati
tatra yadītyādyaniṣṭāpādanaṃ parasya yāvadekaṃ jñānaṃ syāditi hetuhetumadbhāvena gatārtham
sendriyāṇi mati-śrutā-'vadhi-manaḥparyāyajñānāni, tānīndriyakṛtatvādajñānāni syuḥ, kevalajñānamevaikaṃ jñānaṃ syāditi
ātmaiva svatantraścetanatvāt, na śarīram, svatantraśca kartā
tataścāśarīreṇa śuddhena siddhakevalinā kṛtaṃ karmānveṣyaṃ syāt, taccātyantadurlabhaṃ muktasaṃsāraprasaṅgādaniṣṭaṃ ca
na hastādimadrāgikṛtamiṣṭamapi syāt karma, tasyaiva saṃsāritveṣṭeḥ pūrvavaddhetuhetumadbhāvenā- pādanaṃ yāvadātmano'nyatvāt

tṛtīyamapi tathākāśa-ghaṭayoryathāsaṅkhyamanāvṛtyāvṛtyātmakatvāt, ākāśamanāvṛtyātmakaṃ cedāvṛtyātmakaghaṭībhavati ghaṭaścānāvṛtyātmakākāśībhavati āvṛtyātmakaḥ saṃstato ghaṭākāśam iti syāt, tattu tvanmate na
ākāśamevāmūrtam, tadviparīto ghaṭo mūrta eveti kuto ghaṭākāśamudāharaṇaṃ ghaṭate, ghaṭātmānāpatterākāśasya, ākāśānātmāpatterghaṭasya ākāśaghaṭo vā tadviparītaguṇa udāharaṇamiti ?

anena prakāreṇa dravyasya bhavane parigṛhīte dṛṣṭāntasya viparyayasādhanatvāt kutaḥ sānyonyānugamarūpatā yā tvayā pratijñātā evaṃ maduktanyāyāt tvanmatena ca dravyasya kāraṇasya sadā''tmarūpāparityāgāt ? ityuktaṃ parasyāniṣṭāpādanam
cetanācetanayorātmabhāvatyāgāt tvaduktāt dravyasya sāmānyabhavanamupasarjanaṃ bhavadeva mupasarjanamekameva bhavati, na viśeṣaḥ arthāntarābhāva-bhavadbhavanābhyāṃ kenacidabādhyatvāt
yathā ca viśiṣṭaḥ sāmānyanirapekṣo bhavati tathā svaviṣaye'pyekavṛkṣādibhavane dvivacanādiviśeṣāntaranirapekṣeṇaiva tenābhinnaliṅgavacanādinā bhavitavyam
yadyekaṃ nakṣatraṃ kathaṃ punarvasū dvau, atha dvau punarvasū kathamekaṃ nakṣatram, virodhitvādekadvitvayoḥ ? ityādi sarvaṃ yathāviṣayaṃ pratividhātavyaṃ ghaṭapaṭadivat
ca bhavati, tasmādarthāntarābhāvād bhavata eva bhavanācca kenacidaviśeṣo na bādhyate
yathoktaṃ tvayā prāk vṛkṣo vṛkṣasāmānyamupasarjanīkṛtyaika eva bhavati na dvyādirapi, viśeṣavaśavartitvād nāmnaḥ ityādi
mupasarjanamekameva bhavati, na viśeṣaḥ arthāntarābhāva-bhavadbhavanābhyāṃ kenacidabādhyatvāt
yathā ca viśiṣṭaḥ sāmānyanirapekṣo bhavati tathā svaviṣaye'pyekavṛkṣādibhavane dvivacanādiviśeṣāntaranirapekṣeṇaiva tenābhinnaliṅgavacanādinā bhavitavyam
yadyekaṃ nakṣatraṃ kathaṃ punarvasū dvau, atha dvau punarvasū kathamekaṃ nakṣatram, virodhitvādekadvitvayoḥ ? ityādi sarvaṃ yathāviṣayaṃ pratividhātavyaṃ ghaṭapaṭadivat
yathā ca sāmānyena pratipakṣeṇa vinā viśeṣastannirapekṣo bhavati bhavatyeva viśiṣṭastathā svaviṣaye'pyekavṛkṣādibhavane dvivacanādiviśeṣāntaranirapekṣeṇaiva tenābhinnaliṅgavacanādinā bhavitavyam
tvanmate na punastathā bhavati sa viśeṣaḥ, nakṣatrapunarvasvādisamānādhikaraṇavacanaliṅgādibhedadarśanāt
tad bhāvayati --yadyekamityādi sādhanadvayamaniṣṭāpādanam virodhitvādekadvitvayorityādi sarvaṃ yathāviṣayaṃ pratividhātavyamityatideśād liṅgakālādāvapyaniṣṭāpādanasādhanāni draṣṭavyāni
yadi punarvasū pumāṃsau na nakṣatraṃ napuṃsakam, puṃstvāt, vṛkṣavat
atha nakṣatraṃ na pumāṃsau napuṃsakatvāt kuṇḍavadityādi
yadi tārā strī na nakṣatraṃ strīvād gaṅgāvat, atha nakṣatraṃ na strī napuṃsakatvāt kuṇḍavaditi yojyam
syānmatam--lokapratītatvād nakṣatrārtha eva punarvasvarthaḥ punarvasvartha eva ca nakṣatrārtha iti loke prasiddhamāgopālādi
tasmāt sāmānyasya viśeṣatvādadoṣaḥ, itarathā nairarthakyameva syāditi
vayamapi lokapratītereva brūmaḥ, dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane, bahuṣu bahuvacanam pā॰ 1
22--21 ityarthānāmavayamavayavaṃ prati vivakṣitānāmekatvādyapekṣayaikavacanādiśabdaprayogaprasiddheryadyekavacanāntaḥ śabdo'bhidhānārthenāpyekena bhavitavyam, na vdyādinā
atha dvyādiḥ, naikavacanena śabdena bhavitavyam, uktavat
idaṃ tvabhidhānābhidheyapratyayayorvi lakṣaṇaṃ hi nāma śabdānāṃ prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgānvākhyānam

prakṛtyādyarthāvyavasthāyāṃ lakṣaṇāvyavasthānāt kutastajjanyalakṣyatattvapratipattiḥ śabdavyavasthā ca, aviviktībhāvitasvalakṣaṇaviṣayatvāt, aviviktībhāvitasvalakṣaṇaviṣayasthāṇupuruṣapratipattivyavasthāvat
sa vṛkṣa āste iti pratipadya punaḥ ehi manye rathena yāsyasi ityasmāt tadviparītādapi tadvadeva pratipattyā prakṛtyādilakṣaṇālakṣaṇīkaraṇaṃ pratipatteścāpratipattitvaṃ yadṛcchāpravṛttitvāt
saṃvādāt pratītiviruddham, punarvasūśabdo dvyartho dvivacanāntatvāt' iti pratyayo nakṣatrābhidheyaviṣayapratyayena visaṃvadati, sa cānena
kimiva ? kumārabrahmacāripitṛtvavat, yadi kumārabrahmacārī kathaṃ pitā ? atha pitā kathaṃ kumārabrahmacārīti ? tadvadiheti

prakṛtyādyarthāvyavasthāyāṃ lakṣaṇāvyavasthānāt kutastajjanyalakṣyatattvapratipattiḥ śabdavyavasthā ca, aviviktībhāvitasvalakṣaṇaviṣayatvāt, aviviktībhāvitasvalakṣaṇaviṣayasthāṇupuruṣapratipattivyavasthāvat
sa vṛkṣa āste iti pratipadya punaḥ ehi manye rathena yāsyasi ityasmāt tadviparītādapi tadvadeva pratipattyā prakṛtyādilakṣaṇālakṣaṇīkaraṇaṃ pratipatteścāpratipattitvaṃ yadṛcchāpravṛttitvāt
śabdānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgānvākhyānam, taddhi lakṣyāñśabdān vyavasthāpayāmi iti
lakṣaṇāvyavasthānāt kutastajjanyalakṣyatattvapratipattiḥ śabdatattvapratipattiḥ śabdavyavasthā ca ? na staḥ

dṛṣṭāntaḥ--aviviktībhāvitetyādi, yathā viviktau santāvaviviktau bhāvitau svalakṣaṇābhyāṃ sthāṇupuruṣau, tatra yā sthāṇau puruṣapratipattirvyavasthā ca mithyāpratipattivyavasthe te, kasmāt ? aviviktībhāvitasvalakṣaṇaviṣayatvāt, tathā śabdānāṃ lakṣyāṇāṃ pratipattivyavasthe
lakṣyāpratipattyavyavasthābhyāṃ cābhidhānābhidheyaviṣayapratyayadvayavisaṃvādāt kumārabrahmacārī pitā iti pratyayavad nakṣatra-punarvasvādyekadvitvādivirodha iti sambandhaḥ
kutastajjanyalakṣyatattvapratipattiḥ śabdavyavasthā ca ? ityevamapi pāṭho'tra bhavet
ataḥ paraṃ puruṣaviṣaya ucyate, tadyathā — sa vṛkṣa āsta ityādi yāvadapratipattitvam

saḥ iti śeṣopapade āste iti puruṣaviṣayaprakṛtipratyayasaṃvādena svayaṃ pratipadya punaḥ ehi manye iti tadviparītapratipattyā prakṛtyādilakṣaṇamalakṣaṇīkṛtaṃ pratipattiścāpratipattīkṛtā tadvadeveti lakṣyatattvāpratipattyavyavasthādvāreṇeti
kasmāt ? yadṛcchāpravṛttitvādasamīkṣita ehi manye iti prastutakriyāvisaṃvādāt tvaṃ yāmi, ahaṃ yāsi iti prayogavadayathārthamagamakamasādhu
atra pratyayaparā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā, prayogakāle kevalayoḥ prakṛtipratyayayorasambhavāt tathā'narthakatvāt kākavāsitavat
śikṣaṇārthaṃ tu citrabhaktibindu- paurvāparyapratyayatvād brahmacāripitṛtvavadityeva sambandhaḥ
atra prayogaḥ --ehi manya ityādi yāvadayathārthamagamakamasādhu iti pratijñāstisraḥ
prastutā kriyā manyatiḥ, tayā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ visaṃvadati pratyayasyottamapuruṣākhyasya ehiśabdaprayuktamadhyamapuruṣavisaṃvādāditi hetvarthaḥ
tvaṃ yāmi, ahaṃ yāsi iti prayogavaditi tadarthanidarśanaṃ hetvarthānurūpeṇa yānārthayormadhyamottamaviśiṣṭayorbhede sati visaṃvādādayathārthāgamakāsādhutvavaditi

devadatta iti prathamānirdiṣṭaḥ kartrarthaḥ prakṛtyarthamātravācinā bhāvasādhanena bhūyateśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nārhati bhavati ityanena tu syāt tathā ehiśabdaprastutamadhyamapuruṣāntena manyeityuttamāntāyathārthāgamakāsādhutvānyupaneyāni
tvam iti yuṣmadupapade pacati iti śeṣopapadaviṣayaprathamapuruṣaprayogo visaṃvadati tathā ehi manye yāsyasi iti
yatra yuṣmadasmadī samānādhikaraṇe upapade na staḥ tatra śeṣe prathamapuruṣo bhavati
