prahāse gamyamāne manyopapade dhātormadhyamapuruṣo bhavati, manyateścottamaḥ, sa caikavad bhavati
ehi manye odanaṃ bhokṣyasa iti, na hi bhokṣyase, bhuktaḥ so'tithibhiḥ
ehi manye rathena yāsyasi, na hi yāsyasi, yātaste pitā
prahāsa iti kim ? ehi manyase odanaṃ bhokṣya iti
ehi manye rathena yāsyasi rathena yāsyāmīti tvaṃ manyase ityarthaḥ
ehi manye iti prastutakriyāvisaṃvādāt tvaṃ yāmi, ahaṃ yāsi iti prayogavadayathārthamagamakamasādhu
atra pratyayaparā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā, prayogakāle kevalayoḥ prakṛtipratyayayorasambhavāt tathā'narthakatvāt kākavāsitavat
atra pratyayetyādi vākyāvadhike'rthe padāvadhike vā pratipādye vākyaṃ padaṃ vā pratiyogiśabdārthāpekṣameva gamayati kevalasyāprayogāt
padāvadhike tāvadayaṃ niyamaḥ--pratyayaparā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā, prakṛteḥ paraḥ pratyayaḥ pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 3

2 iti vyavasthāpitatvāt prayogakāle kevalayoḥ prakṛtipratyayayorasambhavāt, asambhavaśca tathānarthakatvāt bhū-laṭ-tip-śapādīnām, kimiva ? kākavāsitavat, yathā vāyasavāsitādīnāṃ na kaścidabhidheyo'rtho'sti tathā bhū-tipādīnāṃ kevalānām
kimarthaṃ tarhi bhū sattāyām pā॰ dhā॰ 1 kartari kṛt, laḥ karmaṇi ca pā॰ 3
67, 69 ityādi prakṛtipratyayārthaṃrtha ?pāṭha iti cet, ucyate --śikṣaṇārthaṃ tu citrabhaktibinduvinyasanavat pṛthagadhyayanam
śiṣyān grāhayāmi iti vibhajya prakṛtipratyayārthau darśyete

yathā ekāmeva kāṣṭhādibhaktiṃ lekhayiṣyaṃścitrakarācāryaḥ śiṣyān pūrvaṃ binduvinyāsān kārayati paścāt saṃyojayati tataḥ sā darśanīyā cakṣūramaṇīyā puṣpa-vallī-gṛha-manuṣya-strī-hastyādisaṃsthānā saṃvyavahārārhā bhaktirbhavati evaṃ prakṛtipratyayārthopapradarśanaṃ pṛthak kriyate, apṛthaksiddhasamudāyārthapratipattyupāyatvāt
evameva ca kṛtvoktam--prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtaḥ pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 3
ata eva ca prakṛtiparaḥ pratyayaḥ prayoktavyaḥ pratyayaparā ca prakṛtiḥ pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 3
ata eva ca pratyayārthānapāyitvād manyateḥ prastutasāmānādhikaraṇyatyāgena manye iti uttamaikavacanapratyayaprayogo'yathārthābhidhānam
prahāsādidamasatyameveti cet, bahveva tarhi lakṣaṇānāmalakṣaṇīkaraṇaṃ lakṣyā-
prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūta iti prādhānyena pratyayārtho vivakṣito guṇatvena prakṛtyarthaḥ

ata eva ceti, yaduktaṃ bhāṣye --prakṛtiparaḥ pratyayaḥ prayo- ktavyaḥ, pratyayaparā ca prakṛtiriti pratyayaḥ paro viśeṣaḥ pradhānaṃ yasyāḥ sā pratyayaparā prakṛtiḥ, paraśabdasya pradhānārthatā varṇyate
evaṃ cānena nyāyena pratyayārthād nāpaiti prakṛtiḥ, tatparatvāt
ata eva ca pratyayārthānapāyitvād manyaterityādinā bhāvayitvopasaṃharati yāvadayathārthābhidhānamiti

prakṛtyavinābhāvitvāt pratyayasya pratyayatvāt ehi manye rathena yāsyasi ityasmāt tadviparītādapi tadvadeva pratipattyā pratyayādilakṣaṇālakṣaṇīkaraṇaṃ pratipṛtteścāpratipattitvaṃ yadṛcchāpravṛttatvādityādi yāvadayamavadhiḥ samānabhāvanaḥ pratyayapuruṣānurūpeṇa yojyata iti
ityarthatrayaviṣayamayathārthatvamiti nigamanam itiśabdanigamanārthatvāt, anayā bhāvanayā bhāvitameva bhavati agamakamasādhu ityapi draṣṭavyaṃ buddhicakṣuṣā
idaṃ ca dravyato'yathārthatvam, yasmāt nāhaṃ tvam ityasmadyuṣmaddravyaviparyayeṇāyathārthatvametat
yathā caitat tathā ghaṭapaṭādiśeṣopapadaviṣayo bhinnavyavahāro nirākriyate tvaṃ pacati ityādikuṭuktvādiprayuktabhinnaliṅgādiviparyayārthaśabdaprayogavaditi
syānmatam--ehi manye rathena yāsyasi, na hi yāsyasi, yātaste pitā ityetadasatyameva prahāsaviṣayatvāt
ata eva lakṣaṇamuktam --prahāse ca manyopapade manyateruttama ekavacca pā॰ 1
106 iti, tathā dvivacanabahuvacanaviṣayāvapyudāhṛtau yāsyathaḥ, yāsyatha iti
ehi manye odanaṃ bhokṣyasa iti, bhuktaḥ so'tithibhiḥ
etameta vā manye odanaṃ bhokṣyethe bhokṣyadhve
śatabhiṣajaḥ nakṣatram, godau grāmaḥ, punarvasū pañca tārakāḥ, āmrā vanam,
bahūnāṃ tarhi lakṣaṇānāṃ dhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ pā॰ 3
85 ityevamādīnāmalakṣaṇīkaraṇam tallakṣyāṇāṃ ca agniṣṭomayājī asya putro janitā ityevamādīnāmalakṣyīkaraṇam
pratipatteścāpratipattitvaṃ sarvasyā'satyatvāt, tadasatyatvaṃ pratyāyyārthaviparyayavṛttatvāt prahāsoktivaditi gatārtham
na ca teṣu lakṣaṇeṣu lakṣyeṣu cāsatyamatirbhavati
iha parvate vasati ityetasminnadhikaraṇārthe parvatamadhivasati, adhyāste ityādikarmatvāyukteḥ
atra prayogaḥ--parvatamadhivasati ityādi asatyamidam, svakārakavyadhikaraṇavṛttatvāt, devadatto bhūyate iti yatheti
etasya bhāvanārtha ādhāro'dhikaraṇamityādi yāvadanyasyānādhāratvādveti gatārtho granthaḥ
ata uttaraṃ śatabhiṣaja ityādi devamanuṣyā ubhau rāśī ? ityādiṣu bhāvato'yathārthatā, dravyakṣetrakālabhāvaviṣayavisaṃvādavṛttatvāt svoktārthanirākaraṇārthatvāt, unmattapralāpavat
nanu puṣyasya devaviśeṣatvāt tadviṣayau nakṣatratārāsāmānyārthau, ghaṭaviśeṣaviṣayamṛtsāmānyārthavat
uktaṃ hi--yastu prayuṅkte kuśalo viśeṣe śabdān yathāvadvyavahārayuktaukte
so'nantamāpnoti jayaṃ paratra vāgyogavid duṣyati cāpaśabdaiḥ
yadyevaṃ tarhi kayā vivakṣayā āpaḥ iti bahuvacanamekasminnapi bindau, eka- bhāvāyathārthapratipādanaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvadityādiṣu bhāvato'yathārthateti
evaṃ ca na vācakatā śabdasya na vācyatārthasya, ayathārthatvāt, uktaśabdārthavat
idaṃ ca sādhanamatītaprapañcena bhāvitārthamiti na vivriyate
dhātvarthānāṃ sambandhe yatra kāle pratyayā uktāstato'nyatrāpi syuḥ
adhipūrvāṇāṃ śīṅ sthā ās ityeteṣāmādhāro yastat kārakaṃ karmasaṃjñaṃ bhavati
upa anu adhi āṅ ityevaṃpūrvasya vasaterādhāro yastat kārakaṃ karmasaṃjñaṃ bhavati
kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kriyāśrayabhūtayordhāraṇakriyāṃ prati ya ādhārastat kārakamadhikaraṇasaṃjñaṃ bhavati
uccaritaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtasaṃgateḥ puruṣasya svābhidheye pratyayamādadhātīti śabda ityucyate
evamādīnāṃ vyabhicāro na nyāyya iti tannivṛttiparo'yaṃ nayaḥ
dvitve bahutvaṃ punarvasū pañca tārakā iti
bahutve dvitvaṃ devamanuṣyā ubhau rāśī iti
sādhanavyabhicāraḥ--ehi manye rathena yāsyasi, na hi yāsyasi, yātaste piteti
viśvadṛśvāsya suto janitā, bhāvi kṛtyamāsīditi kālavyabhicāraḥ
santiṣṭhate pratiṣṭhate viramati uparamati iti upagrahavyabhicāraḥ
yadi syāt ghaṭaḥ paṭo bhavatu paṭo vā ? prāsāda iti
tasmād yathāliṅgaṃ yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathāsādhanādi ca nyāyyamabhidhānam
devamanuṣyā ubhau rāśī ? ityādiṣu bhāvato'yathārthatā, dravyakṣetrakālabhāvaviṣayavisaṃvādavṛttatvāt svoktārthanirākaraṇārthatvāt, unmattapralāpavat
nanu puṣyasya devaviśeṣatvāt tadviṣayau nakṣatratārāsāmānyārthau, ghaṭaviśeṣaviṣayamṛtsāmānyārthavat
yastu prayuṅkte kuśalo viśeṣe śabdān yathāvadvyavahārayuktaukte
so'nantamāpnoti jayaṃ paratra vāgyogavid duṣyati cāpaśabdaiḥ || pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1 | 1 | 1
yadyevaṃ tarhi kayā vivakṣayā āpaḥ iti bahuvacanamekasminnapi bindau, eka-
nanu puṣyasyetyādi pūrvapakṣo vivakṣāviśeṣārthaśabdaprayoganyāyāśrayeṇa doṣaparihārārtho yāvad gamakāścāgamakāśceti
puṣyaḥ pumān devo viśeṣaḥ, tadviṣayau tadarthau nakṣatra-tārāsāmānyārthau ghaṭaviśeṣaviṣayamṛtsāmānyārthavat sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tasmādupapannam

viśeṣe vivakṣite pradhāne guṇabhūtāñśabdān prayuṅkte yaḥ kuśalo'rthagatyarthatvācchabdaprayogasya taddarśayannāha vivakṣāpūrvakatvācchabdapravṛtteriti --yathāvadvyavahārayuktau yo yaḥ śabdo vyavahārakāle yasya yasya vivakṣitārthasya viśiṣṭasya viśiṣṭa eva gamaka ityabhimataḥ sa eva sa eva tatra prayujyate nānyo'nyatra vā gauṇamukhyādibhāvena svābhidheyapratyāyanasamarthatvāt sarvaśabdānām

tasmād vivakṣāpūrvakatvācchabdapravṛtterviṣayaviśeṣaparigraheṇa sādhutā'sādhutā ca śabdānām, asādhutvābhimatānāmapi gavyādīnāṃ sādhutvaṃ viśeṣaviṣayatvāt, sādhutvenābhimatānāmapi gavyādīnāmasādhutvamiti
atrācārya āha --yadyevaṃ tarhītyādi yāvat sikatā iti
āpa iti bahuvacanamekasminnapi bindau dṛṣṭam, nātra sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvo'sti
tathā ekayoṣiti dārā gṛhāḥ yoṣiti dārā gṛhāḥ iti, ekasmiṃśca śarkarākaṇe sikatāḥ iti
nityamapi vahvavayavavṛttatvāditi cet, ekaghaṭe'pi tarhyata eva nityaṃ bahuvacanaṃ prāptam, bindvādāviva āpaḥ
atiśayyekātmakanirāsena viśeṣaviṣayaprayogasādhutveṣṭau kasmāt tata eva nyāyāt bindau apchabda ekavacanānto na prayujyate viśeṣaviṣayatvād gavādivat
sa ekavacanānta eva syāt, ekamiti gṛhītatvāt, tantupaṭavat
tathā taṭastaṭī taṭamiti katamaṃ viśeṣamupādāya liṅgabhedaḥ katamad vā sāmānyamatidiśyate ? nanu sthitiprasavasaṃstyānaviśeṣaviṣayo liṅgabhedaḥ
ekasmiṃśca sūkṣmaśarkarākaṇe sikatā iti, kiṃśabdasya kṣepārthatvāt kayā vivakṣayā kiṃ tayā vivakṣayā viparītārthayeti
syānmatam--bahavo'vayavāḥ paramāṇu-dvyaṇukādayo bindāvapi, tadapekṣayā bahuvacanam āpaḥ iti
ata eva tvaduktāt bahvavayavavṛttatvāt iti hetorekasmin ghaṭe'pi nityaṃ bahuvacanaṃ prāptam, bindvādāviva āpaḥ ityaniṣṭāpādanadvāreṇa paroktahetuvyabhicāraḥ
apsu vetyādi, apchabdādapi ekavacanaṃ syāt, nityamapi bahvavayavavṛttatvāt, ghaṭavat, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
yoṣiti dārā gṛhāḥ iti, ekasmiṃśca śarkarākaṇe sikatāḥ iti
nityamapi vahvavayavavṛttatvāditi cet, ekaghaṭe'pi tarhyata eva nityaṃ bahuvacanaṃ prāptam, bindvādāviva āpaḥ
atiśayyekātmakanirāsena viśeṣaviṣayaprayogasādhutveṣṭau kasmāt tata eva nyāyāt bindau apchabda ekavacanānto na prayujyate viśeṣaviṣayatvād gavādivat
sa ekavacanānta eva syāt, ekamiti gṛhītatvāt, tantupaṭavat
tathā taṭastaṭī taṭamiti katamaṃ viśeṣamupādāya liṅgabhedaḥ katamad vā sāmānyamatidiśyate ?

yathāsmābhirukto'tiśayī eka eva ātmā bhavati yat sat kiñciditi tasya nirāsena tvayā viśeṣaviṣayaprayogo gāvyādivat sādhuḥ itīṣṭaḥ, tatredaṃ te'niṣṭamāpādyate— kasmāt tata eva nyāyāt bindau vartamāno'pchabda ekavacanānto na prayujyate, viśeṣaviṣayatvāt, gavādivaditi ? ato'yamapi nyāyo vyabhicaratīti
kiñcānyat, so'pchabda ekavacanānta eva syāt, bahvavayavātmakatve'pi ekam iti gṛhītatvāt tantupaṭavaditi gatārthatvānna vyākhyāyate
evaṃ tāvadayaṃ saṅkhyāviṣayo vicāro na ghaṭate
katamaṃ vātra viśeṣamupādāya liṅgabhedaḥ ? katamad vā sāmānyamatidiśyate viśeṣapratipādanārtham ? na sambhavatītyarthaḥ
gocaraviśeṣopapattau vā so'pi nāsti, na hi taṭo gocaraḥ prasavasya, saṃstyānātmakatvāt, strīvat
na taṭī gocaraḥ saṃstyānasya, prasavātmakatvāt, puruṣavat
athocyeta--nanvevaṃ saṃstyānātmakatvādityādinā triliṅgatvaṃ vyavasthāpitameva saṃstyāne styāyaterḍraṭ strī sūteḥ sap prasave pumān
3 sthitirnapuṃsakam, strī styānam, prasavaḥ pumān, ete cārthāḥ sarvamūrttirteṣu sambhavanti, atra yo viśeṣo vivakṣyate tadviṣayo liṅgabheda iti

etacca na taṭa-taṭī-taṭānāṃ viṣayasya viśeṣaḥ, ekatvādarthasya sa eva viśeṣo nāsti, yadviṣayo liṅgabhedaḥ syāt sa nāsti, abhinnasvarūpatvāt, ghaṭa-ghaṭasvātmavat, yathā ghaṭa eva ghaṭasvātmā tathā taṭa eva taṭī taṭaṃ ca, abhinnasvarūpatvād nāsti viśeṣaḥ

atrocyate --gocaraviśeṣopapattau vā so'pi viśeṣo nāsti, yasmād na taṭo gocaraḥ prasavasya, saṃstyānātmakatvāt, saṃstyānātmakatvaṃ tasyārthasya siddhaṃ tvayaivābhyupagatatvāt tryātmakatvasya, strīvaditi stana-keśavatyāḥ prasavābhāvavaditi
evaṃ śeṣe sādhane gatārthe yāvat strī-puṃsavaditi
adhunā tasyaivārthasya tritvāpekṣayā kriyate --athavetyādi sādhanāni gatārthāni yāvat taṭīvaditi
evaṃ liṅgābhāva eva taṭatvādīnāṃ prasavādidharmābhāve gocaraviśeṣābhāvādityupanayaḥ

na liṅgābhāva eva doṣaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? tataścāsattvamapyeṣāṃ mūlodvartanena, akriyā-'vyayatve sati aliṅgatvāt, khapuṣpavat, mā bhūt pacatyādisvarādyākhyātāvyayābhidheyārthavat sattvāśaṅketi akriyāvyayaviśeṣaṇam
pareṇocyeta parihāraḥ --nanvevaṃ prapañcanena gocaraliṅganirākaraṇavyākhyānena 'saṃstyānātmakatvādityādinā triliṅgatvaṃ svaṃ svaṃ liṅgavyavasthāpanahetuṃ parigṛhṇatā vyavasthāpitameva tvayā
yathā na taṭī, saṃstyāna tvayā taṭaḥ puṃliṅgaṃ prasavātmakatvāt puruṣavadityādi
prasavādīnāmekārthe sannidhibhāve vā sa pumāneva na syāt, strītvāt, devadattādivat
parvatanadībhavanaviṣayaṃ triliṅgatvaṃ viśiṣṭaviṣayamiti cet, na, pumādibhinnabāhvādyekaliṅgatvāt ardharcādiṣu ca viśeṣādarśanādaparihārāt
nanvekasya dṛṣṭaṃ triliṅgatvaṃ bhūtirbhavanaṃ bhāva iti
na, yadi vayaṃ loke dṛṣṭatvāt pratipadyāmahe taṭe dṛṣṭatvādeva kasmād na pratipadyāmahe ? tadeva durdṛṣṭam
prasavātmakatvāt, puruṣavat ityāttha tathā taḥtaṭaḥ puṃliṅgam, prasavātmakatvāt, puruṣavaditi, ādigrahaṇāt saṃstyānānubhayatvābhyāmapi trayāṇāṃ triliṅgatvahetutvamiti
nanūktam--ta eva hi prasavādayo liṅgavyavasthāpanahetavo na santīti sādhitamanantarameva, tasmānna kiñcidetat
abhyupagamyāpi prasavādīnāmekārthe sannidhibhāve vā sa pumāneva na syāt, strītvāt, devadattādivat, tasya strītvaṃ tvayābhyupagataṃ triliṅgatvāt
tathā na strī puṃstvāt, na tau strīpuṃsau napuṃsakatvāt, itaratvena dṛṣṭānto'tra
gocaraviśeṣopapattau vā so'pi nāsti, na hi taṭo gocaraḥ prasavasya, saṃstyānātmakatvāt, strīvat
na taṭī gocaraḥ saṃstyānasya, prasavātmakatvāt, puruṣavat
saṃstyāne styāyaterḍraṭ strī sūteḥ sap prasave pumān
kiṃ punarloke dṛṣṭvā etadavasīyate--iyaṃ strī ayaṃ pumān idaṃ napuṃsakamiti ? liṅgam
kiṃ punastat ? stanakeśavatī strī syāllomaśaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ
...saṃstyāne styāyaterḍraṭ strī sūteḥ sap prasave pumāniti
sūteriti sū ityetasya dhātoḥ sap pratyayo bhavati, sakārasya pakāro bhavatītyarthaḥ
ubhayorantaraṃ yacca tadabhāve napuṃsakam ||pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 4 | 1 | 3
saṃstyānātmakatvādinā iti bhā॰ pāṭho'pi samīcīno bhāti
prasavādīnāmekārthe sannidhibhāve vā sa pumāneva na syāt, strītvāt, devadattādivat
parvatanadībhavanaviṣayaṃ triliṅgatvaṃ viśiṣṭaviṣayamiti cet, na, pumādibhinnabāhvādyekaliṅgatvāt ardharcādiṣu ca viśeṣādarśanādaparihārāt
nanvekasya dṛṣṭaṃ triliṅgatvaṃ bhūtirbhavanaṃ bhāva iti
na, yadi vayaṃ loke dṛṣṭatvāt pratipadyāmahe taṭe dṛṣṭatvādeva kasmād na pratipadyāmahe ? tadeva durdṛṣṭam

ayamatrāśayaḥ--puṃsaḥ striyāḥ napuṃsakasya ca dehe vidyamānā bāhu-jihvādayo'vayavā pumādibhinnaviṣayā api ekaliṅgatvena dṛśyante, na hi pumādibhinnaviṣayatve'pi bāhau liṅgabhedaḥ, evaṃ ca viśiṣṭaviṣayatvaṃ na liṅgabhede hetuḥ
tasmād arthaikatve...liṅgabhedānupapattiḥ pṛ॰ 574 paṃ॰ 23 iti pūrvokto doṣo'parihṛta eva
yathā devadattaḥ pumāneva na tathā taṭaḥ pumānevetyarthaḥ
itaratvena dṛṣṭānto'tra iti pāṭho'tra samyag vibhāvyate
ekasmin dehe bāhuḥ pumān, jihvā strī, akṣi napuṃsakamiti niyataliṅgatvānnaitadapi puṣkalam
kiñcānyat, ardharcādiṣu ca viśeṣādarśanādaparihārāt na iti vartate, ardharcaḥ ardharcaṃ gomayaḥ gomayamityādīnāṃ strīliṅgābhāvāt triliṅgatvaṃ naikārtham
ardharcādayaḥ śabdāḥ puṃsi napuṃsake ca bhāṣyante

āha --nanvekasya dṛṣṭaṃ triliṅgatvam--bhūtirbhavanaṃ bhāva iti, ato'vyabhicāra iti cet, netyucyate, yadi vayamityādi, yadi loke prayogo dṛṣṭa ityetāvatā pratipadyāmahe tvādṛśā iva parapratyeyāḥ taṭe dṛṣṭatvādeva kasmād na pratipadyāmahe ? kiṃ vivādena ? tasmāt tadeva durdṛṣṭam, prasiddhireva duṣprasiddhirityarthaḥ
api cedamityādi, bhūtirbhavanaṃ bhāvaḥ ityete'pi trayo'rthā yathārthābhidhānaśabdanayamatena bhinnāḥ, tasmādetat sādhyam--asāvapyeko'rtho nāneka iti

api ca bhāvo veti etadapi api ca ekasya trailiṅgyāyuktivicāre bhūtyādīnāṃ nānāśabdānāmupanyāso'tivispardhate, paryāyanayaviṣayatvācca bhāvaśabdasyātra kartaivaiko bhāvaḥ tasmādekabhavanāsattvādarthaikatvamapi naiva
nakṣatreṇa sāmānyena puṣyasya atideśaḥ yathā idamā devadattasya
atra yuktau, devadattasyedaṃviṣayatvādatideśo yujyate, na nakṣatreṇa puṣyasya atadviṣayatvāt
nakṣatrādyatideśyo na bhavati puṣyaḥ, asvaviṣayatvāt, sthāṇupuruṣavat
yadyatadviṣayeṇāpyatidiśyeta ghaṭādāvapi nakṣatrādyatideśavṛttiryuktā syāt, atadviṣayatvāt, puṣyavat
sa ca śabdanayasya nāsti, prakṛtyarthasya nyagbhūtatvāt
api ca ekasya trailiṅgyāyuktivicāre bhūtyādīnāṃ nānāśabdānāmupanyāso'tivispardhate, paryāyanayaviṣayatvācca bhāvaśabdasyātra kartaivaiko bhāvaḥ tasmādekabhavanāsattvādarthaikatvamapi naiva
nakṣatreṇa sāmānyena puṣyasya atideśaḥ yathā idamā devadattasya
atra yuktau, devadattasyedaṃviṣayatvādatideśo yujyate, na nakṣatreṇa puṣyasya atadviṣayatvāt
nakṣatrādyatideśyo na bhavati puṣyaḥ, asvaviṣayatvāt, sthāṇupuruṣavat
yadyatadviṣayeṇāpyatidiśyeta ghaṭādāvapi nakṣatrādyatideśavṛttiryuktā syāt, atadviṣayatvāt, puṣyavat
devadattasya idamā arthena vā vṛkṣasyātideśo yujyate, na tu nakṣatreṇa puṣyasya atadviṣayatvāt ityapi pāṭho'tra bhavet
taṭaśabdasyaikārthasya ekasya trailiṅgyāyuktivicāre nānāliṅgānāṃ bhūtyādīnāṃ nānāśabdānāmupanyāso'tivispardhate

itaśca na ghaṭate tadupanyāsaḥ, dravyārthatvāt sāmānyasya bhūti-bhavana-bhāvākhyasyaikatvāt tadviṣayamudāharaṇaṃ syāt, na paryāyanayaviṣayam, paryāyanayaviṣayatvācca bhāvaśabdasyātra kartaivaiko bhavati iti bhāvo viśiṣṭa evaiko ghaṭādiḥ, na tveka eva bhūtyādirūpo viśeṣaḥ kartā

tasmādekabhavanāsattvādarthaikatvamapi naiva, sāmānyabhavanasyaikasya nyagbhūtatvāt viśeṣabhavanasya bhūtyādiviśiṣṭaikarūpatvāt nāstyarthaikatvamatra naye'to dravyārthakṛtaṃ bhūtyādiṣvaikyaṃ tad māṃ pratyasiddhamityarthaḥ
sāmānyārthātideśena viśeṣārthātisarge nidarśanam --ayaṃ devadatta iti, vṛkṣo'rtho bhavati iti dvitīyam
śeṣaṃ gatārthaṃ sabhāvanaṃ yāvad devadattasyeti pūrvapakṣaḥ
uttarapakṣastu atra yuktau devadattasyedamityādinā vaidharmyaṃ nidarśayati atideśābhāvabhāvanārthaṃ yāvadatadviṣayatvāditi prathamanidarśanasya
arthena satā vṛkṣo'tidiśyeta pratyakṣaḥ san parokṣeṇa dharmeṇa viśeṣeṇa, na sāmānyena satā vā khapuṣpādinā vā
nakṣatrādīnāmatadviṣayatvāt pratyakṣanirdeśyasya piṇḍasya devadattārthasya tadviṣayatvāt vṛkṣasyārthaviṣayatvācca vaidharmyam
nakṣatrādyatideśyo na bhavati puṣyaḥ, asvaviṣayatvāt, sthāṇuneva puruṣaḥ puruṣeṇa vā sthāṇuriti
yadyatadviṣayeṇāpyatidiśyeta ghaṭādāvapi nakṣatraṃ tārā ghaṭaḥ ityatideśavṛttiryuktā syāt atadviṣayatvāt puṣyavat ityatiprasaṅgaḥ
nanvevamākhyāturākhyeyārthagataviśeṣairvinā tadākhyānāsambhavād nāntarīyakaṃ viśeṣaṇopādānam, tāni ca saṃkhyāliṅgādibhedā eva
uktaṃ hi--kriyākārakabhedena paryāyavacanena vākyāntareṇa ca vyākhyā
nanu puruṣo'pītyādi asvaviṣayatvāsiddhyudbhāvanaṃ yāvad gavādi goṇyeti

śabdo hi tena prakāreṇa vācyaviśeṣaṃ saṃvādinaṃ bravīti, tatsamparigrahaguṇena satyamucyate so'rthaviśeṣaḥ, na tu tadgatānāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ virodhenocyate yathā strī-puṃ-napuṃsakādīnāmekadvibahutvādīnāṃ caikārthatveneti saṃvāda-visaṃvādadarśano grantho yāvat saṃvādavyudasanavṛttiriti gatārthaḥ

eṣa prakṛtyādivisaṃvādeṣvapi aśeṣa ākṣepa-parihāraprapañca āyojyaḥ samānapracarcatvāt prakṛti-pratyayādyakṣaraviśeṣoccāraṇamātrabhedaḥ prahāsādidamasatyameva iti codyopakramaprabhṛtiryāvadetadavadhi liṅgādiviśeṣatyāgena yathānupūrvottarapakṣaviracano neya iti

nanvākhyāturākhyānakarmaṇi pravṛttasya ākhyeyārthagataviśeṣairavaśyambhāvibhirvinā tadākhyānāsambhavād nāntarīyakaṃ viśeṣaṇopādānam, tāni ca viśeṣaṇāni saṅkhyāliṅgādibhedā eva, itarathā arthopadeśābhāvaḥ, arthapratyāyanārthatvācchabdaprayogasya arthaparatantrasyānantarīyakatvavad liṅgādibhedanāntarīyakatvamiti
dve śūnye kṣayiṇī cetyaṣṭau jñeyāḥ kriyābhedāḥ
kārakabhedāḥ kartrādayaḥ ṣaḍaṣṭau vā kālopāyasahitāsta eva
56 ityasya sthānyādeśapṛthaktvāt sthānivadatideśo guruvad guruputre vartitavyam anyatrocchiṣṭabhojanāt pādagrahaṇācca pā.
...vyākhyāyāḥ kā kathaṃ vā'nupapattirliṅgādyabhede'pi ? anekārthaikaśabdagrahaṇenāpi vyākhyānād liṅgādyabhede'pyarthādhigatiḥ
ata eva ca vyākaraṇādhyayane yatna āstheyaḥ
13 athavā ācāryeṇaiva kriyābhedena divu krīḍetyādi vyākhyātameva yāvat sa vṛkṣa iti gatārtham
ihāpīti siddhaṃ vyākhyānaṃ pradarśya prastutaṃ yojayati kriyākārakabhedābhyāṃ puṣyatītyādi yāvat khapuṣpa iti gatārthā vyākhyā
athavānyā vyākhyā --upoddhātetyādi yāvad bhedalakṣaṇāyā iti vyākhyāyāḥ kā kathaṃ vehā'nupapattirliṅgādyabhede'pi iti sambhantsyate
athavāyamaparo vyākhyāmārgaḥ, tadyathā --adhikaraṇayogapadārthetyādi yāvat kā kathaṃ vānupapattirliṅgādyabhede'pīti
kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate ? sthānyādeśapṛthaktvādādeśe sthānivadanudeśo guruvad guruputra iti yathā
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? āṅo yamahanaḥ ityātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti hantereva syāt vadherna syāt, iṣyate ca vadherapi syāditi
taccāntareṇa yatnaṃ na sidhyatīti tasmāt sthānivadanudeśaḥ
tadyathā--guruvad guruputre vartitavyamiti gurau yat kāryaṃ tad guruputre'tidiśyate evamihāpi sthānivat kāryamādeśe'tidiśyate
yadi ca guruputro'pi gururbhavati tadapi kartavyaṃ bhavati
...vyākhyāyāḥ kā kathaṃ vā'nupapattirliṅgādyabhede'pi ? anekārthaikaśabdagrahaṇenāpi vyākhyānād liṅgādyabhede'pyarthādhigatiḥ
ata eva ca vyākaraṇādhyayane yatna āstheyaḥ
atra vakṣyamāṇād arthapravṛttitattvānām iti ślokāt pūrvaṃ vākyapadīye prāptarūpavibhāgāyā yo vācaḥ paramo rasaḥ
tasya vyākhyāyāṃ bhartṛhariṇā tathā coktam ityullikhya śabdārthasambandhanimittatattvaṃ vācyāviśeṣe'pi ca sādhvasādhūn
sādhuprayogānumitāṃśca śiṣṭānna veda yo vyākaraṇaṃ na veda
kintu nayacakravṛttau pratīkānāṃ sphuṭamadarśanādanayoranyataraḥ śloko'tra mallavādinā vivakṣito'nyo vā kaściditi nirṇetuṃ na pāryate
13, arthasya pravṛttitattvaṃ vivakṣā, na tu vastusvarūpatayā sattvamasattvaṃ vā
yogyaṃ hi śabdaṃ prayoktā vivakṣāprāpitasaṃnidhāneṣvabhidheyeṣu pratyarthamupādatte
...athavārthapravṛtteḥ kiṃ tattvam ? artharūpākāraḥ pratyayātmā bāhyeṣu vastuṣu pratyastaḥ
tattvāvabodhaḥ śabdānām, śabdasya tattvamavaikalyam, anapagatasaṃskāraṃ sādhusvarūpam, taddhyasyāvikalam
anye tu tatprayuyukṣayā prayujyamānā vikalāḥ syurapabhraṃśā iti
arthaśca pravṛttiśceti vā dvandvaḥ, artho dravyaṃ pravṛttiḥ kriyā tayostattvāt, teṣāṃ śabdo nibandhanam
bāhyatvena grahaṇaṃ na tu bāhyaṃ vastvastīti
sati bāhye'rthe tannibandhanā vivakṣā pūrvatra tattvamityuktā, samprati buddhireveti viśeṣaḥ
darśayati --yathāha--vāg-dig-bhū-raśmītyādi śloko'yamācāryeṇaiva vyākhyātaḥ yāvad dṛṣṭyā veti granthenaiva
vyākaraṇaṃ hi lakṣyādhigataye lakṣaṇaṃ kathaṃ nāma śabdādarthe jñānamaviparītaṃ syāt iti
128, abhijalpatvamadhyāsarūpatvamāgataḥ śabda eva svarūpalakṣaṇaḥ śabdasya vācyaḥ

129, so'yamityabhisambandho'dhyāsākhya ucyate, tena padārthasvarūpamācchāditamekīkṛtamiva pratyāyyate tadā'bhijalpaḥ śabda ucyate, adhyāsavaśācchabdārthayorekātmatve'pyarthāṃśasyaiva prādhānyamupayogavaśāt
130, tayoḥ śabdārthayoradhyāsavaśād rūḍherniyamādevāvyabhicāriṇi apṛthagarthatve ekarūpatve sati kiñcideva rūpaṃ yogavaśāt kvacideva loke śāstre vā prādhānyena udriktatayā'vatiṣṭhate
tatra loke'rthāṃśasyaiva prādhānyamityapi darśayitumāha — loke'rtharūpatāṃ śabdaḥ pratipannaḥ pravartate
artharūpatāṃ pratipanno'rthena sahaikatvamiva prāptaḥ śabdaḥ pravartate ayaṃ gaurityādi
śāstre tu śabdasyobhayarūpatāpi vibhāgena paridṛśyata ityāha --śāstre tūbhayarūpatvaṃ pravibhaktaṃ vivakṣayā
131, śāstre hi svarūpapradhāno nirdeśaḥ kvaciccārthapradhāno'pītyubhayarūpatā śabdasya dṛśyate
anye tu bruvate śabda evābhijalpatvamāgataḥ śabdārthaḥ iti
sa cābhijalpaḥ śabda evārthaḥ ityevaṃ śabde'rthasya niveśanam so'yam ityabhisambandhaḥ, tasmād yadā śabdasyārthena sahaikīkṛtaṃ rūpaṃ bhavati taṃ svīkṛtākāraṃ śabdamabhijalpamityāhuḥ

vāgādiṣu gośabda eko'nekārthaḥ, ekasmin pṛthubudhnādilakṣaṇe'rthe ghaṭa-kuṭa-kumbhādiśabdo'nekaḥ pravṛttaḥ ityevamādeḥ prakāśyasyārthasya prakāśakaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ sthāvara-jaṅgamānāmiva prakāśyānāṃ sūryaḥ
tathā na vyākaraṇamantareṇa vācyasya sūkṣmasya jñānaṃ vācakasya ca śabdasya, yaḥ śabdaḥ śabdakarmako vācameva brūte hasatijalpatyādistadviṣayaṃ ca jñānaṃ na sambhavati
arthā abhidheyāḥ, pravṛttayaḥ kriyāḥ puruṣahitahetavo'hitahetavo vā, teṣāmubhayeṣāṃ tattvāni svānyaviparītāni rūpāṇi śabdaireva jñāyante
athavārthasya pravṛttitattvāni yathāsvamekaikasyānantadharmātmavipariṇāmāḥ, tāni śabdairjñāyante, śabdā vyākaraṇeneti
athavā arthā dharmārthakāmamokṣāḥ, taddhetavaḥ pravṛttayaḥ, tāsāṃ tattvāni yathāsvaṃ sādhyasādhanabhāvāḥ
ityādivyākhyāviśeṣeṣu tadviṣayasamyagjñānasya śabdāḥ kāraṇāni, śabdajñānasya tu vyākaraṇamiti
129, 130, 131 darśanotprekṣābhyāmarthamupagṛhya tatra nyagbhūtasvaśaktiḥ buddhau pariplavamāna āntaro vijñānalakṣaṇaḥ śabdātmā śrutyantarapravṛttiheturabhijalpa iti bhartṛharyādimatam
vasurātasya bhartṛharyupādhyāyasya mataṃ tu sa ca svarūpānugatamarthamantaravibhāgena saṃniveśayati
punarvasū nakṣatram ityādisaṃkhyāvirodhādyayuktervijñānamapi tadviṣayamayuktam ityādivacanakhedo'yamakasmāt kriyate tvayā
kiṃ kāraṇam ? abhijalpo hi śabdārthaḥ, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, śabdārthasyābhijalpatvād na liṅgādivicārakhedenārthaḥ, asadviṣayatvāt, khapuṣpaviṣayavicārakhedavat
syānmatam--ko'sāvabhijalpa iti, atrocyate --sa ca śabda eva, sa cābhijalpaḥ śabda eva
darśanotprekṣābhyāmarthamupagṛhya tatra nyagbhūtasvaśaktiḥ buddhau pariplavamāna āntaro vijñānalakṣaṇaḥ śabdātmā śrutyantarapravṛttiheturabhijalpa iti bhartṛharyādimatam
vasurātasya bhartṛharyupādhyāyasya mataṃ tu sa ca svarūpānugatamarthamantaravibhāgena saṃniveśayati
tathāhi--bāhyayoḥ śabdārthayorbhinnendriyagrāhyatvādibhyo bhedasya siddhestayoraikyāpādanaṃ paramārthato'yuktameveti buddhisthayoreva śabdārthayorekabuddhigatatvādekīkaraṇaṃ yuktam
tathāhi--upagṛhītābhidheyākāratirobhūtaśabdasvabhāvo buddhau viparivartamānaḥ śabdātmā svarūpānugatamarthamavibhāgenāntaḥ saṃniveśayan abhijalpa ucyate
sa ca buddherātmagata evākāro yukto na bāhyaḥ tasyaikāntena parasparaṃ viviktasvabhāvatvāt

yo'rthaḥ so'yaṃ śabdo ghaṭaḥ ityabhedopacārasambandhād yadā śabdasya rūpamarthainaikīkṛtaṃ bhavati tadā yathā indrakaḥ, candrakaḥ itīndracandrādyapratyakṣārthānabhijño'pi indra-candraśabdarūpāpannaṃ gopālādimarthaṃ pratyāyayan dṛśyate so'rthena ekībhūtaḥ śabda eva abhijalpaḥ ityucyate

tayorapṛthagātmatve satyavyabhicāriṇi anyonyāvinābhāvitve'pi rūḍhivaśādeva kiñcid rūpaṃ prādhānyenāvatiṣṭhate śabdarūpamartharūpaṃ vā yathā laukikā arthapradhānāḥ śābdāḥ śabdapradhānā iti, tamarthaṃ pravibhāgena darśayati--saṃvyavahārakāle loke'rtharūpatāmiti śloko gatārthaḥ
agnimānaya ityukte loke dahanādilakṣaṇe'rthe sampratyayaḥ, na śabde
120 iti strīvācakeṣu sārtheṣu śabdeṣu, bhujo kauṭilye pā॰ dhā॰ 1418 ityevamādiṣu artheṣveva sampratyayaḥ

pradhānādidarśanena puruṣasya utprekṣayā vārthamabhidheyatvena upagṛhya pūrvoktacandrādivat sākāraṃ tatra nyagbhūtasvaśaktiḥ asvatantrīkṛtābhidhānasāmarthyaḥ buddhau pariplavamānaḥ ayamitthamanena śabdenocyata ityāntaro vijñāna- lakṣaṇaḥ śabdātmā śrutyantarasya bāhyasya dhvanyātmakasya pravṛttau hetuḥ utthāpakaḥ so'bhijalpālpo'bhidheyākāraparigrāhī bāhyācchabdādanya iti bhartṛharyādimatam
vasurātasya bhartṛharyupādhyāyasya mataṃ tu sa ca svarūpānugatamityādi, sa ca abhijalpaḥ svarūpānugatamartharūpamantaravibhāgena sanniveśayatīti

idānīmartheṣu na śaktiḥ pṛthagasti, kintu śabdādhīneti yathā te śabdairvidhīyante tathaivāvagamyanta iti svamāhātmyopasthāpita eva śabdārtha ityaṣṭamaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayitumāha --aśakteḥ sarvaśaktervā śabdaireva prakalpitā
132, athavā sarvaśaktirartho vyavasthitaḥ, tasya pratiniyataśaktyabhidhānaṃ śabdeneti navamaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayitumatraivoktam--sarvaśaktervā iti
śaktyārthaḥ kadācit kriyārūpatayābhidhīyate, kadācit siddharūpatayeti niyatā kriyādirūpatā śabdārthatayā pratipādyate
ihaikamevārthavastu ekasyāmavasthāyāmekasmin kāle yugapat paryāyeṇa vocyate viruddhairdharmaiḥ
tadyathā--odanaṃ pacati, pākamodanasya nirvartayati, nirvṛttiṃ pākasya karoti
tatra yadi karmatvaṃ kathaṃ śeṣarūpatvamodanasya śeṣarūpatvaṃ ca pākasya
tasmādavidyamānā vā śaktayo'syārthasya śabdena vivakṣāvaśāt samadhyāropyante
na hi tasyā vastuviṣayābhyāṃ sannidhānāsannidhānābhyāṃ kiñcidapi prayojanamasti
satyapi bāhye'rthe tannirapekṣaṃ svātantryamabhijalpasya pradarśayitumāha --aśakteḥ sarvaśaktervetyādi

yā etā gati-sthiti-jalpi-cintyādidhātuvācyāḥ kriyā bāhyārthaśaktyabhimatāḥ tadvān vāsau bāhyo'rtho'stu aśaktireva vā dvayorapi śaktimadaśaktipakṣayostāḥ kriyādiśaktayo niyatā eva jalpanādi manuṣyādīnāmeva, sarpaṇaplavanādyāḥ sarpaśakunādīnāmeva iti, sarvā eva tu ekasya kasyacidarthasya anekāḥ śabdaireva prakalpitāḥ śabdaśaktyutthāpitā ityarthaḥ
vastuta eka odana ekasyāṃ pacanāvasthāyāmekasmin muhūrtādau kāle bahubhirvaktṛbhiryugapadekena vā paryāyeṇa vaktrocyate viruddhairdharmaiḥ
tadyatheti nidarśayati, odanam iti devadattādikartṛsamārūḍhakriyaṃ karma, pākamodanasya iti ṣaṣṭhyā sambandhamātraṃ pākakarmatvam, nirvṛttiṃ pākasya iti ca pākasambandhitvamiti
bāhye'rthe viruddhadharmasambandhābhāvād yugapadekakāle na ghaṭate evam
nāpi krameṇa prayoge, vastuna ekatvāt pākasamavāyina odanākhyasya pākāvasthāyāḥ kālasya ca
tasmādityādi pāriśeṣyāt avidyamānā vetyādinā prathamavikalpe darśayati śabdasyaiva śaktiṃ yāvat samadhyāropyanta iti
sarvaśaktiyoge vetyādi dvitīyavikalpe'pi śabdaśaktimeva darśayati yāvat prakāśayatīti
tatrāśaktipakṣe vastugatā śaktiḥnāstyeva ityabhyupagatatvādaprayojikā śabdaprayogasya, khapuṣpavadasattvāt
na hi tasyā ityādi bhāvanā gatārthā yāvat kiñcidapi prayojanamasti, prayojane hi tāṃ tāṃ śaktimadhyāropayati
sarvaśaktipakṣe tu vyavasthitāmavyatikīrṇāṃ tāṃ tāṃ śaktimupādāya svaviṣayaniyatāḥ śabdāḥ prayujyante
yogyaśabdanibandhanā hi vivakṣā śrotṛbuddhau tāṃ tāṃ śaktim adhyāropayati

tadidaṃsambandhātmakaśabdārthayorbhedād yatrāsau prayujyate śabdo vaktumiṣyate ca śaktiśca yatrādhyāropyate tad vastu sarvasyāsyādhārabhūtam
yathārtharūpaṃ tathā hi sa yogyaḥ śabdastasyārthasya vācakaḥ
arthanibandhanā hi vivakṣā, itarathā vacanasya sati prayogaḥ syāt
tasyāmasatyāmapi bāhyārthaśaktau matpakṣe sambhavatyeva śabdaprayogaḥ, yasmād yogyaśabdanibandhanetyādi gatārthaṃ yāvacchaktimadhyāropayati

anenaiva tāvat tvadvacanena śabdādanyad vastu śaktyākhyaṃ śaktimadvā siddham

tat punarvastu kīdṛśamiti cet, darśayati --tadidaṃsambandhātmaketyādi, so'yamityabhisambandhāt ityetasmādeva vacanāt tacchabdavācyaṃ vastu idaṃśabdavācyācchabdādanyat arthādvā tacchabdavācyādidaṃśabdavācyaḥ śabdo'nyaḥ, ādhārādheyayorbhedāt tadidaṃsambandhātmakaśabdārthayoḥ

yatrāsau prayujyate śabdaḥ vaktumiṣyate ca yadviṣayā buddhirutpādayitumiṣṭetyarthaḥ śaktiśca yatrādhyāropyate tad vastu sarvasyāsya śabdaśaktibuddhi-vivakṣākhyasyārthakalāpasyādhārabhūtam, ādheyānāmādhāraprāṇataḥ siddheḥ
yogyaśabdācca bāhyārthasiddhiḥ, yogyo'nurūpaḥ śabdaḥ, kenacidarthena kaścit tadanurūpa eva śabdo yujyate pṛthubudhnādyarthena ghaṭaśabdaḥ
tasmād ghaṭākhyādarthāt siddhāt paścād bhavati śabdaḥ, anuśabdasya paścādarthatvāt siddhe'rthe paścācchabdenārthasya yogo'nurūpaḥ
yathārtharūpādipami ?tyādi, athavā anurūpo yogyaḥ, yathārtho'nuśabdaḥ, yathārūpaṃ yad yad rūpaṃ yathārūpamanurūpaṃ yathā yujyate tathetyarthaḥ

kathaṃ ca yujyata ityata āha --tathā hi sa ityādi, tena hi prakāreṇāsau yogamarhati yogyaḥ śabdaḥ tamarthaṃ pratyāyayiṣyāmīti prayogadarśanāt tasyārthasya vācakatvopeta ityarthaḥ, yo hyarthasyāvācakaḥ sa nānurūpo na yogya ityuktaṃ bhavati tvayaiva
na ca vivakṣāmātreṇa śabdaḥ śrotṛbuddhau tāṃ tāṃ śaktimādhātuṃ śaknoti
evaṃ cānena tvadvacanenaiva viśeṣalakṣaṇāḥ śaktayaḥ parigṛhītā eva tvayā
asmanmatavadeva ca viśeṣasvarūpapravṛttyā vinā na kaścicchaktimānanyaḥ
tāsāṃ ca teṣu teṣu vivakṣaiva vyañjikā
vivakṣaiva tāṃ tāṃ śaktimadhyāropayati prāgātmani paścāt prayogācchrotṛbuddhau
na hi śabda ityādi, śabdo hi samīkṣitapratyāyyapratyāyakasambandho vaktumiṣyate, na hyanāmṛṣṭapratyāyyapratyāyakabhāvaḥ

arthaṃ saṃpratyāyayiṣyāmīti śabdaḥ prayujyate--pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2

tvadvacanādeva asyārthasyāvidyamānāḥ śaktayo'dhyāropyante iti vikalpotthāpanādasambhavaṃ śaktimato'nyasya vayamapi brūmaḥ

yā sā viśeṣāṇāṃ svarūpapravṛttistayā vinā na kaścicchaktimān nāmānyaḥ, kintu viśeṣā eva viśeṣeṇāsmadabhīṣṭāḥ śaktayaḥ iti yadyucyante tvayā ucyatām, ko vārayati ? tāśca svārthasatyaḥ svena rūpeṇa santi śaktayo viśeṣarūpeṇa strī-puṃ-napuṃsakādibhāvena śaktyantaravyāvṛttarūpā viśeṣā eva vartamānāḥ santītyarthaḥ

tāsāṃ ca śaktīnāṃ teṣu teṣu pravṛttivastuṣu strītvādiṣu vivakṣaiva vyañjikā, vivakṣayā vyajyante prakāśyante satya eva śabdaprayogeṇa, saiva hi vivakṣā taṭastaṭī taṭam ityādīn sato viśeṣānabhivyanaktītyarthaḥ

kā vivakṣā ? vaktumicchā, saiva tāṃ tāṃ śaktimarthagatāṃ śabdamanapekṣya siddhāmadhyāropayati prāgātmani vaktari, paścāt prayogācchrotṛbuddhau, nāsatīm, vaktrabhiprāyagahaṇārthaprayatanāt pumānayamanena vivakṣitaḥ, strī iyam, netare ityādyananyabuddhivyavasthāpanena
atra prayogaḥ --śabdanirapekṣaiva vivakṣādhyāropyā śaktirartha iti pratijñā
pratyāyyatvāt, pratyāyakena vaktrā śrotari pratyayādhānaṃ pratyāyyatvaṃ śaktyākhyasyārthasya siddhameva
yaḥ pratyāyyaḥ sa śabdanirapekṣa pratyāyyatvāt, abhijalpārthāvayavavat, prayojakatvāccāsyāḥ śaktereva vivakṣābījatvāt

sarvaśaktipakṣe'pi cāsmanmatamevocyate tvayā, arthārthatvācchabdaprayogasya vyavasthitāmavyatikīrṇāṃ tāṃ tāṃ śaktimupādāya svaviṣayaniyatāḥ śabdāḥ prayujyante liṅgādibhinnasāmānādhikaraṇyakriyāyāṃ vyatikarāpatteḥ
yattu viṣayodgrāhe viruddhairdharmairyuktamityabhidhīyate etannātisamyakpratyapekṣita- eva siddhaḥ

abhijalpārthāvayavavat, yathā tvatprayuktasyābhijalpaśabdasyābhidheyo'rthaḥ samudāyaḥ ābhimukhyena jalpo'bhijalpaḥ tadidaṃsambandhātmaka ekībhāvastvayā śabdārthayorvyutpāditaḥ, sa ca pratyāyyo'vayavārthābhyām abhiśabdārthena jalpārthena ca, ābhimukhyena jalpo'bhijalpaḥ iti samudāyārthapratipatteravayavārthapratipattipūrvakatvāt

mā bhūd vivakṣā-prayogayostvadīyayorānarthakyamiti tāvabhyupagantavyau khapuṣpavailakṣaṇyena śabdanirapekṣau śaktyākhyau tvayā pratyāyyatvāt tathā śaktyākhyo'rthaḥ, itarathā abhijalpaśabdavaiyarthyaṃ syāditi

sarvaśaktipakṣe'pi cāsmanmatamevocyate tvayā, kasmāt ? arthārthatvācchabdaprayogasya vyavasthitām ityādinā, tadyathā--vyavasthitāṃ śabdenānāneyāmavyatikīrṇāmananyaśabdavācyāṃ tāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ strīpuṃnapuṃsakādikāṃ śaktyantaravyāvṛttyā vivakṣitāṃ viśiṣṭāmeva upādāya svaviṣayaniyatāḥ śabdāḥ prayujyante'bhinnaliṅgasaṅkhyādiviśiṣṭaikaśaktiviṣayaniyatāḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? liṅgādibhinnasāmānādhikaraṇyakriyāyāṃ vyatikarāpatteḥ, uktaṃ prāk --tārā-puṣya-nakṣatrāṇāṃ strī-puṃ-napuṃsakānāṃ vyatikareṇa prayogo'paśabdaḥ iti
kasmāt ? ekaikadravyānantaparyāyatvādasmanmatameva, ahaṃ hi tvayaiva saha virudhye na vādaparameśvareṇa
tena ca saha ko virodhaḥ ? tasya hi matam--ekaikaṃ dravyamanantaparyāyam, sāpekṣanirapekṣāśca pariṇāmāḥ paryāyāḥ śaktaya ityucyante, dravyāṇi cānyonyānugataśaktitvāt sarvaśaktīni

132 ityetasyāḥ kārikāyā viṣayaḥ śabdotthāpitāḥ kriyādiparikalpanā iti, etasyārthasya nidarśanārthamudgrāhyate --viruddhairdharmairyuktamityabhidhīyata svārtham, sarvasyāsyāviruddhaikārthatvāt
nanu sarva eva aviruddho'rthaḥ yadeva odanaṃ pacati iti karma tadeva pāka odanasya iti ṣaṣṭhyocyate
pākaśabdena ca bhāvaḥ kṛtocyate, pacati iti tiṅā kartrarthaḥ, kṛdabhihitabhāvadravyavattvāt kartuḥ sādhyatvāt
yadā caudanaḥ pratīto bhavati tadviṣayakriyāsandehe kiṃ karoti iti praśne odanasyāvyākhyeyatvādasyaiva pacervidhānaṃ pacati iti
tasyaiva pacaterapūrvasya vyākhyāne pākaṃ karoti iti pacinā prativacanāt karmatvam, uktavat
pākasya nirvṛttiṃ karoti iti kartṛpratyayārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe

itye- ityādiḥ sa eva granthaḥ pratyuccāryaḥ --ihaikamevārthavastu ityādi yāvaccheṣarūpatvaṃ ca pākasya ityudāhṛtya tasmādavidyamānā vā śaktaya ityādinā bhāvayitvā tadupasaṃhāre'bhihitam --tasmādubhayorapi pakṣayorityādi yāvat sambhavatīti
yadeva odanaṃ pacati iti paciviṣayaṃ karmaudanākhyaṃ tadeva pāka odanasya ityanayā ṣaṣṭhyocyate, anabhihite karmaṇi dvitīyā pā॰ 2
3 1--2 ekatra, ekatra ca kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti ṣaṣṭhī pā॰ 2
pākaśabdena ca bhāvaḥ pacyarthaḥ kṛtā ghañā ucyate, pacati iti tiṅā kartrarthaḥ, sa eva pākaṃ nirvartayati iti nidarśyate varṇyate na tiṅeti
kiṃ kāraṇam ? kṛdabhihitabhāvadravyavattvāt, uktaṃ hi — kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavad bhavati pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 3
67 iti pākaṃ karoti iti dravyavat karmaṇi dvitīyā, nirvartayati iti ca karotītyarthaḥ

kutaḥ ? kartuḥ sādhyatvāt, viklittistandulānāṃ pākaḥ, tadviṣayaḥ kartā sādhyate viklittinirvṛttiṃ karoti devadattaḥ, vikledayati, pacati, pākaṃ nirvartayati ityekārthatvāt pacikriyāvyāpṛtatvena sādhyate devadatta ityarthaḥ

yadā caudanaḥ pratīto bhavati tadviṣayabhujipacyādikriyāsandehe kiṃ karoti iti praśne odanasya prasiddhasyānūdyamānasyāvyākhyeyatvādasyaiva pacerbhujyādivyatirekeṇa vidhānaṃ pacati iti, tasyaiva pacaterapūrvasya vyākhyāne kiṃ karoti iti pṛṣṭe pākaṃ karoti iti pacinā prativacanāt karmatvam uktavaditi anabhihite karmaṇi dvitīyā kṛdabhihitabhāvadravyavattvāditi

pākasya nirvṛttiṃ karoti iti kartṛpratyayārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe, karoti iti devadattasya vyāpāraṃ viśiṣṭaṃ sthālyādivyāpārebhyaḥ, sambhavanadhāraṇādīnāṃ prakaraṇāt tatprayojakatvāt sthālyādyapi pacane vartate ityādinā sāmānyakārakatvaṃ devadattādhīnasya viśiṣṭasya kārakāntarapravartanābhāvaṃ ca darśayati
1 ityasyārthaḥ, vṛddhiḥ itīyaṃ saṃjñā bhavati ādaicāṃ varṇānām ākārasya ca aicoścetyādipratītāpekṣavyākhyānavat
nanu sarva eva aviruddho'rthaḥ yadeva odanaṃ pacati iti karma tadeva pāka odanasya iti ṣaṣṭhyocyate
pākaśabdena ca bhāvaḥ kṛtocyate, pacati iti tiṅā kartrarthaḥ, kṛdabhihitabhāvadravyavattvāt kartuḥ sādhyatvāt
yadā caudanaḥ pratīto bhavati tadviṣayakriyāsandehe kiṃ karoti iti praśne odanasyāvyākhyeyatvādasyaiva pacervidhānaṃ pacati iti
tasyaiva pacaterapūrvasya vyākhyāne pākaṃ karoti iti pacinā prativacanāt karmatvam, uktavat
pākasya nirvṛttiṃ karoti iti kartṛpratyayārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe
vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñātvena vidhīyate pratyekamādaicāṃ varṇānāṃ sāmānyena tadbhāvitānāmatadbhāvitānāṃ ca
evaṃ sarvatra pākaḥ sādhyarūpatāyāmeva vyavasthitaḥ sādhanamākāṃkṣatīti tasminneva kāle karmatvaṃ śeṣarūpatvaṃ cāviruddhaṃ tādarthyāt, śeṣasyākārakavivakṣaṇāt, tasmādaviruddhā kriyādiparikalpanā
tasmācchabdasyāpradhānatvāt kuto'sya kalpanāśaktiḥ ? ata itthaṃ kārikā paṭhitavyā--
sa cābhijalpatvamāgato vācyatāṃ yāyāt so'yamityabhisambandhācchabdasyārthena sahaikīkaraṇāt
na hi kaścit arthaḥ pṛthagasti śabdāt

itthaṃ vyākhyānaprakāreṇa sarvatra pākaḥ sādhyarūpatāyāmeva vyavasthitaḥ sādhanamākāṃkṣatīti tasminneva kāle karmatvaṃ śeṣatvaṃ ca bhajate, tasmād yuktamaviruddham, tādarthyāt sa eva sādhyarūpo'rthaḥ karmarūpāpannaḥ śeṣarūpāpannaśca sādhanādhīnanirvṛttika ucyate
kasmāt ? śeṣasyākārakavivakṣaṇāt, satāmeva hi kārakāṇāmavivakṣā śeṣa ucyate, tasmādaviruddhā kriyādiparikalpanā'rthaśaktiviṣayaiva na śabdotthāpitā
ata iti uktanyāyāditthaṃ kārikā paṭhitavyā --śaktervā sarvaśaktervetyādi
viśeṣāḥ śaktaya evopasarjanībhūtasāmānyāḥ, tadartho hi śabdaprayogaḥ, tasya vivakṣitatvāt, yathārthābhidhānaṃ ca śabdaḥ tattvārthabhāṣya 1

sarvaśaktervā iti vādaparameśvaramatenoktavat ekasyaivārthasyāviruddhaśaktiviśeṣasyānekaśaktyātmakasya vā svārthenaiva prakalpitā na śabdenāpradhānena niyatā vyavasthitā kriyā-karma-śeṣa-kartrādiparikalpanā
yadapi ca tvayā parikalpitam abhijalpaḥ śabdārthaḥ iti tadapi svena rāgeṇaiva svadṛṣṭiparituṣṭyaivoktam, nopapattyā
kasmāt ? abhijalpagatyarthābhāvāt, arthagatireva śabdagatiḥ iti vakṣyate
sa ca śabdo'bhijalpatvamāgato vācyatāṃ yāyāt ātmānamevārtharūpāpannaṃ brūyāt sambhāvyeta, kayopapattyā ? ityata āha --so'yamityabhisambandhācchabdasyārthena sahaikīkaraṇāt, asmādeva tvadvacanāt
na ca tad yadabhijalpatvamāgato vācyatāṃ yātīti
asambhavaṃ darśayati --na hi kaścidityādi yāvat sambandheneti
yena sahaikīkriyate'rthena tvanmatena yena sahaikīkriyeta śabdaḥ sambandhena
prayujyamānanāmnyapi bāhye yena yena viśeṣeṇa bhūyate tadupasarjanaṃ tad nāma, arthagatyarthatvācchabdaprayogasya tadvaśapravṛttitvāt, bhṛtyavat
vṛkṣa ityatra yadyapi pañcakaṃ śabdasya rūpaṃ sa mukhyo'rthaḥ, ya ekīkriyate so'pradhānaḥ iti śabdādarthasya pṛthak siddhau kriyetaikyamanayoḥ, tattu nāsti tvanmatenārthābhāvāt
sambandhasyāpi ca dviṣṭhatvāt pṛthagarthasiddhiḥ, itarathā sambandhābhāvāt

ato yena yena viśeṣeṇa bhūyate tasyārthasyaiva prādhānyam, nāmno dravyabhavanopasarjanatvāt dravyabhavanasyopa- ? sarjanaṃ tat, tadbhāvād dravyabhavanopasarjanatvāt tadupasarjanamasyātyantāpūrvasya mūrtasyāmūrtalakṣaṇaṃ bhavanaṃ viśeṣo'mūrtasya mūrtalakṣaṇam
iti sthite viśeṣaprādhānye itthamāntaranāmnyaprayogārhe viśeṣaprādhānyaṃ vyākhyātam
prayujyamānanāmnyapi bāhye yena yena viśeṣeṇa bhūyate tadupasarjanaṃ tad nāma, arthagatyarthatvācchabdaprayogasya tadvaśapravṛttitvāt, bhṛtyavat
atra bahutaraḥ pāṭhaḥ khaṇḍitaḥ pratibhāti sarvāsvapi pratiṣu

prayujyamānanāmnyapi bāhye yena yena viśeṣeṇa bhūyate yo yo viśeṣo bhavati tadupasarjanaṃ tasyaiva viśeṣasyopasarjanaṃ tad nāma bāhyam, arthagatyarthatvācchabdaprayogasya, arthaparatantro hi śabdaḥ prayujyate, tadeva hetutvenāha --tadvaśapravṛttitvāditi, bhṛtyavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ
bhṛtyo hi svāmivaśapravṛttiḥ svāmiparatantra upasarjanaṃ tathā śabda upasarjanamarthaḥ pradhānam, yatra prayujyate tadvaśavartī śabdaḥ, viśeṣo'rtha eva pradhānamiti
vacanaṃ saṅkhyā, ādigrahaṇād liṅga-kālakāraka-puruṣopagrahā gṛhyante viśeṣāḥ, tadvaśaṃ nāma
tathā cācāryasiddhasena āha--yatra hyartho vācaṃ vyabhicarati nābhidhānaṃ tat iti
tathā vyākhyātāro'pi prātipadikārthastathāpi vivakṣāpūrvakatvācchabdapravṛtteḥ vivakṣitasaṃkhyābhidhāyyeva vacanaṃ vidhīyate
tathā ca loke vṛkṣaśabdaprayoge sāmānyamupasarjanaṃ viśeṣaḥ pradhānamiti gamyate, ekārthagaterdvyādinivṛtteḥ
dṛśyate hi vacanādistasmād viśeṣādapayān, yathā ekavacanaṃ dvivacanārthaṃ nakṣatraṃ punarvasū...
svārtho liṅgaṃ dravyaṃ saṅkhyā karmādikārakāṇi iti pañcakaḥ prātipadikārthaścatuṣkastriko vā saṅkhyā-dravyāntaḥ

tathā''khyātasyāpi sarvasya nāmatvāviśeṣāt namayati arthaṃ gamayati ityādinirukteryadyapi pañcakaṃ sambhavati tathāpi tu vakturvivakṣitapūrvikā śabdapravṛttiriti sāmastyopagamaṃ parityajya pratipipādayiṣitaṃ viśeṣamekameva brūte śabdaḥ
ekadvibahuvacaneṣu prāpteṣu vivakṣitasaṅkhyābhidhāyi eva vacanaṃ vidhīyate trayāṇāmanyatamadeva, netare

ekavacanam iti samāsadvayasambhavāt sandehe'vadhārayati kimekasya vacanamekavacanamekaṃ ca tadvacanaṃ ca tadekavacanamiti vā ? ekasya vacanamekavacanamucyate, anenārthaḥ, karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīti śabdavyutpādanena
evaṃ ca kṛtvā loke vṛkṣaśabdaprayoge sāmānyamupasarjanaṃ viśeṣaḥ pradhānamiti gamyate
itarathā sāmānyaprādhānyāt sarvagatiragatiḥ sandeho vā syāt, yuktā tu viśeṣagatistadvaśavartitvānnāmnaḥ
anena tu evambhūta iva eva ? prakāśito lakṣyate, sarvaviśuddhatvāt tasyeti
yataḥ sa evamabhyupaiti--yadārthaśceṣṭāpravṛttastadā tatra ghaṭa ityabhidhānaṃ pravartyaṃ nānyadeti
na hi puruṣaḥ strī, yadīṣyeta vacanārthahāniḥ syāt, bhedārthaṃ hi vacanam
ataḥ svātiḥ tārā nakṣatramiti liṅgataḥ, nimbāmrakadambā vanamiti vacanataḥ, sa pacati tvaṃ pacasi ahaṃ pacāmi pacāvaḥ pacāma iti puruṣataḥ
tathā viruddhaviśeṣatvāt taṭastaṭī taṭamityavastu, raktanīlamiti yathā
yad vastu tadaviruddhaviśeṣamabhyupayanti santaḥ, yathā ghaṭaḥ kuṭaḥ kumbha iti
tathā cocyate — yatra hyartho vācaṃ na vyabhicaratyabhidhānaṃ tat
tathā ca loke vṛkṣaśabdaprayoge sāmānyamupasarjanaṃ viśeṣaḥ pradhānamiti gamyate, ekārthagaterdvyādinivṛtteḥ
dṛśyate hi vacanādistasmād viśeṣādapayān, yathā ekavacanaṃ dvivacanārthaṃ nakṣatraṃ punarvasū...
dhātuṃ pratyayaṃ pratyayāntaṃ ca varjayitvā arthavacchabdasvarūpaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñaṃ syāt
te'pi hi viśeṣāḥ paratantrā eva, tato'svavaśatvādanavasthānāt sāmānyabhavanaprādhānyameva
na hi vṛkṣavadekavacanameva dṛśyate sarvatra, yadi syāt syād viśeṣaprādhānyam, tasmād viśeṣavyabhicārāt sāmānyaprādhānyameva nyāyyam

mā maṃsthāḥ--viśeṣaprādhānyāvyabhicāra iti, dṛśyate hi vacanādistasmād viśeṣādapayān, vacana-liṅga-kāla-kārakapuruṣopagrahādiviśeṣāṇāṃ svasthitivyatikramaḥ svasamānādhikaraṇaviśeṣāccāpagatirloke dṛśyate
tadudāharaṇāni --yathā ekavacanaṃ dvivacanārthaṃ nakṣatraṃ punarvasū ityādīnyuttānārthāni yāvaddhetuḥ karmeti
sarvatrāpyevameva ca, yathāntyamudāhṛtamabhediliṅgaviśeṣavyabhicāre tathā prāktaneṣvapi vacanādi- ato viśeṣānavasthānād viśeṣo viśeṣa eva na bhavitumarhati
tataśca sāmānyamapi naiva, pravartakābhāvāt svavaśatvāt viviktavṛttitvāt muktavat, arthāntarābhāvabhavadbhavanābhyāṃ kenacidabādhyatvāt
atha so'pyasti bhedenārthaḥ śabdāt na tarhi śabda eva śabdārtho'bhijalpatvamāgato vācyaḥ
sa yathā śabdastathārtho'pi sambandhenaikīkriyamāṇatvāt pṛthak siddhaḥ kṣīrodakavad dvayorapyekīkṛtatve tulyatvāt
ato viśeṣānavasthānād viśeṣo viśeṣa eva na bhavitumarhati sāmānyāghrātarūpatvād viśeṣātmānavasthānāt
tataḥ kim ? tato'sau naiva syāt, bhavanameva nānubhavet, aviśiṣṭatvādanantaroktāt, aviśiṣṭatvamanavasthānād bhāvitavat, anavasthānamasvavṛttitvādasvavaśatvād bhāvitavadeva
pṛthak pṛthag vā viśeṣābhāve hetavastrayo'pi khapuṣpadṛṣṭāntāḥ
tataśca viśeṣābhāvāt sāmānyamapi naiva syāditi vartate
kasmāt ? pravartakābhāvāt, sāmānyasya hi prakṛtyarthasya bhavanādeḥ kriyātmanaḥ pravartakaḥ pratyayārthaḥ kartā syād viśeṣaḥ, tadabhāvānna pravartate sāmānyam

kimarthaṃ na pravartayati viśeṣaḥ sāmānyamiti cet, svavaśatvāt, svavaśo hi viśeṣo nāsāvasvavaśaḥ, kasmāt ? viviktavṛttitvāt, kimiva ? muktavat, yathā muktātmānaḥ karmapāratantryāpetatvād viviktavṛttayo na kiñcit pravartayanti na kenacit pravartyante kintu svayameva vartante tasmādapravartakatvasāmānyād dṛṣṭāntāḥ, tadvad viśeṣo'pravartakaḥ asanneva vā
tadvyācaṣṭe --arthāntarābhāva-bhavadbhavanābhyāṃ kenacidabādhyatvāt, arthāntaraṃ ca nāsti viśeṣāt
ato viśeṣānavasthānād viśeṣo viśeṣa eva na bhavitumarhati
tataśca sāmānyamapi naiva, pravartakābhāvāt svavaśatvāt viviktavṛttitvāt muktavat, arthāntarābhāvabhavadbhavanābhyāṃ kenacidabādhyatvāt
atha so'pyasti bhedenārthaḥ śabdāt na tarhi śabda eva śabdārtho'bhijalpatvamāgato vācyaḥ
sa yathā śabdastathārtho'pi sambandhenaikīkriyamāṇatvāt pṛthak siddhaḥ kṣīrodakavad dvayorapyekīkṛtatve tulyatvāt

arthābhāve mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti atha so'pyasti bhedenārthaḥ śabdād yasya tadrūpamanekaṃ sadekaṃ kriyate, kiṃ tataḥ ? idaṃ bhavati --na tarhi śabda eva śabdārtho'bhijalpatvamāgato vācyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? viśiṣṭā śaktiḥ śabdādanyā sarvaśaktirvārtho'nya iti prāptam

tata evedaṃ cāyuktaṃ tvayā yathocyate--taṃ śabdamabhijalpaṃ pracakṣate, sa ca śabdārtha iti, yasmāt sa yathā śabdastathārtho'pi sambandhenaikīkriyamāṇatvāt pṛthak siddhaḥ, kimiva ? kṣīrodakavad dvayorapyekīkṛtatve tulyatvāditi sādhyasādhanadharmānugamapradarśanam
api cetyādi arthārthatvamevoktaṃ prāk pratyāyyatvāt abhijalpārthāvayavavat iti tadarthasmāraṇaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvadartho'rtha evetyavadhāraṇam
yadā caivaṃ tadāsmanmatameva pratipannam, arthasya tattvāt
yo'sau śabdaḥ so'yaṃ na, asmādanya eva saḥ
evaṃ ca kṛtvā yogyaśabdanibandhanā hi vivakṣā śrotṛbuddhau tāṃ tāṃ śaktim adhyāropayati iti tvadukto grantho yukto'smin darśane
yogya eva śabdo nāyogyaḥ krīḍitamevāstu iti prayujyate kākavāśitādivadabuddhipūrvo vā, arthavisaṃvādādekīkartumaśakyatvāt
yadapi coktaṃ tayorapṛthagātmatve ityādi ślokadvayaṃ tadapi cāsmanmataphalameva
tayorapṛthagātmatvaṃ rūḍheratasya tadupacārāt pathi gamanavat, itaretarapradhānopasarjana-
yadā caivamityuktakrameṇa pṛthak siddhau prādhānye cārthasya tadāsmanmataṃ yathārthābhidhānaśabdatvameva pratipannam, arthasya tattvāt
tad vyācaṣṭe --yo'sau śabdaḥ so'yaṃ na artho na bhavati śabdaḥ artha evārthaḥ ityuktatvāditi asmādarthāt pratyakṣanirdeśyādanya evāsau saḥ iti parokṣanirdeśyo bhedena
evaṃviṣaya eva arthaviṣaya eva śabdaḥ, na śabdaviṣayo'rthaḥ nāpradhāna ityarthaḥ

aryate'yaṃ tena śabdena arthaḥ, kimuktaṃ bhavatīti, tenocyate gamyate, ṛ gatau pā॰ dhā॰, tasyārthaḥ śabdasya viṣayaḥ, viṣayiṇo viṣayaparatantratvād yārthasya gatiḥ śabdasyāpi saiva, nātmanaḥ pṛthak svatantrā
evaṃ ca kṛtvetyādi guṇotkarṣamasmanmate darśayiṣyāmaḥ, yogyaśabdetyādi yāvadadhyāropayati iti tvadukto grantho yukto'smin darśane

tadbhāvayati --yogya eva śabdaḥ pṛthubudhnādilakṣaṇasyārthasya ghaṭaśabdaḥ nāyogyaḥ paṭādiśabdo yaḥ kaścit krīḍitamevāstu iti prayujyate kākavāśitādivadabuddhi- pūrvo vā, kasmāt ? arthavisaṃvādāt, arthena visaṃvādo'sya vācyavācakasambandhābhāvaḥ, sa ca ekīkartumaśakyatvāt sambandhayitum
hiśabdo'pi cetyādi, yogyaśabdanibandhanā hi ityatra hiśabdo hetvarthe, yasmād yogyaśaktītyādi tadvyākhyā gatārthā yāvad maryādayā veti
tadanantaraṃ yat svalakṣaṇavyāptipradarśanārthaṃ lokagataśabdārthasaṃvyavahāravyavasthāpanārthaṃ coktaṃ tadapi cāsmanmatam arthasyārthāntaratvaṃ śabdādāpannam ityetatphalameva
katamat tat ? idaṃ ślokadvayam— tayorapṛthagātmatve vākyapa॰ ityādi
vayamatra niścinumaḥ--tayorapṛthagātmatvaṃ rūḍheḥ lokapratīteḥ atasya tadupacārād bhinnayorabhedopacārāt

kimiva ? pathi gamanavat, yathā panthāḥ pāṭaliputraṃ gacchati iti patho'sad gamanaṃ puruṣagatyabhedopacārāt tadavinābhāvād dvyarthatvāt tayorucyate tathā śabdārthayoravyabhicārādavinābhāvādabhedopacārād lokarūḍherapṛthagātmatvaṃ pṛthagbhūtayoreveti
tathā loke'rtharūpatāṃ śabdaḥ pratipannaḥ pravartate, vyākaraṇaśāstre tu śabdarūpatāṃ pratipannaḥ pravartate, śabdādhigamārthapravṛttirviśeṣo bhavativat
arthasya ca goḥ sāsnādi bhinnaṃ rūpam, tadarthatvācchabdasya gakārādivarṇānupūrvī śrotranādamātram
taddhi na kadācidartho bhavitumarhati kalpituṃ vā avyavasthitatvād vyatikīrṇatvādaniyatatvāt
pratipanno'pi svasambandhādeva sambandhasya dviṣṭhatvācchabdārthayorekībhāvagateḥ, nānyathā uktavat

tarapradhānopasarjanabhāvāt śabdasyopasarjanatvādarthasya prādhānyād dvyarthataiva, kimiva ? sanmitravat, yathā snigdhayormitrayoḥ pṛthak siddhayorekakāryapravṛttayoritaretarapradhānopasarjanatvaniyamastathā śabdārthayoḥ, tattu tvadvacanādeva siddham, yathoktaṃ tvayā--kvacideveti yāvadavatiṣṭhate
tathā loke'rtharūpatāṃ śabdaḥ pratipannaḥ pravartate, vyākaraṇaśāstre tu śabdarūpatāṃ pratipannaḥ pravartate, śabdādhigamārthapravṛttirviśeṣo bhavativat
arthasya ca goḥ sāsnādi bhinnaṃ rūpam, tadarthatvācchabdasya gakārādivarṇānupūrvī śrotranādamātram
taddhi na kadācidartho bhavitumarhati kalpituṃ vā avyavasthitatvād vyatikīrṇatvādaniyatatvāt
pratipanno'pi svasambandhādeva sambandhasya dviṣṭhatvācchabdārthayorekībhāvagateḥ, nānyathā uktavat
yathā prathamaśloko'smanmataṃ samarthayati tathā loke'rtharūpatām ityeṣo'pi
gāmabhyāja śuklām iti na śabde buddhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? abhidheye lokasiddhā
turviśeṣaṇe, śabdādhigamārthapravṛttirviśeṣo bhavativaditi, bhavatiśabdamadhigamayiṣyan bhū sattāyāmpā॰ dhā॰ 1 laṭ kartari ityādi karoti tasmād bhinnau
arthasya cetyādi, goḥ sāsnādi bhinnaṃ rūpam
tadarthatvācchabdasya gakārādivarṇānupūrvīśabdasya śrotranādamātram, tadarthaṃ śabdaprayogād gakārādivarṇānupūrvīmātroccāraṇam
taddhi na kadācidartho bhavitumarhati, kalpituṃ vā na iti vartate, tvayā yo'bhijalpaḥ kalpita eva sa na bhavatyarthaḥ
goḥ sāsnādi svarūpam, gośabdasya tu gakārādivarṇānupūrvīṃ svarūpamityāśayaḥ

bāhyārthastu vyavasthitaḥ deśakālādibhinnaśabdaśatasaṅkule'pi ghaṭaśabdasya ūrdhvagrīvādye svābhidheye prayogāt avyatikīrṇaśca, niyataḥ pratipādane'vaśyavācyatvāt tenaiva śabdena sa eva iti tatraiva ca buddhyutpatteḥ

abhyupetyāpi rūḍherapṛthagātmatvapratipattimavyabhicārādanayoḥ pratipanno'pi svasambandhādeva sambandhasya dviṣṭhatvācchabdārthayorekībhāvagateḥ pratiniyato'bhidhānābhidheyasambandhaḥ pārthakyamantareṇa na bhavitumarhati ghaṭaśabdārthayorityuktam, ekīkaraṇasyānyathā'sambhavāt, ata āha --nānyathā uktavaditi
kiñcānyat, śāstre tūbhayarūpatvaṃ pravibhaktaṃ vivakṣayā vākyapa॰ 2
131 evameva ca darśanotprekṣābhyāmityādi śabdād bahirarthasiddhau ghaṭate
dhvaniḥ śabdārthābhyāṃ na pravartyeta akartṛbhyāṃ karaṇakarmabhyām

yastu prayuṅkte kuśalo viśeṣe pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ ityādikrameṇa gośabdasya sāsnādimati sādhutvaṃ siddhe'rthe śabde sambandhe ca pṛthak, goṇyādāvasādhutvaṃ rūḍhitaḥ, arthaviśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ goṇyā āvavane sādhutvamityādi ca nānyathā ghaṭate
tasya ca sādhvasādhutvajñānasya prayojanaṃ dharmaniyamaḥ siddhe śabdārthasambandhe pā॰ vā॰ ityādiruktaḥ so'pi pṛthagarthasiddhiṃ sūcayati
lokenābhidheye'rthe śabdāḥ prayuktāḥ prayojanena vā, tatrārthasya pṛthak siddhau śabdasya ca tadviṣayasya dharmārthaḥ prayoganiyamaḥ sādhoḥ svārthaḥ śāstreṇa kriyate bhakṣyābhakṣyaniyamavaditi
evameva ca darśanotprekṣābhyāmityādi śabdād bahirarthasiddhau ghaṭate
dhvaniḥ śabdārthābhyāṃ na pravartyeta akartṛbhyāṃ karaṇakarmabhyām
pṛ॰ 128 paṃ॰ 18, pṛ॰ 573 paṃ॰ 25, ṭipṛ॰ 57 paṃ॰ 22— 26
kathaṃ punaridaṃ bhagavataḥ pāṇinerācāryasya lakṣaṇaṃ pravṛttam ? siddhe śabdārthasambandhe
...yadi tarhi loka eṣu śabdeṣu pramāṇaṃ kiṃ śāstreṇa kriyate ? lokato'rthaprayukte śabdaprayoge śāstreṇa dharmaniyamaḥ kriyate
loke tāvadabhakṣyo grāmyakukkuṭaḥ, abhakṣyo grāmyasūkara ityucyate
...evamihāpi samānāyāmarthāvagatau śabdena cāpaśabdena ca tatra dharmaniyamaḥ kriyate--śabdenaivārtho'bhidheyo nāpaśabdeneti

evameva cetyādi etasyaiva kārikātrayābhihitasyārthasya varṇakadaṇḍako'pi darśanotprekṣābhyāmityādi, pradhānapuruṣeśvarādimayam ityādidarśanāni śabdād bahirarthasiddhau ghaṭante, vastunyabhinne ghaṭādau bāhye tu puruṣāṇāṃ cotprekṣā nityānityāditvena niyamena sadbhāve, nānyathā
kotprekṣā ? ityādi tadgranthānusāreṇāsambhavaṃ sopapattikaṃ darśayati yāvat kuto'bhijalpo heyaḥ ? iti sabhāvanaṃ gatārtham
arthābhāve na ghaṭate, arthasadbhāve yujyata iti piṇḍārthaḥ
abhinne ekasmin vastuni ghaṭādau bāhye nityānityāditvena puruṣāṇāmutprekṣā ghaṭate, na tu bāhyārthābhāve ityāśayaḥ
atrārucau tu vastuni bhinne iti pāṭhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ
kuto'bhijalpo heyaḥ hetugamyaḥ ityarthe yathāśrutameva sādhu
anyathā tu kuto'bhijalpo'heyaḥ iti kuto'bhijalpo'bhidheyaḥ iti vā pāṭho'tra sambhavet
kiñcānyat, śrutyantarapravṛttihetuḥ ityetadapi tvatkalpitābhijalpe naivopapadyate, asmadiṣṭe tūpapadyate

tadyathā--śruteranyā śrutiḥ śrutyantaram, antarekībhūtābhijalpapṛthagbhūto dhvanirvyavahārānupātī syāt, sa tvadiṣṭābhyāṃ śabdārthābhyāṃ na pravartyeta akartṛbhyāmacetanābhyāṃ karaṇa-karmabhyām, pravṛttihetuḥ śrutyantarasya bhavitumarhati
śabdārthayorekībhūyāntarvartamānayoḥ kānyā śrutiḥ śrutyantaramityucyeta ? kena ca viśeṣeṇa tatpravṛttiheturucyate ? asti viśeṣaḥ
tadyathā--ghaṭārthapratyāyanārthaṃ dhvanyātmakaśabdotpattikāryadarśanāt tadanurūpaḥ kāraṇabhūto'numīyate ghaṭaśabdaḥ, nārthaḥ tadvirūpatvāt
tasmācchrutiḥ śrutyantarasya pravartikā śrutitvāt, nārtho nāpyātmā
nanu tasyāpi śrutyantarasya śrutitvāt pūrvaśrutivadarthapravartitaḥ śabdaḥ, arthābhāve prayogānarthakyāt
ābhimukhyena jalpatyarthaṃ śabdaḥ, tamartho'bhijalpayati, tadviṣaya evābhijalpa ityucyate
cetanātmatvāt tvātmā svatantraḥ, svātantryāt kartā, sa pravṛttihetuḥ śrutyantarasya bhavitumarhati

idaṃ cāyuktaṃ śrutyantaram iti vibhajya kathanam, śabdārthayorekībhūyāntarvartamānayoḥ kānyā śrutiḥ śrutyantaram ityucyeta ? tasmād viśeṣābhāve kathamavibhrāntairavibhaktaḥ san vibhaktaḥ śabdātmā ucyate ? kena ca viśeṣeṇa śrutyantarābhāvena tatpravṛttiheturucyate ? caitanya-svātantryakṛtaṃ kartṛtvaviśeṣamantareṇa śrutyantarāsambhave kasya pravṛttihetutvam ?
śabdārthayorekībhūyāntarvartamānayoḥ kānyā śrutiḥ śrutyantaramityucyeta ? kena ca viśeṣeṇa tatpravṛttiheturucyate ?
tadyathā--ghaṭārthapratyāyanārthaṃ dhvanyātmakaśabdotpattikāryadarśanāt tadanurūpaḥ kāraṇabhūto'numīyate ghaṭaśabdaḥ, nārthaḥ tadvirūpatvāt
tasmācchrutiḥ śrutyantarasya pravartikā śrutitvāt, nārtho nāpyātmā
nanu tasyāpi śrutyantarasya śrutitvāt pūrvaśrutivadarthapravartitaḥ śabdaḥ, arthābhāve prayogānarthakyāt
ābhimukhyena jalpatyarthaṃ śabdaḥ, tamartho'bhijalpayati, tadviṣaya evābhijalpa ityucyate
kāraṇānurūpatvāt kāryāṇāṃ dhvanyātmakaśabdotpattikāryadarśanādantarniviṣṭo'pi tadanurūpaḥ kāraṇabhūto'numīyate śālyaṅkuradarśanācchālibījavad ghaṭaśabdaḥ, nordhvagrīvādilakṣaṇo'rthaḥ tadvirūpatvāt
upādānaṃ ca śruteranurūpā śrutireva yuktā, nārtho ghaṭādirvairūpyāt
tasmācchrutiḥ śrutyantarasya pravartikā nārtho nāpyātmetyayaṃ viśeṣa iti
etadapyanumānaṃ pratitarkabādhyam, vijñānasanniviṣṭaghaṭārthapravartyā sā śrutiḥ śrutitvāt
nanu prāguktam--arthapratyāyanārthaṃ śabdaḥ prayujyate na vāyasavāsitādivad nirarthakaḥ krīḍitamevāstu iti vetyādi

niruktyartho'pyabhijalpasya tathā ghaṭate nānyathā, japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci pā॰ dhā॰ 397, 398, ābhimukhyena jalpatyarthaṃ śabdaḥ, taṃ prayuṅkte'rthaḥ abhijalpayati, tadviṣaya evābhijalpa ityucyate, yadyābhimukhyenāvasthitamarthaṃ jalpati tato jalpaḥ śabdaḥ, so'rtho viṣayo'sya tadviṣaya evābhijalpaḥ śabdaḥ, etaduktaṃ bhavati--arthaviṣayaḥ śabdaḥ śabdārthakalpanāyāṃ yuktataraḥ syāt, arthotthāpitaśabdābhijalpatvapakṣe'bhijalpaśabdārthaparikalpanā yuktatarā syāt, na tu tvatparikalpite śabdaprerite
yattu vasurāto bhartṛharerupādhyāyaḥ sa ca svarūpānugatamarthamantaravibhāgena saṃniveśayatītyāha tena dvāvapi śabdo'rthaścābhyupagatau
na tu sa tena śabdanayenābhihitānanyānyaliṅgādisāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvādidoṣān parihartuṃ śaknoti
nanu śabdānugatārthamantaravibhāgena iti bruvatā arthatantraḥ śabdo'bhihitaḥ, na śabdatantro'rthaḥ
yathā ca rūpādaya ekaikabhavanātmakā na paryāyāntaramapekṣante viśeṣatvāt tathā puṣyatārānakṣatrādipuṃliṅgādayaḥ parasparavirodhitvād viśeṣāṇāmiti kutaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam ?
yattu vasurāto bhartṛharerupādhyāyaḥsa ca svarūpānugatam ityādyāha tena dvāvapi śabdo'rthaścābhyupagatau, sambandhasya dviṣṭhatvāt sambandhinorabhyupagatiḥ
prācyādatyandhadarśanāt taimirikadarśanamidaṃ tattvadṛṣṭiṃ pratyāsīdati, na dūrāpayātam, abhijalpasvarūpaṃ tu punastenāpi nirastam

etasminnapi darśane yathā puṣyaśabdārthayorantaḥ sanniveśanamavibhāgena svaliṅgavacanakārakādibhedayorevamiṣṭālliṅgāderanyānyaliṅgādīni anyaśabdārthagatānyapi sanniveśayiṣyati sa iti sāmānyopasarjanaviśeṣapradhānavādinā śabdanayenābhihitāṃstatsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvādidoṣān parihartumaśakta eva tathāpi

svarūpamanugato'rthaḥ, tamarthamantaravibhāgena iti bruvatā arthatantraḥ śabdo'bhihito na śabdatantro'rthaḥ, yadyarthamanugataḥ śabdo'ntaravibhāgena sanniveśyeta tataḥ śabdapreritatvācchabdāvadhāraṇādartho vyudastaḥ syāt, kintu tadviparītaṃ śabdāvadhāraṇavyudasanādarthaprādhānyāva- lambanaṃ kṛtam
tato'rthatantratvāt arthapradhānatvācchabdapravṛtteḥ, pravartako hi śabdasyārthaḥ, tasmāt tadavasthā doṣāḥ
tasmāduktavadeva viśeṣaprādhānyavāde'rthāntaranirapekṣāṇāṃ puṣya-tārā-nakṣatrādiviśeṣāṇāṃ nāsti sāmānādhikaraṇyam, ato viśeṣa eka eva vyavasthitaḥ
eṣā tāvad vastuno'rthaparyāyeṣu bhāvanā kṛtā śabdagocarātikrānteṣu, vyañjanaparyāyeṣvanenātideśaḥ kriyate --yathā cetyādi
rūpādayo yugapadbhāvyabhimatā apyekaikabhavanātmakā na paryāyāntaramapekṣante viśeṣatvāditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ

ekamekameva bhavanaṃ bhavati na dvitīyamiti kutaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? puṣyaḥ pumān sa kathaṃ strī bhavatīti tārā iti, napuṃsakaṃ vā nakṣatram iti ? evaṃ vacana-kāla-kāraka-puruṣopagrahādibhedā na parasparāpekṣā viśeṣaikabhavanāditi bhāvanīyam
tathā nāma-sthāpanā-dravya-bhinnaliṅgādivācyeṣṭākaraṇād bhāvayuktavācī śabdaḥ iti ca lakṣaṇāntaram
tatra vibhāgena dravyadravyārthavācyaṃ pūrvanayeṣūktamiṣṭaṃ na karotīti naigamādigocaramanenāpi vyāvartitameva śabdanayena
ṛjusūtrasyārthaparyāyasya gocaraṃ ca bhinnaliṅgādivācyamiṣṭaṃ na karotīti yathā vacanādi sādhu iti manyamānaḥ śabdanayaḥ pravartate yuktyā ca yathā tasya mataṃ śabdasya tathā prakārāntaṃ pradarśitam
nāmaṃ ṭhavaṇā davietti esa davvaṭṭhiyassa ṇikkhevo
bhāvo u pajjavaṭṭhiyaparūvaṇā esa paramattho || sanmati॰ 1 | 6 tti

adhunā sāmānyabhedaṃ sthāpanādravyārthamavyāvartitaṃ vyāvartayitukāmaḥ sambandhayati --vyavahārāntaḥpātisthāpanāvācyeṣṭākaraṇapradarśanārthaṃ tu, vyavahāranayāntaḥpātinī sthāpanā, tadvācyamiṣṭaṃ na karoti ityetat pradarśayiṣyate, sthāpanādravyārthasvarūpe cāvidite na śakyaṃ tat pradarśayitumiti sthāpanādravyārthasvarūpameva tāvadākhyāyate
tatra sthānakriyāyāḥ kartustiṣṭhataḥ prayojake samavetā ṇyantavācyā ṇyāsaśrantho yuc pā॰ 3
tāṃ vaktukāmaḥ sthānameva tāvad vyācaṣṭe --sthīyate yasmiṃstat sthānam, bhāva-karaṇā-'dhikaraṇa-karmasādhaneṣvadhikaraṇaṃ tāvadāha
vakṣyamāṇārthasambandhād bhāvaḥ kriyā sthānam, kartrā tiṣṭhatā sthīyate, atastannirṇayārthaṃ pṛcchati --kena sthīyata iti
itiśabdo hetvarthe, yasmāt sacittasya devadattāderacittasya vā ghaṭādeḥ sthānam iti viśeṣyānuktamataḥ sāmānyena yena kenacit sthātavyam
yasmin ityadhikaraṇasyoktasya nirṇayārthaṃ pṛcchati --kva ca sthīyata iti
āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ, maryādayā karaṇamabhividhinābhivyāptyā vā''kāraḥ, bhūkṛñoḥ sarvadhātvarthavyāpitvādā parisamāpanamabhivyāptiḥ prastutasya rūpasya, tena ākaraṇam, tasmin sthānaṃ maryādayā vā
īṣat tiṣṭhata aikāgryeṇa sthānam, svayaṃ tiṣṭhato'sadbhāvena sarvatra viśeṣya sthāpyamānaṃ sthānam, aniścitaikakriyaprayojyatvavat asadbhāvena vā atadbhūtarūpe'pi sthūṇendravat, tathā'kṣādiṣu

tatrābhividhiṃ vyācaṣṭe --abhividhiḥ parisamāpanamabhivyāptiḥ, kasya ? prastu- tasya rūpasya svabhāvasya vastvātmanaḥ, tena abhividhinā prastutarūpaparisamāpanena ākaraṇamābhavanam, tasmin sthānam, maryādayā vetyanarthāntaraṃ yojayati
kā maryādā ? anyarūpavilakṣaṇatā rūpāntaravyāvṛttirniyama ityarthaḥ, na hyanākāraṃ kiñcidasti, sarvamākāraparigraheṇa bhavati tiṣṭhatīti sthānamākāro maryādābhividhibhyām
asya sthānasya svatantrasthātṛsamavāyinaḥ prayojake hetukartari vihito ṇic, tasya bhāvaḥ kriyā prakarṣayojanā prayojanā prayojakatvaṃ hetukartṛtvaṃ sthāpanā
kimuktaṃ bhavati ? īṣat tiṣṭhato viprakīrṇarūpasthānasya sthāturaikāgryeṇa sthānaṃ tadaikāgryādhānam

tad vyācaṣṭe --svayaṃ tiṣṭhato'sadbhāvena sarvatreti akṣa-varāṭakādyasamāptābhipretākāraṃ svayameva tiṣṭhadasadbhāvena tiṣṭhati, tattu viśeṣya sthāpyamānaṃ parisamāptaṃ sthānaṃ svaviśiṣṭa ākāre'bhivyāpya tiṣṭhati indro'yaṃ skandaḥ ityādi rūpāntaravyāvṛttyā maryādayā niyataṃ veti

kimiva ? ityata āha --aniścitaikakriyaprayojyatvavat, yathā paci-paṭhi-gamyādikriyāvadhāraṇābhāvenāniścitakriyaṃ svatantraṃ kartāraṃ hetukartā paca paca iti niyuṅkte pacāveva sthāpayati kriyāntaravyāvṛttyā tatraiva sthāne pacyākāre niyamayati sa sthāpanāniyamaḥ, evaṃ sarvatrā''kāre sadbhāvasthāpanayā niyamaḥ prastutarūpasya parisamāptyā rūpāntaravilakṣaṇatayā maryādayā veti sthānārthaḥ
taṃ vyākhyāya sthāpanārtho vyākhyātaḥ śabdaḥ vyutpattyā

evaṃ tarhi asadbhāvasthāpanāyā niyamayiturabhāvād na vyāpitā lakṣaṇasyeti cet; na ityucyate, sukhapratipādyatvādādau sadbhāvasthāpanā itthaṃ pratipāditā, tatsamānaṃ pratipādanamitarasyāmapītyata āha --asadbhāvena vā atadbhūtarūpe'pi sthūṇendravat, tadeva hi vastu vyaktāvyaktākārapariṇāmaṃ svayaṃ tathā tathā tiṣṭhad viśeṣyābhīṣṭe sthāpyate yathā sthūṇaivāsaṃskṛtāvasthāyāmapyavyaktatarāvayavākārāyāṃ viśeṣyamāṇā citrāvasthāṃ vyaktāvayavākārāmapratyāsīdantī indraḥ iti sthāpyate tasmāt sāpi sthāne niyamyate, ato vyāpyeva lakṣaṇam
parisamāpanamabhivyāptiḥ prastutasya rūpasya, tena ākaraṇam, tasmin sthānaṃ maryādayā vā
īṣat tiṣṭhata aikāgryeṇa sthānam, svayaṃ tiṣṭhato'sadbhāvena sarvatra viśeṣya sthāpyamānaṃ sthānam, aniścitaikakriyaprayojyatvavat asadbhāvena vā atadbhūtarūpe'pi sthūṇendravat, tathā'kṣādiṣu
tasmād yathā bālādītyādi uktopapattinigamanaṃ sabhāvanamudāharaṇaṃ yāvad devadattaḥ

bālatvasya kāraṇadravyāṇi pītthakādīni yuvatvādīnāṃ cānyānyānīti dravyabheda upapannaḥ, tathā pācako lāvako'dhyāpaka tvāt tadākāratattvo devadatta ekaḥ sarvabhedo'pi evaṃ citralepyapustādibhedopapattāvapi tathā tiṣṭhatastasya tasya sthānasya prayojanāt sā sthāpanā, tatkarmaṇastattvāpatteḥ
sthāpanayā nikṣepaḥ sthāpanānikṣepaḥ, sthāpanā sadbhāvāsadbhāvābhyāṃ vastu nikṣipati
yathā puruṣād nāmakarma nāmakarmaṇo devadattāditā tathā ca citrakarādiḥ...
ityādirnāmabhedaḥ, kriyāyāḥ kṣāyopaśamikavīryātmakatvād bhāvabhedaścopapannaḥ, vividhaśabdādevamādibhedā gṛhītāḥ

satyāṃ caivaṃ dravya-nāma-bhāvabhedopapattau devadattākārasyābhinnatvāt tadākāratattvo devadatta ekaḥ sarvabhedo'pi nānyo'nyaśca ākāraparamārthatvābhedāditi bhāvayitvā tenodāharaṇena dārṣṭāntikeṣu citrādiṣvapi bhāvayitumāha --evaṃ citra-lepya-pustādibhedopapattāvapi tathā tiṣṭhatastasya tasya sthānasya prayojanāt sā sthāpanā
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tatkarmaṇastattvāpatteḥ, citrakarakarmaṇastadindratvāpatteḥ pīthakādidravya-pācakādināma-bhāvabhedakarmaṇāṃ devadattākāratvāpattivaditi vyāpitā sthāpanāyāḥ
sthāpanādravyārthaikāntavādinastu na kiñcidākāravyatiriktamasti, ato bhrāntimātraṃ bhedāḥ
tvāt tadākāratattvo devadatta ekaḥ sarvabhedo'pi evaṃ citralepyapustādibhedopapattāvapi tathā tiṣṭhatastasya tasya sthānasya prayojanāt sā sthāpanā, tatkarmaṇastattvāpatteḥ
sthāpanayā nikṣepaḥ sthāpanānikṣepaḥ, sthāpanā sadbhāvāsadbhāvābhyāṃ vastu nikṣipati
yathā puruṣād nāmakarma nāmakarmaṇo devadattāditā tathā ca citrakarādiḥ...
bhā॰ pāṭho'pi samīcīna eva bhāti, tadidantvāpatteḥ tasya idantvāpatterityartho bhāti
atrārthe'rucau tu tadindratvāpatteḥ iti pāṭhaḥ kalpyaḥ
tasmāt sthāpanayā nikṣepaḥ iti tṛtīyāsamāse sthāpanānikṣepaḥ ityasya vyākhyānārthamāha --sthāpanā sadbhāvāsadbhāvābhyāṃ vastu nikṣipati
kimiva ? yathā puruṣād nāmakarma, prāgamūrtātmā lakṣaṇataḥ sannātmā karmatvena mūrtātmanā parivartate ābhavati
tataśca nāmakarmaṇo devadattāditā, tasmādupāttāt karmaṇo nāraka-tairyagyona-devadattākhyamanuṣyatvāpattireṣa dṛṣṭāntaḥ

tadvyākhyā --tatrātmavadatathābhūtasya tathātvāpādanāt tadekatā citrakarmādidevadattasyeti, yathā jīva-karmaṇoranyonyātmāpattyā bhinnābhimatayorekatvāpattirākhyātā tathā citragatavarṇakādidevadattatvāpattirapītyarthaḥ

athavābhyupagacchāmo jīvakarmaṇorapi bhedam, eka eva jīvākhyo'rthaḥ pāriṇāmikajīvabhavyābhavyatvādibhāvāpattipariṇāmaḥ kṣāyopaśamikaudayikādipariṇāmaścaikadvitricaturindriyatiryaṅnārakādiḥ sarva eva devadattaḥ karmātmaikyāditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ
tad darśayati --yathā ca jīvatvādi pūrvarūpamityādi daṇḍako gatārthaḥ

athavā jīvasya karmapudgalānāmapi cābheda eva, kṣāyopaśamikaudayikādipṛthakpariṇāmābhāvādeka eva pāriṇāmiko bhāvaḥ, atastayorapi nāsti tatrātmavadatathābhūtasya tathātvāpādanāt tadekatā citrakarmādidevadattasya
yadi sthāpanayā citrādi sthāpyaṃ devadattoddeśena devadattasvarūpamāpadyate tathā devadatto'pi kasmānna citrādisvarūpamāpadyate
tathendratāmakṣādirāpadyate nākṣatāmindra ityatra ko viśeṣahetuḥ ? nanvasāvapi indranāmagotrakarmasthāpyatvāt sthāpanānikṣepātmakatāṃ nātivartate
ato yujyata evaitat, na na yujyate
sthāpanā ākāro vastvātmā nikṣipyate svātmani ghaṭādiḥ kumbhakārādibhiḥ, mumukṣubhirātmā

tathendro'pīndrā- parasparato bhedo dharmābhedādityata āha --yathā ca jīvatvaṃ tatpūrvaṃ jīvapūrvaṃ pāriṇāmikena caitanyena sarvapariṇāmābhimukhenā'vyaktākāramasadbhāvasthāpanaṃ satataṃ tiṣṭhat sthāpyate tathā pudgalānāmapi varṇādipāriṇāmikā bhāvā asadbhāvasthāpanena mahāśveta-sindūrādivarṇakajātam, atastayorekatā, kasmāt ? ākāratattvaikatvāt buddhyā''kriyamāṇatvenābhedāt tatpariṇāmātmakatvāt tathā tathā sthānaniyamādabheda iti
aupaśamikakṣāyikau bhāvau miśraśca jīvasya svatattvamaudayikapāriṇāmikau ca
yadi sthāpanayā citrādi sthāpyaṃ devadattoddeśena devadattasvarūpamāpadyate tathā devadatto'pi kasmānna citrādisvarūpamāpadyate
ato yujyata evaitat, na na yujyate
sthāpanā ākāro vastvātmā nikṣipyate svātmani ghaṭādiḥ kumbhakārādibhiḥ, mumukṣubhirātmā

ayamabhiprāyaḥ--yadi sthāpyākārānākāravastuno'tiriktasyoddeśyasya devadattasya svarūpaṃ citrādi sthāpyavastu āpadyate tatastadvaccitrādeḥ sthāpyasya svarūpaṃ kasmād devadattādiruddeśyo'rtho nāpadyate, tulye sthāpayitṛvaśād vyatiriktārthasvarūpāpattihetutve sthāpanāyāḥ ? tathā indratāmakṣādirāpadyate nākṣatāmindra ityatra ko viśeṣahetuḥ ? iti sadbhāvāsadbhāvasthāpanayoścodyametat
naitadaniṣṭam, iṣyata evaitat, ato na doṣaḥ
yathā citra-lepyādi sthāpyamindroddeśena indro bhavati tathendro'pyakṣādirbhavati
api ca so'pīndranāma- gotrakarmasthāpyatvāt sthāpanānikṣepātmakatāṃ nātivartate, puruṣād nāmakarma nāmakarmaṇo devadattāditā ityādigranthena bhāvitatvāt
ato yujyata evaitat, na na yujyate, dviḥpratiṣedhasya prakṛtyāpatteḥ
evaṃ tāvat sthāpanayā nikṣepaḥ iti tṛtīyāsamāse sthāpānānikṣepadravyārthanayavyāpitā darśitā
sthāpanāyā nikṣepa iti samāsaḥ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīṃ kṛtvā

kena ? kumbhakārādibhiriti vyākhyātaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsārtho'pi vastutaḥ prastute vyāpakatvapradarśanārthamāha --mumukṣubhirātmā svātmani nikṣipyate iti vartate, kīdṛśa iti cet, karmāmiśraḥ sthāpyate svākāre'viviktaḥ san viviktarūpatvena
tathendro'pī nindrayorvivekamajānatāṃ puṃsāṃ sākṣāt pradarśyate; yasmād na tadākāravinābhūta indro ghaṭa iva vikukṣivinābhūtaḥ
tyādi aviviktaviviktasthānalakṣaṇasthāpanānikṣepātmakatvaṃ jagataḥ pratyakṣīkriyate vyāpitvād lakṣaṇasyāsya, indrānindrayorvivekamajānatāṃ puṃsāṃ sa indraḥ sākṣāt pradarśyate
kasmāt ? yasmād na tadākāretyādi, nayanaśabdlavarṇatādyākāramantareṇa indrābhāvāt tadākāratattva evendra ityuktatvāt
kimiva ? ghaṭa iva vikukṣitvādivinābhūtaḥ, yathā ghaṭo vikukṣitvādyākārādṛte nāsti tadātmaka evāsti tathā indro'pi svākāravinābhūto nāsti tadātmaivāstīti
nindrayorvivekamajānatāṃ puṃsāṃ sākṣāt pradarśyate; yasmād na tadākāravinābhūta indro ghaṭa iva vikukṣivinābhūtaḥ
sthāpanāyāṃ nikṣepo sthāpanānikṣepa iti evakārārtho draṣṭavyaḥ, tad vyācaṣṭe --na nāmni na śabde nikṣipyate, kiṃ tarhi ? sthāpanāyāmeva nikṣipyate
kasmāditi cet, ata āha --yato nāmāpi sahārthena tattantrameva, ākāratantra eva śabdo'rthaśca

tad bhāvayati --sthānakaraṇetyādi, akārādayo varṇāḥ pratiniyatakaṇṭhādisthānākārajanmānaḥ saṅgatyā nairantaryeṇa uccarantaḥ sup-tiṅntādiviśeṣākārāḥ tadgamyāśca nāmākhyātavācyadravyakriyārthākārāḥ sarve'ntarbhūtākāratattvasthāpanāvipariṇāmavijṛmbhitamātram
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tadabhāva ityādi, ākārābhāve śabdārthayorabhāvādākārāgrahaṇe ca tayoragrahaṇāt
jihvāmūlaṃ ca dantāśca nāsikoṣṭhau ca tālu ca
ghoṣā vā saṃvṛtāḥ sarve aghoṣā vivṛtāḥ smṛtāḥ

dravyanikṣepo'pi sthāpanāntarbhūta iti brūmaḥ, tadyathā --dravyamapītyādi, dravyanikṣepo'pi sthāpanānikṣepa eva ākāramayatvād dravyasya, yathā śrīparṇīdāru dravyaṃ kāraṇamantarlīnākāraṃ tasya tasyākāraviśeṣasya tadavyaktasāmānyavyaktestathā''kārasamparigrahamātramiti sthāpanaiva dravyamapi

bhāvanikṣepo'pi sthāpanaiva āgamato noāgamataśca, āgamatastatprābhṛtajña upayukta ityupayukto bhāvaḥ pāriṇāmikaḥ, kṣāyopaśamikaśceṣṭā jīvasya vīryāntarāyakṣayopaśamajo bhāvaḥ, pudgalānāṃ tu rūpādiryugapadbhāvī pāriṇāmiko bhāvo nīlādirvā tadviśeṣaḥ śivakādirayugapadbhāvī vā ityevamādirūpā bhedā yasya so'yaṃ kriyopayogarūpādinīlādiśivakādirūpabhedo bhāvaḥ
jīvādiprābhṛtaviṣayeṇopayogenāviṣṭa ātmā āgamato bhāvajīvo bhāvasamyagdarśanamiti cocyate
evaṃ nikṣepatrayaṃ sthāpanānikṣepa eva saṅkṣepato rūpāntaravyāvartanena rūpāntarākaraṇātmakasthāpanāsvarūpānatikramāt
atrāpi rūpāntaraṃ ced vyāvartya rūpāntaraṃ nā''kuryāt rūpāntarasya indrāderakṣanikṣepapratipādyasyāvarodhaḥ pratipattirna syāt, bhavati tu

tasmādaviruddho'bhipretākāre vṛtto nāmnā śabdena indraḥ iti buddhyā vādhyāropaḥ tatkarmaṇaḥ akṣanikṣepasthāpanākarmaṇaḥ, kimiva ? dravyārthasthāpanendrasthūṇāvat, yathā rūpāntaravyāvṛttyā rūpāntararā ?karaṇād dravyārthasthāpanendrārthā sthūṇā indrastathā'kṣādiriti
sthāpanāyā ākārasvarūpatvād rūpāntaravyāvartanena rūpāntarasya ākaraṇātmakaṃ yat sthāpanāsvarūpaṃ tadanatikramādityāśayo bhāti
etattattvādhyavasāyādeva liṅga-samācāra-devatāpratimānamaskaraṇādi loke, naitadupapattyā pratipādyaṃ sthāpanaiva sarvam iti, loke rūḍhatvāt

tathāhi--pāṣaṇḍināṃ liṅgagrahaṇāni yathāgamamākāraviśeṣaprasiddhestatsahacāriṇo niyamā arhadrudrendrabuddhādidevatāpratimāsthāpanāni tannamaskārajapastutibalimālyādibhirabhyarcanāni ca prativiśiṣṭākāranibandhanāni dṛṣṭāni, na hi dṛṣṭād gariṣṭhaṃ pramāṇamastītyevaṃ sthāpanādravyārthanayamatamuktam
tatra viśeṣākāraḥ svarūpameva paramārthaḥ, na sāmānyākāraḥ
tasya paramārthasya ekabhavanasya sthāpanānikṣepe kārye sāmānyākāradravyārtha upasarjanaṃ pradhānasya paramārthasya sadbhāvasyā'sadbhāva upakāritvāt, pāṇyaṅguli sāmānyākāradravyārtha upasarjanam
kutasteṣāṃ sthāpanā dravyataḥ ? kṣetrato yugapadbhāviparyāyeṣu viśeṣavyatirekeṇārthābhāvād nāsti sthāpanā

kālato bālādyayugapadbhāviparyāyeṣvapi viśeṣavyatirekeṇārthābhāvāt kathaṃ sthāpanā kriyatāṃ kasya vā ? asadbhāvasthāpanāyāśca dravyārthatvāt sadbhāvasthāpanāyāśca paryāyārthatvāt dravyārthaprādhānye itaranirākaraṇam

paramārthatastu tadatyantaviśeṣe tattvamavikalpyamasti, na tāni pāṇyādīni svarūpataḥ, kutasteṣāṃ sthāpanā dravyataḥ ? tathā kṣetrato yugapadbhāviparyāyeṣu viśeṣavyatirekeṇārthābhāvād nāsti sthāpanā, ākāra ābhavanamākārye ākartari vārthe nāsti sthāpanāyā ākāratvāt
kālato'pyayugapadbhāviparyāyeṣu bālādiṣvekamekaṃ viśeṣabhavanaṃ paramārthaḥ, tad bhāvayati --bālādyayugapadbhāvītyādi yāvat kathaṃ sthāpanā kriyatāṃ kasya vā ? iti gatārtham

kālato bālādyayugapadbhāviparyāyeṣvapi viśeṣavyatirekeṇārthābhāvāt kathaṃ sthāpanā kriyatāṃ kasya vā ? asadbhāvasthāpanāyāśca dravyārthatvāt sadbhāvasthāpanāyāśca paryāyārthatvāt dravyārthaprādhānye itaranirākaraṇam

kiñcānyat, sadbhāvasthāpanāyāḥ paryāyārthatvādasadbhāvasthāpanāyā dravyārthamātratvāt te dve prarūpayatā tvayā paryāyārthaprādhānyāvalambitvamitthaṃ nirākṛtam, dravyārthaprādhānye vā paryāyā nirākṛtā akṣādyasadbhāvetyādinā grantheneti tad darśayati --asadbhāvasthāpanāyāścetyādi yāvaditaranirākaraṇam
yo'pi nāmabuddhyadhyāropa uktaḥ abhipretākāravṛtta ityādi so'pi nayāntarayornāmadravyārthaparyāyārthayorviṣayaḥ
tatra nāmadravyārthaviṣayo nāmādhyāropaḥ, paryāyārthaviṣayo buddhyadhyāropaḥ --āgamato jāṇae uvautte bhāvasāmāiyaṃ ti
dravyadravyārthastvityādi atikrānteṣu vidhyādibhaṅgeṣu dravyadravyārtho vyākhyāto dūṣitaḥ punarna vācyaḥ
se kiṃ taṃ bhāvasāmāie ? 2 duvihe paṃ॰, taṃ॰--āgamao a noāgamao a
se kiṃ taṃ āgamao bhāvasāmāie ? jāṇae uvautte
itastu bhāvetyādi, asmiṃśca śabdanaye ubhayaniyamabhaṅgalakṣaṇe viśeṣa evaiko bhavatīti śabdārthavyākhyānena dravyadravyārthavācyaṃ nāmasthāpanādravyārthavācyaṃ ceṣṭaṃ na karotīti bhāvitameva
nāgninā śabdena pacyate na ca citralikhitena, tayorvyavahārākṣamatvāt, kiṃ tarhi ? tathāvṛttibhāvenaiva
mānamapi na yathā mānaprasthakena tathā tannāmnā
nāmapratyayanāmakarmatattvāt tenaiveti cet, na, cetanabhedaniyatapṛthivyāditattvābhāve yogavakratādivipariṇāmāpravṛtteḥ phalābhāvād nāmakarmādyanupapatteḥ
dravyamapi ca bhavyaṃ tathā tathā bhāve eva ghaṭate, tvanmate dravyabhavane tu na
tathā prasphuṭam agnirdravyam iti puṃnapuṃsakayorbhāvabhede sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛṣṭam
bhā॰ pratipāṭhānusāreṇa tatheha ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt

aihikamodanādi pacikriyādeḥ sthālīkāṣṭhādisādhanāyāḥ phalam, āmuṣmikaṃ svargādi dānāderodanādisādhanāyāḥ phalam, na tatra kāṣṭhasthālyādīni nāmamātrāṇi na citralikhitāni vā, kintu tathābhūtāni pacebhāgadhicerbhāgadheyāni tānyeva viśeṣaikabhavanāni
nāgninā śabdena pacyate, na cetyādi bhāvitārthaṃ yāvanna yathā mānaprasthakena tathā tannāmneti
syānmatam--prāguktacaitanyanāmapratyayāyattaṃ nāmakarma, tattattvāni kāṣṭhādīni, atastenaiva nāmnā loke vyavahāra iti

etacca na, cetanabhedetyādi yāvad nāmakarmādyanupapatteriti, atrāpi cetanabhedeṣu yāni pṛthivyāditattvāni niyatāni tathābhūtiyogye viśeṣātmani teṣāmabhāve tiryaggatinirvartanīyayogavakratādivipariṇāmāpravṛtteḥ phalābhāvaḥ, tadabhāvāt kuto nāmakarma ? kutaḥ kāṣṭhādivanaspatipṛthivyagnyāditiryakśarīratvādīni ? ato viśeṣaikabhavanameva kriyā-phalādivyavahārahetuḥ na nāmaśabda iti suṣṭhūktam
tathā citrakarmetyata āha --na ca citralikhitāgni-prasthakābhyāṃ dahana-māne tayorvyavahārākṣamatvāt, tathāvṛttibhāvasyaiva vyavahārakṣamatvāt

104, bhavati iti bhavyaṃ tena tena prakāreṇa lokavyavahārakṣameṇa bhavanād bhāva eva ghaṭate, tvanmate dravyabhavane tu na, agniprasthakādi sarvamekabhāva eva bhūtaṃ dravyārthābhedāt ko dravyaśabdenātyantaviruddhārthena bhedavācinā tathā tathā bhavanārthena sambandhaḥ ?
agnirdravyam iti puṃnapuṃsakayorbhāvabhede sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛṣṭam, nānyathā tat
syānmatam--dravyaśabdasya dārusamānādhikaraṇatvād napuṃsakaṃ dāruprasthakatvādvā samānādhikaraṇīkaraṇād dāruṇyapi sa nāvatiṣṭheta
evaṃ pratipadārthaṃ bhāvanikṣepaḥ śabdanayasyāsyoktaḥ, na yatharjusūtram
yathoktam--asatyopādhi yat satyaṃ tadvā śabdanibandhanam vākyapa॰ 2
viśeṣā upādhayaḥ kuṇḍalādayo vikārā asatyā yasya satyasya sarvabhedānuyāyinaḥ suvarṇādeḥ sāmānyasya tadabhidhīyate viśeṣairiva sāmānyam
sate hitaṃ prasthaka iti; etaccāyuktam, yasmād dāruprasthakatvādvā samānādhikaraṇīkaraṇād dāruṇyapi sa nāvatiṣṭhetetyatiprasaṅgadoṣaḥ
katham ? yathā dravyatvād dāruprasthakatvābhedastathā dravyatvāt pṛthivyudakādyabheda iti doṣa eva
svamate tu doṣābhāvo guṇotkarṣaścetyata āha --tathābhūtetyādi gatārthaṃ yāvad dahano'gniḥ
evaṃ pratipadārthaṃ bhāvanikṣepaḥ śabdanayasyāsyoktaḥ, na yatharjusūtram
asatyopādhi yat satyaṃ tadvā śabdanibandhanam vākyapa॰ 2 | 128
anye tvāhuḥ--yadasatyopādhi satyaṃ sa śabdārtha iti
tatra śabdārthatvenāsatyā upādhayo viśeṣā valayāṅgulīyakādayo yasya satyasya sarvabhedānuyāyinaḥ suvarṇādeḥ sāmānyātmanaḥ tat satyamasatyopādhi
viśeṣā upādhayaḥ kuṇḍalādayo vikārā asatyā yasya satyasya sarvabhedānuyāyinaḥ suvarṇādeḥ sāmānyasya tadabhidhīyate viśeṣairiva sāmānyam
viśeṣā upādhayaḥ kuṇḍalādayo vikārā asatyāḥ, satyaṃ sarvabhedānuyāyi suvarṇādi sāmānyam tadabhidhīyate viśeṣairiva sāmānyam

uktārthanigamanam --evaṃ pratipadārthaṃ sarvapadārtheṣu bhāvanikṣepaḥ śabdanayasyāsyoktaḥ, na yatharjusūtram, nāmādicaturvidhanikṣepābhilāṣiṇo yathā ṛjusūtranayasya vartamānaparyāyagrāhiṇo mataṃ tathā na bhavatīti śabdamataṃ darśitam
yathoktamiti śiṣṭāntaramataṃ ca darśayati --asatyopādhi yat satyaṃ tadvā śabdanibandhanamiti
tadvyācaṣṭe --viśeṣā upādhaya ityādi tadīya eva grantho yāvat tadabhidhīyata iti
suvarṇaprakṛtyupamarde kuṇḍalavikārasya viśeṣasyāsatyasya sāmānyavādimate satyaṃ prakṛtiḥ sāmānyaṃ pratipādyam
tathā puruṣādisāmānyasya pratipādakā viśeṣā upādhayaste te prakṛtipuruṣeśvarāḥ svāgameṣu
tat saṃhṛtyā''cāryaḥ sate hitaṃ satyam iti satyam, karmaṇi caturthī
asatyāḥ punarupādhayo'sya dravyaṃ mṛd ghaṭa ityādipravṛttayastadābhāḥ
anyathā tacchabdārthatāyāṃ taddhitārthaṃ vyutpādya vibhaktimāha --karmaṇi caturthīti ṣaṣṭhyarthe, caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ pā॰ 2
73 iti vihitatvāt hinoterdadhātervā dhātoḥ karmaṇi dvitīyasyāṃ prāptāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīcaturthyau vibhāṣyete
asatyāḥ punarupādhayo'sya dravyaṃ mṛd ghaṭa ityādipravṛttayastadābhāḥ
etadarthairyoge caturthīṃ vā syāt pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī
āśiṣi āyuṣyaṃ cirajīvitaṃ kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇasya vā bhūyāt
evaṃ madraṃ, bhadraṃ, kuśalaṃ nirāmayaṃ, sukhaṃ śam, arthaḥ prayojanaṃ, hitaṃ pathyaṃ vā bhūyāt
rūpādiśivakādiparyāyā vṛttirasya tattvasya tadavikalpaṃ śibikāvāhakayāneneveśvarastatparyāyavṛttitattvaṃ yāti satataṃ vartate, deśabhinnaṃ rūpādi kālabhinnaṃ śivakādi satyam
asatyāḥ punarupādhayo'sya liṅgādyupādhyupāyena nidarśanam --dravyaṃ mṛd ghaṭaḥ ityādipravṛttayastadābhāḥ rūpādiśivakādiparyāyatattvābhāsāḥ
evameva cetyādi etaddarśanasaṃvādīdamiti jñāpakametena lakṣaṇena saṅgṛhītaṃ yāvadānīyatāmiti
katarad devadattasya gṛham ? iti praśne prativacanam--yatrāsau kākaḥ iti kākaśabdo gṛhārthapratipādanārthatvāt kākārtha eva san gṛhārtha ityucyate tathā uditasvārthavat jātiśabdo viśeṣārtha iti

kimiva ? vāgvisargakālopalakṣaṇanakṣatradarśanaśrutivat, yathā nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭvā vāco visṛjanti iti nakṣatradarśanamatrātantram, nakṣatradarśanayogyaḥ kālo'tra tadarthena paśyatinā uktavaduktaḥ, paramārthena tu paśyatiḥ svārthe eva vartate tathā jātiśabdo viśeṣārtha iti
anyathā mukhyanyāyena tacchabdārthatāyā punaruktadoṣād viśeṣaśabdāprayoga eva syāt
