tatra diṅgāgasya kaṃ granthaṃ lakṣyīkṛtya ubhayaniyamanayenāpohavādo'tra prativihita iti niścetuṃ na pāryate tathāpi pṛ॰ 417-- 1 ityatra sāmānyaparīkṣākāralikhita evātrāpi iti vakṣyamāṇollekhadarśanāt sāmānyaparīkṣāntargato'pohavādopya'trādo'pyatrābhipretaḥ syāditi sambhāvyate
diṅgāgena bahavo granthāḥ saṃskṛtabhāṣāyāṃ racitāḥ, te ca prāyaḥ sarve'pi naṣṭāḥ
sarveṣāṃ svagranthānāṃ viṣayasaṃgrahāya yaḥ pramāṇasamuccayo vṛttyā saha diṅgāgena racitastatra pañcame'pohaparicchede vistareṇāpohanirūpaṇaṃ vartate

ataḥ savṛttikasya pramāṇasamuccayasya viśālāmalavatīṭīkāyāśca bhoṭabhāṣānuvādān muhuḥ paryālocyāpohaparicchedādatyantamupayogī aṃśo bhoṭabhāṣānuvādataḥ saṃskṛtabhāṣāyāṃ parivartya ihopanyasyate iti nayacakre'pohacacāryāṃ sarvatra yathāsthānaṃ so'nusandheyaḥ
yasmin viṣaye śabdaḥ prayujyate tasya yenāṅgenāvinābhāvitayā sambaddhastat kṛtakatvādivadarthāntaravyavacchedena dyotayati
na jātiśabdo bhedānāṃ vācaka iti vakṣyati
jātiśabdastāvat sadādiḥ dravyādīnāṃ na vācaka ānantyāt
ānantye hi bhedānāmaśakyaḥ śabdena sambandhaḥ kartum
sacchabdo hi yathā dravye vartate tathā guṇādiṣvapīti vyabhicārāt saṃśayaḥ syāt, nābhidhānam
ye'pi manyante jātimātrasya tadyogasya vā vācakaḥ sambandhasaukaryādavyabhicārācca iti tadayuktam, vācako yogajātyorvā bhedārthairapṛthakśruteḥ
tathāhi--sad dravyam, san guṇaḥ, sat karma iti bhedārthairdravyādiśabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt
na hi sattā yogo vā dravyaṃ guṇo vā bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? dravyasya guṇasya vā
tasmāt sambandhidharmeṇa sambandhasyābhidheyatvāt svadharmeṇa sambandhavāciśabdābhāva iti asya jātiśabdābhidheyatvaṃ nopapadyate
ye tu viśeṣaśabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt sambandhasaukaryādavyabhicārācca jātimanmātraṃ vivakṣitamityāhuḥ tatra--
iti diṅgāgasya granthāntarasthāyāḥ kārikāyāstu nayacakre khaṇḍanaṃ dṛśyata iti dhyeyam
tathāpi sacchabdo jātisvarūpapātromātropasarjanaṃ dravyamāha, na sākṣāt, iti tadgataghaṭādibhedānākṣepādatadbhedatve sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ
yathā śuklaśabdaḥ svābhidheyaguṇamātraviśiṣṭadravyābhidhānād dravye sato'pi madhurādīn nākṣipati tato'tadbhedatvamevamatrāpi prasajyate
sacchabdo hi bhūtārthena svarūpaṃ jātiṃ vāha
na hi yo yatropacaryate sa tamarthaṃ bhūtārthenāha
tadvati ca guṇasārūpyaṃ na pratyayasaṃkrāntito nāpi guṇopakārāt sambhavati
kathaṃ na pratyayasaṃkrāntita iti cet, upacāre--
yathā rūpaśabdena madhurādīnāmanākṣepo'tadbhedatvāt taiḥ śabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na bhavati rūpamāmlam iti
tulanā--yaḥ punarasminneva pakṣe'paro doṣo'bhihitaḥ--sacchabdo'pi bhūtārthena svarūpaṃ jātiṃ vāha
tatra pravṛttastadvatyupacaryamāṇo gauṇaḥ syāt--iti so'pi samānaḥ
yathā yo bhṛtyaḥ sa svāmī iti bhṛtye svāmiśabdābhidhāne rājñi bhṛtye ca samānā buddhirna bhavati
yathā yaḥ svāmī sa bhṛtya ityatra rājñi bhṛtye ca PSV2
yatra samānā pratītistatra krameṇābhidhānaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā kundasya kumudasya śukteśca śauklyamiti
guṇopakārāt tādrūpye prakarṣaḥ syād vinā dhiyā || 5
atra bhikṣuṇoktam--kiñcit kutracid vartamānamupakāramāsaṃjadvartate yathā lākṣā sphaṭike'nurañjanopakāreṇa vartate
na hi lākṣānurakte sphaṭike gṛhyamāṇe tadgrahaṇamaparamapekṣate
na caivamatrāsti tena nāsti upakārakoto dravye vṛttiḥ--iti
yadi sphaṭikavad guṇopakārāt tadvān guṇasvarūpaḥ syāt tathā sati guṇaprakarṣabuddhinirapekṣā dravye prakarṣabuddhiḥ syāt
na hi sphaṭike raktabuddherbhāva upadhānabuddhimapekṣate, avimaleṣu bhedabuddhyabhāvāt
sarvo hi śābdaḥ pratyayo'rtheṣu saṃsargarūpeṇa vyavacchinnastataḥ sphaṭikapratyayavadayathārthaḥ syāt
sāmānyādibahutve ca yugapacca grahītṛṣu upakāro virudhyeta
yadā ca bahavo grahītāro bhavanti guṇavataḥ śuklādeḥ tadyathā--ghaṭaḥ pārthivo dravyaṃ san śuklo madhuraḥ surabhirityevamādi tadā guṇopakāro virudhyate
na hi śakyaṃ tadā dravyeṇa ekaguṇarūpeṇa sthātum, aviśiṣṭatvāt
atha punaḥ sarvairghaṭatvādibhiryugapadupakāraḥ kṛtsnasya kriyate tataḥ sarveṣāṃ pratyekaṃ ghaṭādirūpagrahaṇābhāvād mecakadarśanaṃ yugapat sarvarūpāpatteḥ syāt
sadityanena padena punarjātirabhidhīyate piṇḍo vā sambandho vā jātimān vā padārthaḥ
yadyayaṃ jātivācakaḥ sacchabdo bhavati sad dravyam iti bhedavācinā dravyaśabdena saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti

atha dravyādivṛttitvāt sattāyā eva dravyādiśabdaiḥ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tathāpi pāratantryāt sattāyā guṇatvam, guṇaguṇyabhidhāyinośca śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na dṛṣṭamiti yathā śaṅkhasya śauklyamiti
sacchabdaḥ piṇḍānāṃ vācako bhaviṣyatīti na yuktaṃ piṇḍānāmānantyāt
na hyekasya śabdasyānekadravyaguṇaprapañcena sambandha ākhyātuṃ śakyaḥ
na cānākhyāte śabdārthasambandhe śabdādarthapratipattiryuktā svarūpamātrapratīteḥ vyabhicārācca
na ca yasmādabhidhānāt pariplavate buddhistadabhidhānamiti yuktaṃ vaktum
tasmāt sacchabdo bhedānāṃ na vācaka iti
na hi sacchabdāt tadbhedā ghaṭādayo gamyanta iti tadvadghaṭādibhedānākṣepāt sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ
athavā asvatantratvāditi sacchabdaḥ prādhānyena sattāyāṃ vartate
yacca yatra vartamānamanyatropacaryate na tat tasyābhidhāyakaṃ mañcaśabdavaditi
tadvati ca na guṇasārūpyāt pratyayasaṃkrāntiḥ yathā svāmiśabdasya bhṛtye
na guṇoparāgāt yathā nīlaḥ sphaṭika iti kramavṛttyabhāvād yugapadasambhavācca ayathārthajñānotpattiprasaṅgācca
asādhāraṇaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyābhidhāyako bhaviṣyatīti na yuktam, anyatra pratyayābhāvaprasaṃgāt
tasmādanyārthāpohakṛcchrutiriti anyaśabdārthāntarāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatta ityucyata iti
jātimato vācakatve ca ye doṣāste'nyāpohābhidhāne'pīti pratijñā

tatra PSV1 na pramāṇāntaraṃ śābdamanumānāt tathāhi tat

tasmāt kṛtakatvādivat svārthamanyāpohena bhāṣate iti yad uktaṃ tadeva sthitam pṛ॰ 160

bheda-jātimadabhidhānapakṣeṣu doṣadṛṣṭerarthādāpannam anyāpohakṛcchrutiḥ ityanyāpohaṃ varṇayati śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutiḥ abhidhatte ityucyate ityanyāpoha- vādinoktam, arthau ca svasāmānyalakṣaṇāvuktau, nāto'nyat prameyamasti iti tato'nyatṛtīyārthāsambhavāt svārtha eva tāvadavadhāryaḥ, tāvacchabdasya kramārthatvādarthāntarasyāpyavadhārayiṣyamāṇatvāt, śabdāntarārthāpohamātroktau doṣo'sattvaprāptiḥ, tasmāt tāvatā'paritoṣāt svārthe kurvatī ityuktaḥ kaḥ svārthaḥ ? ucyate --svārthaḥ svalakṣaṇaḥ, anyato'nyaḥ svaḥ, ananyaḥ sa evetyarthaḥ pramāṇayorapi niyataviṣayāvadhṛteḥ pratyakṣaviṣayaḥ sa svārtha iti
iha śabdārthe savikalpārthe sāmānyataḥ savikalparūpe'dhyāropāpavādātmani sa na sambhavati svārthaḥ pratyakṣaviṣayaḥ, svalakṣaṇamanirdeśyam pra॰ samu॰ 1
syānmatam--pratyakṣādarthādanyo'sti svārtha iti cet, tanna ca tato'nyaḥ pratyakṣārthāt svārthaḥ
anyāpohaḥ svārtho na bhavati, taddvayātiriktaśca tṛtīyo na kaścidanyo'sti, lakṣyadvitvāvadhāraṇāt tataśca pramāṇadvitvāvadhāraṇāt
tasmāt tṛtīyo'rtho'pi nāsti, kutaḥ svārthaḥ ? ityata āha --tiṣṭhatu tāvat svārthaḥ asattvādavicārya ityarthaḥ
āha ca svārthasāmānyaṃ tādṛg vācyaṃ khapuṣpavat
pramāṇasamuccayasya prathamaparicchede svasaṃvedyamanirdeśyaṃ rūpamindriyagocaraḥ iti kārikā dṛśyate
svalakṣaṇamanirdeśyaṃ rūpamindriyagocaraḥ iti tu pāṭhabhedena nayacakravṛttau aṣṭame're pṛ॰ 437-- 2 ityatra uddhṛtā, ata iyaṃ kārikā diṅgāgasya granthāntarādatroddhṛtā pratīyate
pramāṇasamuccayasya dvitīyaparicchedasya dvitīyaśloke tu svalakṣaṇamanirdeśyaṃ grāhyabhedāt tadanyathā iti pāṭho bhāti
evaṃ ca kṛtvā śabdavācyavicāre prastute jāti-sambandha-jātimadabhidhānā ityuktaṃ tvayā na pratyakṣaviṣayasvārthatvena
atha kvacidadṛṣṭo'pi anyāpohaḥ ityasmādeva śabdādavagantavyaḥ svārthaḥ, yasminnanyo'pohyate sa svārthaḥ

tadapi na, svārthe ityādhārādheyādarśanāt svarūpavidhivinābhūtatvāt kasmin svārthe'pohyate ? anyaśabdaśabdāntarārthayorasthitarūpatvāt ko hyasāvanyo yasya yasmād vā'pohaḥ kriyeta ? nāmasambhavāt anyāpohakṛcchrutiḥ iti bhedapakṣasya jātimatpakṣāviśiṣṭatveṣṭeḥ śabdārthāvavadhṛtya uktaṃ tvayā, na pratyakṣaviṣayasvārthatveneti tvadvacanameva jñāpakam
atha kvacidadṛṣṭo'pi anyāpohaḥ ityasmādeva śabdādavagantavyaḥ svārthaḥ, yasminnanyo'pohyate sa svārthaḥ
tadapi na, svārthe ityādhārādheyādarśanāt svarūpavidhivinābhūtatvāt kasmin svārthe'pohyate ? anyaśabdaśabdāntarārthayorasthitarūpatvāt ko hyasāvanyo yasya yasmād vā'pohaḥ kriyeta ?
taddarśayati --agniranagnirnetyādi, tasyāpi cāpohārthasyākhyeyatvāt, na cākhyāto'sau īdṛśaḥ svārthaḥ iti viśeṣya
evaṃ tarhi bhedopādāne vā asvārthatvamapohārthādanyatvāt, apohārthasyaiva tvayānumānatveṣṭeḥ

kiñcānyat, parapratyāyanāditvabhinnārthatvācca, sacānumānaviṣayaḥ svārthaḥ ātmanaḥ pratyāyane liṅgādivasturūpaḥ, parapratyāyane śabdavācyo jñānarūpo jñānārthatvācchabdaprayogasyetyayuktamasya svārthasya dvairūpyam
evaṃ na pratyakṣaviṣayo nānumānaviṣayaḥ svārtho ghaṭate śabdasya tvanmatādeva
atra ātmane iti pāṭho'pi samīcīno bhāti, svasmai idaṃ svārtham, parasmai idaṃ parārtham ityāśayena ātmane ityapi pāṭho'trābhipreto bhavet
śabdārthavicāre pratyakṣānumānaviṣayatvavicāro'sambaddha iti cet, tanna, tṛtīyārthāsambhavāt ityādeḥ pradarśitatvāt
tathāpi tvadanuvṛttyā yadyapi pratyakṣānumānaviṣayayoradṛṣṭo'pi anyāpohaḥ ityasmādeva śabdādavagantavyaḥ svārthaḥ, anyasyāpoho na svasyārthasya, svārthe cānyasyāpoho na nirāśraya uktadoṣāt
tasmāt yasminnanyo'pohyate sa svārtha iti ghaṭaḥ ityukte aghaṭo na bhavati paṭādiḥ iti ghaṭe paṭādyapohād ghaṭaḥ svārtha iti śabdaviṣaya eva svārtho niścita iti matam

tathāpi tadapi na svārtha ityādhārādheyādarśanāt, sa evādhārābhimataḥ svārtha ādheyābhimataśca śabdo na dṛśyete tau svarūpavidhivinābhūtatvāt, yasmin anyasya śabdāntarārthasyāpohaṃ karoti ityucyate sa evādhāro'rtho na vidhīyate śabdaścādheyaḥ

tasmāt tayoradarśanāt kasmin svārthe'pohyate ityabhisambhantsyate, na ced vidhīyate anyasyārthasya sūtroktasya bhāṣyoktasya śabdāntarārthasya yo'nanyo na bhavatīti cet, nanu sa eva vidherananyaḥ pratyakṣaḥ

hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmād vṛkṣaśabdo'vṛkṣaśabdanivṛttiṃ svārthe kurvan svārthaṃ vṛkṣalakṣaṇaṃ pratyāyayati evaṃ nivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ vastu śabdārthaḥ dravyādi san, na nivṛttimātram
॰vasthānāt tasmiṃstu vidheye vasthānāt tasmiṃstu vidheya iti dvirbhūtaḥ pāṭhaḥ pratiṣu

yo'nanyo na bhavatīti cet, syānmatam--yathaiva svārthaḥ anyo na bhavati ityanyasyāpohena pratīyate tathaivānyo'pi ananyo na bhavati iti tadapohena pratīyate iti ced manyase, atra brūmaḥ --nanu sa eva vidherityādi, svena vidheyenopalakṣitasya ananyasya prāṇādanyapratīterananyaḥ sa eva svārtho vidheyaḥ, tasyāgrahaṇe ananyaḥ iti buddherabhāvāt ananyaḥ svārtho vidheḥ ityāpannam
itarathā anyo netyādi yāvad grahaṇābhāvāt, yathā ghaṭādanyaḥ paṭaḥ ityukte sa na bhavati, evaṃ paṭādanyo ghaṭaḥ so'pi na bhavatyeva, dvayorapi vyāvṛttimātrasthititvāt
tataścāpratiṣṭhitasvārthayostayorayaṃ svaḥ anyaḥ sa iti tadatayorgrahaṇābhāvaḥ
tataśca kutaḥ ko'nyaḥ ? kutaḥ kasyāpohaḥ ? ityapohaśabdārthābhāvaḥ
kathamiti cet, ucyate --tasmādanyaḥ, anyasmāt sa iti
iti hetvarthe, yasmādanyabalāt sa prasidhyati tadbalādanyaḥ, itaretarāśrayāṇi ca na prakalpanta ityuktam
evaṃ laukikānyāpohaśabdārthamātrānusāreṇa parīkṣyamāṇe'nyāpohe na ghaṭate svārthaḥ

athānyāpohetyādi yāvad na sadasaditi anyāpohalakṣaṇavākyānusāreṇa parīkṣāmāha— anyāpohalakṣaṇavākyaṃ tenānyāpohakṛcchutiḥkucchrutiḥ iti, tasya vyākhyā --śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatta ityucyate iti, tadanuvṛttyā vyāvṛttiryasmin vidyate svārthe sa gṛhyate na vyāvṛttimātram, hiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt
taddarśayati --hiśabdo yasmādarthe, tannirūpayati laukikodāharaṇena --yasmād vṛkṣaśabda ityādi yāvat pratyāyayati iti

evaṃ nivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ vastu śabdavācyārthaḥ, katamo'sau ? dravyādi san dravya-pṛthivī-mṛd-ghaṭatvādi, na nivṛtti yathā kṛtakatvasya anityatvaviśiṣṭaḥ śabdo'numeya evaṃ śabdo'pi svamabhidheyamarthāntaravyavacchedaviśiṣṭaṃ dyotayati pramāṇatvāt
atrāpi vidhirevāṅgīkṛtaḥ, avyāvṛttasvārthārthatvāt devadatta ! gāmabhyāja śuklām iti gavānayanavidhāyakavākyavat

vyāvṛttivyatiriktasya svārthasya vidhānaṃ tvayaivoktam, śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatta ityucyate, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmād vṛkṣaśabdo'vṛkṣanivṛttiṃ svārthe kurvan svārthaṃ vṛkṣalakṣaṇaṃ pratyāyayati iti tvadvacanādeva svārthavidhānasya pradarśanāt
nivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ vastu śabdārtho dravyādi san ityādigranthenāpi svārthavidhānameva pradarśitam
anyathā sarvatraiva vyāvṛttimātram, na svārtho nāma kaścidastīti svārthe kurvatī śrutirityanarthakaṃ syāt

athavā anumānānumeyasambandha eva vācyavācakasambandhaḥ iti manyamāno yathā kṛtakatvasyetyādi satatsvarūpavyākhyānamudāhṛtyānumānam evaṃ śabdo'pītyādi dārṣṭāntikaṃ ca satatsvarūpavyākhyānaṃ nigamayati pramāṇatvāt iti hetudharmaṃ ca tayostulyam
yathā vakṣyati nidarśanam --na pramāṇāntaraṃ śābdamanumānāt pra॰ samu॰ 5

siddhasenagaṇiviracitāyāṃ tattvārthavṛttābuddhṛte'smin diṅgāgavacane hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yathā vṛkṣaśabdo'vṛkṣaśabdanivṛttiṃ svārthe kurvan svārthaṃ vṛkṣalakṣaṇaṃ pratyāyayatītyucyate evaṃ ca nivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ vastu śabdārthaḥ na nivṛttimātram tattvārthavṛ॰ 5
24 pṛ॰ 357 iti pāṭhadarśanādatra yathā vṛkṣa॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
yathā kṛtakatvasya anityatvaviśiṣṭaḥ śabdo'numeya evaṃ śabdo'pi svamabhidheyamarthāntaravyavacchedaviśiṣṭaṃ dyotayati pramāṇatvāt
atrāpi vidhirevāṅgīkṛtaḥ, avyāvṛttasvārthārthatvāt devadatta ! gāmabhyāja śuklām iti gavānayanavidhāyakavākyavat

vyāvṛttivyatiriktasya svārthasya vidhānaṃ tvayaivoktam, śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatta ityucyate, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmād vṛkṣaśabdo'vṛkṣanivṛttiṃ svārthe kurvan svārthaṃ vṛkṣalakṣaṇaṃ pratyāyayati iti tvadvacanādeva svārthavidhānasya pradarśanāt
nivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ vastu śabdārtho dravyādi san ityādigranthenāpi svārthavidhānameva pradarśitam
anyathā sarvatraiva vyāvṛttimātram, na svārtho nāma kaścidastīti svārthe kurvatī śrutirityanarthakaṃ syāt
iti sampūrṇā kārikā pramāṇasamuccayasya pañcame'pohaparicchede, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 607 paṃ॰ 7
tvayaivaṃ bruvatāpi apohātiriktaḥ svārtha uktaḥ, ato vidhirevāṅgīkṛtaḥ
kasmāt ? avyāvṛttasvārthārthatvāt, avyāvṛttasvārtho'rtho'syetyavyāvṛttasvārthārthametad vyāvṛttimān svārtho gṛhyate ityādi vākyam

yasyāvyāvṛttasvārthārthatvaṃ tad vākyaṃ vidhimaṅgīkurvad dṛṣṭam, yathā devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklām iti gavānayanavidhāyakaṃ vākyamagavādidohādivyāvṛttimaddevadattakartṛkaśuklagavakarmānayanakriyāsvārtham, tathā ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavati ityanyāpohopalakṣitasvārthavākyamiti tvayaivoktam

tadvivaraṇaṃ ca hiśabdo yasmādarthe ityādyupakramya hetvarthabhāvanodāharaṇaṃ vṛkṣaśabdaḥ savyākhyādaṇḍakaḥ sottarapūrvapakṣapratyuccāraṇaṃ savyākhyānaṃ yāvat pradarśanāditi tvadvacanādeva svārthasya vidhānaṃ sphuṭīkṛtam

evaṃ nivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ vastu śabdārtho dravyādi san ityādinā granthena kṛtakatvasyānityatvaviśiṣṭaśabdānumeyatvadṛṣṭāntena sabhāvanena evaṃ śabdo'pi svamabhidheyamityādinā svārthavidhānameva pradarśitam

evamanicchataste doṣaḥ--yathā vṛkṣaśabdaprayoge paṭādyavṛkṣānyaśabdārthavyāvṛttirapi prāptā, tataḥ sarvatraiva vyāvṛttimātram, na svārtho nāma kaścidasti, ataḥ svārthe kurvatī śrutiḥ ityanarthakaṃ syāt
yadapi ca tat sadityasanna bhavatīti tadapyatipariślatham
nanu yugapadbhūtapaṭādyabhavanenaiva ghaṭabhavanaṃ dṛṣṭam, yugapadbhūtarasādyabhavanenaiva ca rūpabhavanaṃ dṛṣṭam
anyathā tadbhavane ghaṭo na bhavet tvanmatavaduktavacca
ayugapadbhāviṣvapi ayugapadbhūtapiṇḍādiśivakādipūrvottarabhavanābhavanena ca bhavati san iti, anyathānupapatteḥ
yadi tu sadasanna bhavet tato'nyāpoho nirviṣaya eva bhavet
bhedo bhedāntarārthaṃ tu virodhitvādapohate pra॰ samu॰ 5 | 28
atrāha--syādetadevaṃ yadi avṛkṣanivṛttyā gamyate svārthaḥ kaściditi, kiṃ tarhi ? vṛkṣaḥ sannityasanna bhavatīti tasyāpi vṛkṣasattvasyāvṛkṣāsattvamātrārthatvādanyāpohameva śabdārthamabhyupagacchāmīti

atra brūmaḥ --yadapi ca tat sadityasanna bhavatīti sacchabdo'sacchabdārthaṃ nivartayatīti tataḥ sat ityukte asanna bhavati ityayamartho gamyate tato'nyāpoha eveti bhavatoktaṃ tadapyatipariślatham, durbaddhadārubhārakavad viśīryata ityarthaḥ
tatra tāvannanu yugapadbhūtapaṭādyabhavanenaiva ghaṭabhavanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yugapadbhūtarasādyabhavanenaiva ca rūpabhavanaṃ dṛṣṭam, yad ghaṭasya sattvaṃ tat paṭasyāsattvam, rasasyāsattvaṃ rūpasya sattvam
tasmāt sadityasanna na bhavati, asad bhavatyeva
anyathā tadbhavane ghaṭo na bhavet, paṭasya sato ghaṭe bhavane ghaṭa eva na bhavet, paṭasattvenāvaṣṭabdhatve ghaṭāvakāśābhāvāt
kimiva ? tvanmatavat, tavaiva hi śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatte iti matamitaretarābhāvātmakaṃ ca tattvamiti
kiñcānyat, uktavacca, anantarātītanaye bhāvābhāvabhāvanāyām ityupakramya bahudhoktam
piṇḍo yadi na bhavet kośaka-sthāsaka-kuśūlakādirvā yadi na bhavet tataḥ śivako bhavet
evaṃ kośakādiṣvapi pūrvottarabhāvābhāve vartamānabhāvo bhavet, na bhāve
tathā kapāla-śakala-śarkarakādibhāveṣu yojyaṃ bāla-kumāra-yuva-madhyama-sthavireṣu ca tathaiva prāganekadhā bhāvitam abhavanneva bhavati iti
athaivaṃ necchasi yadi tu sadasanna bhavet tava tato'nyāpoho nirviṣaya eva bhavet
tadyathā--ghaṭaḥ ityaghaṭo na bhavatīti naiva syāt, ghaṭa ityukte'ghaṭa eva syāt ghaṭaśca na bhavet, aghaṭāsattvābhāvāt ghaṭasattvābhāvācca
kiṃ kāraṇam ? sadasanna bhavati iti ghaṭasyāghaṭatvenātmāsadrūpeṇāpi paṭadinā bhavanāt
tataḥ ko doṣaḥ ? tataśca idaṃ doṣajātamaniṣṭamāpadyate --bhedo bhedāntaretyādi yāvadityādi ādigrahaṇāt sāmānyāntarabhedārthāḥ svasāmānyavirodhinaḥ pra॰ samu॰ 5
28 iti vā ityādi yathārthaṃ na bhavati
naiva caivaṃ svārthaviśeṣagatiḥ syāt, pratipakṣāpakṣepaṇakṣīṇaśaktitvāt, sādhyanirdeśaḥ pratijñā yathārthaṃ yathā tvayābhivāñchitaṃ tathā na bhavati, anṛtaṃ tadityarthaḥ
atra prayogaḥ --nāpohetāpyevam, tvaduktena vidhinā sannasan na bhavati iti virodhitvāt asmanmatena sannasan bhavati ityavirodhitvāt dvidhāpi pakṣadharmasiddheḥ virodhyavirodhitvāditi
yathā sadityasadeva anapohāt virodhitve'pi sati avirodhitvāt tathā vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā iti avṛkṣāśiṃśapādi nāpohetetyanyāpohābhāvaḥ
naiva caivaṃ svārthaviśeṣagatiḥ syāt, pratipakṣāpakṣepaṇakṣīṇaśaktitvāt, sādhyanirdeśaḥ pratijñā
tathāhi diṅgāgenoktamakṣapādaṃ prati--sādhyanirdeśa ityatra siddhyabhāve kṛtārthatā
sādhyavacanaṃ hyatra siddhinivṛttau caritārthatvāt sādhyaviśeṣe nāvatiṣṭhate
yathā śabdo nityaḥ, asparśatvāt, buddhivat iti PSV1

syānmatam--nāhaṃ bravīmi yugapadbhāvināṃ ghaṭādirūpādīnāṃ bhāvānāṃ śivakādibālādīnāṃ vā'yugapadbhāvināṃ bhedabhavane'nyasyābhavanaṃ nāstīti, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃvṛtisattvād ghaṭa evāsan santānapatitāśca rūpādaya evāsantaḥ kṣaṇikatvād ghaṭarūpādisaṃvṛtisatāṃ muṣṭipaṅktyādivadasattvāt sannasanna bhavatīti
tasmād yugapadayugapadbhāvisarvabhāvabhedabhavanasya bhavananiyamaḥ sanneva tatvatta ?d bhavati ityucyate ghaṭādyasadvyudāseneti
sanneva na tvasan bhavati iti sanneva na tvasad bhavati iti sanneva tad bhavati iti vā pāṭho'pyatra sambhāvyate

atrocyate --tadapi na, viditabhavanānuvādatvāt, evaṃvādinaste ghaṭādirūpādyasattvāt tadaprasiddhau ghaṭo rūpādirvā bhavati na bhavati apohyate nāpohyate vā svārtho na svārtha ityādyanuvādāyuktiḥ, prasiddhaviditārthaviṣayatvādanuvādasya
anuvadatā ca tvayā ghaṭo rūpādi ca sat ityabhyupagatam, tataḥ sadabhyupagamāt sutarāmasatsattvamāpannam, ato'satsattvāduktadoṣāvimokṣastadavastha eva

rūpādivyatiriktaghaṭādyasattvābhyupagame anirdeśyaparamaniruddhakṣaṇikasantānivyatiriktasantānarūpādyasattvābhyupagame ca ghaṭādiviśeṣaḥ svārtha iti vacanamagatikam, naiva ghaṭo'yam iti svārthaviśeṣagatiḥ syāt aghaṭo na bhavati ityarthagaterabhyupagame

kasmāt ? pratipakṣāpakṣepaṇakṣīṇaśaktitvāt, asanna bhavati iti pratipakṣasyāpakṣepaṇe kṣīṇā śaktirasya ghaṭaśabdasya, yatra ca śabde pratipakṣāpakṣepaṇakṣīṇaśaktitvaṃ tasya svārthaviśeṣavacanagatirnāsti, yathā akṣapādapakṣalakṣaṇe sādhyanirdeśaḥ pratijñā nyā॰ sū॰ 1
asmanmatena tu yadā tadā'nenaiva viṣayeṇa bhavitavyam, uktavat
33 ityasmin vākye sādhyahetudṛṣṭāntābhāsayorapi asādhyatvanivṛttilakṣitayoḥ sādhyatvāt sādhyaviśeṣasvārthāgatiḥ tathā'ghaṭo na bhavatīti aghaṭanivṛttau caritārthatvād ghaṭasvārthaviśeṣāgatiḥ syāt
asmanmatena tu yadā tadā'nenaiva viṣayeṇa bhavitavyam, uktavat

tanna, ghaṭādisarvasaṃvṛtyarthāsattvādagatireva sāmānyārthasyāpyasattvenābhyupagatatvāt tvayaiva, ata eva cāsmābhirevamiti śiviśeṣitamanantarātītāsadvastu ānnānāt asatyopādhisatyaśabdārthavādino'sya nayasya matenāpi sāmānyārthāvācyatvād nāsti śabdasya svārthaḥ
itaśca nāsti; yasmāt arthaviśeṣaśca tavāvācya eva, yathoktam— nārthaśabdaviśeṣasya vācyavācakateṣyate
sāmānyasyāsattvād viśeṣasyāvācyatvāt katamo'nyaḥ svārtha iti, nāsti tvanmatenaiva
tathā cānena śabdanayena sāmānyasyābhyupagatatvādasaṃgatiparihārāya ṭīkākṛdbhiḥ tvayaiva iti viśeṣitamityāśayo bhavet

asmanmatena tu abhidheyo vidhinaivāvaśyam, yasmādasya ca vākyasya yadā tadā'nenaiva viṣayeṇa bhavitavyam, śabdābhidheyenārthena cet kāryaṃ sudūramapi vicārādhvanā gatvā yasmin kasmiṃścit kāle viśeṣasyaiva vastutvādanyasyārthasyābhāvādanena viśeṣeṇaiva viṣayeṇa bhavitavyam, nānyena
nanu yugapadbhūtapaṭādyabhavanenaiva ityādi yāvad bhavanābhavanena ca bhavati san iti, anyathā'nupapatteḥ
yadi tu sadasanna bhavet ityādinā yāvat sādhyaviśeṣāgativat ityetadavadhinā granthena asattvasyāpāditatvāt
tathā cānyāpoha upekṣyaḥ, yasmādanyānapoharūpa eva bhāvastasmādanyasyāpoho nāstītyupekṣyo'nyāpohaḥ
deśataḥ paṭo ghaṭo na bhavati, ghaṭo'pi paṭo na bhavati iti parasparato'pohaḥ siddhaḥ, tathā rūpaṃ raso na bhavati raso'pi rūpaṃ na bhavati iti
kālataḥ pūrvakṣaṇa uttarakṣaṇabhāvyartho nāsti, uttaraḥ pūrvo na bhavati' iti parasparāpohasiddhireveti

atrocyate --ata evopekṣyaḥ, yasmāt parasparatā vidhirūpaiva ityanekadhā prarūpitaṃ tasmād vidhereva viśeṣaviṣayasya sattvāt tato'nyasya śabdārthasyābhāvāt pārasparyasya viśiṣṭārthaviṣayatvād vidhereva vyāvṛttirūpatvāccopekṣyo'nyāpoha iti suṣṭūktam

abhyupetyāpi tvaduktanyāyenā'nyāpohamasmadiṣṭavidhirūpābhidhānameva brūmaḥ --bhavatu vā tatrāpohaḥ tathāpi sarvaviśeṣayuktasyaiva svārthasya gamanamupalakṣyate, svarūpavidhivinābhūtasyāsambhavādapohasya viśeṣāṇāmeva sadbhāvādityudgrāhitārthavad vidhirūpeṇaiveti

yadapyuktam--pūrvadṛṣṭasāmānyena dhūmenāgnyanumānavadabhidhānaṃ sāmānyasya śabdena na viśeṣasya pūrvamadṛṣṭatvāditi; tad na ca pūrvadṛṣṭasya, na hi loke pūrvapratipādanāya śabdaḥ prayujyate prakāśitaprakāśanavaiyarthyavat
kṣaṇikatvācca pūrvadṛṣṭaściranaṣṭaḥ kvāsau ? kathaṃ vā śabdenocyate ? nanūktam pūrvadṛṣṭasāmānyena iti, uktamidam, ayuktamuktam, sāmānyasya saṃvṛtyākhyasyāpohākhyasya cāsattvāt

ato na pūrvadṛṣṭasya gatiḥ śabdena, ata āha --na ca pūrvadṛṣṭasya, na hi sa pūrvadṛṣṭaḥ, nāpi pūrvadṛṣṭenārthaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? ajñātajñānārthatvācchrotuḥ śrotā hyajñātārthajñānenā'rthī, tasya jñānādhānārthaḥ śabdaḥ prayujyate vaktrā na dṛṣṭajñānārtham, uktārthānāmaprayogāt
evaṃ ca kṛtvā'jñātārthatvād viśeṣārthasyaiva sattvāditthamasmābhiḥ paṭhyate— arthaśabdaviśeṣasya vācyavācakateṣyate
yathāsaṅkhyamarthaviśeṣasya vācyatā śabdaviśeṣasyaiva vācakatāsmābhiriṣyate'nayoreva sattvāt, na sāmānyārthaśabdayorasattvāt
tasya viśeṣasya pūrvamadṛṣṭatvāt sa evājñātatvājjñāpyate, kenopāyena cet, ucyate— sāmānyādupasarjanāt
navamāre tu ॰dṛṣṭatvāt iti pāṭho nirdiṣṭa iti dhyeyam

atadbhedatve sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥatadbhedatve iti kimuktaṃ bhavatīti tad vyācaṣṭe --asadasadityādi, sat ityukte'sadapohyate asanna bhavati iti tadasadasat, tadevāsadasacchabdenābhidheyaṃ vastu asadvyāvṛttisāmānyam, tasya viśeṣā bhedā na bhavanti ghaṭādayaḥ satvantaḥ, teṣāmasadasacchabdābhidheyavastvaviśeṣatve sākṣādanukteḥ sataḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāva iti vartate

kathaṃ sākṣānna bravīti sat ? yasmādanyāpohe'pi tāvat sākṣāt pravartamānastadgataṃ nityatvādibhedaṃ nākṣipati kimaṅga punaranyāpohena vyavahite tadgatān bhedān ghaṭādīnākṣepsyati ? etadarthavyaktīkaraṇārthaṃ sadityasanna bhavati ityavaśyaṃ bhavatiśabdaprayogād bhavati ityartho mukhyaḥ śrayaṇīyo'vyāhataḥ
nityatvādayo jātidharmā apohe saṃgacchanta iti diṅgāgasyābhiprāyamatra nirākaroti
te ime vastudharmā avastunyatidiśyamānā asūtrapaṭakāritvaṃ sūcayantītyāha--api caikatvanityatvapratyekasamavāyitāḥ
etad bhāvayitukāmaḥ praśnayati --kathaṃ sākṣānna bravīti saditi

tasya bhāvanārthaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ jātimatpakṣatulyadoṣatvāpādanāya ca --yasmādanyāpohe'pītyādi yāvat tadgatān bhedān ghaṭādīnākṣepsyatīti, jātimatīvāpohe'pi tāvadasadvyāvṛttimātre sākṣāt pravartamāno'nyāpohasāmānyagataṃ nityatvādibhedaṃ nākṣipati anyāpohe'pakṣīṇaśaktitvāt, kimaṅga punaranyāpohena vyavahite sadityasanna bhavati ityasadasattvenāvacchinne'bhidheyabhāge'pohavati gatān ghaṭādīn bhedānākṣepsyatīti sambhāvanāsti ? iti piṇḍārthaḥ

sacchabdābhiprāyasyaivopavarṇanenānyāpohavādinaṃ tāvaduddhaṭṭayannidamāha --etadarthetyādi yāvat kuta eva tadanyāpohaḥ ? etasyānyāpohārthasya vyaktīkaraṇārthaṃ sadityasanna bhavati iti vakyamavaśyamupādeyam, sacchabdamātrādanabhivyakteḥ
tatra cāvaśyaṃ bhavatiśabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ, kriyāpadamantareṇa sacchabdena saha prayuktanañorarthābhāvāt bhavatiśabdasahitayoḥ sāphalyāt
yathoktam --yatrāpyanyat kriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāpyastirbhavantīparaḥ prathamapuruṣe'prayujyamāno'pyastīti gamyate pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
tasmād bhavatītyarthaḥ sa eva mukhyaḥ śrayaṇīyaḥ, ko'sau ? sadartha eva
sa ca avyāhataḥ kvacidavyāvṛtto bhāve sarvatraivaiṣṭavyaḥ

bhede tu ghaṭe vartamānaṃ sattvaṃ paṭādiṣu na vartate ityasadapi syāt, evaṃ ca bhavatyarthasambhedanaṃ syāt, mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti tadbhayādasambhedāya bhedānākṣepa eva, gamiṣyamāṇaghaṭādidravyaprabhedasya tiraskṛtapaṭādyapekṣā sattvasya prāptirmanorathairapi na labhyeta, asattvaviviktasattvaprāptāvevā'tyayaste, kutastato'nyasyāpohaḥ ? asadasatvata ayaṃ tu guṇadharma eva svato'nyān...
na hyasatyāṃ vyāptau sāmānādhikaraṇyam, rūpaśabdena madhurādīnāmanākṣiptatvādavyāptatvāt tacchabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na bhavati, vyāptau tu bhavati, yathā rūpamāmlaṃ rūpaṃ nīlamiti
evābhidhāne śaktyabhāvaḥ dūrata evānyāpoha iti na svārthābhidhānaṃ nānyāpohaṃ vā kuryāt sacchabdaḥ
na hyasatyāṃ vyāptau sāmānādhikaraṇyam, rūpaśabdena madhurādīnāmanākṣiptatvādavyāptatvāt tacchabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na bhavati, vyāptau tu bhavati, yathā rūpamāmlaṃ rūpaṃ nīlamiti
ayaṃ tu guṇadharma eva svato'nyān bhedānākṣeptumasamarthatvād nīlādivat
ato ghaṭādibhedānāmanākṣiptatvādatadbhedatve sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ iti ayaṃ tu guṇadharma eva svato'nyān vyāvartya satvaddravyābhidhānāt, nīlādivat
tataśca ghaṭādibhedānāmanākṣiptatvādatadbhedatve sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ iti vā kaścidāśayo'tra sambhāvyate

tulanā--evamapohamātrābhidhāne doṣasāmyamuktvā jātimadabhidhāne'pi tadvato nāsvatantratvāt ityādinā sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvādi yad bhikṣuṇoktaṃ tadapohavadabhidhāne'pi samānamityupapādayiṣyan pakṣaparigrahaṃ tāvat karoti--athānyāpohavadvastu vācyamityabhidhīyate
iti atra bhikṣurāha--jātiśabdaḥ sadādistadviśiṣṭameva dravyamabhidadhanna tadgatameva ghaṭādiviśeṣarūpamākṣipati
paratantro hyasau sattāṃ nimittīkṛtya dravye vartate, na tu svatantraḥ sarvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ vakti
na hyekopādhiviśiṣṭe dravye'bhihite paropādhinā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati
yathā madhuraśabdena mādhuryopādhiviśiṣṭaṃ khaṇḍadravyamabhidadhatā tadgatāparaśuklādyanākṣepāt tena na sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ yathaitanmadhuraṃ śvetamiti tathaitenāpi na bhāvyaṃ san ghaṭaḥ iti iti
tadetat sarvamasminnapi pakṣe samānamityāha--tatrāpi paratantratvād vyāptiḥ śabdena durlabhā
tatrāpi hyasadapohaviśiṣṭadravyaṃ pratipādayan sacchabdaḥ paratantro vartate nāsau tadgatamaparamaghaṭādivyāvṛttaṃ sadākṣeptuṃ samartha ityabhiprāyaḥ
ataśca tathaiva khaṇḍādidravye madhurādibhiḥ śabdairātmīyāmadhurāśuklādivyāvṛttimātrapravṛtteḥ parasparaṃ śuklamadhuratvādivyāptyasambhavenākṣepo nāsti
ataśca madhuraṃ śuklamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ na bhavatyeva
sacchabdenāpyasadvyāvṛttimātraviśiṣṭadravyābhidhāyinā aparā tadgatāghaṭādivyāvṛttirākṣeptuṃ na śakyate tat kathamatrāpi san ghaṭaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam
atha mā bhūd bhavatyarthasya sambhedanaṃ paṭādyasattveneti sarvatra bhavatyartha eva cediṣyate tataḥ bhavatyasambhede'viviktaikasattvaprāptau tavānyāpohayatnavaiyarthyameva prāptam

kiṃ kāraṇam ? ghaṭasya paṭabhāvādapi, yadi san ghaṭa ityukte paṭādirapi sanneveti sarvasya sattvenaivākrāntatve ca sannasanna bhavati iti kiṃviṣayo'nyāpohaḥ syāt, asannāmakārthasyātyantamabhāvāt ? ityalamatyuddhaṭṭanena, prastutamastu
viśeṣaṇaṃ guṇaḥ, tasya dharma eṣaḥ, svato'nyānityādi gatārthaṃ yāvat sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ
ṭīkāyāṃ coditam --anākṣiptairavyāptairapi sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati vivakṣāvaśāt idaṃ viśeṣyamidaṃ viśeṣaṇam iti
atra bhāṣyeṇa para evottaramāha — na hyasatyāṃ vyāptāvityādi sādharmyavaidharmyābhyāṃ yāvad rūpamāmlaṃ rūpaṃ nīlamiti
atra ca svarūpāpohaguṇā guṇatvenocyante'nugrāhakatvāpekṣayā, apoha-guṇa-dravyāṇi ca dravyatvena anugrāhyatvāpekṣayā

śuklaśabdo hi svābhidheyaguṇamātraviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamabhidadhad dravye sato'pi madhurādīn naivākṣipati, tataścātadbhedatvam, evamihāpi sacchabdo hi pūrvamasanna bhavatītyasattvādavacchinnamaṃśamātramabhidhāya satvad dravyamabhidadhad naivākṣipati tadviśeṣaṃ tadviśeṣān vā yattattadvat satvanmātravaditi sacchabdavācyārthābhedatvaṃ dravyādīnāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ vā

śruto guṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ śuklasadādi, tadgatā bhedāḥ śuklatarādayo dravyādayo ? vā, teṣāmabhedatvaṃ tadvati, anuvṛttipakṣe'nyāpohapakṣe vā jātisvarūpopasarjanamātratvād guṇabhūtatvādanyāpohamātropasarjanatvād guṇabhūtatvāccātadbhedatvādanākṣepaḥ
satvatpakṣe śabdasvarūpaṃ guṇa eva, jāti-guṇau guṇo dravyaṃ ca, dravyaṃ tu dravyameva, upakārī guṇaḥ pradhānaṃ dravyamityarthaḥ

apohapakṣe śabdasvarūpaṃ guṇa eva, apoha-guṇau guṇo dravyaṃ ca, dravyaṃ ca dravyameveti pakṣadvaye'pi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvavibhāgakrameṇa tulyadoṣatvāpādanena ca sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvotkīrtano grantho yāvat satvanmātravaditi prāyo gatārthaḥ
viśeṣastu vivriyate--atra ca svarūpa-jāti-guṇā guṇatvenocyante jāti-guṇa-dravyāṇi ca dravyatveneti pareṇoktatvānnocyate
atra ca svarūpāpohetyādi yāvadanugrāhyatvāpekṣayeti tatsamānārthokteḥ so'pi draṣṭavyaḥ
etasyārthasya bhāvanā --śuklaśabdo hītyādi yāvat tataścātadbhedatvaṃ śuklābhedatvamiti satvadabhidhānapakṣe doṣotkīrtanaṃ nidarśanatvena gatārtham

evamihāpi sacchabdo hi pūrvamasanna bhavatītyādi dārṣṭāntikatvena saiva paripāṭī tulyā yāvat satvaddravyamabhidadhaditi nayenetyataḥ prabhṛti udakādinā dravyabhedena satvad guṇarūpādiguṇabhedena karmagamanādikarmabhedena vā satvaditi
taṃ viśeṣamiti ekaṃ vāpohavantaṃ dravyādibhedānāmanyatamaṃ tān viśeṣān veti sarvān bhedān vā naivākṣipati iti vartate

va?yattattadvaditi, tiṣṭhantu tāvad viśeṣāṇāmanyatamaḥ sarve vā, kiṃ tarhi ? vivakṣitamekaṃ ghaṭādi vā guṇādivirahitaṃ tadvastu naivākṣipati nāpyārātīyaṃ tato dravyādi vā tadvadvastu taṃ viśeṣaṃ tadviśeṣān vā, nārātīyānāmapi viśeṣāṇāmavibhi ?dhāteti
iti sacchabdavācyārthābhedatvaṃ dravyādīnāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ veti bhāvitārthānusāreṇopasaṃhāraḥ
sadasti asyeti satvān, yathā sa nirākriyate tvayā satvanmātrapakṣe'nākṣepāt tathā'nyāpohavatpakṣe'pītyāśayo bhāti
atrāpi sacchabdena asadvyāvṛttimātraviśiṣṭadravyābhidhānāt sato'pi dravyādīnāmanākṣepaḥ, tataśca tadabhedatvam
nanu ca tatra dṛṣṭaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam--śuklaṃ khaṇḍam, tacca madhuram, śuklataraḥ
sadityasanna bhavati iti asatvādavacchinnaṃ dharmiṇoṃ'śamātraṃ sacchabdo'bhidhatte na tasyānyaṃ kañcit, apohanityatvādyaṃśavat
mā maṃsthāḥ--naivaṃ saṃbhavatīti, ata āha --tatsatsvarūpajātiviśiṣṭadravyābhidhāyitvāt, vyākhyātārtha evāyaṃ hetuḥ, dṛṣṭāntānuguṇyena tu pakṣadvayaprasiddhyāpādanārthaṃ tadvaditi sāmānyenoktaḥ
śuklaśrutivaditi, aśuklanivṛttimātraṃ dharmyaṃśaṃ śuklaśabdo'bhidadhattasyaivāṃśāntaraṃ nābhidhatte yathā tathā sacchabdo'sannivṛttimātramuktavā nānyat kiñciditi
vyākhyārtha evāyaṃ hetu dṛṣṭānto tu ya॰
tadupasarjanaṃ dravyamāha ityatra dravyaśabdaśca adravyaṃ na bhavati ityetāvadadravyāpohamātramabhidhatte tenaiva nyāyena, na tadviśeṣaṃ na dravyaviśeṣam

tataḥ kimiti cet, itthaṃ tayoḥ saddravyaśabdayoravacchinnabhāgamātraviṣayatvādabhedavattvam, abhedavattvād nirviṣayatvam, nirviṣayatvāt kuta ekārthatā sacchabdadravyaśabdayoḥ ? ityataḥ asadasadrūpe'pi asadvyāvṛttirūpe satyapi na sato bhedā dravyādayaḥ, na dravyasya ghaṭādayaḥ, na sacchabdasya dravyādiśabdāḥ, tasmādatadbhedatvamanākṣiptatvāt, ato'sāmānādhikaraṇyam
dṛṣṭamiṣṭaṃ ca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ satvadabhidhāne'pohavadabhidhāne cetthaṃ na prāpnotīti
athavā dṛṣṭaviruddhaṃ tvayocyate śuklaśabdasvarūpa-jāti-guṇānāṃ khaṇḍadravyasya vātyantabhinnārthatvāt jātimatpakṣe'pohavatpakṣe ceti
punaḥ tacca khaṇḍaṃ madhuram iti rūparasayorbhedāt dravyasya rūparasābhyāṃ ca bhedādasambaddhamevedam
tathā śuklataraḥ śuklatamaḥ iti guṇajātigataprakarṣabhedasya dravyeṇāsambandhaḥ
iha vā kiṃ na dṛṣṭam--saddravyaṃ sadguṇaḥ satkarmeti ? etadeva tu na prāpnotītyucyate
yathā caite jātimatpakṣe sacchabdaprayoge ghaṭādyanākṣepo'tadbhedatvamasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca doṣāstathānyāpohe'pi, asākṣādvacanatvāt
bhavatsākṣādvacane ca rūpanīlatvavad guṇaparyāyalakṣaṇaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ bhavadeva sadyo vastvabhidhīyate prādhānyeneti nāsvatantraviśiṣṭaṃ bhavadvastu
yathā cāhuḥ--sacchabdena saha bhedaśabdā asamānādhikaraṇāḥ, tadabhidhāne'nā-
atra doṣastādavasthyādevamucyate --iha vā kiṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ saddravyaṃ sadguṇaḥ satkarma iti ? na hi dṛṣṭād gariṣṭhaṃ pramāṇamasti, tasyānatikramaṇīyatvāt
kiṃ tarhi ? etadeva tu dṛṣṭaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ guṇaśabdatve viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa śabdasvarūpa-jātyupasarjane tadvati vācye'pohavati vā na prāpnotīti ucyate paraṃ prati doṣaḥ
yathā parapakṣe sacchabdaprayoge ghaṭādyanākṣepo'tadbhedatvamasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca doṣāḥ śuklaśabdamadhurānākṣepādidṛṣṭāntāstathā anyāpohapakṣe sacchabde'pi jātimatsacchabdaghaṭādyanākṣepādidṛṣṭāntāḥ

taccaitat sarvaṃ doṣajātamasatyopādhisāmānyasopānārohisatyabhavadarthaviśeṣasākṣādvacanapakṣe nāsti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ copapadyate iti tatpradarśanārthamāha --bhavatsākṣādvacane cetyādi yāvajjātyupasarjanaṃ veti

rūpanīlatvavaditi rūpajātisāmānyāsatyopādhyanugatidvāreṇa nīlaviśeṣasya sadyo bhavataḥ sata evārthasya gatirarūpānīlatvanivṛttyasatyopādhidvāreṇa vā yathā bhavati tathehāsmadiṣṭaguṇaparyāyalakṣaṇaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ bhavadeva sadyo vastu abhidhīyate prādhānyena mukhyayaiva vṛttyā sākṣād
yattatra dravyaghaṭapaṭādi bhedajātaṃ guṇa-karma-sāmānya-viśeṣādi vā parikalpitaṃ tadasat, saṃvṛtisattvāt
guṇa-paryāyalakṣaṇo hi viśeṣa eva san, na aṅgulivyatiriktamuṣṭivad balākādivyatiriktapaṅktyādivacceti dravyādyapi tadeva iti etasmāddhetoḥ nāsvatantraviśiṣṭaṃ bhavadvastu
taccoktavidhinā'pohavatpakṣāpekṣamasadasadupasarjanaṃ jātimatpakṣāpekṣaṃ jātyupasarjanaṃ vā, dvidhāpi na doṣa iti
tatra sacchabdeneti prathame sādhane bhedaśabdānāṃ sāmānyaśabdena saha sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ pakṣīkriyate
tadabhidhānaṃ guṇabhūtenānyāpohenāpohavato'bhyupagatam, lakṣaṇavākye śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatte kṣiptatvād bhedānām, śuklābhidhānānākṣiptamadhurādivat
sacchabdo bhedaiḥ sahāsamānādhikaraṇaḥ, sāmānyānabhidhāyitvāt, śuklaśabda iva madhurādibhiḥ sahāsāmānyavācī
dravyādiśabdo vā sacchabdena sahāsamānādhikaraṇaḥ, atadviśeṣasambandhitvāt, madhuraśabda iva śuklaśabdena
sacchabdo vā asadvyāvṛttimantaṃ nābhidhatte, ghaṭādiśabdaiḥ sahāsamānādhikaraṇatvāt, anityaśabdavat
yathā cāha--vidyamānāḥ pradhāneṣu na sarve bhedahetavaḥ
ataḥ siddho hetuḥ --tadabhidhāne'nākṣiptatvād bhedānām, teṣāmeva ca pakṣīkṛtatvāt
sacchabdo bhedaiḥ sahāsamānādhikaraṇaḥ, sāmānyānabhidhāyitvāt, śuklaśabda iva madhurādibhiḥ sahāsāmānyavācī
dravyādiśabdo vā sacchabdena sahāsamānādhikaraṇaḥ, atadviśeṣasambandhitvāt, madhuraśabda iva śuklaśabdena
sacchabdo vā asadvyāvṛttimantaṃ nābhidhatte, ghaṭādiśabdaiḥ sahāsamānādhikaraṇatvāt, anityaśabdavat
dvitīye'pi sādhane sacchabde pakṣīkṛte bhedānākṣepāt kasya tat sāmānyamapohavadvastu ? iti sāmānyānabhidhāyitvaṃ siddhaṃ tasya
pūrvatra śuklaśabdasahayogāvadhikā bhedaśabdā eva sādhyāḥ dṛṣṭāntāśca, iha tu bhedaśabdāvadhikāḥ sāmānyaśabdā iti viśeṣaḥ
tṛtīye dravyādiśabdo veti sākṣād viśeṣaśabda eva tadvāreṇa viśeṣārtha eva vā sākṣāt pakṣaḥ
atadviśeṣatvam, asadasataḥ sāmānyasya na viśeṣā dravyādayaḥ, anākṣiptatvāduktanyāyena
na ca tat sāmānyaṃ teṣāṃ sambandhi te vā tasyeti siddhamatadviśeṣasambandhitvam
sacchabdo vā'sadvyāvṛttimantaṃ nābhidhatte, apohavataḥ svārthābhimatasyābhidhānameva vā nirākurmahe
ghaṭādiśabdaiḥ sahāsamānādhikaraṇatvāt, sacchabdasya ghaṭādiśabdaiḥ sahāsamānādhikaraṇatvaṃ bhedānākṣepāt siddham
anityaśabdavat, anityaḥ śabdaḥ ityukte nityo na bhavati iti nityatvavyāvṛttimantaṃ brūte nāsadvyāvṛttimantam, śabdaśabdenaiva ca samānādhikaraṇo'nityaśabdo na ghaṭādiśabdaiḥ
ataḥ sādhyasādhanadharmadvayaṃ dṛṣṭānte dārṣṭāntike ca siddhamiti
yathā cāheti jñāpakaṃ sampratipannavādyantaramatapradarśanaṃ tasyārthasya dṛḍhīkaraṇārtham

pradhāneṣu viśeṣyeṣu vidyamānā api bhedahetavo dharmāḥ sarve nocyante, kaścideva viśiṣṭo vivakṣitaḥ kenacid viśeṣaṇena tadvācinā viśeṣaśabdenocyate'rtho viśeṣāntarāvyāpāreṇa, tatraiva caritārthatvāt tasya guṇabhūtatvāt
ata eva ca te viśeṣaśabdāḥ ityucyante vyāvṛttārthābhidhāyitvāditi
etenaiva yatnena tvadīyena ca vidhipradhānasatvadabhidhānapakṣadoṣoktiyatnena kṛtaprayojanatvānna pṛthag dūṣyate
kena tasyāḥ sāmānyaśrutitvam ? yadā sā svarūpaguṇamātraviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamāha tadā bhedānāmanākṣepāt kasya tat sāmānyaṃ yadabhidadhatīti sāmānyaśrutiḥ ityucyeta
athavā sacchabdo mukhyayā vṛttyā bhūtārthena svarūpeṇa prakāśyamānaḥ saṃvṛtisadvastu svarūpavyavahitamāha sa tatra vṛttaḥ svarūpavyavahite'rthe sati asadvyāvṛttiṃ na
sacchabdanivartitāsadapohaḥ sarvatra vṛtteḥ samānaḥ, tadvācitvāccāsau sāmānyaśabdaḥ, bhedāśca ghaṭādayo'sadvyāvṛttyā vyāptatvādākṣiptāstadbhedā eva
ataḥ sarvo'yaṃ vāgvyāyāmo viphalaḥ--sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nāsti, bhedā na bhavanti, sāmānyaṃ na bhavati, anākṣepāt ityādiraprasakta eva vicāra iti
atra brūmaḥ--tvadvacanānuvṛttyaiva tvamidaṃ praṣṭavyo'si --kena tasyāḥ sāmānyaśrutitvam ? kena hetunā tasyā asadvyāvṛttyarthāyāḥ sacchruteḥ sāmānyaśrutitvam ? nāstyeva heturityabhiprāyaḥ

tvanmatenaiva yadā sā svarūpaguṇamātraviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamāha, svarūpaṃ guṇo viśeṣaṇam, tat parimāṇamasya tat svarūpaguṇamātram, tenaiva viśiṣṭaṃ nādhikena, lakṣaṇavākye'pi śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī iti vacanāt dravyamasadvyāvṛttiguṇapramāṇaviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ
tadā bhedānāmanākṣepāt kasya tat sāmānyaṃ yadabhidadhatīti sāmānyaśrutiḥ ityucyeteti
strīliṅgatvāt sāmānyaśruteḥ abhidadhatī iti śatṛpratyayānto'yaṃ prayoga iti dhyeyam
sacchabdo mukhyayā vṛttyā bhūtārthena svarūpeṇa prakāśyamāna iti śabdasvarūpamātreṇa buddhyā gṛhyamāṇaḥ saṃvṛtisadvastu svarūpavyavahitamāha

sa tatra vṛttaḥ svarūpavyavahite'rthe sati vyāvṛtterasataḥ san asanna bhavati iti prasajyapratiṣedhāsambhavāt pratiṣedhasamāśrayo'rthaḥ sattulyaeva syāt asan iti, nañivayuktamanyasadṛśādhikaraṇe pā॰ vā॰ 3
abrāhmaṇo brāhmaṇavadadhīte iti brāhmaṇasadṛśe puruṣa eva pratyayo nāśve na gavīti yathā na tu tathā kiñcidasat sattulyamasti, satonasyāsattvādasatonatvābhāvāt
na hi yo yatropacaryate sa tamarthaṃ bhūtārthenāha
svarūpe'nyāpohe ca mukhyayā vṛttyā vartitvāpohaśabdastadvati vartate, na mukhyayā vṛttyā, upacārāt
na tāvat pratyayasaṃkrāntitaḥ sārūpyādupacāraḥ saṃbhavati, sārūpyāsambhave pratyayasaṃkrāntyabhāvāt krameṇānabhidhānācca

nāpi guṇopa- itthaṃ sacchabdo'sadvyāvṛttiṃ na karoti bhūtārthena, kiṃ tarhi ? upacārādasadasad bravīti, anyasyāpohaṃ gauṇyā vṛttyā brūte, sa sacchabdo'pohe'pi tāvadadṛṣṭatvāt tadvati apohavati dūrata evādṛṣṭatvādapradhānaḥ, apradhānatvādasvatantraḥ na hi yo yatropacaryate sa tamarthaṃ bhūtārthenāheti sādhyena mukhyānabhidhānena hetorupacārāpradhānāsvātantryānugamaṃ darśayati
mañcaśabdo mañcasthān mañcasvarūpāpannāneva brūte na puruṣatvāpannāniti
tathāpohārthaḥ śabdo'poha eva vyavasthito'pohavatsu dravyeṣu vartata iti dārṣṭāntikam
śloko'yaṃ na pramāṇasamuccayādapi tu diṅgāgasyaiva granthāntarāduddhṛto'treti pratīyate
ato'sya pūrvārddhaṃ pṛ॰ 473-- 2, 475-- 1 ityatra yathā vakṣyate tathātrāsmābhiryojitam
pramāṇasamuccaye tu yathāyaṃ ślokastathā pṛ॰ 607 ityatra darśitamasmābhiḥ
atrārucau tu sato'nyasyāsattvādasato'nyatvābhāvāt iti pāṭhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ
na hi yo yatropacaryate sa tamarthaṃ bhūtārthenāha

mañcāḥ krośanti' iti kriyāsambandhasyādheye mañcasthe prāṇinyupapatterādhārarūpābhedenādhāravacano'pi mañcaśabdastadādheyavacana iti niścīyate evam ānīyantāṃ gāvaḥ iti kriyāsambandhasya jātāvanupapattestadabhedāpannā vyaktayaḥ kriyāsamanvayasamarthā jātinibandhanena śabdenopādīyanta ityavagamaḥ
svarūpe'nyāpohe ca mukhyayā vṛttyā vartitvāpohaśabdastadvati vartate, na mukhyayā vṛttyā, upacārāt
na tāvat pratyayasaṃkrāntitaḥ sārūpyādupacāraḥ saṃbhavati, sārūpyāsambhave pratyayasaṃkrāntyabhāvāt krameṇānabhidhānācca
svarūpamanyarūpanivṛttyātmakamarthāntaranivṛttyātmakaṃ ca svārthaṃ mukhyayā vṛttyā abhidadhānastadvati upacāreṇa vartate nābhidhānenāpohaśabda iti samo nyāyaḥ
mañcaśabdavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ tadvati na vartate mukhyayā vṛttyā iti sādhye
dvayī hi upacārasya gatiḥ--sārūpyāt, yathā yamalayoranyatarasmin sa evāyam iti pratyayasaṅkrānteḥ, rājño bhṛtye'mātyādau rājā iti vā pratyayaḥ

tatra na tāvat pratyayasaṅkrāntitaḥ sārūpyādupacāraḥ sambhavati sārūpyāsambhave pratyayasaṅkrāntyabhāvāt svāmibhṛtyayorbhinnatvāt, yadi saiva buddhiḥ saṅkrāntā syādabhinnā svāmini bhṛtye ca svāmyanujñātamuktāvalīva syāt, na tu bhavati, kārāt, sphaṭikavad viśeṣaṇaprakarṣamagṛhītvā viśeṣye pratyayaprasaṅgāt, ayathārthajñānotpatteḥ, yugapadasambhavācca
viśeṣa eva vastu paramārthato'sti, na dravyārthaḥ sāmānyam
tasyāsattvād viśeṣa eva svatantraḥ kalpitasāmānyopasarjanaḥ, mañcaśabdavat
itaśca tvanmativad bhedāt tadvato na vācakaḥ
bhinnā hi vyāvṛttimantaḥ kiṃ tarhi ? rājavadamātyaḥ iti bhinnaivābhedopacārā bhavati
kiñca, kramavṛttyabhāvācca, na hi krameṇa sakṛduccaritaḥ śabdaḥ kṣaṇikatvādasadapohe vartitvā tadvati vartate rāja-bhṛtyabuddhivat

tannāpi guṇopakārāt, sphaṭikavad viśeṣaṇaprakarṣamagṛhītvā viśeṣye pratyayaprasaṅgāt, yathā sphaṭike raktatvādipratyaya upadhānaprakarṣamagṛhītvā bhavati tathā viśeṣaṇaprakarṣamagṛhītvā viśeṣye pratyayaḥ syāt, na tu bhavati
kiñca, ayathārthajñānotpatteḥ, yathā sphaṭike raktatvādipratyayo mithyāpratyayastathā viśeṣaṇasarūpapratyayo viśeṣye syāt
kiñca, yugapadasambhavācca, yadā ca bahavo grahītāro bhavanti guṇavataḥ śuklādeḥ tadyathā--ghaṭaḥ pārthivo dravyaṃ sañchuklo madhuraḥ surabhiḥ ityevamādiviśeṣaistadā guṇopakāro virudhyate
na hi śakyaṃ tadā dravyeṇa ekaguṇarūpeṇa sthātum, anekātmakasyāviśiṣṭatvāt

atha punaḥ sarvairghaṭatvādibhirupakāro yugapat kṛtsnasya kriyate tataḥ sarveṣāṃ pratyekaṃ grahītṝṇāṃ ghaṭādirūpagrahaṇābhāvāt sarvaguṇasaṅkareṇa mecakadarśanam yugapat sarvarūpāpatteḥ syāt sphaṭikavadeva, na tu bhavati
tasmādayuktastādrūpyāt pratyayasaṅkrānterupacāraḥ, yamalādivat; nāpi guṇopakārāt sphaṭikavaditi
kārāt, sphaṭikavad viśeṣaṇaprakarṣamagṛhītvā viśeṣye pratyayaprasaṅgāt, ayathārthajñānotpatteḥ, yugapadasambhavācca
viśeṣa eva vastu paramārthato'sti, na dravyārthaḥ sāmānyam
tasyāsattvād viśeṣa eva svatantraḥ kalpitasāmānyopasarjanaḥ, mañcaśabdavat
itaśca tvanmativad bhedāt tadvato na vācakaḥ
etadantargataḥ pāṭhaḥ pramāṇasamuccayavṛttau prāya īdṛśa evopalabhyate
mañcaśabda iti ślokasyāntyapāde pāṭhāntaraṃ tathā bhāvaśabdo dravyeṣu vartate iti
tasya vyākhyā --viśeṣa eva vastu paramārthato'sti, na dravyārthaḥ sāmānyaṃ jātirghaṭādiṣvekaṃ bhavat kiñcidasti
tasya sāmānyasya asattvād viśeṣa eva svatantraḥ kalpitasāmānyopasarjano yathā prāk prakrāntaḥ
kimiva ? mañcaśabdavat, saiva vyākhyā gatārthā bhāvaśabdasya guṇaparyāyavācitvāt
bhinnā hi vyāvṛttimantaḥ satvanta ivārthā ghaṭādaya iti hetu satvanta ivārthā ghaṭādayaḥ
bhedānāṃ cānantye sambandhāśakyatvād vyabhicārāccāvācaka ityuktaṃ prāk tvayaiva
yasyābhidhātā so'rtho'sadasanmātrākhyo bhedavat sattvaṃ vā syāt sattāmātraṃ vā sattāsambandho vā satvanmātraṃ vā ? tatra--nāpohaśabdo bhedānāmānantyād vyabhicārataḥ
ke te vyāvṛttimanta iti cet, ucyate--asadasanto'rthā ghaṭādayaḥ
bhedānāṃ cānantye sambandhāśakyatvād vyabhicārāccāvācaka ityuktaṃ prāk, kena ? tvayaiva
bhedānāṃ cānantye sambandhāśakyatvād vyabhicārāccāvācaka ityuktaṃ prāk tvayaiva
nanu cāyaṃ ghaṭādiṣu dravyādibhedānabhidhānena parihṛto doṣaḥ
na hyatra bhedā abhidhīyante, kiṃ tarhi ? teṣāmasadasanmātraṃ sāmānyarūpam
vyabhicāro'pi nāsti, tadabhāve śabdasyāpravṛtteḥ ityāśayo bhāti
yasyābhidhātā so'rtho'sadasanmātrākhyo bhedavat sattvaṃ vā syāt sattāmātraṃ vā sattāsambandho vā satvanmātraṃ vā ? tatra--
diṅgāgasyaiva na jātiśabdaḥ ityādi kārikādvayaṃ kiñcit parivartya diṅgāgamataṃ pratividhātumatra granthakṛtopanyasyate
satvanmātrapakṣe pūrvameva hi dravyādibhedānabhidhānenānantyavyabhicāradoṣau parihṛtau tathehāpi asadasatvanmātrapakṣe bhedānabhidhānena taddoṣaparihāra iti taddarśayati

yasyārthasya śabdo vācaka iṣyate so'rtho'sadasanmātrākhyo bhedavat sattvaṃ vā syāt, bhedavatī sabhedā sattā jātirityarthaḥ, kiṃ tadasadasanmātramucyate, sattāmātraṃ vā bhedanirapekṣā sattaiva vā, sattāsambandho vā, satvanmātraṃ vā ? sadanuvṛttyabhidhānapakṣavadete catvāro vikalpāḥ asadasatvati vyāvṛttimatyapi pakṣe sambhaveyurgatyantarābhāvāt

tanna, abhāvasya pratiṣiddhatvāt, śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatte iti tvayaiva svārthavacanena uktatvādasmābhiḥ svārtha eva tāvannirdhāyate ityādinā yāvad ananyaḥ pratyakṣa iti granthena vicārya bhāṣye pratiṣiddhatvāt
pariśeṣādetāvanta eva vikalpā bhavanto bhaveyuḥ asadasanmātram iti śabdārthasya
vidhivādimatavadapohavādimate'pi catuṣṭaye sthite samāna evātrāpi vicāro granthaśceti tathaivāha --nāpohaśabdo bhedānāmityādi ślokadvayam
antye pāde tūpasaṃhāre viśeṣaḥ --sattādyartho'pyato na sa iti, mātraśabdalabhyārthaitāvattvāt
etacchlokadvayaṃ vyākhyātukāmaḥ sambandhayati --evaṃ sanmātrasattādyāpādanavadihāpīti tulyadoṣatvavivakṣā bhavantamanyāṃśca pratīti na jātiśabdo bhedānāmānantyād vyabhicārataḥ
ānantye hi bhedānāmaśakyaḥ śabdena sambandhaḥ kartum
na cākṛtasambandhe śabde'rthābhidhānaṃ nyāyyam, svarūpamātrapratīterityādi yāvad na, guṇatvādivyabhicārāt

pūrvamapohaśabdena sampannatvād viśrabdhaṃ paravācoyuktyaiva na jātiśabdaḥ ityādi paragranthameva udadikṣat, asadasadviśiṣṭasanmātra-bheda-sattāsambandha-satvatpakṣāṇāṃ tvadiṣṭānāṃ vidhirūpāṇāṃ ca pareṣṭānāmaviśeṣāditi
tadyathā --na jātiśabdo bhedānāṃ vācakaḥ iti vakṣyati
jātiśabdastāvat sadādiriti, yasmāt sacchabdo jātisambandhino jātimupādāyātmarūpeṇa dravyādīnabhedopacārādāha tasmādabhedopacārahetunā vyapadiśyate jātiśabda iti
yathā siṃho māṇavakaḥ iti siṃhaśabdo māṇavakaguṇānupādāyābhedopacārapravṛtterabhedopacārahetunā vyapadiśyate guṇaśabda iti
kasmānna vācaka iti hetuparipraśnaḥ, yasmād vāṅmātreṇa na śraddhīyate
kasyānantyāt ? bhedānām, yasmāt te pūrvaṃ prakṛtā na cānyaḥ śrūyate
ānantyehi bhedānāmaśakyaḥ śabdena sambandhaḥ kartum, na hi pāṭaliputrādisthā dravyādaya ihasthena sacchabdena sahākhyātuṃ śakyāḥ
evaṃ tāvat sambandhibhedād bhedamabhyupagamyedamucyate, na tu tasya vastunaḥ svagato bhedo'sti
tatredameva kāraṇam--yat sambandhāntaraviśiṣṭābhidhāyī śabdaḥ sambandhāntaraviśiṣṭaśabdavācyamasamartho vaktum, gavāśvādivat
ānantye hi bhedānāmaśakyaḥ śabdena sambandhaḥ kartum
na cākṛtasambandhe śabde'rthābhidhānaṃ nyāyyam, svarūpamātrapratīterityādi yāvad na, guṇatvādivyabhicārāt
33, vakṣyamāṇairāśrayādibhiḥ svasambandhibhirbhidyamānopacaritabhedā gavāśvādiṣu sattaiva mahāsāmānyameva jātirgotvāśvatvādikā aparasāmānyaṃ, nānyā paramārthabhinnā sā vidyate
tathā goḥ sattā gotvaṃ nāparamanvayi pratibhāsate evamaśvasya sattā aśvatvamityādi vācyam
tasyāmeva ca gavādibhedabhinnāyāṃ sattākhyāyāṃ jātau sarve gavādayo ḍitthādaya ākāśādayaśca śabdā trācakatvena vyavasthitā ityasāṃkaryeṇa niyatopādhivaśājjātyabhidhāyinaḥ siddhāḥ
na cākṛtasambandha ityanākhyātasambandhe śabda iti dviṣṭhatve'pi sambandhasya śabdasyaivāvinābhāvitvādarthapratyāyakatvaṃ darśayati

atra cānantyaṃ pāramparyeṇānabhidhānahetuḥ--tato hi sambandhāśakyatā, sambandhāvyutpatteranabhidhānaṃ svarūpamātrapratīteriti yatra śabdasyārthena sambandho'vyutpanno yathā mlecchaśabdānāṃ tatra etāvacca...

...sa eva doṣaḥ, tena sahābhūtasāmānyatvāt, yathā satvadarthasacchabdasya ghaṭādibhedārthatvābhāvāt tena sahāsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tathā tavāpi asadasadarthasacchabdasya ghaṭādibhedārthatvābhāvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ
śabdamātrameva pratīyate nārtha ityādiḥ saha ṭīkayā bhāṣyagrantho draṣṭavyo yāvad na guṇatvādivyabhicārādityavadhirācāryeṇa yāvatkāritaḥ savyākhyānaḥ sāmānyaparīkṣākāralikhita evātrāpīti na likhyate
etāvaccātra bhavet--bhedā vā, sattāmātraṃ vā, sattāsambandho vā, sattāyāḥ svādhāro vā

...sa eva doṣaḥ, tena sahābhūtasāmānyatvāt, yathā satvadarthasacchabdasya ghaṭādibhedārthatvābhāvāt tena sahāsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tathā tavāpi asadasadarthasacchabdasya ghaṭādibhedārthatvābhāvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ
diṅgāgaracite sāmānyaparīkṣāgranthe na jātiśabdo bhedānāmānantyād vyabhicārataḥ
iti ślokadvayaṃ tadvyākhyā ca vistareṇa sambhāvyate
na cāsti sambhava iti yathā vicāritamiti mātraśabdāpāditasattādyartho'pyato na sa ityupasaṃhāraḥ
alamatiprasaṅgeneti, bhedāt ityetatprasaṅgāgatasākṣādvidhivādimatadūṣaṇamidaṃ saprasaṅgamuktam --sattādyartho'pyato na sa iti, mātragrahaṇasya etāvadviṣayasambhavānativartitvāt
adhunā bhavantaṃ prati mātragrahaṇāt tatsambhavino vikalpāsta eveti tān dūṣayiṣyāmaḥ
tadyathā— athavā bhedāditi yasmādvyāvṛttimānityādi, bhedāt ityayaṃ heturvyāvṛttimatpakṣe doṣamāpādayitumitthaṃ vyākhyāyate
yasmād vyāvṛttimānasadasatvāniti pūrvebhyaḥ pakṣebhyo viśeṣaṃ darśayati
śeṣaṃ tulyaṃ yāvat sa eva atadbhedatve sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāva eva doṣaḥ pratijñātastvāṃ pratyāpādyate
ghaṭaḥ ityukte yasminnasadasattvaṃ ghaṭe sa ghaṭo'nyatra ghaṭāntare paṭādau ca na vartate, ato bhinnaḥ, bhinnatvāccātadbhedā ghaṭādayaḥ, tasmāt tena sahābhūtasāmānyatvaṃ siddham
yo yena sahābhūtasāmānyastasya tena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na bhavati

yathā satvadarthetyādinidarśanadaṇḍakaḥ, satvānartho'sya sacchabdasya so'yaṃ sacchabdaḥ satvadarthaḥ, tasya ghaṭādibhedārthatvaṃ nāsti tvanmatena, tadabhāvāt tena sahāsāmānādhikaraṇyam, sākṣādvidhivādimata iva tavāpi sacchabdo'sadasadartho ghaṭādibhedārtho na bhavati, atastadvadeva sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāva iti
diṅgāgena savṛttike pramāṇasamuccaye pañcame'pohaparicchede yadabhihitaṃ tasya prārambhikoṃ'śa iha pṛ॰ 607— 608 ityatrāsmābhirbhoṭabhāṣānuvādāt saṃskṛte parivartya pradarśitaḥ
sa cātrāpohaparīkṣāyāṃ yatra yatra yathā yathopayujyate tathā tathānusandheyaḥ
madhye tūbhayathā dṛśyate, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 630 paṃ॰ 29, pṛ॰ 631 paṃ॰ 32
yato jātiḥ svarūpaṃ ca tadvadrūpaṃ na yujyate
yato jātiḥ svarūpaṃ tadvadrūpaṃ ca na yujyate ?
bhedarūpeṇābhidhāne'pi avaśyaṃ jātirūpeṇa bhedābhidhāne jātau sākṣād bhedeṣūpacārāt tadvatīva sarvatra doṣo vācyaḥ, jātāvapyabhidheyāyāṃ śabdasvarūpādhyāropeṇa jātyabhidhānāt sambhavāt
jātiyogo jātirūpeṇa sadādinābhidhīyata ityatrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ doṣo vācyaḥ
jātiṣu ? sākṣād bhedeṣūpacāra iti tadvatīva sarvo doṣo vācyaḥ PSV1
tadvāṃśca bheda evoktaḥ sa ca pūrvaṃ nirākṛtaḥ || 8
taduktam --tadvāṃstu bheda eveṣṭaḥ sa ca pūrvaṃ nirākṛtaḥ iti
na jātiśabdo bhedānāṃ vācakaḥ iti pūrvaṃ nirākṛtaḥ sa ca jātimān
nanu coktam--jātiśabdo jātimanmātrasya vācako na tu bhedarūpeṇeti
jātiśabdaḥ pūrvaṃ nirākṛtaḥ na jātiśabdo bhedānāṃ vācakaḥ iti
sa ca jātimatyapi uktaḥ tena jātimatyapi uktam ? ?
yaccātra bhikṣuṇā jātimanmātraṃ vācyaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkya vikalpitam--atha jātimattvaṃ kiṃ jātitadvatoḥ sambandhaḥ kiṃ vā sāmānyarūpamiti
evaṃ ca vikalpya pūrvoktajātisambandhābhidhānadoṣo yojanīyaḥ ityuktvoktam— tadvanmātre'pi sambandhaḥ sattā veti vicāritam' iti
sa ca sambandhe guṇe vā syāt
tatrāpi na vācako yogajātyorvā bhedārthairapṛthak śruteḥ ityuktam
yathāha--samāsakṛttaddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānaṃ bhāvapratyayena anyatra rūḍhyavyabhicaritasambandhebhyaḥ iti
tadvānartho ghaṭādiścenna paṭādiṣu vartate | sāmānyamarthaḥ sa katham ?
yadapi cāsmin pakṣe bhikṣuṇoktam--yadā gotvaviśiṣṭaḥ śābaleyo gośabdasya vācyatvamityaṅgīkṛtaṃ tadāsau bāhuleye nāstīti tatra gośabdapravṛttirna syāditi

tacca yadi sāmānyavān ghaṭādiḥ, sa paṭādiṣu avartamānaḥ kathaṃ teṣāṃ sāmānyamiti yujyate ? nanu ca sāmānyavānabhidhīyate, kimarthaṃ tatra sāmānyatvamāropyate iti cet, yasmāt sacchabdaḥ sāmānyasya vācaka iti pratijñātam
tadvān ghaṭādiḥ sacchabdavācyatvāt tulyaḥ, na tu tadvatā kenacit api VT.
athāpi syāt--ananyadravyavartini sadguṇe sacchabdād ghaṭādyāśaṅkāyāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhaviṣyati nīlatarādivaditi cet, yadyekatrāsitādivat
nīlaśabdo hi nīlatarādiṣvanyābhāve tadvati na yujyate
nīlatarādiṣu nīlasāmānyābhyupagame'pi yathā nīlaguṇastridhā bhinna evaṃ ghaṭatvādijātimatī sajjātirnāsti yatastadviśeṣānupādāya dravye vṛttau ghaṭādiviśeṣe vṛttirāśaṅkyeta
idamatrāvadheyam--phṣ1 madhye'yaṃ kārikāṃśo dṛśyate, phṣ2 madhye tu na dṛśyate
ato'yaṃ vastutaḥ kārikāṃśo vṛttyaṃśo veti nirdhārayituṃ na pāryate
nānimittaḥ sa ceṣyate iti nirnimittaṃ ca tanneṣṭam ityapi vā pāṭho'tra bhavet
nanvevamaśabdavācyeṣvapyarthākṣipteṣu ghaṭādiṣu tadvānartho'vaśyaṃ ghaṭatvādinā kenacidanubaddha iti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhaviṣyatīti cet, arthākṣepe'pyanekāntaḥ
arthākṣepo hi yatrārthasāmarthyād niścaya utpadyate yathā divā na bhuṅkte iti rātribhojane niścayaḥ
atra tu sadityukte ghaṭādiṣvaniścayāt saṃśaya iti PSV1 arthākṣepo nāsti
tasmājjātiśabdaḥ kathañcidapi bheda-sāmānya-sambandha-jātimatāṃ vācako na yujyate tenānyāpohakṛcchrutiḥ
tasmāt kṛtakatvādivat svārthamanyāpohena bhāṣate pṛ॰ 607 paṃ॰ 8 iti sthitam
pratyāyayati tenaiva na tu śabdaguṇādibhiḥ || 13 || iti saṅgrahaślokau PSV1
yadyanyāpohapātraṃ śabdārthaḥ kathaṃ nīlotpalādiśabdeṣu sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaśca syāt
kathaṃ na syāditi cet, yasmād bhinnaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdānāmapohya iti cet, nāyaṃ doṣaḥ
nīlotpalādiśabdā apohyabhede satyapi svārthaviśeṣavyaktyarthaṃ sthāṇukākanilayanavat svāpohārthamekatra samuditāḥ samānādhikaraṇabhūtāḥ
nanvekādhikaraṇaṃ yat tad nīlamapi notpalamapi neti kathaṃ tad nīlaṃ ca tadutpalaṃ ceti nīlotpalamityucyata iti cet,
nīlaṃ cotpalaṃ ceti cet, ucyate--na hi tat kevalaṃ...
na hi tat kevalaṃ nīlaṃ na ca kevalamutpalam
nīlotpalaśabdābhyāṃ te samudite pratīyete, na kevale, kevalayostu varṇavat tannirarthakam
yathā nīśabda--laśabdau santāvapi nīlābhidhāne nirarthakau eva PSV2 evamatra api PSV1
nīlotpalaśabdābhyāṃ samuditābhyāṃ taducyate na kevalābhyām, kevalaṃ tu varṇavat tannirarthakam
asya savṛttikasya pramāṇasamuccayasya jinendrabuddhinā viracitā viśālāmalavatī vyākhyā bhoṭabhāṣānuvādāt saṃskṛte parivartyātropanyasyate--
jātirūpaṃ bhedeṣu na yujyate, śabdasvarūpaṃ jātau, śabdasvarūpavajjātirūpaṃ sambandhe
nanu tadvatpakṣād bhedapakṣasya ko viśeṣa iti cet, tadvatpakṣe sajjātirūpeṇa sacchabdenābhidhānam, bhedapakṣe tu dravyādirūpeṇa
evaṃ hi te bhedarūpeṇābhihitā bhavantīti viśeṣaḥ
tatrāpi dravyatvādiṣu sākṣād bhedeṣūpacāra iti pūrvavadeva doṣo vaktavyaḥ--sākṣād upacārapravṛttatvaṃ kameṇānabhidhānaṃ guṇopakāravirodhaśceti
sambhavāditi jātyabhidhāne prakarṣaḥ syād vinā dhiyā ityasyāsambhavāt

nanu pūrvaṃ sambandhasyānabhidheyatvamuktaṃ tat kathamidānīṃ sadrūpeṇābhidhānamāśrīyate kathaṃ cātra abhedopacāraḥ sambandhasyāṅgīkriyate ? pūrvaṃ hi asattvabhūtatvād ākhyātārthe śabdasyābhedopacārānupapatteranabhidhānamuktam, sambandho'pyasattvabhūta eva, tat kathaṃ tasya sattvaṃ sacchabdenābhedopacāro vā ? abhedopacārābhāve ca kutaḥ pūrvoktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ ? atha sattayā abhedopacāreṇa sa ucyate kathaṃ sadyogaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattiriti cet, nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, sambandhābhidhānamabhyupagamyāsya doṣasyoktatvāt
yadi ca sambandho'bhidhīyate tathāpi tadvatpakṣadoṣānatikrama eva jātimatā tulyasāmarthyāt iti darśanārthamidamuktam
atra bhedā bhedarūpeṇa nābhidhīyante, kiṃ tarhi ? jātimatāṃ teṣāṃ yannirviśeṣaṃ rūpaṃ sattvenāropitaṃ tadeva bhedarūpāsaṃspṛṣṭamabhidhīyate
kathaṃ punastadvanmātraṃ sattā sambandho vā bhavatīti ceducyate --tadvanmātraṃ hi ityādi
mātraśabdena viśeṣanirākaraṇe sāmānyaṃ sarvānugatirūpaṃ śabdārtha ityuktaṃ bhavati
tacca pravṛttinimittatvād bhāvapratyayena ucyamānaṃ sattāṃ sambandhaṃ vā vihāya nānyadupalabhyate, bhāvapratyayasya tatraiva vihitatvāt
rājapuruṣatvaṃ pācakatvam aupagavatvamityeteṣu samāsādiṣu svasvāmi-kriyākāraka-nimittanaimittikasambandhā ucyante yathāsaṃkhyam
yadanekatra na vartate tanna sāmānyam, svalakṣaṇavat, tadvāṃśca tathā, iti vyāpakābhāvaḥ
evaṃ manyate--sambandhasaukaryādavyabhicāravacanācca sacchabdasya sāmānyavācitvamāśrīyate bhedaśabdaiḥ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyābhyupagamācca, sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvābhāve sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nopapadyata iti
tathāhi--sāmānyaśabdād nirviśeṣaṃ pravartamānā buddhirviśeṣaśabdairbhedāntarebhyo vyavacchidya viśiṣṭaviṣaye'vasthāpyate
atra ca sāmānyena tadvānityabhyupagame vikalpadvayam--kiṃ sattādisāmānyasya tadvattvam āhosvit tadvato ghaṭādeḥ samānatvamiti
syādetat ? nanu tatraiveti cet, atrocyate— taccetyādi
śabda evābhidhāyaka eteṣāṃ tulyaḥ, na vācyamevaṃ kiñcidapītyarthaḥ
tadvatā kenacidapi neti, abhidhānasāmyenaiva eteṣāṃ samānatvam, na tvabhidheyena tadvadvasturūpeṇa kenacidityarthaḥ
nanu sattā śabdasvarūpeṇa tadvatī abhidhīyate, sambandhaśca sattārūpeṇa
tasmāt sattāyāḥ sambandhasya vā abhidheyena tadvatā tulyatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cet, ucyate --sattāyogau cetyādi
bhede jātau ca tadyoge doṣastulyo hi teṣvapi' pṛ॰ 630 paṃ॰ 2 ityādinā pūrvameva nirākṛtaṃ jātiyogayostadvattvenābhidhānam
yadi ghaṭādiṣu śabdaḥ samānastadā sa eva śabdaḥ śabdatvena tadvān teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ syāditi cet, ucyate --nānimitta ityādi
nimittavato yasya śabdasya yatra nimittābhāvaḥ tasya tatra yogo bhavituṃ nārhati yathā daṇḍaśabdasya daṇḍarahite puruṣe
ghaṭādiṣvapi nimittavato jātiśabdasya nimittābhāva iti kāraṇānupalabdhiruktā
tataścetyādau yadi sāmānyamabhidheyaṃ tatastadviśeṣyārthaṃ ghaṭa ityucyata iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāt
dravyāntare na vartata iti ananyadravyavartī sadguṇo ghaṭādi dravyam
sadguṇa iti sattāguṇavānityarthaḥ, sattā guṇo'syeti kṛtvā
evamatulyatve satyapi sacchabdād ghaṭādyāśaṅkāyāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhaviṣyati nīlatarādivat

nīlaguṇavad dravyaṃ nīlatarādidravyāntare'tadguṇe na vartate iti tadasāmānyam, tathāpi nīla ityukte yo'yaṃ nīla ityuktaḥ sa kiṃ nīlatara āhosvinnīlatama iti viśeṣāśaṅkā bhavati, tato nīlataro nīlatama iti bhedaśabdairviśeṣyate evaṃ sadityukte yaḥ san ayaṃ kiṃ ghaṭa āhosvit paṭa iti ghaṭādyāśaṅkā bhavati tatastacchabdairviśeṣyate ghaṭaḥ paṭo veti
yannīlatvaṃ vartate tatsambandho vā tasya śabdārthatvaṃ na bhavati
tasmādatrāpi nānimittaḥ sa ca mataḥ pṛ॰ 631 paṃ॰ 19 ityetat samānamiti dārṣṭāntikena samānasya dṛṣṭāntasyāpyasiddhireva
abhyupāye'pīti, yadyapi dṛṣṭāntaḥ sidhyati tathāpi sattāyāṃ tattulyatvaṃ nāsti
na vidyate ghaṭatvādijātirasyāṃ sattājātāvityevam ajātiḥ sajjātiḥ ajātimatīti sattāyāṃ ghaṭatvādayo jātiviśeṣā na santi nīlaguṇe nīlatarādiviśeṣavat yatastadviśeṣānupādāya dravye varteta
sa ekatrāpi dravye vartamānaḥ svaviśeṣānupādāya yathābhisambhavaṃ vartata iti tadvācinīlaśabdānnīlatarādyāśaṅkā yujyata iti darśayati
tadabhāvamatra darśayituṃ yathā divā na bhuṅkta iti vaidharmyanidarśanam
yatrārthākṣepastatra niścayaḥ yathā divā na bhuṅkte ityatra rātribhojane
sadityabhidhāne ca ghaṭādiṣu na niścayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? sandehaḥ
tasyaiva anekavidhatve'pi na śabdāt sarvathā gatiḥ
sa ca tatsāmānyāpekṣayā, na tu viśeṣāpekṣayā
tasmād yādṛśaḥ sambandhaḥ pratyāyakatvamapi tādṛśameva yujyate
idamuktaṃ bhavati--sāmānyāpekṣayāsya sambandhaḥ, sāmānyaṃ ca vyavacchedarūpameva yathoktavat anyasyāyogāt
atha kenāṃśena pratyāyayatīti cet, ucyate --anekadharmā śabdo'pītyādi
yenārthaṃ nātivartata iti sāmānyadharmeṇa vṛkṣatvādinā yena na vyabhicarati pratyāyayati tenaiveti anena sa eva dharmaḥ pratyāyaka ityarthaḥ
tathāhi--te vṛkṣārthaṃ vināpi rasādiṣu dṛṣṭāḥ, na tu vṛkṣaśabdatvādi sāmānyam
yasmād bhinna ityādi apohyabhedena sahacārādarthabhedaṃ darśayati
ye bhinnārthāste na samānādhikaraṇā na ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhūtāḥ, ghaṭapaṭādiśabdavat, nīlotpalādiśabdā api tatheti vyāpakavirodhaḥ
yadyapi apohyabhedād bhinnārthāstathāpyasti viśeṣaḥ svārthabhedagatau jaḍāḥ pratyekamiti śeṣaḥ
anena pratyekaṃ svārthabhede saṃśayahetutvam arthāpattyā sahitānāmeva niścayahetutvaṃ viśeṣa uktaḥ

yasmādevamutpalanīlādiśabdānāṃ parasparārthe svārthaviśeṣe pratyekaṃ saṃśayahetutvaṃ sahitānāmeva niścayahetutvaṃ tasmādekasmin vastuni nīlotpalamityabhinnakāryatvaṃ viśiṣṭārthābhivyaktilakṣaṇaṃ yujyate
apohyabhede satyapi iti, idamapi pūrvavadapohyabhedenārthabhedaṃ darśayati
sthāṇusthāṇu ūrdhva?kākanilayanavat svāpohārthamiti nīlasāmānyotpalasāmānyayoḥ apohārtham ekatra samuditā iti
yasmād nīlotpalādiśabdāḥ pratyekaṃ svārthaviśeṣe sandehahetavaḥ sahitā eva niścayahetavaḥ, tasmāt sahitāḥ svārthaviśeṣaikārthavyañjakāḥ samānādhikaraṇabhūtāḥ
śabdāntareṇa nīlādiśabdena sahitasya utpalaśabdasya prakāśyo viśiṣṭo'rthaḥ sa utpalaśabde kevale na sambhavati
evaṃ nīlaśabde'pi utpalaśabdena sahitasya yaḥ prakāśyaḥ sa kevale na sambhavatīti śabdāntarasānnidhyena viśiṣṭārthe pravṛtteḥ parasparaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ
...nanvekādhikaraṇaṃ yat taditi, vigrahakāle nīlaṃ ca tadutpalaṃ ca iti kriyate tasmāt pṛcchati
anena yaduktaṃ śabdāntarasahitenaiva śabdena viśeṣyārthaḥ prakāśyate ityatrābhyupagamabādhāmāha
na hi tat kevalaṃ nīlam iti kevalanīlaniṣedhena nīlaśabdamātravācyatvasya niṣedhaḥ
evaṃ na ca kevalamutpalamiti utpalaśabdamātravācyatvasya kevalasya
tathāhi--kevalanīlaśabdena kevalotpalaśabdena ca yadabhidhīyate tat kevalaṃ nīlaṃ kevalaṃ cotpalamiti prasiddham
kasmāt punaḥ nīlotpalaśabdābhyāṃ kevalābhyāṃ tannābhidhīyata iti ceducyate --samudāyābhidheyatvāditi
yasmāt sahitābhyāmeva nīlotpalaśabdābhyāṃ so'rtho'bhidhīyate na kevalābhyām, anyathā ekena tadarthasyābhihitatve paryāyaśabdavat tayoḥ saha prayogo nopapadyate
tato'nena vigrahakāle'pi sahitābhyāṃ nīlotpalaśabdābhyāṃ tadabhidhīyata ityabhyupagamād nābhyupagamabādheti darśayati
nanu kevalābhyāṃ kiṃ pratīyate iti cet, na kiñcidapi, yasmād varṇavat tannirarthakam
yasmād vyāvṛttibhānasadasatvānartho'nyatra na vartate tato bhinnaḥ
bhinnatvāccātadbhedatve sa eva doṣaḥ ityāśayaḥ sambhāvyate

...ekasminnarthe yadā bahavo vaktāro bhavanti ghaṭaḥ pārthivo dravyaṃ san śuklaḥ ityevamādiviśeṣaistadā so'rtho ghaṭarūpeṇa kṛtsno vābhidhīyeta ekadeśena vā ? na tāvat kṛtsnaḥ, vaktrantarasya pārthivatvenābhidhānāsambhavaprasaṅgāt
śabdaśca nimittamupādāya pravartate, ato vyāvṛttimatpakṣe vyāvṛttimatāṃ bhedānna sāmānādhikaraṇyam, ekatra tannimittābhāvāt chatridaṇḍivat ityāśayo'tra bhāti
śabdamātraṃ hītyādi tvanmatadoṣoktistulyā tavāpi yāvat tannimittābhāvāt chatridaṇḍivaditi
yathā chatranimittaśchatrī daṇḍanimitto daṇḍī bhinnanimittatvāt parasparamasamānādhikaraṇau tathā vyāvṛttimatsacchabdapakṣe'pīti

bhedād vyāvṛttisāmānyānāmityādi, vidhipakṣadūṣaṇavadihāpi vyāvṛttisāmanyavadbhedādanyadevāsadvyāvṛttisāmānyāt aghaṭanivṛttisāmānyam, ataḥ san ghaṭaḥ iti bhinnavyāvṛttiviśiṣṭasanghaṭatvasāmānyayorbhedāditi

ata ūrdhvaṃ tulyagamanīyameva vidhipakṣadūṣaṇena sarvamiti tadvyākhyaiveyaṃ likhyate--ekasminnarthe ghaṭādau ghaṭatva-pṛthivītva-dravyatva-sattvādibhinneṣu vaktṛṣu kaścid ghaṭaḥ iti brūte kaścit pṛthivī ityādi yāvat san iti, tatra ghaṭābhidhāne so'rtho ghaṭarūpeṇa kṛtsno vābhidhīyeta, ekadeśena vā ? na tāvat kṛtsnaḥ, tasminneva kāle vaktrantarasya pārthivatvenābhidhānāsambhavaprasaṅgāt, na hi aghaṭavyāvṛttirūpasāmānyaṃ gṛhītvā'tadrūpābhiprāyiśabdaprayogo yuktaḥ, sa cetaravaktṛvaśāt kṛtsno ghaṭarūpeṇa sthita ityasambhavo rūpāntarasya kṛtsnasyaikasya
aneka ?vṛttisāmānyarūpapratītestadvatastatsārūpyeṇa yugapad vaktrabhiprāyabhedena yukto bhāvaḥ san ghaṭaḥ iti prayogaḥ
kṛtsnābhidheyasvarūpopādānaśabdābhihitatvāt, yatra kṛtsnābhidheyasvarūpaṃ tadupādānena śabdenābhidhīyate tatrānyasya sāmānyaviśeṣaṇa pārthivatvādivat
na hi vyāvṛttisāmānyaśabdaistadvata ekadeśo vaktuṃ śakyaḥ, atadasatvatsāmānyaviṣayatvāt, yathā ācāryo mātula iti

athāpi syāt--asadvyāvṛttijātimati bahvarthāśaṅkāyāṃ ghaṭādibhedavāci- prayogasyābhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā paraṃ prati tvadudāhṛtaghaṭapārthivatvoktau yadi ghaṭatvena samastaṃ vastu viśiṣṭaṃ tataḥ pārthivatvasyāvakāśābhāvānna yujyate iti iṣṭo doṣastathā yadyaghaṭatvanivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ vastu samastamuktaṃ tato'pārthivanivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ na yujyata iti samānaḥ
na hi vyāvṛttisāmānyaśabdaistadvata ekadeśo vaktuṃ śakyaḥ, atadasatvatsāmānyaviṣayatvāt, yathā ācāryo mātula iti
sambandhibhedenaika evārtho'nekarūpatvena pratibhāsata ityatra bhāṣye pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 3
63, uktamidaṃ bhāṣye--upādhyāyasya śiṣyo mātulasya bhāgineyaṃ gatvāha--upādhyāyaṃ bhavānabhivādayatāmiti
tathā mātulasya bhāgineya upādhyāyasya śiṣyaṃ gatvāha--mātulaṃ bhavānabhivādayatāmiti
atra ca yathaiko'rthaḥ kañcit pratyupādhyāyo bhavati kañcit prati mātulo bhavati tathā sa prakāraḥ paktibhāvayorbodhe ca
svagataviśeṣāpekṣayā sāmānyasvabhāvo'pi pacirbhāvaṃ prati viśeṣaḥ, bhāvaḥ punaḥ paciṃ prati sāmānyameva
tulanā--yadapi ca bhikṣuṇā śaṅkitam--mā bhūt piṇḍāntareṇa viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ
tasminneva piṇḍe sattādiviśiṣṭe'bhihite'paratadgataviśeṣākāṃkṣāyāṃ viśeṣaṇādivyavahāro bhaviṣyati san ghaṭaḥ iti
yathā nīlaśabdena nīlaguṇe'bhihite tadgataviśeṣāpekṣayā tarabādiviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati nīlataro nīlatama iti iti
evaṃ cāśaṅkya parihṛtam--yuktaṃ tatra nīlo guṇaḥ prakarṣāprakarṣādibhedabhinnastarabādibhirviśeṣyate
sattājātistu ghaṭādijātiśūnyā svātmaviśiṣṭaṃ padārthaṃ pratipādayantī naiva ghaṭatvādīnākāṃkṣatīti na tatra viśeṣaṇābhidhānaṃ bhavati
ataścātmanyavidyamānamaghaṭāpohamasadapoho naivākṣeptuṃ samartha iti tairnāghaṭāpohairviśeṣyate yathā'nīlāpohaḥ svagatairaprakarṣāpohairviśeṣyate
yat punaḥ aśabdavācyaireva ghaṭādibhiḥ sajjātyākṣiptairviśeṣaṇādivyavahāro bhaviṣyati ityāśaṅkya bhikṣuṇā dūṣitam--anaikāntiko ghaṭākṣepaḥ, paṭe'pi saṅkrāntisambhavāt iti
na hyasadapoho'naikāntiko dhūmavadagnimaghaṭāpohamākṣeptuṃ samarthaṃ ityāha--arthākṣepo'pi nāstyeva sandehālliṅgaliṅgivat

athāsyaikadeśaṃghaṭaḥ ityaghaṭanivṛttyā gṛhṇāti ekaḥ, aparo'pārthivanivṛttyā deśaṃ pārthivaḥ iti gṛhṇātīti matam tadayuktamapratīteḥ, na hi nimittāntarairucyamānasya ekadeśapratītirdṛṣṭā yathā ācāryo mātula iti tathā na hi vyāvṛttisāmānyaśabdaistadvata ekadeśo vaktuṃ śakyaḥ
atasya anyasya vyāvṛttasya asattvam, tadasyāsti san ghaṭaḥ ityādisāmānye, sa viṣayo'sya śabdasya so'tadasatvatsāmānyaviṣayaḥ, yatrātadasatvatsāmānyaviṣayatvaṃ śabde tasyaikadeśo na śakyo vaktum
yathā vidhivādimatamāśaṅkyate tathāpohavādimatam --asadvyāvṛttijātimatītyādi śabdaviśeṣitagranthamarthatastulyaṃ yāvad nīlatama iti veti
asya vyākhyā— śabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati tatsāmānyaguṇatvāt tadvāciśabdasyāpi tadvyavacchedyaviṣayatvāt

yatra yatra tatsāmānyaguṇatvaṃ tatra tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛṣṭam, tadyathā ananyadravyavartini nīlaguṇe'nīlanivṛttisāmānyasya nīlatarādidravyavṛttitvāt taiḥ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati nīlataro nīlatama iti vā
yataśca nīlaśabdo'pi na dravyaṃ nīlatvenāha, kiṃ tarhi ? anīlavadabhāvam
tatra ca na nīlādibhedānāṃ kasyacidapi sambhavaḥ

yadyapi tadvad ghaṭādi paṭādiṣu na vartate tathāpi ekatrātadvyāvṛttyādhāre vartate sattā, tato bahvarthāśaṅkāsti, tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ ghaṭādibhedavādibhiḥ śabdairyeṣu sā sattā vartate taistadvācibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti pratijñā
tatsāmānyaguṇatvāditi hetuḥ, sā sāmānyaguṇo yeṣāṃ te bahavo'rthāstatsāmānyaguṇāḥ, tadbhāvāt tatsāmānyaguṇatvāt
tadvāciśabdasyāpi tadvyavacchedyaviṣayatvāt, tayā sattayā vyavacchedyāḥ sarve viṣayā arthāḥ, te viṣayā asya śabdasya sa tadvyavacchedyaviṣayaḥ, tadbhāvāt tadvyavacchedya- viṣayatvāt

dṛṣṭāntaḥ --tadyathā ananyadravyavartinītyādi, anīletaro hi nīlaguṇo'nanyadravyavartī dravye nīlaguṇa eva vartate, nīlatarādiṣvavartamāne'pi tasmin nīlaguṇasāmānye anīlanivṛttisāmānyasya nīlatarādidravyavṛttitvāt taiḥ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati, yathā nīlataraḥ paṭo nīlatama iti veti

sodāharaṇopasaṃhāre parihāre vayamatra brūmaḥ--tacca na, sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvasya nīlatvanīlaguṇadravyāderanīlatvānīlaguṇadravyanivṛttilakṣaṇasya tacchabdārthābhāvāt sampradhāryatvāt, nīlatvajātiśabdārthasyātadvyāvṛttilakṣaṇasya nīlaguṇaśabdārthasya cābhāvādanīletarajātiguṇadravyadṛṣṭāntābhāvāt tatsāmānyaviśeṣabhāvo'trāpi sampradhāryaḥ

tadbhāvanāhetuḥ --yataśca nīlaśabdo'pītyādi, so'pi hi nīlaśabdo na dravyaṃ nīlatvenāha yattattaratamādiprakarṣabhedasya sāmānyaṃ syāt, kiṃ tarhi ? anīlavadabhāvamanīlatvajāteranīlaguṇasya vā nivṛttimāha
tatra cābhāve na nīla-nīlatara-nīlatamānāṃ bhedānāṃ kasyacidapi sambhavaḥ
śabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati tatsāmānyaguṇatvāt tadvāciśabdasyāpi tadvyavacchedyaviṣayatvāt

yataśca nīlaśabdo'pi na dravyaṃ nīlatvenāha, kiṃ tarhi ? anīlavadabhāvam
tatra ca na nīlādibhedānāṃ kasyacidapi sambhavaḥ
syānmatam--anīlatvajātiguṇābhāvo nīlaguṇadravyabhāva eva, sa ca sāmānyaṃ nīlādibhedānām, iti cenmanyase
atrocyate --evaṃ vidhiśabdārthatā tarhi, sa eva nīlatvajātiguṇādhāradravyasya vidhiḥ

astu, ko doṣa iti cet, ucyate --yasmādevaṃ sato'pi na sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tvaduktanyāyena abhūtasāmānyaviśeṣatvāt, ananyadravyavartini nīlaguṇe nīla-nīlataranīlatamaprakarṣabhedābhāvāt sāmānyaviśeṣatvābhāvaḥ
tasmādabhūtasāmānyaviśeṣaviṣayatvāt tvaduktanīla upetyāpi tu sāmānyaviśeṣatvābhāvamasadaghaṭādivyāvṛttimatāṃ brūmo jāterajātitaḥ
na hyabhidhānapratyayahetāvasadabhāvātmikāyāṃ sajjātāvaghaṭābhāvādyātmikā ghaṭatvādijātirasti yathā nīlaguṇe dravye nīlaprakarṣabhedaḥ yato'sadasatvato'ghaṭābhāvaghaṭatvādīnupādāya pravarteta
na cāvidyamānaḥ svātmanyartho viśeṣaṇena śakyate viśeṣyavastunyadhyāropayituṃ svarūpavat
na sad ghaṭādi viśeṣayiṣyati, avidyamānatadrūpatvāt, nīlamiva madhuram

arthākṣiptāstarhi ghaṭādayo bhavitumarhanti, asadvyāvṛttimato'nyatamaghaṭatvādi- nīlatarādivat sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāva iti dṛṣṭāntāsiddheḥ sacchabde'sadvyāvṛttyā bhedānāmasadvyāvṛttipakṣe vidhipakṣe vā nāsti sāmānādhikaraṇyam
na hyabhidhānapratyayahetāvasadabhāvātmikāyāṃ sajjātāvaghaṭābhāvādyātmikā ghaṭatvādijātirasti yathā nīlaguṇe dravye nīlaprakarṣabhedaḥ yato'sadasatvato'ghaṭābhāvaghaṭatvādīnupādāya pravarteta
na cāvidyamānaḥ svātmanyartho viśeṣaṇena śakyate viśeṣyavastunyadhyāropayituṃ svarūpavat
na sad ghaṭādi viśeṣayiṣyati, avidyamānatadrūpatvāt, nīlamiva madhuram

tasmādasadapohe'ghaṭāpohābhāvāt svātmanyavidyamānamaghaṭāpohamasadapoho nākṣeptuṃ samartha iti sacchabdasya na ghaṭādiśabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve hi sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāt ityāśayo bhāti
upetyāpi tu, na vyāvṛttimadabhidhānaṃ sacchabdena, asadvyāvṛttimataḥ sato'bhidhānamabhyupagamyāpi sāmānyaviśeṣatvābhāvamasadaghaṭādivyāvṛttimatāṃ brūmaḥ
kutaḥ ? jāterajātitaḥ, nāsyāṃ jātirvidyata iti ajātiriti vigrahāt sāmānyānāmasāmānyādhāratāṃ darśayati

na hyabhidhānapratyayahetāvityādi yāvat pravarteteti, sadabhidhāna-pratyayayorheturasadabhāvātmikā sajjātiḥ sattā, tasyāṃ tvaghaṭābhāvātmikā ghaṭatvajātirnāsti, yathā nīlaguṇe dravye nīlaprakarṣabheda iti dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaidharmyaṃ darśayati
tataḥ kim ? tato na cāvidyamānaḥ svātmanyarthaḥ sattā-nīlatvādiviśeṣaṇena śakyate viśeṣyavastuni ghaṭotpalādāvadhyāropayitum
kimiva ? svarūpavaditi vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā svarūpaṃ śabdo viśeṣye'dhyāropayati na tatheheti
tasmādityādi prastutopasaṃhāro yāvat sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāditi gatārthaḥ
prayogaścātra --na sad ghaṭādi viśeṣayiṣyati, avidyamānatadrūpatvāt, avidyamānatadrūpatvaṃ pratipāditatvāt siddham

kutaḥ ? asadvyāvṛttimato'nyatamaghaṭatvādisāmānyaviśeṣānubaddhatvāt, asadvyāvṛttimaddhi vastu ghaṭatvādīnāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāmanyatamenāvaśyamanubaddham, asaccenna bhavati avaśyaṃ sad bhavati, sacca ghaṭatvādyanyatamaditi paro manyeta
...asadvyāvṛttimatā viśeṣākṣepo yujyate cet ghaṭādibhedānāṃ vyabhicārād dravyatvamātrākṣepastarhi bhaviṣyati, tadapi na, guṇādivyabhicārāt
ayamatrāśayo bhāti--arthākṣepe'pi na niyamaḥ, sacchabdādasadvyāvṛttimatārthena ghaṭāderiva paṭāderapyākṣepasambhavāt
tathā ca san ghaṭaḥ ityatra ghaṭākṣepaniyamābhāvāt sacchabdasya na ghaṭaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam
atha mā bhūd vyabhicārād ghaṭādīnāmākṣepaḥ, dravyatvamātrākṣepo bhaviṣyati asadvyāvṛttimatā avyabhicārāt
etāvaccātra bhavet--anyāpohavanto bhedā vā, anyāpoho vā, anyāpohasambandho vā, anyāpohasya svādhāro vā ityāśayo'tra sambhāvyate
anyatve'pi na sāmānyabhedaparyāyavācyanut iti diṅgāgenābhihitaṃ pramāṇasamuccayādau
tatra sāmānya-bheda-paryāyavācināmanapohe vidhireva vastutaḥ kāraṇamiti vidhereva śabdārthatvaṃ sidhyatītyāśayena ubhayaniyamanaya upakrāmati
tulanā--atra ca bhikṣuṇā vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ darśayatoktaṃ--vṛkṣastaruriti paryāyāṇāṃ ca parasparamanapohyatvam, anyatve'pi ca sāmānyabhedaparyāyavācināmavirodhāt iti
tadidamanapohe kāraṇaṃ nātīva budhyata ityāha--sāmānyādyanapohaśca nāvirodhena kalpate
kimiti nāvakalpata ityāha--na hi śabdasvarūpāṇāṃ syād viruddhāviruddhatā

asya bhāṣyaṃ savyākhyānaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvadasadvyāvṛttimatā viśeṣākṣepo yujyate cet ghaṭādibhedānāṃ vyabhicārād dravyatvamātrākṣepastarhi bhaviṣyati, mātragrahaṇād dravyatvasāmānyaviśeṣamātraṃ gṛhyate sadviśeṣaṇeneti
guṇakarmaṇorapi sadbhāvāt kiṃ dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karma vā sat syādasadvyāvṛttimat iti saṃśaya eva
na cāsti sambhava eteṣāṃ vikalpānāṃ doṣavattvāt tena nā'pohakṛcchrutiriti
arthākṣepe'pyanekāntastenānyāpohakṛcchrutiḥ iti yaduktaṃ diṅgāgena tat pratividhātumatra mallavādisūribhiḥ tena nāpohakṛcchrutiḥ ityuktam

yathā vidhivādināmanyāpohavādinaśca doṣāstathā sāmānyopasarjanavidhipradhānavādino'pīti mā maṃsthāḥ, mā ca maṃsthā anyāpohavādilakṣaṇavadatiprasaktatvādapavādo'syāpyārabdhavyo lakṣaṇasyetyata āha— kimanyatve na sāmānyabhedaparyāyavācyanut ? avirodhāt iti vākyaśeṣaḥ

kim iti praśne, kiṃ tvaṃ manyase--anyatve sāmānya-bheda-paryāyaśabdānāmarthaṃ vṛkṣaśrutirnāpohate pṛthivī-śiṃśapā-tarvādiśabdānāmavirodhāt, virodhācca paṭādīnapohata iti, yato'sya viroddhāviruddhayoranyatvādapohānapohaprasaṅge tulye tvayeva mayāpi yathā śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatte iti lakṣaṇasyātiprasaṅgabhayādārabdhavyam — vidhiḥ
yadanyatve'pi na sāmānya- anyatve'pi na sāmānya-bheda-paryāyavācyanut, avirodhāt iti
vidhinā hi sāmānyopasarjanaṃ viśeṣaṃ śabdo'bhidadhāno virodhābhāvāt tānapi gamayati tadaṅgabhāvād This page consists merely of footnotes.
śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ svārthe kurvatī śrutiḥ tadarthā syāt
nanvidameva vidhinā vācakatve'numānaṃ śabdasya--yadanyatve'pi sāmānyādīnāṃ viśeṣānuguṇānāṃ gatiḥ
samūhaśca prakṛtipratyayādīnāṃ tathārthāntaravācaka iti yuktyā vakṣyāmaḥ
kiṃ tvaṃ manyase tvayeva mayāpi atiprasaṅgabhayādārabdhavyam--anyatve'pi na sāmānyabhedaparyāyavācyanuditi ? iti sambandhaḥ
diṅgāgena pramāṇasamuccayavṛttau yadabhihitaṃ tadatra bhoṭabhāṣānuvādataḥ saṃskṛte parivartyopanyasyate

yathā śiṃśapā na palāśādi evaṃ ghaṭādyapi na
evaṃ sāmānyaśabdaḥ svārthamabhimataviṣaye sthāpayan bhedaśabdena bhedabhedaśabdena vā kathaṃ nopekṣyate ? evamavirodhāt sāmānyādiśabdārthāpoho na yujyate
evaṃ ca sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdayoḥ svārthasāmānye pravartamānayordvayorbahūnāṃ vā tadviśiṣṭārthāntaravācakatvaṃ yathāpūrvoktavadupapadyate

upāttaṃ na tayostulyā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatā || 27 || iti saṃgrahaślokau PSV1
kiṃ punaratra kāraṇaṃ yena medaśabdo bhedāntaraśabdārthamapohata iti cet,
atra bhikṣuṇā palāśaḥ śiṃśapeti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na bhavatīti darśayatoktam--bhedo bhedāntarārthaṃ tu virodhitvādapohate--iti
bhedaśabdā hi palāśaśiṃśapādaya ekaṃ vṛkṣatvasāmānyamanyonyamapahṛtya rājyamiva rājaputrāḥ svaviṣaye sthāpayantaḥ parasparavirodhino vartante
tenaikāpohenaikaḥ pravartamānaḥ kathaṃ tena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ labhatāmityarthaḥ
bhedārthā hi śabdāḥ parasparavirodhinaḥ sāmānyārthāpahāritvād rājaputravat
tataḥ parasparārthaṃ na sahante, yathāyaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapeti śiṃśapāśabdo vṛkṣaśabdena saha prayukto dhavādibhyo vṛkṣatvamācchidya svaviṣaye sthāpayan
evaṃ tāvad bhedaśabda ekadravyāpahāritvād bhedāntaraśabdārthamapohate iti yujyate
atha ghaṭādikamasambaddhaṃ sāmānyāntarabhedārthaṃ kuto'pohata iti cet, yasmāt
etena sā mānyāntarabhedānāṃ guṇādīnāṃ tadbhedānāṃ ca rūpādīnāṃ sambaddhasambandhād mitramitraśatruvadmitraśatrumitravacca apoha upekṣā ca veditavye
tenāpohyata iti gamyate ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
sāmānyāntarabhedā guṇādayastadbhedāśca rūpādayaḥ sambaddhasambandhād mitramitraśatruvad mitraśatrumitravaccāpoḍhā upekṣitāśca veditavyāḥ ityapi pāṭho'tra bhavet
asya jinendrabuddhiracitā viśālāmalavatī vyākhyā bhoṭabhāṣānuvādāt parivartyopanyasyate--pūrvaṃ kṛtakatvādivat svārthamanyāpohena bhāṣate pṛ॰ 607 ityuktam
anyatve tulye'pīti prasaṅgakāraṇamāha, pratiṣedhasya prasaṅgapūrvakatvāt, anyatvaṃ cāpohe nimittam
ye'viruddhāste parasparamapratikṣipanto nāpohante yathā dravye rūpādayaḥ
evaṃ trayāṇāmavirodhitvaṃ yugapadabhidhāyedānīṃ pratyekaṃ darśayitumāha --paryāyaśabdasya ityādi
ya ekārthāste'virodhino yathā dravye rūpādayo mitrāṇi vā
ye'virodhinaste parasparato'pratikṣiptā yathā ta eva, paryāyaśabdā apyavirodhina iti vyāpakavirodha eva
svārthaśca pratikṣeptuṃ na yukta ityanapohatve hetvantaramāha
yo yasya svārthaḥ sa tena nāpohyate yathā vijñānena svārthaḥ, paryāyaśabdo'pi paryāyaśabdāntarasya svārthaḥ
sāmānyaśabdasya vṛkṣaśabdasya yat svasāmānyaṃ vṛkṣatvaṃ tadviśeṣāḥ svabhedāḥ śiṃśapādayaḥ, teṣu arthāntarasya ghaṭādervṛkṣaśabdenāpoho bhedaśabdena śiṃśapāśabdena anumanyata eva arthitvāt
yathā palāśādirūpaḥ śiṃśapāśabdārtho na bhavatīti palāśādayastatpratikṣepyā evaṃ ghaṭādirūpo'pi na bhavatīti ghaṭādayo'pyapohyāḥ
etenetyādinā svasāmānyasya vṛkṣatvasya yat sāmānyaṃ pārthivatvaṃ tacchabdaḥ pārthivaśabdaḥ sāmānyasāmānyaśabdaḥ tena yadapohyamāpyādi tacchiṃśapāśabdenāpyanumanyate, arthitvāt
yathā śiṃśapā na palāśādi evamāpyatvādyapi nāsti

yathā bhedaśabdo'virodhāt sāmānyaśabdārthaṃ na pratikṣipati evaṃ sāmānyaśabdo'pi sadādiḥ svārthaṃ sattādikam abhimataviṣaye sthāpayanniti bhedeṣvanavasthitatvāt sthāpayan guṇādito vyavacchinne dravyādau niveśayan...
...bhedaśabdena dravyādinā bhedabhedaśabdena vā pārthiva-vṛkṣa-śiṃśapādiśabdena kathaṃ nopekṣyate ? upekṣyata eva, arthitvāt svaviṣaye sthityā nirviṣayasvārthānupapatteḥ
samūhaścetyādi avirodhādapratikṣepe guṇotkarṣaṃ darśayati, athavā anyonyāpratikṣepe hetvantaramāha
...evaṃ ceti parasparārthāpratikṣepa evetyarthaḥ, dvayoriti yathā vṛkṣam iti prakṛtipratyayayoḥ...
bahūnāmiti yathā rājapuruṣaḥ surūpa āgacchati iti svārthasāmānye pravartamānānāṃ sarveṣāmapi vākyapadānāmitareṣāṃ ca vākyārthavācakatvamapratikṣepe yojanīyam
na hi tat kevalaṃ nīlaṃ na ca kevalamutpalam pṛ॰ 630 paṃ॰ 22 ityādinā nīlotpalaśabdayoḥ samūhārthasya pratyekaṃ nairarthakyadarśanena samūhasyārthāntarābhidhāyakatvamuktam
āha ceti sāmānyabhedaśabdayoravirodhe sāmānyaśabdena bhedānāmatyāgānupādāne adhikṛtya kārikāmāha— tanmātrākāṅkṣaṇādityādi
yo yeṣu saṃśayahetustena te na pratipāditāḥ, yathā sa eva, sāmānyaśabdo'pi svabhedeṣu saṃśayaheturiti kāraṇavirodhaḥ
sāmye caikārthatā tayoriti yatra sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdābhyāmubhayamaparihṛtamanupāttaṃ ca tatraikārthatvaṃ tatsāmānādhikaraṇyamityarthaḥ
yathā sāmānyaśabdena svabhedā apratikṣiptā atyaktāḥ kimevaṃ bhedaśabdenāpi sāmānyam ? iti paryanuyogaṃ pariharannāha --anekamapītyādi
yadyapi sāmānyamanekaṃ tathāpi tad bhedaśabdenopāttaṃ pratipāditamityarthaḥ, pratipādanād bhinnasyopādānasyāsambhavāt
...avyabhicāriṇeti yasmād viśeṣaḥ sāmānyaṃ na vyabhicarati sāmānyābhāve viśeṣābhāvāt tasmāt tenopāttam
na tayoriṣṭāstulyā ? viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyateti vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapādivyabhicāravyavacchedamapekṣata ityasti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, śiṃśapā tu vṛkṣasāmānyāvyabhicāraṃ nāpekṣata iti nāsti
bhedo bhedāntarārthamiti vṛkṣatvasya bhedaḥ śiṃśapādiḥ, parasparato bhidyata iti kṛtvā
atra viṣayeṇa viṣayinirdeśād bhedo bhedāntaraṃ ca śabda iti vijñeyam
rājaputrāṇāṃ pitari mṛte sāmānyārtho rājyam, tasya tairyathāsarvaparākramamapahṛtatvād virodhinaḥ, tataśca parasparārthaṃ na sahante
ye sāmānyārthāpahāriṇaste parasparavirodhinaḥ, rājaputravat, sāmānyaśabdā api tatheti svabhāvaḥ
ye virodhinaste parasparārthaṃ na sahante, tadvadeva, bhedaśabdā api tatheti vyāpakavirodhaḥ
sāmānyāntarasya pārthivatvāderye bhedā ghaṭādayastadvācakaśabdaiḥ saha śiṃśapāśabdasyaikārthāpahāritvaṃ nāsti, kiṃ tarhi ? vṛkṣaśabdena
śiṃśapāsāmānyaṃ vṛkṣatvam, tato'nyatvāt pārthivatvaṃ sāmānyāntaram, tadbhedo ghaṭādiḥ, so'sambaddhaḥ śiṃśapāśabdena virodhābhāvāt, tacchabdena śiṃśāpāśabdasyaikadravyāpahāritvamapi nāsti
sāmānyāntarabhedārthā iti tameva apohakāraṇaṃ virodhaṃ darśayati
atra ca yadyapi na sākṣād virodhastathāpi paramparayāstyeva
tato vṛkṣaśabdena tena ghaṭādyapohaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ śiṃśapāśabdenānumanyate mitraśatruvat
arthatastat teneti śiṃśapāśabdārthaḥ śiṃśapāsāmānyam, taccāghaṭādirūpatvād ghaṭādito vyāvṛttam
śiṃśapāśabdasya tatra vyāpāro nāsti tathāpi śiṃśapāśabdena tena ghaṭādyapoḍhamiti gamyate, tadgatyārthatastasyāpoḍhatvāt

eteneti anayā yuktyā pārthivatvasāmānyāt sāmānyāntaraṃ dravyatvam, tatsāmānyaṃ sattā, tadbhedā guṇāḥ karmāṇi ca, teṣāmapi bhedā rūpādaya utkṣepaṇādayaśca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ svavirodhisāmānyaśabdenāpoḍhā viśeṣaśabdenopekṣitāśca sambaddhasambandhād veditavyāḥ
atra mitramitreti dviruktiḥ paramparayā mitrapratipādanecchayānatātparyeṇāvagantavyā, anyathā ekīkṛtenaiva mitreṇa mitrasya pratīteḥ
guṇaviśeṣā rūpādayaḥ karmaviśeṣāścotkṣepaṇādayastu śiṃśapāśabdena mitraśatrumitravad dravyaśabdena...
śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ svārthe kurvatī śrutiḥ tadarthā syāt
tvayā punarutsargavākye mahatā kleśena pratipādyāpavādavādena tyaktaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? anirvāhakatvāt, kimanena pratijñātamarthamanirvahatā ? śabdāntarārthāpohaṃ svārthe kurvatī tadarthā anyāpohārthā syāt, tattu noktamatyantaṃ sāmānyādiśabdāntarārthāpohāniṣṭeḥ
tataḥ kim ? tataḥ sāmānyādiśabdāntarārthātyāgāttu tvadaniṣṭo nanvayameva paramavidhiḥ
sa ca vidhireva śabdārthaḥ sāmānyādyanyaśabdārtheṣu avyāhatatvāt paramaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ
yathā na hi ghaṭādi sāmānyānupasarjanaṃ bhavitumarhati, vastutvāt, ātmavat
yathā sa santānākhyasāmānyopasarjanastamantareṇa na bhavitumarhati ā mukterevaṃ ghaṭaśabdenāpyāgṛhītā mṛdādayastacchabdārthāntaḥpātitvādākārādivat
tatra tāvat --sāmānyānudukteḥ sāmānye viśeṣavidhyartho na vyāhanyate, tvayaiva sāmānyaṃ na nudati ityuktatvādasmadiṣṭam--upasarjanīkṛtasāmānyo viśeṣo vidhinaivokta iti
sādhanamidam--sāmānyopasarjanameva na sāmānyānupasarjanaṃ bhavitumarhati ghaṭa-paṭādi bāhyavastviti pratijñā
