ātmavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, āntaro'rtho nāmarūpasantānākhya ātmā, yathā sa śarīrādipratikṣaṇadeśabhinnarūpādisukhavijñānādiviśeṣatattvo'rthaḥ santānākhyasāmānyopasarjanastamantareṇa na bhavitumarhati naraka-manujādiviśeṣatattvo vā''mukteḥ yāvad mokṣastāvad viśeṣāḥ sāmānyānuviddhā eva tathā ghaṭādayo'pi bāhyā ityata āha --evaṃ ghaṭaśabdenāpyāgṛhītā mṛdādaya iti sādhye bāhye sāmānyamṛdādyupasarjanaṃ ghaṭaviśeṣārthaṃ darśayati
tacchabdārthāntaḥpātitvāditi ātma-ghaṭādyaviśeṣavācinā sarvanāmnā vastutvasāmānyasya sādhyenānugatatvaṃ viśeṣāvinābhāvino darśayati
evaṃ tāvad ghaṭe viśeṣaśabdārthe pārthiva-dravya-sattvādisāmānyātyāgo yuktaḥ, vidhipradhānaśabdārthatvāt

evaṃ tarhi vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā iti śiṃśapāviśeṣo vidhinā kathamucyate vṛkṣavidhāvanupasarjana ityatrocyate — bhedāstūcyanta eva, vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā ityādivad ghaṭasya ye ye rūpādayo yugapadayugapadbhāvinasta eva mukhyaśabdārthatvāducyante, ghaṭasāmānyasya tadaṅgatvād ghaṭādyupasarjanarūpādiviśeṣaparamārthatvāt tadbhavanabhavanātmakatvāt, sa viśeṣo bhavanaṃ bhāvaḥ pratyekaṃ nirvikalparūpādibhavanamātmalābhaḥ, tadbhavanabhavanamātmāsya ghaṭasyeti tadbhavanabhavanātmako ghaṭaḥ śibikāvāhakayāne īśvarasyeva yānavat ityuktaṃ prāk

tannirūpayati-- rūpādirūpādisvarūpaśabdārthatvavaditi, yadyapi yugapadbhāvino rūpādisvabhāvā eva santo rūpa-rasa-gandhasparśa-śabdā eva nirvikalpā vastutvācchabdārthaḥ pratikṣaṇavartyayugapadbhāvino vā viśeṣāstathāpi sāmānyopasarjanadvāreṇa iti sāmānyaśabdāḥ prayujyante, na tu kalpitena paramārthasatā vā vinā tena sāmānyena śabdārthā bhavitumarhantīti
tasmāt sāmānyaśabdaprayogo viśeṣapratipādanārthaḥ, viśeṣāstu vivakṣitā eva paramārthatvādasya nayasya
na hi kuṭana-kumbhatābhyāṃ vinā ghaṭanam, nāpi ghaṭanaṃ vinā kuṭana-kumbhate
paryāyaśabdasya tāvad vidheya evārthaḥ, darśanāt, dvimātṛvat
viśeṣaṇasvarūpāpannaviśeṣyapratītitvād yugapadaprayoge'pi sa eva bhedaḥ pratīyate
na hi svārthānupātitvād vidhiḥ svarasasamāpatitaḥ pratikṣeptuṃ yuktaḥ
ye punaḥ paryāyaśabdāste tadvidhānā evameva viśeṣaṃ vidadhati, ghaṭanaviśeṣasya kuṭana-kumbhādyarthātmakatvāt, tasya kuṭilatā kuṭanam, ghaṭanaṃ ceṣṭā, kumbhatā vṛttatvam
tābhyāṃ ghaṭana-kuṭanābhyāṃ vinā nāsti kumbhatā nāma kācit, tayā vā vinā na ghaṭana-kuṭane sta iti na ? hi kuṭanetyādinānyonyāvinābhāvaṃ darśayati

itthaṃ pratipadyasva yathā ghaṭaḥ ityukte paṭastatpratipakṣaśabdārtho'nyastathaivāpratipakṣasāmānya-viśeṣa-paryāyaśabdārthā anye, tatasteṣāmanyatve tulye vidhiprādhānyādeva tān nāpohate, nānyat kāraṇaṃ vidheḥ

yadi vidhirneṣyate tato na kevalāvavyāptyatiprasaṅgadoṣāveva, kiṃ tarhi ? eṣo'pyaniṣṭopacayaḥ--udakādyāharaṇārthine ghaṭaḥ ityukte tatrāprastutasya avivakṣitasya paṭāderaghaṭasyā'sattvaṃ vyāvṛttiravivakṣito'śabdārtha eva śabdārtha ityetadāpannam
kiñca; vidhipakṣe'smadiṣṭe sākṣādeva avyavahitameva svārthaṃ brūta ityeṣa ca viśeṣaḥ
tadyathā— paryāyaśabdasya tāvadityādi yāvat pratikṣeptuṃ yukta iti
paryāyaśabdasya ghaṭa-kuṭādervidheya evārthaḥ, kasmāt ? darśanāt, vidheyatvadarśanāt, tadeva hi vidheyaṃ ghaṭanaṃ kuṭanamubhayaṃ vā

kimiva ? dvimātṛvat, yathā viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa viśeṣyapradhāne nirdeśe rādhakamātā, pūrṇakamātā, rādhakapūrṇakamātā iti dvābhyāmanyatareṇa vā viśeṣyate saiva tathā viśeṣaṇasvarūpāpannaviśeṣyapratītitvāt sambandhiviśiṣṭarūpapratipatterityarthaḥ, yugapadaprayoge'pīti nimittabhede'pyarthaikatvād yugapadaprayoge'pi sa eva nimittopalakṣito bhedaḥ pratīyate
syānmatam--nimittabhede nimittibhedāt kimarthaṃ nimittāntarāpoho na bhavatīti, etacca na hi svārthānupātitvād vidhiḥ svarasasamāpatitaḥ pratikṣeptuṃ yuktaḥ
nimittāntareṇāpi tasyaiva viśeṣārthasya ata eva sāmānyaśabdenāpi sa eva viśeṣārthaḥ sākṣādavyavahitavṛttinā vidhinā pratīyate
pratiṣedhavyāpāranirākāṅkṣaṃ vidhyarthasya pratipattau upasarjanatvenāpohabuddherutpattervidhiḥ pradhāno'pradhāno'pohaḥ, yathā śiṃśapādyupahārivṛkṣaśabdārthe'ghaṭaghaṭānavatāraḥ
pratīteḥ sa evārthaḥ svenaiva rasena samāpatitaḥ pratipādayitumiṣṭaśca kimiti pratikṣipyate ? na hi svārthapratikṣepo yuktaḥ

kiṃ kāraṇam ? dūramapi gatvā tena vinā tadagateḥ ghaṭaḥ ityukte aghaṭo na bhavati iti pratiṣedhadvayenārthāntaraṃ vyāvartyāpi ghaṭa evāvaśyaṃ pratipattavyaḥ, sa ca kuṭa eveti kuṭatvena vinā ghaṭatvābhāvāt kuṭatvasyāpyavinābhāvinaḥ svenaiva rasena pratīyamānatvādakleśenāgato vidhireva śabdārthaḥ paryāya iti
ata eva sāmānyaśabdenāpi sa eva viśeṣārthaḥ sākṣādavyavahitavṛttinā vidhinā pratīyate
pratiṣedhavyāpāranirākāṅkṣaṃ vidhyarthasya pratipattau upasarjanatvenāpohabuddherutpattervidhiḥ pradhāno'pradhāno'pohaḥ, yathā śiṃśapādyupahārivṛkṣaśabdārthe'ghaṭaghaṭānavatāraḥ
kiñcānyat, ata eva avinābhāvāt sāmānyaśabdenāpi ghaṭasya pārthivādinā sāmānyasāmānyaśabdena vā dravya-sattvādinā vidhīyamānaḥ sa eva viśeṣārtho ghaṭākhyaḥ sākṣādavyavahitavṛttinā vidhinā pratīyate
tāni hi bhedarūpāṇi anekātmakasya vastunaḥ sāmānyādyākāreṇāpi gṛhyamāṇāni kathaṃ na vidhīyante ? sarvathetyādi, tasmādavyavahitavidhivṛttinā śabdena ghaṭasyaiva svabhedāḥ samākṣiptāḥ
yathoktam --saddravyapṛthivīmṛddhaṭādibhisambandhādasti dravyaṃ pārthivo mārtiko ghaṭa iti ghaṭe sampratyayaḥ iti

tat kathamiti cet, ucyate --tadrūpaparamārthatvena, tāni bhedarūpāṇi eva sāmānyavadābhāsamānāni avidyamānānyeva vā sāmānyādirūpāṇi bhedapratipādanaparatayā tasyaiva viśeṣasya paramārtharūpatvenāṅgāṅgibhāvaṃ gatāni, asatyopādhisatyaśabdārthatvāt
tathā cāṅgāṅgibhāvagatyā tadrūpaparamārtharūpayā avyavahitavṛttinā vidhinā svabhedāḥ samākṣiptā iti vartate
uddhṛtametat prāgapi nayacakravṛttau pṛ॰ 33 paṃ॰ 10 ityatra

yo'pi tvayānyāpoha iṣṭaḥ so'pi vidhimantareṇa na bhavati, yasmāt aghaṭo na bhavati ityetamavivakṣitaṃ dviḥpratiṣedhamanādṛtyānapekṣya vidhirūpeṇa vivakṣitavidhyarthasya ghaṭasya pratipattau satyāmuttarakālaṃ bhavati, nāpratipattau
tasyaivaṃ caritavidhyarthasya ghaṭasya upasarjanatvenāpohabuddheraghaṭābhāvabuddherutpatteravaśyātmā vidhiḥ pradhāno'pradhāno'poha iti

kimiva ? śiṃśapādyupahārivṛkṣaśabdārthe'ghaṭaghaṭānavatāravat, yathā vṛkṣaḥ ityukte śiṃśapādibhedānāmanyatamena vinārthavānna bhavati vṛkṣaśabda iti śiṃśapādi upaharannarthavān, tasmin mūlādimati śiṃśapādyavaśyambhāviviśeṣasvabhāve'rthe'ghaṭānavatāraḥ, aghaṭo na bhavati ityasya tu dūrata eva, naivāsau śabdārtho guḍamādhuryagativadarthāpattilabhyatvāt
ghaṭānavatāra ityeva vā pāṭhaḥ, ghaṭasya vṛkṣārthe'vakāśābhāvavadanupāttāvṛkṣāpohasya ko'vakāśa iti
atra ॰bhāve'rthe ghaṭānavatāraḥ, ghaṭo na bhavati ityasya ityapi pāṭhaḥ sambhavet
yadi tu so'pyapohapara eva syāt tato'vṛkṣavyāvṛttivyāpṛtatvād vṛkṣabhedaṃ nākṣiped nānumanyeta na vyudasyet, anarthitvāt, avṛkṣābhavanavat
avṛkṣo ghaṭādi, tadabhavanasyāprastutatvād vṛkṣaśabdasya tatra vyāpāra eva nāsti tathā'prastutatvād vṛkṣabhedākṣepe vṛkṣaśabdasya vyāpāra eva nāsti īdṛśaṃ kimapi mūlaṃ sambhāvyate
yadasau vṛkṣārthaṃ śiṃśapādibhedātmakaṃ svārthamananyatvenākṣipati tasmāt tena saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ pratipadyate tadbhavanavidhyekārthībhāvāt
bhavanavidhivinābhūtaṃ bhedānākṣepi na samānādhikaraṇaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapeti tvadabhimataṃ vastu syāt, abhavattvāt, vandhyāputravat
syānmatam--atrāpi vṛkṣaḥ iti avṛkṣo na bhavati ityapoha evocyate, na śiṃśapādyupahāraḥ, tasyaiva visaṃvādasthānatvād na svārtha iti
yadi tu so'pi vṛkṣaśabdo'pohapara evābhaviṣyat tataḥ so'vṛkṣavyāvṛttivyāpṛtatvād vṛkṣabhedaṃ śiṃśapādīnnākṣipet, ākṣipatīti ceṣṭaṃ śiṃśapādisāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanāt
tathā nānumanyeta anākṣiptatvāt tamartham, anumanyate tu
na vyudasyet apoha eva ityabhāvamātrārthatvāt khapuṣpavat
vakṣyati copasaṃhāre--śūnyamātratvāt kiṃ kaḥ kena kasmādvāpohate ? iti
kuto'nākṣepānanumatyavyudāsā iti cet, ucyate --anarthitvāt, anarthī hi śiṃśapādinā bhedena vṛkṣaśabdaḥ, tasmānnākṣepādīn kurute
tadvyākhyā --avṛkṣo ghaṭādītyādirgatārthā yāvad vyāpāra eva nāstīti

vidhivāde tvasmatpakṣe yasmādasau vṛkṣaśabdo vṛkṣārthaṃ ghaṭādibhyo'nyatvena śiṃśapādibhedātmakaṃ svārthamananyatvenākṣipati tasmāt tena saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ pratipadyate--vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapeti, tadbhavanavidhyekārthībhāvāt

tatsamānādhikaraṇaṃ bhavanaṃ bhavanamasya tadbhavanabhavanam, tasya tadbhavanabhavanasya vidhirātmalābhaḥ sthitirācāraḥ, tena vinābhāve tadvirahitatve na ghaṭate ghaṭāṃ nopaiti, bhavanavidhivinābhūtasya bhedākṣepābhāvāt, na hyabhavato bhedā ākṣepakatvaṃ vāsti yataḥ samānādhikaraṇatā syāt
sādhanamapyatra--bhavanavidhivinābhūtaṃ bhedānākṣepi na samānādhikaraṇaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā iti tvadabhimataṃ vastu syāt, abhavattvāt, vandhyāputravat
anupapannasāmānādhikaraṇyabhedākṣepānumati tvadiṣṭaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā iti padadvayābhidheyam, abhavattvāt, vandhyāputravat
kuto'sya bhedasya bhedatvam ? kathaṃ so'pi tarhyabhedaḥ ? yadyasāvapi bhedo na bhavati na tarhi vṛkṣo bhavati, abhūtaśiṃśapādibhedatvāt, ghaṭavat
so'pyevameva ghaṭo na bhavati, abhūtagrīvādibhedatvāt, vṛkṣavat
atha kathañcid bhavatyapi vṛkṣastataḥ svārthādyukteḥ sa eva vidhirviṣayaḥ saṃvṛtto'rthaḥ

itara āha --kuto'sya bhedasya bhedatvam, śiṃśapādervṛkṣabhedābhimatasya tadbhedatvam ? vṛkṣasāmānyasyānuvṛttilakṣaṇasyā'vṛkṣābhāvatve satyasiddhatvāt kasya bhedaḥ śiṃśapādiḥ ? tasmād bhedasya śiṃśapāderbhedatvaṃ kutaḥ ? naivāstītyarthaḥ
kathaṃ so'pi tarhyabhedaḥ ? na bhavati śiṃśapādirvṛkṣaḥ abhedo'nyasmādanivṛtto'napohaḥ śiṃśapāvṛkṣābhāvāvyāvṛtto vṛkṣa eva na bhavati, kuto bhedaḥ śiṃśapādirvṛkṣa iti
yadyasāvapi bhedo na bhavati śiṃśapādiḥ na tarhi vṛkṣo bhavatīti vṛkṣasyaivāvṛkṣatvamavastutvaṃ pratijñāyate
so'pyevamevetyādi, yadi tu so'pi ghaṭo na bhavati bheda itīṣyate tasyāpyaghaṭatvamabhūtagrīvādibhedatvāt, vṛkṣavat
evaṃ grīvādirabhūtakapālāditvāt ityādi yāvat paramāṇurna bhavati, abhūtarūpādibhedatvāt, vijñānavat
sarvatra vā sāmānyena na bhavantyete'rthāḥ svabhedaśūnyatvāt khapuṣpavaditi
evam anena vidhinā sarvamidaṃ dṛśyādi pratyakṣābhimatamanumeyamabhidheyaṃ vā vastu śūnyamāpadyate tvanmatenaiva
kaḥ kiṃ kena kasmādvāpohate ? sarvasya śūnyatve kaḥ kim ityādi kartṛkarmakaraṇāpādānabhūtānāṃ śabdādīnāmabhāve'pohābhāva evamityarthaḥ

mā bhūdeṣa sarvaśūnyatvadoṣa iti tyaktvā bhavanābhāvamātrārthaikāntāpohakalpanāṃ kenacit prakāreṇa bhavatyapi vṛkṣo'vṛkṣo na bhavati, śiṃśapā bhavatyapi itīṣyate śabdārthaśūnyatvadoṣabhayāt tato vayaṃ brūmaḥ --svārthādyukteḥ svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatte ityādivacanāt sa eva vidhirviṣayaḥ saṃvṛtto'rthaḥ

tadidānīṃ prastutanayamatena śabdārthaṃ yojayati --tadupasarjanaścāpoho'sattvādasatyaḥ, viśeṣārthasya vidherupasarjano'pohaḥ, sa cāsattvādasatyaḥ, uktavadeva prāg vistareṇa asatyopādhiḥ satyaḥ śabdārthaḥ, sa ca viśeṣameva vidadhāti nāpohate ityeṣa śabdārthavidhiriti
na bhavati śiṃśapā na bhavati śiṃśapā pra॰
sāmānyasya svārthaṃ viśeṣaśabdo'bhidhatte tattvenātmānaṃ vidadhadabhedatvāsattvāpattityāgena śiṃśapādisamparigraheṇa atyajannevānuvṛttivyāvṛttī tadupasarjanāśiṃśapā'bhavanabījatāṃ yān
yadi tu so'pyapohapara eva syāt tataḥ śiṃśapāśabdo na vidadhyād vṛkṣārthaṃ vyāvṛttatvāt arthāpattyā nānumanyeta vopāttārthāvirodha iti aśiṃśapā'bhavanavat

yathānyatve viśeṣaprādhānyāt sāmānya-bheda-paryāyaśabdārthāstadaṅgatvāt tadātmakatvādvā nāpohyante tathā vivakṣitaśabdārthādanyasya viśeṣaśabdārthasya viśeṣaśabdārthasya vā sāmānyasya svārthaṃ viśeṣaśabdo'bhidhatte
katham ? tattvenātmānaṃ sāmānyena sahaikībhāvaṃ vidadhat ātmana upasarjanabhāve sāhāyakīkārayan
kiṃ karoti ? svārthaṃ vidhatte iti vartate

abhedatvāsattvāpattityāgena, na ca vṛkṣa-pārthiva-mṛd-dravya-sattvasāmānyāni tyaktvā viśeṣameva tairekāntena viviktaṃ pratipādayati tathārūpārthāsambhavāt sāmānyopasarjanatvopāyapratipādyaviśeṣātmalābhatvāt, nāpi avṛkṣāśiṃśapādi na bhavati ityasattvāpattimeva svārthapratipattirahitāṃ brūte'bhidheyābhāve śabdārthavyavahārocchittiprasaṅgāt

ko'sau viśeṣaśabdastadartho veti cet, ucyate --śiṃśapādiḥ, tatsamparigraheṇa vṛkṣādeḥ sadantasyānuvṛtteḥ sāmānyasya samparigraheṇa tadabhāvāvṛkṣādyasadantavyāvṛttyapohaparigraheṇa cātyajannevānuvṛttivyāvṛttī, kiṃ kāraṇaṃ na te tyajati ? iti cet, ucyate--yasmāt tadupasarjanāśiṃśapā'bhavanabījatāṃ yān svārthamabhidhatte gacchan vrajannityarthaḥ, svārthānuvṛttisāmānyopasarjanatvasya aśiṃśapāyā ghaṭādestatrābhavanalakṣaṇasya ca vyāvṛttisāmānyasya svārthaḥ śiṃśapāśabdasya śiṃśapārthaḥ, sa bījaṃ tayoranuvṛttivyāvṛttyoḥ, itarathā kimasāvapohetāpratipādayan kiñcit ?
pramāṇasamuccayavṛttau sāmānyaśabdo viśeṣaśabdena sahāviruddhaḥ ityetaddarśanāvasare bhedabhedaśabdo'pi gṛhītaḥ
svārthamabhidhatte iti anantaramevoktaṃ vakṣyate ca punarapi pṛ॰ 644 paṃ॰ 16 ityatra
yadi tu so'pītyādi pūrvavad grantha īṣadviśiṣṭaḥ prasaṅgo yāvad viśeṣārthavidhirityupanayaḥ

tatra viśeṣa ucyate--vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā ityatra śiṃśapāśabdo na vidadhyād vṛkṣārthaṃ śiṃśapāviśeṣātmāpannaṃ vyāvṛttatvāditi pūrvavad gamaḥ, arthāpattyā nānumanyeta vā avṛkṣo na bhavati ityukte'rthādāpannaṃ vṛkṣo bhavati iti, ayamartho mā bhūt, iṣyate cāsau, kutaḥ ? upāttārthāvirodhāt, upāttārthāvirodha iti atra itiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt
yattu avirodhādanyatve'pi sāmānyādiśabdārthānapohaḥ ityuktaṃ so'pyevamevāvirodho ghaṭate bhavanavidhyekārthībhūtatvāt
evaṃ ca sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdayoḥ svārthasāmānye vartamānayostadviśiṣṭārthavācakatvam, dvyādisamūhasya vākyārthavācakatvam
tadavinābhāviviśeṣārthagamanikayā neyaḥ abhavattvāt avṛkṣatvāt ityādihetukaḥ, abhāvamātrābhyupagamācca hetusiddhiḥ, tadviparyaye'smatpakṣāpattiḥ
yadapi tvayā kāraṇamuktamanyatve'pi sāmānyādiśabdārthānapohe teṣāmavirodhāt iti so'pi evamevāvirodho ghaṭate, bhavanavidhyekārthībhūtatvāt

sāmānyākhyaṃ viśeṣākhyaṃ ca yat kiñcidvastu tat sarvaṃ bhavanameva anyonyātmāpattyā ekībhūtam, sa eva śabdārtho vivakṣitārthopakārāvinābhāvitvena ekībhūto vidhīyamānatvādeva aviruddhaḥ iti yujyate, nānyāpohe, anyatvāviśeṣādabhāvatulyatvācca kau virodhāvirodhau ? iti
vyāvṛttivyāpṛtatvāditi iti pāṭho'tra samyag bhāti, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 644 paṃ॰ 1
aśiṃśapā ghaṭādi, tadabhavanapratipādana evāpakṣīṇaśaktitvāt śiṃśapātmakavṛkṣārthavidhāne tasya vyāpāra eva nāsti
yadasau vṛkṣārthaṃ śiṃśapādibhedātmakamākṣipati tasmāt tena saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ pratipadyate tadbhavanavidhyekārthībhūtatvāt
bhavanavidhivinābhūtaṃ sāmānyāvidhāyi na samānādhikaraṇaṃ tvadabhimataṃ vastu syāt, abhavattvādavṛkṣatvāt, vandhyāputravat
kuto'sya sāmānyasya sāmānyatvam ? kathaṃ so'pi tarhyasāmānyaḥ ? yadyasāvasāmānyaḥ na tarhi śiṃśapā bhavati, abhūtavṛkṣāditvāt, ghaṭavat
so'pyevameva yāvat paramāṇurna bhavati, abhūtasāmānyatvāt, khapuṣpavat
evaṃ ca sarvasya śūnyatve kaḥ kiṃ kena kasmādvā'pohate ? atha kathañcid bhavatyapi śiṃśapā tataḥ svārthādyukteḥ sa eva vidhirviṣayaḥ saṃvṛtto'rthaḥ
yattu avirodhādanyatve'pi sāmānyādiśabdārthānapohaḥ ityuktaṃ so'pyevamevāvirodho ghaṭate bhavanavidhyekārthībhūtatvāt
evaṃ ca sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdayoḥ svārthasāmānye vartamānayostadviśiṣṭārthavācakatvam, dvyādisamūhasya vākyārthavācakatvam
tadvyākhyā --evaṃ cetyādi, evaṃ ca kṛtvā vidhipradhānaśabdārthatvāt sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdayorityādi yāvad vākyārthavācakatvamiti
nīlotpalam iti vṛttipadārthabhavanasāmānyavācinoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvasambandhalakṣaṇasāmānyaviśeṣabhāvivṛttyarthavācitvam, tathā rājapuruṣādīnāṃ rājābhisambandhaviśeṣaṇādīnāṃ jñeyam

dvyādisamūhasyeti devadattastiṣṭhati, devadatto gehe tiṣṭhati, devadatta ! gāmabhyāja śuklām ityādidvi-tri-catuḥ-pañcādipadasamūhānāṃ vākyārthavācakatvam, upāttārthāvirodhisāmānyopakṛtavidhyarthatvāt sarvaśabdānāmiti
anyāpohavāde'bhihitamidaṃ diṅgāgavacanaṃ vidhipradhānaśabdārthatva eva ghaṭata iti darśayati
nākṣipatyeva sadbhedān kiṃ mudhā bhramyate tvayā
iti yaduktaṃ pṛ॰ 638 paṃ॰ 15 diṅgāgena tadatra pratikṣipati granthakāraḥ

yaduktaṃ tvayā ghaṭādibhedānākṣepitvāt sacchabdasya jātisvarūpopasarjanadravyamātrābhidhānāt pāratantryād ghaṭādibhedābhedatvāt taiḥ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ iti, yathā pareṣāṃ doṣastathā tavāpi asanniṣedhamātrābhidhānapāratantryād nākṣipatyeva sadbhedān ghaṭādīniti tulye doṣasambhave kiṃ mudhā bhramyate tvayā ? iti
pāratantryāt sacchabdānākṣepavacanena san ghaṭaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnotīti pratyuktaṃ pratiṣedhasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ veditavyam

tanmātrākāṅkṣaṇādityādi, ātmārpaṇāmātramākāṅkṣati sāmānyaṃ svabhede, atastanmātrākāṅkṣaṇād bhedaḥ śiṃśapā vṛkṣeṇa sāmānyena nojjhito'nyatvepi, kiṃ tarhi ? upātta eva kasmāt ? tatsamābandhāt tattvāt, tena saha viśeṣeṇa sāmānyasyānubaddhatve sati tattvāt ekatvāpatterviśeṣapravaṇatvādanyatve satyapi ekakāryatvādekārthatā sāmānyaviśeṣayoranyonyāparityāge sati ātmalābhādanyataratyāge svarūpāpratilambhāt sāmānādhikaraṇyam
na hi vṛkṣeṇa vinā śiṃśapā śiṃśapāṃ vinā vā vṛkṣo'stīti
atra yaduktam --nopāttaḥ saṃśayotpatteḥ sāmye caikārthatā tayoḥ pra॰ samu॰ 5
26 iti tat kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? kuto vā sāmyaikārthate ? saṃśayastāvadanyāpohamātrokteranupāttatvād viśeṣāṇāṃ sāmānyaśabdena nāsti, yadyupāttāḥ syurviśeṣāḥ syāt saṃśayaḥ
sāmyamapi ca nāsti anupāttatvāt, kutaḥ samānādhikaraṇyam ? upāttatvānna saṃśayaḥ syād vṛkṣavaditi cet, na, uktatvāt sāmānyādupasarjanād vidhiviśeṣārthānniyame niścayadarśanāditi
nojjhito'nyatve'pi iti nojjhito'tyaktaḥ iti vā pāṭho'tra sambhāvyate
śiṃśapā vinā vā na vṛkṣo'stīti pra॰

iha vidhipradhāne śabdārthe vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā iti cokte bhedaśabdena anekaṃ ca sāmānyaṃ pṛthivī-dravya-sadādi nāma-sthāpanā-dravya-bhāvākhyaṃ ca sarvamapyupāttamavyabhicāriṇā bhedena śiṃśapādividhyekārthībhūtatvāt
tataḥ saṃśayavyāvṛttyarthaṃ bhavatyeva viśeṣaṇatvaṃ vṛkṣasya śiṃśapāyāśca viśeṣyatvam
vivakṣāvaśāt kadācid vṛkṣeṇa śiṃśapā viśeṣyate kadācicchiṃśapayā vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā vṛkṣaḥ, vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapā ityaniyamadarśanāt
tasyāniyamasya hetuṃ darśayati --nāmādyanekamityādi, nāmaśiṃśapā sthāpanāśiṃśapā dravyaśiṃśapā bhāvaśiṃśapā
kanyāyāḥ śiṃśapā iti nānni kṛte kanyā nāmaśiṃśapā
tacca sāmānyaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā sarvasya nāmatvāt, śiṃśapaiva vā nāmādyapekṣayā sāmānyam

tadvyāvṛttyarthaṃ vṛkṣaśiṃśapāmaudayikabhāvātmikāṃ bhāvaśiṃśapāmānayeti bhavatyeva viśeṣaṇatvaṃ vṛkṣasya śiṃśapāyāśca viśeṣyatvam, aniyamaḥ, na tu yathocyate tvayā --na tayostulyā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatā pra॰ samu॰ 5
tataḥ saṃśayavyāvṛttyarthaṃ bhavatyeva viśeṣaṇatvaṃ vṛkṣasya śiṃśapāyāśca viśeṣyatvam
yadapyucyate tvayā— bhedo bhedāntarārthaṃ tu virodhitvādapohate
28 iti, tatrāpi na tu virodhitvādapohate, virodhābhāvādaṅgāṅgibhāvena sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvāpatteruktanyāyena sarvasya nāmādyapekṣasya
kasmāt tarhyapohate ? ucyate--yasmādittham svārthāvabaddhaśaktiśca bhedo bhedamapohate
svārthe'vabaddhā śaktirasya śiṃśapāśabdasya vṛkṣasāmānyasahāyasya śiṃśapāyāmevāvabaddhā, tasyā eva vivakṣitatvāttu śabdāntarārthapratipādanasahāyabhāvāpratipatteḥ

kiṃ kāraṇam ? sāmānyārthaviśeṣārthavidhimanniyamaśruteḥ, yeyamabhihitānāṃ sāmānyaśabdena upasarjanasāmānyārthena viśeṣāṇāṃ niyamārthā viśeṣaśrutiriṣṭāyāḥ śiṃśapāyāḥ pratipādanasya taddvāratvād yathāsmābhiḥ prāg vistareṇa vyākhyātā sā sāmānyārthaviśeṣārthaguṇapradhānayuktavidheyārthavatī

tasmāddhetostasyāḥ sāmānyārthaviśeṣārthavidhimanniyamaśruterbhedāntarasyāvivakṣitatvāt prayojanābhāvāt svārthāvabaddhaśaktitvād bhedaḥ śiṃśapādirbhedaṃ khadirādimapohate, na tu virodhitvāt, sāmānyaviśeṣayoranyonyāvinābhāvitve sāmānyāvinābhāvinā viśeṣāntareṇa svarūpeṇaiva kathaṃ virudhyate viśeṣaḥ śiṃśapādiḥ khadirādinā ? iti
yattūktaṃ kathaṃ punaḥ śabdasyārthāntarāpohena svārthābhidhāne pūrvadoṣāprasaṅgaḥ kathaṃ vārthāntarāpohena svārthābhidhānam ?
atredamavadheyam --diṅgāgasya katamasmād granthādidaṃ sarvamapohavādimataṃ kenacidviracitayā taṭṭīkayā sahātra mallavādikṣamāśramaṇairuddhṛtamiti nirṇetuṃ na pāryate, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 606 ṭi॰ 7
yathā tu pramāṇasamuccaye'pohaparicchede diṅgāgenābhihitaṃ tathā bhoṭabhāṣānuvādāt saṃskṛte parivartyātropadarśyata iti sarvatra pūrvottarapakṣayoryathāyogamanusandheyo'yaṃ pramāṇasamuccayagranthaḥ--
kathaṃ punaḥ śabdasyārthāntarāpohena svārthābhidhāne pūrvadoṣāprasaṅgaḥ ? yasmāt
tatra tulye nāvaśyaṃ sarvatra vṛttirākhyeyā, kvacidānantye'rthasyākhyānāsambhavāt
anvayadvāreṇa tvanumāne vṛkṣaśabdādekasmin vastuni śiṃśapādipratibhāsī saṃśayo na syāt
tataśca yathānulomyena vṛkṣa-pārthiva-dravya-sat-jñeyaśabdebhyaścatustridvyekaniścayo bhavati tathā prātilomyenāpi niścayena bhavitavyam
jñeyaśabdāccaturṣu sattādiṣu sandehāt sacchabdāt triṣu dravyādiṣu dravyaśabdād dvayoḥ pārthivavṛkṣatvayoḥ pārthivaśabdādekatra vṛkṣatve
na ca sambandhadvāraṃ muktvā śabdasya liṅgasya vā svārthakhyāpanaśaktirasti, tasyānekadharmatve'pi sarvathā gatyasambhavāt
asya savṛttikasya pramāṇasamuccayasya jinendrabuddhiracitā viśālāmalavatī vyākhyāpi bhoṭabhāṣānuvādāt saṃskṛte parivartyehopanyasyate--"kathaṃ punarityādi
...caturṣu pakṣeṣu ye doṣāḥ pūrvamuktāste kathaṃ na syuriti pṛcchati
dvāramupāyaḥ, śabdasya liṅgatvāt tasya cānvayavyatirekalakṣaṇasambandhabalena gamakatvāt
liṅgasya tattulya eva vṛttistadatulye cāvṛttirevetyetaddhi anvayavyatirekayoḥ svarūpam
tatra tattulye nāvaśyamiti niyamenāsya sajātīye sarvatra vṛttirnākhyeyā
nahi vṛkṣādiśabdasya vṛkṣādau sarvatra darśanasambhavaḥ, teṣāmānantyāt
ata āha --atulye tu satyapyānantya iti yatra śabdārthābhāvasteṣāmānantye satyapi svārthābhāve śabdābhāvalakṣaṇo vyatireko darśayituṃ śakyate, adarśanasya abhāvamātratvāt
śabdārthayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasiddhau kāraṇārthābhāve tatkāryaśabdābhāvo bhaviṣyatītyetanmātreṇādarśanaṃ pratīyate

ata eveti yasmād darśanasya tattulye sarvatrāsambhavaḥ, tadatulye tvadarśanasya sambhavastasmāt svasambandhibhyaḥ sajātīyebhyo'nyatra vipakṣe'darśanāt tadvyavacchedānumānamiti yatra svārthābhāve'darśanaṃ tadvyavacchedānāmanumānam anumitiḥ svārthābhidhānamityucyate
etena yadyapi anvayavyatirekayordvayorapyanumānāṅgatvaṃ tathāpi vyatirekasya prādhānyāt taddvāreṇaiva gamakatvamiti darśayati
yadyanvayadvāreṇaivābhidhānamiṣyate tathā sati vṛkṣaśabdasyārthādisahitasya śiṃśapādiṣvanugamo'stīti vṛkṣaśabdāt kevalādekasmin vastuni śiṃśapādipratibhāsī saṃśayo na syāt, api tu niścaya eva syāt
atha bahuṣu dṛṣṭatvāt saṃśaya evaṃ tarhi tatra saṃśayavat pārthivatva-dravyatvādipratibhāsyapi saṃśayaḥ syāt, pārthivatvādiṣu bahuṣu dṛṣṭatvāt
yasmād bahuṣvapi vartamāno yadabhāve na bhavati tat pratipādayati, netarat
jñeyaśabdaḥ saddravyapārthivavṛkṣatveṣu cartuṣu saṃśayasya hetuḥ, yasmāt sa teṣāmabhāve'pi dṛṣṭaḥ
sacchabdo dravya-pārthiva-vṛkṣatveṣu triṣu, dravyaśabdaḥ pārthivavṛkṣatvayordvayoḥ, pārthivaśabda ekasmin vṛkṣatve
anyathetyānulomyena vṛkṣaśabdaḥ pārthivadravyasajjñeyeṣu caturṣu niścayasya hetuḥ
yadi ca dṛṣṭavad vidhinā gamayet yathākramaṃ catustridvyekārthaniścayastarhi prātilomyena syāt, jñeyaśabdādīnāṃ sattvādiṣu dṛṣṭatvāt
yasmāt tadabhāve'pi dṛṣṭatvāt sandehastasmād vyatirekadvāreṇaiva gamakatvamiti
anumānasya nimittam, tat parityajya śabdasya liṅgasyeva svārthakhyāpanaśaktirnāsti
yathā arthātmakaṃ liṅgamavinābhāvasambandhadvāreṇa gamayat svārthaṃ vyatirekadvāreṇaiva gamayati evaṃ śabdo'pīti khyāpayituṃ liṅgasyeva iti vacanam
tasyānekadharmatve iti śiṃśapādibhedena puṣpitaphalitatvādibhedena vā vṛkṣādyarthasyānekadharmatve'pi sarvathā gatyasambhavāditi
yadi sarvathā puṣpitaphalitatvādinā gamyate tadā yathoktasambandhaṃ vinā vidhinaiva gamyeta
tasmād vidhinā na gatiḥ, api tu arthāntaravyatirekadvāreṇa
bhedānabhidhānāditi, teṣāmanyonyābhāve'pi sattvād vyabhicāro bhavati, na tu sāmānyasyābhidheyatve, tasyābhinnatvāt tadabhāve ca śabdābhāvāt

etena sāmānyāntarabhedārthāḥ svasāmānyavirodhinaḥ ityādi sarvamabhihitena nyāyena sāmānyaviśeṣabhavanavidhyekībhūtārthatvādinā pratyuktārtham; pratyuktaḥ pratiṣiddho'syārthastvadīyasya evamādino vacanasya

kathaṃ punaḥ śabdasyārthāntaretyādi codyaṃ parābhiprāyaṃ gṛhītvā svamatanirdoṣatāpradarśanārthaṃ svamataṃ pratyuccārayatotthāpitaṃ yāvat pūrvadoṣāprasaṅga iti, bheda-jāti-tatsambandha-tadvatpakṣagatā doṣāstavāpi ānantya-vyabhicārādayaḥ kathaṃ na syuriti
nanu śabdasyārthāntarāpoheneti parapakṣadoṣābhidhānamātreṇa svapakṣāsiddhitaḥ pṛcchati kathaṃ vārthāntarāpohena svārthābhidhānaṃ pakṣasiddhiḥ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
anvayadvāreṇa cānumāne yasmādanugamo'sti vṛkṣaśabdasya śiṃśapādiṣu tasmāt kevalenāpyanumānaṃ prāpnoti
atha bahuṣu dṛṣṭa iti saṃśayo bhavati evaṃ sati vṛkṣārthe pārthivatva-dravyatva-sattveṣu saṃśayaḥ syāt
atrocyate tvayā --adṛṣṭeranyaśabdārthe svārthasyāṃśe'pi darśanāt, anyāpohenārthābhidhānasiddhiḥ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
tatra yathā dhūmasya ekadeśe darśanādagneḥ anagnau cādarśanādanagnivyudāsenāgnipratītistathā śabdasyānvayavyatirekāvarthābhidhāne dvāram
tatra tulye nāvaśyaṃ sarvatra vṛttirākhyeyā, kvacidānantye'rthasyākhyānāsambhavāt, na hi sambhavo'sti vṛkṣaśabdasya sarvavṛkṣeṣu darśane, nāpi sarvatra liṅgini sarvaliṅgasya sambhavo'gnidhūmādivat
yadyapi ca kvacidasti ḍitthādiṣu sambhavaḥ, tathāpi na taddvāreṇānumānam, sarvātmanā'pratīteḥ
guṇasamudāyo hi ḍitthākhyo'rthaḥ, na ca sarve kāṇakuṇṭādayo ḍitthaśabdād gamyante

diṅgāgaracitasya kasyacidapohaviṣayakagranthasyāṃśo'tra kenacid viracitayā taṭṭīkayā saha prāyo yathākṣarameva nayacakravṛttikṛdbhiḥ siṃhasūrikṣamāśramaṇairihopanyastaḥ, tatra kiyad diṅgāgasya kiyacca taṭṭīkākṛta iti samyag vivektuṃ na pāryate, mallavādikṣamāśramanenāpi kiyadatra mūlarūpeṇopāttamityapi na samyag vijñāyate
yāvattu diṅgāgenābhihitamityasmākaṃ pratibhāti tāvadasmābhiḥ sthūlākṣarairatra vṛttau darśitam, yathā tu pramāṇasamuccaye vartate tathā pṛ॰ 650 ṭi॰ 2 ityatra pradarśitamasmābhiḥ prāk
tata āha --atulye tu satyapyānantye śakyamadarśanamātreṇā'darśane'pravṛtterākhyānam, adarśanamātratvāt, adarśanaṃ hi darśanābhāvamātram

ata eva ceti, yasmāddarśanasya sarvatrāsambhavaḥ satyapi ca darśane sarvathānumānābhāvaḥ ata eva svasambandhibhya iti yatra dṛṣṭaḥ so'tra sambandhī abhipretaḥ na tu avinābhāvitvasambandhena, anyatrādarśanāditi abhidheyābhāve'darśanāt, anyathā hi vṛkṣaśabdasya tasmin vastuni pṛthivī-dravyādyabhāve'pi darśanaṃ vaktavyaṃ syāt, tadvyavacchedānumānamiti yatraivādarśanamuktaṃ vṛkṣābhāve'vṛkṣe tato vyavacchedānumānam avṛkṣo na bhavati iti
anvayadvāreṇa cānumāne'yaṃ doṣaḥ --yasmādanugamo'sti vṛkṣaśabdasyārthādisahitasya śiṃśapādiṣu tasmāt kevalenāpyanumānaṃ prāpnoti

atha bahuṣu palāśādiṣvapi dṛṣṭa iti saṃśayo bhavati evaṃ sati vṛkṣārthe pārthivatva-dravyārtha-sattārthāḥ santi teṣu vṛkṣaśabdasya samānatvāt saṃśayaḥ syāt, niścayastu ānulomyena tridvyekārthaniścayahetavaḥ
na ca sambandhadvāraṃ muktvā śabdasya liṅgasya vā svārthakhyāpanaśaktirasti
āha ca— bahudhāpyabhidheyasya na śabdāt sarvathā gatiḥ
pūrvadoṣābhāvaśca, yasmāt śruteḥ sambandhasaukaryaṃ na cāsti vyabhicāritā bhedānabhidhānāt iti
na ca sambandhadvāraṃ muktvā śabdasya iti yathā bhedādyanabhidhānaṃ pūrvamuktaṃ taddarśayati
na ca sambandhadvāraṃ muktvā śabdasya liṅgasya vā svārthakhyāpanaśaktirasti
āha ca— bahudhāpyabhidheyasya na śabdāt sarvathā gatiḥ
pūrvadoṣābhāvaśca, yasmāt śruteḥ sambandhasaukaryaṃ na cāsti vyabhicāritā bhedānabhidhānāt iti
tathā vṛkṣa॰ iti pāṭho'pyatra samīcīno bhāti
bahudhāpyabhidheyasyeti, śiṃśapādibhedā atrābhipretā na dravyādayaḥ, tathāhi--vṛkṣavadbhedeṣu saṃśayo dṛṣṭo'rthatastu dravyādiṣu niścayaḥ
svasambandhānurūpyāttviti, yasmādasau tajjātīye dṛśyamāno'rthāntaranivṛttidvāreṇaiva dṛṣṭo'bhidhāyakaḥ prāgevānyatrādṛśyamānastasmāt sambandhānurūpyāt tadviśiṣṭamevārthamāha

anekadharmā śabdo'pi sāmānyadharmaiḥ khaguṇatvādibhirvṛkṣārthaṃ tasmin vastuni nābhidhatte, tathāhi--te vināpi vṛkṣārthena rasādiṣu dṛṣṭāḥ, na tu vṛkṣaśabdo'nyatra dṛṣṭaḥ, tasmād vṛkṣaśabdenaiva pratyāyanamupapannamityuktā svapakṣasiddhāvupapattiḥ
pūrvadoṣābhāvaśca, yasmācchruteḥ sambandhasaukaryam bahutve'pi tulyātulyayorvṛttyavṛttī, sambandhasaukaryād na cāpi vyabhicāritā bhedānabhidhānāt
evaṃ tāvad bhedābhidhāne ye doṣā uktāste parihṛtā iti anyāpohavādipakṣaḥ
ācāryo'syāpi dūṣaṇaṃ vaktukāmaḥ prāk tāvat tatra yadidaṃ śrutisambandhasaukaryamucyata iti parihārabījameva dūṣayitumāha --etadayuktam, yata ityādi yāvad na ghaṭete iti
yasmāt tāvanvayavyatirekāvapīha na ghaṭete, dūrata eva yāvarthābhidhānahetū tulyātulyavṛttyavṛttibhyāṃ bhavata ityabhimatau
apohārthā- bhāvāt sambandhābhāvaḥ, svārthagandhasyāpyadarśanāt saṃśayabījamapi nāsti, kuto vyabhicārāśaṅketyupanyāsaḥ
vyabhicārāvyabhicārāśaṃkā ityapi bhā॰ pratipāṭhānusāreṇa pāṭhaḥ syāt
sa kimanyo'rthaḥ sa eva bhavati utānyo na bhavati ? yadi tāvat sa eva bhavati tatastacchabdotpādyavijñānaviṣaye'vyāvṛttyā'nyākhye'rthe vidhinaiva pratipanne kimapohena kriyate, arthapratītervṛttatvāt
tadā hyarthāpattyā tadanyayorubhayorapi tattvaṃ svataḥ siddham
anyatvasya cobhayaviṣayatvāt tadagrahe ko'sāvanyaḥ ? kuto vā anyo na bhavatītyucyate ?

tato yadidamuktaṃ codyapakṣa eva arthāntarāpohena svārthābhidhāne iti, atra arthāntaraṃ nāma anyo'rtha iti yasmād bhavati tasmāt tat tāvad vicāryate --sa kimanyo'rthaḥ sa eva bhavati vidhinānyākhyo'rtha ucyate utānyo na bhavatītyapohena ? iti dvayī kalpanā syāt
tatra yadi tāvad matam--anya iti sa evānyākhyo bhavatīti tataḥ saḥ iti śabdenotpādyate yad vijñānaṃ tasya vijñānasya svārtho'bhidheya evānyākhyo'rthaḥ viṣayaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ sa eva
tataśca tasminnavyāvṛttyā'nyākhye'rthe vidhinaiva pratipanne kimapohena kriyate ? nārtho'pohenetyarthaḥ
kasmāt ? arthapratītervṛttatvāt, arthapratītyartho hi śabdaprayogaḥ, anyāpohakalpanā ca tadabhidhānasvarūpaparijñānārthā tadarthapratītau vyarthā sā
tadyathā --tadā tasmin vidhinānyavijñānakāle yadyanyo bhavati tataḥ sa na bhavati, atha sa bhavati anyo na bhavatīti arthādāpannaṃ tadanyayorubhayorapi tattvam
sa copasarjano vidhirna bhavitumarhati, kasmāt ? asatyopādhisatyaśabdārthatvāt
atha anyo na bhavati, atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityanyo na bhavatīti tasyāpyanyākhyasyārthasya anyavyāvṛttireva anyo na bhavati iti syāt svarūpam
tataḥ kim ? tato'pi praśnāvyavasthā, so'pi yo'nyo na bhavatītyucyamāno'rthaḥ kiṃ sa eva bhavati, uta anyo na bhavati ? iti pṛcchyase tvam
tatra yadi sa eva bhavatīti brūyāstvaṃ pūrvavad vidhirarthaḥ
athānyo na bhavati so'pi anyastathā praṣṭavyo yo'nyo na bhavatītyucyate tato'pyanyaḥ praṣṭavya iti praśnānavasthā
kiñcānyat, anyatvasya cobhayaviṣayatvāt, anya iti sa ucyate'nyāpekṣayā so'pi etadapekṣayā ayamasmādanyo'yamasmādanyaḥ iti tayordvayorapi svarūpataḥ siddhau dviṣṭhaṃ sadanyatvaṃ sidhyati

tatastasya anyatvasya ubhayaviṣayatvāt tadagrahe ko'sāvanyaḥ ? tayoranyākhyayorvidhirūpeṇāgrahaṇe ko'sāvanyo nāma yadapohādanyāpohaḥ syāt ? kuto vā anyo na bhavati iti ucyate yato'syānyasyānyatvaṃ sidhyet ? yato'nyo yo'nyaḥ ityetaddviṣṭhatvādanyatvasya nirdhāryametadanyatvam, nānyathā nirdhārayituṃ śakyamityabhiprāyaḥ
evaṃ tu na sa kaścidartho bhavitā
anyo na bhavati ityucyamāne ubhayato'pyabhāvādanyavyāvṛtterabhavanaparamārthatvādabhūtasvānyatvād vandhyāputravadaviṣaya eva

yadyanya ityananyo na bhavati tato'nyasyaivānuvadanāt ko'sāvanyo'nanyo nāma anyānyatvatadananyatvātulyaḥ śabdārthaḥ ? anyaśabdārthasya ca ananyaśabdārthād bhinnatve'nya ityananyo na bhavatītyapohārthaḥ syāt, atulye'nyasminnavṛtteḥ
itthamuktanyāyena na sa kaścidartho bhavitā na kadācit tādṛgvidho bhavati, anyo'pyanyo na bhavati so'pi sa na bhavatīti ubhayato'pyabhāvaprasaṅgāt svārthasyāṃśo'pi gandho'pi na dṛśyata eveti
so'pi na bhavatīti ityapi pāṭho'tra saṅgacchate

asyārthasya bhāvanā --anyo na bhavati ityucyamāne kiṃ sampravṛttam ? ubhayato'pi na bhavati, na bhavati ityanyasya vyāvṛttireva, na kaścid vidhigandho'pītyato'nyavyāvṛtteḥ hetoḥ abhavanameva paramārthaḥ, tatparamārthatvādātmānyatvābhāvaḥ
tataśca abhūtasvānyatvād vandhyāputravadaviṣaya eva, na hi vandhyāputrādirabhāvaḥ śabdārtho bhavitumarhati
evaṃ tāvad yadi sa eva bhavati, anyo na bhavati iti ca vikalpayorvidhivādaprasaṅgo'nyāpohanairmūlyaṃ coktau doṣau

atha taddoṣadvayaparihārārtham athocyeta--anyo'pyananyo na bhavati, anya iti na sa eva bhavati nāpyanyo na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? tato'nyasmādanyo'nanyo na bhavati, anyāpohaśabdārthavyāpitvād vyāvṛttyaiva gamayati, ato na vidhiprasaṅgo nābhāvamātratā veti
atrocyate --yadyanya iti ananyo na bhavati tato'nyasyaiva anuvadanādityādi yāvadatulye'nyasminnavṛtterityuttarapakṣaḥ
kimuktaṃ bhavati ? yo'yamanyaḥ so'nya eva san anyaḥ ucyate, sa evānanya eva, svayameva bhavati paramanapekṣyetyarthaḥ
tataḥ kim ? tato yo'sāvananyo nāma so'nya eva, sa evānyākhyaḥ anyaḥ san ananyaḥ ityuktaṃ bhavati
tasmāt tasyaiva anyatvasya ananyaśabdenāpi anuvadanāt ko'sāvanyaḥ pṛthak tato'nyasmādananyo nāma ? nāstītyarthaḥ

yadi syāt parāpekṣaḥ syāditi nirūpayati --anyānyatva-tadananyatvātulyaḥ śabdārtha iti, anyasmādanyaḥ anyānyaḥ, tadbhāvo'nyānyatvam, tasmād bhinnena ananyatvenātulyo'nyānyatvāt ko'sau anyānyatva-tadananyatvātulyaḥ śabdārthaḥ ? yathā vaidharmyeṇa ghaṭaḥ ityukte ghaṭānyānya-tadananyātulyo yo'sau tadatattvātulyaḥ sa ātmānyatvānyaḥ san anyaḥ ityucyate
na hi ghaṭasya paṭāditarānyatvavadanyatvam, paṭasya vā ghaṭādanyatvaṃ ghaṭānyatvavat
na hi ghaṭasya tasmādeva ghaṭāt paṭānanyatvavadananyatvam
nanvevaṃ so'pi anyasmādanya eva bhavannanyaḥ sannananyo bhavati
dṛśyate paṭādirapohyo ghaṭaśabdena na tatheha kaścidananyaśabdena bhinno'nanyo'sti yato'syānyasyānyānyasmād bhinnasya paṭavadavṛttiḥ syāt, anyonyāpekṣatvādanyatvasya, sa ca nāstīttham
kiñcānyat— anyaśabdārthasya cetyādi anyāpohe nyāyaṃ darśayati
yadā cānyaśabdārthādananyaśabdārtho bhinno bhavati tasmāccānyaśabdārthastadā anyaḥ ityukte ananyo na bhavati ityapohārtho vidherbhinnaḥ syāt
yo'sau tadatattvātulyaḥ sa ātmānyatvānyaḥ san anyaḥ ityucyate
na hi ghaṭasya paṭāditarānyatvavadanyatvam, paṭasya vā ghaṭādanyatvaṃ ghaṭānyatvavat
na hi ghaṭasya tasmādeva ghaṭāt paṭānanyatvavadananyatvam
nanvevaṃ so'pi anyasmādanya eva bhavannanyaḥ sannananyo bhavati
itara āha--syādetadevaṃ yadyanya evānyatve sthito'nya ucyeta parāpekṣānyatvāt ananyaḥ sa evānya iti
kiṃ tarhi ? svāpekṣānyatva eva anyaḥ ityucyate
yo'sau tasya anyasya atadbhāvena atattvenātulya ātmīyena sa svato'nyasmādevānyasmādātmānyatvānyaḥ ātmānyatvānyaḥ san anyaḥ ityucyate

nidarśanam --atulyaṃ hi ghaṭasyānyatvaṃ paṭādasmādanyasmāt, na hi ghaṭasyetyādinā ghaṭānyatvasya paṭānyatvenāsaṅkaraṃ darśayati yāvaditarānyatvavadanyatvam, paṭasya vetyādinā paṭānyatvasya ghaṭānyatvāsaṅkaraṃ yāvad ghaṭānyatvavaditi bhāvitārtham
etaccihnāntargataḥ ॰ṭānyatvā॰ ityādiḥ ॰kṣatā॰ ityantaḥ pāṭho bhā॰ pratau nāsti
tvaduktā taddviṣṭhatvādanyatāparasparāpekṣatā, tasyāṃ tulyāyāmapītaretarāpekṣānyatāyāṃ tata eva svata evātmano'nanyatvaṃ tattvam, sa eva ghaṭo'nanyaḥ
tasmādanyatvamapi svata eva ananyatvamapi tatheti vyavasthite bhavatyanyāpoha iti
nanvitthaṃ so'pi yo'nyaḥ anyasmādanyasvarūpāt svata eva siddhānyatvādanyākhyādarthādanya eva bhavannanyaḥ sannananyo bhavati sa eva bhavati

tasya anyasya svātmani vyavasthitasya tadananyatvaṃ anyāpoha iti cānanyāpoho na bhavatītyapi na parihāra eva, anyāpoha ityananyābhāvāpoho na bhavatīti yato'rthāntarāpohena svārthāpohe vṛttyārthe'nyaviśiṣṭo'pohaḥ
yathā apoha ityanapoho na bhavati tathānyaviśeṣaṇāpoha- tattvamātmatvamapohamāno'nyāpohastadapoha eva bhavati svāpoha eva nānyāpohastvadiṣṭaḥ parāpoha ityarthaḥ
anyāpoha iti cānanyāpoho na bhavatītyapi na parihāra eva, anyāpoha ityananyābhāvāpoho na bhavatīti yato'rthāntarāpohena svārthāpohe vṛttyārthe'nyaviśiṣṭo'pohaḥ
yathā apoha ityanapoho na bhavati tathānyaviśeṣaṇāpoha-
tadyathā --anyāpoha iti ca ananyāpoho na bhavatīti, anyaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāpohasya ananyaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāpohaḥ pratipakṣaḥ, sa na bhavatītyarthaḥ
kasmāt ? anyāpoha iti ananyābhāvāpoho na bhavatīti yataḥ arthāntarāpohena svārthāpohe vṛttyārthe'nyaviśiṣṭo'poha iti
kimuktaṃ bhavati ? ananyasyābhāvo'nyaḥ anyasya vā'bhāvo'nanyaḥ pratipakṣaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭāntatvena nyāyaṃ darśayati --yathā apoha ityanapoho na bhavatīti, tathānyaviśeṣaṇā- pohapradarśanārthamityādi dārṣṭāntikam

kimuktaṃ bhavati ? yathā apohaḥ ityukte anapoho na bhavati iti padārthe dviḥpratiṣedhaprakṛtyāpādanādapoha evārtho bhavati tathā anyaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasyāpohasya pradarśanārtham anyāpohaḥ ityukte'nyasyābhāvo'nanyaḥ, so'rtho'syeti anyābhāvārtho'nyaśabdaḥ, tadbhāvo'nyābhāvārthānyaśabdatā, satyāṃ ca tasyāmanyābhāvārthānyaśabdatāyām anyāpohaḥ ityananyābhāvasyānanyāpohasya tadvyāvṛtteḥ apoho na bhavati ityeṣo'rthaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ

tasya cedananyābhāvasyānanyasyāpoho na bhavati na tarhi ananyānapoho na bhavati tatpratipakṣatvādanyānapohasyeti yathā viśeṣyavipakṣavyāvṛttistatheha etasmin anyo na bhavati ityanyaśabdārthe tvadīye anyāpohaḥ ityananyābhāvasyāpoho na bhavati, svasyānanyasyābhāvo'nyo'nanyābhāvaḥ, tasyāpoho na bhavatītyanyāpoha eva na bhavati, ananyāpohaḥ svāpoha evetyananyābhāvārthaḥ

tacca na, yasmāt tatrāpi ko'nyaḥ ? ko'nanyaḥ ? ko'pohaḥ ? ko'napohaḥ ? iti vicāraṇāyāmananyābhāva eva uktavadanavadhāraṇāt anyasyaiva nānanyasya iti vidhivādāpatteḥ ananyasyāpoha eva nānapohaḥ iti svasyāpohānapohābhyāmavadhāraṇānavadhāraṇābhyāṃ vidhipratiṣedhādanyānanyavicāre ca pradarśanārthamanyāpoha ityukte'nyābhāvārthānyaśabdatāyām anyāpohaḥ ityananyābhāvasyāpoho na bhavati
evaṃ prakrame'pi ca na sa kaścidartho bhaviteti svārthasyāṃśo'pi na dṛśyata eva
ananyo na bhavati ityucyamāne ubhayato'pyabhāvādananyavyāvṛtterabhavanaparamārthatvādabhūtasvānanyatvād vandhyāputravadaviṣaya eva

yeṣāmapi cārthāntarāṇāmapohena svārthābhidhānaṃ tatra yat tadarthāntaraṃ tat kiṃ bhavadevāpohyata utābhavat ? yadi tāvad bhavadarthāntaraṃ bhavati tatastacchabdotpādyavijñānaviṣaye'vyāvṛttyā siddhe vidhivṛttaikagatigurutarapratipattyātmake bahutaraviṣaye vidhivāde pratipanne kimapohena punaḥ kriyate, arthapratītervṛttatvāt
tadā hyarthāpattyā vidhiprasaṅgāt sarvathānyāpohe nairmūlyamityayamapi na niḥsaraṇopāyaḥ
sthitametat --ananyābhāvasya apoho na bhavatīti yato'rthāntarāpohena svārthābhidhāne na syāt
pradarśanārthamanyāpoha ityukte'nyābhāvārthānyaśabdatāyām anyāpohaḥ ityananyābhāvasyāpoho na bhavati
evaṃ prakrame'pi ca na sa kaścidartho bhaviteti svārthasyāṃśo'pi na dṛśyata eva
ananyo na bhavati ityucyamāne ubhayato'pyabhāvādananyavyāvṛtterabhavanaparamārthatvādabhūtasvānanyatvād vandhyāputravadaviṣaya eva

yeṣāmapi cārthāntarāṇāmapohena svārthābhidhānaṃ tatra yat tadarthāntaraṃ tat kiṃ bhavadevāpohyata utābhavat ? yadi tāvad bhavadarthāntaraṃ bhavati tatastacchabdotpādyavijñānaviṣaye'vyāvṛttyā siddhe vidhivṛttaikagatigurutarapratipattyātmake bahutaraviṣaye vidhivāde pratipanne kimapohena punaḥ kriyate, arthapratītervṛttatvāt
svārthābhidhānaṃ te syāt ityapi pāṭho'tra vicāraṇīyaḥ

evamāpāditaśabdārthanyāye'pi ca na sa kaścidityādināpohanairmūlyamāpādayannupasaṃharati pūrvānyavikalpadūṣāvad viparyayeṇānanyavikalpadūṣaṇaṃ yāvadabhūtasvānanyatvād vandhyāputravadaviṣaya eva, sa ca nibandhanamanyāpohasya syāditi gatārtham
yadapyuktam arthāntarāpohena svārthābhidhāne iti, atra arthāntarāṇi arthebhyo'nyāni teṣāmarthāntarāṇāṃ madhye yat tadarthāntaraṃ so'rthādanyo'rthaḥ tat kim ? iti pūrvavad vikalpadvayam

yadi tāvadityādi prathamavikalpe dūṣaṇam, sa eva bhavannartho'rthāntaratve sthitaḥ sa bhavatīti cediṣṭastacchabdotpādyavijñānaviṣayaḥ, tasya viṣayasya siddhatvāt, tasminnavyāvṛttyā siddhe sā ca pratipattirasmadiṣṭāyā vidhivṛttaikagaterlaghīyasyā ekārthaviṣayāyā garīyasī teṣāmarthānāṃ bhūyasāṃ pratipattiḥ, sa ca vidhivāda eva bhūyorthaviṣayo garīyaḥpratipattyātmakaśca, tasmiṃśca vidhivṛttaikagatigurutarapratipattyātmake bahutaraviṣaye vidhivāde pratipanne kimapohena punaḥ kriyate, sarvārthaviṣayasya sa eva iti vidhipratipatteḥ prāgeva vṛttatvāt
tvameva hi bahutarārthaviṣayaśabdavidhivādī saṃvṛtto'nantārthaśabdavādī cetyataḥ kimapohakalpanayā kriyate ? tadā hyarthāpattyetyādi
svārthaśca vivakṣito'rthaḥ ye cānye'rthā arthāntarāṇi, tadetadubhayaṃ svata eva siddhātmasvabhāvaṃ vidhinaiva

yat punaratra san ghaṭaḥ ityukte sat ityanugamasāmānyajñānam asannaghaṭaśca na bhavati iti vyāvṛttisāmānyajñānaṃ ca, tadubhayamarthāpattyā yadi bhavati bhavatu guḍamādhuryavadupasarjanīkṛtātmasvarūpam, ko svārthārthāntarāṇāṃ tattvaṃ svataḥ siddhamityanugamasāmānyajñānaṃ vyāvṛttisāmānyajñānaṃ ca yadi bhavati bhavatu, asatyopādhisatyaśabdārthatvāt
arthāntarasya cobhayaviṣayatvāt tadagrahe kimidamarthāntaram ? kuto vārthāntaraṃ na bhavatītyucyate ? evaṃ tu na sa kaścidartho bhavitā

yadyanarthāntaraṃ na bhavati tato'rthāntaratvasyaivānuvadanāt ko'sāvarthāntarārthāntaratvatadanarthāntaratvātulyaḥ śabdārthaḥ ? arthāntaraśabdārthasya cānarthāntaraśabdārthād bhinnatve'rthāntaramityanarthāntaraṃ na bhavatītyapohārthaḥ syāt atulye'nyasminnavṛtteḥ
yo'sau tadatattvātulyaḥ sa ātmānyatvānyaḥ san arthāntaram ityucyate
na hi ghaṭasya paṭāditarārthāntaratvavadarthāntaratvam, paṭasya vā ghaṭādarthāntaratvaṃ ghaṭārthāntaratvavat
na hi paṭasya tasmādeva paṭād ghaṭānarthāntaratvavadanarthāntaratvam
nanvevaṃ tadapyarthāntarādarthāntaram eva bhavadarthāntaraṃ sadanarthāntaraṃ bhavati
evaṃ tāvad bhavadarthāntaraṃ ced bhavati tata ukto doṣaḥ
svārthārthāntarāṇāṃ tattvaṃ svataḥ siddhamityanugamasāmānyajñānaṃ vyāvṛttisāmānyajñānaṃ ca yadi bhavati bhavatu, asatyopādhisatyaśabdārthatvāt
arthāntarasya cobhayaviṣayatvāt tadagrahe kimidamarthāntaram ? kuto vārthāntaraṃ na bhavatītyucyate ?
evaṃ tu na sa kaścidartho bhavitā

yadyanarthāntaraṃ na bhavati tato'rthāntaratvasyaivānuvadanāt ko'sāvarthāntarārthāntaratvatadanarthāntaratvātulyaḥ śabdārthaḥ ? arthāntaraśabdārthasya cānarthāntaraśabdārthād bhinnatve'rthāntaramityanarthāntaraṃ na bhavatītyapohārthaḥ syāt atulye'nyasminnavṛtteḥ
yo'sau tadatattvātulyaḥ sa ātmānyatvānyaḥ san arthāntaram ityucyate
na hi ghaṭasya paṭāditarārthāntaratvavadarthāntaratvam, paṭasya vā ghaṭādarthāntaratvaṃ ghaṭārthāntaratvavat
na hi paṭasya tasmādeva paṭād ghaṭānarthāntaratvavadanarthāntaratvam
nanvevaṃ tadapyarthāntarādarthāntaram eva bhavadarthāntaraṃ sadanarthāntaraṃ bhavati
athārthāntaraṃ na bhavatīti manyase tato'navasthā praśnasya pūrvavyākhyātānyaśabdārthapraśnānavasthānavat
arthāntarasya cobhayaviṣayatvādityādi śeṣam anyatvasya cobhayaviṣayatvāt ityādinā tulyaṃ yāvat tacca nibandhanamanyāpohasya syāditi
athocyetetyādi yāvad na bhavatīti pūrvavadeva pūrvapakṣaḥ
yo'sau tadatattvātulya ityādi pūrvavadeva pūrvapakṣaḥ yāvat tasmādeva paṭād ghaṭānarthāntaravadanarthāntaratvamiti
tatrottarapakṣo nanvevaṃ tadapyarthāntarādarthāntaramityādi yāvadaśeṣapakṣavirodhāpatti tadanarthāntaratvaṃ tattvamapohamāno'rthāntarāpohastadapoha eva bhavatīti svavacanādyaśeṣapakṣavirodhāpattiḥ
evaṃ tu prakrame na sa kaścidartho bhavitā ubhayato'pyabhāvaprasaṅgādarthāntarasvārthasyāṃśo'pi dṛśyate na sa kaścit
kutaḥ svārthasyāṃśe'pi darśanamiṣṭaṃ tvayā ? ubhayato'pyabhāvādanyavyāvṛtterabhavanaparamārthatvādabhūtasvānyatvād vandhyāputravadaviṣaya eva
tataḥ svārthasyāṃśe'pyadarśanāt kva so'nvayaḥ ? ke cānye'nantāstadbhedāḥ ? ekasminnapi hi śrutisambandhābhāva eva svārthābhāvasyoktatvāt
kleśenāpi mahatā na śakyaḥ sambandha itthamāpādayitum

atra arthāntarāpoha ityanarthāntarāpoho na bhavati iti pūrvavat pareṇa parihāre'bhihite ityapi na parihāra eva anyāpoha ityananyābhāvāpoho na bhavatīti yataḥ ityādiḥ sa eva grantho'trāpi tulyārtha iti na viśeṣya likhyate tathā tu draṣṭavya ityatidiśyate
evaṃ tu prakrame na sa kaścidartho bhavitā ubhayato'pyabhāvaprasaṅgādarthāntarasvārthasyāṃśo'pi dṛśyate na sa kaścit
kutaḥ svārthasyāṃśe'pi darśanamiṣṭaṃ tvayā ? ubhayato'pyabhāvādanyavyāvṛtterabhavanaparamārthatvādabhūtasvānyatvād vandhyāputravadaviṣaya eva
tataḥ svārthasyāṃśe'pyadarśanāt kva so'nvayaḥ ? ke cānye'nantāstadbhedāḥ ? ekasminnapi hi śrutisambandhābhāva eva svārthābhāvasyoktatvāt
kleśenāpi mahatā na śakyaḥ sambandha itthamāpādayitum
evaṃ tu prakrame na sa ityādiḥ sa eva granthastulyārtho yāvadanyāpohasya syāditi
viśeṣastu arthāntarasvārthasyāṃśo'pi dṛśyate na sa kaścit, kutaḥ svārthasyāṃ'śe'pi darśanamiṣṭaṃ tvayeti
etaccihnāntargato dṛśyate ityata ārabhya svārthasyāṃśe'pi ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratau nāsti

nānyaśabdārthaḥ, nārthāntaraśabdārthaḥ, nāpohaśabdārthaḥ, na svārthaśabdārthaḥ iti prasaṅgānuprasaṅgāgatānāmeṣāṃ śabdārthānāṃ nairmūlyam, tannirmūlatvādanvayavyatirekayornairmūlyam, tannairmūlyādanyāpohārthanairmūlyam
yadbalāt tvayocyate — anvayavyatirekau hi śabdārthasyābhidhāne dvāram, tau ca tulyātulyayorvṛttyavṛttī iti, tayorabhāvādapohārthanairmūlyaṃ svārthasya ca tvadiṣṭasyoktatvāt
tataḥ svārthasyāṃśe'pyadarśanāt kva so'nvayaḥ ? ke cānye'nantāstadbhedāḥ ? tadabhāvāt kimānantyena kalpitena yasmādekasminnapi śrutisambandhābhāva eva, svārthābhāvasyoktatvāt

tataśca yat tvayā kalpyate--svārthasyāṃśe'pi darśanācchruteḥ sambandhasaukaryam pra॰ samu॰, kleśenāpi mahatā na śakyaḥ sambandha itthamāpādayitum, ato'laṃ sambandhasaukaryeṇa vāṅmātrasāreṇa mahatāpi kleśena durupapādena, tyajyatā āstāṃ te'vyabhicāritā
tatra vidhivāde tadatadātmakasaṃśayajñānasya prāptatvāt kimiva na prāptam ? atra tūktanyāyena saṃśayādi anāspadam
āstāṃ te śabdasambandhaḥ ityanena pādatrayeṇa ślokasya adṛṣṭeranyaśabdārthe svārthasyāṃśe'pi darśanāt
kvāsāvanvayaḥ ityapi pāṭhaścintyaḥ, tulanā— pṛ॰ 664 paṃ॰ 14
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 650 ṭi॰ 1, pṛ॰ 652 paṃ॰ 1, pṛ॰ 653 paṃ॰ 7
tatra vidhivāde tadatadātmakasaṃśayajñānasya prāptatvāt kimiva na prāptam ?
caturthapādena yat tvayoktaṃ na cāsti vyabhicāritā iti sā tāvadāstāṃ svapakṣagatāpohavādinastavāvyabhicāritā viprakṛṣṭatvāt
bhedapakṣe saṃśayadoṣāpādanārthaṃ yattūktaṃ tvayā--vyabhicārata iti, sacchabdo hi yathā dravye vartate tathā ghaṭādiṣvapīti vyabhicārāt saṃśayaḥ syāt, nābhidhānam pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ iti

atra brūmaḥ --tatra vidhivāde sa cāsaśca vidheya-vyāvartyau bhāvau, tayostasyātasya ca bhāvasya sambhavo yasyātmā tad bhavati tadatadātmakaṃ saṃśayajñānam, tasya saṃśayajñānasya prāpta- tvāt kimiva na prāptamabhidhānaṃ niścayo viparyayo vā'nadhyavasāyo vā ? sarvaṃ prāptamityarthaḥ
pramāṇasamuccayavṛttau tu guṇādiṣvapi iti pāṭha iti dhyeyam
atra tūktanyāyena anyāpohārthanairmūlyāt svārthāṃśasyāpyadarśanāt tvatpakṣe saṃśayādyanāspadam, ādigrahaṇād viparyayā-'nadhyavasāya-nirṇayā apyanāspadā nirviṣayā ityarthaḥ

kasmāt ? tadatadbhāvātmakabhāvābhāvātmakaśabdārthatvāt, sa cāsaśca bhavan bhāvo bhavati ityuktamasmābhiḥ, tasyābhāva ātmā yasya śabdārthasya tvadabhimatasya, tasya bhāvāt tadatadbhāvātmakabhāvābhāvātmakaśabdārthatvāt
tadvyaktiḥ— asvārthatvāt, na bhavati na bhavati ityubhayato'pi abhāvaviṣayatvāt

tadvyaktiḥ --anvayavyatirekaviṣayatvāsattvāditi, saṃśayaviparyayāvapi nirviṣayau vidhyarthābhāvāt, anadhyavasāyo'pi svārthabhāvātmakasyādhyavasāyasya paryudāsenā'nadhyavasāyo'dhyavasāyādanya iti bhavati, ubhayato'pyabhāve kuto'nadhyavasāyaḥ nirviṣayatvāt khapuṣpavat ? iti
tasya vyākhyā--tvanmatavadeva, adarśanādanyaśabdārthe iti prathamapādārthastvadvyākhyāta eva, svārthasya cāṃśe'pyadarśanāt tvanmatavadeveti dvitīyapādārthaḥ
sarvatra darśane nāsti sambhavaḥ, nāpi sarvatra liṅgini sarvaliṅgasya sambhavo'gnidhūmādivat
yadyapi kvacidasti ḍitthādiṣu sambhavastathāpi na taddvāreṇānumānam, sarvātmanā'pratīteḥ
na ca sarve kāṇakuṇṭādayo guṇāstasya ḍitthaśabdād gamyante
anena yadapi tadekadeśe darśanamiṣṭaṃ svārthāṃśe tadapyadarśanamevetyuktaṃ bhavati sarvātmasvadarśanāt
anvayānuktyudāhṛteḥ vyāvṛttyā ḍitthārthagaterudāharaṇametaditi cet, na, tatpratipattinirmūlatvāt anavagataparyudāsakasvārthatvāt, avidite devadatte na bhavatyadevadattaḥ iti vacanavat
evaṃ ca śabdasyārthābhāvād yaḥ sambandhāśakyatvaṃ doṣaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ sa ihāpi
vṛkṣaśabdasyāvṛkṣetyādi yāvad darśane nāsti sambhavaḥ, nāpi sarvatra liṅginītyādi śabdasyānumānatvāt sarvatrānumeye darśanāsambhavo'pi ayoguḍāṅgārāgnyādyanumeye dhūmādiliṅgādarśanavaditi
atra paro brūyāt--nanu ḍitthādisvābhidheye sarvatra darśanamiti, atra tvayottaraṃ yaduktam --yadyapi kvacidityādi sa eva ṭīkāgrantho yāvadanumānāsambhava iti vayaṃ tvanmatādeva brūmaḥ

anenottaravacanena tvadīyena yadapi tadekadeśe darśanamiṣṭaṃ svārthāṃśe tadapyadarśanamevetyuktaṃ bhavati kāṇa-kuṇṭādayaḥ sarve guṇāstasya guṇasamudāyātmakasya na gamyante iti vacanāt sarvātmasvadarśanācchabdasya sarvātmanā'pratīterudāharaṇe'bhihitatvādadarśanaṃ svārthāṃśe'pi samarthitam
etaduktaṃ bhavati--'ḍitthaḥ ityapi aḍittho na bhavati iti vyāvṛttyā ḍitthārthagateranvayābhāvādeva ḍitthodāharaṇamiti

etacca na, tatpratipattinirmūlatvāt, naitadaḍitthavyudāsamātramupapadyate pratipatterabhāvaprasaṅgāt na bhavati na bhavati ityubhayato'pi abhāvamātratvāt, pratipattinirmūlatvaṃ kasmāt ? anavagataparyudāsakasvārthatvāt, anavagataḥ paryudāso yasya svārthasya so'navagataparyudāsakasvārthaḥ, tadbhāvādanavagataparyudāsakasvārthakatvād nāsti pratipatterbījam
dṛṣṭāntaḥ--avidite devadatte na bhavati adevadattaḥ iti vacanamapratipattereva kāraṇaṃ nirmūlatvāt tathaitaditi
tadbhāvayati --evaṃ ca śabdasyetyādi yāvat sa ihāpīti
yathā pūrvamuktam --āstāṃ te śabdasambandhaḥ, arthābhāvāt' iti sambandhāśakyatvaṃ doṣaḥ sa eva
tato'nyasya cārthasyābhāvādalabdhātmake'rthadvaye śabdasya kena sahāvinābhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ syāt ? iti śruteḥ sambandhadauṣkaryam
yaḥ sa vṛkṣaśabdastaditaro vā tasya tenārthena na śakyate sambandhaḥ kartum, tena sahātyantamadṛṣṭatvāt, śrāvaṇatvanityānityatvavat
na ca sambandhadvāraṃ muktvā śabdasya liṅgasya vā svārthakhyāpanaśaktirasti
ata eva na nāsti vyabhicāritā, asādhāraṇadharmatvāt
yo hyasādhāraṇaḥ pakṣadharmaḥ sa yāvatā bhedena sarvasaṅgrahastatra saṃśayahetuḥ tadvatā tatsaṅgrahādekāntavyāvṛtteśca pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ ?
tathācāha--yo hyasādhāraṇaḥ sādhanadharmaḥ sa yāvatā bhedena sarvasaṃgrahastatra saṃśayahetuḥ, tadvatā tatsaṃgrahādekāntavyāvṛtteśca
yuktaṃ tāvat caturvidhasya anaikāntikasya ubhayatra sattvāt saṃśayahetutvam
yo hyasādhāraṇaḥ sādhyadharmaḥ sa yāvatā bhedena sarvabhāva PSV1saṃgrahastatra saṃśayahetuḥ, tadvatā tatsaṃgrahādekāntavyāvṛtteśca
śrāvaṇatve tannāstītyāha — śrāvaṇatvasya kathamiti kena prakāreṇeti kāraṇādarśanāt pṛcchati
yadyasādhāraṇaḥ saṃśayahetutvaṃ kuta ityata āha --ya ityādi
yāvatā bhedeneti nityānityabhāvabhedena vā sāśravānāśravabhedena vā tīrthakaravyavasthāpitabhāvabhedena vā sarvabhāvasaṅgrahastatra teṣu bhāveṣu saṃśayahetuḥ
tadvatāṃ tatsaṃgrahāditi asādhāraṇadharmavatāṃ taiḥ saṃgrahāt teṣu vā saṃgrahāt ekāntavyāvṛtteśceti ekānto nirṇayaḥ, tadvyāvṛttirabhāvaḥ, anena ekatra bhāve sādhanābhāvamāha

Giuseppe Tucci ityebhirvihite English bhāṣānuvāde itthamupalabhyate--Some say; it is logical to admit only four kinds of reasons called inconclusive, because they are in both ways in the affirmative as well as in the negative instances.
But how can the cause: because sound is audible, be an inconclusive one ? I reply: because it is too--narrow asādhāraṇa.
When the predicate of the middle term is too narrow it includes all the possible varieties of the predicate to be proved.
Therefore it is absolutely a doubtful reason.

In fact it is merely included in the subject possessing that particular nature: thus it is deprived of one of the neccessary aspects of the reason, that is it does not reside in any positive instance.

tadupasaṃhṛtya pratijñāyate --yaḥ sa vṛkṣaśabdo yasya sa vṛkṣo'rthaḥ taditaro vetyavṛkṣaśabdāvṛkṣārthayoḥ sambandho vṛkṣaśabdārthayoḥ pratipattyarthaḥ, tasya śabdasya tenārthena lokaprasiddhena vā tvadabhiprāyānna śakyate sambandhaḥ kartumiti pakṣaḥ, tena sahātyantamadṛṣṭatvāt śrāvaṇatvanityānityatvavaditi gatārthaṃ sādhanam
na ca sambandhadvāraṃ muktvā śabdasya liṅgasya vā svārthakhyāpanaśaktirastīti tvayaivokto'yaṃ nyāya iti darśayati
sa ca sambandho nāsti uktavat, uktaṃ sambandhadauṣkaryam
etasmādeva sambandhadauṣkaryād yaduktaṃ tvayā bhedābhidhānapakṣe doṣajātaṃ vyabhibhicāraḥ, so'pohapakṣe na cāsti vyabhicāritādoṣaḥ, bhedānabhidhānāditi

tadapi na bhavati, na nāsti vyabhicāritā astyeva sambandhadauṣkaryasyoktatvāt na nāsti astyeva vyabhicāritādoṣa iti idamapi cātra anvayavyatirekau śabdasyārthābhidhāne dvāram ityuktvā punaranvayasya nirākaraṇaṃ tat kenābhiprāyeṇeti na vidmo yadanvayaviṣaya ekadeśe nirūpyate tvayā vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavatītyavṛkṣavyudāsena
liṅgyekadeśasambhaviliṅgavattu na svārthāṃśamātre sambhavati pratyakṣavṛkṣamūlādibhedānantye sambandhāśakyatve pratipattyabhāvāt
avṛkṣavyavacchinnasyāpi svārthasya nānumānāya nābhidhānāya syād vṛkṣaśabdaḥ, pakṣaḥ
asādhāraṇadharmatvaṃ sapakṣāsapakṣayoradṛṣṭatvāt tad vyācaṣṭe --yo hyasādhāraṇaḥ pakṣadharma ityādi yāvadekāntavyāvṛtteśceti tadvyākhyayā gatārtham
etaccihnāntargato ॰bhicāra ityata ārabhya sambandhadauṣkaryasyo॰ ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratau nāsti

idamapi cātra anvayavyatirekau śabdasyārthābhidhāne dvāram ityuktvā punaranvayasya nirākaraṇaṃ tat kenābhiprāyeṇeti na vidmo yadanvayaviṣaya ekadeśe nirūpyate tvayā vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavatītyavṛkṣavyudāsena
liṅgyekadeśasambhaviliṅgavattu na svārthāṃśamātre sambhavati pratyakṣavṛkṣamūlādibhedānantye sambandhāśakyatve pratipattyabhāvāt
avṛkṣavyavacchinnasyāpi svārthasya nānumānāya nābhidhānāya syād vṛkṣaśabdaḥ,
anvayasya nirmūlanītatvād yad anvaya-vyatirekau śabdasyārthābhidhāne dvāram ityuktvā punaranvayasya nirākaraṇaṃ tad bhavataḥ kenābhiprāyeṇeti na vidmaḥ
katamadanvayanirākaraṇamiti cet, ucyate — yadanvayaviṣaya ekadeśe nirūpyate tvayā vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavatītyavṛkṣavyudāsena
kathaṃ punaranenānvayo nirākriyata iti ced brūmaḥ --nanvevamityādi yāvat kvāsāvanvaya iti iti bhāvanā gatārthā
svārthadeśavyāpyanvayo nāstīti cokto guṇasamudāyamātratvāt guṇabhūteṣu cāvayaveṣvasattvaṃ darśanasyoktaṃ tvayaiva
liṅgināmagnīnāmekadeśe'gnāvekasmin sambhavato dhūmasya liṅgasyāgnergamakatvavat tu na svārthāṃśamātre sambhavatīti śabdādabhidheyapratipattirna bhavitumarhati
pratyakṣavṛkṣetyādi, ayaṃ vṛkṣaḥ iti pratyakṣasyāpi mūlādimataḥ sākṣādupalabhyamānasya saṃjñāvyutpattikāle sambandhakaraṇaṃ nāsti

śiṃśapādibhedānantye jātiśabdasya bhedairanantaiḥ sambandhāśakyatve pratipattyabhāvavadekāṃśe'pi svārthākhye mūlādi-koṭarādi-hrasva-dīrgha-tanu-viśālādibhedānantye sambandhāśakyatvaṃ kvacidadṛṣṭatvāt, kimaṅga punaratyantaparokṣasvargādiśabdasvārthāṃśamātre'pi tadvadevāpratipatteḥ ? no ced dhavakhadirādyanantabhedābhidhānaṃ vṛkṣaśabdasya syādadṛṣṭasvārthāṃśatvāt
atrāniṣṭāpādanasādhanam --avṛkṣavyavacchinnasyāpi svārthasya nānumānāya nābhidhānāya syād vṛkṣaśabdaḥ na prabhavatītyarthaḥ
tadekadeśavartitvāt, svārthasya dharmiṇaḥ pakṣasyānumeyasya abhidheyasya ekadeśe vartituṃ śīlamasya dharmaḥ sādhu vā vṛttirasyeti tadekadeśavartī

avanaspativyavacchinnacaitanyasādhanārthasvāpavat, yathā sacetanā vanaspatayaḥ iti pratijñāyāṃ svāpāt iti heturdharmiṇo vanaspaterekadeśe śirīṣādau vartamāno'pi tālādiṣu avartamāno na caitanyānumānāya prabhavati avyāpitvāt, tathā vṛkṣaśabdo'pi avṛkṣavyāvṛttyartho vṛkṣasvārthāṃśavṛttirnānumānāya nābhidhānāya prabhavati
naiva vṛttirasti ityuktameva, vakṣyāmaśca anumānasyāpi svārthābhāvam
pratijñārthasyaikadeśaḥ sannasiddha iti vigrahaḥ, pratijñārthasyāsiddhatvāt heturapi tadekadeśaḥ sannasiddha ityarthaḥ
avyāpakāsiddha iti, iha pakṣadharmo yo na bhavati sa evocyate'siddhaḥ
iha pakṣīkṛteṣu taruṣu patrasaṅkocalakṣaṇaḥ svāpa ekadeśe na siddhaḥ
na hi sarve rātrau saṅkocabhājo nyagrodhādāvadarśanāt tasya kintu kvacideveti
syānmatam--sādhyāśeṣānityatvāvyāpiprayatnānantarīyakatvavadanumānaṃ syāt, vanaspatyavyāpisvāpavadanumānābhāsaḥ syāt ? iti sandeha iti
etacca na, aśeṣapakṣāvyāpītyādi, prayatnānantarīyakaṃ hi sapakṣaṃ na vyāpnoti, svāpastu pakṣameva na vyāpnotīti parihāraḥ

vṛkṣaśabdo hyaśeṣamavṛkṣād vyavacchinnaṃ vṛkṣārthaṃ nāmavṛkṣaṃ manuṣyādiṃ sthāpanāvṛkṣaṃ citrādiṃ vāsmanmatena sādhyadharmasāmānyena samānaṃ sapakṣaṃ na tu na vyāpnoti, nāpyanumāne'tra doṣaḥ, svārthāṃśavṛttitvādavyāpipakṣadharmatvād vanaspaticaitanye svāpavadityudāhṛtam
syānmatam--uktasvāpadṛṣṭāntamanapekṣya vṛkṣaśabdo yatra na dṛṣṭastānapi svārthādanyān gamayati dṛṣṭasvārthānumānasādharmyādaṃśe dṛṣṭaśaktitvāditi

ata āha --svāpodāharaṇanirapekṣādṛṣṭadeśavartitvābhyupagame tu atulye'pi vṛttiprasaṅgaḥ, atulye sādhyavipakṣe vṛttiḥ syādavṛkṣe ghaṭādau vṛkṣaśruteḥ, adṛṣṭadeśavartitvāt, mūlādimati palāśādau svārthāṃśe vā vṛttivat

iti kuto'nvayavyatirekau kuto vā pakṣadharmatvaṃ kutastrailakṣaṇyaṃ kuto'numānatvaṃ śabdasya ? yadi liṅgavacchabdastrilakṣaṇo'nyāpohena svārthaṃ gamayati tato vṛkṣaśabdasyāvṛkṣāvyavacchinneṣu vṛttiḥ syāt, anumānatvāt, anvayapradarśanārthaprayuktaghaṭādivat
na tu vṛkṣeṣu vṛttiḥ syāt, pakṣatvād vṛkṣāṇāṃ sapakṣaśabdārthāvacchinnārthatvāt kṛtakasyeva nityeṣu
apohasvārthavaditi avṛkṣo na bhavati ityavṛkṣāpohasya svārtho mūlādimānanantaḥ koṭarādibhedena, tadvācitve cādoṣo dṛṣṭa evaṃ bhedavādino'pyānantye'pi bhedānāmakṛtasambandhe'pi doṣābhāvaḥ syāt

tvanmatasvārthe'pi vā tadvad doṣa eva syāditi kutastulyātulyayorvṛttyavṛttibhyāmanvayavyatirekau ? kuto vā śabdasyābhidheyasya pakṣasya dharmatvaṃ liṅgavalliṅginaḥ ? kutastrailakṣaṇyam ? kuto'numānatvamiti, evaṃ ca śabdaliṅgagatapakṣāpakṣasapakṣavisaṃvāde sādharmyābhāvālliṅgaśabdayoḥ kuto'numānatvaṃ śabdasya ? iti
iti kuto'nvayavyatirekau kuto vā pakṣadharmatvaṃ kutastrailakṣaṇyaṃ kuto'numānatvaṃ śabdasya ?
yadi liṅgavacchabdastrilakṣaṇo'nyāpohena svārthaṃ gamayati tato vṛkṣaśabdasyāvṛkṣāvyavacchinneṣu vṛttiḥ syāt, anumānatvāt, anvayapradarśanārthaprayuktaghaṭādivat
na tu vṛkṣeṣu vṛttiḥ syāt, pakṣatvād vṛkṣāṇāṃ sapakṣaśabdārthāvacchinnārthatvāt kṛtakasyeva nityeṣu
ya॰ pratau śabdaliṅgagatapakṣāpakṣa॰ ityatra 230 patrāṅkaḥ samāpyate
tadanantaraṃ 234 tame patre pramādāt 231 ityaṅko likhitaḥ, 231 tame 232 ityaṅkaḥ, 232 tame 233 ityaṅkaḥ, 233 tame tu 234 ityaṅko likhitaḥ
ya॰ pratau pramādādevaṃ likhiteṣvapyaśuddhāṅkeṣu tatraiva patrāṇāṃ vāmakoṇe śuddhāṅkā apyupanyastāḥ

kintu ya॰ pratimavalambya kaiścidanyalekhakairyāḥ pratayo likhitāstaistvetadaparijñānādaśuddhāṅkānusāreṇa svapratayo likhitā iti 230 patrānantaram 234 tamaṃ patraṃ likhitamiti tāsu bhūyān pāṭhavyatyayaḥ sañjātaḥ
atastāsu ॰miṣyete ityata ārabhya atraśabdavācyasyāgniviśiṣṭasya dhū॰ ityanto vakṣyamāṇaḥ pāṭho'kasmādatrāpatitaḥ
asmābhistu yathā bhā॰ pratau pā॰ pratau ca pāṭho dṛśyate yathā ca ya॰ pratau śuddhāṅkeṣu patreṣu pāṭho likhitastathaivātropanyasta iti sa evopādeyaḥ

tadvyākhyā --yadi liṅgavacchabda ityādi, yadi kṛtakatvādiliṅgavacchabdastrilakṣaṇo'nyāpohena svārthaṃ gamayatīti manyase tato vṛkṣaśabdasyāvṛkṣāvyavacchinneṣu vṛkṣādabhidheyāt svārthāṃśākhyādanyatrātulye sapakṣe vṛttiḥ syāt pakṣadharmād vṛkṣaśabdādanyasyāvṛkṣaśabdādivācye tato vyavacchinne kṛtakatvānityatvāśraye ghaṭe iva vṛttiḥ syādanumānatvāt anvayadarśanārthaprayuktaghaṭādivaditi gatārtham

na tu vṛkṣeṣu vṛttiḥ syāt, kiṃ kāraṇam ? pakṣatvād vṛkṣāṇām, pakṣa eva vṛkṣaśabdākhyasya dharmasya dharmiṇo vṛkṣārthāḥ sapakṣādavacchinnāḥ, teṣveva na tu vṛttiḥ syāt, anumānatvādeva, tvadabhimatā'vṛkṣānnivṛttimātraṃ vṛkṣatā nānyasminnapi sādhyadharmasāmānyena samāne'rthe, atastvadabhimatyā tulyatvaṃ yeṣu sādhyād vṛkṣād bhinneṣu arthāntareṣu teṣu vṛkṣaśabdasya vṛttirnāsti pakṣadharmābhimatasya
tasmāditi vaidharmyeṇa, tasmāt sapakṣābhāvāt tattulye nāsti vṛttiḥ śabdasya, kiṃ tarhi ? tatraiva vṛttiḥ
hetvapavādaniyatavyavasthāniyamād neti cet, na, pakṣasapakṣāsapakṣavyavasthāyāṃ tadvyavasthābhāvāt tadasiddhāvasiddhiḥ
āpattyanabhyupagame tvanyāpohānyathātvaṃ sapakṣāvacchinnasyāpi sapakṣatvāt sapakṣāpakṣepaṇakṣīṇaśakteśca pakṣāsapakṣayorviśeṣaṃ gamayituṃ nālam, sādhyanirdeśavat
sapakṣādanyo vā sapakṣābhāvo vā syādasapakṣaḥ, sa ca sādhyadharmasāmānyena samāno'rthaḥ sapakṣaḥ pakṣādanyaḥ pakṣābhāvo'pakṣa evavā sapakṣaḥ
iha tatraiva vṛkṣārthe vṛttatvāt vṛkṣaśabdastaddharmo'pi san viruddho'sādhāraṇānaikāntiko vā syāt
pakṣādanyaḥ pakṣābhāvo'pakṣa eva sapakṣaḥ ityapi pāṭho bhavet
pakṣādanyaḥ pakṣābhāvo'pakṣaḥ, pakṣa evāsapakṣaḥ ityapi pāṭho'tra cintyaḥ
22 iti lakṣaṇāt trilakṣaṇasya hetorapavādo hetvābhāso viruddho'sādhāraṇaḥ sādhāraṇo'siddho veti niyamitatvādasapakṣavṛttigatadoṣābhāvo'sya vṛkṣaśabdasyeti
etacca na, pakṣasapakṣāsapakṣavyavasthāyāṃ tadvyavasthābhāvāt, hetu-hetvābhāsavyavasthā pakṣa-sapakṣā-'sapakṣavyavasthāyāṃ siddhāyāṃ sidhyet
asapakṣastu sa eva pakṣastvanmatābhyupagamāt syāt sapakṣābhāvamātratvāt, itarathā naiva syāduktavadeva
yadyevamāpattidoṣaṃ nābhyupaiṣi asapakṣavṛttigataṃ tato'nyāpohānyathātvaṃ doṣaḥ, anyāpoho'pi tarhi anyābhāvāt tadapohābhāvācca svārthāpoha eva syāt
kasmāt ? sapakṣāvacchinnasyāpi sapakṣatvāt, sapakṣādanyaḥ pakṣastato'vacchinno'sapakṣo vā sa eva sapakṣaḥ tataḥ pakṣādanyaḥ
kiñcānyat, sapakṣāpakṣepaṇakṣīṇaśakteśca, sapakṣādanyo'sapakṣaḥ pakṣa ityukte sapakṣavyāvṛttimātre caritārthatvāt pakṣāsapakṣayorviśeṣaṃ gamayituṃ nālaṃ pakṣa evāyaṃ nāsapakṣaḥ iti
kimiva ? sādhyanirdeśavat, yathā sādhyanirdeśaḥ pratijñā nyāyasū॰ 1

33 ityakṣapādapakṣalakṣaṇaṃ siddhinivṛttau caritārthatvāt sādhyaviśeṣaṃ pakṣamevāsiddhahetu-dṛṣṭāntebhyo vyatiriktaṃ na gamayitumalaṃ vipakṣāpakṣepaṇakṣīṇaśaktitvāt tathā sapakṣādanyo'sapakṣaḥ ityasapakṣāt pakṣaṃ viśeṣya na gamayitumalaṃ sāmānyamātravṛtteḥ
tvayā tu viśeṣavṛtteḥ pakṣa evāsapakṣāvacchinnavṛttiriṣyate, tattu na sidhyatītthaṃ nyāyāt
nanu sādhyanirdeśaḥ pratijñetyukte sādhyayorhetudṛṣṭāntayorapi prasaṅgo yathā'?nityaḥ śabdaścākṣuṣatvāt, nityaḥ śabdo'sparśatvād buddhivacceti

tadviṣayapakṣadharmatvādeva tulye vṛttirvṛkṣārtha iti cet, ananumānaṃ tarhi śabdaḥ pakṣa eva vṛttatvād dvilakṣaṇatvādasādhāraṇavat, ekalakṣaṇatvādvā anvayavyatirekābhāvād viruddhavat tadviṣayamātrārthatvādanyāpohaśabdārthatvasya
vyatirekasya svārthāsambhavādapi vyarthataiva vā, pakṣamātrasyāpyalakṣaṇatvāt, avyaktaśrutivat
guṇasamudāyo hi vṛkṣākhyo'rtha iti vṛkṣasya mūlakoṭarādyānantye vācyatvābhāvaḥ saṃvṛtimātratvāt samudāyasya tadarthāgateḥ
yacca vṛkṣaśabdo vṛkṣārthavṛttiḥ tat katham ? guṇasamudāyasaṃvṛtyarthatvāt, senāśabdavat

sa eva vṛkṣārtho viṣayaḥ pakṣaḥ, tasya pakṣasya dharmo vṛkṣaśabdaḥ, tasmāt tadviṣayapakṣadharmatvādeva tulye vṛttirvṛkṣārthe, tacca dṛṣṭam, pakṣasya dharmo hetuḥ ityanayaivoktyā gatatvād viśeṣārthagatirevetyarthaḥ

atrocyate --ananumānaṃ tarhi śabdaḥ, anumānābhāsa ityarthaḥ, pakṣa eva vṛttatvāt, tacca kāraṇatvenāha, dvilakṣaṇatvādasādhāraṇavadityādi gatārthaṃ yāvat tadviṣayamātrārthatvādanyāpohaśabdārthatvasyeti, sa eva viṣayastadviṣayo vṛkṣaḥ, tanmātrameva vācyam ityuktamanyāpohaśabdārthatvam

kiñcānyat, vyatirekasya svārthāsambhavādapi vyarthataiva vā, anyāpoho hi vyatirekamātram, na bhavati na bhavati ityabhavanaparamārthatvādubhayato'pyabhāva eva vandhyāputravat, na svārthaḥ kaścit' ityuktam

tasmād vṛkṣaśabdasya vyarthataiva pakṣamātrasyāpyalakṣaṇatvādavyaktaśrutivat, yathā mlecchaprayuktaśabdārtho vyāvṛttimātrārthatvāt svārthamātrasyāpyalakṣaṇād vyartho histamis ityādi tathā vṛkṣaśabdaḥ syāditi tadarthābhāvapradarśanārthamāha --guṇasamudāyo hītyādi
tasmāt taddvāreṇānumānāsambhava uktavaditi prāguktaṃ tanmatameva smārayati, saṃvṛtisataḥ sāmānyasamudāyākhyasyāsattvād viśeṣāṇāmṛju-vakra-nirvivarakoṭarādīnāmavācyatvāditi

tasmāt tadekalakṣaṇatāpi nāsti, kuta eva svārthādbhinnasyābhūtasya pratipattiranyasya yato'nyāpohaḥ sidhyet, sa tu nāstyanyaḥ, tadabhāvāt tatpratipattiniścayalabhyapratipattilabhyo'nyo nāsti, tatpratiniścayalabhyo hi tulyātulyavivāvekātmeti
tulanā--pṛ॰ 652 paṃ॰ 14, pṛ॰ 671 paṃ॰ 3, pṛ॰ 673 paṃ॰ 1
tadbhāvanāgranthaḥ tat katham ityādi yāvat senāśabdavaditi gatārthaḥ
vṛkṣa vṛkṣaśabdasya samudāyārthavṛttitaiveti cet, na, abhyupagatamūlādisapakṣatvāt tadatulyatvād vṛkṣārthasya tulyātulyavṛttyavṛttyādivacanavaiyarthyameva

rūpādisatyatvapratipādanārthe'pi ca ḍitthādyudāharaṇe rūpādiparasparavyāvṛttyā'nvayābhāve vyatirekasyābhāvāt na kiñcit satyam, sajātīyāsajātīyavyāvṛttasvarūpatvādatyantāpūrvatvādanirdeśyasvalakṣaṇatvāt
235 evaṃ sarvatrātulye pakṣa eva vṛtteḥ liṅgavacchabdo'numānaṃ na bhavati pramāṇameva vā na bhavati
syānmatam--vṛkṣaśabdaḥ samudāyenārthenārthavān, mūlādīnāṃ ca samudāyo vṛkṣa ucyate, tasmāt samudāyārthavattvādadoṣa iti

etacca na, abhyupagatetyādi, abhyupagatānāṃ mūlādīnāṃ tadātmatvenaikatve sapakṣatvam, sapakṣādanyatvaṃ pakṣatvam, tenātulyatvamanyatvaṃ sapakṣād vṛkṣārthasya, tadatulyatvāt tulyātulyavṛttyavṛttyādivacanavaiyarthyameva
kiñcānyat, saṃvṛtisatyatvācca samudāyasyāpi vṛkṣavadanarthatvāt senāvanāderapi vyarthatvameva
avṛkṣo na bhavati vṛkṣaḥ ityasya mūlādisvarūpasattāmātratvenāpyatulya eva vṛttiḥ, rūpādibhedasamudāyasaṃvṛtyarthatvāt
vṛkṣaśabdasya samudāyārthavṛttitaiveti cet, na, abhyupagatamūlādisapakṣatvāt tadatulyatvād vṛkṣārthasya tulyātulyavṛttyavṛttyādivacanavaiyarthyameva

rūpādisatyatvapratipādanārthe'pi ca ḍitthādyudāharaṇe rūpādiparasparavyāvṛttyā'nvayābhāve vyatirekasyābhāvāt na kiñcit satyam, sajātīyāsajātīyavyāvṛttasvarūpatvādatyantāpūrvatvādanirdeśyasvalakṣaṇatvāt
evaṃ sarvatrātulye pakṣa eva vṛtteḥ liṅgavacchabdo'numānaṃ na bhavati pramāṇameva vā na bhavati

rūpādisattvādarthavān syāditi cet, tadapi na, rūpādisatyatvapratipādanārthe'pi ca ḍitthādyudāharaṇe tvayaiva kāṇa-kuṇṭādiguṇasamudāyānvayābhāvoktyā'nyāpohaprayāse kriyamāṇe rūpādiparasparavyāvṛttyā'nvayābhāve vyatirekasyābhāvāt na bhavati na bhavati ityabhavanaparamārthatvād na kiñcit satyam

tatkāraṇamāha— sajātīyāsajātīyavyāvṛttasvarūpatvāditi, tatsatyasyāpi punaḥ kṣaṇātipātitvāt kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'tyantānyatvād dvitīyakṣaṇe tadabhāvāt katamad rūpam, atyantāpūrvatvād nirbījatvādanirdeśyasvalakṣaṇatvāt ? svalakṣaṇamanirdeśyaṃ rūpamindriyagocaraḥ pra॰ samu॰ 1
tasmādatulye pakṣe sapakṣāsapakṣavyāvṛttyā tatraiva vṛttiḥ śabdasya
nāstyeva vārthe vṛttiḥ, athavā śabdasyāprāmāṇyaṃ pratipannameva tvayā, yasmādetat tvanmatānusāryeva jñāpakam --śāstreṣu prakriyābhedairityādi śloko gatārthaḥ
liṅgavacchabdo'numānaṃ na bhavati pramāṇameva vā na bhavatītyuktasyārthasya yathāpratijñaṃ pratipāditasyopasaṃhāraḥ proktārthakramasaṅgrahātmakaḥ
śabdavattu liṅge dvailakṣaṇyameva syāt, pakṣa eva vṛttatvāt, asādhāraṇavat
liṅgamapi śabdavanna bhavati ityupapādayiṣyāmītyata āha --śabdavattu liṅge dvailakṣaṇyameva syādityādi
prathamameva tāvadanumānatvācchabdavad dvilakṣaṇaṃ liṅgamiti sādhayati, tato dvilakṣaṇatvādasādhāraṇa ityādi yaduktamanantaraṃ śabde doṣajātaṃ tat sarvaṃ liṅgasya śabdavadityevoktakrameṇa jñeyam
ekalakṣaṇatvamanvayavyatirekābhāvāt pakṣadharmatvamātraṃ viruddhavaditi śabde yaduktaṃ tad liṅge syāt
tadvyākhyā --sapakṣavṛttyabhāvāt, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? anyatra vṛttyasambhavāt, pakṣādanyatrāvṛtterityarthaḥ
ata evānvayābhāvād vyatirekavyāpārāvakāśābhāvaḥ, tasmād vyatirekavyāpārāvakāśābhāvādekalakṣaṇaṃ vā śabdavalliṅgamapi, śabdasya caikalakṣaṇaṃ prāguktaṃ viruddhavadanvayavyatirekābhāvāditi

kimiva ? sādhyadharmasādhanavyāptivat, yathā yat kṛtakaṃ tadanityam iti kṛtakatvasyānityatvenāvinābhāvena vyāptatvādavinābhāvino'nityatvasya gatiḥ kṛtakatvādiṣṭā, na tu yadanityaṃ tat kṛtakam ityanityatvasya kṛtakatvenāvinābhāvinā, vyāptau satyāmapyagateḥ anyatra tadabhāve satyavivakṣitatvāt prayatnānantarīyakatvādau tvanmatena yathā tathehāpyanvayavyatirekau sannihitāvapyakāraṇam, śabdārthe tāddharmyamātrāt tadgateḥ
liṅgasya liṅgini vyāptistasmāt satyapyakāraṇam || pra॰ samu॰ 2 | 22 1/2

tataḥ kim ? tatastayorakāraṇatvāt pakṣadharmatvamātrakāraṇatvādekalakṣaṇaṃ śabdavalliṅgamapi, anumānatvādekalakṣaṇatvācca viruddho'pi te'numānam ityāpannam ekalakṣaṇatvācchabdavadabhimatatrilakṣaṇaliṅgavacca
agniratra dhūmāditi svārthānumāne guṇasamudāyo hi dhūmākhyo'rthaḥ
tasmāt taddvāreṇānumānāsambhava iti tadekalakṣaṇatāpi naiva, kuta evānyāpohaḥ ? pakṣadharmyeva vā dharmasyādhāraḥ prāpnotīti tasminneva vṛttiḥ syāt pakṣadharmamātralakṣaṇā, na tulyānvayātmikā
anyatra ca vṛttau satyāṃ vyatirekākāṅkṣā syāt
śabdo'pi vā nānumānaṃ viruddhavaditi śabdasyānumānatvābhāve liṅgasyāpi prāptamevānanumānatvam, dvayorapītyabhiprāyaḥ
agniratra dhūmāditi svārthānumāne guṇasamudāyo hi dhūmākhyo'rthaḥ
tasmāt taddvāreṇānumānāsambhava iti tadekalakṣaṇatāpi naiva, kuta evānyāpohaḥ ?
pakṣadharmyeva vā dharmasyādhāraḥ prāpnotīti tasminneva vṛttiḥ syāt pakṣadharmamātralakṣaṇā, na tulyānvayātmikā
anyatra ca vṛttau satyāṃ vyatirekākāṅkṣā syāt
pakṣadharmyeva ca dharmasyādhāraḥ ityapi bhavet pāṭhaḥ
vyarthataiva vetyādi śabdavad liṅgasya vaiyarthyaṃ prāgvyākhyātavidhinā yojyam

tad bhāvayati --agniratra dhūmādityasminnapi svārthānumāne guṇasamudāyo hi dhūmākhyo'rtha iti, vṛkṣasya mūlādikoṭarādyānantye vācyatvābhāvavat bahala-kuṭilatvādyānantye ca dhūmatvābhāvaḥ jñātasambandhatvā- bhāvāt saṃvṛtimātratvācca samudāyasya tadarthāgateḥ

svārthamātrālakṣaṇatve kuta eva tasyāgṛhītatvāt sa bhavati dhūmo nādhūmo'nyo bhavati itiviṣayatvādubhayapratipatterabhāve'nyābhāvādanyāpohaḥ ? kutaḥ agnirityanagnirna bhavati, dhūma ityadhūmo na bhavati iti ca ? dūrata evaitanna ghaṭāmiyarti
tulanā pṛ॰ 652 paṃ॰ 14, pṛ॰ 668 paṃ॰ 5, pṛ॰ 673 paṃ॰ 1

yathaiva vṛkṣa eva, na kaścit sapakṣaḥ iti prasañjitā śabdārthavṛttistathā agniḥ iti pakṣo dharmī dhūmasya dharmasyādhāraḥ prāpnoti anumeyatvāditi sapakṣasya tulyāderabhāvaḥ, tadabhyupagame pakṣābhāvaḥ prāguktaśabdānumānaviṣayavat, iti tasminneva vṛttiḥ syāt pakṣamātre sapakṣābhāvāt
kimuktaṃ bhavati ? na tulyānvayātmikā, anvayārthābhāvād na syād vṛttiḥ
anyatra cetyādi, pakṣadharmasya cānyatra sapakṣe satyāṃ vṛttau tulye tadvadatulye'pi vṛttiḥ syāt ityāśaṅkāyā vyāvṛttaye vyatirekākāṅkṣā syāt, sā tu sapakṣasyaivābhāvānnāsti vyatirekākāṅkṣā
atha ca bhavati jñānaṃ tataḥ prāpte pratyakṣe śābdalaiṅgike'pi jñāne, anvayavyatirekaviyutatathyajñānatvāt avikalpakatvāt, sannikṛṣṭārthavat
ata idaṃ pūrvāparāsamīkṣayaivoktaṃ na pramāṇāntaraṃ śābdamanumānāditi

yadi na pramāṇāntaraṃ śābdamanumānāt, tathāhi--tat svārthamanyāpohena bhāṣate kṛtakatvādivat tato'nyāpohārthakṛtā doṣā na śabda evaikasmin, kiṃ tarhi ? tadvidhadoṣajālopanipātasambandhyeva te'numānamapi
dhūma ityadhūmo na bhavatīti niranvayā pratipattirapratipattireva, grāhyadarśanarahitatvāt sthāṇvasthāṇvapratipattivat
vināpyanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ bhavati jñānam dhūmo'yam, agnirayam, vṛkṣo'yam iti
katame te prāpte ? śābda-laiṅgike'pi jñāne pratyakṣe eva prāpnutaḥ

svapratipādyavastudharmatve sati anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tasya gamakatvāt anumānaṃ śābdam, nānumānādanyat pramāṇam ityetadapi ata eva pūrvāparāsamīkṣayaivoktam, anvayavyatirekarahitatvasyoktatvāt pratyakṣatvasyopapāditatvāt
eṣa tu pāṭho ghaṭamāna upalakṣyate --nāpramāṇāntaramityādi ślokaḥ
yadi na pramāṇāntaramityādi tadeva pratyuccārayati yāvat kṛtakatvādivaditi
na śabda evaikasminniti yathā mayoktāḥ śābdapratyakṣaprasaṅgādidoṣāḥ anyāpohārthakṛtāḥ kevale, kiṃ tarhi ? tadvidhadoṣajālopanipātasambandhyeva te'numānamapi
tat kathamiti cet, tarhi tadevaṃ prakāśyate --nanvevaṃ kṛtakatvādyapyanumānaṃ svārthaṃ parārthaṃ vā trilakṣaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ śabdavaduktavidhinā svārthamātmāpohena nāśayedeva, na na nāśayati, iyaṃ pratijñā
tasya bhāvanā sādhanam --dhūma iti adhūmo na bhavati iti niranvayā pratipattirapratipattireveti pratijñā

sthāṇvasthāṇvapratipattivaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā guṇasamudāyo hi dhūmākhyo'rthaḥ bahalapāṇḍutvādyānantye ca dhūmatvābhāvaḥ, tasmāt taddvāreṇānumānāsambhava iti tadekalakṣaṇatāpi naiva kuta evānyāpohaḥ, agṛhītabrāhmaṇābrāhmaṇārthāpratipattivat
evaṃ tāvaddhūmārtha eva na niścīyate, kiṃ punaryatrāsau vartate ? yacca dhūmo'gnimatpradeśadharma iti tadapi nanvalpabahutāpa...
sthāṇvasthāṇuviṣayavijñānarahitasya grāhyasya darśanābhāvādapratipattirniranvayatvāt tathā dhūma ityadhūmo na bhavatīti
guṇasamudāyo hi dhūmākhyo'rthaḥ bahalapāṇḍutvādyānantye ca dhūmatvābhāvaḥ, tasmāt taddvāreṇānumānāsambhava iti tadekalakṣaṇatāpi naiva kuta evānyāpohaḥ, agṛhītabrāhmaṇābrāhmaṇārthāpratipattivat
evaṃ tāvaddhūmārtha eva na niścīyate, kiṃ punaryatrāsau vartate ?
tadvyākhyā --guṇasamudāyo hītyādi pūrvavadeva bhāvanīyaṃ pāṇḍutvādyakṣaraviśeṣaṃ yāvat kuta evānyāpohaḥ, agṛhītabrāhmaṇābrāhmaṇārtharthāpratipattivaditi sādhanenaiva bhāvitamapratipattitvam
evaṃ tāvaddhūmārtha eva na niścīyate, kiṃ punaryatrāsau dhūmo guṇasamudāye paramārthe'gnau vartate ? so'pi na niścīyate'gnirityarthaḥ
tābhyāṃ cāgnidhūmābhyāṃ tato'nyayoranagnyadhūmayorapohau syātām, tadabhāvāt kutastāvapi ? iti

yacca dhūma ityādi dharme'gnau siddhe tadvati pradeśe ca dharmiṇyagnimati siddhe'gnimatpradeśadharmo dhūmaḥ sidhyet, tat sarvamasiddhamiti taddarśayati --tadapi nanvalpabahutāpetyādi samāsadaṇḍako yāvad guṇasamudāyo'sau, nāgnideśau nāma kaucidapi sta iti tameva taduktaṃ nyāyaṃ darśayati
tajjñānābhyāṃ tviti agnideśajñānābhyāṃ tadarthādhyāropaṇenetyādinā tamevāśeṣamatītaṃ granthamatidiśati yāvadanyopādānamātmanaśca tyāga iti granthāvadhiṃ ca darśayati samānapracarcatvāditi
evaṃ tāvat pakṣadharmasya cānupapattirvyākhyātā kiṃ bhavadeva bhavati utābhavat, anyadananyat, apohaśca guṇasamudāyaparamārthaśca svārthaḥ ityādivikalpairātmāpohāt
sapakṣāsapakṣāvapi bhavantāveva bhavata utābhavantau anyāvananyāvapohyohau guṇasamudāyasvārthau cetyādivikalpairātmāpoha iti samānatvāt
ā kuta ārabhya grantha iti cet, ucyate --kimanyatve na sāmānya-bheda-paryāyavācyanut ? vidhiḥ
yathā kṛtakatvāderna pakṣastenaiva nyāyena na pakṣo'nyāpohavādinaḥ
idamapi cāta eva pūrvavadalakṣaṇaṃ yat tvayoktam--

etasya granthasyopari upasaṃhāragranthaḥ prāguktanyāyaprāṇa eva --yathā kṛtakatvāderna pakṣaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ, agniratra iti vā svārthaparārthayostenaiva nyāyena na pakṣo'gniviśiṣṭo deśo'nityatvaviśiṣṭaḥ śabdo vānyāpohavādinaḥ na bhavati na bhavati ityabhavanaparamārthatvādubhayato'pyabhāvamātratvāt
tasmiṃścāsati pradeśa-śabdādidharmiṇi pakṣe kutastasya pakṣadharmaḥ ? iti pakṣa-dharmau na staḥ
evaṃ nāsya sapakṣo nāsapakṣa iti tathā bhāvitārthameva bahudhā
tadevaṃ pakṣādyatathārthatvāt atasmiṃstaditi pratyayo'numānam iti subhāvitārtham
tasmādatattatpratyayātmakatvādanumānamapramāṇam, alātacakre bhramadṛṣṭeḥ puṃso'cakre cakram iti pratyayavaditi
apramāṇādanumānāt paraparikalpitaṃ śābdamapi nāpramāṇāntaraṃ nārthāntaram, apramāṇamevānumānavaditi prakṛtopasaṃhārārthaḥ
1 iti śloko yathā na lakṣaṇaṃ tathedamapi liṅga-liṅginorgamaka-gamyaniyamārthakam
katamat taditi cet, ucyate— yat tvayoktam tathāṅgamityādi

liṅgamaṅgaṃ dhūma-kṛtakatvādi liṅginam agnyanityatvādiviśiṣṭaṃ deśa-śabdādimarthaṃ nātikramya vartate yena rūpeṇa, kena ca nātivartate ? dhūma ityadhūmo na bhavati, kṛtaka ityakṛtako na bhavati ityadhūmākṛtakanivṛttyātmanā nātikrāmati, tenaiva ca rūpeṇānyato vyāvṛttyātmakena gamayati, sattva-dravyādyanekadharmāpi saṃstaistu vyabhicārānna gamayati sattvādisāmānyadharmairiti
liṅginaḥ anubandhinaḥ sāmānyadharmāḥ sattva-dravyatvādayo gamyante gamyante te'pi liṅgena liṅgino ye'nubandhinaḥ
viśeṣā na tu gamyante tasyaiva vyabhicāriṇaḥ
yattūktaṃ na sarvatra liṅgini liṅgaṃ sambhavati yathā agniratra dhūmāt tadidamapyaprekṣyavāditayā
yadi liṅgyeva tat sarvaṃ kathaṃ tasya liṅgaṃ nāsti ? atha nāsti liṅgaṃ kathaṃ tadvān
agnidhūmodāharaṇe ca agniratra iti nirdeśādagnimattvena deśasya sādhyatvādagnimati pradeśe sarvatra dhūmavattvaṃ liṅgamastyeva
viśeṣāstauṣa-kārīṣādayo na gamyante tasyaiva, vyabhicāritvād liṅgasya viśeṣaiḥ sahādṛṣṭatvāt
evaṃ liṅgasyānyavyāvṛttaṃ sāmānyaṃ gamakam, nāvyāvṛttamanyataḥ sattvādi
liṅginaḥ sāmānyaṃ gamyaṃ nivṛttamanagnyādibhyo'gnitvaṃ sattvādi cāgnitvānubaddhamavyabhicārāditi
viśeṣā na tu gamyante tasyaiva vyabhicāriṇaḥ
vyabhicārād viśeṣāstu pratītāḥ pratipādakāḥ || pra॰ 16 1/2 samu॰ 2 | 18 1/2
yattūktaṃ na sarvatra liṅgini liṅgaṃ sambhavati yathā agniratra dhūmāt tadidamapyaprekṣyavāditayā
yadi liṅgyeva tat sarvaṃ kathaṃ tasya liṅgaṃ nāsti ? atha nāsti liṅgaṃ kathaṃ tadvān
agnidhūmodāharaṇe ca agniratra iti nirdeśādagnimattvena deśasya sādhyatvādagnimati pradeśe sarvatra dhūmavattvaṃ liṅgamastyeva
pūrvodāhṛtāḥ sāmānyadharmāḥ sattvādayo liṅgasya dhūmasya na gamayanti, uktakāraṇatvāt
viśeṣāstu kecid liṅgyavinābhāvinaḥ pratītāḥ pratipādakāḥ pāṇḍutva-bahulatvādaya iti

etat punaḥ kathaṃ pūrvavadalakṣaṇam ? ityata āha --kimaṅgamityādi ślokatrayaṃ kṣepaprastāreṇopanyastaṃ samastasya tvaduktasyārthajātasya pūrvoktena na bhavati, na bhavati ityabhavanaparamārthatvāt khapuṣpavadabhāvena gamyagamakaniyamo nāstyeveti gatārtham
yat svārthasyāṃśe'pi darśanād gamakatvaṃ samarthayatoktaṃ na sarvatra liṅgini liṅgaṃ sambhavati iti, tadidamapyaprekṣyavāditayā, na vāditākauśalamityabhiprāyaḥ

liṅgamasyāstīti liṅgi, yadi tat sarvaṃ liṅgi bhasmāṅgārāyoguḍapākādyagnyākhyaṃ vastu kathaṃ tasya liṅgaṃ nāsti liṅgābhāve liṅgitvasyaivābhāvāt ? matvarthīyanirdeśyasya liṅgitvābhyupagamādeva liṅgāstitvamityabhiprāyaḥ
atha nāsti liṅgaṃ kathaṃ tadvān ? liṅgamasyāsti iti liṅgavān liṅgītyarthaḥ, matvarthīyanirdeśyo na bhavitumarhati so'rthastannimittatvābhāvāditi svavacanavirodhi te vacanamiti

idaṃ tāvat praṣṭavyo'sti--agniratra dhūmāt iti idamaḥ pratyakṣaviṣayasya prātipadikasya saptamyantanirdeśe atra iti pratyakṣopalabhyadhūmādhārapradeśābhisambandho dhūmavattvāddhūmāditi yathā agniratra iti dhūmādhārapradeśapratyakṣanirdeśādagneḥ parokṣasya jijñāsitatvāt tadvattvena deśasya ayoguḍāṅgārādyagnau dhūmāsambhavāditi cet, na, agnisattvasya siddhatvāt tadviṣayaliṅgāliṅgatvāt tadaliṅgitvāt pratyakṣāviṣayavat

atra ityabhidheyasya liṅgitvādagnidhūmavattayośca vibhāgavivakṣāyāṃ sādhya- sādhyatvāt, itarathā atra ityanarthako nirdeśaḥ syāt, tasmāt sarvalokaprasiddhe'gnimati pradeśe sādhye sarvatra dhūmavattvaṃ liṅgamastyeva
ayoguḍāṅgārādyagnau dhūmāsambhavāditi cet, na, agnisattvasya siddhatvāt tadviṣayaliṅgāliṅgatvāt tadaliṅgitvāt pratyakṣāviṣayavat
syānmatam--sarvatra liṅgini liṅgaṃ nāsti, ayognau guḍāgnāvaṅgārāgnau ca kanajvalatsvapikanatsvapi dhūmasya pratyakṣata evādarśanāditi

na hi agniratra iti pratijñāyāṃ pratītamagnisāmānyaṃ sādhyate, agnisattāyāḥ pratītatvālloke pratyakṣopalabdhadhūmabalena atra iti deśaviśiṣṭasyāpratyakṣasya sisādhayiṣitatvāt ayoguḍāṅgārabhasmacchannādyagniṣvapi dhūmamātrāyāḥ kasyāścid darśanāt tadavinābhāvāt
tadaliṅgitvāt pratyakṣaviṣayavaditi, te hyayoguḍāṅgārādyagnayo na liṅgino liṅgābhāvāt teṣāṃ tasyāmavasthāyām, deśe ca tasminnatijñātatvāt
na hi te liṅgyante liṅgādarśanād liṅganirapekṣaprasiddheśca, yathā pratyakṣopalabdhikāle
yatra cāsau liṅgaṃ tatra liṅgini deśe siddhatvādeva liṅgam, tatrā'siddheragnitvena deśe liṅgyeveti
ca satsvapi dhūmasya ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt
yadi tvatra liṃgena sambandho vivakṣitastarhi tasminnavijñātatvāt ityapi pāṭho bhavet
syānmatam--ayognyādīnāmapyasiddhatvāt pakṣāntargatatve sati ucyate--na sarvatra liṅgini agnimati dṛśyate dhūma iti
etadayuktam, tadasiddhau pakṣadharmādinirmūlatvāt, teṣāmapyayognyādīnāṃ sādhyatve dhūmaḥ sarvatra dharmiṇyabhāvādavyāpī pakṣadharmo'siddhau vanaspaticaitanye svāpavat syāt
deśaviśeṣānapekṣāgnisāmānyasādhyatve sapakṣābhāvādasādhāraṇatvam atra ityabhidhānavaiyarthyaṃ ca syāt

tanmā bhūditi atra śabdavācyasyāgniviśiṣṭasya dhūmaviśiṣṭatvena svayamātmanaiva ātmanaḥ sādhyatvāt sādhanatvācca liṅgitvaṃ liṅgatvaṃ cetyata āha --atra ityabhidheyasya liṅgitvādagnimaddhūmavattayośca vibhāgavivakṣāyāṃ sādhyasādhanadharmabhāvāditi
sa eva hi pradeśo'gnimattvena sādhyo'pratyakṣāgnikatvāt, sādhanadharmabhāvālliṅgini liṅgasyāsambhavo na sambhavati tayostatraiva pradhānopasarjanabhāvena parasparaṃ niyatabhāvatvāt
vanaspaticaitanye svāpavadū dhūmaḥ sandehahetuḥ syāt pakṣāvyāpisādhanadharmatvāt tatpratipattyādhānādhāradharmabhāvātmakapratyayāvyavasthānakāraṇatvāt sthāṇupuruṣabhāvābhāvapratipattivat
tasmādviśiṣṭadeśasādhyasādhanadharmabhāvād liṅgini sādhye liṅgasya sādhanasya asambhavo na sambhavati, sambhava eva sambhavatītyarthaḥ
kasmāt ? tayostatraiva pradhānopasarjanabhāvena parasparaṃ niyatabhāvatvāt, agniḥ pradhānaṃ dhūmanirvṛttau, dhūmasyāgnipariṇāmatvāt tannirvartyatvāt

upasarjanamagnirdhūmagatau, apratyakṣatvāt tatkāladeśayoḥ, anyathā bhavatyevetyuktatvāt tenānyonyapradhānopasarjanabhāvena niyamena bhavantau tau dharmāvagnidhūmākhyau deśasyaikasya bhedavivakṣāyāṃ sādhya-sādhane bhavataḥ
etaccihnāntargataḥ sāmānya॰ ityata ārabhya 'pratyakṣāgni॰ ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratau dvirbhūtaḥ
sādhanadharmabhāvālliṅgini liṅgasyāsambhavo na sambhavati tayostatraiva pradhānopasarjanabhāvena parasparaṃ niyatabhāvatvāt
vanaspaticaitanye svāpavadū dhūmaḥ sandehahetuḥ syāt pakṣāvyāpisādhanadharmatvāt tatpratipattyādhānādhāradharmabhāvātmakapratyayāvyavasthānakāraṇatvāt sthāṇupuruṣabhāvābhāvapratipattivat
tadvyākhyā --agnimatpradeśaparicicchitsāyāmityādi pūrvaṃ gamakatvena liṅgasya dhūmasya prādhānyaṃ gamyasya liṅgino'gnerguṇabhāvaṃ darśayati yāvat tatsambandhimatpratipattiśceti
tataḥ paraṃ yadi ca tasya deśasyetyādinā nirvṛttāvagneḥ prādhānyaṃ dhūmāprādhānyaṃ ca yāvat talliṅgatāṃ labhata iti
pakṣadharmatva-sapakṣānugati- vipakṣavyāvṛttirūpatāṃ vyākhyāya dhūmasya pūrveṇāgnisādhyatāṃ gamayati
uttareṇāgniviśiṣṭadeśasādhyatvaṃ vyākhyāya tadbalanirvṛttadhūmapratyakṣatāyāṃ trailakṣaṇyena gamakatvaṃ dhūmasya vyācaṣṭe
tayorekavastudharmatvāditi, etaduktaṃ bhavati--sambhavatoreva liṅgaliṅginoḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvo'nvayaprādhānyāt nāpohaprādhānyāt
na cedicchasi tato'niṣṭāpādanasādhanam --nāsambhavan dhūmo liṅgatāṃ labhate, apakṣadharmatvāt
yatra yatrāpakṣadharmatvaṃ tatra tatra talliṅgatvābhāvaḥ, yathā tasmin pradeśe'nagnidhūmāderadhūmāyognyādikāle vā
kiñcānyat, prākcchabde vyākhyātamadhunā liṅge'pyucyate vanaspaticaitanye svāpavadityādi
agnimānayaṃ deśaḥ dhūmavattvāt ityasmin sādhane tvadabhimatyā dhūmaḥ sandehahetuḥ syāt, pakṣāvyāpisādhanadharmatvāt, tadvyākhyā --tatpratipattyādhānetyādi daṇḍakahetuḥ
tasya pratipattistatpratipattiḥ, tasyā ādhānaṃ tatpratipattyādhānam, tasyādhāro dharmaḥ, tasya bhāva ātmā yasya sa bhavati tatpratipattyādhānādhāradharmabhāvātmakaḥ pratyayo yathāsmābhirvyākhyātaḥ
tasya pratyayasyāvyavasthāne kāraṇībhavati sa dhūmastvanmatena pakṣāvyāpisādhanadharmatvāt sarvatra liṅginyabhāvādaniyataliṅgisambhavatvāt
yathā sthāṇāvabhavan vastrasaṃyamanādidharmaḥ puruṣe ca bhavan yattu tadanyatrāyoguḍāṅgārāgnyādāvadarśanaṃ tarkyate dhūmasya tatra darśanābhāve liṅgatvāvyākhyānādadoṣa eva
evaṃ cānenaiva nyāyena yastadviparītaḥ prakāśyaprakāśakatvabhedapāṭhaḥ so'pyasamyak--sambandho yadyapi dviṣṭhaḥ sahabhāvyaṅgaliṅginoḥ

sthāṇuḥ iti pratipattyādhānādhārabhāvātmakapratyayāvyavasthānakāraṇatvāt dviviṣayasandehakṛdekadobhayatrābhāvāt kiṃ sthāṇuḥ syāt kiṃ puruṣaḥ syāt tathā vayonilayanādiḥ puṃsi abhavan sthāṇau bhavannubhayaviṣayaṃ saṃśayaṃ karoti
yatra dṛṣṭastatra niścayahetureva sthāṇau vayonilayanaṃ puruṣe ca vastrasaṃyamanam, tatra bhavanāt
tathāyamapi agniratra dhūmāt iti sandehahetuḥ syāt sādhye bhavanāniyamāt
yattu tadanyatrāyoguḍāṅgārāgnyādāvadarśanaṃ tarkyate dhūmasya tatra darśanābhāve liṅgatvāvyākhyānādadoṣa eva
evaṃ cānenaiva nyāyena yastadviparītaḥ prakāśyaprakāśakatvabhedapāṭhaḥ so'pyasamyak--
