nanu dvigatatvāt sambandhasya saṃyogivalliṅgidharmaṇā liṅgena bhavitavyamiti cet, naitadasti, sambandho yadyapi dviṣṭhaḥ sahabhāvyaṅgaliṅginoḥ
na hi yādṛśī vyāpakadharme vyāptiḥ tādṛśyeva vyāpyadharma iti
dviṣṭhatvāt sambandhasya kathamubhayatraikākāratā vyāpterna syādityāśaṅkya yadyapi ityanena dviṣṭhaṃ sambandhaṃ vāstavamabhyupagamyāpi pratividhatte
aṃgejñarjñānaparasya grahaṇādaṃgyate liṅgyate pratīyate'nena parokṣārtha iti aṅgaṃ liṅgam, tena liṅgaliṅginorityarthaḥ
yathā ādhārādheyabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho dviṣṭho'pi naikarūpayā vṛttyā dvayorvartate
yata evaikasambandhayoge'pi nādhārasyādheyatvamādheyasya vādhāratvaṃ tathā liṅgaliṅginorvyāptirapi dhūmatvādāvanyathā anyathā ca vahnitvādau
ata eva dhūmatvādireva vyāpyatayā gamako na prameyatvādiḥ
vahnitvādireva vyāpyatayā gamyo na tu tārṇatvādirnāpi dhūmo gamyo vahnirgamaka iti
yat tvayedaṃ sādhyādanyatrāyoguḍāṅgārāgnyādāvadarśanaṃ pratyakṣatastarkyate dhūmasya tatra sapakṣe liṅgasya sarvatra darśanābhāve liṅgatvāvyākhyānādadoṣa eva
liṅginyadarśane tu syād doṣaḥ, liṅgī cātra pradeśaḥ pratyakṣadhūmasambandhī, tatra sarvatra dṛśyata eva
tasmād bhrāntavacanametat sarvatra liṅginyadarśanānna dṛṣṭavat pratipattiḥ iti
anenaiva nyāyena darśabalādeva gamayati ityuktena yastadviparītaḥ prakāśyaprakāśakatvabhedapāṭhaḥ so'pyasamyak
katamo'sāviti cet, ucyate --sambandho yadyapi dviṣṭha ityādikārikāḥ sabhāṣyāḥ
tadyathā --nanu dvigatatvāt sambandhasya saṃyogivad liṅgidharmaṇā liṅgena bhavitavyam iti codite naitadasti, sambandho yadyapi dviṣṭhaḥ pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2
yathā hi yathā hi satyapi dvigatatve sambandhasya na kadācidādhāra ādheyadharmā bhavati nāpyādheya ādhāradharmā tathā na kadācilliṅgaṃ liṅgi bhavati liṅgi vā liṅgam
saṃyogī tu yathaikastathā dvitīya iti na tadvadiha

tasmād yadanityārthe'pi kṛtakatvavyāpitvaṃ tenākṛtakatvānavakāśādanityatvena kṛtakatvasyākṛtakatvapratiṣedhena gamyataiva syād na gamakatvam
anityatvasya kṛtakatvena vyāpteḥ anityatvāt tadakṛtakaṃ na ityayamaprastuta evārthaḥ pratīyate iti kriyālopena nirdiśati
yaḥ prastuto nityatvābhāvo'nityatvaṃ sa tena vyāptatvāt kṛtakatvārthe na darśyate
agavārthaṃ na nivartayediti gavārthasya na sādhanamityarthaḥ
vyāpitvāt kṛtakārthe tu nityābhāvo na darśyate ?
iti nirdiṣṭaṃ svārthānumānam pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2 | 19 1/2--24 1/2

tasmād yadanityārthe'pi kṛtakatvavyāpitvaṃ tenākṛtakatvānavakāśādanityatvena kṛtakatvasyākṛtakatvapratiṣedhena gamyataiva syānna gamakatvam

pūrvayā kārikayā kṛtakatvenānityatvaṃ vyāptaṃ na sādhanamavivakṣitatvāt

tadbhāvadarśanaṃ yat tadityādi, sa evāgnirdhūmo bhavati, tenaivāgninā dhūmena bhūyate taddeśendhanādisambaddhena, nānyena ayognyādinā'bādinā vā dhūmena bhūyate, na so'gnirdhūmo na bhavati bhavatyeveti tadbhāvasyāsvanivṛttihetubhāvābhūtasya darśanādeva dhūmo dhūmo bhavannevāgniṃ gamayati, na yatra na dṛṣṭastadavacchedena tvanmatena adhūmo na bhavati yatastasmādanagnirna bhavati iti, tadbhāvāgrahaṇe doṣadarśanāt

ko doṣa iti cet, ucyate --atadabhāvānvayaśabdārthatāyāṃ vidhirūpatadbhāvānvayaśabdārthaviparītakalpanāyām agniratra dhūmāt ityasminnanumāne'gnidhūmavipakṣavyāvṛttimātreṣṭāvaniṣṭam adhūmasya paṭasyābhāvo ghaṭo vandhyāputro vā syāt, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
liṅginyapi tathānagneḥ pavanasyābhāva udakaṃ khapuṣpaṃ vā syādasambaddham, aniṣṭaṃ caitadapi

kiṃ kāraṇam ? tatretyabhūtānvayasādhanārthātathārthatvāt, yatra dhūmastatrāgniḥ ityanvayasahitaḥ sādhanārthastathārthaḥ satyastadbhāvāt tatpradeśasambandhyagnidhūmabhāvāt, anyathā tvadiṣṭātadabhāvātmakasya abhūtānvayasādhanārthasyātathārthatvādanantaranirdiṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiḥ

ata eva tarhi asmadiṣṭatadbhāvadarśanādeva tu sādhyasādhanadharmayoḥ agnidhūmayostathābhūtānvayadarśanahetoḥ saṃyogino- raṅgulyoriva yathaikasya tathā dvitīyasyāpi tadbhāvāviśiṣṭā vṛttiriṣṭā, na tvādhārādheyavadatulyā, yathā ādhāra ādhāra eva, ādheya ādheya eva, na viparyayeṇeti

kasmāt ? dvayorapi liṅgini ādhāre deśendhanādau parasparapratyayādhārādheyapradhānopasarjanabhāvenāvinābhāvāt, prāgvyākhyātanirvartakagamyabhāvena ekavastudharmatvāt, kṛtakānityatvavat, yathā hi prāgabhāva-pradhvaṃsābhāvalakṣaṇa eka eva hyabhūtvā bhavan bhūtvā cābhavan kṛtakaścānityaśca bhāvaḥ sādhya-sādhanākhyāṃ labhate tatheha agni-dhūmākhya eka eva evaṃ ca sapakṣe sādhyasādhanadharmayoḥ sahabhāvadarśanārthamanvayavṛttyā sādharmyadṛṣṭānta ucyate tathāpratyakṣasambandhitvavivakṣāyāḥ

na hi caitrā- sādhya-sādhanavyapadeśaṃ labhate pradeśendhanādirbhāvaḥ

saṃyoginorapi na yathaikasya saṃyogastathā dvitīyasya, saṃyogitvāt, sthāṇvādisaṃyogavat
yadi svatvādinā tataḥ svāmisambandhitvāt svasya svāmyāyattatvāduttarakālaṃ smṛtiranarthikā
liṅgagrahaṇe tulyamiti cet, na, tasya sambandhitvenāgrahaṇāt
anumeyasthaṃ liṅgaṃ dhūmāditvena pūrvaṃ gṛhyate paścāt tasyāgnyādibhiravinābhāvitvaṃ smaryate
svasvāmyādisambandhāt ekasmāt PSV1 śeṣasiddhiranumānamiti yaduktaṃ tadayuktam
na cāgṛhītaḥ sambandho'numānasya kāraṇam, jñānakāraṇatvena tasya jñāpakatvāt
atra cāgnito'pi dhūmānumitiprasaṅgaḥ, sambandhāviśeṣāt, aviśiṣṭo hyagnidhūmayornimittanaimittikasambandhaḥ
iti pramāṇasamuccayavṛttau dvitīye svārthānumānaparicchede PSV1 C.

svādisambandhinaḥ svatvādirūpeṇaiva āhosvid rūpāntareṇa grahaṇaṃ syāt ? yadi svatvādirūpeṇa svam ityevaṃ gṛhyate tarhi svāmisambandhitvāt svasya svāmyabhāve svatvasyānupapatteḥ svāminiścayāpekṣatvāt liṅgadarśanāt pūrvameva svāmipratipattyā bhavitavyam, anyathā idamasya svam ityevaṃ grahaṇaṃ na sambhavati
tataścottarakālaṃ sambandhasmṛtiranarthikā syāt, svāminaḥ prāgeva siddhatvāt śeṣānupapatteḥ
liṅgagrahaṇe tulyamiti yadyavinābhāvitvena liṅgaṃ gṛhyate avinābhāvitvamapi pratiyogyantarāpekṣameveti liṅgagrahaṇāt pūrvameva sādhyapratipattyā bhavitavyam
tathā ca sādhye pratiyogini siddhe sambandhasmṛterānarthakyam
dharmiṇi dhūmādeḥ sattvamātraṃ gṛhyate, na sambandhitvamiti
kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhe hi yathā kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhaḥ śāstre vivecitaḥ tathaivāpratītatvamatra vivakṣitam, na sarvatheti vedyam
śāstre hyekasyaiva bhāvasya svarūpātyāgāt pariṇāmena kāryakāraṇabhāvo vyavasthāpyate
ya evaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhaṃ na pratipādayanti te'pyanyathā taṃ pratipadya avinābhāvitvamātropalabdheranumeyaṃ niścinvanti
yasmāt kāryakāraṇayorekatve idaṃ kāryamidaṃ kāraṇamityetadeva na syāt
nanu kāryakāraṇabhāvatve satyapi na bhedaḥ, traiguṇyajātyabhedādekatvamiti cet; na, kāryakāraṇābhyāṃ bhinnasya traiguṇyasyānupalakṣaṇāt
nityasya krameṇa yugapadvā pariṇāmo na sambhavati

nanu svasvarūpasiddhiḥ svāmyapekṣaiva, tadvyabhicāraḥ kuta iti cet, ayamāśayaḥ--anumānakāla eva svatvena gṛhītaṃ liṅgaṃ pratiyoginaṃ pratipādayati, āhosvit sambandhagrahaṇakāle tathā paricchinnamanumānakāle cānyathopalabhyamānamiti
yadyanumānakāle idamasya svam ityevaṃ niścitaṃ gamakamiṣyate, atrokto doṣaḥ--svāmisambandhitvāt svatvasya pṛ॰ 683 paṃ॰ 31 ityādinā

tasmād dvitīyaṃ darśanamabhyupagantavyam, tataśca vyabhicāraḥ, svasvāminoḥ paramparayā vyatirekabhāvasambhavāt tathā'numātuṃ na śakyate--atrātmanā tat pūrvaṃ svatvena gṛhītaṃ tasmād yatredamasti tatrāsya svāmī niyamena bhavitumarhatīti
bhūpateḥ sampattyādyabhāve'pi kevalasya chatrāderadhipatyabhāve ca darśanasambhavāt
syādetat--svasvāmibhāvādinā sarvaḥ sambandho na gamakaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? yatrāvyabhicāra ityāha --upalabdhasambandhasya netyādi
yadi yathoktasambandhagrahaṇe'pi punarliṅgasya vyabhicāritvamavyabhicāritvaṃ cāpekṣate tato'vinābhāvitvamevānumānasya kāraṇaṃ bhavet, na svasvāmyādisambandhāḥ

avinābhāvasyānumānakāraṇatve syādetat, sa yathoktasambandhe sati bhavati, tato nirdeśa iti cet, tadayuktam, tasmin satyapi tadabhāvāt sambandhasyāviśiṣṭatvāditi nimittanaimittikasambandho dviṣṭha iti sa yathaikatra tathā dvitīye'pīti ubhayatra gamakabhāvaḥ syāt
bhavitavyameveti iti bhavitavyamiti iti vā pāṭhaḥ samyak pratīyate
ata eva caivaṃ vaktumayuktaṃ yathā tvayā yata evaṃ visrabdhamucyate guṇadoṣavicāranirapekṣeṇa niḥśaṅkena
katamadayuktamiti cet, idaṃ tad darśyate'smābhiḥ --yathā hi satyapi dvigatatva ityādi yāvat tadvadiha na bhavatīti saṃyoginoratulya ādhārādheyoriva na bhavatīti
tatra vayaṃ tanna ghaṭata iti brūmaḥ
tadyathā --nanu tadvadeveha ādhārādheyavadeva, saṃyoginorapi liṅgaliṅginordhūmāgnyorna yathaikasya pratyakṣasya saṃyogastathā dvitīyasyāpratyakṣasyeti pakṣaḥ, saṃyogitvāditi hetuḥ

sthāṇvādisaṃyogivaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā hi sthāṇuśyenayoḥ saṃyoginoḥ sthāṇorakarmaṇaḥ śyenasya sakarmaṇaśca saṃyogaḥ sakarmākarmakatvābhyāmatulyaḥ tathā malla-dvyaṅgulākāśādisaṃyogasaṃyogināṃ tathā caitrāśvādīnāmapyatyantapriyavāhanāditvādyupalakṣitatve pratyakṣāpratyakṣāditvainaiva viśeṣa iti
yatrūṇāyattūktamityādi sambandhavādinameva prati ānyāpohikena paryanuyujya yaduktaṃ doṣajātam— tataḥ svāmisambandhitvāt svasya svāmyāyattatvāduttarakālaṃ smṛtiranarthikā

tatsambandhipratyakṣāt tathaivānumānāva- yadi svasvāmibhāvena pratyakṣaḥ sambandhyekastato dvitīyasya svasya svāmino vā tena sahaiva gatatvādanyonyāpekṣatvācca sambandhasya śeṣasiddhyarthaṃ smṛtyānarthakyam

athānyathā, atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti svasvāmitvādibhyo'nyena kenacit prakāreṇa pratyakṣaḥ sambandhyekaḥ tatastatsambandhasmaraṇādanumānamiti manyethāḥ tanna bhavati tasya prakārasyānuktatvāt svasvāmyādibhāvena sambandhāt iti vacanāt sva-svāmibhāvena vā prakṛti-vikārabhāvena vā kāryakāraṇabhāvena vā nimitta-naimittikabhāvena vā mātrā-mātrikabhāvena vā sahacaribhāvena vā vadhya-ghātakabhāvena vā kaścidarthaḥ kasyacidindriyasya pratyakṣo bhavati iti tebhyo'tiriktasyāvacanādeteṣāmeva vacanāditi
tataḥ sambandha॰ iti tatsambandha॰ iti vā pāṭho'pyatra samīcīna eva
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 685 paṃ॰ 3, 20, ṭi॰ 1, pṛ॰ 240 paṃ॰ 12
etasmin parokte doṣajāte parihāraṃ brūmaḥ --na kiñcidatra noktam

dvayostu sambandhinorupalabdhe sambandhe'nyatarapratyakṣatvottarakālamupalabdhacarasambandhānusāriṇī smṛtiḥ kimityanarthikā syāt, agnyapekṣadhūmavat ? evaṃ ca kṛtvoktam--kaścidarthaḥ kasyacidindriyasya pratyakṣo bhavati
tasmādidānīmindriyapratyakṣādarthāt pūrvaṃ samudāye kṛtasambandhamatiraviśiṣṭasyārthasyāstitvaṃ pratipadyate, yathā pūrvaṃ dhūmāgnyoḥ sambandhaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhūmadarśanādagnerastitvaṃ pratipadyate iti
yattu tena pratyucyate--liṅgagrahaṇe tulyamiti cet pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2
ahamapyevaṃ bruve--liṅgisambandhitvālliṅgasya liṅgyapekṣameva liṅgatvamiti yadi liṅgaṃ gṛhītaṃ tena sahaiva liṅgī gṛhītaḥ
yasmāduktabhedāt sambandhādanumānam, tacca tatsambandhipratyakṣāt ekasmāt pratyakṣāt iti vacanāt tenaiva prakāreṇānumānāvatāraṇāt

yathā dhūmaḥ pratyakṣa eko bahula-vartulorddha-pāṇḍutvādiviśeṣeṇāgnyavinābhāvirūpeṇa viśiṣṭaḥ pratyāsanne deśe'gniṃ gamayati viśeṣāṇāmavinābhāvināṃ gamakatvādaśvasyābharaṇa-mardanapriyatvādiviśeṣāścaitrāvinābhāvinaścaitraṃ sambandhādeva gamayanti tathā caitrasya vā viśeṣā ārohaka-poṣaka-tadguṇaraktatvādayo'śvāvinābhāvino'śvaṃ gamayantyevetyupalabdhe sambandhe'nyatarapratyakṣatvottarakālaṃ yatrāyaṃ pratyakṣo'śvaścaitro vā tatretaro'pi iti yā upalabdhacarasambandhānusāriṇī smṛtiḥ sā kimityanarthikā syāt ? naivānarthiketyarthaḥ

yathāgnijanyātmalābho dhūmaḥ proktaviśeṣayukto'gneḥ sambandhasmaraṇāt pratyakṣo'pratyakṣasya sambandhino'numānāyālam, agnirvā pratyakṣo'pratyakṣasya tatpariṇāmatvād bhāvi-bhūtadeśakālasambandhī sambandhina evaikasya pratyakṣatvāt sambandhāddhādekasmāt pratyakṣāccheṣasiddhiranumānam iti vā pāṭhāt sambandhina eva pratyakṣasya samānādhikaraṇokteḥ
dvayostu sambandhinorupalabdhe sambandhe'nyatarapratyakṣatvottarakālamupalabdhacarasambandhānusāriṇī smṛtiḥ kimityanarthikā syāt, agnyapekṣadhūmavat ?
evaṃ ca kṛtvoktam--kaścidarthaḥ kasyacidindriyasya pratyakṣo bhavati
tasmādidānīmindriyapratyakṣādarthāt pūrvaṃ samudāye kṛtasambandhamatiraviśiṣṭasyārthasyāstitvaṃ pratipadyate, yathā pūrvaṃ dhūmāgnyoḥ sambandhaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhūmadarśanādagnerastitvaṃ pratipadyate iti
tulanā kaścidarthaḥ kasyacidindriyasya pratyakṣo bhavati' iti bhāṣyavacanāt
yattu tena pratyucyate--liṅgagrahaṇe tulyamiti cet pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2
ahamapyevaṃ bruve--liṅgisambandhitvālliṅgasya liṅgyapekṣameva liṅgatvamiti yadi liṅgaṃ gṛhītaṃ tena sahaiva liṅgī gṛhītaḥ
evaṃ ca kṛtvoktamityasyaiva lakṣaṇasya bhāṣyaṃ jñāpakamāha kaścidarthaḥ kasyacidindriyasya pratyakṣa ityādi sāmānyavācinā kiṃvṛttena yāvadagnerastitvaṃ pratipadyata iti
avaśiṣṭasyāviśiṣṭasyeti vā pāṭhaḥ, avaśiṣṭasya apratyakṣasya, aviśiṣṭasya darśanakālatulyasya taddeśavartino veti
svāmisambandhitvāt svasya svāmyapekṣameva svatvamityuttarakālaṃ smṛterānarthakyaṃ prāptam ityatra tena ānyāpohikena pratyucyate paramatamāśaṅkya --liṅgagrahaṇe tulyamiti cet
syānmatam— smṛterānarthakyaṃ sva-svāmyādisambandhipratyakṣatvāt ityetalliṅga-liṅginoḥ sambandhāviśeṣāt samānaṃ doṣajātamiti
tat tathaiva, yadyeṣa doṣaḥ syāt svasvāmyāditve liṅge'pi syādevāyaṃ liṅgaliṅginoranyonyāpekṣatvāt
atha tatra neṣyate, svasvāmyādiṣvapi mā bhūditi suṣṭhacyate --ahamapyevaṃ bravebruve, kasmāt ? liṅgi yattūcyate--na, tasya sambandhitvenāgrahaṇāt
liṅgamanumeyasthaṃ pūrvaṃ dhūmāditvena gṛhyate paścāttasyāgnyādibhiravinābhāvitvaṃ smaryate pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2
tadihāpi tulyam, anumeyasthaṃ svaṃ pūrvaṃ gṛhyate paścāt tatrasthaścaitro'vinābhāvīti smaryate na taddeśasambandhīti, deśādisthānagnidhūmavat
dṛṣṭaḥ svasvāmyādisambandhānabhijñānāmapi avinābhāvitvamātropalabdherniścayaḥ, na cāgṛhītaḥ sambandho'numānasya kāraṇam, jñānakāraṇatvena tasya jñāpakatvāt pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2
etadayuktam, avinābhāvitvasya sahacaribhāvasambandhatvāt tasmādapi yo niścayaḥ so'pi svāmyādyarthavyutpannānāmeva bhavati tadāditvāt sahacaribhāvasya
sambadhitvālliṅgasyetyādi tattulyatvapradarśanaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvad liṅgī gṛhīta iti

athānyathā tannoktamiti, yathānyāṃstvamuddhaṭṭayasi svāmyāditvenāgrahaṇe'nyathā grahaṇaṃ cet tannoktamiti tathā vayamapi tvāmuddhaṭṭayāmaḥ--anyathā liṅge grahaṇaṃ svasvāmyādiṣu anyatheti cenmanyase tannoktamiti
liṅgamanumeyasthaṃ pūrvaṃ dhūmāditvena gṛhyate paścāttasyāgnyādibhiravinābhāvitvaṃ smaryate pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2
tadihāpi tulyam, anumeyasthaṃ svaṃ pūrvaṃ gṛhyate paścāt tatrasthaścaitro'vinābhāvīti smaryate na taddeśasambandhīti, deśādisthānagnidhūmavat
dṛṣṭaḥ svasvāmyādisambandhānabhijñānāmapi avinābhāvitvamātropalabdherniścayaḥ, na cāgṛhītaḥ sambandho'numānasya kāraṇam, jñānakāraṇatvena tasya jñāpakatvāt pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2
etadayuktam, avinābhāvitvasya sahacaribhāvasambandhatvāt tasmādapi yo niścayaḥ so'pi svāmyādyarthavyutpannānāmeva bhavati tadāditvāt sahacaribhāvasya
atra yattūcyate tvayā--mā maṃsthā liṅgagrahaṇe tulyamiti, liṅge tvasti viśeṣaḥ --na, tasya sambandhitvenāgrahaṇāt

na hi liṅgaṃ sambandhitvamātreṇa gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi ? anumeyadeśasthaṃ dhūmāditvena pūrvaṃ gṛhyate, paścāt tasyāgnyādibhiravinābhāvitvaṃ smaryate, ādigrahaṇācchabdasya kṛtakāditvena prāg grahaṇaṃ paścādanityatvāvinābhāvitvena smaryata iti sarvatra vyāpīti

deśādisthānagnidhūmavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā'gnirabhavan dhūmo deśādisthaḥ prāg gṛhyate pratyakṣo'pratyakṣāgneranyatvāt tataḥ paścāt agniriha ityanusmaryate tathāśvaḥ svaṃ caitrādanyo gṛhyate grāmādisthaḥ tataḥ paścāt tatrasthaścaitro'vinābhāvīti smaryate ihāgniḥ iti dhūmasambandhyagnismaraṇavaditi tulyamiti
svasvāmyādisambandhena sambandhāccheṣasiddhiranumānam ityasya lakṣaṇasya doṣastenoktaḥ, atra brūmaḥ --ayuktamidam

kasmāt ? avyutpannasya tadgaterityādi tanmatapratyuccāraṇaṃ yāvajjñāpakatvāditi, svasvāmyādisambandhānabhijñā api dhūmādagnimavinābhāvasambandhād niścinvanto dṛśyante, sa ca mā bhūdagṛhītasambandhatvānniścayaḥ, jñānakāraṇatvaṃ hi jñāpakasya hetorliṅgādergṛhītasvarūpasya notpādakabījādivaditi
kasmāt ? avinābhāvitvasya sahacaribhāvasambandhatvāt, na vinā bhavati saha bhavati saha caratītyeko'rthaḥ
tasmādapi sahacaribhāvasambandhād yo niścayaḥ so'pi svāmyādyarthavyutpannānāmeva bhavati, nāvyutpannānām
kasmāt ? tadāditvāt svasvāmyāditvāt sahacaribhāvasya, saptānāṃ sambandhānā avinābhāvagamyātiriktārthaviṣayatvena tu sahacaribhāvādṛte'pi svasvāmyādisambandhavyutpannabuddherevānumānaṃ dṛśyate
paścāt tatpratipattiḥ svasvāmisambandhena bhavati kokilaśāvako'yam, tatsvabhāṣāsamanvitatvāt, itarakokilavat
evaṃ svasvāmyādisambandhā anumāpakāḥ, anumeyavyaktikāle tathopalabhyamānatvāt, tatprasiddhaliṅgavat
sa ca sahacaribhāvo'vinābhāvo gṛhyamāṇa evānumānakāraṇaṃ jñātajñānotpattihetutvājjñāpakasya
paścāt tatpratipattiḥ svasvāmisambandhena bhavati kokilaśāvako'yam, tatsvabhāṣāsamanvitatvāt, itarakokilavat
evaṃ svasvāmyādisambandhā anumāpakāḥ, anumeyavyaktikāle tathopalabhyamānatvāt, tatprasiddhaliṅgavat
athavā vināpyavinābhāvitvena svasvāmyādivyutpatteranumetyata āha --avinābhāvagamyātiriktā- rthaviṣayatvena tvityādi yāvaditarakokilavaditi sādhanenopasaṃhāro'syārthasya
vyāpako yaḥ sa evāṃśo grāhyo vyāpyastu sūcakaḥ

ityetallakṣaṇavaiparītyena sahacaribhāvādṛte'pi svasvāmyādisambandhavyutpannabuddherevānumānaṃ dṛśyate, tadyathā— kākabhavanetyādi samāsadaṇḍako vyāpaka-vyāpyatvābhyāṃ sahacaribhāvapradarśane yāvad vyāpitvāvinābhāvirūpopetatāyāmapīti, kākājjanma vyāpīti tatsvīkṛtastatprasavakālaḥ, tatkṛtanīḍaprasavaḥ, aṇḍabhedaḥ, vivṛddhiḥ, kākena kākyā ca poṣaṇaṃ vātsalyena, tasya dvitīyena kākaśāvakena sahacaraṇam, kākyāḥ pṛṣṭhato gamanamityetāni pūrvapūrvakāṇi vyāpakāni sādhyāni uttarottarāṇi vyāpyāni sādhakābhimatāni avinābhāvasambandhīni dharmāntarāṇi santyapi na kāraṇāni tāni kokilatvajñānasya

yāvadā kutaḥ ? svasvāmibhāvapratyavagamanādārāt, yāvat svasvāmisambandhaṃ nāvaiti tāvat kokilatvāpratipatteḥ paścāt tatpratipattiḥ svasvāmisambandhena bhavati, tata uttarakālaṃ kokilaśāvako'yaṃ na kākaśāvakaḥ iti parityajyāvinābhāvyabhimatāṃstāṃstān dharmān vyāpakān vyāpyāṃśca tathā loke pratipattāro vaktāraśca bhavanti, kokilaśāvako'yam ityanumimate ca tatsvabhāṣāsamanvitatvāt viśiṣṭamādhuryopetasvaratvāt, itarakokilavaditi
vyāpako yaḥ sa evāṃśo grāhyo vyāpyastu sūcakaḥ
ato'tra sādhanaṃ saṃhatārthamucyate --evaṃ svasvāmyādisambandhā anumāpakā itthamuktanyāyena
kasmāt ? anumeyavyaktikāle tathopalabhyamānatvāt, anumeyasya agni-kokilā-'nityatvāderarthasya vyaktikāle tenaiva svasvāmyādiprakāreṇopalabhyamānatvāt
kimiva ? tatprasiddhaliṅgavat, tena tena prakāreṇa prasiddhaṃ dhūmādiliṅgaṃ tasya sambandhino'numāpakamagnyādeḥ svasvāmyādiprakāreṇaiva sambandhāt, yathā kokilaśāvakastajjātīyānukārisvareṇaiveti
upalabdhasambandhasya na punaravyabhicārāpekṣānumitiryuktā, tasyaivābhivyañjakatvāpatteḥ pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2
pratyakṣetarasambandhyanumeyaḥ pratyakṣādyaviruddhārthaḥ pakṣo dharmadharmisamudāyākhyo nirdoṣa evānena śeṣasiddhivacanena gṛhītaḥ
yathāyogaṃ sambandhādekasmāt pratyakṣāt pratyakṣavadvā prasiddhāt pakṣadharmasambandhāccheṣeṇa śeṣasya siddhiriti śeṣasiddhivacanādeva viruddhāsādhāraṇadharmavyudāsaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati--svasvāmyādisambandhādanumānaṃ na bhavati, tadavyabhicārārthaṃ viśeṣākāṅkṣitvāt upalabdhe'pi sve svāmini vāśve caitre vā svatantrajīvadatyantāviyogā ākāṅkṣyante
teṣāmevāvyabhicārāt ta eva hi anumāpakāḥ syuḥ, na svasvāmyādisambandhaḥ satyapi tasminnanumānābhāvād vyabhicārīti

evaṃ pratyuccārya ācārya uttaramāha --etadapi na, śeṣasiddhivacanenāvyabhicārividhivṛtterupāttatvāt, sambandhādekasmāt pratyakṣāccheṣasiddhiranumānam ityasmin svārthānumānalakṣaṇe śeṣasiddhivacanena vidhivṛttiravyabhicāriṇyevopāttā, tasmādayamadoṣaḥ
tat kathamiti bhāvyata iti cet, ucyate --idaṃ hi sarvābhāsavyudāsenetyādi

pratyakṣāditaraḥ śeṣaḥ sambandhī svādinā viśiṣyamāṇo deśādiḥ sambandhyate'numeyo'numānābhāsabhedaiḥ pratyakṣādivirodhairaviruddhārthaḥ pakṣo dharmadharmisamudāyākhya uttaratrāvayavavidhāne parārthānumāne vītākhye sādhyābhidhānam iti vakṣyamāṇo nirdoṣa evānena śeṣasiddhivacanena gṛhītaḥ
yathāyogaṃ sva-svāmi-nimitta-naimittikādiṣu tena tena sambandhena sambandhāt pratyakṣāditi pratyakṣasya dharmādupalabdhāt prasiddhāditi yāvat
tatraiko yaḥ pratyakṣaḥ sa pakṣadharmaḥ, śeṣo'numeyaḥ

kṛtakatvādyapratyakṣatvādavyāpīti cet, ata āha --pratyakṣavadvā, pratyakṣavat pratyakṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tasmāt prasiddhatvāt, sambandhī pakṣadharmo'śvaḥ svam, tasya pakṣadharmasya sambandhāt prāgupalabdhādanusmaryamāṇāccheṣeṇa śeṣasya caitrasya siddhiriti śeṣasiddhivacanādeva viruddhāsādhāraṇadharmavyudāsaḥ yatra yatrāśvaḥ svaṃ tatra tatra devadattaḥ svāmī ityatyantāviyogādisambandhānvayayuktatvāt sapakṣavṛttiḥ vipakṣa eva vā vṛttiḥ kutaḥ ? śeṣāya śeṣe vā pratyakṣādekasmāt sambandhāt ityetāvatā siddhe siddhivacanaṃ siddhireva nāsiddhiḥ ityavadhāraṇāt prameyatvād nityaḥ iti sādhāraṇānaikāntikavadasiddhirmā bhūditi
pratyakṣāt prasiddhādityarthaḥ tataḥ pratyakṣāt pratyakṣakāryāccānyasyāpi jñānasya viṣaye liṅge pratyakṣavyapadeśo bhavati
itthaṃ hi vyabhicāriviśeṣavyāvartanenāpi sa eva sambandhī gamakaḥ sambandhyantarasya
na hi vātyāprasaṅgavyāvartanena dhūmasya vyañjakatvam, bahveva hyavātyā ghaṭapaṭādi; na hi tadvadagneragamako dhūmaḥ
tathā kṛtakatvasya anityatvopalabdhasambandhasya anityatvāvyabhicārapradarśanārthaṃ vyatireka ucyate
yadyupalabdhasambandhasya punaravyabhicāritvāpekṣamanumānaṃ na syāt vyatirekavacanaṃ na syāt
itthaṃ hi vyabhicāriviśeṣavyāvartanenāpi sa eva sambandhī dhūmādiraśvādirvā gamakaḥ sambandhyantarasya pratyakṣo'numeyasya dvitīyasyaikaḥ sambandhyantarasya sambandhitvāt

na te viśeṣā vyāvartyā vidheyā vā gamakāḥ tatsamarthanārthatvāt, yathā na hi vātyāprasaṅgavyāvartanena dhūmasya vyañjakatvam, adhūmo vātyā, sā na bhavatyayaṃ dhūmaḥ iti vātyāyāṃ nivartitāyāmagnerna gamako bhavati dhūmo yatrādṛṣṭastadvya- vacchedamātreṇa, yasmād bahvevāvātyā ghaṭa-paṭādi, na hi tadvadagneragamako dhūmaḥ, na vā'vātyeti vyañjakaṃ gamakamagnerbhavitumarhati ghaṭapaṭādyadhūmatāyāmasatyāmeva, kiṃ tarhi ? dhūmataiva hi satī vahnitāyāḥ sambandhinī sambandhinyā vyañjiketi
vidhirūpā dhūmataiva gamikā, na tvadhūmatāyā abhāvaḥ
na hi vātyādigatā yā adhūmatā tadabhāvavattve'pi ghaṭapaṭāderagnigamakatvaṃ dṛśyate
yadi tvayamāśayo na rocate tadā na vā'vātyeti vyañjakaṃ gamakamagnerbhavitumarhati ghaṭapaṭādi dhūmatāyāmasatyāmeva iti pāṭhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ

kiñcānyat, tvayāpīṣyata etat prasiddhasambandhyevāprasiddhasambandhino gamakakaṃ yadavyabhicārasvarūpāvadhāraṇārthaṃ vyabhicāriviśeṣavyāvṛttirucyata ityatastatpradarśanārthamāha --tathā kṛtakatvasyetyādi

anityaḥ śabdaḥ, kṛtakatvāt, yad yat kṛtakaṃ tat tadanityam iti sambandhavidhinā pradarśya kṛtakatvasyaivānityatvāvyabhicārapradarśanārthaṃ yadanityaṃ na bhavati tat kṛtakamapi na bhavati' iti vyatireka ucyate, yadyupalabdhasambandhasya punaravyabhicāritvāpekṣamanumānaṃ na syāt vyatirekavacanaṃ pakṣadharmasādhyānugatisamarthanārthaṃ na syāt, tattu dṛṣṭam, nāpi ca tasyaiva vyatirekavacanasyābhivyañjakatvamāpadyate
tathā ca evaṃ ca kṛtvāsmannyāyena kṛtakatvasyānityatvopalabdhasambandhasya vyatireke punaravyabhicārāpekṣā'numitiryuktā, na tu tvanmatena
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasyaivābhivyañjakatvavyakteḥ, yo'sau punaravyabhicāraḥ sa tasyaiva pakṣadharmasyābhivyañjakatvamabhivyanakti, na svayamevānukaṃpākampate
tvayā na jñātamanumānasvarūpaṃ sat mayā jñātam
yathā tvamāha tathā sambandhānumānaikadeśasya bhāṣyamātramevedam, tadanatiriktārthatvāt, vṛddhirādaijarthavyākhyānavat
so'tra sa ityapratyakṣo'gnicaitrānityatvādidharmaḥ atra iti pradeśe pratyakṣād dhūmāśvakṛtakatvādeḥ pakṣadharmāt sādhyārthaḥ pakṣo'vagamyatām
tadvatsattvāditi hetuḥ, so'smin sambandhī vahnicaitraśabdādirastīti tadvān dhūmāśvakṛtakatvādiḥ, sa eva dharmaḥ san tasya bhāvāt tadvatsattvāt
yatra yatra tadvatsattvaṃ tatra tatra so'sti, pūrvavat, yathā pūrvottaradhūmādiragnyādinā sambandhāt tatsvāmika eva tathehāpītyevamādīnāmupalakṣaṇārthaṃ caitrāśvodāharaṇamiti
tvayā na jñātamanumānasvarūpaṃ sat mayā jñātam
yathā tvamāha tathā sambandhānumānaikadeśasya bhāṣyamātramevedam, tadanatiriktārthatvāt, vṛddhirādaijarthavyākhyānavat
kasmāt ? ādhārādheyasaṃyogivadvṛttyabhedāt, ādhārādheyavadvṛtteḥ saṃyogivadvṛtteścābhedāt yattvayoktam --ādhārādheyavadvṛttistasya saṃyogivanna tu pra॰ samu॰ iti, tasya vyāvartitatvāt
kiñcānyat, asmadabhihitestu pūrvatvāt, dinna-vasubandhvādibhyo buddhācca pūrvakālatvāt kāpilasya tantrasya ārhataikadeśanayamatānuhāritvācca tadanumānasya taccāsmanmatopajīvanameva
tvayā na jñātamanumānasvarūpaṃ sat mayā jñātamiti

bhāṣyamātramevedamiti pakṣaḥ, sambandhānumānaikadeśasyaivaitallakṣaṇasya bhāṣyamātraṃ tvatprayāsaphalam, tadanatiriktārthatvāt, yad yato'natiriktārthavyākhyānaṃ tat tadekadeśasyaiva bhāṣyamātram yathā vṛddhiritīyaṃ saṃjñā bhavati ādaicāṃ varṇānām, saṃjñādhikāraḥ saṃjñāsampratyayārthaḥ ityādi vṛddhirādaic pā॰ 1
1 ityasya, tathedaṃ tvadīyamavinābhāvasambandhavyutpādanamasmajjñātasya sambandhānumānaikadeśasya bhāṣyamātram, tadapi sarvaṃ na viditamityabhiprāyaḥ
ata āha --evaṃ ca dravyārthāsatyopādhisatyārthavyākhyānujñā kṛtā tvayā sāmānyopasarjano viśeṣaḥ śabdārthaḥ iti dravyārthasyāpyanujñānādabhyupagataṃ bhavati dravyārthavādimatānumānalakṣaṇānujñānāt
tasyāṃ cāsatyopādhisatyārthavyākhyānujñāyāṃ liṅgino liṅgatvaṃ prasaktam ityasyābhāvaḥ, na pādhisatyārthavyākhyānujñā kṛtā tvayā
tasyāṃ ca nahi liṅgino liṅgatvaṃ prasañjayituṃ śakyam
tathāpi syāt vivakṣābhedāt tathā tathā svasvāmyādigamyagamakatvāt
tadyathā devadatta yajñadattayoḥ saṃyuktayoranyonyaṃ liṅgatvaṃ liṅgitvaṃ ca bhavati tathā svasvāmyādiṣu
yat punaridamuktam--yasya tvavinābhāvitvaṃ sambandho'bhimatastasyāyamadoṣaḥ pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2
hi liṅgino'pratyakṣasya liṅgatvaṃ pratyakṣatvaṃ prasañjayituṃ śakyamṛddhimadbhirbuddha-bodhisattvādibhirapi yathokto'smābhiravyatikara iti
tasyāṃ ca nahi liṅgino liṅgatvaṃ prasañjayituṃ śakyam
tathāpi syāt vivakṣābhedāt tathā tathā svasvāmyādigamyagamakatvāt
tadyathā devadatta yajñadattayoḥ saṃyuktayoranyonyaṃ liṅgatvaṃ liṅgitvaṃ ca bhavati tathā svasvāmyādiṣu
yat punaridamuktam--yasya tvavinābhāvitvaṃ sambandho'bhimatastasyāyamadoṣaḥ pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 2

na hi liṅgasya liṅgitve liṅgino vā liṅgatve kaścid doṣo'sti vivakṣābhedāt tathā tathā sva-svāmyādigamyagamakatvāt, svaṃ vā gamyatvena gamakatvena vā vivakṣyeta svāmī vā yadā tadā vivakṣitasyānyatarasya gamyatvaṃ gamakatvaṃ vā yathāvivakṣaṃ dṛśyate, tadyathā--devadattetyādi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā kasmiṃścit kāle'nyatarakarmaṇā devadatto yajñadattena yukto bhavati yajñadatto vā devadattena tayoścānyonyaṃ liṅgatvaṃ liṅgitvaṃ ca paryāyeṇa vivakṣāvaśād bhavati yugapadvobhayakarmajasaṃyogitvāt tathā svasvāmyādiṣviti
tathāhītyādi rājño viśeṣitasya lājapeyātaraṇaṃ tatkaraṇājñayetyādi gatārthamagninā dhūmānumānamiti

nāgneḥ pūrvaṃ paścādvā dhūmaḥ saṃyogī na dhūmo vāgneriti matvā'niṣṭamāpādyate --agnito'pi dhūmānumitiprasaṅga iti; kiṃ tarhi ? tatkāla eva cāgnyupalabdhikāla eva dhūmo'sti iti bhavatyevāniṣṭāpādanamidaṃ vyatikaraprasaṅga iti
atrocyate --na, asambhavāt, na sambandhāviśeṣādagniliṅgatvaṃ dhūmaliṅgitvaṃ ca prāptam, kiṃ tarhi ? pratyakṣatvāddhūmo'sādhyaḥ sādhanaṃ tu, sādhyastvagnirapratyakṣatvādanumeyatvādasādhanam
dhūmo'pi sādhyaścet pratyakṣamapramāṇaṃ syāt tadaprāmāṇye cānumā nirbījā syāt
kiñcānyat, saṃyogyekarūpatvānumānāccāniṣṭāpādanam agnito'pi dhūmānumānaprasaṅgaḥ iti yadetad bhavatsādhanametadanapekṣitārtham
yat punaridamityādi svapakṣe doṣābhāvapradarśanārthaṃ yaduktaṃ tvayā yasya tvavinābhāvitvamityādi agryādisambandhī...
itthamuktvā yat punaridamucyate--agnito'pi dhūmānumitiprasaṅgaḥ iti nyāyadigmūḍhena tat
iha deśasādhyatāmuktvā liṅgiliṅgatattvavyavasthānavṛtterevaṃ vaktavyam— agnimato'pi dhūmavadanumāprasaṅgaḥ...
dhūmavattvasya hi liṅgatvaṃ yuktam, liṅgitvamapi taddeśavivakṣāyā agnimattvaviśiṣṭasya deśasyaiva
ata eva mayā tatpradhānamevocyate--agnito'pi dhūmānumitiprasaṅga iti

vayaṃ tu brūmo'tra guṇadoṣābhimāna ityādi sādhya-sādhanadharmavaddeśādyanumeyatvamuktvā punastasyaiva doṣābhidhānādapratyabhijñātam agnyādisambandhītyādinā tvayaivābhyupagatamiti darśayati tasyaiva deśasya liṅgatvaṃ liṅgitvaṃ ca na dharmayoragnidhūmayoriti yāvad liṅgīti tvanmatamevedamiti pratyabhijñāpayati
itthamuktvā yat punaridamucyate--agnito'pi dhūmānumitiprasaṅgaḥ iti nyāyadigmūḍhena tat
iha deśasādhyatāmuktvā liṅgiliṅgatattvavyavasthānavṛtterevaṃ vaktavyam— agnimato'pi dhūmavadanumāprasaṅgaḥ...
dhūmavattvasya hi liṅgatvaṃ yuktam, liṅgitvamapi taddeśavivakṣāyā agnimattvaviśiṣṭasya deśasyaiva
ata eva mayā tatpradhānamevocyate--agnito'pi dhūmānumitiprasaṅga iti
dhūmavattvaviśiṣṭasya hi deśasyaiva liṅgatvaṃ yuktam ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt
itthamuktvā yat punaridamucyate--agnito'pi dhūmānumitiprasaṅga iti, nyāyadigmūḍhena taditi

kathaṃ punaramūḍhā bruvata iti cet, brūmastvāṃ śikṣāṃ grāhayantaḥ, tadyathā --iha deśasādhyatāmuktvā liṅgiliṅgatattvavyavasthānavṛtterevaṃ vaktavyamityādi, tāṃ nyāyavyavasthāmanuvartamānena tvayetthaṃ vaktavyam agnimato'pi dhūmavadanumāprasaṅga ityādyupadeśagrantho yāvadubhayato'pi tanmatubarthasya tathā tatheṣṭavadvṛtteriti tatkāraṇoktim
dhūmaviṣaya etadeva syād dhūma eva deśaviśeṣānapekṣo'numāpakaḥ syādagnireva vānumeyastadā'gnito dhūmānumānaṃ dhūmādagnyanumānavat syāt prasaṅgaḥ saṃyoginoraviśeṣāt
atha punardeśasya sādhyasādhanatvaṃ nāsti doṣagandho'pīti ityapi pāṭhaḥ sambhavet
dhūmavattvadharmaviśiṣṭasya deśasyaiva liṅgatvaṃ yuktam, dhūmavattvena siddhasya tasya sādhakatvāt
liṅgitvamapi taddeśavivakṣāyā hetoḥ agnimattvaviśiṣṭasya deśasyaiva liṅgitvaṃ yuktam
agniviṣaye tu deśe liṅgatvaṃ na yuktam, kiṃ kāraṇam ? na hyagnimattvasya yuktaṃ liṅgatvaṃ sādhyatvāt, sādhyatvaṃ liṅgitvāt, liṅgitvamasiddhatvāt
asmanmatena tu liṅgatvamapi agnimattvaviśiṣṭasya deśasyaiva śakyaṃ bhāvayitum, agnipratyakṣatve dhūmāpratyakṣatve ca kadācit
ata eva mayā tatpradhānameva deśapradhānamevocyate--agnito'pi dhūmānumitiprasaṅga iti
na cāsau liṅgī bhavitumarhati loke siddhatvādananumeyatvāt
na dharmī dharmiṇā sādhyo na dharmastena dharmyapi
dharmeṇa dharmaḥ sādhyastu sādhyatvāddharmiṇastathā || pra॰ samu॰ 3 | 13
upacārādevedamucyata iti cet, atra tattvaṃ mṛgyate, suhṛtsūpacāraḥ...
atrāha --nanvevaṃ deśamupekṣya anādṛtya agnereva liṅgitvaṃ syād bhavituṃ yogyam
atrocyate --na cāsau liṅgī bhavitumarhati agniḥ, kasmāt ? loke siddhatvāt, ato'nanumeyatvāt
tathā coktaṃ tvayā yathāsmanmataṃ dharmaviśiṣṭo dharmyeva sādhyaḥ sādhanaṃ ca ityatra tvadvacanameva jñāpakam
na dharmī dharmiṇā sādhyo yathāgnirdhūmena, siddhatvādagnestaddharma- tvābhāvād dhūmasya
na dharmo dharmiṇā iti vartate, yathāgninoṣṇasparśaḥ, siddhatvāt taddharmatvābhāvācca
tena dharmyapi tena dharmeṇā'nantaranirdiṣṭena vibhaktipariṇāmanirdeśāt dharmyapi na sādhyaḥ, yathā--asti pradhānam, bhedānāmanvayadarśanāditi, dharmyasiddhereva dharmāsiddheḥ
nanu dharmayorapi parasparaṃ dharmatvāsiddhirdharmitvābhāve, tasmādayuktaṃ sādhya-sādhanatvamiti
netyucyate sādhyatvāddharmiṇastathā, tena prakāreṇa tathā anekadharmaṇo dharmiṇo vastunaḥ sisādhayiṣitadharmaviśiṣṭasya sādhyatvāt siddhadharmaviśiṣṭasya sādhanatvāt
tathā cāha --sādhyatvāpekṣayā cātra dharma-dharmivyavasthā na guṇa-guṇitvenetyadoṣaḥ iti
syānmatam--satyam, paramārthato liṅgaliṅgibhāva ekasya vastunaḥ siddhasādhyadharmaviśiṣṭasya tathāpi upacārakṛtāddharmabhedād bhinnamivābhinnamapyucyate iti
etaccāyuktam, yasmādatra tattvaṃ mṛgyate suhṛtsūpacāra ityādi yāvat sādhyatvadhatvāddharmiṇastatheti gatārthaṃ savyākhyānam
tadupasaṃhṛtya tvāṃ prati yadasiddhaṃ prastutamagnimaddeśaliṅgatvaṃ tat sādhayāmaḥ
dṛṣṭāntaḥ --dhūmavattvasvātmavadeva, yathā dhūmavattvaṃ svātmā deśasya tadananyatvāt liṅgaṃ tathāgnimattvasvātmā tadananyatvāddeśasya liṅgameva, tadananyatvaṃ ca pratipāditameveti
athātra kiṃ pratipattavyaṃ dhūmaliṅgādagnipratipattivadagnerapi dhūmapratipattiḥ syāt
atha kiṃviṣayaḥ sampradhāraḥ ? darśitanyāyadeśasādhyatāyā yuktameva liṅgasya liṅgino vā liṅgitvaṃ liṅgatvaṃ vā
atrāha --nāgnimattvasya liṅgatvaṃ vyabhicāritvāt, vyabhicarati hyagnimattvaṃ pradeśasya dhūmavattvādṛte'pi deśāntare kālāntare cāyoguḍāṅgārādiṣu dṛṣṭatvāt
kimiva ? prameyatvavat, yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ, prameyatvāt, ākāśavat ityukte prameyatvaṃ ghaṭādāvanitye vināpi nityatvena dṛṣṭaṃ tathā agnimattvaṃ dhūmavattveneti vyabhicāritvādananyatvasyāsādhakatvam
dhūmavattvasya tu bhavati agnimattvena vinā na dṛṣṭatvāditi

dhūmasya hi vastutvena ātmalābhenaivānumānabhūtenāgnyavinābhūtena liṅgatvaṃ niyataṃ pāṇḍutvabahulatvāvicchinnamūlatvādirūpeṇa dhūmatvaniścayakareṇa, tatra liṅgitvadoṣaprasaṅgasyāvatāra eva nāsti pratyakṣatvāt siddhatvādeva liṅgatvāt
avyabhicāritvopapādanenetyādi, yadi tu agnimattvaṃ prameyatvavad dhūmaṃ vyabhicaret tato dhūmasya dhūmatvameva sandihyeta bāṣpanīhārādibhāvenābaddhamūlāditvāt
tasmāt sandigdhāsiddho hetuḥ syāddhūmaḥ, kuto'sya liṅgatvam ? agnyavinābhāvitvenaiva tu baddhamūlatvādirūpeṇa dhūmatvasiddheḥ syāt pakṣadharmatvālliṅgatvam, tathāgnerapi dhūmasiddhau liṅgatvam
itara āha --athātra kiṃ pratipattavyaṃ dhūmaliṅgādagnipratipattivadagnerapi dhūmapratipattiḥ syāt, vastuno liṅgaliṅgitvāviśeṣāt
ācāryo'trāpi aviśeṣamāpādayitukāmastameva vācayituṃ cāha --atha kiṃviṣayaḥ sampradhāra iti
itara āha --darśitanyāyadeśasādhyatatāyā hetoḥ, darśito'yaṃ nyāyaḥ--deśa evāgnimattvena sādhyaḥ sādhanaṃ dhūmavattveneti
tasmāt yuktameva liṅgasya liṅgino vā liṅgitvaṃ liṅgatvaṃ vā, na virudhyata etat
satyapi saṃyogitvāviśeṣe dhūmasaṃyogitvamevāgnergamakaṃ dṛṣṭam yatra yatra dhūmastatra tatrāgniḥ iti
tasmādagneranyathā saṃyogitvamanyathā dhūmasya, yasmād na hi sarvatretyādi yatra yatrāgnistatra tatra dhūmaḥ iti āśaṅkyamanumānam anugamābhāvāt sarvatrāgnau dhūmābhāvāt

mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti deśāsādhyateṣyate, tasyāṃ ca deśāsādhyatāyāmapi siddhasādhananyāyavirodhadoṣaḥ dhūmādagniḥ iti agneḥ siddhatvāt sādhyatvenepsitaḥ pakṣaḥ nyāyamukha॰ iti lakṣaṇānavatāraḥ prakāśitaprakāśanavacca vaiyarthyamiti
agnisādhanavadeva hi dhūmasādhane'pi vināgninā dhūmasya dṛṣṭatvād vyabhicārād nānumānasambhavaḥ
sambhāvyate tu dhūmadarśanāt agniratra iti agnidarśanādvā dhūmo'tra iti, agne randhanagṛhatvavat
agniratra iti pratijñāyām agnirevātra iti nāvadhāryate tāvat tatra pṛthivīndhanādisadbhāvāt
nāpi agniratra bhavatyeva ityavadhāryate sadāgnidhūmābhāvāt tatra
tasmād vivakṣite deśe kāle bhavatyagniriti pratijñārthaḥ, avyutpattividhyanavadhṛteḥ, raktamidaṃ karavīrapuṣpam iti pratijñāvat
vāsagṛhe'panītāgnike dhūmo'gninā vinā dṛṣṭo'raṇinirmathane vā'bhūtāgnike tasmāt tulyo vyabhicāraḥ
kathaṃ punaranumānasambhavaḥ ? sambhāvyate tu dhūmadarśanādagniratreti agnidarśanādvā dhūmo'treti, tat punaḥ pramāṇāntaragate deśe'gnita eva dhūmaḥ, baddhamūlatvādibhirdhūmādvāgniriti
tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ --agne randhanagṛhatvavaditi tvaritataraṇakaraṇārthājñāptāgnihastasūpakārake randhanagṛhe dhūmaḥ sambhavati iti

dhūmo'gneranyatra na sambhavatītyanvayasyārthaḥ sambhavārthatvena itaravaditi dhūmavat, yathā dhūmo'gnau sambhavati sa kadācit kvacit tathāgnirdhūme sambhavati ityanvayārthaḥ śakyata eva, pratītirapi tathā

athavālilaṃ bhavatviti alamiyatā krīḍiteneti vastutaḥ pratipattitaśca pratipāditamapi asmābhirna pratipadyase liṅga-liṅgitvāviśeṣaṃ kimartham ? yadyapi na pratipadyase tathāpyata uttaramavayavanirūpaṇenāpi pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ
agnirevātra iti nāvadhāryate tāvat tatra pṛthivīndhanādisadbhāvāt tadabhāve'gnereva durlabhatvāt, deśasyaiva vā'bhāvāt tadādheyayoragnidhūmayorapyabhāvāpatteḥ

nāpi agniratraiva ityavadhāryate tatpradeśāgnito'nyeṣāmagnīnāmanagnitvābhyupagame pratyakṣādiprasiddhiviruddhārthatvāt pratijñādoṣāt, tatpradeśavyatirikteṣu pradeśeṣvagnyabhāvāt yatra yatrāgnistatra tatra dhūmaḥ iti dṛṣṭānto na śakyo vaktum, atastannirāsaḥ
nāpi agniratra bhavatyeva ityavadhāryate bhavatiprayogavyavahāreṇa, na na bhavatyapi kadāciditi
kiṃ kāraṇam ? sadāgnidhūmābhāvāt tatra tasmin deśe kādācitkāgnivyudāso nirarthakaḥ satatamagnidhūmayorabhāvāt
tasmādvivakṣite deśe tasmiṃstasmin kāle bhavatyagniḥ iti pratijñārthaḥ
kasmāt ? dhūmaśca pakṣadharmo'nubaddharūpa evāgninā bhavati agnisahacaritvāgninimittatvakhyāpanārtham
asmin vidyata evāgnirdhūme, na na vidyata eva, na ca na vidyate'pi kvacit
tasmin hi kila sati vidyata evāgniḥ, na na vidyate vātyādivat, na ca na vidyate'pi dhūmāsahacarāyognidhūmavat, na vā sapakṣasahacare na vidyata eva kṛtakamiva nitye

nanvevaṃ kimarthaṃ nimittanaimittikabhāvopādānam ? na, agnivad vyabhicāri- avyutpattividhyanavadhṛteḥ, vidhinaivāvyutpāditāvadhāraṇenoktatvāt raktamidaṃ karavīrapuṣpam ityavyutpannaraktaśvetaviśeṣaṇāya puruṣāyeva tannirūpaṇārthā raktameva, śvetameva vā ityavadhāraṇānapekṣā pratijñā

tasmin hi kila sati vidyata evāgniḥ, na na vidyate vātyādivat, na ca na vidyate'pi dhūmāsahacarāyognidhūmavat, na vā sapakṣasahacare na vidyata eva kṛtakamiva nitye
nanvevaṃ kimarthaṃ nimittanaimittikabhāvopādānam ? na, agnivad vyabhicāri-

tadvyākhyā --iha kvacidityādi, rūpasparśayoḥ sahacaribhāvaḥ, daṇḍādi nimittam ghaṭo naimittika iti nimittanaimittikabhāvaḥ, tāvetau sahacarinimittanaimittikabhāvāvavayavau, tadeva hi tat, iha tu dvyavayavameva liṅgam
tatrāvinābhāvītyādi, sahacaribhāvaṃ tāvadādau nirūpayāmaḥ, so'vinābhāva eva

tadvyākhyā nirūpaṇārthā --sahacarāvityādi sahacaro yasmin vidyata iti sahacarī dhūmasyāgniriti inipratyayaḥ saptamyarthe, asya trividho'rthaḥ --asmin vidyata evāgnirdhūme agnita eva cāyamiti pakṣadharmāvadhāraṇam
na na vidyata eveti sapakṣānanugato vipakṣa eva san iti viruddhāsādhāraṇānaikāntikāśaṅkā mā bhūditi
na ca na vidyate'pi kvacit sahacarī dhūma iti sādhāraṇānaikāntikāśaṅkā mā bhūditi vā
tadvyācaṣṭe --tasmin hi kila satīti, parābhimatasya dhūme liṅgini agniliṅgatvasya vyudāsārthaṃ tadudāharaṇāni, sati vidyata evāgnirna na vidyate vātyādivadityasiddhavyudāsena
na ca na vidyate'pi dhūmāsahacarāyognidhūmavaditi sādhāraṇānaikāntikāśaṅkāvyudāsena
na vā sapakṣasahacare na vidyata eva kṛtakamiva nitya iti viruddhāsādhāraṇānaikāntikāśaṅkāvyudāsena
evaṃ tarhi asiddhaviruddhānaikāntikavyudāsena sahacaribhāvānumānasiddhau satyāṃ kimarthamanarthakanimitta-naimittikabhāvopādānam ? tasmādekāvayavamevāstviti
etacca na, agnivad vyabhicāritvād dhūmasyāpi, yathāgnirdhūmaṃ vyabhicarati ayognyādāvabhāvāt tathā dhūmo'pi agnimapanītāgnikavāsagṛhādau araṇinirmathanādau ceti samānam
tadvyākhyā yadi he hi sa sadetyādi sadṛṣṭāntopanayā sabhāvanā gatārthā prāguktanyāyā
deśāntarāsañcāridhūmasya tatkālasannihitāgninimittatvād viśiṣṭasyaiva dhūmasyāgnau gamakatvam, viśeṣaṇārthavattvāt
evaṃ cāgnerapi gṛhītatvād na pratyakṣādi pramāṇāntaramapekṣyate kṛtakatvene- panena viśiṣṭadhūmagrahaṇaṃ tasminneva deśe kāle ca nānutpanno nātīto nāpanīto vāgniḥ ityetasyārthasya prakhyāpanārtham
satyapi sahacaribhāve nimittabhūttaṃ tamagnimantareṇa dhūmasyaivābhāvād nimittanaimittikabhāva eṣitavyaḥ

so'pi nimittanaimittikabhāvaḥ sahacaribhāvena vinā vyabhicaratyeveti darśayannāha --balākāpatākāvaccetyādi yāvad dhūme'gnervyabhicāradarśanāditi bhāvanā gatārthā, naimittikasadbhāve nimittābhāvadarśanāt sthapatikṛtaprāsādādivaditi
deśāntarāsañcāridhūmasya tatkālasannihitāgninimittatvād viśiṣṭasyaiva dhūmasyāgnau gamakatvam, viśeṣaṇārthavattvāt
evaṃ cāgnerapi gṛhītatvād na pratyakṣādi pramāṇāntaramapekṣyate kṛtakatvene-
ubhayaviśeṣaṇasampattau satyāṃ kācid vyabhicāradig na sambhavati

tat katham ? iti tad darśayati --deśāntarāsañcārītyādinā bhāvayan, tatkālasannihitāgninimittatvād dhūmasya vyabhicāramalaviśuddhasya tairviśeṣaṇairviśiṣṭasyaiva sahacariṇyagnau gamakatvam, itarathā dhūmasyāpi agneriva dhūme vyabhicārād viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādevānumānārthavattvam, viśeṣaṇānupādāne'gnimattvameva na gamayati ubhayato'pi sahacaritve nimittanaimittikatve vā'sati yasmāt tasmāt sa yathāgnimattvaṃ gamayati tathā sannihitāgninimittatvamapi gamayati iti vartate, yathāgnimattvena vinā nāsti dhūmavattvaṃ tathā tannimittatvamantareṇa nāstītyagnimattvavannimittatvamapi gamayati ubhayatrāvyabhicārāditi
na hi tasyāgnito'nyad nimittaṃ bhavitumarhati sahacaraṃ vā...
kṛtakatvenevānityatvasya, tadyathā prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvākhyamekameva vastvadhruvamanityaṃ kṛtakaṃ cocyate, dhruva sthairye, dhruvaṃ sthiram, nerdhruve tyap pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 4
104 nityam, na nityamanityamiti kṛtakam ityukte tadevānityamadhruvamityuktaṃ bhavati utpādavināśayoradhrauvyābhedāt tathā dhūmagrahaṇe'gnigrahaṇaṃ pradeśātmābhedāt

sa eva nimittamagnirdhūmasya sahacaraśca, na hi tasyetyādi yāvat kriyetetyādi, nahi tasya dhūmasya agnito'nyad nimittaṃ pradeśapariṇāmātmakād deśāntarasthāgnipāṣāṇāmbukumbhādi bhavitumarhati sahacaraṃ vā tadasambaddhatrailokyaliṅgitvaprasaṅgāt, pariṇāmyapariṇamyabhedapariṇāmāntarasādhyatve pariṇāmāntarasādhanatvāt evamasyaiva hetu-hetumadbhāvabhāvanārthamāha --pūrvapratyakṣetyādi yathā pūrvaṃ pratyakṣakāle'gninā sambaddho dhūmo'gniśca dhūmena tathānvayakāle tasya sambandhasya smaraṇād yatrāgnistatra dhūmaḥ, yatra dhūmastatrāgniḥ ityanyatareṇa vivakṣitena hetunopāttasya itarasya sādhyasyābhivyaktiḥ pratyakṣakāle iva pratyakṣavat
na hi tasyāgnito'nyad nimittaṃ bhavitumarhati sahacaraṃ vā...
pariṇāmyabhedapariṇāmāntarasādhyatve pariṇāmāntarasādhanatvādekasyaiva hetuhetumadbhāvabhāvanārthamāha ityapi pāṭho'tra bhavediti dhyeyam
...anityatvaprayatnānantarīyakatvayoranyonyavyāptiṃ pratijñāya hetumāha --ārhatatvasyābhyupagamyamānatvāditi anyāpohābhyupagamāt svavacanādeva jainendraṃ matamabhyupagataṃ tvayeti vakṣyāmaḥ
yadyapi svaṃ vacanamanapekṣyāpi anityaṃ sarvaṃ prayatnānantarīyakaṃ na bhavati iti brūṣe tathāpi te vacanaṃ nyāyāpetamevedam
tadyathā --tānyapītyādi, tānyapi abhrendracāpādīni siddhaprayatnānantarīyakānyeveti pratijñā, lokapratyakṣetyādi samāsadaṇḍako heturyāvad vihitavṛttitvāditi
tadvyākhyā lokapratyakṣetyādiviśeṣaṇaprayojanāni ca piṇḍārthena vidyudādīnāṃ caitanyaṃ tāvat sādhyate--jīvaśarīraṃ vātādayaḥ, anaṇvāditve sparśādimattvāt, govat
tasyāpi gormṛtasya jīvatvābhāvād mā bhūdanaikāntikateti jīvaśarīratve'pi tu nātyantaktaśarīracittetyādi yāvat svayaṃ pravṛttatvāditi viśeṣaṇavyākhyā

vātādicaitanye siddhe cetanavihitavṛtti cetyādinā vidyudabhrameghaśabdādīnāṃ cetanavātaprayatnotthatā darśyate, savitṛgatītyādinā yāpyādhārādheyavadvṛttiḥ--liṅge liṅgī bhavatyeva liṅginyevetarat punaḥ
yasmālliṅge liṅgī bhavatyeva tasmād yuktaṃ yadagnivad dhūmo dravyatvādīnāmapi prakāśako na taikṣṇyādīnām
yasmācca liṅginyeva liṅgaṃ bhavati nānyatra tasmād yuktaṃ yad dhūmo dhūmatveneva pāṇḍutvādibhirapi prakāśayati na dravyatvādibhiḥ
dhūmabhūtaṃ gamayati dhūmabhūtāgnitvāt tadbhāvasya tadbhāvatvenaiva gamakatvāt
yathā cedaṃ tathā dravyatvādisāmānyasyāpi dhūmabhūtergamakatvamagneḥ pāṇḍutvavat
yattu dhūmo dīptyādiviśeṣāṇāmagamakastat tadbhāvadarśanavidhereva tathā cānyathā ca dṛṣṭatvād vyabhicārāt
