yasmācca liṅginyeva liṅgaṃ bhavati nānyatra tasmād yuktaṃ yad dhūmo dhūmatveneva pāṇḍutvādibhirapi prakāśayati na dravyatvādibhiḥ
dhūmabhūtaṃ gamayati dhūmabhūtāgnitvāt tadbhāvasya tadbhāvatvenaiva gamakatvāt
yathā cedaṃ tathā dravyatvādisāmānyasyāpi dhūmabhūtergamakatvamagneḥ pāṇḍutvavat
yattu dhūmo dīptyādiviśeṣāṇāmagamakastat tadbhāvadarśanavidhereva tathā cānyathā ca dṛṣṭatvād vyabhicārāt

evamavinābhāvitvakutarkasya vinābhāvenāsmābhiḥ tadbhāvadarśanādeva sādhyasādhanadharmayoḥ vidheḥ saṃyogivadvṛttiḥ yathāpratijñamuktā, na tvādhārādheyavadvṛttiḥ iti pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ --yāpyādhārādheyavadityādi
yāmapi ādhārādheyavadvṛttiṃ manyase liṅge liṅgī bhavatyevetyādi ślokaḥ
tadvyākhyā --yasmād liṅge dhūme liṅgī agnirbhavatyeva na na bhavatyapi tasmād yuktamityavadhāraṇārthapradarśanam
yasmācca liṅginyevetyādi yāvad dravyatvādibhirityādi tadviparītāvadhāraṇapradarśanaṃ gatārtham
sāmānyasya gamyatvaṃ liṅgini na viśeṣāṇām, liṅgasya ca viśeṣāṇāṃ keṣāñcid gamakatvaṃ na sāmānyasya dṛṣṭam, tat sarvamavinābhāvādādhārādheyavadvṛtteriti pūrvapakṣaḥ
iyamapi ādhārādheyavadvṛttiḥ tadbhāvadarśanavidhereva yatra dṛṣṭastad gamayati darśanabalena, na yatrādṛṣṭastadvyavacchedena vyāvṛttibaleneti
atrāpi na hītyādi yāvanat ? yoṣidgaṇḍapāṇḍutvaṃ na gamayati agnim, abhūtāgnidhūmakatvāt; dhūmabhūtaṃ tu pāṇḍutvaṃ gamayatyagniṃ dhūmabhūtāgnitvāt, vidhereva tadbhāvasya tadbhāvatvenaiva gamakatvāt
yathā cedamityādi, pāṇḍutvādiviśeṣasya dhūmabhūtatvena gamakatvavad dravyatvādisāmānyasyāpi dhūmabhūtergamakatvamagneriti bhāvanā yāvat pāṇḍutvavaditi
yattu dhūmo dīptyādītyādi, dīpti-taikṣṇyādiviśeṣā tadbhāvadarśanānubandhena hi buddhyutpattiranumānam

gatirapi tadbhāvadarśanavidhereva, tathā cānyathā ca dīpti-taikṣṇyādirūpeṇa tadvirahitatvena ca dṛṣṭatvād vyabhicārāt, nātyantābhūtaśītādivyabhicārādasambaddhādagatiḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? sambaddhavyabhicārādeva
kiñcānyat, darśanavidherevānumānalakṣaṇopapatteḥ sa evaiṣitavya ityata āha --tadbhāvadarśanānubandhena hi buddhyutpattiranumānamityetadanumānalakṣaṇam
tad vyācaṣṭe --dhūmavattvamityādi, yadā dhūmavattvaṃ pradeśasyāgnimattvānubaddhameva ityaikāntikaṃ grahaṇaṃ tadānumānaṃ bhavati dhūmādagniratra iti, tasyāgnerekāntenaiva grahaṇamavyabhicārāt

vyabhicārāt tvanumānābhāsam, tadyathā--vṛkṣa-kṣupādivajjvalanataikṣṇyādivyabhicāreṇa, yathā yadā tu vṛkṣaḥ kṣupo vātra, dhūmāt iti tadānumānābhāsaṃ bhavati, vināpi vṛkṣādinā dṛṣṭatvād vyabhicārād darśanabalenaiva

sa cāsaśca pakṣau tadatatpakṣau, tayordvayam, tadgatamekāntaṃ bhūtameva, abhūtameva ityanāśritya yathā agniratraiva, agniratra bhavatyeva evamādyaniścitāsandigdharūpaṃ jñānamanavadhṛtārthamanadhyavasāyaḥ, viparyayaścābhūte bhūtapratyayaḥ, bhūte cābhūtapratyayaḥ, sthāṇau puruṣapratyayavat

tvanmatyā vyāvṛttestvanumānāprāmāṇyāpattiḥ na bhavati na bhavati ityubhayato'pyabhavanaparamārthatvādarthāntaramabhāvo vā'tyantamadṛṣṭatvāt agnirna bhavati, udakamanagniḥ sa na bhavati ghaṭaḥ khapuṣpaṃ vā iti ajñānamevetyaprāmāṇyāpattiḥ pūrvoktanyāyena

grāhyasyāgnervidhirūpeṇa vṛttiragnibhavanam, tadanurodhinī na bhavati yā pratipattiḥ sā grāhyavṛttyananurodhinī, tasyāḥ pratipattergrāhyavṛttyananurodhinyā hetoraprāmāṇyaṃ vyāvṛttyanumānasya, puruṣe sthāṇupratyayavaditi prāguktanyāyabalenāniṣṭāpādanaṃ gatārtham
evaṃ ca tadapi na dūṣaṇaṃ yat kila sambandhānumānalakṣaṇasya asyedaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇam vai॰ sū॰ 9
liṅga evetarat punaḥ ityapi dvitīyapādo'tra syāt
na tu liṅgini liṅgaṃ bhavatyeva liṅgisattve'pi liṅgābhāvād ayognivat
liṅgini deśe dhūmo bhavanneva pakṣadharmo bhavati
yathā vāha--liṅginyeva liṅgaṃ bhavati nāliṅgini, tadapi na ghaṭate, niyamena tasya sadbhāve tatraivāgnau liṅgatvāt
atideśena sambandhānumānalakṣaṇasya sambandhādekasmāt ityādeḥ asyedaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇam vai॰ sū॰ 9

18 ityādeśca yat kila dūṣaṇaṃ sambandhasyāviśiṣṭatvād dhūmādagnidravyādivad dīptitaikṣṇyādīnāmapi gamyatvam, dhūmapāṇḍutvādiviśeṣagamakatvavad dravyasattvādisāmānyasyāpi gamakatvam, agnervā gamakatvaṃ dhūmavat, dhūmasya vāgnivad gamyatvam' ityete doṣāḥ prasaktā dṛṣṭavad vidhivṛtteranumānokteḥ yathā dṛṣṭastathā sandehānadhyavasāyaviparyayaniścayakṛdityabhyupagamāditi
vaiśeṣikamataparīkṣāvasare pramāṇasamuccayavṛttau dvitīyaparicchede vistareṇāpāditamidaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ diṅgāgena

vistarārthibhiḥ Gaekwad's Oriental Series, Baroda ityatra prakāśitasyāsmatsampāditasya vaiśeṣikasūtrasya saptame pariśiṣṭe pṛ॰ 184— 196 ityatra savṛttikāt saṭīkācca pramāṇasamuccayāduddhṛtā vaiśeṣikānumānaparīkṣā vilokanīyā
kiñcānyat, liṅge liṅgī bhavatyeva ityasyāḥ kārikāyā yo'rtho'vadhāraṇavaiparītyenā'numānami- tyuktastasya dūṣaṇārthamāhācāryaḥ --liṅgena na vinā liṅgītyādi ślokaḥ
na yathāhetyādi paramatapradarśanaṃ yāvadayognivaditi niyamaviparyayeṇa sodāharaṇam
atrottaram --liṅgini deśe'gnimati dhūmo bhavanneva pakṣadharmo bhavati, nābhavan asiddhatvādaliṅgatvāt
tasya ca dhūmasyāgnigatataikṣṇyādiliṅgatvaṃ na bhavati, na dṛṣṭatvād dhūme tasyāgneradṛṣṭatvāt taikṣṇyādinā ca saha vidhivṛttyeti
na bhavati, dṛṣṭatvād dhūme tasyāgneḥ, adṛṣṭatvāt taikṣṇyādinā ca saha vidhivṛttyeti ityapi pāṭho'tra bhavet
liṅginyeva ityasyāvadhāraṇasya nirūpaṇam--yadā bhavati liṅgaṃ tadā nāliṅgini bhavati udakādau dhūma iti
tadapi na ghaṭate, kasmāt ? niyamenetyādi, tasya dhūmasya sadbhāve baddhamūlatvādiviśeṣaparicchinne tatraivāgnau nānyatrāyognyādau liṅgatvam
kiṃ kāraṇam ? agniratra iti atraśabdasyādhikaraṇavācino'rthavattve atraśabdavācyaitatpradeśasambandhinyevāgnau liṅgitvāt, anyathā'numānābhāvadoṣasyoktatvāt
tasmāt sa eva tasyaiva liṅgamiti siddham
yat punardhūmagatadravyatvādyagnyaprakāśanaṃ tattu asmadiṣṭadarśanavidhereva tathā vyabhicārāt
athocyeta--viśeṣā na tu gamyante tasyaiva vyabhicāriṇaḥ pra॰ samu॰ 2
na ca liṅginyeva liṅgamiti niyamo vāsagṛhavat
śakyate ca liṅge dhūme niyamādagniriti vaktum, asandhukṣitānagnitvāt

kintu yathā ca tvayocyate liṅge liṅgī bhavatyeva iti, tatra liṅge celliṅginiyamaḥ tathā cedaṃ doṣajātam--taikṣṇyaṃ kimiti neṣyate ? dhūmatvāvadhāraṇakāraṇaviśeṣāṇāṃ dīptatara-mandaprakāśanādiviśeṣasahacaratvād dhūmādagnigativat tadavadhāraṇakāraṇaviśeṣasahacarāgniviśeṣaḥ kasmānneṣyate tebhya eva dhūmāvadhāraṇakāraṇaviśeṣebhyaḥ ?

tadyathā pracuraharitetyādi, yatra dogdhāraḥ puruṣā eva dohayantībhirvirahitāḥ, gokule haritatṛṇākīrṇe navāvāse gavāṃ maśakanivāraṇārthaṃ haritatṛṇendhano'gniḥ kriyate tatraitaddaṇḍakoktaviśeṣo dhūmastārṇālpatādiviśeṣānagnergamayati
hastalā mṛtpātrakārāḥ śilpinaḥ, tadgṛhāṅgaṇagatastauṣastauṣāgniṃ gamayatīti viśeṣāṇāmapi liṅgitvadṛṣṭerliṅge dhūma eva liṅgino'gnerbhāvaḥ
tasmād nāvadhāraṇavaiparītyena liṅgaliṅgitā, na ca viśeṣāgamyateti
syānmatam--mayā viśeṣyokta evādoṣo'sya viśeṣā na tu gamyante, ke ? ye tasyaiva vyabhicāriṇa iti
etadapi na, taikṣṇyādivacanāt, tvayā hi dīptitaikṣṇyādayo viśeṣā na gamyante iti kārikārthaṃ vivṛṇvatoktatvāt taikṣṇyādīnāṃ ca gamyatattvasya darśitatvāditi
evādoṣo viśeṣā na tu ? eva doṣo viśeṣā na tu ?
pramāṇasamuccayavṛttau anekadharmaṇo'rthasya na liṅgāt sarvathā gatiḥ
iti kārikārdhasya vivaraṇe etad vākyaṃ vilokyata iti dhyeyam

kiñcānyat, mayā tatrāpi coktameva tadbhāvadarśanavidhereva taditi, tadapi ca viśeṣāṇāṃ gamyagamakatvaṃ sādhyasādhanadharmayostadbhāvena dṛṣṭayorvidhirūpeṇa saṃyogivad vṛtterdṛṣṭabalenaiva na vyāvṛttyetyabhihitameva
liṅgena na vinā liṅgī ityādi ślokaśca sādhūktaḥ
yadapyuktaṃ liṅginyeva liṅgam iti, tadapi na ca liṅginyeva liṅgam iti niyamo vāsagṛhavat, yathā vāsagṛhe'panītāgnike liṅgināgninā vināpi dhūmasya dṛṣṭatvādaraṇinirmathanāvasthasyeti
śakyate ca liṅge dhūme niyamādagniḥ iti vaktum, kasmāt ? asandhukṣitānagnitvāt, na hyasandīpte evaṃ ca liṅgaṃ liṅgini vyāpitvādeva gamakatvaṃ bhajate kṛtakānityatvavat
tvanmativat sādhyadharmasya liṅgitve sādhanadharmasya liṅgatve'pi brūmaḥ--yathā liṅgamapi vyāpi tathā liṅgamapyaṅgyapi
ubhayaṃ liṅgaṃ liṅgi vā na yat tad goviṣāṇavat
ndhanāvastho'raṇyavastho vāgniradhūmakaḥ, adhūmatvādanagnireva agi ragi lagi gatyarthaḥ ityaṅganād gamanādagniḥ
anindhano na gacchati na dahati, agacchannadahannanagnireva

bhasmacchannasyāpi bāṣpoṣmapudgalaniścaraṇāt sendhanatvaṃ sadhūmatvaṃ ca paramārthataḥ tatpariṇāmādagnyabhihatakāṣṭhatṛṇādīndhanānāṃ sandīpanaprajvalanajvālāṅgāramurmurabhasmacchannoṣmamātrādyavasthāsu ślakṣṇadhūmapariṇāmāśūnyatvāt sarvatra dhūme'gnirniyataḥ tathāgnau dhūmaḥ
evaṃ ca liṅgaṃ liṅgini vyāpitvādeva gamakatvaṃ bhajate kṛtakānityatvavat
tvanmativat sādhyadharmasya liṅgitve sādhanadharmasya liṅgatve'pi brūmaḥ--
ubhayaṃ liṅgaṃ liṅgi vā na yat tad goviṣāṇavat
evaṃ ca kṛtvātra prayogaḥ --liṅgaṃ dhūmo liṅginyagnau vyāpitvādeva gamakatvaṃ bhajate vidhivṛttyaivetyarthaḥ
kṛtakānityatvavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā kṛtakatvamanityatāṃ vyāpnuvad gamayati tathā dhūmo'pyagnimiti

asmanmatena sādhyaṃ sādhanaṃ ca ekameva ityuktatvāt parasparavyāpitvād vidhirūpeṇaivobhayato'pi gamyagamakatā na vyāvṛttyetyatra kiṃ citram ? tvanmatenāpi bhedaṃ kṛtvā sādhyadharmasyāgnerliṅgitve sādhanadharmasya dhūmasya liṅgatve'pi brūmaḥ --yathā liṅgamapi vyāpītyādi ślokaḥ
yathocyate tvayā— kāmaṃ liṅgamapi vyāpi liṅginyaṅgi tu tattataḥ

kimuktaṃ bhavati ? satyapi kila kṛtakānityavat saṃyogivadvṛttyā'nyonyavyāpitve dhūma evāgnergamako nāgnirdhūmasya, yathā gotvād viṣāṇī iti gotvaṃ viṣāṇitvasya gamakam; na viṣāṇitvād gauḥ iti viṣāṇitvaṃ goḥ, gaja-vṛṣa-mahiṣa-varāhādiṣu vyabhicārāditi

asya vyākhyā --saṃyogivadvṛttāvityādi pradeśadharmatvāt tasyaiva sādhyasādhanatvopavarṇanaṃ prāguktamatidiśya tathā liṅgamapyaṅgyapi, vātyādivyudāsenāgnipariṇāmatvena baddhamūlatvāderubhayaliṅgaliṅgitā'syaiva prāguktā smaryatām, ko doṣaḥ ? iti tameva nyāyaṃ smārayati
tasya prakarṣeṇa gatiḥ pracāro'nutpiñjalagamanikā, na dhūmasāmānyāgnimadgativat
yasmād vyāptirevaṃvidhā'pekṣyate'smadiṣṭā dvaividhyena ubhayāvyabhicārātmikā yatra yatra...
dhūmo yathāgnisānnidhyārthaviśeṣaṇairātmalābhādagnisānnidhyaṃ gamayati tathā eva cetyādi sahetukaṃ pratijñātaṃ nigamayati
niyattaṃ na yattad goviṣāṇavaditi, yacchabdo yasmādarthe, tacchabdastannirdeśe, yasmād goviṣāṇavadekato na vyabhicarati tasmādubhayaṃ liṃgaṃ liṅgi veti grāhyam
tadvyākhyā --viṣāṇaṃ hītyādi asādharmyadarśanaṃ go-viṣāṇayoḥ kṛtakānityatvayośca gatārtham
kāmaṃ liṅgamapi vyāpi liṅginyaṅgi tu tattataḥ
vyāpitvānna tu tattasya gamakaṃ goviṣāṇavat || pra॰ samu॰ 2 | 21 1/2 iti
tasya prakarṣeṇa gatiḥ pracāro'nutpiñjalagamanikā, na dhūmasāmānyāgnimadgativat
yasmād vyāptirevaṃvidhā'pekṣyate'smadiṣṭā dvaividhyena ubhayāvyabhicārātmikā yatra yatra...
kiṃ kāraṇamitthamiti cet, asmaduktāyā vyāptervidhirūpāyā eva gamyagamakatvāditi
tadvyākhyā vidheyo bhāva ityādi, bhāvagrahaṇamabhāvarūpāyā vyāpternirākaraṇārtham

tasya bhāvasya, nābhāvaḥ pratiṣedhyaḥ tatrāpracāraḥ, sa cāpramāṇaphalaṃ bhavitumarhati arthāntarasyātyantābhāvasya cāvivakṣitatvāt prāguktadoṣasambandhācca, prakarṣeṇa gatiḥ pracāro vastuyathābhāvāvagama ityarthaḥ, anutpiñjalagamaniketi tadarthagamanam avyathāgamanam
vaidharmyeṇa na yathā tvadiṣṭamiti darśayati --na dhūmasāmānyāgnimadgativaditi ekato vyāptiṃ viṣāṇitvādikalpāṃ darśayati
yasmād vyāptirevaṃvidhā parasparasaṃsṛṣṭā'pekṣyate gatāvarthasya tasmāt satyeva vyāptiḥ sādhanamityabhisambhantsyate, viśabdasya dvaividhyārthatvāt

taddarśayati— asmadiṣṭā dvaividhyena vyāptirubhayāvyabhicārātmikā, tasmāt kim ? sphuṭamevānvayātmako dṛṣṭānto nocyate'smābhiḥ, yatra yatretyādirubhayavyāptipradarśano gatārtho yāvat satyeva sādhanamityupasaṃhāra iti
tasmād dṛṣṭāntalakṣaṇamapi sādhyenānugamo hetoḥ pra॰ samu॰ 4
2 ityādi prayoganiyamābhidhānātmakamanarthakam, mudhā bhrāntaṃ cātra tvayeti

evaṃ kṛtvā yathā'gnisānnidhyārthairviśeṣaṇairdhūmātmalābhādagnisānnidhyamevāgnisānnidhyasādhakaṃ tathā kṛtakatvaṃ ghaṭādau, ghakārā-'kāra-ṭakārā-'kāravisarjanīyānāṃ pūrvasya pūrvasya vināśa kṛtakatvamanityatvasānnidhyādātmalābhādanityatvasānnidhyaṃ gamayati...
asmādeva ca nyāyād yadapyuktaṃ nāśinaḥ kṛtakatvena pra॰ samu॰ 2
23 ityādi tadapyevamadhyeyam--nāśinaḥ kṛtakatvena vyāptestat kṛtakaṃ kṛtam
uttarottarotpatteḥ kāraṇam, tata eva vināśādanityatvādutpatteḥ kṛtakatvasyātmalābhādanityatvasānnidhyamevānityatvasānnidhyaṃ gamayatītyubhayato vyāptiḥ satyeva kāraṇam
śivakādivināśakrameṇa etadarthabhāvanā gatārthā — agnisānnidhyārthetyādi yāvad ghaṭakṛtakatvavaditi
asmādeva ca nyāyād yadapyuktaṃ nāśinaḥ kṛtakatvena pra॰ samu॰ 2
asmādeva ca nyāyād yadapyuktaṃ tvayā --nāśinaḥ kṛtakatvena pra॰ samu॰ 2
23 ityādi kārikayā ekato vyāptigamakatvapradarśanārthaṃ tadapyevamadhyeyam— nāśinaḥ kṛtakatvena vyāptestat kṛtakaṃ kṛtam
tadvyākhyā --yeyamityādi yāvat kṛtakatvasyānityatvamiti gatārthaṃ sthāpitam ityanuvartanāditi
etasmādeva nyāyād yo'pyukto viṣāṇitvena gaurvyāptaḥ pra॰ samu॰ 2
gotvād viṣāṇī iti saṃyogivad vidhivṛtteḥ sādhayed viṣāṇitāṃ gotvaṃ tatraiva niyatatvāt
tāvad dvayamapyuktam--anumānamabhidhānaṃ cādhārādheyavadvṛttyā na gamayati, atra ca pakṣe kāṃścid doṣānatyadiśāma
saṃyogivad vidhivṛttyā gamayati, atra ca pakṣe guṇānabhyadhāma
yat punarniruktīkṛtyānvayāsambhavaṃ vyatirekāsambhavamāśaṅkyoktaṃ syādetad vyatirekasyāpyasambhavaḥ iti, tad yuktamevoktam, anvayavyatirekayorabhāvāt
anvayavyatirekau hi pratyayātmakau, na vastugate tulyātulyayorvṛttyavṛttī, viśeṣasyaiva vastutvādasya nayasya
na ca sambhavo'sti sarvāvṛkṣārthavyatirekasya, ānantyāt, sarvavṛkṣārthānvayavat

dvayamapyuktam, anyāpohaviśiṣṭārthaikadeśānvayadarśanādanumānamabhidhānaṃ cādhārādheyavadvṛttyā na gamayatītyuktam, atra ca pakṣe kāṃściddoṣānatyadiśāma adīdṛśāma, pāṭhāntaraṃ saṃyogivad vidhivṛttyā ubhayato vyāptyā gamayatītyuktam, atra ca pakṣe guṇānabhyadhāmetyevaṃ śabdena smārayati

tvayā anvayavyatirekāvarthānumāne dvāram ityuktvā guṇasamudāye ḍitthākhye'rthe kāṇa-kuṇṭādyavayavānvayānabhidhānādanvayāsambhavaṃ niruktīkṛtya anvayāsambhavavad vyatirekāsambhavamāśaṅkyoktaṃ syādetad vyatirekasyāpyasambhava iti, tad yuktameva tvayoktam, asmaduktasaṃyogivadvidhivṛttimantareṇānvayavyatirekayorabhāvāt
tayoreva tāvad lakṣaṇam--anvayavyatirekau hi pratyayātmakau, samānabhavanānuvṛttipratyayo'nvayaḥ, tadviparīto vyatirekaḥ, na vastugate tulyātulyayorvṛttyavṛttī tvadukte
kasmāt ? ānantyāt, ānantye hi bhedānām pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 5

sarvavṛkṣārthānvayavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā sarve vṛkṣārthā ānantyāt sambandhāśakyatvādanvayābhāvāccānabhidheyāstathā bahutaravyāvartyaghaṭapaṭādyanantataratvādavyatirekaḥ, tathā dhūmasya udakādisarvānagnivyatirecane sāmarthyābhāvo vācyaḥ sarvavṛkṣānantyādanvayavaditi
ata eva svasambandhibhyo'nyatrādarśanāt tadvyavacchedenānumānam pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 5
sarvasyādarśanānna syāt ityapi bhavet pāṭhaḥ, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 708 paṃ॰ 14
tataḥ prakāśakaṃ na syāt ? liṅgaṃ na liṅgameva syāt ? tato na liṅgameva syāt ?
bhedāvivakṣaikatvāpāditaikatvaṃ sāmānyaṃ liṅgaṃ tathābhāvitaikatvasya liṅgino gamakaṃ tadbhāvenaiva
tulanā— heturapadeśo liṅgaṃ nimittaṃ pramāṇaṃ kāraṇamityanarthāntaram --vai॰ sū॰ 9
anvayagatadoṣābhāvaṃ vyatirekagataṃ guṇaṃ ca darśayati granthaḥ --atulye satyapyānantye ityādi
tato'nyasyābhāvamātraṃ sāmānyato vyatirecanīyaṃ tadbhedarūpāṇi asaṃspṛśatā śabdena liṅgena vā
yadi dṛṣṭavad vidhirūpeṇa liṅgaṃ liṅginaṃ na prakāśayet sarvatra liṅginyadarśanāt talliṅgaṃ liṅgameva na syāt, agatirvā sarvathā bhavet kasyacidapyarthasyeti piṇḍārthaḥ

tatra viśeṣasyaiva vācyatvādanumeyatvāccārthasya sāmānyasyāsattvādasatyopādhisatyaśabdārthatvaṃ tvayoktatvāt, asmābhiryathā arthaśabdaviśeṣasya vācyavācakateṣyate sāmānyasyāsattvād viśeṣasyaiva sattvāt, na hyabhāvo vācyaḥ khapuṣpavat
tasya sāmānyasyāsattvādeva pūrvamadṛṣṭatve viśeṣasyaiva dṛṣṭasya kalpitāsatya- sāmānyopasarjanadvāreṇa vācyatvācchabdasyāpi tathaiva vācakatvāt sāmānyopasarjanopāyena
etaccihnāntargato ॰dasatyo॰ ityata ārabhya sattvāt ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratau nāsti

tattvālliṅgaṃ śabdo dhūmādi vā kathaṃ gamakaṃ bhavati ? ucyate--bhedānāmavivakṣayā sāmānyasya ekatvādāpāditaṃ teṣāmekatvaṃ bhedānāṃ yasmiṃstalliṅgaṃ bhedāvivakṣāpāditaikatvaṃ sāmānyaṃ liṅgaṃ tadbhāvāpanno dharmo dhūma-śabdādiḥ, tathābhāvitaikatvasya tena śabda-dhūmādiprakāreṇa bhāvitamekatvaṃ śākhādibhinnāvayavavatastaro yadi tu na tathā prakāśayatītīṣṭaṃ kintvanyāpohena tato naiva prakāśakaṃ syāt sarvasyādarśanāt pratidravyamapohyasyādarśanāt
na hi sa vā bhavati tato'nyo vā, adṛṣṭatvāt, vandhyāputravat
na ca tadatulyamatacchabdamatadrūpaṃ tathā tathā'dṛṣṭaṃ pratipattuṃ śakyam
apratipanne ca tasmin kasya kathaṃ vāpohaḥ syāt ? apitṛtvavat syāditi cet

yathā pituranyo'pitā sarvo vyāvṛttibuddhimātreṇa stāpādibhinnakarmavataścāgnerliṅginaśca, vācya-liṅgyabhedāt prāguktanyāyena ātmanaivātmano vācakā ātmanaivātmano'numeyāḥ, tadbhāvadarśanādeva sāmānyasya viśeṣapratipādanārthatvācchibikāvāhakayāneśvarayānavad gamakaṃ tadbhāvenaiva, agnereva dhūmatvāt baddhamūlādiviśiṣṭatayā dhūmasyaivāgnitvādādimadhyānteṣu araṇyādīndhanasandhukṣaṇamurmurādyavasthadhūmādipudgalāgnitvāt
evamuktanyāyena liṅgaṃ gamakaṃ liṅgī gamyaścetyadoṣa ityatītaṃ nyāyaṃ smārayati
yadi tu na tathā prakāśayatītīṣṭaṃ kintvanyāpohena tato naiva prakāśakaṃ syāt sarvasyādarśanāt pratidravyamapohyasyādarśanāt
na hi sa vā bhavati tato'nyo vā, adṛṣṭatvāt, vandhyāputravat
na ca tadatulyamatacchabdamatadrūpaṃ tathā tathā'dṛṣṭaṃ pratipattuṃ śakyam
apratipanne ca tasmin kasya kathaṃ vāpohaḥ syāt ?
yadi tu na tathetyādi paramate doṣaḥ
yadi yena prakāreṇa dṛṣṭastenaiva prakāreṇa liṅgaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tenaiva ca prakāreṇa vidhinā prakāśayatītiṣṭaṃ na, tvayā tu kimiṣṭam ? anyāpoheneti
tataḥ kim ? tato naiva prakāśakaṃ syāt

kasmāt ? sarvasyādarśanāt, yathā vidheyamadṛṣṭaṃ tvanmatena tathā vyāvartyamapi kiñcinna dṛṣṭamavṛkṣānagnyākhyam, ghaṭapaṭādibhedānāmānantyād dravyaṃ dravyaṃ prati pratidravyamapohyasyādarśanāt kiṃ tad vṛkṣādagnerarthādanyadavṛkṣānagnyākhyam ? adṛṣṭameva bhavet

yataśca buddhervyāvṛttiriṣṭā, na hyadṛṣṭvārtham ayaṃ bhavati, ayaṃ na bhavati ityanvayavyatirekau bhavitumarhato buddheḥ, dṛṣṭāneva buddhiranviyādarthān tebhya eva ca vyāvarteta, yathā devadatto'yaṃ yajñadatto na ityādi, nātyantādṛṣṭakhapuṣpavandhyāputrādiviṣayā
etadarthapradarśanārthamāha --na hi sa vṛkṣo'gnirvā bhavati tato'nyo vā ghaṭādiḥ, adṛṣṭatvāt, vandhyāputravat
dṛṣṭa eva sa vā bhavati anyo vā tataḥ
na ca tena dṛṣṭenā'tulyamatacchabdam, na sa vṛkṣaśabdo'gniśabdo vā śabdo'sya tadidamatacchabdamavṛkṣo'nagnyādi vā
kiṃ kāraṇam ? yasmāt tathā tathā tena tena prakāreṇā'dṛṣṭaṃ ghaṭapaṭakuḍyādibhedaprakāreṇādṛṣṭatvāt pratipattumaśakyam

tataścā'pratipanne cetyādi vyākhyātārthabhedarūpeṇāgrahaṇam, tata evānyo'pi nāsti, sati cāgrahaṇe'nyasya cābhāvāt kasya kathaṃ vāpohaḥ syāt ? prāguktavidhinā kiṃ kena kuto'pohyate ityādigrantho'tra yojya iti

apitṛtvavat syāditi cet, syādiyamāśaṅkā, yathetyādi tadvyākhyā, pituranye sarve puruṣā anāśritabhedarūpāstadanvayādṛte'pi dṛṣṭāt pituranyatvavyāvṛttibuddhimātreṇa svabhedānapekṣā niravayavā eva niravayava eva pratīyate tathāgnivṛkṣābhyāmanye'vṛkṣājvalanāḥ sarve'pi vyāvṛttibuddhimātreṇa niravayavāḥ pratīyeran, ko doṣaḥ ? sarvasyādarśanānna syāt
yuktaṃ piturapituśca dṛṣṭasya vyaktagrahaṇottarakālaṃ pituḥ paryudāsenānyasyāpitṛtvaṃ pratipādyeta, na tu piturevādarśane
yathā tvidaṃ tvayeṣṭaṃ tulye vṛttiratulye cāvṛttiḥ
tatra tulye nāvaśyaṃ sarvatra vṛttirākhyeyā, kvacidānantye'rthasyākhyānāsambhavāt, na hi sambhavo'sti vṛkṣaśabdasya sarvavṛkṣeṣu darśane
nāpi sarvatra liṅgini sarvaliṅgasya sambhavaḥ, agnidhūmādivat
yadyapi ca kvacidasti ḍitthādiṣu sambhavaḥ tathāpi guṇasamudāyamātrasya kāṇakuṇṭāderdarśanāsambhavaḥ, satyapi ca darśane sarvathā'numānāsambhavaḥ iti tathā sarvasyādarśanāt pitṛkalpasya...
yadi hi svārthaḥ parārthaśca sampiṇḍya vidhinā gṛhītaḥ syāt tata evaṃ pratipadyeta ayaṃ vṛkṣaḥ, ayaṃ na bhavati iti, nātyantāviditavṛkṣāvṛkṣaśabdārthatāyām
pratīyanta iti dṛṣṭāntastathāgnivṛkṣābhyāmanye'vṛkṣājvalanā vṛkṣajvalanaparyudāsenānantā bhedā api vyāvṛttibuddhimātreṇa niravayavāḥ pratīyeran ko doṣa iti
niravayava eva pratīyate tathāgnivṛkṣābhyāmanye'vṛkṣājvalanāḥ sarve'pi vyāvṛttibuddhimātreṇa niravayavāḥ pratīyeran, ko doṣaḥ ?
yuktaṃ piturapituśca dṛṣṭasya vyaktagrahaṇottarakālaṃ pituḥ paryudāsenānyasyāpitṛtvaṃ pratipādyeta, na tu piturevādarśane
yathā tvidaṃ tvayeṣṭaṃ tulye vṛttiratulye cāvṛttiḥ
tatra tulye nāvaśyaṃ sarvatra vṛttirākhyeyā, kvacidānantye'rthasyākhyānāsambhavāt, na hi sambhavo'sti vṛkṣaśabdasya sarvavṛkṣeṣu darśane
nāpi sarvatra liṅgini sarvaliṅgasya sambhavaḥ, agnidhūmādivat
yadyapi ca kvacidasti ḍitthādiṣu sambhavaḥ tathāpi guṇasamudāyamātrasya kāṇakuṇṭāderdarśanāsambhavaḥ, satyapi ca darśane sarvathā'numānāsambhavaḥ iti tathā sarvasyādarśanāt pitṛkalpasya...
yadi hi svārthaḥ parārthaśca sampiṇḍya vidhinā gṛhītaḥ syāt tata evaṃ pratipadyeta ayaṃ vṛkṣaḥ, ayaṃ na bhavati iti, nātyantāviditavṛkṣāvṛkṣaśabdārthatāyām
atra doṣakutūhalaṃ ced brūmaḥ --sarvasyādarśanād na syāt

yuktaṃ piturasmaddarśanena vidhirūpeṇa dṛṣṭasya aṅgādaṅgaṃ sambhavasi kauṣītakibrā॰ 27 ityādinyāyāt svaputrasya guṇasamudāyarūpasya prāṇān dattavataḥ paryudāsenānyasya bhrātrādeḥ svajanasya pitṛviparītabuddheradhyāsena grāhyasya eṣa pitā devadattaḥ, neme vasurātādayaḥ iti piturapituśca vyaktagrahaṇottarakālaṃ parajanasya cānyasyāpitṛtvaṃ pratipādyetetyeṣo'sti nyāyaḥ
tvaddarśane punarguṇasamudāyasya na tu piturevādarśane yuktam iti vartate na ghaṭate pitureva grahaṇāsambhave asati vā pitari guṇasamudāyamātrārthagrahaṇābhidhānābhāvaprakāreṇoktena
sa hi pitarītyādinā darśanavidhiṃ pituḥ pitṛdarśanāccāpitṝṇāṃ taditarabhedānāṃ ca kathayati darśanavidhiṃ yāvat pratyayotpattiriti granthena
yathā tvidamityādi yathā tvayeṣṭaṃ tulye vṛttiratulye cāvṛttiḥ ityudgrāheṇa yāvat sarvathānumānāsambhava iti grantho vyācakṣāṇa eva gataḥ paramatam
nyāyena tvaduktenaiva tathā sarvasyādarśanāt pitṛkalpasyetyādinā dārṣṭāntikavaiṣamyāpādanaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvat tadapohasya vā'pratipattiriti
tvanmatena kasyacideva svārthasya parārthasya cādarśanādapi pitṛtvapratyayābhāva eveti piṇḍārthaḥ

athavā sarvasyādarśanāt ityādinā prakārāntareṇa doṣaṃ brūmaḥ --yadi hi svārtha ityādi, vṛkṣaḥ ityukte'smaduktena nyāyena sāmānyopasarjano viśeṣaḥ samastaḥ śiṃśapādirabhihitaḥ syāt tenāpoḍhaścāvṛkṣaḥ sabhedo ghaṭapaṭādiḥ sampiṇḍya ayamanyo'smād vṛkṣāt vṛkṣaśabdādaṃhripaśabdo'nyatvādavṛkṣaḥ, tathā tadarthaḥ, agnervahnyādiranyo'nagniḥ
tatra sāmānyaśabdārtheṣu tāvat sadityasanna bhavati ityatra dvayī vṛttiḥ--anaṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttiḥ sacchabdaḥ, aṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttirvā
sadityukte asanna bhavati iti dvinañprayogāt bhavatyeva iti siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ--yo na bhavati yathā vā na bhavati tasya dvividhasyāpyasadbhavanasyātra sambandhitvaṃ nāsti
iti gṛhītaḥ syāt tata evaṃ pratipadyeta --ayaṃ vṛkṣaḥ ayameva vṛkṣa eva bhavati, tato'nyo'yaṃ ghaṭapaṭādiravṛkṣo vṛkṣo na bhavatīti
nātyantāviditavṛkṣāvṛkṣaśabdatāyāṃ na cātyantādṛṣṭavṛkṣāvṛkṣasvarūpatāyāṃ vā sā pratipattirbhavitumarhati ayaṃ vṛkṣo'yaṃ na bhavati iti, khapuṣpavandhyāputrādivaditi
svajanasyapaṃ॰ 17 iti prāgabhihitatvādatra parajanasya ca ityuktam
tatra sāmānyaśabdārtheṣu tāvat sadityasanna bhavati ityatra dvayī vṛttiḥ--anaṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttiḥ sacchabdaḥ, aṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttirvā
sadityukte asanna bhavati iti dvinañprayogāt bhavatyeva iti siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ--yo na bhavati yathā vā na bhavati tasya dvividhasyāpyasadbhavanasyātra sambandhitvaṃ nāsti
tena dvivighenāpyasatā na bhavitavyam ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt

etadarthanidarśanārthaṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha --vṛkṣaśabdādaṃhripaśabdo'nyatvādavṛkṣastathā tadarthaḥ, agnervahnyādiḥ, ubhayatra vā sattvadravyatvādisāmānyaviśeṣadharmo'nyo'nagniravṛkṣaśceti viditasakalavṛkṣāvṛkṣāgnyanagnyādiśabdārthasyaiva tajjñānaṃ dṛṣṭam
na hi kiñciddarśanamātrādvā tadvṛttinirniyamo vā bhavataḥ, kasmāt ? vyabhicārāt, vṛkṣānvayo'pi vraścakapuruṣavyabhicārād vraścanadharmābhāvavyabhicārādavṛkṣa eva
anyo'pi hi bhavannananyo bhavati pīlu-hasti-vṛkṣādivat sāmānya-viśeṣa-paryāyaśabdārthebhyaḥ

tatra sāmānyaśabdārtheṣu tāvadudāharaṇam--sadityasanna bhavati iti, atra hi dvayī vṛttiścintyate— anaṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttiḥ sacchabdaḥ aṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttirvā syāt ? tatra prathamaṃ tāvad vyudastabhedasāmānyamātravṛttiranaṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttiḥ śabdaḥ
sa kīdṛśa iti cet, tannirūpaṇārthamāha --apohaḥ kevalo vyāvṛttyartho nirnibandhana ucyate
tadudāharaṇam --sat ityukte asad na bhavati iti dvinañprayogāt prakṛtyāpatteḥ bhavatyeva iti vidhyartha eva jñāyate
tataḥ kiṃ saṃvṛttam ? siddhe sati ārambho niyamārtha iti asad na bhavati iti dvābhyāṃ pratiṣedhābhyāṃ niyamyate vihitaṃ sattvameva
tat kathamiti cet, ucyate --yo na bhavati khapuṣpādiḥ yathā vā na bhavati ghaṭa-paṭādiprakāreṇa tasya dvividhasyāpyasadbhabhavanasyātra vṛkṣe sambandhitvaṃ nāstītyuktaṃ bhavati
athaitebhya eva doṣebhyo'ṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttirapoha iṣyate tata idaṃ vighaṭate— sadityasanna bhavatīti
pratisvasat sarvamapi ghaṭādīti sadevāsadapi bhavati itaretarābhāvādibhyaḥ
asatāpi hi tena satā kenacid bhavitavyam, pratyekavṛttitvāt, yathā ghaṭa ityaghaṭo na bhavati vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavati
vidhiḥ, asacchabdaśca tadarthaḥ, itthaṃ coktanyāyena asacchabdārtho vidhipradhānaparyudāsātmakastyaktaḥ syāt
sa eva vṛkṣo bhavati sattvāt, sato'nyasyāsato'tyantābhāvāt prasajyapratiṣedhamātramasat prasaktaṃ pratiṣiddhamityeṣo'rthaḥ syāt
tasmāt prasajyapratiṣedhamātrārthatvāt tataśca ayamasmādanyaḥ ityanyasyābhāvāt anyāpohaḥ śabdaḥ ityasyābhyupagamasya tyāgaḥ kṛta iti doṣaḥ syāt
kiñcānyat, tata eva arthāntarāpohaṃ hi svārthe kurvatī śrutirabhidhatte ityetasya arthāntarāpohena svārthābhidhānam iti lakṣaṇasya tyāgaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt, eṣo'pyabhyupagamatyāgadoṣo'para iti
evaṃ tāvadanaṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttiḥ sadityasanna bhavatīti sāmānyaśabdārthe'nyāpoho na yukto vidhireva yukta iti
athaitebhya eva doṣebhyo'ṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttirapoha iṣyate tata idaṃ vighaṭate— sadityasanna bhavatīti
pratisvasat sarvamapi ghaṭādīti sadevāsadapi bhavati itaretarābhāvādibhyaḥ
asatāpi hi tena satā kenacid bhavitavyam, pratyekavṛttitvāt, yathā ghaṭa ityaghaṭo na bhavati vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavati
ghaṭādīti sadityasanna na bhavati ityapi pāṭhaḥ syāt
atha mā bhūvannete paryudāsātmakānyaśabdārthārthāntarāpohasvārthābhidhānalakṣaṇābhyupagamatyāgadoṣā iti tebhya eva bhayādaṅgīkṛtārthāntaravṛttirapoha iṣyate tata idaṃ vighaṭate sadityasanna bhavatīti
kasmāt ? pratisvasat sarvamapi ghaṭādīti, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt pratisvaṃ sarvasya sattvāt, sarvaṃ hi pratisvaṃ pratyātma pratyekamātmanā sadevāsadapi bhavati, na hyasanna bhavati

kutaḥ ? itaretarābhāvādibhyaḥ, prākpradhvaṃsetaretarasaṃyogasamavāyāpramāṇasāmarthyādibhedena sadevāsad bhavati iti vistarata utpatadbhireva pratipāditamasmābhiḥ--ghaṭo ghaṭātmanā san bhavati asanneva paṭātmanā ityādi
tata idaṃ vighaṭate 2 tata idaṃ vighaṭate pra॰
atra prayogaḥ --asatāpi hi tena satā kenacid bhavitavyamiti pratijñā, yo bhavati yena prakāreṇa ca bhavati tena dvividhenāpyasatā bhavitavyamityarthaḥ

kasmāt ? pratyekavṛttitvāt, pratisvamātmarūpeṇa vartamānatvāt, athavā sattvāt, yaḥ san pratyekaṃ vā vartate so'sannapi kenacit prakāreṇa dṛṣṭo bhāvaḥ, yathā ghaṭādanyaḥ paṭo ghaṭatvenāsanneva paṭatvena san dṛṣṭa iti tadvadidamapi asadeva sad bhavatīti, tathā pratyekavṛttitvāditi
abhyupagatamapi caitat tvayāpi, vismṛtamadhunā mayā smāryametat --yathā ghaṭa ityaghaṭo na bhavati vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavatīti evamādyanyāpohaśabdārthavāditvād bhavataḥ

atra brūmaḥ--yadi sacchabdo'sacchabdo'pi bhavati tata eva ghaṭaśabdādyudāharaṇamavakāśaṃ labhate, anyathā kuto'syāvakāśaḥ ? sacchabda eva hi sannasacchabdo bhavatyeva itarathā ghaṭasya sataḥ paṭādyasattvābhāve kasya sataḥ śapanācchabdaḥ syāt sacchabdaḥ

tatra tāvadanaṅgīkṛtārthāntaratāyāmityādiḥ sa eva nyāyaḥ prāktanaḥ adravyaṃ na bhavati iti dvinañyayogād dravyameveti siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ, yo na bhavati yena na bhavatītyādi sa eva grantho vidhipradhānaparyudāsātmakādravyaśabdārthatyāgādidoṣāpādanaḥ prasajyapratiṣedhamātrārthatvādityetadarthātideśo gatārtho yāvad bhāvitavadabhyupagamatyāgaḥ

dvitīyavikalpe'pi arthāntarāpohatāyāmityādi tameva nyāyamatidiśati — pratisvasannyāyāt, pratisvadravyatvāt sarvadravyāṇāṃ dravyamityadravyaṃ na na bhavati itaretarābhāvādibhya ityādi yathāyogaṃ yojyaṃ tathaiva

atrāha --nanūcyamānasacchabdavadetatsiddhiḥ, siddhaṃ sacchabdamasatsvarūpavinirmuktaṃ manyamānaścodayati yaḥ sacchabdaḥ sa sataḥ śapanādāhvānāt, ataḥ śabdād yathā sacchabda eva sadarthavācyeva ca nāsacchabdo nāsadarthavācī vā tathā sadvastvapi syāditi
ghaṭaśabdādirapi viśeṣaśabdastadarthaśca tathā na paṭādiśabdastadartho vā bhavitumarhatīti
nābhyupagacchāma etat sacchabdo'sacchabdo na bhavati iti, tathodāharaṇatvāsambhavāt sacchabdāsacchabdatva evodāharaṇatvasiddheḥ
yadi hi sacchabdo'sacchabdo'pi bhavati tata eva loke'nyāpohavāde ca ghaṭaśabdādyudāharaṇamavakāśaṃ labhate, anyathā kuto'sya ghaṭādyudāharaṇasyāvakāśaḥ ?

tad vyācaṣṭe --sacchabda eva hi sannasacchabdo bhavatyeva, sadeva śabdayan ghaṭādi paṭādyaśabdanādasacchabdo bhavatyeva, itarathā ghaṭasya sataḥ paṭādyasattvābhāve sattvābhāvaḥ, sattvābhāvāt saṅkarādidoṣāccāsattve kasya sataḥ śapanācchabdaḥ syāt sacchabdo'ṅgīkṛtabhedārthatve ? tasmādayuktamuktam sacchabdavadasanna bhavati sadvastviti
evamarthataḥ sataḥ śabdaḥ sacchabdaḥ ityarthadvāreṇa sacchabdo'sacchabdo na bhavati ityayuktam
viśeṣaśabdārtheṣu tu ghaṭa ityaghaṭo na bhavati ityatrāpi na na bhavatyaghaṭaḥ
aghaṭo'pi ca ghaṭo bhavati, ghaṭate ghaṭayati vā tantutantuvāyagavāśvādiḥ
tathā pratyakṣaprasiddherananyatvaṃ siddhaṃ gośabdasya vāgādiṣu vartamānasya, tacchabda-
śabdato'pi ca astisacchabdaḥ aserdhātoḥ śatrantasya sat iti rūpasiddheryaḥ sacchabdaḥ so'nya eva
saderdhātoḥ kvibantasya yaḥ sacchabdaḥ so'pyanya eva, sadiprakṛtiḥ sacchabdo na bhavatyeva asiprakṛtiḥ sacchabdaḥ
tasmācchabdato'pi sacchabdo'sacchabdo bhavatyeva na na bhavatīti
yathā sacchabdasya rūpasiddhikṛtanānātvakṛte sattvāsattve tathā dravyaśabdasyāpi draṣṭavye
tathā drorvikāro dravyam, droravayavo vā dravyam, dravyaṃ ca bhavye pā॰ 5
104 bhavatīti bhavyaṃ dravyam, dravatīti dravyaṃ drūyate vā, dravaṇād guṇānāṃ guṇasandrāvo dravyam, ityādivyutpattyā pṛthivyādisvabhedāpekṣayā ca dravyaśabdaḥ sannadravyaśabdaśca
dravyādiśabdeṣu iti ādigrahaṇāt pṛthivyudakādisāmānyaśabdeṣvapi svabhedāpekṣeṣu vācyamityatideśārthaḥ
ghaṭa ityaghaṭo na bhavati ityatrāpi na na bhavatyaghaṭo bhavatyaghaṭa iti
tadyathā--āmacchidrādīti, āmaghaṭaśchidraghaṭo na bhavati, ādigrahaṇāccitralepyādighaṭa ityādayo ghaṭā evāghaṭā ghaṭanasāmarthyābhāvādaceṣṭatvāt
ghaṭayan vā ghaṭaḥ syāt prayoktṛkartari, tadabhāvādapyaghaṭo bhavatyeveti
kiñcānyat--aghaṭo'pi ca ghaṭo bhavati ceṣṭārthavattvāt svatantraḥ prayoktā ca, taddarśayati --ghaṭate ghaṭayati vā tantutantuvāyagavāśvādiriti prakṛtyantād ṇyantādvā kartaryaco vihitatvāt
gaurityagaurna bhavati ityetadapi na yuktam, yasmād gauragaurbhavati, agaurapi gaurbhavati ityetat pradarśyate
tatra hi dvayī śabdānāṃ gatiḥ--ekaḥ śabdo'nekārthaḥ, anekaḥ śabda ekārtho bhavati
gośabdasya tāvad vāgādiṣu vartamānasya ekatvaṃ pratyakṣaprasiddham, viśeṣānirūpyatvāt tatsambandhāśakyatvam
tasmiṃścaikātmatve śaktibhedāt tattadarthapratyāyanaśaktayaḥ prakalpyāḥ, ekapuruṣapitṛputrādivat pratisambandhamanyathāvṛtteḥ
gadanādiviśeṣanirūpyānyatve vā gavāntaravad gaureveti gaurityagaurna bhavatītyapi na, vāgādigavānāṃ vyatirekāt
ataḥ pratyakṣaprasiddherananyatvaṃ siddham, taccānāśaṅkanīyam— kimanyo'nanyo gośabda iti

syānmatam--bhinnārthagatergośabdasyānyatvam, sādṛśyāttu sa eva iti bhavatīti, etacca na, tacchabdaviśeṣānirūpyatvāt, ayamudātto'nudāttaḥ svarito vāci vartate, ayaṃ diśi ityādiviśeṣarūpasyānirūpyatvād nāstyanyatvaṃ pratyakṣasyānumānād balīyastvācca
tataḥ kim ? tatastatsambandhāśakyatvam, anirūpyātmarūpāṇāmasatāṃ pṛthaganupalabdhanānārthaiḥ saha na śakyaḥ sambandhaḥ kartum

tasmiṃścaikātmatve sati śabdasya śaktibhedāt sambandhibhirabhivyaktāt tattadarthapratyāyanaśaktayaḥ prakalpyāḥ, kimiva ? ekapuruṣapitṛputrādivat, yathaika eva puruṣo'nekaśaktisambandhibhedāpekṣayā pitā putro mātulo bhāgineya ityādivyapadeśabhāg bhavati tathā gośabdo'pi vāgādiṣu
kasmāt ? pratisambandhamanyathā vṛtteḥ, sa eva sambandhaṃ sambandhaṃ prati pratisambandhaṃ sambandhijanitamanyatvamanyathānyathā vartate
tasmādekatvād gośabdasya vāgādibhinnārthavācitvād gaureva vāgādiragaurbhavati, agaurapi gaurbhavati
tasmiṃścaikātmatve śaktibhedāt tattadarthapratyāyanaśaktayaḥ prakalpyāḥ, ekapuruṣapitṛputrādivat pratisambandhamanyathāvṛtteḥ
gadanādiviśeṣanirūpyānyatve vā gavāntaravad gaureveti gaurityagaurna bhavatītyapi na, vāgādigavānāṃ vyatirekāt
syānmatam--nimittabhedād gośabdā bhidyante, tāni ca nimittāni gadana-garjana-gamana-giraṇādīni, pṛṣodarādyākṛtigaṇatvād rūpasiddheranyatvameveti

etaccoktavidhinā na yuktamapyabhyupagamya gadanādiviśeṣanirūpyānyatve vā gavāntaravad gaureva, yathā hi gośabdaḥ sāsnādimatyekasminnapyarthe gamananimitte vṛtto'pi khaṇḍa-muṇḍa-śābaleya-bāhuleya-saurabheyādibhedeṣu gavāntareṣu gaureva

iti hetvarthe, yasmāt khaṇḍādiviśeṣāpekṣayā sāmānyaśabdo gośabdastasmāt pūrvavadasminnapi pakṣe gaurityagaurna bhavatītyapi na, kasmāt ? vāgādigavānāṃ vyatirekāt, tadyathā gauḥ ityukte vāgādiṣu na vyatiricyate gotvaṃ gośabdavat vāgityukte digādibhyo vyatiricyate vāg na dik iti
ekottaraśatanāmatvāccāmbhaso viṣamaviṣaṃ bhavati aviṣamapi viṣaṃ bhavatītyādi
tathā pīluvṛkṣo vṛkṣatvādapīlurbhavati dhavādivat, hastivat pīlurvā
salilamudakamamṛtaṃ vā jīvanaṃ viṣam ityādyekottaraṃ śatamudakanāmāni nirukte paṭhyante
tato viṣamaviṣaṃ bhavati, aviṣamapi viṣaṃ bhavati, apānīyaṃ granthisarpādiviṣaṃ māraṇātmakaṃ na, jīvanātmakam
tathā pīluvṛkṣaḥ vṛkṣatvādapīlurbhavati dhavādivat, hastivat pīlurvā
evaṃ harirāmārjunādayo'pi iti ca vyāpitāmapyasya nyāyasyodāharaṇabāhulyena darśayati
nīraṃ vāri jalaṃ dakaṃ kamudakaṃ pānīyamambhaḥ kuśaṃ toyaṃ jīvanajīvanīyasalilārṇāṃsyambu vāḥ saṃvaram
kṣīraṃ puṣkarameghapuṣpakamalānyāpaḥ pathaḥpāthasī kīlālaṃ bhuvanaṃ vanaṃ ghanaraso yādo nivāso'mṛtam
pāvanaṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ cāpi vallūraṃ tusitaṃ payaḥ
andhaṃ tu kaluṣaṃ toyamatisvacchaṃ tu kācimam
atha svārthābhāvābhāvamātratve kaḥ śabdārthaḥ 'vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavati' iti tacchabdadhūmaliṅgābhyāmanyāvapohyāvavṛkṣānagnī bhedāsaṃsparśena
tatra ca prasahyapratiṣedhārthe tanmātrameva ca gamyeta
kimiva ? ekādityetyādi yāvat kāritvavaditi gatārthaḥ proktārthopasaṃhāraḥ
tanna, pratyarthavṛttītyādi yāvad viśeṣasmṛtihetavaḥ iti yathāsaṅkhyaṃ sakarabhādyudāharaṇabhāvitārthaṃ kārikādvayaṃ nimittāntarādekārthāvacchedākhyānam
sakarabhā dhenurānīyatām ityatra karabhasaṃsargād viśiṣṭā eva dhenuravagamyate

atha pareṇocyeta--nanūktameva guṇasamudāyamātrasya kāṇakuṇṭāderdarśanāsambhavaḥ, satyapi ca darśane sarvathānumānāsambhavaḥ sarvaprakāreṇādṛṣṭatvāt iti nirākāṅkṣīkṛte mūlata eva punaridānīṃ ko vicāraḥ--darśanaṃ syāt na syāditi ? sthite tu svārthasyābhāve sāmānyarūpasyābhāvamātrasya nivṛttirabhāvabhedāsaṃsparśāt vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavati agnirityanagnirna bhavati ityavṛkṣānagnyabhāvabhedāsaṃsparśenocyate, na vā'bhāvasya bhedāḥ santi
atrocyate --atha svārthābhāvābhāvamātratve tvadiṣṭe kaḥ śabdārtha iti pṛcchati vṛkṣa ityādi pratyuccāryātrāpyapohābhāvamāpādayitukāmaḥ

tacchabdo vṛkṣaśabdaḥ parārthe'numāne svārthe dhūmaśca liṅge, tābhyāmanyāvapohyāvavṛkṣānagnī ghaṭādibhedarūpāṇyasaṃspṛśyetyabhimato'rthaḥ, tatra ca prasahyapratiṣedhārthe vṛkṣo na bhavatyavṛkṣaḥ iti tanmātrameva ca gamyeta, na ca gamyata ityabhiprāyaḥ
vṛkṣādanyo'vṛkṣa iti na vṛkṣaparyudāsena ghaṭādirarthātmā'nyaḥ kaścillabhyate, anyasyāsattvādavivakṣitatvācca vṛkṣa eva vyākhyeyo vivakṣita vṛkṣa eva vyākhyeyaḥ
sa svayamanavagataḥ kathamabhāvaṃ viśeṣayituṃ śaknuyāt avṛkṣo madabhāvaḥ iti, tasya bhāvena labhyātmalābhatvāt
tataśca vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavatītīdamuktaṃ bhavet--yo'bhāvābhāvaḥ sa vṛkṣaḥ
tato ghaṭapaṭādīnāmabhāvanivṛttimātratvād vṛkṣaśabdārthavattvaṃ prāptam, kuto'pohasteṣāṃ syāt

sarvadarśananirākāṅkṣatāyāṃ śabdādanumānādvā vṛkṣo'gniriti ca viśeṣavacanapratyayānarthakyaṃ syāt, abhāvābhāvamātrasyaikatvāt, bhedaviṣayavacanānumānavyavahāranirviṣayatvāt abhūtabhedaviṣayatvāt khapuṣpādivat

kiṃ tarhi ? svasambandhi- tvāt, sa svayamanavagataḥ kathamabhāvaṃ viśeṣayituṃ śaknuyāt avṛkṣo vṛkṣābhāvo madabhāvaḥ iti, khapuṣpamiva vandhyāputraḥ ? kasmāt ? tasyābhāvasya bhāvena labhyātmalābhatvāt sa svayamasan kathamasato viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt ? ubhayatra cānvaye vyatireke ca ghaṭādīnāṃ bhedarūpāṇāṃ sapakṣāsapakṣayorasaṃspṛśyatveneṣṭatvād na kiñcit kenacid viśeṣayituṃ śakyam
sa svayamanavagataḥ kathamabhāvaṃ viśeṣayituṃ śaknuyāt avṛkṣo madabhāvaḥ iti, tasya bhāvena labhyātmalābhatvāt
tataśca vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavatītīdamuktaṃ bhavet--yo'bhāvābhāvaḥ sa vṛkṣaḥ
tato ghaṭapaṭādīnāmabhāvanivṛttimātratvād vṛkṣaśabdārthavattvaṃ prāptam, kuto'pohasteṣāṃ syāt

sarvadarśananirākāṅkṣatāyāṃ śabdādanumānādvā vṛkṣo'gniriti ca viśeṣavacanapratyayānarthakyaṃ syāt, abhāvābhāvamātrasyaikatvāt, bhedaviṣayavacanānumānavyavahāranirviṣayatvāt abhūtabhedaviṣayatvāt khapuṣpādivat
asmāduktanyāyādeṣa śabdārthaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ, vṛkṣa ityavṛkṣo na bhavati ityukte idamuktaṃ bhavet sambhāvyeta yo'bhāvetyādi, abhāvasyābhāvo vṛkṣa ityuktaṃ syāt, nānyadabhāvanivṛtteḥ
tato ghaṭapaṭādīnāmabhāvanivṛttimātratvād vṛkṣatāvad vṛkṣaśabdārthavattvaṃ prāptam, kuto'pohasteṣāṃ syāt ? tatsaṃsparśe hi syādapohaste vṛkṣo na bhavatīti
॰haste vṛkṣo na bhavantīti ? tulanā pṛ॰ 718 paṃ॰ 24
kiñcānyat, sarvathā vā gatirbhavet, abhāvābhāvamātraṃ hi vṛkṣo'gnirvā syāt, na sapakṣāsapakṣabhedasaṃsparśena dṛṣṭavat
ataḥ sarvadarśananirākāṅkṣatā, tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ śabdād vṛkṣādanumānādvā dhūmādabhāvābhāvamātravṛkṣāgnitvādadṛṣṭabhedāsaṃsparśādeva tvaduktāt vṛkṣo'gniḥ iti ca viśeṣavacanapratyayānarthakyaṃ syāt
kasmāt ? abhāvābhāvamātrasyaikatvāditi svaparārthānumānayoḥ sāmānyena hetuḥ khapuṣpādivaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ
ayamanyo vyākhyāvikalpaḥ, tadyathā vikalpaḥ --sarvathā vā'gatirbhavet praśleṣalabhyākāratvāt

kiṃ tarhi ? iti pakṣāntaraṃ śrayate nirdoṣaṃ manyamānaḥ, svasambandhivṛkṣasyāgnervā sāmānyadharmeṣu tadanubandhibhedeṣu cāvinābhāviṣu darśanasaṃsparśena tadvyatirikteṣvadarśanasaṃsparśenānyāpohasya pravṛttatvādadoṣaḥ
yatra dṛṣṭaḥ so'tra sambandhyabhipreto na tvavinābhāvitvasambandhena
anyatrādarśanāditi anumeyābhāve'darśanāt, anyathā hi vṛkṣaśabdasya dhūmasya ca tasmin vastuni pṛthivīdravyādyabhāve'pi darśanaṃ vaktavyaṃ syāt
tadvyavacchedānumānamiti yatraivādarśanamuktaṃ vṛkṣābhāve'vṛkṣe'gnyabhāve'nagnau vā tato vyavacchedānumānam--avṛkṣo'nagnirvā na bhavatīti
evaṃ ca kṛtvā vṛkṣaśabdād dhūmācca dravyatvādyanumānamupapannaṃ bhavati

evaṃ tarhi yadi sattādīni viśeṣaṇāni vṛkṣo bhavanti sa vā tāni bhavati ekabhavanātmako'rtho'sya vṛkṣaśabdasya tatsvātmavat tato'nanyatvāt dravyādivṛkṣa- sattādravyatvādisāmānyadharmāstadanubandhino bhedāśca śiṃśapādayaḥ teṣvavinābhāviṣu darśanasaṃsparśena tadvyatirikteṣu ghaṭādiṣvadarśanasaṃsparśena jalādiṣu cānyāpohasya pravṛttatvānna sambhavantyubhayapakṣagatā doṣāḥ
yatra dṛṣṭaḥ so'tra sambandhyabhipreto na tvavinābhāvitvasambandhena
anyatrādarśanāditi anumeyābhāve'darśanāt, anyathā hi vṛkṣaśabdasya dhūmasya ca tasmin vastuni pṛthivīdravyādyabhāve'pi darśanaṃ vaktavyaṃ syāt
tadvyavacchedānumānamiti yatraivādarśanamuktaṃ vṛkṣābhāve'vṛkṣe'gnyabhāve'nagnau vā tato vyavacchedānumānam--avṛkṣo'nagnirvā na bhavatīti
evaṃ ca kṛtvā vṛkṣaśabdād dhūmācca dravyatvādyanumānamupapannaṃ bhavati
evaṃ tarhi yadi sattādīni viśeṣaṇāni vṛkṣo bhavanti sa vā tāni bhavati ekabhavanātmako'rtho'sya vṛkṣaśabdasya tatsvātmavat tato'nanyatvāt dravyādivṛkṣa-
ata eva cedamityādi etatpakṣasaṃśrayadarśanārthaṃ bhāṣyagranthamāha svasambandhibhyo'nyatrādarśanādityādi
asya vyākhyā ṭīkāgrantho yatra dṛṣṭa ityādiḥ yāvadavṛkṣo'nagnirvā na bhavatīti gatārthaḥ

evaṃ ca kṛtvetyādi yāvadupapannaṃ bhavatīti, anekāvinābhāvināṃ pṛthivīdravyatvādīnāṃ vṛkṣaśabdād dhūmāccānubandhināmanumānaṃ yujyate taddarśanasparśena, vṛkṣatvāt pṛthivī dravyaṃ sacca dhūmatvācca vṛkṣavadagnivacceti
itarathā tvityādi, atyantavyatireke sambandhitvābhāve'nubandhināṃ dravyādīnāmapyanyatvādatulye vipakṣa eva vṛtterapakṣadharmatvānaikāntikatvaviruddhatvānumānābhāvadoṣāḥ syuḥ
anubandhināṃ dravyādīnāṃ tyāge tadavinābhāvino vṛkṣasya svārthasyāsambhava eveti ca doṣaḥ
tasmāt svasambandhyabhāvetyādyuktopasaṃhāraḥ, sambandhino'rthāntarasya bhāve darśanāt sambandhina eva bhāvābhāve'darśanāccānumānasyābhipretasya siddhiriti
ayamapi pāṭhaḥ samīcīno bhāti, vyākhyāyāṃ sambandhino'rthāntarasya iti darśanāt

yadi sattādīnītyādi sattādravyapṛthivyādīni viśeṣaṇāni vṛkṣasya vṛkṣādabhinnāni santi vṛkṣo bhavanti tāni vṛkṣa evetyarthaḥ, sa vā vṛkṣastāni bhavati tena tāni viśeṣyante devadattapāṇyādivadekabhavanātmanetyetadāpannam
tasminnekabhavane prayogaḥ śākhādimati darśanamityucyate'syārthaḥ sa ekabhavanātmako'rtho'sya vṛkṣaśabdaprayogasya
kimiva ? tatsvātmavat sattādravyatvādivṛkṣasvātmavad vṛkṣasya sattādravyatvādisvātmavat ekabhavanātmavadityarthaḥ
kasmāt ? uktanyāyena tato'nanyatvāt tebhyastasya tasmād vā teṣāmananyatvāt dravyādivṛkṣabhāvadarśanād vṛkṣadravyādibhāvadarśanādityarthaḥ
yat ko'pi bhavati tad bhavanaparamārthata eva...
yo'pyasau vyāvartate so'pi bhavanaparamārthata eva bhavata eva vyāvṛtteḥ, devadattādivyāvṛttivat, na khapuṣpādivat
evaṃ bhavadbhavananirūpaṇe sthita evārtha; sa cānyaścetyanyāpohaparigrahe sarvathā vā gatirbhavet
athavā anirvāhakaikāntavyākhyāvikalpapradarśanāt sarvathā vā vikalpānāṃ gatiranekāntaḥ sa evaivaṃ bhavet

pṛthivīdravyasattvābhāve darśanaṃ vṛkṣasya vṛkṣābhāve vā pṛthivyādibhāvadarśanaṃ vṛkṣātmaviṣayaṃ nābhyanujñāyate yasmāt tasmādekabhavanātmakatvānujñānādanyābhāvādatisphuṭa evāyaṃ vidhivādastvayābhyupagataḥ, pūrveṣvapi pakṣeṣu sphuṭa eva vidhivādaḥ, asmiṃstvatisphuṭaḥ
yat ko'pi bhavatītyādinā bhavanameveti darśayati yāvad vaidharmyeṇa khapuṣpavaditi

bhavata eva vyāvṛtteriti hetuḥ, bhavanneva vyāvartate kartari ṣaṣṭhīvibhaktyutpatteḥ, parvate pratihatasya devadattasya vyāvṛttivat sata eva vyāvṛtterityapādānalakṣaṇā pañcamī vā, yo bhavati parvatādiḥ tasmād bhavata eva parvatāderdevadattādervyāvṛttivat na khapuṣpādivaditi vidhivāda eva sphuṭīkṛtaḥ
yat ko'pi bhavati tad bhavanaparamārthata eva...
yo'pyasau vyāvartate so'pi bhavanaparamārthata eva bhavata eva vyāvṛtteḥ, devadattādivyāvṛttivat, na khapuṣpādivat
yaḥ ko'pi iti cet pāṭhaḥ syāt tadā yaḥ ko'pi bhavati sa bhavanaparamārthata eva iti mūlaṃ sambhāvanīyam
evaṃ bhavadbhavananirūpaṇe sthita evārtha; sa cānyaścetyanyāpohaparigrahe sarvathā vā gatirbhavet
athavā anirvāhakaikāntavyākhyāvikalpapradarśanāt sarvathā vā vikalpānāṃ gatiranekāntaḥ sa evaivaṃ bhavet
atra yaḥ ko'pi ityapi bhavet pāṭhaḥ
itthaṃ bhavadeva bhavatīti nirūpaṇe'yamasya sthita evārthaḥ— sa cānyaścetyayamanyāpohaparigrahaḥ, tasmiṃśca sati sarvathā vā gatirbhavet, anugamo vidhirevetyupasaṃharati
athavā anirvāhaketyādi, ye tvamī vyākhyāvikalpāḥ kalpitā vidhivāde'nyāpohavāde caikāntarūpāste sarve na nirvahantītyupekṣyāḥ
tatpradarśanāt sarvathāśabdo vimardaramaṇīyaḥ pariniṣṭhito'tītasarvavicārasyāyaṃ piṇḍārtha ityetadākhyānārthaḥ
ko'sau piṇḍārtha iti cet, ucyate--veti vāśabdo vikalpārthaḥ, vikalpānāṃ gatiriti vikalpānāmeva jñānaṃ niścayaḥ pariniṣṭhā sarvathā ghaṭo ghaṭo'pyaghaṭo'pītyādi niścayaḥ

kā sā gatiḥ ? anekāntaḥ, sa eva evaṃ bhavet sa evānekānto vimardakṣamo vicāraparyavasāne'vatiṣṭhetettham, sarvanyāyapariśuddhiphalatvādasya sarvavikalpāḥ, saṅkṣepeṇa vidhi-pratiṣedhau, tāvubhāvitthaṃ gṛhītāviti darśayati --vidhivikalpo'pi sadādyātmakārthagrahaṇāditi vidhim, apohavikalpo'pi svasambandhyanyapratiṣedhārthatvāditi pratiṣedham
tena sarvathā vikalpānāṃ vā gatiḥ syādvādaḥ
sa ca dravyārthaparyāyārthāvekāntatyāgarūpaikavākyamatyātmakau, tayorviṣayavibhāgena śabdārthamupasaṃhṛtya vikalpo'pi svasambandhyanyapratiṣedhārthatvāt
na ca tena saha kasyacid virodhaḥ, ārādhyatvāccharaṇatvācca sarveṣāmapi
tataścedamapi duradhītamevānyāpohavādinā--dṛṣṭavad vidhirūpeṇa yadi liṅgaṃ prakāśayet
14 iti yattūktam--anvayadvāreṇa cānumāne'yaṃ doṣaḥ--yasmādanugamo'sti vṛkṣaśabdasyārthādisahitasya śiṃśapādiṣvapi tasmāt kevalo'pi śiṃśapāvācī syād vṛkṣaśabdaḥ

atha bahuṣu palāśādiṣvapi dṛṣṭa iti saṃśayo bhavati, evaṃ sati vṛkṣārthe sattvadravyatvapārthivatvāni santi teṣu vṛkṣaśabdasya samānatvāt saṃśayaḥ syāt, niścayastu dṛṣṭaḥ, avṛkṣanivṛttyā'rthāmidhānavadapṛthivyadravyāsattvavyāvṛttyā vṛkṣābhidhānāt
yathā hi vṛkṣaśabdo'vṛkṣanivṛttyaikārthako'pārthivavyāvṛttyāpi svārthe vartate tathā vṛkṣapārthivadravyasacchabdā ānulomyena tridvyekārthaniścayahetavaḥ, prātilomyena saṃśayahetava iti
darśayati yathāsaṅkhyam --dravyārthata ityādi gatārthaṃ sodāharaṇaṃ yāvat syādanapoha ityādi
na ca tenetyādi yāvat sarveṣāmapīti vādaparameśvaratvapradarśanaṃ syādvādasya gatārtham
na ca tena saha kasyacid virodhaḥ, ārādhyatvāccharaṇatvācca sarveṣāmapi
sarvathā'pratipattiḥ syāt sarvathā vā gatirbhavet || pra॰ samu॰ 3 | 14 iti
yattūktam--anvayadvāreṇa cānumāne'yaṃ doṣaḥ--yasmādanugamo'sti vṛkṣaśabdasyārthādisahitasya śiṃśapādiṣvapi tasmāt kevalo'pi śiṃśapāvācī syād vṛkṣaśabdaḥ

atha bahuṣu palāśādiṣvapi dṛṣṭa iti saṃśayo bhavati, evaṃ sati vṛkṣārthe sattvadravyatvapārthivatvāni santi teṣu vṛkṣaśabdasya samānatvāt saṃśayaḥ syāt, niścayastu dṛṣṭaḥ, avṛkṣanivṛttyā'rthāmidhānavadapṛthivyadravyāsattvavyāvṛttyā vṛkṣābhidhānāt
yathā hi vṛkṣaśabdo'vṛkṣanivṛttyaikārthako'pārthivavyāvṛttyāpi svārthe vartate tathā vṛkṣapārthivadravyasacchabdā ānulomyena tridvyekārthaniścayahetavaḥ, prātilomyena saṃśayahetava iti
evaṃ sati vṛkṣārthe sattvadravyatvapārthivatvādiṣu kasmānniścayo bhavati ityapi mūlaṃ syādatra
yathā hi vṛkṣapārthivadravyasacchabdā ānulomyena tridvyekārthaniścayahetavastathā pratilomyena saṃśayahetavaḥ ityapi pāṭho'tra bhavet

tataścedamapi duradhītamevānyāpohavādinā ityuktārthānusāreṇātideśena dūṣayati kārikām, anyāpohasya kevalasya dūṣitatvād darśanabalenaiva śabdārthapratipattervyākhyātatvāt ante vā syādvādopasaṃhārādekāntavidhivādadūṣaṇasya prakāśitaprakāśanavad vaiyarthyāditi
yatūktamityādi yat pareṇa doṣajātamupanyastaṃ vidhivādinaṃ prati tat parihartukāmaḥ pūrvapakṣayati
vṛkṣo mañcakaḥ kriyate ityādyarthaprakaraṇaśabdāntarasannidhyādibhiḥ śiṃśapādiṣvapi dṛṣṭatvāt sarvatra sarvathā kevalo'pi śiṃśapāvācī syād vṛkṣaśabdaḥ, aniṣṭaṃ caitat kevalasyāpratyāyanāt
atra ॰dibhiḥ śiṃśapādibhiḥ śiṃśapā॰ iti pāṭho dvirbhūtaḥ pratīyate

bahuṣu palāśādiṣvapi dṛṣṭo'yaṃ vṛkṣaśabdastasmāt katama eṣāṃ vivakṣitaḥ syāt ? iti sāmānyāt saṃśayo bhavatītyāśaṅkya tatrāpi doṣaṃ brūyādanyāpohavādī evaṃ satītyādi, vṛkṣārthe sattvadravyatvapārthivatvāni dṛṣṭāni, teṣu niścayo dṛṣṭa ityanaikāntikametat
asya ca nyāyasya guṇopacayavarṇanam --yathā hi vṛkṣetyādi gatārthaṃ yāvat saṃśayahetava iti
anvayadvāreṇa cānumāne'yaṃ guṇaḥ--dṛṣṭabalenaivārthādibhiḥ saha śiṃśapādiṣu vṛkṣaśabdasya dṛṣṭatvānniścayo bhavati kevalāt saṃśayo yathādarśanamanumānapravṛtteḥ
evameva ca vṛkṣārthabhavanena vinā vṛkṣo na bhavatīti vṛkṣaśabdāt tadbhavanaṃ yathā pratīyate tathā pārthivadravyasattvāni pratīyante, tairvinā vṛkṣabhavanasyaivādarśanāt
vidhirūpeṇa darśanasāmarthyenaiva ca vṛkṣapārthivadravyasacchabdā ānulomyena tridvyekārthaniścayahetavaḥ, prātilomyena saṃśayahetavaḥ

vyākhyā --anvayadvāreṇa cānumāne'yaṃ guṇa ityādi, dṛṣṭabalenaiva hi artha-prakaraṇa-viśeṣaṇādibhiḥ saha śiṃśapādiṣu dṛṣṭatvānniścayo bhavati, tairvinā na dṛṣṭatvāt kevalāt saṃśayaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? yathādarśanamanumānapravṛtteḥ

yadapyucyate--sattva-dravyatva-pārthivatvādiṣu kasmād niścayo bhavati ? iti, tatrāpi dṛṣṭabalādeva, evameva ca vṛkṣārthetyādi yāvad vṛkṣabhavanasyaivādarśanāditi etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā vṛkṣaḥ svārthabhavanena vinā na bhavatīti vṛkṣaśabdāt tadbhavanaṃ pratīyate tathā pārthivadravyāstitvairvinā vṛkṣatvasyābhavanād vṛkṣatvabhavanapratītivat pārthiva-dravya-sattvāni pratīyante tairvinā tasyaivādarśanāditi

yadapi ca vṛkṣaśabdāt pārthiva-dravya-sattvatryarthagatiḥ pārthivaśabdād dravya-sattvadvyarthagatiḥ dravyaśabdāt sattvagatiḥ prātilomyena sadādyānulomyena cottareṣu pūrvasmāt saṃśaya iti tadapi vidhirūpeṇa darśanasāmarthyenaiva ca vṛkṣapārthivadravyasacchabdā ānulomyenetyādi tatpradarśanaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvat saṃśayahetava iti darśanasyaiva niścaya-saṃśayahetutvāt
evaṃ gamyatāmityādiruktopasaṃhāro tuya ?darthaprakaraṇādisahitād vṛkṣaśabdācchiṃśapāvṛkṣatvatattvād dhavādibhyo'rthebhyo'nyasmācchiṃśapādiśabdād viśeṣātmakādiva viśeṣadarśanādeveti
yo'yaṃ vṛkṣaśabdoccāraṇe kadācicchiṃśapāyā gatiḥ kadācit tadagatirityaniyamaḥ sa viśeṣādarśanādagatiḥ viśeṣadarśanād gatiḥ
tatra nidarśanam --yathā avibhātaikadeśetyādi dhūmaviṣayaṃ prāgvarṇitaṃ darśanaṃ saṃśayāya, viśiṣṭaṃ tu niścayāyeti dṛṣṭāntaḥ
kena punarnyāyenaitadevam ? iti tad vyācaṣṭe --tadbhāvadarśananyāyavat, yathopavarṇitaṃ prāg deśa evāgnidhūmātmakastadbhāvena dṛṣṭo vidhinā ātmānamevātmanā sādhayatītyādi sa evātrāpīti
evaṃ vṛkṣatvasya pṛthivītvādibhistribhiḥ pṛthivyā dravyasattvābhyāṃ dravyasya sattvenānulomyena tathā darśanāt prātilomyena tathā'darśanācca nirṇayasaṃśayau
atha manyeta--tāvetau na yuktau darśanādubhayato'pi aviśeṣo niścaya eva vā syāt
manmate tu yuktau, atulyatvāt svārthābhāve vṛttyavṛttyoḥ
nanūktam--avṛkṣādāvadarśanāt tadvyavacchedānumānaṃ svārthābhidhānam pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 5
evaṃ ca sati kva tad darśanam ?

evaṃ vṛkṣatvasyetyādi prakṛtopasaṃhāraḥ, śiṃśapādiviśeṣeṣu pṛthivyādisāmānyeṣu ca tulyamapyanekatra vṛttaṃ vṛkṣatvaṃ svārthena sahaiva vṛtteḥ pṛthivītvādibhirgamyate tribhirānulomyena pṛthivī-dravya-sattvaiḥ pṛthivī, dravya-sattvābhyāṃ dravyaṃ, sattve tvekameva ānulomyena tathā darśanāt
sattvādyuttarottarasaṃśayastu prātilomyenādarśanādeva tatheti yāvad nirṇayasaṃśayāviti gatārthaḥ
tāvetau niścayasaṃśayau na yuktau darśanādubhayato'pi vṛkṣadarśanasya dhava-śiṃśapayoraviśeṣo niścaya eva vā syāt
manmate punaranyāpohe svārthābhāve vṛtteḥ saṃśayo yujyeta avṛtteśca niścayaḥ, kasmāt ? atulyatvāt svārthābhāve vṛttyavṛttyoḥ, te hi svārthābhāvavṛttyavṛttī yathāsaṅkhyaṃ saṃśayaniścayahetū
tad vyācaṣṭe--saṃśayahetavastāvad vṛkṣādiśabdāḥ śiṃśapādisvārthābhāve'pi palāśādau vṛtteḥ, sadādiśabdāśca dravyādisvārthābhāve'pi guṇādau vṛtteḥ saṃśayahetavaḥ
niścayahetavastu vṛkṣāvayavāñchākhādīn vyāpnuvantaḥ pārthivamṛddravyatvādīṃścānubandhino'rthān svārthasyābhāve na vartante, tataste vyāvṛttibalenaiva niścayahetava iti
etacca na, darśanasyaivotsargāpavādabhūtatvāt, vṛkṣabhavanadarśanameva hi palāśaśiṃśapādiṣūtsargeṇa pravṛttaṃ saṃśayāya śiṃśapābhavananiyatamapavādabhūtaṃ niścayāya
kasmāt ? vastuno'tulyatvāt, vastveva hi viśiṣṭamatulyaṃ śiṃśapāpalāśākhyaṃ parasparataḥ, tadupakāritvāt sāmānyavṛkṣabhavanasya sāmānyādupasarjanāt ityuktanyāyatvāt

kimiva ? sthāṇu-puruṣetyādi dṛṣṭānto yāvad darśanavaditi yathā ūrddhatvaṃ sāmānyaṃ sthāṇuḥ syāt puruṣaḥ syāt iti saṃśayahetuḥ, śakuninilayanaṃ sthāṇureva iti niścayaheturviśiṣṭatvāt, vastrasaṃyamanaṃ vā puruṣa eva iti, tathaiva vṛkṣaśiṃśapādiṣvapi darśanādeva
vṛkṣāderabhāvo hi avṛkṣādi, tatraivādarśanam, tato vyavacchedyamānaṃ yat tadavṛkṣādi na bhavatīti tadeva svārthābhidhānamiti
evaṃ ca sati kva tad darśanaṃ yat tvayeṣṭam ? yato nanvadarśanād darśanasyaiva siddhirevam
yadi darśanaṃ nābhyupagamyate vṛkṣa ityatrāvṛkṣābhāva evoktaḥ syāt tata idamadarśanamevāvṛkṣe
apitṛvadavṛkṣādarśanaṃ vyatireka iti cet, na uktavat
sthite hi vṛkṣe darśane tvavṛkṣa iti syāt
vidhiprādhānye tu pṛthivītvādyuttarabhavanaṃ vṛkṣabhavanavijñānavidhyāpādyaṃ tadātma- darśanotsargāpavādābhyāṃ vastuno'tulyatvāt saṃśayaniścayāviṣyeyātām, tattu nāsti darśanam
vayaṃ hyānantyavyabhicārādidoṣān darśanapakṣe'pekṣyādarśanasādhanārthamavṛkṣādyabhāvo vṛkṣādiśabdārtha iti kalpayāmo darśanasyaivābhāvāt taddoṣāsaṃsparśādadarśanamātrasyābhinnatvāditi
vyavacchedānumānam iti pāṭho'tra samyag bhāti, tulanā--pṛ॰ 650 paṃ॰ 20
yadi darśanaṃ nābhyupagamyate vṛkṣa ityatrāvṛkṣābhāva evoktaḥ syāt tata idamadarśanamevāvṛkṣe
apitṛvadavṛkṣādarśanaṃ vyatireka iti cet, na uktavat
sthite hi vṛkṣe darśane tvavṛkṣa iti syāt
tad vyācaṣṭe— yadi darśanamanvayo vidhirnābhyupagamyate vṛkṣa ityatrāvṛkṣasyābhāva evoktaḥ syāt, na vṛkṣo nāma kaścit syāt
tataḥ kim ? tata idamadarśanamevāvṛkṣe, vyatireka evetyarthaḥ
tataścābhāvamātrameva khapuṣpādītyādiprāguktavanna kiñciduktaṃ syāt avṛkṣābhāvo vṛkṣaḥ ityabhāvamātratvāt

tatrāvṛkṣasyaivābhāvo vṛkṣībhūtatvāt sarvasyāvṛkṣābhāvasya kutastadadarśanamavṛkṣasya vṛkṣadarśanenaiva vyāptatvāt ? vṛkṣadarśanabalādeva cāvṛkṣādarśanasiddhiḥ, vṛkṣadarśanācca ayaṃ vṛkṣaḥ, ayaṃ ghaṭādiravṛkṣaḥ iti siddhiḥ, nādṛṣṭe

etacca na, uktavat pitṛkalpasya darśanaṃ syādatrāpi, na cet prāguktavadevānupapattiḥ, pratyakṣadarśanabalena hi ayaṃ vṛkṣaḥ, ayamanyo'smād ghaṭādiravṛkṣaḥ iti vyavasthite vidhinā dṛṣṭe'nyāpohalakṣaṇama- darśanaṃ syāt, nānyatheti
etadarthapradarśano granthaḥ --vyavasthākārītyādi yāvat sthite hi vṛkṣe vidheye darśane tvavṛkṣa iti syāt vidhinā darśanānvaye sati sidhyatyetaditi darśayatyeṣa granthaḥ
vyāvṛttipakṣe tvaniṣṭāpādanam --sa tu tava kadetyādi yāvat tacca neṣyata eva tvayeti vibhaktipariṇāmād
ghaṭādibhyo vyāvṛttau satyāṃ vṛkṣādisiddhiḥ tatsiddhau ghaṭādivyāvṛttisiddhirityanavasthā parasparataḥ syāt
sā mā bhūditi darśanaṃ vyavasthāpakameṣitavyaṃ vidhinā vyāvartyavyāvartakayorvṛkṣādisadādyavṛkṣādyasadādyoriti
kathaṃ punarvidhiprādhānye taddoṣābhāvaḥ ? ucyate --vidhiprādhānye tu pṛthivītvādyuttaretyādi sādhanaṃ yāvat svātmavaditi

vṛkṣa-pṛthivī-dravya-santo vṛkṣa-śiṃśapā-kubja-kusumita-mūla-skandha-śākhādayaśca vṛkṣādayaḥ pūrve cottare ca bhāvā vidhinā dṛṣṭāḥ, pārthivabhavanaṃ vṛkṣabhavanavijñānavidhyāpādyameva vṛkṣātmakatvāt katvāt tato'nanyatvād vṛkṣasvātmavat
tathā vṛkṣādipūrvabhavanaṃ śiṃśapādyuttarabhavanavijñānavidhyāpādyaṃ tadātmakatvāt tato'nanyatvād vṛkṣamūlādivat
vyāvṛttiprādhānye tu dṛṣṭavat pārthivatvādyasiddhau vṛkṣo naiva vṛkṣaḥ syāt pārthivatvenāsiddhatvāt toyavat
tathā pārthivaṃ dravyatvenāsiddhatvāt pārthivaṃ naiva syāt, guṇavat
evaṃ dravyaṃ na dravyaṃ syāt sattvenāsiddhatvāt khapuṣpavat
tato'nanyatvād vṛkṣasvātmavat, vṛkṣātmakatvaṃ ca pārthivatvādīnāṃ pūrvamāpāditaṃ mūlādyuttarabhavanānāṃ cetyatastadekātmakatvasiddhau satyāṃ sādhanasya sādhīyastvam
tathā vṛkṣādipūrvetyādi sādhanaṃ tadviparyayeṇa uttarabhavanadharmāpādanam, tadanatiriktātmakatvāt tato'nanyatvāt, vṛkṣamūlādīti dṛṣṭāntaḥ
śiṃśapādyuttarabhavanavijñānavidhyāpādyo vṛkṣaḥ, tadātmakatvāt, mūla-skamdha-palāśādidharmātmanā vṛkṣa eva yathā bhavan dṛṣṭastathā śiṃśapādyātmanā vṛkṣa eva bhavatīti
evaṃ vidhirūpeṇa dṛṣṭavadevānumānaṃ vidhiprādhānye yujyate'bhidhānaṃ ca
tathā vṛkṣādipūrvabhavanaṃ śiṃśapādyuttarabhavanavijñānavidhyāpādyaṃ tadātmakatvāt tato'nanyatvād vṛkṣamūlādivat
vyāvṛttiprādhānye tu dṛṣṭavat pārthivatvādyasiddhau vṛkṣo naiva vṛkṣaḥ syāt pārthivatvenāsiddhatvāt toyavat
tathā pārthivaṃ dravyatvenāsiddhatvāt pārthivaṃ naiva syāt, guṇavat
evaṃ dravyaṃ na dravyaṃ syāt sattvenāsiddhatvāt khapuṣpavat

tadyathā --dṛṣṭavat pārthivatvādyasiddhau pārthivadravyasadekātmakabhavanameva vṛkṣabhavanamanicchato'smanmataṃ te vṛkṣo naiva vṛkṣaḥ syāt pārthivatvenāsiddhatvāt toyavat, yathā toyaṃ pārthivatvenāsiddhaṃ vṛkṣo na bhavati evaṃ vṛkṣo'pi vṛkṣo naiva syāt
tathā pārthivaṃ dravyatvenāsiddhatvāt pārthivaṃ naiva syāt, guṇavat, yathā guṇasya dravyatvenāsiddhatvādapārthivatvaṃ tathā pārthivasyāpi apārthivatvaṃ syāt
evaṃ dravyaṃ na dravyaṃ syāt, sattvenāsiddhatvāt, khapuṣpavaditi
pārthivadravyasattvāsiddhayo'siddhā iti cet, na, vyāvṛttiprādhānye'nyatvāt svārthānubandhibhedānāmapi vyāvṛttatvāt svārthābhāvābhāvaśabdārthatvāt
prasiddhivirodhadoṣa iti cet, tavaiva vyāvṛttiprādhānyābhyupagamāddoṣo na mameti
tathā sadapi na sat, dravyāditvenāsiddhatvāt khapuṣpavat iti vartate
evaṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ nātmarūpabhāk syāt, uttararūpeṇābhūtatvāt, agnivaditi yathāvad gatārthamaniṣṭāpādanam
savṛttike pramāṇasamuccaye dvitīye svārthānumānaparicchede diṅgāgena yadabhihitaṃ tadatra bhoṭabhāṣāntarataḥ saṃskṛte parivartyopanyasyate--
vahnerdīptitaikṣṇyādayo yāvanto viśeṣāste santo'pi dhūmena na gamyante vyabhicārāt

ye punaranubandhino yadabhāve'gnirna bhavati teṣāṃ dravyatvaguṇatvādīnāmadravyādibhyo vyāvṛttireva pratīyate, yathāgneranagnito vyāvṛttimātraṃ svasambandhānurūpyāt pratīyate, tathāhi--ayamanagnau sarvatra na dṛṣṭaḥ, anyatra ca dṛṣṭaḥ
tatra guṇatvena adravyād gandhatvenāpārthivādadravyācca saurabhyeṇāsurabhisādhāraṇāt saurabhyaviśeṣeṇānutpalādervyavaccheda ekaikavṛddhyā kriyate
sarvatrādarśanānna syāt iti pāṭho viśālāmalavatyāmādṛto bhāti
yadi ca yathā dhūmo'gnau dṛṣṭastathottarakāle prakāśayati kadācidapi naiva prakāśayet
yathānagnau sarvatra na dṛṣṭastathā sarvatrāgnāvapi na dṛṣṭaḥ
yadi ca yathā dṛṣṭastathā prakāśayati tathā sati dīptitaikṣṇyādayo viśeṣā api gamyeran
yasmāt sāmānyarūpeṇaivānagnipratiṣedhena prakāśyate tasmād vidhināpi tadevāsya rūpaṃ dṛṣṭamiti pratīyate na viśeṣarūpam
tato'nyat tad na dṛśyeta, bhedo vaikatra darśanāt || 2 | 15 1/2
atha sāmānyamekāśrayagrahaṇe'pi samastaṃ gṛhyate tathā sati āśrayavad nānā syāt
dhūmo'pi dhūmatvapāṇḍuratvādinā yenāṃśenāgniṃ na vyabhicarati tenaiva gamayati, na dravyatvādibhiḥ, vyabhicārāt
āha ca— gamyante te'pi liṅgena ye liṅginyanubandhinaḥ
viśeṣā na tu gamyante tasyaiva vyabhicāriṇaḥ
viśeṣā na tu gamyante tasyaiva vyabhicāriṇaḥ || 2 | 17 1/2
asya jinendrabuddhinā racitā viśālāmalavatī ṭīkāpi bhoṭabhāṣānuvādāt saṃskṛte parivartyehopanyasyate --anubandhivyavaccheda iti
anubandhinā sambandhinā yenāṃśenāgniḥ pratīyate tasya dravyatvādeḥ vipakṣādanyasmād vyavacchedo vyāvṛttiḥ pratīyate
ke punaranubandhino viśeṣā iti cet, yadabhāve'gnirna bhavatītyādi
nanu dhūmasya prakāśakatvād yadabhāve dhūmo na bhavati iti vaktavyam, kuta evamucyata iti cet; ayamevārtho'nena prakāreṇokta iti na doṣaḥ
tathāhi--yadabhāve'gnirna bhavati tadabhāve dhūmo'pi na bhavatyeva
athavā ye sambandhina iti dhūmasyaivānubandhina iti yojyam
kasmād vyāvṛttimātraṃ gamyate na viśeṣa ityāha— svasambandhānurūpyādityādi
anagnau sarvatra na dṛṣṭa ityanena vyāvṛtteḥ prādhānyaṃ vipakṣe sarvatrādarśanena kathayati anyatra ca dṛṣṭa iti caśabdena kvacidadarśanamapīti dyotanenānvayāprādhānyam

evaṃ yasmādanvaya upacarito vyāvṛttistu mukhyaḥ sambandhaḥ sa ca sāmānyenaiva sambhavati na viśeṣeṇa tasmāt tadānurūpyād vyāvṛttidvāreṇa atrāgnireva, nānagnirbhavati iti anagnito vyāvṛttimātraṃ pratīyate na viśeṣaḥ
yathā cāgnitvena sambandha evaṃ dravyatvaguṇitvādibhirapīti teṣāmapyadravyatvādibhyo vyāvṛttireva pratīyate
guṇatvena adravyāditi idaṃ dravyaṃ guṇatvāt iti guṇatvenādravyavyavaccheda utpalādau kriyate
tathāhi--tat sarvatrādravye na dṛṣṭam, dravye dṛṣṭam
yadapekṣayā gandhenaikavṛddhyā vyavacchedaḥ kriyate tatpradarśanārthaṃ guṇatvena adravyāt ityuktam
ata eva guṇatvasyāpyekavṛddhyā vyavacchedaṃ prati aṅgabhāvo'sti
yadi tenādravyavyavacchedo vidhīyate tarhi gandhenaikavṛddhyā vyavacchedaḥ kriyate, nānyathā
tathā ca kārikāyāṃ dvandvasamāsāntatvena guṇatvaśabdasyāvirodhaḥ padāntareṇa tulyasāmarthyāt
gandhatvenāpārthivādadravyatvācceti idaṃ pārthivaṃ dravyaṃ ca gandhatvāt iti apārthivādadravyācca vyavacchedaḥ kriyate
saurabhyeṇa asurabhisādhāraṇāditi saurabhyeṇa pūrvābhyāmasurabhisādhāraṇācca vyavacchedaḥ kriyate
gandhaviśeṣasurabhisādhāraṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ surabhisādhāraṇam, yad na surabhisādhāraṇaṃ tat tathoktam
sa katham ? yadi vipakṣād vyāvṛttidvāreṇa heturgamakaḥ, anyathā na yujyate

sukaro hi śabdasyānyāpohena sambandhaḥ, śabdo jātimātrasya tadyogasya vā na vācako bhedārthairapṛthakchruteḥ
tathā hi sad dravyaṃ san guṇaḥ sat karma iti bhedārthairdravyādiśabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt, tacca dṛṣṭam
na hi sattā yogo vā dravyaṃ guṇo vā bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? dravyasya guṇasya vā
tathaiva hi anyāpohasya na samānādhikaraṇābhāvaprasaṅgadoṣajātasya abhāva iti
sadityasanna bhavati ityasato nivṛttiḥ sarvadravyaguṇakarmaghaṭarūpotkṣepaṇādibhedavyāpinī, tasyā asannivṛtteḥ sarvabhedavyāpitvāt tairabhinnārthatvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapannamiti

tadvyākhyā --sāmānyaśabdasya hītyādi, sāmānyaśabdasya hi sadāderyo'rthāntaravyudāsaḥ asanna bhavati iti kṛtyaṃ vyāpāraḥ sa tvayetthamavadhāritaḥ svabhedāpratikṣepeṇeti vāṅmātreṇoktaṃ prāguktaṃ vismṛtyeti pūrvapakṣapratyuccāraṇam
kasmāt ? tasya sacchabdasya sanniyamārthatvāt--asanna bhavati iti dviḥpratiṣedhasya prakṛtyāpatteḥ sattvena niyatatvādasatpratiṣedhasyābhāvatvāt
tataḥ kim ? tato bhedānāṃ parasparataḥ sadasattvāt, itaretarābhāvatvādasattvam, sanniyamāt sattvam, ataḥ svabhedāḥ pratikṣiptā eva, santo'pyasanta eva na bhavantīti prāptam

tataśca bhedaśrutyā dravyaguṇādikayā ghaṭapaṭādikayā ca saha sāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapannamasannivṛtterabhāvasādhanatvāt, abhāvena caikavibhaktitvamanupapannaṃ bhedānāṃ saddravyaṃ sadguṇaḥ san ghaṭaḥ ityādi
na vibhaktimātrasāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattireva, kiṃ tarhi ? padasyāpyanupapannaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vibhaktibhedenāpi sad dravyasya guṇasya vā ityādi
sambandhasyāpi bhedairdravyādibhirabhāvasyānupapatteḥ kasya vā te bhedāḥ sacchabdenābhinnāsattvanivṛttimātropādānāt ? tasmādapṛthakchrutidoṣo'styeva
diṅgāgena savṛttike pramāṇasamuccaye pañcame'pohaparicchede yadabhihitaṃ tadatra bhoṭabhāṣāntarāt saṃskṛte parivartyopanyasyate--

tasmāt pāratantryeṇa svabhedānākṣepadoṣo bhāktadoṣaśca na staḥ
tata eva sāmānyaviśeṣāntarayogānusaraṇamapi na kartavyam, sākṣādarthāntaraniṣedhāt
asya jinendrabuddhiracitā viśālāmalavatī ṭīkāpi bhoṭabhāṣānuvādāt saṃskṛte parivartyehopanyasyate--vyāpteranyaniṣedhasyeti
vyāptiḥ svabhedāpratikṣepaḥ, anyaniṣedho yathoktaṃ sāmānyam, tasya vyāpteḥ svabhedeṣu vyāpakatvādityarthaḥ
sāmānyaśabdasya yo vyāpāraḥ pratīyate, sa ca kīdṛśa iti cet, arthāntaravyudāsaḥ, sa svārthāpratikṣepeṇa
yathā jātyabhidhāne jātyantarāṇāṃ pratikṣepastathārthāntarāpohābhidhāne na dravyatvādiviśeṣāṇām
...hiśabdo yasmādartha itiśabdastasmādarthorthe, yasmādevaṃ tasmād bhedārthairdravyādiśabdaiḥ sacchabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate
...tasmādekameva vastu sattvadravyatvābhyāṃ vyajyamānaṃ sad dravyam iti saddravyaśabdābhyāmabhidhīyate
tathā hi svārthāvyabhicāra iti, samudāyārtho hi viśiṣṭaḥ, yadi padaṃ tadvācakaṃ syāt tadā tadabhāve'pi padasya vṛttestatpratītirna syāt

tasmāt pāratantryeṇeti, yamupādāya dravye śabdaḥ pravartate so'rthāntarāpoho na jātyādivat kimapyarthāntaram, tato vyavadhānābhāvāt kutaḥ pāratantryam ? tadeva hi vastu asadādibhyo vyāvṛttaṃ sākṣādabhidhīyate, tasmād yastasya bhedaḥ sa tatrābhedād na pratikṣipyate
na hyanyatra mukhye vartamānaḥ śabdo dravyādiṣūpacaryate
nāpītyādi, bhedānāmānantyamanavasthānam, tasmādanabhidhānadoṣo nāsti tadvāṃśca bheda evoktaḥ sa ca pūrvaṃ nirākṛtaḥ ityanenoktaḥ

yat punaretad bhedārthairabhinnavibhaktikatvāt iti tanna, samānārthāparijñānāt
na brūmaḥ sattāśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, api tu sattāyāḥ pradhānasādhanavācinā sacchabdena dravyaguṇakarmāṇyabhidhīyante
evaṃ ca sati yuktaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamubhayoḥ saddravyaśabdayoḥ, ekaviṣayatvāt
yadā punarayaṃ sattāśabdaḥ sattāpradhāna evāṅgabhūtaṃ sādhanamabhidhatte na tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dravyasya satteti bhavati
diṅgāgamatasya nirākaraṇamatra prastutam, ato'yaṃ śloko diṅgāgasyaiva kasmiṃścid granthāntare bhavediti sambhāvyate
yastu bhartṛhareḥ śloko diṅgāgenoddhṛtaḥ sa pṛ॰ 607 paṃ॰ 19 ityatra draṣṭavyaḥ
sattā-sambandhābhidhānapakṣayorapṛthakchrutidoṣo'sti, nāpohapakṣe viśeṣahetusadbhāvāditi tasya viśeṣahetoḥ pratipādanārthamuktam --tatra hītyādi
sattāsambandhābhidhānapakṣayorguṇau sattā ṇyābhāvo yuktaḥ, iha tu arthāntarāpoho yasmin vastuni kriyate tad dravyaṃ śabdārthaḥ nāpohamātram
sa ca sacchabdena vyāptaḥ, aparityāgāt, na tu sākṣāduktaḥ
tadyathā--sacchabdaḥ asannivṛttyupasarjanaṃ dravyamāha, na sākṣāt, saṃśayotpatteḥ, tasmād viśeṣārthairdravyādiśabdaiḥ sacchabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vākyārthe yuktaṃ saddravyaṃ sadguṇaḥ satkarma...
yasmādavayavaśabdārthābhyāmanyaḥ samudāyārthaḥ, tasya ca vācakau tau samuditau, na tu sacchabdo dravyārthamāha na dravyaśabdaḥ sadartham
kathaṃ tarhi yat sat tad dravyaṃ yad dravyaṃ tat saditi ? ubhayaśabdavyudāsānugṛhītasya śabdadvayābhidheyasya samudāyārthasyaikatvāt tathocyate, na tu sadarthasya dravyaśabdenābhidhānāt
sambandhau viśeṣaṇatvāt, tadvastu guṇītyataḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvo yuktaḥ

iha tvarthāntarāpohaḥ sadityasanna bhavatīti nāsadbhāvamātramevocyate, kiṃ tarhi ? arthāntarāpohena viśiṣṭaṃ vastveva sadityucyate, yasmin vastuni so'pohaḥ kriyate tacca dravyaṃ śabdārthaḥ, nāpohamātram
sa cāpohaviśiṣṭo'rtho dravyādiḥ sacchabdena vyāpto'parityāgāt, na tu sākṣāduktaḥ
ṇyābhāvo yuktaḥ, iha tu arthāntarāpoho yasmin vastuni kriyate tad dravyaṃ śabdārthaḥ nāpohamātram
sa ca sacchabdena vyāptaḥ, aparityāgāt, na tu sākṣāduktaḥ
tadyathā--sacchabdaḥ asannivṛttyupasarjanaṃ dravyamāha, na sākṣāt, saṃśayotpatteḥ, tasmād viśeṣārthairdravyādiśabdaiḥ sacchabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vākyārthe yuktaṃ saddravyaṃ sadguṇaḥ satkarma...
yasmādavayavaśabdārthābhyāmanyaḥ samudāyārthaḥ, tasya ca vācakau tau samuditau, na tu sacchabdo dravyārthamāha na dravyaśabdaḥ sadartham
kathaṃ tarhi yat sat tad dravyaṃ yad dravyaṃ tat saditi ? ubhayaśabdavyudāsānugṛhītasya śabdadvayābhidheyasya samudāyārthasyaikatvāt tathocyate, na tu sadarthasya dravyaśabdenābhidhānāt
ubhayaśabdavyudāsānugṛhītasya śabdadvayābhidheyatvāt, na tu sadarthasya dravyaśabdenābhidhānāt ityapi mūlaṃ syādatra
kasmādanabhidhānamiti cet, saṃśayotpatteḥ, upāttatve sati anabhihite saṃśayaḥ syāt
tasmāt sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ viśeṣārthairdravyādiśabdaiḥ sacchabdasya vākyārthe yuktaṃ na padārthe

ko'sau vākyārtha ityata āha --yasmādavayavaśabdārthābhyāmanyaḥ samudāyārthaḥ, saddravyaśabdārthāvayavāvasadadravyanivṛttyupalakṣitau tābhyāmanya ubhayaśabdavyudāsānugṛhītaḥ samudāyārthaḥ, tasya ca vācakau tau samuditau na viparītārthau, tad darśayati --na tu sacchabdo dravyārthamāha, na dravyaśabdaḥ sadarthamiti
anupāttatve ityapi cintyam, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 638 paṃ॰ 14
atra codyam --kathaṃ tarhīti yat sat tad dravyam, yad dravyaṃ tat sat iti bhinnārthatvena yuktam ? iti

atra tenaivocyate --ubhayaśabdavyudāsānugṛhītasya asadadravyanivṛttyanugṛhītasya saṃhataśabdadvayābhidheyasya samudāyārthasyaikatvāt tathocyate, na tu sadarthasya dravyaśabdenābhidhānāditi pūrvapakṣaḥ
yat sat tad dravyam, yad dravyaṃ tat sat iti bhinnārthatve na yuktamiti
atrāpi śakyaṃ vaktum--āśritasya guṇiṇa ?tvād guṇaguṇinorbhedāt sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvastadavasthaḥ
iha tu jātiyogau yasmin vastuni varteyātāṃ tad dravyaṃ sadityucyate...
paścimasyāpi doṣasya bhāva eva, sākṣādavṛttyādidoṣajātasya sātiśayasyokta-
diṅgāgena kvacid granthe yat svamataṃ pratipāditaṃ tadatra nirākriyate
katham ? sākṣādvṛtterabhedācca arthāntaramupādāya svabhedeṣu śabdo na vartate
tasmāt pāratantryeṇa svabhedānākṣepadoṣo bhāktadoṣaśca na staḥ
sattā-yogapakṣagato vibhaktibhedaprasaṅgadoṣo'trāpi śakyo vaktum, āśritasya guṇitvāt
tadyathā--sadabhāvābhāva āśritaḥ, dravyādyabhāvābhāva āśrayaḥ, tayośca guṇaguṇinorbhedāt tadabhidhāyinoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvastadavasthaḥ
yā tvayoktopapattiḥ sā'pi jātiyogapakṣayorapi kramata ityatastatpradarśanārthamāha --iha tu jāti-yogau yasmin vastunītyādi
sattātaḥ sacchabdaḥ tatsambandhādvā sati vartate vastuni dravyādibhedavati sattvavat sat ityabhedopacārād matublopādvā, tvayoktāpohavṛttivad varteyātāṃ jātiyogau sadeva sattvavat iti
āśritasya guṇatvādāśrayasya ca guṇitvāt ityapi pāṭho'tra cintyaḥ

yaduktaṃ jātimatpakṣe— tadvato nāsvatantratvād bhedājjāterajātitaḥ ityādi doṣajātaṃ tasyābhāvo'nyāpohapakṣe sākṣādvṛtteḥ, tatra hi sacchabdaḥ sattāmudāpāya dravye vartamānastadbhedān ghaṭādīnākṣeptumasamarthaḥ
atra punarasatpratiṣedhena sākṣādvartata iti tasya ye viśeṣāstān na pratikṣipati
bhāktadoṣo'pyata eva nāsti, na hyanyatra mukhyā vṛttirdravyādiṣūpacaryate
nāpi bhedānavasthānādanabhidhānadoṣaḥ, kasmāt ? abhedāt, na hyarthāntarāpoho bhedeṣu bhidyate, abhāvāt
yattūktam— satvān ghaṭādirartho na paṭādiṣu na vartate iti, sākṣād ghaṭapaṭādiṣvasatpratikṣepāditi
sacchabdo'pohamātrasvarūpopasarjanaṃ dravyamāha, na sākṣādityādi sarvaṃ prāguktam
sātiśayasyoktatvādasmābhiḥ, tadeva smārayannāha --sacchabdo'pohamātrasvarūpopasarjanaṃ dravyamāha, na sākṣādityādi sarvaṃ prāguktaṃ jātimadvadapohavān ityupakramya
tatra ca jātimatīvāpohavatyapi sarve doṣā yathā saṅgatāstathā pratipāditā iti na punarlikhyate
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 607 paṃ॰ 25 ṭi॰ 5, pṛ॰ 623 paṃ॰ 17, pṛ॰ 625 paṃ॰ 8, pṛ॰ 628 paṃ॰ 3, pṛ॰ 735 paṃ॰ 24
atredamavadheyam--pramāṇasamuccayavṛttau asāmānyadoṣaḥ ityabhihitaṃ diṅgāgena, atra tu pṛ॰ 734 paṃ॰ 15 ityatra ca sāmānyadoṣaḥ ityabhihitaṃ granthakṛtā
ato diṅgāgena granthāntare'bhihitaṃ sāmānyadoṣo'pi nāsti iti vacanamatra vivakṣitaṃ bhāti
pramāṇasamuccayavṛttau asāmānyadoṣa uktaḥ, anyatra tu diṅgāgena sāmānyadoṣa ukta iti bhāti
satvān ghaṭādirartho na paṭādiṣu na vartate
pramāṇasamuccaye tadvānartho ghaṭādiśca na paṭādiṣu vartate iti tadvānartho ghaṭādiścenna paṭādiṣu vartate iti vā pāṭho dṛśyate
ata idaṃ kārikārdhaṃ diṅgāgasya granthāntarādatroddhṛtaṃ pratīyate

satvān sattāvān ghaṭādirartho na na sacchabdārtha ityāśayaḥ, kasmāditi cet, paṭādiṣu na vartate sa hi ghaṭādirarthaḥ paṭādiṣu na vartate, tasmāt sāmānyamarthaḥ sa katham ? sāmānyaṃ hyanekavṛtti, ghaṭādirarthastu paṭādiṣu na vartate tasmāt sa na sāmānyamityāśayo'tra bhāti
sacchabdo'pohamātrasvarūpopasarjanaṃ dravyamāha, na sākṣādityādi sarvaṃ prāguktam

syānmatam--jātimattvavadapohavattvamapyayuktamiti, tadāśaṅkyate --yattūktamanyāpohavādinā paraṃ prati āśaṅkya tadyathā --syādetadapohaviśiṣṭārthastarthatva ityādi yāvat tulyaṃ śabdārthasya samānatvam śabdasya ca samānatvamarthasya ca apohapakṣe'pi iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
itthaṃ pūrvapakṣīkṛtyottaramāha--tataḥ adravyatvācca bhedācceti kārikayā caśabdād bhāṣye likhitam

tadvyākhyā --nāpyarthāntarāpoho nāmetyādi yāvannāsti sāmānyadoṣa ityapohapakṣe jātimatpakṣagatadoṣābhāvapratipādanaṃ viśeṣapradarśanāditi tvadabhiprāyaṃ pradarśya vayamatrottaraṃ brūmaḥ --tadvattvaṃ ca tvaduktavat

yadi paramatābhyupagamāt sāmānyavatpakṣe satsāmānyānvayāt sāmānyavadviśeṣaṇasya sāmānyasyārthāntaratvaṃ pāratantryādi ca brūṣe sāmānyavad vyāvṛtterapi arthāntaratvaṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ pāratantryādi ca nanu tadavasthameva, tadvato'nyapratyayātmakatvāt sāmānyavat tadvyāvṛtterapi
atha svamatena brūṣe na sāmānyaṃ na vyāvṛttimaditi kutastadviśiṣṭavastvabhidhānaṃ khapuṣpaśekharaviśiṣṭavandhyāputrābhidhānavat
tadāśaṅkya tena yattūkta॰ ityapi pāṭho'tra bhavet
diṅgāgasya granthāntarādiyaṃ kārikātroddhṛtā pratīyate, pramāṇasamuccaye tu neyaṃ kārikā dṛśyate
kiñcānyat, pramāṇasamuccayavṛttau arthāntarāpohamātrasya abhinnatvādadravyatvācca iti pāṭha upalabhyata iti dhyeyam

yadi cārthāntarāpoho na bhāvāntaraṃ kathamidam--yat sat tad dravyaṃ yad dravyaṃ tat saditi ? ubhayaśabdavyudāsānugṛhītasya śabdadvayābhidheyasya samudāyasyaikatvāt tathocyate na tu sadarthasya dravyaśabdenābhidhānāt, arthāntarāpoho yasmin vastuni kriyate tad dravyaṃ śabdārtho nāpohamātram
kathamidam--yat sat tad dravyaṃ yad dravyaṃ tat saditi ? arthāntarāpoho yasmin vastuni kriyate tad dravyaṃ śabdārtho nāpohamātram

atra prastutārthopakārāpakārānaṅgatvād bhāvāntarābhāvāntaratvābhyāṃ vicāritābhyāṃ na kiñcit prayojanamasti, kintu idamatra prastutārthaupayogikam, tadyathā--buddhisthasya śabdaprayogajanitajñānopalakṣitasyānvayavyatirekadvāreṇāvadhāritasyārthasyā''nuguṇyena vaśavartitayā ayaṃ bhavati, ayaṃ na bhavati iti tayorvidhipratiṣedhayorbhedena pratyayaḥ śabdārthasambandhajñasya śabdaprayogādutpadyate, sāmānyopasarjanaviśeṣaśabdārthapakṣe vā
dvayorapi ca pakṣayorupasarjanīkṛtaviśeṣaṇatvād bhedānākṣepādasvātantryādanabhidhānaṃ tulyamityeṣa vicāraprayāsārthaḥ

tad dṛṣṭāntena darśayati --yathā jātisvarūpetyādinā tadvatpakṣavādimatena yāvadanākṣepa iti, dārṣṭāntikena ca tathā yathākathañcidityādinā yāvadasvātantryahetutvāditi suṣṭhūcyate--paścimasyāpi doṣasya sātiśayasya bhāva eveti

yadapyuktam--arthāntarāpoho'sadaghaṭanivṛttiḥ san ghaṭa iti, tasmāt sāmānyadoṣo'pohapakṣe nāstīti, tadapi pratyāsannamātmoktaṃ vismṛtya tvayābhihitamiti bodhayitukāma idameva tāvat pratyuccārayati --yadi cārthāntarāpoho na bhāvāntaramityādi

abhāvāntaratvādarthāntarāpohasyāpohavānarthaḥ śabdavācyo na bhavati, ato nāpoho viśeṣaṇaṃ nāpohavān so'rtha iti yadi tvayeṣṭamiti asya virodhāpādanārthamucyate— kathamidamityādi pūrvapakṣitamasmābhiryāvanna tu sadarthasya dravyaśabdenābhidhānādityetasya sūcanaṃ sūtreṇa yāvad nāpohamātramiti gatārtham

kimuktaṃ bhavatīti cet, ucyate--yadi dravyaṃ yadyadravyamarthāntarāpohaḥ tadvāṃstvarthaḥ tvasvaśabdārthatvena vivakṣitatvāducyata eva buddhisthānvayavyatirekārthabhedapratyayotpattidarśanādityuktaṃ bhavati
na hi loke śabdaprayogajanitapratyayaparicchedyāpalāpenānyaḥ śabdārthaḥ śakyaḥ kalpayituṃ sudūramapi gatvā pratipattiśaraṇāvasthānād vādānāmiti nāyaṃ niḥsaraṇopāyaḥ
etena asvātantryād bhedājjāterajātitaḥ iti savyākhyāvikalpā doṣahetavo'parihṛtā veditavyāḥ, teṣāṃ tvaduktanyāyādhvānatikramāt parihārahetūnāṃ tadvikalpānusāritvāccetyalaṃ prasaṅgena
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 623 paṃ॰ 17, pṛ॰ 625 paṃ॰ 8, pṛ॰ 628 paṃ॰ 3, pṛ॰ 733 paṃ॰ 13
atra ca saṃghātaḥ śabdārtha utpattāvabhivyaktau vā
yadyaprāptayaugapadyāni padāni kāryāt prasiddhād vyavasthā lokaprasiddhereva vā, anavasthitatarkatvāt puruṣāṇām
prastutanayamataḥ śabdārtho vidhīyate --atra ca vidhiniyamaniyame saṅghāto varṇa-pada-vākyādīnāṃ śabdārtha utpattāvabhivyaktau veti
yadi varṇādayo janyante yadyabhivyajyante kārya-nityapakṣayordvayorapi aviruddhaḥ saṅghāto vākyādiḥ śabda iti

syānmatam--utpannamātrapradhvaṃsitvād varṇādīnāṃ yaugapadyābhāve kutaḥ saṅghāta iti, atrocyate--yadyaprāptayaugapadyāni padāni kāryāt prasiddhād vyavasthā loke, kiṃ tat kāryam ? arthapratipādanam, tadyathā--varṇādīnāṃ tirohitānāṃ pariṇāmāntaramāpannānāṃ vinaṣṭānāṃ vā buddhau saṃskāramādhāyā'bhidheyavijñānotpattinimittatvaṃ tadabhāve tadabhāvāt prayogānantarīyakatvācca pratyayasyānumīyate
lokaprasiddhereva vā vyavasthā, dṛṣṭā hi loke teṣāṃ varṇapadādīnāṃ śabdānāmarthapratyāyanāsambhavādarthapratyāyakastatsamudāya iti śaktiḥ prasiddhā

sannidānīṃ samudāyaḥ samudāyibhyo varṇādibhyastadasambhavikāryāntaradarśanādanya iti kecidāhuḥ, tasmādeva kāryād mā bhūdahetukamarthapratyāyanaṃ teṣu tasya pratideśaṃ samasteṣu vā deśaiḥ sāmastyena vā vṛttyasambhavānna vyatirikta ityapare

sikatātoyavad deśāntareṣu asato'ntyeṃ'śe kutaḥ sambhavaḥ pratyāyanasya ? kintu tilatailavat sarvāvayaveṣu tirohitābhimateṣu sūkṣmatāmāpanneṣu vitatya vyavasthito buddhisaṃskāraparipākasamudāyo'bhivyañjakaḥ pratyayasyetyapare
sa ca samudāyātmā śabda eka evābhinnaḥ pratyāyako'rthasyaikapratyayadarśanāt, aneka eva vā pratyavayavāhitasaṃskārabalādheyārthajñānatvādityevamādīni vicārāntarāṇyevaitāni

puruṣamatisamutthāpitaśuṣkatarkaviṣayatvāt kiṃ na etaiḥ, yadi vyatiriktaḥ yadyavyatiriktaḥ antye śeṣasamasteṣvabhinno bhinno vā pratyāyakaḥ samudāyo'vayavā eva vā ? yo'stu so'stu, sarvathā'rthapratyāyanāt phalāt samudāyaḥ śabda ityetāvadupayujyate
kiṃ kāraṇam ? anavasthitatarkatvāt puruṣāṇām, yathoktam --yatnenānumito'pyarthaḥ vākyapa॰ 1
kiṃ tarhi pratipattavyam ? āgamamātraṃ tvetat padasamūho vākyamiti
yathoktam— jo hetuvādapakkhaṃmi hetuo āgame ya āgamio
anupūrvabhāva ānupūrvyam, tadaniyataṃ yasya so'niyatānupūrvyaḥ ayaṃ ca śabdaikadeśatvāt paryavāstikaḥ
nirgamavākyamapyasya--duvālasaṃgaṃ gaṇipiḍagamekaṃ purisaṃ paḍucca sādiyaṃ sapajjavasiyaṃ nandīsū॰ 42 ityādi
padasamūhaḥ, tadyathā--devadatta gāmabhyāja iti kadācit, kadācicca devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklām, devadatta mahiṣīṃ gṛṣṭiṃ kalyāṇīm iti pātramāhara, āhara pātraṃ sauvarṇaṃ ca ityādi
jo hetuvādapakkhaṃmi hetuo āgame ya āgamio
so sasamayapaṇṇavao siddhaṃtavirādhao itaro sammati॰ 3 | 45 tti
nirgamavākyamapyasya--duvālasaṃgaṃ gaṇipiḍagamekaṃ purisaṃ paḍucca sādiyaṃ sapajjavasiyaṃ nandīsū॰ 42 ityādi
ayaṃ punarnayaḥ kvāntarbhavati, dravyārthe kiṃ paryāyārthe ? ucyate --ayaṃ ca śabdaikadeśatvāt paryavāstikaḥ
ta ssa tu sāhapasāhā saddavikappā suhumabhedā
5 ityārṣe'pi saptanayaśatāmnānāt paryavāstikabhedasya śabdanayasya bheda ityarthaḥ
ta ssa tu sāhapasāhā saddavikappā suhumabhedā || sammati॰ 1 | 5
paryavāstika iti kaḥ śabdārthaḥ ? ucyate --parirupasargaḥ samantādarthe, ava gatyarthe dhātuḥ
itthamakṣarārthamuktvā vastuto darśayati— ko'sau ? bhedo bhāvopasarjanaḥ, yo bhavati ghaṭādirbhedaḥ sa bhavanakriyopasarjanaḥ paryavaḥ
so'stīti yasya nayasya matiḥ sa paryavāstika iti taddhitapratyayāntārthaḥ prakṛtyarthena viśeṣito jñeyaḥ

kimetāḥ svamanīṣikā evocyante, asti kiñcid nibandhanamasyārṣamapīti ? asti ityucyate, tadyathā --nirgamavākyamapyasya--duvālasaṃgaṃ gaṇipiḍagamekaṃ purisaṃ paḍuccetyādyārṣagranthaṃ sākṣitvenā''haitanmatasaṃvādinam
yadyapyayamāgamo'nekapuruṣānvayena sadā vyavasthitastathāpi pratyekaṃ puruṣaviśeṣāśrita eva niścayāya kriyāsāmānyopasarjanaviśeṣaparamārthatvād bhavatyarthasya
tacca dvādaśāṅgaṃ gaṇipiṭakamata eva sādyaṃ saparyavasānaṃ ca kṣaṇikamevetyarthaḥ
iti parisamāptau, itthaṃ parisamāpto vidhiniyamayorniyamopapradarśano guṇa-pradhānabhāvenāyamaṣṭamo'raḥ | samāptaśca dvitīyo mārga ubhayavikalpabhedopadarśanaḥ
yadi bhedapradhāno bhāvaḥ kathamasau ? sa bhavitāramantareṇa svarūpamapi prāptumasamartho'svatantratvādasan khapuṣpavat
tataśca bhettavyābhāvād bhedā api na bhavitumarhantīti dharmadharmisvarūpavirodhaḥ
pṛthivī ghaṭo bhavati ityatra yadi viśeṣa eva bhavati tarhi sāmānyasyābhāve viśeṣo'pi nāstyeva
tasmiṃstu dūṣite svamatapradarśanaṃ yuktamiti taddūṣaṇārthamāha --yadi bhedapradhāno bhāva ityādi yāvad dharma-dharmisvarūpavirodhaḥ

yad bhedo bhavati prādhānyena, anvayo'syopasarjanam ityuktaṃ tatra tamevaṃvidhaṃ bhāvamavadhārayāmaḥ --kathamasau ? iti, sa tvayeṣṭo'nvayo bhāvo bhaviturbhedasya kriyā bhedātirekeṇa bhavitāraṃ kartāramantareṇa svarūpamapi prāptumasamartho niścayoye ?
tasya anvayasya bhāvasya abhāve bhedā eva viprakīrṇā bhedyavasturahitāḥ syuḥ
tataśca bhettavyasyānvayasyābhāvād bhedā api na bhavitumarhanti

bhidyamāno hi bhedaḥ, kuto bhidyate'sau nirbhedyatvāt khapuṣpavaditi bhedābhāvād dharmadharmiṇoḥ svarūpābhāve anvayopasarjano bhedapradhānaḥ śabdārthaḥ ityetad vākyaṃ nirākṛtadharmadharmisvarūpakaṃ saṃvṛttam
ubhayorbhettṛbhettavyayorabhāvaḥ, na gaganakusumādudumbarakusumamudumbarakusumādvā gaganakusumaṃ bhettṛ bhettavyaṃ veti dṛṣṭāntaḥ, tathā upasarjanapradhānayoḥ sāmānya-bhedayoriti dārṣṭāntiko'rthaḥ
itthaṃ nirupākhyatvācchūnyatvāpattau svavacanā-'bhyupagamā-'numāna-pratyakṣavirodhā api prāptāḥ, te cāniṣṭā iti
kiñcānyat, pṛthivī ghaṭo bhavati ityatra nirdhāryam--kiṃ pṛthivī bhavati na ghaṭaḥ, uta ghaṭo bhavati na pṛthivī, ubhayaṃ vā bhavati, na bhavati ? iti

tatra yadi viśeṣa evetyādi, sāmānyasyopasarjanasyābhāve viśeṣo'pi nāstyevetīdānīmevoktatvādasati ca ghaṭe viśeṣe kutaḥ sāmānyasyāsato' atha pṛthivyāderanvayitvaṃ pravṛtterbhavati tataścopasarjanatvaṃ sāmānyasya nāsti
ubhayasmiṃstvasati sa yadyabhāva eva bhedaḥ, tenaiva bhedena na bhūyeta abhāvatvāt khapuṣpavat
atha bhāva eva tato bhāvāvyatirekād bhūtatvādubhayathāpi na punarbhūyeta, bhūtaghaṭādivadākāśādivat
na hi bhūta eva bhavati, tathā'sattvāpatteḥ
yadi bhūtameva bhavet tatastadasat syāt, utpadyamānatvāt, ajātaghaṭādivat
bhedeṣu bhavanānvaya aupacārikaḥ iti cet, nanvanvayadravyaṃ svātmanyeva tiṣṭhati, tataśca tadavasthāmātraṃ ghaṭādibhedā iti ghaṭādibhedā evaupacārikā ityuktaṃ bhavati
yathā aṅgulirvakrā bhavati ityukte vakratā aṅguleḥ bhedāvasthāmātramityau- satpradhānopakāritā ? iti

atha mā bhūt pṛthivyādisāmānyopasarjanatve dvayorapi sāmānya-viśeṣayorabhāvadoṣa iti pṛthivyāderanvayitvaṃ pravṛtterbhavati sattvāt, tataścopasarjanatvaṃ sāmānyasya nāsti svatattvavyāpitvāt bhāvatvāt pravartamānatvād bhedavat, itthamapyupasarjanatvanivṛttiḥ
atha pṛthivyāderanvayitvaṃ pravṛtterbhavati tataścopasarjanatvaṃ sāmānyasya nāsti
ubhayasmiṃstvasati sa yadyabhāva eva bhedaḥ, tenaiva bhedena na bhūyeta abhāvatvāt khapuṣpavat
atha bhāva eva tato bhāvāvyatirekād bhūtatvādubhayathāpi na punarbhūyeta, bhūtaghaṭādivadākāśādivat
na hi bhūta eva bhavati, tathā'sattvāpatteḥ
yadi bhūtameva bhavet tatastadasat syāt, utpadyamānatvāt, ajātaghaṭādivat
yena bhūyate bhedena tenaiva na bhūyeta ityapi mūlamatra syāt
bhedeṣu bhavanānvaya aupacārikaḥ iti cet, nanvanvayadravyaṃ svātmanyeva tiṣṭhati, tataśca tadavasthāmātraṃ ghaṭādibhedā iti ghaṭādibhedā evaupacārikā ityuktaṃ bhavati
yathā aṅgulirvakrā bhavati ityukte vakratā aṅguleḥ bhedāvasthāmātramityau-

ubhayasmiṃstviti sāmānye pṛthivyāṃ bhede ca ghaṭe dvaye'pi asati bhāve'nvaye bhavitari ca viśeṣe sa yadyabhāva eva bhedo yena bhūyate bhedena sa bheda itīṣyate tenaiva bhedena na bhūyeta abhāvatvāt, abhāvatvamabhavanakriyātmakatvāt, khapuṣpavat

atha bhāva eva, mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti anvayasvabhāva evāsau bhedo bhāva eveṣyate tato bhāvāvyatirekād bhāvātmakatvādanvayātmakatvād bhūtatvādubhayathāpi pradhānopasarjanatvābhyāṃ pṛthivī-ghaṭatvābhyāṃ na punarbhūyeta, bhūtatvāt, bhūtaghaṭādivat ākāśādivad vaiyarthyāt
yadi bhūtameva bhavet utpannamevotpadyate tatastadasat syāt, utpadyamānatvāt, ajātaghaṭādivadityasattvāpattiḥ, aniṣṭā ca seti na bhāvo bhavati nābhāvo bhavatyubhayaṃ pṛthivī ghaṭaśceti

atredamavadheyam--lekhakapramādāt ॰ti na bhāvo bhavati na bhāvo bhava॰ iti dvirbhāvo'pyatra saṃbhavati, tathāṅgīkāre tu aniṣṭā ca seti na bhāvo bhavatyubhayaṃ pṛthivī ghaṭaśceti iti pāṭho'pyatra sambhavet
syānmatam--bhedeṣu ghaṭādiṣveva pṛthak satsu paramārthataḥ yo'sau bhavati bhavati iti bhavanānvayaḥ sa aupacārika iti
nanu tvayaiva svadravye pṛthivyādi tiṣṭhati svātmanyeva tataśca tasya pṛthivyādidravyānvayasyāvasthāmātraṃ ghaṭādibhedā iti ghaṭādibhedā evaupacārikāḥ, pṛthivyādisāmānyameva tattvam ityuktaṃ bhavati
kimiva ? ityata āha --yathāṅguli pacārikatvaṃ vakratāyāḥ, nāṅguleḥ, na hi vakratvamaṅgulirbhavati anutpannatvāt khapuṣpavat
ata uktanyāyāt tribhuvanaṃ bhinnābhimatamapyabhinnameva dravyāśritatvād bhedānām
viśeṣasvarūpapratyavekṣāyāṃ bhavanaṃ svenaiva mahimnā pṛthag vartate
tad yadi pūrvaṃ bhavanamasvatantraṃ pṛthak cāvṛtti tato nirmūlatvādasan ghaṭaḥ khapuṣpavat
nāpyasya bhāvaḥ, tataśca asattvāviśeṣāt rityādi, yathā aṅgulirvakrā bhavati ityukte'ṅguleravasthā vakratā'ṅguleḥ sāmānyasya bhedāvasthāmātramityaupacārikatvaṃ vakratāyāḥ, nāṅguleḥ
