yugapadbhāvideśabhinnābhimataparyāyeṣvapi bhedatvācca rūpavat tadavasthāmātram iti vartate

yathā ghaṭa eva cakṣurādigrahaṇāpadeśaviśiṣṭatvāt rūpaṃ raso gandhaḥ ityādibhedenocyate'ṅgulirvā, vijñānamātrasya tatra bhedatvād vastuno ghaṭasyābhinnatvāt, evaṃ pṛthivyādisāmānyabhedā ghaṭādayo'śma-sikatādayaśca vijñānamātreṇeti

atredamavadheyam atra yadi nanu tvayetyādi iti pratīkaḥ śuddha ityabhyupagamyate tadā nanu tvayaiva tadavasthāmātraṃ ghaṭādibhedā iti ghaṭādibhedā evaupacārikā ityuktaṃ bhavati iti mūlamatra sambhāvyate
pacārikatvaṃ vakratāyāḥ, nāṅguleḥ, na hi vakratvamaṅgulirbhavati anutpannatvāt khapuṣpavat
ata uktanyāyāt tribhuvanaṃ bhinnābhimatamapyabhinnameva dravyāśritatvād bhedānām
viśeṣasvarūpapratyavekṣāyāṃ bhavanaṃ svenaiva mahimnā pṛthag vartate
tad yadi pūrvaṃ bhavanamasvatantraṃ pṛthak cāvṛtti tato nirmūlatvādasan ghaṭaḥ khapuṣpavat
aṅgulirvakrībhavati ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt, dṛśyatāṃ paṃ॰ 10
tadavasthā॰ ityapi pāṭho'tra sambhavet dṛśyatāṃ paṃ॰ 12

atītavidhyādidravyārthikanayeṣu eka-sarvagata-nityakāraṇavastumātravijṛmbhitaṃ stimitasarastaraṅgādivat tribhuvanaṃ bhinnābhimatamapyabhinnameva, dravyāśritatvād bhedānāmavasthādisaṃjñānāṃ puruṣādivādeṣu pratipāditatvāt dravyasya paryāyānāśritatvācca

tasyāpi ca viśeṣasya svarūpaṃ pratyapekṣyamāṇamanvayasāmarthyādṛte na labhyate, tadyathā--pūrayati pālayati kāryasyātmano'vasthādeḥ svarūpamiti kāraṇaṃ bhavanamanvayaḥ svenaiva mahimnā pṛthag vartate bhedādṛte'pi yathopavarṇitamanekadhā'tītanayeṣu
tad yadi pūrvaṃ bhavanamasvatantraṃ pṛthak cāvṛtti yathā tvayeṣṭaṃ syāt tataḥ kim ? tato nirmūlatvādityādi, nirmūlatvādasan ghaṭaḥ khapuṣpavat
syānmatam--kiṃ ghaṭasya mūlena bhavanena ? kiṃ na sa svayameva bhavati ? iti, etacca nāpi sa ghaṭaḥ svayameva bhāvaḥ, kasmāt ? viśeṣapradhānapakṣahāneḥ

yadi viśeṣa eva bhāvastato ghaṭa eva viśeṣaḥ, sa eva bhāvo bhavanam, tena bhūyate'nvayena bhāvenetyatastathābhāvatvād ghaṭasyāpi bhāvamātraṃ sāmānyamarthaṃrthaḥ ? khapuṣpavadevāviśeṣa iti pūrvoktavadāvirbhāvādibhedānupapattivirodhāḥ
dṛśyamānatve'pi tathā tasyābhavanādasattvaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā mṛgatṛṣṇikāgandharvanagarayoḥ
mṛgatṛṣṇikāgandharvanagarayorhi pratyakṣatve'pi śītādiviśeṣāsattvādasattvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathā viśeṣasya pratyakṣatve'pyasattvam
athocyeta--śītādirjīvājīvādiśca viśeṣo mṛgatṛṣṇikāsalile gandharvanagare ca nāstīti viśeṣāsattvāt syādasattvam, nāvaśyaṃ viśeṣe viśeṣairbhāvyaṃ yato viśeṣāsattvādasattvaṃ kalpyeta
yadi syurviśeṣe viśeṣā aviśeṣa eva syāt, viśeṣavattvāt, saddravyapṛthivyādisāmānyavat
api ca vayamapyetadeva brūmaḥ--anvaya eva syāditi
dṛśyamānatve'pi tathā tasyābhavanādasattvaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā mṛgatṛṣṇikāgandharvanagarayoḥ
mṛgatṛṣṇikāgandharvanagarayorhi pratyakṣatve'pi śītādiviśeṣāsattvādasattvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathā viśeṣasya pratyakṣatve'pyasattvam
athocyeta--śītādirjīvājīvādiśca viśeṣo mṛgatṛṣṇikāsalile gandharvanagare ca nāstīti viśeṣāsattvāt syādasattvam, nāvaśyaṃ viśeṣe viśeṣairbhāvyaṃ yato viśeṣāsattvādasattvaṃ kalpyeta
yadi syurviśeṣe viśeṣā aviśeṣa eva syāt, viśeṣavattvāt, saddravyapṛthivyādisāmānyavat
api ca vayamapyetadeva brūmaḥ--anvaya eva syāditi
yathā ghaṭasya vinaṣṭasya kapālānyabhāvasya bhāvahetutvānniruddhasya, kapālāni hi ghaṭanirodhahetukāni utpadyante tadupakāritvāt

kasmāt ? tataścāsattvāviśeṣāt khapuṣpavadevāviśeṣa iti pūrvoktavadāvirbhāvādibhedānupapattivirodhā ityanenātītaṃ granthamatidiśati yadetadasattvaṃ nāma tvayā kvacid manyate tato'nyat kāryam, tadasamarthavikalpatvāt, ghaṭapaṭavat
vikalpāsāmarthyaṃ cāsatkāryayorityādi yāvat svavacanādivirodhopasaṃhāreṇa viśeṣavirodho'prayogaprasaṅgāt svarūpavirodha iti

tadvyākhyā --mṛgatṛṣṇikā-gandharvanagarayorhītyādi, bhavanasya pṛthagbhāvena bhavanāt paramārthasattvāt salila-nagarayorasattvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā tathā sāmānyopasarjanatāyāṃ viśeṣasya pratyakṣatve'pyasattvamiti
nā'vaśyaṃ viśeṣe ghaṭādau pṛthivīviśeṣāṇāmaśmasikatādibhedairbhāvyaṃ yato viśeṣāsattvaṃ kalpyeta
yadi syurviśeṣe viśeṣā aviśeṣa eva syāt, sāmānyameva anvaya eva syād viśeṣo viśeṣavattvāt, saddravyapṛthivyādisāmānyavat
atrācārya āha --api ca vayamapyetadeva brūmaḥ--anvaya eva aviśeṣaṃ sāmānyameva syāditi
mṛgatṛṣṇikā tvākṛtajalaviśeṣāpi kiṃ śītādibhedā na bhavati ? bhāvābhāvādeva
yadi viśeṣa eva pradhānaṃ syāt salilabhāvānanvitaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇikādivad ghaṭādyapyasat syāt, nirupākhyatvāt idaṃ tat iti nopākhyāyeta
tato na kiñcit syāt pṛthivyādisāmānyenānupaṣṭabdhatvāt khapuṣpavat

tathā kasmādudakādinā na vyajyate pṛthivī vibhinnena ? atyantavailakṣaṇyādvā kaścidevāvācyo'rthaḥ kasmānna syāt, anvayarahitatvāt ? ata eva ca jīvakarmasambandhasantatyākhyānvayābhāvāt saṃsāramokṣādyanupa- yadi tathābhavanena viśeṣeṇā''kṛtyākhyena vinā bhavedanvayo viśeṣa eva niḥsāmānyaḥ, sa ca nāsti khapuṣpavat

nāpi sāmānyameva nirviśeṣaṃ ghaṭādi, kiṃ tarhi ? ākṛtiviśeṣanirvṛttau nirvṛttirghaṭādīnāṃ sāmānyabhavanasya viśeṣātmābhivyakteḥ, tathā rūpādīnāṃ rūpa-rasa-gandhādiviśeṣa ghaṭāvasthānāt ākriyamāṇaviśeṣasya tathā tathā vastuno bhavanāt
mṛgatṛṣṇikā tvākṛtajalaviśeṣāpi kiṃ śītādibhedā na bhavati ? bhāvābhāvādeva
yadi viśeṣa eva pradhānaṃ syāt salilabhāvānanvitaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇikādivad ghaṭādyapyasat syāt, nirupākhyatvāt idaṃ tat iti nopākhyāyeta
tato na kiñcit syāt pṛthivyādisāmānyenānupaṣṭabdhatvāt khapuṣpavat
tathā kasmādudakādinā na vyajyate pṛthivī vibhinnena ? atyantavailakṣaṇyādvā kaścidevāvācyo'rthaḥ kasmānna syāt, anvayarahitatvāt ?
etaccihnāntargato ghaṭādi ityata ārabhya viśeṣa॰ ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratau nāsti
tadvaidharmyaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇikāyāmityata āha --mṛgatṛṣṇikā tvākṛtajalaviśeṣāpi kiṃ śītādibhedā na bhavati ? iti kāraṇanirṇayārthaṃ praśnaḥ
yathā cāsāviti yathā mṛgatṛṣṇikādirbhāvābhāvānnāsti tathā ghaṭādirviśeṣo'nvayabhāvābhāvānnāsti

parasya tu doṣaḥ --yadi viśeṣa eva pradhānaṃ syāt salilabhāvetyādi salilabhavanenānanvitaṃ ghaṭādyapi mṛgatṛṣṇikākalpamasat syāt nirupākhyatvāt, upākhyā hi bhavanaprāṇikā, kimityupākhyāyetetyata āha --idaṃ taditi nopākhyāyeta pṛthivī iti dravyaṃ sad ghaṭaḥ iti vā
tataḥ kim ? na kiñcit syāt, kasmāt ? pṛthivyādisāmānyenānupaṣṭabdhatvāt khapuṣpavat
viśeṣe eva prādhānyaṃ syāt iti yadyarthastadā bhā॰ pratipāṭho'pi saṅgacchate

yadi viśeṣaḥ sāmānyanirapekṣaḥ syāt tato yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ iti vā viśiṣṭayā vṛttyā pṛthivyādi vyajyate tathodakajvalanānilākāśādinā kasmānna vyajyate pṛthivī vibhinnena atyantamanyasya pṛthivīdravyasya vailakṣaṇyādvā sarvasya dravyagaṇasya vyatirekeṇa niranvayo nirupākhyaḥ kaścidevāvācyo'vedyarūpo'rthaḥ kasmānna syāt, anvayarahitatvāt ?

yasmādanvayarahitasya nirupākhyasyābhāvastasmād mithyādarśanādipratyayajīvakarmasambandhasantatyākhyānvayābhāvād narakādigativiśeṣasukhaduḥkhaphalākhyasaṃsāraviśeṣārthapravṛttayoḥ puṇyapāpakarmaṇoranupapattiḥ, tadanupapatteḥ saṃsārānupapattistatpratipakṣasamyagdarśanādipariṇāmaviśeṣānupapattiḥ, tata pattiḥ, aniyatatathāpravṛtteḥ
satyāṃ ca tathāniyatapravṛttau pṛthivī ghaṭaḥ ityanvayaprādhānyamevaiṣitavyam, viśeṣastu pṛthivīmanuvartate
sadāpi viśeṣānuvṛtteruktavad neti cet, etadvad viśeṣābhāvāt
nāpyabhāvaṃ na tadupasarjanaṃ na bhāva eva nāviśeṣaṃ na viśeṣopasarjanaṃ na viśeṣa eva nobhayopasarjanaṃ nobhayapradhānaṃ vastu

atha mā bhūvannete doṣā iti tathāniyatapravṛttiriṣyate tataḥ satyāṃ ca tathāniyatapravṛttau jīvakarmasambandhasaṃsāramokṣādikāyāṃ jīvo nārakaḥ saṃsārī muktaḥ ityādivat pṛthivī ghaṭaḥ ityanvayaprādhānyamevaiṣitavyam, viśeṣastu ghaṭaḥ pṛthivīmanuvartate jīvatvaṃ nārakatvādiḥ
kasmāt ? yasmād loke pradhānaṃ hyanuvṛtyate na guṇaḥ, guṇastvanuvartate na pradhānaṃ nīlotpalavaditi
satyāṃ ca tathāniyatapravṛttau pṛthivī ghaṭaḥ ityanvayaprādhānyamevaiṣitavyam, viśeṣastu pṛthivīmanuvartate
sadāpi viśeṣānuvṛtteruktavad neti cet, etadvad viśeṣābhāvāt
nāpyabhāvaṃ na tadupasarjanaṃ na bhāva eva nāviśeṣaṃ na viśeṣopasarjanaṃ na viśeṣa eva nobhayopasarjanaṃ nobhayapradhānaṃ vastu
ityādiprapañcena viśeṣa eva sāmānyenā'nuvṛtyate na viśeṣeṇa sāmānyamiti
etacca na, etadvad viśeṣābhāvāt, sa eva hi viśeṣo naivāstīti pūrvanayeṣu bahudhā bhāvitam
tasmānna viśeṣaikāntapakṣaḥ sāmānyaṃ śaknotyatyantaṃ nivartayituṃ nāpi sāmānyaikāntapakṣo viśeṣapakṣam
avacanīyaṃ bhavanaviśeṣābhyāṃ kāraṇakāryatvābhyāmekānekatvābhyāṃ pradhānopasarjanatvābhyām ityādibhirvikalpairvikalpyamānamavaktavyatattvaṃ vastu bhavati

nāpyabhāvaṃ niranvayam na tadupasarjanaṃ bhāvopasarjanaṃ viśeṣapradhānaṃ vastu ityabhisaṃbadhyate, na bhāva eva nirākṛtaviśeṣaḥ, tathā nāviśeṣaṃ viśeṣaśūnyam, na viśeṣopasarjanaṃ sāmānyapradhānamiti, na viśeṣa evā'tyantatiraskṛtasāmānyaḥ, nobhayopasarjanaṃ vastu atyantanirākṛtasvātantryasāmānyaviśeṣam, nobhayapradhānamatyantasvatantratulyakakṣasāmānyaviśeṣam, sarvavikalpeṣveṣvabhāvāpattidoṣadarśanāt
kīdṛk tarhi vastu bhavati ? ityata āha --avacanīyabhāvaviśeṣetyādiḥ samāsadaṇḍako gatārtha uktaparyāyavikalpayugalakaiḥ
yathā naikatvam agnerindhanena saha indhanasyāgninā vā saha
yadi syādekatvamagnerindhanena dagdhendhanavadagnirindhanarahitatvād na pravarteta, anindhanasyāpravṛtteścābhāvataivāgneḥ syāt
yathendhanamagnirahitamapyanupajātāgnikaṃ pravartate tathendhanarahito'pyagniḥ pravartsyati sūkṣmāvastha iti cet, ko vā bravīti indhanamagnirahitam iti
tatra tāvadagnīndhanayorekatvaṃ nānātvamubhayatvamanubhayatvamanyatarapradhānopasarjanatā vā syāt ? iti vikalpya sarvathāpyavaktavyataiva iti vakṣyamāṇo dṛṣṭāntārthaḥ, tadvikalpānupapatteḥ
taccaikatvamagnerindhane na saha indhanasyāgninā vā saha syāt, sahayukte'pradhāne tṛtīyā, indhanamevāgnireva vā syāt
tanna tāvadagnerindhanena sahaikatvaṃ ghaṭate, tenasahaikatvāt tatprādhānyād vakṣyate doṣo'sattvam
yadi syādekatvamagnerindhanena dagdhendhanavadagnirindhanarahitatvād na pravarteta, yathā dagdhendhano'gnirna pravartate tathāsyāpravṛttiḥ
anindhanasyā'pravṛtteścābhāvataivāgneḥ syāt asti-bhavati-vidyati-padyati-vartatayaḥ sannipātaṣaṣṭhāḥ sattārthāḥ iti vacanāt pravṛttisattārthatvādapravṛtterasattāparyāyatvāt
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 34 paṃ॰ 21 pṛ॰ 190 paṃ॰ 23 pṛ॰ 199 paṃ॰ 7 pṛ॰ 324 paṃ॰ 27
yathendhanamagninā sahaikatve'pyanupajātāgnikaṃ pravartamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathāgnirapīndhanena sahaikatve pravartitumarhati sūkṣmāvasthaḥ kāryānumeyo'pratyakṣa ityarthaḥ
tasmādanaikāntikatvādahetustadekatvamiti cenmanyase, atra brūmaḥ --ko vā bravītītyādi

tadvyācaṣṭe --tadapekṣatvādindhanatvasya dīpano'gnirindhana-dīpana-dahana-bhasmīkaraṇārthatvāt tatpariṇatāvevendhanam idhyate dahyate dīpyate iti indhanamagnitvapariṇatāveva ekatvavādino viśeṣeṇa atatpariṇatāvagnitvendhanatvayora tvādindhanatvasya indhanamagnitvapariṇatāveva
sūkṣmāvasthatvena ca viśeṣāvasthāprāptiḥ sā sāmānyaviśeṣakāryakāraṇaguṇapradhānānāmananyatve siddhe syāt
yadyapyagnerindhanena sahaikatvādapravṛtterasattvaṃ sambhāvyate tathāpi ādivadindhanāgnyekatvād na doṣaḥ, dṛṣṭatvāt, sahabhāvaśca dviṣṭha iti
atha bhede pravṛttiḥ katham ? kasmānnendhanamagniḥ, dahanaikatvāt, antavat ? ante bhāvāt ñiindhī dīptau pā॰ dhā॰ 1449 iti smṛtervirodhitvāccānidhyamānasyānindhanatvam
kiṃ kāraṇam ? kārakāṇāmeva kārakatvāt, kartṛ-karmādiśaktyāveśāvasthāyāmeva kartṛkarmādikārakatvaṃ kārakāṇāmasaṅkīrṇātmalābhaṃ syāt, nānyathā, sarvamṛdghaṭāditvaprasaṅgāt
sūkṣmāvasthatvena ca viśeṣāvasthāprāptiḥ sā sāmānyaviśeṣakāryakāraṇaguṇapradhānānāmananyatve siddhe syāt
yadyapyagnerindhanena sahaikatvādapravṛtterasattvaṃ sambhāvyate tathāpi ādivadindhanāgnyekatvād na doṣaḥ, dṛṣṭatvāt, sahabhāvaśca dviṣṭha iti
atha bhede pravṛttiḥ katham ? kasmānnendhanamagniḥ, dahanaikatvāt, antavat ? ante
yadapyuktam --sūkṣmāvasthāgnirindhanarahita iti, tadapi nopapadyata ityetatpradarśanārthamāha --sūkṣmāvasthatvena cetyādi

indhanāvyatirekeṇa dīptisāmānyāvasthasyāgneḥ sūkṣmātīndriyendhananīlālīnāgnikā dīptiviśeṣāvasthāprāptiryā tvayocyate evaṃ guṇyavasthasya guṇāvasthāprāptiḥ kāryāvasthasya kāraṇāvasthāprāptiśca sā sāmānya-viśeṣa-kārya-kāraṇa-guṇa-pradhānānāmananyatve siddhe syāt tathā vaktuṃ yujyeta, tadapi tu cintyamevaiteṣāmananyatvaṃ sāmānya-viśeṣādyavasthayorbhedāsiddheḥ
syānmataṃ tava--nāhaṃ bravīmi agnerindhanena sahaikatvam, kintu indhanasyāgninā sahaikatvam

tadvyākhyā --yadyapyagnerityādi, satyaṃ yathā agnerindhanena sahaikatvena kṛtādekatvādapravṛttirdagdhendhanavat, anindhanasya apravṛtteścāsattvaṃ sambhāvyate doṣaḥ tathaikatve'sattvadoṣasambhāvanāyāṃ satyāmapi adoṣatve'sti nyāyaḥ
kasmāt ? dṛṣṭatvāt, dṛṣṭā hīndhane'nupajātāgnike prāgavyaktasyāgneḥ paścād vyaktiruttarādharayoraraṇyornirmathanena

kiñca, yasmāt sahabhāvaśca dviṣṭha iti, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvād yathā agninā sahendhanaṃ bhavatyevamagnirapīndhanena saha bhavatītyataḥ prāgagnyutpatteḥ sata evāgnervyaktivadagnāvapīndhanasya sattvameva, anyathā sahabhāvānupapatteriti
atra brūmaḥ--etadeva tvaṃ pṛcchyase --atha bhede pravṛttiḥ katham ? agnīndhanayorekatve ko viśeṣa vendhanatvāpattiragneḥ, indhanaikatvāt, prāgvat
ekatve kuto'yaṃ viśeṣaḥ--idaṃ na sahedaṃ saheti
athāpi kathañcidekatvaṃ tathāpi ekam ekameva iti na vaktavyam, ekatvāt, ekadevadattahastādyanekatvavat
heturyena sahabhāvasya dviṣṭhatvāt ityucyate tvayā ? atrāniṣṭāpādanasādhanamapi tadyathā --kasmānnendhanamityādi
itaretaraikarūpāpattyabhyupagamād vyaktendhanāgnitvābhyāmaraṇyavasthāyāmiva jvālāvasthāyāmiva ca indhanamagniragnirapīndhanameva syāt
tatra tāvadindhanamagnireva syāt, dahanaikatvāt, antavat antakālavat kevalāgnikālavat jvālāṅgārādyavasthāvadityarthaḥ
ante veti tadviparyayeṇa indhanatvāpattiragnerjvālādyavasthasya indhanaikatvāt prāgvat araṇyavasthāvat, aniṣṭaṃ caitat te
ekatve kuto'yaṃ viśeṣaḥ--idaṃ na sahedaṃ saheti
athāpi kathañcidekatvaṃ tathāpi ekam ekameva iti na vaktavyam, ekatvāt, ekadevadattahastādyanekatvavat
indhanena sahāgnirekaḥ, agninā sahendhanam iti vikalpābhyupagamādekatvapratijñāhāniḥ, bhede hi satyetau vikalpau yujyete, tadekatve vikalpānupapatteḥ
atastaddarśayannāha --ekatve kuto'yaṃ viśeṣaḥ--idaṃ na sahedaṃ saheti vikalpānupapattipradarśanaṃ gatārthaṃ puruṣādyekakāraṇamātrādvaitavādināmiveti

kiñcānyat, ekatve mathanakriyādhārakaraṇādyanupapatteśca ekatvavyāghātaḥ iti vartate, 'adharāraṇirādhāro mathanakriyāyām, karaṇamuttarāraṇiḥ, ataḥ karma ityevamādikārakavyāpārādibhedaḥ sarvo lokaprasiddho nopapadyate, agnīndhanayorekatvāt, ākāśamathanādyabhāvavat
tathāpi yadekamityabhimataṃ tadekamiti na vaktavyaṃ syāt, ekameva iti na vaktavyamityarthaḥ

kasmāt ? ekatvāt, yatraikatvaṃ tatra ekameva ityavaktavyaṃ dṛṣṭam, ekadevadattahastādyanekatvavat, yathaika ityabhimato'pi devadatto hastapādādyavayavabahutvāt eka eva iti na vaktavya evamagnīndhanayoriti dārṣṭāntiko vakṣyate
hasto'pyeka eveti na vaktavyaḥ, aṅgulyādyanekatvāt, aṅguli-prakoṣṭha-bahirantastalādibahutvāt

aṅgulirapi parvādibahutvāt, atha mā bhūvannamī doṣā ityagnīndhanayoranyatvamabhyupagamyate tena tarhīdamāpatitam— tasyendhanāt pṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamākhyeyaṃ yathānyeṣāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ paṭādibhyaḥ pṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamākhyāyate

rūpākhyānamaśakyaṃ kartum, na hyanyadanyasādhāraṇam, agnerindhanaṃ pṛthag nirdeṣṭuṃ na śakyate sāmānyaviśeṣaikānyatvānavasthitatattvaghaṭapaṭasaṃvṛtivat, anirūpyamāṇastvasannāpadyetāgniḥ, parvāpi tvagādiparvāvayavaskandhabahutvāt, skandho'pi paramāṇubahutvāt ekameva iti na vaktavyam iti vartate, yāvadaṇoriti, mūrtadravyameva paryantāvadhitvāt kimaṇureka iti vaktavyaḥ ? netyucyate, aṇo rūpādyanekatvāt, rūpa-rasa-gandha-sparśabahutvād rūpādyātmakatvāt
rūpaṃ raso gandhaḥ sparśo vā ekaḥ iti vaktavyaḥ ? netyucyate, rūpādeḥ pratikṣaṇamanyatvāt, rūpamapi kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'nyadanyadutpadyate vinaśyati cetyanyatvādanekamekatvād rūpamiti na vaktavyam
evaṃ raso gandhaḥ sparśaśca vācya iti
syānmatam— deśabhinneṣu aṅguli-parva-tvagrūpādīnāmanekatvāt ekam ityavaktavyaṃ syāt, kālabhinnastu kṣaṇika eka eva rūpādyanyatamo'sādhāraṇo'rthaḥ kimiti ekaḥ iti nocyate iti

atrocyate --pratikṣaṇaikasyāpi atyantānekatvāt, kṣaṇe kṣaṇe hyekaḥ pratikṣaṇaikaḥ, kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prati vartata iti vīpsārthakarmapravacanīyatvāt prateḥ, so'pyanekaḥ parasparāsaṅkīrṇarūpaḥ kenacit kadācidasambadhyamānatvādasamāno'sādhāraṇaḥ, asamānaścānekaḥ, samānatve hyekatvaṃ syāt
tasmādasambandhādasamānatvādanekatve'pyavaktavya eva, sambaddho hyarthaḥ sāmānyenocyeta ayaṃ saḥ iti itthamayam iti vā
atha mā bhūvannamī doṣā ityagnīndhanayoranyatvamabhyupagamyate tena tarhīdamāpatitam— tasyendhanāt pṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamākhyeyaṃ yathānyeṣāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ paṭādibhyaḥ pṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamākhyāyate
rūpākhyānamaśakyaṃ kartum, na hyanyadanyasādhāraṇam, agnerindhanaṃ pṛthag nirdeṣṭuṃ na śakyate sāmānyaviśeṣaikānyatvānavasthitatattvaghaṭapaṭasaṃvṛtivat, anirūpyamāṇastvasannāpadyetāgniḥ,

etatpakṣatyāgena pakṣāntaraparigrahe kāraṇamācakṣāṇaḥ pakṣāntaraṃ grāhayati — agnīndhanayoranyatvapakṣo nirdoṣa iti manyamānenābhyupagamyate cet tvayā so'pi nirdoṣa iti mā maṃsthāḥ, tena tarhītyādi, tena agnīndhanayoranyatvābhyupagamena kāraṇena idamāpatitam--tasyāgnerindhanāt pṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamākhyeyaṃ ghaṭāderivākāśasya sauṣiryam
nirdiṣṭe hi pṛthagbhūte rūpe'nyatvaṃ sidhyecchakyaṃ ca pratipattum--ayamasmādanya iti
tattu tvayā na śakyate'gnerindhanāt pṛthagbhūtaṃ tattvaṃ darśayitum

yasmād na hi anyadanyasādhāraṇam, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmād ghaṭādi paṭādyanyasādhāraṇarūpaṃ na bhavati tantvādīnāṃ tasmācchakyate tataḥ pṛthagbhūtena tattvena nirdeṣṭum, na tathendhanāt pṛthagbhūtamasādhāraṇamagnestattvaṃ ghaṭasyeva jalāharaṇādi paṭādivilakṣaṇaṃ śakyaṃ vaktum
syānmatam--kathaṃ tvayādhunā ghaṭāt paṭo'nyaḥ iti viśeṣeṇa nānātvena pṛthivī ghaṭaḥ iti ca sāmānyakṛtaikyena nirdiṣṭaṃ rūpam ? tathāgnīndhanayorapi śakyata eva vakṣyamāṇaṃ dāhyadāhakratvādīti
tadvā kuto'nindhanam ? yadi syādanindhano'gniḥ satatameva niravaśeṣadagdhendhano'pi bhavet, agnitvāt, jvālāvat
athocyeta--yadyapyagnerindhanena sahānyatvaṃ nāsti tathāpi indhanasya agninā sahānyatvamasti dṛṣṭatvāt

ata eva tu indhanatvaṃ sidhyatyu- atrocyate--na mama kiñcidavaktavyavādinaḥ sāmānya-viśeṣādyekatva-nānātvābhyāṃ vyavasthitamasti vastu kiñcit, kiṃ tarhi ? tvanmatānuvṛttyā pratipādanārthaṃ saṃvṛtyā sāmānya-viśeṣaikatvānyatvābhyāṃ pṛthivīghaṭapaṭavat ityudāhiyate, na manmatena, manmatena tu tāvanavasthitatattvāveveti tat pradarśayannudāharati-- sāmānyaviśeṣetyādi, sāmānya-viśeṣayorekatvānyatvābhyāmanavasthitaṃ tattvaṃ yayostāvimau ghaṭapaṭau sāmānyaviśeṣaikānyatvānavasthitatattvaghaṭapaṭau, tayoḥ saṃvṛtiḥ upacāraḥ, abhyupagatya parakalpanena udāharaṇam, tayā tulyaṃ saṃvṛtivat, yathā saṃvṛtyā ghaṭapaṭāviṣṭāvapi asādhāraṇarūpau nirdiśyete na tathāgnīndhane ityarthaḥ
tasmādanirūpyo'nirūpyamāṇastvasannāpadyeta agniḥ, kasmāt ? anindhanatve sati arūpatvāt khapuṣpavat, upādānasvarūpāt pṛthaganirūpitātmarūpatvādityarthaḥ
ghaṭa-paṭādiṣvapyetat sādhanam--amṛttve sati arūpatvād ghaṭo'san khapuṣpavat, atantutve sati arūpatvāt paṭo'san khapuṣpavadityādi yojyam
tadvā kuto'nindhanam ? yadi syādanindhano'gniḥ satatameva niravaśeṣadagdhendhano'pi bhavet, agnitvāt, jvālāvat
athocyeta--yadyapyagnerindhanena sahānyatvaṃ nāsti tathāpi indhanasya agninā sahānyatvamasti dṛṣṭatvāt
athācakṣothāstvam--indhanāt pṛthagagnerasti rūpam, tadyathā— jvālā gaganadeśe
evamanicchato doṣa ucyate--yadi syādanindhano'gniḥ satatameva niravaśeṣadagdhendhano'pi murmurādyavastho- ttarakālamapi bhavet, agnitvāt, jvālāvat
evaṃ tāvat pūrvoktaikatvavadindhanena sahāgneranyatvaṃ na vaktavyam
indhanasyānyatvaṃ hutavahāt, dṛṣṭatvāt, loke hi dṛṣṭam— indhanamāharati kāṣṭhamāharatīti, na hi dṛṣṭād gariṣṭhaṃ pramāṇamasti
atrottaram --tadviṣaya evaiṣa upacāraḥ, agnitvapariṇatikāla pacārataḥ, gauṇasya mukhyamūlatvāt
ñiindhī dīptau pā॰ dhā॰ 1449 iti dīptisvabhāvo'gnirevendhanam
siddhayathārthendhanatvaṃ mukhyamapekṣya tadviṣayamagnyapariṇate'pi dāruṇi indhanatvamupacārād bhavati
tadanyatve agnīndhanānyatve sa upacāro naiva syāt, mukhyendhanābhāvāt, kharaviṣāṇatīkṣṇakuṇṭhādisādharmyābhāve tadupacārābhāvāt
ñiindhī dīptau pā॰ dhā॰ 1449 iti dīptisvabhāvo'gnirevendhanam

agnipariṇatadārumukhyendhanatvādeva tadapariṇatāvapi indhanatvaṃ sidhyatyupacārataḥ, kasmāt ? gauṇasya mukhyamūlatvāt, siddhe hi mukhye siṃhe śaurya-krauryāditatsādharmyād māṇavakaḥ siṃha ucyate nāsati mukhye siṃhe

tasyāgnitvapariṇatāvevendhanatvasaṃvādinīṃ smṛtiṃ jñāpikāmāha --ñiindhī dīptau pā॰ dhā॰ 1449 iti, nanu smarantyabhiyuktāḥ vaiyākaraṇāḥ śabdārthasambandhajñā dīpana ityagnim, dīptisvabhāvo'gnirevendhanaṃ dīptyarthatvādindheḥ

yathā prāgekatve yadyagnirindhanena sahaikaḥ syāt tato dagdhendhanavadekasyāpravṛtterabhāvataiva syādityādi granthoktena nyāyenaikatvaṃ niṣiddhaṃ yāvat sahāsahatvadviṣṭhatvāditi, tathā anyatve dagdhendhanavadanyasyāpravṛtterabhāvataiva syādityādistulyārthagamaviśeṣeṇa grantho yojyaḥ, anyatve'pyabhāvāpattisāmyāt

svātmavad nānyatvamiti, agnisvātmā'gneryathānyo na bhavati tathā tadindhanamapi, tadvṛttitvāt, tasya vṛttistadvṛttiḥ, saiva vā vṛttistadvṛttiḥ, tadvṛttireva vṛttirasya tadvṛttiragniḥ, dīptirevendhanatvavṛttiḥ, dīptirūpavṛttitvādagnirevendhanamagnyātmavat
adahyamānaṃ hīndhanameva na bhavati kārakāṇāmeva kārakatvādityādi vyākhyātatvāt
kāṣṭhaśabdavyavahāre'pi agnikāṣṭhayoranyatvaṃ vyāhanyate, tadyathā --yadāyamityādi, kāṣṭhendhano'gnistato'nyo nāsti svendhanāt
atrāśaṅkā --nanu yadaiva kāṣṭhamanagnikaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tadā tenāgnināvinā dṛṣṭatvādanyatvasiddhiriti

atra vayaṃ brūmaḥ --athābhedavṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā hīyamabhedavṛttiḥ dīpyamānaṃ kāṣṭhamindhanam kasmānnāgniḥ kāṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vāgniḥ prāgvat paścādvadvā tadanyatvāt ? yadi kāṣṭhaṃ kathamanagni ? kāśṛdīptau pā॰ dhā॰ 647, 1162 ityaśeṣavirodhāḥ
iti, sā cābhedavṛttiranyatve na prāpnoti, adīpyamānākāśendhanatvāprāptivat
kasmādityādi paraspararūpāpādanenāniṣṭāpādanaṃ yathāsaṅkhyaṃ prāgvat paścādvadvā tadanyatvāditi gatārthaṃ sādhanadvayam
kasmānnāgniḥ kāṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vāgniḥ prāgvat paścādvadvā tadanyatvāt ? yadi kāṣṭhaṃ kathamanagni ? kāśṛdīptau pā॰ dhā॰ 647, 1162 ityaśeṣavirodhāḥ
kiñcānyat --yadi kāṣṭhaṃ kathamanagniḥ ? kāśanāt kāṣṭhamagnitvameva kāśanād dīpanādaṅganāt, nānyathā
tathā indhanamanagni ityapi svavacanavirodhaḥ, yasmāt kāṣṭhaṃ niyamādagniḥ agnirapi niyamāt kāṣṭhamevamindhanamagniśca, tataḥ svavacanavirodhaḥ
tadbhāvanārthaṃ tadarthasaṃvādinīṃ smṛtiṃ jñāpikāmāha --kāśṛ dīptau pā॰ dhā॰ 647, 1162 kāśaterauṇādike kartṛvācini kthanpratyaye kāṣṭham iti rūpasiddherityasmāddhetoraśeṣavirodhāḥ

kiṃ dāruṇyapi śakyamitthaṃ bhāvayitum ? dāñ dāne pā॰ dhā॰ 1091 deñṅ rakṣaṇe pā॰ dhā॰ 962 do avakhaṇḍane pā॰ dhā॰ 1148 daip śodhane pā॰ dhā॰ 924 ityeteṣāṃ caturṇāmanyatamasya rupratyayāntasya dāru iti rūpasiddheḥ
ko hi nāma śakyaṃ na śaknuyād vaktum
śodhanāvakhaṇḍanārthayostāvat siddhameva, daha bhasmīkaraṇe pā॰ dhā॰ 991 ekārthatvāt tathāpi dānarakṣaṇārthayorasambhavāt tadarthadāru tvanudāharaṇam, tannodāharaṇatvena vivakṣyate

sahabhavanamasahabhavanamityetad dvayamapi dviṣṭham, ato yadyekaṃ kāṣṭhamagnināgnirvā kāṣṭhena atha nānā sarvathāpyanayoranyonyāvinābhāvinorbhavati etat, tattu dvayamekamanyaditi vā na śakyate vaktum, tasmānna tadanyat
athāpi kathañcidanyatvam, anyat anyadeva iti na vaktavyam, anyatvāt hastādyanyānanyadevadattavat, yāvad rūpādikṣaṇāntarānyānanyaparamāṇuvat

pūrvavadabhyupetya tvanmatyā anyat anyadeva iti na vaktavyam, anyatvāt, hastādyanyānanyadevadattavat, hastā-'ṅguli-parva-tvak-skandha-paramāṇu-rūpa-rasa-kṣaṇikatvādyanyatve'pi devadatta evaikastathā tathā gṛhyate cakṣurādivyapadeśaviśiṣṭarūpādyātmakaghaṭavat sambandhyantarāpekṣaviśiṣṭapitṛtvādivyapadeśātmakadevadattavacca sa evaikaḥ, anyathā tadekatvābhāve tadbhedābhāvād bhedāsta eva anye iti vaktumaśakyāḥ, devadattātmakatvād ghaṭādyātmakatvācca, tatpratipādanopāyapradarśano granthaḥ --yāvad rūpādikṣaṇāntarānyānanyaparamāṇuvaditi bhāvanodāharaṇaṃ bhāvitārthamevamanyatrāpi ghaṭādau bhāvayitavyamiti
te agnīndhane na stastarhi, kasmāt ? agnyanagnitvavyāvṛtteḥ, vyāvṛttāgnyanagnitvādityataḥ ekatve'gnirevendhanam anyatve'nagniḥ

tathā indhanānindhanatvavyāvṛtteḥ ityapi bhavati hetuḥ tatparyāyārthatvāt, khapuṣpavat, yathā khapuṣpaṃ nā'gnirnānagniḥ tadekatvānekatvavyāvṛtterasacca tathā agnīndhane na syātām, ubhayamapi netyarthaḥ
tathā agnīndhane asatī syātām ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ na ityetadanāvaśyakam

bhinnaṃ viviktamasaṅkīrṇaṃ vyavasthānaṃ kāṣṭhamevedaṃ dāhyaśaktyādilakṣaṇam, agnirevāyamauṣṇyadāhakādilakṣaṇaḥ iti, tadeva vyavasthānaṃ cihnaṃ lakṣaṇamasya ubhayasya, tadbhāvād bhinnavyavasthānalakṣaṇatvāt saṃvṛtisadghaṭa-paṭavad nānubhayatvam
etacca na, yasmāt siddhaṃ sattvaṃ dharma-dharmiṇoriti tatprasādhanārthamāha --yadi dāhyadāhakatvetyādi

yadi dāru dāhyameva, dāhako'gnireva iti lakṣaṇaniyamo na syāt tayorvyavasthitastato'gnirapi dahyeta kāṣṭhavat, pacyeta odanavat pācakatvalakṣaṇāvyavasthānāt pākyatvāt, tato bhujyeta ca odanavadeva pṛthak, aniṣṭaṃ caitat

tathendhanamapi dāhyapākyādivyavasthitabhinnalakṣaṇaṃ yadi na syāt pṛthageva dahed vināpi agninā kāṣṭhatṛṇādi saṃhatam paceccodanādika dahyeta kāṣṭhavat, pacyeta odanavat, bhujyeta ca pṛthak, tathendhanamapi pṛthageva dahet, paceccodanādikamagnivadityanubhayatāpyavaktavyaiva
bhinnavyavasthānavṛttobhayatvānabhyupagame tu sarvātmakaikabhāva evātyantābhāva eva vobhayatvaṃ syāt
magnivadagnitvādityato dahanamantareṇaiva pākaḥ syāt, na tu bhavati
anubhayaṃ cennāsti ubhayamasti tarhi, taccobhayaṃ bhinnavyavasthānavṛttam
dahyeta kāṣṭhavat, pacyeta odanavat, bhujyeta ca pṛthak, tathendhanamapi pṛthageva dahet, paceccodanādikamagnivadityanubhayatāpyavaktavyaiva
bhinnavyavasthānavṛttobhayatvānabhyupagame tu sarvātmakaikabhāva evātyantābhāva eva vobhayatvaṃ syāt

athaivaṃ nābhyupagamyate tato bhinnavyavasthānavṛttobhayatvānabhyupagame tu prāptaṃ kīdṛgubhayam ? tadyathā --sarvātmakaiketyādi ekaṃ sarvātmakaṃ nityaṃ sarvagatamanutpādavyayaṃ kāla-niyati-svabhāvapradhāna-puruṣādīnāmanyatamad bhāvatattvamasadalīkanirupākhyamavastu atyantāsat khapuṣpādi vetyetadubhayaṃ syāt, ekatvānyatvānubhayatvābhāve gatyantarābhāvāt
syānmatam--anubhayamubhayābhāvo'sattvam asattvasya pratiṣiddhatvādubhayaṃ tatpratipakṣaḥ satī eva dve vastunī bhavitumarhata iti
tadapi na, anyatvāvaktavyatvāt, etadubhayatvamanyatvameva parasparabhinnalakṣaṇe agnīndhane anyonyasmādanye iti, taccānyatvaṃ vicāritam— asadeva iti
etacca na, tasyāpyavaktavyatvāt, ekatvasyāpyasattvasya utpatataiva mayoktatvādavaktavyataiva
etaccāyuktam, ekatvādyayuktivat tadayukteriti tadatidiśannāha --ekatvānyatvobhayatvānubhayatvapratiṣedhena ca pradhānopasarjanabhāvo'pi pratiṣiddha eveti

yasmādetayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayorapravṛtteragnīndhanayoścāsattvamevaikatvānyatvapakṣayoriti pratipāditaṃ tasmādanayorasatoḥ kā pradhānopasarjanatā khapuṣpavandhyāsutayoriva ? sā hi satoreva svāmi-bhṛtyayordṛṣṭeti
kiñca, anyatvapakṣa evaiṣā pradhānopasarjanatā yujyate, sa ca niṣiddhaḥ
agnīndhanayośca pravṛtteretāvatāṃ gatiḥ evaṃ yadyekatvaṃ viśeṣasya bhāvena nānyatā, tato'nātmano bhāvasya kharaviṣāṇavadapravṛtterabhāvataiva syāt

nanu yathā viśeṣa eko'pi rūparasādirghaṭapaṭādirvā bhāvarahitaḥ pravartate tathā sūkṣmāvastha ekako bhāvaḥ pravartsyatīti cet, ko vā bravīti viśeṣo bhāvarahita iti ? viśiṣyate viśeṣa iti sata eva viśeṣatvāt tadapekṣatvācca viśiṣyate sa tasmāt tena vā sa ityādinā
aviśiṣyamāṇo'viśiṃṣan vā na viśeṣo bhavati, kārakāṇāmeva kārakatvāt

ko vā''śvāso viśeṣa ekaika eva pravartate iti saṃvṛtisadghaṭapaṭavat ? syād yaduta ekatvaṃ nānātvamubhayatvamanubhayatvamagnyupasarjanamindhanapradhānatvamindhanopasarjanamagnipradhānatvamiti, sarvathāpi na ghaṭate, tasmāt sarvathāpyavaktavyataiveti dṛṣṭāntavarṇanamidaṃ kṛtam
evaṃ yadyekatvaṃ viśeṣasya bhāvena nānyatā, tato'nātmano bhāvasya kharaviṣāṇavadapravṛtterabhāvataiva syāt

nanu yathā viśeṣa eko'pi rūparasādirghaṭapaṭādirvā bhāvarahitaḥ pravartate tathā sūkṣmāvastha ekako bhāvaḥ pravartsyatīti cet, ko vā bravīti viśeṣo bhāvarahita iti ? viśiṣyate viśeṣa iti sata eva viśeṣatvāt tadapekṣatvācca viśiṣyate sa tasmāt tena vā sa ityādinā
aviśiṣyamāṇo'viśiṃṣan vā na viśeṣo bhavati, kārakāṇāmeva kārakatvāt
ko vā''śvāso viśeṣa ekaika eva pravartate iti saṃvṛtisadghaṭapaṭavat ?
sāmānyaviśeṣayostāvat tadyathā--yadyekatvaṃ viśeṣasya ghaṭāderbhāvena anvayena pṛthivyādinā, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? sāmānyameva nirviśeṣaṃ bhavatyekamityatastatpradarśanārthamāha --nānyateti

tataḥ kim ? tato'nātmano bhāvasya aśmasikatāmṛlloṣṭavajrādighaṭādiviśeṣātmakalābharahitasyānātmatvaṃ pṛthivyādeḥ sāmānyasya, anātmatvācca kharaviṣāṇavadapravṛttiḥ, apravṛtterabhāvataiva syāt kharaviṣāṇavadeva
nanu yathendhanetyādi sa eva nanu yathā viśeṣa eko'pi ityādiḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ
kintu rūpādiyugapadbhāviparyāyaṃ viśeṣavādinaṃ prati siddhamudāhṛtya bhāvavādī tvanmate tatpravṛttivad manmate sūkṣmāvastha ekako bhāvaḥ pravartsyati iti brūyāt
atrāvaktavyavādī svamatenottaraṃ brūte --ko vā bravītītyādi niḥsāmānyaviśeṣapravṛttyabhāvāpādanena dṛṣṭāntāsiddhiṃ varṇayati
sata eva viśeṣatvāt, sanneva viśeṣībhavati sāmānyameva nāsat khapuṣpādītyarthaḥ
tadapekṣatvācceti, rūpaṃ rasād viśiṣyamāṇaṃ sambandhirasamapekṣya viśeṣo bhavati, tathā raso'pi rūpam, ghaṭa-paṭau cā'nyonyam, nātyantāsat khapuṣpamamapekṣyeti
taddarśayati kārakavyākhyayā viśiṣyate sa tasmāt tena vā sa ityādinā
aviśiṣyamāṇe ṇa ityādi, yadi sūkṣmāvasthāprāptirapi avayavāvayavisāmānyaviśeṣakāryakāraṇānāṃ bhede siddhe syāt

bhāvena rahito viśeṣastato viśeṣaḥ iti nirdeśameva nārhet, viśiṃṣannanyamanyena ca viśiṣyamāṇo viśeṣo bhavati vyāpārāveśādeva kārakāṇāṃ kartrādīnāṃ kārakatvāt, viśeṣaṇakriyāveśābhāve hyaviśeṣa eva syāditi
tasmāt sthitamidam--sāmānyameva viśeṣaḥ sāmānyāpekṣa eva veti

tathā ca kutaḥ pṛthak pravṛttirviśeṣasya sāmānyāvinābhāvāt ? ko vā''śvāsaḥ ? na manoratho'pi karaṇīyaḥ --rūpaṃ raso vā ghaṭapaṭādirvā viśeṣa ekaika eva pravartata iti, tvanmanorathānuvṛttyā saṃvṛtisattvenā'bhyupagatayorghaṭapaṭayorivānyatvapratipatternimittabhūtamiti svapne'pyevaṃ mā maṃsthā ityabhiprāyaḥ

yāpi prāptidik kācit tvayonnīyate kenacinnayāntareṇa sūkṣmāvastho bhāvo viśeṣarahitastiṣṭhati iti sāpyavayavānāmavayavino viśeṣāṇāṃ sāmānyāt kāraṇāt kāryāṇāṃ bhede siddhe syāditi sambhāvyeta, nānyathā

pradhānāvasthā hi sūkṣmā sattvarajastamasāṃ samatā, sā mahadādiviṣayasthūlāvasthāpekṣaiva, ta eva hi guṇāḥ sūkṣmāḥ sthūlāśca, te cāvasthe parasparāpekṣe, sarpasphaṭāṭopakuṭilagatisthitikuṇḍalakībhavanādivat sarpamantareṇa na te viśeṣā bhāvaṃ na tānantareṇa sa iti, evaṃ ca sūkṣmāvasthoktyaiva tvayābhyupagataṃ bhavati, sa ca sūkṣmatāṃ yān bhāvo bāla-yuva-madhyama-sthavirādyavasthāviśeṣa eva bhavati tadvyatirekeṇānavasthānāt
tathā ca tadanupapattiḥ, evaṃ ca sati bhāvasyānvayākhyasya bhāvatvānupapattiḥ, abhāvatvāpattyabhyupagamāt
kasmāt ? prāgabhāva-pradhvaṃsābhāvātmakatvādavasthayoḥ sūkṣma-sthūlayoḥ, yathā ghaṭaḥ prāgabhūtvā bhavati bhūtvā ca na bhavatītyabhāvātmakatvādasanneva prāk paścācca
evamasūkṣmaḥ sūkṣmo bhavati punaśca na bhavati, tathā sthūlo'pītyabhāvavāditvamāpannaṃ bhāvavādinaste'bhyupagamahāniśca
atha mā bhūdabhyupetahānirityabhāvatvameva bhāvasyābhyupagacchasi tataśca cakṣurādilakṣaṇetyādi

yadyasattvaṃ sāmānyasyeṣṭaṃ tasmāccāsataḥ sāmānyāccakṣurādilakṣaṇarūpādīnāmākāśādīnāṃ cāvasthākhyānāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ nirbījānāmutpattirasatī, rūpasya cakṣurlakṣaṇam, ādigrahaṇācchrotra-tvagajihvā-ghrāṇāni śabda-sparśa-rasa-gandhānāṃ lakṣaṇāni, lakṣyā rūpādayaḥ, śabdādyātmakāni cākāśādīni bhūtānītyādisarvaśāstra-lokagatavyavahārābhāvaprasaṅgād bhāvasyābhāvatvamapi nābhyupagantavyamiti
yadi bhāvaḥ viśeṣān vyāpnoti na tu viśeṣo bhāvaṃ tasmād viśeṣeṇa saha bhāvasyaikatvaṃ nāsti, viśeṣasya tvasti bhāvena saha bhāvopagrahāntarbhāvitavṛtterviśeṣatvāt
atha bhedavṛttiḥ katham ? kasmānna samānabhūtaḥ sannaviśeṣarūpa eva saṃvṛtto bhāvavat ? bhāvo vā viśiṣṭatvād viśeṣarūpaḥ, tadekatvāt, viśeṣavat ?

prāgagnīndhanaikatve--agnerindhanena sahaikatve doṣādindhanasyāgninā sahaikatve doṣābhāvaṃ manyamānena yathā parihāraḥ pareṇocyate tatheha bhāvasya viśeṣeṇa sahaikatve doṣād viśeṣasya bhāvena sahaikatve doṣābhāvaṃ manyamānaḥ parihāramāha--tadyathā--yadi bhāvaḥ sāmānyaṃ pṛthivītvādi ghaṭapaṭādīnaśma-sikatādīṃśca viśeṣān vyāpnoti, na tu viśeṣo'śma-ghaṭādirbhāvaṃ pṛthivītvaṃ vyāpnoti ekadeśavṛttitvāt
tasmād viśeṣeṇa saha ghaṭena paṭena vā pṛthivyā ekatvaṃ nāsti, ghaṭasya tvasti viśeṣasya sāmānyena pṛthivyādinā bhāvena saha

kasmāt ? bhāvopagrahāntarbhāvitavṛtterviśeṣatvāt, bhāvasya sāmānyasya upagraheṇa tenopagṛhītatvāt tasminnantarbhāvitā vṛttiḥ vartanamastitvaṃ viśeṣasya bhāvātmarūpāpannatvāt kāraṇād viśeṣasya viśeṣatvam nānyathā
tasmād bhāvopagrahāntarbhāvitavṛtterviśeṣatvād viśeṣasya sāmānyena sahaikatvamastu bhāvāvyatiriktātmatvāt, ko doṣa iti
etāvat pṛcchyate sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvavādī samānopālambhānivṛtteḥ --atha bhedavṛttiḥ katham ? iti

tadyathā--pṛthivī ityaviśeṣeṇa ghaṭa-paṭādiṣvabhinnā bhāvasya, ghaṭa paṭo na bhavati iti ghaṭā-paṭāderbhinnā viśeṣasya, te ca vṛttī parasparavibhinne, tayoḥ kopapattirekatve paraspararūpānāpattau nānātvakṛtāyām ? iti taddarśayati aniṣṭāpādanadvāreṇa --kasmānna samānabhūtaḥ sannaviśeṣarūpa eva saṃvṛttaḥ ? yo'yaṃ ghaṭo rūpādirvā viśeṣaḥ paṭādibhyo rasādibhyo vā vyāvṛtto'pi mṛd mṛdeva ityavyāvṛttaḥ samānabhūtaḥ sa san san, bhavati bhavati, pṛthivī pṛthivī ityeva vā nirviśeṣaḥ kasmānna bhāvavad bhavati, pratiṣedhadvayasyāviśeṣāniṣṭāpādanāt ? dṛṣṭaṃ viśeṣaṃ samarthayati— bhāvo vā viśiṣṭatvād viśeṣarūpaḥ kasmānna saṃvṛttaḥ iti vartate, tadekatvād viśeṣavat, mṛdbhavanapṛthivītvatyaktarūpo rūparasādiviśeṣa eva kasmānna bhavati ? ubhayatra tadekatvāt iti hetuḥ

aniṣṭāpādanasādhanaṃ ca --bhāvo viśeṣa eva syāt tadekatvāt tatsvātmavat, viśeṣo vā bhāva eva syāt tadekatvāt tatsvātmavat, mṛt syād ghaṭa eva tadekatvāt ghaṭasvātmavat, ghaṭo vā mṛdeva syāt tadekatvāt tatsvātmavat
kuto'yaṃ viśeṣaḥ--idaṃ sahedaṃ na saheti, dviṣṭhatvāt sahāsahabhāvasya, viśeṣaṇakriyādhārakaraṇādyanupapatteśca
athāpi kathañcidekatvaṃ tathāpyekam ekameva iti na vaktavyamityādi pūrvavad yāvat paramāṇuvaditi
atha mā bhūvannamī doṣā ityanyatvaṃ bhāvaviśeṣayoḥ
tatra yadi bhāvasya viśeṣeṇa sahānyatvamabhyupagamyate tata idamāpatitaṃ tena tarhi tasya viśeṣapṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamākhyeyaṃ yathānyeṣāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ paṭādipṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamākhyāyate

ekatve kuto'yaṃ viśeṣaḥ--idaṃ na sahedaṃ saheti ? bhāvo viśeṣeṇa sahaiko na viśeṣo bhāvena, viśeṣo bhāvena sahaiko na bhāvo viśeṣeṇa ityetau vikalpau naikatve ghaṭete, viśeṣahetvabhāvāt, anyatva eva ca ghaṭete, dviṣṭhatvāt sahāsahabhāvasyeti

itaśca nopapannamekatvaṃ bhāvena saha viśeṣasya viśeṣaṇakriyādhārakaraṇādyanupapatteśca, viśeṣaṇakriyā kartari viśiṃṣati samavetā viśeṣye vā karmaṇi pṛthivī-ghaṭādau, tau tasyā yathāvivakṣamādhārau, yena paṭādinā vipakṣabhūtena viśiṣyate tat karaṇam, bhāvasyaiva vā viśeṣaḥ yato viśiṣyate ghaṭo'yaṃ paṭādirna bhavati iti so'rtho'pādānam, yasmai viśiṣyate pratipādyate sa sampradānaṃ śrotā ityeṣāṃ kārakāṇāṃ kriyāyāśca vipūrvaśiṣidhātuvācyāyā bhinnārthanibandhanatvādekatve satyanupapattiḥ

abhyupetyāpyekatvaṃ na yuktameveti brūmaḥ --athāpi kathañcidityādi pūrvavadekatvapratiṣedhenāvaktavyaprasādhanaṃ tameva granthamatidiśati pūrvavad yāvat paramāṇuvaditi sāvadhikaṃ sahetudṛṣṭāntāpādyāvaktavyatvaniṣṭhaṃ tulyagamakatvād vyākhyātārthameveti
etaddoṣabhayāt pakṣāntaraṃ nirdoṣaṃ manyamānaścet paro gṛhṇīyāt --atha mā bhūvannamī doṣā iti, kiṃ tat pakṣāntaram ? anyatvaṃ bhāva-viśeṣayoḥ
tatrāpyekatvavad dvayī gatiḥ--bhāvasya viśeṣeṇa sahānyatvaṃ viśeṣasya vā bhāveneti
tatra tāvad yadi bhāvasya viśeṣeṇa sahānyatvamabhyupagamyate tata idamāpatitaṃ doṣajātam --tena tarhītyādi yāvat saṃvṛtighaṭa-paṭava diti tulyagamaṃ pūrvavat
śeṣaṃ tathaiva gamanīyaṃ rūpākhyā- namaśa kyaṃ kartumityādi

upasaṃhārasādhanam --anirūpyamāṇastvasannāpadyeta, aviśeṣatve'rūpatvāt, khapuṣpavat, aviśeṣatvaṃ bhāvasya viśeṣādatyantamanyatvāt pṛthivyā aśmasikatādyavasthāviśeṣamanta sādhāraṇam, sāmānyaviśeṣaikānyatvānavasthitatattvasaṃvṛtighaṭapaṭavat
tadvā kuto'viśeṣam ? yadi syād bhāvo viśeṣarahitastato niravaśeṣaviśeṣābhāve'pi khapuṣpādāvanupravṛttirūpaḥ syād bhāvatvād ghaṭādivat
yadyapi sāmānyasya viśeṣeṇa sahānyatvaṃ nāsti tathāpi viśeṣasya sāmānyena sahānyatvamasti dṛṣṭatvāt
dṛṣṭo hi viśeṣo bhāvavinābhūto'pi yathā bhinno ghaṭa iti
tadanyatve sa naiva syāt, abhāvatvāt, khapuṣpavat
ata eva tatsiddhiḥ; bhinnasamānādhikaraṇasya mukhyamūlatvād gauṇasya
pūrvoktācca tadvṛtti- reṇāsthānāt tadātmatvamanicchata ekāntenāviśeṣatvam, aviśeṣatve satyarūpatvaṃ bhāvasya tadatirekeṇānirūpyarūpatvāt
tadvā kuto'viśeṣam ? yadi syād bhāvo viśeṣarahitastato niravaśeṣaviśeṣābhāve'pi khapuṣpādāvanupravṛttirūpaḥ syād bhāvatvād ghaṭādivat
yadyapi sāmānyasya viśeṣeṇa sahānyatvaṃ nāsti tathāpi viśeṣasya sāmānyena sahānyatvamasti dṛṣṭatvāt
dṛṣṭo hi viśeṣo bhāvavinābhūto'pi yathā bhinno ghaṭa iti
tadanyatve sa naiva syāt, abhāvatvāt, khapuṣpavat
ata eva tatsiddhiḥ; bhinnasamānādhikaraṇasya mukhyamūlatvād gauṇasya
ityukte'nyatvavādinā athocyeta--rūpaṃ pṛthag bhāvasya viśeṣād vyāvṛttirūpādanupravṛttau dṛṣṭam iti vākyaśeṣaḥ
atra brūmaḥ --tadvā kuto'viśeṣam ? yadetad ghaṭāśmādiṣu pṛthivītvānuvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ rūpaṃ tad viśeṣeṇa vinā naivāstīti tadavasthaṃ pṛthagrūpākhyānāśakyatvam
abhyupetyāpi tvadanuvṛttyā nirviśeṣaṃ bhāvamatyantānyatvavādinaste doṣaṃ brūmaḥ --yadi syād bhāvo viśeṣarahitastato niravaśeṣaviśeṣābhāve'pi khapuṣpādāvanupravṛttirūpaḥ syād bhāvatvād ghaṭādāviva

uktadoṣabhayāt sāmānyasya viśeṣeṇa sahānyatvam ityetad viśeṣapradhānamanyatvaṃ mā bhūnnāma tathāpi viśeṣasya sāmānyena sahānyatvamasti dṛṣṭatvāt, dṛṣṭo hi viśeṣo bhāvavinābhūto'pi viśeṣa eva bhāvarahitaḥ kva dṛṣṭa iti taddarśayati --yathā bhinno ghaṭa iti, bhedo hi ghaṭasya pradhvaṃsābhāvo vināśaparyāyaḥ, sa ca viśeṣo bhāvādatyantavilakṣaṇo dṛṣṭaśca, ato'nyatvaṃ viśeṣasya bhāvāditi
tasmādavinaśvarāṇvādipudgalasaṅghāta-visaṅghātaviṣayapariṇāmatvāt utpanno vinaṣṭaḥ ityādyupacāro bhāvasyaiva nābhāvasya khapuṣpādeḥ sambhavati
yadi manyethā bhāvādabhedopacāra iti, sa bhāvādanyatve khapuṣpavad naiva syāt, bhinnaḥ utpannaḥ iti vā nopacaryeta ghaṭaḥ, abhāvatvād viśeṣatvāt khapuṣpavat
yadā cāyaṃ bhāvāvyatirikta evopalabhyate tadā na kadācidapyabhāvo bhavati khapuṣpavat
nanu yadaiva sāmānyamaviśeṣaṃ tadaivānyatvam, na, aviśeṣāt
siddhe hyanyatve sahāsahabhavanaṃ dviṣṭhatvāt syāt, tattu na siddham
avaśyaṃ caitadevam--bhāvaviṣaya evaiṣa bhedopacāraḥ, bhedopacārādeva bhedasiddhiḥ, bhāvādeva vā bhedopacārasiddhiḥ

kiṃ kāraṇam ? bhinnasamānādhikaraṇasya mukhyamūlatvād gauṇasya, bhinno ghaṭaḥ iti ghaṭena samānādhikaraṇo bhedopacāro gauṇo mukhyaṃ bhedamanupravṛttisahacaritamavasthāviśeṣaṃ nava-taruṇa-madhya-jīrṇādikaṃ sarpasyeva sphaṭāṭopa-kuṭilagati-kuṇḍala-prasṛta-dīrghavṛttyāttādyavasthāviśeṣaṃ bhāvasyāpekṣya vinaṣṭe'pi bhinnaḥ ityupacāraḥ kriyate, gauṇasya mukhyamūlatvāt
abhinna eva vā bhāve kapālādyavasthāyāṃ bheda upacaryate stimitasaraḥsalilavadanutpādavyayatvād bhāvasya puruṣa-kālādikāraṇamātrasya

kiñca, viśiṣyate viśeṣaḥ iti sato viśeṣatvāt tadapekṣatvācca viśiṣyate sa tasmāt tena vā sa ityādinā aviśeśiṃṣannaviśiṣyamāṇo vā na viśeṣa eva kārakāṇāmeva kārakatvāt pṛ॰ 753 ityādigranthena pūrvoktāccetyatidiśati

kiñca, tadvṛttitvācca pūrvoktācca iti vartate viśeṣavṛttitvād bhāvasya viśeṣasvātmavad na viśeṣebhyo'nyatvam, tathā ca bhāvavṛttitvādvā bhāvavad viśeṣasya bhāvād nānyatvam, tadvṛttitvaṃ cānayoratītanyāyena subhāvitam, ghaṭapaṭādibhāvānuvṛttirūpatve'pi pṛthaganirdeśyarūpatvāt

syānmatam--antyaviśeṣastu paramāṇuṣvanyapratyayahetutvād vyāvṛttirūpa eveti cet, tanna, yasmād bhāvādantyaviśeṣastu naiva pṛthagbhūtaḥ, viśeṣatvāt, ghaṭavat, yathā ghaṭo viśeṣo bhāvātmakastadvṛttitvāt svātmavad bhāvādapṛthagbhūtastathāntyaviśeṣo'pi
tad vyācaṣṭe --yadā cāyamityādi, na kadācidapyabhāvo bhavati, khapuṣpavat iti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ

atrāha --nanu yadaiva sāmānyamaviśeṣaṃ tadaivānyatvam, nanu bhāvo'nuvṛttilakṣaṇo nirākṛtasarvaghaṭapaṭādiviśeṣo na kvacit kutaścid vyāvartate, ato viśeṣāt parasparavyāvṛttilakṣaṇādanyaḥ iti siddhamiti
etacca na aviśeṣāt, uktaṃ prāganekadhā nirākṛtasarvaviśeṣasya bhāvasyātmalābhābhāvādabhāvatvam, aviśeṣatvācca khapuṣpavadasataḥ kuto'nyatvam ?

kiñca, yadapi ca bhāvo viśeṣeṇa saha bhavati na viśeṣaḥ, viśeṣo bhāvena saha na bhāvaḥ, tau ca athāpi kathañcidanyatvam, anyat anyadeva iti na vaktavyam, anyatvāt, hastādyanyānanyadevadattavad yāvad rūpādikṣaṇāntarānyānanyaparamāṇuvat
yadi hyanuvṛtti-vyāvṛttilakṣaṇaniyamo na syāt tato rūpādirapi viśeṣaḥ pravarteta bhāvavat
parasparamasaha iti vṛttibheda ucyate sa cāsiddhaḥ, tayoranyatvasyāsiddhatvāt
siddhe hyanyatve sahāsahabhavanaṃ dviṣṭhatvāt syāt, tattu na siddham,
athāpi kathañcidanyatvam, anyat anyadeva iti na vaktavyam, anyatvāt, hastādyanyānanyadevadattavad yāvad rūpādikṣaṇāntarānyānanyaparamāṇuvat
yadi hyanuvṛtti-vyāvṛttilakṣaṇaniyamo na syāt tato rūpādirapi viśeṣaḥ pravarteta bhāvavat

abhyupagamyāpi brūmaḥ --taathāpi kathañcidityādi yāvat paramāṇuvaditi sa eva tulyagamo grantho'nyatvaniṣedhārthaḥ anyat anyadeva iti na vaktavyamiti pratijñāya anyatvāt, hastādyanyānanyadevadattavad yāvad rūpādikṣaṇāntarānyānanyaparamāṇuvaditi savyākhyānopāyapradarśanena gatārthaḥ
bhāva-viśeṣayoraviśeṣa ekatvam, viśeṣo'nyatvam, tayoḥ pratiṣiddhatvād viśeṣāviśeṣatvābhāvaḥ, yasya viśeṣāviśeṣatvābhāvastasyāsattvam, yathā khapuṣpasyeti

anubhayatvamasattvam, tadapi avacanīyam, kasmāt ? bhinnavyavasthānalakṣaṇatvāt, yathāgnīndhanayordahana-dāhyādivyavasthāne bhinne lakṣaṇe sta ityanubhayatvaṃ nāstītyuktaṃ tatheha bhāva-viśeṣayorapi anuvṛtti-vyāvṛttī vyavasthāne bhinne lakṣaṇe sta ityanubhayatvamapi avacanīyam
aniṣṭāpādanodāharaṇe tu viśeṣa --tato rūpādirapītyādi, rūpaṃ viśeṣo raso'pi pravarteta pṛthageva bhāvāt svenaiva rūpeṇa vyāvṛttirūparahitatvāt bhāvavat
bhāvo'pi cānuvṛttirūpaḥ san rūpādeḥ pṛthageva vyāvarteta anupravṛttirūparahitatvāt khapuṣpavat

yadyanupravṛtti-vyāvṛttī sāmānya-viśeṣayorbhinnavyavasthāne na syātāṃ syādeṣa prasaṅgaḥ prastute, yasmād bhāvo rūpa-rasādiṣvanupravartamāno dṛśyate viśeṣaśca rūpa-rasādibhyaḥ parasparaṃ vyāvartamānaḥ tasmānnānubhayatvamapyasti
sarvātmakaikabhāva bhinnavyavasthānalakṣaṇavṛttobhayatvānabhyupagame tu sarvātmakaikabhāva evātyantābhāva eva vobhayatvaṃ syāt
ato'nyathoktau vastuvisaṃvādaḥ, anyasyānanyatvena ekasyānekatvena ubhayasyānubhayatvenāvadhāraṇāt, ghaṭapaṭaviparyayāvadhṛtivat
ayaṃ ca niyamo niyama eva vastu itīcchati, sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvaikāntāyatasvavṛttereva niścitaniyatādhikyayamanāt
evobhayatvaṃ syāt, atyantābhāve khapuṣpa eva vā, gatyantarābhāvāt
bhinnavyavasthānalakṣaṇavṛttobhayatvānabhyupagame tu sarvātmakaikabhāva evātyantābhāva eva vobhayatvaṃ syāt
ato'nyathoktau vastuvisaṃvādaḥ, anyasyānanyatvena ekasyānekatvena ubhayasyānubhayatvenāvadhāraṇāt, ghaṭapaṭaviparyayāvadhṛtivat
ayaṃ ca niyamo niyama eva vastu itīcchati, sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvaikāntāyatasvavṛttereva niścitaniyatādhikyayamanāt
anubhayatvapratiṣedhādityādiḥ pūrvavat tulyagamo grantho yāvat sarvathaivāvaktavyataiveti dṛṣṭāntāgnīndhanopasaṃhāravad dārṣṭāntikabhāvaviśeṣopasaṃhāreṇa gatārthaḥ
evaṃ hi bhavati bhavanamagnīndhanavat ityupakramya sa eva dṛṣṭāntagrantho yāvat sarvathāpyavaktavyataiva iti

tasyopari yadyekatvaṃ guṇasya dravyeṇa saha nānyatetyādi dravya-guṇayoḥ paraspareṇa sahaikatvānyatvānubhayatvobhayatvapradhānopasarjanatvapratiṣedhena sarvathaiva avaktavyatā ityupasaṃhāro yāvat tāvadaśeṣo grantho yojyaḥ
ādigrahaṇāt sarvagatā'sarvagata-nityā-'nityā-'vasthā-'vasthāvad-bhojya-bhoktrādivikalpeṣu samānaḥ pracarca iti sthitamavacanīyaṃ vastviti

yathā ghaṭe paṭaḥ ityavadhāryamāṇe paṭe ca ghaṭaḥ ityavadhāryamāṇe visaṃvādaḥ evamanyatvamananyatvenetyādi yojyam, ekatvā-'nyatvobhayatvā-'nubhayatvā'nyatarapradhānopasarjanatvairavadhāryamāṇaṃ vastu visaṃvadate parasparata iti vastu vyākhyātam
nayasvarūpamucyate --ayaṃ ca niyamaḥ vidhi-niyamasarvabhaṅgasamūhasamyaktvapratipādanādhikāre pratyeka atra cābhijalpaḥ śabdārthaḥ
āha hi— śabdo vāpyabhijalpatvamāgato yāti vācyatām
svarūpajijñāsāyāmeṣa nayo niyama eva vastu itīcchati

yathā varṇitaṃ niyamaśabdākṣarārthaṃ ca vastunā yojayati atītavikalpavastvasambhavaṃ pradarśayan--tadyathā sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvaikāntāyatasvavṛttereva niścita-niyatā-''dhikyayamanāt, yamernipūrvasya ghañi prādisamāse niścito yamo niyato'dhiko vā niyamaḥ, kasmāt ? uktavidhinā sāmānya-viśeṣayorekatve'nyatve dvitve ubhayatve'nyatarapradhānopasarjanatve ca ayatasvavṛttitvād niścita-niyatā-'dhikābhāvena, avaktavyatve niścitaniyatā-'dhikabhāvena yatasvavṛtitvād yathārthaniyamasaṃjño'yaṃ bhaṅgaḥ
āha hi— śabdo vāpyabhijalpatvamāgato yāti vācyatām
ete samarthena nityaṃ samasyante kutsitaḥ puruṣaḥ kupuruṣaḥ
evaṃ vastuto'kṣarārthataśca niyamasvarūpamuktvā śabdārthamāha --atra caivaṃvidhabhāvatāyāmabhijalpaḥ śabdārthaḥ
prāgeṣo'bhijalpaḥ śabdārthaḥ prāsaṅgiko vyaktyādivastupratyākhyānaprasaṅganokta iti na punarvyākhyāyate
tatsūcanārthaṃ tvāha --āha hītyādi tallakṣaṇakārikāḥ sūcayaṃstameva granthaṃ samarpayati śabdo vāpyabhijalpatvamāgata ityādidvyardhakārikayā

kathaṃ punastena granthenāvaktavyatoktā ? iti cet tatpradarśanārthamāha --so'yam ityekīkṛtatvācchabdarūpasyārthena so'yam ityabhedasambandhavaśenaikīkṛtaṃ yadā iti vacanādanyatvamavaktavyamityuktaṃ bhavati
arthena ityekatvaṃ śabdāda bhinnenārthenaikīkaraṇaṃ dviṣṭhatvādekīkaraṇasya anekamekaṃ kriyate śabdarūpamarthena iti vacanādekatvamavaktavyamityuktaṃ bhavati
etābhyāmeva yuktibhyāmubhayatvamanubhayatvaṃ ca pradhānopasarjanate cāvaktavyānīti jñeyāni
saṅghāto vākyam, devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklām iti pratyekavṛttisāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvānekārthasthatvāt
evaṃ ca kṛtvā dikpradarśanamātreṇa śabdo'rthapratyāsattyā bravīti ityucyate
vākyārthastarhi kaḥ ? vākye jñāte vākyārtho jñāyata evetyāha --saṅghāto vākyam

kasmāt ? iti cet, ucyate— devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklām iti pratyekavṛttisāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvānekārthasthatvāt, yasmād devadattādīni padāni padārthasāmānye pratyekaṃ vartamānāni viśiṣṭasaṃsarge'rthe vartante sa vākyārthaḥ, yathoktam --sāmānyavartināṃ padānāṃ viśeṣe'vasthānaṃ vākyārthaḥ , tayośca sāmānyaviśeṣayorekatvānyatvobhayatvānubhayatvādyanekātmakārthatvasyāvacanīyatvena parigrahādanekārthe sthitaḥ śabda ekarūpeṇāvadhārayitumaśaṃkyatvādavaktavyastadartha iti
kevalaṃ padaṃ yasyaivārthasya vācakaṃ vākyasthamapi tadevābhidadhāti
tataḥ samudāye padānāṃ parasparānvaye padārthavaśād yadādhikyaṃ saṃsargaḥ sa vākyārthaḥ
uktaṃ ca--yadatrādhikyaṃ vākyārthaḥ saḥ pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 2
vākyārthasya cāsya jātivat pratyekaparisamāptiḥ, keṣāñcinmate saṃkhyādivat samudāyaparisamāptiriti pakṣadvayaṃ darśayitumāha --sa tvanekapadastho'pi pratibhedaṃ samāpyate
evaṃ ca kṛtvā yadapyuktam— sāmānyārthastirobhūto viśeṣo nopajāyate
15 iti, tadapi pratyuktameva yathāvicāritaniścitamavaktavyaṃ sarvathā vastviti dikpradarśanamātreṇa śabdo'rthapratyāsattyā vijñānādhānamātreṇa bravīti ityucyate
devadattādīnāṃ ca bhāgābhimatānāmarthayogābhyupagame sāmānye'vasthitānāṃ padānāṃ viśeṣe'vasthānamityetasmin satyekānte parigṛhyamāṇe sāmānyārthastirobhūto na viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhate
15, iha sāmānyavṛttiruccārito devadattādiśabdaḥ sāmānyārthasambaddha eva tirobhavati
tatra yena śabdenāvirbhāvakāla eva viśiṣṭo'rtho na pratilabdhaḥ sa śabdaḥ sāmānyārthaḥ tirobhūto viśeṣe'vasthātuṃ na punarutsahate
tatropāttasya nitye śabdārthasa bandhe kutastyāgaḥ ? yuktinirūpaṇeṣu cārthātmasu abhidhānakriyāyogābhāve vinivṛtto'navadhāryamāṇātmā śabdaḥ śabdopakramasyārthasyābhāvādaviṣayaḥ kvāvasthāpyatām
yat punarmīmāṃsakairucyate yathā padasaṃghāta evākāṃkṣāyogyatāsannidhānavaśāt parasparasamanvito vākyaṃ saṃsargaśca vākyārtha iti tad dūṣayitumāha --sāmānyārtha iti
iha devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklāṃ daṇḍena pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 1
tatra devadattapadaṃ tāvad yadi sāmānyamātre prathamaṃ vartate tattasya gavādipadakāle vācaḥ kramavartitvāt tirodhānādasattvameveti kutaḥ padāntaraśravaṇakāle tadarthapratītiḥ
asattvādeva ca na padāntarasannidhāne tasya viśeṣe'vasthānam ? abhyupagamyāpi smaryamāṇatayā padāntarasaṃnidhāne vidyamānatvaṃ padasya na viśeṣe'vasthānaṃ yujyata ityāha --upāttasyeti

sāmānyalakṣaṇasya sakalapadārthasādhāraṇasyārthasya pūrvamupāttasya vācyatvena parigṛhītasyedānīṃ padāntarasaṃnidhāne tyāgaḥ kuto yujyate, śabdārthasambandhasyānityatāprāpteḥ ? na ca tathā mīmāṃsakasyābhyupagama iti
svārthānnivṛtto'sau padāntarasaṃnidhāne śabdaḥ kvedānīmavatiṣṭhatām ? śabdāntarabodhye'rthe tasya vācakabhāvavirahāt sthitiḥ kathaṃ yujyate ?
evameva ca bhāvayuktavācī iti yujyate yadavaktavyamiti paryavaṇamātramāha

evameva ceti yadapi lakṣaṇakāreṇa śabdanayalakṣaṇamuktam --nāma-sthāpanā-dravyavācyeṣṭākaraṇād bhāvayuktavācī śabdaḥ iti, bhāvaḥ paryāyo niyamo guṇo vā, tadyuktavācī tadyuktamarthaṃ brūte iti śabdanayamataṃ tadapi evaṃ yujyate yadavaktavyamiti paryavaṇamātramāha, sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvānekātmakasya vastuno vācā vaktumaśakyatvāt
śabdanayadeśatvāt paryavāstika eṣaḥ,tassa tu saddavikappā sāha-pasāhā suhumabhedā sanmati॰ 1

kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhāvayuktavācitve paryāyagrahaṇaṃ na sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ bhāvaśabdasya sāmānyavācitve ? iti cet, ucyate --bhuvo bhinnadhātvarthavācitvāt, bhūvādayaḥ sarvadhātavo bhvarthe, bhūvādaya iti vaderauṇādika iñpratyaye bhūvādayaḥ sarvadhātavaḥ
tasmānna sattārtha eva bhūḥ, bhū-kṛñoḥ sarvadhātvarthavācitvāt

paryavati bhavatīti bhāvaḥ, paryavaṇaṃ ca praveśanam, ava rakṣaṇa-gati-kāntiprīti-tṛptyavagamana-praveśa-śravaṇa-svāmyarthayācana-kriyecchā-dīptyavāptyāliṅgana-hiṃsā-dahanabhāva-vṛddhiṣu pā॰ dhā॰ 60॰ iti paṭhitatvād bhāvaḥ paryavaḥ praveśaḥ
samantādavaḥ paryava iti pariśabdaḥ samantādarthaḥ, avaśabdaḥ praveśārthaḥ
tad vastuto darśayati --samantāt praviśati ekatāmanyatāmubhayatāmanubhayatāṃ ca yo'rthaḥ sa paryavaḥ, asti ityasya matirāstikaḥ, paryave āstikaḥ paryavāstika iti mūlasaṃjñāsya nayasya śabdasya
tassa tu saddavikappā sāha-pasāhā suhumabhedā sanmati॰ 1 | 5
eta evārthā agre'pi pṛ॰ 547-- 2 ityatra vakṣyante

samprati pracalite pāṇinīyadhātupāṭhe mādhavīyadhātupāṭhe ca ava rakṣaṇagatikāntiprītitṛptyavagamanapraveśaśravaṇasvāmyarthayācanakriyecchādīptyavāptyāliṅganahiṃsādānabhāgavṛddhiṣu iti pāṭha upalabhyata iti dhyeyam
tadasya ityeva asti paralokaḥ ityevaṃ matiryasya sa āstikaḥ
bhāvaḥ, samantāt praviśati ekatāmanyatāmubhayatāmanubhayatāṃ ca yo'rthaḥ sa paryavaḥ, paryave āstikaḥ paryavāstikaḥ
upanibandhanamasya--tadubhayassa ādiṭṭhe avattavvaṃ ātā ti ya ṇo ātā ti yabhagavatī॰ 12
kimetāḥ svamanīṣikā ucyanta utāstyasyopanibandhanamārṣamapi ? iti, asti ityucyate-- upanibandhanamasya tadubhayassa ādiṭṭhe ityādi
imā ṇaṃ bhaṃte rayaṇappabhā puḍhavī ātā no ātā ? iti pṛṣṭe bhagavadvacanam --gotamā ! siā ātā siā ṇo ātā
se keṇaṭṭheṇaṃ bhaṃte evaṃ vuccati siā ātā siā ṇo ātā ? iti hetuparipraśnaḥ
bhagavāṃstaduttaramāha— goamā ! appaṇo ādiṭṭhe ātā, parassa ādiṭṭhe ṇo ātā, tadubhayassa ādiṭṭhe avattavvaṃ ātā ti ya ṇo ātā ti ya iti
iti niyamabhaṅgo navamo'raḥ śrīmallavādipraṇītanayacakrasya ṭīkāyāṃ nyāyāgamānusāriṇyāṃ siṃhasūrigaṇivādikṣamāśramaṇadṛbdhāyāṃ samāptaḥ
tadyathā--idaṃ tat tadevodyate tadeva cāpodyate tvayā
ekatvādi pratiṣidhya vyavasthāpya ca parasparataḥ punaścāpodyate
dṛṣṭānte yaduktam agnerindhanapṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamākhyeyam ityādinā ca pratiṣiddhaṃ so'pi ca pratiṣedho'pratyayaḥ, yathoktam--'agnerindhanapṛthagbhūtaṃ tattvamaśakyaṃ darśayitum, na

vidhyādisakalabhaṅgātmakasamyagdarśanādhikāre vartamāne vikalanayasvarūpajñānamūlatvāt samyagdarśanasya vidhyubhayavikalpacatuṣṭayātmakau mārgau vyākhyāya niyamavikalpacatuṣṭayātmake tṛtīye mārge vartamāne tatra niyamabhaṅgaṃ prathamamuktvā abhijalpaśabdārthatvamābhimukhyena dikpratyāsattyā na sākṣād vastunaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayorekatvānyatvādyanekaduruparavadhārāvasthatvādavaktavyatā ityanantaraṃ niyamanaye'bhidhānāt atrāpyaparituṣyan niyamavidhibhaṅgārastvāha --naivaṃvidho niyamo yujyate svavacanavirodhādidoṣādanekāvasthāpattāvaniyatatvācca, idaṃ hi tvadīyaṃ vacanaṃ lokābhāṇaka eva saṃvṛttaḥ
tadyathā--idaṃ tattadevodyate tadeva cāpodyate tvayā, tadeva vadasyapavadasi cetyarthaḥ
tataḥ kim ? tataścāsat tadaśobhanaṃ nāsti vetyarthaḥ
kasmāt ? svayaṃvihitanivartitvāt, ātmanā vihitameva nivartayituṃ śīlamasyeti svayaṃvihitanivarti tvadvacanam, tadbhāvāt svayaṃvihitanivartitvāt

kimiva ? sarvoktānṛtapakṣavat, yathā sarvamuktamanṛtam iti vadatā yadevoditaṃ sarvamuktamanṛtam iti vidhinā tadevānṛtatvena vyāptatvāt pratiṣidhyamānamapodyate tathedamapi tvadīyaṃ sarvamavaktavyam iti
etasya pratipādanārthamekatvādi pratiṣidhya vyavasthāpya ca parasparataḥ punaścāpodyate
tadyathā--prāgeva tāvat sāmānya-viśeṣayorekatve pratiṣiddhe'nyatvamupasthitamarthāt, tadvalena pratiṣedhāt

kathaṃ pratiṣiddham ? iti cet, ucyate--tadyathā --dṛṣṭānte yaduktam agnerindhanapṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamā hyanyadanyasādhāraṇam, sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvānavasthitatattvaghaṭapaṭasaṃvṛtivat anirūpyastvasannāpadyetetyādi
tadetat punastvayaivāpoditaṃ nanu jvālā deśe ityanyatvaṃ sphuṭībhūtamapi tadvā kuto'nindhanam ? jvālārūpamindhanasahitameva iti bruvatā
nanu bhavadviśeṣasamudāyakṛtamekatvaṃ rūparasādighaṭaikatvaviśeṣavat, ato'nyatvapratiṣedho'tisphuṭa eva svavacanavirodhaḥ
khyeyam ityādinā ca pratiṣiddhaṃ so'pi ca pratiṣedho'pratyayaḥ

katham ? iti cet, ucyate— nanu jvālā deśe, yat tadindhanapṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamagneḥ pṛcchyate tajjvālā ākāśadeśe gṛhāṇeti nirūpaṇenānyatvaṃ sphuṭībhūtamapi punaḥ tadvā kuto'nindhanam ityanindhanapratyākhyānena jvālārūpamindhanasahitameva iti bruvatā
tathā cedamuktaṃ bhavati--adīpyamānaṃ prāganindhanamakāṣṭhaṃ ca saddārūdakādi paścād dīptisvabhāvamindhanaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ bhavatīti
tacca yatsamparkādidhyate dīpyate ca dārūdakādi tat tasyāgne rūpamiti
yadyanyatvaṃ samarthitameva parigṛhyeta syāt sapratyayam, na tu parigṛhītam
tadetat punastvayaivāpoditaṃ nanu jvālā deśe ityanyatvaṃ sphuṭībhūtamapi tadvā kuto'nindhanam ? jvālārūpamindhanasahitameva iti bruvatā
nanu bhavadviśeṣasamudāyakṛtamekatvaṃ rūparasādighaṭaikatvaviśeṣavat, ato'nyatvapratiṣedho'tisphuṭa eva svavacanavirodhaḥ

bhāva-viśeṣayorekatvaṃ pratiṣidhyānyatvaṃ vyavasthāpya tatpratiṣedhidārṣṭāntikopasaṃhāre yaduktaṃ viśeṣasya bhāvapṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamākhyeyam ityādi tameva granthaṃ taduktaṃ darśayati, etadapi tvayaivāpoditamanyatvapratiṣedhavacanam
nanu viśeṣā eva bhavanti, na sāmānyaṃ nāma kiñcidasti
te ca viśeṣā eva bhavantaḥ samuditā ekam ityucyante
naikaṃ kiñcidanekātmakaṃ vastu, kiṃ tarhi ? ekaika evaiko viśeṣo'nyo'nyo bhavatīti paramārthaḥ praṇidhānavadbhirabhrāntairavagamyate, bhrāntāstu viśeṣā eva bhavantaḥ samuditā ekaśa ekam ityupāsate

kimiva ? rūparasādighaṭaikatvaviśeṣavat, yathā rūpa-rasa-gandha-sparśa-saṅkhyā saṃsthānādayo dharmā viviktā bhinnendriyagrāhyāḥ samuditā eko ghaṭaḥ ityucyante tathā bhrāntyā samudāyaikatve'satyapi viśeṣā eva rūpaṃ raso na bhavati raso'pi nanūbhayato'pi pratiṣedhādadoṣaḥ
kiṃviṣayā tarhyavaktavyatā ? na tāvad bhāvasya viśeṣasyobhayasya vā
apravibhāgatastāvadekatvaṃ nāsti pratiṣiddhatvāt, pravibhāgato'pi nāsti niṣiddhatvādeva
tathaiva pravibhāgato'pravibhāgato vānyatvaṃ nāsti yadbalenānubhayatvaṃ vyāvartyetaikatvaṃ vā
tathānubhayatvamapi nāsti yadbalenaikatvānyatvobhayatvāni vyāvartyeran, yasya vācyatāṃ gṛhītvā'vācyaṃ vā vyāvartyeta

rūpaṃ na bhavati ityādītaretarābhūtevirviśeṣaguṇaḥ anyo'nyo na bhavatīti samudāyakṛtādekatvād bhrāntihetukāt pṛthagekatvavilakṣaṇaṃ viviktaṃ viśeṣaviṣayaṃ pratipādayituṃ viśeṣasya bhāvapṛthagbhūtaṃ rūpamākhyeyam ityādinā pṛthagekatvamanyatvaṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ svarūpeṇāvadhārayitavyamiti vacanādevānyatvaṃ samarthitam, ato'nyatvapratiṣedho'tisphuṭa eva svavacanavirodho dārṣṭāntikopasaṃhāre'pīti
kiṃviṣayā tarhyavaktavyatā ? na tāvad bhāvasya viśeṣasyobhayasya vā
apravibhāgatastāvadekatvaṃ nāsti pratiṣiddhatvāt, pravibhāgato'pi nāsti niṣiddhatvādeva
tathaiva pravibhāgato'pravibhāgato vānyatvaṃ nāsti yadbalenānubhayatvaṃ vyāvartyetaikatvaṃ vā
tathānubhayatvamapi nāsti yadbalenaikatvānyatvobhayatvāni vyāvartyeran, yasya vācyatāṃ gṛhītvā'vācyaṃ vā vyāvartyeta
ekatvaṃ pratiṣidhya punaranyatvamapi pratiṣiddhameva, tathobhayatvamanubhayatvaṃ ca pratiṣidhyāvaktavyataiva samarthiteti

atredamasi tvaṃ praṣṭavyaḥ --kiṃviṣayā tarhyavaktavyatā ? yadyubhayapratiṣedha eva katamat tadvastu yadavaktavyam ? kiṃ tad bhāvo viśeṣa ubhayaṃ vā ? iti nirdhāryam, vastutve sati vikalpatrayānativṛtteḥ
tatra na tāvad bhāvasya, na viśeṣasya, na ubhayasya vā, nakārānuvartanāt
apravibhāgenaikatvaṃ yathā --puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam śuklayaju॰ saṃ॰ 31
pravibhāgena sati dvitīye tena sahāsamparkādekaṃ syāt, yathā— na siṃhavṛndaṃ bhuvi bhūtapūrvamāśīviṣāṇāmapi nāsti vṛndam
na siṃhavṛndaṃ bhuvi bhūtapūrvamāśīviṣāṇāmapi nāsti vṛndam
apravibhāgatastāvadekatvaṃ bhāvasya viśeṣasya ubhayasya vā nāsti, dvitīyarahitasya rūpākhyānāśakyatvena tvayaiva pratiṣiddhatvāt
pravibhāgato'pi nāsti sahāsahabhavanasya dviṣṭhatvāt ityādinā niṣiddhatvādeva
siddhe caikatve tadbalenānyatvaṃ vyāvartyeta, sambhāvyetaikatvaṃ parigṛhya taddvāreṇa tadupāyenānyatvasya vyāvartanam, tattu nāstyaikatvam, tadabhāvādanyatvapratiṣedhābhāvaḥ

tacca nānyatvaṃ siddham, tathaiva pravibhāgato'pravibhāgato vānyatvaṃ nāsti ghaṭa-paṭayoriva jīva-śarīrayoriva vā sambhāvyamānam, tvayaiva tasyāpi niṣiddhatvāt, yadbalenānyatvadvāreṇānubhayatvaṃ vyāvartyetaikatvaṃ vā

tathānubhayatvamapi nāsti ekatvānyatvayorlakṣaṇabhedaniyamādityuktam yadbalena ekatvānyatvobhayatvāni vyāvartertyeran, yasya vācyatāṃ gṛhītveti idaṃ vācyamekatvamanyatvamubhayatvaṃ vā dṛṣṭamidaṃ tu tadvanna bhavatītyavācyaṃ tathedaṃ vācyamanubhayaṃ tadvat tāni na vācyānītyati vācyabalādavācyaṃ vā vyāvartyeta itaravyavasthāpūrvatvāditaravyāvartanasyānvaya-vyatirekābhyāmarthādhigamācca
kathamiti tat kathaṃ bhāvyate ? iti pṛcchati

ucyate --ekaśabdo hyanyanirapekṣasaṅkhyārtho'pravibhāgaikaśabdārthatvāt, hiśabdo yasmādarthaḥ, yasmādekaśabdaḥ saṅkhyāvācitve'nyanirapekṣāṃ saṅkhyāṃ saṅkhyeyaprādhānyenāha--saṅkhyāntaravyāvartanārthārtham eko'yaṃ na dvi-tryādayo'rthāḥ iti loke tasmāt ekaḥ ityukte nānyo'sti ityuktaṃ bhavati, sa cārtho na ghaṭate, na sa nirapekṣaḥ, yasmād ekatvānyatvobhayatvānubhayatvavikalpānāmanyonyāpekṣatvāt prāguktavidhinā
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣo'nyanirapekṣasaṅkhyārthatvakṛta ityasahāyavācī vikalpyetaikaśabdastasmādastyekatvam, tadastitvādanyatvādyapyastītyavaktavyaviṣayasadbhāvasiddhiriti

atra brūmaḥ --tathāpītyādi, sahaiti iti sahāyaḥ, sahā'yanaṃ sahagatirdvayorbahūnāṃ vā bhavatīti sahagaterdvyādyarthenāvyatirekādekatvaṃ nāstīti tadavasthamavaktavyāviṣayatvam, kintu anyatvameva ca sidhyediti punaranyatvameva
athaanya ekaḥ, so'pi tato'nya ekaḥ, ityekaśabdo'nyārthavācī tato'nyārthe tu sākṣādanyatvameva viśeṣaviṣayam, tato'nyatvaniṣedho'tisphuṭa eva svavacanavirodha ityuktam
yathā caikaśabdo'smaduktanyāyenānyatve vartate tena prakāreṇa tathānanyatvamapi sidhyati, ananyatvena vinānyatvasyābhāvāt
ityekatvādipratiṣedhāḥ kim ? kathamavaktavyam ? te tu niṣedhyānāmatathātve nirmūlatvādavaktavyameva vyāvartayanti
atha ta ekatvādayo vidyamānāḥ pratiṣidhyante tatastatrāvaktavyatvanirviṣayatā
athāvidyamānāḥ kathaṃ pareṇa pratipannāḥ ? na hyeṣāṃ bhavataikāntabhavanaṃ vyāvartyānekāntabhavanaṃ pratipādyate vādaparameśvaravādavat
evaṃ tāvadekatvaṃ siddhapratipakṣabalāt siddhaṃ sad vyāvartyate nānyadetyavaktavyanirviṣayatā vānyathetyuktam
ityekatvādipratiṣedhāḥ kim ? kathamavaktavyam ? te tu niṣedhyānāmatathātve nirmūlatvādavaktavyameva vyāvartayanti
atha ta ekatvādayo vidyamānāḥ pratiṣidhyante tatastatrāvaktavyatvanirviṣayatā
athāvidyamānāḥ kathaṃ pareṇa pratipannāḥ ? na hyeṣāṃ bhavataikāntabhavanaṃ vyāvartyānekāntabhavanaṃ pratipādyate vādaparameśvaravādavat

na tāvad bhāvasya viśeṣasya ubhayasya vā kathañcidapi pravibhāgato'pavibhāgato vānyatvamasti ubhayatvamasti ityupakramya anyatvāsiddhāvekatvābhāvamubhayatvābhāvamubhayatvāsiddhau caikatvānyatvābhāvaṃ vā''pādayitvā bhāvayitavyamiti
evamuktavidhinā ekatvādipratiṣedhāḥ kim ? ke te pratiṣedhāḥ ? na bhavantītyarthaḥ
te tu ekatvādipratiṣedhā niṣedhyānāmatathātve niṣedhyatvābhāve nirmūlā nirmūlatvādavaktavyameva vyāvartayantīti
na nirmūlāḥ pratiṣedhāḥ, na ca nirviṣayamavaktavyam, ekatvādipratiṣedhatathārthatvāt
te hi parābhiprāyagatānāmekatvādīnāṃ pratiṣedhyānāmekāntānāṃ vyāvartanārthāḥ, tasmādadoṣa iti
atrocyate --atha ta ekatvādaya ityādi yāvat kathaṃ pareṇa pratipannā iti
yadi tāvadekatvādayaḥ pareṇa yathā vidyante tathaiva pratipannāḥ santaḥ pratiṣidhyante tatastatrāvaktavyatvanirviṣayatoktā
athāvidyamānā atyantamabhūtatvāt khapuṣpavadasantaste kathaṃ pratipattuṃ śakyante ? ato'pratipannatvādeva na pratiṣedhyā iti pratiṣedhānupapattiḥ

syānmatam--syādvāde'pi sāmānya-viśeṣayoḥ kimekatvaṃ nānātvamubhayatvamanubhayatvamavaktavyatvam ? iti pṛṣṭe pratiṣedhāḥ kriyante--naikatvaṃ nānyatvaṃ nobhayatvaṃ nāvaktavyatvam, kiṃ tarhi ? syādekatvaṃ syādanyatvaṃ syādubhayatvaṃ syādanubhayatvaṃ syādavaktavyamityādi
etaccāyuktaṃ tadvaidharmyāditi taddarśayati— na hyeṣāṃ bhavatetyādi
syādvādo hi vādānāmīṣṭe nigrahānugrahasamarthatvāt, tasmiṃścaikatvādayo bhavanta avaktavyaśabdasya tu pratipakṣaḥ sambhāvyate, nañyuktatvāt, abrāhmaṇavat
api ca tvayāpi dikpratyāsattyā vaktavyo'rtha ityabhyupagatam
tasmādarthādāpanno dvinañprayogaḥ pratiṣedhapratiṣedhatvāt prakṛtiṃ gamayati anabrāhmaṇavat
saṃvṛtyaiva vāgvyavahāra iti cet; aparamārthastarhyavaktavyatvam, saṃvṛtisatyapadasamudāyārthatvāt, maṇḍūkajaṭābhārakṛtakeśālaṅkāravandhyāputrakhapuṣpamuṇḍamālākhyānavat
evaikāntagrāhaniṣedhena nigṛhyante'nugṛhyante cānekāntapratipādanāt, na tadvadavaktavyavādinā bhavatāmeva teṣāmekatvādīnāmekāntabhavanaṃ vyāvartyānekāntabhavanaṃ pratipādyate
tatra hyanekāntarūpeṇa syādaikyaṃ syānnānātvam ityādi vaktavyā eva santaḥ ekāntarūpeṇāvaktavyāḥ ityucyante sapratipakṣatvād bhāvānām, tathā hyāha--
avaktavyaśabdasya tu pratipakṣaḥ sambhāvyate, nañyuktatvāt, abrāhmaṇavat
api ca tvayāpi dikpratyāsattyā vaktavyo'rtha ityabhyupagatam
tasmādarthādāpanno dvinañprayogaḥ pratiṣedhapratiṣedhatvāt prakṛtiṃ gamayati anabrāhmaṇavat
saṃvṛtyaiva vāgvyavahāra iti cet; aparamārthastarhyavaktavyatvam, saṃvṛtisatyapadasamudāyārthatvāt, maṇḍūkajaṭābhārakṛtakeśālaṅkāravandhyāputrakhapuṣpamuṇḍamālākhyānavat
ekāntena hi vadato mithyāvādaḥ prasajyeta || iti
atra sādhanamāha niyamavidhinayaḥ --avaktavyaśabdasya tu pratipakṣaḥ sambhāvyate, nañyuktatvāt, abrāhmaṇavat

nañyuktatvāditi śabde'rthe ca heturyojyaḥ, tathā dṛṣṭānto'pi abrāhmaṇavaditi brāhmaṇo na bhavatyanyo vā brāhmaṇādityabrāhmaṇaḥ satyeva brāhmaṇe pratipakṣe kṣatriyādirbhavati tathā pratipakṣe vastuni vaktavye satyavaktavyaśabdo'rtho vā bhavitumarhatīti

na kevalaṃ sambhāvanayāsmadīyayā vaktavyatvamavaktavyatvaṃ ca vastunaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? tvayāpi abhijalpaśabdārthavā dinā dikpratyāsattyā vaktavyo'rthaḥ ityabhyupagatam, atra cāvayormatisaṃvādaḥ, sa cāvaktavya eva tvanmatyā yo'bhijalpenocyate'rthaḥ so'vaktavya iti vaktavya eva nañā pratiṣidhyate
tasmādarthādāpanno dvinañprayogo'yam--avaktavya ityavaktavyaḥ, sa ca dvinañprayogaḥ pratiṣedhapratiṣedhatvāt prakṛtiṃ gamayati, anabrāhmaṇavaditi
athavā kaścilloke brūyāt--avaktavyo na bhavati abrāhmaṇo na bhavati iti prayogavat so'navaktavyadvinañprayogāt pratiṣedhapratiṣedhatvāt prakṛtiṃ gamayediti
etena svavacanābhyupagamavirodhāvudbhāvya svayaṃ vaktavyatve sādhanamāheti piṇḍārthaḥ
syānmatam--na śabdaḥ kañcidarthaṃ brūte, yathoktam— vikalpayonayaḥ śabdā vikalpāḥ śabdayonayaḥ
atha yasyāvaktavyasya ete deśāḥ sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvādayastadviśeṣāt kiṃ tadavyatiriktaṃ vyatiriktaṃ vā ? avaktavyasya svāvayavatathāniyamādeva tasya vyavasthānāt
yena yena vikalpena yad yad vastu vikalpyate
parikalpita evāsau svabhāvo na hi vidyate
tatra kaḥ śabdārthaḥ ? kā vā cintā--mayoktaṃ satyaṃ na tvayoktamiti ? tasmāt saṃvṛtisatyavyavahāragocaratvādadoṣaṃ sarvamiti
atha yasyāvaktavyasya ete deśāḥ sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvādayastadviśeṣāt kiṃ tadavyatiriktaṃ vyatiriktaṃ vā ? avaktavyasya svāvayavatathāniyamādeva tasya vyavasthānāt
yena yena vikalpena yad yad vastu vikalpyate
yad yad vastu prakalpyate ādhyātmikaṃ bāhyaṃ vāntaśo yāvad buddhadharmā api parikalpita evāsau svabhāva iti, atra kāraṇamāha--na sa vidyata iti
yad vastu vikalpaviṣayastad yasmāt sattābhāvānna vidyate tasmāt tad vastu parikalpitasvabhāvameva, na hetupratyayapratipadyasvabhāvam
tathāhi--ekasmin vastuni tadabhāve ca parasparaviruddhānekavikalpapravṛttirdṛṣṭā, na caikaṃ vastu tadabhāvo vā parasparaviruddhānekasvabhāvo yujyate
uktaṃ ca sūtre--na khalu punaḥ subhūte dharmāstathā vidyante yathā bālapṛthagjanā abhiniviṣṭāḥ iti
— iti vasubandhuracitānāṃ triṃśikāvijñaptikārikāṇāṃ sthiramativiracite bhāṣye Bibliothèque de l'Ecole des Hautes des Hautes Etudes
parikalpita evāsau svabhāvo na hi vidyate || triṃśikāvijña॰
kasmāt ? saṃvṛtisatyapadasamudāyārthatvāt, yastvayā padasaṅghāto'bhyadhāyi vākyamiti śabdastadarthaśca sa saṃvṛtimātrārthatvādaparamārthaḥ

maṇḍūkajaṭābhāreṇa kṛtaḥ keśālaṅkāro naṭakeśabhārako yasya vandhyāputrasya sa maṇḍūkajaṭābhārakṛtakeśālaṅkāravandhyāputraḥ, tasya khapuṣpadāmnā muṇḍamālā kṛtā, tasyā ākhyānaṃ surabhiḥ pañcavarṇā svākāragaganakusumamayī ityādi varṇanaṃ saṃvṛtisatyapadasamudāyārthatvānna paramārtha stathedaṃ sarvamapīti nāstyavaktavyatā
dharma-dharmiṇau hi vibhāgena vyavasthitau punaḥ samuditau pakṣaḥ syāt, yathā sādhyadharmaviśiṣṭo dharmī pakṣaḥ--anityaḥ śabda iti
tasya dharmiṇaḥ kṛtakatvādiranyo dharmo vyavasthita eva hetuḥ syāt

tau ca sādhyasādhanadharmau sahitau dharmyantare pradarśyete yatra yat kṛtakaṃ tadanityaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā ghaṭaḥ iti sa dṛṣṭānta itīdaṃ dharmadharmivibhāgavyavasthānātmakaṃ sādhanaṃ nopapadyate nirastadharmadharmivibhāgavyavasthatvāt, dharmadharminirasanaṃ cāvaktavyatvād bhāvaviśeṣaikatvānyatvādinirasanadvāreṇa vastunastasya ca nirviṣayatvasyānantaroktatvāt

tasmānnirastadharma-dharmisaṅgrahātmakatvāt pakṣādi asādhanam kharaṃ kharaviṣāṇam, sphuṭitapṛṣṭhatvāt, yadi sāmānyakṛtaikatvobhayatvakṛtānyatvayorviśeṣeṇākrānteḥ sāmānyakṛtaikatvobhayatvakṛtānyatvaviśeṣāvyatiriktatāyāmavaktavyārthasaṃvādādavaktavyatvasya niyamatvāt tathā tathā viśeṣādavyatiriktaṃ tato vyatirekādanyatvākṣānteḥ, nanu viśeṣamātramevaivam
tasmāt pakṣādyasādhanatvāt sambhāvanīyamavaktavyatvaṃ tvatparikalpitasya vastuno nānyathetyudghaṭṭako'yam

yadi sāmānyakṛtaikatvobhayatvakṛtānyatvayorviśeṣeṇākrānteḥ sāmānyakṛtaikatvobhayatvakṛtānyatvaviśeṣāvyatiriktatāyāmavaktavyārthasaṃvādādavaktavyatvasya niyamatvāt tathā tathā viśeṣādavyatiriktaṃ tato vyatirekādanyatvākṣānteḥ, nanu viśeṣamātramevaivam
abhyupetyāpi avaktavyatāṃ doṣaṃ brūmaḥ--idamasi tvaṃ praṣṭavyaḥ --atha yasyetyādi

avaktavyātmakasya deśino ya ete deśāḥ sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvādayo yaistadavaktavyamiṣyate teṣāṃ yo viśeṣo'vayavastasmāt kiṃ tadavyatiriktamityādi ayaṃ hi niyamavidhinayo viśeṣavādī tameva svābhipretaṃ viśeṣaṃ gṛhītvā codayati

syānmatam--sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvādinirākaraṇenaivāvaktavyaṃ jātyantaraṃ vastu niyamitaṃ niścitaniyatā'dhikabhāvena, tatra kutastadavyatiriktatvādipraśnotthānam ? iti, atrocyate--avaktavyasya viśeṣāṣasvāvayavatathāniyamādevāsti tasya vastuno vyavasthānāt tat kiṃ tairavyatiriktaṃ vyatiriktaṃ vā ityādi praśnotthānaṃ tadavayavatvācca tasya sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvādyāśaṅkāsambhavavaditi tadupapattiṃ pradarśayan paramatamāśaṅkate--tadyathā yadi sāmānyetyādi

tatrāvaktavyavāde yadi tat sāmānyakṛtamekatvaṃ viśeṣībhūtamākramya viśeṣaḥ svarūpaṃ vastunyarpayan sāmānyakṛtaikatvaviśeṣaṃ vyāvartayet na sāmānyameva ityaviśeṣāpādanena yadi cobhayatvakṛtamanyatvaṃ na sāmānyaṃ ca viśeṣaścaiva iti, tatastadekatvānyatvayorapi viśeṣeṇāvyatiriktatāyāṃ satyāmavaktavyārthaḥ saṃvadet, nānyathā, teṣāmekatvādiviśeṣāṇāṃ svātantrye sati avaktavyatvanivṛtteḥ, viśeṣāṇāṃ hi vastuparatantratve sati avaktavyārtho niyamyamānaḥ saṃvadatītyata āha --avaktavyatvasya niyamatvāt, tasya ca niyamasya tathā tathā tena tena prakāreṇa sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvobhayatvādīnāmātmāntaranivṛttāvātmāntaratvāpatterviśeṣyamāṇasya niyamatvādavaktavyatvasya viśeṣatvameva, tasmādavyatiriktaṃ viśeṣādavaktavyaṃ vastu
yadi punarviśeṣavyatiriktaṃ syāt tato vyatirekādanyatvaṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ vastunaḥ parasparataścaikatvādīnāṃ syāt
iṣṭaṃ cāvaktavyaṃ tvayetyata āha— tato vyatirekādanyatvākṣānteriti

tathā bhāvopavenā''krānterviśeṣakṛtaikatvobhayakṛtānyatvabhāvāvyatiriktatāyāmavaktavyārthasaṃvādādavaktavyatvasya niyamatvāt tathā tathā viśeṣādavyatiriktaṃ tato vyatirekādanyatvākṣānteḥ iti paṭhitvā bhāvavādipakṣe'pyupapattiravyatirekasya tathaiva yojyā
yasya bhāvena sahaikatvānyatvādi vicāryate yasmācca bhāva ekatvānyavādibhiravaktavya ucyate eṣa viśeṣo'pyekaikaḥ
sa ca vastu viśeṣāvyatiriktatvāt tatsvātmavat, bhavatīti bhāva iti sattārthatvāt tasya

tathā ca nirdhāritārthāvaktavya- sāmānyaviśeṣābhyāmākrānteḥ bhāvaviśeṣakṛtaikatvānyatvabhāvaviśeṣāvyatiriktatāyām ityādiḥ sa eva grantho yāvat ekatvākṣānteḥ ityubhayavādipakṣe'pyupapattiravyatirekasya tathaiva yojyeti
yasya bhāvena sahaikatvānyatvādi vicāryate yasmācca bhāva ekatvānyavādibhiravaktavya ucyate eṣa viśeṣo'pyekaikaḥ
sa ca vastu viśeṣāvyatiriktatvāt tatsvātmavat, bhavatīti bhāva iti sattārthatvāt tasya
tataḥ kim ? yadyevaṃ viśeṣāvyatiriktaṃ tata etadāyātam --nanu viśeṣamātramevaivaṃ niyamavidhinayamanorathapūraṇam

tad bhāvayati --yathā bhinno'pītyādi, yathā parasparaviviktāsādhāraṇarūpatvād viśeṣāṇāṃ bhinno'pyeko viśeṣo rūpādiḥ svarūpād rūpādyātmano'vyatiriktatvād viśeṣa eveti dṛṣṭāntavarṇanaṃ vakṣyamāṇatvādabhyupagamyata iti tvayāpīṣṭamityanumānayati

syānmatam--tat kathaṃ mayābhyupagatam ? iti tatpradarśanārthamāha --yasya bhāvenetyādi, yo'sau tvayā kiṃ bhāvena saha viśeṣasya ekatvam, anyatvam ? ityādivicāre'bhyupagato yasmācca viśeṣād bhāva ekatvānyatvādibhiravaktavya ityucyate eṣa viśeṣo'pi ekaikaḥ
kasmāt ? avyatireko hyekalakṣaṇam, yaddhi na kutaścid vyatiricyate tad ekam ityucyate, yathā puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam śukla yaju.
sa ca viśeṣabhāvo vastu, avaktavyasya viśeṣāvyatiriktatvāt, uktavidhinā siddho hetuḥ, tatsvātmavaditi viśeṣāvyatiriktaṃ viśeṣasya viśeṣa eva viśeṣa iti yathā tathā'vaktavyākhyamiti sambandhaḥ

mā bhūt prāguktasāmānyaparyāyabhāvaśabdabuddhirityasaṃmohārthaṃ bhāvo vastu iti vastuparyāyatvaṃ darśayannāha --bhavatīti bhāva iti sattārthatvāt tasya, tataśca viśeṣamātrameva iti sāmānyaśaṅkānirāso vastuparyāyaścetyupanayārthaḥ
sthitamidameka eva viśeṣastadavaktavyasāmānyamiti, tasmiṃśca sthite tadekatvāt kuto'vacanīyatā ? dvitīyābhāvāt kena sahaikatvānyatvādyavaktavyatā tasya viśeṣamātrasya bhāvasya ? iti
tadbhāvanā --na hi viśeṣa ityādi, nāvacanīyo viśeṣaḥ, viśeṣāvyatiriktatvāt, tatsvātmavadityuktārthopasaṃhārārthaṃ sādhanaṃ gatārtham
evaṃ nirdhārito viśeṣaḥ, nirdhāritatvād vācya eva syāt, anirdhārite hyavācyaḥ syāt
tasmādavaktavyasāmānyārtho viśeṣa eva iti vaktavyaḥ, viśeṣāvyatiriktatvāt, tatsvātmavat
atha tathāpyavacanīyamevāvacanīyasāmānyamicchasi evaṃ tarhi viśeṣo viśeṣa ityavacanīyaḥ, viśeṣāvyatiriktatvāt, avaktavyasāmānyavat
tasyāpyavācyatve vastunaścāvācyatve tayoḥ parasparamavacanīyatvādubhayato'pyavacanīyaṃ sāmānyaṃ vacanīyaṃ prasaktam, tathā viśeṣo'pi
nanvevaṃ tasya bhāvatve vaktavyataiva abhāvatve'pi vaktavyataiva
tathā tvaduktavadapyavastutā abhūtāvaktavyatvāt, yathā ca vastu viśeṣād vyatiriktaṃ tathā viśeṣo'pi vastuno vyatiriktaḥ

evaṃ nirdhāritamapi viśeṣaṃ svapakṣarāgādavācyameva manyase tathā ca nirdhāritetyādi yāvat prasaṅgaḥ, ayamabuddhipūrvako yadṛcchayā kriyate vyavahārastvayā nirdhāritārthāvaktavyavacanāt, uṣṇatvena nirdhāritasyāgneḥ śīto'gniḥ iti vacanavyavahāravat
tasmād viśeṣa eva iti nirdhārito'vaktavyasāmānyārtho viśeṣa eva iti vaktavyaḥ, nāvaktavyaḥ, viśeṣāvyatiriktatvāt tatsvātmavat
svapakṣarāgeṇaiva viśeṣāvyatiriktatve'pyavacanīyamevāvacanīyasāmānyamicchasi evaṃ tarhi viśeṣo viśeṣaḥ ityavacanīyaḥ, viśeṣāvyatiriktatvāt, avaktavyasāmānyavat
etacca na, tvayā viśeṣasya ekatvādivācyatvenābhyupagamya pratiṣedhenāvaktavyatvapratipādanasya kṛtatvāt
tasyāpi viśeṣasyāvācyatve vastunaścāvaktavyasāmānyasyāvācyatve'vaktavyasāmānyena viśeṣo na vācyo viśeṣeṇa sāmānyamavācyam, tayoścāvacanīyayoḥ parasparamavacanīyatvam
tataḥ kim ? tataścobhayato'pyavacanīyamavacanīyaṃ sadavacanīyaṃ sāmānyamiti dviḥpratiṣedhasya prakṛtyāpattervacanīyaṃ prasaktam, tathā viśeṣo'pīti vacanīyatvameva syād dvayorapīti
evaṃ tāvad viśeṣāvyatiriktatvā- davaktavyaṃ vaktavyameva ityuktam
athā mā bhūvannamī doṣā iti vastuno viśeṣād vyatiriktatvamiṣyeteti

atrāpi pūrvaṃ praśnotthāne codyopakrame viśeṣavyatiriktakāraṇamāha --avaktavyatvāditi, yasmāt sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvādiviśeṣairvaktavyairavaktavyo'rtho bhinnalakṣaṇastasmādavaktavyatvādeva svalakṣaṇād bhinnād vyatiriktaṃ viśeṣād vastvityupapattiḥ
iyameva bhāvaikatvobhayānyatvayoḥ pūrvavad vyatiriktatve yojyopapattirasminnapi pakṣe
tasyā api ca rūpaṃ nirūpyam--kimekatvaniṣedhe'nyatvam, anyatvaniṣedhe
nanvevaṃ tasya viśeṣavyatiriktatvād dvayī gatiḥ --atyantabhāvo vā'bhāvo vā, nānyāsti
bhāvatve vaktavyataiva, abhāvatve'pi asat iti vaktavyataivetyavaktavyatvanivṛttirevamasmannyāyena doṣaḥ

kiñcānyat, tathā tvaduktavadapyavastutā, tena prakāreṇa tathā viśeṣyaṣavyatiriktatvanyāyena tvaduktenaiva tadavaktavyākhyaṃ vastu avastu syāt, kasmāt ? abhūtāvaktavyatvāt, bhāvaikatvāviśeṣadvāreṇa hyavaktavyatvamuktam, tadvyatiriktatve tasyābhūtāvaktavyatvam, abhūtāvaktavyatvācca khapuṣpavadavastviti
bhāvapakṣe'pi bhavatyeva bhavatīti bhāvasya vaktavyatvādabhūtāvaktavyatvam, tasmāt tvanmatenaiva bhāvapakṣe'pi abhūtāvaktavyatvāt pradhānādivat tadavastviti
yathā ca tadavaktavyākhyaṃ vastu viśeṣād vyatiriktamiṣyate tathā viśeṣo'pyavaktavyākhyād vastuno vyatiriktaḥ, vyatirekasya dviṣṭhatvāt
tvadiṣṭaṃ vastu asat, aviśeṣatvād viśeṣavyatiriktatvāt, khapuṣpavat
no cet, khapuṣpaṃ syāt, viśeṣavyatiriktatvāt, vastuvat; khapuṣpaṃ sat, vastuvyatiriktatvādvā, viśeṣavat

evaṃ tasya vastuno'sattvaṃ sāmānya-viśeṣayoḥ kimekatvamanyatvamavaktavyam ityādi vikalpaprapañcanamākāśaromanthavat parikleśamātraphalamayathārthatvāditi ākāśakusumasaurabhādivicārāyathārthatvādivadayathārthatvamasya vicārasyoktavidhinā siddhamiti

syānmatam--sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvādyavaktavyatvavad vyatirekāvyatirekatvābhyāmavaktavyaṃ vastvabhyupagacchāmi, ato'narthako vicārakleśo viśeṣeṇa sahāvya'pyasya vyatirekāvyatirekatvābhyāmapyavaktavyatvādavaktavyau viśaṣavyatirekāvyatirekau yasmiṃstad vastu avaktavyaviśeṣavyatirekāvyatirekamityeṣa me pakṣa iti
etaccihnāṅkitaḥ ॰vyatirekatvā॰ ityanta ārabhya viśeṣa॰ ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratau nāsti

ekatvam, tayorniṣedhe'nubhayatvam, anubhayatvaniṣedhe cobhayatvam ? pratiṣedhyavipakṣarūpamāśrayitavyam, atha nāśrīyate kim ? yadyāśrīyate niṣidhyamānapratipakṣarūpatā tataḥ sāṅkhyādivādagatānanyatvādidoṣopādānam

viśeṣasya bhāvaviśeṣaikatvāderbhāva-viśeṣaikatvānyatvādyavaktavyadharmāṃśavṛttilābhavad vyatiriktāvyatiriktatvaviśeṣāvaktavyatvadharmāṃśavṛttilābhād viśeṣa evāvaktavyatvena viśeṣyatvād gaura-danturatvadvayaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyadevadattavat pradhāno'vaktavyasya copasarjanatā ca syāt

kiñcānyat, tasyā api ca rūpaṃ nirūpyam, kathaṃ nirūpyamiti cet, ucyate --kimekatvetyādi, dvābhyāṃ nyāyābhyāmanyatareṇāvaśyaṃbhāvyatvād nirūpyam, tadyathā --ekatve niṣedhye'nyatvamāpatati, anyatve niṣedhye caikatvam, tayorniṣedhe'nubhayatvam, anubhayatvaniṣedhe cobhayatvam
tasmāt pratiṣedhyavipakṣarūpamāśrayitavyam, tacca tasya viśeṣapradhānāvaktavyopasarjanasya dvirviśeṣāṃśavṛtterāśrīyate tvayā
atha nāśrīyate kim ? iti pṛcchāmo gatidvayānativṛtteriti kimiti tattvayaiva nirūpayitum
tatra tāvad yadyāśrīyate niṣidhyamānapratipakṣarūpatā tataḥ paryāyeṇa sāṅkhyādivādagatānanyatvādidoṣopādānam, yadā viśeṣānyatvaṃ niṣidhyate tadā sāṅkhyamatamekatvamupāttaṃ syāt

yadya vayavaikatvaṃ niṣidhyate tadā vaiśeṣikābhimatānyatvopādānam, ādigrahaṇāt puruṣakālādikāraṇavādopādānaṃ kāryamātrasamudāyavādopādānaṃ ca, tatra ye doṣāstvayaivāvaktavyavādinābhihitāsta evāśeṣāstavāpatanti
etaccihnāntargataḥ 776— 779 pṛṣṭhasthaḥ pāṭhaḥ pṛ॰ 781 paṃ॰ 11 ityatra etaccihnāṅkitapāṭhāt parato vidyate sarvatra
tathāpi pūrvāparasambandhaṃ paryālocya tata uddhṛtyātra niveśyate'smābhiḥ

atha mā bhūvannamī doṣā iti nāśrīyate pratiṣedhyapratipakṣarūpaṃ tataḥ pratipakṣarūpānāśrayaṇe sarvavikalpānāmityādi yāvat kuta āyātā avaktavyatā ? pratiṣedhyapratipakṣarūpamanāśritya pratiṣiddhe'nyatamavikalpe nivartye tāvati kṛtārthaḥ san vikalpāntaramapi nivartayet, anenaiva krameṇa ekaikaṃ nivartya sarvavikalpeṣu viśeṣaikatvādiṣu nivartiteṣu atyantamasat syāt, na sadvastu, tataśca kuta iyamavaktavyatā āyātā ? vikalpāntarapratiṣedhena hi vikalpāntarābhyupagame tadekāntanirākaraṇadvāreṇāvaktavyatvasyāgamanaṃ syāt, na hi sarvavikalpātītasya khapuṣpāderavaktavyatā syāt
tvādīnāṃ nivṛttāvatyantamasat syād vastu, kuta āyātā avaktavyatā ? anavadhāraṇaparigrahāttu syādvādaṃ vādaparameśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ prapanno'si

evaṃ tarhi nanu pratipādanam ityapyavacanīyam, atyantāsattvāt, khapuṣpavat, viśeṣavacanasya viśeṣāviśeṣādyekatvādyavaktavyatvāt pratipādyapratipādakayorapyekatvānyatvobhayatvānubhayatvādyavaktavyatvāt
syānmatam--anavadhāritaikatvādiviśeṣaṃ sarvākāram ekamapi anyadapi avaktavyamapi ityādi parigṛhyate tad vastu iti cet, evaṃ tarhi ? anavadhāraṇaparigrahāttvityādi
sarveṣāṃ vikalpānāmekatvādīnāmavadhāraṇamantareṇānumatyā parigrahād ekaṃ dravyamanantaparyāyam iti vastvabhyupagamyam--syādekaṃ syānnānā syādubhayaṃ syādanubhayaṃ syādavaktavyamiti

tadapi syādvādaṃ vādaparameśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ prapanno'sīti na kiñcid vaktavyaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ, tathāpi vādaparameśvaraśaraṇagamanaṃ te'bhyupagamavirodhād manasvino vijigīṣutāṃ niruṇaddhi, tenāpi saha viruddhatvāt pūrvamiti

atha matam--niṣedhyapratipakṣaikāntābhyupagame ta eva maduktā doṣāḥ, syādvādābhyupagame'bhyupagamavirodhaḥ, tadbhāvādekāntavādagatadoṣavidūrīkaraṇārthaṃ paryāyeṇa pratiṣiddhapratipakṣasadbhāvamanabhyupagamya asadeva tad vastviti cedetaducyeta tvayā

etadapyaśobhanam, viśeṣadvāraniṣedhānupapattestato'pyamukepyayukte ?tyādi, yadyatyantāsadeva tadvastu tasya khapuṣpavadatyantāsattvād bhāvaviśeṣaikatvānyatvamavaktavyam ityayuktam, viśeṣadharmāsattve viśeṣyatvābhāvāt, khapuṣpavat
ubhayatvenāpyayuktam, sadāśrayatvāccobhayalakṣaṇatvasya ekatvānyatvayoḥ sattvāt, taddvāreṇa cānubhayatvasyātyantāsattvasyāpyavaktavyatā sidhyatītyabhiprāyasya tvayaiva kṛtatvāt
nanu yadyavacanīyaṃ kathaṃ pratipādanam ? atha pratipādanaṃ kathamavacanīyam ? athocyeta--avacanīyamityetadapyavacanīyameva, vastutvāt, tadarthavat
tat kiṃ kathañcidavacanīyaṃ sarvathā vā ? sarvathā vā cā vaktavyatve pratyakṣādivirodhāḥ
iti viśeṣaikatvānyatvādi asadeva pratipādanārthaṃ kalpyate, gatiriyaṃ pratipādanasya grāmādipathopadeśe digādipradarśanavat citrabhaktibinduvinyasanavaditi
ratra nanū bhayalakṣaṇopapatteḥ, pratiṣedhyapratipakṣāsattve hyekatvānyatvayoḥ sattvamitaretaraniṣedhārthāpattivihitamubhayalakṣaṇatvamāpadyeta, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
asatye vartmani sthitvā tatastattvaṃ samīhatevākya pa॰ 2
240 tasmādupāyāḥ śāstrāṇi jijñāsūnāmabudhānāmapalāpanāḥ prataraṇā eva boddhavyāḥ
yasmāt tatrāsatyarūpe śāstraprakriyāmātre'rthe sthitvā avidyāmutsṛjya satyaṃ vidyāsvarūpaṃ brahma samīhate prāpnotīti yāvat
atattve vartmani sthitvā tatastattvaṃ samīyate || vākyapa॰ 2 | 240
nanu yadyavacanīyaṃ kathaṃ pratipādanam ? atha pratipādanaṃ kathamavacanīyam ?
tat kiṃ kathañcidavacanīyaṃ sarvathā vā ? sarvathā vā cā vaktavyatve pratyakṣādivirodhāḥ
atra brūmaḥ --evaṃ tarhi nanu pratipādanam ityapyavacanīyameva, yat tadekatvādipratipādanamasat kalpitamupāyatvābhimataṃ tat pratipādanam ityavacanīyam, atyantāsattvāt, khapuṣpavat
pratipādanam iti cocyate tvayā, pratipādanaṃ hi loke viśeṣavacanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yo gauraḥ sa devadattaḥ iti tadvaidharmyeṇa
kiñcānyat, viśeṣavacanasya viśeṣāviśeṣādyekatvādyavaktavyatvāt, vacanamapi kiṃ viśeṣo'viśeṣa eko'nya ubhayamanubhayamavaktavyam ? ityevamādivikalpeṣu avaktavyam
kiñcānyat, pratipādyo yaḥ śabdo yaśca pratipādakastayorapyekatvānyatvobhayatvānubhayatvādi avaktavyam, tasmādapi pratipādanam ityavacanoyam

na pratipādyapratipādakabhedo'styavaktavyasya, nāpi kecid viśeṣāḥ pratipādakāḥ pratipādyāt sāmānyād bhidyante, kintu sarvasya saviśeṣaṇasaviśeṣyasyāsya vākyasaṅghātasyaikasyaivoktaprakāreṇāvaktavyārthapratipādanavacanādadoṣa iti
atra brūmaḥ --nanu yadyavacanīyamityādi gatapratyāgatena virodhāpādanaṃ gatārtham

athocyeta tvayā --avacanīyam ityetadapi vacanamavacanīyameva, aho punarahamavacanīyavādī yat kiñcidavacanīyamapi pratipadye, yat kintu sahārthena pratipādya-pratipādakabhedarahitaṃ samastavṛttivacanametadapi nocyata eva vastutvāt, tadarthavaditi

atredānīṃ cintyatāṃ paramaniścaye tvadīye--tat tāvat pratyakṣamucyamānaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ vacanīyaṃ tasyāvacanīyatve dvayī gatiḥ --tat kiṃ kathañcidavacanīyaṃ sarvathā vā ? iti paryanuyujya dūṣaṇam --sarvathā ityevaṃvidhamavastu sarvathāpyarūpatvāt sarveṇa vānena virodhāt khapuṣpavat, itaraḥ pratyakṣarūpādivat
kuta etadekatvādyavaktavyatā ? vece ?tyādi, ubhayathā ca sarvathā, yadi kenacit prakāreṇa yadi sarvathetyarthaḥ

tatra yadi kenacit prakāreṇāvacanīyaṃ yathā sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvādivikalpānāmanyatamena tvayaiva uktvoktvā tasyāvaktavyatvapratipādanasya kṛtatvādekatvenānyatvenobhayatvenānubhayatvenānyataropasarjanapradhānatayā ca tathā tathā vacanīyatvāt pratyakṣaṃ śrūyamāṇatvāt pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
sarvathā'pyavaktavyatve tathaiva pratyakṣādivirodhā sta eva, sarvathāpyavacanīyamiti vacanāt taddvāreṇa śeṣadoṣaprasañjanāt
ityevaṃvidhamavastu sarvathāpyarūpatvāt sarveṇa vānena virodhāt khapuṣpavat, itaraḥ pratyakṣarūpādivat
itiśabdo hetūpasaṃhārārthaḥ, etasmāt kāraṇādavaktavyākhyaṃ yadevaṃvidhaṃ vikalpitaṃ tvayā vastviti tadavastu

kasmāt ? sarvathāpyarūpatvāt, sarvaiḥ prakāraiḥ sarvathā, yadi sāmānyaviśeṣaikatvānyatvādivikalpairvācyamavācyamatha tairavyatireka-vyatirekādivikalpairvācyamavācyamatyantāsadeva vā sāmānya-viśeṣaśabdapratipādya-pratipādakādivikalpairvā vaktavyamavaktavyaṃ cetyādyuktavidhinā sarvathā vicāryamāṇasya rūpaṃ nāvatiṣṭhate tasmāt sarvathāpyarūpatvāt khapuṣpavadavastu tat
kiñcānyat, sarveṇa vānena virodhāt avastu iti vartate, uktavidhinaiva sarveṇa svavacanādinā pramāṇenānena virudhyata eva, ato'pyavastu
