itaraḥ pratyakṣarūpādivaditi vaidharmyadṛṣṭānta ityarthaḥ, yasya rūpamasti tat sarveṇa na kenacid virudhyate, yathā pratyakṣaṃ svasaṃvedyaṃ sarvavādinaṃ prati jñānasukhādi rūpādivat iti vijñānamātra-śūnyavādino muktvā'nyān prati tasmānnāvaktavyaṃ vastu ityupasaṃhāraḥ
nāpi nirvicāravaktavyam, ekāntavādaprasaṅgāt tatra coktadoṣatvāt,na dravyaṃ na kāraṇaṃ na sāmānyam iti pūrvodgrāhitavikalpapratiṣedhena naikatvaṃ teṣāmeva yathā tvayaivāvaktavyavādinā niṣiddham
॰pratiṣedhenānekatvam iti ॰pratiṣedhe nānaikatvam iti vā pāṭho'pyatra bhavet
tadapi rathādivaditi na bhavati vastu, satyapi kiṃ tarhi vastu ? rūpādaya eva samudāyinaḥ, ta eva hi bhavanti, yat tat tairbhūyate sa bhāvaḥ
ko hi sa pṛthivyādervinābhāvaḥ ? pṛthivī kā'śmādinā vinā ?...
ātmā ca na nāmānyaḥ kaścidasti, arūpāditvāt, khapuṣpavat
yathā cakreṣākṣoddhyādyaṅgasamūhe rathasaṃjñā, hastyādyaṅgasamūhe senāsaṃjñā, samudāyo vibhajyamāno'ṅgeṣu tiṣṭhati parato vā parato rūpādiṣveva tiṣṭhati, rūpādaya viśeṣatve samudāyatvād rathādivat
na bhāvaḥ sāmānyākhyo viśeṣapratipakṣo'pi tatpratiṣedhārthāpattyā prasakto'pi, tvayaiva pratiṣiddhatvāt
kiṃ tarhi vastu ? rūpādaya eva samudāyinaḥ, ta eva hi bhavanti, yat tat tairbhūyate sa bhāvaḥ
ko hi sa pṛthivyādervinābhāvaḥ ? pṛthivī kā'śmādinā vinā ?...
ātmā ca na nāmānyaḥ kaścidasti, arūpāditvāt, khapuṣpavat
yathā cakreṣākṣoddhyādyaṅgasamūhe rathasaṃjñā, hastyādyaṅgasamūhe senāsaṃjñā, samudāyo vibhajyamāno'ṅgeṣu tiṣṭhati parato vā parato rūpādiṣveva tiṣṭhati, rūpādaya
kiṃ tarhi vastu ? iti cet, ucyate --rūpādaya eva samudāyinaḥ
ta eva hi bhavanti, na samudāyo nāma kaścidityavadhārayati

yattattairbhūyate sa bhāvaḥ bhavanaṃ bhūtirbhāvasādhano bhāvaśabdaḥ, te hi tasyā bhavanakriyāyāḥ kartāraḥ śabdārthasaṃvyavahāreṇa, yo'nyaiḥ parikalpyate samudāyaḥ kāraṇaṃ dravyamityādiḥ sa na bhāvaḥ sāmānyākhyaḥ kaścidasti
kasmāt ? arūpāditvāt, samastā rūpādayo hetutvenocyante, rūpādyanyatamānātma- katvādityarthaḥ
evaṃ sādhanena bhāvasya sāmānyasyābhāvaṃ pradarśya vastuto darśayati --ko hi sa pṛthivyādervinetyādi
evaṃ pṛthivī kā'śmādinā vinetyādi yāvat ke'ṇavo rūpādibhyo vineti gatārthaḥ
rūpa-rasa-gandha-sparśaśabdā rūpādayaḥ rūpa-vedanā-vijñāna-saṃskārā vā, tadvyatiriktamanyat pṛthivyādi tadabhivacanamātram, ata āha--ātmā ca na nāmānyaḥ kaścidasti, arūpāditvāt, khapuṣpavat

yathā samudāyo vibhajyamāno'ṅgeṣu tiṣṭhati, tānyapyaṅgāni vibhajyamānāni ātmāṃśeṣu, parato vā parata iti yāvat paramāṇuśo vibhajya rūpādiṣveva tiṣṭhati, pratyekamekaikamaṅgaṃ paramāṇuparyantaṃ vibhajya suṣṭhu nibhālyamāno'pi ratho na dṛśyate tathā senā vanaṃ puruṣo'nyo vārtho na dṛśyate'ṅgavyatiriktaḥ, kintu tatsamudāya ābhāsate, rūpādaya eva pratyavabhāsante samuditāstatheti
yadi so'ṅgeṣu sātmā syāt tata upalabdhidharmā sannagrahaṇanimittānāmabhāve rūpādivadupalabhyeta vastutvāt
rūpādivyatirikto'sti cet samudāyaḥ khapuṣpād bhavedarūpatvāt rūpādibhya iva
athānarthāntaratāyā rūpādyasambhavibhāravahanādikāryaṃ rathādau dṛṣṭaṃ tat katham ? tat teṣveva rūpādiṣu dṛṣṭam

sātmā sātmaka ātmāvātsāātmavān syād yadi ratho'nyo vā rūpādyātmavyatiriktenātmanā tataḥ sa upalabdhidharmā sannagrahaṇanimittānāmatidūra-sannikarṣā-'bhibhavādyupalabdhipratibandhināmabhāve rūpādivadupalabhyate vastutvāt, na punarupalabhyate

tato'nyatve tvaniṣṭāpādanam --rūpādivyatirikto'sti cet samudāyo'tadātmako'nupalabhyamāno'pi khapuṣpād bhavedarūpatvādarūpādyātmakatvād rūpādibhya iva, na hyatadātmakasya samudāyasyotpattau rūpādayo hetubhāvaṃ pratipadyante vyomakusumasya, tatra ghaṭādisamudāyasya rūpādayo hetavo bhavanti khapuṣpādisamudāyo neti rūpādaya eva vā ghaṭādisamudāyasya hetavo na vyomakusumādītyatra ko viśeṣahetuḥ ?

athānarthāntaratāyāmityādi yāvat katham ? syānmatam yadyanarthāntaraṃ rūpādibhyo rathādisamudāyaḥ, rūpādiṣvadṛṣṭaṃ bhāravahanādi kāryaṃ tatrāsambhavi rathādau dṛṣṭaṃ loke, tat katham ? pratiniyatakāraṇasādhyatvāt kāryāṇām, tantu-paṭādivat

atra prayogaḥ --svato vyatiriktasahakārisambandhino rūpādayaḥ, svāsambhavikāryadarśanāt, cakṣurādivat, yathā kṛṣṇasārādi cakṣurvyatiriktamindriyamupalabdhikāraṇaṃ sahakāricakṣuṣā sambaddhamanumīyate cakṣuṣyasambhavad rūpajñānaṃ kāryaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā rūpādyasambhavibhāravahanādikāryadarśanād rathādisamudāyānyatvamanumeyamiti
atrocyate --kva tarhi tad dṛṣṭam ? tad bhāravāhanādi kāryaṃ teṣveva rūpādiṣu dṛṣṭam, ataḥ svāsambhavitvaviśeṣaṇāsiddhiḥ

siddhatvamabhyupetyā'pi anaikāntikaṃ kāryadarśanam, taddarśayati --nanvavivādetyādi, āvayoravivādena śibikāvāhakebhyaścaturbhyo vyatiriktāt sahāyādṛte'pi śibikāvahanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kāryam, ato'naikāntikaṃ tat
tathā pratyekavastvityādi yāvadalātacakravaditi bhāravahanādikriyāyāḥ samudāyiṣveva sambhavaṃ samudāye cāsambhavaṃ darśayituṃ samudāyapratiṣedhārthaṃ nyāyamāha

tena prakāreṇa tathā rūpādino vastunaḥ pratyekaṃ vṛttistāmanatikrāmanta eva svāṃ vṛttimavatiṣṭhante rūpādayaḥ, svavṛttyatyāgavyavasthayaiva kriyāṃ bhāravahanādikāmārabhante teṣāmeva vastutvāt, anyathā vastuno viparyaye nirvivaraṃ deśabhedena sthitānāṃ rūpādīnāmeva śibikāvahanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kāryam
tathā pratyekavastuvṛttimanatikrāmanta eva svāṃ vṛttimavatiṣṭhante rūpādayaḥ teṣāmeva vastutvāt, anyathā samudāyākhyasyārthasya parikalpanāmātratvādanavasthitaikasvatattvādalātacakravat
nanu ghaṭādāvavasthitaikarūpatve'pi sattvam, na, samudāyatvāt sādhyatvāt
rathaḥ śabdavikalpato vastuviparītaḥ saṃvṛtisan śabdārthamātrameva saṃsārānubandhavat
paramārthatastu paścāt pūrvaṃ cābhāvādaṅgeṣu nāsti rathaḥ

vastutvāt tato'nyathā samudāyākhyasyārthasya parikalpanāmātratvādanavasthitaikasvatattvatvāt alātacakravat; yathā alātasya bhrāmyataścakravadābhānaṃ bhrāntaparikalpanāmātraṃ nirvivaratvāt tathā rūpādīnāṃ nirvivarāṇāṃ paramāṇvādivadābhānaṃ bhrāntaparikalpanāmātram, kimaṅga punaḥ savivara-savivaratara-savivaratamaghaṭa-paṭādinagarādi-pṛthivyāṃsavyaṃśasamudāyānām ? na hyeṣāṃ samudāyānāmekaṃ svaṃ tattvamavasthitaṃ rūpādivat parasparaviviktamasti, ato'lātacakravadasanto rūpādiparatattvavyapadeśabhāktvāt
tasmādasataḥ samudāyasya bhāravahanādikā kā kriyā ? iti
tathā pratyekavastuvṛttimanatikrāmanta eva svāṃ vṛttimavatiṣṭhante rūpādayaḥ teṣāmeva vastutvāt, anyathā samudāyākhyasyārthasya parikalpanāmātratvādanavasthitaikasvatattvādalātacakravat
nanu ghaṭādāvavasthitaikarūpatve'pi sattvam, na, samudāyatvāt sādhyatvāt
rathaḥ śabdavikalpato vastuviparītaḥ saṃvṛtisan śabdārthamātrameva saṃsārānubandhavat
paramārthatastu paścāt pūrvaṃ cābhāvādaṅgeṣu nāsti rathaḥ
āha --nanu ghaṭādāviti yāvat svatvasattvamiti anaikāntikatvodbhāvanam, avasthitaikasvarūpaṃ ghaṭādi sadbhāvāditi
atrocyate --na, samudāyatvāt, nānaikāntikatvamasya hetoḥ, samudāyatvād ghaṭasya śakaṭādivadeva sādhyatvād ghaṭasattvasyānaikāntikābhāsatetyarthaḥ

rūparūpādisthitaikarūpatve'pi sattvamiti cet, śukla-nolādirūpeṣu rūpasāmānyaṃ saccānavasthitaikarūpaṃ ca dṛṣṭam, tasmādanaikāntikatvamiti cet, na, rūpasāmānyasamudāyasādhyatvāt, śuklādiviviktarūpavyatiriktasāmānyarūpasya samudāyākhyasya sattvāsiddheravastutvād vipakṣāsiddhernānaikāntikatā
adhunā vastutattvaṃ nirūpayati --pratyekaṃ vṛttā rūpādivyaktirbhedarūpaiva na sāmānyam, sā ca avasthitaikarūpā parasparaviviktekarūpetyetanmātrasatyameva vastu
tasya tu vastuno'bhivacanamātram, ābhimukhyena pratipattinimittaṃ samudāyavacanaṃ ghaṭaḥ iti paṭo rathaḥ ityādi vā
ucyamāna eva sa rathaḥ śabdavikalpito vastuviparītaḥ saṃvṛtisan śabdārthamātrameva parikalpanāmātrārthatvācchabdasya
kimiva ? saṃsārānubandhavat, yathā saṃsārasyānubandhahetuḥ mātā me, pitā me, bhrātā, bhāryā, putraḥ yathocyeta sat kāryam, tadyathā rūpādibhiḥ...
yadetat sannāma tato'nyadeva tu kāryam, tadatulyavikalpatvāt, rūpādikhapuṣpavat
iha śabdādīnāṃ kāraṇānāmākāśādīnāṃ ca kāryāṇāmubhayeṣāmapi sattvaṃ kāryākāśasattvameva vā ityetad vikalpadvayaṃ syāt, itarayorabhyupagatapratipakṣatvād vādābhāvāt
tadyadi tāvadu- ityādiranupakāriṣvapyupakāribuddhyā vyavahāro'tattvaḥ premavāsanāvaśād bhavati tathā samudāyo'tattvavyavahāravāsanayā svarasāt kriyate, nātra kaścit paramārthaḥ
yadetat sannāma tato'nyadeva tu kāryam, tadatulyavikalpatvāt, rūpādikhapuṣpavat
iha śabdādīnāṃ kāraṇānāmākāśādīnāṃ ca kāryāṇāmubhayeṣāmapi sattvaṃ kāryākāśasattvameva vā ityetad vikalpadvayaṃ syāt, itarayorabhyupagatapratipakṣatvād vādābhāvāt

kastarhi paramārthaḥ ? paramārthatastu paścāt pūrvaṃ cābhāvādaṅgeṣu prāk cakrākṣādisaṃyogād yathā rathasyātmā nāsti cakrādivisaṃyogīkṛteṣu ca paścānnāsti tathā saṃyuktāvasthāyāmapyaṅgeṣu svātmarahitatvānnāsti ratha iti
anenaiva nyāyena kiñcit kāryaṃ ghaṭapaṭādi buddhipūrvakaṃ puruṣeṇa kriyate svata eva ca kāraṇāt kāryamutpadyata ityetad mṛṣetyetaduktaṃ bhavati

tat punaḥ kāryamutpadyate kāraṇāditi yathānye manyante yathā tu yujyata iti pradarśanārthamāha tairyathocyate satkāryam --tadyathā rūpādibhirityādi, śabdāditanmātrāṇyatra rūpādigrahaṇena gṛhītāni vācoyuktimātreṇa prakriyāvaśād bhinnatvāt
iyamākāśādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ śabdādyekottarotkarṣeṇa sanniveśāt kāryatve prakriyā āprāgarāntare vyākhyātatvānna punarvyākhyāyate

sādhanam --yadetat sannāma tato'nyadeva tu kāryaṃ sadvyatiriktasvabhāvam, satsvabhāvaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ kasmāt ? tadatulyavikalpatvāt, yasya yenātulyo vikalpastat tato'nyadeva, anyasvabhāvam, tadātma na bhavatītyarthaḥ kimiva ? rūpādikhapuṣpavat, yathā rūpādayaḥ santaḥ khapuṣpamasat, tat taistulyavikalpaṃ na bhavati tathā kāraṇaiḥ sadbhī rūpādibhiḥ kāryamākāśādi tulyavikalpaṃ na bhavati, tasmāt khapuṣpavat satastato'nyasvabhāvamiti
etasya sādhanasyāsiddhapakṣadharmaśaṅkānirākaraṇārthaṃ vyākhyānamārabdhukāmaḥ svayameva pṛcchati paroktyā vyākhyāpayitum kathamatulyavikalpaḥ ? iti
caturṣu bhaṅgeṣu dvau bhaṅgāvupayojyāviti tāvevopanyasyati— iha śabdādīnāmityādi
śabdādayaḥ kāraṇāni, viyadādayaḥ kāryāṇi, teṣāmubhayeṣāmapi sattvamityeko vikalpaḥ
kasmāt ? uktābhyāmita yostayorabhyupagatasya satkāryavādasya pratipakṣatvād matpakṣatvamevāto vādābhāvādetau dvāvevopayojyau
bhayasattvaṃ tataḥ sattvāviśeṣāt kāraṇānāṃ śabdādīnāṃ kāryāṇāṃ cākāśādīnāmaviśeṣe sati yathā svarūpatattvā eva śabdādaya utpadyante tathākāśādayo'pi tatsvatattvā evotpadyeran sattvāviśeṣād rūpādivat
atha na rūpādiprādurbhāvavad bhūmyādiprādurbhāvaḥ tacca kāryaṃ sadeveti niścitaṃ tataḥ kāryameva sad na rūpādi
rūpādi asat, sadvilakṣaṇatvāt, khapuṣpavat, svarūpatattvena bhūtatvāt sataḥ kāryād

tatrāpi --tad yadi tāvadubhayasattvaṃ prathamavikalpa iṣṭaḥ sattvāviśeṣāt kāraṇānāṃ śabdādīnāṃ kāryāṇāṃ cākāśādīnāmaviśeṣaḥ, sati cāviśeṣe yathā svarūpatattvā eva śabda-sparśa-rūpa-rasagandhatattvā eva śabdādaya utpadyante'bhivyajyante vā tathākāśādayo'pi tatsvatattvā evotpadyeran nonādhikasvabhāvāḥ
tasmāt tadatulyavikalpatā siddhā, tatassato'nyasvabhāvaṃ kāryam ākāśādyasadityarthaḥ

etatprasaṅgabhayādatha na bhūmyādyekottararūpādipararūpotkarṣāpakarṣavaiṣamyarahitaviviktasvarūparūpādiprādurbhāvavad bhūmyādiprādurbhāvo vailakṣaṇyādatulyavikalpatetīṣyate tacca kāryaṃ sadeva iti niścitaṃ tataḥ kāryameva sadastu, na rūpādi, svapararūpāpaprādurbhāvavailakṣaṇyādanayorasataḥ sadvilakṣaṇatvāt rūpādyasat syāt, sadvilakṣaṇatvāt, khapuṣpavat
sadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ hetordarśayati --svarūpatattvena bhūtatvād rūpādeḥ pararūpatattvāvirbhāvinaḥ sataḥ kāryād vilakṣaṇatvāditi

rūpādisvatattvaprādurbhāvavailakṣaṇye'pi rūpādi sat svatattvaprādubhārvātmakaṃ ceṣyate tatastadvailakṣaṇyāt kāryamasat prāpnoti, asvatattvāvirbhāvātmakatvāt, ekottararūpādipararūpatattvotpattirasvatattvāvirbhāvaḥ
tacca sadvailakṣaṇyaṃ kasyeva ? ityata āha --alātacakravaditi, yathā ulmukaṃ bhrāmyamāṇaṃ kaṇamātrasvatattvatyāgena cakrābhāsamutpadyamānamasadevaṃ kāryamapīti

atha mā bhūddoṣa iti sadeva kāryamiṣyate tataḥ sattve svata eva prādurbhavet kāryam, yathā rūpaṃ sad rasarūpamanādāya prādurbhavati raso'pi rūparūpaṃ tathā sparśa-śabda-gandhāḥ paraspararūpam, kintu svenaiva rūpeṇāvirbhavanti tathākāśādikāryamapi svarūpeṇaivāvirbhavet, pararūpeṇa tu ekādyutkarṣeṇāvirbhavati itīṣṭamato'niṣṭastulyāvirbhāvaste prāptaḥ sattvāt, rūpādivat
ityevaṃ prādurbhāvavailakṣaṇyādatulyavikalpa- tvamāpāditaṃ sadbhyo rūpādibhyaḥ kāryasya
tadanicchataḥ prādurbhāvāviśeṣaprasaṅgapayevasānakaṃ cakrakaṃ tatraiva prasaṅge sthitaṃ sattvād rūpādivat ityutthāpya sattvād rūpādivat ityeva
athaivamapi rūpādi sat svatattvaprādurbhāvātmakaṃ ceṣyate tatastadvailakṣaṇyāt kāryamasat, asvatattvāvirbhāvātmakatvāt, alātacakravat
atha sadeva kāryamiṣyate tataḥ sattve svata evāvirbhavet, sattvāt, rūpādivat
evaṃ tu anāvirbhāvyatvād na pratyakṣavyaktayaḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ pratiniyatacakṣurādyaviṣayatvāt khapuṣpavat
rūpādyeva tu yat kiñcit pratyakṣam, svata evāvirbhavitṛtvāt, itaravat
tatra kāryasamīpa evakāra ityanyatra sacchabdārthe tatpratiyogini niyamaḥ sattvaṃ kārya eva niyataṃ

punaridānīṃ bhūmyādiprādurbhāvatulyaṃ rūpādiprādurbhāvaṃ kāryāsattvabhayādicchatastathaiva bhūmyādikāryāsattvaṃ sadvailakṣaṇyādasvarūpotpatterutthāpya tatparyavasānameva cakrakaṃ tadviparyayeṇa yāvad bhūmyādivaditi gamanīyam

rūpādiṣu viṣayeṣu cakṣurādīnāṃ pratiniyataṃ grahaṇaṃ cakṣuṣā rūpameva, jihvayā rasa meeva ityādi grahaṇaṃ vyaktiravirbhāvaḥ sa na syāt, cakṣurādyaviṣayatvāt, rūpādaya eva hi pratisvaṃ niyatāścakṣurādīnāṃ viṣayāḥ, pṛthivyādayastu na prativiviktarūpādisvatattvā ityanāvirbhāvyāḥ, tasmādanāvirbhāvyatvād na pratyakṣavyaktayaḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ pratiniyatacakṣurādyaviṣayatvāt khapuṣpavat
rasameva gṛhṇāti iti vivakṣāyāṃ yathāśrutamapi sādhu
yat kiñcit iti sāmānyavacanād viśeṣya pakṣīkriyate --rūpameva pratyakṣam, svata evāvirbhavitṛtvāt, itaravaditi sāmānyavacanād rasavaditi viśeṣya dṛṣṭāntaḥ
tasmāt pratyakṣatvādyavirodhāt tadeva bhavati rūpādyeva vastviti siddham

athaivaṃ doṣavadityubhayasattvapakṣamuktadoṣabhayāt tyaktvā anyataraṃ sat kāraṇaṃ rūpādi kāryaṃ vākāśādi itīṣyamāṇe kāryasadvādino me prātipakṣyeṇa kāryāsattvābhyupagame vādāvasānaṃ mā bhūditi kāryāsattvābhyupagamaparihāreṇa kāraṇasattvapakṣaṃ tyaktvā kāryasattvapakṣamekamevāśrayestvaṃ tataḥ kāryameva sat ityavadhāryamāṇaḥ pakṣaḥ syāt
tanmataṃ kaḥ punarvādī kāryameva sat, na kāraṇam iti pratipadyate nānyat saditi
rūpāderasattve kāryasya sattve viparītā saṃjñā kriyate sato'saditi asataśca saditi
kāryāsattvanivṛttyekāntatyāgāccābhyupagamavirodhavat svavacanādivirodhāḥ— yadi kāryaṃ kathaṃ sat ? atha sat kathaṃ kāryam ? kāraṇe kāryasattvanyāyāttu sa evobhayasattvavādaḥ, tatra coktā doṣāḥ

yasya siddhānte rūpādayo na syurākāśādaya eva syuḥ ? iti, atrocyate--tasyaiva ubhayasadvādinaḥ sāṅkhyasya kāraṇe kāryasattvasiddhāntād bhavedayaṃ pakṣaḥ, kāraṇāvinābhāvitvāt kāryasya kāryābhyupagame'bhyupagatameva kāraṇam, kintu na niyamyate kāraṇamasadeva sadeva vā iti, yadi syādastu ko vārayati ? kāryaṃ tu sattvena niyamyate

tatrāpi ca dvayī gatiḥ--kāryameva sat sadeva kāryamiti vā, tatra kāryameva sat iti kāryasamīpe evakāraḥ kriyate yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇam iti kāryaṃ sadeva ityavadhāryamāṇe kāryasya sattvena niyamāt sattvasya kāryeṇāniyamāt kāraṇe'pi sattvamiti pūrvavicāritobhayasattvapakṣa eva āpatatītyavadhāraṇavaiphalyaṃ syāt, taccāniṣṭam, tasmādevakāraprayatnasāphalyāt kāryaśabdārthādanyatra sacchabdārthe tatpratiyogini niyamaḥ-- kāryameva saditi
taddarśayati --sattvaṃ kārya eva niyataṃ nānyat saditi
tataḥ kim ? tataśca rūpādi na saditi te prasaktam

tasya rūpādeḥ pratyakṣamupalabhyamānasyāsattve kāryasyāsataḥ pratyakṣādyanupalabhyasya sattve viparītā svamanīṣikayā saṃjñā kriyate sato'saditi asataśca saditi saṅgītyāgnimaṅgalanāmavat paścimāpaścimatvavat
yadapi ca kāryasattvaṃ kharaviṣāṇādīnāṃ sat iti nāmeti nāmavad nāmamātrameva nārtha iti
rūpāderasattve kāryasya sattve viparītā saṃjñā kriyate sato'saditi asataśca saditi
kāryāsattvanivṛttyekāntatyāgāccābhyupagamavirodhavat svavacanādivirodhāḥ— yadi kāryaṃ kathaṃ sat ? atha sat kathaṃ kāryam ? kāraṇe kāryasattvanyāyāttu sa evobhayasattvavādaḥ, tatra coktā doṣāḥ
kiñca, kāryāsattvanivṛttyekāntatyāgācca abhyupagatasya ekāntena sat kāryam ityasya ca tyāgaḥ, na hi kāryamasadapi kenacit prakāreṇeṣyate tvayeti abhyupagamavirodhavat svavacanādivirodhāḥ
yadi kāryaṃ kathaṃ sat ? kriyata iti hi kāryam

kiñcānyat, kāraṇe kāryasattvanyāyāttu sa evobhayasattvavādaḥ, kāraṇāvinābhāvitvāt kāryasya kāryasattvāt kāraṇasattvamapīti prāguktādeva nyāyādubhayasattvavādo'vaśyambhāvī, tatra coktā yathā ca pṛthivyādyevamātmāpi rāśivat sārthavat...
etadapi na, ananyatra pravṛtterapi samudāyibhyaḥ samudāyasyānarthāntaratvāt, tadyathā--yathā ca śikharādibhyaḥ...
doṣāḥ atulyavikalpatvāt sato'nyadeva tu kāryam ityādi upakramya cakrakadvaye, tayeva cāvasthitā iti
evaṃ tāvat kāryameva sat ityavadhāraṇe doṣāḥ
etadapi na, ananyatra pravṛtterapi samudāyibhyaḥ samudāyasyānarthāntaratvāt, tadyathā--yathā ca śikharādibhyaḥ...

atha mā bhūvannamī doṣā iti sadeva kāryam ityavadhāryate yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇam iti sattvena kāryaṃ niyataṃ sattvaṃ tvaniyataṃ kāraṇasyāpi sattvābhyupagamāt sadanavadhṛteḥ pūrvadoṣa eva ubhayasattvavādadoṣa eveti

yathā ca pṛthivyādi evamātmā'pi, yathā pṛthivī-ghaṭādīni rūpādibhyo'nyāni na santi tathā rūpa-vedanā-vijñāna-saṃjñā-saṃskārebhyaḥ skandhebhyo'nya ātmā nāsti, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃvṛtyā tatsamudāye prajñāpyate tatsantāne vā, yathā rāśivat sārthavadityādi dṛṣṭāntāḥ samudāyāsattvapratipādanārthā rūpādimātravastutvapratipādanāḥ
dṛṣṭāntabāhulyaṃ cetasi bhāvanotpādanārthaṃ dṛḍhīkaraṇārthaṃ ca tadarthasya
ayaṃ śloka iti dvādaśe're pṛ॰ 530-- 2 vakṣyate
atrāha --nanu śuddhaśabdaprayogādeva sa san ātmā iti śuddhapadena śabdāntareṇocyamānatvād rūpādivadeva tebhyo'nya iti

śabdāntaravācyatvānaikāntikodbhāvanārthaṃ tadvaidharmyāpādanārthamāha punarapi --narādipṛthagkpravṛttestatra syādasattvaṃ tatrāna tvātmani, narā'śvādīnāṃ pṛthagk samūhāt pravṛttidarśanāt tatsamūhādanyatrādarśanāt senāyāḥ syādasattvam, ātmanastu mā bhūnnāmarūpāpṛthagbhāvāt tadātmatvācca
tatrocyate— etadapi nottaram, ananyatra pravṛtterapi samudāyibhyaḥ samudāyasyānarthāntaratvāt
tatrāpi śikharādivibhāgādeva na syāditi cet, na, buddhivibhāge'pyananyatvāt pānakavat, tadyathā--maricakṣoda...
audāsīnyācca tattveṣu ahaṃmānākuśalasaṃskārānuśayād ātmāsti ityahaṃkāraḥ pravartate
tatrāpi śikharādivibhāgādeva na syāditi cet, syānmatam--buddhyā vibhajyamānāḥ śikharādayaḥ pṛthagupalabhyante pṛthakchikharī, na tadvad rūpādibhya ātmeti
dārṣṭāntikavarṇanaṃ tu sa samprayuktavijñānādidharmavyatiriktātmābhāvasādharmyāt tadyathā --sukhito duḥkhita ityādi
mādhuryetyādi pānakāṅgadravyaguṇavicāro'rthāntarasādhanāya nālamiti dṛṣṭāntaḥ, dārṣṭāntikaḥ tatheva puruṣetyādi
tṛṣṇācchedādiprayojanasiddhiryathā tadatiriktārthābhāve'pi tathā karmaphalasambandhādisaṃvyavahāraprayojanasiddhiḥ pañcasu rūpādiṣu skandheṣveva, atastadatiriktātmaparikalpanāvaiyarthyamiti
kṣaudraṃ madhu ced vivakṣitaṃ tadā ॰kṣaudre॰ iti samīcīnaḥ pāṭhaḥ

tattvavicāraṃ pratyaudāsīnyāt pañcaskandhatattvaviparītātmaparikalpanayā viparyayajñānībhūtatvāccittasya mānā-'timānādisaptamānāntargatāhaṃmānākuśalasaṃskārānuśayāt ahaṃmānākhyākuśaladharmanikṣiptavāsanāparipākāt ātmā'sti ityahaṅkāraḥ pravartate, tato na pañcaskandhavyatiriktaḥ puruṣa iti
mānaḥ katamaḥ ? hīnāt śreyānasmi, sadṛśena sadṛśo'smīti vā yā cittasyonnatiḥ
atimānaḥ katamaḥ ? sadṛśāt śreyānasmi śreyasā sadṛśo'smīti vā yā cittasyonnatiḥ
mānātimānaḥ katamaḥ ? śreyasaḥ śreyānasmīti yā cittasyonnatiḥ
asmimānaḥ katamaḥ ? pañcasūpādānaskandheṣu ātmātmīyābhiniveśād yā cittasyonnatiḥ
abhimānaḥ katamaḥ ? aprāpte uttare viśeṣādhigame prāpto mayeti yā cittasyonnatiḥ
mithyāmānaḥ katamaḥ ? aguṇavato guṇavānasmīti yā cittasyonnatiḥ
iti abhidharmasamuccaye asaṅgaviracite navasu saṃyojaneṣu mānasaṃyojananirūpaṇe pṛ॰ 45 Visva Bharati Studies 12
māno hi nāma sarva eva satkāyadṛṣṭisamāśrayeṇa pravartate
tathāhi--ātmātmīyabhāvaṃ skandheṣu adhyāropya ayamahamidaṃ mama ityātmānaṃ tena tena viśeṣeṇonnamayati, anyebhyo'dhikaṃ manyate
agauravaṃ guruṣu guṇavatsu ca pudgaleṣu stabdhatā kāyavācoraprasṛtatā, duḥkhotpattiḥ punaratra punarbhavotpattiḥ
sa ca punaścittonnatisvarūpābhede'pi cittonnatinimittabhedāt saptadhā bhidyate--māno'timāna ityevamādi
eṣa ca rūpāditattvasya vastuvyavasthāgativinirmukterghaṭādisamudāyavastvantarasaṃkrāntiḥ syāt, sā cobhayāvastutvāpādanāya iti pratipatteḥ samabhirūḍhaḥ yasya śatasaṃkhyasyāpīdameva lakṣaṇam
vatthūṇaṃ saṃkamaṇaṃ hoti avatthū ṇaye samabhirūḍhe
tatrāyaṃ tasya guṇasamabhirūḍho nāma prabheda eva
asya cotpattivigati-sthitibhirapi naiva sambadhyate vastu utpātāditrayasaṅkrānterapyabhāvāt tadubhaya-
vatthūṇaṃ saṃkamaṇaṃ hoti avatthū ṇaye samabhirūḍhe | āva. ni. 757
adhunā katamanayavikalpo'yam ? ityetanniścayārthamāha— eṣa ca rūpāditattvasyetyādi

eṣa nayo rūpādimātrameva vastu, tacca vastvantaraṃ samudāyākhyaṃ na saṅkrāmati itīcchati, ato ghaṭādisamudāyavastvantarasaṅkrānterayathārthatvadoṣād vastuvyavasthāyā yā gatistāṃ vimuñcet, ato vastuvyavasthāgativinirmukterghaṭādisamudāyavastvantarasaṅkrāntiḥ syāt, sā cobhayāvastutvāpādanāya, rūpādayastatsamudāyaścāvastunī syātām, rūpādayaḥ samudāyarūpāpatteḥ svarūpe'navasthitatvādavastu, samudāyo rūpādirūpavat svarūpeṇa tasyāvyavasthitatvādavastviti ubhayāvastutvamāpādayet sā vastvantarasaṅkrāntiritītthaṃ pratipatteḥ samabhirūḍha evaṃ matvā ekībhāvenābhimukhyena eka eva rūpādirartha eva iti yā yā saṃjñā tāṃ tāṃ samabhirūḍhaḥ yasya śatasaṅkhyasyāpīdameva lakṣaṇam ekkekko ya satavidho āva॰ ni॰ 759 tti śatasaṅkhyaṃ saprabhedamevambhūtaṃ vyāpnotyetad lakṣaṇam
vatthūṇaṃ saṃkamaṇaṃ hoti avatthū ṇaye samabhirūḍhe āva॰ ni॰ 757 iti
samprati samabhirūḍhamāha --vatthuo saṃkamaṇaṃ hoi avatthu naye samabhirūḍhe

vastuno ghaṭākhyādikasya saṃkramaṇam--anyatra kuṭākhyādau gamanam, kim ? bhavati avastu, asadityarthaḥ, naye paryālocyamāne, kasminnaye ityāha--samabhirūḍhe, sam ekībhāvena abhirohati vyutpattinimittamāskandati śabdapravṛttau yaḥ sa samabhirūḍhaḥ
eṣa hi paryāyaśabdānāmapi pravibhaktamevārthamabhimanyate yathā ghaṭanād ghaṭṭhaḥ...kuṭanāt kuṭaḥ...

na śabdāntarābhidheyaṃ vastu dravyaṃ paryāyo vā tadanyaśabdavācyavastuśabdarūpatāṃ saṃkrāmati, na khalu paṭaśabdavācyo'rtho jātucidapi ghaṭaśabdavācyavasturūpatāmāskandati, tathānupalambhāt āskandane vā vastusāṃkaryāpattiḥ

tatraitallakṣaṇaṃṇe vatthūto saṃkamaṇaṃ hoti avatthū ṇaye samabhirūḍhe āva॰ ni॰ 757 tti tasya śatabhedasya saptanayaśatāranayacakre samabhirūḍhe śatadhā bhinne katamaḥ samabhirūḍho'yam ? iti mṛgyamāṇe guṇasamabhirūḍho nāmāyaṃ paryāyasamabhirūḍhādanyastatprabheda eva pravakṣyamāṇaḥ
ayaṃ ca niyamavidhiḥ, asyaiva guṇasamabhirūḍhasya punarime bhedāḥ--vidhiḥ 1 vidhividhiḥ 2 mabhūtaṃ rūpādi ca bhūtam, tayorvastvantarasaṃkrānternanūbhayaṃ vyāhanyate
sthitirapi ca bhāvanātmikā bhavantyeva bhavatītyato bhavanavyāpterbhavanaṃ sarvatra saṃkrāmati vastvantaramiti na vastutaiva sthiterapi
atha tathā tathā bhāva eva bhavatīti tasyaivaikasyābhivyāptiḥ, tanna, prativastu tathā bhavanasya bhūtatvād nanvabhavanenāpi vyāptirastyevaivamiti bhāvābhāvayoḥ saṃkrānteravastutā

vidhyubhayam 3 vidhiniyamaḥ 4 ubhayam 5 ubhayavidhiḥ 6 ubhayobhayam 7 ubhayaniyamaḥ 8 niyamaḥ 9 niyamavidhiḥ 10 niyamobhayam 11 niyamaniyamaḥ 12 iti dvādaśadhā bhinnasya śatabhedasamabhirūḍhaikadeśasyāyaṃ niyamavidhirnāma bheda iti
mabhūtaṃ rūpādi ca bhūtam, tayorvastvantarasaṃkrānternanūbhayaṃ vyāhanyate
sthitirapi ca bhāvanātmikā bhavantyeva bhavatītyato bhavanavyāpterbhavanaṃ sarvatra saṃkrāmati vastvantaramiti na vastutaiva sthiterapi
atha tathā tathā bhāva eva bhavatīti tasyaivaikasyābhivyāptiḥ, tanna, prativastu tathā bhavanasya bhūtatvād nanvabhavanenāpi vyāptirastyevaivamiti bhāvābhāvayoḥ saṃkrānteravastutā
kiñcānyat, yathā cāyaṃ ghaṭādivastvantarasaṅkrāntiṃ necchati rūpādīnāṃ tathāsya cotpattivigati-sthitibhirapi naiva sambadhyate nayasya, utpātāditrayasaṅkrānterapyabhāvāt
yadyutpattyādivastvantarasaṅkrāntiḥ syāt kuto'sya samabhirūḍhatā syāt ? iti

katham ? iti darśayati— utpatti-vigatyostāvat prāgabhāva-pradhvaṃsābhāvātmakatvāt, utpattiḥ prāgabhāvaḥ, vināśaḥ pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ, tadubhayamabhūtam, rūpādi ca bhūtam, tayorbhūtābhūtayorvastvantarasaṅkrānternanūbhayaṃ vyāhanyate, bhūtaṃ cet kathamabhūtam ? athābhūtaṃ kathaṃ bhūtaṃ rūpādi vastu ? iti
utpūrvasya patateḥ prayoga ekādaśe're'pi prārambhe dṛṣṭaḥ

utpatti-vināśānāśritā sthitirbhūtatvād na vyāhanyate rūpādineti cet, ucyate--satyaṃ bhūtā, sthitirapi ca bhavanātmikā bhavantyeva bhavatītyato bhavanavyāpteḥ sarvaprakāraiḥ sarvaṃ bhavati ghaṭo'pi rūpamapi raso'pi ityādi bhavanaṃ sarvatra saṅkrāmati vastvantaramiti na vastutaiva sthiterapīti
asya tulanā ekādaśe dvādaśe cāre draṣṭavyā
atha manyase tena tena prakāreṇa ghaṭarūpa-rasādinā bhāva eva bhavatīti tasyaivaikasyābhivyāptirna vastvantarasaṅkrāntiriti

tanna, kasmāt ? prativastu tathā bhavanasya bhūtatvāt, rūpasya rasādyātmanā rasasya rūpādyātmanā gandhasyāpi śeṣātmanā parasparavyāvṛttātmanā sarvasya vastyuvastunaḥ pratyupahatatvāt nanvabhavanenāpi vyāptirastyevaivamiti bhāvamabhāvaḥ saṅkrāmati abhāvaṃ vā bhāva iti mahatī saṅkrāntiḥ, tasyā eva hetoravastutā
yadi vastu, tathā'vidyamānatvāt sāmānyādayaḥ samudayaśca tyājyāḥ, viśeṣā eva parigrāhyāḥ, tato'dhikataramasat, tasya vikṣepeṇa vidhirucyate
śabdārthastu paryavo'nekatā guṇaḥ, paryāyaḥ paryavo vā, sa evāstītyasya matiḥ paryavāstikaḥ

tasmāt sthityutpattivigatinirapekṣā rūpādayaḥ, tanmātrarūpaṃ tanmātratattvaṃ cedam, tadbhāvastanmātrarūpatā, tasyāṃ ca sthityutpatti-vigatinirapekṣarūpādimātrarūpatāyāṃ sarvasiddhiḥ, sarvaṃ sidhyati nātra kaścid doṣaḥ
anyasya śatabhedasamabhirūḍhamadhyapatitasya mūḍhasamabhirūḍhasya darśanena tūtpāda-vyayayoga eva rūpādīnāmiti, so'pyasti kaścidāmūḍhaḥ kiṃ tena ? ityayaṃ tannecchati āmūḍhatvāt tasya
evaṃ cāyaṃ guṇasamabhirūḍhaniyamavidhiruktaḥ, atrāpyavaktavyalakṣaṇasyāpyanantarasya niyamasya vidhestadbhāvanārthamāha --evaṃ hi niyamo bhavatītyādi

katham ? yadi vastu, tena prakāreṇāvidyamānatvāt sāmānyādayaḥ samudayāśca tyājyāḥ, kintu viśeṣā eva rūpādayo deśabhinnāḥ pratyakṣādipramāṇagocaratvāt parigrāhyā ityuktaṃ tato'dhikataramasat, tasyāsato vikṣepeṇa vidhirucyate, yadi vastu tato'syaivaṃ niyamo yujyata ityeṣa niyamasya vidhiranantarātītanayapratikṣepeṇa pūrvatarātītavicāraprasiddhapuruṣādivādotsargavidhivṛttānāṃ tadanantarātītānāṃ ca vidhyubhayādivṛttānāmātmātmīyānāmapavādena niyamaḥ kriyate vidhīyate itthaṃ tayā vā vicāraprasiddhotsargavidhivṛttātmātmīyāpavādaniyamakriyayeti vyākhyāto nayaḥ
śabdārthastu paryava iti parigamanam, taccānekatā guṇaḥ gaṇa guṇa saṅkhyāne , rūpādayaḥ parasparaviśiṣṭā guṇāḥ samyak khyānāt, sa ca guṇaḥ paryāyaḥ parito gamanāt paryavo vā pūrvavat
pāṇinīyadhātupāṭhe 321 gaṇa saṃkhyāne, 359, saṃketa, 360 grāma, 361 kuṇa 362 guṇa cāmantraṇe iti curādau dṛśyate
pṛthak padāni vākyārthaḥ, svena svenārthena yuktāni devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklām ityatra devadattādipadānyeva vākyam, teṣāmevārtho vyākhyātārthaḥ, uktarūpāt samudāyāsattvāt
asyopanibandhanaṃ yato nirgamastadyathā--kativihe ṇaṃ bhaṃte bhāvaparamāṇū paṇṇatte ? goyamā ! catuvvihe, taṃ jahā--vaṇṇavaṃte rasavaṃte gaṃdhavaṃte phāsavaṃte bhaga॰ 20
varṇavanta ityādinirdeśe ta eva varṇādayaḥ parasparavantaḥ

asya nayasyopanibandhanamārṣamucyate yato nirgamastadyathā--kativihe ṇaṃ bhaṃte bhāvaparamāṇū paṇṇatte iti praśne vyākaraṇaṃ goyamā ! catuvvihe, taṃjahā--vaṇṇavaṃte rasavaṃte gaṃdhavaṃte phāsavaṃte iti

varṇavanta ityādi, bhāve varṇādāveva pṛṣṭe tadvanto'nye ke'rthā vyākṛtāḥ ? iti cet, ucyate, na kecit, kintu ta eva varṇādayaḥ parasparavantaḥ, rasa-gandha-sparśā varṇavantaḥ, varṇastadvān, rasavarjā rasavantaḥ, gandhavarjā gandhavantaḥ, sparśavarjāḥ sparśavanta iti matupā nirdiṣṭāḥ, yasmād matupiha saṃsaṅge, parasparasaṃsaktā eva varṇādaya iti
kaivihe bhaṃte ! paramāṇu pannatte ? goyamā ! cauvvihe paramāṇū pa॰ taṃjahā--davvaparamāṇū khettaparamāṇū kālaparamāṇū bhāvaparamāṇū
davvaparamāṇū ṇaṃ bhaṃte kaivihe pa॰ ? goyamā cauvvihe pa॰ taṃ॰ acchejje abhejje aḍajjhe agejjhe
khettaparamāṇū ṇaṃ bhaṃte kaivihe pa॰ ? goyamā cauvvihe pa॰ taṃ॰ aṇaddhe amajjhe apadese avibhāime
kālaparamāṇū pucchā, goyamā cauvvihe pa॰ taṃ॰ avanne agaṃdhe arase aphāse
bhāvaparamāṇū ṇaṃ bhaṃte kaivihe pa॰ ? goyamā cauvvihe pa॰ taṃ॰--vannamaṃte gaṃdhamaṃte rasamaṃte phāsamaṃte
tatra dravyarūpaḥ paramāṇurdravyaparamāṇuḥ eko'ṇuḥ, varṇādibhāvānāmavivakṣaṇād dravyatvasyaiva vivakṣaṇāditi
avibhāimetti avibhāgena nirvṛtto'vibhāgima ekarūpa ityarthaḥ vibhājayitumaśakyo vetyarthaḥ
...matupprabhṛtayaḥ sanmātra iti cedatiprasaṃgaḥ matupprabhṛtayaḥ sanmātra iti cedatiprasaṃgo bhavati ihāpi prāpnoti--vrīhirasya yavo'syeti
gomān yavamān, bhūmādiyuktasyaiva sattā kathyate, na hi kasyacid yavo nāsti
saṃkhādakī kakudāvartī, nindāyuktasyaiva sattā kathyate, na hi kaścinna saṃkhādakī
rūpavān varṇavān praśaṃsāyuktasyaiva sattā kathyate, na hi kasyacid rūpaṃ nāsti
kṣīriṇo vṛkṣāḥ, kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā iti nityayuktasyaiva sattā kathyate, na hi kasyacit kṣīraṃ nāsti
udariṇī kanyeti atiśāyanayuktasyaiva sattā kathyate, na hi kasyacidudaraṃ nāsti
daṇḍī, chatrī, saṃsargayuktasyaiva sattā kathyate, na hi kasyacid daṇḍo nāsti
yāvatībhiḥ khalvapi gobhirvāhadohaprasavāḥ kalpante tāvatīṣu sattā kathyate, kasyaciccatasṛbhiḥ kalpante kasyacicchatenāpi na prakalpante
sanmātre carṣidarśanāt, sanmātre ca punaḥ ṛṣirdarśayati matupam--yavamatībhiradbhiryūpaṃ prokṣatīti
saṃsaṅge'sti viva'stivivakṣāyāṃ bhavanti matupādayaḥ || pā॰ ma॰ bhā॰ 5 | 2 | 94
davvaṃ pajjavaviyutaṃ davvavijuttā ya pajjavā ṇatthi
parasparanirapekṣaṃ cobhayanayapradarśitaṃ vastu pramāṇābhāvato na saṃbhavatītyāha --davvaṃ pajjavaviuyaṃ davvaviuttā ya pajjavā ṇatthi
dravyavirahitāśca paryāyā na santi anugataikākāramṛtsāmānyānuviddhatayā mṛtpiṇḍa-sthāsa-kośakuśūlādīnāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ pratipatteḥ
ato dravyārthikābhimataṃ vastu paryāyākrāntameva, na tadviviktam, paryāyābhimatamapi dravyārthānuṣaktaṃ na tadvikalam parasparaviviktayoḥ kadācidapyapratibhāsanāt

kiṃbhūtaṃ punardravyamastītyāha --utpādasthitibhaṅgā yathāvyāvarṇitasvarūpāḥ parasparāvinirbhāgavartinaḥ, haṃdi ityupapradarśane, dravyalakṣaṇaṃ dravyāstitvavyavasthāpako dharmaḥ, etad dṛśyatām, yataḥ pūrvottaraparyāyaparityāgopādānātmakaikānvayapratipattistathābhūtadravyasattvaṃ pratipādayatītyutpāda-vyayadhrauvyalakṣaṇaṃ vastvabhyupagantavyam
iti paramārtho jinamate | kintu pratyekanayavyākhyānād bhāvamātraṃ tvanena gṛhītam
idamaśakyaṃ śrotumapi yad yattad rūpādibhavanameva bhāva iti vyavasthāpya vastusaṃkrāntipratiṣedhi notpayattbhāvanotpattyabhāva iti vacanam
avaśyaṃ hi taiḥ kenāpi prakāreṇa bhavitavyaṃ bhāvarūpeṇābhāvarūpeṇa vā
tatra cātyantabhavanena yad bhavanaṃ tad vyāvartitam, ata utpādavināśenaivaiṣāṃ bhavanamavyāvartitam, tadvyāvartane'bhāvatā teṣām
nanu tairyat tad bhūyate sa eva bhāva iti bhavataivoktam
na tarhi tairbhūyate'nutpādavināśitvāt khapuṣpavat vaidharmyeṇa pṛthivī-śivaka-stūpakādivat, akālatve'kālatvāt

nayacakrasamyagdarśanādhikāre pratyekanayasvarūpaparijñānapūrvakatvānnayacakrajñānasya anantaranayadarśane cāparitoṣāduttarotthānamiti sa eva sambandhaḥ, pūrvasya dūṣaṇaṃ svamataprakriyā ca sahocyate niyamobhayanaye'sminnityata āha --idamaśakyam ityādi

idaṃ śrotumapyaśakyaṃ kuto vaktuṃ svavacanādivirodhāt ? katamadaśakyam ? yad yattadityādi, yad yasmādityarthaḥ, yattaditi vacanamabhisambadhyate rūpādibhavanameva bhāva iti svamataṃ vyavasthāpya vastusaṅkrāntipratiṣedhi notpattyabhāva iti
tairavaśyaṃ hi rūpādibhiḥ kenāpi prakāreṇa bhavitavyaṃ bhāvarūpeṇābhāvarūpeṇa vā ata eva tvadvacanāt hiśabdasya vacanahetvarthatvāt

tadavadhārayitumāha --tatra cetyādi, tayośca bhāvābhāvayoratyantabhavanena yad bhavanaṃ tad vyāvartitaṃ dravyārthikamatameṣu paryavāstikanayeṣu, ato bhavanavyāvartanād bhāvarūpeṇa bhavanābhāvāta pariśaṣādutpādavināśenaivaiṣāṃ rūpādīnāṃ bhavanamavyāvarttaṃ rtitam

kiṃ kāraṇam ? yasmāt tadvyāvartane'bhāvatā teṣāṃ rūpādīnāmutpāda-vināśarūpeṇāpi bhavane vyāvartite khapuṣpavadabhāvatā syāt, taddhi kenacidrūpeṇābhavanādatyantāsat, tathā mā bhūdityutpāda-vināśarūpaṃ bhavanamiṣṭaṃ tvayāpīti taddarśyate --nanu tairyattad bhūyate sa eva bhāva iti bhavataivoktaṃ janmabhaṅgabhavanābhyupagamāt

atrocyate --na tarhi tairbhūyate, anutpādavināśitvāt, khapuṣpavat, vaidharmyeṇa pṛthivī-śivaka-stūpakādivadutpāda utpādavināśāveva hi vastūnāṃ bhavanasya bījam, rūpādaya iva tantvādibhavanabījam, tadabhāve tadabhāvāt tadbhāve tadbhāvāt
itarathā hi anutpādavināśatvādaparyāyatvād nirmūlatvānna syād vastu vandhyāputravat
yo hi bhāva utpannaḥ sa naṃṣṭā ced nāśavighnaḥ kaḥ ? yadi hi utpannaḥ san bhāvo vināśarūpabhavanātmakatvāt

itaśca na bhūyate akālatve'kālatvāt, tāveva sādharmya-vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntau, nāsya kālo'stītyakālaḥ, akālatve sati akālatvāt, kālasyākālatvāt kālavat sattvāśaṅkā syāt, mā bhūditi akālatve sati akālatvāt iti viśeṣyate
utpādavināśāveva hi vastūnāṃ bhavanasya bījam, rūpādaya iva tantvādibhavanabījam, tadabhāve tadabhāvāt tadbhāve tadbhāvāt
itarathā hi anutpādavināśatvādaparyāyatvād nirmūlatvānna syād vastu vandhyāputravat
yo hi bhāva utpannaḥ sa naṃṣṭā ced nāśavighnaḥ kaḥ ? yadi hi utpannaḥ san bhāvo

kimiva ? rūpādaya iva tantvādibhavanabījaṃ tadabhāve tadabhāvāt tadbhāve tadbhāvāt, rūpādisamudāyo hi tantu-paṭādayastadabhāve na santi tadbījatvāt tadbhāva eva ca bhavanti evaṃ vastvapi utpāda-vināśabījatvāt tadātmabhavanakamiti
॰bhavana ityata ārabhya eva ca ityanta etadantargataḥ pāṭho bhā॰ pratau nāsti
anutpādavināśatvādaparyāyam, aparyāyatvānnirmūlam, nirmūlatvānna syāditi krameṇa hetuhetumadbhāvena gatārtham

nānityasāmānyamātreṇa santuṣyāmaḥ kālāntarāvasthāyināṃ pṛthivyudakarūpādīnāmutpāda-vināśadarśanānumitenānityavastupratipakṣanityasaṃsparśasambandhinā, kālāntarāvasthānasyāpi anityapratipakṣatvāt, kiṃ tarhi ? pratipakṣavinirmuktamevānityatvaṃ vastunaḥ
tāni rūpādīni kṣaṇikānītyavadhāryatām, kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇikaḥ, paramaniruddhaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ, sa evāsyāsti na dvitīyādisamayāntarāvasthāyīnīti niścīyatām
nyāyo'pyatra --yo hi bhāva utpannaḥ sa naṃṣṭā cennāśavighnaḥ kaḥ ?

utpatti-vināśāvanantarasādhitau, sa utpannaḥ san bhāvo vināśasvabhāvaścet tasya vināśa vināśasvabhāvaḥ tasya ko vināśapratibandhī vighno yenāvatiṣṭheta hrasiṣṭhamapi kālaṃ saḥ ? na cennaiva vinaṃkṣyati
atha punarevaṃ neṣyate kadācidapi sa naiva vinaṃkṣyati pūrvavat
kaḥ kasya vināśahetuḥ ? yathā ghaṭasyāśmādyabhighāto vināśahetuḥ, agnisaṃyogaḥ pārthivarūpādīnāmapāṃ ca vināśahetuḥ
tasmin sati paścādagrahaṇād ghaṭādivināśe sa sa hetuḥ

yathāsaṃkhyanirdeśā hi svayameva pārthivaghaṭarūpādayo ghaṭākāreṇotpadyamānā ghaṭa ityākhyāṃ labhante, te punaḥ vinaṣṭā utpattereva dharmaṇaḥ sataḥ ko vināśapratibandhī vighnaḥ yenāvatiṣṭheta hrasiṣṭhamapi kālaṃ saḥ, utpannamātra eva vināśaṃ nānubhavet, anantarāsattve sati tatsva bhāvatvād vināśakṣaṇavat ?
naṃṣṭā cennāśavighnaḥ ko na cennaiva vinaṃkṣyati
vināśasvabhāvaḥ tasya ko vināśapratibandhī vighno yenāvatiṣṭheta hrasiṣṭhamapi kālaṃ saḥ ? na cennaiva vinaṃkṣyati
atha punarevaṃ neṣyate kadācidapi sa naiva vinaṃkṣyati pūrvavat
kaḥ kasya vināśahetuḥ ? yathā ghaṭasyāśmādyabhighāto vināśahetuḥ, agnisaṃyogaḥ pārthivarūpādīnāmapāṃ ca vināśahetuḥ
tasmin sati paścādagrahaṇād ghaṭādivināśe sa sa hetuḥ
yathāsaṃkhyanirdeśā hi svayameva pārthivaghaṭarūpādayo ghaṭākāreṇotpadyamānā ghaṭa ityākhyāṃ labhante, te punaḥ vinaṣṭā utpattereva
na cennaiva vinaṅkṣyati, asya bhāṣyaṃ yāvat pūrvavadityaniṣṭāpādanasādhanamevamanicchata iti gatārtham
tenaiva vyākhyāpayitukāmaḥ pṛcchati --kaḥ kasya vināśaheturyatsannidhānā-'sannidhānābhyāṃ vināśā-'vināśau ? iti
sa brūyāt --yathā ghaṭasyetyādi, aśma-musalādyabhighāto ghaṭavināśahetuḥ, agnisaṃyogaḥ pārthivānāṃ rūpādīnāmapāṃ ca vināśahetuḥ, tatsānnidhye vināśo'sānnidhye'vasthānamiti

kathaṃ sādhyam ? iti, tvayā sādhyaṃ tenā'śmādyabhighātena ghaṭasya vināśo'gnisaṃyogāt pārthivarūpādīnāmapāṃ ceti, mayā svayameveti, tatrāvayoḥ katarasya vacastathyam ? tasmādanyatarāsiddhatvādahetuḥ kathaṃ nirdhāryate hetureva iti viśeṣaheturvācyaḥ
itara āha--asti viśeṣahetuḥ, tasmin sati paścādagrahaṇāt tadasānnidhye grahaṇāt tatsannidhāvagrahaṇād ghaṭādivināśe sa sa heturiti niścīyate
atrocyate--idamajñāpakam yasmāt svayaṃ vināśe'pi asmatpakṣe tulyamevāsati grahaṇaṃ teṣām
kasmāt ? yasmāt tathānutpattito'grahaḥ, abhighātādisānnidhyāt prāk tathotpattergrahaṇam, paścādagrahaṇaṃ tatsānnidhye tathānutpatteḥ
kathaṃ kṛtvā kā bhāvanā ? ata āha --yathāsaṅkhyanirdeśā hipārthivaghaṭarūpādayaḥ, pṛthivyāṃ vināśakāraṇatvāt
tathā pārthivā api rūpādayo'gnisambandhasāmarthyāt tathā notpadyante
yo jātaśca na ca dhvasto naśyet paścāt sa kena ca
pañcavarṇa-ṣaḍrasa-dvigandhāḥ, aṣṭa sparśāḥ, śeṣeṣūdaka-tejo-vāyuṣu hīnatarā iti yā yā saṅkhyā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathāsambhavamityarthaḥ

rūpādaya eva ghaṭākāreṇotpadyamānā ghaṭa ityākhyāṃ labhante samudāyaviśeṣāt, te punaḥ svayameva vinaṣṭā utpattereva vināśakāraṇatvāt, tatrāśmādyabhighātena santatipatitānāmanyeṣāṃ rūpādīnāmutpādo nirudhyate, tasmādabhighātapratyayavaśādanye rūpādayo na punastathotpannāstasmāt santatinirodhāt tadānīmabhighātakāle ghaṭatvena rūpādyagrahaṇam, tenābhighātena sa ghaṭo na vināśitaḥ
tathā pārthivā apītyādi teṣvapi rūpādiṣu saiva bhāvanā, atrāgnisambandhasāmarthyamanyeṣāṃ tatsantatau rūpādīnāmutpitsūnāṃ nirodhakaṃ na pūrveṣāṃ vināśakam
tathāpāmapi agnisambandhastatsatantau bhūyastathotpattinirodhe hetuḥ, utpannānāṃ vināśaḥ svayameva bhavati
evaṃ svayameva vināśo jātānāṃ nānyena kenacid vināśitatvāditi
tathā pārthivā api rūpādayo'gnisambandhasāmarthyāt tathā notpadyante
yo jātaśca na ca dhvasto naśyet paścāt sa kena ca
atrāha--kathamidamavagantavyam--dṛśyamāna'bhighātādau vināśahetau svayameva vinaṣṭā ghaṭādayo na tu tena hetunā vināśitā iti ? kośapānena pratyāyyaḥ svayaṃ vināśa iti
etadadhunānumānena pratyāyyase --svayaṃ vināśi ghaṭādi, jātatvāt, pradīpaśikhāvat, etadanumānam
yathā hi samudāyasya tathābhūtadeśābhedabhavanābhāvādasattvaṃ tathā rūpāderapyasattvaṃ tathābhūtakālābhedabhavanābhāvād rūpādirūpakālālabhedādityarthaḥ
yadi tad yathā rūparūpaṃ rūpaṃ tathā rūpaṃ tadrūpaṃ syād dvitīyakṣaṇādiṣu kadācit tatastaditi kṛtvā rūpamucyeta
yathā samudāyaḥ svarūpeṇāsanneva rūpādīnāmevaṃ rūpamapi pṛthaktattvānavasthitārthatvāt
yo jātaśca na ca dhvasto naśyet paścāt sa kena ca
yathā hi samudāyasya tathābhūtadeśābhedabhavanābhāvādasattvaṃ tathā rūpāderapyasattvaṃ tathābhūtakālābhedabhavanābhāvād rūpādirūpakālālabhedādityarthaḥ
yadi tad yathā rūparūpaṃ rūpaṃ tathā rūpaṃ tadrūpaṃ syād dvitīyakṣaṇādiṣu kadācit tatastaditi kṛtvā rūpamucyeta
yathā samudāyaḥ svarūpeṇāsanneva rūpādīnāmevaṃ rūpamapi pṛthaktattvānavasthitārthatvāt
yato'pyuktam--yatha ukkhitte loḍhammi ukkheve atthi kāraṇaṃ

yathāpyatrakṣepaḥpyutkṣepaḥ ? patanakāraṇaṃ nānyat evamihāpi jātimeva kāraṇatvena vināśasya varṇayāmo nānyaditi nāstyahetukatā vināśasya jātihetukatvāccāsyodgamanameva vināśasya heturiti kṛtvā eṣāpi gāthā sunītā bhavati--evime saṃkhatā dhammāḥ saṃbhavanti sakāraṇāḥ
sa bhāva eva dhammāṇāṃ yaṃ vibhoṃti samudgatāḥ

tataḥ kim ? tatastatraivaṃ pratikṣaṇanaśvaratāyāṃ satyāṃ rūpādīnāmabhūtatathārthatvam, abhūtārthatathātvāt samudāyavadevāsattvamarthasya rūpādestena prakāreṇa deśābhedabhavanātmanā'bhāvastadabhūtamarthatathātvaṃ pratikṣaṇanaśvaratāyā uktatvāt
rūpāditvena santo rūpādayo deśābhedena ghaṭādi- samudāyātmanā na santi, tathābhūtadeśābhedabhavanābhāvāt samudāyasya saṃvṛtisataḥ paramārthato'sattvāt

tathā rūpāderapi rūpādiparamārthatayā bhavato'pi ekasmin kṣaṇe rūpādiparamārtho'styeva, sa tu kṣaṇāntaraṃ na pratīkṣate kālato bhedāt pūrvakṣaṇarūpāduttarakṣaṇarūpamanyadeva, evaṃ rasādayo'pi, ataḥ kālābhedabhavanābhāvād deśābhedabhavanābhāvasamudāyavanna santi
tasyottarakālāpratīkṣitvāt tadevedam ityaśakyaṃ vaktuṃ rūpam, tato'tyantamanyatvāt, rasādivat

tasyānyatvamāvītena samarthayitumāha kṛtvā kalpanayā itthaṃ syād yadi syāditi, tadyathā— yadi tad yathā rūparūpaṃ rūpaṃ rasādivyatiriktaṃ rūpātmakameva rūpaṃ tattve tenaivātmanā rūpeṇa tathā rūpaṃ tadrūpaṃ yadi syād dvitīyakṣaṇādiṣu kadācit, na kadācidapi bhavatītyarthaḥ, yadi syāt tatastaditi kṛtvā rūpamucyeta, na tu bhavati pratikṣaṇanaśvaratvāt, kiṃ tarhi ? idaṃ tu tadabhāva evaṃ niyamo niyamito'sattvena viśeṣaḥ, tat kimabhāva eva, na, abhāvārthastu
yat tat pratikṣaṇamabhavanaṃ tasya tattu bhavanamapi atyantābhāvaviparītavṛtti kathamanarthatāyāṃ syāt
na tat kṣaṇe kṣaṇe na bhavet, atyantābhāvatvāt, khapuṣpavat
nanu sa nityavādavat bhavanavyapadeśaḥ sattve ghaṭate
anyathā hi kuto'sya bhavanalakṣaṇālakṣyasyopākhyā ? abhāvo vārtho'syeti asyaśabdanirdeśyo'nyo'rthaḥ san sambadhyate abhāvasyāśrayabhūtatvāt, itarathā nirāśrayau prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvau na syātām

na hi bhāvamanāśritya paramparāpatitam, yad rūpaṃ bhavati tat tasminneva kṣaṇe na bhavati, punarapi kṣaṇāntare bhavadeva na bhavati, punarapi na bhavati ityevamabhāvaparamparayā''ghrātatvādasadeva samudāyavat
evaṃ niyamo niyamito'sattvena viśeṣaḥ, tat kimabhāva eva, na, abhāvārthastu
yat tat pratikṣaṇamabhavanaṃ tasya tattu bhavanamapi atyantābhāvaviparītavṛtti kathamanarthatāyāṃ syāt
na tat kṣaṇe kṣaṇe na bhavet, atyantābhāvatvāt, khapuṣpavat
nanu sa nityavādavat bhavanavyapadeśaḥ sattve ghaṭate
abhāvo vārtho'syeti asyaśabdanirdeśyo'nyo'rthaḥ san sambadhyate abhāvasyāśrayabhūtatvāt, itarathā nirāśrayau prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvau na syātām
uktasphuṭīkriyārthamupasaṃhṛtya sādhanamāha --yathā samudāyaḥ svarūpeṇāsanneva rūpādīnāmiti dṛṣṭāntaḥ, evaṃ rūpamapīti sādhyanirdeśaḥ asanneva iti vartanāt
atha kiṃ viśeṣasyāsattvena niyama eva tat kimabhāva eva ? netyucyate, abhāvārthastu, abhāvaścāsāvarthaśca bhāvaścetyarthaḥ

katham ? yat tat pratikṣaṇamabhavanaṃ tasya rūpādivastunastattu bhavanamapi kṣaṇe kṣaṇe vṛttaṃ khapuṣpābhāvādyatyantābhāvaviparītavṛtti sat kathamanarthatāyām avastutāyāṃ syāt ? kiṃ punaḥ syāt ? itthaṃ syāt--nāsti, na tat kṣaṇe kṣaṇe na bhavet, atyantābhāvatvāt, khapuṣpavat, aniṣṭaṃ caitat 'pratikṣaṇaṃ na bhavati na bhavati, iti viśeṣābhyupagamādityataḥ so'bhāvaḥ sannartho vastu cetyarthaḥ khapuṣpādyatyantābhāvaviparītavṛttitvāt

nanu saityādi tasya bhavanāghrātatvaṃ darśayati pratikṣaṇamatyantavilakṣaṇavāde nityavāda iveti nityavādavat, yathā sāṅkhyādinityavāde rūpaṃ rūpameva rūpamevaikaṃ bhavati tathehāpi tadrūpameva rūpameva ityādi bhavati iti bhavanavyapadeśaḥ sattve ghaṭate, anyathā hi kuto'sya tasyātyantabhedasyātyantānvayarahitasya bhavatiiti bhavanena lakṣaṇenālakṣyasya upākhyā ? dūrata eva na yuktā bhāva ityupākhyā
abhāvo vārtho'syeti bahuvrīhisamāso vā,abhāvo'rtho'sya iti asyaśabdanirdeśyo'nyo'rthaḥ sannasataḥ sambadhyate bahirarthatvād bahuvrīheḥ
kasmāt ? abhāvasyāśrayabhūtatvāt bhāva eva prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvau bhavitumutsahete
tadupapadanañ vā tadartha iti na bhāvamantareṇotsahate
nanu rūpādibhāvo'rthaḥ kṣaṇikatāyāṃ satyāmapi nābhāvamantareṇa notsahate bhavitum
nanvevaṃ kathamutpanne putra-ghaṭādāvarthe āśvāsaḥ, vinaṣṭe cānāśvāsaḥ ? nanvaviṣaya evāyaṃ vyavahāraḥ, vastuni kṣaṇike'syāsambhavāt, uktavat
itarathā nirāśrayau prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvau na syātām, iṣṭau ca tau na hi bhāvamanāśritya prāgabhāva-pradhvaṃsābhāvau bhavitumutsahete, asadviśeṣatvādatyantābhāvavailakṣaṇyāt
sa cāśrayo'rtha eva tayoḥ, pūrvamasadrūpamutpattyavasthāyāṃ sat paścāttu asadityucyamānatvāt
tadupapadanañ vā tadartha iti na bhāvamantareṇotsahate
nanu rūpādibhāvo'rthaḥ kṣaṇikatāyāṃ satyāmapi nābhāvamantareṇa notsahate bhavitum
nanvevaṃ kathamutpanne putra-ghaṭādāvarthe āśvāsaḥ, vinaṣṭe cānāśvāsaḥ ? nanvaviṣaya evāyaṃ vyavahāraḥ, vastuni kṣaṇike'syāsambhavāt, uktavat
tadupapadanañ vā tadartha iti na bhāvamantareṇotsahate'abhāvaḥ, iti bhāvopapadanañprayogaḥ pratiṣedhavācitvāt siddhārtha eva nāsiddhārthaviṣayaḥ
nanu rūpādibhāvo'rthaḥ kṣaṇikatāyāṃ satyāmapi rūpādirartho bhāvo nābhāvamantareṇa notsahate utsahata eva bhavitum

na cābhāvo bhavitumutsahate, nañupapadatvāt, abrāhmaṇavat, yathā brāhmaṇādanyasya abrāhmaṇaḥ iti nirdeśastathā rūpāderbhāvādanyasya abhāvaḥ iti nirdeśo yuktaḥ satyāmeva kṣaṇikatāyām na bhavati ityabhāvānuviddho bhāva eva bhavatīti bhāvādrūpāderityasata evārthatvam
kṣaṇikatvādasattve kathamutpanne putrādau ghaṭādau cārthe bhūtam ityāśvāso'nena mayā kāryaṃ kāryaṃ, dagdha-mṛta-pradhvasteṣu cānāśvāsaḥ gataṃ kāryam iti ? eṣa vyavahāro nopapadyeta, aviṣayatvāt
saviṣayatve vāsya vyavahārasya putrāderakṣaṇikatve yukta āśvāsaḥ kālāntaravinaṣṭatve'nāśvāsaśceti

atrocyate --nanvaviṣaya evāyaṃ vyavahāraḥ, vastuni kṣaṇike'syāsambhavāt, uktavat, yathā tathābhūtadeśābhedabhavanābhāvād rūpādisamudayo'bhāvastathā tathābhūtakālābhedabhavanābhāvāt tadabhāva-tadabhāvaparamparāpatitameva rūpādyapi ityuktanyāyena rūpādyasattve kuto'vatāra āśvāsā-'nāśvāsavyavahārasya ? evameva ca vairāgyabhāvanā śarīra-svajana-dravyādinairmamyāt kvacidapyanāśvāsāt saṃsāraheturāgādiprātikūlyena ghaṭate, tadarthaścāyamārambha iti guṇopacayaḥ kṣaṇikabhāve
na tahi sūkṣmau sta eva akāraṇatvāt khapuṣpavadutpādavināśau
evameva ca santānasiddhiḥ | anyathā na kāraṇaṃ na kriyā
bhūtiryeṣāṃ ryaiṣā ? kriyā saiva kārakaṃ saiva cocyate
yacca vyavahārāviṣayatvamuktaṃ tanna bhavati, yasmāt sa yujyate saṃvṛtyā vyavahārastu santānaviṣayatvāt

tadviṣayanirdhāraṇārthamutpāda-vināśau vikalpayati --sūkṣmo'numeyo mahatotpādenotpādo vināśena vināśa iti, dvayoḥ pratyekaṃ dvaividhyāccāturvidhyam, taddarśayati --mahotpādaḥ sūkṣmotpāda iti, bhaṅgo'pyevamityatideśena ca tadvivekapradarśanam mahatāttā santāna utpāda-vināśayoḥ sūkṣmatā tatpravṛtteḥ, tayormahotpāda-bhaṅgayoḥ pravṛttidarśanād bubhukṣā-tṛptyoriva
tatra santānasya putraghaṭādermahatyutpāde bhavatyāśvāso vināśe'nāśvāsaḥ, itarayoḥ sūkṣmotpāda-bhaṅgayorucchvāsaniḥśvāsānumitabhrānti-viśrāntyorivānumeyatā
itara āha --na tarhi sūkṣmau sta eva akāraṇatvāt khapuṣpavadutpādavināśāviti
santānagatāveva yau tau nāśotpādau staḥ, sakāraṇatvāt, cakrasthaghaṭasyevotpāda āhataghaṭasyeva vināśa iti
kimiva ? ityata āha --yato nāśotpādau samaṃ yadvannāmonnāmau tulāntayoḥ, yathā tulāyā eko'nto namati unnamati apara ekasminneva kṣaṇe tadvad rūpotpatti-rūpāntaravināśāviti
evameva ca santānasiddhiḥ yugapadutpādavināśe rūpanairantaryāt santatam anavarataṃ bhavanāt, anyathā uktanyāyādanyathā na kāraṇaṃ sarvathā vināśotpādayoranavasthāne na kriyā karturbhaviturabhāvāt
etadarthasaṃvādi jñāpakamāha --kṣaṇikāḥ sarvasaṃskārā iti ślokaḥ, utpatteḥ sakāraṇatvāt pratyayajanmānaḥ saṃskārāḥ

kṣaṇamātrāvasthāyināṃ dvitīyaṃ kṣaṇamasthitānāṃ kutaḥ kriyā teṣām ? kā tarhi kriyā loke parigṛhītā kriyate ghaṭaḥ iti ? kiṃ kārakaṃ karoti kaṭaṃ kumbhakāraḥ ityādi ? atrocyate --bhūtiryeṣāṃ janmaiva kriyā, saiva ca kārakam ātmanaivātmānaṃ nivartayatīti janmaiva vināśakāraṇamityuktam
kiṃ vā kārakam ityapi pāṭho'tra bhavet
anyadanyadeva hi rūpādyutpadyamānaṃ dṛśyate pratyakṣata eva tadyathā vahatīvodake
atha santānavat sūkṣmotpādavināśayorapyantare vastu rūpādi dṛśyeta
santāno vāvasthito na dṛśyeta svotpādavināśayorantare, sūkṣmotpādavināśavat

athavā nāyamartho yuktisādhyaḥ pratyakṣatvāt, anyadanyadeva hi rūpādi utpadyamānaṃ dṛśyate pratyakṣata eva, tadyathā--vahatīvodake, yathā srotasi nadyādīnāṃ vahadudakamanyadanyadevā''gacchati gataṃ tu gatameva, atha ca mandabuddherbhrāntasya santāne'navarate srotasi tadeva iti mithyāpratyaya upajāyate tathā sarvarūpādiṣu
yathā santāno'vasthito dṛśyate svotpāda-vināśayorantare tathā sūkṣmotpāda-vināśayorapyantare vastu rūpādi dṛśyeta
pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyamānatvādeva vā na codyam, na hi pramāṇajyeṣṭhaṃ pratyakṣamatikramyopapannamiti pratyakṣaviruddhaṃ pratipattuṃ yogyam, pratyakṣasya pramāṇāntareṇābādhyatvāt

tathāhītyetasyārthasya saṃvādyupapattyantaravāci jñāpakamāha, yadyekasmin kṣaṇe jātamiti ślokaḥ, yadyutpattireva vināśakāraṇaṃ na syāt dvitīyakṣaṇādyavasthānavat sadāvasthānameva syāt vināśahetvabhāvādityuktam, na caitadevaṃ bhavati
tasmājjanmaiva vināśaheturātmanaḥ, tadvināśa eva cottarotpattikāraṇamiti sthitametat--kṣaṇikaṃ rūpādi bāhyaṃ vastviti

etābhyāmeva mahotpāda-bhaṅgābhyāṃ santānajābhyāṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ sūkṣmotpāda-bhaṅgāvanumeyau, tadyathā— ante kṣayadarśanādādau kṣayo'numīyate pradīpaśikhāvat, yathā pradīpaśikhā utpattikālādārabhya kṣīyamāṇā'nte nivāte'pi sarvathā kṣīyate, sā ca kṣaṇāntarāvasthāne sati na kṣīyate kadācidityuktam, kṣīyate tu sarvā
tathā ghaṭādirapi janmanaḥ ayaṃ ca nayaḥ 'pratikṣaṇamanyo bhavanneva bhavati, ityabhyupagacchati, ato niyamobhayaṃ vāñchati
nikṣepacatuṣṭaye ca bhāvanikṣepavikalpamanāgamato bhāvamupayogaṃ pratipadyate, upayogaivambhūtasya nayasyaikadeśatvāt
indrānubhavanakāle tadupayogakāla eva vendraḥ, anyadā'nindraḥ, tadbhāvasyaiva tadbhūtatvāt
atra ca pratikṣaṇātikrāmitvād vastuno buddhistho yo'rthaḥ sa śabdārthaḥ
ayaṃ ca nayaḥ 'pratikṣaṇamanyo bhavanneva bhavati, ityabhyupagacchati, ato niyamobhayaṃ vāñchati
nikṣepacatuṣṭaye ca bhāvanikṣepavikalpamanāgamato bhāvamupayogaṃ pratipadyate, upayogaivambhūtasya nayasyaikadeśatvāt
indrānubhavanakāle tadupayogakāla eva vendraḥ, anyadā'nindraḥ, tadbhāvasyaiva tadbhūtatvāt
atra ca pratikṣaṇātikrāmitvād vastuno buddhistho yo'rthaḥ sa śabdārthaḥ
ayaṃ ca nayaḥ pratikṣaṇamanyo bhavanneva bhavati ityabhyupagacchati ato niyataṃ vidadhāti niyamayati ceti niyamobhayaṃ vāñchati
nikṣepacatuṣṭaye ca bhāvanikṣepavikalpamanāgamato bhāvamupayogaṃ kṣāyopaśamikaṃ bhāvamaudayikaṃ pāriṇāmikaṃ vā bhāvamupayogasādbhūtaṃ vijñānalakṣitaṃ bāhyaṃ rūpādi pratipadyate
vyajyate'nena vyanaktīti vyañjanaṃ śabdaḥ, arthastu tadgocaraḥ, tacca tadubhayaṃ ca tadubhayaṃ śabdārthalakṣaṇamevaṃbhūto nayo viśeṣayati
idamatra hṛdayam--śabdamarthena viśeṣayati arthaṃ ca śabdena
tathā cāha bhāṣyakṛt--'vaṃjaṇamattheṇa'tthaṃ ca vaṃjaṇeṇobhayaṃ visesei

jaha ghaḍasaddaṃ ceṭṭhāvayā tahā taṃ pi teṇeva viśeṣā॰ 2252, asyā gāthāyā leśato vyākhyā--vyañjanaṃ śabdamarthena viśeṣayati arthavaśād naiyatye vyavasthāpayatītyarthaḥ, yathā sa eva tattvato ghaṭaśabdo yaśceṣṭāvantamarthaṃ pratiniyataṃ vyavasthāpayatīti bhāvaḥ
yathā vā ghaṭaśabdavācyatvena prasiddhā ceṣṭā sā ghaṭanād ghaṭa iti vyutpattyarthaparibhāvanābalād yoṣidādimastakārūḍhasya ghaṭasya jalāharaṇādikriyārūpā draṣṭavyā, na tu sthānabharaṇakriyārūpā

evamubhayam--śabdenārthamarthena śabdaṃ viśeṣayati, atraiva codāharaṇamāha--jaha ghaḍasaddamityādi, yathā ghaṭaśabdaṃ ceṣṭāvatārthena niyamayati sa eva tattvato ghaṭaśabdo yaśceṣṭāvantamarthaṃ pratipādayati, tathā tamapyarthaṃ tenaiva śabdena niyamayati yathā ghaṭaśabdavācyā ceṣṭā ghaṭanād ghaṭa iti vyutpattibalena yoṣidādimastakārūḍhasya ghaṭasya jalāharaṇakriyārūpā draṣṭavyeti

...evaṃbhūtaśabdavyutpattiścaivam— evaṃśabdaḥ prakāravacanaḥ, evaṃ yathā vyutpāditastaṃ prakāraṃ bhūtaḥ prāpta evaṃbhūtaḥ śabdaḥ, tatsamarthanapradhāno nayo'pyevaṃbhūta upacārāt, evaṃbhūtaśabdasamarthanā cāsya prāgevopadarśitā yathā yasminnarthe śabdo vyutpādyate sa vyutpattinimittamartho yadaiva svarūpato vartate tadaiva taṃ śabdaṃ pravartamānamabhipraiti, na śeṣakālam yathodakādyāharaṇavelāyāṃ yoṣidādimastakārūḍho viśiṣṭaceṣṭāvān ghaṭo ghaṭaśabdavācyaḥ, na śeṣaḥ, ghaṭaśabdapravṛttinimittaśūnyatvāt paṭādivat, tathā ghaṭaśabdo'pi tattvataḥ sa eva draṣṭavyo yaśceṣṭāvantamarthaṃ pratipādayati, na śeṣaḥ, śeṣasya svābhidheyārthaśūnyatvāditi
sa bāhyaṃ vastviti jñātaḥ śabdārthaḥ kaiścidiṣyate || vākyapa॰ 2 | 133
indro'nindraścendraḥ, idi paramaiśvarye pā॰ dhā॰ 63, pāramaiśvaryānubhavanakāla evendro'nyadā'nindraḥ
purandarāditvasya tvanavakāśa eva kṣaṇikatvādupayogasya ca tadarthasya ca
kasmāt ? tadbhāvasyaiva tadbhūtatvāt, sa eva bhāva upayogībhūtaḥ purandarādyanyatamaparyāyastatkṣaṇa eva ca nānyadeti bhāvitārtham

śabdārthaḥ ko'tra ? ityatrocyate --atra ca pratikṣaṇātikrakrāmitvād vastuno buddhistho yo'rthaḥ sa śabdārthaḥ, kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'nyadeva vastūtpadyotpadyā'tikrāmadapi buddhau tiṣṭhati, yastu kṣaṇo buddhisthaḥ so'rthaḥ śabdasya rūpaṃ raso gandhaḥ ityādi
etatsaṃvādyāgamāntaraṃ jñāpakamāha nayavādānāṃ jaināgamaprabhavatvātū --yo vā'rtho buddhiviṣaya ityādi vyākhyātārthānusāritvānna vyākhyāyate
athavā buddhyupārūḍha eva śabdasyārtho na bāhya iti daśamaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayitumāha --yo vārtho buddhiviṣayo bāhyavastunibandhanaḥ
sa bāhyaṃ vastviti jñātaḥ śabdārthaḥ kaiścidiṣyate

śabdasya buddhyupārūḍhasya vaikalpikasya yo buddhyupārūḍho bāhyavastunibandhanaḥ bāhyaṃ vastu vikalpajananadvāreṇa nibandhanaṃ yasya sa tathābhūtaḥ sa ca vaikalpiko'rtho bhramavaśād dṛśyavikalpailpyai ?kākāreṇa abahīrūpo'pi bahīrūpatayādhyasto'dhyastameva vastvavagacchāmi śabdāditi śabdanimittamiti śabdārtha iṣyate
buddhiviṣayaḥ iti buddhau viparivartamānaḥ, buddhistha iti yāvat
bāhyavastunibandhana iti sadasad bāhyaṃ vastu nibandhanamakṣaracihnasthānīyaṃ svarūpamupadarśayituṃ prakramyate yasya sa bāhyavastunibandhanaḥ
bāhyaṃ vastviti jñātaḥ iti buddhirūpatvenāvirbhāvito bāhyatayādhyavasita ityarthaḥ

tathāhi-yāvad buddhirūpamartheṣvapratyastaṃ buddhirūpameveti tattvabhāvanayā gṛhyate tāvat tasya śabdārthatvaṃ nāvasīyate tatra kriyāviśeṣasambandhābhāvāt, na hi gāmānaya dadhi khādetyādikāḥ kriyāstādṛśi buddhirūpe sambhavanti
yadā tu bāhyavastuni pratyasto bhavati tadā tasmin pratipattā bāhyatayā viparyastaḥ kriyāsādhanasāmarthyaṃ tasya manyata iti bhavati śabdārthaḥ

vākyārthastarhi kaḥ ? ucyate --santānavṛttaśca kramo vākyārthaḥ, vijñānasantāne rūpādibāhyārthasantāne ca ya utpatti-vināśakramaḥ sa vākyārthaḥ vākyavarṇapadādiśabdānāmānupūrvyoccāraṇaṃ pratisvaṃ janma-nirodhānugrahakramaḥ

upanibandhanaṃ yato'sya nirgamastadyathā--imā ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! rayaṇappabhā puḍhavī kiṃ sāsatā asāsatā ? goyamā ! davvaṭṭhayāe sāsatā vaṇṇapajjavehiṃ gaṃdhapajjavehiṃ rasapajjavehiṃ phāsapajjavehiṃ saṃṭhāṇapajjavehiṃ asāsatā jīvājīvābhi॰ 3
jaināgamo'pyevamityata āha --upanibandhanaṃ yato'sya nirgamastadyathā--imā ṇaṃ bhaṃte ityādigrantho gatārthaḥ, aśāśvatatvena paryāyāṇāṃ nirdeśāt
ante kṣayād yadyevaṃ tato vastuvat prasiddhyabhyupagamaḥ kṛto bhavati

pūrvanayamatāparitoṣakāraṇamuttaranayotthānam, uttarottarasūkṣmekṣikayā ca pūrvasya doṣadarśanāt svamatasausthityābhimānāccārambha ityata āha --ante kṣayād yadyevam yadi tvayānte kṣayadarśanāt svarasenaiva vastunaḥ kṣaya evādāvapyanumīyate, tataḥ kim ? tato vastuvat prasiddhyabhyupagamaḥ kṛto bhavati, vastunīva vastuvat, yathā vastunaḥ prasiddhasya loke sthitasya ghaṭādeḥ kṣayo bhavatīti prasiddhistathā tvayābhyupagatamiti prāptam, vināśasyotpādasya ca prasiddhavastuviṣayatvāt
itarathā kharaviṣāṇa- syeva sthityabhāve vināśotpādayorapyabhāvaḥ pratisandhānābhāvāt, sthitasya bhavata eva hi bhavanamitītthamabhyupagamaste

tasmād vastuvyavasthāsiddhyupahitaniyamānatikramāt ityasmāddhetorbhavata evotpāda-vināśapratisandhānād vyavasthitaṃ vastu siddhaṃ niyatamutpāda-vināśavyapadeśabhāg bhavatītyetaṃ niyamaṃ nātikrāmati khapuṣpādivailakṣaṇyenopahitam, ato vastuvyavasthāsiddhyupahitaniyamānatikramād niścayena sthitaṃ niṣṭhitaṃ vyavasthitamiti gṛhāṇa tvadvacanādevetyataścāha --niṣṭhitaṃ tarhi tat, antavattvāt, ghaṭādivastuvaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathā mṛtpiṇḍādyavasthānāmante ghaṭo'styeva avasthita evāntavattvāt tathā mṛlloṣṭādyavasthāsvapi
tataśca kṛtakatvādārabdhamapi ghaṭādivastuvadeveti hetuhetumadbhāvenā''rambha-kriyā-niṣṭhāḥ sādhitāḥ upasaṃhṛtyaikatvenāha --evaṃ ta ityādi
ārambha-kriyā-niṣṭhāḥ pūrvanirvṛttavastunibandhanāḥ, kriyātvāt, antavat, ante ivāntavat, yathā ante nivṛttikāle kriyā bhavanaṃ janma ātmalābhaḥ sā pūrvanirvṛttavastunibandhanā tathā prārambhādikriyāḥ
bhūtiryeṣāṃ kriyā saiva kārakaṃ saiva cocyate
na hi kṣaṇikaśabdārthaḥ kṣaṇena svena tadvatā cārthena svāminā vinā ghaṭate iti tasya kṣaṇasya svāmī tatsamavasthāyī dravyārtho'rtho bhavitumarhati
dvividho hi kṣaṇaḥ utpattikṣaṇo vināśakṣaṇaśca tadanantaram

itara āha --kutaḥ kriyā, kṣaṇikatvāt ? ante'pi ca kriyātvaṃ nābhyupagamyate mayā kṣaṇikatvādabhāvatvāt prāguktavidhinā, kimaṅga punarārambhakaraṇādyavasthāsu avasthitavastvanabhyupagamāt ? uktaṃ hītyādi jñāpakam
kṣaṇikāḥ sarvasaṃskārā ityādiślokaḥ pratyāprāgvyā ?khyātārtha iti na punarvyākhyāyate

yadanyadravyārthanayadarśanasyoktakṣayotpādādikriyābhyupagamādi vastuvyavasthāsiddhikāraṇaṃ vā kṣaṇabhaṅgābhāvapratipādanasamarthaṃ tat tāvadāstām, kiṃ tarhi ? kṣaṇikaśabdārthatattvānvīkṣaṇādeva kṣaṇabhaṅgavādasya bhaṅgaḥ śakyate kartum, kasmāt ? kṣaṇikaśabdasya sva-svāmilakṣaṇāstyastimatsambandhavāciṭhanpratyayāntasya sthitārthābhāve'bhidheyābhāvaprasaṅgāt

taddarśayati --na hi kṣaṇikaśabdetyādi, kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇiko yathā daṇḍo'syāstīti daṇḍikaḥ, yathā caitreṇa daṇḍasambandhinā svāminā daṇḍena svena ca vinā daṇḍikaḥ iti śabdo nārthavān bhavatyevaṃ kṣaṇikaśabdo'pi kṣaṇena svena tadvatā cārthena svāminā vinā nārthavān

bhā bhūt so'narthaka iti tasya kṣaṇasya svasya daṇḍasyeva caitraṣṭhanpratyayāntaḥ svāmī tena saha samavasthātuṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa dravyārthalakṣaṇo'rtho jainendravyutpāditotpāda-vināśaparyāyārthasahacāristhitadravyārthavad bhavitumarhati, itarathā kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇikaḥ iti na śabdobdārtho ghaṭate so'vasthātṛdravyābhidhāyitve tu ghaṭate
tulanā--yaścāyaṃ matvarthīyaḥ kṣaṇikā iti sa katham ? yadi niruktanyāyena kṣayaḥ kṣaṇa iti kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇika iti tanna yuktaṃ kālabhedāt
yadā kṣayo na tadā kṣayīti bhinnakālayorna matvarthīyo dṛṣṭaḥ
atha punarbhāva evānantareṇa vināśena viśiṣyamāṇaḥ kṣaṇika ityucyate tathāpi tenaiva tadeva tadvanna bhavatīti na yukto matvarthīyaḥ
atrāha --na, paryāyaviṣaya eva tatsvāmitvopapatteḥ, paryāyāntarasya svaparyāyāntaraṃ svāmītyastyastimatsambandha upapadyate, tadarthavācī ca tatpratyayaḥ
tad vyācaṣṭe --dvividho hi kṣaṇa ityādi, dvaividhyam utpattikṣaṇo vināśakṣaṇaśca tadanantaramiti
tasya sphuṭīkaraṇam --anantaravacanamantarā kṣaṇānantaro vināśakṣaṇaḥ sa eva tasyāsti paryāyasya paryāyaḥ
evamapi na yukto'padeśa itarābhāva itarasyāpi tathā'bhāvāt
yadā daṇḍo vidyate caitro'pi vidyate tadāsya tena tadvattā nyāyyā syāt
iha tu yadotpattikṣaṇo na tadā vināśakṣaṇaḥ yadā ca vināśakṣaṇo na tadotpattikṣaṇa iti uttareṇa prācyāpadeśo na yuktaḥ
yadapi ca nidarśanamuktaṃ tadapi yugapat satostulāntayoryujyeta, na tu vidyamānāvidyamānayoḥ kṣaṇayoryaugapadyaṃ ghaṭakhapuṣpayoriva
lāvasthānavyudāsārtham, nāntarāle kiñcidasti ityasyārthasya darśanārtham, tasya jñāpakaṃ prāguktam--
kṣaṇānantaro vināśakṣaṇaḥ sa eva tasyāsti paryāyasya paryāyaḥ
evamapi na yukto'padeśa itarābhāva itarasyāpi tathā'bhāvāt
yadā daṇḍo vidyate caitro'pi vidyate tadāsya tena tadvattā nyāyyā syāt
iha tu yadotpattikṣaṇo na tadā vināśakṣaṇaḥ yadā ca vināśakṣaṇo na tadotpattikṣaṇa iti uttareṇa prācyāpadeśo na yuktaḥ
yadapi ca nidarśanamuktaṃ tadapi yugapat satostulāntayoryujyeta, na tu vidyamānāvidyamānayoḥ kṣaṇayoryaugapadyaṃ ghaṭakhapuṣpayoriva

evaṃ nirantarayoḥ kṣaṇayoryo'yamutpattikṣaṇānantaro vināśakṣaṇaḥ sa cāpakarṣakālaparyantakālacchedena buddhyā vibhajyamāno yo vibhāgaṃ na prayacchati sa eva tasyāsti paryāyasya paryāyaḥ, tasmāt kṣaṇikaśabdaḥ kṣaṇasya kṣaṇāntarāpekṣatvādarthavān, ato na doṣo dravyārthaparigraho'vasthitārtho'nveṣya iti
atrocyate --evamapi na yukto'padeśaḥ kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇikaḥ iti paryāyāntarāpekṣayāpi

kasmāt ? itarābhāva itarasyāpi tathā'bhāvāt, yathā daṇḍābhāve daṇḍikatvena caitrasyāpyabhāvāccaitro daṇḍika iti nocyate evamutpattikṣaṇasya vināśakṣaṇasya vā parasparamitarakāla itarasyātyantamasattvād vināśakṣaṇa utpattikṣaṇavānna bhavati utpattikṣaṇo'pi vināśakṣaṇavānna bhavati kharaviṣāṇavattvena caitrābhāvavat
yadā daṇḍo vidyate caitro'pi vidyate tadāsya caitrasya tena daṇḍena tadvattā daṇḍavattā daṇḍikatā nyāyādanapetā syāditi vaidharmyeṇa nidarśanam
iha tu yadotpattikṣaṇa ityādinā utpatti-vināśakṣaṇayorasādharmyaṃ darśayati yāvat prācyāpadeśo na yukta iti gatārtham

yadapi ca nāśotpādau samaṃ yadvannāmonnāmau tulāntayoḥ iti hetuhetumattvanidarśanamuktaṃ tadapi arthāntarabhūtayoryugapatsatostulāntayoryujyeta, na tu vidya- mānāvidyamānayoḥ kṣaṇayoryaugapadyaṃ ghaṭa-khapuṣpayoriva, tathā natyunnatyośca sattvād yaugapadyaṃ syāt, ato'samañjasatā dṛṣṭānta-dārṣṭāntikayoḥ
ityetaccāyuktam, naśyataḥ sattve sahāvasthānamutpadyamānena, asattve tadavasthamasamañjasatvam
tasmādayukta uttareṇa prācyasyāpadeśaḥ kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇika iti
atha sthātā kaścid dvayorapi tato yadyekasmin kṣaṇe jātam...
na hi rūpādivināśavyatirikta utpādaḥ, ya utpādaḥ sa eva vināśaḥ, so'syāstīti kṣaṇikaḥ
evaṃ te ya utpādaḥ sa eva vināśaḥ, na vināśātirikta utpādakṣaṇaḥ,

syādiyamāśaṅkā--tayoḥ pūrvottarakṣaṇayoranyatarastiṣṭhatyato vyapadeśasiddhiriti, tatpratyuccāraṇam --atha sthātā kaścid dvayorapi kṣaṇayoriti, yadyuttaro yadi pūrvo yathecchasi tathāstu, tiṣṭhatu nāma, tathābhyupagate'pi doṣaḥ --tato yadyekasmin ityādiślokaḥ tvayokto vināśakāraṇābhāvādanantakālāvasthānamiti doṣa eva
evaṃ tāvad dvayoḥ kṣaṇayoḥ sambandhābhāvāt kṣaṇikaśabdārtho'san yadyantarālāvasthānavyudāsārthatve'nantaraśabdasya vyapadeśasiddhiḥ iti vartate
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti utpattyanantaravināśakṣaṇaḥ iti anantaraśabda utpattikṣaṇamevāha, sa evotpattikṣaṇo'nantaravināśī samānādhikaraṇasamāsatvāt

kvāsya sambandhivācipratyayatā dṛṣṭeti cet, darśyate --yathotpādavānaṅkura ityucyate nātrāṅkuravyatirikta utpādo na cotpādavyatirikto matupartho ya utpādavānaṅkura ityucyate, dṛṣṭaścāyaṃ vyapadeśastenaiva tasya
atra brūmaḥ --evaṃ te ya utpāda ityādi tanmatapratyuccāraṇaṃ yāvadutpādātiriktāsambhavāditi, taccāniṣṭaṃ tavaiva, kṣaṇikaśabdārthasamīkaraṇavyākhyāpravṛttena tvayā tasyaiva vināśitatvāt
na ca sa yasya kṣaṇaḥ, na ca yo'sau kṣaṇaḥ,
tasmādina upādānādayuktā kalpanā, bahuvrīhervā, bhedavyavahāramabhyupagamya śabdārthavicārāṅgīkaraṇāt

utpādavināśayoścaikārthanipātinoḥ parasparanirākṛtārthatvādasatyārthatvam, kumāra- iti taddarśayati --na ca sa yasya kṣaṇa iti, na ca so'rtho yastena kṣaṇena tadvatkṣaṇika ucyate svāmī daṇḍeneva daṇḍikaścaitraḥ, tvayaiva utpādakṣaṇātiriktārthāsambhavāt ityuktatvāt
na ca yo'sau kṣaṇa iti, so'pi kṣaṇo nāsti yaścaitradaṇḍitvavyapadeśakāraṇadaṇḍasthānīyasvatvabhāk yena sambandhāt kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇika ucyate tato'nyaḥ
ataḥ sā kṣaṇikatātva'tra nāstyeva śabdārtha ityarthaḥ
tasmāt prastutavirodhitvāt śabdārthavirodhitvādayukteyam ātmalābha evānantaravināśī iti vyākhyā
na ca sa yasya kṣaṇaḥ, na ca yo'sau kṣaṇaḥ,
tasmādina upādānādayuktā kalpanā, bahuvrīhervā, bhedavyavahāramabhyupagamya śabdārthavicārāṅgīkaraṇāt
ita ārabhya etaccihnāntargato dṛṣṭānto vā ityantaḥ pṛ॰ 812 paṃ॰ 27 pāṭho ya॰ pratau nāsti
kṣaṇikaśabdārthasamīkriyārtham anantaravināśī ityatra inipratyayāntavināśaśabdanirdeśo'pyayuktastasyāpyarthāsambhavāt, na kevalaṃ kṣaṇikaśabda eva uktanyāyena
itaścāyuktā bahuvrīhervā, anantaraṃ vināśo'syetyanantara- vināśaḥ ityevocyamāne'pi ayuktamevābhihitanyāyād bahuvrīherapi citraguvad bhinnārthaviṣayatvāt tadarthāsambhavācceti
syānmatam--ātmavān devadattaḥ, utpādavānaṅkuraḥ ityabhinnārthe matupādipratyayadarśanāt padamekākṣaram ityādyabhinnārthabahuvrīhidarśanāccādoṣa iti

kiñcānyat, anantaravināśakṣaṇe kṣaṇadvaividhyādasambandhaḥ, ātmalābha evānantaravināśī iti bruvataḥ sa evotpādo vināśaścetyekārthadvidhāvṛttiprasaṅgo'sambandhaśca saḥ, tayoścotpāda-vināśayoḥ parasparavirodhāt pūrvadoṣānativṛtteśca
utpādārthenetyādi, ātmalābhasya utpādaparyāyatvāt virodhino vināśasyānavakāśāt tadā kṣaṇikārthāsattvameva
anantaravacane'pāntarālavyudāsārthavyākhyāpatteḥ prāguktadoṣasambandhādayuktam, taddarśayati --itarābhāva ityādi gatārthaṃ sādhanaṃ yāvad vyapadeśābhāva iti
utpādānarthāntaratvācca sarvasya matuparthābhāva eva sarvatra rūpādāvapi
na cātadātve'pyasya prayogo dṛṣṭaḥ, atītānāgatakālāpekṣadaṇḍadaṇḍisahabhāvaparigrahādeva āsīd bhavitā ca daṇḍī iti prayogāt
ato yaducyate ātmalābha eva vināśaḥ iti, eṣā'yuktā kalpanā

kiñcānyat, utpāda-vināśayoścetyādi sādhanaṃ yāvat pitṛvat svavacanavirodhadoṣodbhāvanam, tadyathā--utpādavināśāvekārthanipātināvasadarthau, parasparanirākṛtārthatvāt, kumārabrahmacāritvapitṛtvavat, yathā kaścid brūyāt pitā me kumārabrahmacārī iti, tatra kumārabrahmacāritvaṃ pitṛtvena nirākṛtaṃ pitṛtvaṃ kumārabrahmacāritvena, atastau janma-kṣayadharmāvapi tathā viruddhau kṣaṇa ekasmin vṛttāvityasatyārthau
tataḥ kim ? tataḥ satyāṃ tasyāmasatyatāyāṃ dravyārthasatyatvāpattireva, yadi vastuna utpādavināśau na staḥ sacca tadvastviṣyate tato'vasthitaṃ taditi prāptamarthādeva
kiñcānyat --utpādānarthāntaratvācca sarvasya matuparthābhāva eva sarvatra rūpādāvapīti prāpta iti vākyaśeṣaḥ

yathā tvayoktam --ātmalābha eva vināśaḥ, matupartho'pi sa eva, utpādavadaṅkuratvavadutpādātiriktārthāsambhavāt sarvamutpādamātram iti, tathā ca katamo'nyo'rtha utpādād yatastenotpādena tadvānaṅkurādirutpādavāniti vyapadiśyeta tadvyatiriktāsambhavāt ? evaṃ rūpāderapyutpādamātratvāt utpādavad rūpaṃ, raso gandhaḥ śabdaḥ sparśo vā utpādavān iti naiva kaścidarthaḥ syāt, tadabhāvāt utpādavat iti vyarthako nirdeśo matuparthapratyayāntaḥ syāt
syānmatam--asahamānebhāve'pi atadātve matuparthapratyayadarśanād vyabhicāriṇo dūṣaṇahetavastvadīyāḥ, tadyathā--daṇḍī āsīt, daṇḍī bhavitā ityādi

na caivaṃ mantavyam--asahabhūtayostattadvatoratadātve matuparthapratyayāntanirdeśa iti, kiṃ tarhi ? atītā'nāgatakālāpekṣadaṇḍa-daṇḍisahabhāvaparigrahādeva āsīd bhavitā ca daṇḍī iti prayujyate dhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ pā॰ 3
dhātvarthānāṃ sambandhe kāle pratyayā uktāstato'nyatrāpi syuḥ
somayājyasya putro bhavitā somena yakṣyamāṇo yaḥ putrastatkartṛkaṃ bhavanam
...tatra dhātusambandhe kālāntaravihitānāṃ pratyayānāmanyasmin kāle sādhutvābhyanujñānārthamidaṃ sūtram
evamuktadoṣatvāt ātmalābha eva vināśa ityayuktā kalpanā
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 809 paṃ॰ 6, pṛ॰ 810 paṃ॰ 12, pṛ॰ 811 paṃ॰ 14
ata utpādamātratvād ghaṭādyaṅkurādīnāṃ ghaṭādayo'ṅkura eva, aṅkurasvarūpānarthāntaratvāt, aṅkurasvātmavat
yadeva kāraṇaṃ kāryamapi tadeva, tadāsāditarūpavattvāt, utpādāsāditāṅkurotpādānarthāntaratvavat
athāpītyādi etānuktān doṣānupekṣyā'vamatya doṣāḥ pratyakṣavirodhādaya ucyante

tadyathā— yadyutpādādanarthāntaramutpadyamānamaṅkurādīti taduktameva smārayati dūṣayitum, tataḥ kim ? tato ghaṭādi utpadyate'ṅkuro'pi, ata utpādamātratvād ghaṭādyaṅkurādīnāmabhedaḥ, ghaṭādayo'ṅkura eva te prāptāḥ, kasmāt ? aṅkurasvarūpānarthāntaratvāt, aṅkurasvātmavat
yathā ca sa evaṃ ghaṭādyapi, yathāṅkura eva ghaṭādayo'pi aṅkurasvarūpotpādānarthāntaratvādaṅkurasvātmavat evaṃ ghaṭādirevāṅkuro'pi ghaṭādisvarūpotpādānarthāntaratvāt tatsvātmavat

tataśceti sarvasārvātmyamiti sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ ghaṭo'pi paṭo'pi aṅkuro'pi aṅkuro ghaṭo rathaḥ puruṣo mahiṣo'pi mahiṣaḥ puruṣaḥ mahiṣo meṣo'śvo hastyapītyādi sarvasarvātmakatvamutpādānarthāntaratvāt puruṣādyekakāraṇānarthāntaracetanapuruṣatvādivat
tataśca sarvajagaddravyārthāpattirapi, sarvameva na viśeṣo nāma kaściditi prāptam
kiñcānyat, na kevalaṃ sarvajagaddravyārthāpattireva, tato mūladravyārthaḥ kāraṇadravyārtho'pyāpadyate
tat katham ? iti bhāvayati --yadeva kāraṇaṃ kāryamapi tadeveti pakṣo'niṣṭāpādanārthaḥ

tadāsādita- rūpavattvāditi hetuḥ, tena kāraṇena āsāditaṃ rūpamasya kāryasya, yathā tanturūpamāsāditaḥ paṭaḥ kāraṇarūpāsāditakāryarūpatvāt kāraṇameva kāryam, kimiva ? tvadabhimatotpādāsāditāṅkurotpādānarthāntaratvavat, yathā utpādenā''tmarūpamāsādito'ṅkuraḥ tadanarthāntaratvādutpāda eva tathā tantvādikāraṇarūpāsāditaṃ paṭādi kāryaṃ kāraṇameveti
āha --nanu kāryeṇaiva kāraṇarūpamāsādyate, paṭenaiva tantavaḥ paṭarūpamāsādyante, tasmādanyatarāsiddho heturviparyayābhyupagamād dṛṣṭānto vā sādhanadharmavikala iti
etacca na, tulyapari nanūktavastuvādavad bhavadeva bhavati, tasmāt tenaiva bhavatā dravyeṇa kāraṇena kāryarūpamāsādyetamāsādyate
anyathā khapuṣparūpamapyāsādyetaiva, nirbījamapyutpādādeva bhavet, tasyotpādādarthāntaratvenābhūtatvāt, aṅkuravat
yattūttareṇa prācyasya na yukto vyapadeśa ityasyottaramucyate na, bhāvidharmavyapadeśāt iti
bhāvinaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sandhāyocyate kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇika iti, maraṇadharmivat
tasyaiva cāsau bhāvasya vyayaḥ prācyasyeti nyāyya eva vyapadeśaḥ bhāvikṣaṇasandhānaṃ ca prathamamevopāttaṃ mayā ātmalābhānantaram ityuktatvāt

ato'nantaraśabdalopaṃ kṛtvā ṭhanpratyaya utpādyate praśnārthatvāt, vayaṃ brūmaḥ kāraṇena kāryamātmasāt kṛtaṃ tantvādinā paṭādīti, tvaṃ brūyāḥ kāryeṇa paṭādinā ātmasāt kṛtāstantvādaya iti, katarasya vacasā viśeṣanirṇayo'stvāvayoḥ ?
nanūktavastuvādavad bhavadeva bhavati, tasmāt tenaiva bhavatā dravyeṇa kāraṇena kāryarūpamāsādyetamāsādyate
anyathā khapuṣparūpamapyāsādyetaiva, nirbījamapyutpādādeva bhavet, tasyotpādādarthāntaratvenābhūtatvāt, aṅkuravat
yattūttareṇa prācyasya na yukto vyapadeśa ityasyottaramucyate na, bhāvidharmavyapadeśāt iti
bhāvinaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sandhāyocyate kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇika iti, maraṇadharmivat
tasyaiva cāsau bhāvasya vyayaḥ prācyasyeti nyāyya eva vyapadeśaḥ bhāvikṣaṇasandhānaṃ ca prathamamevopāttaṃ mayā ātmalābhānantaram ityuktatvāt

nanu pūrvamutpatataiva mayoktam ārhatavādavadutpāda-vināśavatā vastunā sthitimatāpi bhavitavyaṃ bhūtatvāt ityādi, tacca bhavadeva bhavati nābhavat, bhavacca kāraṇaṃ dravyameva utpādaṃ vināśaṃ kāryaṃ vātmasāt karoti āsādayati
tasmāt tenaiva bhavatā dravyeṇa kāraṇena āsādyete kāryotpādāviti

yadyevaṃ neṣyate, atastvanyathā khapuṣparūpamapyāsādyetaiva, nirbījamapi utpādādeva bhavet, utpādo hi bhavatā nirbījo'bhyupagataḥ, sa cotpādo nirbījaḥ kāraṇāni ātmasāt karotītīṣṭaḥ, tasmāt tenotpādena ātmasātkriyeta khapuṣpa-vandhyāsutādyapi
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasya khapuṣpāderutpādādarthāntaratvenā'bhūtatvāt, yad yadutpādādarthāntaratvenābhūtaṃ tat tenā''sādyamānamātmasātkriyamāṇaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā aṅkura utpādenetyāpannam, aniṣṭaṃ caitat
yadasmābhirdūṣaṇamuktam--uttareṇa vināśena prācyasyāsatastatkāle tena vā vināśena samprati asatā na yukto vyapadeśaḥ iti, asyottaraṃ parihārāntaraṃ yaducyate tvayā— na bhāvidharmavyapadeśāditi
tadvyākhyā --bhāvinaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sandhāya ucyate kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇikaḥ iti asahabhāvināpi bhāvinā tadvattā bhavati
kimiva ? maraṇadharmivat, yathā bhāvinā maraṇadharmeṇa tadvān manuṣyādiḥ prāṇī vyapadiśyate tathā prathamakṣaṇo dvitīyakṣaṇenā'sahabhāvināpi bhāvinā kṣaṇika ityapadoṣo vyapadeśaḥ

tasyaiva cāsau bhāvasya vyayaḥ prācyasyeti nyāyya eva vyapadeśaḥ, yadi tāvat kālāntarabhāvinā maraṇadharmeṇāpi vyayātmakena tasyaiva dharmaḥ iti vyapadiśyate bhāvaḥ kimiti punarātmalābhānantarabhāvinā vināśenā''tmīyena prathamakṣaṇa eva kṣaṇika iti nocyate ? bhāvikṣaṇasandhānaṃ kṣaṇika iti tasyotpannasya vyāpārasthitiriktatājñāpanārthaṃ yadvat kṣaṇika āste kṣaṇikaṃ niketanamiti
yuktaṃ yad maraṇadharmiṇi sthita evārthe ātmākhye'bhāvavilakṣaṇe bhāvāntaravilakṣaṇe ca maraṇadharmivyapadeśaḥ
cetyādi, maivaṃ maṃsthāḥ--pratibadhyamānena idānīṃ hetvantaramupāttamiti, kiṃ tarhi ? bhāvikṣaṇasandhānaṃ ca prathamamevopāttaṃ mayā ātmalābhānantaram iti viśeṣyoktatvāt
kṣaṇika iti tasyotpannasya vyāpārasthitiriktatājñāpanārthaṃ yadvat kṣaṇika āste kṣaṇikaṃ niketanamiti
yuktaṃ yad maraṇadharmiṇi sthita evārthe ātmākhye'bhāvavilakṣaṇe bhāvāntaravilakṣaṇe ca maraṇadharmivyapadeśaḥ
ato'nantaraśabdalopaṃ kṛtvāanantarakṣaṇo'syāsti iti vigṛhya anantaraśabdalopaṃ kṛtvā ṭhanpratyaya utpādyate kṣaṇika iti, yathā devadatto devikaḥ devila iti vā ṭhājādāvūrdhvaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ pā॰ 5
kimarthaṃ punarevamucyate ? brūmaḥ --tasyotpannasya vyāpārasthitiriktatājñāpanārtham, utpannaṃ kriyāvirahitaṃ sthitivirahitaṃ ceti jñāpayitum
tadudāharaṇe yathāsaṃkhyam --yadvat kṣaṇika āste niḥkarmetyarthaḥ, kṣaṇikaṃ niketanaṃ sthitapuruṣādirahitaṃ gṛhamityarthaḥ
asmin prakaraṇe yaṣṭho'jādi-pratyayaśca tasmin pratyaye pare prakṛterdvitīyā ca ūrdhvaṃ sarvaṃ lupyate
anukampito devadatto devikaḥ, deviyaḥ devilaḥ, devadattakaḥ
caturthādaca ūrdhvasya lopo vācyaḥ, anukampito bṛhaspatidatto bṛhaspatikaḥ
anajādau ca vibhāṣā lopo vaktavyaḥ, devadattakaḥ, devakaḥ
lopaḥ pūrvapadasya ca, dattikaḥ, dattiyaḥ, dattilaḥ, dattakaḥ
vināpi pratyayaṃ pūrvottarapadayorvā lopo vācyaḥ, devadattaḥ, dattaḥ, devaḥ
uvarṇālla ilasya ca, bhānudattaḥ, bhānulaḥ, ṛvarṇādapi savitriyaḥ, savitṛlaḥ

dravyārthanarthena sthitasya janana-maraṇe yujyete bālādyavasthāniyamaparamparākriyānubhāvinaḥ savyāpārasya sthitasyaivārthasyasyāṃkṣaṇikasyātmākhyasyābhāvavilakṣaṇasya bhāvāntaravilakṣaṇasyeti dṛṣṭāntasya vaidharmyaṃ darśayati, viparyayasādhanād viruddho heturiti
evaṃ sthitameva jāyate jātaṃ ca mriyate sthityavinābhāvinī janma-maraṇe maraṇāvinābhāvi ca janmeti evaṃ loke dṛṣṭatvāt

upadṛṣṭāntaśca --kṛtakatvānityatvetyādi, kṛtakatvadharmā anityatvadharmā cāvasthita eva ghaṭādiḥ śabdānityatvapratijñāyāṃ dṛṣṭānta ucyate yat kṛtakaṃ tadanityaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā ghaṭādiḥ iti nāsthito nātyantābhāvo nāpi tato'rthāntarabhūto vā taddharmāsambandhī ākāśādiriti tadvadavasthitaghaṭādyanityatvasya kṛtakatvena vyapadeśavadavasthitapuruṣamaraṇavyapadeśo janmanā tadavinābhāvāditi dṛṣṭāntasya svapakṣasādhanatāmāpādya dārṣṭāntikatvopasaṃhāraṃ karoti — ghaṭādyanityadharmivyapadeśavad maraṇadharmivyapadeśaḥ
etaccihnāntargataḥ ॰na sthitasya ityata ārabhya sthitasyaivārtha॰ ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratau nāsti
vā sthitaḥ iti ca sthitaḥ iti vā pāṭho'pyatra bhavet

āyuṣkajananamaraṇapariṇato vidyamāna evātmā jāyate mriyate ca, asati ca, kriyānupapatteḥ, tathā cābhiyuktāḥ paṭhanti--mṛṅ prāṇatyāge pā॰ dhā॰ 1404 iti, vyavasthito jīvaḥ prāṇāṃstyajatyupādatte ca, tatra tadbhūtatvāt kiṃ sandhānena ?
yadapyuktaṃ tasyaiva cāsau bhāvasya vyaya iti nyāyya eva vyapadeśa iti tadapi na kiñcit,
āyuḥkarmaṇā vyavasthitena jīvasya janana-maraṇe nāsatā khapuṣpādinā nārthāntareṇātmāparigṛhītaparamāṇvākāśādinā vā
yathoktam— āyugavasena jīvo jāyati jīvati ya āugassudae
aṇṇāyugodae vā marati tu savvāyuṇāse vā
tasmāt tayorjanma-maraṇayordvayorapi tatrāyuḥkarmaṇi sthite vidyamānatvād vidyamāna evātmā svayamudīrṇāyuḥkarmapariṇato jāyate sa eva mriyate bhuktāyuḥkarmatvāt
asati ca kriyānupapatteḥ, nātyantāsati khapuṣpe janma-maraṇādikriyopapadyate nāpyarthāntare tatpariṇāmaśūnye gaganādau
āyugavasena jīvo jāyati jīvati ya āugassudae
anyāyuṣkodaye vā mriyate tu sarvāyurnāśe vā
aṇṇāyugodae vā marati tu savvāyuṇāse vā
tasmādarthatattvasya vyavasthāpanārthāyāḥ pravṛtterarthatattvaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ pravṛttatvād vaiyākaraṇāḥ paṭhanti --mṛṅ prāṇatyāge pā॰ dhā॰ 14.
4 iti, vyavasthito jīvo mriyate prāṇānupāttānindriyā''yurbalocchvāsalakṣaṇāṃstyajati upādatte ca tāneva jāyata iti
tatra tadbhūtatvāt tatraivamprakāre'vasthitaprāṇopādānatyāgalakṣaṇajanma-maraṇātmakāyuṣkarmasādbhūtātmasvarūpatvāt kiṃ sandhānena ? kiṃ prayojanaṃ kalpitena sandhānena ? nāstītyarthaḥ
pañcendriyāṇi āyuḥ manovākkāyabalāni ucchvāsaśceti daśavidhāḥ prāṇāḥ, teṣāmupādānaṃ janma, upāttānāṃ teṣāṃ tyāgo maraṇamiti bhāvaḥ
tasyaiva bhāvasya vyayatvād vināśenotpādasya kṣaṇo'syāstīti kṣaṇikaḥ iti vyapadeśo nyāyādanapeta iti tvayā yaduktaṃ tadapi na kiñcit, nārtho'nenāyuktatvāt

taddarśayati --utpadyamāna-vinaśyatorapi tāvadityādi, yāvetāvutpattṛ-vinaṃṣṭārau bhāvau utpadyamānavinaśyatorapi tāvadabhūtatvāt khapuṣpayoriva sambandhābhāvaḥ, kimaṅga punarutpādavināśayorasattvabhūtatvādavastutvāccāsambhāvyapravṛttyoreva ? api cātrāpi ṣaṣṭhyarthānupapattiḥ asambandhādasahabhāvāt
nanvasahabhavane'pi ṣaṣṭhī vikāraviṣayā, tadyathā--dhānānāṃ saktavaḥ, tandulānāmodanaḥ
etadapi na, dravyaparyāyasahavṛtteḥ, ghaṭasya vināśa iti yathā mṛddravyasyaiva
ataḥ sahabhāvinoreva sambandhādupapadyate'trāpi ṣaṣṭhī bhāvasya vyaya iti
tāvetāvapi tvanmate na staḥ, utpāda evāṅkuraḥ iti vacanāt

tasmāt utpattaiva vinaṃṣṭā ityayuktaṃ vaktum, kimaṅga punarityādi dūrata eva utpadyamāna-vinaśyadarthābhāve tatprabhāvalabhyayorutpāda-vināśayoḥ sambandhakathā, kutaḥ ? tayorasattvabhūtatvāt ? asattvabhūtatvamavastutvācca, na vastunī sto yayostāvutpāda-vināśāvavastu, tadbhāvādavastutvāt, tau cāsambhāvyapravṛttī khapuṣpavadasambhāvyapravṛttyoreva sambandhābhāvaḥ iti vartate

utpadyamānavinaśyatorapi tāvadabhūtatvāt khapuṣpayoriva sambandhābhāvaḥ, kimaṅga punarutpādavināśayorasattvabhūtatvādavastutvāccāsambhāvyapravṛttyoreva ? api cātrāpi ṣaṣṭhyarthānupapattiḥ asambandhādasahabhāvāt
nanvasahabhavane'pi ṣaṣṭhī vikāraviṣayā, tadyathā--dhānānāṃ saktavaḥ, tandulānāmodanaḥ
etadapi na, dravyaparyāyasahavṛtteḥ, ghaṭasya vināśa iti yathā mṛddravyasyaiva
ataḥ sahabhāvinoreva sambandhādupapadyate'trāpi ṣaṣṭhī bhāvasya vyaya iti

yathaiva astyastimatsambandhābhāvādasahabhāvinorutpāda- vināśayoḥ kṣaṇikaḥ iti ṭhanpratyayābhāvaḥ tathā tasyaiva bhāvasya vyayaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhyarthānupapattirapi asambandhāt, sambandhalakṣaṇā hi vibhaktayaḥ, kārakāvivakṣāyāṃ śeṣe sambandhe prātipadikārthavyatireke ṣaṣṭhīvidhānāt, sambandhābhāvaścāsahabhāvāditi
prakṛtyupamardaśca vikāraḥ, tadyathā--dhānānāṃ saktavaḥ tandulānāmodana iti, na hyatra prakṛtirvikṛtyavasthāyāmasti, atha ca prakṛtau ṣaṣṭhī śrūyate dhānānāṃ tandulānām iti

atra brūmaḥ --etadapi na, kasmāt ? dravya-paryāyasahavṛtteḥ, dravyaṃ prakṛtirdhānātandulādiḥ paryāyeṇa viśeṣeṇa vikāreṇa saha vartate, dhānātandulādiprakṛtereva saktvodanatvādivikārapariṇāmāt tathā tathā vyavasthānāt

kimiva ? ghaṭasya vināśa iti yathā mṛddravyasyaiva piṇḍa-śivakādikramabhāvidharmaṇo rūpādisahabhāvidharmaṇaśca ghaṭasyaiva kapālatvena mṛdātmanaḥ paramāṇvādisaṅghātapariṇāmyavayavasaṃsthānāntareṇa vartanaṃ vināśo ghaṭasyesyaiva ityucyate
ataḥ sahabhāvinoreva sambandhādupapadyate'trāpi ṣaṣṭhī bhāvasya vyayaḥ iti bhāvo vīyate, bhavanneva vartate vyeti udeti vetyuktaṃ bhavati dravyārthāparityāgenaivotpāda-vyayavṛtteḥ
ato'nyathā hyadravyayostūtpāda-vināśayornirbījayorvakrastvavaktavyamiti vaktumevāśakyametat, bhāva evāsau vastutvābhimato nāsti, kuto'syotpādo vināśo vā dharmo dravyārthasyasyābhāve khapuṣpasyeva ?
bhavantī hi mṛd dravyārthena bhavati, tadyathā śivakasya stūpakībhāva utpādāt stūpakaḥ, saṃva ca stūpakatvenotpadyamānā vyeti
evaṃ tu bhāva eva na saḥ, pūrvamabhāvāt paścādabhāvāt pūrvaṃ paścāccābhāvāt, vandhyāputravat
yathā tu tvadudgrāha evaṃ prāk paścād madhye cābhāvāt
tadyathā--tvayā hyucyate tasyaiva cāsau bhāvasya vyaya iti
bhāvasya iti kartṛlakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt karmalakṣaṇā vā ? yadi kartṛlakṣaṇā sa eva bhāvo vyeti, na bhavatyutpāda eva
yadi karmalakṣaṇā tato vināśakartṛkaḥ kenotpādo nivartyeta ? tasmāt sa eva na bhavatyutpāda iti madhye'pyabhāvaḥ

tadvaidharmyeṇa dravyārthavādina evotpāda-vināśopapattipradarśanārthamāha --bhavantī hi mṛd dravyārthena bhavantyeva bhavantī svarūpamatyajantī bhavati utpadyate, tadyathā--śivakasya stūpakībhāva utpādāt stūpaka iti nidarśanam
saiva ca mṛd bhavantī vyeti, tannidarśanam --stūpakatvenotpadyamānā śivakatvād vyetīti

bhavanāddhi bhāvaḥ, bhāvasya vyayaḥ ityatra yo'yaṃ bhāvaśabdaḥ so'pyevamasmaduktadravyārthaviṣaya eva ghaṭate yadarthasya vyaya ucyate, nānyathā, yattvabhavat khapuṣpādi adravyaṃ tannotpadyate na vyeti vā
itthamuktanyāyena tvayokto bhāvaḥ sa bhāva eva na bhavati
tathā paścādabhāvāditi bhāva eva sa na iti vartate
evametau pratyekaṃ hetū, samuditāvapi, tadyathā --pūrvaṃ paścāccābhāvāditi
trayāṇāmapi hetūnāṃ vandhyāputravat ityeka eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ
tvanmatenaiva caite hetavaḥ siddhāḥ, utpādakṣaṇasyaiva sattvābhyupagamāt
ato bhāva eva na sa iti sādhūktam
pūrvamabhāvāt paścādabhāvāt bhavanābhāvādityarthaḥbhāva eva na saḥ ityapi pāṭho'tra bhavet
sāpi na kāryā pratyāśā, kasyāmapyavasthāyāmasattvāt, tata āha --yathā tu tvadudgrāha evaṃ prāk paścād madhye cābhāvāt bhāva eva na saḥ iti vartate

adhunā tvanmate vartamānakṣaṇe'pyasattve sādhite prāk paścāccābhāvatvaṃ siddhameva bhavatīti tat sādhayitumāha tvadvacanādeva, tadyathā— tvayā hyucyate tasyaiva cāsau bhāvasya vyayaḥ iti vyapadeśaprasiddhisādhanārthena vacanena

tasya cāyamartho bhāvasya iti kartṛlakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt karmalakṣaṇā vā ? yadi kartṛlakṣaṇā sa eva bhāva utpādo vyeti vinaśyati na bhavati, tenaiva vīyate na bhūyate vinaśyatītyuktaṃ bhavati, ko'sau na bhavati ? utpāda eva
yadi karmalakṣaṇā tato vināśakartṛkaḥ kenotpādo nivartyeta ? ityayukta eva bhāvaḥ

tvanmate tu tasyā api svakālasamavasthāyidravyavṛttavikārāntaragaterasambhavāt tadāsāvasannihita eva bhāvaḥ kathaṃ vyeti ityucyate ? yadi yadā sannihitastadaiva vyeti naiva tarhyutpadyate, na sannihitaḥ, na bhavati
athotpadyate bhavati sannihitaḥ, na tarhi vyeti utpādavyayayorvipratiṣedhāt, kuta eva tattvadvacanaṃ tasyaiva bhāvasya vyaya iti
evaṃ cottaro'pyasya vināśakṣaṇo naiva bhavati yatastadapekṣaḥ kṣaṇika ityucyeta, anutpannatvāt, khapuṣpavat ākāśavadvā
dvayābhāve tu yadi sadeva ced vastviṣyate tata ārhatābhimatadravyārthasadbhāve kṣaṇe kṣaṇe tasmāt sa eva na bhavatyutpāda iti madhye'pyabhāvaḥ
tasmāt prāk paścād madhye cābhāvād bhāvasya vyayaḥ iti vacanāt kṣaṇikaśabdo nārthavān syāt
vināśakartā kaḥ ? kenotpādo nivartyeta ? ityapi pāṭho'tra syāt

tvanmate tu tasyā api svakālasamavasthāyidravyavṛttavikārāntaragaterasambhavāt tadāsāvasannihita eva bhāvaḥ kathaṃ vyeti ityucyate ? yadi yadā sannihitastadaiva vyeti naiva tarhyutpadyate, na sannihitaḥ, na bhavati
athotpadyate bhavati sannihitaḥ, na tarhi vyeti utpādavyayayorvipratiṣedhāt, kuta eva tattvadvacanaṃ tasyaiva bhāvasya vyaya iti
evaṃ cottaro'pyasya vināśakṣaṇo naiva bhavati yatastadapekṣaḥ kṣaṇika ityucyeta, anutpannatvāt, khapuṣpavat ākāśavadvā
dvayābhāve tu yadi sadeva ced vastviṣyate tata ārhatābhimatadravyārthasadbhāve kṣaṇe kṣaṇe

api ca tandulānāmodanaḥ ityatra odanasya vikārasyātmalābhakāle dravyārthatastandulānāṃ samavasthāyitvādodanena saha sthāsnutvād vikārāntaramodanatvaṃ tatra dravye vṛttaṃ gaccheyuḥ āpadyeraṃstandulāḥ, sambhavediyaṃ gatiridṛśī

tvanmate tu tasyā api svakālasamavasthāyidravyavṛttavikārāntaragaterasambhavāt tadvaidharmyāt tadāsāvasannihita eva bhāva utpādastvadiṣṭo'sanneva kathaṃ vyeti ityucyate ? khapuṣpavadasannihitaḥ kena nyāyena vyeti iti śakyate vaktum ?
syānmatam--yadā sannihitastadā vyeti ityucyate iti nanūktam
atrocyate, sampradhāraḥ sa eva vartate--tadevāyuktamiti, yadi yadā sannihitastadaiva vyeti naiva tarhi utpadyate, na sannihitaḥ, na bhavati, nāstītyarthaḥ
athotpadyate bhavati sannihitaḥ, na tarhi vyeti

kasmāt ? utpādavyayayorvipratiṣedhāt, viruddhaḥ pratiṣedho vipratiṣedhaḥ, utpādo vyayena virudhyate vyayaścotpādena, ato viruddhatvāt parasparanivāritatvād vipratiṣedhāt kuta eva tattattvadvacanaṃ tasyaiva bhāvasya vyayaḥ iti ? dūrata eva na ghaṭate bhāvābhāvāditi
