doṣadikpradarśanārthaṃ tayaiva diśāha--sarvaśūnyavādagatapakṣadharmādyabhāvaśca na sādhyaḥ, asiddhyādipakṣāsiddhau parāyattādihetavo na sidhyantyevānayoktadiśeti sphuṭatvānnātrābhiniviśāmahe
api ca vijñānābhyupagamādityādi yāvat sato vijñānalakṣaṇatvāditi
tvayaivābhyupaga- tamasiddhyādihetubhirbāhyārthanaiḥsvābhāvyamāpādya vijñānamātramevedaṃ sarvaṃ svapnasiṃhādivajjāgratsiṃhadarśana puruṣa evedaṃ sava yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam
yadi tanmātraṃ kiṃ svapno'svapnaḥ ? svapnasya jāgaraṇād viśeṣaṇaṃ na ghaṭate, ubhayorapyabhāvatulyatvāt

putrajanmādi-bhaya-harṣa-sukha-duḥkhādivijñānamapi ityataḥ sarvasya vijñānalakṣaṇasyaiva sattvāt tasya ca sarvatvāt sarvametadvijñānamātram, sa ca puruṣa eva jñaḥ, tanmayaṃ cedamatītānāgatābhimatamapi vartamānameva stimitasaraḥsalilataraṅgabudbudādyavasthāvat suṣupta-supta-jāgarita-turīyākhyacaturavasthāmātrabhedamabhinnamastyevāstītyabhyupagataṃ bhavati
etat puruṣasūktaṃ vyākhyātaṃ tatraiveti na punarvivriyate
puruṣa evedaṃ sava yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam
yadi tanmātraṃ kiṃ svapno'svapnaḥ ? svapnasya jāgaraṇād viśeṣaṇaṃ na ghaṭate, ubhayorapyabhāvatulyatvāt
pṛ॰ 136 paṃ॰ 8, pṛ॰ 144 paṃ॰ 11, pṛ॰ 189 paṃ॰ 5, ṭipṛ॰ 59 paṃ॰ 2
svapnasiṃhadarśanabhayādivat ityudāhṛtya kalpanāmātratvasya pratipāditatvād grāhyābhāvaḥ, grāhyābhāve grāhakatvasyābhāvaḥ
yathoktaṃ tadabhāve tadapyasaditi pratyuccāraṇameva tadarthaṃ yāvat svapnamudāharadbhiriti

yadi tanmātraṃ kimityādi, yadi vijñānameva svapno'svapno na bhavati, tasmin svapne siṃhadarśanamasadeva bhayanimittam, vibuddhasya bhayāpagamo'sattve svapnasiṃhasya, jāgratsiṃhadarśanaṃ ca sākṣānmṛtyunimittaṃ satyameva, prītihetuśca jāgratputradarśanam, svapne'tadapekṣaṃ vibuddhe prītyapagamāt
tattu tvatpakṣe svapnasya jāgaraṇād viśeṣaṇaṃ na ghaṭate, kasmāt ? ubhayorapyabhāvatulyatvāt khapuṣpasya vandhyāsutādiveti
jāgarajñānaṃ pramāṇarūpaṃ svapnajñānaṃ pramāṇābhāsarūpamiti vivakṣāyāṃ ॰satvāt iti sādhu

sarvaśūnyatāyāṃ ceṣyamāṇāyāṃ svapnāsvapnādivyavahārābhāvaprasaṅga eveti darśayannāha--savvābhāve ca kao sumiṇo sumiṇotti saccamaliyaṃ ti viśeṣāvaśyakabhā॰ 1705 sarvābhāve ca sarvaśūnyatāyāṃ cābhyupagamyamānāyāṃ svapno'yam, asvapno'yam iti kutaḥ ? kiṃkṛto'yaṃ viśeṣa ityarthaḥ
athocyeta--vijñānāstitvamapi kaḥ pratipadyate kalpanāmātratvāt ? vijñānāddhi vijñānaṃ tadvijñeyābhāve kutastat ? svapne tatkāraṇasya vijñeyasyābhāvāt
syānmatam--bhāvyadṛṣṭāntayorjāgara-svapnavijñānayorarthābhāvatulyatvaṃ tathāpi tvatprasiddhābhāvārthena svapnenaiva jāgarābhāvārthatvapratipādanaṃ sukaraṃ tvanmatyanuvṛttyā kriyate
ayaṃ hi pratipādyasya materanurodha upāyaḥ pratipādayitumabhāvatulyatve'pīti
etacca na, ubhayorapyabhāvatulyatvāt, materapyamaterbhedena viśeṣaṇaṃ pratipādyasya pratipādakāderapratipādyād viśeṣaṇam ityādyapyabhāvatulyatvānna ghaṭata eva
kiñcānyat, svapnadṛṣṭānto'pi khapuṣpavyudasanena ca svapnasiṃhadarśanavat iti vacanaṃ ghaṭate khapuṣpaṃ na bhavati siṃha iti
svapnadṛṣṭāntavyākhyāne ca vṛthābhaya-harṣādi viśeṣaṇamavṛthābhaya-harṣādinā vinā na bhavitumarhati
kiñcānyat, vijñānaviṣayā cāstitā nanu sthitaiva, vijñānamātram iti bruvatā vijñānāstitvamabhyupagatameva tvayā, tataśca sarvaṃ niḥsvabhāvam ityetad mithyā
kiñca, nirbhedaṃ ca nāstitvaṃ nāstyeva, kutaścit sato vastuno viśeṣya sadeva śakyaṃ vaktuṃ nāstīti khapuṣpasya puṣpaṃ nāsti nāśokasya iti, nāviśeṣya
tasmānna śūnyatvaṃ sarvasya, sarvamiti sattvameva tat tathā tena prakāreṇa svapnavijñānasiṃhāderapi nāstitvamanyāstitvaṃ sādhayatīti

vijñānāstitvamapi kaḥ pratipadyate, kalpanāmātratvāt ? asiddhyādihetubhya eva svapnavannāsti vijñānamapi, vijānāti iti hi vijñānaṃ syāt, sā ca vijñānakriyā kartṛtvaṃ vā vijñānasya nāsti vijñeyakarmābhāvāt svapne

tat pradarśayannāha --vijñānāddhi vijñānaṃ tadvijñeyābhāve kutastat ? vijānāti iti vijñānasya vijñānatvaṃ syāt, tadvijñeye karmaṇyasati kutaḥ ? nāsti kutaścit kāraṇāt, svapne tatkāraṇasya vijñeyasyābhāvāt
vibuddhe'pyevameveti jāgradvijñānasyāpi svapnavijñānavad vijñeyābhāve vijñānatvābhāvāt kā vijñānāstitvāśā ? iti

vijānāti vijñānam ityavijñānāt svapnājjāgradvijñānaṃ viśeṣyate tvayaiva, avijñānam iti ca svapno jāgradvijñānāt, tathā vijñeyam ityavijñeyāt svapnaviṣayādarthā tathā vijñāna-bhāvādiṣu nañaḥ kā gatiḥ ? kiṃ prāgādiviśeṣeṇa nāsti utāviśeṣeṇavaṇaiva ? yadi viśeṣya nāsti tataḥ prākpaścāditaretarāsāmarthyāsaṃyogebhyo nanu nirvṛttā'dhvasta-tat-samartha-sambaddhaghaṭāstitvameva prasajyate
atha kathaṃ punarvandhyāputro na bhavati ? yadi tadviṣayo'tyantābhāvaḥ syāt vandhyāputro na sambhavet

tadyathā--bhavacca tad dravyaṃ cetanamace- bhāsājjāgradviṣayo rūpādirarthaḥ, jāgradviṣayācca vijñeyāt avijñeyam iti svapnaviṣayaṃ vastu taccātacca bhedenābhyupagamyate jñāna-vacanaviṣayatayā sadvāda evābhyupagato'tra tvayā

tathā vijñāna-bhāvādiṣu nañaḥ kā gatiḥ ? kiṃ prāgādiviśeṣeṇa nāsti utāviśeṣeṇavaṇaiva ? yadi viśeṣya nāsti tataḥ prākpaścāditaretarāsāmarthyāsaṃyogebhyo nanu nirvṛttā'dhvasta-tat-samartha-sambaddhaghaṭāstitvameva prasajyate
atha kathaṃ punarvandhyāputro na bhavati ? yadi tadviṣayo'tyantābhāvaḥ syāt vandhyāputro na sambhavet

vijñānamapi vijñānaṃ na bhavati, bhāvo bhāvo na bhavati ityādiṣu nañaḥ kā gatiḥ ? vicārya tvayā vācyam, kimatra niścitaṃ sattvamasattvaṃ vijñānādeḥ ? kiṃ prāgādiviśeṣeṇa nāstīti utāviśeṣeṇaiva ? iti nirdhārya brūhi

tatra yadi viśeṣya nāsti ityucyate tataḥ prākpaścāditaretarāsāmarthyāsaṃyogebhyaḥ yathā ghaṭaḥ prāg nāsti mṛdādyavasthāyāṃ paścāt kapālatve itaretaratayā paṭatve asāmarthye chidrabudhnatve asaṃyoge gehe nāstīti tato yathāsaṅkhyaṃ nanu nirvṛttetyādi, prāgabhāve nirvṛtto'sti iti nañ viśeṣayati, paścādabhāve'pi adhvasto'sti iti, itaretarābhāve so'sti, asāmarthyābhāve samartho'sti, gehasaṃyogābhāve bahiḥsaṃyogo'sti iti
vijñānamavijñānaṃ na bhavati, bhāvo'bhāvo na bhavati iti pāṭho'pyatra sambhāvyate

atha mā bhūdevaṃ nirvṛttāstitvādiprasaṅga ityaviśeṣya nāsti, na bhavati ityādiparyāyairasiddhyādihetubhyo vandhyāputrādivadaviśeṣāṣyā'tyantaṃ nāstītyucyate evaṃ cenmanyase, atrāpi brūmaḥ --atha kathaṃ punarityādi, bandhyāputranāstitvamapi atyantābhāvābhimatamasiddham, ato nirvṛttā-'dhvasta-tat-sāmarthya-sambandhapramāṇādiviśeṣapratiṣedhavācinaiva nañā sāmānādhikaraṇyād bhavatyeveti vayaṃ sambhāvayāmaḥ

yadi vandhyāputro'tyantābhāvaḥ syāt nirvṛttyādimatprāgabhāvādisvabhāveṣu na sambhavet, sambhavati tu svayaṃ bhavitṛtvena, tasmānnātyantābhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? sambhavatyevāsya nirvṛttyādi bhavitṛtvabhākṣvartheṣu
tadyathā--bhavacca tat sambhāvyate dravyaṃ cetanamacetanaṃ ca dvividham
acetanasyāpi tadbhāvānatiriktatvādanādyanantaviparivartānyathātvāda viruddhaṃ vandhyāputratvam tadanyonyānugatimantareṇa tadabhāvāt śarīrārambhavat

tatra cetanasyetyādi, idaṃ hi cetanamātmadravyamanādyanantabhaveṣu bhavitumutsahate, kutaḥ ? karmaparivartānyathātvāt, anādyanantakarmabandhasantānasya viparivartāstiryaṅ-nara-narakā-'marabhavāḥ, te cānādyanantā bhavanaśīlā eva svajātyaparityāgenā'nyathā'nyathā'nyathābhavantaḥ, itaradravyavat pudgaladravyavat, yathā pudgaladravyaṃ rūpa-rasa-gandha-sparśalakṣaṇamūrtyācaitanyāparityāgena bhūmyudaka-vahni-pavana-vanaspati-trasa-śarīriśarīra-śītoṣṇa-tamaśchāyā-''tapodyotādiparivartamanyathā tathā cānubhavati tathā cetanātmakarmaparivartānubhāvimanuṣyastrīvandhyāvātvābhyāṃ pracyutya janmāntare manuṣyatvotpattau strītvotpattau vā putravattve dravyārthābhedāt saiva vandhyā putravatī jāyata ityatra vandhyāputra ityenamarthaṃ daṇḍakena darśayati— anantarabhavavandhyetyādinā yāvat prabandhātmakatvāt avandhyātve'pi, kasmāt ? tadbhāvānatiriktatvāt, tasmāt pūrvasmād bhāvādanatiriktaḥ sakarmā cetanaḥ, tadvat pūrvavandhyātvavat putravattvaparyāyasambhūtāvapi bālakumāravadveti dṛṣṭāntāntaraṃ lokasiddham, yathā bālaḥ kumāro yuvā ityādiparyāyeṣvapi sa eva bhavati tathā vandhyā-putravattvāvasthayoreka eva jīva iti
acetanasyāpi tadbhāvānatiriktatvādanādyanantaviparivartānyathātvāda viruddhaṃ vandhyāputratvam tadanyonyānugatimantareṇa tadabhāvāt śarīrārambhavat

tadyathā--vandhyāśarīragatānāṃ pudgalānāmutsṛṣṭānāṃ keśa-nakha-danta-mūtraśakṛt-sveda-rasa-rudhira-māṃsādīnāṃ mṛttva-vrīhyāditvasambhūtau a ?vandhyayā striyā puṃsā vā''hāritānāṃ rakta-śukratvādibhāvena copāttānāṃ putratvenotpattāvapi vandhyāputrāstitvaṃ tadbhāvānatiriktatvādanādyanantaviparivartānyathātvāt ityādinā nyāyenāviruddhaṃ vandhyāputratvam

tat sādhayati --tadanyonyānugatimantareṇa tadabhāvāt, yad yadanyonyānugatimantareṇa na bhavati tat tat tasyaiva tadeva vā, śarīrārambhavat, yathā śarīraṃ teṣāṃ pudgalānāmanādyanantabhavabhāviparivartānyathātvādanyonyānugatimantareṇābhāvācca tānyeva tāni jīvapudgaladravyāṇi tathā vandhyāyā eva pudgalāḥ putrapudgalā ityapyaviruddhaṃ vandhyāputratvam

tasmāt sarvamidaṃ sarvasvabhāvamaśūnyamiti pratipattavyam aśūnyagṛhavat praveṣṭṛsthātṛnirgantṛkalpotpādasthitivināśasahitameva sarvamekamanekātmakaṃ vyavahārapravyaktāparikalpitatadatadākāraṃ svataḥ parata ubhayataścāstyeva
yadi tvasvaviṣayametat syāt, nānāmikā madhyamādīrghatāyāmapi kaniṣṭhikāto dīrghā syāt, na ca madhyamā śakrayaṣṭidīrghatāyām

sarvaśūnyavāde sādhana-dūṣaṇāsambhavāt pratipādya-pratipādakavyavahārābhāvāt vijñānamātrapakṣasyāpi sarvaikajñapuruṣamātratvābhyupagamāpatteḥ svapna-vandhyāputrādidṛṣṭāntānāṃ ca sarvasarvātmakatve sati asiddheḥ idaṃ sarvasvabhāvamaśūnyam iti pratipattavyam tvaduktārthaviparyayeṇa aśūnyagṛhavat praveṣṭṛva-sthātṛpraveṣṭṛ-sthātṛ-nirgantṛkalpairutpāda-sthiti-vināśaiḥ sahitameva sarvamekamanekātmakamaṅgulivakrapraguṇatvādivat vicitravarṇakṛkalāsavadvā vyavahāreṇa pravyajyamānaiḥ saha-kramabhāvibhiraparikalpitaireva satyairbhedairnityādibhistaccātacca vastu tadatadākāravipariṇāmadarśanād vyavahārapravyaktāparikalpitatadatadākāraṃ svataḥ parata ubhayataścāstyeva, na nāsti iti grāhyamuktanyāyāt
etadaṅkitaḥ pravyajya॰ ityata ārabhya vyavahāra॰ ityantaḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratau nāsti

saṃsiddhistāvatsam ityekībhāve, sarve bhāvā bhedābhimatāḥ sāmānyāntarbhūtāḥ parasparamekībhūtāḥ sidhyantītyata āha --saṃsiddhistadātmabhedaikībhāvena sadbhāvaḥ, saṃsiddhiḥ sahabhāvaḥ sahanirvṛttiryugapadvṛttirityanarthāntaram

yadi svatvasvaviṣayametat kaniṣṭhikāhrasvatvāpekṣamanāmikādīrghatvaṃ tvanmatena syāt nānāmikā madhyamādīrghatāyāmapi kaniṣṭhikāto dīrghā syāt, madhyamāṃ dīrghāṃ dṛṣṭvā svagatena hrasvatvapariṇāmena hrasvā satī dīrghā punarna syādevārthāntarāpekṣayāpi svātmanyavidyamānadīrghatvāt khapuṣpavat madhyamāyattahrasvatvāt, bhavati tu dīrghāpi svāyattakaniṣṭhikāpekṣasvagatadīrghatvapariṇāmāt

tathā na ca madhyamā śakrayaṣṭidīrghatāyāṃ śakrayaṣṭyapekṣamadhyamāhrasvapariṇāmāt svagatād hrasveti na cānāmikāpekṣāt svadīrghatva svagatanānārūpyānatikramāttu ekapuruṣapitṛputratvādivat tathā tathā niyamavṛtterhrasvatvadīrghatvāvyāghātaḥ
hrasve'pi ca dīrghatvaṃ dīrghatve'pi hrasvatvam, apratidbandvitvāt, iṣṭahrasvadīrghasvātmavat
pariṇāmāt dīrghā syāt iti vartate, bhavati tu
tasmādanāmikāyā madhyamāyāśca kaniṣṭhikāpekṣābhimataṃ dīrghatvaṃ svāyattameva dīrghatarāpekṣe hrasvatve saṃvṛtte'pi sasvato hrasvatarāpekṣayā dīrghatvasyāvasthitatvāt
evaṃ hrasvatvamapītyanenaiva nyāyena kaniṣṭhikāyā hrasvatvamapi svāyattameva ityatidiśati
yadi hyasvaviṣayametat syāt na kaniṣṭhikā'nāmikādīrghatāyāmapi saparvāvayavādibhyo dīrghā syāt, na cānāmikā madhyamādīrghatāyāmiti
॰bhāve sarve bhāvā bhedābhimatāḥ sāmānyāntarbhūtāḥ parasparamekībhāve sarve bhāvā bhedābhimatāḥ sāmānyāntarbhūtāḥ parasparamekī॰ pra॰
hrasve'pi ca dīrghatvaṃ dīrghatve'pi hrasvatvam, apratidbandvitvāt, iṣṭahrasvadīrghasvātmavat

kasmāddhetoḥ ? svagatanānārūpyānatikramāttu yasmādātmagatā eva tāstāḥ sāpekṣa-nirapakṣāḥ pariṇāmaśaktayo hrasva-dīrgha-sthūla-kṛśa-laghu-guru-nityā-'nitya-mūrtā-'mūrta-cetanā-'cetanādayaḥ pudgalānā- manyeṣāṃ cākāśā-''tma-kālādīnāṃ sve sve pariṇāmā jainendradarśanāt sarvasarvātmakadravyārthanaye vā vidhividhyādibhaṅgāntare

kimiva ? ekapuruṣapitṛputratvādivat, yathaika eva puruṣaḥ svaputrāpekṣayā pitṛtvena pariṇataḥ svapitrapekṣayā ca putratvena tathā mātula-bhāgineya-bhrātṛ-śvaśura-pautra-dauhitra-bhrātrīyaprācyodīcya-hrasva-dīrgha-paṇḍita-mūrkha-svāmi-dāsādiśaktibhiḥ pariṇamati svagatābhirāpekṣakṣikaiśca jñāna-darśana-sukha-duḥkha-krodha-harṣa-bhayādibhirutpāda-vyaya-dhrauvyalakṣaṇatvād vastutvāt
na ca tāḥ śaktayastatrāvidyamānāḥ sambhāvyante khapuṣpādāviva

na ca tāsāṃ śaktīnāṃ parasparavirodho nāpyanavasthā na ca saṅkaraḥ svaputrāpekṣayā pitṛtvasya niyatatvāt, evaṃ śeṣāṇāmapītyata āha dārṣṭāntikam --tathā tathā niyamavṛtteḥ hrasvatva-dīrghatvāvyāghāta iti etad virodhābhāvopanayanam, tathā saṅkarā-'navasthādoṣābhāvopanayanamapi draṣṭavyam

anenaiva svagatanānārūpyānatikramāttvekapuruṣapitṛ-putratvavat tathā niyamapravṛtterhrasvatva-dīrghatvāvyāghāta iti doṣaparihāranyāyena hrasvasadbhāvo dīrghasyābhāvo na bhavatīti sahānavasthānadoṣaparihāraḥ kṛto bhavatīti tasmādeva hetoruktadṛṣṭāntavat
tathā itaretarāśrayatvādasiddhiḥ ityeṣo'pi doṣo nāsti uktavat svāśrayatvādeva
ata evāpratidvandvitvam, viruddhābhimatasarvadharmāvirodhavṛttatvāt ata, itthaṃ sādhanam --hrasve'pi ca dīrghatvamiti pakṣaḥ, dvitīyo dīrghatve'pi hrasvatvamiti
sa ca tadatadatītānāgatavartamāneṣu aviśiṣṭa eka eva tadbhāve bhāvāt tadabhāve'bhāvāt ghaṭa-pāṃśu-karpāsatantu-paṭavat

tatra astyeko ghaṭaḥ iti trayāṇāmekatve yatraikatvaṃ tatrāstitvasyāpi niṣkalena svatattvena bhavitavyam, anarthāntaratvāt, yatra yasyānarthāntaratvaṃ tatra tasya niṣkalameva svatattvaṃ bhavati ekasminnekatvasvatattvavat

astitvasvatattvaṃ ca sarva- iṣṭahrasva-dīrghasvātmavat, iṣṭasya hrasvasya svātmā tena svātmanā hrasvatvenāpratidvandvitvād hrasve bhavatyevaṃ hrasve dīrghatvaṃ bhavati dīrghe'pi hrasvatvaṃ hrasvātmavaditi virodhadoṣo'pi parihṛta ittham
sa ca tadatadatītānāgatavartamāneṣu aviśiṣṭa eka eva tadbhāve bhāvāt tadabhāve'bhāvāt ghaṭa-pāṃśu-karpāsatantu-paṭavat

tatra astyeko ghaṭaḥ iti trayāṇāmekatve yatraikatvaṃ tatrāstitvasyāpi niṣkalena svatattvena bhavitavyam, anarthāntaratvāt, yatra yasyānarthāntaratvaṃ tatra tasya niṣkalameva svatattvaṃ bhavati ekasminnekatvasvatattvavat
iṣṭasya hrasvasya svātmā hrasve bhavati ityanvayaḥ
yo'pi tadanantaramitaretarayogadoṣodbhāvanāya vicāraḥ kṛtastasyānavatāra eva, sva-parobhayebhyo bhavane sarvabhedānāṃ virodhābhāvapratipādanādeva tadgatadoṣaparihārasyāpi kṛtatvāt
ata āha— evameva cetaretarayogavicārānavatāra iti gatārtham
tad bhāvayati --iha bhāva eva bhāvo nābhāva iti sarvabhedaśakti bhavatyeva bhavati vastu na na bhavati ityuktatvāt
sa cetyādi, sa ca bhāvaḥ tadatadatītā-'nāgata-vartamāneṣu tasminnatasmiṃśca vṛtte vartamāne vartsyati ca deśa-kālaviśiṣṭābhimateṣu aviśiṣṭa eka eva
kasmāt ? tadbhāve bhāvāt tadabhāve'bhāvāt, teṣu teṣu svabhedeṣu bhavatsveva bhavati abhavatsu na bhavati atastadbhāve bhāvāt tadabhāve cābhāvādaviśiṣṭa eva tebhya ekaḥ

kimiva ? ghaṭa-pāṃśu-karpāsa-tantu-paṭavat, yathā ghaṭaḥ kapāla-śakalādikrameṇa pāṃśubhūtaḥ, pāṃśurmṛt, mṛdi karpāsabījasambandhāt karpāsībhūtāyāṃ tantavaḥ, tantubhyaḥ paṭa iti krameṇa ghaṭa-paṭaikatvavat sarvasarvaikyamiti sthite'sminnyāye tatra astyeko ghaṭaḥ iti trayāṇāmekatvameva, sati caikatve yatraikatvaṃ tatrāstitvasyāpi niṣkalena svatattvena bhavitavyam, kasmāt ? anarthāntaratvāt
asya hetoḥ sādhyenānvitatvaṃ pradarśyate --yatra yasyetyādi yāvat svatattvaṃ bhavatīti gatārtham
kimiva ? ekasminnekatvasvatattvavat, yathaikasmin vastuni ekatvasvatatvaṃ tato'narthāntaratvānniṣkalameva bhavati tathaikatve'stitvamapi niṣkalameva bhavitumarhatīti
astitvasvatattvaṃ ca sarvabhāvā iti pareṇāniṣṭamāpādayitumuktam, mama tu sarvaśakti ekaṃ vastvicchata iṣṭameveti na doṣaḥ
astitvaikatvābhyāmananye sarvabhāvāḥ ghaṭādayaḥ, ekaśca ghaṭastadananyadastitvam, saṃśca ghaṭastadananyadekatvam iti ghaṭe sarvasiddhiḥ
tathā ghaṭatvaṃ yatra tatrāstitvaikatvayorapi niṣkalenaiva svatattvena bhavitavyam, anarthāntaratvāt, yatra yasyānarthāntaratvaṃ tatra tasya niṣkalameva svatattvaṃ bhavati ghaṭa iva ghaṭasvatattvasya
kiñcānyat, yatrāstitvamityādi dvitīyamaniṣṭāpādanaṃ pareṇoktaṃ tadapīṣṭameveti pūrvavat parihāra iti manyamānastathaiva sādhanaṃ pūrvavadityatidiśati

tadyathā --yatrāstitvaṃ tatraikatvasyāpi niṣkalenaiva svatattvena bhavitavyam, tato'narthāntaratvāt, yatra yasyānarthāntaratvaṃ tatra tasya niṣkalameva svatattvam, astitve'stisvatattvavat, ekatvasvatattvaṃ ca sarvasminnekaikasmin ekaikamastyekaṃ cetyato'- stitvaikatvābhyāmananye sarvabhāvāḥ
saṃśca ghaṭa iti sattvenaikatvāvyatirekadvāreṇa paghaṭaikatvāstitvābhyāṃ sarvabhāvaghaṭatvaṃ yathā evaṃ ghaṭe sarvasiddhiḥ astitvāvyatirekādekatvāvyatirekatvācceti ghaṭe sarvasiddhiruktā
tathā ghaṭatvamityādinā ghaṭe astitvaikatvāvyatirekatvādanarthāntaratvādinā'stitvaikatvāvyatirekād ghaṭavat sarvaḥ paṭādirapi ghaṭaḥ
tathā'pādiḥ udakādirapi ghaṭa eva yāvān bhāvaḥ, na me kaściddoṣaḥ, matpakṣasādhanā eva te hetavaḥ

tannidarśanam--deśamātrabhede tāvat ūrdhvamadhyabudhnadeśabhede'pyabhinnaḥ sa evaiko'sti ca ghaṭaḥ, kālamātrabhede'pi bāla-kumārādibhede sa evaiko naraḥ, tathā sarvabhāvāḥ, parasparato deśa-kālā-''kārādimātrabhede'pi ekabhavanāviśiṣṭatvādabhinna eka eva bhāvo bhinna ivābhāti
evamuktanyāyena sarvātmakamevakamevāsti nityaṃ sarvagataṃ sarvabhedasvabhāvaṃ ca vastviti pratyakṣādipramāṇairupalabhāmahe
ato'nyathā pratyakṣādivirodhāḥ, ghaṭasya kapāla-mṛt-karpāsa ete cenneṣyante sarvaṃ ghaṭo'styeka iti pratipattavyam, ghaṭānarthāntaratvāt, ghaṭasvātmavat
ghaṭo hi ghaṭa evopalabhyate na tvasau paṭo'pīti
atha punaḥ sāmānye ghaṭasyāstitvaikatve syātāṃ tataḥ sarvarūpa upalabhyeta ghaṭaḥ
ko vā bravīti nopalabhyata iti ? 'na bhoḥ ! ahamupalabhyamānameva sarvarūpaṃ santaṃ tantu-paṭa-vrīhyudakādiparivartasya pratyakṣaṃ darśanāt pratyakṣavirodhastadbhāvameva sarvātmakamanicchataḥ
ete cenneṣyante sarvaṃ ghaṭo'styeka iti pratipattavyam, ghaṭānarthāntaratvāt, ghaṭasvātmavat
ghaṭo hi ghaṭa evopalabhyate na tvasau paṭo'pīti
atha punaḥ sāmānye ghaṭasyāstitvaikatve syātāṃ tataḥ sarvarūpa upalabhyeta ghaṭaḥ
ko vā bravīti nopalabhyata iti ? 'na bhoḥ ! ahamupalabhyamānameva sarvarūpaṃ santaṃ
ete cenneṣyante mā bhūvannete doṣā iti maduktaṃ yāvat kiñcit tat sarvaṃ ghaṭo'styeka iti pratipattavyam, kasmāt ? ghaṭānarthāntaratvāt, ghaṭasvātmavaditi sādhanamupasaṃhārārtham

yat punaruktam astyekaghaṭānāṃ trayāṇāṃ nānātve viparītasvabhāvatvaṃ ghaṭabahutvamabhāvatvaṃ ca prāpnuyuḥ iti vikalpāntarāśaṅkayā vicārāntaraṃ kṛtaṃ tatra brūmaḥ --viparītasvabhāvā-'bhāva-bahutvādyāśaṅkānavatāra eva, anyatvānabhyupagamāt sarvaśaktyekavastutadātmabhedaikībhāvena saṃsiddhisadbhāvābhyupagamādapratijñātavyāsyāropaṇaṃ tat svamativilasitamātrameva te
pṛ॰ 837 paṃ॰ 20, pṛ॰ 839 paṃ॰ 1, pṛ॰ 840 paṃ॰ 2

idaṃ tāvad nāstitvaṃ pratyakṣādipramāṇasiddham--ghaṭādi anyadanyena prakāreṇa uṣṭrādyapyanyadanyena ghaṭo'pi paṭāduṣṭro'pi gardabhādanyo'nyathā pratyakṣādibhirupalabhyate nāstīti, tadyathā--ghaṭaḥ paṭatvena nāsti paṭo'pi ghaṭatvenetyādi
tad bhāvayati --ghaṭo hītyādi, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmād ghaṭo ghaṭa evopalabhyate na tvasau paṭo'pīti upalabhyate, tasmāt pratyakṣata eva ghaṭaḥ paṭatvena nāsti

atha punastvanmatena yadi sāmānye ghaṭasya tasyāstitvaikatve syātāṃ tatastvaduktanyāyena sarvarūpa upalabhyeta ghaṭaḥ paṭa-kaṭa-rathādirūpaḥ, na tūpalabhyate, tasmānnāsti paṭāditveneti pararūpeṇābhāvaḥ
sarvarūpa upalabhyata eva, nopalabhyate iti tvanmukhādetacchrūyate
na bho ityādi, tvaṃ nāma sarvātmakamupalabhyamānamapyapalapya śūnyaṃ kartumicchasi, na punarahamupalabhyamānameva sarvarūpaṃ santaṃ kartuṃ śaknomi ityaho sāhasam
upalabdhiḥ sarvalokapratyakṣā kartuṃ śaknomi' ityaho sāhasam

ghaṭo mṛt, mṛdaḥ pṛthivītvam, pṛthivyā dravyatvaṃ druvikāratvāt, dravyasya bhavyatvād bhavyasya bhavitṛtvād bhavituḥ sarvatvāt sarvaṃ hi bhavad bhavati iti sarvasya sarvatvāt sarvarūpo ghaṭa upalabhyate hastavat
sarvo'pyabhinno'sāvarthaḥ, nañsahitaḥ sa eva hetuḥ, ekavat
na hi tābhyāmasti- tvayā'palapyamānā pūrvoktasarvapramāṇavirodhitāṃ te vacasaḥ sampādayati
tasmādayukto bhavato'bhiprāya iti grantho gatārthatvānna vivriyate

ghaṭo mṛt, mṛdaḥ pṛthivītvam, pṛthivyā dravyatvaṃ druvikāratvāt, dravyasya bhavyatvād bhavyasya bhavitṛtvād bhavituḥ sarvatvāt sarvaṃ hi bhavad bhavati iti sarvasya sarvatvāt sarvarūpo ghaṭa upalabhyate hastavat
sarvo'pyabhinno'sāvarthaḥ, nañsahitaḥ sa eva hetuḥ, ekavat

tad vastu ghaṭākhyaṃ bhavat sarvarūpaṃ bhavati ityetad bhāvayitumāha --ghaṭo mṛt, mṛnmayatvāt mṛttvaṃ ghaṭasya siddham, mṛdaḥ pṛthivītvaṃ tadaṃśatvāt, pṛthivyā dravyatvaṃ druvikāratvāt sattāvikāratvāt, dravyasya bhavyatvāt, bhavyasya bhavitṛtvāt, bhavituḥ sarvatvāt, sarvaṃ hi bhavad bhavati, tacca sadasti bhāva iti ghaṭa-paṭādi sarvaṃ parasparasvarūpam, tasmāt sarvasya sarvatvāt sarvarūpo ghaṭa upalabhyate

kimiva ? hastavat, yathā hasto'ṅgulaparva-sandhi-rekhādisarvarūpa upalabhyate sadekāṅgulādyātmakatvāt tathā ghaṭo'pi sadekātmakapaṭādirūpa upalabhyata eveti na kiñcidetat anyathā tāvannāstyeva ghaṭaḥ iti, anyathā tathāpi ca ghaṭasya sattvādanyathātvāsiddheriti
athocyeta--anyatvaṃ tarhi sādhayāmi bhinna evāsāvartho ghaṭaḥ paṭādibhyo bhinnaprakāratvāt vādi-prativādimativacanavat varṇa-saṃsthāna-prayojanādiprakārabhedadarśanācca nāsiddhirhetoḥ
ato'nyatve siddhe tadupalabdhirapi bhinnaprakāraiveti na syāt sarvasarvarūpopalabdhiriti
etacca na, tulyatvāt, naitaduttaraṃ tulyatvādasya hetorasmatpakṣasādhanatvena
tadbhāvanā --yena prakāreṇaikasyātmalābho ghaṭasya tena prakāreṇāstitvaikatvādinā sarvabhāvānāmapyātmalābho deśa-kālabhedābhimatodrdhva-madhyā-'dhobhāga-nava-yuva-madhya-purāṇādinā
nañsahitaḥ sa eva hetuḥ ātmalābhe bhinnaprakāratvāt iti yastvayoktaḥ ātmalābhe'bhinnaprakāratvāt iti sa vaktavyaḥ

ekavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ, yathaiko ghaṭaḥ paṭo vā bhavannūrdhvādi-navādi-deśa-kālaprakāreṇa bhinna ityabhimato'pyabhinna eva astitvaikatva-ghaṭatvābhedāt evaṃ paṭādiḥ tathā sarvabhāvā abhinnaprakārātmalābhatvāḥ syuḥ
nanu tat sarvasiddhānteṣvapi pratyakṣasiddhamatathā matvā mokṣāya yatyate
yadi hi tad vastūtpadyeta vinaśyed vā tataḥ prāgabhāva-paścādabhāvavad madhye'pyabhāvasvābhāvyānna syādekarūpaṃ tvadiṣṭaśūnyatā vā syāt

mā maṃsthā asiddho heturityata āha --na hi tābhyāmastitvaikatvābhyāṃ ghaṭasyānyatvamasti sa tveka eva ghaṭo yasmāt ghaṭādvā sarvabhedabhājastayorastitvaikatvayoranyatvam na hi iti vartate, sarvān paṭa-kaṭādīn bhedān svagatānūrdhvādi-navādīniva bhajamānād ghaṭādastitvaikatvayoranānātvam
tataḥ kim ? tatastadananyatve ghaṭāstitvaikatvānanyatve'bhihitanyāyena siddhe sarve bhāvāḥ paṭādayo'pi tato'nanye, tadastitvaikatvābhyāmanarthāntaratvāt, ghaṭavadityuktatvāt
ata āha --teṣāmapi ghaṭātmakatvaṃ paṭādīnāṃ tadanarthāntaratvāt ghaṭāstitvaikatvānarthāntaratvāt ghaṭasvātmavaditi bhāvitārtho'yamatītārthopasaṃhāraḥ

itthaṃ sarvamekaṃ sarvātmakam iti bruvataste pratyakṣadṛṣṭaṃ bhedenā'śanāyitabhuktyanantarā tṛptirbubhukṣāvirodhinī tadanantarabhāvi ca sukhaṃ duḥkhavirodhītyevamādi virudhyate, na hi pratyakṣaviruddhaṃ pratijñātuṃ yogyamiti
atra brūmaḥ --nanu tat sarvasiddhānteṣvapi pratyakṣasiddhamatathā matvā mokṣāya yatyate iti

nanu viṣayasukhānāmatathātvāt duḥkhapratīkāramātratvāt duḥkhasanmiśratvāt duḥkhabhūyiṣṭhatvāt anātyantikatvācca duḥkhatvameva, tṛpterapi gṛddhyabhilāṣajananahetutvādatṛptitvameveti matvā nirābādhamaparādhīnamātyantikamaikāntikaṃ viṣayasukhaviparītaṃ kathaṃ nāma muktisukhaṃ nirdvandvaṃ prāpnuyāma iti śāstraprāmāṇyāt sarvasiddhāntaprasiddhapravṛttitvānna tvayā punaranyā vimatiḥ kāryeti saṃyukterapi sarvabhāvāḥ santīti grāhyāḥ

yadi hi ityādi, yadi hi tad vastūtpadyeta utpannatvācca vinaśyedevetyutpadyeta vinaśyed vā, tataḥ kim ? tataḥ prāgabhāva utpatteḥ, paścādabhāvo, vināśāt, tadvad madhye'pyabhāvasvābhāvyānna syādekarūpamiti bhedavadvā syāt tvadiṣṭaśūnyatā vā na tu kasyacid vastuna ādiranto vāsti vastutvātyāgāt śivakādikapālādighaṭamṛdvat pratyakṣamevānādyanantatvāt
ato'sau tathāvasthita eka eva bhāvo nirbhedaḥ, bhedāsambhavāt
kiṃ na khapuṣpādadravyādervārabhyate ? syāt, vāśabdād yattvayā tarkyate tasyopapattiḥ sambhāvyetotpatti-vināśasadbhāve
kiṃ tarhi ? na tu kasyacid vastuna ādiḥ utpattiḥ antaḥ vināśo vāsti
kasmāt ? vastutvātyāgāt, na hi vastu svarūpaṃ vastutvaṃ tyajati

kimiva ? śivakādi-kapālādighaṭa-mṛdvat, yathā hi ghaṭaḥ śivakastūpaka-cchatraka-kuśūla-ghaṭāvasthāsu bhedābhimatāsu mṛttvābhedād mṛdeva, kapāla-śarkarikā-dhūli-tuṭi-paramāṇuṣvapi mṛttattvād mṛdevādyantarahitā, tathānyadapi vijñānādi vastutvātyāgāditi nāstyutpādaḥ, tadabhāvād vināśābhāvaḥ
na tu kasyacid vastuna ādiranto vāsti vastutvātyāgāt śivakādikapālādighaṭamṛdvat pratyakṣamevānādyanantatvāt
ato'sau tathāvasthita eka eva bhāvo nirbhedaḥ, bhedāsambhavāt
tadupasaṃharati --ato'sau tathāvasthita eka eva bhāvo nirbheda iti, bhedāsambhavāt bhedasambhavakāraṇābhāvāt
taddarśayati vaidharmyeṇa--utpāda-vināśābhyāṃ hi bhedaḥ sambhāvyeta, sa tūktavidhinānādyanantatvānna sambhavatīti
nanūktaṃ dravyāṇi dravyāntaramārabhante pṛthivyādiparamāṇudravyāṇi svataḥ svātmani dve bahūni vā parasparasaṃyogāpekṣāṇi ārabhante kāryadravyamanyat
guṇāśca ārambhakacaturvidhadravyasamavetāstairārabdhe kāryadravye niyamata eva svataḥ parātmani guṇāntaramārabhante
ityādinā ārambhavacanenāniṣṭhitaṃ prāk, paścādārambhāt kriyā, kriyāto niṣṭhetyaniṣṭhitam
tatra yadi niṣṭhitaṃ syād niṣṭhitatvānnā''rabhyeta niṣpannaghaṭavaditi
idamatra bodhyam- dravyāṇi dravyāntaramārabhante guṇāśca guṇāntaramvai॰ sū॰ 1
aniṣṭhitatvādasat khapuṣpavat, asattvāt tadvad nārabhyate nārabhate
itaro ghaṭavaditi vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ, tadrūpaśaktivivartamātraṃ tvetat sarvam bhāvaikyāt
athaivamapi vastuno'vasthānaṃ neṣyate tato'nārabdhāni tāni dravyāntarāṇi, aniṣṭhitatvāt, khapuṣpavat
sa kiṃ nityo'nityaḥ yadi nityaḥ sarvavastunityatā, ādisvarūpatvāt tannityatvācca
kriyamāṇaniṣṭhitayoścā- yathā ghaṭo mṛdrūpāditvena niṣṭhita eva sannākārāntaravyaktirūpeṇārabhyate pṛthubudhnorddhagrīvādinā na tathārabhyeteti
tadvyaktiḥ--kiṃ na khapuṣpādadravyādervārabhyate ? iti dravya-guṇa-karmādibhedavadvastuviparītat kutaścidanārambhād niṣṭhitādevotpattirabhivyaktirārambhaḥ
athaivamapi vastuno'vasthānaṃ neṣyate tato'nārabdhāni tāni dravyāntarāṇi, aniṣṭhitatvāt, khapuṣpavat
sa kiṃ nityo'nityaḥ yadi nityaḥ sarvavastunityatā, ādisvarūpatvāt tannityatvācca
kiṃ kāraṇam ? bhāvaikyāt, ekasyaiva puruṣāderbhāvasya kāraṇamātrasya vijṛmbhitatvāt kāryatvāvasthāmātrabhedena

niṣṭhitameva vastu nāniṣṭhitam, kasmāt ? anārabdhārabdhatvāt anārabdhaṃ kāryābhivyaktirūpeṇa ārabdhakemeva ca kāraṇalīnaśaktyavasthatvena, yaccānārabdhārabdhaṃ tad niṣṭhitameva nāniṣṭhitam, kimiva ? śikyakādivat, yathānārabdhamapi śikyakatvena sūtraṃ śaktatvād niṣṭhitamevamanyadapi vastviti pathā yajñopavītasūtrādidṛṣṭāntairbhāvayitavyam
itthaṃ yuktyā pratipāditamapyavasthānaṃ vastuno neṣyate tataste aniṣṭāpādanamidam --anārabdhāni tāni dravyāntarāṇi ārabdhābhimatānyapi, aniṣṭhitatvāt, khapuṣpavadatyantāsattvādityabhiprāyaḥ
ādirutpattiḥ pratyakṣata eva ghaṭāderdṛśyate, sa ca bhede heturghaṭādervastunaḥ, yadi hyanutpannāvinaṣṭaṃ syāt syādabhinnamiti
atra pṛcchyase --sa kimityādi, sa ādirārambhaḥ sa pratyakṣābhimataḥ kiṃ nityo'nityaḥ ? iti nirdhāryaḥ
kiñcātaḥ ? yadi nityaḥ sarvavastunityatā, sarveṣāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ ca vastūnāmaviśeṣeṇa nityatvameva syāt, ādisvarūpatvāt tannityatvācca
ādernityatvādādereva ca vastutvādārambha evādisaṃjño'sti na kriyā-niṣṭhe staḥ, tayośca kriyamāṇa-niṣṭhayorabhāvāt tathā janayitavyasya tena prakāreṇa ghaṭāditvena utpādyasya bhedasyābhāvaḥ
tayośca dṛṣṭavyabhicāramitaratraikasmin pratyakṣaṃ kathaṃ pramāṇīkariṣyata iti punarapi taddhāniḥ
athādinityatāyāṃ doṣānnirvṛttanityatvamabhyupagacchasi, itthaṃ hi nirvṛttanityatāyāṃ sarvaikyaṃ nāsti pṛthagvibhinnasvarūpatvāt
nanvevamapi nārambho na kriyā iti bhedābhāva eva
athādiranityo'bhyupagamyate tataḥ sa kiṃ jāto'jātaḥ ? yadi jātastasyaivānutpādaḥ, ajātatvāt, nirvṛttaghaṭavadityādiḥ, tatvaduktavadevedaṃ na yujyate
antoktamapi ca tvaduktadoṣāvimokṣānna yujyate pūrvavadityante'pyutpādābhāvaḥ evamanutpādāt sarvabhedaikyasiddhiḥ
ādiḥ pratyakṣata eva bhedaheturdṛśyata iti viśeṣya ādidereva pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇīkṛtaṃ na kriyā-niṣṭhe, tayoḥ pratyakṣayorapi parityāgaśca kṛtaḥ, sa ca pratyakṣavirodhādayuktaḥ

tayoścetyādi, tayośca pratyakṣayoḥ kriyā-niṣṭhayorapramāṇīkaraṇe pratyakṣamapyapramāṇamiti dṛṣṭo vyabhicāraḥ, taddarśanādāderapi pratyakṣasya tadvadevāprāmāṇyāt punarapyādeḥ pratyakṣasya tyāga iti sarvathā tvayaiva pratyakṣamapramāṇīkṛtam

etaddoṣabhayādādinityatvapakṣaṃ tyaktvā nirvṛttanityatvamabhyupagacchasi doṣābhāvaṃ ca yasmānna paraikateti, itthaṃ hi nirvṛttanityatāyāṃ tvayoktaṃ sarvaikyam, tacca nāsti pṛthagvibhinnasvarūpatvāditi
yadi nityaniṣṭhitameva vastu tato nārambho'sti na kriyā ityabhyupagatatvāt kuto bheda ārambhaḥ kriyā labhyate ? iti bhedābhāva evāsmadiṣṭaḥ prasaktaḥ

etaddoṣabhayādāderanityatābhyupagamyate cet tvayā tata itthaṃ paryanuyojyo'si— sa kimādirjāto'jātaḥ ? ityādi tvatparyanuyogavadeva triṣvapi vikalpeṣu tvaduktadoṣavaddoṣā iti diśaṃ darśayati --yadi jātaḥ tasyaivānutpādaḥ, ajātatvāt, nirvṛttaghaṭavadityādiriti prathamavikalpamuktvā śeṣaṃ granthamatidiśati --tatvaduktavadevedaṃ na yujyate ityajātajātājātavikalpayorapi tvaduktā eva doṣā ityutpādābhāvaḥ

antoktamapi cetyādi, ante'pyutpādābhāvo vinaṣṭā-'vinaṣṭa-vinaṣṭāvinaṣṭavikalpeṣu tvaduktadoṣāvimokṣāt yāvadathocyeta--antaḥ pratyakṣa eva bhedaheturdṛśyata iti asmin pūrvapakṣe sa kiṃ nityo' sāmagrīdarśanādapi sarvāstitvasiddhiḥ
sāmagrī aśeṣabhāvānāṃ bhāvāntaraṃ bhāvāntaraṃ prati vṛttiḥ
etatsaṃvādena ghaṭapaṭādīti dṛśyate saṃjñā yataḥ pravartate cetanācetanaṃ jagat
yadi sāmagryaśeṣatā sarvasya sarvatra vṛttestileṣu tailavat sikatāsvapi tailaṃ syāt

nitya ityādi sa eva paryanuyogaḥ, viśeṣastu atra antapratyakṣapramāṇīkaraṇācca ārambha-kriyamāṇapratyakṣadvayaparityāgaḥ, tayośca dṛṣṭavyabhicāramitaratraikasmin pratyakṣaṃ kathaṃ pramāṇīkariṣyate ? iti punarapi taddhāniriti vācya ityatideśaphalam --evamanutpādāt sarvabhedaikyasiddhiḥ
sāmagrī aśeṣabhāvānāṃ bhāvāntaraṃ bhāvāntaraṃ prati vṛttiḥ
etatsaṃvādena ghaṭapaṭādīti dṛśyate saṃjñā yataḥ pravartate cetanācetanaṃ jagat
yadi sāmagryaśeṣatā sarvasya sarvatra vṛttestileṣu tailavat sikatāsvapi tailaṃ syāt
tathā ca tena prakāreṇotpatti-vināśābhāvādiproktakāraṇatayā tadevaikaṃ sarvātmakaṃ svaṃ paramubhayaṃ cetyetamarthaṃ sampādayati sāmagrī svāvayavātmakatvāt tasyāḥ
kiṃlakṣaṇā sāmagrī ? iti cet, ucyate --sāmagrī aśeṣabhāvānāṃ bhāvāntaraṃ bhāvāntaraṃ prati vṛttiḥ ekaikasminnabhinnaikātmakavastubhedamātre bhāve bhedāntarasyaikaikasya vṛttiryā sā sāmagrī ityucyate

taddarśayati --yathā pṛthivyādisāmagryā ityādi, pṛthivyudaka-vahni-pavana-gaganā-''tmādisarvasamūhātmakaḥ karpāsaḥ tadrūpādayaḥ, tatsamūho'ṇuḥ, aṇusamūhāḥ pakṣmāṇi, tatsamūhāstantavaḥ, tatsamūhaḥ paṭa iti taṃ tamarthaṃ prati sāmagrī pṛthivyapyudakādi-tadrūpādi-paṭādisamūhātmikā vastuno'nekaśaktyātmakasyaikasya vyaktā-'vyaktaśaktyapekṣatvāt sarvasarvātmakatvāt sāmagryāmevaṃ darśanam

etena sarvasarvātmakaikavastubhedasāmagrīdarśanatvena saṃvādi rūpādi pṛthivyādi parasparasāmagrī ghaṭa-paṭādīti dṛśyate saṃjñā yatetaḥ pravartate cetanācetanaṃ jagat yathā vidhividhinayabhaṅge prāg vyākhyātam
yadyaśeṣaṃ svabhedasāmagrīmātraṃ sarvasya sarvatra vṛtteryathā tileṣu tailaṃ sat tathā sikatāsvapi tailaṃ syāt tatrābhāvavat tileṣvapyabhāva eva syāt, na tu bhavati
nanu yathā tileṣvapyavyaktaṃ tailaṃ nopalabhyate tathā sikatāsvapyanabhivyaktaṃ tailaṃ nopalabhyate sikatānāmeva tathā tathā viparivṛtteḥ sikatānāmabhāve tilamūlādyabhāvāt
tadantarasya sarvasya tadu sarvasyāsya bāhyataḥ || śukla yaju॰ vā॰ saṃ॰ 40 | 5

ko vā bravīti--sikatāsu nāsti tailaṃ tileṣvevāstīti ? kintu yathā tileṣvapyavyaktaṃ svābhivyaktyupāyādyaṃtadyantrapīḍanādermarṛte nopalabhyate carvaṇādikriyāsu kṣīravadāsvādyamānakṛttilānāṃ mūlāṅkurādyavasthāsu ca tathā sikatāsvapyanabhivyaktaṃ tailaṃ nopalabhyate sikatābhūpradeśoptatilabījasyāṅkura-mūla-parṇādiprabhave sikatānāmeva tathā tathā viparivṛtteḥ sikatānāmabhāve tilamūlādyabhāvāt sikatāsveva tailamasti tadvadudakādidravyeṣu samāsadaṇḍakokteṣu dravyeṣvasti tailaṃ yāvadbhāvamanyasyātmanīti tilatayotpannajīvadravyasyāpi tailavattvāt vyaktāvyaktarūpeṇa sarvasya sarvatra bhāvāt samānametat
tathā sadā darśanāt, sarvadā bhāvasya bhāgāntarādarśane'pi darśanameva

kasmāt ? saṃsiddhyādihetubhiḥ sampāditasarvātmakaikavastutvāt prākpaścāditaretara-deśa-pramāṇa-sāmarthya-saṃyogātyantābhāvānāṃ pratipakṣabhūtā bhāvā evātyantābhūtābhimatavandhyāputrāntā ityuktatvādatyantasatyāste santorthyā'rthāḥ adarśanād dṛṣṭyaṣṭiśaktivaikalyādadṛśyamānabhāgāntarā asanta iti kalpyeran na paramārthato'santo na vā na dṛśyante, yasmāt tadapi nāstyevādarśanam, kasmānnāsti ? yasmād bhāvitaṃ sāmagrīdarśanahetau ekabhavanātmakam iti, tadvad bhāvitavadekabhavanātmakatvāt atītanyāyabhāvitasarvātmakabhavanātmakatvāt, nirvibhāgasya hi vastunaḥ para-madhyabhāgāḥ śaktibhedāt kalpitā api vastvabhedāt tadeva te, bhāgasya dṛśyatvāt tato'pṛthaktvād bhāgāntarāṇāmapi darśanameva
nirvibhāgameva hi sadvastu, vibhāgenekṣaṇaṃ bhrāntiḥ ityuktam
tadejati tannaijati ityādi ṛgdvayaṃ tatraiva vyākhyātatvānna vivriyate
nyāyaṃ tu saprabhedaṃ smāraṇārthamatidiśati --bhāvitānekārthadravyārtha puruṣa evedaṃ sarva yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam
yaḥ punarbhedaḥ so'satyeva bhede bhedābhimānaḥ tasyābhinnasya kramābhivyakteḥ ekadravyasvatattvarūpādivat
bhedavaditi dravyārthanayeṣu ṣaṭsu vidhyādibhedeṣvādyeṣu yathā bhāvitaṃ prāk yathālokagrāhameva vastu ityādiṣu sa evāśeṣo grantho'trāvatārayitavyaḥ
atra ṛgdvayam ityuktam, tatra tadejati ityādi prathamā ṛk, dvitīyā kā ṛgatra vivakṣiteti sphuṭaṃ na jñāyate, tathāpi puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam ityādi puruṣasūktaṃ tvatra vivakṣitaṃ bhavediti bhāti
puruṣa evedaṃ sarva yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam
yaḥ punarbhedaḥ so'satyeva bhede bhedābhimānaḥ tasyābhinnasya kramābhivyakteḥ ekadravyasvatattvarūpādivat

ya punarbhedo ghaṭaḥ paṭa ityādiḥ so'satyeva bhede bhedābhimānaḥ, kasmāt ? tasyābhinnasya vastunaḥ kramābhivyakteḥ, krameṇa hi śaktimataḥ śaktimātrā abhivyajyamānā bhedā ivābhāsante puruṣagrahaṇaśaktyapekṣayā, na tu paramārthato bhedo'sti

kimiva ? ekadravyasvatattvarūpādivat, yathaikameva ghaṭākhyaṃ vastu cakṣurādigrahaṇāpadeśaviśiṣṭaṃ rūpādivyapadeśabhāg bhavati yathā cakṣuṣā gṛhyamāṇaṃ rūpam jihvayā rasaḥ ghrāṇena gandhaḥ śrotreṇa śabdaḥ tvacā sparśa iti tathā sarvasyābhinnasyaikasyaiva ghaṭa-paṭādibhedābhāvasanamabhimānamātrameveti

tataśca vidhividhinayādārabhya vidhividhyantarānukrameṇa yāvad dravyakriyobhayanayaḥ tāvad dravyārthāṃśāvadhṛteḥ tataḥ paraṃ paryāyārthabhedānāmuttarottaraikāntāyuktatvaprakrāntyā yāvacchūnyavādasyāpi ekāntāyuktatvamadhunā prakrāntam

tadapi kiṃ dravyārthaikāntamataṃ satyaṃ kimasatyam ityasmin sandehe'bhidhīyate --etadapi naivaikāntena yuktamiti prakrāntameva, kathamityata āha --tataścetyādi, tataśca sarvasaṃgrahātmakād vidhervidhinayārādārabhya uttarottaraikāntāyuktatvaprakrāntyā teṣu teṣvarāntareṣu vicāritameva kiṃ puruṣa evāvasthā avasthā eva puruṣaḥ ityādivikalpaparyanuyogopakrameṇeti tadanusmārayati --vidhividhyantarānukrameṇa vidhividherbhedānāṃ puruṣa-niyati-kāla-svabhāva-bhāvānāṃ pūrvapūrvadūṣaṇenottarottaravyavasthānam, tataḥ paraṃ vidhyubhayādīnāmanukramasya paripāṭyāḥ krameṇa vidhinā yāvat ko'vadhirdravyārthadūṣaṇamiti cet, ucyate--yāvad dravya-kriyobhayanayaḥ uktastāvad dravyārthāṃśāvadhṛteḥ tataḥ paraṃ paryāyārthabhedāt, teṣāmapi paryāyārthabhedānāmuttarottaraikāntāyuktatvaprakrāntyā yāvacchūnyavādaḥ, śūnyavādasyāpi ekāntāyuktatvamadhunā vidhividhinayamate prakrāntam

tadekāntāyuktatvakhyāpanā tu ekāntavādānāṃ parasparasaṃyuktatvamāpādya pratyekaśo dviśo yāvad dvādaśaśaḥ saprabhedasteṣāmupari vidhinayaḥ prathamokto draṣṭavyaḥ, tatsmāraṇaṃ yathālokaparigrahameva vastviti vidhiriti, tadutthānādigranthagrahaṇāt samastārasūcanam
tadvyāvartitetyādi, tena vidhinayena vyāvartitayoḥ savikalpayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayoruddhārārthaṃ vidhiniyamavidhiḥ, tatastannivartanārthamubhayobhayanaya ityayamapi kramo yāvat punarayamavadhiriti
yathā cānena śūnyavāde pūrvapakṣatvasambandhastathā ṣaḍvidhena dravyārthena
yathā ca taiḥ sambandhaḥ śūnyavādasya tathā vidhyādīnāṃ dvādaśānāmapi yathārucitamabhisambandhaḥ, śūnyavādasyāpi yena kenacidantaritasya sambandhopapatteḥ
yathā cānenetyādi, yathā cānena vidhividhinayenaikāntāyuktatvavādinā śūnyavāde pūrvapakṣatvasambandhastathaikaikena ṣaḍvidhena dravyārthena

yathā ca tairityādi, yathā ca dravyārthabhedaiḥ pratyekaṃ vidhividhinayenaiva yogaḥ śūnyavādasya tathā śūnyavāde pratiṣiddhe'pi tadanantarameva vidhyādīnāṃ dvādaśānāmapyarāṇāṃ yathārucitamabhisambandhaḥ, śūnyavādasyāpi yena kenacidekādaśānāmanyatamenāntaritasya sambandhopapatteḥ, pratyekaṃ jagatsvabhāvapratipādanasamarthānāṃ vyāpināṃ yena kenaciditi vacanāt yadi vidhyaranayādīnāṃ samanantareṇaikādyantaritena uttareṣāṃ vā pūrveṇa samanantarātītenaikādyantaritātītenetyaviruddhaḥ krameṇotkrameṇotkramakramābhyāṃ vā sambandho'stītyarthaḥ, tasmācca sarvabhāvavyāvartanānantarasambandhād dvādaśānāmanyatamādarādanantarasyānantarasyotthānaṃ tattadaradūṣaṇārthaṃ kramaḥ

tena krameṇa sambandhena sarvakumatapakṣāṇāṃ mithyādṛṣṭipraṇītaśāstrāṇāṃ vyavasthāyāśceṣṭanārthaṃ sarvamidaṃ nayacakraśāstraṃ kramate sarvaikyabhāvāpāditasyādvādānapekṣasarvanayamithyādṛṣṭitvāt tatra tatra ca tattaddaurvihityasya pratipāditatvāt parasparavihiha ?tapakṣāṇāṃ krameṇoktārthānusāreṇa sarveṣāmanyonyadūṣaṇatvāt
evaṃ ca kṛtvāsya śāstrasya nayādīnāṃ cakraṃ nayacakraṃ nayasamūha ityanvarthasaṃjñā syāt, nayānāṃ svaparamatasādhana-dūṣaṇasamarthānāṃ samūhatvāt
nayante'rthān prāpayanti nayanti gamayantīti nayāḥ, vastuno'nekātmakasyānyatamaikātmakaikāntaparigrahātmakā nayā iti, teṣāṃ cakram
nayānāṃ cakram iti pāṭho'tra samīcīno bhāti
yathaitasmānnayādutthānaṃ sarvanayānāmantyādaviruddhaṃ tathā sarvebhyo'pi, sarvasmādekaikasmādapi nayāt sarvanayānāmutthānamaviruddhameva, sarvasya sarveṇa saha virodhitve sati vivādasadbhāvāt
atra yathā caitasmānnayā॰ ityapi pāṭhaḥ saṃbhavet
teṣāṃ dravyārtha-paryāyārthanayau dvau mūlabhedau, tatprabhedāḥ saṃgrahādayaḥ
imā ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! rayaṇappabhā puḍhavī kiṃ sāsatā asāsatā ? gotamā ! sitā sāsatā, sitā asāsatā
se keṇaṭṭheṇaṃ bhaṃte ! evaṃ vuccati--sitā sāsatā, sitā asāsata tti ? gotamā ! davvaṭṭhatāe sāsatā, vaṇṇapajjavehiṃ gaṃdhapajjavehiṃ rasapajjavehiṃ phāsapajjavehiṃ saṃṭhāṇapajjavehiṃ asāsatā

eṣāmaśeṣanayānāṃ kiṃ nibandhanamiti ceducyate --eṣāmaśeṣaśāsanānanayārāṇām, aśeṣaśāsanānyeva jaiminīyopaniṣadādīni nayāḥ arasaṃsthānīyāni syādvādatumbasya nayacakrasya, teṣāmaśeṣaśāsananayārāṇāṃ ca bhagavadarhadvacanamupanibandhanam
teṣāṃ cāśeṣaśāsanārāṇāṃ dravyārtha-paryāyārthanayau dvau samāsato mūlabhedau, tatprabhedāḥ saṃgrahādayaḥ, titthakaravayaṇasaṃgahavisesapatthāramūlavākaraṇī
davvaṭṭhio ya pajjavaṇayo ya sesā vikappā siṃ
davvaṭṭhio ya pajjavaṇayo ya sesā vikappā siṃ || sammati॰ 1 | 3
tatra dravyārthasya vikalpāḥ ṣaṭ saṃkṣepeṇātroktāḥ, paryāyārthasya ṣaṭ
teṣāmupagrāhakaṃ jinavacanaṃ tadyathā --imā ṇaṃ bhaṃte ! rayaṇappabhā puḍhavī kiṃ sāsatā asāsatā iti pṛṣṭe vyākaraṇaṃ siyā sāsatā, sitā asāsatā iti samagrādeśāt
punaḥ se keṇaṭṭheṇaṃ bhaṃte ! etaṃ evaṃ vuccati— sitā sāsatā, sitā asāsatā iti vyākhyāpanārthaḥ praśnaḥ

tasya vikalādeśād vyākaraṇam, ratnaprabhāyāḥ svatattvamubhayātmakaṃ vibhāgena vidadhāti, tadyathā --davvaṭṭhatāe sāsatā, vaṇṇapajjavehiṃ gaṃdhapajjavehiṃ rasa jjavehiṃ phāsapajjavehiṃ saṃṭhāṇapajjavehiṃ asāsata tti
atredamavadheyam--pṛ॰ 3, 450 madhye nayacakre jīvājīvābhigamasūtrata uddhṛte pāṭhe jīvājīvābhigamasūtre ca etaṃ iti padaṃ nopalabhyate
ato'tra bhaṃte evaṃ vuccati iti pāṭha eva samīcīno bhāti

syādekaḥ syādekānekaḥ syādanekaḥ, syāt kāraṇaṃ syāt kāraṇakārye syāt kāryam, syāt sarvagataṃ syāt sarvagatāsarvagataṃ syādasarvagatam, vidhi-vidhiniyamaniyamasvabhāvatvāt vidhyādidvādaśātmakatvāt, ghaṭavaditi bhāvitameva nayacakraśāstreṇānena

tatra syādeka iti catvāro vikalpāḥ saṅkṣipya pakṣīkṛtāḥ, syādekāneka ityubhayavikalpāḥ, syādaneka iti niyamavikalpāḥ

eteṣāmuktānāṃ vidhyādinayānāṃ parasparabhinnaprasthānānāṃ sarvaśāstramatānuvṛttyā saṃhṛtyoktānāṃ sadasatpakṣadvayatayā dravyārtha-paryāyārthadvitvānativartināṃ tayoranyatarasyaikāntasya śāstrasya prabandhaḥ puruṣaparamparayā''gamāvyavacchedaparamparayā sadeva, asadeva, nityameva, anityameva ityādirvighaṭitārtha iti pakṣārthaḥ

śāstravacanaṃ sāṅkhyādīnāṃ dūṣyamāṇameva, laukikaghaṭa-bhavatyādiprayogebhyo dṛṣṭāntabhūtebhya utkālapakṣīkāka ?raṇārthaṃ mā bhūd dṛṣṭānta-dārṣṭāntikayorapraviveka iti prastutavastuvicchedādaparamā ?rthatvāditi hetuḥ, prastutaṃ vastu duḥkhavimokṣoddeśasādhyasādhanasambandhavidhānaṃ pramāṇameva saṃsiddhinirūpaṇaṃ ca, tadvicchedo vyāghātaḥ vighno'nyathābhāvaḥ tadanirvāhaḥ, mahāsaraḥpuṇḍarīkajighṛkṣārthapravṛttāprāptapaṅkanimagnapuruṣavat

sa paramārtho yasya etayordravyaparyāyārthayoranyataraikāntaśāstraprabandhasya sa prastutavastuvicchedaparamārthaḥ svābhipretaviparyayahetuḥ, tadbhāvāt prastutavastuvicchedaparamārthatvād vighaṭitārthaḥ

kimiva ? daśa dāḍimānītyādivākyavat, yathedamasambaddhāvayavārthamekavākyabhāvānāpattervighaṭitārthaṃ prastutavastuvicchedaparamārthatvāt tathoktadravyārthaparyāyārthānyataravikalpaikāntaśāstraprabandho vighaṭitārtha ityeṣo'rtho bhāvita eva atītasamastanayacakraśāstreṇetyevamanena samastena granthenaitadabhihitaṃ vidhiniyamabhaṅgavṛttivyatiriktatvādanarthakavacovat jainādanyacchāsanamanṛtam, jainameva śāsanaṃ satyaṃ vidhiniyamabhaṅgavṛttyātmakatvād bhavativad ghaṭavadveti, ekameva vā sādhanaṃ tat sādharmya-vaidharmyābhyāṃ sarvaikāntavādidūṣaṇāyānekāntavādipakṣasādhanāya ca prabhavatīti yathāpratijñaṃ vyākhyātam
evaṃ ca vṛttivacanamaśeṣabhaṅgaikavākyatāyāmeva pratibhaṅgamapi vṛttiriti khyāpanārtham
syādvādatumbapratibaddhasarvanayabhaṅgātmikaikaiva vṛttiḥ satyā, ratnāvalīvat, anyathā vṛttyabhāva eva

sarvanayātmakaikavṛttijainasatyatvasādhanapravṛttyaivārthāpattyāśeṣaśāsanāsādhutvapratipādanaṃ kṛtam, vidhyādinayānāmekabhāve sarvabhāvāt ekābhāve sarvābhāvāt, varṣaṇābhidhānameghābhyunnativacanavat pratijñādāvitarabhaṅgārthāvyabhicārāt, tathāhi--ayameva prayogārthaḥ, eka
tadbhāvanārthamāha --evaṃ ca kṛtvā vidhiniyamabhaṅgavyatiriktatvāditi siddhe vṛttivacanamaśeṣabhaṅgaikavākyatāyāmeva pratibhaṅgamapi vṛttiriti vyākhyāpanārtham

kimuktaṃ bhavati ? syādvādatumbapratibaddhasarvanayabhaṅgātmatmikaikaiva vṛttiḥ satyā ratnāvalīvat, yathā prativiśiṣṭajāti-varṇa-cchāyā-sāra-śuddhi-prabhāvā-'rtha-saṃsthānādiguṇagaṇopetamaṇigaṇasamūhātmikaikaiva ratnāvalītyucyate yathāsthānavinyāsaratnā, na pratyekam, tathā vidhyādinayārāṇāmapi tumbapratibaddhāravṛttivat syādvādapratibaddhaikāntanayavṛttiḥ, anyathā vṛttyabhāva eveti ca cakradṛṣṭāntasādharmyād nayacakraśāstrayathārthanāmatvādeva dṛṣṭāntāntarapratipādanena nārtho vā, tathaiva ca sarvaikāntaprakrama iti, evaṃ ca kṛtvā sarveṣāmekāntanayānāmavṛttirevāsatyatvāditi prakrāntameva tatra tatra

etacca sarvanayātmakaikavṛttijainasatyatvasādhanapravṛttyaivārthāpattyā śeṣaśāsanāsādhutvapratipādanaṃ kṛtam, tadasādhutvapratipādanena ca jainasatyatvapratipādanaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati anyonyāvinābhāvād jainaśāsanasatyatvetaraśāsanāsatyatvasādhanayorekasya sādhanasya sādharmya-vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntābhyāmanvaya-vyatirekapradarśanātmakābhyāmarthadvayapratipādanād vidhyādinayānāmekabhāve sarvabhāvāt parasparāpekṣatvādekābhāve sarvābhāvāditi
atra vṛttiriti khyāpanārtham iti samīcīnaṃ bhāti
atra ॰bhāve sarvabhāvāt iti ॰bhāve vā sarvabhāvāt iti pāṭho vā samīcīno bhāti

yathā vṛṣṭirmeghonnamanamantareṇa na sambhavatītyavinābhāvāducyate tathā vidhyādīnāmekasminnapyukte śeṣanayā apyuktā eva anyonyāvinābhāvāt pratijñādāvitarabhaṅgārthāvyabhicārāditi yathaikasyāṃ nityapratijñāyāmanityobhayāvaktavyādipratijñāvaśyaṃbhāvitā tathā tatsādhanadharmāṇāṃ hetūnāṃ tadanvaya-vyatirekapradarśanasādharmya-vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntānāṃ cārthāvyabhicārād dvādaśānāmabhidhānaṃ kṛtameva bhavatyarthataḥ, tato niḥśaṅkamekasminnapi naye vivakṣite śeṣanayāvinābhāvāt syācchabdādiviśeṣitānekāntasādhanaprakriyaiva sādhīyasīti prāptam, ata āha— tathāhi--ayameva prayogārtho yo'smābhirupasaṃhṛtya śāstrapiṇḍārthatvenokto vidhividhyādīti, eka eva eva cāyaṃ hetuḥ
